9: Veribbi abba bahadeh vehava tain chad gavra abbatrayehu amar ribbi abba niftach pitchin deorayeta deha shaata veiddana hu leittakkana vearchan

Deha esha umaya verucha af al gav deinnun telat yesodin illain kulhu talyan vela itgeli avidta dilhon ad deara gale lon keden ityeda umnuta dechal chad minnayehu

Vei tema ha beoma telitaa hava dichtiv tadshe haaretz deshe uchtiv vattotze haaretz ella hay af al gav dichtiv beoma telitaa reviaa hava veitkelil beoma telitaa lemeheve chad bela piruda ulvatar yoma reviaa itgeli avidteh leappaka omana leumanuteh dechal chad vechad begin deoma reviaa ihu ragla reviaa dekkurseya illaa
Vechal avidtayehu dechulhu ben yomin kadmain uven yomin batrain hau talyan beoma deshabbatta hada hu dichtiv vayechal elohim bayyom hashshevii da shabbat veda hu ragla reviaa dekkurseya
Vei tema i hachi mahu et shabbetotay tishmoru teren ella shabbat demaale shabbeta veshabbatta deoma mammash let lon piruda

Amar hahu tayea dehava tain batrayehu umahu umikdashi tirau amar leh da kiddusha deshabbat amar leh umahu kiddusha deshabbat amar leh da kiddusha deitmashshecha milleela amar leh i hachi avedat leshabbat delav ihu kodesh ella kiddusha desharya aloy milleela amar ribbi abba vehachi hu vekarata lashshabbat ong likdosh Adonai mechubbad idkar shabbat lechud ukdosh Adonai lechud amar leh i hachi man kedosh Adonai amar leh kedusha denachata milleela vesharya aleh amar leh i kedusha deitmashshecha milleela ikre mechubbad itchazze deshabbat lav ihu mechubbad uchtiv vechibbadto amar ribbi elazar leribbi abba anach lehay gavra demilla dechachmeta it beh deanan la yedana vah amru leh ema ante
Patach veamar et shabbetotay et leasgaa techum shabbat deihu teren alfin ammin lechal sitra uvgin kach asge et shabbetotay shabbat illaa veshabbat tattaa deinnun teren kelilan kechada ustimin kechada

Ishtaar shabbat achora dela idkar vehava bechissufa amra kammeh mare dealma miyyoma deavdat li shabbat itkarena veoma lav ihu bela lelya amar lah beratti shabbat ante veshabbat karena lach aval ha ana meatter lach beitra illaa yattir aavar keroza veamar mikdashi tirau veda shabbat demaale shabbatta deihi yira vesharya vah yira uman ihu dekudsha berich hu achlil veamar ani Adonai veana shemana meabba deamar hachi vedayyek et leasgaa techum shabbat shabbetotay da iggula veribbua dilgo veinnun teren ulkovel innun teren it tere kedushate deit lanu leadkara chad vayechullu vechad kadosh vayechullu it beh telatin vechamesh tevin uvikdusha deanan mekaddeshin telatin vechamesh tevin vesalik kolla leshivin shemahan dekudsha berich hu uchneset yisrael itattar behu

Patach ribbi elazar veamar ma rav tuvcha asher tzafanta lireecha vegv kamma hu tava illaa veyakkira dezammin kudsha berich hu lemebad gabbe beni nesha leinnun zakkain illain dachale cheta demishtaddele beorayeta kad alin lehahu alma tuvcha la ketiv ela rav tuvcha uman ihu zecher rav tuvcha yabbiu veda ihu innuga dechayyin denagdin mealma deate legabbe chay almin deihu zecher rav tuvcha vadday ihu verav tuv levet yisrael vegv
Tu ma rav tuvcha hacha aglif raza dechachmeta vechal razin itkelilu hacha ma kema deitmar rav da ilana rav vetakkif begin deit ilana achora zuta minneh veda hu rav veail leh berum rekiin
Tuvcha da or deitbere beoma kadmaa asher tzafanta lireecha begin deganiz leh letzaddikayya behahu alma paalta da gan eden illaa dichtiv machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai veda hu paalta lachosim bach
Neged bene adam da gan eden diltatta lego metivta dirkia behahu gan eden dilela ufarche veistachyan betalle nahare afarsemona dachya venachate vesharan letatta
Ulzimnin itchazun neged bene adam lemebad lon nissin kemalachin illain kegavena dechazena hashta nehiru devutzina illaa vela zachina leistakkala ulminda razin dechachmata yattir

13: Chade ribbi shimon amar lon vadday archa denissin veatin illain ka avartun deana damichna hashta vechamena lechu velivnayahu ben yehoyada deka meshadder lechu teren itrin al yeda dechad sava leaattera lechu vadday bearcha da kudsha berich hu hava tu dachamena anpayechu meshanyan amar ribbi yose yaot amartun dechacham adif minnavi ata ribbi elazar veshavi reshe ben birkoy deavoy vesach ovada

26: Deitachadat behu keneset yisrael gevura diltatta veda batraa denatla lon veitkelelat minnehon

Pikkuda arbesar lenatra yoma deshabbatta deihu yoma denayecha mikkal ovade bereshit hacha kelilan teren pikkudin chad netira deom hashshabbat vechad lekadsha hahu yoma bekiddusheh lenatra yoma deshabbatta kema deadkarna veatarna alayehu deihu yoma denayecha lealmin vechal avidan beh ishtachlelu veitavidu ad deitkaddash yoma

Kevan deitkaddash yoma ishtaar beria deruchin dela itbere lon gufa vechi la hava yada kudsha berich hu leakava lekaddesha yoma ad deyitberun gufin lehani ruchin ela ilana dedaat tov vera atar hahu sitra achora dera uvaa leittakkefa bealma veitparshu kamma ruchin bechamma zayenin leittakkefa bealma begufin

Kevan dechama kudsha berich hu kach atar miggo ilana dechayye neshiva derucha uvatash beilana achora veatar sitra achora detov veitkaddash yoma deha beriu degufin veitaru deruchin besitra detov ihu behay lelya vela besitra achora

Veilmale akdim sitra achora behay lelya ad dela yakdim sitra detov la yachil alma lemekam kammayehu afilu riga chada aval asvata akdim kudsha berich hu dedalig kammeh kiddusha deoma veakdim kamme sitra achora veitkeyyam alma uma dechashiv sitra achora leitbene bealma leittakkefa itbene behay lelya sitra detov veittakkaf veitbenun gufin veruchin kaddishin behay lelya missitra detov uvgin kach onatan dechakkimin deyade da mishshabbat
27: Deha keden chamat da sitra achora dechamma deihi chashivat lemebad avide sitra dikdusha azla umshatteta bechamma chayyalin vesitrin dilah vechamat kal innun deka meshamshe arsayehu begilluya degufehon linhora devutzina vechal innun benin denafkin mittamman hau nichfin desharu alayehu ruchin mehahu sitra achora veinnun ruchin artilain dechayyavaya deikrun mazzikin veshariat behu lilit uktilat lon

Kevan deitkaddash yoma veshalta kedusha al alma hahu sitra achora azirat garmah veittamrat kal lelya deshabbatta veoma deshabbatta bar min asimon vechal kat dileh deazle al sheragge bitmiru lemechome al gilluye deshimmusha ulvatar ittammerun go nukva dithoma rabba kevan denafak shabbatta kamma chayyalin umashshiryan parchin umshattetin bealma veal da itkan shir shel pegaim dela yishletun al amma kaddisha

Lean atar meshattete behahu lelya kad nafke bivhilu vechashvin leshalletaa bealma al amma kaddisha vechaman lon bitzlota veamrin shirata da uvsheruta mavdele bitzlota umavdele al hakkos parche mittamman veazle umshatte umatan lego madbera rachamana leshezvan minnayehu umisitran bisha

Amru rabbotenu telata innun garmin bisha legarmayehu chad man delayyit garmeh tinyana man dezarak nahama o perurin deit behu kazzayit telitaa man deokid sheragga bemifka deshabbatta ad la matu yisrael lekiddusha desidra degarim lenura degehinnom leadlaka behay nura ad la mata zimnayehu

Dechad duchta it baggihinnam leinnun deka mechallele shabbatot veinnun daanushin bagehinnom laytin leh lehahu deokid sheragga ad la mata zimneh veamri leh hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver vegv tzanof yitznafcha tzenefa kaddur el eretz rachavat yadayim

Begin delav yaot hu leadlaka nura kad nafik shabbatta ad demavdele yisrael bitzlota umavdele al kassa begin dead hahu zimna shabbat hu ukdusha deshabbat shalit alana uvshaata demavdilin al kassa kal innun chayyalin vechal innun mashshiryan deitmenan al yome dechol kal chad vechad yativ leatreh ufulchaneh deitmene aleh

Begin dechad al shabbatta veitkaddash yoma kodesh itar veshallit bealma vechol itadde mishshultanuta dileh ad shaata denafik shabbatta la tayevin leatrayehu veaf al gav denafik shabbatta la tayevin leatrayhu ad zimna deamre yisrael baruch atta Adonai hammavdil ben kodesh lechol keden kodesh istallak umashshiryan deitmaniu al yome dechol mitarin vetayevin leatrayhu kal chad vechad al matreh deitpekad aleh

Veim kal da la shaltin ad dihon nehorin meraza dishraga vechulhon ikrun meore haesh begin umisoda denura atyan kulhu veshaltin al alma tattaa vechal da kad bar nash adlik sheragga ad la shelimu yisrael kiddusha desidra

Aval i ihu mamtin ad deyashlimu kiddusha desidra innun chayyavin degehinnom matzdikin alayehu dina dekudsha berich hu veinnun mekayeme al hahu bar nash kal birchan deka amre tzibbura veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim baruch atta bair uvaruch atta bassade vegv ashre maskil el dal beom raa yemaltehu Adonai beom ra mibbae leh may beom raa yoma deshalta hahi raa lemesav nishmeteh

Ashre maskil el dal da hu shechiv mera leassaa leh mechovoy gabbe kudsha berich hu davar achar da yoma dedina sharya al alma ishteziv minneh kema deittemar beom raa yemaltehu Adonai yoma deitmasar dina lehahu raa leshaltaa al alma
28: Hurmenuta demalka galif gelufe bithiru illaa butzina dekardinuta venafik go satim distimu merisha deen sof kutra begulma naitz beizka la chivar vela ucham vela sumak vela yarok vla gon kelal kad madid meshicha avid gonin leanhara lego bego botzina nafik chad neviu deminneh itztabbeu gonin letatta

Vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed zohar setima distimin batash avira dileh behay nekuda uchden itpashat hay reshit veavid leh hechala likareh ultushbachteh tamman zara zara dekudsha leolada letoalta dealma veraza da zera kodesh matztzavtah

Zohar deminneh kulhu maamarot itberiu beraza deitpashtuta dinkuda dezohar satim da i behay ketiv bara let tevaha dichtiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo
Zohar raza da bereshit kadmaa dechola shemeh shema kaddisha gelifa besitroy elohim gelifa beitra asher hechala tamir veganiz sheriuta deraza dereshit asher rosh denafik mereshit
29: Ittakkan levatar nekuda vehechala kechada keden bereshit kalil reshita illaa bechachmeta levatar itchallaf gavan hahu hechala veikre bayit nekuda illaa ikre rosh kalil da beda beraza bereshit kad ihu kolla kechada bichlala chada ad la have yishshuva beveta kevan deizdera letikkuna deyishshuva keden ikre elohim temira setima

Veet tikkuna dechar venukva veet raza ve-Adonai vecholla chad haaretz da elohim kegavena illaa lemebad perin veibin shema da kelila bitlat duchte umittamman itperash shema da lechamma sitrin ad hacha raza desitra desitrin degaled uvane vekiyyem beorach satim besitra dechad kera

31: Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayehi or mehacha ihu sheruta leashkacha genizin hech itbere alma bifrat dead hacha hava bichlal uvatar ithaddar kelal lemehve kelal ufrat uchlal

Ad hacha hava kolla talya baavira meraza deen sof kevan deitpeshat chela behechala illaa raza deelohim ketiv beh amira vayyomer elohim deha leela la ketiv beh amira bifrat veaf al gav divrishit maamar hu aval la ketiv beh vayyomer

Da vayyomer ihu kayema lemishal ulminda vayyomer chela deitram vearamuta bachashay meraza deen sof beraza demachashava vayyomer elohim hashta olid hahu hechala mimma deitadiat mizzara dekodesh veolid bachashay vehahu deityelad ishtema levar man deolid leh olid bachashay dela ishtema kelal kevan denafak minneh man denafak itavid kol deishtema levar
Yehi or kal ma denafak beraza da nafak yehi al raza deabba veima deihu ulvatar ithaddar linkuda kadmaa lemeheve sheruta leitpashsheta lemilla achora or

Vayehi or or dichvar hava or da raza setima itpashtuta deitpeshat veitbeka meraza desitra deavir illaa setima baka bekadmita veappik chad nekuda setima meraza dileh deha en sof baka meavira dileh vegale hay nekuda kevan dehay itpeshat ma deishtaar ishtechach or mehahu raza dehahu avir setimaa

Kad ishtechach minneh nekuda kadmaa itgeli levatar aleh mate vela mate kevan deitpeshat nafak veihu hu or deishtaar meavir vehayenu or dichvar hava veha kayyama nafak veistallak veitgeniz veishtaar chad nekuda minneh lemehve mate tadir beorach genizu behahi nekuda mate vela mate nahir beh beorach nekuda kadmaa denafak minneh uvgin chach kolla achid da beda nahir behay uvhay

Kad salik kolla salkin veitachadan beh veihu mate veigniz beatar deen sof vecholla chad itavid hahu nekuda deor or ihu veitpeshat unhiru beh sheva atvan dealfa beta vela akrishu velachim hau nafak choshech levatar venafku beh sheva atvan achoran dealfa beta vela akrishu vekayemu lachim nafak rakia deafrish machloket ditren sitrin venafku beh temanya atvan achoranin keden dalgu sheva atvan dehay sitra vesheva dehay sitra veitgelifu kulhu behahu rakia vehau kayeme lachim akresh hahu raki veakrishu atvan veiglimu veittzayeru betziyyurayehu veaglif tamman orayeta leanhara levar
Yehi or dehu el gadol raza denafik meavir kadmaa vayehi raza dechoshech deikre elohim or deitkelil semala beyamina uchden meraza deel have elohim itkelil yamina bismala usmala beyamina
Vayyar elohim et haor ki tov da ammuda deemtzaita ki tov anhir ela vetatta ulchal shear sitrin beraza shema deachid lechal sitrin vayyavdel elohim vegv afrish machloket lemeheve kolla shelim

Vayyikra elohim vegv mahu vayyikra kera vezammin leappaka mehay or shelim dekayema beemtzaita chad nehiru deihu yesoda dealma dealeh kayyamin almin umehahu or shelim ammuda deemtzaita itpeshat yesoda chay almin deihu yom missitra deyamina velachoshech kara layela kera vezammin veappik missitra dechoshech chad nukva sihara deshalta belelya veikre layela raza dedny adon kal haaretz
Al yamina behahu ammuda shelim debbeemtzaita kalil beraza dismala vesalik leela ad nekuda kadmaa venatil veachid
32: Tamman milla ditlat nekudin cholam shuruk chirik zera kodesh deha let zara deizdera bar beraza da veitchabbar kolla beammuda deemtzaita veappik yesoda dealma uvgin kach ikre kol deachid lecholla binhiru detiuvta

Semala lahit betokpa vearach bechulho dargin arach recha umehahu lehitu deesha appik hahi nukva sihara vehahu lehitu hava choshech begin dehava mechoshech utren sitrin illen appiku teren dargin illen chad dechar vechad nukva

Yesoda achid beammuda deemtzaita mehahu tosefet nehora dehava beh dechevan dehahu ammuda deemtzaita ishtelim veavid shelam lechal sitrin keden ittosaf beh nehiru meela umikkal sitrin bechedva decholla beh umehahu tosefet dechedva nafik yesoda dealmin veikre musaf mehacha nafkin kal chayyalin letatta veruchin venishmatin kaddishin beraza tzevaot el elohe haruchot

Layela adon kal haaretz missitra dismala mehahu choshech uvgin dehahu choshech tiuvteh leitkelala beyamina vechalash tukfeh itpeshat minneh hay layela kad share lehitpashta hay layela ad la istayyam hahu choshech al veitkelil beyamina veyamina achid leh veishtaar bigriu hay layela

Uchma dechoshech tiuvteh leitkelala beor hachi layela tiuvteh leitkelala beyyom choshech gara nehoreh uvgin kach appik darga bigriu vela binhiru choshech la nahir ella kad itkelil beor layela denafak minneh la nahir ella kad itkelil beyyom geriu delayela la ishtelim ella bemusaf ma deittosaf hacha gara hacha

Bemusaf hava beh raza dinkuda illaa veraza deammuda deemtzaita bechal sitrin uvgin kach ittosaf beh teren atvan belelya geriu beh illen teren keden kara ketiv vayyikra vegara minneh uchtiv kara layela hacha raza dishma deshivin utren atvan gelifa dechitra illaa

Chachmeta demoshe beha istakkal uvovada divreshit ashgach beovada divrishit hava machloket semala beyamina uvhahu machloket deitar beh semala nafak beh gehinnom veitdevak beh ammuda deemtzaita deihu yom telitay al benayehu veafrish machloket veaskim litren sitrin vegehinnom nachit letatta usmala itkelil beyamina vehava shelama becholla

Kegavena da machloket korach beaharon semala beyamina istakkal moshe beovada divreshit amar li itchazze leafrasha machloket ben yamina lismala ishtaddal leaskama benayehu vela bae semala veatkaf korach betukfeh
Amar vadday gehinnom betukfa demachloket semala itzterich leitdabbeka hu la bae leitdabbeka leela ulitkallela beyamina vadday yechot letatta betukfa derugza dileh

Veal da la bae korach leaskama hay machloket bida demoshe begin dela hava leshem shamayim vela chayish likara dilela veakkechish ovada divreshit kevan dechama moshe dehava makkechish ovada divreshit veitdecha ihu levar keden vayyichar lemoshe meod
Vayyichar lemoshe al deakkechishu leh dela askim hahu machloket meod al deakkechishu ovada divreshit uvcholla akkechish

Tesirin diltatta deithattach behittucha derucha da itztayeru minneh tziyyurin deitlabbeshan bilvusha achora kegon tziyyura divire dachyan shor se chesavim vese izzim ayyal utzvi veyachmur vegv innun devayan leitkelala bilvusha deadam hahu rucha penimaa deinnun sitrin salik behahu shema deitkere vah gufa dileh levusha dehahu shema besar shor shor ihu penimaa dehahu gufa basar dileh levusha vechen kulhu

Kegavena da besitra achora mesaova rucha deitpashshat bishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot nafka missitra dimsaavu lav ihu adam uvgin kach la salik bishma da shema dehahu rucha tame la salik bishma deadam velet beh chulaka gufa dileh levusha dehahu tame basar tame yitma lego besar levusha dileh begin kach beod deshare hahu rucha behahu gufa itkere tame nafak rucha mehahu levusha lav ikre tame vela salik hahu levusha bishma

Tesirin letatta deithattach behittucha derucha da itztayeran minneh tziyyurin deitlabbeshan bilvusha achora kegon tziyyure beire mesaave veorayeta patach behu veze lachem hattame kegon chazir veofe uvire dehahu sitra rucha salik behahu shema gufa levusha dileh vegufa besar chazir ikre chazir lego bisra levusha dileh uvgin kach illen teren sitrin mitparshan illen itkelilu beraza deadam veillen itkelilu beraza detame kal zina azil lezineh veithaddar lezineh

Nehorin illain deka menaharin naharin behahu rekia hashshamayim vechu leitztayera letatta tziyyurin kedeka chaze dichtiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim vegv velimshol bayyom uvallayela shaltanu ditren nehorin da ihu shaltanu kedeka chaze

Maor gadol shaltano bimama maor katan shaltano belelya veraza da mehacha shaltanuta didchura bimama lemanaa veteh deitzterich ulaola beh tarpa umzona kevan deal lelya venukva nakit kolla let shultanu deveta bar benukva deha keden shaltanu dilah dichtiv vattakam beod layela vattitten teref levetah hi velo hu memshelet hayyom didchura memshelet hallayela denukva

Veet hakkochavim kevan denukva pekidat beta veitkenisat levaalah let shultanu leveta ella leulemtan deishtaaran beveta leatkana kal tikkune beta uvatar ithaddar beta leshaltanu didchura bimama kolla kedeka chaze

Vayyaas elohim et shene hamorot da maor veda maor begin kach innun nehorin desalke leela ikrun meore or veinnun nehorin denachatu letatta ikrun meore esh deinnun dargin letatta veshalte kal yomoy dechol veal da kad nafik shabbatta mevarchin al sheraga deha ityehiv lon reshu leshaltaa
Etzbean devar nash innun sitra dedargin verazin dilela veit behu penimain vaachorayim achorayim innun levar veinnun remez letofrin deetzbean uvgin kach it
40: Reshu leistakkala bettofrin bemotzae shabbat deha naharin mehahu sheragga venaharin mehahu esh leshaltaa

Illen itchazyan etzbean lego la it reshu leitchazya behahu sheragga deha milleela naharin veikrun panim penimain veraza da veraita et achoray ufanay lo yerau dela yistakkal bar nash bemotzae shabbat beetzbean lego beshaata deamar bore meore haesh veraita et achoray illen panim dilvar deitremizu betufre ufanay lo yerau illen etzbean lego illen shalte beshabbatta veillen shalte bachol

Uvoma deshabbatta kudsha berich hu shallit bilchodoy beinnun panim penimain al kurse yekareh vechulhu itkelilan beh veshaltanuta dileh ihu uvgin kach achsin nayecha lechal almin veyartin yeruta deoma da amma kaddisha deikrun amma chad beara meore or missitra deyamina deihu or kadmaa dehava beoma kadmaa deveoma deshabbatta naharin innun meore or bilchodayehu veshaltin uminnayehu naharin kulhu letatta

Vechad nafik shabbatta genizin meore or dela itgalyan umore haesh shaltin kal chad vechad al duchtayehu ematay shaltin bemotzae shabbat ad maale yoma deshabbatta veal da itzterichu leitnahara mehahu sheragga bemotzae shabbat

Vehachayyot ratzo vashov dela yachil ena lemishlat behu begin deinnun ratzo vashov chayyot deitgalleyan innun dehahu ofan kaim begavayehu uman ihu da metatron deihu rav veyakkir mishar illen veillaa chamesh mea parse

Chayyot demittamran innun techot teren atvan illain deitkasyan atvan shallitin al illen reticha leillen vehahu temira lechal temirin dela ityedo kelal shallit al kolla verachiv al kolla chayyot deitgalleyan innun letatta techot illen illain demittamran veitnaharan minnayehu venatlin beginayehu

Chayyot illain kulhu kelilan birkia hashshamayim vealayehu ketiv yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim vehau limorot birkia hashshamayim kulhu talyan behahu rekia hashshamayim rakia sheal gabbe hachayyot da hahu dichtiv udmut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach da hahu kadmon Adonai

Deha mittamman ulhala let man deyachil leistakkala ulminda may tama mishshum deihu satim bemachashava umachashava dekudsha berich hu temira setima illaa machashava devar nash bechal alma leitdabbeka ulminda lah millin detalyan bemachashava illaa let man deyachil leitdabbeka lon machashava mammash al achat kamma vekkamma lego min machashava man ihu deavid raaone deha let suchletanu lemishal kal shekken leminda

En sof let beh rishshuma kelal vela talya sheelta beh vela raaona leistakkeluta demachashava kelal miggo setima distima merish nechitu deen sof nehir nehiru dakkik vela yedia satim bistimu kechidduda demachata raza setima demachashava la yedia ad deitpeshat nehiru minneh beatar deit beh reshimin deatvan kulhu mittamman nafkan

Beresh kolla resha vesofa dechal dargin reshimu deitreshim beh dargin kulhu vela ikre ella echad leachazaa deaf al gav deit beh diuknin saggiin lav ihu ela chad vadday ihu at deillain vetattain talyan beh

Reshita dealef temiru deraza demachashava illaa vehahu itpashtu dehahu rakia illaa kolla satim behahu resha begin dechad nafik mehay rakia bediyyukna deraza derisha demachashava nafka behahu emtzaita dealef shit dargin kelilan beh raza dechulhu chayyot temirin illain miggo machashava
Chad nehiru denahir veitgeniz deha nehiru deat divreshit chom hayyom dehava avraham yativ petach haohel deihi pitcha mittatta leela vechom hayyom nahir al hahu pitcha venahara mittamman

Tinyana nehiru deazil leitchashcha leet penot erev raza ditzlota deyitzchak leatkana hay darga dichtiv vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot erev istakkeluta deerev vachashochan kulhu legabbeh behay penot erev veistakkal istechan yaakov behahu memanna deesav
41: Ilen nehiru denahir beasvata raza dichtiv beyaakov vayyizrach lo hashshemesh vegv vadday kad itkelil behahu penot erev mikkan ulhala vehu tzolea al yerecho da ihu netzach yisrael

Al yerecho yerecho ketiv velo yerechav da darga reviaa dela itnabbe bar nash mittamman ad deata shemuel vealeh ketiv vegam netzach yisrael vegv keden itkan dehava chalsha mikkad istakken yaakov avinu bimmanna deesav

Vayyigga bechaf yerecho kad ata legabbe deyaakov netal tukfa mehahu penot erev bedina takkifa veyaakov hava itkelil beh vela yachil leh vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho natal tukfa dedina mittamman begin deyarcha ihu levar miggufa deyaakov gufa hava veguppeh hava kalil beraza ditren dargin beraza deikre adam kevan denatal tukfa levar miggufa miyyad vatteka kaf yerech yaakov

Vela itnabbe bar nash mittamman ad deata shemuel veal da netzach yisrael ketiv beh ki lo adam hu yehoshua itnabbe mehodo shel moshe dichtiv venatatta mehodcha alav hod veda darga chamishaa netzach yarcha semala deyaakov uvgin kach ata david vechalil leh beyamina dichtiv neimot bimincha netzach yemincha la ketiv ella bimincha

May tama itchallash yarcha deyaakov begin deitkarav beh setar mesaava venakit tukfa minneh veitakkev ad shemuel veal da ata leadkara deda ihu yarcha deyisrael dichtiv vegam netzach yisrael veal da kal miloy hau bedina besheruta uvsofa

Vetu kudsha berich hu kalil leh levatar behod ematay levatar demashach malchin veal da shakil ihu kemoshe veaharon ma moshe veaharon bitren sitrin dilela af hu letatta kegavena deinnun teren sitre uman innun netzach vehod kegavena demoshe veaharon dilela vechulhu dargin achidan da beda dichtiv moshe veaharon bechohanav ushmuel bekore shemo deha shit sitrin itkelilu veachidan da beda
Kema deillen achidan moshe veaharon ushmuel uf hachi achidan yaakov moshe veosef yaakov mareh deveta mit yaakov netal moshe beta umanne lah bechayyav yosef al yede deyaakov umoshe hava tzaddik

Yaakov beosef natal beta dichtiv elle toldot yaakov yosef moshe la shimmesh bah ad denatal leh leosef kad nafkat shechinta min galuta la yachil leizdavega bah ella beosef dichtiv vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo ammay ketiv immo ela gufa la izdavag benukva ad deizdavag bahade berit veal da moshe natal leh leosef immeh kevan dehava immeh shimmesh benukva kedeka yeut uvgin kach yaakov moshe veosef kechada azle

Yaakov mit vegufeh aolu leh beara kaddisha yosef mit gufeh la itkabbar beara kaddisha ela garmoy moshe la hay vela hay ammay ella yaakov baalah kadmaa dematronita hava mit yaakov izdavega beh bemoshe uvod dehava moshe behay alma mane lah kedeka yeut veihu hava baalah tinyana

Yaakov ailu leh leara kaddisha gufeh shelim begin deihu gufa yosef garmoy vela gufeh begin degarmin innun chayyalin umashshiryan dilela vechulhu nafke mehahu tzaddik vetzaddik tzevaot ikre may tama begin dechal tzevaot umashshiryan illain minneh nafkin veal da garmoy deinnun tzevaot aolu beara

Moshe hava levar vela al tamman la gufeh vela garmoy ella aolat shechinta beara batar demit moshe veithadderat levaalah kadmaa vadday ihu yaakov mikkan nukva deitnesevat bitren behahu alma ahadderat lekadmaa moshe hava levar kevan devaalah kadmaa hava beara

Moshe zacha bechayyav ma dela zacha beh yaakov yaakov shimmesh bah behahu alma moshe behay alma vei tema digriu demoshe hava lav hachi ela kad nafke yisrael mimmitzrayim missitra deovla hava vechal innun shittin ravrevan mealma illaa hau
42: Uvhahu diukna azlu bemadbera vechad minhon la alu veara ella benehon toladin dilhon kedeka chaze deinnun tikkuna desihara vechal ovade ara tikkuna desihara hava

Moshe shimmesh besihara beod deihu begufa umanne lah liruteh kad itpattar mehay alma salik bisliku illaa berucha kaddisha veithaddar berucha leovla ilaa vetamman itdabbeku beinnun shitin ribbo dehau dileh ma dela hava ken leyaakov dehu ithaddar berucha lego shemitta ma dela hava ken bechayyav kevan deveta achora hava leh

Veara kaddisha betikkuna ittakkanat bechela dilela veal da la itchazun lemehve kulhu kechada innun dealma illaa hau bilchodayehu kulhu berucha veinnun dealma tattaa hau bilchodayehu kulhu begufa vela itchazun lemeheve illen veillen go sihara ela illen go sihara veillen levar lenahara illen miggo illen
Vechulhu dealu beara diukna dekadmae hau vela hau bisliku illaa kavatayehu begin dela yehe dara vela hava mikkadmat dena keinnun kadmae deitchazzeya lehon ziv yekara demarehon appin beappin

Yaakov shimmesh binshoy begufa levatar itdabbak rucha berucha moshe itperash meitteteh veshimmesh kad ihu begufa behahu rucha kaddisha levatar itdabbak rucha berucha illaa temira dilela vechal dargin hau mitdabbekan kulhu kechada rucha demoshe deovla ihu gufeh dishmitta rucha deyaakov leitdabbeka bishmitta gufeh dinshoy hava behay alma

Kal innun nehorin illain bediukna dilhon letatta beara vechulhu talyan birkia hashshamayim hacha raza ditren shemahan kelilan kechada veshichlula dilhon telata veithadderan lechad da lakovel da veihu shema gelifa mechakkeka kelilan behay beraza dimhemnuta

Vayyomer elohim naase adam sod Adonai lireav vegv patach hahu sava desavin veamar shimon shimon man hu deamar vayyomer elohim naase adam may nihu hacha hay elohim adhachi parach hahu sava desavin vela chama leh uchma dishma ribbi shimon dehava kare leh shimon vela ribbi shimon amar lechavroy vadday hay hu kudsha berich hu deittemar beh veattik yomin yativ ha kean ihu shaata lemiftach behay raza devadday hacha it raza dela ityehiv reshu leitgalya uchan mashma dirshuta ityehiv leitgalleya

Patach veamar lemalka dehava leh kamma binyanin lemivne vehava leh umana vehahu umana la hava avad middaam ella mershu demalka kema deatte amer vaehye etzlo amon malka vadday ihu chachma illaa leela veammuda deemtzaita malka letatta elohim umana leela veda ima illaa elohim umana letatta veda shechinta diltatta

Veitteta let lah reshu lemebad middaam bela reshut baalah vechal binyanin dehau beorach atziluta hava amar abba beamira legabbe imma yehe keden uchden umiyyad hava kema deatte amer vayyomer elohim yehi or vayehi or vayyomer hava amar lelohim yehi or mare devinyana ihu omer veumana avid miyyad vehachi kal binyanin beorach atziluta hava amar yehi rakia yehi meorot vecholla itavid miyyad

Kad mata lealma deppiruda deihu olam hannivdalim amar umana lemare binyana naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu amar mare binyana vadday tav hu lemebad leh aval atid hu lemechete kammach begin deihu kesil hada hu dichtiv ben chacham yesammach av uven kesil tugat immo
Ihi amra batar dechoveh talya beimma vela beabba ana baina lemivre leh bediyyukna dili hada hu dichtiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vela baa leishtattafa beh abba
43: Uvfishechem shulcha immechem amar malka leimma vela amarit lach deatid hu lemechote behahu zimna tarich leh vetarich imma immeh uvgin da ketiv ben chacham yesammach av uven kesil tugat immo ben chacham da adam deihu beorach atzilut uven kesil da adam divria

Kamu kulhu chavraya veamru ribbi ribbi vechi it piruda ben abba veimma demissitra deabba ihu beorach atzilut umissitra deima babberia amar lon chavrayya chavrayya lav hachi hu deha adam deatziluta dechar venukva hava missitra deabba veimma veda ihu vayyomer elohim yehi or vayehi or yehi or missitra deabba vayehi or missitra deimma veda ihu adam du partzufin

Aval lehay let beh tzelem udmut ella imma illaa hava leh chad kinnuy desalik lechushban elohim vehahu kinnuy ihu or vechoshech uvgin hahu choshech dehava behahu kinnuy amar abba deatid lemechote leadam deatzilut deihu or levush illaa

Vehay ihu or debbara kudsha berich hu beom rishon dignazo letzaddikayya vehahu choshech deitbere beoma kadmaa lerashshiayya kema deatte amer urshaim bachoshech yiddammu uvgin hahu choshech dehava atid lemechote lehahu or la baa abba leishtattafa beh uvgin da amar naase adam betzalmenu hahu or kidmutenu hahu choshech deihu levusha laor kegavena degufa deihu levusha lenishmeta hada hu dichtiv or uvasar talbisheni chadu kulhu veamru zakkaa chulkana dezachina lemishma millin dela ishtemau ad kean

Patach od ribbi shimon veamar reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi vegv amar chavrayya shimu millin attikin debbaena legallaa batar deityehiv reshu illaa lememar may nihu deamar reu atta ki ani ani hu ella da hu ilat al kal illain hahu deitkere illat haillot illat meillen illot dela yaavid chad meillen illot shum ovada ad denatil reshut mehahu dealeh kema deokimna leela benaase adam

Naase vadday al teren ittemar deamar da lehahu dilela mineh naase vela avid middaam ela birshu vaamira mehahu dilela mineh vehahu dilela minneh la avid middaam ad denatil etza mechavreh aval hahu deitkere illat al kal illot delet leela minneh vela letatta shave leh kema deatte amer veel mi tedamuni veeshve yomar kadosh amar reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi denatil etza minneh kegavena dehahu deamar vayyomer elohim naase adam

Kamu kulhu chavrayya veamru ribbi hav lana reshu lemallala behay atar amru veha la okmat leela deilot haillot amar lechtr naase adam amar lon hau shemain udnayechu ma defumchon memallelan veha la amarit lechu hashta deit deitkere illat haillot velav ihu hahu deitkere illat al kal illot deleillat al kal illot let leh tinyana denatil etza minneh deihu yachid kodam kolla velet leh shuttafa

Uvgin da amar reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi denatil etza minneh dela it leh tinyana vela shuttafa velav chushbena deit echad beshittuf kegon dechar venukva veittemar behon ki echad kerativ aval ihu chad bela chushban vela shittuf uvgin da amar veen elohim immadi kamu kulhu veishtattachu kammeh veamru zakkaa bar nash demareh issettekkam immeh legallaa razin temirin dela hau mitgalleyan lemalachayya kaddishayya

Amar lon chavrayya it lan leashlama kera dechamma razin temirin it behay kera ani amit vaachayye vegv ani amit vaachayye bisfiran achayye missitra deyamina chayye umissitra dismala mota vei la istakkeman tarvayehu beammuda deemtzaita la itkeyyam dina deinnun bemotav telata kechada
44: Istekkamu telata lemebad dina veyete yad deihi peshuta lekabbel shavim deihu veda shechinta itkere yad yamin missitra dechesed yad semol missitra digvura yad missitra deammuda deemtzaita kad bar nash tav bituvta hay yad sheziv leh min dina aval kad dan illat al kal haillot ittemar beh veen miyyadi matztzil
Veod telat zimnin ittemar behay kera ani ani ani deit behon deitremizu bed veit behon vaachayye vaani veen deitremizu beillen shemahan

Veim kal da dehay kera ha ukmuha chavrayya legabbe elohim acherim kema deatte amer reu atta ki ani ani hu da kudsha berich hu ushchinteh deittemar behu ani vaho veen elohim immadi da venachash ani amit vaachayye ani amit bishchinti leman deihu chayyav vaani achayye bah leman deihu zakkay veen miyyadi matzil da yad deihu Adonai veihu vecholla keshot aval ma deittemar leela illat illaa deihu illat al kal haillot vehay raza la itmasar lechal chakkima unvia

Ta chaze kamma illot innun setimin deinnun mitlabbeshin veinnun murkavin bisfiran usfiran merkava legabbayehu deinnun temirin mimmachashavta divne nesha vealayehu ittemar ki gavoha meal gavoha shomer vegv nehorin metzuchtzachin illen al illen veillen dimkabbelin innun chashochin meachoranin dealayehu dimkabbelin minnayehu veillat haillot let nehora kayyama kammeh dechal nehorin mitchashchan kammeh

Davar acher naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu ha ukmuha chavrayya al malache hashsharet deinnun amri hay kera amar lehu batar dehau yadin ma dehava uma deatid lemeheve veinnun hau yadin deatid lemechete ammay bau lemebad leh

Vela od ella deazza vaazael hau mekatrege aleh bezimna deamar shechinta lekudsha berich hu naase adam amru ma adam vattedaehu ma atte bae lemivre adam vattedaehu deatid lemechete kammach beitteta dileh deihi choshech deor ihu dechura vechoshech nukva semala choshech divria behahu zimna shechinta amarat lon behay deattun mekatregin attun atidim leminpal kedichtiv vayyiru bene haelohim et benot haadam ki tovot henna vegv vetau vehon veappil lon shechinta mikkedusha dilhon

Amru chavrayya ribbi ribbi addehachi azza vaazael la hau meshakrin bemillulayehu devadday benukva atid adam lemechete amar lehu hachi amra shechinta attun izdammantun lekatrega kodamay yattir mechela dimroma i attun havetun shappirin meadam beovadayechu yaot lechu lekatrega aleh aval ihu atid lemechete beitteta chada attun binshin saggiin chibbatechon yattir mibbene nesha kema dichtiv vayyiru bene haelohim et benot haadam vegv et bat haadam lo neemar ella et benot haadam velo od ella im adam chav ha akdim leh teshuva leahadara lemareh leatkana bamme dechav

Amru leh chavrayya i hachi ammay kule hay amar ribbi shimon lechavrayya i la dehava hachi devara kudsha berich hu yitzra tava uvisha deinnun or vechoshech la hava zechu vechova leadam divria ella deitberi mittarvayehu uvgin da ree natatti lefancha hayyom et hachayyim vegv amru leh kule hay ammay vela hava shappir dela itbere dela lemechav ulgarma kal ma degarim leela vela hava leh la onesh vela sachar

Amar lon min haddin hava leh lemivreyeh kach begin deorayeta begineh itberiat dichtiv bah onasha lerashshiayya veagra letzaddikayya vela hava agra letzaddikayya veonasha lerashshiayya ella begin adam divria lo tohu beraah leshevet yetzarah amru vadday kean shemana ma dela shemana ad hashta devadday la vera kudsha berich hu milleta delav ihu tzarich
45: Ihu levusha dishchinta vei adam la hava atid lemivre havat shechinta bela chissuya kegavena deani uvgin da kal man dechav keillu afshit lishchinta malbushaha vehay ihu onasha deadam

Vechal man dimkayyem pikkudin deorayeta keillu hu lavish lishchinta bilvushaha uvgin da ukmuha bechissuya detzitzit ki hi chesuto levaddah hi simlato leoro bamme yishkav begaluta veha ukmuha ta chaze choshech ihu uchmu deorayeta or cheveru deorayeta

Veyaakov begin dechama berucha dekudsha dochaka degaluta batraa besof yomayya vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo ufalig amma kaddisha begaluta leg sitrin kema deatte amer vayyasem et hashshefachot veet yaldehen rishona beresha begaluta deedom veet lea viladeha acharonim veet rachel veet yosef achronim uvgin dechama batar ken aniyyuta vetzaara dilhon amar veshavti beshalom el bet avi veamar venatan li lechem leechol uveged lilbosh

75: Gelifan leela vetatta ulistakkala mittamman beraza demarehon uvinnuga dilela

78: Amar rabbi yose man hu tziyya amar leh da hu atar degehinnom kema deatte amer tziyya vetzalmavet veraza da ketiv vechoshech al pene tehom da raza atar degehinnom da hu tziyya atar demalach hammavet kidkaamaran deihu machshich anpayehu divriyyata veda hu atar dechoshech illaa

Kal innun memannan dealma deitmannun leshaltaa mehacha nafik dinhon leshaltaa miggo hahu rucha deitreshim bitlat atvan umehacha maberin kiyyumayehu mealma veitdenu behay nura denagid venafik della itmasar behay hechala begin deitreshimu bitlat atvan hacha hay rucha itkelil behu hahi chevata appik chayyalin umashshiryan delet lehon chushbena
Kal dinin dealma mehay hechala nafke hen letav hen levish bar telat bane chayye umzone dela ityehav reshu beatar da deha behahu nahar illaa dechal nehorin nagdin minneh kayema milla beemtzaita
86: Dehechala da hu atar metakkena lakovel rucha dilela bego rucha da veda salka behu

Teren eser patchin innun lehechala da bechal pitcha ufitcha kal innun sarchin ummannan deinnun machreze leodaa letatta kal innun dinin dizminin lenachata letatta kema deatte amer kare vechayil vechen amar godu ilana vegv

Umiggo karoze illen natle milla kal marehon degaddefin ad deode milla larakia dechamma umittamman kad nafik shimsha nafik milla veitshatya bealma ad demate lehahu chiveya dirkia dechal kochve dirkia gelidu beh deihu beemtzaita dirkia

Veshamin milla venaktin lah innun sarchin ditchot veinnun dimmannan al hahu chiveya umittamman itpashshat lealma veafilu ruchin veshedin veafilu ofe shemaya modae leh bealma karozin tavin vesatmin pitchin la salka rucha berucha ad dechulhu ruchin tattae kulhu chad bahade hay rucha vechulhu itkelilan vealin da beda ad deitavid kolla chad

Bar nash kad ihu beve mareh hacha itdan hen lechayyim hen lammavet chayyin talya leela i itdan hacha lechayyim yahave chayyin milleela vei la la yahavin zakkaa chulakeh man deitdevak bemareh veyeul venafik hacha kida beanpin beara leitgabbara al dina al hay hechala ittemar el emuna veen avel vegv

Hekala chamishaa hechala da hechala divraka zeher deihu rucha demazhir nahir leinnun tatae rucha da ihu kalil ufatach vesagir nahir venatzitz lekkal sitrin minnetzitzo da nahir chad nehora keen argevana nehora da kalil kal gevanin denaharin nehora chivar veucham sumak veyarok itkelilan illen beillen itrekim chivar besumak ucham beyarok levatar chivar beucham veitavid chad chevata merukkama veitkelil bah yarok vesumak deoknaha kidiukna devar nash dechalil kal diuknin

Minah nafku samchin deinnun chevan ravrevan al illen diltatta chad ikre ofan deihu teren begin dechad itchazze hay itnehir achora begaveyh davik da beda al da beda levatar al achora da beda veitchazzun reshin led sitrin dealma vechulhu chad gufa veillen innun dichtiv behu kaasher yihye haofan betoch haofan vechulhu illen keshirin da beda kechezu dechevan illain dela mitparshan lealmin hay chevata dearba gevanin merukkaman achidan illen beillen led sitrin mehacha kad natla chevata da natla litren sitrin
Hay rucha divraka itkelil bitren ruchin rucha da divraka appik chad chevata vechal innun nehorin rucha achora itnehir minneh deikre rucha melahata

Naharin minneh teren nehorin deinnun arba veillen nehorin mithappechin bigvanin vehacha ihu lahat hacherev hammithappechet illen innun nehorin demithappechan shenana decharba veilen kayeme al hechala diltatta begin dehay lahat hacherev kayema al innun nehorin deve dina mehacha kal innun dayanin dedayene dina charba talya al reshayehu milleela

Hay lahat hacherev deillen innun nehorin delistar semala appiku chad chevata achora dekayema al dela kayeme bekiyyumayehu tere mimina utre missemala kad rucha dechevata hay al beillen natzitz minayehu tere nitzotzin melahatan venafke mehay hechala levar umithappeche tadir illen nitzotzin melahatan lezimnin nukve lezimnin guvre lezimnin ruchin lezimnin irin kaddishin
May tama begin dechad itkelil hay chevata bechevata kadmaa miggo tekifu deitkelilan da beda nafka chad nitztzotza melahata tadir dela itdeach lealmin veshata veazla abbatrayehu deinun teren nitzotzin
Vehashta inun guvrin veavdin shelichuta bealma vead la mesayeme mitdaache vehahu nitzotza batash behu
87: Venahir lon veitchaddeshun kemillekadmin veinun nukve veazle veshatan vead la mesayeme mitdaache vehay nitzotza batash behu venahir lon veithadderan kemillekaddemin begin dehahu nitzotza kalil mikkolla kalil mid gevanin uvgin da inun mithappechin lechal hane gavene

Rucha da itkelil berucha achora kidkaamaran veitchazzun teren kechada vela keachoranin kadmain dechad itkelil da beda la itchazze bar chad vehacha itchazzun teren vekayeme bachavivuta kelilan mikkulhu tattae veaf al gav deinnun teren innun chad kad itpeshat rucha berucha veitchazzun bechavivuta kelilan mikkulhu tattae vedda hu raza dichtiv shene shadayich kishne afarim teome tzeviya haroim bashshoshannim

Vechad teren ruchin mitpashtan da beda bechavivuta keden ithaddar hay hechala veikre hechal ahava hechala dirchimuta hechala da kaim tadir bekiyyumeh itgeniz beraza derazin leman deitzterich leitdabbeka beh vehacha ketiv etten et doday lach

Levatar kad naharin teren ruchin deinnun chad nafke kamma chayyalin lechamma sitrin alfin verivvan delet lon shiura minhon ikrun dudaim minhon gefanim minhon rimmonim ad dematu kamma chayalin levar ad hahu kochava deikre nogah vechulhu bachavivu dela mitparshin lealmin behacha ketiv im yitten ish et kal hon beto baahava boz yavuzu lo hacha hishtachavaa ufrisu deyadin leitdabbeka birchimu demareh

Hechala shetitaa hacha hu rucha deikre chut hashshani raza dichtiv kechut hashshani siftotayich hay hechala ikre hekal haratzon hacha rucha deihu raava dechal hane ruchin tattain rahatin avatreh leitdabbeka beh binshika birchimuta

Hay rucha itkelil beshit vekayema beshit itkelil beshit diltatta bahadeh vekayema beshit illain uvgin chach hay rucha appik teresar nehorin kelilan kulhu mittatta umilleela hane teresar nehorin innun chadun lesalka leela ulkabbela kal innun diltatta

Hechala da deihu ratzon raava decholla man dekashar kishrin vesalik lon hacha da hu deappik ratzon meyeya bachavivuta bego hechala da itkenish moshe birchimu denashik neshike rechimuta hay hu hechala demoshe rucha da rucha dirchimuta rucha deyichuda deamshich rechimu lechal sitrin

Veinnun teresar nehorin salkin velahatin minnetzitzu dilhon nafke arba chevan kaddishin rechime deahava illen ikrun chayyot gedolot leitchabbera innun zute leitkelala behu dichtiv chayyot ketannot im gedolot

Illen achidan da beda led sitrin keegoza demitchabbera led sitrin ubbegin kach ikre hechala da ginnat egoz dichtiv el ginnat egoz yaradti may el ginnat egoz begineh deginnat egoz yaradti deihu hechala dirchimu leitdabbeka dechura benukva

Illen arba mitparshan litresar telat telat lechal setar kal innun tattae kelilan behu uvhu kayamin ruchin beruchin nehorin binhorin kulhu illen beillen ad deitavidu chad uchden hay rucha dechalil mikkulhu salka leitattera berucha dilela hahu deikre shamayim vezammin leh leitchabbera bahadeh kevan deitkesharu kulhu diltatta bahadeh amar yishshakeni minneshikot pihu uchden ihu chedva leitkashshera rucha berucha ulishtallama da beda keden ihu shelimu bechibbura chada
Kevan dehay rucha itchabbar bahadeh veishtelim da beda veitnehiru da beda bechal shelimu kedeka chaze behay reuta detzalle bar nash zakkaa desalik kola kedeka chaze
88: Ad hahu atar lechabbera rechimu da beda keden kal innun hechalin vechal innun ruchin deitkelilu behay kal chad vechad meinnun ruchin vehechalin deinnun bichlala deshamayim kal chad vechad natil hahu hechala vehahu rucha deitchazze leh leitchabbera bahadeh ulishtallama bahadeh kedeka yaut
Da beda leitchabbera da beda leishtallama da beda veraza da vayyishshak yaakov lerachel vegv
Avraham deihu yemina leela natil rucha deikre ahava leitkashshera da beda leitchabbera da beda lemehve chad vesimanach hinne na yadati ki ishsha yefat mare att veshappiru deitteta beinnun shadayim
Yitzchak deihu semala natil hahu hechala terin ruchin nogah vezohar beraza dichtiv chamuke yerechayich vegv leitkashshera illen beillen lemeheve chad

Yosef hatztzaddik ammuda dealma natil hechala desappir rucha deikre livnat hassappir veaf al gav dichtiv vetachat raglav begin yekara demalka vehachi hu vadday ulvatar ammuda da natil yattir deihu raza derazin beatar dehechala sheviaa ad hacha mitchabberan dargin umitchabberan da beda leishtallama da im da lemeheve kulhu chad kolla kedeka chaze uchden Adonai hu haelohim vegv zakkaa chulakeh bealma den uvalma deate man deyada lekashra lon ulitdabbeka bemareh

Hakka hakkeraa vehishtachavaa vekida ufrisu dekkappin unfila deappin leamshacha reuta derucha illaa nishmata dechal nishmatin deihu talya leela ad en sof deminneh nafke nehiru uvirchan leashlama kolla milleela kedeka yaut ulmeheve kolla bishlimu mittatta umilleela vechal anpin nehirin bechal sitrin kedeka yaut keden kal gizre dinin mitbatlin vechal reuta itavid leela vetatta veal da ketiv vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaer uchtiv ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheyeya elohav

Hekala sheviaa hekala da lav beh diukna mammash kolla ihu bistimu vegv raza derazin paruchta difrisa kayemin kulhu hechalin dela leitchazzaa terin keruvim lego min da kayema kappurta diukna dekodesh kudshin begin kach hechala da ikre kodesh hakkodashim hay kodesh hakkodashim atar mittakna lehahu nishmata illaa kelala decholla alma deate legabbe hay illae

Deha kad mitchabberan kulhu ruche da beda veishtallimu da im da kedeka chaze keden itar rucha illaa nishmata decholla legabbe ela setima dechal setimin leatara al kolla leanhara lon meela letatta ulashlama lon leadlaka botzinin

Vechad kolla bishlimu binhiru decholla venachit nehiru illaa keden hay hechala sheviaa ihu hechala setimaa bistimu decholla lekabbela hahu kodesh hakkodashim nehiru denachit ulitmalya mittamman kenukva demitabbera min dechura veitmalya vela itmalya ella mehay hechala demittakna lekabbela hahu nehiru illaa veraza da hechala sheviaa ihu atar dechibbura deziuuga leitchabbera sheviaa bishviaa lemeheve
89: Uman deyada lekashra yichuda da zakkaa chulakeh rachim leela rachim letatta kudsha berich hu gazir veihu mevattel salka datin deihu mekatrega bemareh lav hachi ella begin dechad ihu kashir keshirin veyada leyachada yichuda vechal anpin nehirin vechal shelimu ishtechach vecholla itbarcha kedeka yaut kal dinin mitabberin umitbattelin vela ishtechach dina bealma zakkaa chulakeh bealma den uvalma deate da hu letatta dichtiv beh vetzaddik yesod olam da hu kiyyuma dealma bechal yoma kare aloy karoza veatta tagil bayeya bikdosh yisrael tithallal

Kegavena da karbana salka tenana umistappekin kal chad vechad kidkachaze leh vechahani biruta velevae bivsimu deshirata da itkelil beda veayele hechala behechala rucha berucha ad demitchabberan beduchtayehu kedeka chaze leh shayefa beshayefa veishtallimu da beda veityachadu da beda ad deinnun chad venaharin da beda

Keden nishmata illaa decholla atya milleela venahir lon vehau nehirin kulhu botzinin bishlimu kedeka chaze ad dehahu nehora illaa itar vecholla ail legabbe kodesh hakkodashim veitbarcha veitmalya kevera demayin navin vela paskin vechulhu mitbarchan leela vetatta

Hacha raza derazin hahu dela ityeda vela ail bechushbena reuta dela itpas lealmin besim lego lego begavayehu vela ityeda hahu reuta vela itpas leminda uchden kolla reuta chada ad en sof vecholla ihu bishlimu mittatta umilleela umiggo lego ad deitavid kolla chad

Hay reuta la ail lego af al gav dela ityeda ad decholla ishtelim veitnehir bekadmita bechulhu sitrin keden basim hahu reuta vela itpas lego bego bistimu uchden zakkaa chulakeh man deyitdabbak bemareh behahi shaata zakkaa ihu leela zakkaa ihu letatta ale ketiv yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha

Ta chaze kevan dechulhu ishtallimu da beda veitkashsheru da beda bekishshura chada venishmata illaa nahir lon missitra dilela vechullehu nehorin innun botzina chada bishlimu keden raava chada demachashava itpas nehiru dela itpas vela ityeda bar hahu reu demachashava tafis vela yada ma tafis ella deitnehir veitbassam hahu reu demachashava veitmalya kolla veishtelim kolla veitnehir veitbassam kolla kedeka yaut veal da ketiv ashre haam shekkacha lo vegv

Man dezache leitdabbeka bemareh kehay gavena yarit almin kulhu rechima leela rechima letatta tzeloteh la ahaddera rekanya da itchatte kamme mareh kivra kamme avoy veavid leh reuta bechal ma deitzterich veemteh shallit al kal biryan ihu gazir vekudsha berich hu avid aleh ketiv vetigzar omer veyakam lach veal derachecha nagah or
Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayehi or vegv amar rabbi yitzchak mikkan deakaran kudsha berich hu lehani netian lo
Desalik nehoreh misyafe alma ad seyafe alma vechi tov hu
90: Leagnaza leh dela yehenun minneh chayyave alma

Amar rabbi shimon vayyar elohim et haor ki tov dela yishtechach beh ritcha ketiv hacha ki tov uchtiv hatam ki tov beene Adonai levarech et yisrael vesofa dikra vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech ubbegin kach la ishtechach beh ritcha veaf al gav deshitef lon kudsha berich hu kechada

Ta chaze nehiru illaa lemehve nahir hay or umehahu nehiru chadu lecholla beh vehu yamina leitattera gulfoy gelifin bahadeh veha ittemar ketiv ma rav tuvcha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach ma rav tuvcha da or kadmaa deganiz kudsha berich hu lireecha latztzaddikim leinnun dachale chattaa kidkaamaran

Vayehi erev vayehi voker yom echad vayehi erev missitra dechoshech vayehi voker missitra deor umiggo deinnun mishtattefe kechada ketiv yom echad rabbi yehuda amar may taama bechal yoma veoma ketiv vayehi erev vayehi voker leminda deha let yom bela layela velet layela bela yom vela ivun leitperasha

Amar rabbi yose hahu yom denafak or kadmaa itpeshat bechulhu yome dichtiv bechulhu yom amar rabbi elazar mashma dichtiv bechulhu boker velav boker ela missitra deor kadmaa rabbi shimon amar yoma kadmaa azil im kulhu vechulhu beh begin leachazaa delav behu piruda vecholla chad

Vayyomer elohim yehi or yehi itpashtuta dehay or letatta veillen innun malachin deitberiu beoma kadmaa it lon kiyyuma leitkayema listar yamina vayyar elohim et haor ki tov et leitkelala ispaklaryaa dela nahara im ispaklaryaa denahara deittemar ki tov amar rabbi elazar et leitkelala ulasgaa kulhu malachin deatyan missitra deor da vechulhon naharin kekadmita bekiyyuma shelim
Yehi rakia betoch hammayim amar rabbi yehuda behay itperashu mayyin illain mimmayin tattain rakia peshituta demayyin veha ittemar vihi mavdil ben mayyin illain letattain
Vayyaas elohim et harakia bisgiu illaa vayehi rakia la ketiv ella vayyaas deasge leh birvu sagya

Amar rabbi yitzchak bashsheni itbere gehinnom lechayyave alma bashsheni itbere machloket bashsheni la ishtelim beh avidta ubbegin kach la ketiv beh ki tov ad deata yom telitaa veishtelim beh avidta begin kach ki tov tere zimne chad al ashlamut avidta deom sheni vechad legarmeh beom telitae ittakkan yom sheni veitperash beh machloket uveh ishtelimu rachame al chayyave gehinnom beoma telitaa mishtakkechin shevivin degehinnom begine kach itkelil beh yom sheni veishtelim beh

Rabbi chiyya hava yativ kammeh derabbi shimon amar leh hay or beom rishon vechoshech beom sheni veitperashu maya umachloket hava beh ammay la ishtelim beom rishon dehay yamina kalil lismala amar leh al da hava machloket utlitaa bae lemeal benayehu leachraa ulasgaa behu shelam
Tadshe haaretz deshe itchabberuta demayyin illain betattain lemebad perin mayin illain veavde ibin vetattae karan lon leillain kenukva legabbe dechura begin demayin illain dechurin vetattae nukvin
Rabbi shimon amar kal da hu leela vehu letatta amar rabbi yose i hachi elohim deka amaran man elohim elohim chayyim leela vei tema letatta elohim setam ella letatta ihu toldot
91: Kema deatte amer elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram veamrinan be beraam vehahu leela avahan decholla hu ihi avidta veal da ara avdat toldot deha hi mitabbera kenukva min dechura

Rabbi elazar amar kal chelin hau beara vela appikat chelaha veinnun toldoteha ad yom hashshishshi dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya vei tema veha ketiv vattotze haaretz deshe ella afikat tikkun chelaha leityashva kedeka yaut vecholla hava ganiz beh ad deitzterich deha bekadmita ketiv tzadya verekanya ketargumo ulvatar ittakkanat veityashvat vekabbilat zara udshain veisvin veilanin kedeka yaut veappikat lon levatar umorot hachi name la shimshu nehora dilhon ad deitzterich

Yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim leachlala chiveya visha deattil zuhama veavad piruda dela meshammesh shimsha besihara meorot levatin veal da garim deitlatya ara dichtiv arura haadama uvgin kach meorot ketiv

Yehi meorot da sihara rekia hashshamayim da shimsha vetarvayehu bichlala chada leizdavega leanhara almin leela vetatta mashma dichtiv al haaretz vela ketiv baaretz demashma leela vetatta chushban decholla besihara hu

Rabbi shimon amar gimatriyyaot vecheshbon tekufot veibburin kolla hu besihara deha leela lav ihu amar leh rabbi elazar vela veha kamma chushbenin veshiurin kaavde chavraya amar leh lav hachi ella chushbana kayema besihara umittamman yeul bar nash leminda leela amar leh veha ketiv vehau leotot ulmoadim amar leh leotot ketiv chaser amar leh ha ketiv vehau amar leh haveyan kulhon dihaon beh keispuka da deitmalya mikkolla aval chushbena decholla besihara hu

Ta chaze nekuda chad it umittamman sheruta lemimne deha ma dilgo dehahi nekuda la ityeda vela ityehav lemimne veit nekuda leela satim dela itgalya kelal vela ityeda umittamman sheruta lemimni kal satim veumka hachi name it nekuda letatta deitgalya umittamman hu sheruta lechal chushbena ulchal minyan veal da hacha hu atar lechal tekufot vegimatriyyaot veibburin vezimnin vechagge veshabbatte veyisrael dedavke bekudsha berich hu avde chushban lesihara veinnun davkin beh vesalkin leh leela dichtiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elokechem vegv
Yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chaya amar rabbi elazar ha ukmuha deinnun mayin rechishu veolidu kegavena dilela veha ittemar veof yeofef al haaretz yauf mibbae leh mahu yeofef

Amar rabbi shimon raza hu veof da michael dichtiv vayyaaf elay echad min hasserafim yeofef da gavriel dichtiv vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon battechilla muaf biaf al haaretz Adonai Adonai dehu rekia hashshamayim kidamaran ole umastin vechu

Amar rabbi abba veha malach hammavet bashsheni itbere ella al haaretz da refael deihu memanna leasvata deara divgineh itrappiat ara vekayyam bar nash alah verafe lechal cheleh al peni rekia hashshamayim da oriel vecholla hu bakkera
Uvgin kach ketiv batreh vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim amar rabbi elazar illen innun shivin memannan ravrevan al shivin ammin uvgin kach itberiu kulhu lemeheve shallitan al ara
Veet kal nefesh hachayya haromeset illen innun yisrael deinnun
92: Nefesh vadday dehahu chayya veikrun goy echad baaretz asher shartzu hammayim leminehem deinnun mishtaddelin beorayeta veet kal of kanaf leminehu illen tzaddikayya divhon uvgin kach innun nefesh chayya davar acher veet kal of kanaf kedeka ittemar illen innun sheluche alma

Amar rabbi abba nefesh chayya deinnun yisrael begin deinnun bene dekudsha berich hu venishmathon kaddishin minneh atyan nafshan dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot mean atar hu amar rabbi elazar meinnun sitre semala dimsaave lon it lon nishmatin uvgin kach kulhu mesaavin umsaavin leman dekarav bahadayehu

Vayyomer elohim totze haaretz nefesh chayya vegv kulhon shear chevan achoranin kal chad vechad kefum zineh veamar rabbi elazar hay mesayyea lema deamaran nefesh chayya illen yisrael deinnun nefesh chayya kaddisha illaa behema varemes vechayeto eretz illen shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot delav innun nefesh chayya ella kidkaamaran

Naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu deitkelil beshit sitrin kalil mikkolla kegavena dilela beshayefe metaknan beraza dechachmeta kedeka yaut kolla tikkuna illaa naase adam raza dechar venukva kolla bechachmeta kaddisha illaa betzalmenu kidmutenu leishtachlela da beda lemehevi hu yechiday bealma shallit al kolla

Vayyar elohim et kal asher asa vehinne tov meod hacha ittakkan ma dela ittemar ki tov bashsheni begin deitbere beh mota vehacha ittemar vehinne tov meod veazla kema deamre chavraya vehinne tov meod ze mavet

Vayyar elohim et kal asher asa vehinne tov meod vechi la chama leh kodem ella kolla chama leh kudsha berich hu uman deamar et kal leasgaa kal darin deyetun levatar ken vechen kal ma deyitchaddesh bealma bechal dara vedara ad la yetun lealma asher asa da kal ovadin divreshit detamman itbere yesoda veikkera lechal ma deyete veyitchaddesh bealma levatar ken uvgin kach chama leh kudsha berich hu ad la hava veshave kolla beovada divreshit

Yom hashshishshi may shena bechulhu yome dela ittemar behu he ella hacha kad ishtachlal alma itchabberat nukva bidchura bechibbura chad Adonai bashshishshi lemeheve kolla chad vayechullu ishtachlelu chola chad ishtachlelu mikkolla veishtalimu becholla

Vayechullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechal tzevaam rabbi elazar patach ma rav tuvcha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam ta chaze kudsha berich hu bara levar nash bealma veatkin leh lemehve shelim befulchanih ulittakkana archoy begin deyizke linhora illaa deganiz kudsha berich hu letzaddikayya kema deatte amer ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo

Uvma yizke leh levar nash lehahu nehora beorayeta dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta bechal yoma yizke lemehve leh chulka bealma deate veyitchashev leh keillu vane almin deha beorayeta itbene alma veishtachlal hada hu dichtiv Adonai bechachma yasad eretz konin shamayim bitvuna uchtiv vaehye etzlo amon vaehye shaashuim yom yom vechal deishtaddal bah shachlil almin vekayyim leh vetta chaze berucha avid kudsha berich hu alma uvrucha mitkayema rucha deinnun delaan beorayeta vechal shekken rucha dehevel deravye deve rav

Ma rav tuvcha da tuva deitgeniz lireecha leinnun dachale chattaa paalta lachosim bach may paalta da ovada divreshit rabbi abba amar da gan eden deha beumanuta avid leh kudsha berich hu beara kegavena dilela leittakfa beh tzaddikayya
93: Hada hu dichtiv paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam deha hu neged adam veachara neged illain kaddishin amar rabbi shimon gan eden leela veneged bene adam have leitkansha beh tzaddikayya deavde reuta demarehon

Vayechullu dechalu ovadin dilela veovadin diltatta hashshamayim vehaaretz leela vetatta rabbi shimon amar ovada veumanuta deorayeta shebbichtav veovada veumanuta detora shebbeal pe vechal tzevaam illen perate deorayeta appin deorayeta shivim panim lattora vayechullu deitkayemu veishtachlelu da beda shamayim vaaretz perat uchlal vechal tzevaam raze deorayeta dachyan deorayeta mesaavan deorayeta

Vayechal elohim bayyom hashshevii da tora shebbeal pe deihu yom shevii uveh ishtachlal alma deihu kiyyuma decholla melachto asher asa velo kal melachto deha tora shebbichtav appik kolla betukfa dichtav denafik mechachmeta

Telat zimnin hacha bayyom hashshevii vayechal elohim bayyom hashshevii vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii vayevarech elohim et yom hashshevii ha telat vayechal elohim bayyom hashshevii da tora shebbeal pe deim yom hashshevii da ishtachlal alma kedeka amaran

Vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii da yesoda dealma besifra derav yeva sava da yovla veal kach ketiv hacha mikkal melachto decholla nafik minneh veanan da yesoda kidkaamaran deha nayecha beh hava yattir mikkolla

Vayevarecha elohim et yom hashshevii da kohen gadol dimvarech lecholla vehu natil beresha ditnan kohen notel barosh uvirchan beh sharyan levarcha veikre shevii rabbi yesa sava amar hani tere chad bisoda dealma ihu vechad beammuda deemtzaita

Vechen oto leman lehahu atar deat kayyama beh sharya kema deatte amer vehirani oto veet navihu uvhay atar sharyan kal kidushin leela venafke minneh lichneset yisrael lemehav lah tafnuka lechem pannag veazla ha kema dichtiv measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadanne melech measher da keyam shelim dehava lechem oni ithaddar lemehve lechem pannag vehu yitten maadanne melech man melech da keneset yisrael hu yahiv kal tafnukin dealmin vechal kiddushin denafkin milleela mehay atar nafkin veal da vayekaddesh oto hahu at kayyama
Ki vo shavat beh nayecha decholla deillain vetattain beh shabbatta lenayecha asher bara elohim mikkelala dezachur nafka shamor leatkana avidta dealma laasot da omana dealma lemebad avidta decholla

Tu parish rabbi shimon milla veamar ketiv shomer habberit vehachesed shomer da keneset yisrael habberit da yesoda dealma vehachesed da avraham dichneset yisrael hi shomer habberit vehachesed veikre shomer yisrael da hu natir pitcha decholla beh talyan kal avidan dealma vadday asher bara elohim laasot leshachlela leatkana kolla kal yoma veoma ulappaka ruchin venishmatin veafilu ruchin veshedin

Vei tema delav innun tikkuna dealma lav hachi deha innun letikkuna dealma hau ulalkaa behu lechayyave alma deinnun azlin lekivlayehu leochacha lehu umay deazil lismala itachid besitra semala lekivlayehu begine chach letikkuna hau ta chaze ma ketiv bishlomo vehochachtiv beshevet anashim uvnige bene adam man nige beni adam illen innun mazzikin
Ta chaze bishata deitberian itkaddash yoma veishtaaru rucha bela gufa veillen innun baryan dela
94: Ishtachlalu umistar semala innun zuhama dedahava veal da begin dela ishtachlelu veinnun pegimin shema kaddisha la sharya behu vela itdabbeku beh udchilu dilhon mishma kaddisha ihu vezain vedachalin minneh ushma kaddisha la sharya beatar pagim

Veta chaze hay bar nash deitpegim dela shavak bar behay alma kad nafak minneh la itdabbak bishma kaddisha vela alin leh befargoda begin deihu pagim vela ishtelim veilana deitakker baya netia zimna achora begin dishma kaddisha ishtelim bechal sitrin ufgimo la itdabbak beh lealmin

Vetta chaze hane baryan pegimin innun meela umittatta uvgini chach la mitdabbekan leela vela mitdabbekan letatta veillen dichtiv behu asher bara elohim laasot dela ishtallimu ela vetatta vei tema ha ruchin innun ammay lav leela ella kevan dela ishtelimu letatta beara la ishtelimu leela vechulhu missetar semala ka atyan umitkasyan meena divne nesha vekayeme lekivlayehu leavasha lon telat lon kemalache hashsharet utlat lon kivne nesha veha ukmuha

Batar deitberiu ruchin ishtaaru innun ruchin batar rechayya denukva dithoma rabba lelya deshabbatta veoma deshabbatta kevan denafak kedushata deoma vela ishtallimu nafku lealma veshatan lechal sitrin uvaya alma leitnattera minnayehu deha keden kal setar semala itar veeshsha degehinnom melahata vechal innun devistar semala azlin veshatan bealma uvaan leitlabbesha begufa vela yachlin keden baena leistammera minnayehu veatkinu shir difgaim bechal shaata didchilu dilhon sharya bealma

Ta chaze kad itkaddash yoma bemaale shabbatta sukkat shalom sharya veitperisat bealma man sukkat shalom da shabbatta vechal ruchin veilulin veshedin vechal sitra dimsaave kulhu temirin vealin beena derechayya denukva dithoma rabba deha kevan deitar kedushata al alma ruach mesaava la itar bahadeh veda arik mikkammeh deda

Uchden alma bintiru illaa vela baenan letzallaa al netiru kegon shomer et ammo yisrael laad amen deha da beoma dechol ittakkan dealma baya netiru aval beshabbat sukkat shalom itperisa al alma veitnetir bechal sitrin veafilu chayyave gehinnom netirin innun vecholla bishlama ishtakkecha illain vetattain ubbegin kach bekiddusha deoma mevarchinan happores sukkat shalom alenu veal kal amo yisrael veal yerushalam

Ammay al yerushalam ella da hi medora dehahi sukka uvaena lezammena lehahi sukka deitperasat alana ulmeshra immana ulmeheve alana keimma desharya al benin uvgin da la dachalin mikkal sitrin veal da happores sukkat shalom alenu

Ta chaze beshaata deyisrael mevarchin umzammenin lehay sukkat shalom ushpiza kadisha veamre happores sukkat shalom keden kedushata ilaa nachata ufrisat gadfaha alayehu deyisrael umchasya lon keimma al benin vechal zinin bishin itkannishu mealma veyatve yisrael techot kedushata demarehon uchden da sukkat shalom yahiv nishmatin chadtin livnaha may taama begin debbeh nishmatin sharyan uminneh nafkin vechevan desharya ufrisat gadfaha al benaha arikat nishmatin chadtin lechal chad vechad

Tu amar rabbi shimon al da tanenan shabbat dugma dealma deate ihu hachi hu vadday veal da shemita veovel dugma da beda veshabbat vealma deate hachi hu vehahu tosefet denishmeta meraza dezachur ka atya al hay sukkat shalom denatil
95: Mealma deate veda tosefet yahavat lealma kaddisha uvhahu tosefet chadan veyitneshe minnayehu kal millin dechol vechal tzaarin vechal akin kema deatte amer beom haniach Adonai lecha meatzbecha umeragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha vegv

Uvlelya deshabbatta bae bar nash leatama mikkolla begin leachazaa dehay sukkat shalom mikkolla itkelilat uvilvad dela yafgim mechla chada leoma veit deamre teren litren seudate achoranin deoma veshappir vechal shekken i salik yattir leoma veyachil lemitam mimmechlin achoranin velizire bitre tavshilin sagya veukmuha chavraya

Ner shel shabbat linshe amma kaddisha ityehivat leadlaka vechavraya ha amru deihi kibbeta botzina dealma veachashichat leh veshappir aval raza demilla hay sukkat shalom matronita dealma hi venishmatin deinnun botzina illaa bah sharyan veal da matronita baaya leadlaka deha beduchtaha itachdat vaavadat ovada

Veitteta baaya bechedva delibba uruta leadlaka botzina deshabbat deha yekara illaa hi lah uzchu rav legarmah lemizke livnin kaddishin dihon botzina dealma beorayeta uvdachalta veyisgon shelama beara vihevat levaalah orka dechayyin begin kach baaya leizdahara bah

Ta chaze shabbat lelya veoma zachor veshamor ihu kechada veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekadsho uchtiv shamor et yom hashshabbat zachor lidchura shamor lenukva vecholla chad zakkain innun yisrael chulakeh dekudsha berich hu adveh veachasanteh alayehu ketiv ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheyeya elokav

Vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela asher lakach min haadam vegv amar rabbi shimon ketiv elohim hevin darkah vehu yada et mekomah hay kera gevanin saggiin it beh ella mahu elohim hevin darkah kema deatte amer vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela da tora shebbaal pe deit bah derech kema deatte amer hannoten bayyam derech begine kach elohim hevin darkah

Vehu yada et mekomah man mekomah da tora shebbichtav deit bah daat Adonai elohim shem male leatkana lah becholla veal da itkeriat chachma veitkeriat bina begin dehava beshem male Adonai elohim becholla bishlimu bitre shemahan

Et hatztzela da aspaklarya dela nahara kema deatte amer uvtzali samchu veneesafu asher lakach min haadam begin deha mittora shebbichtav nafkat leishsha leitkashshera beshalhova distar semala deha orayeta missitra digvura ityehivat leishsha lemeheve esh Adonai katir kechada

Vayevieha el haadam begin dela baaya leishtakkacha bilchudaha ella leitkelala ulitchabbera battora shebbichtav kevan deitchabberat bahadeh hu yazun lah vitakken lah veyitten lah ma deitzterich hayenu dichtiv veet haaretz veha okimna mikkan olifna man deansiv beratteh ad la teul levaalah avuha veimmah metakkenin lah veyahavin lah kal ma deitzterich kevan deitchabberat bevaalah hu yazun lah vehu yitten lah ma devaya
Ta chaze bekadmita ketiv vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela deabba veimma atkinu lah ulvatar vayevieha el haadam leitkashshera kolla kechada ulitchabbera chad bechad vehu yahiv ma deitzterich

Davar acher elohim hevin darkah kad beratta beve imma hi istakkela bechal yoma bechal ma devaaya berattah dichtiv elohim hevin darkah kevan dechavrat lah bevaalah hu yahiv lah kal ma devaaya vitakken ovadaha hada hu dichtiv vehu yada et mekomah
96: Ketiv vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam hacha ishtachlal becholla beyamina uvismala veha okimna deitkelil beyetzer hattov aval vayyitzer Adonai elohim beyetzer tov uvyetzer ra ammay ella yetzer tov leh legarmeh yetzer hara leatara legabbe nukve raza demilla mikkan olifna detzafon itar tadir legabbe nukva veitkashshar bahadah uvgin kach itkeriat ishsha

Vetta chaze yetzer tov veyetzer hara begin deityahavat nukva benayehu veitkashshera bahadayehu vela mitkashshera ad deyetzer hara itar legabbah umitkashsheran da beda vechevan demitkashsheran da beda keden itar yetzer tov deihu chedva veayete lah legabbeh Adonai Adonai

Et haadam ha okimna aval dechar venukva kechada mitparshan lemehve appin beappin ma ketiv afar min haadama hashta kayema leatkana ta chaze itteta kad itchabberat bevaalah itkeriat al shem baalah ish ishsha tzaddik tzedek ihu ofer veihi afar ihu tzevi veihi tzeviya tzevi hi lechal haaratzot

Ketiv lo titta lecha ashera kal etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha asher taase lach etzel mizbach vechi leela minneh o beatar achora man sharya ella ha okimna asher da baalah deitteta itkeriat al shum baalah ashera veal da ketiv labbaal velaashera begin kach ketiv lo titta lecha ashera kal etz etzel mizbach Adonai elokecha lakovel atar dehahu mizbach Adonai deha mizbach Adonai ihu kayema al da veal da lakovla lo titta lecha ashera achora

Ta chaze bechal atar kal innun palche shimsha ikrun ovdin labbaal veinnun defalchin lesihara ikrun ovde ashera veal da labbaal velaashera vaashera itkere al shum baalah asher i hachi ammay itavar shema da ella ashera al shum dichtiv beashri ki ishruni vanot vehu dela ashruha shear ammin vekayema achora techotah vela od ella dichtiv kal mechabbedeha hizziluha ubbegin kach itavar shema da uvgin dela yittakkefun innun deavde shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot vekarenan mizbeach deihu meadama dichtiv mizbach adama vegv begine kach afar min haadama

Vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim itkelil nishmat chayyim behahu afar kenukva demitabbera min dechura deha mitchabberan veitmalya hay afar mikkolla umay ihu ruchin venishmatin vayehi haadam lenefesh chayya hashta ittakkan vekayyam adam leatkana ulmezan lenefesh chayya

Vayyiven Adonai elohim uf hachi name beshem male deha abba veimma atkinu lah ad la atat levaalah et hatztzela kema deatte amer shechora ani venava benot yerushalam aspaklarya dela nahara aval abba veimma atkinu lah leitpayasa baalah bahadah

Vayevieha el haadam mehacha olifna devaan abba veimma dechalla leaola birshuteh dechatan kema deatte amer et bitti natatti laish hazze vegv mikkan vaelach baalah yete legabbah deha beta dilah hu dichtiv vayyavo eleha vayyavo gam el rachel bekadmita vayevieha el haadam dead hacha it leabba ulimma lemeevad levatar ihu yete legabbah vechal beta dilah hu veyittol reshut minah
Veal da itarna dichtiv vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham denatil reshu bekadmita mikkan olifna deman demitchabber
97: Beinteteh bae lemifga lah ulvasma lah bemillin vei lav la yavit legabbah begin dihe reuta dilhon kechada bidla anisu

Vayyalen sham ki va hashshemesh leachazaa deasir leh levar nash leshamsha arseh bimama vayyikkach meavne hammakom vayyasem meraashotav hacha olifna daafilu yehon lemalka arse dedahava ulvushe yekar lemevat behu umatronita tatken leh arsa mittakkan beavnin yishbok dileh veyavet bamme deihi tatkin dichtiv vayyishkav bammakom hahu

Ta chaze ma ketiv hacha vayyomer haadam zot happaam vegv ha besimu demillin leamshecha immah chavivuta ulamshacha lah liruteh leatara immah rechimuta chame kamma besimin innun millin kamma mille dirchimuta innun etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari begin leachazaa lah deinnun chad vela it piruda benayehu becholla

Hashta share leshabbacha lah lezot yikkare ishsha da hi dela yishtakkach kavatah da hi yekara deveta kullehon nashin gabbah kekofa bifne beni nasha aval lezot yikkare ishsha shelimu decholla lezot vela leachara kolla hu male rechimuta kema deatte amer rabbot banot asu chayil veatte alit al kullana

Al ken yaazav ish et aviv veet immo vedavak beishto vehau levasar echad kolla leamshacha lah birchimu ulitdabbeka bahadah kevan deitar legabbah kal millin illen ma ketiv vehannachash haya arum vegv ha itar yetzer hara leachada bah begin lekashra lah betiuvta degufa ulatara legabbah millin achoranin deyetzer hara itannag behu

Ad levatar ma ketiv vatere haishsha ki tov haetz lemaachal vechi taava hu laenayim vattikkach mippiro vattochal kevelat leh biruta vattitten gam leishah immah ha keden hi itara legabbeh betiuvta leatara leh reuta urchimu da milla leachazaa ovada livne nasha kegavena dilela

Amar rabbi elazar i hachi bemay nokim leh leela yetzer hara deachid bah benukva amar leh ha itara illen leela veillen letatta yetzer tov veyetzer ra yetzer tov miyyamina veyetzer ra mismala usmala leela achid benukva lekashra lah kechada begufa kema deatte amer semolo tachat leroshi vegv veal da millin itparshan leela vetatta ad hacha mikkan ulhala millin bezutra dezifta lizireh detinkin lefarsha milla veha itaru beh chavrayya

Rabbi shimon hava azil litverya vehau immeh rabbi yose verabbi yehuda verabbi chiyya addehachi chamu leh lerabbi pinchas dehava ate kevan deitchabbaru kechada nachatu veyatvu techot ilana chad meilane tura amar rabbi pinchas ha yativna meillen mille maalyata deatte amer bechal yoma beena lemishma

Patach rabbi shimon veamar vayyelech lemassaav minnegev vead bet el ad hammakom asher haya sham aholo battechilla ben bet el uven haay vayyelech lemassaav lemassao mibbae leh may lemassaav ella teren matlanin innun chad dideh vechad dishchinta deha kal bar nash bae leishtakkecha dechar venukva begin leatkafa mehemnuta uchden shechinta la itparsha minneh lealmin

Vei tema man denafik leorcha dela ishtechach dechar venukva shechinta itparsha minnih ta chaze hay man denafik learcha yesadder tzelota kamme kudsha berich hu begin leamshacha aleh shechinta demareh ad la yippuk learcha bezimna deishtechach dechar venukva kevan desaddar tzeloteh veshivcheh ushchinta sharya aleh yippuk deha shechinta izdavegat bahadeh begin deyishtechach dechar venukva dechar venukva bemata dechar venukva bechakla hada hu dichtiv tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav
98: Zimna devar nash itakkav beorcha bae lenatra ovadoy begin deziuuga illaa la yitperash minneh veyishtechach pagim bela dechar venukva bemata itzterich kad nukveh immeh kal shekken hacha deziuuga illaa itkashsherat beh vela od ella deha ziuuga illaa natir leh bearcha vela mitparsha minneh ad deyitov leveteh

Beshaata deal leveteh baa lechadta devithu begin didvithu garma leh hahu ziuuga illaa kevan deata legabbah bae lechadta lah begin teren gavene chad begin chedvata dehahi ziuga chedvata demitzva hi vechedvata demitzva chedvata dishchinta ihu

Vela od ella deasge shalom setam hada hu dichtiv veyadata ki shalom aholecha ufakadta navecha velo techota vechi i la pakid leitteteh chet ihu hachi hu vadday begin degara yekar ziuuga illaa deizdavegat beh udvithu garma leh

Vechad dei mitabbera itteteh ziuuga illaa arikat bah nishmata kaddisha dehay berit ikre berit dekudsha berich hu veal da bae lechavena bechedvata da kema devae bechedvata deshabbat deihu ziuuga dechakkimin veal da veyadata ki shalom aholecha deha shechinta atya immach vesharya bevetach veal da ufakadta navecha velo techota may velo techota leshammasha kamme shechinta chedvata demitzva

Kegavena da talmide chachamim demitparshan minneshayehu kal innun yomin deshabbatta begin leitasseka beorayeta ziuuga illaa izdavag behu vela mitparsha minnayehu begin deyishtechach dechar venukva kevan deal shabbat bayan talmide chachamim lechadta lidvithu begin yekar ziuuga illaa ulchavvena libbayehu biruta demarehon kema deittemar

Kegavena da hay man deitteteh beome mesaavu dilah venatir lah kedeka yeut kal innun yomin ziuuga illaa izdavag bahadeh deyishtechach dechar venukva kevan deitdechiat itteteh bae lechadta lah chedva demitzva chedva illaa vechulhu taame deka amaran bechad darga salkin setama demilla kal innun beni mehemnuta baoyan lechavvena libba uruta behay

Vei tema i hachi shevacha hu devar nash kad nafik learcha yattir min beteh begin ziuuga illaa deizdavegat bahadeh ta chaze bezimna devar nash hu beveteh ikkera deveta devithu begin dishchinta la itadde min beta begin devithu kema detaninan dichtiv vayevieha yitzchak haohla sara immo dishragga itdelakat may tama begin dishchinta atat leveta

Raza demilla imma illaa la ishtakkechat gabbe dechura ella bezimna deittaknat beta veitchabberu dechar venukva keden imma illaa arikat birchan livarukke lon kegavena da imma tattaa la ishtakkechat legabbe dechura ella bezimna deittaknat beta veate dechar legabbah denukveh veitchabbaru kechada keden imma tattaa arikat birchan levarcha lon

Veal da bitre nukvin itattar dechura beveteh kegavena dilela vehayenu raza dichtiv ad taavat givot olam hay tiuvta degivot olam beh nukva illaa leatkana leh ulaattera leh ulvarcha leh nukva tattaa leitchabbera beh ulitzena minneh

Uchgavena da letatta kad dechura insiv taavat givot olam legabbeh veitattar bitre nukve chad illaa vechad tattaa illaa learka aleh birchan tattaa leitzena minneh ulitchabbera bahadeh ubbar nash beveteh taavat givot olam legabbeh veitattar behu
Kad nafik bearcha lav hachi ima illaa itchabberat bahadeh vetattaa ishtearat kad tav leveteh bae leitattera bitre nukve kidkaamaran amar rabbi pinchas afilu biklipe sanpore kitra la patche
99: Amar rabbi shimon kegavena da orayeta kaim ben tere battim kema dichtiv lishne batte yisrael vegv chad setima illaa vechad itgalya yattir illaa kol gadol dichtiv kol gadol velo yasaf
Vehay kol penimaa ihu dela ishtema vela itgalleya veda hu kad nevia be garon appik Adonai bechashay unvia tadir vela pasak veihu dakka penimaa dela ishtema lealmin

Umehacha nafka orayeta deihu kol yaakov vehay ishtema denafka mehahi dela ishtema ulvatar itachid dibbur bahadeh venafak levar mecheleh umittakpeh vekol deyaakov deihu orayeta achid ben tere nikve achid behay penimaa dela ishtema veachid behay dilvar deishtema

Teren innun dela ishtamu utren innun deishtamu teren dela ishtamu da hu chachma illaa setimaa dekayema bemachashava dela itgalya vela ishtema levatar nafka veitgalleya zeer bachashay dela ishtema hahu deikre kol gadol dehu dak venafik bachashay

Teren innun deishtamu innun denafke mehacha kol deyaakov vedibbur deitachid bahadeh hay kol gadol deihu bachashay vela ishtema ihi bayit lachachma illaa vechal nukva bayit ikre vehay dibbur batraa ihu bayit lakkol deyaakov deihu orayeta veal da orayeta sharya bevet bet reshit

Patach veamar bereshit bara elohim hayenu dichtiv vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela et hashshamayim hayenu dichtiv vayevieha el haadam veet haaretz kema deatte amer veetzem meatzamay vadday hay ihi eretz hachayyim

Tu patach rabbi shimon veamar neum Adonai ladoni shev limini ad ashit oyevecha hadom leraglecha neum Adonai ladoni darga illaa ledarga tattaa kaamar shev limini leitkashshera maaravit bidromit semala beyamina begin letabbera chelehon dishar amin ovde kochavim umazzalot neum Adonai ladoni neum Adonai da yaakov laadoni da aron habberit adon kal haaretz
Davar acher neum Adonai da yovla laadoni da shemita dichtiv bah ahavti et adoni shev limini deha yemina beovla sharya ushmita bae leitkashshera beyamina

Ta chaze shemita da la itkeshar bekiyyuma shelim beyamina vvismala miyyoma deishtakkechat kad baya leitkashshera oshit deroa semala lekovlah uvara alma den uvgin dehu missitra dismala let beh kiyyuma ad zimna deelef sheviaa divhahu yoma lechud itkashshar keden beyamina uchden tehve ben yamina usmala bekiyyuma shelim veyishtakkechun shamayim chadashim veeretz chadasha uchden la taade mittamman lealmin

I hachi bemay nokim shev limini ella ad zimna yedia dichtiv ad ashit oyevecha hadom leraglecha vela tadir aval behahu zimna la taade mittamman lealmin dichtiv ki yamin usmol tifrotzi lemehve kolla chad
Ta chaze et hashshamayim da shechinta illaa veet haaretz da shechinta diltatta beitchabberuta didchar venukva kechada veha ittemar kema deitaru beh chavraya ad kean
