Bau lemezal kamu amar rabbi shimon milla hacha gabban patach rabbi shimon veamar tere kerae ketive ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu uchtiv hatam veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom hane kerae okimna lehu bechamma atar veitaru behu chavraya ta chaze ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu ha ittemar milla da bego chavraya deit esha achla esha veachil lah veshatze lah begin deit esha takkifa meesha veukmuha
Aval ta chaze man devae leminda chachmeta deyichuda kaddisha yistakkal beshalhova desalka miggo gachelta o miggo botzina dedalik deha shalhova la salka ella
100: Ta chaze beshalhova desalka it teren nehorin chad nehora chivera denahir vechad nehora deitachid bah uchma o tichla hahu nehora chivera ihu leela vesalka veorach mishor utchoteh hahu nehora tichla o uchma deihu karsaya lehahu chivera
Vehahu nehora chivera share ilaveh veitachidu da beda lemehve kolla chad vehahu nehora uchma o gavan tichla deihu letatta hu karsaya dikar lehahu chivara veal da raza ditchelta
Vehay karsaya tichla uchma itachad bemilla achora leitdalleka dehu mittatta vehahu itar leh leitachada binhora chivvera
Veda tichla uchma lezimnin ithadar sumka vehahu nehora chivvera dealeh la ishtanne lealmin deha chivvera hu tadir aval hay tichla ishtanne ligvanin illen lezimnin tichla o uchma ulzimnin sumka
Vehay itachid litrin sitrin itachid leela behahu nehora chivvera itachid letatta behahu milla ditchotoy dimtakna beh leanhara ulitachada beh

Veda achla tadir veshatze lehahu milla deshaveyan leh deha bechal ma deitdabbak beh letatta vesharya aloy hahu nehora tichla shatze leh veachil leh begin deorchoy hu leshetzaa ulmeheve achil deha beh talya shetzu decholla mota decholla uvgine chach ihi achil kal ma deitdabbak beh letatta

Vehahu nehora chivvera desharya aloy la achil vela shatze lealmin vela ishtanne nehoreh veal da amar moshe ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu ochla vadday achil veshatze kal ma desharya techotoy veal da amar Adonai elohecha velo elohenu begin demoshe behahu nehora chivvera dilela hava dela shatze vela achil
Ta chaze let leh itaruta leitdalleka hay nehora tichla leitachada binhora chivvera ella al yede yisrael deinnun mitdabbekan beh techotoy

Vetta chaze af al gav dearcheh dehay nehora tichla uchma leshetzaa kal ma deitdabbak beh techotoy yisrael mitdabbekan beh techotoy vekayeman bekiyyuma hada hu dichtiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim bayeya elohechem vela elohenu behahu nehora tichla uchma deachil veshatze kal ma deitdabbak beh techoteh veattun mitdabbekan beh vekayeme dichtiv chayyim kullechem hayyom

Veal nehora chivvera sharya leela nehora setima deakkif leh veraza illaa hacha vecholla tishkach beshalhova desalik vechachmetin deelonin beh ata rabbi pinchas unshakeh amar berich rachamana deiarana hacha azlu immeh derabbi pinchas telat milin

Ahadderu rabbi shimon vechavraya amar rabbi shimon ha deamaran raza dechachmeta ihu beyichuda kaddisha divgin kach batraa dishma kaddisha ihu nehora tichla uchma deitachid behv dehu nehora chivvera denahir

Ta chaze lezimnin hay nehora tichla ulzimnin Adonai ella bezimna dela mitdabbekan beh yisrael letatta leadlaka leh leitachada binhora chivvera ihu ulzimna demitare leh leitchabbera im nehora chivvera keden ikre Adonai
Menalan dichtiv ki yihye naara betula naar ketiv bela Adonai may tama begin dela itchabberat bidchura uvchal atar dela ishtakkechu dechar venukva la ishtechach vesalka mittamman veishtaar

Deha ihi kal zimna deitchabbar binhora chivvera denahir ikre Adonai deha keden kolla itchabbar kechada ihi itdabbekat binhora chivvera veyisrael mitdabbekan bah vekayema techotah leadlaka lah uchden kolla chad
Veda hu raza dekarbana ditnana desalik atar leh lehay nehora tichla leadlaka vechad itdelak itchabbar
101: Binhora chivvera ushragga dalik beyichuda chad

Uvgin dearcheh dehay nehora tichla leshetzaa ulmehve achil kal ma deitdabbak beh techoteh kad raava ishtakkach ushragga dalik bechibbura chad keden ketiv vattippol esh Adonai vattochal et haola vegv uchden ityeda dehahi sheragga dalik bechibbura chad vekishshura chad nehora tichla itdabbak binhora chivvera veihu chad achil techoteh tarbin veillavan demashma deha la achil techoteh ella bezimna deihu salik vecholla itkashshar veitchabbar binhora chivvera uchden shelama dealmin kulhu vecholla itkashshar beyichuda chad

Ulvatar desiyyem leshetzaa techoteh hay nehora tichla mitdabbekan beh techoteh kahane velevae veyisrael illen bechedva deshir veillen biruta delibba veillen bitzlota vesharga dalik alayehu veitdabbeku nehorin kechad unhirin almin umitbarchin illain vetattain

Uchden veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom veattem attem mibbae leh ella leosafa al tarbin veillavan deinnun mitdabbekin beh veachlin veshatzan veattun mitdabbekan beh behahu nehora tichla uchma deachla veattun kayyamin hada hu dichtiv chayyim kullechem hayyom
Kal gevanin tavin lechelma bar mittichla deihu achil veshatze tadir veihu ilana deveh mota vesharya al alma tattaa uvgin decholla sharya techoteh ihu achil veshatze

Vei tema hachi name sharya bishmaya leela vechamma chayyalin innun leela vechulhu kayeme ta chaze kal innun dilela behahu nehora tichla itkallelan aval tattae lav hachi deinnun milla gassa alma dekayema vesharya aleh uvgin kach achil veshatze lon velet lah milla achora letatta bealma dela ishtetze begin dinhora tichla shatze lechal ma dekayema aleh

Bearbein vechamesh gavene zine nehorin itpelig alma shiva mitpallegin leshiva tehomin kal chad batash bithoma dileh veavanin mitgalgelin bego tehoma veayil hahu nehora beinnun avanin unkav lon umaya nafku behu veshakin kal chad vechad al tehoma vechafya litren sitrin
Nafku maya beinnun nukvin veal nehora uvatash learba sitre tehoma mitgalgela nehora bachavertah veiaru bechad ufalgin mayin

Veachidan kal innun shiva beshiva tehome vecharan bachashoche tehoma vechashuche innun itarve behon vesalkin maya venachatin umitgalgelin beinnun nehorin veitarvu kechada nehorin vachashochin umayin veitavidu minnayehu nehorin dela itchazzan chashochan

Batash kal chad bechavreh umitpallegin leshivin vechamesh tzinore tehoma uvhu nagdan maya kal tzinnora vetzinnora salik bekaleh veizdazean tehomin vechad hahu kala ishtema kal tehoma kare lechavreh veamar pallig memach veeul bach hada hu dichtiv tehom el tehom kore lekol tzinnorecha

Techot illen telat mea utmanin gidin minhon chivverin minhon uchmin minhon sumkin itkelilu da beda veitavidu gavan chad innun gidin itrekimu bishva esre reshatot vechal chad reshet gidin ikre itrekimu da beda venachatin beshippule tehome techot illen teren rishtin kayemin kechezu defarzela utren rishtin achoranin kechezu dinchasha

Teren karsevan kayeme alayehu chad miyyamina vechad missemala kal innun rishtin mitchabberan kechada umayin nachatin meinnun tzinnorin vealin beillen rishtin innun tere karsevan chad kurseya dirkia uchma vechad kurseya dirkia sasgona
Illen teren karsevan kad innun salkin salkin behahu kurseya dirkia uchma vechad nachatin nachatin behahu kurseya dirkia sasgona
Illen teren karsevan chad miyyamina vechad missemala vehahu kurseya dirkia uchma miyyamina vehahu kurseya dirkia sasgona missemala
102: Kad salkin bekkurseya dirkia uchma maich kurseya dirkia semala venachatin beh

Mitgalgelin karsevan chad bechad naktin kal innun rishtin begavayehu vealin lon beshippola dithoma tattaa kaim chad kurseya vesalik leela mikkal innun tehome vekaim kurseya achora letatta dechal tehome ben teren karsevan illen mitgalgelin kal innun tehome vechal innun tzinnorin itneatzu ben teren karsevan illen
Shivin vechamesh tzinnorin innun shiva innun illae decholla vechal innun achoranin achidan behu vechulhu neitze begalgeloy dehay kurseya besitra da unitzin begalgeloy dehay kurseya besitra da
Behon mayin salkin venachatin innun denachatin karan bithome uvake lon innun desalkin illain beinnun nukve avnin vesalkin umalyan lishva yammin ad kan shiva gevane nehorin beraza illaa
Shiva nehorin achoranin mitpallegin leshiva yammim veyamma chad kalil lon hahu yamma chad ihu yamma illaa dechulhu sheva yamin kelilan beh

Shiva nehorin illen alin lego hahu yamma umachan leh leyamma leshiva sitrin vechal sitra vesitra itpelag leshiva nachalin kedichtiv vehikkahu leshiva nechalim vegv vechal nachala venachala itpelag leshiva neharin vechal nahara venahara itpelag leshiva archin vechal orcha veorcha itpelag leshiva shevilin vechal memoy deyamma kulhon alin legavayehu
Shiva nehorin salkin venachatin leshiva sitrin shiva nehorin illain alin lego yamma shitta innun umechad illaa nafke kema denatil yama hachi palig memoy lechal innun yammin lechal innun neharin

Chad tanina letatta bistar semala shaat bechal innun neharin ate bistar kaskesoy kulhon takkifin kefarzela umate leshaava veshaiv atrah vechal innun nehorin itchashchan kammeh pumeh velishneh melahata esha chadud lishnih kecharba takkifa
Ad demate lemeal lemakdesha go yamma uchden saiv makdesha veitchashshechan nehorin unhorin illain salkin min yama keden yamma mitpalgin memoy bistar semala veyamma kafe vela nagdin memoy

Veal da raza demilla kema dichtiv vehannachash haya arum mikkal chayyat hassade asher asa Adonai elohim raza dechiveya visha nachit metatta leela vehu shaat al appe mayin meriran venachit leafte letatta ad deyippelun go rishtoy
Hay chiveya hi mota dealma vehu al bemeoy desatim devar nash hu listar semala veit chiveya atra dechayye bistar yamina tarvayehu azle immeh devar nash kema deukmuha

Mikkal chayyat hassade deha kal shear chevan dechakla let behu chakkim leavasha kehay begin deihu zuhama dedahava vay leman deitmeshich avatreh deihu garim leh mota ulchal deatyan avatreh veha ukmuha adam imshich avatreh letatta venachit leminda bechal ma diltatta kema denachit hachi itmeshich reuteh vearchoy abbatrayehu ad dematin lehay chiveya vechamu teuvteh dealma veshatu archoy beatar da keden kam veitmeshich ihu abbatrayehu deadam veitteteh veitdabbak behu vegarim lehu mota uvchal dare deatu avatreh ad dematu yisrael letura desinay la pasak zuhama dileh mealma veha ittemar kevan dechatu veitdabbeku beilana desharya beh mota letatta ma ketiv vayyishmeu et kol Adonai elohim mithallech baggan mehallech en ketiv kan ella mithallech

Ta chaze ad la chata adam hava salik vekaim bechachma dinhiru illaa vela hava mitparesh meilana dechayye kevan deasge tiuvta leminda ulnachata letatta itmeshach abbatrayehu ad deitperash meilana dechayye veyada ra veshavak tov veal da ketiv ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha
103: Ra man deitmeshach batar ra let leh dira im ilana dechayye
Vead la chatu hau shamin kala milleela vehau yade chachmeta illaa vekayeme bekiyyuma dezihara illaa vela dachale kevan dechatu afilu kala diltatta la have yachlin lemekam beh

Kegavena da ad la chavu yisrael beshaata dekayemu yisrael al tura desinay itavar minnayehu zuhama dehay chiveya deha keden bittul yetzer hara hava mealma vedachu leh minnayehu uchden itachidu beilana dechayye vesalku leela vela nachatu letatta

Keden hau yadin vechaman ispaklaryan illain veitnaharin enayehu vechadan leminda ulmishma uchden chagar lon kudsha berich hu chagorin deatvan dishmeh kaddisha dela yechul leshaltaa alayehu hay chiveya vela yesaav lon kekadmita

Kevan dechatu baegel itavar minnayehu kal innun dargin unhorin illain veitabberu minnayehu innun chagiru mezayenin deitatteru mishma illaa kaddisha veamshichu alayehu chiveya visha kemilkaddemin vegarmu mota lechal alma ulvatar ma ketiv vayyar aharon vechal bene yisrael et moshe vehinne karan or panav vayyiru miggeshet elav

Ta chaze ma ketiv bekadmita vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vechulhu chaman zaharin illain umitnaharin beispaklarya denahara dichtiv vechal haam roim et hakkolot veal yamma hau chaman vela dachalin dichtiv ze eli veanvehu levatar dechatu pene hassarsur la hau yachlin lemecheme dichtiv vayyiru miggeshet elav

Ta chaze ma ketiv behu vayyitnatztzelu bene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev deitavar minnayehu innun mezayenan betura desinay begin dela yishlot behu hahu chiveya visha kevan deitavar minnayehu ma ketiv umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane harchek min hammachane

Amar rabbi elazar may hay kera legabbe hay ella kevan deyada moshe deitavaru minnayehu deyisrael innun zayenin illain amar ha vadday mikkan ulhala chiveya visha yete ledayera benayehu vei yakum makdesha hacha benayehu yistaav miyyad umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane harchek min hammachane begin dechama moshe deha keden yishlot chiveya visha ma dela hava mikkadmat dena

Vekara lo ohel moed vechi la hava bekadmita ohel moed ella bekadmita ohel setam hashta ohel moed may moed rabbi elazar amar letav verabbi abba amar levish rabbi elazar amar letav ma moed deihu yom chedva desihara deittosfa beh kedusha la shalta beh pegimuta uf hacha kara lah bishma da leachazaa deha itrachek ohel mibbenayehu vela itpegim veal da vekara lo ohel moed ketiv

Verabbi abba amar levish deha bekadmita hava ohel setam kema deatte amer ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lanetzach vehashta ohel moed bekadmita lemehav chayyin arukkin lealmin dela yishlot behu mota mikkan ulhala ohel moed kema deatte amer uvet moed lechal chay hashta ityehiv beh zimna vechayyin ketzuvin lealma bekadmita la itpegim vehashta itpegim bekadmita chavruta veziuuga desihara beshimsha dela yaadun hashta ohel moed ziuuga dilhon mizman lizman uvgine chach vekara lo ohel moed ma dela hava kodem

Rabbi shimon hava yativ lelya chad velae beorayeta vehau yatve kammeh rabbi yehuda verabbi yitzchak verabbi yose amar rabbi yehuda ha ketiv vayyitnatztzelu bene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev vekaamrinan degarmu mota alayehu mehahu zimna ulela veshallit behu hahu chiveya visha deaadu leh minnayehu bekadmita yisrael tenach yehoshua dela chata aade minneh hahu zayena illaa dekabbil immehon betura desinay o la
104: I tema dela aade minneh i hachi ammay mit kishar bene nasha i tema deitadde minneh ammay veha la chata deha ihu im moshe hava beshaata dechavu yisrael vei tema dela kabbil hahu itra betura desinay kema dekabbilu yisrael ammay
Patach veamar ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev yashar yechozu fanemo hay kera amru beh chavraya may dekaamru aval ki tzaddik Adonai tzaddik hu ushmeh tzaddik uvgine chach tzedakot ahev

Yashar ihu yashar kema deatte amer tzaddik veyashar veal da yechozu fanemo kal bene alma vitaknu archayehu lemehach beorach meshar kedeka yaut ta chaze kad dain kudsha berich hu alma la dan leh ella lefum rubban divne nasha

Vetta chaze kad chav adam beilana deachal minneh geram lehahu ilana deshare beh mota lechal alma vegarim pegimu leafrasha itteta mibbaalah vekaim chova difgimu da besihara ad dekayemu yisrael betura desinay kevan dekayemu yisrael betura desinay itavar hahu pegimu desihara vekayema leanhara tadir

Kevan dechavu yisrael baegla tavat kemilkaddemin sihara leitpagma veshalta chiveya visha veachid bah umashich lah legabbeh vechad yada moshe dechavu yisrael veitavar minayehu innun zayenin kaddishin illain yada vadday deha chiveya achid beh besihara leamshacha lah legabbeh veitpegimat keden appik lah levar

Vechevan dekayema leitpagma af al gav dihoshua kaim beitra dezayenin dileh kevan dippegime sharya bah veithadderat kema deitpegimat bechova deadam la yachil bar nash leitkayema bar moshe dehava shallit bah umoteh hava besitra achora illaa veal da la hava reshu vah lekayema lihoshua tadir vela leachora veal kach ohel moed kare leh ohel deha sharya beh zeman katziv lechal alma
Veal da raza demila it yamina leela veit yamina letatta it semala leela veit semala letatta it yamina leela bikdushsha illaa veit yamina letatta deihu besitra achora

It semala leela bikdushsha illaa leatara rechimuta leitkashshera sihara beatar kaddisha leela leitnahara veit semala letatta deafrish rechimuta dilela veafrish lah milleanhara beshimsha ulitkerava bahadeh veda hu sitra dechiveya visha

Dechad semala da diltatta itarat keden mashich lah lesihara veafrish lah milleela veitchashchat nehoraa veitdabbekat bechiveya visha uchden sheivat mota letatta lecholla veitdabbekat bechiveya veitrachkat meilana dechayya

Veal da garim mota lechal alma veda hu dichden isteavat makdesha ad zeman katziv deatkanat sihara vetavat leanhara veda hu ohel moed veal da yehoshua la mit ella beita shel nachash da dekariv ufgim mashkena kidkadmita

Veda hu raza dichtiv vihoshu bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel deaf al gav deihu naar letatta lekabbela nehora lo yamish mittoch haohel kema deitpegim da hachi name itpegim da af al gav dezayena kaddisha hava leh kevan deitpegim sihara hachi hu vadday la ishteziv bilchodoy minneh mehahu gavena mammash

Ta chaze kegavena da kevan dechav adam natal kudsha berich hu minneh innun zayene atvan nehirin kaddishin deatar leh kudsha berich hu uchden dachalu veyadu deha itpashtu minnayehu hada hu dichtiv vayyedu ke erumim hem bekadmita hau mitlabbeshan beinnun kitre yekar mezayenin deinnun cheru mikkolla kevan dechavu itpashtu minnayehu uchden yada deha mota kare lon veyadu deitpeshitu mecheru decholla vegarmu mota lon ulchal alma
105: Vayitperu ale teena ha okimna deolifu kal zayeni charshin vekosmin vaachidu behay diltatta kema deittemar vehahi shaata itgera zekifu vekoma deadam mea ammin uchden itavid piruda vekaim adam bedina veitlatya ara veha okimna

Vayegaresh et haadam amar rabbi elazar la yedana man avid teruchin leman i kudsha berich hu avad teruchin leadam i la aval milla ithappich vayegaresh et et dayeka uman gerash et haadam haadam vadday gerash et

Uvgin da ketiv vayeshallechehu Adonai elohim miggan eden ammay vayeshallechehu begin degerash adam et kidkaamaran vayyashken ihu ashre lon beatar da deihu garim vesatim orchin ushvilin veashre dinin al alma veamshich levatin mehahu yoma ulela

Veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet kal innun desharyan bekozfe dinin al alma demithappechin ligvanin saggiin begin leitperaa mealma lezimnin guvrin lezimnin nashin lezimnin esha melahata ulzimnin ruchin delet man dekaim behu vechal da lishmor et derech etz hachayyim dela yosifun leavasha kekadmita

Lahat hacherev innun dimlahatan esha vekostiri al rashehon derashshiaya vechayyavaya umithappechin gevanin lechamma zayenin lefum archayehu divni nasha veal da lahat kema deatte amer velihet otam hayyom habba vegv veha ittemar hacherev da cherev la kema deatte amer cherev la melea dam vegv
Amar rabbi yehuda lahat hacherev kal innun kasterin diltatta demithappechin middeokna lidokana kulhon memannan al alma leavasha ulastaa lon lechayyave alma deavrin al pikkude demarehon

Ta chaze kevan dechav adam amshich aleh kamma zayenin bishin vechamma gardini nimmusin vedachil mikkulhu vela yachil lekayema alayehu shelomo yada chachmeta illaa veshave leh kudsha berich hu itra demalchuta vehau dachalu minneh kal alma kevan dechav amshich aleh kamma zayenin bishin vechamma gardine nimmusin vedachil mikkulhu uchden yachilu leavasha leh uma dehava bideh netalu minneh
Veal da bemma deazil bar nash uvhahu archa deitdabbak beh hachi mashich aleh chela memanna deazil lekovleh kach adam hava mashich aleh chela achora mesaav desaiv leh ulchal bene alma

Ta chaze kad chav adam mashich aleh chela mesaava vesaiv leh ulchal bene alma vehay hu chiveya visha deihu mesaav vesaiv alma detaninan kad appik nishmatin mibbeni nesha ishtaar minneh gufa mesaav vesaiv beta vesaiv lechal innun dimkarvin beh hada hu dichtiv hannogea bemet vegv

Veal da kevan deihu natil nishmeta vesaiv gufa keden ityehiv reshu lechal innun sitre mesaavan lesharya aloy deha hahu gufa istaav missitra dehahu chiveya visha desharya aloy veal da bechal atar dehahu chiveya visha share mesaav leh veistaav

Vetta chaze kal bene alma beshaata denayeme al arsayehu belelya velelya paris gadfaha al kal bene alma taame taama demota umiggo detaame taama demota hay rucha mesaava shatya al alma vesaiv alma vesharya al yedoy devar nash veistaav

Vechad itar veithaddar leh nishmateh bechal ma deyikrav bidoy kulhu mesaave begin desharya alayehu ruach mesaova veal da la yissav bar nash manoy lealbasha mimman dela natil yedoy deha amshich aleh hahu ruach mesaava veistaav veit leh reshu lehay ruach mesaava lesharya bechal atar deishtechach reshimu missitreh
Veal da la yittol yedoy bar nash mimman dela natil yedoy begin deamshich aleh hahu ruach mesaova vekabbil leh hay denatal maya minneh veit leh reshu lesharya aloy
106: Devar nash begin kach bae bar nash leistammera bechal sitroy missitra dehay chiveya visha dela yishlot aloy vezammin kudsha berich hu lealma deate leaavara leh mealma hada hu dichtiv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz bila hammavet lanetzach vegv

Vehaadam yada et chava ishto vegv rabbi abba patach mi yodea ruach beni haadam haola hi lemala veruach habbehema hayyoredet hi lematta laaretz hay kera kamma gevanin it beh vehachi hu kal milloy deorayeta kamma gevanin bechal chad vechad vechulhu yaut vehachi innun

Vechal orayeta mitparsha beshivin anpin lakovel shivin sitrin veshivin anpin vehachi hu bechal milla umilla deorayeta vechal may denafik mikkal milla umilla kamma gevanin itparshan minneh lechal sitrin
Ta chaze kad bar nash azil beorach keshot hu azil limina veamshich aleh rucha kaddisha illaa meela vehay ruach salik biruta kaddisha leitachada leela ulitdabbeka bikdusha illaa dela itadde minneh
Vechad bar nash azil beorach bish vesate archoy hu amshich aleh ruach mesaova delistar semala vesaiv leh veistaav beh kema deatte amer velo tittamu bahem venitmetem bam ata leistaava mesaavin leh

Vetta chaze beshaata devar nash azil beorach keshot veamshich aleh rucha kaddisha illaa veitdabbik beh bera deolid veyippuk minneh lealma hu mashich aleh kedusha illaa vihe kaddish bikdusha demareh kema dichtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim vegv
Vechad ihu azil bistar semala veamshich aleh ruach mesaava veitdevak beh bera deyippuk minneh lealma hu amshich aleh ruach mesaavu veyistaav bimsaavu dehahu sitra

Veal da ketiv mi yodea ruach beni haadam haola hi lemala kad ihu beitdabbekut yamina salka hi leela vechad ihu beitdabbekut semala hahu setar semala deihu ruach mesaavu nachit meela letatta veshave diyyureh bevar nash vela aade minneh uvra deolid behahu mesaavu ihu have bereh mehahu ruach mesaav ihu hahu bera

Adam itdabbak behahu ruach mesaav veitteteh itdabbeka beh bekadmita venatlat vekabbilat hahu zuhama minneh olid bar hay bera bera deruach mesaava ihu veal da teren benin hau chad mehahu ruach mesaav vechad kad tav adam bituvta uvgine chach hay missitra mesaova missitra dachya

Rabbi elazar amar beshaata deattil nachash hahu zuhama bah bechava kabbilat leh vechad ishtammash immah adam olidat teren benin chad mehahu sitra mesaova vechad missitra deadam vehave dame hevel bediukna dilela vekayyin bediukna diltatta uvgin kach itperashu archayehu da min da

Vadday kayin bera deruach mesaova hava deihu chiveya visha hava uvgin dekayin ata missitra demalach hammavet katil leh leachuy vehu besitra dileh uminneh kal medorin bishin umazikin veshedin veruchin atyan lealma

Amar rabbi yose kayin kina dimdorin bishin deatu missitra dimsaova lealma ulvatar ayetiu karbana da akriv missitra dileh veda akriv missitra dileh hada hu dichtiv vayehi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama vegv rabbi shimon amar vayehi mikketz yamim may mikketz yamim da hu ketz kal basar uman ihu da malach hammavet

Vekayin mehahu ketz yamim ayete karbana dayeka dekaamar mikketz yamim vela amar mikketz yamin uvgin kach katuv bedaniyyel veatta lech lakketz vetanuach vetaamod legoralcha amar leh leketz hayyamim o leketz hayyamin amar leh leketz hayyamin vekayin mikketz hayyamim ayete
107: Vayyave kayin mipperi haadama kema deatte amer umipperi haetz amar rabbi elazar mipperi haadama kema deatte amer oy larasha ra ki gemul yadav vegv alayehu veyitdabbak behu lekatla lon ulsaova lon veal da kayin akriv missitra dileh

Vehevel hevi gam hu mibbechorot leasgaa sitra illaa deatya missetar kedushata uvgine chach vayyishsha Adonai el hevel veel minchato veel kayin veel minchato lo shaa la kabbil kudsha berich hu veal da vayyichar lekayin meod vayyippelu fanav deha la itkabbilu anpoy innun anpin desitroy vekabbil leh lehevel
Uvgine chach katuv vayehi bihotam bassade bassade da itteta kema deatte amer ki bassade metzaah vekayin kane al nukva yetera deityelidat im hevel dichtiv vattosef laledet veha ittemar

Halo im tetiv seet kema deittemar aval seet kedeamar rabbi abba seet tistallak leela vela techot letatta amar rabbi yose hay milla hashta ittemar veyaut hu aval hachi shemana seet yesallak minach veyishbok lach itdabbekuta da deruach mesaava

Vei la lappetach chattat rovetz may lappetach da dina illaa deihu pitcha decholla kema deatte amer pitchu li shaare tzedek chattat rovetz hahu sitra deitdabbekat beh veitmashchat alach yehe natir lach leitperaa minnach ketarguma

Amar rabbi yitzchak ta chaze beshaata dekatil kayin lehevel la hava yada hech nishmateh minneh vehava nashich leh beshineh kechiveya veha ukmuha chavraya beh shaata layet leh kudsha berich hu vehava azil lechal sitre alma vela hava atar dimkabbel leh ad deatfach al resheh vetav kamme mareh vekabbilat leh ara bemadora letatta

Rabbi yose amar ara kabbilat leh lemehach bah dichtiv vayyasem Adonai lekayin ot rabbi yitzchak amar lav hachi ella letatta kabbilat leh ara bemadora chada ditchotah dichtiv hen gerashta oti hayyom meal pene haadama meal pene haadama gorash aval letatta la gorash
Uvan atar kabbilat leh ara bearka vechal innun dedayere tamman alehon ketiv yevadu meara umittechot shemaya elle vetamman shave medoreh vehayenu dichtiv vayyeshev beeretz nod kidmat eden

Tosefta kevan deamar kayin gadol aoni minso machal leh kudsha bericha hu palgu meonsheh begin degazar aleh bekadmita vamar leh na vanad tihye vaaretz vehashta ishtaar benod bilchodoy hada hu dichtiv vyetztze kayin millippene kelomar dechad nappak min kadam hhava begin lemehevi nad beara vla na

Vod amru kad nappak kayin min kadam hamar lo adam beri ma itteavid dinacha amar lo kayin abba kevar ittebbasrit dimchal li kudsha bericha hu benod bilchodoy amar lo heacha hu amar lo begin dettavit veodit kammeh amar adam vchi den hu rav vettakkif chela ditteshuva veana la yadiatt shera leshabbecha lemareh ulodaa leh pattach vamar mizmor shir leom hashabbatt tov lehodott la kelomar tov leshabbacha vlattava ulodaa kammeh kudsha bericha hu
Veamar rabbi yitzchak mehahi shaata dekatil kayin lehevel deitperash adam meitteteh teren ruchin nukvin hau atyan umizdavegan immeh veolid ruchin veshedin deshatan bealma

Vela tikshe lach hay deha bar nash kad ihu bechelmeh atyan ruchin nukvin vechayechan immeh umitchammeman minneh veolidin levatar veillen ikrun nige bene adam vela mithappechan ella lidokne bene nasha velet lon saarin beresha veal da ketiv bishlomo vehochachtiv beshevet anashim uvnige bene adam veafilu kehay gavena ruchin dechurin atyan linshe alma umitabberan minnayehu veolidan ruchin vechulhon nige bene adam ikrun
Batar mea utlatin shenin itlabbash adam
108: Bekinuya veitchabbar beitteteh veolid bar ukra shemeh shet raza desofa deatvan bekitre gelifan rabbi yehuda amar raza derucha deitavid deitlabbash begufa achora bealma hada hu dichtiv ki shat li elohim zera acher tachat hevel

Veamar rabbi yehuda ketiv vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo mashma divnin achoranin la hau bediukna dileh veda bidmuto ketzalmo betikuna degufa uvtikuna denafsha beorach meshar kema deamar rabbi shimon mishmeh derav yeva sava benin achoranin beitdabbekuta dezuhama denachash vehahu derachiv beh deihu samael hau uvgine chach la hava bediukna deadam vei tema ha amarte dehevel missitra achora hava hachi hu aval tarvayehu la hau bediukna diltatta

Amar rabbi yose veha ketiv vehaadam yada et chava ishto vattahar vatteled et kayin vela ketiv vayyoled et kayin veafilu behevel la ketiv vayyoled ella vattosef laledet et achiv et havel veda hu raza demilla aval behay ma ketiv vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo

Rabbi shimon amar mea utlatin shenin itperash adam meitteteh vechal innun mea utlatin shenin hava olid ruchin veshedin bealma begin hahu chela dezuhama dehava shaiv beh kevan dechasil minneh hahu zuhama tav vekanni leinteteh veolid bar keden ketiv vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo

Ta chaze kal bar nash deazil listar semala vesaiv archoy kal ruche mesaave mashich al garmeh veruach mesaav itdabbak beh vela aade minneh veitdabbekuta dehahu rucha mesaav have vehay bar nash vela beachora uvgine chach itdabbekuta dilhon lav ihu ella beinnun demitdabbekin behu zakkain innun tzaddikaya deazle beorach meshar veinnun zakkae keshot uvnehon zakkain bealma vealayehu ketiv ki yesharim yishkenu aretz

Amar rabbi chiyya may dichtiv vaachot tuval kayin naama may irya hacha dekaamar kera dishmah naama ela begin detaayan bene nasha avatrah veafilu ruchin veshedin rabbi yitzchak amar innun bene haelohim azza vaazael tau batrah

Rabbi shimon amar imman shel shedim havat demissitra dekayin nafkat vehi itmannat al lelya beaskera deravye amar leh rabbi abba veha amar mar dehi itmannat lechayecha bivni nasha amar leh hachi hu vadday deha ihi atyat vechayechat behu bivne nasha ulzimnin deolidat ruchin bealma minnayehu vead kan ihi kayemat lechayecha behu bivni nasha

Amar leh rabbi abba veha innun metin kivne nasha may tama ihi kayemat ad hashta amar leh hachi hu aval lilit venaama veagrat bat machalat denafkat missitra dilhon kulhu kayyamot ad divaer kudsha berich hu ruach mesaova mealma dichtiv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz

Amar rabbi shimon vay lon livne nasha innun dela yadin vela mashgichin vela mistakkelin vechulhu atimin dela yadin kamma malya alma mibbiryan meshanyan dela itchazun umimilin setimin deilmale ityehav reshu leena lemecheze yitmehun bene nesha hech yachlin leitkayema bealma

Ta chaze hay naama imma deshedin havat umissitrah atyan kal innun shedin demitchammeman mibbeni nasha venatle ruach tiuvta minnayehu vechayechat behon deavde lon baale keryan uvgin devaal keri ate missitra deruach mesaova bae leaschaa garmeh leitdakkaa minneh veha ukmuha chavraya

Ze sefer toldot adam lidokni amar rabbi yitzchak achme kudsha berich hu leadam deokne dechal innun darin deyetun lealma vechal chakkime alma umalche alma dizminin lekayema alayehu deyisrael mata lemecheme david malka deyisrael deityelid umit amar leh mishshenin dili ozif leh shenin vegaru meadam shenin vesalik lon kudsha berich hu ledavid
Veal da shabbach david veamar ki simmachtani
109: Adonai befaolecha bemaase yadecha arannen man garam li chedva bealma paolecha da hu adam kadmaa deihu paolo dekudsha berich hu vela paolo devasar vadam maase yadav dekudsha berich hu vela mibbene nasha veal da gari innun shivin shenin meadam meelef shenin dehava leh leitkayema behu
Veachme leh kudsha berich hu kal chakkime dara vedara ad demata ledareh derabbi akiva vechame orayeta dideh vechade chame mitateh veatziv patach veamar veli ma yakru reecha el me atzmu rashehem

Ze sefer sefer vadday veha okimna dechad hava adam beginta deeden nachit leh kudsha berich hu sifra al yeda deraziel malacha kaddisha memanna al raze illain kaddishin uveh gelifin gillufe illain vechachma kaddisha veshivin utren zine dechachmeta hau mitparshan minneh leshit mea veshivin gelifin deraze illae

Beemtzaita desafra gelifa dechachmeta leminda elef vechamesh mea maftechan dela itmasseran leillae kaddishe vechulhu istimu beh besafra ad demata legabbe deadam hau mitkanneshe malache illae leminda ulmishma vehau amre ruma al hashshamayim elohim al kal haaretz kevodecha

Ba shaata itremiz legabbeh malacha kaddisha veamar leh adam adam hve ganiz yekara demarach dela ityehiv reshuta leillae leminda bikara demarach bar ante vehava immeh tamir veganiz hahu sifra ad denafak adam migginta deeden

Deha bekadmita hava meayyen beh umishtamesh kal yoma beginzaya demareh veitgalyan leh razin illain ma dela yadu shammashe illain kevan dechata veavar al pikkuda demareh parach hahu sifra minnih vehava adam tofeach al reshoy uvache veal beme gichon ad kadleh umaya avdin gufeh chaladin chaladin veishtanne ziyivih

Beshaata hahi ramaz kudsha berich hu lirfael veativ leh hahu sifra uveh hava mishtaddel adam veanach leh leshet bereh vechen lechal innun toldot ad demata leavraham uveh hava yada leistakkala bikara demareh veha ittemar vechen lechanoch ityehav leh sifra veistakkal minneh bikara illaa
Zachar unkeva beraam rabbi shimon amar razin illain itgalleyan behani tere kerae zachar unkeva beraam leminda yekara illaa raza dimhemanuta demiggo raza dena itbere adam
Ta chaze beraza deitberiu shamayim vaaretz itbere adam behu ketiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz beadam ketiv ze sefer toldot adam behu ketiv behibbaram beadam ketiv beom hibbaram
Zachar unkeva beraam mehacha kal diukna dela ishtechach beh dechar venukva lav ihu diukna illaa kedeka chaze uvraza dematnitin okimna

Ta chaze bechal atar dela ishtakkechu dechar venukva kechada kudsha berich hu la shavi medoreh behahu atar uvirchan la ishtakkachu ella beatar deishtechach dechar venukva dichtiv vayevarech otam vayyikra et shemam adam beom hibbaram vela ketiv vayevarech oto vayyikra et shemo adam deafilu adam la ikre ella dechar venukva kechada

Rabbi yehuda amar miyyoma deitcharav be makdesha birchan la ishtakkechu bealma veitavidu bechal yoma dichtiv hatztzaddik avad may avad avad birchan dehau sharyan beh kema dichtiv berachot lerosh tzaddik uchtiv avda haemuna kegavena da ketiv vayevarech otam uchtiv vayevarech otam elohim mishshet ityachasu kal dare alma vechal innun tzaddike keshot dehau bealma
Amar rabbi yose illen atvan batrain dehau beorayeta ishtakkachu batar daavar adam al atvan deorayeta kulhu
110: Uvituvteh lekamme mareh achid beillen teren umikkeden ithadderu atvan lemafrea beseder

Uvgin da kara lehahu bera deityelid leh deihu bidmuto ketzalmo shet deinnun siyyuma deatvan vela ittakkanu atvan ad dekayemu yisrael al tura desinay uchden ahadderu atvan al tikkunayehu keoma deitberiu shamayim vaaretz veitbassam alma vekayema al kiyyumeh

Rabbi abba amar yoma deavar adam al pikkuda demareh bayan shamayim vaaretz leitakkara meatrayehu may tama begin deinnun la kayemu ella al berit dichtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti veadam avar berit shenneemar vehemma cheadam avru berit

Veilmale degale kamme kudsha berich hu dizminin yisrael lekayema al tura desinay lekayema hay berit la itkeyyam alma rabbi chizkiyya amar kal man deode al cheteh kudsha berich hu shavik leh umachil al choveh

Ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma avad hay berit vekayema aleh alma menalan dichtiv bara shit da berit dealma kayema aleh shit deminneh negidin venafka birchan lealma vealeh itbere alma veadam avar al hay berit veaavar leh meatreh

Hay berit itremizat beat at zeera ikkera visoda dealma kad olid bar ode al cheto vekara shemeh vela adkar beh lemeheve shit begin deavar aleh uvgin kach kudsha berich hu mineh ishtil alma veityachasu kal dare zakkaa dealma

Vetta chaze kad kayemu yisrael al tura desinay al ben teren atvan illen raza divrit uman ihu vet veal ben teren atvan deishtearu veyahiv leh leyisrael vechad al raza divrit ben teren atvan illen deinnun veitavidu shabbat kema deatte amer veshamru bene yisrael et hashshabbat laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam kema dehava sheruta dealma leityachasu behu kal dare alma meillen teren atvan hau talyan ad deishtachlal alma kedeka yaut veal benayehu berit kaddisha veishtachlal bishlimu veitavidu shabbat
Amar rabbi yose illen teren atvan ishtachlelu beat bet vechad

Amar rabbi yehuda letatta ithadderu uvchal dara vedara hava gafif alma beatvan vela mityashvin beduchtayehu kad ityahavat orayeta leyisrael ittakkan kolla rabbi elazar omer beome enosh hau chakkimin beni nasha bechachma decharshin vekosmin uvchachmata lemeetzar lechele dishmaya vela hava bar nash miyyoma denafak adam migginta deeden veappik imeh chachmeta detarpe ilana deishtaddal bah deha adam veitteteh veinnun denafku minneh ad deata enosh sheviku lah

Kad ata enosh chama lon vechama chachmathon meshanyan illain veishtaddelu behon veavdin avidtin vecharshin vekosmin veolifu minhon ad deitpashtat hahi chachmeta bedara demabbul vechulhu hau avde avidtayehu leavasha

Vehau mittakfe legabbe noach beinnun chachmetan veamre dela yachil dina dealma leashraa alayehu deha innun avde chachmeta ledachya lechal innun mare dedina umeenosh shariu kulhu leishtaddelu beillen chachmetan hada hu dichtiv az huchal likro beshem Adonai

Rabbi yitzchak amar kal innun zakkain dehau behu levatar behahu dara kulhu hau mishtaddele lemachaa behu kemo yered metushelach vechanoch vela yachilu ad deitpashtu chayyavin marde bemarehon veamre ma shadday ki naavdennu
Vechi hay tippeshuta hau ka amre ella begin dehau yade kal innun chachmetan vechulhu memannan dealma deitpakkedan alayehu vehau merachatzan behu ad deativ kudsha berich hu alma kedeka hava deha
111: Bekadmita hava mayim bemayim ulvatar ativ leh lealma kidkadmita vela itchariv mikkola deha berachamin ashgach alayehu dichtiv Adonai lammabbul yashav vela ketiv elohim

Beomoy deenosh afillu yenuke dehahu dara kulhu hau mashgechan bechachmatan illain vehave mistakkelan behu amar rabbi yesa i hachi tippeshin hau dela hau yadin dezammin kudsha berich hu leayetaa alayehu me tofana vimutun behu

Amar rabbi yitzchak minda yade aval achidu tippeshuta belibbayehu deinnun hau yade hahu malacha dimmanna al esha vehahu dimmanna al maya vehau yadin lemeetzar lon dela yachlin lemebad dina alayehu veinnun la hau yade dekudsha berich hu shalit al ara uminneh yete dina al alma

Ela hau chaman dealma itpakkad bida deinnun memannan uvhu kal mille alma uvgine kach la hau mistakkelan beh bekudsha berich hu vela mashgichin beavidteh ad deara itchabbalat veruach kudsha achriz bechal yoma veamar yittammu chattaim min haaretz urshaim od enam

Veorich kudsha berich hu lon kal hahu zimna deinnun zakkain yered umtushelach vechanoch kayemin bealma kevan deistallaku mealma uchden anchit kudsha berich hu dina alayehu veitavidu kema deatte amer vayyimmachu min haaretz

Vayyithallecha chanoch et haelohim veenennu ki lakach oto elohim rabbi yose patach ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho hay kera ittemar avalotta chaze kach archoy dekudsha berich hu beshata devar nash itdabbak beh vehu ashre diyyureh aleh veyada dilvatar yomin yisrach akdim velakit recheh tav minneh vesalik leh mealma

Hada hu dichtiv ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho ad shehammelech da kudsha berich hu bimsibbo da hahu bar nash deitdabbak beh veazil bearchoy nirdi natan recho innun ovadin tavin deveh divginhon yistallak mealma ad dela mata zimneh

Veal da hava shelomo malka amar yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz asher yesh tzaddikim vegv yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim kema deokimna divgin deovadehon tavin kudsha berich hu salik lon mealma ad la mata zimnayehu veavid behon dinin veyesh reshaim asher maggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim dekudsha berich hu orich lon yomin veorich rugzeh behu vechal da kema deittemar illen begin dela yisrechun veillen begin delihadderu legabbeh o begin deyippuk minnayehu benin demaale

Ta chaze chanoch zakkaa hava vekudsha berich hu chama leh deyisrach levatar velakit leh ad la yisrach hada hu dichtiv velilkot shoshannim begin deyahave recha tav lakit lon kudsha berich hu ad la yisrechu veennu ki lakach oto elohim veenennu learcha yomin kishar beni nasha dehau orche yomin may tama begin delakach leh kudsha berich hu ad la mate zimneh

Rabbi elazar amar chanoch natil leh kudsha berich hu meara veaskeh lishme meromim veamsar bideh kal ginze illain um maftechan satre gelifin debbehu mishtammeshe malache illae vechulhu itmesaru bideh veha okimna

Vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baaretz vechal yetzer machshevot libbo rabbi yehuda patach ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra hay kera ittemar veukmuha avalotta chaze man deitdabbak beyetzer hara veitmashich avatreh veyistaav hu visaavun leh kema deittemar

Ki rabba raat haadam kal bishin hau avde vela ishtelim chovayehu ad dehau oshdin damin lemaggana al ara uman innun dehau mechabbelin archayehu al ara hada hu dichtiv rak ra kal hayyom ketiv hacha rak ra
112: Uchtiv hatam vayehi er bechor yehuda ra beeni Adonai

Amar rabbi yose vechi ra lav ihu rasha amar leh la rasha afillu arim yedeh legabbe chavreh af al gav dela avid leh midi ikre rasha kema dichtiv vayyomer larasha lamma takke reecha hikkita la ketiv ella takke

Aval ra lo ikre ella man dimchabbel archeh vesaiv garmeh vesaiv ara veyahiv chela vetukpa leruach mesaova deikre ra dichtiv rak ra kal hayyom vela al befalterin vela chame appe shechinta begin divhay istallak shechinta mealma

Menalan miyyaakov dechad istallak shechinta minneh chashiv devivnohi hava pisul divginayehu ittakkaf bealma rucha mesaova vegara nehora min sihara ufagim lah vei tema ammay begin deda saiv makdesha veistalleka shechinta mealoy deyaakov kal shekken hahu dimsaav archeh vesaiv garmeh dehu atkif leh lerucha mesaova uvgin kach kad istaav ikre ra

Ta chaze kad bar nash istaav la yitpakkad meim kudsha berich hu letav uvchal zimna itpakkid mehahu deitkere ra levish hada hu dichtiv vesavea yalin bal yippaked ra kad azil beorach meshar keden bal yippaked ra veal da ketiv rak ra kal hayyom uchtiv lo yegurcha ra veda ikre ra vela ikre rasha uchtiv gam ki elech bege tzalmavet la ira ra ki atta immadi

Vayyinachem Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz vayyitatztzev el libbo rabbi yose patach hoy moshche heaon bechavle hashshave vechaavot haagala chattaa hoy moshche heaon illen beni nasha dechatan kame marehon bechal yoma veitdamman beenayehu innun chovin deinnun kechavle hashsheva vechashvin dehahu ovada deavdin vehahu chova deavdin delav ihu chelum vela ashgach behu kudsha berich hu ad deavdin lehahu chova takkif verave kaavot haagala deihu takkif dela yachil leishtetzaa

Veta chaze kad avid kudsha berich hu dina bechayyave alma af al gav deinnun chatan kamme kudsha berich hu veargezin leh kal yoma la bae leovada lehu mealma vechad ashgach beovadehon itnecham alayehu al deinnun ovde yedoy veorich lon bealma

Uvgin deinnun ovade yedoy natil nechama veitnecham alayehu vechayis alayehu vechad bae lemebad behu dina kivyachol atziv dechevan deovade yedoy innun atziv alayehu kema deatte amer vedachavan la hanel kadamohi

Ketiv hod vehadar lefanav oz vechedva bimkomo amar rabbi yose ta chaze vayyitatztzev el libbo ketiv el libbo atziv vela leatar achora libbo kema deatte amer kaasher bilvavi uvnafshi yaase rabbi yitzchak amar vayyinnachem Adonai kema deatte amer vayinnachem Adonai al haraa asher dibber laasot leammo
Rabbi yesa amar letav rabbi chizkiyya amar levish rabbi yesa amar letav kema deittemar dekudsha berich hu nachim al deinnun ovade yedoy vechayis alayehu vayyitatztzev begin deinnun chatan kammeh

Verabbi chizkiyya amar levish dechad kudsha berich hu bae leovada lechayyave alma natil nichumin alayehu vekabbil nichumin kivyachol keman dimkabbel nichumin al ma deavid kevan dekabbel nichumin vadday dina itavad vela talya milleta bitshuva

Ematay talya bitshuva ad la kabbil tanchumin alayehu ha kabbil tanchumin alayehu la talya milleta bitshuva kelal vedina itavid uchden osif dina al dina veatkif lehahu atar dedina lemebad dina veovid lon lechayyavaya min alma vecholla bakkera dichtiv vayyinnachem Adonai kibbel tanchumin ulvatar vayyitatztzev el libbo yahav tukpa ledina lemebad dina

Rabbi chiyya amar vayyinnachem Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz natal tanchumin vechedva kad avad kudsha berich hu laadam beara deihu kegavena illaa vechal malache illae meshabbechan leh lekudsha berich hu kad chamu leh bediukna illaa veamaru
113: Vattechasserehu meat meelohim vechavod vehadar teatterehu
Levatar kad chata adam itatztzev kudsha berich hu al dechata deyahav pitchon pe lemalache hashsharet deamru kammeh bekadmita kad baa lemivre leh ma enosh ki tizkerennu uven adam ki tifkedennu

Amar rabbi yehuda vayyitatztzev el libbo begin devae lemebad behu dina shenneemar betzet lifne hechalutz veomrim hodu layeya ki leolam chasdo veamar rabbi yitzchak ammay la ketiv hacha ki tov ella begin deovid ovde yedoy kammayehu deyisrael

Kegavena da kad hau yisrael avrin yamma atu malache illae lememar shira kammeh kudsha berich hu behahu lelya amar leh kudsha berich hu uma ovade yaday tavin beyamma veattun amrin shira keden velo karav ze el ze kal hallayela uf hacha bechal zimnin deibud rashshiaya ihu mealma keden atzivu ishtechach alayehu

Rabbi abba amar beshaata dechav kamme kudsha berich hu adam veavar al pikkudoy keden ishtechach atzivu kammeh amar leh kudsha berich hu adam vay dechalshat chela illaa behay shaata itchashchat nehora chad miyyad tarich leh migginta deeden

Amar leh ana aalit lach leginta deeden lekarva karbana veatte pegimat madbecha dela itkerav karbana mikkan ulhala laavod et haadama vegazar aleh mita vechas aleh kudsha berich hu veganiz leh beshaata demit samich leginta

Ma avad adam avad mearta chada veittammar bah hu veitteteh mena yada ella chama chad nehora dakkik ayil behahu atar denafik migginta deeden vetaav teuvteh lekivreh vetamman hu atar samuch litra deginta deeden

Ta chaze la istallak bar nash mealma ad dechame leh leadam harishon shail leh al ma azil mealma vehech nafik hu amar leh vay divginach nefakna mealma vehu ativ leh beri ana avarit al pikkuda chada veitannashit beginah chame atte kamma chovin vechamma pikkudin demarach avarte

Amar rabbi chiyya ad kedo yoma kaim adam harishon vechaze baavahan teren zimnin beoma veode al chovoy veachme lon hahu atar dehava beh bikara illaa veazil vechame kal innun tzaddikayya vechaside denafku minnih veyartu lehahu yekara illaa divginta deeden veavahan kulhon odan veamrin ma yakar chasdecha elohim uvne adam betzel kenafecha yechosaun

Rabbi yesa amar kulhu bene alma chaman leh leadam harishon beshaata demistalleke min alma leachazaa sahaduta divgin chovoy devar nash ihu istallak mealma vela vegineh deadam kema ditninan en mita belo chet

Bar innun telata deistallaku begin hahu eta denachash hakkadmoni veillen innun amram levi uvinyamin veit deamre uf name yishshay dela chavu vela ishtechach alayehu chova dimutun beh bar deadkar alayehu hahu eta denachash kidamaran

Ta chaze kulhon darin dehau beomoy denoach kulhu afshitu chovin al alma beitgalya leenehon decholla rabbi shimon hava azil yoma chad befile ditverya chama beni nesha dehave mekatre bekitra dekashta bekulfa dekansir amar uma chova da beitgalya leargaza lemarehon yahiv enoy behu veitremiyyu lego yamma umitu

Ta chaze kal chova deitavid beitgalya dache lah lishchinta meara uslikat diyyurah mealma illen hau azlin berisha zakif veavde chovayehu beitgalya vedachu lah lishchinta mealma ad dekudsha berich hu dacha lon veaavir lon minneh veal da ketiv hago rasha lifni melech vegv hago siggim mikkesef vegv
Vayyomer Adonai lo yadon ruchi baadam leolam beshaggam hu basar vegv amar rabbi elazar ta chaze kad bera kudsha berich hu alma avad lehay alma leishtammasha
114: Kegavena dilela vechad bene alma innun zakkain deazle beorach meshar kudsha berich hu atar rucha dechayye dilela ad dematu innun chayyin leatar deyaakov sharya beh

Umittamman nagde innun chayyin ad deitmeshich hahu rucha lehay olam dedavid malka sharya beh umittamman nagde birchan lechulhu innun tattae vehahu rucha illaa itnegid veitmeshich letatta veyachlin leitkayema bealma

Uvgine kach leolam chasdo da hu olam dedavid malka uvgin kach ketiv leolam bela vav deha kad hahu rucha itnegid lehahu olam mittamman nafke birchan vechayyin lechola leitkayema hashta dechavu bene nasha istallak kolla begin dela yimte hahu rucha dechayye lehay olam leithannaa minneh tattae ulitkayema beh beshaggam hu basar begin dela yitrak hay rucha lehay olam may tama dela leasgaa nachash tattaa dedargin deyittakkaf beh rucha dikdusha dela yitarav beruach mesaav

Beshaggam hu basar da nachash kadmaa deyitbarach vegin kach hu basar kema deatte amer ketz kal basar ba lefanay veamar rabbi shimon da malach hammavet vehau yamav mea veesrim shana orichu dekustira dekitra

Hannefilim hau baaretz tane rabbi yose illen azza vaazael kema deittemar deappik lon kudsha berich hu mikdushata dilela vei tema vehech yachlu leitkayema behay alma amar rabbi chiyya illen hau meinnun dichtiv veof yeofef al haaretz veha ittemar deillen itchazu livne nasha kechezu dilhon vei tema hech yachlin leithappacha ha ittemar deithappechan lechamma gevanin uvshaata denachte aglimu baavira dealma veitchazzun kivne nasha

Vehane azza vaazael demardu leela veappil lon kudsha berich hu veaglimu beara veitkayemu beh vela yachilu leitpashta minneh ulvatar tau batar neshe alma vead kean yoma da innun kayeme veolfe charshin livne nasha veolidu benin vekaru lehu anakim gibbarin veinnun nefilim ikrun bene elohim veha ittemar

Vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam asher barati meal peni haadama rabbi yose patach ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem ta chaze kad bar nash bae lenakma meachara shatik vela amar midi deilu odeh yistammar vela yachil leh

Aval kudsha berich hu lav hachi avid la avid dina bealma ad deachriz veoda lehu zimna teren utlata begin dela itay deyimche bideh deyema leh ma avadat vela yistammar minneh vela yachil lekayema kammeh
Ta chaze vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam asher barati meal pene haadama oda lon al yeda denoach veatre behon kamma zimnin vela shame batar dela shemau ayete alehon dina veovid lon meal appe ara

Ta chaze ma ketiv beh benoach vayyikra et shemo noach lemor ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu Adonai Adonai Adonai Adonai mena hava yada ella beshaata delayet kudsha berich hu alma dichtiv arura haadama baavurcha amar adam kamme
115: Kudsha berich hu ribbono shel olam ad matay yehe alma belatuta amar leh ad deyityelid lach ben mahul kegavena dilach
Vehau mechakkan ad shaata deityallid noach vechevan deityalid chama leh gazir rashim beat kaddisha vechama shechinta mitdabbeka bahadeh keden kara shemeh al ma deavid levatar

Bekadmita la hau yade lemizra ulmechetzad ulmecherash vehau avde pulchana deara bidayehu kevan deata noach atkin umnuta lehu vechal manin ditzrichin letakna ara lemebad perin hada hu dichtiv ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu umeitzvon yadenu min haadama deihu appik ara mimma deitlatya dehau zarin chittin vekatzrin govin vedardarin uvgine chach ketiv ish haadama

Rabbi yehuda amar ish haadama kema deatte amer ish naomi begin deikre tzaddik veappik lah leara bekarbana deavad mimma deitlatya dichtiv lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam uvgin da ikre ish haadama veal da kera leh shema al ma deyete

Rabbi yehuda patach lechu chazu mifalot elohim asher sam shammot baaretz hay kera ukmuha veittemar aval lechu chazu vegv deillu hau mifalot sam kiyyum baaretz aval begin dehau mifalot shema delohim sam shammot baaretz

Amar leh rabbi chiyya hashta itarat lehay lav ana hachi amina leh begin deven shema da uven shema da kolla hu shevacha aval ana amina leh kema deitaru chavraya deshave shemahan shammot baaretz shemot mammash

Rabbi yitzchak amar kolla hu veafilu ma deamar rabbi yehuda shappir kaamar deillu yehe alma bishma derachame yitkayyam alma aval begin deitbere alma al dina vekayema al dina sam shammot baaretz veshappir hu deilmale kach la yachil alma leitkayema mikkamme chovehon divne nasha

Ta chaze noach kad ityelid karun leh al shema dinchama veleheve shema garim aval kudsha berich hu lav hachi noach behippuch atvan chen kema deatte amer venoach matza chen amar rabbi yose chen hayenu noach betzaddikaya shemehon garim letav bechayyavaya shemehon garim levish benoach ketiv venoach matza chen beene Adonai beer bechor yehuda ithappachu atoy levish er ra ra beene Adonai

Ta chaze kevan deityelid noach chama ovadehon divne nasha deinnun chatan kamme kudsha berich hu vehava ganiz garmeh veishteddal befulchana demareh begin delo lemehach beorchayehu vechi tomar bamma ishtaddal behahu sifra deadam vesifra dechanoch vehava ishtaddal behu lemiflach lemareh
Ta chaze dehachi hu deha noach mena hava yada likrav karbana lemareh ella begin deashkach chachmeta al ma mitkayyem alma veyada deal karbana mitkayyem veilmale karbana la hau kayeme illae vetattae
Rabbi shimon hava azil bearcha vehau immeh rabbi elazar bereh verabbi yose verabbi chiyya ad dehau azle amar rabbi elazar leavuhi archa metakna kamman bainan lemishma mille deorayeta

Patach rabbi shimon veamar gam badderech keshehassachal holech libbo chaser vegv kad bar nash bae leatkana archeh kamme kudsha berich hu ad la yippuk learcha bae leamlacha beh ultzalle kammeh al archeh kema detaninan dichtiv tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav deha shechinta la itparsha minneh
Uman deihu la mehemna bemareh ma ketiv
116: Beh vegam badderech keshehassachal holech libbo chaser man libbo da kudsha berich hu dela yehach immeh bearcha vegara min siyyateh bearcheh begin dehahu bar nash dela meheman beh bemareh ad la yippuk bearcha la bae siyyata demareh

Veafilu bearcha kad ihu azil la ishtaddal bemille deorayeta uvgine chach libbo chaser dela azil bahadeh demareh vela ishtechach bearcheh veomer lakkol sachal hu afillu kad shema milla dimhemnuta demareh hu amar detippeshuta hu leishtaddala beh

Kehay deshailu levar nash al at keyama dirshimu bevisreh devar nash veamar lav ihu mehemnuta shama rav yeva sava veistakkal beh veitavid tilla degarme veanan behay orcha besiyyata dekudsha berich hu bainan lememar mille deorayeta

Patach veamar horeni Adonai darkecha ahallech baamittecha yached levavi leyira shemecha hay kera kashya deha taninan kola hi bida dekudsha berich hu bar lemeheve zakkaa o chayyava vedavid hech tava da meim kudsha berich hu

Ella david hachi kaamar horeni Adonai darkecha hahu orach mishor umtakna legallaa enay ulminda leh ulvatar ahallech baamittecha ehach beorach keshot vela aste leyamina velismala yached levavi man levavi kema deatte amer tzur levavi vechelki vechal da ana tava leyira et shemecha leitdabbeka bedachaltach leistammara orche kedeka yaot leyira shemecha atar chulki deveh sharya dachalta lemidchal

Ta chaze kal bar nash dedachil leh lekudsha berich hu sharya immeh mehemnuta kedeka yeut deha hahu bar nash shelim befulchana demareh uman dela sharya beh dachala demareh la sharya immeh mehemnuta velav ihu keday lemeheve leh chulaka bealma deate

Tu patach veamar veorach tzaddikim keor nogah holech veor ad nechon hayyom zakkain innun tzaddikaya bealma den uvalma deate dekudsha berich hu bae bikarehon ta chaze ma ketiv veorach tzaddikim keor nogah may keor nogah kehahu nehora denahir devara kudsha berich hu beovada divreshit da hu deganiz lon letzaddikaya lealma deate holech veor deihu salik binhoreh tadir vela gara minneh

Aval bechayyavaya ma ketiv derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu lo yadu vechi la yadin ella chayyavaya azle beakimu dearcha behay alma vela baan leistakkela dezammin kudsha berich hu lemedan lehu behahu alma ulaalaa lon bedina degehinnom veinnun tzachin veamrin vay lan dela orichna udnin vela atzitna behahu alma uvchal yoma amre da

Ta chaze zammin kudsha berich hu leanhara lon letzaddikayya lealma deate ulmehav lon agar chulakhon atar deena la shalta lemekam aleh kema deatte amer ayin lo raata elohim zulatecha yaase limchakke lo uchtiv veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi uchtiv veassotem reshaim ki yihu efer tachat kappot raglechem zakkain innun tzaddikaya bealma den uvalma deate alayehu ketiv tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz uchtiv ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
117: Elle toldot noach rabbi chiyya patach veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer zakkain innun yisrael demishtaddele beorayeta veyade archin deorayeta divginah yizkun lealma deate

Ta chaze kal yisrael it lon chulaka lealma deate may tama begin denatrin berit dealma itkayyem aleh kema deatte amer im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti veal da yisrael denatre berit vekabbilu leh it lon chulaka bealma deate

Velo od ella begin chach ikrun tzaddikim mikkan olifna kal man denatir hay berit dealma itkeyyam aleh ikre tzaddik mena lan miyyosef begin denatar leh livrit alma zacha deikre tzaddik veal kach veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz

Rabbi elazar amar elle bechal atar pasal et harishonim taninan vechu ma ketiv leela befarshata divreshit venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan umishsham yippared vegv hahu nahar denagid venafik veayyil leginta veashke leh mishshaku dilela veavid leh nayecha veavid ibin verabbe zarin vehu keden nayecha lechola veda nayecha leh leginta veda avid nayecha beh kema deatte amer ki vo shavat uchtiv vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii veda raza demilla da avid toldot vela achora

Man teva da aron habberit venoach veteva letatta hachi hau kedugma dilela noach ketiv beh berit dichtiv vahakimoti et beriti ittach vegv vead deitkeyyam beh berit la ayil letevuta dichtiv vahakimoti et beriti ittach uvata el hatteva uchden hava teva aron habberit
Teva venoach kolla kegavena dilela uvgin dehay berit leela hu avid toldot kegavena da noach ihu avid toldot begine kach elle toldot noach
Noach ish tzaddik hachi hu vadday kegavena dilela veal da vetzaddik yesod olam ketiv veara al da itkayemat deha ihu ammuda dealma kayema aleh uman ihu da tzaddik venoach ikre tzaddik letatta

Veraza dechola et haelohim hithallech noach dayeka dela itperash minneh lealmin ulmeheve hu beara kegavena dilela ish tzaddik yesoda dealma berit shalom shelama dealma ish haadama vadday veal da venoach matza chen beene Adonai

Tamim haya bedorotav may bedorotav ilen innun denafku minneh hu ashlim lechulhu vehu hava shelim mikkulhu tamim haya deityelid mahul dichtiv hithallech lefanay vehye tamim bedorotav velo bedarin dealma deha minneh nafku

Ta chaze noach itchazze miyyoma deitberi alma lemeheve beteva bechibbura chad ulmeal bah vead la itchabberu kechada la hava alma kedeka yeut levatar ma ketiv umeelle naftza kal haaretz mahu naftza kema deatte amer umishsham yippared demittamman ishtechach piruda veitbaddaru toldot lechal sitrin
Vecholla chad kedugma chada begine chach elle toldot noach elle vadday deha yesoda dealma ihu deavid
118: Toldot lekayema beara ata rabbi abba unshakeh amar arya becheleh tinara nakiv vetavar kach hu vadday vetta chaze mishshiura detevuta uf name hachi hu

Tosefta lamma noach noach tere zimni ella kal tzaddik vtzaddik di bealma it leh teren ruchin rucha chad bealma den vrucha chad bealma deatte vhachi tishkach bechulhu tzaddike moshe moshe yaakov yaakov avraham avraham shemuel shemuel shem shem bar miyyitztzechak dela kettiv beh kema dichtiv behu begin deyitztzechak beshaatta deittekerav al gabbe madbecha nappekatt nishmatteh dehavatt beh behay alma vchevan deittemar beh beavraham barucha mechayye hammettim tavatt beh nishmatteh dealma deatte begin da tishkach dela yiched kudsha bericha hu shemeh ella al yitztzechak begin deittechashav kemett veal da ramaz kera vamar hen bikdoshav lo yaamin

Davar acher elle toldott begin dehava tzaddik shabbach leh tere zimni tamim haya bedorottav aval bedarin acharanin eno necheshav lichlum kemo dara deavraham vdara demoshe vdara dedavid davar acher chame may avad bedara dechulhu chayyavim kal vachomer illu haya bedara dechulhu tzaddikim

Rabbi elazar patach lechu chazu mifalot Adonai asher sam shammot baaretz hay kera ha ittemar veukmuha aval lechu chazu may chazu kema deatte amer chazut kashe hugad li beovadoy dekudsha berich hu avid itgeli nevua illaa livni nasha asher sam shammot shemot vadday deha shema garim lecholla

Ketiv vayyikra et shemo noach lemor ze vegv ammay hacha lemor veammay ze ella lemor da itteta ze da tzaddik ketiv hacha ze yenachamenu uchtiv hatam ze Adonai kivinu lo zakkain innun tzaddikaya dirshimin birshimu degushpanka demalka lemehve bishmeh reshimin veihu shave shemahan beara kedeka yeut

Ketiv vayyikra et shemo noach uchtiv vayyikra shemo yaakov ammay la ketiv et ella hatam darga achara vehacha darga ochara Adonai kedichtiv vaere et Adonai vaere Adonai la ketiv ella et Adonai uf hacha benoach vayyikra et shemo noach vayyikra shemo yaakov darga dileh kudsha berich hu mammash kara leh yaakov aval hacha et leitkelala shechinta

Elle toldot noach vegv rabbi yehuda patach tov ish chonen umalve yechalkel devarav bemishpat tov ish da kudsha berich hu deikre tov kema dichtiv tov Adonai lakkol uchtiv Adonai ish milchama lehay kol chonen umalve leatar delet leh middileh vehahu atar minneh ittezan yechalkel devarav bemishpat deha hahu davar la ittezan ella bemishpat kema deatte amer tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha

Davar acher tov ish da tzaddik dichtiv imru tzaddik ki tov ki peri maallehem yochelu rabbi yose amar da noach dichtiv noach ish tzaddik rabbi yitzchak amar da shevacha deshabbat deveh patach tov dichtiv tov lehodot la
Rabbi chiyya amar kolla chad vechulhu milla chada amru veda avid toldot bealma toldot dealma man innun illen nishmathon detzaddikaya deinnun iba deovadoy dekudsha berich hu

Rabbi shimon amar beshaata dekudsha berich hu mitatter beitroy mitatter meela umittatta meela meatar deamika decholla mitatter mittatta bamme benishmathon detzaddikaya keden ittosaf chayyim meela umittatta veitkelil atar makdesha mikkal sitrin uvera itmalya veyamma ishtelim uchden yahav lecholla

Ketiv shete mayim mibborcha venozlim mittoch beercha ammay borcha bekadmita ulvatar beercha deha bor la ikre ella rekanya dela nevia beer mayin denavin ella kola atar chad hu ella atar demiskene achidan beh ikre bor delet leh middileh ella ma deyahavin begaveh uman ihu
Levatar itavid beer deihu nevia umalya mikkal sitrin uman ihu itmalya meela
119: Unvia mittatta itmalya meela kema deamaran unvia mittatta minnishmathon detzaddikaya

Davar acher shete mayim mibborcha da david malka dichtiv beh mi yashkeni mayim mibbor bet lechem it man deyemar venozlim da yitzchak mittoch da moshe deihu beemtzaita beercha da aharon deitkere beer mayim chayyim veddavid malka deitchabbar imhon venozlim da avraham mittoch da yaakov deihu beemtzaita beercha da yitzchak deikre beer mayim chayyim ha behay kera ishtechach reticha kaddisha illaa meavahan vedavid malka itchabbar imhon

Tiuvta denukva legabbe dechura lav ihu ella kad ayyil rucha vah veashdat mayya lekivla mayyin illain dechurin kach keneset yisrael la itarat tiuvta legabbe kudsha berich hu ella berucha detzaddikaya dealin begavah uchden navin mayya miggavah lekivla mayyin didchura vecholla itavid tiuvta chada utzrora chada vekishshura chada veda hu raava decholla vetiyyula dimtayyel kudsha berich hu benishmathon detzaddikaya

Ta chaze kal innun toldot deginta deeden la nafkin mitztzaddik ella kad ayyil behay teva bechibbura chada vecholla genizin bah ulvatar minah nafkin uf hacha noach ish tzaddik la appik toldot lemifre bealma ad deal latteva veitkenash kolla bah vehau genizin bah ulvatar minnah nafku lemifre bealma ulitkayema beara veilmale denafku miggo teva la itkayemu bealma

Vecholla kegavena dilela miggo teva nafke leela miggo teva nafke letatta da kegavena da vehacha itkeyyam alma vela mikkadmat dena divgine chach ketiv venozlim mittoch beercha uchtiv vayyoled noach shelosha vanim
Vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim amar rabbi yehuda kevan dichtiv vattishshachet haaretz ammay lifni haelohim ella kevan deavadu chovehon beitgalleya leenehon decholla keden lifne haelohim ketiv

Rabbi yose amar ana ifcha amarit vattishshachet haaretz lifni haelohim bekadmita lifne haelohim dela hau avde beitgalleya lifne haelohim avadu vela lifne bene nesha ulvasof avadu beitgalleya hada hu dichtiv vattimmale haaretz chamas dela hava atar bechal ara dela hava beitgalleya uvgin kach bitre gavene amar kera

Elle toldot noach rabbi abba amar miyyoma deavar adam al pekuda demareh kal bene alma deityallidu levatar ikrun bene haadam vela lishvacha ikrun hachi ella keman deamar benoy dehahu deavar al pekuda demareh
Kevan deata noach ikrun bene alma al shemeh denoach toldot noach leshivcha dekaim lon bealma vela toldot deadam deaavur lon mealma vegarim mota lechulhu

Amar leh rabbi yose i hachi ha ketiv levatar vayyered Adonai lirot et hair veet hammigdal asher banu beni haadam bene haadam ketiv vela ketiv bene noach amar leh begin deadam kamme mareh tav leh dela ivre vela yichtov aleh hay kera

Ella ta chaze ketiv ben chacham yesammach av kad bera tav kal beni alma dachrin leh leavoy letav vechad ihu bish kolla dachrin leh leavoy levish adam begin dechata veavar al pekuda demareh kad atu innun demardu bemarehon ma ketiv asher banu bene haadam benoy deadam kadmaa demarad bemareh veavar al pekudeh
Uvgine chach elle toldot noach elle vela kadmae elle denafku vealu go teva veappiku toldin lealmin vela toldot adam denafak migginta deeden vela appik lon mittamman

Ta chaze illu appik adam toldot migginta deeden la yishtetzun ledare darin vela itchashshach nehora desihara lealmin vechulhu hau kayemin lealmin veafilu malache illai la kayeme kamayehu binhora veziva vechachmeta kema deatte amer betzelem elohim bara oto aval kevan degarim
120: Cheta venafak ihu migginta deeden veavad toldot levar la itkayemu bealma vela havi kedeka chaze

Amar rabbi chizkiyya veche hech yachlin lemebad toldot tamman deha illemale la itmeshich aleh yetzer hara vechata itkeyyam ihu bealma bilchodoy vela yaavid toldot kegavena da illemale dechavu yisrael beegla veamshichu alayehu yetzer hara la avadu toldot lealmin vela yetun darin achoranin lealma

Amar leh ilmale lo chata adam la avid toldot kegavena da missitra deyetzer hara aval avid toldot missitra derucha kaddisha dehashta la avid toldot ella missitra deyetzer hara uvgin dechal toldot divne nasha kulhu missitra deyetzer hara begin kach let lon kiyyum vei efshar lon leitkayema desitra achora itarav behu

Aval illemale la chata adam vela ittarach migginta deeden hava avid toldot missitra deruach kudsha dekaddishin kemalache illain kayemin ledare darin kegavena dilela kevan dechata veolid benin levar migginta deeden vela zacha leappaka lon migginta la itkayemu afillu leishterasha bealma da ad deata noach deihu tzaddik veal batteva umin teva nafku kal darin dealma umittamman itbadderu lechal arba ruche alma

Vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinni nishchata ammay nishchata begin ki hishchit kal basar et darko kema deittemar rabbi chiyya patach kera veamar vayyar elohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa ta chaze beshaata divne nasha zachan venatre pikkude deorayeta keden ara ittakfat vechal chedu ishtakkechat bah may tama begin dishchinta sharya al ara uchden kolla illae vetattae bechedva vechad bene nasha mechabbelan archayehu vela natre pekude orayeta vechatan kamme marihon uchden kivyachol dachyan lah lishchinta mealma veishtearat ara mechabbela deha shechinta itdachya vela sharya alah uchden itchabbelat may taama itchabbelat begin desharya rucha achora alah dimchabbela alma veal da amrinan deyisrael yahave oz lelohim dimkayemin alma elohim da shechinta

Veim chas veshalom i yisrael yishtakkechu chayyavin ma ketiv ruma al hashshamayim elohim vegv mishshum dereshet hechinu lifamay kafaf nafshi besivat chamas vesinat chinnam karu lefanay shucha vegv kegavena dedor hammabbul divgin chamas dehavat benehon hava benehon sina udvavu

Yachol af veara deyisrael ken veha taninan ara deyisrael la sharya alah rucha achora vela memanna achora bar kudsha berich hu bilchodoy ta chaze deara deyisrael hachi hu dela sharya alah memanna vela shelicha achora bar kudsha berich hu bilchodoy aval shaata chada sharya alah lechabbela beni nasha menalan middavid dichtiv vayyar david et malach Adonai vecharbo shelufa beyado netuya al yerushala uchden itchabbalat ara

Amar rabbi elazar afillu behahi shaata kudsha berich hu hava ketiv hacha malach Adonai uchtiv hatam hammalach haggoel oti uchtiv vayyissa malach haelohim hen letav vehen levish kudsha berich hu shallit alah letav begin dela itmassera techot shear memannan vechal dayere alma yichsefun min ovadayehu levish begin dela yechodun innun leshaltaa alah
Vei tema veha ketiv ki raata goyim bau mikdashah vecharivu beta vei lav shaltin innun memannan la itcharav makdesha ta chaze ketiv ki atta asita uchtiv asa Adonai et asher zamam

Ta chaze ketiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata nishchata vadday kema deittemar hachi name vayyar elohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa deha keden ara karat leela vesalka bisliku illaa umkashta anpaha kenukva dimkashta legabbe dechura hachi name ara deha gedilat benin zakkain lemalka

Vehacha dela tavu dara detofana ma ketiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata vegv keitteta deistaavat veastirat anpaha mibbaalah uvzimna deasgiu chove beni nasha beitgalleya ara shavita anpaha kenukva delet lah kissufa mikkolla kema deatte amer vehaaretz chanfa tachat yoshveha veal da vayyar ki nishchata vadday may taama begin ki hishchit kal
121: Rabbi elazar azal legabbeh derabbi yose berabbi shimon ben lakonya chamoy kevan dechama leh atkin leh tufsita dekumra bematun dekulfa vitivu amar leh chamoy efshar deshamate meavuch hay dichtiv asa Adonai asher zamam bitztza emrato asher tziva mime kedem

Amar leh ha ukmuha chavraya bitztza emrato devaza porpira dileh asher tziva mime kedem deha porpira pakid lah meinnun yome kadmae illae uvoma deitchariv be makdesha baza lah begin dehay porpira ihi yekara dileh vetikuna dileh uvaza leh

Amar leh asa Adonai asher zamam vechi malka chashiv leavasha livnoy ad la yetun lemechte amar leh lemalka dehava leh man yekar uvchal yoma hava dachil aleh dela yitbar vehava mistakkel beh vetakkin beenoy leomin ata bereh veargiz leh lemalka netal malka hahu man yekar utvar leh hada hu dichtiv asa Adonai asher zamam

Ta chaze min yoma deitbene be makdesha hava kudsha berich hu mistakkel beh vechaviv aleh sagge vehava dachil alayehu deyisrael deyechotun vicharev be makdesha vechen bechal zimna dehava ate legabbe be makdesha hava lavish hahu porpira levatar degarmu chovin veargizu kamme malka itcharav be makdesha uvaza hahu porpira hayenu dichtiv asa Adonai asher zamam

Adonai hayenu bezimna deitchariv be makdesha aval bezimna ochara let chedva kamme kudsha berich hu kezimna deitavidu chayyave alma veinnun deargizu kammeh hada hu dichtiv uvaavod reshaim rinna vechen bechal dara vedara deavid dina bechayyave alma chedva vetushbachta kamme kudsha berich hu

Vei tema ha taninan delet chedva kamme kudsha berich hu kad ihu avid dina bechayyavaya ella ta chaze beshaata deitavid dina bechayyavaya chedvan vetushbechan kammeh al deitavidu mealma vehanne mile kad mata hahu zimna deorich lon vela tavan legabbeh mechovayehu aval i itavid behu dina ad la mata zimnayehu ki lo shalem aon haemori ad henna keden let chedva kameh uvaish kammeh al deitavidu

Vei tema ihu ad la matu zimnayehu ammay avid behu dina ella innun garmin bisha legarmayehu deha kudsha berich hu la avid behu dina ad la mata zimnayehu ella begin demishtattefe bahadayehu deyisrael leavasha lon uvgin kach avid behu dina veovid lon mealma bela zimna veda hu deavish kammeh uvgin kach atba mitzrae beyamma veovid sanehon deyisrael bime yehoshafat vechen kulhu deha beginehon deyisrael itavidu bela zimna

Aval kad ishtelim zimna deorich lon vela tavu keden chedva vetushbachta kammeh al deitavidu mealma bar bezimna deitchariv be makdesha deaf al gav deishtelim zimna dilhon deargizu kammeh la hava chedva kammeh umehahu zimna la hava chedva leela vetatta

Ki leyamim od shiva anochi mamtir al haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layela vegv rabbi yehuda amar hani arbaim yom vearbaim layela may avidtayehu ella arbaim yom lealkaa chayyave alma uchtiv arbaim yakkennu lo yosif lakovel arba sitre alma lechal chad asara begin debbar nash mearba sitre alma itbere veal da umachiti et kal hayekum veitzterich arbaim lealkaa ulitmeche alma
Rabbi yitzchak hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon amar leh hay kera dichtiv vattishshachet haaretz
122: Lifni haelohim i bene nasha chatan ara bemma amar leh begin dichtiv ki hishchit kal basar et darko kema deittemar kegavena da vattitma haaretz vaefkod aonah aleha ella bene nasha chatan vei tema ara bemma ella ikkera deara bene nasha innun veinnun mechabbelin ara vehi itchabbalat ukra ochach dichtiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata ki hishchit kal basar et darko al haaretz

Ta chaze kal chetoy devar nash kulhu chabbaluta dileh talyan bitshuva vecheta deoshid zara al ara umchabbela archeh veappik zara al ara mechabbil leh umchabbil ara vealeh ketiv nichtam aonich lefanay uchtiv beh ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra bar bitshuva sagge uchtiv vayehi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai vayemitehu Adonai veha ittemar

Amar leh ammay dain kudsha berich hu alma bemaya vela beesha vela bemilla achora amar leh raza hu deha innun chabbilu archayehu begin demayin ilain umayin tattain la itchabbaru dechar venukva kedeka yeut uman illen mayyin illain bina umayyin tattain malchut illaa tattaa vechad innun mechabbelin istalak dehu dechar veishtaar
Nivkeu kal mayenot tehom rabba ha mayin tattain vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu da mayin illain mayin illain vetattain

Rabbi chiyya verabbi yehuda hau azle bearcha umatu legabbe turin ravrevan veashkachu bene turaya garme bene nasha dehau meinnun beni tofana ufasu telat mea pesian begarma chada tevahu amru hayenu deamru chavrana deinnun la hau missettafe middina dekudsha berich hu kema dichtiv vayyomru lael sur mimmennu vedaat derachecha lo chafatznu ma avdu hau setimin beraglayehu mabbue tehoma umayin nafkin retichan vela yachilu lemekam behu ad dehau nishmatin unfalu beara umayetin

Vayyoled noach shelosha vanim vegv amar rabbi chiyya lerabbi yehuda ta veema lach mille deshamana behay metal levar nash deail lenukva dimarya bezimna chada venafke teren o telata benin chad mitparsha meachora bearchoy beovadoy da zakkaa veda chayyava veda benoni uf hacha name telat kitre derucha azlin veshatan veitkelilan bitlat almin

Ta chaze nishmata nafkat veail ben ture piruda veitchabbar rucha benishmata nachit letatta itchabbar nefesh beruach vechulhu umitchabberin da im da amar rabbi yehuda nefesh veruach kelilan da im da nishmeta sharya bearchoy devar nash vehi medora temira dela ityeda atraha

Ata bar nash leitdakkaa mesayein leh benishmeta kaddisha vedachan leh umkaddeshin leh veikre kadosh la zacha vela ate leitdakkaa teren dargin petichin deinnun nefesh veruach beh nishmeta kaddisha let beh vela od ella dei yistaav mesaavin leh vesiyyua dilela aadiu mineh mikkan ulhala kal chad lefum archeh

Tosefta keture ramay dekastore dehustera anan pettichan ayenin pettichan udnin kal min kalaya nachit meela lettatta mettabbar turin vtinnarin man innun dechaman vela chaman atimin udnin settimin ayenin la chaman vla shamin la yadin besuchlettanu chad dichlila bitteren begayehu dachyan leh levar
Innun mitteddabbekan ven beinnun tere chad umana deumana la sharya begavayehu la alin ben sippere kaddishin kal innun deumana da la
123: Sharya begavayehu la ichtevu besippere dachranaya ittemechun misippera dechayye kema deatte amer yimmachu misepper chayyim veim tzaddikim al yikkattevu

Lon kad yippekun mehay alma lon man yittebba lon kad yittemasrun bida deduma vtokdun benura dedalik vela yippekun minneh bar beresh yarche vshabbatte kema deatte amer vhaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbatt beshabbatto yavo chal basar lehishtachaott leppanay amar Adonai levattar karoza devistar tzappon achriz alayehu vamar yashuvu reshaim lishola vegv kamma chavile terikin ittekkanshu alayehu bearba sitrin esha melahata bege ben hinnom

Telatt zimnin beoma mitteppakdan vela od ella bezimna deyisrael attivu bekol ram amen yehe shemeh rabba mevaracha kudsha bericha hu ittemele rachamin vechayis al kolla vramiz lemalacha dimmanna al tare degehinnom shemeh uttelatt mappettechan bideh uppettach telatt tarin devistar madbera vechaman nehora dehay alma atta tenana denura vsattim orchin

Keden telatt memannan dittechott yedayehu telatt magroppin menashvan bidayehu vattivu tenana leatterayehu vravechin lon shaatta uppalgutt shaatta ulvattar tayevin leeshayehu vechen telatt zimnin beoma uvchal zimnin deamre yisrael amen yehe shemeh rabba mevaracha vchu innun ravechin lon zakkain innun tzaddikaya deorchehon menahara behahu alma lechal sitrin kema deatte amer vorach tzaddikim keor nogah holecha vor ad nechon hayyom

Rabbi abba amar baggehinnam it medorin al medorin tinyanin telitain ad sheva veha ukmuha chavraya vezakkain innun tzaddikaya deinnun mistammerin mechove chayyavaya vela azle bearchayehu vela mistaave behu vechal man deistaav kad azil lehahu alma nachit laggehinnom venachit ad medora tattaa

Utren medorin innun dismichin da im da sheol vaavaddon man denachit lishol dayenin leh tamman umkabbel ansheh usliku leh limdora achora illaa vechen darga batar darga ad deinnun salkin leh aval man denachit laavaddon la salkin leh lealmin uvgin kach ikre avaddon deha avid hu mikkolla

Ta chaze noach zakkaa hava atre bivne dareh vela hau shame leh ad dekudsha berich hu ayete alayehu dina degehinnom may dina degehinnom esha vetalga maya veesha da tzenina veda reticha vechulhu bedina degehinnom itdanu veitavidu mealma
Ulvatar itkeyyam alma kedeka chaze leh veal noach batteva veail bah kal zina vezina dealma vadday noach etz ose peri hava venafku min teva kal zeyane alma kegavena dilela

Ta chaze kad hay etz ose peri itchabbar beetz peri kal innun zayenin dilela chevan ravrevan uzeran vechamma zayenin vechal chad lezineh kema deatte amer chayyot ketannot im gedolot kegavena da noach batteva vechulhu nafku min tevuta veitkeyyam alma kegavena dilela uvgine chach noach ish haadama ikre noach ish tzaddik ikre veha ukmuha

Rabbi chiyya amar telat mea shenin ad la ate tofana hava noach atre behu al ovadehon vela hau shamin leh ad dekudsha berich hu ashlim zimna deorich lon veitavidu mealma ta chaze ma ketiv leela vayehi ki hechel haadam larov al pene haadama uvanot yuldu lahem vehau azlin artilain leenehon decholla ma ketiv vayyiru bene haelohim et benot haadam vegv veda hava yesoda veikkara lemegad bechovehon ad degarim lon leishtetzaa mealma uvgin kach itmashchan batar yetzer hara uvgizoy vesharshoy vedachu mehemnuta kaddisha mibbenayehu veistaavu kema deittemar begin kach ketz kal basar ba lefanay laalafa kategorya alayehu

Vayyomer elohim el noach ketz kal basar ba lefanay rabbi yehuda patach hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi eda me chadel ani amar david kamme kudsha berich hu teren kitztzin innun chad leyamina vechad lismala veinnun teren orchin lemehach behu bene nasha lehahu alma ketz leyamina dichtiv leketz hayyamin veketz lismala dichtiv ketz sam lachoshech ulchal tachlit hu choker may ulchal tachlit bezimna dedina sharya al alma leshetzaa even ofel vetzalmavet ketz sam lachoshech da malach hamavet da nachash ketz kal basar ketz sam lachoshech deha misitra dehittucha dedahava kaate ulchal tachlit bezimna dedina sharya al alma hu choker lemehve kategorya lealma leachshacha appehon dibberayeta vechu
124: Ketz leyamina kidkaamaran dichtiv leketz hayyamin amar leh kudsha berich hu ledaniyyel veatta lech lakketz vetanuach amar leh menucha behay alma o behahu alma amar leh behahu alma kema deatte amer yanuchu al mishkevotam amar leh bezimna dikumun meafra ekum benayehu o lav amar leh vetaamod amar leh ha yedana di yekumun kittot kittot minnehon dezakkae keshot uminnehon dechayyave alma vela yedana im man minnehon ekum amar leh legoralcha amar leh ha amarte veatta lech lakketz it ketz leyamina veit ketz lismala vela yedana lean ketz leketz hayyamin o leketz hayyamim amar leh leketz hayyamin

Uf hacha david amar leh lekudsha berich hu hodieni Adonai kitztzi ma ihu chulak advi vela nach dateh ad deitbassar deyehve leyamina dichtiv shev limini ta chaze uf kudsha berich hu amar leh lenoach ketz kal basar ba lefanay man ihu da ketz deachshach appayehu divriyyata deihu ketz kal basar

Ba lefanay mikkan olifna chayyave alma makdimin leh umashchan leh alayehu leachshacha lon dechevan deyahave leh reshuta natil nishmata vela natil ad deyahave leh reshuta veal da ba lefanay lemetal reshu leachshacha appayehu divne alma uvgine chach vehinneni mashchitam et haaretz veal da ase lecha tevat atze gofer begin leishtezava vela yachil leshaltaa alach

Ta chaze taninan bezimna demota it bemata o bealma la yitchaze bar nash beshuka begin deit leh reshu limchabbela lechabbala kolla begine chach amar leh kudsha berich hu bae lach leistamra vela techoze garmach kamme dimchabbela dela yishlot alach
