Vei tema man yahiv hacha mechabbela deha mayin hau veitgabbaru ta chaze let lach dina bealma o kad itmache o kad itmasar alma bedina dela ishtechach hahu mechabbela deazil bego innun dinin deitavidu bealma uf hachi hacha tofana hava umchabbela azil bego tofana veihu ikre hachi deitkelil bishma da veal da amar kudsha berich hu lenoach letamra garmeh vela yitchaze bealma

Vei tema hay tevuta itchaze bego hay alma umchabbela azil begaveyh kal zimna dela yitchaze appe debbar nash kamme mechabbela la yachil leshaltaa aleh menalan mimmitzrayim dichtiv veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker may tama begin deihu ishtekkach veyachil hu lechabbela velo itzterich leitchazzaa kammeh begin kach hava ganiz noach vechal innun deimmeh betevuta umchabbela la yachil leshaltaa alayehu

Rabbi chiyya verabbi yose hau azle bearcha iara behanne ture dekardu chamu reshimin bekiin bearcha dehau min yome detofana amar leh rabbi chiyya lerabbi yose hanne bekiin dehau miyyomoy detofana vekudsha berich hu shavik lon ledare darin begin dela yitmache chovehon derashshiaya kammeh

Dechacha archoy dekudsha berich hu lezakkain deavdin reuteh bae deyidkerun lehu leela vetatta vela yitneshe duchranehon ledare darin letav kegavena da lerashshiaya dela avdin reuteh begin dela yitneshe chovayehu uladkara anshayehu vedachranehon levish ledare darin hayenu dichtiv nichtam aonech lefanay vegv

Patach rabbi yose veamar tzahali kolech bat gallim hakshivi layesha aniyya anatot hay kera ukmuha chavraya aval hay kera al keneset yisrael ittemar tzahali kolech bat gallim beratteh deavraham avinu hachi ukmuha bat gallim kedichtiv gal naul gallim innun nehorin demitkanshe veazle vealin legavah umalyan lah kedichtiv shelachayich pardes rimmonim

Hakshivi layesha kema deatte amer layish oved mibbeli teref layish dechar layesha nukva ammay ikre layish i mishshum dichtiv layish gibbor babbehema o mishshum dichtiv layish oved mibbeli taref ella kolla ihu layish gevura tattaa udate miggevura illaa layish oved mibbeli taref beshaata deinnun nechalin mistalkin vela alin legavah keden itkere layesha deavidat mibbeli teref dichtiv layish oved mibbeli
125: Uma deamar layesha hayenu aniyya anatot missekkena demiskenuta kema deatte amer min hakkohanim asher baanatot uchtiv anatot lech al sadecha may irya ella kal zimna dedavid malka hava kayyam istallak evyatar beutra uvcholla levatar amar leh shelomo anatot lech al sadecha

Ammay kare leh shelomo hachi ella amar leh beomach hava abba bemiskenu vehashta lech al sadecha hashta it lomar ammay ikre evyatar anatot i tema dehava min anatot ha taninan dichtiv vayyimmalet ben echad laachimelech ben achituv ushmo evyatar vehu minnov hava deha nov ir hakkohanim hava veaf al pi deamru dehi nov hi anatot veammay lah ikre anatot begin denachatat lemiskenu veitavid karta al yeda deshaul veitavidu kahani ella anatot kefar hava velav hu nov veal da kare leh evyatar anatot begin deamar vechi hitannita bechol asher hitanna avi umikkarta denov hava veal miskenu dedavid dehava beomoy ikre leh hachi

Amar rabbi chiyya bemiskenuta hava alma miyyoma deavar adam al pikkude kudsha berich hu ad deata noach vekariv karban veityeshav alma amar rabbi yose la ityeshav alma vela nafka ara mizzuhama denachash ad dekayemu yisrael al tura desinay veitachidu beilana dechayye keden ityeshav alma

Veilmale dehadru yisrael vechavu kammeh kudsha berich hu la hau metin lealmin deha itpassak minnayehu zuhama denachash kevan dechavu keden itbaru innun luche kadmae dehau behu cheru decholla cheru dehahu nachash deihu ketz kal basar

Vechad kamu levae lekatla ketala keden itar chiveya bisha vehava azil kammayehu vela yachil leshaltaa behu begin dehau yisrael mizdarzin kulhu bechagiru mezayenan vela yachil hahu nachash leshaltaa behu vechevan deamar lemoshe veatta hored edyecha mealecha ityehiv reshu lehay nachash leshaltaa alayehu

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyitnatztzelu bene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev vayyitnatztzelu vayenatztzelu mibbae leh ella vayyitnatztzelu al yeda deachara begin deityehiv reshu lenachash leshaltaa et edyam mehar chorev dekibbelu mittura dechorev kad ityehiv orayeta leyisrael

Amar rabbi chiyya noach dehava tzaddik ammay la hava batil mota mealma ella begin dead la salkat zuhama mealma veod deinnun la hau mehemnin beh bekudsha berich hu vechulhu achidan betarpe ilana letatta umitlabbeshan beruach mesaova

Vetu levatar osfu lemechote ulmehach batar yetzer hara kad bekadmita veorayeta kaddisha deihi ilana dechayye akkatte la nachit lah kudsha berich hu beara vetu deihu amshich leh bealma levatar dichtiv vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch aholo veha ittemar

Ad dehau azle chamu chad yuday dehava ate amar rabbi yose hay bar nash yuday ihu veitchaze kad mata gabbayehu sheilu leh amar lon shelicha demitzva ana deha anan dayere bichfar deramin umate zimna dechag veanan tzerichin lulav vezinin deimmeh veana azil lekata lon lemitzva azlu kechada
Amar lehu hahu yuday hanni arba minin delulav debbechulho atan leratzuye alma shematun ammay anan tzerichin lon bachag amar leh kevar itaru behu chavraya aval i milla chadta ihu techot yedach ema lah

Amar lon vadday hahu atar deanan dayere beh hu zeer vechulhu aske beorayeta veit alan tzurva merabbanan rabbi yitzchak bar yose mechozaa shemeh uvchal yoma veoma amar lan millin chadtin beorayeta veamar deha bechag zimna hu leshaltaa Adonai innun shear ammin innun ravrevin memannan al shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot umitbarchan missitrayehu deyisrael vekarinan lon mayim hazzedonim kema deatte amer hammayim hazzedonim
Uvgin leshaltaa alayehu atena beraza dishma kaddisha beinnun arba minin shebballulav leratztzuye leh lekudsha berich hu ulshaltaa
126: Alayehu beraza dishma kaddisha ulatara alan mayin kaddishin lenascha al gabbe madbecha
Tu amar lon berosh hashshana itaruta kadmaa ihu bealma may itaruta kadmaa da be dina diltatta deitar lemedan alma vekudsha berich hu yativ al alma bedina vedain alma

Veshalta hay be dina lemedan alma ad yoma dechippure denaharin anpaha vela ishtechach chiveya daltora bealma deihu itassak bame deatyan leh hahu sair deihu missitra deruach mesaova kedeka chaze leh uvgin deitassak behahu sair la kariv lemakdesha

Vesair da kehahu sair derosh chodesh deitassak beh veanhiru anpaha derosh hashana veal da yisrael kulhu mashkechin rachame kamme kudsha berich hu veitavar chovayehu veraza chada amar lon vela ityehiv reshu legallaa bar lechaside kaddishin elonin chakkimin amar rabbi yose man ihu amar lon ad la badikna bechu

Azlu levatar amar lon kad sihara itkerivat beshimsha atar kudsha berich hu sitra detzafon veachid bah birchimu umashich lah legabbeh vedarom itar missitra achora vesihara salka umitchabbera bemizrach uchden yanka mitteren sitrin untilat birchan bachashay uchden itbarcha sihara veitmalya vehacha itkerivat itteta bevaalah

Kema deit raza diukna shayefe deadam vetikunoy hachi name it raza dediukna deshayefe nukva vetikkuni denukva vecholla parish begavan hachi name it leela achid bah veitar lakovel birchimu hachi name it letatta raza vetikkuna deadam tattaa achora techot sihara

Kema didroa semala leela achid bah veitar lekovlah birchimu hachi name it letatta hay nachash ihu deroa semala deruach mesaova veachid beh man derachiv beh vekarava legabbe desihara umashich lah benayehu bidviku dekutfa veistaovat
Uchden yisrael letatta mekarvin sair vehahu nachash itmeshach avatreh dehahu sair vesihara itdechiat vesalkat leela veitkesharat leela leitbarcha unhirin anpaha ma deitchashchat letatta

Keden hacha beoma dechippure kevan dehahu chiveya bisha itassak behahu sair sihara itparshat minneh veitassekat leolafa alayehu sanegorya vesochechet alayehu keimma al benin vekudsha berich hu barich lon milleela umachil lon

Levatar yisrael kad matu lachag mitare sitra deyamina leela begin deyitkashshar beh sihara veyitnehiru anpaha kedeka chaze uchden palgat chulaka devirchan lechal innun memannan diltatta deyitassekun bechulakhon vela yetun leyanka ulkarava besitra dechulakhon deyisrael

Kegavena da letatta kad shear amin itbarchun kulhon innun mitassekin beachsanat chulakhon vela hau atyan leitarva bahadayehu deyisrael ulchamda chulak achsantehon uvgin kach yisrael innun mashchin birchan lechal innun memannan begin deyitassekun bechulakhon vela yitarvun bahadayehu

Vechad sihara itmele birchan leela kedeka yeut yisrael atyan veyankin minah bilchodayehu veal da ketiv bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem may atzeret ketargumo kenishu kal ma dichnishu meinnun birchan illain la yankin minneh ammin achoranin bar yisrael bilchodayehu uvgin kach ketiv atzeret tihye lachem lachem vela lishar ammin lachem vela lishar memannan

Veal da innun meratztzin al hammayim lemehav lon chulak birchan deyitassekun beh vela yitarvun levatar bechedvata deyisrael kad yankin birchan illain veal hahu yoma ketiv dodi li vaani lo dela itarav ochara bahadan
Lemalka dezamman rechimoy bisudata illaa deavid leh leoma reshima ha rechimoy demalka yeda demalka
127: Itrae beh amar malka hashta ana bae lemechede im rechimay vedachilna dechad ana bisudata im rechimay yaalun kal innun kastore memannan vitivun immana liftora lemisad seudata dechedva im rechimay ma avad akdim hahu rechimoy kusturin diroke uvisra detore veakriv kammayehu deinnun kasture memannan lemechal levatar yativ malka im rechimoy lehahi seudata illaa mikkal iddunin dealma uvod deihu bilchodoy im malka shail leh kal tzarkoy veyahiv leh veachade malka im rechimoy bilchodohi vela itarvin achoranin benayehu kach yisrael im kudsha berich hu begin kach ketiv bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem

Amru rabbi yose verabbi chiyya kudsha berich hu atkin orcha kamman zakkain innun demishtaddele beorayeta ate neshakuhu kara aleh rabbi yose vechal banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich kad matu be chakal yativu amar hahu bar nash may shena dichtiv vayeya himtir al sedom veal amora vegv umay shena betofana dichtiv elohim elohim bechal atar vela ketiv vayeya

Ella taninan bechal atar dichtiv vayeya hu uvet dino elohim setam dina bilchodoy ella bisdom itavid dina vela leshetzaa alma uvgin kach itarev ihu bahade dina aval betofana kal alma shatze vechal innun deishtakkachu bealma

Vei tema noach udimmeh satim maayana hava dela itchaze veal da kal ma deishtechach bealma shatze leh veal da vayeya beitgalya vela shatze cholla elohim bae setimu uvae leistammera deha kolla shatze veal da elohim bilchodoy have
Veraza da Adonai lammabbul yashav mahu yashav ilmale kera ketiv la yachlinan lememar yashav bilchodoy dela atya im dina ketiv hacha yashav uchtiv hatam badad yeshev bilchodoy
Uvgin denoach hava satim maayana levatar kad itavid dina veshatze alma venach rugzeh ma ketiv vayyizkor elohim et noach vegv deha kad shatze alma la idkar desatim maayana hava

Veraza olifna kudsha berich hu satim vegalya galya hu be dina diltatta satim hu atar dechal birchan nafke mittamman uvgin kach kal milloy devar nash deinnun bistimu birchan sharyan aloy vechal deinnun beitgalleya hahu atar deve dina sharyan aloy begin deihu atar beitgele vehahu deikre ra ayin shallit aleh vecholla hu beraza illaa kegavena dilela

Bacha rabbi yose veamar zakkaa dara derabbi shimon sharya begaveh deha zechuta dileh azmin lan beture millin illain keillen amar rabbi yose hay bar nash leodaa lan millin illen ka ate veshadreh kudsha berich hu legabban kad atu vesidderu millin kammeh derabbi shimon amar vadday shappir ka amar

Vrabbi elazar hava yativ yoma chad kammeh derabbi shimon avuy amar leh hay ketz kal basar ithanne meinnun karbanin dehau yisrael mekarvin al gabbe madbecha o la amar leh kolla hau mistappeke kechada leela vetatta

Veta chaze kahani velevae veyisrael innun ikrun adam bechibbura deinnun reutin kaddishin desalkin miggavayehu hahu kisba o imra o hahi behema dekarvin itzterich ad la yitkeriv al gabbe madbecha lefarasha alah kal chattain vechal reutin bishin leitvaddaa alah uchden hahi itkere behema becholla bego innun chattain uvishin vehirhurin

Kegavena dekarbana daazazel dichtiv vehitvadda alav et kal aonot bene yisrael vegv hachi name hacha vechad salka al gabbe madbecha metula al chad teren uvgin kach da salka leatreh veda salka leatreh da beraza deadam veda beraza divhema kema deatte amer adam uvhema toshia Adonai
Chavitin vechal shear menachot leatara rucha kaddisha biruta dechahane veshirata delevae uvitzlota deyisrael uvhahu tenana veshamna vekimcha desalik mitravan umistappekin
128: Kal shear mare dedinin dela yachlin leshaltaa behahu dina deitmasar lon vecholla bezimna chada ta chaze kolla itavid beraza dimhemnuta leistappeka da beda ulistallaka leela man deitzterich ad en sof

Amar rabbi shimon aremat yeday bitzlotin leela dechad reuta illaa leela leela kayema al hahu reuta dela ityeda velo itpas kelal lealmin resha desatim yattir leela vehahu resha appik may deappik vela yedia venahir may denahir kolla bistimu

Reo demachashava illaa lemirdaf avatreh ulitnehara minneh chad perisu itperis umiggo hahu perisa birdifu dehahi machashava illaa mate vela mate ad hahu perisa nahir ma denahir uchden ihu machashava illaa nahir binhiru satim dela yedia vehahu machashava la yada

Keden batash hay nehiru demachashava dela ityeda binhiru defarsa dekayema denahir mimma dela yedia vela ityeda vela itgalya uchden da nehiru demachashava dela ityeda batash binhiru difrisa venaharin kechada veitavidu tesha hechalin

Vehechalin lav innun nehorin velav innun ruchin velav innun nishmatin vela it man dekayema behu reuta dechal tesha nehorin dekayeme kulhu bemachashava deihu chad minnayehu bechushbena kulhu lemirdaf batrayehu beshaata dekayeme bemachashava vela mitdabbekan vela ityedau veillen la kayeme la biruta vela bemachashava illaa tafsin bah vela tafsin beillen kayeme kal raze dimhemnuta vechal innun nehorin meraza demachashava illaa kulhu ikrun en sof ad hacha matu nehorin vela matun vela ityedau lav hacha reuta vela machashava
Nahir machashava vela ityeda mimman denahir keden itlabbesh veastim go bina venahir leman denahir veail da beda ad deitkelilu kulhu kechada

Uvraza dekarbana kad salik kolla itkashshar da beda venahir da beda keden kayeme kulhu bisliku umachashava itattar been sof hahu nehiru deitnehir minneh machashava illaa ikre en sof uminneh ishtechach vekayema venahir leman denahir veal da kolla kaim zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikaya bealma den uvalma deate
Ta chaze hay ketz kal basar kema dekishshura ishtechach leela bechedu uf hachi name letatta bechedveta uruta leistappeka kolla leela vetatta veima kayema alayehu deyisrael kedeka yeut

Ta chaze bechal reshe yarcha veyarcha kad sihara mitchaddesha yahavin leh lehay ketz kal basar chulka chada yattir al karbanin leitaska beh veyishtammesh bechulakeh vihe sitra deyisrael bilchodayehu begin deyitachadun bemalchehon veda ihu sair begin deihu bechulaka deesav dichtiv beh sair hen esav achi ish sair veal da ihu ishtammash bechulakeh veyisrael innun mishtammeshin bechulakehon uvgin kach ketiv ki yaakov bachar lo yah yisrael lisgulato

Ta chaze hay ketz kal basar kal reuteh lav ihu ella bevisra tadir uvgin kach tikkuna devisra tadir legabbeh veal da ikre ketz kal basar vechad ihu shallit shallit al gufa vela al nishmeta nishmeta salka leatra uvisra ityehiv leatar da kegavena da bekarbana diruta salka leatar chad uvisra leatar chad

Ubbar nash deihu zakkaa ihu karbana mammash lechappara veachora delav ihu zakkaa lav ihu karbana begin deveh muma dichtiv ki lo leratzon vegv veal da tzaddikaya kappara innun dealma vekarbana innun bealma ta chaze vayyomer elohim lenoach ketz kal basar ba lefanay lemetal reshu leachshacha appayehu
129: Divne alma uvgine chach hinni mashchitam et haaretz ketiv vayaas noach kechol asher tzivahu Adonai

Ta chaze ma ketiv venoach ben shesh meot shana vegv vechi ammay ata chushbena da lemimne ella ilu la hava noach ben shesh meot shana la yeul letevuta vela yitchabbar bahadah kevan deishtallim beshesh meot shana keden itchabbar bahadah

Veal da min yoma deishtallim chovayehu divne alma orich lon kudsha berich hu ad deishtallim noach beshesh meot shana veishtallim dargeh kedeka yeut vehava tzaddik shelim uchden al letevuta vecholla kegavena dilela venoach ben shesh meot shana kema deamaran uvgine chach la ittemar keven shesh meot shana tu patach veamar vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim may tama hinni kevan deamar vaani ella ani anochi kolla milla chada hi

Ta chaze bechal atar ani itavid gufa lenishmeta vadday dimkabbela mimma dilela uvgin kach itremiz beat kayyama dichtiv ani hinne beriti ittach ani dekayema beitgalleya mezumenet leminda ani karseya lema dilela ani deavidna nukmin ledare darin vaani kalil dechar venukva kechada levatar itreshim bilchodoy deizdamman lemebad dina hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim
Kevan deamar mevi et hammabbul la yedana deihu mayim ela et hammabbul leasgaa malach hammavet deaf al gav demaya hau mechabbela azil bealma leshetzaa beinnun mayin

Ani Adonai hachi taninan neeman ana leshallema agar tav letzaddikayya ulitpara merashiayya uvgin kach avtach lon kera letzaddikayya beani leshallema agar tav dilhon lealma deate veagzim lerashiayya leitpera minnayehu lealma deate beani

Leshachet kal basar kema deokimna deda hu mechabbela dealma veal da ketiv velo yitten hammashchit lavo el battechem lingof veda hu leshachet kal basar missitra deketz kal basar ba lefanay deha kevan demata zimna deorich lon kudsha berich hu ad deashlim noach leshesh meot shana keden leshachet kal basar amar hachi olifna mishmeh derabbi yitzchak deamar lan

Patach veamar amarti lo ere yah yah beeretz hachayyim lo abbit adam od im yoshve chadel amarti lo ere yah kamma atimin innun beni nasha dela yadin vela mashgichin bemille deorayeta ella mistakkele bemilloy dealma veitneshe minnayehu rucha dechachmeta

Dechad bar nash istallak mehay alma veyahiv chushbena lemareh mikkal ma deavad behay alma beod deihu kaim rucha vegufa kechada vechame ma dechame ad deazil lehahu alma ufaga leh leadam harishon yativ letara deginta deeden lemechome kal innun denatru pikkude demarehon vechade behu

Vechamma tzaddikayya sachoraneh deadam innun deitmenau mearcha degehinnom vesatu legabbe archa degan eden veillen ikrun yoshve chadel vela ketiv yoshve chaled begin dela hau kemo chulda degarra umancha vela yada leman shavka ella yoshve chadel kema deatte amer chidlu lachem min haadam vegv deitmena lon mearcha degihinnom veatkifu behu leaala lehu beginta deeden

Davar acher yoshve chadel innun marehon ditshuva dimnau garmayehu meinnun chovin dechayyavaya uvgin deadam harishon tav bituvta kamme mareh yativ al innun deitmenau mechovehon veinnun bene chadel kema deatte amer eda me chadel ani uvgin kach ihu yativ letara deginta deeden vechade behu betzaddikayya deatyan behahu orcha deginta deeden

Ta chaze ma ketiv amarti lo ere yah vechi man yachil lemechome yah ella sofa dikra ochach dichtiv yah beeretz hachayyim ta chaze kad salkin nishmatin leatar tzerora dechayye tamman mithannan bezahora deaspaklarya denahara denahir
130: Meatar ilaa decholla veilu la mitlabbesha nishmata bezahara dilvusha achora la tichol leitkarava lemechome hahu nehora

Veraza demilla kema deyahave lenishmata levusha demitlabbesha beh lemekam behay alma hachi name yahave lah levusha dezahara illaa lemekam beh behahu alma ulistakkala bego hahu aspaklarya denahara miggo hahu eretz hachayyim

Ta chaze moshe la yachil lekarva leistakkela bamme deistakkal ella kad itlabbash bilvusha achora kema deatte amer vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar vetargum bimtziut anana veitlabbash bah keman deitlabbash bilvusha uvgin da umoshe niggash el haarafel asher sham haelohim uchtiv vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vegv vayehi moshe bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layela veyachil leistakkala bamme deistakkal

Kegavena da mitlabbeshin nishmathon detzaddikaya behahu alma bilvusha kegavena dehahu alma dela yitnaheg ella bilvusha kegavena da vekayeme leistakkala binhora denahir behahu eretz hachayyim vezehu yah yah beeretz hachayyim dehava savir dela yizke lehahu nehora ulhahu istakkeluta begin denahara denagid pasik leh vela olid lo abbit adam od da adam kadmaa kema deittemar

Vechal da lamma begin deamar leh nevia ki met atta behay alma vela tichye lehahu alma begin deman dela olid benin behay alma kad nafik minneh metarchin leh michal ma deamaran vela sharya lemechome behahu nehora denahir uma chizkiyya dehava leh zechut avot veihu zakkaa tzaddik vachasida kach kal shekken man delet leh zechut avot vechate kamme mareh

Hay levusha dekaamaran ihu ma deamru chavraya chaluka derabbanan deitlevishu behahu alma zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya deganiz lon kudsha berich hu kamma tavin veidunin lehahu alma alayehu ketiv ayin la raata elohim zulatecha yaase limchakke lo

Vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim al haaretz rabbi yehuda patach hemma me meriva asher ravu bene yisrael et Adonai vayyikkadesh bam vechi beatar achora lo ravu bene yisrael et Adonai may shena hacha dekaamar hemma me meriva vela achoranin ella hanne me meriva hau vadday deyahavu chela vetukfa lemarehon dedina leittakfa begin deit mayin metukin veit mayin meriran it mayin tzelilan veit mayin achiran it mayin shelam veit mayin ketatu veal da hemma me meriva asher ravu bene yisrael et Adonai deamshichu alayehu leman dela itzterich veisteivu beh hada hu dichtiv vayyikkadish bam

Amar leh rabbi chizkiya i hachi may vayyikkadesh vayyikkadeshu mibbae leh ella milla istelikat vayyikkadesh itpegim man dela itzterich kivyachol deitpegemat sihara vayyikkaddesh lav leshivcha ihu hacha vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul kema deokimna leayetaa mechabbela alayehu kema deinnun isteavu beh

Amar rabbi yose vay lon lerashshiaya dela baan leatava kamme kudsha berich hu al chovehon beod deinnun behay alma dechad bar nash ativ veitnecham al chovoy kudsha berich hu machil leh vechal innun demittakfin bechovayehu vela bau leatava kamme kudsha berich hu al chovehon levatar yinpelu leggehinnom vela yiskun leh mittamman lealmin

Ta chaze begin deatkifu libbayehu kal innun dara denoach uvau leachazaa chovayehu beitgalya kudsha berich hu ayete dina alayehu behahu gavena amar rabbi yitzchak veafilu kad chate bar nash veitkasya kudsha berich hu rachaman vei tav bar nash legabbeh chafe aleh umachil leh veshavik leh vei la gale leh leene cholla menalan missota

Vehachi name itmechun illen chayyavaya meara beitgalya vehech itmechun ella dehau nafke maya vehau retichan min tehoma vesalke veaavar minnayehu mashcha vechevan deaavar minnayehu mashcha hachi name bisra vela ishtearu ella begarmayehu lechod lekayema dichtiv vayyimmachu min haaretz vechal innun garme itpardan da min da vela ishtaaru kechada umikkola itavaru mealma rabbi yitzchak amar vayyimmachu min haaretz may vayyimmachu kema deatte amer yimmachu missefer chayyim mikkan olifna delet lon techiyya lealmin vela yekumun bedina
131: Vahakimoti et beriti ittach amar rabbi elazar mehacha kiyyuma divrit leela kekiuma divrit letatta mashma dichtiv ittach veamar rabbi elazar mikkan olifna dechad zakkain innun bealma itkeyyam alma leela vetatta amar rabbi shimon milla satim ihu kad itaruta didchura legabbe nukva kad ihu mekanne lah

Ta chaze raza demilla kad tzaddika ihu bealma miyyad shechinta la itadiat minneh vetiuvta dilah beh keden tiuvta dilela legabbah birchimu ketiuvta didchura lenukveh kad ihu mekanni lah veal da vahakimoti et beriti ittach itar tiuvta beginach kegavena da veet beriti akim et yitzchak

Vahakimoti et beriti ittach lemeheve at beriti bealma ulvatar uvata el hatteva deilmale lav ihu tzaddik la yeul letevuta deha la itchabbar latteva bar tzaddik uvgine chach uvata el hatteva veha ittemar

Amar rabbi elazar bechal zimna divne nasha yitachadun bivrit da vela yishbekun leh let am velishan bealma deyechul leavasha lon venoach atkif bivrit da venatar leh begine chach kudsha berich hu natar leh vechal beni dareh la natru leh begin kach kudsha berich hu aavar lon mealma veha ittemar behahu chova mammash deinnun chavu behahu gavena itmechun mealma

Rabbi yehuda hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon vehau aske behay kera dichtiv vayerappe et mizbach Adonai heharus may vayerappe ta chaze bime eliyyahu yisrael kulhu shavku leh lekudsha berich hu veshavku berit kayyama dilhon kad ata eliyyahu vechama deka shavku bene yisrael hay berit kayyama veaavaru minnayehu hay berit

Kevan dechama eliyyahu chach ata leatkana milla leduchteh kevan dekariv milla leduchteh ittese kolla hada hu dichtiv vayerappe et mizbach Adonai heharus da berit kayyama Adonai dehava shavik mealma uchtiv vayyikkach eliyyahu shettem esre avanim lemispar shivte bene yaakov da hu tikkuna demizbach Adonai

Asher haya devar Adonai elav lemor yisrael yihye shemecha may tama idkar hacha yisrael ella vadday yisrael yihye shemecha vadday leistallaka leela veleatava berit kayyama leatreh vehayenu dichtiv ki azvu beritcha beni yisrael uvgin kach et mizbechotecha harasu

Ta chaze kal zimna deyisrael natru keyama kaddisha keden avde kiyyuma leela vetatta vechad shavke lehay berit keden la ishtechach kiyyum leela vetatta dichtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti uvgin kach vayerappe et mizbach Adonai heharus vechi refua ihu hachi hu vadday deha mekayyem lehahu atar dimhemnuta talya beh

Ta chaze uf hachi pinchas beshaata dekanne leovada dezimri atkin lehay berit beatreh uvgin kach ketiv hinni noten lo et beriti shalom vechi salka datach divgin pinchas hava uma ketata hava leh lefinchas behay berit ella hacha itkeshar milla beduchteh hinni noten lo et beriti uma etten lo shalom leitchabbera berit beatreh veal da hinni noten lo et beriti uma shalom deihu atreh leitchabbera bahadeh ma deitparash minneh bechovayehu begineh itchabbar beh veal da hoil vehu atkin milla beduchteh mikkan ulhala vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav berit kehunnat olam tachat asher kinne lelohav vegv

Amar rabbi shimon let lach milla bealma dekudsha berich hu kanne lah kemo chova divrit kema deatte amer cherev nokemet nekam berit vetta chaze la ishtelim chova dedara detofana ella begin dechavu bechabbilu al ara veaf al gav dehau mekappeche da leda kedichtiv vattimmale haaretz chamas uchtiv ki
132: Mala haaretz chamas mippenehem mikkal makom vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim vehinni mashchitam midda keneged midda hinni mashchitam bechova dechabbaluta

Veit deamre dela ishtelim kistayehu ella bechova dechamas dehau mekappechin da leda dehau bishin lashshamayim velabberiyyot ta chaze kamma innun memannan milleela deitpakdan al kale deinnun demasre dina al chavrehon al ma deavde lon veal da ketiv ki mala haaretz chamas mippenehem uvgin kach ketiv vehinni mashchitam et haaretz

Vayyomer Adonai lenoach bo atta vechal betcha amar rabbi shimon ammay bechulhu elohim vehacha Adonai may shana hacha deittemar Adonai shema illaa derachame ella raza ihu deolifna lav orach ara lekabbela itteta ushpiza bahadah ella birshu devaalah

Uf hachi noach baa leaala betevuta leitchabbera bahadah velav hava yaot ad devaalah deteva yahav leh reshu leaalaa dichtiv bo atta vechal betcha el hatteva uvgin kach ikre hacha Adonai baalah deteva uchden al noach veitchabbar bahadah vechen olifna delet leh reshu leushpiza lemeal leveta ella birshu baalah mareh deveta hada hu dichtiv levatar vayyavo noach vegv

Ta chaze ma ketiv ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze mikkan olifna dela yekabbel bar nash ushpiza beveteh i ihu chashid beh deihu chayyava ella i kaim beenoy lezakkaa dela chashid beenoy kelal hada hu dichtiv bo atta vechal betcha el hatteva may tama begin ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze

Veolifna dei yahiv leh reshu bilchodoy vela yahiv reshu lechal innun deatyan immeh la yeul lon leveta hada hu dichtiv bo atta vechal betcha el hatteva lechola yahiv reshuta lemeal umikra da olifna raza dearchoy deara

Rabbi yehuda patach ledavid mizmor layeya haaretz umloah tevel veoshve vah ha taninan ledavid mizmor deamar shirata ulvatar sharat aleh ruach kaddisha mizmor ledavid desharat aleh ruach kaddisha ulvatar amar shirata

Layeya haaretz umloah hay kera al ara deyisrael ittemar deihi ara kaddisha umloah da shechinta kema deatte amer ki male chevod Adonai et bet Adonai uchtiv uchvod Adonai male et hammishkan may male vela mila ella male vadday deitmalya mikkolla deitmalya min shimsha sihara shelim bechal sitrin male mikkal tuva dilela keiskofa da deitmalya mikkal tuva dealma veal da ketiv layeya haaretz umloah tevel veoshve vah da shear aran
Davar acher layeya haaretz umloah da ara kaddisha illaa dekudsha berich hu itrae vah umloah illen nishmathon detzaddikayya itmalya minnayehu mechela deammuda chad dealma kayema aleh
Vei tema al chad kayema ta chaze ma ketiv ki hu al yammim yesadah ki hu man hu da kudsha berich hu kema deatte amer hu asanu uchtiv ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit

Al yammim yesadah veal neharot yechonneha illen shiva ammudim dekayema alayehu umalyan lah hi itmalya minnayehu hech itmalya minnayehu beshaata deasgiu zakkain bealma keden ara da avdat perin veitmalya mikkolla

Uvshaata deasgiu chayyavin bealma keden ketiv azlu mayim minni yam venahar yechorav veyavesh azlu mayim minni yam da ara kaddisha deamaran deishtakya mishshaku illaa venahar yecherav veyavesh hahu ammuda chad dekaim alah leitnahara minneh venahar yecherav veyavesh kema deatte amer hatztzaddik avad

Veamar rabbi yehuda behahu zimna deitavidu innun chayyavin mealma kudsha berich hu ishtadal al alma vela chama man deagin ola vei tema ha noach dehava leh leaggana al garmeh ulafaka minneh toladin lealma hada hu dichtiv ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze baddor hazze dayeka
133: Amar baddor hazze da shevacha dileh dehava behahu dara chayyava veishtechach kule hay ish tzaddik tamim veafilu bedara demoshe aval la hava yachil leaggana al alma begin dela ishtakkechu asara bealma kema deatte amer ulay yimmatzun sham asara vela ishtakkechu tamman uf hacha la ishtakkechu asara ela hu utlat benoy venukvayehu vela hau asara

Rabbi elazar shail leh lerabbi shimon avoy ha taninan beshaata dealma itmalya chove bene nasha vedina nafak vay lehahu zakkaa deishtechach bealma deihu itpas bechovoy dechayavaya bekadmita noach ech ishteziv dela itpas bechovayehu amar leh ha ittemar dekudsha berich hu baa leafaka minneh toladin lealma miggo tevuta vetu deha dina la yachla leshaltaa aloy begin dehava tamir veganiz batteva veitkasya meena
Vetta chaze ketiv bakshu tzedek bakshu anava ulay tissatru beom af Adonai venoach bikkesh tzedek veal begavah leshaltaa ulkatrega leh
Hacha itremiz leinnun kaddishe elonin leminda beraza deatvan kaddishin illain hippucha deatvan leitmeche leinnun chayyavaya veal da vayyimmachu min haaretz ketiv bo atta vechal betcha

Rabbi yitzchak patach molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto bokea mayim mippenehem laasot lo shem olam da zechuta deavraham deihu yamina mimmoshe tiferet demoshe uvgin kach bokea mayim mippenehem deha zechuta deavraham bokea mayim ihu vechal da lama laasot lo shem olam

Ta chaze ma ben moshe lishar bene alma beshaata deamar lah kudsha berich hu lemoshe veatta hannicha li vegv veeese otcha legoy gadol vegv miyyad amar moshe vechi eshbok dinhon deyisrael begini hashta yemrun kal innun bene alma deana katlit lon leyisrael kema deavad noach

Dechevan deamar leh kudsha berich hu disheziv leh betevuta dichtiv vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim vegv uchtiv umachiti et kal hayekum asher asiti meal pene haadama vaani hinni mekim et beriti vegv uvata el hatteva kevan deamar leh deyishteziv hu uvnoy la baa rachamin al alma veitavidu uvgin kach ikrun me hammabbul al shemeh kema deatte amer ki me noach zot shor noshobbaatti moavor me noach

Amar moshe hashta yemrun beni alma deana ketilat lon begin deamar li veeese otcha legoy gadol hashta tav li deemut vela yishtetzun yisrael miyyad vayechal moshe et pene Adonai elohav baa rachamin alayehu veitar rachame al alma

Veamar rabbi yitzchak sheruta devaa rachame alayehu may kaamar lamma Adonai yechore appecha beammecha vechi milla da ech amar leh moshe lamma veha avadu kochavim umazzalot kema deatte amer asu lahem egel masseche vayyishtachau lo vayyomru elle vegv umoshe amar lamma ella hachi olifna man dimratztze leachora la bae lemebad hahu chova rav ella yazir leh kammeh ulvatar yasge leh kammeh achora dichtiv attem chatatem chataa gedola

Vela shavik leh lekudsha berich hu ad demasar garmeh lemota dichtiv veatta im tissa chatatam veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta vekudsha berich hu machil lon dichtiv vayyinnachem Adonai al haraa vegv venoach la avad ken ella baa leishtezava veshavik kal alma

Uvchal zimna dedina sharya al alma ruach kudsha amar vay dela ishtechach kemoshe dichtiv vayyizkor ayye hammaalem miyyam vegv dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay deha ihu bitzlota salik lon min yamma uvgin deshave garmeh bitzlota alayehu deyisrael beyamma ikre hammaalem miyyam deihu assik lon min yamma
Ayye hassam bekirbo et ruach kadsho da ihu moshe deashre
134: Shechinta benayehu deyisrael molicham battehomot kad itbaku maya veazlu bego tehome beyabbeshta diglidu maya begin deamsar garmeh al yisrael

Amar rabbi yehuda af al gav dezakkaa hava noach lav ihu keday dekudsha berich hu yagin al alma begineh ta chaze moshe la tala milla bizchuteh ella bizchut avahan kadmae aval noach la hava leh beman deyitle bizchuta kemoshe

Amar rabbi yitzchak veim kal da kevan deamar leh kudsha berich hu vahakimoti et beriti ittach hava leh lemive rachame alayehu vekarbana deakriv levatar deyakriv leh min kadmat dena dilma yishshachech rugza mealma

Amar rabbi yehuda may hava leh lemebad deha chayyave alma hau margizin kamme kudsha berich hu veihu yakriv karbana ella vadday noach dachil al garmeh hava begin dela yeera beh mota bego chayyave alma dehava chame ovadehon bisha kal yoma vehech margezan kamme kudsha berich hu kal yoma

Rabbi yitzchak amar kal zimna dechayyave alma asgiu zakkaa deishtechach benayehu hu itpas bekadmita dichtiv umimmikdashi tachellu vetaninan al tikre mimmikdashi ella mimmekudashi venoach hech sheziv leh kudsha berich hu ben kal innun chayyavaya ella begin deyifkun minneh toladin bealma dehava tzaddik kedeka yeut

Vetu deihu atre behu kal yoma veoma vela kabbilu minneh vekiyyem benafsheh kera dichtiv veatta ki hizharta rasha vegv uchtiv veatta et nafshecha hitztzalta mikkan kal man deazhar lechayyava af al gav dela kabbil minneh hu sheziv leh legarmeh vehahu chayyava itpas bechoveh vead kamma yazhar leh ad deyimche leh ha ukmuha chavraya

Rabbi yose hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon yoma chad amar leh may chama kudsha berich hu leshetzaa kal chevat bera veof shemaya immehon dechayavaya i bene nasha chatan beire veofe shemaya ushar beriyan ma chatu amar leh begin dichtiv ki hishchit kal basar et darko al haaretz kulhu hau mechabbele archayehu shavke zinayehu vedavku bezina achora

Ta chaze innun chayyave alma garmu hachi lechal biryan uvaon leakkechasha ovada divreshit veinnun garmu lechal biryan lechabbela archayehu kema deinnun mechabbelan amar kudsha berich hu attun beitu leakkechasha ovade yeday ana ashlim reuta dilchon umachiti et kal hayekum asher asiti meal peni haadama ahadar alma lemayin kema dehava bekadmita mayin bemayin veha ittemar mikkan ulhala aavid biryan achoranin bealma kedeka yeut

Vayyavo noach uvanav veishto unshe vanav itto rabbi chiyya patach veamar im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai kamma innun bene nasha atimin libba setimin ayenin dela mashgichin vela yadin bikara demarehon dichtiv beh halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male hech baun beni nasha leistattera mechovayehu veamre mi roenu umi yodenu uchtiv vehaya bemachshach maasehem lean yittamrun mikkammeh

Lemalka devana palterin veavad techot ara temirin petzirin leomin maradu bene palterin bemalka aschar alayehu malka begayesoy ma avadu alu utmiru garmayehu techot nukve pesirin amar malka ana avdit lon umikkammay attun baan leittammara hada hu dichtiv im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai ana hu daavadit nukve pesirin veavadit chashocha unhora veattun ech yachlin leittammara kammay

Ta chaze kad bar nash chate kamme mareh veamshich garmeh leitkasya kudsha berich hu avid beh dina beitgalya vechad bar nash adke garmeh kudsha berich hu bae leastara leh dela yitchaze beom af Adonai devadday ibbae leh leenash
135: Dela yitchaze kamme mechabbela kad sharya al alma dela yistakkel beh deha kal innun deyitchazzun kammeh it leh reshu lechabbala

Vehayenu dekaamar rabbi shimon kal bar nash deeneh bisha ena dimchabbela sharya aloy veihu mechabbela dealma ikre velibbae leh leinesh leistammera minneh vela leitkerava bahadeh dela yittezak veasir lemikrav bahadeh beitgalya umishshum hachi meish ra ayin bae leistammera minnih mikkamme malach hammavet al achat kamma vechamma

Ma ketiv bevilam unum haggever shetum haayin deena bisha hava leh uvchal atar dehava mistakkel beh hava amshich aleh ruach mechabbela uvgin kach hava bae leistakkala behu beyisrael begin dishetze bechal atar deeneh hava mistakkel ma ketiv vayyissa bilam et enav dezakif ena chad umaich ena chad begin leistakkala behu beyisrael beena bisha

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyar et yisrael shochen lishvatav vechama dishchinta chafya alayehu urvia alayehu mittakkena bitresar shivtin techotah vela yachil leshaltaa alayehu eneh amar ech echol lehon deha ruach kaddisha illaa revia alayehu vechafat lon begadfaha hada hu dichtiv kara shachav kaari uchlavi mi yekimennu mi yekimennu mealayehu begin deyitgalyan veshalta ena alayehu

Veal da kudsha berich hu baa lechafya lenoach leistattera meena dela yachil ruach mesaova leshalta aleh begin dela yitchabbel veha ittemar vayyavo noach kema deittemar leistattera meena mippene me hammabbul demayin dachaku leh amar rabbi yose chama malach hammavet dehava ate uvgin kach al letevuta veistammar vah terisar yarche
Veammay teresar yarchin pelige bah rabbi yitzchak verabbi yehuda chad amar yarchin dechach ihu dina dechayavaya vechad amar leashlama tzaddik dargin teresar ushar dargin deitchazze leafaka min teva

Rabbi yehuda amar shitta yarche innun bemaya veshita yarche beesha veha hacha maya hau ammay teresar yarche amar rabbi yose bitre dinin degehinnom itdanu bemaya veesha bemaya demayin denachatu alayehu milleela hau tzeninin ketalga beesha demayin denafke mittatta hau retichan keesha veal da bedina degehinnom itdanu beesha umaya ad deishtetziu mealma venoach hava mistatter betevuta veitkasse meena umchabbela la kariv legabbeh vetevuta ihi hava shatya al anpe maya kema deatte amer vayyisu et hatteva vattaram meal haaretz

Arbaim yom laku dichtiv vayehi hammabbul arbaim yom al haaretz vegv vechal shear zimna itmechun mealma hada hu dichtiv vayyimmachu min haaretz vay lon leinnun chayavaya deha la yekumun leachya bealma lemekam bedina hada hu dichtiv vayyimmachu kema deatte amer shemam machit leolam vaed deafilu lemekam bedina la yekumun

Vayyisu et hatteva vattaram meal haaretz rabbi abba patach ruma al hashshamayim elohim al kal haaretz kevodecha vay lon lechayavaya deinnun chatan umargizin lemarehon bechal yoma uvchovayehu dachyan lah lashshechinta meara vegarmin detistallek mealma ushchinta ikre elohim vealah ketiv ruma al hashshamayim elohim

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyisu et hatteva dedachyan lah levar vattaram meal haaretz dela sharya bealma veistalkat minnah vechad istalkat mealma ha let man deyashgach bealma vedina shalta keden aloy vechad yitmachun chayyave alma veyistallekun minneh shechinta ahadrat medorah bealma

Amar leh rabbi yesa i hachi ha ara deyisrael deitmachun chayyavaya dehau behahu zimna ammay la ahadderat shechinta leatrah kedivkadmita amar leh begin dela ishtaaru vah shear zakkae alma ella bechal atar deazlu nachtat veshaviat
136: Medorah immehon uma beara nuchraa achora la itparsha minnayehu kal shekken i ishtearu beara kaddisha

Veha ittemar bechal chovin dechayyave alma dachyan lah lashshechinta chad minnayehu man dimchabbel archeh al ara kidamaran uvgin kach la chame anpe shechinta vela al befalterin veal da ketiv beillen vayyimmachu min haaretz itmachun min kolla

Ta chaze behahu zimna dezammin kudsha berich hu leachyaa metaya kal innun metin deyishtakkechun levar bishar arin nuchrain kudsha berich hu yivra lon gufayehu kedeka chaze deha garma chad deishtaar beh bevar nash techot ara hahu garma yitavid kechamira beisa vealeh yivne kudsha berich hu kal gufa

Vela yahiv lon kudsha berich hu nishmatin ella beara deyisrael dichtiv hinne ani poteach et kivrotechem vehaaleti etchem mikkivrotechem ammi veheveti etchem el admat yisrael deyitgalgelun techot ara ulvatar ma ketiv venatatti ruchi vachem vichyitem vegv deha beara deyisrael yekabbelun nishmatin kal bene alma bar illen deistaavu usivu ara beillen ketiv vayyimmachu min haaretz min haaretz dayeka veaf al gav deakshu veafligu kadmae al da vayyimmachu kema deatte amer yimmachu missefer chayim

Amar leh rabbi shimon vadday let lon chulaka bealma deate dichtiv vayyimmachu min haaretz uchtiv leolam yirshu aretz aval yekumun bedin vealayehu ketiv verabbim misheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot ulderaon olam uflugta beha aval kolla kema deukmuha chavraya

Vayyimmach et kal hayekum asher al pene haadama rabbi abba amar leachlala kal innun shallitin deshaltin memannan al ara veda hu hayekum asher al pene haadama dechad avid kudsha berich hu dina bivne alma aavar leinnun shallitin dimmannan alayehu bekadmita ulvatar leinnun deyatve techot gadfayehu dichtiv yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom ulvatar al malche haadama al haadama

Vehecha mitavran kammeh ella aavar lon benura dedalik hada hu dichtiv ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna esha deachil esha hahu yakum dealayehu beesha veinnun deyatve techotayehu bemaya uvgine kach vayyimmach et kal hayekum asher al peni haadama ulvatar meadam vead behema ad remes vead of hashshamayim vayyimmachu min haaretz kal illen diltatta vayyishshaer ach noach ach limute dela ishtaaru bealma bar noach udimmeh betevuta rabbi yose omer chagir hava deachish leh arya veha ukmuha

Vayyizkor elohim et noach veet kal hachayya veet kal habbehema asher itto batteva rabbi chiyya patach arum raa raa venistar hay kera ittemar al noach deal letevuta veistattar bah veal lego tevuta bezimna demayya dachaku leh veha ittemar dead la al letevuta chama leh lemalach hammavet deazil benayehu veaschar lon kevan dechama leh al latteva veistattar begavah hada hu dichtiv arum raa raa venistar raa raa da malach hammavet venistar mikkammeh hada hu dichtiv mippene me hammabbul

Rabbi yose amar arum raa raa venistar ahadar al ma deittemar bezimna demota sharya bealma bar nash chakkim yissater vela yakum levar vela yitchaze kamme mechabbela begin dechevan deityehiv leh reshu yechabbel kal innun deyishtakkechun kammeh veyaavrun kammeh beitgalya vesofa dikra uftaim avru veneenashu avrin kammeh veitchazyan kammeh veneenashu davar acher avru avru pikkuda veneenashu davar acher arum raa raa venistar da noach uftaim avru veneenashu illen bene dareh
Kevan deistattar veishtahe tamman kal hahu zimna
137: Levatar vayyizkor elohim et noach amar rabbi shimon ta chaze beshaata dedina itavid la ketiv beh zechira kevan deitavid dina veitavidu chayyave alma keden ketiv beh zechira deha kad dina sharya bealma itchabberuta la ishtechach umchabbela sharya al alma
Kevan deitavar dina veishtakkich rugza tav kolla leatreh uvgin kach ketiv hacha vayyizkor elohim et noach deveh sharya zachor denoach ish tzaddik ketiv beh

Ketiv atta moshel begeut hayyam beso gallav atta teshabbechem beshaata deyamma kafitz begalgule uthome salke venachate kudsha berich hu shadar chad chuta missitra deyamina umashich galgeloy veshachich zapeh velet man deyada leh
Yona nachat leyamma veizdamman leh hahu nuna uvala leh hech la nafkat nishmeteh minneh vela parcha miyyad ela begin dekudsha berich hu shallit behahu geuta deyamma

Vehahu geuta deyamma hu chad chuta dismala desalik leh leyamma leela uveh istallak vei lav hahu chuta demate leh missitra deyamina la salka lealmin dechad dehahu chuta nachit leyamma veyamma itachid bah keden itarin galgeloy veshaagan lemitraf tarpa ad dekudsha berich hu ativ leh leachora vetavin leatrayehu

Hada hu dichtiv beso gallav atta teshabbechem teshabbechem leinnun galle yamma teshabbechem tetabbar lon leatava leatrayehu davar acher teshabbechem mammash shevacha hu lon begin desalkin betiuvta lemechome mikkan kal man dechasif leistakkala ulminda af al gav dela yachil shevacha ihu dileh vecholla meshabbechan leh
Amar rabbi yehuda noach kad hava batteva dachil hava dela yidkar leh kudsha berich hu lealmin vechevan deitavid dina veitavaru chayyave alma keden ma ketiv vayyizkor elohim et noach
Rabbi elazar amarotta chaze beshaata dedina sharya bealma la libae leh leenish deyidkar shemeh leela deha i adkar shemeh yidkerun chovoy veyetun leashgacha beh

Menalan mishshunammit dehahu yoma yom tov derosh hashshana hava vekudsha berich hu dain alma uchden amar leh elisha hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech da kudsha berich hu dichden ikre melech melech hakkadosh melech hammishpat vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet la baena deyidkerun li veyishgechun bi ella betoch ami man deayyil resheh ben amma la yishgechun aleh lemedan leh levish begine chach amra betoch ammi

Ta chaze noach beshaata derugza sharya bealma la idkar kevan dedina itavar ma ketiv vayyizkor elohim et noach hashta idkar shemeh davar acher vayyizkor elohim et noach kema deatte amer vaezkor et beriti

Rabbi chizkiyya hava azil mikkappotkiyya lelud paga beh rabbi yesa amar leh tevahna alach deatte bilchodach deha taninan dela yippuk bar nash yechiday bearcha amar leh ravya chad azil bahaday veihu ate avatray amar leh veal da tevahna ech azil bahadach man dela tishtae beh mille deorayeta deha taninan kal man deazil bearcha velav immeh mille deorayeta istakkan benafsheh amar leh hachi hu vadday
Adhachi mata hahu ravya amar leh rabbi yesa beri mean atar ante amar leh mikkarta delud veshamana dehay bar nash chakkim azil tamman vezammina garmay lefulchanih ulmehach bahadeh
Amar leh beri yedate mille deorayeta amar leh yedana deha abba hava olif li befarashat karbanot vearchina udnay lemay dehava amar im achi deihu keshisha minnay amar leh rabbi yesa beri ema li
Patach veamar vayyiven noach mizbeach layeya vayyikkach mikkal habbehema hattehora umikkal haof hattahor vayyaal olot bammizbeach vayyiven noach mizbeach da ihu mizbeach deakriv beh adam kadmaa noach
138: Ammay kariv ola deha ola la salka ella begin hirhura delibba venoach bemma chav ella noach hirher veamar ha kudsha berich hu gazar dina al alma deyitcharav dilma begin desheziv li kal zechuta paka li vela yishtaar li zechu bealma miyyad vayyiven noach mizbeach layeya
Hahu mizbeach deakriv beh adam harishon hava i hachi ammay vayyiven ella begin dechayyave alma garmu dela kayema beduchteh kevan deata noach ketiv beh vayyiven
Vayyaal olot olat ketiv chada ketiv ola hi ishshe reach nichoach layeya ola salka dechar vela salka nukva dichtiv zachar tamim yakrivennu ammay ketiv ishshe deha esh bae leishtakkecha tamman

Ela af al gav deola itkeriv dachar ulatreh itkeriv nukva la baya leitparsha minneh ella bah itkeriv begin lechabbera da beda desalka nukva legabbe dechura leitchabbera kechada veaf al gav deishshe leshum ishim

Noach itzterich leh lemikrav ola deihu beatar didchura avad leh kudsha berich hu leitchabbera ulaalaa batteva veal da akriv ola ola hu ishshe esh Adonai deitchabbar semala benukva deha nukva missitra dismala ka atya udchura misitra dimina beitdabbekuta da beda uvgin kach ikre nukva ishshe ishshe ketiru dirchimu deachid bah semala lesalka lah leela ulitkashshera kechada uvgin kach ola hi ishshe keshiru didchar venukva da beda

Vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach uchtiv ishshe reach nichoach ishshe hachi shemana tenana veesha mechubbarin kechada deha let tenana bela esha kema dichtiv vehar sinay ashan kullo mippene asher yarad alav Adonai baesh

Ta chaze esh nafik millegav veihu dak veachid bemilla achora levar delav ihu dak hachi veitachadan da beda uchden tenana salka may tama begin deitachid esha bemilla deragish vesimanach chutma denafik beh tenana miggo esha

Veal da ketiv yasimu ketora beappecha begin deahadar esha leatreh vechotma itkenish behahu recha lego lego ad deitachid kolla vetav leatreh veitkeriv kolla lego machshava veitavid reuta chada uchden reach nichoach denach rugza veitavid nayecha

Deha tenana itkenish veayyil vekamit beesha veesha achid bitnana veayele tarvayehu lego lego ad denach rugza vechad itachid kola da veda venach rugza keden hu nayecha ukshiru chad veitkere nayecha nayecha derucha chedvata decholla kechada nehiru devotzinin nehiru deanpin uvgin kach ketiv vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach keman dearach vechanish kolla lego atreh

Ata rabbi yesa unshakeh amar uma kal haden tava it techot yedach vela yedana beh amar ahadarna min orcha venitchabber bahadach azlu amar rabbi chizkiyya archa da bahade shechinta nehach deha mitakna kamman achid bida dehahu yenuka veazlu amru leh ema lan kera chad meinun deamar lach avuch

Patach hahu yenuka veamar yishshakeni minshikot pihu da hu teovta illaa deyippuk reuta mippuma lenashka vela nafik mechotma kad esha nafka deha kad itchabber puma lenashka nafik esha biruta binhiru deanpin bechedva dechola beitdabbekuta denayecha
Uvgin kach ki tovim dodecha miyyayin mehahu yayin demechode venahir anpin vechayechin ayenin veavid reuta velav miyyayin dimshakker veavid rugza veachshich anpin velahatan ayenin yayin derugza
Veal da begin dechamar da tav nahir anpin vechade ayenin veavid tiuvta dirchimu makrivin leh kal yoma al gabbe madbecha
139: Shiura deman deshate leh chade leh veavid leh nayecha dichtiv venisko yayin reviit hahin uvgin kach ki tovim dodecha miyyayin mehahu yayin deitar rechimuta vetiuvta

Vecholla kema diltatta itar rechimuta dilela teren sheraggin kad itdaach nehora dilela bitnana desalik mehahu diltatta itdelik hahu dilela amar rabbi chizkiya hachi hu vadday dealma illaa talya betattaa vetattaa beillaa umezimna deitcheriv be makdesha birchan la ishtakkachu leela vetatta leachazaa deda beda talya

Veamar rabbi yose birchan la ishtakkachu ulvatin ishtakkachu deha yeniku decholla behahu sitra nafke may tama begin deyisrael la sharyan beara vela palche pulchana deitzterich leadlaka botzinin ulishtakkacha birchan uvgin kach la mishtakkeche leela vetatta vealma la yativ bekiyyumeh kedeka yeut

Veamar rabbi chizkiyya lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam may hu amar rabbi yesa hachi shemana merabbi shimon deamar kal zimna deesha dilela osif letakfa tenana deihu dina diltatta atkif rugza veshatze kolla begin dechad nafik esha let leh pesek ad deyishtelim dina vechad dina diltatta la osif leittakfa bedina dilela avid dina ufasik vela yishtallam dina leshetzaa uvgin kach ketiv lo osif lemehav tosefet leittakfa dina diltatta

Amar hahu yenuka shemana begin dichtiv arura haadama baavurcha deha behahi shaata deitlatya ara bechova deadam ityehiv reshu leshaltaa alah hahu chiveya visha deihu mechabbela dealma veshatze bene alma mehahu yoma dekariv noach karbana vearach leh kudsha berich hu ityehiv reshu leara lenafka mittechot hahu nachash venafka mimsaava veal da makrivin yisrael karbana lekudsha berich hu begin leanhara appe ara amar rabbi chizkiyya yaot hu vehay hava tale ad dekayemu yisrael al tura desinay amar rabbi yiyisa kudsha berich hu azir lah lesihara veshalta hahu nachash aval begin chova deadam itlatya begin lemelat alma behahu yoma nafkat ara mehahi kelala vekayema sihara behahi geriuta bar beshaata dekurbana ishtakkachu bealma veyisrael yatvin al arahon
Amar rabbi yesa lehahu yenuka ma shemach amar leh abba amar leh abba tehe becholla bechachma uvshanin kara aleh yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha

Amar rabbi chizkiyya zammin kudsha berich hu leaavara ruach mesaova min alma kema dichtiv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz uchtiv billa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kal panim vecherpat ammo yasir meal kal haaretz ki Adonai dibber

Vezammin kudsha berich hu leanhara lesihara veleafaka lah mechashocha begin hahu chiveya visha kema dichtiv vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim may or hahu or deganiz leh kudsha berich hu beovada divreshit

Vayevarecha elohim et noach veet banav vayyomer lahem peru urvu vegv rabbi abba patach veamar birkat Adonai hi taashir velo yosif etzev immah birkat Adonai da shechinta deihi itpakda al birchan dealma uminnah nafke birchan lecholla

Ta chaze ma ketiv bekadmita vayyomer Adonai lenoach bo atta vechal betcha el hatteva vegv kema deittemar demareh deveta yahav leh reshu lemeal levatar itteta amra leh lenafka bekadmita al birshuta devaalah lesof nafak birshu deitteta mikkan olifna mareh
140: Deveta yail veitteta tafik hada hu dichtiv vayyomer elohim el noach lemor tze min hatteva dereshu hava vidaha leafaka leh leushpiza vela leaala leh

Kevan denafak yahav mattenan lah begin deihi beveta uveta bidaha veinun mattenan deyahav lah begin leasgaa lah rechimuta bevaalah mikkan olifna orach ara leushpiza veal da levatar deyahav lah mattenan leasgaa lah rechimuta bevaalah barcha leh dichtiv vayevarech elohim et noach veet banav vayyomer lahem peru urvu vegv uvgin kach ketiv birkat Adonai hi taashir vadday kema deittemar

Velo yosif etzev immah raza dichtiv beitztzavon tochalenna itztzavon atzivu verugza bela nehiru deanpin kad itchashach sihara uvirchan la mishtakkeche beitztzavon sitra derucha achora deimna birchan mealma uvgin kach velo yosif etzev immah veda hu raza dichtiv lo osif lekallel od et haadama

Umoraachem vechittechem yihye mikkan ulhala yehe lechon deyyoknin divne nasha deha bekadmita la hau diuknin divne nasha ta chaze bekadmita ketiv betzelem elohim asa et haadam uchtiv bidmut elohim asa oto kevan dechatu ishtannu deuknayehu mehahu diukna illaa veithappachu inun lemidchal mikkamme chevan bera

Bekadmita kal beriyyan dealma zakfan ayenin vechaman diukna kaddisha illaa vezaan vedachalin mikkammeh kevan dechatu ithappach deuknayehu meenayehu lidukna achora veithappach divne nasha zain vedachalin kamme shear beriyyan

Ta chaze kal inun bene nasha dela chatan kamme marehon vela avrin al pikkude orayeta ziv diukna dilhon la ishtanne mechezu didukna illaa vechal beriyyan dealma zain vedachalin kammeh uvshaata divni nasha avrin al pitgame orayeta itchallaf diukna dilhon vechulhu zain vedachalin mikkamme beriyan achoranin begin deitchallaf diukna illaa veitavar minnayehu uchden shalte behu chevat bera deha la chamu behu hahu diukna ilaa kidkachaze

Veal kach hashta kevan dealma itchaddash kemillekaddemin barich lon beracha da veshallit lon al kolla kema deatte amer vechal dege hayyam beyedchem nittanu veafilu nune yamma rabbi chiyya amar beyedchem nittanu mikkadmat dena dechad bera kudsha berich hu alma mesar kolla bidehon dichtiv urdu vidgat hayyam uvof hashshamayim vegv

Vayevarecha elohim et noach rabbi chizkiyya patach ledavid maskil ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa hay kera ukmuha aval kera da beraza dechachmeta ittemar deha taninan baasara zine shevacha shabbach david lekudsha berich hu vechad minnayehu maskil vehu darga chad meinun asara vedavid atkin garmeh ad la yishre aloy hay darga

Ashre nesuy pesha deha beshaata dekudsha berich hu atkil chove vezachvan divne nasha dehahu tikla devistar chovin mistallekin veinun ochoranin zachyan deinun betikla achora machriin letatta da hu nesuy pesha

Kesuy chataa beshaata dedina sharya bealma dihe mechafya dela yishlot aloy mechabbela kema dehava lenoach dechasse leh kudsha berich hu mehahu chataa deamshich aleh adam al alma dechevan dechataa da angid adam al alma shear beriyyan shaltan uvar nash dachil minnayehu vealma la atkin betikkunih uvgin kach kad nafak noach mittevuta kudsha berich hu barcheh dichtiv vayevarech elohim et noach veet banav vegv
Veattem peru urvu behanne birchan la ishtakkachu nukve ella et noach veet banav aval nukve la amar kera amar rabbi shimon veattem kelala didchure
141: Venukve kechada vetu et noach leasgaa nukveh veet banav leasgaa nukve dilhon

Uvgin kach ketiv attem peru urvu lemebad toldot mikkan ulhala shirtzu vaaretz vehacha yahiv lon kudsha berich hu sheva pikkude orayeta lon ulchal deatu abbatrayehu ad dekayemu yisrael betura desinay veityehav lon kal pikkude orayeta kechada

Vayyomer elohim lenoach vegv zot ot habberit asher ani noten beni uvenechem vegv et kashti natatti beanan natatti mikkadmat dena rabbi shimon patach umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse ma ketiv leela vaeshma et kol kanfehem kekol mayim rabbim kekol shadday belechtan illen arba chevan ravrevan illain kaddishin dehahu rakia mittakkena alayehu vechulhu gadfayehu mitchabberan da beda lechafya gufayehu

Uvshaata deinun parse gadfayehu ishtema kol gadfin dechulhu deamre shirata hada hu dichtiv kekol shadday dela ishtechich lealmin kema dichtiv lemaan yezammercha chavod velo yiddom umay amre hodia Adonai yeshuato leene haggom gilla tzidkato

Kol hamulla kekol machan kekol mashshiryata kaddisha kad mitchabberan kal chelin illain leela umay amre kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot melo chal haaretz kevodo ahadderu ledarom amru kadosh ahadderu letzafon amru kadosh ahadderu lemizrach amru kadosh ahadderu lemaarav amru baruch
Vehay rakia kaim al reshehon uvchal atar deihi azla ascharu appin lehahi sitra deitkelilu anpin beh ischaru anpin learba zaveyan vechulhu mistacharin letatta

Beribbua dileh itgelifat bearba anpin anpe arye anpe nishra anpe shor anpe adam galif bechulhu adam anpe arye adam anpe nesher adam anpe shor kulhu kelilan beh uvgin kach ketiv udmut penehem pene adam

Vehay rakia deitrabba kulhu gevanin kelilan beh arba gevanin itchazzeyan beh gelifin bearba arba bearba gelifin reshimin tehirin illain vetattain kad mitparshan gevanin deinun arba salkin teresar gavan yarok gavan sumak gavan chivar gavan sappir deitkelilu mikkal gevanin hada hu dichtiv kemare hakkeshet asher yihye beanan beom haggeshem ken mare hannogah saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai chezu digvanin decholla uvgin kach et kashti natatti beanan

May kashti kema deittemar beosef dichtiv vatteshev beetan kashto begin deosef tzaddik ikre uvgin kach kashto da berit dekeshet deitkelil betzaddik divrit da beda itachid uvgin denoach hava tzadik kayema dileh keshet

Vayyafozu may vayyafozu anhiru bachamidu decholla kema deatte amer hannechemadim mizzahav umippaz rav umtukim itnehiru binhiru illaa kad natar berit uvgin kach ikre yosef hatztzaddik al da ikre hakkeshet berit kalil da beda

Zahara yekara illaa chezu dechal chezu chazu kechezu temirin gevanin temirin gevanin dela itgalyan velet reshu leistakkala beena bakkeshet kad itchaze bealma dela yitchaze kelana bishchinta vechen gevanin dekeshet hu chezu sostifa ketira kechezu yekara illaa dela leistakkala

Vechevan deara chamat lehay keshet keyama kaddisha itkayemat bekiyyuma veal da vehayeta leot berit ben elohim vegv hay deamaran deillen telat gevanin vechad deitkelil benayehu kulhu raza chada uvgo anana salka leitchazaa

Umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir hay hi even shetiyya deihi nekuda chada dechal alma vekayema alah kodesh hakkodashim umay hi kurseya kaddisha illaa deihi memanna al illen arba demut kisse bearba samchin veda hu tora shebbeal pe
Veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav millemala da hu tora shebbichtav mikkan detora shebbichtav yeshauun
142: Yatah al tora shebbeal pe begin dehay kurseya leda kemare adam deihu diukna deyaakov deihu yativ alah

Rabbi yehuda kam lelya chad lemile beorayeta befalgu lelya beve ushpiza bemata machseya vehava tamman beveta chad yuday deata bitre kesira dekatfira patach rabbi yehuda veamar vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva yihye bet elohim da hi even shetiyya demittamman ishtil alma veala itbene be makdesha

Zakaf resheh hahu yuday veamar lah hay milla ech efshar veha even shetiyya ad la itbere alma havat uminah ishtil alma veatte amarte vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva demashma deyaakov shave lah hashta dichtiv vayyikkach et haeven asher sam meraashotav vetu deyaakov bevet el hava vehay avna havat biyerushala

Rabbi yehuda la aschar resheh legabbeh patach veamar hikkon likrat elokecha yisrael uchtiv hasket ushma yisrael mille deorayeta bayan kavana umillin deorayeta baan leittakkana begufa uruta kechada kam hahu yuday veitlabbash veyativ legabbeh derabbi yehuda veamar zakkain attun tzaddikaya demishtaddele beorayeta yoma velele

Amar leh rabbi yehuda hashta dechavenat garmach ema milach denitchabber kechada deha mille deorayeta bayan tikkuna degufa vetikkuna delibba vei lav bearsay shechivna uvlibbay amarna millin ella ha taninan deafilu chad deyativ velae beorayeta shechinta itchabberat bahadeh uma shechinta hacha veana shachiv bearsay vela od ella devaayan tzachuta

Vetu dechal bar nash dekam lemile beorayeta mippalgu lelya kad itar ruach tzafon kudsha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden vehu vechal tzaddikaya divginta kulhu tzayetin leillen millin denafke mippumeh uma kudsha berich hu vechal tzaddikayya mitaddenin lemishma mille deorayeta beshaata da veana ehe shachiv bearsay amar leh hashta ema milach

Amar leh sheelna al ma deamarte bifsuka da vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva yihye bet elohim deda even shetiya hech efshar deha even shetiyya ad la itbere alma havat uminnah ishtil alma veatte amarte asher samti demashma deyaakov shave lah hashta uchtiv vayyikkach et haeven asher sam meraashotav

Vetu deyaakov bevet el hava veavna da havat biyerushalam amar leh kal ara deyisrael ichpal techotoy vehahu even techoteh havat amar leh asher sam ketiv uchtiv vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva amar leh i yadate milla ema lah

Patach veamar ani vetzedek echoze fanecha esbea vehakitz temunatecha david malka chavivuta udvekuta dileh behay even hava vealah amar even maasu habbonim hayeta lerosh pinna vechad baa leistakkela bechizu yekara demareh netal lehay even bideh bekadmita ulvatar ayil

Begin dechal man devae leitchazaa kamme mareh la ail ella behay even dichtiv bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh vedavid meshabbach garmeh veamar ani betzedek echoze fanecha vechal ishtaddeluteh dedavid leitchazaa behay even kedeka yeut legabbe dilela

Ta chaze avraham atkin tzelota detzafra veoda tivu demareh bealma veatkin hahi shaata betikkunaha kedeka yaot dichtiv vayyashkem avraham babboker yitzchak atkin tzelota demincha veoda bealma deit din veit dayyan deyachol leshezava ulmedan alma
Yaakov atkin tzelota dearvit uvgin tzelota da deatkin ma dela atkin var nash mikkadmat dena kedeka yeut vegin kach shabbach garmeh veamar
143: Vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva dead hahi shaata la shavi lah achora kavateh

Uvgin kach vayyikkach et haeven asher sam meraashotav vayyasem otah matztzeva may matztzeva dehava nefila veokim lah vayyitztzok shemen al roshah deha beyaakov talya milta lemebad yattir mikkal bene alma

Ata rabbi yehuda unshakeh amar leh vechal hay yedate veatte mishtaddel bischorata umannach chayye alma amar leh dehava dechika li shaata veit li teren benin vekayemin kal yoma beve rav veana ishtaddalna al mezonayehu ulmehav lon agar lemorayehu begin deyishtaddelun beorayeta
Patach veamar ushlomo yashav al kisse david aviv vattikkon malchuto meod may shevacha da ella deatkin even shetiyya veshave alah kodesh hakkodashim uchden vattikkon malchuto meod
Uchtiv uritiha lizkor berit olam deha kudsha berich hu tiuvta dileh bah tadir uman dela itchaze bah la ail kamme mareh veal da ketiv uritiha lizkor berit olam
Uritiha may uritiha raza hu kema deatte amer vehitveta tav al mitzchot vegv leitchazzaa alayehu veika deamre da reshimu deat kaddisha di bevisra
Amar rabbi yehuda vadday kolla hu aval hay keshet deitchaze bealma beraza ilaa kayema vechad yifkun yisrael min galuta zemina hay keshet leitkashta begavenoy kechalla da demitkashsheta levaalah
Amar leh hahu yuday kach amar li abba kad hava mistallak mealma la tetzappe leragle dimshicha ad deyitchaze hay keshet bealma mitkashta begaveni nehirin veyitnehir lealma uchden tzefe leh lemashiach

Menalan dichtiv uritiha lizkor berit olam vehashta deitchazzeya bigvanin chashochin mitchazzeya leduchrana dela yiyite mabbul aval behahi zimna itchazzeya bigvanin nehirin umitkashsheta betikkuna kechalla demitkashsheta levaalah uchden lizkor berit olam veyidkar kudsha berich hu lehay berit deihu begaluta veyakim lah meafra hada hu dichtiv uvikkeshu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam uchtiv veavdu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam asher akim lahem asher akim meafar kema deatte amer akim et sukkat david hannofalet veal da uritiha lizkor berit olam ulakma lah meafra
Veamar hachi abba divgin kach idkar beorayeta purkana deyisrael udchurana dilah veda hu dichtiv asher nishbati meavor me noach od al haaretz ken nishbati miktzof alayich umiggear bach
Vayyihu beni noach hayyotzim min hatteva rabbi elazar amar kevan dichtiv vayyihu bene noach ammay amar hayyotzim min hatteva vechi benin achoranin hau leh dela nafke min tevuta
Amar leh rabbi abba in deha levatar olidu benoy benin dichtiv veelle toldot shem vegv veinun la nafke miggo tevuta uvgin kach ketiv hayyotzim min hatteva shem cham vayafet

Rabbi shimon amar ilu havena shechiach bealma kad yahiv kudsha berich hu sifra dechanoch bealma vesifra deadam atkifna dela yishtakkechun bene enasha begin dela chayeshu kal chachaman leistakkela behu vetaan bemillin achoranin leafaka mershu illaa lirshu achora vehashta ha chakkime alma yadin millin vesatmin lon umittakfe befulchana demarehon

Vehay kera ashkachna beraza derazin dechad itar chedva dechal chedvan temira setima savta desavtin anhir minneh nehiru dakkik chedva dechal chedvan nahir leyamina bimshach revut illaa venahir lismala bechedva dechamra tav nahir leemtzaita bechedva ditren sitrin ruach itar veruach salka veityehiv berucha
Davkan da beda telat alin bitlat miggo telat nafka chad berit dedavka bivrit itavarat ruach desalka mitavarat minneh kad ityehivat bitren sitrin itdabbeku rucha berucha
144: Umitabberan mittelat benin venoach veteva nafku minnayehu telata kegavena ditlata illain veillen inun denafku miggo tevuta shem vecham veyafet shem devistar yamina cham devistar semala yefet argevana dechalil lon

Vecham hu avi chenaan zuhama dedahava techot kastifin itaruta derucha mesaava denachash kadmaa uvgin kach reshim veamar vecham hu avi chenaan deayete levatin al alma hahu chenaan deitlatteya hahu chenaan deachshich anpe beriyyan

Uvgin kach la nafik miggo kelala dechulhu ella da dichtiv vecham hu avi chenaan hahu deachshich alma vela ketiv bichlala da veshem hu avi chach o yefet hu avi chach ella miyyad kafatz veamar vecham hu avi chenaan vadday

Veal da kad ata avraham ma ketiv vayyaavor avram baaretz dead la hava kiyyuma deavahan vela atu zara deyisrael bealma deyippuk shema da veyeul shema illaa kaddisha kad hau zakkain yisrael ikre ara al shema da eretz yisrael kad la zachu ikre ara al shema achora eretz kenaan

Veal da ketiv vayyomer arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav deihu ayete levatin al alma uvnachash ma ketiv arur atta mikkal habbehema hayenu dichtiv eved avadim veal da ketiv shem cham veyafet telat ilen bene noach hayyotzim min hatteva kidkaamrinan

Shelosha elle beni noach kiyyuma dechal alma kiyyuma deraza illaa umeelle naftza chal haaretz hayenu raza ditlat gevanin illain dechad hahu nahar denagid venafik ashke leginta bechela ditlat illen illain umittamman itparshan gevanin diltatta kal chad vechad kalil bechavreh leachazaa dikara dekudsha berich hu itpashshat leela vetatta veihu chad beillae vetattae

Amar rabbi elazar telat gevanin illen bechal inun deatyan missetar dikdusha umechezu ditlat gevanin illen mitparshan lechal inun deatyan missitra derucha achora vechad tistakkel beraza dedargin tishkach hech mitparshan gevanin lechal inun sitrin ad deayelin letatta beraza deinun shiva veesrin tzinnorin dedashshe dechafyan lithome
Vecholla yedia lachachimin elonin zakkaa chulakhon detzaddikaya dekudsha berich hu itrae bikrehon vegale lon sitrin illain dechachmeta alayehu ketiv sod Adonai lireav uvrito lehodiam

Patach rabbi elazar veamar Adonai elohay atta aromimcha ode shimcha ki asita pele etzot merachok emuna omen kamma it lon livne nasha leistakkala bikra dekudsha berich hu ulshabbecha likareh begin dechal man deyada leshabbecha lemareh kedeka yaot kudsha berich hu avid leh reuteh vela od ella deasge birchan leela vetatta
Veal da man deyada leshabbecha leh lemareh ulyachada shemeh chaviv hu leela vechamid letatta vekudsha berich hu mishtabbeach beh vealeh ketiv vayyomer li avdi atta yishrael asher becha etpaer

Vayyachel noach ish haadama vayyitta kerem rabbi yehuda verabbi yose chad amar miggan eden ittarchat untziv lah hacha vechad amar beara havat veakar lah veshatal lah uvhahu yoma avdat ibin venitzat lavlevin veanavim vehava sachit lah veshate min chamra verave

Rabbi shimon amar raza dechachmeta ihu hacha behay kera kad baa noach lemivdak behahu chova devadak adam harishon lav leitdabbeka beh ella leminda ulatkana alma vela yachil sachat anavim lemivdak behahu kerem kevan demata lehay vayyishkar vayyitgal vela hava leh chela lemekam uvgin kach vayyitgal galle pirtza dealma dehava satim betoch aholo ketiv beh veal da ketiv veal tikrav el petach betah betoch
145: Kegavena da bene aharon detaninan shetuye yayin hau vechi man yahiv lon chamra behahu atar lemishte i salka datach deinun chatzifin hau derao chamra lav hachi ella vadday mehahu chamra rao dichtiv vayyakrivu lifne Adonai esh zara ketiv hacha esh zara uchtiv hatam lishmarcha meishsha zara vecholla chad milla

Vechen kegavena da vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal veal da itar cham avi chenaan kema deittemar veityehiv atar lichnaan leshaltaa umay dehava haden tzaddik beraza divrit serso vetanya deaavar mineh hahu kiyyuma

Uvgin kach amar arur deha levatin itaru bekadmita al yedeh bealma eved avadim yihye kema deatte amer arur atta mikkal habbehema vegv kolla yittakkan lezimna deate vehu la yittakkan vecholla yifkun lecheru vehu la yippuk veraza ihu leinun deyade archoy ushvile deorayeta

Patach veamar ki feshaay ani eda vechattati negdi tamid kamma it lon livne nasha leistammera mechovayehu mikkame kudsha berich hu deha levatar dechata bar nash rashim hu choveh leela vela itmechak bar betukfa dituvta sagya kema deatte amer ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam aonech lefanay

Ta chaze kevan dechav var nash kamme kudsha berich hu zimna chada avid reshimu vechad chav beh zimna tinyana ittakkaf hahu reshimu yattir chav beh zimna telitaa itpashshat hahu kitma missitra da lesitra da keden ketiv nichtam aonech lefanay
Ta chaze david malka kevan dechav kamme kudsha berich hu al iska devat sheva chashiv dehahu chova itreshim aleh lealmin ma ketiv gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut aavar hahu reshimu mikkammeh
Amar leh rabbi abba veha taninan devat sheva dileh dedavid malka havat min yoma deitbere alma ammay yahavah kudsha berich hu leuriya hachitti min kadmat dena

Amar leh hachi orchoy dekudsha berich hu af al gav deitteta azmina leh levar nash lemeheve dileh akdim achara unsiv lah ad demata zimneh dehay kevan demata zimneh itdachya hay denasiv lah mikkamme hay achora deate levatar veistallak mealma vekashe kammeh kudsha berich hu leaavara leh mealma ad la mate zimneh mikkamme hay achora
Veraza devat sheva deityehivat leuriya hachitti bekadmita puk veduk vetishkach ammay ityehivat ara kaddisha lichnaan ad la yetun yisrael vetishkach milla da vecholla raza chada ihu umilla chada

Ta chaze david af al gav deode al choveh vetav bituvta la aade libbeh uruteh meinun chovin dechav umehahu chova devat sheva begin dedachil alayehu tadir dilma garim chad minnayehu vikatreg aleh beshaata desakkana uvgin kach la anshe lon mineh umeruteh

Davar achar ki feshaay ani eda kulhu dargin detalyan behu chove bene nasha ani eda vechattati negdi tamid da pegimu desihara dela nafka misuvta ad deata shelomo veitnehirat beashlamuta uchden itbassam alma vitivu yisrael lerachatzan dichtiv vayyeshev yehuda veyisrael lavetach ish tachat gafno vetachat teenato veim kal da vechattati negdi tamid vela itpesak mealma ad deyete malka meshicha lezimna deate kema deittemar veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz
Hu haya gibbor tzayyid lifni Adonai al ken yeamar kenimrod gibbor tzayid lifne Adonai ta chaze hu hava gevar takkif levushoy deadam harishon hava lavish vehava yada lemetzad tzeda divriyyata behu

Amar rabbi elazar nimrod hava mefatte livriyyata lemehach batar pulchan deavoda zara vehava shallit beinun levushin venatzach bene alma vehava amar deihu shallita bealma ufalchin leh beni nasha veammay ikre shemeh nimrod demarad bemalka illaa dilela demarad beillae umarad betattae
146: Levushin shallit al kal beni alma umalach behu umarad bemareh veamar deihu shallita dealma vehava mefatte livriyyata avatreh ad demashach bene nasha lemefak mibbatar pulchana demare alma amar rabbi shimon beilen levushin yade behu chavraya raza illaa

Matnitin vayehi chal haaretz safa achat udvarim achadim rabbi shimon patach vehabbayit behibbanoto even shelema massa nivna umakkavot vehaggarzen kal kele barzel lo nishma babbayit behibbanoto vehabbayit behibbanoto vechi la hava bani leh shelomo vechulhu umanin dehau tamman mahu behibbanoto

Ella kach hu kema dichtiv miksha tease hamnora im hi miksha mahu tease ella vadday kolla beat venisa itavid ihu miggarmeh kevan desharan lemebad avidta olif leumanin lemebad bah ma delo hau yadin mikkadmat dena

May tama begin devircheta dekudsha berich hu shera al yedayehu veal da ketiv behibbanoto ihu itbeni miggarmeh dehu ulfa ulfan leumanin hech sharan lemebad vela istallak meenayehu reshimu dehahu avidta mammash umistakkelan beh veavde ad deitbene kal beta

Even shelema massa nivne shelema ketiv chaser even shelema vadday massa deitnetil veatya vesharya alayehu veitavid avidta massa deantil yadan lemebad dela middatayehu ketiv hacha massa uchtiv hatam ulmassa et hammachanot
Umakkavot vehaggarzen kal kele barzel lo nishma begin deshamir baza kolla vela ishtema milla dela itzterichu lishar manin lemebad vecholla beat venisa hava

Amar rabbi shimon kamma chavivin inun mille deorayeta zakkaa chulakeh man deitassak behu veyada lemehach beorach keshot vehabbayit behibbanoto kad salka biruta dekudsha berich hu lemebad yekara likareh salka miggo machashava reuta leitpashta veitpashtat meatar deihi machashava setima dela ityeda

Ad deitpashtat vesharya leve garon atar deihu nevia tadir beraza deihu ruach chayyim uchden kad itpashtat hahi machashava vesharya beatar da ikre hahi machashava elohim chayyim dichtiv Adonai hu elohim chayyim

Od baa leitpashta ulitgalleya mittamman nafku esha verucha umaya kelilan kechada venafak yaakov gevar shelim veihu kol chad denafik veishtema mehacha machashava dehava setima bachashay ishtema leitgalya
Od itpashtat hay machashava leitgalya uvatash hay kol veakkish besifvan uchden nafka dibbur deashlim kolla vegale kolla ishtema decholla ihu hahi machashava setima dehavat lego vecholla chad

Kevan demata itpashtuta da veitavid dibbur bitkifa dehahu kala keden vehabbayit behibbanoto kaasher nivna lo ketiv ella behibbanoto bechal zimna vezimna even shelema kema deittemar uchtiv baatara sheitra lo immo

Massa denafka millego vesharya venatil levar nafka milleela vesharya venatil letatta umakkavot vehaggarzen kal kele barzel illen shear dargin tattain dechulhu talyan beh vela ishtemau vela itkabbelan lego kad ihi salka leitachada leela ulyanka mittamman veda hu behibbanoto

Uchden kad ihi yanka kulhu kayeme bechedvata veyankin veitmalyan birchan uchden kayemin almin kulhu beraza chada beyichuda chad vela have behu bechulhu almin piruda levatar denatle chulakhon kal chad vechad kulhu mitpashtan umitparshan lesitrayehu lema deitmannan
Ta chaze vayehi chal haaretz safa achat vegv
147: Levatar ma ketiv vayehi benasam mikkedem mehahu kadmaa dealma vayyimtzeu bika beeretz shinar deha mittamman mitparshan lechal inun sitrin veihu rish malchu leitbedara

Vei tema ha ketiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan umishsham yippared vadday hachi hu dechevan denatle mittamman have piruda vechad inun kenishin tamman leyankaa la havi piruda vechad natlin have piruda dichtiv vayehi benasam mikkedem vayyimtzeu bika kema deittemar

Vayehi chal haaretz safa echat udvarim achadim deha keden alma bisoda veikkara vesharsha chada umhemnuta chada beh bekudsha berich hu ma ketiv vayehi benasam mikkedem mikkadmaa ikkara dealma mehemnuta decholla vayyimtzeu bika metzia ashkachu venafku bah mittechot mehemnuta illaa

Ta chaze nimrod ma ketiv beh vattehi reshit mamlachto bavel deha mittamman netal leitachada birshu achora vehacha vayyimtzeu bika beeretz shinar mittamman netalu belibbayehu leafaka mershuta illaa lirshu achora

Vayyomru hava nivna lanu ir umigdal verosho bashshamayim venaase lanu shem rabbi chiyya patach veharshaim kayyam nigrash vegv vechi it yam nigrash in dechad yamma nafka mittikkuneh veazil bela chabbala keden nigrash veitterach meatreh keman derave chamra vela yativ al buryeh vesalka venachata may tama begin ki hashket lo yuchal veyigreshu memav refesh vetit demafku memoy kal hahu tina deyamma vechal tinnufa lesifvateh

Kegavena da inun reshaim denafka mearcha detakna veazle keravi chamra bela tikkuna denafke meorach meshar leorach akim may tama begin ki hashket lo yuchal deha akimu dearchayehu garim lon lemehach bela tikkuna uvla shechichu
Vela od ella dechal rugza didhu beshaata deamri milla mippumayehu hahu milla refesh vetit kulhu mafke tinnufa vegiula mippumayehu levar ad demistaave

Kumtura dehurmana memallelan belashon hakkodesh demalache hasharett ishtemodan beh vela hau memallin belishan achora begin kacha kettiv veatta lo yibbatztzer mehem vegv deilmale mishtaan belishan achora demalache illae la hau ishtemodan beh gara chashivu deinun chashvin lemebad begin deovada deshedin lav ihu ella beriga chada lechezu bene enasha velo yattir

Udvarim achadim dehau yadin dargin illain kal chad vechad buryeh velo ittechelaf lehu darga uvgin kacha kettiv udvarim achadim uvgin kacha itteyaatu beita bisha ita dechachmetta dichtiv hava nivne lanu ir umigdal
Kolla beraza dechachmetta hu uvau leittakpa beara sitra achora ulmippelach pulchana dileh begin dehau yadin deha kal dinin bishin mittamman nachattin lealmin uvayan lidchuye darga dekuddesha

Ir umigdal da chachmetta illaa hau yade doshoma kaddisha la ittettakkaf beara ella beir umigdal ir dichtiv ir dad hi tziyyon vegv migdal dichtiv kemigdal david tzavarecha uvchachmetta avadu lemeheve shaltana desitra achora biara dedachya adon kal haaretz meattereh ulmehevi diura lesitra achora beara

Venaase lanu shem kema daachida ihu shem leela nattekif lah benono lemeheve shem beara pen nappotz yedia hau yadin deyittebbadderun meal appe ara uvgin kacha hau mitteyachadin lemebad avidta da bechachma

Sitra achora ihu dechar venukva tukpa dezuhama dedina kashya uchma deadam chav behu veittekappu begineh alma uf hachi innun avdin deittettakkaf yattir dichtiv asher banu bene haadam benoy deadam kadmaa deayete veashlit sitra achora al alma sitra visha kema desitra dikdusha lav shaltaneh behay alma ella beir umigdal uf hachi chashive innun lemivne ir umigdal lemishlat hay setar bisha bealma
148: Ta chaze vayyomru hava nivna lanu ir umigdal verosho bashshamayim let hava ella hazmana bealma nivne lanu ir umigdal verosho bashshamayim kulhu beeta bisha atu lesarva beh bekudsha berich hu bishtuta atu betippeshu delibba
Amar rabbi abba shetuta nesivu belibbayehu aval bechachma dirshiu atu begin lenafka mershu illaa lirshu achora ulachlafa yekareh likara nuchraa uvcholla it raza dechachmeta illaa

Hava nivna lanu ir umigdal ta chaze kad matu lehay bika deihu reshu nuchraa veitgeli lehu atar deshaltenuta da tekia bego nune yamma amru ha atar lemetav ulittakfa libba leithannaa beh tattae miyyad hava nivna lanu ir natkin beatar da ir umigdal

Venaase lanu shem atar da yehe lan ledachala vela achora venivne leatar da ir umigdal lamma lan lesalka leela dela nechol leithannaa minnah ha hacha atar metakna venaase lanu shem dachala lemiflach tamman pen nafutz ledargin achoranin venitbaddar lesitre alma
