Nachatt hay shema dekaddisha lemechezi ovadehon devinyano devanu veinnun hau memallelan bilshon kodesh legabbe kal innun dargin kaddishin vehau matztzelichin kevan denachattatt kedusha ittebbalbelu kal innun dargin illain nachattu vettattain seliku vela hau kayemin beorach meshar kema dehau ulvattar bilbel lishanhon be lishan veittebbaddaru lechal sitre alma

Chad memanna hu birkia uveh kayemin kal mappettechan deovade alma vihu kayema zammin beshaatte verige deoma veinnun hau yadin beraza dechachmetta ginza dehay memanna vehau patteche vesagre umatztzeleche beovadehon bememra deppumhon kevan deittebbalbal memra dilhon kolla ittemena minnayehu

Vaattar mettukkan ashkachu behahu bika sitra desitrin vayyimtzeu bika attar mettukkan lehay sitra bisha devau innun leattekappa veittemenau tukpa dehahu sitra hava talya leittepperaa behahi bika ad denatla tamman chelin umashiryan kegavena deinnun devanu karta umigdela veitteyehivu kulhu bidaha veittekatalu tamman
Innun dolo bau lemepak beketz hayyamin ittebbehilu venappelu beketz hayyamim behahu attar deittechallash tukpa bekadmita behay bika da kettiv vehi melea atztzamott
Veittettakpatt behahu tzulma deakim nevuchadnetztzar veittebbar tukpa levattar beinnun garmin uvhahu tzulma deinnun kadmae kayemu vkamu al raglehon vehahu tzulma ittebbar
Uchden yadu kal ammin dealma delet eloha bar kudsha bericha hu bilchodoy vtu deittekaddash shemeh al yeda dechananya mishael vaazarya vecholla bechad yoma veal da kettiv vehikdishu ett kedosh yaakov

Vayyered Adonai lirot et hair veet hammigdal da hu chad meinnun eser zimnin denachata shechinta leara vechi ma hu lirot vela hava yada mikkadmat dena ella lirot leashgacha bedina kema deatte amer yere Adonai alechem veyishpot

Et hair veet hammigdal hacha it leistakkala deha la ketiv lirot et bene haadam ella lirot et hair veet hammigdal ammay ella beshaata deashgach kudsha berich hu bedina bekadmita yashgach bedarga dilela ulvatar bedarga diltatta bekadmita beillae ulvatar betattae uvgin dehay milla mata leela ashgachuta dilela hava beh bekadmita dichtiv lirot et hair veet hammigdal
Asher banu bene haadam may bene haadam benoy deadam kadmaa demarad bemareh vegaram mota lealma asher banu bene haadam binyana vadday amru uvau lemivni leela
Rabbi shimon patach ko amar Adonai elohim shaar
149: Hechatzer happenimit happone kadim yihye sagur sheshet yeme hammaase uvom hashshabbat yippateach uvom hachodesh yippateach hay kera it leistakkala beh veihu raza kema deittemar yihye sagur sheshet yeme hammaase ammay

Ella ilen yeme chol detara da yihye sagur dela leishtammasha chol bekudsha uvom hashshabbat yippateach uvom hachodesh yippateach deha keden shimmusha dekudsha bekudsha uchden itnehir sihara leitchabbera beshimsha
Ta chaze tara da la itpattach beinnun shitta yome dechol begin deha beinnun yome dechol alma tattaa ittezan veshaltin kal innun shit yomin dechol al alma bar beara deyisrael

Veinnun deshalte la shalte beara kaddisha begin dehashshaar hazze ihu sagur aval beom hashshabbat uvom hachodesh kulhu mitabberan vela shaltin begin dehashshaar hazze ihu patuach vealma ihu bechedva veittezan mittamman vela ityehiv alma lirshu achora

Vei tema dechal innun shit yomin innun shaltin bilchodayehu ta chaze happone kadim ad la yekumun leshaltaa ihu istakkal tadir bealma aval la itpattach leitzena alma mikkudsha bar beoma deshabbatta uvoma dechadsha vechulhu yomin kulhu itdabbekan beoma deshabbatta veitzenu mittamman deha beoma deshabbatta kulhu tarin petichan venayecha ishtechach lecholla leillae vetattae ta chaze vayyered Adonai lirot nachat mikkudsha lechol leashgacha bamme debbanu vekayemu kiyyuma leatara al alma ledachala lon

Rabbi yitzchak hava yativ kammeh derabbi shimon amar leh ma chamu illen deavadu shetuta da lemarda beh bekudsha berich hu vechulhu beeta chada itkayemu beda amar leh ha ittemar dichtiv vayehi benasam mikkedem itnetilu meela letatta itnetilu meara deyisrael venachatu levaval amru ha hacha atar lemidbak

Venaase lanu shem vegv veyitdabbak siyyua diltatta beatar da begin dechad dina ate leashraa bealma ha atar da lekovleh umehacha ithanne alma veyittezan deha leela dechiku ihu leitzena alma minneh vela od ella anan nissak lirkia venaggach beh kerava dela yechot tofana bealma kedivkadmita

Vayyomer Adonai hen am echad vesafa achat lechullam begin dechulhu kechada beyichuda dechulhon yaavdun veyitzlechun beovadayehu yitbadderun dargin kal chad lesitreh uvgin kach yitbadderun kal hanne diltatta ma ketiv vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham

Vei tema lishanhon ammay itbalbel ella begin dechulhon memallelin bilshon hakkodesh hahu lishna ka avid lon siyyua begin divovada uvmillula defuma talyan millin illen leadbeka kavana delibba uvda avde siyyua lehahu atar devae leakama

Veal da itbalbal lishanhon dela yachilu leittakkafa reuthon bilshon hakkodesh kevan deitchallaf lishanhon la atzlachu beovada begin dechela dilela la yade vela ishtemode bar bilshon hakkodesh vechad itbalbal lishna dilhon itchallash chelehon veitbar tukfa dilhon

Ta chaze deha milla deamre tattae bilshon hakkodesh kulhu chele shemaya yade beh veittakfe beh velishan achora la yadin vela ishtemode beh veal da illen kevan deitbalbal lishana dilhon miyyad vayyachdelu livnot hair deha itbar chelayehu vela yachilu lemebad midde biruta dilhon
Leheve shemeh mevarach min alma vead alma di chachmeta ugvurata di lehhi deha begin deanchit kudsha berich hu raze dechachmeta lealma itkalkalu beh bene nasha uvau leitgara beh
Yahav chachmeta illaa leadam harishon uvhahi chachma
150: Deitgele leh yada dargin veitdevak beyetzer hara ad deistalleku minneh mabbue dechachmeta ulvatar tav kamme mareh veitgalleyan leh minnayehu vela kekadmita levatar behahu sifra dileh yada chachman ulvatar atu bene nasha veargizu kammeh

Yahav chachmeta lenoach uflach bah lekudsha berich hu levatar ma ketiv vayyeshte min hayyayyin vayyishkar vayyitgal kema deittemar yahav chachmeta leavraham uflach bah lekudsha berich hu levatar nafak minneh yishmael deargiz kamme kudsha berich hu vechen yitzchak nafak minneh esav yaakov nesav teren achatan
Yahav chachmeta lemoshe ma ketiv beh bechal beti neeman hu vela hava kemoshe shammash meheman bechulhu dargin vela sata libbeh betiuvta dechad minnayehu ella kaim bimhemnuta illaa kedeka yeut

Yahav chachmeta illaa lishlomo malka levatar ma ketiv beh mishle shelomo hammassa neum haggever leitiel leitiel veuchal amar shelomo itti el vechachmeta dileh hu veuchal veechul lemebad reuti levatar vayyakem Adonai satan lishlomo vegv

Ta chaze begin zeiru dechachmeta deashkachu illen mehahu chachma dekadmae itgaru beh bekudsha berich hu uvanu migdal veavadu kal ma deavadu ad deitbaddaru meanpe ara vela ishtaar behu chachma lemebad mide

Aval lezimna deate kudsha berich hu yitar chachmeta bealma veyiflechun leh bah hada hu dichtiv veet ruchi etten bekirbechem veasiti lav kekadmae dechavilu beh alma ella veasiti et asher bechukkay telechu veet mishpatay tishmeru vaasitem

Rabbi yose verabbi chiyya hau azle bearcha amar leh rabbi yose lerabbi chiyya niftach beorayeta venema milla patach rabbi yose veamar ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machancha lehatztzilcha velatet oyevecha lefanecha vehaya machnecha kadosh velo yire vecha ervat davar veshav meacharecha ki Adonai elohecha mithallech mehallech mibbae leh ella kema deatte amer mithallech baggan leruach hayyom veda hu ilana deachal minneh adam harishon mithallech nukva mehallech dechar

Veda hu deazil kammayehu deyisrael kad hau azle bemadbera dichtiv vayeya holech lifnehem yomam vegv hu deazil kammeh debbar nash kad azil bearcha dichtiv tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav veda hu deazil kammeh debbar nash beshaata deihu zache velamma lehatztzilcha velatet oyevecha lefanecha leishtezava bar nash bearcha vela yishlot beh achora

Uvgin kach libbae leh lebbar nash leistammera mechovoy uldakkaa legarmeh may dachu da dichtiv vehaya machanecha kadosh may kadosh kedoshim mibbae leh ella machanecha kadosh illen shayefe gufa degufa itchabbar veittakkan behu uvgin kach vehaya machancha kadosh velo yire vecha ervat davar

May ervat davar da milleta deeryan deda hu milla dekudsha berich hu mais bah yattir mikkolla kevan deamar velo yire vecha ervat ammay davar ella hanni chayyave alma degaale umsaave garmayehu bemilla dilhon denafke mippumayehu veha ihu ervat davar

Vechal kach lamma begin deihu azil kammach vei atte avid keden miyyad veshav meacharecha dela yezil bahadach veyetuv meacharecha veanan ha azlinan kammeh bearcha nitassek bemille deorayeta deha orayeta itattera al resheh devar nash ushchinta la aadiat mineh

Patach rabbi chiyya veamar vayyomer Adonai hen am echad vesafa achat lechullam vegv ta chaze ma ketiv vayehi benasam mikkedem may mikkedem mikkadmono shel olam vayyimtzeu vayyiru mibbae leh may vayyimtzeu ella metzia ashkachu tamman meraze dechachmeta mikkadmae deitnear tamman min bene tofana uvah ishtadlu lemebad behahi avidta deavadu lesarva beh bekudsha berich hu vehau amre befuma veavde
151: Chame ma ketiv hen am echad vesafa achat lechullam begin deinnun belibba chad uruta chad ummallele bilshon hakkodesh veatta lo yibbatzer mehem kal asher yazmu laasot velet man deyimna ovada dilhon aval may aavid avalbel lon dargin dilela velishan dilhon letatta uchden itmena ovada dilhon

Uma begin dehau biruta velibba chad ummallele bilshon hakkodesh ketiv lo yibbatzer mehem kol asher yazmu laasot vedina dilela la yachil leshaltaa behu anan o chavraya demitassekin beorayeta veanan belibba chad uruta chad al achat kamma vechamma

Amar rabbi yose mikkan leinnun mare demachloket let lon kiyyuma deha kal zimna divne alma illen im illen biruta chada velibba chad af al gav demarde beh bekudsha berich hu la shalta behu dina dilela kevan deitpallegu miyyad vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham vegv

Amar rabbi chiyya ishtema decholla bemilla defuma talya deha kevan deitbalbel miyyad vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham aval bezimna deate ma ketiv ki az ehefoch el ammim safa verura likro kullam beshem Adonai ulavdo shechem echad uchtiv vehaya Adonai lemelech al kal haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushmo echad baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
Sitre tora tona bettukpa dehurmanu demalka antziv chad ilana rabba vettakkif go netian ilain netia ilana da bitteresar techumin istachar bearba sitrin dealma perisa ragleh
Tk parse matlanoy kal reuttin deinnun parsin beh talyan kad ittear hay kulhu mittearin bahadeh let man denappik merutteh levattar kulhu birutta chada bahadeh
Kam milleela ittenachit bematlanoy lego yamma minneh yamma ittemalya ihu mekora mayin denavin techotteh mitteppallegin kal memoy divreshit shaku deginta beh talyan
Kal nishmettin dealma minnih parchin nishmettin illen alin beginta lenachatta lehay alma nishmatta kad nappeka ittebbarcha beshevo birchan lemeheve abba leguppa bisliku Adonai dediukno illaa
Kad baya lenachatta lehay alma ome lah kudsha bericha hu lemitar pikkude orayeta ulmebad reutteh umasar lah mea mappettechan
152: Leh avraham mikkal bene darih dehau abbire lev veinnun rechokim mitztzedaka kema deittemar

Rabbi yose patach ma yedidot mishkenotecha Adonai tzevaot kamma it lon livni nasha leistakkala befulchana dekudsha berich hu deha kal bene nasha la yade vela mistakkele al ma kaim alma veinnun al ma kayemin dechad bera kudsha berich hu alma avad shemaya meesh umimmayim mitarvin kechada vela hau galde ulvatar aglidu vekayemu berucha illaa umittamman shatil alma lekayema al samchin veinnun samchin la kayemin ella behahu rucha uvshaata dehahu rucha istallak kulhu meraffin vezain vealma irtat hada hu dichtiv hammargiz eretz mimkomah veammudeha yitpallatzun vecholla kaim al orayeta dechad yisrael mishtaddele beorayeta mitkayyem alma veinnun kayemin vesamchin kayemin beatrayehu bekiyyuma shelim

Ta chaze beshaata deitar palgut lelya vekudsha berich hu al leginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikaya kulhu ilanin divginta deeden mezammeran umshabbechan kammeh dichtiv az yerannenu atze hayyaar millifne Adonai vegv

Vecharoza kare vechayil veamar lechon amrin kaddishin elonin man minchon deayil rucha beudnoy lemishma veenoy pekichin lemecheme velibbeh patuach leminda beshaata derucha dechal ruchin arim besimu denishmata umittamman nafik kala dekalaya cheyelin itbaddar learba sitre alma

Chad salik listar chad chad nachit lehahu setar chad ayil ben teren teren mitarin mitatteran bitlat telat ayele bechad chad appik gevanin shit minhon listar chad veshit minhon nachate lehahu setar shit ayele bitresar teresar mitarin beesrin utren shit kelilan baasara asara kaim bechad
Vay leinnun denayeme shenta bechorehon la yade vela mistakkelan ech yekumun bedina dechushban itpakad
153: Kad istaav gufa venishmata shatya al anpe deavira detihara vesalka venachata vetarin la mitpattechan mitgalgelan keavnin bego kusfita vay lon man yitba lon dela yekumun beidduna da bego duchte deinnuge detzaddikaya itpakdun duchtayehu itmasserun bida deduma nachate vela salke alayehu ketiv kala anan vayyelach ken yored sheol lo yaale

Behahi shaata itar shalhova chad missetar tzafon uvatash bearba sitre alma venachit umate ben gadfe detarnegola veitar hahu shalhova beh vekare velet man deitar bar innun zakkae keshot dekayeme veitaru beorayeta uchden kudsha berich hu vechal innun tzaddikaya divgo ginta deeden tzayete lekalehon kema deatte amer hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashshemiini

Vayyomer Adonai el avram ma ketiv leela vayyamat haran al pene terach aviv vegv may irya hacha ella ad hahu yoma la hava bar nash demit bechayye avoy bar da vechad itreme avram lenura itketil haran uvgin da nafku mittamman man katil lon leharan ella kevan deramu avraham lenura dekkassedae itgeli aleh kudsha berich hu ushezaveh vehava haran achuy kae tamman amru kassedae vegin zechuteh deharan ishteziv miyyad nafak shalhova deesha veokdeh leharan hada hu dichtiv vayyamat haran al peni terach aviv veit deamre zara detterach let esha shalta beh aval nerame leharan lenura vei la itokad neda bevadday dela shalta nura bezare miyyad rami leh leharan lenura veittokd vehava terach avoy kaim tamman hada hu dichtiv vayyamat haran al pene terach aviv behahu yoma yadu kal umaya velishnaya dela shezveh leavraham ella kudsha berich hu deihu yechidai dealma vehau mayeten benayehu lemishkeneh deavraham veamrin leh chaminan lach deatte rachitz bekudsha berich hu deihu ribboneh dealma olif levanana meorchach deatte yeda vealayehu amar kera nedive ammim neesafu am elohe avraham

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyikkach terach et avram beno veet lot ben haran vegv vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim vayyetzu ittam itto mibbae leh deha ketiv vayyikkach terach vegv may vayyetzu ittam ella terach velot im avraham vesara nafku deinnun hau ikkera lemepak miggo innun chayyavayya dechevan dechama terach deavraham bereh ishteziv miggo nura ithaddar lemebad reuteh deavraham uvgin kach vayyetzu ittam terach velot

Uvshaata denafku ma ketiv lalechet artza kenaan diruta dilhon hava lemehach tamman mikkan olifna kal man deitar leitdakkaa mesayein leh ta chaze dehachi hu dechevan dichtiv lalechet artza kenaan miyyad vayyomer Adonai el avram lech lecha vead deihu itar bekadmita la ketiv lech lecha

Ta chaze mila dilela la itar ad deitar letatta bekadmita al ma detishre hahi dilela veraza demilla nehora uchma la itachid binhora chivara ad deihi itarit bekadmita kevan deihi itarit bekadmita miyyad nehora chivera sharya alah

Veal da ketiv elohim al dami lach al techerash veal tishkot el begin dela yitpesak nehora chivara mealma lealmin vechen hammazkirim et Adonai al domi lachem begin leatara letatta bemma deyishre itaruta dilela vechen kevan deitar bar nash itaruta bekadmita keden itar itaruta dilela ta chaze kevan dichtiv vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim vegv miyyad vayyomer Adonai el avram vegv
Vayyomer Adonai el avram lech lecha amar rabbi elazar lech lecha legarmach leatkana garmach leatkana darga dilach lech lecha let ante lemekam hacha ben chayyavin illen
154: Deha kudsha berich hu yahiv leh leavraham rucha dechachmeta vehava yada umtzaref sitre deyishuve alma veistakkal behu veatkal betikla veyada chelin di memannan al sitre yishuva
Kad mata lego nekuda deemtzaita deyishuva takil betikla vela hava salik beyadeh ashgach leminda chela di memanna alah vela yachil leitdabbeka biruteh
Takil kamma zimnin vechama deha mittamman ishtil kal alma ashgach vetzaraf vetakal leminda vechama deha chela illaa dealah let leh shiura amik vesatim velav ihu kegavene desitre darge deyishshuva

Ashgach vetakil veyada deha kemma demehahi nekuda emtzaita deyishshuva minneh ishtil kal alma lechal sitroy hachi name yada deha chela deshare alah mittamman nafku kal shear chelin dimmanan al kal sitre alma vechulhu beh achidan keden vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim lalechet artza kenaan

Od ashgach vetakil vetzarif lemekam al berira demilla dehahu atar vela hava yada vela yachil lemekam alah leitdabbeka kevan dechama tukfa dehay atar vela yachil lemekam aleh miyyad vayyavou ad charan vayyeshvu sham

May tama deavraham ella deihu hava yada vetzarif bechal innun shaltanin medabbere alma bechal sitro deyishshuva vehava takil vetzarif innun deshaltin besitre deyishshuva medabbere kochvaya umazzalehon man innun takkifin illen al illen vehava takil kal yishshuve dealma vehava salik bidoy kad mata lehay atar chama takkifu deamikin vela yachil lemekam beh
Kevan dechama kudsha berich hu itaruta dileh vetiuvta dileh miyyad itgeli aleh veamar leh lech lecha leminda lach ulatkana garmach
Meartzecha mehahu sitra deyishshuva dehavit mitdabbak beh umimmoladtecha mehahu chachma deatte mashgach vetakil toldata dilach veriga veshaata vezimna deityelidat beh uvhahu kochava uvhahu mazzala
Umibbet avicha dela tashgach beveta deavuch vei it lach sharsha leatzlacha bealma mibbeta deavuch begin kach lech lecha mechachma da umeashgachuta da

Ta chaze dehachi hu deha nafku meur kasdim vehau becharan ammay yema leh lech lecha meartzecha umimmoladtecha ella ikkera demilleta kema deittemar el haaretz asher arekka arekka ma dela yechilat lemekam aleh vela yechilat leminda chela dehahi ara deihu amik vesatim
Veeescha legoy gadol vegv veeescha begin dichtiv lech lecha vaavarachekka begin dichtiv meartzecha vaagaddela shemecha begin dichtiv umimmoladtecha veheye beracha begin dichtiv umibbet avicha

Rabbi shimon amar veeescha legoy gadol missitra deyamina vaavarachekka missitra dismala vaagaddela shemecha missitra deemtzaita veheye beracha missitra deara deyisrael ha hacha kurseya dearba samchin dechulhu kelilan beh beavraham mikkan ulhala birchan leacharine demittezene mehacha dichtiv vaavarcha mevarachecha

Sitre tora veeescha legoy gadol hay birketta chada vaavarechcha teren vaagaddela shemecha telatt veheye beracha arba vaavarcha mevarachecha chamesh umkallelcha aor shit venivrechu vecha kal mishpechott haadama sheva kevan deittebbarchu beillen sheva birchan ma kettiv vayyelecha avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai lenachatta lehay alma kema deitteppakda

Miyyad vayyelecha itto lot da ihu nachash deittelatya veittelatya alma begineh deihu kaim leppittecha leastaa leguppa velo tippeol nishmatta pulchana deitteppakdatt ad deyaavrun alah behay alma shenin deha mitteresar shenin ulela nishmatta ittearatt lemippelach pulchano deitteppakdatt hada hu dichtiv
155: Umkallelcha aor venivrechu vecha kol mishpechot haadama

Rabbi elazar hava yativ kammeh derabbi shimon avoy vehave imeh rabbi yehuda verabbi yitzchak verabbi chizkiyya amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi shimon avoy hay dichtiv lech lecha meartzecha umimmoladtecha kevan dechulhu nafku lemehach ammay la ittemar leh dechulhu yifkun

Deha af al gav deterach hava pelach leavoda zara kevan deitar beitaruta tav lemefak bahadeh deavraham vechaminan dekudsha berich hu itrae bituvta dechayyavaya ushra lemefak ammay la ketiv lechu lachem ammay leavraham bilchodoy lech lecha

Amar leh rabbi shimon i tema deterach kad nafak meur kasdim begin leahadara bitshuva hava lav hachi ella kad nafak leishtezava nafak dehau kulhu bene areh baan lemikteleh kevan dechazu deishteziv avraham hau amre leh leterach ante hu dehavit mate lan beillen pesilin umiggo dachala dilhon nafak terach kevan demata lecharan la nafak mittamman levatar dichtiv vayyelech avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai vayyelech itto lot veilu terach la ketiv
Patach veamar vayyimna mershaim oram uzroa ramma teshabber hay kera ukmuha aval vayyimna mershaim oram da nimrod uvne dareh denafak avraham minnayehu dehava oram uzroa ramma teshabber da nimrod

Davar acher vayyimna mershaim oram da terach uvne veteh oram da avraham haor la ketiv ella oram dehava immehon uzroa ramma teshabber da nimrod dehava mate avatreh kal bene alma uvgin kach ketiv lech lecha begin leanhara lach ulchal innun deyifkun minach mikkan ulhala

Tu patach veamar veatta lo rau or bahir hu bashshechakim veruach avra vattetaharem veatta lo rau or ematay beshaata deamar kudsha berich hu leavraham lech lecha meartzecha umimmoladtecha umibbet avicha bahir hu bashshechakim devaa kudsha berich hu leadbaka leh leavraham behahu or dilela ulanhara tamman
Veruach avra vattetaharem deha levatar tavu bituvta terach vechal bene veteh bene veteh dichtiv veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan terach dichtiv veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom vegv
Veavram ben chamesh shanim veshivim shana sheva vechamesh teresar innun
Uchden ittechaziatt nishmatta behay alma deihi atteya mechamosh shanim deinnun tk parse deilana dechayye veshivim shana da ihu hahu ilana mammash deihu sheviaa ledargin veshivin shana ittekere
Keden nappekatt mehahu zuhama denachash vealatt beppulchana kaddisha hada hu dichtiv betztzeto mecharan mehahu rugza vettukpa dehahu nachash dehava aste leh ad hashta leguppa veshalta aloy

Beilana shalta arla telatt shenin bevar nash telatt sare shenin deikrun shene arla kevan deaavaru al guppa innun shenin veitteavratt nishmatta lemippelach pulchana kaddisha pekidatt leguppa lirutta tava lichpof lehahu nachash deha la yachil

Vayyelecha avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai amar rabbi elazar ta chaze deha la ketiv vayyetze avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai ella vayyelech kema deatte amer lech lecha deha yetzia bekadmita avdu dichtiv vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim lalechet artza kenaan vehashta ketiv vayyelech vela ketiv vayyetze

Kaasher dibber elav Adonai deavtach leh bechulhu havtachot vayyelech itto lot deitchabbar immeh begin lemelaf meovadoy veim kal da la olif kule hay amar rabbi elazar zakkain innun tzaddikayya deolfe archoy dekudsha berich hu begin lemehach behu uldachala minneh mehahu yoma dedina dezammin bar nash lemehav dina vechushbana lekudsha berich hu
Patach veamar beyad kal adam yachtom ladaat kal anshe maasehu hay kera ukmuha aval
156: Dichtiv vayyikkach avram ett saray ishto vegv Adonai Adonai da guppa deihi legabbe nishmatta kenukva legabbe dechura veett lot ben achiv da nachash dolo aade kal kacha min guppa begin devekutta deguppa la aadiu kal kacha minneh aval ittearutta denishmatta alke leh tadir veattere beh veochach leh vechappif leh karcheh vela yachil leshaltaa

Veett kal rechusham asher rachashu illen ovadin tavin deavid bar nash behay alma beittearutta denishmatta veett hanneppesh asher oshu vecharan hahu neppesh dehavatt bidvekutta bekadmita bechavrutta dehahi arla bahade guppa veattekin lah levattar deha levattar dittelesar shenin ulela denishmatta ittearatt leattekana leguppa tarvayhu mettakkenin lehahu neppesh demishtatteppa bettukpa denachash utteuvteh bisha hada hu dichtiv veett hannepposh asher asu vecharan
Veim kal da nishmetta attekepatt beh behahu nachash lettabbera leh bettukpa beshibudo ditteshuva hada hu dichtiv vyaavor

Ta chaze behahu yoma deashlimu yomoy devar nash leafaka mealma hahu yoma degufa itbar venafsha baya leitparsha minneh keden ityehiv reshu levar nash lemecheme ma dela hava leh reshu lemecheme bezimna degufa shalta vekaim al buryeh
Uchden kayeme aleh telat shelichan vechashve yomoy vechovoy vechal ma deavad behay alma vehu ode al kolla befumeh ulvatar hu chatim aleh bideh hada hu dichtiv beyad kal adam yachtom

Uvideh kulhu chatimin lemedan leh alma al kadmae veal batrae al chadte veal attike la itneshe chad minnayehu hada hu dichtiv ladaat kal anshe maasehu vechal innun ovadin deavad behay alma begufa verucha hachi name yahiv chushbena beguppa verucha ad la yippuk mealma

Ta chaze kama dechayyavaya akshe kedal behay alma hachi name afillu beshata devae lenafka mehay alma akshe kedal vegin kach zakkaa hu bar nash deyalif behay alma archoy dekudsha berich hu begin lemehach behu vechayyava af al gav deistakkal behanne tzaddikaya akshe kedal vela bae lemelaf
Uvgin kach it leh letzaddika lemitkaf beh veaf al gav dechayyava akshe kedal hu la yishbok leh veit leh leatkafa bideh vela yishbok leh dei yishbok leh yehach veyachariv alma

Ta chaze min elisha dedacha legechazi vechen beavraham kal zimna dehava lot bahadeh la itchabbar bahade rashshiayya kevan deitperash minneh ma ketiv vayyivchar lo lot et kal kikkar hayyarden uchtiv vayeehal ad sedom ma ketiv batreh veanshe sedom raim vechattaim layeya meod

Amar rabbi abba hay deamarte vayyelech avram vela ketiv vayyetze avram shappir hu aval sofa dikra ma ketiv betzeto mecharan amar rabbi elazar mecharan ketiv vehahi yetzia meeretz moladto havat bekadmita

Vayyikkach avram et saray ishto mahu vayyikkach ella amshich lah bemille maalyata begin delet leh reshu lebbar nash leafaka itteteh lemehach beara achora bela reuta dilah vechen hu omer kach et aharon kach et halviyim uvgin kach vayyikkach avram mashich lah bemillin veoda lah archehon deinnun beni dara kamma bishin uvgin kach vayyikach avram et saray ishto

Veet lot ben achiv ma chama avraham ledavka immeh lot ella begin detzafa beruach hakkodesh dezammin lemepak minneh david veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan illen gerim vegiyyorot deatkinu nafshayehu avraham megayyer guvrin vesara megayyeret nashin umaale alehon keillu avdu lehon
Amar rabbi abba i hachi kamma bene nasha hau i tema dechulhu azlu immeh amar rabbi elazar in bene nasha dehau azlin immeh kulhu ikrun

Keerez ballevanon yisge ma erez ballevanon illaa al kolla vecholla yatve techotoy uf hachi tzaddik hu illaa al kolla vecholla yatve techotoy vealma la kayema ella al tzaddik chad dichtiv vetzaddik yesod olam vealeh kaim alma uvgineh istemich vealeh ishtil
Rabbi yehuda amar veha taninan deal shiva samchin alma kayema dichtiv chatzva ammudeha shiva amar leh rabbi yose hachi hu vadday aval kulhu achoranin bishviaa
163: Kayeme deihu samcha dealma veihu tzaddik veda ashke veravi alma vezan kolla vealeh ketiv imru tzaddik ki tov ki peri maallehem ychelu uchtiv tov Adonai lakkol verachamav al kal maasav

Amar rabbi yitzchak ha ketiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan da hu samcha dealma kaim aleh veihu ashke leginta veginta ishtakke minneh uminneh avida perin vechulhu perin parchin bealma veinnun kiyyuma dealma kiyyuma deorayeta uman ninhu nishmathon detzaddikaya deinnun peri ovadoy dekudsha berich hu uvgin kach bechal lelya velelya nishmathon detzaddikaya salkan

Vechad itpelag lelya kudsha berich hu ate leginta deeden leishtashea behu beman amar rabbi yose bechulhu ben innun dimdorehon behahu alma ben innun deyatve bimdorehon behay alma bechulhu mishtaasha behu kudsha berich hu befalgut lelya

Ta chaze alma dilela itzterich leitaruta dealma tattaa vechad nishmathon detzaddikaya nafke mehay alma vesalke leela kulhu mitlabbeshe binhora dilela bediukna yekar uvhu kudsha berich hu mishtaasha vetaiv lon deinhu peri ovadoy veal da ikrun yisrael deit lon nishmatin kaddishin benin lekudsha berich hu kema deatte amer banim attem layeya elohechem banim vadday iba deovadoy

Amar rabbi yesa veafilu innun divhay alma heach amar leh begin di befalgut lelya kal innun zakkae keshot kulhu mitare lemikre beorayeta ulmishma tushbechan deorayeta veha ittemar dekudsha berich hu vechal innun tzaddikaya divgo ginta deeden kulhu tzayetin lekalehon vechuta dechesed itmeshach alayehu bimama dichtiv yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo uvallayela shiro immi
Veal da tushbechan desalkin belelya kammeh da tushbachta shelim ta chaze beshaata deyisrael hau segirin bevattehon kad katal kudsha berich hu bechorehon demitzrae hau amare halela vetushbechan kammeh

Ta chaze dedavid malka hava kam befalgut lelya dei tema dehava yativ o shachiv bearseh vehava amar shirin vetushbechan la ella kema dichtiv chatzot layela akum lehodot lecha akum vadday baamida leitasseka beshirin vetushbechan deorayeta

Uvgin kach david malka chay lealmin veafilu beome malka meshicha ihu malka deha tenan malka meshicha i min chayya hu david shemeh vei min metaya hu david shemeh veihu hava itar betzafra ad la yete dichtiv ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar

Ta chaze kal hahu lelya desara havat legabbeh defaro atu malache illae lezamra leh lekudsha berich hu beshirin vetushbechan amar lehu kudsha berich hu kullechu zilu veavidu machteshin ravrevin bemitzrayim reshimu leman deana zammin lemebad levatar ma ketiv vayenagga Adonai et paro negaim gedolim vegv
Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyikra paro leavram vegv mena hava yada deha la ketiv hacha kema deittemar baavimelech dichtiv veatta hashev eshet haish ki navi hu vegv vehacha la amar leh middi

Amar rabbi yitzchak ha ketiv al devar saray eshet avram dehachi hau amre leh al devar saray eshet avram deha la hava memallel immeh kema dimmallel baavimelech ella bemilla da ittemar vela yattir machtesha da al devar saray eshet avram ihi vela hava mallil immeh keden yada deha itteteh deavraham ihi miyyad vayyikra paro leavram vayyomer vegv

Vayetzav alav paro anashim lamma begin dela yikrav bar nash behu leavasha lon vayeshallechu oto levaya avadu leh bechal ara demitzrayim amar leh kudsha berich hu hachi ante zammin lemebad livnoy atte tozif lon mearach dichtiv vayehi beshallach paro et haam deozif lon mikkal areh
Amar rabbi abba kal kach lamma izdammen leh leavraham ulmay itzterich ella begin legaddela shemeh deavraham vesara bealma
164: Deafilu bemitzrayim deinnun chorashe alma vela hava yachil bar nash leishteziv minnayehu itgaddal avraham veistallik leela hada hu dichtiv vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim lean atar hannegba
Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze kolla raza dechachmeta ihu veka ramaz hacha bechachmeta vedargin diltatta deka nachit avraham leumkayya dilhon veyada lon vela itdabbak behu vetav lekamme mareh

Vela itpatta behu keadam dechad mata lehahu darga itpatta benachash vegarim mota lealma vela itpatta kenoach dechad nachat umata lehahu darga ma ketiv vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch aholo aholo ketiv beh

Aval beavraham ma ketiv vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim desalik vela nachit vetav leatreh ledarga illaa deitdabbak beh bekadmita veovada da hava begin leachazaa chachmata deitkayyam bekiyyuma shelim kedeka chaze leh vela itpatta vekam bekiyyuma vetav leatreh hannegba da darom darga illaa deitachid beh bekadmita dichtiv haloch venasoa hannegba uf hacha hannegba atar deitdabbak beh bekadmita

Ta chaze raza demilla i avram la yechut lemitzrayim vela yitztaref tamman bekadmita la yehe chulak adveh bekudsha berich hu kegana da livnoy kad baa kudsha berich hu lemeobbad leh amma chada amma shelim ulkarva lon legabbeh i la nachatu bekadmita lemitzrayim vela yitztarfun tamman lo hau amma yechida dileh
Kegavena da i la ityehivat ara kaddisha lichnaan bekadmota veyishlot bah la hat ara chulkeh veadveh dekudsha berich hu vcholla raza chada

Rabbi shimon hava azil bearcha vehava immeh rabbi elazar bereh verabbi abba verabbi yehuda ad dehau azle amar rabbi shimon tavahna hech bene alma la mashgichin leminda mille deorayeta val ma kayeme patach veamar nafshi iviticha ballayela af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka hay kera ukmuha veokimna leh aval ta chazi nafsha debbar nash kad salik learseh nafkat minneh vesalka leela vei tema dechulhu salkan lav kal chad vechad chame appe malka ella nafsha salka vela ishtaar bah bahade gufa bar chad reshimu dekusta dechayyuta delibba

Venafsha azla uvaya lesalka vechamma dargin ledargin lesalka shatat vehi itarat behanne kumrin tehirin dimsaavuta i hi dechiat dela istaavat bimama salka leela vei lav dechiat istaovat benayehu veitdabbekat behu vela salka yattir

Vetamman modae lah millin veihu itdabbekat meinnun millin dizman kariv ulzimnin dechayechin bah umodain lah millin kedivin uchden azla kehay gavena kal lelya ad deyitar bar nash vetavat leatrah zakkain innun tzaddikaya degale lon kudsha berich hu razin dileh bechelma begin deyistammerun min dina vay leinnun chayave alma dimsaavin garmayehu venafshayehu
Ta chaze innun dela istaavu kad salke bearsayehu nafsha salka vealat ben kal hanne dargin bekadmita vesalka vela itdabbekat behu ulvatar azla veshatat vesalka kefum orchah

Hahi nafsha dezachat lesalka itchaziat kammeh disvar appe yomin veitdabbekat biruta leitchazzaa betiuvta illaa lemecheme benoam malka ulvakkera behechaleh veda hu bar nash deit leh chulaka tadir bealma deate

Veda hi nafsha dichsifa dilah kad salka bekudsha berich hu vela itdabbekat behanne zinin tehirin acharanin vehi azlat batar zina kaddisha beatra denafkat mittamman uvgin kach ketiv nafshi iviticha ballayela begin lemirdaf batrach vela leitpattaa batar zina achora nuchraa
Ta chaze nafshi da nefesh deihi shalta ballayela ulmirdaf batar darga ruach bayyom dichtiv nafshi iviticha
165: Ballayela da nefesh deihi shalta ballayela af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka da ruach deihu shalta bimama
Vei tema ditren dargin innun bifruda lav hachi deha darga chad innun veinnun teren bechibbura chad vechad illaa deshalta alayehu veitdabbak behu veinnun beh veitkeriat neshama

Vechulhu dargin salkan beraza dechachmeta dechad mistakkelan illen dargin yistakkel bar nash bechachma illaa vehay neshama ayil behu umitdabbekan bah vechad hay shalta keden hahu bar nash ikre kadosh shelim mikkolla reuta chada legabbe kudsha berich hu

Nefesh ihu itaruta tattaa veda semicha begufa vezanat leh vegufa achid bah vehi itachadat begufa levatar ittaknat veitavidat kurseya leashraa alah ruach beitaruta dehay nefesh deitachidat begufa kema dichtiv ad yeare alenu ruach mimmarom
Levatar dimtakkeni tarvayehu zeminin lekabbela neshama deha ruach itavid kurseya legabbe neshama leashraa aleh vehay neshama ihi setima illaa al kolla temira dechal temirin
Ishtechach deit kurseya lekkurseya vekkurseya legabbe illaa alayehu vechad tistakkal bedargin tishkach raza dechachmeta behay milla vecholla hu chachmeta leitdabbeka behay gavena millin setimin

Ta chaze nefesh ihi itaruta tattaa deitdabbeka beh begufa kegavena dinhora devutzina dinhora tattaa deihi uchma itdabbekat biftila vela itperash minnah vela ittaknat ella bah vechad ittaknat bappetila itavidat kurseya linhora illaa chivara desharya al hahu nehora uchma

Levatar kad mittaknan tarvayehu itavidat hahu nehora chivara kurseya linhora setimaa dela itchaze vela ityeda ma deshara al hahu nehora chivara uchden nehora shelim vechach hu bar nash deihu shelim becholla uchden ikre kadosh kema deatte amer likdoshim asher baaretz hemma vegv kegavena da beraza illaa

Ta chaze beshaata deal avraham leara itchaziyi leh kudsha berich hu kema deittemar dichtiv layeya hannire elav vekabbil tamman nefesh uvana mizbeach lehahu darga levatar haloch venasoa hannegba dekabbil ruach levatar desalik leitdabbeka go neshama keden vayyiven sham mizbeach layeya setam da hi neshama deihi setima dechal setimin

Levatar yada devae leitzterafa ulitattera bedargin miyyad vayyered avram mitzrayema veishteziv mittamman vela itpatta go innun tehirin veittzarif vetav leatreh kevan denachat veittzarif miyyad vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim salik vadday vetav leatreh veitdabbak bimhemnuta illaa dichtiv hannegba

Mikkan ulhala yada avraham chachmeta illaa veitdabbak bekudsha berich hu veitavid yamina dealma keden veavram kaved meod bammikne bakkesef uvazzahav kaved meod besitra demizrach bammikne besitra demaarav bakkesef missitra dedarom bazzahav missitra detzafon

Atu rabbi elazar verabbi abba vechulhu chavraya unshaku yedoy becha rabbi abba veamar vay vay kad tistallak min alma man yanhir nehora deorayeta zakkaa chulakhon dechavraya deshamin millin deorayeta illen mippumach

Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze ma ketiv vayyelecha lemassaav lemifkad atreh vedargoy lemassaav lemassao ketiv man massao da darga kadmaa deitchaze leh bekadmita ketiv hacha massao uchtiv hatam even shelema massa nivne veha okimna even shelema vadday massa kema deittemar
Vayyelecha lemassaav kal innun dargin darga batar darga kema deittemar minnegev
166: Vead bet el leatkana atreh ulchabbera lon beyichuda shelim deha minnegev vead bet el ishtechach raza dechachmeta kedeka yeut

El hammakom asher haya sham aholo battechilla aholo behe man aholo da bet el even shelema kidamaran tu reshim veamar el mekom hammizbeach asher asa sham barishona dichtiv layeya hannire elav uchden vayyikra sham avram beshem Adonai keden itdabbak bimhemnuta shelemata

Ta chaze bekadmita salik mittatta leela dichtiv vayyera Adonai el avram uchtiv layeya hannire elav veda hu darga kadmaa kidamaran even shelema ulvatar haloch venasoa hannegba darga batar darga ad deitattar baddarom chulakeh veadveh levatar satim milla kad salik veamar layeya setam da alma illaa umittamman natil bedargin venachit meela letatta veitdabbak kolla beatreh kedeka yeut

Vehacha kad tistakkel bedargin tishkach raza dechachmeta illaa ma ketiv vayelech lemassaav minnegev missitra deyamina sheruta dealma illaa setima amika leela ad en sof venachit darga batar darga minnegev vead bet el meela letatta

Uchtiv vayyikra sham avram beshem Adonai adbak yichuda beatreh kedeka yeut dichtiv el mekom hammizbeach asher asa sham barishona may asher asa sham desalik lah mittatta leela vehashta nachit bedargin meela letatta begin dehi la taade meinnun dargin illain veinnun la yaadun minnah veyityached kolla beyichuda chada kedeka yaot

Keden itattar avraham vehava chulak adveh dekudsha berich hu vadday zakkain innun tzaddikayya demitattere beh bekudsha berich hu vehu mitatter behon zakkain innun bealma den vezakkain innun bealma deate alayehu ketiv veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz uchtiv veorach tzaddikim keor nogah holech veor ad nechon hayyom

Azlu kad matu bechad be chakal yatvu patach rabbi shimon veamar pene elay vechanini vegv hay kera it leistakkala beh veha okimna leh bechamma atar aval behay kera millin setimin it beh pene elay vechi david amar pene elay vechanini

Ella begin darga dileh deihu itattar beh kaamar tena uzcha leavdecha tena uzcha da oz illaa kedichtiv veyitten oz lemalko man malko da melech setam malka meshicha uf hacha leavdecha da malka meshicha kidamaran melech setam

Vehoshia leven amatecha vechi la hava bereh deyishay ihu ad deihu amar bishma deimmeh vela bishma deavoy ela ha okimna dechad yete bar nash lekabbel milla illaa leidkara bae lemehach bemilla deihu vadday veal da adkar leimmeh vela leavoy vetu ha taninan deda melech kidkaamaran

Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze ma ketiv vayehi riv ben roe mikne avram riv ketiv chaser devaa lot lemehdar lefulchana nuchraa defalche yatve ara vesofeh dikra ochach dichtiv vehakkenaani vehapperizi az yoshev baaretz

Umnalan delot ahadar lesarchaneh lefulchana nuchraa dichtiv vayyissa lot mikkedem may mikkedem mikkadmono shel olam ketiv hacha vayyissa lot mikkedem uchtiv vayehi benasam mikkedem ma lehallan netilu mikkadmono shel olam uf hacha ken

Kevan deyada avraham delot lehachi nate libbeh miyyad vayyomer avram el lot vegv hippared na mealay let ante keday leitchabbera bahaday keden itperash avraham minneh vela baa lemehach ulitchabbara immeh dechal man deyitchabbar lechayyava sofeh lemehach avatreh ulitannash
167: Menalan mihoshafat deitchabbar im achav veilmale zechu deavahan itannash tamman dichtiv vayyizak yehoshafat uchden ishteziv dichtiv vayesitem elohim mimmennu

Veal da la baa avram lemehach bahadeh delot veim kal da la baa lot lemehdar missurchaneh ella vayyivchar lo lot et kal kikkar hayyarden vayyissa lot mikkedem itnetil min kadmaa dealma vela baa leitdabbeka bimhemnuta shelemata keavraham

Avram yashav beeretz kenaan leitdabbeka beatra dimhemnuta ulminda chachmeta leitdabbeka bemareh velot yashav beare hakkikkar vayyeehal ad sedom im innun chayyavin dealma denafku miggo mehemnuta dichtiv veanshe sedom raim vechattaim layeya meod kal chad itperash learcheh kedeka yeut vegin kach zakkain innun chavraya demishtaddele beorayeta yemama velelya vechavruta dilhon bekudsha berich hu vealayehu ketiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom

Vayeya amar el avram achare hippared lot meimmo vegv rabbi abba patach vayyakam yona livroach tarshisha millifni Adonai vegv vay leman deistattar mikkamme kudsha berich hu dichtiv beh halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male neum Adonai vehu ate lemeerak mikkammeh

Ella ketiv yonati bechagve hassela beseter hammadrega yonati da keneset yisrael bechagve hassela da yerushlem deihi salka al kal alma ma sela ihi illaa vetakkifa al kulla uf yerushlem ihi illaa vetakkifa al kolla beseter hammadrega da atar deikre bet kodesh hakkodashim libba dechal alma

Uvgin kach ketiv beseter hammadrega begin detamman havat shechinta mistattera keitteta deihi tzenua levaalah vela nafka mibbeta levar kema deatte amar eshtecha kegefen poriya beyarkete vetecha vegv kach keneset yisrael la sharya levar meatraha bistiru dedarga ella bezimna degaluta deihu bego galuta uvgin deihi begaluta shear ammin it lon tivu veshalva yattir

Ta chaze bezimna deyisrael sharyan al ara kaddisha kolla hava mittakkan kedeka yeut vekkurseya shelim alayehu veavde pulchana uvaka avirin dealma vesalik hahu pulchana leela leatreh begin deara la ittaknat lefulchana ella leyisrael bilchodayehu uvgin kach shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot hau mitrachake dela hau shaltin bah kidhashta begin dela itzanu ella mittamtzit

Vei tema ha chamenan kamma malchin hau deshallitin bezimna devet hammikdash kayyam al alma ta chaze bevayit rishon ad la seivu yisrael ara la hau shaltin shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot ella itzanu mittamtzit uvah hau shaltin velav kal kach kevan dechavu yisrael vesaivu ara keden kivyachol dachu lah lishchinta meatrah veitkarvat leduchta achora uchden shaltin shear amin veityehiv lon reshu leshaltaa

Ta chaze ara deyisrael la shallit alah memanna achora bar kudsha berich hu bilchodoy uvshaata dechavu yisrael vehau mekatrin letaavan achoranin bego ara kivyachol iddachya shechinta meatrah umashche umkatre leitkashra taavan achoran go shechinta uchden ityehiv lon shaltanuta begin diktoret kitra hu leitkattara uchden shaltu shear ammin uvatlu neviim vechal innun dargin illain la shaltu beara

Vela aadiu shaltanuta dishar ammin begin deinnun mashchu lishchinta legabbayehu veal da bevet sheni ha shultanuta mishar amin la aadiu vechal shekken begaluta dishchinta bishar ammin atar dishar memannan shaltin uvgin kach kulhu yankin min shechinta deitkerivat gabbayehu
168: Da bezimna deyisrael hau sharan al ara ufalche pulchana dekudsha berich hu shechinta havat tzenua benayehu vela nafkat miggo beta levar beitgalya uvgin kach kal innun neviim dehau behahu zimna la natlu nevua ella beatrah kidkaamaran uvgin kach yona hava arak levar meara kaddisha dela yitgele aleh nevua vela yehach bishlichuta dekudsha berich hu
Vei tema ha chaminan deitgalleya shechinta bevavel deihu levar ha okimna dichtiv hayo haya dehava ma dela hava min kadmat dena miyyoma deitbeni be makdesha vehahi nevua leshaata havat
Uchtiv al nehar kevar nahar dichvar hava miyyoma deitbere alma ushchinta itgalleya tadir aleh dichtiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan umishsham yippared vegv veda ihu chad minayehu

Vetamman itgalleya shechinta lefum shaata deitzterichu lah yisrael lefum tzaarayehu aval bezimna achora la itgalleya uvgin kach yona begin dela tishre aloy shechinta vela titgele aleh azal meara kaddisha vearak hada hu dichtiv millifne Adonai uchtiv ki yadu haanashim ki millifni Adonai hu boreach

Ta chaze kemma dishchinta la itgalleya ella beatra deitchaze lah uf hachi la itchaze vela itgalleya ella bebbar nash deitchaze lah deha min yoma desalik al reuteh delot leithappecha besurchaneh istalkat rucha kaddisha meavraham vechad istallak lot minneh miyyad shara ruach kudsha beduchteh hada hu dichtiv vayeya amar el avram achare hippard lot meimmo vegv

Ta chaze kevan dechama avraham delot hava tav lesurchaneh hava dachil avraham amar dilma chas veshalom begin chavruta deda avidna begineh chulaka kaddisha deaatar li kudsha berich hu kevan deitperash minneh amar leh sa na enecha ure min hammakom asher ata sham

May min hammakom asher atta sham deitdabbekat beh bekadmita veitatterat behemnuta shelemata tzafona vanegba vakedma veyama illen innun massaav dehau bekadmita dichtiv vayyelech lemassaav uchtiv haloch venasoa hannegba illen dargin illain deitattar bimhemnuta shelemata bekadmita

Uchden itbassar dela yaade minneh umin benoy lealmin dichtiv ki et kal haaretz asher atta roe may asher atta roe da darga kadmaa deitgalleya leh kema deatte amer layeya hannire elav uvgin kach asher atta roe begin dedarga da kadmaa itkelil mikkulhu dargin vechulhu itchazun beh uvgin kach ki et kal haaretz asher atta roe vegv
Rabbi elazar iara beve ushpiza belud vehava immeh rabbi chizkiyya kam belelya lemile beorayeta kam rabbi chizkiyya gabbeh amar leh rabbi elazar bekistera dekusta chavraye shechiche

Patach rabbi elazar veamar ketappuach baatze hayyaar vegv ketappuach da kudsha berich hu deihu chamid umitattar bigvanoy mikkal shear ilanin dela it dedame leh rashim ihu mikkolla rashim hu delet achora kavateh

Begini kach betzillo chimadti betzillo vela betzilla achora betzilo vela vetzilla dishar memannan chimmadti ematay min yoma dehava avraham bealma deihu chamid verachim leh lekudsha berich hu beahava kema deatte amer avraham ohavi ufiro matok lechikki da hu yitzchak deihu iba kaddisha

Davar acher betzillo chimadti veyashavti da yaakov ufiro matok lechikki da yosef hatztzaddik deavad perin kaddishin bealma veal da ketiv elle toldot yaakov yosef dechal innun toldot deyaakov uvgin kach ikrun yisrael al shema deefrayim dichtiv haven yakkir li efrayim vegv
Davar acher ketappuach baatze hayyaar da avraham dedame leh letappuach desalik rechin
169: Veitreshim bimhemnuta shelemata al kal bene dareh veitreshim chad leela veitreshim chad letatta dichtiv echad haya avraham

May tama hava echad dela hava achora bealma di salik limhemnuta dekudsha berich hu bar ihu amar leh rabbi chizkiyya veha ketiv veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan amar leh ad kean innun la hau bedargin ilain deitattar behu avraham

Levatar amar leh tu shemana dela ikre avraham echad ad deistallak beyitzchak veyaakov kevan deistallak beyitzchak veyaakov vehau kulhu telathon avahan dealma keden ikre avraham echad uchden hu tappuach bealma rashim mikkal bene alma amar leh shappir ka amarte

Davar acher ketappuach baatze hayyaar da kudsha berich hu ken dodi da kudsha berich hu betzillo da kudsha berich hu chimadti veyashavti beoma deitgele kudsha berich hu al tura desinay vekabbilu yisrael orayeta veamru naase venishma

Ufiro matok lechikki illen millin deorayeta dichtiv behu umtukim middevash venofet tzufim davar acher ufiro matok lechikki illen nishmathon detzaddikaya dechulhu iba deovadoy dekudsha berich hu vekayeme immeh leela
Ta chaze kal nishmatin dealma deinnun iba deovadoy dekudsha berich hu kulhu chad beraza chad vechad nachate lealma kulhu mitparshin bigvanin dechar venukva veinnun dechar venukva mechubbarin kechada

Vetta chaze tiuvta denukva legabbe dechura avid nefesh uruta detiuvta didchura legabbe nukva veitdabbekuta dileh bah appik nefesh vechalil tiuvta denukva venatil lah veitkelil tiuvta tattaa betiuvta dilela veitavidu reuta chada bela piruda
Uchden kalil kola nukva veitabberat min dechura vetiuvtin detarvayehu mitdabbekan kechada veal da kolla kalil da beda vechad nishmatin nafkin dechar venukva kechada nafkin

Levatar kevan denachate mitparshan da lesitra da veda lesitra da vekudsha berich hu mezavig lon levatar vela ityehiv ziuuga leachora ella lekudsha berich hu bilchodoy deihu yada ziuuga dilhon lechabbera lon kedeka yaot

Zakkaa hu bar nash dezache beovadoy veazil beorach keshot begin deitchabbar nefesh benefesh kema dehava meikara deha i zache beovadoy da hu bar nash shelim kedeka yeut uvgin kach ketiv ufiro matok lechikki dehu betikkuna mevorach leitbarcha minneh alma begin decholla beovadin devar nash talya i zache i la zache

Amar rabbi chizkiyya hachi shamana dichtiv mimmenni peryecha nimtza kudsha berich hu amar leh lichneset yisrael mimmenni vadday peryecha nimtza peryi nimtza la ketiv ella peryecha hahu tiuvta denukva deavid nefesh veitkelil betukfa diddechura veitkelil nefesh benefesh veitavidu chad kalil da beda kidamaran levatar ishtakkachu tarvayehu bealma veda bechela didchura ishtechach iba denukva
Davar acher betiuvta denukva ishtechach iba didchura dei lav tiuvta denukva legabbe dechura la itavidu perin lealmin hada hu dichtiv mimmenni peryecha nimtza

Vayehi bime amrafel melech shinar vegv rabbi yose patach mi heir mimmizrach tzedek yikraehu leraglo vegv hay kera ukmuha chavraya aval hay kera beraza dechachmeta ihu deha taninan shiva rekiin avad kudsha berich hu leela vechulhu leishtemoda yekara dekudsha berich hu vechulhu kayemin leodaa raza dimhemnuta illaa

Ta chaze it rekia illaa satim leela minnayehu deinnun shiva veda hu rekia dedabbar lon venahir lon lechulhu veda la ityeda vekayema bishelta dela yedia begin deihu satim veamik vecholla tevahin aleh uvgin kach ikre mi kema deukmuha dichtiv mibbeten mi yatza hakkarach veittemar vehay hu rekia illaa
170: Veit letatta rekia deihu tattaa mikkulhu vela nahir uvgin deihu tattaa dela nahir hahu rekia dealayehu itchabbar beh veillen teren atvan kalil lon begaveh veikre yam dehahu rekia illaa deikre mi

Begin dechal innun rekiin achoranin itavidu nachalin vealin legabbeh uchden ihu yam illaa veavad ibin venunin liznayehu veal da amar david ze hayyam gadol urchav yadayim sham remes veen mispar chayyot ketannot im gedolot

Veal da ketiv mi heir mimmizrach tzedek yikraehu leraglo mi heir mimmizrach da avraham tzedek yikraehu leraglo da hu rekia tattaa dechulhu rekiin deitavid yam yitten lefanav goyim man hay hu rekia tattaa deamaran deavid nukmin veappil sanin uvhay ishtabbach david veamar veovay natatta li oref umsanay atzmitem

Yitten lefanav goyim illen innun ammin dehava radif alehon avraham vekudsha berich hu hava katil lon umlachim yarde illen memannan ravrevan dilela dechad avid kudsha berich hu dina bealma becholla avid dina beela vetatta
Yirdefem yaavor shalom orach beraglav lo yavo yirdefem da avraham deavraham hava radif lon vekudsha berich hu hava avar kammeh vekatil lon dichtiv yaavor shalom da kudsha berich hu deikre shalom

Orach beraglav lo yavo vechi salka datach dehava avraham azil bego anane o bego susvan urtichin ella orach beraglav lo yavo dela hava azil kammeh deavraham la malacha vela shelicha ella kudsha berich hu bilchodoy dichtiv orach beraglav man raglav illen malachin deinnun techotoy dekudsha berich hu kema deatte amer veamdu raglav bayyom hahu vegv

Davar acher mi heir mimmizrach ta chaze beshaata dekudsha berich hu itar alma leayetaa leavraham ulkarva leh legabbeh hay itaruta begin dezammin yaakov lemepak minneh ulkayema teresar shivtin kulhu zakkain kammeh dekudsha berich hu

Tzedek yikraehu leraglo dekudsha berich hu hava kare leh tadir min yoma deitbere alma kema deatte amer kore haddorot merosh uvgin kach tzedek yikraehu vadday leraglo leitchabbera beh befulchaneh ulkarva leh legabbeh kema deatte amer haam asher beraglecha

Davar acher mi heir mimmizrach demittamman sheruta dinhora leanhara begin dedarom hahu tukfa dileh miggo mizrach ihu veal da mi heir hahu nehora dedarom mimmizrach begin deihu natil veittezan bekadmita vetiuvta dehahu rekia illaa lemehav leh lemizrach

Tzedek yikraehu leraglo da maarav deihu kare leh tadir vela shachich kema deatte amer elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el begin demaarav itar tadir legabbeh yitten lefanav goyim umlachim yarde deha minneh kabbil tukfa leachnaa kal innun ammin dealma

Rabbi yehuda amar mi heir mimmizrach da avraham dela natil itaruta legabbe kudsha berich hu ella mimmizrach begin dechama shimsha denafik betzafra missitra demizrach natil itaruta lenafsheh deihu kudsha berich hu amar da hu malka devara yati pelach leh kal hahu yoma leramsha chama shimsha deitkenish vesihara nahara amar da hu vadday deshallit al hahu pulchana defalachit kal hay yoma deha itchashach kammeh vela nahir palach leh kal hahu lelya

Letzafra chama deazla chashocha veitnehir sitra demizrach amar vadday kal illen malka it alayehu veshallit deanhig lon kevan dechama kudsha berich hu tiuvta deavraham legabbeh keden itgale aloy umallil immeh dichtiv tzedek yikraehu leraglo demallil immeh veitgele aleh
Rabbi yitzchak patach dover tzedek maggid mesharim
171: Kudsha berich hu kal milloy innun bekushta veavid mesharim bemma avid mesharim begin dechad bera kudsha berich hu alma la hava kaim vehava mitmotet lehacha ulhacha amar leh kudsha berich hu lealma ma lach deatte mitmotet amar leh ribbono shel olam la yachilna lemekam delet bi yesoda al ma deitkayyam

Amar leh ha ana zammin lemekam bach chad tzaddik deihu avraham di yarchim li miyyad kaim alma bekiyyumeh hada hu dichtiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram al tikra behibbaram ella beavraham beavraham mitkayyem alma

Amar rabbi chiyya maggid mesharim deha ativ leh alma lekudsha berich hu hahu avraham zammin hu deyifkun minneh benin deyacharivu makdesha veokidu orayeta amar leh zammin chad bar nash lemepak minneh deihu yaakov veyifkun minneh teresar shivtin kulhu zakkain miyyad itkeyyam alma begineh hada hu dichtiv maggid mesharim
Rabbi elazar amar ha atarna vayedabber vayyagged vayyomer kulhu letaamayehu mitparshan vayedabber ihu beitgalya darga levar dela ihu darga penimaa keinnun dargin illain veda ihu dover tzedek

Vayyagged ihu remez ledarga penimaa illaa deshaltaa al dibbur veda hu maggid mesharim man mesharim da darga illaa deyaakov sharya beh hada hu dichtiv atta konanta mesharim uvgin kach maggid ketiv vela ketiv dover

Amar rabbi yitzchak veha ketiv vayyagged lachem et berito amar leh hachi hu vadday ihu darga deshalta al tattaa deihu dover tzedek vecholla ihu leistakkala hacha ta chaze deaf al gav deddibbur ihu tattaa la tema dela illaa ihu ella vadday dibbur malya ihu mikkolla vedarga illaa ihu vesimanich ki lo davar rek hu mikkem

Rabbi elazar hava azil leve chamoy vehau immeh rabbi chiyya verabbi yose verabbi chizkiyya amar rabbi elazar ha chamena deitaruta dilela lav ihu ella kad itar letatta deha itaruta dilela betiuvta diltatta talya
Patach veamar elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el da hu itaruta diltatta begin leshaltaa amar david elohim al domi lach leatara legabbe illaa ulitchabbera gabbe yamina

May tama begin ki hinne oyevecha yehemaun vegv ki noatzu lev yachdav alecha berit yichrotu uvgin kach elohim al domi lach leatara legabbe ela deha keden itarat yamina uktirat lah bahadah vechad itkashrat beyamina keden itbar sanin dichtiv yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev

Veta chaze beshaata deitchabbaru kal innun malchin leaggacha kerava aleh deavraham ityaatu leaavara leh min alma vechevan deshaltu belot bar achuha deavraham miyyad azlu dichtiv vayyikchu et lot veet rechusho ben achi avram vayyelechu may tama begin dediukneh delot hava dame leavraham uvgin kach vayyelechu dechal hahu kerava begineh hava

May tama begin dehava avraham appik bene alma mippulchana nuchraa veail lon befulachana dekudsha berich hu vetu kudsha berich hu atar lon bealma begin legaddela shema deavraham bealma ulkarva leh lefulchaneh

Veraza demilla kevan deavraham itar lemirdaf abbatrayehu keden elohim al domi lach ad deitkashshar kolla beavraham vechad itkashshar kolla beavraham keden itbaru kulhu malchin mikkammeh kedeka amaran dichtiv yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev vegv

Umalki tzedek melech shalem hotzi lechem vayayin rabbi shimon patach veamar vayehi beshalem sukko vegv ta chaze kad salik biruta dekudsha berich hu lemivre alma chad shalhova devutzina dekardinuta unshaf zika bezika chashchat veokidat veappik miggo
172: Sitre tehoma chad tif vechibber lon kechad uvara behu alma
Hahu shalhova salik veitattera bissemala vehahu tif salik veitattar beyamina salku chad bechad ichlafu duchte da lesitra da veda lesitra da denachit salik udsalik nachit
Itkatteru da beda nafik mibbenayehu ruach shelim keden innun teren sitrin itavidu chad veityehiv benayehu veitatteru chad bechad keden ishtechach shelam leela ushlam letatta vedarga itkayyam

Itatterat bev vav beh keden salka veitkashshera bekishshura shelim keden umalki tzedek melech shalem melech shalem vadday melech ihu deshallit bishlimu ematay ihu melech shalem beoma dechippure dechal anpin nehirin Adonai Adonai

Davar acher umalki tzedek da alma batraa melech shalem da alma illaa deitattar chad bechad bela piruda teren almin kechada veafilu alma tattaa kolla hu vechad milla ihu hotzi lechem vayayin ditre illen beh vehu chohen leel elon meshammesh alma lakovel alma vehu chohen da yamina leel elon alma illaa uvgin kach bae kahana levarcha alma

Ta chaze birchan natil hay alma tattaa kad itchabbar bechahana rabba keden vayevarachehu vayyomar baruch avram leel elon hachi hu vadday kegavena da bae kahana letatta lekashra kishrin ulvarcha hay duchta begin deyitkashshar beyamina leitkashshera teren almin kechad baruch avram raza demilla tikkuna devirchan ihu

Barucha avram kema deamrinan baruch atta leel elon Adonai elohenu kone shamayim vaaretz melech haolam vehay kera raza devirchan ihu vayevarachehu mittatta leela uvaruch el elon meela letatta vayyitten lo maaser mikkol leitdabbeka beatar dekishshura itkashshar letatta
Ad dehau azle iara behu rabbi yesa vechad yuday bahadeh vehava amar hahu yuday ledavid elecha Adonai nafshi essa ledavid vechi ammay la ketiv mizmor ledavid o ledavid mizmor

Ela begin dargeh kaamar ledavid tushbachta deamar begineh elecha Adonai nafshi essa elecha Adonai leela nafshi man nafshi da david darga kadmaa dekaamaran essa asallek kema deatte amer essa enay el heharim begin dechal yomoy dedavid hava mishtaddel lesalka dargeh leitattera leela ulitkashshera tamman bekishshura shelim kedeka yeut

Kegavena da ledavid barchi nafshi et Adonai begin dargeh kaamar umay amar barchi nafshi et Adonai et leitkashshera bekishshura leela vechal keravay man keravay illen shear chevan bera deikrun keravayim kema deatte amer umeay hamu alav davar acher barchi nafshi begineh kaamar et Adonai da shelimu decholla et Adonai kelala decholla

Amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi yesa chamina lach deha im shechinta kaatit veitchabbarat amar leh hachi hu vadday utlat parse hu deazilna bahadeh veamar li kamma mile maalyata veana agirna leh leoma da vela yedana deihu botzina denahir kidchamina hashta
Amar leh rabbi elazar lehahu yuday ma shemach amar leh yoezri amar leh yoezer veelazar yetivan kechada yatvu gabbe chad tinnara
173: Behahu chakal patach hahu yuday veamar anochi anochi hu moche feshaecha lemaani vechattotecha lo ezkor may tama tere zimne anochi anochi

Ella chad besinay vechad beshaata devara alma dichtiv anochi Adonai elohecha da hu besinay vechad kad bera alma dichtiv anochi asiti eretz veadam aleha barati hu begin leachazaa dela have piruda ben ela vetatta
Moche feshaecha maavir peshaecha la ketiv ella moche begin dela yitchazzun lealmin lemaani may lemaani begin innun rachamin detalyan bi dichtiv ki el rachum Adonai elohecha vegv

Davar acher moche feshaecha lemaani ta chaze chayyave alma avdin pegimuta leela dechad innun chovin salkin rachamin unhiru illaa veyanniku devirchan la nachit letatta vehay darga la natil birchan dilela leyannaka letatta uvgin kach lemaani begin dela yitmanun birchan leyannaka lecholla
Kegavena da reu atta ki ani ani hu leachazaa dela have piruda ben ela vetatta kema deittemar

Ta chaze kegavena da kad ishtakkachu zakkain bealma itaru birchan lealmin kulhu kevan deata avraham itar birchan lealma dichtiv vaavarechcha veheye beracha may vehye beracha remez deyishtakkechun begineh birchan leela vetatta dichtiv venivrechu vecha vegv uchtiv vaavarcha mevarachecha

Ata yitzchak oda lecholla deit din veit dayyan leela leitpara merashshiaya veihu itar dina bealma begin deyidchalun leh lekudsha berich hu kal bene alma ata yaakov veitar rachame bealma veashlim mehemnuta bealma kedeka chaze

Beome deavraham ma ketiv umalki tzedek melech shalem deitatterat kurseya beduchteh uchden ishtechach melech shalem bela pegimu kelal hotzi lechem vayayin deappik mezonin lealmin kulhu kedeka chaze hotzi lechem vayayin dela itmenau birchan mikkulhu almin hotzi kema deatte amer totze haaretz midargin dilela appik mezonin uvirchan lealmin kulhu

Vehu chohen leel elon deishtechach kolla bishlimu illaa kedeka chaze leitchazaa kema dechayyavaya avde pegimu bealma umane birchan hachi name begin zakkain atyan birchan lealma uvginayehu itbarchan kal bene alma

Vayyitten lo maaser mikkol may maaser mikkol meinnun birchan denafke mikkol begin deihu atar dechal birchan denachate lealma mittamman nafke davar acher vayyitten lo maaser mikkol kudsha berich hu yahav leh maasra uman ihu da darga dechal pitchin dimhemnuta uvirchan dealma beh kayeme veihu maaser veihu chad measara veihu asara mimmea mikkan ulhala al avraham bekiyyuma dilela kedeka chaze

Amar leh rabbi elazar shappir ka amarte amar leh rabbi elazar may avidtach amar leh karyana dardeke beatri hashta ata rabbi yose dichfar chanin lemata usliku lon migabbay veotvu lon legabbeh vehau yahavin li kal beni mata agra kehahu zimna dedardeke hau gabbay veistakkalna benafshay dela itchaze li leithanne minnayehu lemaggana vaagirna garmay bahade dehay chakkim amar rabbi elazar birchan deabba itzterichu hacha

Kamu atu kammeh derabbi shimon vehava yativ velae kal yoma kammeh derabbi shimon veoma chad hava asik bintilat yadayim kammeh amar kal man dela natil yedoy kedeka yeut af al gav deitannash leela itannash letatta umay onsheh letatta degarim leh legarmeh miskenuta kema deonsheh kach hachi hu zache man denatil yedoy kedeka yeut degarim legarmeh birchan dilela desharan birchan al yedoy kedeka yeut veitbarach beutra
174: Levatar akdim rabbi shimon chama leh deantal yedoy bemaya venatil lon beshiura sagya demayin amar rabbi shimon malle yadav mibbirchotecha vechach hava mehahu yoma ulhala itattar veashkach sima vehava lae beorayeta veyahiv mezona lemiskene kal yoma vehava chade immehon umasbar lon anpin nehirin kara aleh rabbi shimon veatta tagil bayeya bikdosh vegv

Achar haddevarim haelle haya devar Adonai el avram vegv rabbi yehuda patach ani ledodi vealay teshukato ha ukmuha aval beitaruta diltatta ishtechach itaruta leela deha la itar leela ad deitar letatta uvirchan dilela la mishtakkeche ella bame deit beh mammasha velav ihu rekanya

Menalan meeshet ovadyahu deamar lah elisha haggidi li ma yesh lach babbayit deha birchan dilela la sharyan al patora rekanya vela beatar rekanya ma ketiv vattomer en leshifchatcha kol babbayit ki im asuch shamen may asuch ella amra leh shiura dehay mishcha lav ihi ella kede meshichat etzbea zeira

Amar lah nichamtani deha la yedana heach yishrun birchan dilela beduchta rekanya aval hashta deit lach shemen da hu atar leishtakkacha beh birchan minnalan dichtiv kashshemen hattov vegv vesefeh ma ketiv ki sham tziva Adonai et habberacha chayyim ad haolam uvatra da sharan birchan
Vei tema ketal chermon sheyyored al harre tziyyon vela ketiv shemen ela tal ella ihu shemen veihu tal hahu tal ihu deattil kudsha berich hu mimmishcha illaa dehahu shemen nafak lesitra deyamina

Teren innun yayin veshemen veazlu litren sitrin yayin listar semala shemen listar yamina umissitra deyamina nafke birchan lealma umittamman itmeshach malchuta kaddisha uvgin deshemen hava ittakkan letatta bekadmita shemen izdamman leela ariku devirchan

Sitre tora achar haddevarim haelle vegv illen pitteggame orayeta dichtiv ett haddevarim haelle dibber Adonai el kal kehalchem ma lehallan pitteggame orayeta uf hacha pitteggame orayeta battar deishtaddal bar nash behay alma baddevarim haelle kudsha bericha hu mevaser leh veakdim lah lenishmatta shelam hada hu dichtiv al tira avram anochi magen lacha mikkal zayenin bishin degehinnom

Secharcha harbe meod begin dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta behay alma zache veachsin yerutta achsanta bealma deatte kema dichtiv lehanchil ohavay yish yesh veotztzerottehem amalle behay alma meuttera umikkal tivu dealma man deazil leyamina zache lealma deatte uman deazil lismala ha uttera bealma den

Rabbi abba kad atta mehattam hava machriz man bae uttera uman bae orcha dechayye bealma deatte yete veyishtaddal beorayeta hau mittekkanshin kule alma legabbeh ravak chad hava beshivvutteh yoma chad atta legabbeh amar leh rabbi baena lemile beorayeta kede sheyyihye li uttera amar leh ha vadday amar leh ma shemecha amar leh deazil leyamina zache lealma deatte uman deazil lismala ha uttera bealma den rabbi abba kad atta mehattam hava machriz man bae uttera uman bae orcha dechayye bealma deatte yete veyishtaddal beorayeta hau mittekkanshin kule alma legabbeh ravak chad hava beshivvutteh yoma chad atta legabbeh amar leh rabbi baena lemile beorayeta kede sheyyihye li uttera amar leh ha vadday amar leh ma shemecha amar leh yose amar lon lettalmidoy deyikrun leh rabbi yose mare deuttera vkara yattiv vitteassak beorayeta
Leomin hava kaim kammeh amar leh rabbi an hu uttera amar
175: Dehay shemen dilela kay learaka al david ushlomo leitbarcha benoy mena lan dichtiv vayyaamod hashshemen ketiv hacha vayyaamod uchtiv hatam shorsh yishshay asher omed lenes ammim

Ta chaze mishshulchan delechem happanim devirchan nafkin mittamman umzona lealma la vae leishtakkacha rekanya afillu riga chada begin dela yistallekun birchan mittamman uf hachi la mevarchin al shulchan rekanya deha birchan dilela la sharyan al shulchan rekanya
Ta chaze ma ketiv ani ledodi vealay teshukato ani ledodi bekadmita ulvatar vealay teshukato ani ledodi leatkana leh duchta bekadmita ulvatar vealay teshukato

Davar acher ani ledodi deha taninan shechinta la ishtakkechat imhon dechayyavaya kevan deate bar nash leitdakkaa ulmikrav gabbe dekudsha berich hu keden shechinta sharya aleh hada hu dichtiv ani ledodi bekadmita vealay teshukato levatar ate bar nash leitdakkaa medakkein leh

Ta chaze achar haddevarim haelle deradaf avraham batar illen malchin vekatil lon kudsha berich hu hava avraham tohe amar dilma chas veshalom garaana hahu agra dahavena ahadar bene nasha legabbe kudsha berich hu veachidna behu lekarava lon legabbeh vehashta itketilu bene nesha al yadi miyyad amar leh kudsha berich hu al tira avram anochi magen lach secharcha harbe vegv agra kabbilat alayehu deha kulhu la yizkun lealmin

Haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze lemor may bammachaze ella behahu chezu darga dechal diuknin itchazzeyan beh amar rabbi shimon ta chaze ad la itgezar avraham hava chad darga mallil immeh uman ihu da machaze dichtiv machaze shadday yechoze
Kevan deitgezar hau kulhu dargin sharan al hay darga uchden mallil immeh hada hu dichtiv vaera
Shema minah dela leshem shamayim ka avid veal leidreh shema chad kala dehava amar la taansheh degavra rabba lihevi tav legabbeh amar leh tiv beri tiv veana yahivna lacha uttera

Adhachi atta gavra chad umana deppaz bideh appekeh unpal nehora beveta amar leh rabbi baena lemizke beorayeta veana la zachina uvaena man deyishtaddal beorayeta begini deha it li uttera sagge deka shevak li abba dechad yattiv pettoreh hava mesaddar aleh telesar kasse meillen uvaena lemizke beorayeta veana yahivna uttera

Amar leh lehahu ravak tishtaddal beorayeta veda yahiv lacha uttera yahav leh hahu kassa deppaz kara aleh rabbi abba lo yaarchenna zahav uzchuchit uttemurattah keli paz yattiv velaa beorayeta vehahu bar nash hava yahiv leh uttera

Leomin al chamidu deorayeta bimoy yoma chad hava yattiv vehava bache ashkecheh rabbeh dehava bache amar leh al ma ka bachit amar leh uma mannachno chayye dealma deatte begin hay la beena ella lemizke legabbay amar hashta shema minah deha leshem shamayim ka avid

Kara leh lehahu gavra amar leh tol utteracha vehav leh leyatteme ulmiskeni veana yahivna lacha chulak yattir beorayeta bechal ma deanan laan ahadar leh rabbi yose hahu kassa deppaz vead yoma la aade shemeh umin benoy ben pazzi vehayenu rabbi yose ben pazi vezacha lechamma orayeta hu uvnoy delet lacha agar tav bealma keman delae beorayeta umkayemah

Achar haddevarim haelle haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze lemor vegv bechal attar dichtiv beorayeta bammachaze da shema deitteggele laavahan uman ihu shadday shenneemar vaera el avraham el yitztzechak veel yaakov beel shadday kema deatte amer asher machaze shaday yechoze veda ihu chezu dechal chezvan illain ittechazzeyan miggavih kehay mare dechal diuknin ittechazzeyan beh vcholla chad mare machaze chad hu da targum veda lashon hakkodesh

Amar rabbi yose saggiin innun beorayeta veal da hava leh roshu leunkelus lettargem behahu lishna degale kudsha bericha hu beorayeta velishna da sattim ihu miggo malache ilaa bammachaze dehava sattim mimmalache illae dela yade beda kad memallel beh beavraham
May tama begin deavraham la hava mahul vehava arel sattim bisra uvgin kacha hava sattim minnayehu bilshon targum kegavena da bilam dichtiv
176: El avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday vead la itgezar la hau innun dargin sharan aloy lemallala

Vei tema deha bekadmita ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram uchtiv vayyisa avram haloch venasoa hannegba uchtiv vayyiven sham mizbeach ha hacha innun dargin illain vehashta amaran dead la itgezar la hau innun dargin illain sharan al hay darga lemallala immeh

Ta chaze bekadmita yahav kudsha berich hu chachma leavraham leminda chachma leitdabbeka beh veyada raza dimhemnuta aval lemallala immeh la hava ella hay darga tattaa bilchodoy kevan deitgezar kulhu dargin illain hau sharan al hay darga tattaa begin lemallala immeh uchden istallak avraham becholla kema deittemar

Ta chaze ad la itgezar bar nash la itachid bishma dekudsha berich hu kevan deitgezar al bishmeh veitachid beh vei tema avraham deitachid beh ad la itgezar hachi hava deitachid beh vela kedeka yeut deha miggo rechimuta illaa derachim leh kudsha berich hu kariv leh

Levatar pakkid leh deyitgezar veityehiv leh berit kishshura dechulhu dargin illain berit kishshura leitkashshera kolla kechada leachlala da beda berit kishshura decholla itkeshar beh uvgin kach avraham ad la itgezar milloy la hava immeh ella bammachaze kema deittemar

Ta chaze beshaata devara kudsha berich hu alma la itberi ella al berit kema deatte amer bere shit bara elohim vehayenu deal berit kiyyem kudsha berich hu alma uchtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti deha berit kishshura ihu deoma velelya la mitparshan

Amar rabbi elazar kad bera kudsha berich hu alma al tenay hava dechad yetun yisrael im yekabbelun orayeta yaot veim lav hari ana ahadar lechu letohu vavohu vealma la itkeyyam ad dekayemu yisrael al tura desinay vekabbilu orayeta uchden itkeyyam alma

Umehahu yoma ulhala kudsha berich hu bari almin uman innun ziuugin divne nasha deha mehahu zimna kudsha berich hu mezaveg ziuugin veomer bat peloni lifloni veillen innun almin dehu bare ta chaze anochi magen lach anochi da hu darga kadmaa deitachid beh bekadmita

Asher machaze shadday yechozhi yecheze sattim hava milla miggo malache hasharett begin dolo yehe lon pitra dekudsha bericha hu memallel behahu arel mesaova deha malache kaddishe lav nizkakin billeshon targum
I tema dela yade veha gavriel olif leosef lashon vtargum chad me lashon hu ella minda yade aval la nizkakin tenan dela chayeshe vela mashgichin aleh deha mais ihu kammayehu mikkal shear lashon

Vei tema hoil umais ihu mimmalache illae ammay tirgem unkelus orayeta behay lashon veonattan ben uziel hammikra ella mais hu kammayehu vhachi itztzetericha delet kina lemalache illae bahadayehu deyisrael yattir veal da targum tora umikra kacha vela mais ihu deha bechamma duchte kattav kudsha bericha hu beorayeta hachi

Uvgin kacha sattim ihu miggo malache illae kaddishe veal da itteggeli beh beavraham beorach sattim dela yishgechun beh malachin kaddishin vela yehe lon pitra dekudsha bericha hu itteggeli al bar nash arel
Emattay itteggeli leh beitteggalleya demalache illae kad yahiv leh berit keyama kaddisha dichtiv vayedabber itto elohim lemor elohim shema dekudsha velo kettiv bammachaze shema beitteggalleya

Lemor may lemor lemor ulachraza bechal lashon dela tehe beittekkasya lav belishna achora ella belishna decholla mishtayan bah deyachle lememar da leda vela yachle lekatrega ulmemar pitra veal da vayedabber itto elohim lemor elohim velo machaz begin dehava meayyil leh bivrit keyama kaddisha vekariv leh legabbeh

Rabbi yehuda amar vegin kacha att Adonai la itteyehav leh ad deitteggazzar may tama deihi mammash berit ikre veal da kevan deal bivrit keden itteyehivatt leh att dichtiv ani hinne beriti ittacha vehayita leav hamon goyim velo yikare od shimcha avram vegv

Achar haddevarim haelle rabbi chiyya hava azil lemecheme lerabbi elazar pega beh rabbi chaggay amar leh hay archa dimtakno kammeh demar lean ihu azil amar leh lemecheme lerabbi elazar amar leh veana name ezil bahadacha amar leh i techul lemisbar sevara lemay dettishma zil vei lav tuv avatteracha amar leh lo lichush mar lehay deha ana shemano kamma raze deorayeta veyachilna lemekam behu
Pattach rabbi chaggay veamar may dichtiv ett karbani lachmi leishay
Vayyomer avram adonay Adonai ma titten li elohim Adonai ella raza demilla chibbura ditren almin kechada alma tattaa vealma illaa

Ma titten li veanochi holech ariri delet li bar veolifna dechal man delet leh bera behay alma ikre ariri kema deatte amer aririm yihu veavraham al ma amar milla da deamar ma titten li kivyachol keilu la heemin beh bekudsha berich hu

Ella amar leh kudsha berich hu anochi magen lach behay alma secharcha harbe meod bealma deate miyyad itar avraham beraza dechachmeta veamar ma titten li deha yedana dela kabbil agar lemeal beh behahu alma bar nash dela olid bar veal da amar ma titten li veanochi holech ariri deha la titten li dela zachina beh mikkan debbar nash dela zache bivnin behay alma la zache behahu alma leaala go pargoda
Veavraham hava chame beitztagninut dileh dela yolid ma ketiv vayyotze oto
177: Vegv ett karbani da karban bisra deittekerav lechappara dama dama bisra al bisra begin dechal karbanin lav mittekarvin ella al bisra lechappara bisra

Vehachi shemana i bar nash chata behema ma chatat dekudsha bericha hu amar adam ki yakriv mikkem karban vegv ammay ella kudsha bericha hu avid ruach bene nasha veruach habbehema veapperish da min da uvgin kacha ruach bene haadam haola hi lemala veruach habbehema vegv vday mittepperash da min da

Ad la chata adam ma kettiv vayyomer elohim hinni nattatti lachem ett kal esev zorea zara vegv uchtiv lachem yihye leachla velo yattir kevan dechata veyetztzer hara ishtaiv beguppa dileh uvchal innun toladin avad behu dina

Ulvattar atta noach vchama deha guppa ittebbene meattera deyetztzer hara akriv karban kema deakriv adam ma kettiv vayyarach Adonai ett reach hannichoach ki yetztzer lev haadam ra minneurav amar kudsha bericha hu mikkan ulhala hoil veguppa ishtaiv mehahu yetztzer hara yitteannag guppa kema deittechaze leh yechul bisra keyerek esev nattatti lachem ett kol

Kad achil bisra mehahu bisra itteannag bisra dileh veittearav da beda veitterabbe guppa minneh umehahu oneg guppa chata bechamma chetin amar kudsha bericha hu kappara guppa bisra bisra achil uvisra itterabbe mineh uveh chata vegin kacha lechappara guppeh bisra uvisra deachil bisra avid dama leguppa vegin kacha dama deishtaar mehahu bisra levar itteattad lechappara al dama deitteavid mehahu bisra dileh dichtiv ki haddam hu banneppesh yechapper

Kettiv karbani uchtiv karbanchem dichtiv takrivu ett karbanchem ma ben hay lehay ella karbani kegon shelamim deatteyan al shalom karbanchem kegon chataott vaashamott deatteyan al chet vasham vegin kacha ett karbani bisra lachmi nahama vechamra reach da ketorett nichochi da nachatt ruach deavid kahana birutta dishma kaddisha velevae birutta deshir ushvacha
Tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado bemoado may havi i tema bechal yoma babboker uvaerev ihu bemoado ella moado deshalta behahu zimna raava reu deishtechach leela bedarga yedia da kettiv bemoado

Kad karban ittekeriv kolla natlin chulaka veittebbadderan kelipin lechal sitra veyichuda ittekeriv veitteyachad uvotztzinin ittenaharin veishtechach raava uru bechal almin vekudsha bericha hu ishtechach beraza deyichuda chada kedeka chaze atta rabbi chiyya unshakeh amar leh yaott ante beri mini lemehacha lemecheme leh lisvar anpin deomin

Azlu kad matun legabbeh chama lon yatteve al tara amar leh leshammosho zil veema lon hay kurseya dittelatt kayemin mahu kal echad amru leh zil veema leh lemar delav lemaggana amar david malka deihu reviaa even maasu habbonim amar leh zil veema lon dean gaalu beh bedad deihu amar even maasu habbonim

Ahadar rabbi chiyya resheh legabbe rabbi chaggay veamar leh shamatt behay midi amar shemano behay kera dichtiv bene immi nicharu vi samuni vegv dehay kera shelomo malka amaro veal david malka ittemar kad dachu leh achuhi minnayehu

Vettu shemana may chama kudsha bericha hu lemehav malchutta lihuda mikkal achuhi ella attevan dishmeh chakikan beh vekudsha bericha hu yahav yekara lishmeh uvgin kacha achsin malchutta vettu shemana yehuda ha attevan dishmeh vadday leteh ammay ella da david malka deittekashar bishmeh mikkal bene alma dichtiv uvikkeshu ett Adonai elohehem veett dad malkam vegv ha david kashir bishmeh tu deihu kesher shel teppillin vday dad malka uvgin kacha david ittekashar bishmeh

Alu kevan dealu yettivu kammeh ishtik rabbi elazar veinnun ishtiku al rabbi elazar leidreh shema chad kala dehava amar zil veema lon ma deinnun bayan dichsherin innun ahadar legabbayehu amar lon it man dishma milla lema li amru leh anan mechakkan leanhara miggo tzachutta devutztzina illaa usvara
178: Pattach veamar vayeya behechal kadsho has mippanav kal haaretz kad bae kudsha bericha hu lemivre alma istakkal go machashava raza deorayeta verashim rishumin velo hava yachil lemekam ad devara teshuva deihi hechala penimaa illaa veraza settima vettamman ittereshimu veittetztzayeru attevan begilluppayehu

Kevan deittebbere da hava mistakkal behay hechala verashim kammeh tziyyurin dechal alma dichtiv has mippanav kal haaretz reshim kammeh reshumin vetztziyyurin dechal alma bae lemivre shamayim ma avad istakkal beor kadmaa veitteataf beh uvra shamayim dichtiv ote or kashalma veachar kacha note shamayim kayeria

Istakkal lemebad alma tattaa avad hechala ochara veal beh uminneh istakkal urshim kammeh kal almin lettatta uvra lo hada hu dichtiv vayeya behechal kadsho has mippanav kal haaretz has mippanav rashim kammeh kal nekudin dechal alma deinnun shittin vechamesh kechushban shittin innun vechamesh innun vechulhu rashim kammeh kad bera alma vegin kacha yekara dekudsha bericha hu lav ihu ella leinnun deyadin archoy umhachin bah beorach keshot kedeka yeutt

Adhachi dehava mishtae bahadayehu atta nura veaschar leh veinnun yattevu levar shemau chad kala dehava amar i kaddisha heviani hammelecha chadarav bechal innun idrin desava deanpin ulema kaddisha deittemesaru mappettechan dilhon bideh vechulhu mettaknan lacha ulinnun divginacha uvchayyacha kaddisha kal chela dishmaya nagila vnismecha vacha

Kad chamu illen hachi izdazou udchilu saggi nappal alayehu amre let anan chazyan lehay nippuk mikkan venehacha leorchin yattevu tamman kol hahu yoma vela yachilu lemecheme leh veamru let reutta dekudsha bericha hu denetiv hacha nappeku mittamman veazle

Ad dehau azle patach rabbi chiyya veamar barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro vegv zakkain innun yisrael mikkal shear ammin dealma dekudsha bericha hu itterae behu mikkal shear ammin veavad lon chulkeh veachsanteh veal da yahiv lon orayeta kaddisha begin dechulhu hau birutta chada al tura desinay vakdimu asiyya lishmia
