Kevan deakdimu oshoyya lishmia kera kudsha bericha hu leppammalya dileh amar lon ad hacha attun havitun yechidain kammay bealma mikkan ulhala ha banay beara chaverim bahadayehu becholla let lechu roshu lekadsha shemi ad deyisrael yittechabberun bahadayechu beara vechulhu teheon kechada chaverim lekaddesha shemi begin deakdimu asiyya lishmia kegaveno demalache illae avde birkia dichtiv barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro ose devaro bekadmita ulvattar lishmo

Davar acher barchu Adonai malachav illen innun tzaddikaya beara deinnun chashuvin kamme kudsha bericha hu kemalache illae birkia begin deinnun gibbore choach demitteggabbere al yitztzerehon kegibbar tav demitteggabber al saneh lishmoa bekol devaro dezachan bechal yoma lemishma kala milleela beshaatta deitztzeterichu

Hashta man yachil lemekam bahadayehu deinnun kaddishin elonin zakkain innun deyachle lemekam kammayehu zakkain innun deyachle leishtezava mikkammayehu ashgachutta dekudsha bericha hu alayehu bechal yoma hecha anan yechilan lemeal kammayehu veal da kettiv ashre tivchar uttekarev yishkon chatztzerecha uchtiv ashre adam oz lo vacha vegv
179: Hachutza vegv amar leh kudsha berich hu la tistakkal behay ella beraza dishmi yehe lach bar hada hu dichtiv ko yihye zarecha raza dishma kaddisha demittamman itkashshar leh beda vela missitra achora

Ko dehu tara litzlota bah yishkach beracha bah yishkach bar nash sheilteh ko hahu sitra deatya missitra digvura deha missitra digvura ka ata yitzchak vehahu sitra digvura ko ikre demittamman atyan ibin ufere lealma vela missitra diltatta dechochvaya umazzalot

Keden veheemin bayeya itdabbak leela vela itdabbak letatta veheemin bayeya vela bechochvaya umazzale veheemin bayeya deavtach leh deyasge agreh lealma deate veheemin bayeya behahu darga deityehiv leh demittamman yete leh zara leolada bealma vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka
Vayyachsheveha lo deaf al gav deihi dina keilu hi rachame hay ko davar acher vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka dekashir kishra illaa betattaa lechabbera lon kechada

Ta chaze ha itaru avraham molid avram eno molid vechi tema deha olid yishmael beod deihu avram ella hahu bera deavtach leh kudsha berich hu la olid beod deihu avram deha beod deihu avram olid letatta kevan deitkere avraham veal babberit keden olid leela uvgin kach avram eno molid bekishshura illaa avraham molid kema deamaran veitkashshar leela beyitzchak

Vayehi avram ben tishim shana vetesha shanim vegv rabbi abba patach ki mi el mibbalade Adonai umi tzur vegv david malka amar hay kera ki mi el mibbalade Adonai man hu shallita o memanna deyechul lemebad middi mibbalade Adonai ella ma deitpakkad meim kudsha berich hu begin dechulhu la birshutayehu kayeme vela yachle lemebad middi umi tzur uman ihu takkif deyachol lemebad tukfa ugvura miggarmeh mibbalade elohenu ella kulhu bida dekudsha berich hu vela yachil lemebad middi bar birshuteh

Davar acher ki mi el mibbalade Adonai dekudsha berich hu kolla birshuteh vela keman deitchaze bechezu dechochvaya umazzale dechulhu achzeyan milla vekudsha berich hu achlaf leh legavena achora umi tzur zulati elohenu ha ukmuha delet tzayyar kema dekudsha berich hu deihu tzayyar shelim avid vetziyyer diukna go diukna veashlim lehahu diukna bechal tikkuneh veail bah nefesh illaa dedame letikkuna illaa vegin kach let tzayyar kekudsha berich hu

Ta chaze mehahu zara debbar nash kad itar tiuvteh legabbe nukveh venukveh itarat legabbeh keden mitchabberan tarvayehu kechada venafak minnayehu bar chad dechalil mitteren diuknin kechad begin dekudsha berich hu tziyer leh betziyyura deitkelil mittarvayehu veal da bae bar nash lekadsha garmeh behahu zimna begin deyishtechach hahu diukna betziyyura shelim kedeka chaze

Amar rabbi chiyya ta chaze kamma innun ravrevin ovadoy dekudsha berich hu deha umnuta vetziyyura debbar nash ihu kegavena dealma uvchal yoma veoma kudsha berich hu bare alma mezavig ziuugin kal chad vechad kedeka chaze leh vehu tziyyer diuknehon ad la yetun lealma

Ta chaze deamar rabbi shimon ketiv ze sefer toldot adam vechi sefer hava leh ella ukmuha dekudsha berich hu achme leh leadam harishon dor dor vedorshav vechu heach achme leh i tema dechama beruach kudsha deinnun zeminin lemete lealma keman dechama bechachmeta ma deyete lealma lav hachi ella chama beena kulhu vehahu diukna dezamminin lemekam beh bealma kulhu chama beena may tama begin demiyyoma deitbere alma kulhu nafshan dezamminin lemekam bivne nasha kulhu kayemin kamme kudsha berich hu behahu diukna mammash dezamminin lemekam beh
180: Kegavena da kal innun tzaddikayya batar denafkin mehay alma kulhu nafshan salkan vekudsha berich hu azmin lon diukna achora leitlabbesha behu kegavena dehau behay alma vegin kach kulhu kayemin kammeh vechama lon adam harishon beena

Vei tema batar dechama lon la kayeme bekiyyumayehu ta chaze kal milloy dekudsha berich hu bekiyyuma innun vekayemu kammeh ad denachatu lealma kegavena da ketiv ki et asher yeshno fo vegv ha ukmuha dechulhu bene nasha dezamminin lemeheve bealma kulhu ishtechachu tamman

Hacha it leistakkala deha ketiv et asher enennu fo vegv umashma hanhu deyifkun meinnun dekayemu tamman begin dichtiv immanu hayyom vela ketiv immanu omed hayyom ella vadday kulhu kayemu tamman ella dela itchazu leena vegin kach ketiv immanu hayyom af al gav dela itchazun

Vei tema may tama la itchazun hacha kema deitchazun leadam harishon dechama lon ena beena veha hacha itchaze yattir ella hacha kad ityehivat orayeta leyisrael chezu achora vedargin illain hau chaman umistakkelan ena beena vehau teivin leistakkala ulmechome bikara demarehon uvgin kach chamu yekara illaa dekudsha berich hu bilchodoy vela meachora

Veal da kulhu bene nasha dezamminin lekayema bealma kulhu kayeme kamme kudsha berich hu beinnun diuknin mammash dezamminin lekayema beh hada hu dichtiv galmi rau enecha veal sifrecha vegv galmi rau enecha may tama begin dediukna achora illaa havi kehay uvgin kach ketiv umi tzur zulati elohenu man tzayyar tav detzayyar kolla kekudsha berich hu

Davar acher ki mi eloha da raza demilla deha el kelala hu deitkelil mikkulhu dargin vei tema deha el ihu darga achora begin dichtiv el zoem bechal yom ta chaze deha let el mibbalade Adonai delav ihu bilchodoy vela itperash lealmin veal da ketiv ki mi el mibbalade Adonai vegv umi tzur vegv deha tzur lav ihu bilchodoy ella kolla chad kedichtiv veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim vegv

Ta chaze ad la itgezar avraham hava memallel immeh miggo machaze bilchodoy kema deittemar dichtiv haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze vegv bammachaze behahu chezu darga dechal diuknin itchazyan beh kema deittemar vehay machaze ihu raza divrit

Vei tema divgin kach ikre machaze begin deihu darga chezu dechal diuknin itchazyan beh uchden ikre machaze ha amarte bekadmita dead la itgezar avraham la hava memallel immeh bar hay darga dela sharan aloy dargin achoranin vehashta amarte bammachaze chezu dechal dargin illain veha ad la itgezar ketiv haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze

Ella hay darga chezu dechal dargin illain ihu uvchezu dedargin illain ittakkan veaf al gav divhahu zimna deavraham la hava gazir hay darga bechezu dedargin illain ihu uvchal innun gevanin ihu kaim vechezu deinnun gevanin kayeme techoteh chad miyyamina gavan chivar chad missemala gavan sumak chad dechalil mikkal gevanin veihu chezu dechal gevanin illain dekayeme aleh veal da behay chezu kaim aleh deavraham umallil immeh veaf al gav dela itgezar kevan deitgezar ma ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram

Ta chaze machaze shadday ketiv bevilam uvavraham ketiv machaze setam ma ben hay lehay ella machaze shadday illen diltatta minneh veinnun chezu dileh machaze setam machaze da hu Adonai dechal diuknin illain itchazyan beh uvgin kach ketiv beavraham machaze setam uvvilam machaze shadday
Veal da ad la itgezar avraham hava leh hay darga kidamaran kevan deitgezar miyyad vayyera Adonai el avram vegv itchazun kulhu
181: Dargin al hay darga vehay darga mallil immeh kedeka chaze bishlimu veavraham itkattar middarga ledarga veal bivrit keyama kaddisha kedeka chaze bishlimu

Ta chaze kevan deitgezar avraham nafak mearla veal bikyama kaddisha veitattar beittera kaddisha veal bekiyyuma dealma kaim aleh uchden itkeyyam alma begineh begin dichtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti uchtiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram beh baram beavraham vecholla beraza chada kaim uvshaata dekudsha berich hu achame leh leadam kal innun darin dealma vechama lon kal chad vechad kal dara vedara kulhu kayeme beginta deeden behahu diukna dezamminin lekayema behay alma
Vetta chaze ha ittemar kevan dechama leh ledavid delav beh chayyim kelal tavah veihu yehiv leh middileh shenin vegin kach hau leh leadam tesha meot utlatin shenin veinnun shivin istallaku leh ledavid
Umilla da raza dechachmeta ihu dedavid let leh bar shivin shenin meadam kadmaa vecholla raza dechachmeta ihu vechal ma diltatta kolla ihu beraza dilela

Vetta chaze bechal innun diuknin denishmatin dealma kulhu ziuugin ziuugin kammeh levatar kad atyan lehay alma kudsha berich hu mezavig ziuugin amar rabbi yitzchak kudsha berich hu amar bat peloni lifloni amar rabbi yose may ka mayere veha ketiv en kal chadash tachat hashshemesh amar rabbi yehuda tachat hashshemesh ketiv shane leela
Amar rabbi yose may karoza hacha veha amar rabbi chizkiyya amar rabbi chiyya behahi shaata mammash denafik bar nash lealma bat zugo izdammenat lo

Amar rabbi abba zakkain innun tzaddikayya denishmathon mitatterin kamme malka kaddisha ad la yetun lealma dehachi taninan behahi shaata deappik kudsha berich hu nishmatin lealma kal innun ruchin venishmatin kulhu kelilan dechar venukva demitchabberan kechada
Veitmasseran bida dehahu memanna shelicha deitpakkad al idduehon divne nasha velayela shemeh uvshaata denachatin veitmasran bidoy mitparshin ulzimnin da akdim min da veachit lehu bivne nasha

Vechad mata idan deziuuga dilhon kudsha berich hu deyada innun ruchin venishmatin mechabbar lon kidbekadmita umachreza alayehu vechad itchabberan itavidu chad gufa chad nishmata yamina usmala kedeka chaze uvgin kach en kal chadash tachat hashshamesh
Vei tema ha taninan let ziuuga ella lefum ovadoy vearchoy devar nash hachi hu vadday dei zache veovadoy itkashran zache lehahu dileh leitchabbara beh kema denafik
Amar ravi chiyya man deitkashran ovadoy bean atar yitba hahu ziuuga dileh amar leh ha taninan leolam yimkor adam veyissa bat talmid chacham detalmid chacham pikdona demareh itpakdan bideh

Tana beraza dematnita kal innun deatu begilgula denishmatin yachlin leakdama berachame ziuuga dilhon veal hay itaru chavraya shemma yekaddemennu acher berachamim veshappir kaamru acher dayeka veal ken kashin ziuugin kammeh dekudsha berich hu veal kolla vadday ki yesharim darche Adonai ketiv

Rabbi yehuda shalach leh lerabbi elazar amar ha raza demilla yedana innun deatu begilgula denishmatin mean atar lehu ziuuga shelach leh ketiv ma naase lahem lannotarim lenashim vegv uchtiv lechu vachataftem lachem vegv parshata divni vinyamin ochach veal hay taninan shemma yekadmennu acher berachamim
182: Amar rabbi yehuda hay hu vadday dekashin ziuugin kamme kudsha berich hu zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael deorayeta olif lehu archoy dekudsha berich hu vechal temirin ugniza dignizin kammeh

Vadday ketiv torat Adonai temima vegv zakkaa chulakeh man deyishtadal beorayeta vela yitperash minah dechal man deyitperash meorayeta afillu shaata chada kema deitperash mechayye dealma dichtiv ki hi chayyecha veorech yamecha uchtiv orech yamim ushnot chayyim veshalom yosifu lach

Vayehi avram ben tishim shana vegv rabbi yose patach veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz vegv zakkain innun yisrael mikkal shear ammin dekudsha berich hu kara lon tzaddikim detanya mea veesrim utmanya alfe mare degaddefin deazlin vetasin kal alma veshamin kala veachadin leh lehahu kala

Kema detaninan let lach milla bealma delet lah kala veazla vetasa barkia veachadin lah mare degadfin vesalkin hahu kala deamrin vedayenin lah hen letav hen levish dichtiv ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol vegv

Ematay dayenin lehahu kala rabbi chiyya amar beshaata debbar nash shachiv venaim venishmeteh nafkat minneh vehi ashidat beh bebbar nash uchden dayenin lehahu kala hada hu dichtiv mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche ficha may tama mishshum dehi ashidat bevar nash rabbi yehuda amar kal ma debbar nash avid bechal yoma nishmateh ashidat beh bevar nash belelya

Tana amar rabbi elazar bitchilat shaata kammayeta belelya kad nashaf yemama veal shimsha mare demaftechan dimmannan al shimsha al bitresar tarin diftichin bimama batar deal bechulhu kal innun tarin setimin

Karoza kaim veshare leachraza kaim man dekaim veachid leinnun maftechan batar desiyyem karoza kal innun neture alma mitkanshin vesalkin let man defatach pitra kolla mishtakkechin keden dinin diltatta mitarin veazlin veshatin bealma vesihara share leanhara

Umare divava takin umyallelin takin tinyanut keden mitare shirata umzammerin kamme marehon kamma mare teresin kayemu bekiyyumayehu veitarin dinin bealma keden bene nasha nayemin venishmata nafkat veashidat sahaduta veitchayevat bedina vekudsha berich hu avid chesed bevar nash venishmeta tavat leatrah

Befalgut lelya kad tzipporin mitarin sitra detzafon itar berucha kam bekiyyumeh sharvita devistar darom uvatash behahu rucha veshachich veitbassam keden itar kudsha berich hu benimusoy leishtashea im tzaddikayya beginta deeden

Behahu shaata zakkaa chulakeh debbar nash dekaim leishtaasha beorayeta deha kudsha berich hu vechal tzaddikaya divginta deeden kulhu tzayetin lekaleh hada hu dichtiv hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashmiini
Velo od ella dekudsha berich hu mashich aleh chad chuta dechesed lemeheve netir bealma deha illain vetattain natrin leh hada hu dichtiv yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo uvallayela shiro immi

Amar rabbi chizkiyya kal man deishtaddal behay shaata beorayeta vadday it leh chulaka tadir bealma deate amar rabbi yose may tama taddir amar leh hachi olifna dechal palgut lelya kad kudsha berich hu itar beginta deeden kal innun netian deginta ishtakyan yattir mehahu nachala deikre
183: Nachal kedumim nachal adanim dela pasku memoy lealmin kivyachol hahu dekaim veishteddal beorayeta keilu hahu nachala itrak al resheh veashke leh bego innun netian divginta deeden
Velo od ella hoil vechulhu tzaddikayya divgo ginta deeden tzayetin leh chulka shaveyan leh behahu shaku denachala ishtechach deit leh chulaka tadir bealma deate

Rabbi abba hava ate mitverya leve teronya dechamuy verabbi yaakov bereh hava immeh iaru bichfar tarsha kad bau lemishkav amar rabbi abba lemareh deveta it hacha tarnegola amar leh mara deveta ammay amar leh begin dekaimna befalgut lelya mammash

Amar leh la itzterich deha simana li beveta dehaden tikla dekamme arsay malina leh maya venatif tif tif befalgut lelya mammash itraku kulhu maya veitgalgal hay kitfa venahim veishtema kaleh bechal beta uchden hu falgut lelya mammash vechad sava hava li dahava kam bechal palgut lelya veishtaddal beorayeta uvgine kach avad hay

Amar ribbi abba berich rachamana deshadarni hacha befalgut lelya nahim hahu galgala dekitfa kamu ribbi abba veribbi yaakov shamu lehahu gavra dahava yativ veshippule veta utrin benoy immeh vahava amar ketiv chatzot layela akum lehodot lecha al mishpete tzidkecha may ka chama david deihu amar chatzot layela vela bachatzot layela ella chatzot layela vadday lekudsha berich hu amar hachi
Vechi kudsha berich hu hachi ikre in deha chatzot layela mammash kudsha berich hu ishtechach vesiata dileh uchden hi shaata deayil beginta deeden leishtashea im tzadikaya
Amar rabbi abba lerabbi yaakov vadday nishtattef bishchinta venitchabbar kechada karivu veyativu immeh amru leh ema milla defumach deshappir kaamarte mena lach hay amar lon milla da olifna missavay
Vetu hava amar ditlat shaate kamayeta delelya kal dinin diltatta mitarin veazlin veshatin bealma befalgut lelya mammash kudsha berich hu itar beginta deeden vedinin diltatta la mishtakkechan

Vechal nimusin dilela belelya la ishtechachu ella befalgut lelya mammash menalan meavraham dichtiv vayyechalek alehem layela bemitzrayim vayehi bachatzi hallayela uvatrin saggiin beorayeta hachi ishtechach vedavid hava yada

Umna hava yada ella hachi amar sava demalchuta dileh behay talya veal da kaim behahi shaata veamar shirata ulhachi karye lekudsha berich hu chatzot layela mammash akum lehodot lecha vegv deha kal dinin talyan mehacha vedinin demalchuta mehacha mishtakkechin vehahi shaata itketir bah david vekam veamar shirata ata rabbi abba unshakeh amar leh vadday hachi hu berich rachamana deshadderani hacha

Ta chaze layela dina bechal atar veha okimna mile vehachi hu vadday veha itar kame derabbi shimon amar hahu yenuka bereh dehahu gavra i hachi ammay ketiv chatzot layela amar leh ha ittemar befalgut lelya malchuta dishmaya itarat amar ana shemana milla amar leh rabbi abba ema beri tav deha milla defumach kala devutzina lehve

Amar ana shemana deha layela dina demalchuta ihu uvchal atar dina hu vehay dekaamar chatzot begin deyanka bitre gaveni bedina vechesed vadday palguta kadmita dina hu deha palguta achora nehiru anpaha besitra dechesed veal da chatzot layela ketiv vadday

Kam rabbi abba veshave yedoy beresheh uvarcheh amar vadday chashivna dechachmeta la ishtechach bar beinnun zakkae dezachu ba hashta chamena deafilu yenuke bedara derabbi shimon zachu lechachmeta ilaa zakkaa ante rabbi shimon vay ledara deante tistallak minneh yatvu ad
184: Patach rabbi abba veamar veammech kullam tzaddikim vegv milla da ha ukmuha chavraya may tama ketiv veammech kullam tzaddikim vechi kulhu yisrael tzaddike ninhu veha kamma chayyavin it behu beyisrael kamma chattain vechamma rashshiin deavrin al pikkude orayeta

Ella hachi tana beraza dematnitin zakkain innun yisrael deavdin karbana deraava lekudsha berich hu demakrivin benayehu litmanya yomin lekarbana vechad itgezaru alu behay chulaka tava dekudsha berich hu dichtiv vetzaddik yesod olam kevan dealu behay chulaka detzaddik ikrun tzaddikim vadday kullam tzaddikim

Veal ken leolam yirshu aretz kedichtiv pitchu li shaare tzedek avo vam uchtiv ze hashshaar layeya tzaddikim yavou vo innun deitgezaru veikrun tzaddikim netzer mattaay nitzer meinnun netiin denata kudsha berich hu beginta deeden hay eretz chad minayehu veal ken it lehu leyisrael chulaka tava bealma deate uchtiv tzaddikim yirshu aretz leolam yirshu aretz mahu leolam kema deokimna bematnita dilan veha ittemar hay milla ben chavraya
Ella hachi okimna dead hashta la itgezar vechad itgezar itchabbar behay Adonai ushchinta sharya beh uchden ikre avraham
Vehayenu dichtiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram vetana be beraam vetana beavraham may kaamre ella da chesed veda shechinta vecholla nachit kechada vela kashya milla vehay vehay have

Amar rabbi yaakov lerabbi abba hay Adonai dehibbaram zeira ve dehallayeya ravreva ma ben hay lehay amar leh da shemita veda yovla uvgin kach zimnin desihara kayema beashlamuta vezimnin bifgimuta uvanpaha ishtechach veishtemoda vecholla shappir vehay ihu berira demilla

Amar rabbi abba zakkain innun yisrael dekudsha berich hu itrae behon mikkal shear amin veyahiv lon at keyama da dechal man deit beh hay at la nachit laggehinnom i ihu natir leh kedeka yaut dela ayil leh birshuta achora vela meshakker bishmeh demalka dechal man dimshakker behay keman dimshakker bishmeh dekudsha berich hu dichtiv bayeya bagadu ki banim zarim yaladu

Tu amar rabbi abba bezimna devar nash assik bereh leaoleh lehay berit kere kudsha berich hu lefammalya dileh veamar chamu may beriyya avadit bealma beh shaata izdamman eliyahu vetas alma bed tasin veizdamman tamman
Veal da taninan devae bar nash letakkana kurseya achora likara dileh veyema da kurseya deeliyyahu vei lav la share tamman vehu salik veashid kamme kudsha berich hu

Ta chaze bekadmita ketiv ma lecha fo eliyyahu vegv uchtiv kanno kineti layeya ki azvu beritcha bene yisrael vegv amar leh chayyecha bechal atar dehay reshima kaddisha yirshemun leh banay bivsarhon ante tizdamman tamman ufuma deashid deyisrael azvu hu yashid deyisrael mekayemin hay keyama veha taninan al ma itannash eliyyahu kamme kudsha berich hu al deamar diltora al benoy

Adhachi hava ate nehora deoma vehau amare mille deorayeta kamu lemezal amar leh hahu gavra bamme deaskitu behay lelya ashlimu amare may hu amar lehu detechomun limchar anpoy demareh dekayama deha devitay baat bauta da minnayechu ugzar keyama divre deityelid li lemachar leheve hillula dileh amar rabbi abba hay beuta demitzva ihu ulmechome appe shechinta netiv
185: Behahu lelya kanash hahu gavra kal innun rechimoy vechal hahu lelya ishtaddalu beorayeta vela hava man denaim amar lehu hahu gavra bematu minnayechu kal chad vechad lema milla chadta deorayeta

Patach chad veamar bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnadev am barchu Adonai may ka chamu devora uvarak defatchu behay kera ella hachi taninan let alma mitkayema ella al hay berit dichtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela vegv deha shemaya veara al da kayemin

Begin kach kal zimna deyisrael mekayemin hay berit nimmuse shemaya veara kayemin bekiyyumayehu vechal zimna dechas veshalom yisrael mevattelin hay berit shemaya veara la mitkayemin uvirchan la mishtakkechin bealma

Ta chaze la shallitu shear ammin al yisrael ella kadd betilu minnayehu keyama da uma betilu minayehu dela itparan vela itgalyan veal da ketiv vayyaazvu beni yisrael et Adonai vegv vayyimkor otam beyad sisra vayyaazvu et Adonai mammash ad deatat devora veitnaddevat lechal yisrael bemilla da keden itkenau sanehon techotayehu

Vehayenu detaninan deamar kudsha berich hu lihoshua vechi yisrael atimin innun vela itperau vela itgalya vela kayemin keyama dili veatte bae leaola lehu leara ulachnaa sanehon shuv mol et beni yisrael shenit vead deitperau veitgalleya hay berit la alu leara vela itkenau sanehon uf hacha kevan deitnaddevin yisrael behay at itkenau sanehon techotayehu uvirchan itchazaru lealma hada hu dichtiv bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barchu Adonai

Kam achora patach veamar vayehi vadderech bammalon vayyifgeshehu Adonai vayevakkesh hamito leman lemoshe amar leh kudsha berich hu vechi atte azil leappaka yat yisrael mimmitzrayim ulachnea malka rav veshallita veatte ansheyet minach keyama divrach la itgezar miyyad vayevakkesh hamito

Tana nachat gavriel beshalhova deesha leokdeh veitremiz chad chiveya mittokda leshafa leh begaveh ammay chiveya amar leh kudsha berich hu atte azil lekatla chiveya ravreva vetakkifa uvrach la itgezar miyyad itremiz lechad chiveya lekatla leh
Ad dechamat tzippora vegazrat livrah veishteziv hada hu dichtiv vattikkach tzippora tzor mahu tzor ella asvata umay asvata dichtiv vattichrot et arlat benah denitznetza bah ruach kudsha

Kam achora veamar vayyomer yosef el echav geshu na elay vayyiggashu vayyomer vegv vechi ammay kare lehu veha kerivin hau gabbeh ella beshaata deamar lon ani yosef achichem tevahu dechamu leh bemalchu illaa amar yosef malchu da begin da ravachna leh geshu na elay vayyiggashu deachaze lehu hay keyama demila amar da garmat li malchu da begin denatrit lah

Mikkan olifna man denatir lehay at keyama malchu itnatrat leh menalan mibboaz dichtiv chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker dehava mekatreg leh yitzreh ad deome omaa untir lehay berit begin chach zacha denafku minneh malchin shallitin al kal shear malchin umalka meshicha deitkere bishma dekudsha berich hu

Patach idach veamar ketiv im tachane alay machan vegv hachi tana bezot ani voteach mahu bezot da at keyama dizmina tadir gabbe bar nash veitremiza leela uvgine chach ittemar bezot kema dichtiv zot ot habberit zot beriti vecholla bechad darga vetana ze vezot bechad darga innun vela mitparshan
Vei tema i hachi ha shear bene alma hachi ammay david bilchodoy vela achora ella begin deachida beh veitremiza beh vehu chitra demalchuta
Ta chaze begin dehay zot la natar leh david malka kedeka chaze malchuta
186: Itadde minneh kal hahu zimna vehachi olifna hay zot itremiza bemalchuta dilela veitremiza biyerushala karta kaddisha

Behahu shaata dedavid avar aleh nafak kala veamar david bamme deitkatrat tishtere lach tardin miyerushala umalchuta itade minach mena lan dichtiv hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetcha mibbetcha dayeka vehachi hava bemma deavar beh itannash uma david malka hachi shear bene alma al achat kamma vechamma
Patach idach veamar lule Adonai ezrata li kimat shachna duma nafshi tana bamme zachan yisrael dela nachate laggehinnom kishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot vela itmasran bidoy deduma behay at

Dehachi tana beshaata debbar nash nafik mealma kamma chavile tehirin itpakdan aleh zekifin ena vechaman hay at dehu keyama dekudsha itparshan minneh vela ityehiv bidoy deduma lenachata laggehinnom dechal man deitmasar bidoy nachit laggehinnom vadday
Umehay at dachalin illain vetattain vedinin bishin la shaltin beh babbar nash i ihu zachi linture leh lehay at begin dehu itachid bishma dekudsha berich hu

Kevan dedavid malka la natar at keyama da kedeka chaze itadde minneh malchuta veitterid miyerushalam miyyad dachil desavar deyechatun leh miyyad veyimserun leh bidoy deduma veyamut behahu alma ad deitbassar beh dichtiv gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut beh shaata patach veamar lule Adonai ezrata li kimat shachna duma nafshi

Patach idach veamar may hay deamar david vehareni oto veet navihu man yachil lemechome leh lekudsha berich hu ella hachi taninan behahi shaata deitgezar aleh hahu onasha vedavid yada deal dela natar hay at kedeka yeut itannash behay decholla kechada achida vecholla mitremiz behay at vela ikre tzaddik man dela natar leh kedeka yeut hava bae beuteh veamar vehareni oto veet navihu

May oto da at keyama kaddisha deha dachilna deitavid minnay may tama begin ditren illen malchuta viyerushala behay achidan uvgin kach tale bevauteh oto veet navehu deyithaddar malchuta dehay at leatreh vecholla chad milla

Patach idach veamar umibbesari echoze eloha may umibbesari umeatzmi mibbae leh ella mibbesari mammash umay hi dichtiv uvsar kodesh yaavru mealayich uchtiv vehayeta beriti bivsarchem detanya bechal zimna deitreshim bar nash behay reshima kaddisha dehay at minneh chame lekudsha berich hu minneh mammash venishmeta kaddisha itachidat beh
Vei la zache dela natir hay at ma ketiv minnishmat eloha yovedu deha reshimu dekudsha berich hu la itnetir vei zache venatir leh shechinta la itperash minneh

Ematay mitkayema beh kad itnesiv vehay at ayil beatreh ishtattafu kachada veikre chad shema keden chesed illaa sharya alayehu bean atar sharya besitra didchura uman chesed chesed el deate venafak mechachma illaa veitattar bidchura uvgin kach itbasmat nukva
Tu taninan eloha hachi hu amar leh nehiru dechachmeta dechar Adonai nukva ishtattafu kechada eloha ikre venishmeta kaddisha mehay atar itachdat vecholla talya behay at

Veal da ketiv umibbesari echeze eloha da shelemuta decholla mibbesari mammash mehay at mammash veal da zakkain innun yisrael kaddishin deachidan beh bekudsha berich hu zakkain innun bealma den uvalma deate alayehu ketiv veattem haddevekim bayeya vegv uvgin kach chayyim kullechem hayyom
Amar rabbi abba uma bechal kach attun chakkimin veattun yatvin hacha amru leh i tzipporaa yitakru meatrayehu
187: La yadin lean tasan hada hu dichtiv ketzippor nodedet min kinnah ken ish noded mimkomo

Veatra da zache lan leorayeta vehay orcha dilan bechal lelya palguta anan nayemin ufalguta anan askin beorayeta vechad anan kayemin betzafra reche chakla venahare maya neharin lan orayeta veityashavta belibban

Ha dayenuha leela zimna chada vechamma sarche terisin istallaku behahu dina al onsha deorayeta uchden ishtaddeluta dilan yemama velelya beorayeta hu veatra da ka mesayea lan uman deitperash mikkan keman deitperash mechayye alma
Zakif yedoy rabbi abba uvarich lon yatvu ad denahar yemama batar denahar yemama amru leinnun dardeke dekamayehu puku vechamu i nahar yemama vechal chad lema milla chadta deorayeta lehay gavra rabba

Nafku vechamu denahar yemama amar chad minnayehu zammin hay yoma esha milleela amar achora uvhach beta amar achora chad sava hacha dezammin hay yoma leittokda benura da amar rabbi abba rachamana lishezvan
Tava vela yachil lemallala amar kutra dehurmana beara ittafsat vechach hava dehahu yoma chamu chavraya appe shechinta veistacharu beesha verabbi abba itlahitu anpoy kenura mechedvata deorayeta

Tana kal hahu yoma la nafku kulhu mibbeta uveta itkattar bekitra vehau chadtan mille begavayehu keillu kibbelu hahu yoma orayeta mittura desinay batar deistallaku la hau yade i hu yemama vei lelya amar rabbi abba beod deanan kayemin lema kal chad minan milla chadta dechachmeta leakshera tivu lemareh deveta mareh dehillula

Patach chad veamar ashre tivchar utkarev yishkon chatzerecha vegv bekadmita chatzerecha levatar betecha ulvatar hechalecha da penimaa min da veda leela min da yishkon chatzerecha bekadmita kema deatte amer vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyerushala kadosh yeamer lo

Nisbea betuv betecha levatar kema deatte amer bechachma yivne vayit hachachma yivne vayit la ketiv dei ketiv hachi hava mashma dechachma bayit ikre ella ketiv bechachma yivne vayit hayenu dichtiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan vegv
Kedosh hechalecha levatar da hu shelimu decholla dehachi taninan mahu hechal kelomar hay vehay vecholla ishtelim kechada

Resha dekera ma mochach dichtiv ashre tivchar utkarev yishkon chatzerecha hay man deakriv bereh karbana kamme kudsha berich hu raava dekudsha berich hu behahu karbana veitree beh vekariv leh veshave medoreh bitren idrin veachid lehay ulhay deinnun teren itkashsheru kechada dichtiv yishkon chatzerecha chatzerecha vadday tere

Begine chach chaside kadmae savan dehacha kad makrivin benayehu lekarbana da patche veamre ashre tivchar utkarev yishkon chatzerecha innun dekayeme alayehu amre nisbea betuv betecha kedosh hechalecha levatar mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehachniso bivrito shel avraham avinu veinnun dekayeme alayehu amre keshem shehichnasto labberit vechu
Vetaninan bekadmita libbae bar nash rachamin aleh ulvatar al achora dichtiv vechipper baado bekadmita ulvatar uvad kal kehal yisrael veanan orcha da naktinan vehachi shappir vechaze lekamman

Amar rabbi abba vadday kach hu veyaot milla uman dela amar hachi appik garmeh measara chuppot dezammin kudsha berich hu lemebad letzaddikayya bealma deate vechulhu mitkashran behay uvgine chach asara mile dimhemnuta it behay kera ashre tivchar utkarev vegv vechal milla umilla chad chuppa itavid minnah
Zakkaa chulakechon bealma da uvalma deate deha orayeta mitkashshera belibbayechu keillu kayemitu
188: Begufayechu betura desinay beshaata deityehivat orayeta leyisrael

Patach idach veamar mizbach adama taase li vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha vegv tana kal man dekariv bereh lekarbana da keillu akriv kal karbanin dealma lekammeh dekudsha berich hu uchilu bane madbecha shelemata kammeh
Begine chach bae lesaddera madbecha bemana chad malya ara lemigzar aleh hay keyama kaddisha veitchashshiv kamme kudsha berich hu keillu adbach aleh ilavan vekarbanin ana vetore
Venicha leh yattir mikkulhu dichtiv vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha vegv bechal hammakom asher azkir et shemi mahu azkir et shemi da mila dichtiv bah sod Adonai lireav uvrito lehodiam
Hay mizbach adama vadday kema deamina batreh ma ketiv veim mizbach avanim taase li remez legiyyora kad itgayyar deihu meam keshe kedal ukshe libba hay ikre mizbach avanim
Lo tivne ethen gazit ma hu devae leaala leh befulchana dekudsha berich hu vela yigzar yateh ad deyinshe pulchana achora deavad ad hacha veyaade minneh hahu kashu delibba

Vei itgezar vela aade minneh hahu kashya delibba lemeal befulchana kaddisha dekudsha berich hu hare hu kehay pesila deavna degazre leh mehay gisa umehay gisa veishtaar avna kidbekadmita vegin kach lo tivne ethen gazit dei ishtaar bekashuteh ki charbecha henafta aleha vattechallaleha kelomar hahu geziru deitgezar la mehanya leh

Begine chach zakkaa chulakeh deman deakriv hay karbana bechedvata beraava kamme kudsha berich hu uvae lemechode behay chulaka kal yoma dichtiv veyismechu chal chose vach leolam yerannenu vetasech alemo veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha

Patach idach veamar vayehi avram ben tishim shana vetesha shanim vayyera Adonai vegv ani el shadday hithallech lefanay vegv hay kera it leayena beh vekashya bechamma orchin vechi ad hashta la itgeli leh kudsha berich hu leavraham ella haidna kad mata lehanne yomin vayyera Adonai el avram vela kodem vehachtiv vayyomer Adonai el avram vayeya amar el avram vayyomer leavram yadoa teda vegv vehaidna mane chushban yomin vechad mani lehu ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram ishtema dead hashta la itgeli aloy veod dichtiv ben tishim shana vetesha shanim bekadmita shana ulvasof shanim

Ella hachi tana kal innun yomin la ketiv vayyera may tama ella kal kamma dehava atim vesatim kudsha berich hu la itgeli aleh kidkachaze haidna itgeli aleh dichtiv vayyera may tama mishshum devaa legalle beh hay at kitra kaddisha

Veod devaa kudsha berich hu leafaka minneh zara kaddisha vekaddisha la leheve beod deihu atim bisra ella amar hashta dehu ben tishim shana vetesha shanim uzman kariv hu deyinpok minneh zara kaddisha lehve hu kaddisha bekadmita ulvatar yinpok minneh zara kaddisha vegin kach mane yomoy behay vela bechal hanne zimni kadmita
Tu tishim shana dechal yomoy kadmae la hau shanim ella kechad shana dela hau yomoy yomin hashta demata lehay shanim innun vela shana
Vayyomer elav ani el shadday may mashma dead hashta la kaamar ani el shadday ella hachi tana avad kudsha berich hu kitrin tattain dela kaddishin letatta vechal innun dela itgezzaru yistaavun behon

Urshimin behon umay rishshuma it behon deitchaze behu vela yattir uvgin kach istaavun behu veitdabbekun behu batar deitgezaru nafkin meillen vealin begadfoy dishchinta veitgalleya behu reshima kaddisha at keyama shelim
189: Veitreshim behu veishtelim bekiyyuma shelim veal da ketiv behay ani el shadday

Hithallecha lefanay vehye tamim shelim dehashta at chaser birshima deshn vedlt gezar garmach veheve shelim birshima deud uman deihu berishshuma da itchaze leitbarcha bishma da dichtiv veel shadday yevarech otcha

Mahu el shadday hahu devirchan nafkan minneh hu deshallit al kitrin tattain vecholla middachalteh dachalin umizdazein vegin kach man deitgezar kal innun dela kaddishin itrachakan minneh vela shaltin beh vela od ella dela nachit laggehinnom dichtiv veammech kullam tzaddikim vegv

Amar rabbi abba zakkain attun bealma den uvalma deate zakkaa chulaki deatena lemishma millin illen mippumechon kulchu kaddishin kulchu bene elaha kaddisha alayechu ketiv ze yomar layeya ani veze yikra beshem yaakov veze yichtov yado layeya uvshem yisrael yechanne kal chad minnechon achid veitkashshar bemalka kaddisha illaa veattun ravrevan memannan teresin mehahi eretz deikre eretz hachayyim deravrevanohi achlin mimmanna detalla kaddisha

Patach idach veamar ashrecha eretz shemmalkech ben chorin vesarayich baet yochelu uchtiv i lach eretz shemmalkech naar vesarayich babboker yochelu hanne kerae kashyan ahadade vela kashyan hay dichtiv ashrech eretz da eretz dilela deshalta al kal innun chayyin dilela uvgin kach ikre eretz hachayyim vealah ketiv eretz asher Adonai elohecha doresh otah tamid uchtiv eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem lo techsar kol bah lo techsar kol bah dayeka vechal kach lamma mishshum dichtiv shemmalkech ben chorin da kudsha berich hu kema deatte amer beni bechori yisrael

Ben chorin mahu ben chorin kema deatte amer yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem uchtiv ukratem deror baaretz deha kal cheru miyyovla ka ate vegin kach ben chorin vei tema ben chorin vela ketiv ben cherut hachi hu vadday ben cherut mibbae leh

Ella bematnita setimaa dilan tanina kad mitchabberan yud be keden ketiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan vela tema kad mitchabberan ella mitchabberan vadday uvgin kach ben chorin ketiv veal da ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorin vesarayich baet yochelu bechedvata bishlimu beraava

I lach eretz shemmalkach naar hay eretz diltatta detanya kal shear are dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot ityehivu leravrevin teresin dimmannan alayehu veela mikkulhu hahu dichtiv beh naar hayiti gam zakanti vetana hay kera saro shel olam amaro veal da ketiv i lach eretz shemmalkech naar vay lealma demissitra da yanka vechad yisrael begaluta yankin keman deyannik mershuta achora

Vesarayicha babboker yochelu vela bechule yoma babboker vela bezimna achora deoma detanya beshaata dechamma zorachat veatyan vesagdin leh leshimsha rugza tale bealma beshaata demincha rugza talya bealma man garim hay mishshum demalkech naar hahu deikre naar
Veattun zakkae keshot kaddishe elonin bene malka kaddisha la yankin mehay sitra ella mehahu atar kaddisha dilela alayechu ketiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom

Patach rabbi abba veamar ashira na lididi shirat dodi lecharmo vegv vayeazzekehu vayesakkelehu vegv hanni kerae it leistakkela behu ammay ketiv shira tochacha mibbae leh lididi ledodi mibbae leh kema dichtiv shirat dodi kerm haya lididi bekeren ben shamen istakkalna bechal orayeta vela ashkachna atra deikre
190: Ella hanni kerae ha ukmuha chavraya bechamma gevanin vechulhu shappir vehachi hu aval ashira na lididi da yitzchak dehava yedid veikre yedid ad la yippuk lealma
Ammay yedid detaninan rechimu sagge hava leh lekudsha berich hu beh dela itavid ad dela itgezar avraham avuha veikre shelim veittosaf leh leashlamuta vechen lesara hay ityehivat lah

Hacha it leistakkala Adonai lesara shappir aval leavraham ammay vela mibbae leh deha hu dechar hava ella raza illaa hava satim begavan avraham salik leela venatil raza meh illaa deihu alma didchura illaa veh tattaa hay talya bidchura vehay benukva vadday uvgin chach avraham salik veh deela vesara nachata veh deletatta

Tu dichtiv ko yihye zarecha vetana zarecha zarecha mammash dehava share lemeal behay keyam uman deshare lemeal behay keyam al uvgine chach giyyora deitgezar ger tzedek ikre begin dela ata miggiza kaddisha deitgezaru veal da man deal behay shemeh kehay

Avraham vegin kach ketiv beh ko yihye zarecha zarecha mammash veitmasar leh vei lav diitmasar lesara hava leh leavraham leolid letatta kema dehay olidat letatta batar deitmasrat lesara itchabbaru teren kechada veolidu leela umay denafak minnayehu hu begini chach at resha deyitzchak dechar mikkan share dechura leitpashsheta veal da ketiv ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara beyitzchak vela becha yitzchak olid leela dichtiv titten emet leyaakov yaakov ashlim kolla

Vei tema vechi avraham behay itachid vela yattir veha ketiv chesed leavraham ella chulaka dileh kach hu begin deavid chesed im bene alma aval leolada hacha achid umehacha share veal da la itgezar avraham ella ben tishim vetesha shana veraza demilla ha ityeda veokimna bematnita dilan

Uvgin kach yitzchak dina kashya nafak leachada lechulakeh ulolada vechesed ikre veal da yaakov ashlim kolla mehay sitra umehay sitra missitra deachidu avraham veyitzchak lechulakehon leela hu shelemuta missitra deityehiv lehu leolada mittatta leela hu shelemuta veal da ketiv yisrael asher becha etpaar beh itachidu gevanin meela umittatta
Veal da ketiv hacha shira dichtiv ashira na lididi shira vadday deha ikre leolada dechar deha ikre yedid ad la yippuk lealma
Veit deamre ashira na lididi da avraham kema deatte amer ma lididi beveti veavraham yarit yeruta deachsanat chulaka da aval ma deamina deda yitzchak hachi hu
Shirat dodi lecharmo da kudsha berich hu deikre dodi dichtiv dodi tzach veadom yedidi achid bedodi dechar uminneh itneta kerem dichtiv kerm haya lididi

Bekeren ben shamen may bekeren ben shamen ella bemma nafik hay kerm uvma itneta chazar veamar bekeren may keren dichtiv bekeren hayyovel bekeren hayyovel share vehay keren itachid behahu dechar deikre ben shamen

Mahu ben shamen kema deatte amer ben chorin vetarvayehu chad milla shemen demittamman negid mishcha urvu leadlaka botzinin uvgin kach ben shamen veda shemen urvu negid unfik veadlik botzinin ad denatil leh vechanish leh hay keren veda ikre keren hayyovel begine chach let meshichuta demalchuta ella bekeren veal da itmeshach malchuta dedavid deitmeshach bekeren veitachid beh
Vayeazkehu kehay izka deistachar lechal sitrin
191: Vayesaklehu deaade minneh umechulakeh kal innun ravrevin kal innun teresin kal innun kitrin tattain vehu nasiv leh lehay kerm lechulakeh dichtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato

Vayyittaehu sorek kema deatte amer veanochi netatich sorek kollo zera emet ketiv beh mikkan share avraham leolada leela umehay nafak zera emet kollo zera emet vadday hayenu dichtiv ko yihye zarecha vecholla chad milla zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael deyartoy ruta kaddisha da
Sofeh dikra vayyiven migdal betocho mahu migdal kema deatte amer migdal oz shem Adonai venisgav bo yarutz tzaddik vadday
Vegam yekev chatzev bo da tara detzedek kema deatte amer pitchu li shaare tzedek may mashma dechal bar yisrael deitgezar ayyil betarvayehu vezache letarvayehu

Uman dekariv bereh lekarbana da ayyil leh bishma kaddisha veal at da mitkayemin shemaya veara dichtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti vehay mareh dehillula da zacha lecholla lemechoze kudsha berich hu anpin beanpin behay yoma

Zakkaa chulakana dezachina lehay yoma vezakkaa chulakach immana vehay bera deityelid lach karena aleh kal hannikra bishmi vegv yetzartiv af asitiv uchtiv vechal banayich limmude Adonai vegv ozfuha lerabbi abba telat milin

Amru leh hay mareh dehillula ushpizach zacha lechule hay begin dekiyyem kiyyuma demitzva amar may hi amar hahu gavra devitay ittat achi havat umit bela benin venasivna lah veda hu bera kadmaa dehava li minnah vekarena leh bishma deachi deitpattar amar leh mikkan ulhala kere leh idi vehayenu idi bar yaakov barich lon rabbi abba veazil learcheh

Kad ata sidder millin kammeh derabbi elazar vedachil lememar lerabbi shimon yoma chad hava kammeh derabbi shimon veamar rabbi shimon may dichtiv vayyippol avram al panav vayedabber itto elohim lemor ani hinne veriti ittach mashma dead dela itgezar hava nefil al anpoy umallil immeh batar deitgezar kaim bekiyyumeh vela dachil ani hinne veriti ittach deashkach garmeh gazir

Amar leh rabbi abba i nicha kammeh demar delema kammeh meinnun mille maalayeta deshemana vehay amar leh ema amar leh dachilna dela yitanshu al yeday amar leh chas veshalom mishmua raa la yira nachon libbo batuach bayeya sach leh ovada vesidder kameh kal innun millin

Amar leh vechi kal hanne mille maalyata hau temirin gabbach vela amarte lehu gozarna alach dechal telatin yomin illen tile vetinshe vela ketiv al timna tov mibbealav bihot leel yadcha laasot vechach hava amar gozarna divorayeta da yiglun levavel bene chavraya

Chalash dateh derabbi abba yoma chad chama leh rabbi shimon amar leh tufsera delibbach beanpach shechiach amar leh la al didi hu ella al didhu amar leh chas veshalom deitannashu ella begin demillin itgalleyan benayehu kal kach yiglun bene chavraye yillefun innun archin veitkasyan millin begavayehu deha millin la itgalyan ella benana deha kudsha berich hu istechim immana veal yedana itgalleyan millin

Amar rabbi yose ketiv az yibbaka kashshachar orecha vegv zammin kudsha berich hu leachreza al benoy veyema az yibbaka kashshachar orecha vaaruchatcha mehera titzmach vehalach lefancha tzidkecha uchvod Adonai yaasfecha
192: Rabbi chiyya patach hannitztzanim niru vaaretz et hazzamir higgia vkol hattor nishma beartzenu hannitztzanim niru vaaretz kad bera kudsha berich hu alma yahav beara kal chela deitchazi lah vecholla hava veara vela afikat ibin bealma ad deitbere adam kevan deitbere adam kolla itchaze bealma veara galliat ibaha vechelaha deitpakdu va

Kegavena da shamayim la yahavu chelin leara ad deata adam hada hu dichtiv vechol siach hassade terem yihye vaaretz vechal esev hassade term yitzmach ki lo himtir Adonai elohim al haaretz veadam ayin laavod et haadama ittammaru kal innun toladin vela itgallun ushmaya itakkavu dela amtiru al ara begin deadam ayin dela ishtechach vela itbere vecholla itakkav begineh kevan deitchaze adam miyyad hannitztzanim niru vaaretz vechal chayalin deittammaru itgalliu veityehivu vah
Et hazzamir higgia deittakkan tikkuna detushbechan lezammera kamme kudsha berich hu ma dela ishtechach ad la itbere adam vekol hattor nishma beartzenu deha milla dekudsha berich hu dela

Midrash hanneelam rabbanan patche behay kera lereach shemanecha tovim shemen turak shemecha tanu rabbanan hay nishmata devar enash beshaata desalka meara lirkia vekayema behahu zihara illaa deamaran kudsha berich hu mevakker lah

Ta shema amar rabbi shimon ben yochay kal nishmata detztzaddikayya kevan dekayema beatar shechinta yekara dechazya lemetav kudsha berich hu kare laavahata veamar lon zilu uvakkeru liflanya tzaddika deata veakdimu leh shelama min shemi veinnun amrin mare alma la itchaze leabba lemezal lemecheme livra bera itchaze lemecheme ulmecheze ulmitba leavuy

Vhu kare leyaakov veamar leh ante dehava lach tzaara divnin zil vekabbil peni diflanya tzaddika deata hacha vana ezil immach hada hu dichtiv mevakkeshe fancha yaakov sella mevakkesh lo neemar ella mevakkeshe amar rabbi chiyya meresheh dikra mashma dichtiv ze dor dorshav vegv

Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi chiyya yaakov avinu hu kisse hakkavod vechen tana deve eliyyahu yaakov avinu hu kisse bifne atztzemo dichtiv vezacharti et beriti yaakov berit karat kudsha berich hu leyaakov levaddo yoter mikkal avotav
193: Ishtechach bealma ad deitbere adam kevan deishtechach adam kolla ishtechach
Batar dechata kolla istallak mealma veitlatya ara hada hu dichtiv arura haadama baavurecha vegv uchtiv ki taavod et haadama lo tosef tet kochah lach vegv uchtiv vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach

Ata noach vetikken kardumin uftzire bealma ulvatar vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch aholo atu bene alma vechavu kammeh dekudsha berich hu veistallaku chelin deara kemillekaddemin vehau kayeme ad deata avraham

Kevan deata avraham miyyad hannitztzanim niru vaartz ittakkanu veitgalu kal chelin beara et hazzamir higgia beshaata deamar leh kudsha berich hu deyitgezar kevan demata hahu zimna divrit ishtechach beh beavraham veitgezar keden itkeyyam beh kal hay kera veitkeyyam alma umilla dekudsha berich hu hava beitgalleya beh hada hu dichtiv vayyera elav Adonai

Rabbi elazar patach hay kera batar deitgezar avraham dead la itgezar la hava mallil immeh ella miggo darga tattaa vedargin illain la hau kayeme al hahi darga kevan deitgezar miyyad hannitzanim niru vaaretz illen dargin tattain deafikat veatkinat hay darga tattaa
Et hazzamir higgia illen anpoy dearla vekol hattor nishma veartzenu da kol denafik miggo
Deavid leh kisse hakkavod bar min kadmaa

Rabbi eliezer hava yativ vehava lae beorayeta ata legabbeh rabbi akiva amar leh bemay ka asik mar amar leh behay kera dichtiv vchisse chavod yanchilem mahu kisse chavod yanchilem ze yaakov avinu deavid leh karse yekar bilchodoy lekabbala ulfan nishmata detztzaddikaya
Vekudsha berich hu azil immeh bechal resh yarcha veyarcha vchad chame nishmata yekar aspaklarya shechinta demareh mevarchat vesagdat kamme kudsha berich hu hada hu dichtiv barchi nafshi vegv

Amar rabbi akiva kudsha berich hu kaim alohi venishmata patach veamar Adonai elohe gadalta meod vegv kal happarasha ad siyyuma dekaamar yittammu chataim vegv veod amar rabbi akiva vela da bilchodoy ella meshabbachat leh al gufa deishtaar bealma den veamar barchi nafshi et Adonai vechal keravay vegv

Vekudsha berich hu azil mena lan hay mehay kera dichtiv vayyira elav Adonai beelone mamri ze yaakov mahu mamri mishshum deachsin matan almin meeden vhu kisse amar rabbi yitztzechak mamre begimatriyya matan utmanin vechad hava matan deeden dichtiv umatayim lannotrim et piro utmannin vechad dehu kisse uvgin kach itkere vayyera elav Adonai beelone mamre veal shum da nikra mamre
Amar rabbi yehuda mahu beelone retztzono lomar tukpoy hada hu dichtiv avir yaakov vehu yoshev petach haohel hada hu dichtiv Adonai mi yagur beaholecha vegv
Adonai Adonai Adonai mehemna dela lo
194: Hahu penimaa decholla vehahu kol nishma veda kol degazar milla lemallala veavid lah shelimu

Ta chaze dead la itgezar avraham la hava aleh ella hay darga kidamaran kevan deitgezar ma ketiv vayyera elav Adonai leman deha la ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram dei leavram may shevacha hacha yattir mibbekadmita ad la itgezar dichtiv vayyera Adonai el avram
Ela raza setima ihu vayyera elav Adonai lehahu darga demallil immeh ma dela hava mikkadmat dena ad dela itgezar dehashta itgeli kol veitchabbar bedibbur kad mallil immeh

Vehu yoshev petach haohel vehu velo gale man ella hacha gale chachmeta dechulhu dargin sharu al hay darga tattaa batar deitgezar avraham ta chaze vayyera elav Adonai da hu raza dekol deishtema deitchabbar bedibbur veitgeli beh

Vehu yoshev petach haohel da alma illaa dekaim leanhara aleh kechom hayyom deha itnehir yemina darga deavraham itdabbak beh davar acher kechom hayyom beshaata deitkeriv darga ledarga betiuvta deda lakovel da
Kechom hayyom dichtiv vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha
Amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay behahi shaata azil kudsha berich hu uvgin deshamin avahata avraham veyitztzechak dekudsha berich hu azil legabbeh tavin min yaakov lemezal immehon ulakdama leh shelam

Vinnun kayemin alohi mimmay dichtiv vayyissa enav vyar vehinne shelosha anashim nitztzavim alav shelosha anashim illen avahata avraham yitztzechak veyaakov dekayemin alohi vechamu ovadin tavin deavdin vayyar vyaratz likratam mippetach haohel vayyishtachu artza mishshum dechame shechinat yekara imhon hada hu dichtiv al ken alamot ahevucha

Davar acher vayyira elav Adonai beelone mamre rabbanan patche behay kera bishat petirato shel adam detanya amar rabbi yehuda bishat petirato shel adam hu yom haddin haggadol shehanneshama mitparedet min hagguf velo niftar adam min haolam ad sheroe et hashshechina hada hu dichtiv ki lo yiranni haadam vachay uvain im hashshechina shelosha malache hashsharet lekabbel nishmato shel tzaddik hada hu dichtiv vayyera elav Adonai kechom hayyom ze yom haddin habboer kattannur lehafrid hanneshama min hagguf

Vayyissa enav vayyar vhinne shelosha anashim hamvakkerim maasav ma sheasa vehu mode alehem befiv vechevan shehanneshama roa kach yotztzet min hagguf ad petach bet habbelia veomedet sham ad shemmitda kal ma sheasa hagguf immah baolam hazze vaz nishmat hatztzaddik hi semecha bemaaseha usmecha al pikdonah detana amar rabbi yitztzechak nishmato shel tzaddik mitava ematay tetztze min haolam hazze shehu hevel kede lehitanneg baolam habba

Tanu rabbanan keshechala rabbi eliezer haggadol hahu yoma erev shabbat hava veotiv limineh horkenus bereh vhava megalle leh amikta umastarta vehu la hava mekabbel bedateh millayya dechashiv kimtoraf bedateh hava kevan dechama dedata deavoy mityashsheva aloy kabbil minneh mea utmannin vetisha razin illain

Kad mata leavne shayish demitarve bemaya illaa bacha rabbi eliezer ufasak lememar amar kum hatam beri amar leh abba lama amar leh chazina deochit chalaf min alma amar leh zil veema leimmach detistallak tefillai beatar illaa uvatar deestallek min alma veayete hacha lemecheme lehon la tivke deinnun kerivin illain vela tattain vedata devar nash la yada
195: Vayyera elav amar rabbi abba ad la itgezar avraham hava atim kevan deitgezar itgeli cholla veshara aleh shechinta bishlimu kedeka yeut ta chaze vehu yoshev petach haohel vehu da alma illaa deshare al hay alma tattaa ematay kechom hayyom bezimna detiuvta dechad tzaddik lemishre beh
Miyyad vayyissa enav vayyar vehinne shelosha anashim nitztzavim alav man innun shelosha anashim illen avraham yitzchak veyaakov dekayeme aleh dehay darga uminnayehu

Ad dehau yatve alu chakkime dara lemivkar leh olit lehu al dela atu leshammasha leh detaninan gedola shimmushah yoter millimmudah ad deata rabbi akiva amar leh akiva akiva lama la atet leshammasha li amar leh rabbi la hava li penay artach amar etmeha alach i tamut mitat atztzemecha latye dihe kashe mikkulhon mitateh

Bache rabbi akiva veamar leh rabbi olif li orayeta aftach pumeh rabbi eliezer bemaase merkava ata esha vaschar letarviyhon amru chakkimaya shema minah delet anan chazyan uchdain lechach nafku lefitcha devara veyativu tamman hava ma dehava veazal esha

Veolif bevaheret azza telat mea halachot pesukot veolif leh teamim difsuke deshir hashshirim vhau enoy derabbi akiva nachatin maya veitchazzar esha kekadmita kad mata lehay pesuka samchuni baashishot rappeduni battappuchim ki cholat ahava ani la yachil lemisbal rabbi akiva vearim kaleh bivchiyyata vegae vela hava memallel midchilu dishchinta dehavat tamman

Ore leh kal amikta verazin illain dehava beh beshir hashshirim veome leh omaa dela lishtammesh beshum chad pasuk minneh ki hechi dela licharev alma kudsha berich hu begineh vla bae kammeh deyishtammeshun beh
196: Keden vayyar vayyaratz likratam detiuvta dehay darga tattaa leitchabbera behu vechedvata dilah leitmashshecha abbatrayehu vayishtachu artza leittakkena kurseya legabbayehu

Ta chaze avad kudsha berich hu ledavid malka chad samcha mikkurseya illaa kaavahan veaf al gav deihu kurseya legabbayehu aval bezimna deitchabbar behu ihu chad samcha leittakkena bekkurseya illaa uvgin kach natal malchuta bechevron david malka sheva shenin leitchabbera behu veha ittemar

Tosefta vyera elav Adonai beelone mamre ammay beelone mamre vela beattar achora ella begin deyahiv leh eta al geziru dikyama dileh beshaatta deamar kudsha bericha hu leavraham lemigzar azal avraham limmalecha im chavroy amar leh aner ante ben tishin shenin vatte meik garmacha

Amar leh mamre decharte yoma deramu lacha kasdae beattun denura vhahu kappena deavar al alma dichtiv vyehi raav baaretz vayyered avram mitztzerayema vinnun malchin dirdappu batterehon umachit yattehon vkudsha bericha hu shezvinacha mikkolla vela yachil bar nash lemebad lacha bish kum avid pikkuda demaracha amar leh kudsha bericha hu mamre ante yehavte leh eta lemigzar chayyecha let ana mitteggalle aleh ella beppalterin dilacha hada hu dichtiv beelone mamre

Beriyate misgiut kedushata deit beh levatar nafik rabbi akiva vegae venavin enoy maya vehava amar vay rabbi vay rabbi deishtaar alma yatom minnach alu kal shear chakkimaya gabbeh veshaalu leh veativ lehon

Hava dachik leh lerabbi eliezr appik tere derooy vshavinun al libbeh patach veamar i alma alma illaa chazrat leaola ulignaza min tattaa kal nehiru uvutztzina vay lechon tere derae vay lechon tere torot deyishtakkechun yoma den min alma deamar rabbi yitztzechak kal yomoy derabbi eliezer hava nehira shemata mippumeh keoma deityehivat betura desinay

Amar orayeta gemarit vechachmeta sevarit veshimmusha avadit deillu yehon kal bene enasha dealma sofrim la yachlin lemichtav vela chasre talmiday mechachmati ella kechochla beena vana merabbotay ella keman deshate beyamma vela hava ella lemitan tivuta lerabbohi yattir minneh

Vhau shaalin minneh behahu sandela deyibbum ad denafak nishmateh veamar tahor vela hava tamman rabbi akiva kad nafak shabbatta ashkecheh rabbi akiva demit baza maneh vgarir kal bisreh vedama nachit venagid al diukneh hava tzach uvche nafak levara veamar shemaya shemaya amru ulsihara leshimsha dinhiruta dehavat nehir yattir minhon ha itchashshach

Rabbi abba patach veamar mi yaale vehar Adonai umi yakum bimkom kadsho ta chaze kal bene alma la chaman al ma kayeme bealma veomin azlin vesalkin vekayeme kamme kudsha berich hu kal innun yomin divne nasha kayeme behu behay alma deha kulhu itberiu vechulhu kayeme leela umnalan deitberiu dichtiv yamim yutzaru
Vechad matan yomin leistallaka mehay alma kulhu kerevin kamme malka illaa hada hu dichtiv vayyikrevu yeme david lamut vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut

Begin dechad bar nash ihu behay alma la ashgach vela istakkal al ma kaim ella kal yoma veoma chashiv keillu hu azil berekanya deha kad nishmata nafkat mehay alma la yadat lean archa salkin lah deha orcha lesalka leela leatar dinhiru denishmatin illain naharin la
197: Amar rabbi yehuda beshaa shennishmat hatztzaddik rotztza latztzet semecha vehatztzaddik batuach bemitato kede lekabbel secharo hada hu dichtiv vayyar vayyaratz likratam besimcha lekabbel penehem mee ze makom mippetach haohel kedeka amaran vayyishtachu artza legabbe shechina

Rabbi yochanan patach veamar ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim sov deme lecha dodi litztzevi o leofer haayyalim ad sheyyafuach hayyom vegv zo azhara laadam beodo baolam hazze shehu keheref ayin ta chaze ma ketiv veillu chaya elef shanim paamayim beom hammita kal ma shehaya necheshav keom echad etztzelo

Amar rabbi shimon nishmato shel adam matra bo veomeret ad sheyyafuach hayyom veyidme beenecha keheref ayin beodcha baolam hazze venasu hatztzelalim hada hu dichtiv ki tzel yamenu ale aretz bevakkasha mimmecha sov deme lecha dodi litztzevi vegv

Davar acher ad sheyyafuach hayyom vegv amar rabbi shimon ben pazi zo azhara laaddam beodo baolam hazze shehu keheref ayin ma hatztzevi kal beraglav af atta heyi kal katztzevi o keofer haayyalim laasot retztzon boracha kede shettinchal haolam habba shehu hare besamim hannikra har Adonai har hattaanug hahar hatov
Ityehiv lechulhon nishmatin deha kegavena deihu amshich aleh behay alma hachi itmashchat levatar denafik minneh

Ta chaze i bar nash itmeshich batar kudsha berich hu vetiuvta dileh avatrih behay alma levatar kad nafik minneh ihu itmeshich avatrih veyahavin leh orach leistallaka leela batar hahu meshichu deitmeshich biruta kal yoma behay alma
Amar rabbi ava yoma chad iarana bechad mata meinnun dehau min bene kedem veamru li mehahi chachmeta dehau yadin miyyome kadmae vehau ashkechan sifrin dechachmeta dilhon ukrivu li chad sifra

Vehava ketiv beh deha kegavena diruta debbar nash ichaven beh behay alma hachi amshich aleh ruach milleela kegavena dehahu reuta deitdabbak beh i reuteh ichavin bemilla illaa kaddisha ihu amshich aleh lehahi mila milleela letatta legabbeh

Vei reuteh leitdabbeka besitra achora veichaven beh ihu amshich lehahi milla milleela letatta legabbeh vehau amri deikkara demilleta talya bemillin uvovada uviruta leitdabbeka uvda itmeshach milleela letatta hahu sitra deitdabbak bah
Veashkachna beh kal innun ovadin ufulchanin dechochvaya umazzale umillin deitzterichu lon veheach reuta leitkavvena behu begin
198: Kegavena da man devae leitdabbeka leela beruach kudsha deha beovada uvmillin uviruta delibba lechavvena behahi milla talya milleta leamshacha leh legabbeh meela letatta ulitdabbeka behahi milla

Vehau amre kamma devar nash itmeshach behay alma hachi name mashchin leh kad nafik mehay alma uvma deitdabbak behay alma veitmeshach avatreh hachi itdabbak behahu alma i bekudsha bekudsha vei bimsaava bimsaava

I bekudsha mashchin leh legabbe hahu setar veitdabbak beh leela veitavid memanna shammasha leshammasha kame kudsha berich hu ben innun shear malachin kema dehachi itdabbak leela vekaim ben innun kaddishin dichtiv venatatti lecha mahlechim ben haomdim haele

Hachi name kegavena da i bimsaova mashchin leh legabbe hahu setar veitavid kechad minnayehu leitdabbeka behu veinnun ikrun nizke bene nesha uvhahi shaata denafik mehay alma natlin leh veshaavin leh baggehinnam behahu atar dedayene lon livne mesaova desaivu garmayehu veruchayehu ulvatar itdabbak behu veihu nizka kechad meinnun nizke dealma
Amina lon banay keriva da lemillin deorayeta aval it lechu itrachaka meinnun sifrin begin dela

Vei inyana liftirat inish mealma hi nistor kal parshata o nokim parshata behay o behay mahu yukach na meat mayim verachatztzu raglechem vegv veekcha fat lechem vegv vayemaher avraham haohela el sara vegv veel habbakar ratz avraham vegv vayyikkach chema vechalav vegv

Kad ata rav dimi amar lo matztzea hanneshama toelet lagguf illemale ma sheramaz bechan remez hakkarbanot batlu hakkarbanot lo batla hattora hay dela iasak bakkarbanot liasak battora veyithanne leh yattir

Deamar rabbi yochanan keshepperash hakkadosh baruch hu hakkarbanot amar moshe ribbono shel olam tinach bizman sheyyihu yisrael al admatam kevan sheyyiglu meal admatam ma yaasu amar lo moshe yaasku battora vani mochel lahem bishvilah yoter mikkal hakkarbanot shebbaolam shenneemar zot hattora laola lammincha kelomar zot hattora bishvil ola bishvil mincha bishvil chatat bishvil asham

Amar rabbi keruspeday hay man demadkar befumeh bevatte chenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot dekarbanaya inyana vetikruvta vichavin behu berit keruta hu deinnun malachaya demadkerin choveh leavasha leh dela yachlin lemebad leh illemale tivu
Uman yochach hay parshata yochach dechevan deamar vhinne shelosha anashim nitztzavim alav mahu alav leayyen bedineh kevan
199: Yiste libbayechu leillen pulchanin ulchal innun sitrin dekaamar hacha dilma chas veshalom tistun mibbatar pulchana dekudsha berich hu

Deha kal sefarim illen atayyan lon livne nasha begin divne kedem chakkimin hau viruta dechachmeta da yartu meavraham deyahav livne pillaggeshim dichtiv velivne happillaggeshim asher leavraham natan avraham mattanot vayeshallechem meal yitzchak beno beodenu chay kedma el eretz kedem ulvatar itmashchu behahi chachma lechamma sitrin

Aval zara deyitzchak chulaka deyaakov lav hachi dichtiv vayyitten avraham et kal asher lo leyitzchak da chulaka kaddisha dimhemnuta deitdabbak beh avraham venafak mehahu adva umehahu sitra yaakov ma ketiv beh vehine Adonai nitztzav alav uchtiv veatta yaakov avdi vegv begine chach bae leh lebbar nash leitmashcha batar kudsha berich hu ulitdabbeka beh tadir dichtiv uvo tidbak

Ta chaze mi yaale behar Adonai vegv ulvatar ahadar uferash neki chappayim dela avid bidoy tufsa vela ittakkaf behu bemma dela itzterich vetu dela istaav behu vela saiv behu legufa keinnun dimsaavin garmayehu beyadin leistaava veda hu neki chappayim uvar levav kegavena da dela amshich reuteh velibbeh lesitra achora ella leitmashshecha batar pulchana dekudsha berich hu
Asher la nasa lashave nafsho nafsho ketiv nafshi keri veha ukmuha

Dechama nishmata detztzaddikaya kach ma ketiv vayemaher avraham haohela mahu haohela bet hammidrash umahu omer mahari shelosh seim inyan hakkarbanot venishmata mitkavvent behu hada hu dichtiv veel habbakar ratz avraham uchden nayecha lehu vla yachlin leavasha leh

Rabbi pinchas patach kera dichtiv vehinne hechel hannegef baam uchtiv vayyomer moshe el aharon kach et hammachta vegv uchtiv vatteatztzar hammaggefa ketiv hacha maher uchtiv hatam mahari shelosh seim ma lehallan karban leishtezava af kan karban leishtezava

Amar rabbi pinchas zimna chada havina azle vearcha vaarait beh beeliyyahu amina leh lema li mar milla demaale livriyyata amar leh keym gazar kudsha berich hu vealu kammeh kal illen malachaya dimmannan leadkara chove debbar nash di beidna deyidkerun beni enasha karbanaya demanne moshe vshavi libbeh uruteh behu dechulhu yidkerun leh letav

Veod beiddana diara motana bivne enasha keyama itgezar vcharoza aavar al kal chela dishmaya dei yialun benohi beara bevatte chenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot veyemrun birut nafsha velibba inyana diktoret busmin dehau lehu leyisrael deyitbatal motana minnayehu

Amar rabbi yitztzechak bo ure ma ketiv vayyomer moshe el aharon kach et hammachta vten aleha esh meal hammizbeach vesim ketoret amar leh aharon lamma amar ki yatztza hakketztzef millifne Adonai ma ketiv vayyaratz el
200: Nafshi da nefesh david sitra dimhemnuta nafsho da nefesh devar nash mammash begin dechad yippuk mehay alma venafsheh yistallak beovadin dechashrin al ma deyitkayyam behu lemehach ben kal innun kaddishin kema deatte amer ethallech lifne Adonai beartzot hachayyim uvgin dela nasa lashshave nafshi yissa veracha meet Adonai vegv

Ta chaze batar deitgezar avraham hava yativ vechaiv vekudsha berich hu shadar legabbeh telat malachin beitgalleya leakdama leh shelam vei tema deha beitgalleya vechi man yachil lemecheme malachin veha ketiv ose malachav ruchot vegv

Ella vday chama lon denachate leara kegavena divne nasha vela yikshe lach hay deha vadday innun ruchin kaddishin uvshaata denachate lealma mitlabbeshin baavire uvisode degulmin veitchazu livne nasha mammash kechezu diukna dilhon
Vetta chaze avraham chama lon kechezu bene nasha veaf al gav dehava kaiv mimmila nafak verahat abbatrayehu begin dela lemigra dehava avid mikkadmat dena
Amar rabbi shimon vadday kechezu demalachin chama lon mimma dichtiv vayyomar adonay belf shechinta hava atya veillen hau semichin dilah vekkurseya legabbah begin deinnun gevanin telat ditchota
Vechama hashta begin deitgezar ma dela hava chame mikkadmat dena ad la
Toch hakkahal vehinne hechel hannegef baam uchtiv vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim vatteatztzar hammaggefa vla yachil malacha dimchabbela leshalletaa venitbatla motana

Rabbi acha azal lichfar tarsha ata legabbe ushpizeh lechishu alayehu kal bene mata amru gavra rabba ata hacha nezzil legabbeh atu legabbeh amru leh la chas al ovadana amar lehu mahu amru leh deit shiva yomin deshare motana bemata vchal yoma ittakkaf vla itbatal

Amar lehu nezzil leve chenishta venitba rachame min kodam kudsha berich hu ad dehau azle atu veamru peloni ufloni mitu ufloni ufloni natu lamut amar lehu rabbi acha let itta lekayema hachi deshaata dechika

Aval afrishu minchon arbein bene nasha meinnun dezakkain yatir asara asara learbea chulakin vana immechon asara leziveyata demata vaasara leziveyata demata vechen learba ziveyata demata veamru birut nafshechon inyana diktoret busmin dekudsha berich hu yahav lemoshe vinyana dekarbana immeh

Avdu ken telat zimnin veaavaru bechal mata learba ziveyata vhau amrin ken levatar amar lehu nezil leinnun deoshitu lememat afrishu minnayechu levattehon vimru cheden vechad tesayemu imrun illen pesukaya vayyomer moshe el aharon kach et hammachta vten aleha esh vegv
201: Dela lo lo Adonai michael refael
Itgezar bekadmita la hava yada ella deinnun bene nasha ulvatar yada deinnun malachin kaddishin veatu bishlichuta legabbeh beshaata deamru leh ayye sara ishtecha uvisru leh besorat yitzchak

Elav atvan nekudot ayyo vesiman ayyo remez lema dilela remez lekudsha berich hu vayyomer hinne vaohel ketiv hacha hinne vaohel uchtiv hatam ohel bal yitzan vegv ta chaze kevan denakud ammay ketiv levatar ayye ella begin dechibbura didchar venukva kechada raza dimhemnuta keden amar vayyomer hinne vaohel tamman hu kishshura decholla vetamman ishtakkach ayye vegv vechi la hau yade malache illae desara hinne vaohel ammay ketiv ayye ella la yade behay alma ella ma deitmasar lehu leminda

Ta chaze veavarti beeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai vechi kamma shelichin umalachin it leh lekudsha berich hu ella begin deinnun la yade ben tippa devuchra lehahu dela buchra bar kudsha berich hu bilchodoy

Kegavena da vehitveta tav al mitzchot haanashim veammay tzerichin ella begin deinnun la yade ela ma deitmasar lon leminda kegon kal innun millin dezammin kudsha berich hu leayetaa al alma umay tama begin dekudsha berich hu aavar karoza bechulhu rekiin behahi milla dezammin leayetaa al alma
Vayyikkach aharon vegv vayyaamod ben hammetim vegv vchen avdu vitbatal minnayehu

Shamu hahu kala deamar sitra sitra kammayeta ochilu leela deha dina dishmaya la ashre hacha deha yade levatla leh chalash libbeh derabbi acha idmuch shama deamre leh kad avadte da avid da zil vema lon deyachzerun bitshuva dechayyavin innun kammay kam vachazar lehu bitshuva shelemata vekabbilu alayhu dela yitbatlun meorayeta lealam veachalifu shema dekarta vkarun lah mata machseya

Amar rabbi yehuda lo day lahem latztzaddikim shemvatlin et haggezira ella leachar ken shemvarchin lahem teda lach shekken hu dechevan shehanneshama omeret lagguf mahari shelosh seim vegv vechal oto hainyan umvatel et haddin ma ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha keet chayya hare beracha

Kevan sheroim otah hammalachim shezze lakach etztza lenafsho ma osim holchim etztzel harshaim leayyen bedinam velaasot bahem mishpat hada hu dichtiv vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al peni sedom limkom harshaim laasot bahem mishpat
Hada hu deamar rabbi yehuda kach darko shel tzaddik kevan sheroe shemayenin bedino eno mitacher lashuv ulhitpalel ulhakriv chelbo vedamo lifne tzuro ad shemmistallekin baale haddin mimmennu
202: Bealma bae bar nash leitkasya beveteh vela yitchaze beshuka begin dela yitchabbel kema deatte amer veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker minnayehu bae leistattera ma ketiv im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai

Ayye sara ishtecha dela vau lomar kammah kevan deamar hinne vaohel miyyad vayyomer shov ashuv elecha keet chayya vehinne ven lesara ishtecha vegv ta chaze orach ara dead la azmin avraham kammayehu lemechal la amru leh mide begin dela yitchaze divgin hahi besora ka azmin lehu lemechal batar dichtiv vayychelu keden amru leh hahi besora

Vayyochelu salka datach vechi malache illae achle ella begin yekara deavraham itchaze hachi amar rabbi elazar vayyochelu vadday begin deinnun esha deachil esha vela itchaze vechal ma deyahav lon avraham achle begin demissitra deavraham achle leela

Ta chaze kal ma deachil avraham betahora ihu ka achil uvgin kach akriv kammayehu veachle venatir avraham beveteh dachya umsaavuta deafilu bar nash deihu mesaav leh tevila o avid leh lenatra shiva yomin kedeka chaze leh beveteh vehachi hu vadday
Ta chaze ketiv ish asher lo yihye tahor mikre layela vegv may takanteh vehaya lifnot erev yirchatz bammayim iara beh tuma

Vayyar vhinne shelosha anashim nitztzavim alav ma ketiv banneshama vayemaher avraham haohela el sara bechippazon uvimhirut belo shum hakava miyyad memaheret hanneshama etztzel hagguf lehachaziro lemutav ulvakkesh bamme sheyyitkapper lo ad shemmistallekin mimmennu baale haddin

Rabbi eliezer omer mahu deamar vavraham vesara zekenim baim bayyamim chadal lihot lesara orach kannashim ella kevan shehanneshama omedet bemaalatah vehagguf nishar baaretz mikkamma shanim baim bayyamim shanim veyamim harbe vechadal latztzet velavo velaavor orach kishar kal adam itbassar lehachaot hagguf
Mahu omer achare veloti hayeta li edna achare veloti beafar mehayyom kamma shanim hayeta li edna vechiddush vadoni zaken shehayyom kamma shanim sheyyatztzat mimmenni velo hifkidani
Vekudsha berich hu amar hayippale meyeya davar lammoed mahu lammoed oto hayyadua etztzeli lehachaot hammetim ulsara ven melammed sheyyitchaddesh keven shalosh shanim

Amar rabbi yehuda berabbi simon kevan shehanneshama nizonet mizzivah shel mala kudsha berich hu omer leoto hammalach hannikra lech uvasser leguf peloni sheani atid lehachaoto lammoed sheani achayye et hatztzaddikim leatid lavo vhu meshiv achare veloti hayeta li edna achare veloti beafar vshachanti baadama veachal besari rimma vegush afar tihye li chiddush
Kudsha berich hu omer lanneshama hada hu dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el avraham vegv hayippale meyeya davar lammoed hayyadua etztzeli lehachaot et hammetim ashuv elecha oto hagguf shehu
203: Achora kegon ziva o segirat nidda dehau teri mesaavu la sagya leh behahi tevila ben deiara beh keri kodem dekabbil tuma achora ben deiara beh levatar

Veavraham vesara hau metakkene tevila lechulhu ihu legavre veihi lenashshe may tama iasak avraham ledakkaa livni nasha begin deihu tahor veikre tahor dichtiv mi yitten tahor mittame lo echad tahor da avraham denafak mitterach

Rabbi shimon amar begin letakkana hahu darga deavraham uman ihu mayim vegin kach atkin ledakkaa beni alma bemaya uvshaata deazmin lammalachin sheruta demilloy ma ketiv yukach na meat mayim begin leittakkefa behahu darga demayin sharan bah

Uvgine chach hava medakke lechal bene nasha mikkolla medakke lon missitra deavoda zara umdakke lon missitra dimsaova vechamma deihu medakke leguvrin hachi name sara medakkat lenashin veishtakkachu kulhu deatyan legabbayehu dachyan mikkolla

Ta chaze ilana nata avraham bechal atar dediyyureh tamman vela hava salik bechal atar kedeka yeut bar beshaata dediureh beara dichnaan uvhahu ilana hava yada man deitachid be bekudsha berich hu uman deitachid beavoda zara

Man deitachid bekudsha berich hu ilana hava paris anpoy vechafe al resheh veavid aleh tzilla yae uman deitachid besitra deavoda zara hahu ilana hava istallak veanpoy hau selikin leela keden hava yada avraham veazhir leh vela aade mittamman ad deitachid bimhemnuta dekudsha berich hu
Vehachi man deihu dachya mekabbel leh ilana man deihu mesaav la mekabbel leh keden yada avraham umdakke lon bemaya

Umaayana demaya hava techot hahu ilana uman detzarich tevila miyyad mayin salkin legabbeh veilana istallekin anpoy keden yada avraham deihu mesaava uvae tevila miyyad veim lav maya negivan keden yada devae leistaova ulistamra shiva yomin

Ta chaze deafilu beshaata deazmin lon lemmalachin amar lon vehishshaanu tachat haetz begin lemechome ulmivdak behu uvhahu ilana hava badik lechal bene alma veraza begin kudsha berich hu ka amar deihu ilana dechayye lecholla uvgin kach vehishshaanu tachat haetz velo tachat avoda zara

Vetta chaze kad chav adam beetz haddaat tov vara chav dichtiv umeetz haddaat vegv veihu beh chav vegaram mota lealma ma ketiv veatta pen yishlach yado velakach gam meetz hachayyim vegv vechad ata avraham beilana achora atkin alma dehu ilana dechayye veoda mehemnuta lechal bene alma
Amar rabbi chiyya amar rav i havina mistakkelin befarashata da nistakkel bechachmata i inyana denishmata hi lav resha sofa velav sofa resha
Kadosh kevarishona mechudash lihotchem malachim kedoshim voto hayyom atid lefanay lismoach bahem hada hu dichtiv yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav
Vayyomer shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya amar rabbi yitzchak shov ashuv shov yashuv mibbae leh deha maftecha da lemifkad akarot bida dekudsha berich hu ihu vela bida dishlicha achora

Kema detaninan telat maftechan innun dela itmesaru bida dishlicha dechayya utchiyyat hammetim ugshamim vehoil dela itmesaru bida dishlicha ammay ketiv shov ashuv ella vadday kudsha berich hu dehava kaim alayehu amar milla vegin kach ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha

Vetta chaze bechal atar dichtiv vayyomer setam o vayyikra setam hu malacha divrit vela achora vayyomer dichtiv vayyomer im shamoa tishma vegv vayyomer vela kaamar man hu vayyikra dichtiv vayyikra el moshe vela kaamar man hava amar dichtiv veel moshe amar vegv vela amar man hava velo
204: Ella bechal hanne malacha divrit hava vecholla bekudsha berich hu ittemar uvgin kach ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha vegv vehinne ven vegv

Vehinne ven lesara ishtecha may tama la ketiv vehinne ven lecha ella begin dela yachashov deha min hagar ihu kidvekadmita rabbi shimon patach veamar ben yechabbed av veeved adonav ben yechabbed av da yitzchak leavraham

Ematay kabbid leh beshaata deakad leh al gabbe madbecha uva lemikrav leh karbana veyitzchak bar telatin ushva shenin hava veavraham hava sava deilu hava bait beragla chad la yachil lemekam kameh veihu okir leh leavoy veakad leh kechad imra begin lemebad reuteh deavoy

Veeved adonav da eliezri leavraham kad shaddar leh lecharan veavad kal reuteh deavraham veokir leh kema dichtiv vayeya berach et adoni vegv uchtiv vayyomer eved avraham anochi begin leokir leh leavraham

Deha bar nash dehava mayete kesef vezahav veavne yekar ugmallin veihu kedeka yeut shappir bechezu la amar deihu rechima deavraham o kariva dileh ella amar eved avraham anochi begin lesalleka beshivcha deavraham ulokir leh beenayehu

Veal da ben yechabbed av veeved adonav veattun yisrael banay kelana beenayechu lomar deana avuchon o deattun avadin li veim av ani ayye chevodi vegv vegin kach vehinne ven da hu ben vadday vela yishmael da hu ben deokir leavoy kedeka chaze

Vehinne ven lesara ishtecha ben lesara divgineh mitat divgineh keivat nafshah ad denafkat minah vehinni ven lesara leistallaka begineh beshaata dekudsha berich hu yativ bedina al alma dichden vayeya pakad et sara vegv deha madkere lesara beginih deyitzchak veal da ihu ben lesara vehinne ven lesara deha nukva natla livra min dechura

Vesara shomaat petach haohel vehu acharav may vehu acharav vehi acharav mibbae leh ella raza ihu vesara shomaat ma dehava amar petach haohel da darga tattaa pitcha dimhemnuta vehu acharav deode leh darga illaa min yoma dehavat sara bealma la shamat milla dekudsha berich hu bar hahu shaata
Davar acher dehavat yatva sara petach haohel begin lemishma millin vehi shamat hay milla deitbassar bah avraham vehu acharav avraham dehava yativ achoroy dishchinta

Veavraham vesara zekenim baim bayyamim may baim bayyamim shiurin deomin deitchaze keden lehu chad mea vechad tishim alu beomin shiura deomin kedeka yaot baim bayyamim kema deatte amer ki va hayyom deiarav yoma lemeal
Chadal lihot lesara orach kannashim vehahi shaata chamat garmah beidduna achora uvgin kach amra vaadoni zaken deha ihu la cheday leolada begin deihu sava

Rabbi yehuda patach noda bashshearim baalah beshivto im zikne aretz ta chaze kudsha berich hu istallak bikareh deihu ganiz vesatim beiluya sagya lav itay bealma vela hava min yoma deitbere alma deyachil lekayema al chachmata dileh vela yachil lekayema beh

Begin deihu ganiz vesatim veistallak leela leela vechulhu illae vetattae la yachlin leitdabbeka ad dechulhu amrin baruch kevod Adonai mimkomo tattae amre deihu leela dichtiv al hashshamayim kevodo ilae amre deihu letatta dichtiv al kal haaretz kevodecha ad dechulhu illae vetattae amre baruch kevod Adonai mimkomo begin dela ityeda vela hava man deyachil lekayema beh veatte amarte noda bashshearim baalah
205: Ella vadday noda bashshearim balah da kudsha berich hu deihu ityeda veitdabbak lefum ma dimshaer belibbeh kal chad kamma deyachil leiddabbeka berucha dechachmeta ulfum ma dimshaer belibbeh hachi ityeda belibbeh uvgini chach noda bashshearim beinnun shearim aval deityeda kedeka yeut la hava man deyachil leiddabbeka ulminda leh

Rabbi shimon amar noda bashshearim baalah man shearim kema deatte amer seu shearim rashechem vehinnasu pitche olam uvgin ellu shearim deinnun dargin illain beginayehu ityeda kudsha berich hu vei la la yachlin leitdabbaka beh

Ta chaze deha nishmata debbar nash lav ihu man deyachil leminda lah ella begin illen shayefin degufa veinnun dargin deavdin umanuta denishmata vegin kach ityeda vela ityeda kach kudsha berich hu ityeda vela ityeda begin deihu nishmata lenishmata rucha lerucha ganiz vetamir mikkolla aval beinnun shearim deinnun pitchin lenishmata ityeda kudsha berich hu

Ta chaze it pitcha lefitcha vedarga ledarga uminnayehu yedia yekara dekudsha berich hu petach haohel da hu pitcha detzedek kema deatte amer pitchu li shaare tzedek vegv da pitcha kadmaa leaola beh uvhay pitcha itchazzun kal shear pitchin illain man dezache lehay zache leminda beh uvchulho shear pitchin begin dechulhu sharan aleh

Vehashta defitcha da la ityeda begin deyisrael begaluta vechulhu pitchin istallaku minneh vela yachlin leminda ulitdabbeka aval bezimna deyifkun yisrael min galuta zeminin kulhu dargin illain lemishre aleh kedeka yeut

Uchden yindeun beni alma chachmeta illaa yakkira ma dela hau yadin mikkadmat dena dichtiv venacha alav ruach Adonai ruach chachma uvina ruach etza ugvura ruach daat veyirat Adonai kulhu zeminin leashraa al hay pitcha tattaa deihu petach haohel vechulhu zeminin leashraa al malka meshicha begin lemedan alma dichtiv veshafat betzedek dallim vegv

Begine chach kad itbassar avraham hay darga hava amar kema deittemar dichtiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya vayyomer la ketiv man hava veda hu petach haohel veal da vesara shomaat hay darga dehava mallil immeh man dela hava shemaat mikkadmat dena dichtiv vesara shomaat petach haohel dehava mevasser veamar shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya vehinne ven lesara ishtecha

Ta chaze kamma hu chavivuta dekudsha berich hu legabbeh deavraham deha la nafak minneh yitzchak ad deitgezar levatar deitgezar itbassar beh beyitzchak begin deihu keden zara kaddisha vead la itgezar lav ihu zara kaddisha uchden ihu kema dichtiv asher zaro vo leminehu

Vetta chaze ad la itgezar avraham hahu zara dileh la hava kaddisha begin denafak bego arla veitdevak bearla letatta levatar deitgezar nafak hahu zara bego kaddisha veitdevak bikdusha dilela veolid leela veitdevak avraham bedargeh kedeka yeut ta chaze kad olid avraham leyitzchak nafak kaddisha kedeka yeut vehay may aadu veolidu chashocha
Rabbi elazar shail yoma chad lerabbi shimon avoy amar leh hay dekara leh kudsha berich hu yitzchak dichtiv vekarat et shemo yitzchak ammay deha itchaze dead la nafak lealma kara leh yitzchak
