Amar leh ha ittemar deesha natal maya deha maya missitra digvura ka atyan vetu levae deinnun bedichin lehahu sitra bemane zemer vetushbechan lakovel hay sitra vegin kach yitzchak ihu chedva begin deate mehahu sitra veitdabbak beh
Ta chaze yitzchak bedichuta chedva deachlaf maya beesha veesha bemaya veal da ikre hachi uvgin kach kudsha berich hu kare leh
206: Hachi ad la yippuk lealma shema da veoda leh leavraham

Vetta chaze bechulhu achoranin shavak lon kudsha berich hu lemikre lon shemahan veafilu nashe hau karan livnayehu shemahan aval hacha la shavak kudsha berich hu leimmeh lemikre leh shema ella leavraham dichtiv vekarata et shemo yitzchak ante vela achora begin leachlafa mayya beesha veesha bemaya leachlala leh besitreh

Kevan deitbassar avraham beyitzchak ma ketiv vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al peni sedom rabbi elazar amar ta chaze kamma anhag kudsha berich hu tivu im kal beriyan vechal shekken leinnun deazle bearchoy deafilu bezimna devae lemedan alma ihu garim leman derachim leh lemizke bemilla ad la yete hahu dina lealma

Detaninan beshaata dekudsha berich hu rachim leh lebbar nash meshadder leh dorona uman ihu missekkena begin deyizke beh vechevan dezache beh ihu amshich aleh chad chuta dechesed deitmeshach missetar yamina ufaris aresheh verashim leh begin dechad yete dina lealma hahu mechabbela yizdehar beh vezakef enoy vechama lehahu reshimu uchden istallak minneh veizdehar beh begine chach akdim leh kudsha berich hu bemma deyizke

Vetta chaze kad bae kudsha berich hu leayetaa dina al sedom azke kodem leavraham veshaddar leh dorona lemizke immehon begin leshezava lelot bar achuha mittamman hada hu dichtiv vayyizkor elohim et avraham vayeshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha vela ketiv vayyizkor elohim et lot deha bizchuteh deavraham ishteziv umay vayyizkor dedachir leh may deazke kodem im innun telat malachin

Kegavena da bar nash deyizke bitzdaka im bene nesha beshaata dedina sharya bealma kudsha berich hu adkar leh lehahi tzedaka deavad begin debbechal shaata dezache bar nash hachi achtiv aleh leela veafilu beshaata dedina sharya aloy kudsha berich hu idkar leh lehahu tivu deavad vezacha im bene nasha kema deatte amer utzdaka tatztzil mimmavet begine chach akdim leh kudsha berich hu leavraham begin deyizke visheziv lelot

Vayyashkifu al pene sedom ta chaze vayyakumu mishsham haanashim mehahi seuda deatkin lo avraham vezacha behu af al gav demalachin hau zacha behu vechal hahu mechla la ishtaar minneh kelum begine deavraham ulmizke beh deha ketiv vayyochelu beesha dilhon itachil

Vei tema ha telat malachin hau hay esha vehay maya vehay rucha ela kal chad vechad kalil bechavreh uvgine chach vayyochelu kegavena da vayyechezu et haelohim vayyochlu vayyishtu achila vaddait achlu deitzanu min shechinta uf hacha vayyochelu garmu leitzena mehahu sitra deavraham itdevak beh uvgin kach la asharu mimma deyahiv lon avraham kelum

Kegavvena da bae leh lebbar nash lemishte mehahu kassa divracha begin deyizke lehahi beracha dilela uf innun achlu mimma deatkin lon avraham begin deyizkun leitzena missitra deavraham deha mehahu sitra nafik mezona lechulhu malache illae
Vayyashkifu itaruta derachame leshezava lelot ketiv hacha vayyashkifu uchtiv hatam hashkifa mimmeon kadshecha ma lehallan lerachame uf hacha lerachame

Veavraham holech immam leshallecham lemebad lon levaya amar rabbi yesa i tema deavraham yada demalachin innun ammay aavid lon levaya ella amar rabbi elazar af al gav dehava yada begin dechach itzterich leh lebbar nash lemebad levaya leushpizin deha kolla behay talya
Uvod deihu hava azil immehon itgeli kudsha berich hu aleh deavraham dichtiv vayeya amar hamchasse ani meavraham asher ani ose vayeya hu uvet dineh begin dekudsha berich hu hava azil
207: Ta chaze kad bar nash avid levaya lechavreh ihu amshich lishchinta leitchabbera bahadeh ulmehach immeh bearcha leshezava leh uvgin kach bae leh lebbar nash lelauye leushpiza begin dechabbar leh lishchinta veamshich aleh leitchabbera bahadeh

Vegin kach vayeya amar hamchasse ani meavraham asher ani ose rabbi chiyya patach ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar ki im gala sodo el avadav hanneviim zakkain innun zakkae alma dekudsha berich hu itrae behu bechal ma deihu avid barkia vezammin lemebad bealma al yede dezakkain avid leh vela kasse minnayehu lealmin kelum

Begin dekudsha berich hu bae leshattafa bahadeh letzaddikaya begin deinnun atyan umazhirin livne nasha leatava mechovayehu vela yitanshun miggo dina illaa vela yehe lon pitcha defuma legabbeh begine chach kudsha berich hu oda lon raza deihu avid behu dina tu begin dela yemrun deha bela dina avid behu dina

Amar rabbi elazar vay lon lechayyavaya dela yadin vela mashgichin vela yadin leistammera mechovayehu uma kudsha berich hu di kal ovadohi keshot veorchateh din la avid kal ma deavid bealma ad degale lehu letzaddikaya begin dela yehe lon pitcha defuma livne nasha gabbe bene nasha lo chal shekken deit lon lemebad millayehu dela yemallelun bene nasha sitya alehon vechen ketiv vihyitem nekiyyim meyeya umiyyisrael

Veit lon lemebad dela yehe lon pitchon pe livne nasha veyitrun behon i innun chatan vela mashgeche leistammara dela yehe leh lemiddat dina dekudsha berich hu pitcha defuma legabbayehu uvma bitshuva veovadin dechashran
Ta chaze vayeya amar hamchasse ani meavraham amar rabbi yehuda kudsha berich hu yahav kal ara leavraham
Vayeya amar hamchasse ani meavraham vegv ma ketiv lemala vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al peni sedom laasot din barshaim ma ketiv acharav hamchasse ani meavraham

Amar rav chasda en hakkadosh baruch hu ose din barshaim ad shennimlach benishmatan shel tzaddikim hada hu dichtiv minnishmat eloha yovedu uchtiv hamchasse ani meavraham amar hakkadosh baruch hu kelum yesh li laasot din barshaim ad sheemalech benishmot hatztzaddikim veomer lahem harshaim chatu lefanay eese bahem din dichtiv vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba vchatatam vegv

Amar rabbi avhu hanneshama omedet bimkomah vehi yerea lehitkarev elav velomar lefanav kelum ad sheyyomar lemttrn sheyyaggishenna lefanav vetomar ma sheratztzeta hada hu dichtiv vyiggash avraham vayyomer haaf tispe tzaddik im rasha chalila lecha

Ulay yesh chamishshim tzaddikim vegv hanneshama potachat veomeret ribbono shel olam shemma nitasseku ben parashiyyot shel tora veaf al pi shelo nitasseku lishmah sachar yish lahem laolam habba velo yikkansu laggehinnom ma ketiv batreh vayyomer Adonai im emtza bisdom chamishshim tzaddikim vegv

Vha yattir innun parashiyyot hau ella amar rabbi abbahu chamishsha sefarim hem battora uvchal echad veechad nichlalim aseret haddibberot asara maamarot shebbahem nivra haolam chashov asara bechal chad minnehon hu chamishshim

Od potachat hanneshama veomeret ribbono shel olam af al pi shelo nitasseku battora shemma kibbelu onsham al ma shechatu bebbet din venitkapper lahem shenneemar arbaim yakkennu lo yosif umimma shennitbayeshu lifnehem dayyam lehitkapper lahem shello yikkansu laggehinnom ma ketiv acharav lo eese baavur haarbaim

Od potachat vomeret ulay yish sham sheloshim ulay yish benehem tzaddikim shehissigu sheloshim maalot harmuzim bappasuk vayehi bishloshim shana vehem kelulim belv netivot shehem otiyyot sefirot lifamim hem kelulim lishmona
Od potachat vomeret ulay yimmatztzeun sham esrim shemma yegaddelu banim letalmud tora vyish lahem sachar laaseret haddibberot shette peamim bechal yom deamar rabbi yitztzechak
208: Lemeheve leh achsanat yeruta lealmin dichtiv ki et kal haaretz asher atta roe lecha ettenenna vegv uchtiv sa na enecha ure ulvatar kudsha berich hu itzterich leaakara atrin illen amar kudsha berich hu kevar yahavit yat ara leavraham vehu abba lecholla dichtiv ki av hamon goyim netatticha vela yaot li lemimche benin vela oda laavuhon dekarit leh avraham ohavi uvgin kach itzterich leoda leh vegin kach vayeya amar hamchasse ani meavraham asher ani ose

Amar rabbi abba ta chaze invetanuta deavraham deaf al gav deamar leh kudsha berich hu zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba veim kal da deorich immeh veoda leh devae lemebad dina bisdom la baa kameh leshezava leh lelot vela yaavid beh dina may tama begin dela lemitba agra min ovadoy
Veal da shalach kudsha berich hu lelot vesheziv leh begineh deavraham dichtiv vayyizkor elohim et avraham vayeshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha vegv
May asher yashav bahen lot ha ittemar aval begin dechulhu chayyavin vela ishtechach mikkulhu deit leh midi dizchu bar lot mikkan olifna bechal atar dedayerin beh chayyavin chariv ihu
Asher yashav bahen lot vechi bechulhu hava yativ lot ela begineh hau yatve dela itcharvu vei tema bizchuteh la ella bizchuteh deavraham
Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze deshimmusha deavid bar nash lezakkaa hahu shimmusha agin aleh bealma vela od ella deaf al gav deihu chayyava olif mearchoy veavid lon

Ta chaze deha begin deitchabbar lot bahadeh deavraham af al gav dela olif kal ovadoy olif lemebad tivu im biryan kema dehava avid avraham veda hu deotiv lechal innun karte kal hahu zimna deyatvu batar deal lot benayehu

Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze dishchinta la aade minneh deavraham behahi shaata dekudsha berich hu amar leh amar leh rabbi elazar veha shechinta hava mallil immeh deha da itgeli aleh kudsha berich hu dichtiv vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday amar leh hachi hu vadday
Vetta chaze ma ketiv vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba bekadmita vayeya amar ulvassof vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora vegv da ihu darga illaa deitgele leh al darga tattaa
Kal hamgaddel beno letalmud tora umolicho levet rabbo babboker uvaerev maale alav hakkatuv keillu kiyyem hattora peamim bechal yom ma ketiv vayyomer lo ashchit baavur haesrim

Od potachat veomeret ulay yimmatztzeun sham asara omeret ribbono shel olam shema hau meotam haasara harishonim shel bet hakkeneset shennotel sachar keneged kullam shebbaim acharehem ma ketiv vayyomer lo ashchit baavur haasara

Kal ze yish lenishmat hatztzaddik lomar al harshaim kevan shello nimtza beyadam kelum ma ketiv vayyelech Adonai kaasher killa ledabber el avraham veavraham shav limkomo mahu limkomo limkom maalato hayedua

Amar rabbi mitztzeva lo laadam lehitpallel al harshaim kede sheyyachzeru lemutav velo yikkansu laggehinnom dichtiv vaani bachalotam levushi sak vegv vamar rabbi asur lo laadam lehitpallel al harshaim sheyyistalleku min haolam sheilmale silleko hakkadosh baruch hu leterach min haolam keshehaya oved avoda zara lo ba avraham avinu laolam veshivte yisrael lo hau vehammelech david umelech hammashiach vehattora lo nittena vechal otam hatztzaddikim vehachasidim vhanneviim lo hau baolam amar rabbi yehuda kevan sheroe hakkadosh baruch hu shelo nimtza barshaim kelum mikkal otam hainyanim ma ketiv vyavou sheni hammalachim sedoma
209: Erda na veere hakketzaakatah habbaa elay asu kala leman kaamar i tema leinnun malachin man chama mallil im da ufakkid leda ella leavraham kaamar devirshuteh kayemin innun atre davar acher leinnun malachin
Ma deittemar leavraham ma taama asu asa mibbae leh may asu da avraham ushchinta dela aade minneh asu ma deittemar lammalachin begin dehau zeminin tamman vehau mishtakkechin lemebad dina veal da asu

Davar acher asu ketargumo avdu vechi la hava yada kudsha berich hu deihu amar erda na veere veha kolla itgeli kammeh ella erda na middarga derachame ledarga dedina vehayenu yerida veere reiyya da hi leashgacha alehon beman dina yadin lon

Ashkechan reiyya letav veashkechan reiyya levish reiyya letav dichtiv vayyar elohim et beni yisrael vayyeda reiyya levish dichtiv erda na veere Adonai leashgacha alayehu bedina veal da amar kudsha berich hu hamchasse ani meavraham

Veavraham hao yihye legoy gadol veatzum may tama beracha da hacha ela begin leodaa deafilu beshaata dekudsha berich hu yativ bedina al alma la ishtanni deha yativ bedina al da uvrachame al da vecholla beriga chada uvshaata chada

Amar rabbi yehuda veha ketiv vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon zimnin deihu et ratzon vezimnin delav ihu et ratzon zimnin deshama vezimnin dela shama zimnin deishtechach vezimnin dela ishtechach dichtiv dirshu Adonai behimmatzo kerauhu bihoto karov

Amar rabbi elazar kan leyachid kan letzibbur kan leatar chad vechan lechule alma begini chach barich leh leavraham deihu shakil kechal alma dichtiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram vetaninan beavraham
Yihye begimatriyya sheloshim hachi taninan telatin tzaddikim azmin kudsha berich hu bechal dara vedara lealma kema deazmin leavraham

Patach veamar min hashsheloshim hachi nichbad veel hashshelosha lo va vegv min hashsheloshim hachi nichbad illen innun telatin tzaddikim deazmin kudsha berich hu lealma vela yevattel lon minneh uvnayahu ben yehoyada ketiv beh min hashsheloshim hachi nichbad ihu chad minnayehu veel hashshelosha la va dela shakil litlata achoranin dealma kaim alayehu

Veel hashshelosha lo va lemehve beminyana kechad minnayehu beinnun telatin zakkain zacha lemeal bechushbena aval veel hashshelosha lo va dela zacha leitchabbera behu ulmeheve immehon bechulaka chada yihye kema detaninan telatin hava uvgin kach kudsha berich hu barcheh beinnun telatin tzaddikim

Ta chaze amar leh kudsha berich hu leavraham zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba deha selikat kodamay ma deinnun avdin lechal alma dechal alma mane raglayehu dela lemeal bisdom vaamora dichtiv paratz nachal meim gar hannishkachim minni ragel dallu meenosh nau paratz nachal meim gar pirtza hava paritz nachal leinnun bene alma dealu letamman dechulhu dechaman leman dehau yahave lemechal ulmishte levar nash achora shadyan leh beumka denahara veihu denatil leh hachi name

Veal da kulhu bene alma hau nishkachim minni ragel demane raglayehu dela lemeal tamman uman deal dallu meenosh nau dehau dale gufa bechafna la hau yahave leh lemechal ulmishte veishtanne diukneh mishshear bene alma dichtiv dallu meenosh nau ketiv hacha nau uchtiv hatam nau mageloteha hachi name hau satan maagalin vearchin dela lemeal tamman veafilu ofe shemaya hau mane
210: Lemeal tamman dichtiv netiv lo yedao ayit vegv uvgine chach kulle alma hau tzavechin al sedom veal amora veal kulhu karte dechulhu kegavena chada hau

Zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba amar leh avraham ammay amar leh vechattatam ki chavda meod begine chach erda na veere hakketzaakatah hakketzaakatam mibbae leh deha ketiv zaakat sedom vaamora utre karte hau ammay hakketzaakatah ella ha ukmuha

Ta chaze besitra detute kala devarda salkin kutre kulhu bechattefa mitkanshe bechad tif vealin bego nukve dithoma rabba itavidu chamesh bechad chad ihu kad ika tzelilin kalin dechulhu itavidu chad kala desalik mittatta al benayehu veitmashchu kechad
Vehahu kala salka venachata tava dina leitmashcha letatta kad hay kala salka lemitba dina keden itgeli leashgacha kudsha berich hu bedina

Amar rabbi shimon hakketzaakatah man hakketzaakatah da gezerat dina detava dina kal yoma dehachi taninan kamma shenin kayema gezerat dina vetava mikkamme kudsha berich hu al dezabbinu achuy deosef leosef begin digzerat dina tzavechat al dina veal da hakketzaakatah habbaa elay
May habbaa elay da hu raza kema deatte amer baerev hi vaa uvabboker hi shava veda hu habbaa elay tadir kegavena da ketz kal basar ba lefanay veha ittemar asu kala ha ittemar

Vayyigash avraham vayyomar haaf tispe tzaddik im rasha amar rabbi yehuda man chama abba derachmanuta keavraham ta chaze benoach ketiv vayyomer elohim lenoach ketz kal basar ba lefanay vegv ase lecha tevat atze gofer veishtik vela amar leh midi vela vaa rachame aval avraham beshaata deamar le kudsha berich hu zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba vegv erada na veere vegv miyyad ketiv vayyiggash avraham vayyomar haaf tispe tzaddik im rasha

Amar rabbi elazar uf avraham la avad shelimu kedeka yeut noach la avid midi la hay vela hay avraham tava dina kedeka yeut dela yemut zakkaa im chayyava veshare mechamishshim ad asara avad vela ashlim dela baa rachame ben kach uven kach deamar avraham la baina lemitba agar ovadoy

Aval man avad shelimu kedeka yeut da moshe dechevan deamar kudsha berich hu saru maher min hadderech vegv asu lahem egel massecha vayyishtachau lo miyyad ma ketiv vayechal moshe et pene Adonai elohav vegv ad deamar veatta im tissa chattatam veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta veaf al gav dechulhu chatu la zaz mittamman ad deamar leh salachti kidvarecha
Aval avraham la ashgach ella i ishtechach behu zakkay veim lav la veal da la hava bealma bar nash deyagin al dareh kemoshe deihu raaya mehemna
Vayyiggash avraham vayyomar atkin garmeh lemitba da ulay yimmatzu sham chamishshim shara mechamishshim deihu sheruta leminda ad asara deihu asiraa sofa dechal dargin

Amar rabbi yitzchak ad asara illen asara yomin deven rosh hashshana leom hakkippurim begin kach shara mechamishshim ad asara vechevan demata laasara amar mikkan ultatta lav hu atar dekayema bitshuva begine chach la nachat letatta measara
Vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma baerev vegv amar rabbi yose ta chaze ma ketiv leela vayyelech Adonai kaasher
Midrash hanneelam rabbi patach behay kera veelle haggoyim asher hinniach Adonai lenassot bam et yisrael amar rabbi chaze havit behahu alma kaim ella beinnun
211: Killa ledabber el avraham deha kevan deitperash shechinta meavraham veavraham tav leatreh keden vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma baerev deha chad istallak bishchinta veishtaaru innun teren
Kevan dechama lot lon rahat batrayehu may tama vechi kal innun dehau atyan ihu ail lon leveteh veyahiv lon lemechal ulmishte uvni mata hech la katlin leh deha livratteh avdu dina
Umay hu divratteh delot yahavat pitta denahama lechad anya yadu bah shafuha duvsha veotvuha berish igra ad deachluha tzire
Ella begin dehava belelya chashiv dela yistakkelun leh bene mata veim kal da kevan daaalu leveta itkenashu kulhu veascharu leveta

Amar rabbi yitzchak ammay rahat lot abbatrayehu dichtiv vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam rabbi chizkiyya verabbi yesa chad amar diukna deavraham chama imhon vechad amar shechinta atya alayehu ketiv hacha vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam uchtiv hatam vayyaratz likratam mippetach haohel ma lehallan chama shechinta uf hacha chama shechinta

Vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam vayyomer hinne na adonay baalef dalet nun yud suru na geshu na mibbae leh may suru na ella leahadara lon sacharaneh deveta begin dela yechomun lon bene mata vela yealun beorach meshar leveta uvgin kach suru na

Rabbi chizkiyya patach ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit tachat kal hashshamayim yire kamma it lon livne nasha leistakkala beovadoy dekudsha berich hu ulishtaddala beorayeta yemama velele dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta kudsha berich hu ishtabbach beh leela veishtabbach beh letatta begin deorayeta ilana dechayye ihi lechal innun deaskin bah lemehav lon chayyin bealma den

Deshallitin al reuta delibbehon shenneemar edut bihosef samo vegv amar rav yehuda lamma zacha yosef leotah hammaala vehammalchut bishvil shekkavash yitztzero detaninan kal hakkovesh et yitztzero malchuta dishmaya achil aleh

Deamar rav acha lo bara hakkadosh baruch hu layyetztzer hara ella lenassot bo bene adam umi bae kudsha berich hu lenassuta bivne nasha in deamar rav acha mena lan middichtiv ki yakum bekirbecha navi uva haot vehammofet ki menase Adonai elohechem velama bae nasuta deha kal ovadoy devar nash itgeli kammeh ella shelo latet pitchon pe livne adam ree ma ketiv velot yoshev beshaar sedom dehava yativ lenassuta livriyyata

Amar rabbi yitztzechak may dichtiv veharshaim kayyam nigrash vegv afillu bishat dino shel rasha hu meiz panav vazay hu berishato kayyam ree ma ketiv terem yishkavu amar rabbi yitztzechak keshem shebbara kudsha berich hu gan eden baaretz kach bara gehinnom baaretz uchshem shebbara gan eden lemala kach bara gehinnom lemala

Gan eden baaretz dichtiv vayyita Adonai elohim gan beeden gehinnom baaretz dichtiv eretz efata kemo ofel gan eden lemala dichtiv vehayeta nefesh adoni tzerura bitztzeror hachayyim et Adonai elohecha uchtiv veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah
Gehinnom lemala dichtiv veet nefesh oyevecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala gan eden lemata kidkaamaran gan eden lemala lenishmatan shel tzaddikim gemurim lihot nizzonin meor haggadol shel mala

Gehinnom lemata leotam harshaim shello kibbelu berit mila velo heeminu behakkadosh baruch hu vedato vlo shamru shabbat veellu hem ovde kochavim umazzalot shenniddonim baesh shenneemar mehaesh yatztzau vehaesh tochlem uchtiv veyatztzeu verau befigre haanashim vegv

Gehinnom lemala leotam poshe yisrael sheavru al mitztzeot hattora velo chazru bitshuva sheddochim otam lachutz ad sheyekabbelu ansham veholchim vesovvim kal haolam shenneemar saviv reshaim yithallachun
Vesham niddonim shenem asar chodesh leachar ken madoram im otam shekkibbelu ansham bemotam
212: Ta chaze ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit lemehav lon mezona ulsappaka lon mikkal ma deitzterichu begin deihu ashgach bah tadir dichtiv tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah merishit hashshana vead acharit shana
Begin deeretz da ma ketiv bah mimmerchak tavi lachmah ulvatar ihi yehavte mezona vetarfa lechal innun chevan bera dichtiv vattakam beod layela vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha

Veal da ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit tachat kal hashshamayim yire lechulhu bene alma lemehav lon mezona vesippuka lechal ma deitzterich kal chad vechad dichtiv poteach et yadecha umasbia lechal chay ratzon
Davar acher ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit leistakkala ovadoy devar nash ulashgacha bechal ma deavde bene nasha bealma tachat kal hashshamayim yire mistakkel vechame lechal chad vechad

Ta chaze kevan dechama kudsha berich hu ovadin disdom vaamora shaddar lon leinnun malachin lechabbala lisdom ma ketiv vayyar lot chama lishchinta vechi man yachil lemechome shechinta ela chama zahara chad denahir deka salka al reshayehu uchden vayyomer hinne na adonay bealef dalet kema deittemar uvgin shechinta hahu nehiru denahir kaamar suru na el bet avdechem velinu verachatzu raglechem

La avad hachi avraham ella bekadmita amar verachatzu raglechem ulvatar veekcha pat lechem vegv aval lot amar suru na el bet avdechem velinu ulvatar verachatzu raglechem vehishkamtem vahalachtem ledarkechem begin dela yishtemodun behu bene nasha
Vayyomru lo ki varchov nalin begin dechach hau avde orchin dealin tamman la hava bar nash deyichnosh lon leveta veal da amru lo ki varchov nalin ma ketiv vayyiftzar bam meod vegv

Ta chaze kad kudsha berich hu avid dina bealma shelicha chada avid leh vehashta chamenan tere sheluche ammay vechi la sagge bechad ela chad hava uma deamar tere chad hava leappaka leh lelot ulshezava leh vechad lemehpach lekarta ulchabbala ara uvgin kach ishtaar chad
Kal echad vechad kefi hammakom harauy lo veharshaim shel haovde kochavim umazzalot niddonim tamid baesh uvammayim veshuv enam olim shenneemar veishsham lo tichbe

Mishpat harshaim baggehinnam kema dichtiv vayeya himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh vegv vshuv enam olim vlo yakumu leom haddin shenneemar asher hafach Adonai beappo uvachamato beappo baolam hazze uvachamato baolam habba

Amar rabbi yitztzechak lehay gavena it gan eden lemala veit gan eden lemata it gehinnom lemata vit gehinnom lemala amar rabbi yaakov harshaim shekkilkelu berit mila shebbahem vechillelu shabbat befarhesya vechillelu et hammoadot veshekkafru battora veshekkafru bitchiyyat hammetim vechaddome lahem yordim laggehinnom shellemata veniddonim sham veshuv enam olim

Aval yakumu leom haddin veyakumu litchiyyat hammetim vaalehem neemar verabbim misheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam vegv vaalehem neemar vehau deraon lechal basar ma deraon day raon shehakkol yomru day biriyyatam veal hatztzaddikim shebbeyisrael neemar veammech kullam tzaddikim

Vayeya himtir al sedom veal amora vegv rabbi chiyya patach hinne yom Adonai ba achzari vegv hinni yom Adonai ba da be dina letatta ba kema deittemar habbaa elay begin dela avid dina ad deal venatil reshu kegavena da ketz kal basar ba lefanay
Davar acher hinne yom Adonai ba da hu mechabbela letatta kad natil nishmata begine kach achzari veevra lasum haaretz leshamma da sedom vaamora vechattaeha
213: Ma ketiv batreh ki kochve hashshamayim uchsilehem vegv deha min shemaya amtar alehon esha veaavar lon min alma levatar ma ketiv okir enosh mippaz vegv da avraham dekudsha berich hu salik leh al kal bene alma

Rabbi yehuda okim lon lehanne kerae beoma deitcharav be makdesha divhahu yoma itchashchu illae vetattae veitchashchan shemaya vechochvaya rabbi elazar mokim lehanne kerae beoma deokim kudsha berich hu lichneset yisrael meafra vehahu yoma yityeda leela vetatta dichtiv vehaya yom echad hu yivada layeya vehahu yoma yoma denokma ihu dezammin kudsha berich hu lenakma mishshear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot

Vechad kudsha berich hu yaavid nukmin bishar amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot keden okir enosh mippaz da malka meshicha deyistallak veyityakar al kal beni alma vechal bene alma yiflechun veyisgedun kammeh dichtiv lefanav yichreu tziyyim vegv malche tarshish vegv
Ta chaze af al gav dinvua da ittemar al bavel becholla ittemar deha chamenan behay parshata dichtiv ki yerachem Adonai et yaakov uchtiv ulkachum ammim vehevium el mekomam

Vayeya himtir al sedom da darga deve dina letatta denatil reshu meela rabbi yitzchak amar deavid dina berachame dichtiv meet Adonai min hashshamayim begin leishtakkacha dina berachame vei tema may rachame hacha dichtiv vayehi beshachet elohim et are hakkikkar vayyizkor elohim et avraham vegv ulvatar nafku minneh teren umin shelemin vezacha denafik minneh david ushlomo malka

Chame ma ketiv vayehi kehotziam otam hachutza vayyomer vegv ta chaze beshaata dedina share bealma ha ittemar dela libae lebbar nash leishtakkacha beshuka begin dechevan desharya dina la ashgach ben zakkaa vechayyava vela vae leishtakkacha tamman veha ittemar divgin kach istim noach batteva vela yishgach bealma beshaata dedina yitavid uchtiv veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker ad deyitavid dina uvgin kach vayyomer himmalet al nafshecha al tabbit acharecha vegv

Rabbi yitzchak verabbi yehuda hau azle bearcha amar rabbi yehuda lerabbi yitzchak dina deavid kudsha berich hu bammabbul vedina disdom tarvayehu dinin degehinnom hau begin dechayyave gehinnom itdanu bemaya uvesha

Amar rabbi yitzchak sedom bedina degehinnom itdan dichtiv vayeya himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim da missitra demaya veda missitra deesha da veda hu dina degehinnom vechayyavin degehinnom bitren dinin illen itdanu

Amar leh dina dechayyave degehinnom teresar yarche vekudsha berich hu salik lon miggehinnom vetamman mitlabbenin veyatvin letara degehinnom vechaman innun chayyavin dealin vedanin lon tamman veinnun tave rachame alayehu ulvatar kudsha berich hu chayyis alayehu veail lon leduchta deitzterich lon mehahu yoma ulhala gufa ishtechach beafra venishmata yarta
Sitre tora toseppetta keture rammay hurmene divdure chakkimin besuchlettanu yistakkelun leminda beshaatta deresha chivara attekin kurseya al gabbe samchin deavnin demargelitan tavan
Ben innun avnin it chad margalita shappira bechezu yaa bereva kumtera dekantara dimlahata be gevanin innun gevanin melahatan lechal setar
Illen mittepparshan miggo gevanin illen zikin bezikin dintzitzin led sitre alma hacha ita zika takkipa distar semala deitteachid bishmaya innun gevanin shivin dina yattiv vesipperin pettichu
Mehacha nappeke girin usyapin veromchin veesha dekustera veitteachid esha takkipa denappeka mishamayim beh vechad itteachad eshsha illaa beillen diltatta let man deyachil leittebbar rugza
214: Ta chaze deha ittemar deafilu innun bene tofana la itdanu ella beesha umayya mayya keriran nachate milleela umayya retichan salke mittatta keesha veitdanu bitre dinin begin dedina dilela hachi hava vegin kach bisdom gafrit vaesh

Amar leh i yekumun leom dina amar leh ha ittemar aval illen disdom vaamora la yekumun ukra ochach dichtiv gafrit vamelach serefa chal artzah lo tizzara velo tatzmiach vegv asher hafach Adonai beappo uvachamato asher hafach Adonai bealma den beappo bealma deate uvachamato bezimna dezammin kudsha berich hu laachaya metayya amar leh ta chaze kamma deara dilhon itavid lealam ulalme almaya hachi name itavidu innun lealam ulalme almaya
Vetta chaze dina dekudsha berich hu dina lakovel dina innun la hava tayevin nafsha demiskena bemechla uvmishtayya uf hachi kudsha berich hu la ativ lon nafshayehu lealma deate

Vetta chaze innun itmenau mitztzedaka deikre chayyim uf kudsha berich hu mana minnayehu chayyim bealma den uvalma deate vechamma deinnun manu archin ushvilin mibbene alma hachi name kudsha berich hu mana minnayehu orchin ushvilin derachame lerachama alayehu bealma den uvalma deate

Rabbi abba amar kulhu bene alma yekumun vikumun ledina vealayehu ketiv veelle lacharafot ulderaon olam vekudsha berich hu mari derachamin ihu kevan dedan lehu behay alma vekabbilu dina la itdanu bechulhu dinin

Amar rabbi chiyya ketiv vayeshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha vegv mahu bahafoch et hearim asher yashav bahen lot ela bechulhu avad diyyureh lot dichtiv velot yashav beare hakkikkar vayyeehal ad sedom vela kabbilu leh bar demelech sedom kabbil leh

Ayenin lahatin ketisin denura nachit behu lealma vay man deiara beh chagir chartzin ihu charba shinnena bideh la chayis al tav veal bish deha pitteka deinnun shivin birshu deitteachid hahu sitra dishmaya nachit bida semala bechamma dinin

Ittehappecha bechamma gevanin happucha bechal yoma ihu ikre kerum zellutt dimtakkena legabbe bene adam kal gevanin dichle zaamo dekudsha bericha hu beh ittechazzeyan veinnun yattevin berume dealma uvne nasha besichlutta dilhon la mashgeche behon
Gapperit vaesh hittucha demaya veesha demittehatteche min shemaya itteachadu da beda unchatt al sedom vay lechayyavaya dolo mashgichin al yekara demarehon
Asara shemahan gelipan behurmenutta demalka innun vesalkin lechushban sagge shivin gavenan melahate lechal setar nappeke miggo shemahan deiglif raza de shemahan demalachaya deinnun beraza dishmaya
Veinnun michael govorol roppol nuriel kedumiel tzdkl ptch pdl tml tzry tzdkl ypl vtrl kadshiel shv anel ahaniel rachamiel azriel
215: Kad mittechabberan kulhu kechada beraza chada bechela illaa keden ikre vidovad kolla bichlala chada meett Adonai min hashamayim shema kaddisha deitteggelaf be shemahan achoranin raza deshamayim villen innun shivin deshaltin al illen dinin raza de-Adonai villen shivin shemahan bikdusha Adonai shamayim

Illen natlin meillen vedod natil meett yedovad da min da villen talyan meillen tattain beillain vecholla kishura chada uvhay kudsha bericha hu ishtemoda bikareh shamayim deinnun raza yedovad da ihu beraza deshivin utteren shemahan villen innun denappeke min vayyissa vayyavo vayyet

Chht chelek rishon barucha shem kevod malchutto leolam vaed phl nlcha chelek sheni barucha shem kevod malchutto leolam vaed nt yrt chelek shelishi barucha shem kevod malchutto leolam vaed mcha revii barucha shem kevod malchutto leolam vaed nt py mtzr chelek chamishi barucha shem kevod malchutto leolam vaed chelek shishi barucha shem kevod malchutto leolam ved

Veillen innun shivin shemahan deshaltin al shivin dargin tattain raza vidovad illen shivin shemahan yedovad raza deikkere shamayim shiva rekiin innun desalkin leshivin shemahan shema kaddisha veda ihu vadod himtir meett yedovad min hashamayim
216: Da deikkere shamayim minneh ittebbere sittera deikkere adam chashvan shayepe guppa deinnun chushban matan vearbein uttemanya shayepin

Chashvan atteohi matan veshit sare shema da deihu raza vesittera kelala dechal orayeta bechv attevan veeser amiran begin deha shema da matan veshit sare attevan uttelattin utteren shevilin deittekkelilan beh ha matan vearbain uttemanya shayepin deguppa

Raza deikre adam deshallit kurseya raza deshivin diltatta vesittera da dichtiv veal demutt hakkisse demutt kemare adam alav millemala veda hu sittera dichtiv vayeya himtir al sedom vegv meett Adonai min hashamayim vecholla chad umilla chada vesittera chada lachachime libba ittemasar zakkaa chulakhon bealma den uvalma deatte

Sedom gezar dina dilhon demanu tzedaka minnayehu kema deatte amer veyad ani veevon lo hechezika uvgin kacha dina la hava ella min shamayim tzedaka veshamayim kolla chad uchtiv ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha uvgin dettalya tzedaka bishmeh dina hu mishamayim dichtiv mot Adonai min hashamayim

Dina deyisrael mehay attar dichtiv vayyigdal aon batt ammi mechatat sedom veikre yerushalem achott lisdom kema deatte amer hinne ze haya aon sedom achottecha vedinhon hava min shemaya dina chada kisdom al demanu tzedaka minnayehu bar deda ittehappacha veda ittecharav da it lah tekuma veda let lah tekuma

Vattabbet ishto meacharav meachareha mibbae leh ella mibbatar shechinta rabbi yose amar mibbatrih delot dimchabbela azil avatreh vechi avatrih azil veha hu shaddar leh ella bechal atar dehava azil lot itakkav mechabbela lechabbala vechal atar deazil kevar veshavik laachoreh hava mehappech leh mechabbela

Uvgin kach amar leh al tabbet acharecha deha ana achabbel batrach veal da ketiv vattabbet ishto meacharav vechamat mechabbela keden vattehi netziv melach deha bechal zimna dimchabbela la chame anpoy devar nash la mechabbil leh kevan deitteteh ahadderat anpaha leistakkala avatrih miyyad vattehi nitztzav melach

Rabbi elazar verabbi yose hau kayeme yoma chad veaske behay kera amar rabbi elazar ketiv eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem lo techsar kol bah hay bah bah teri zimne ammay ella ha ittemar dekudsha berich hu palig kal ammin vearan limmannan shelichan veara deyisrael la shallit bah malacha vela memanna achora ella ihu bilchodoy begin kach ail leamma dela shallit behu achora leara dela shalit bah achora

Ta chaze kudsha berich hu yahiv mezona tamman bekadmita ulvatar lechal alma kal shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bemiskenut veara deyisrael lav hachi ella eretz yisrael ittezan bekadmita ulvatar kal alma

Uvgin kach eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem ella beatiru besippuka decholla tochal bah vela beatar achora bah bikdishu deara bah sharya mehemnuta illaa bah sharya birketa dilela vela beatar achora

Ta chaze ketiv kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim ad hacha la ityeda gan Adonai i hu eretz mitzrayim vei ihu eretz sedom vei ihu gan Adonai deikre gan eden ella kegan Adonai deit beh sippuka veidduna decholla hachi name hava sedom vehachi name mitzrayim ma gan Adonai la itzterich bar nash leashkaa leh uf mitzrayim la itzterich achora leashkaa leh begin denilus ihu assik veashke lechal ara demitzrayim

Ta chaze ma ketiv vehaya asher lo yaale meet mishpechot haaretz el yerushalem vegv da hu onasha dilhon deitmena minnehon mitra ma ketiv veim mishpachat mitzrayim lo taale velo vaa vegv chame dela ketiv velo alehem yihye haggeshem begin dela nachit mitra lemitzrayim vela itztarchan leh ella onasha dilhon ma hu dichtiv vezot tihye hammaggefa asher yiggof Adonai et kal haggoyim vegv begin demitzrayim la tzerichin lemitra uf sedom ma ketiv beh ki chullah mashke kal iddunin dealma hau vah veal da la vaan divne nasha achoranin yitaddenun bah

Rabbi chiyya amar innun hau chayyavin miggarmayehu umimmamonhon dechal bar nash deihu tzar ena legabbe miskena yaot hu dela yitkayyam bealma velo od ella delet leh chayyim lealma deate vechal man deihu vatran legabbe miskena yaot hu deyitkayyam bealma veyitkayyam alma begineh veit leh chayyim veorka dechayye lealma deate
Vayyaal lot mitztzoar vayyeshev bahar hu ushte venotav immo vegv may tama begin dechama dehava kariv lisdom veistallak mittamman

Rabbi yitzchak patach vehu mesibot mithappech betachbulotav lefaolam vegv kudsha berich hu mesabbev sibbuvin dealma veayete kumrin tehirin lemebad ovadoy ulvatar mehappech lon veavid lon kegavena achora
Uvma betachbulotav avid tachbulin umsabbev sibbuvin laafacha lon velav keinnun kadmae

Midrash hanneelam vayyaal lot mitztzoar vegv amar rabbi abbahu bo ure ma ketiv bayyetztzer hara teda lecha sheeno mitbatel leolam mibbene adam ad oto zeman dichtiv vahasiroti et lev haeven sheaf al pi sheroe bene adam niddonin baggehinnam hu ba vechozer lo etztzel bene adam hada hu dichtiv vayyaal lot mitztzoar mitztzaarah shel gehinnom mishsham ole lefattot bene adam
Amar rabbi yehuda shalosh hanhagot yish baadam hanhagat hassechel vehachachma vzo hi
217: Lefaolam begin paolam divne nasha kema deinnun avdin ovadin hachi mehappech lon kol asher yetzavem al pene tevel artza begin deovadin divne nasha mehappech leinnun mesibbot bechal ma deihu pakkid lon al peni tevel vegv

Rabbi elazar amar vehu mesibbot mithappech hakkadosh baruch hu mesabbev sibbuvin veayete ovadin bealma leitkayema ulvatar dechashivu bene nasha deyitkayemun innun ovadin kudsha berich hu mehappech lon leinnun ovadin mikkema dehau bekadmita

Betachbulotav betachbulato ketiv kehay omana deavid manin decharsa beod dehahi tikla istacharat kameh chashiv lemebad kegavena da avid chashiv lemebad kegavena achora avid mehappech mana da lemana da begin dehahu tikla istacharat kammeh kach kudsha berich hu mehappech ovadoy deihu avid
Betachbulotav chaser uman ihu da be dina letatta deihu tikla deistacharat kammeh veal da mehappech manin mimmana da lemana achora

Vechal da kefi paolam divne nasha i metivin bene nasha ovadehon hahu tikla desachara ascharat lon leyamina uchden itavidu ovadin bealma leotava lon kedeka yeut vetikla ascharat tadir vela shachich behahu sitra deyamina vealma mitgalgela beh

Koach hanneshama hakkedosha vehanhagat hattaava shehi mitava bechal taaot raot vzehu koach hattaava vehahanhaga hamanheget livne adam umchazzeket hagguf vehi nikret nefesh hagguf amar rav dimi zehu koach hammachazik

Amar rabbi yehuda bo ure leolam en yetztzer hara sholet ella beellu kochot illen deamaran nefesh hammitava hi harodefet achar yitztzer hara leolam mashma dichtiv vattomer habbechira el hatztzeira avinu zaken nefesh hammitava hi meoreret et haacheret umfatta otah im hagguf lehiddavek bayyetztzer hara vhi omeret lecha nashke et avinu yayin venishkeva immo ma yish lanu baolam habba nelech venirdof achar yitztzer hara veachar teshukat chemdat haolam hazze uma osot shettehen maskimot lehiddavek bo ma ketiv vattashkena et avihen yayin mitpatmot lehitorer leyyitztzer hara baachila uvishtiyya

Vattakam habbechira vattishkav et aviha kesheadam shochev al mitato ballayela nefesh hamitava hi hamoreret layyitztzer hara umharheret bo vhu davek bechal hirhur ra ad shemmitabberet meat shemmevi belev haadam otah hammachashava haraa udveka bo vaadayin yish belibbo velo nigmar laasotah ad shezzot hattaava meoreret lechoach hagguf kemittechilla lehiddavek bayyetztzer hara vaz hu tashlum haraa hada hu dichtiv vattaharena shette benot lot
218: Tachbulato deaschar tadir vehava kayema beascharuta deyamina kudsha berich hu aschar leh besitra dismala umhappech mesibbot umanin dehau bekadmita lehahu setar semala

Uchden tikla aschara veitavidu ovadin bealma leavasha lon livne nasha vetikla aschar lehahu sitra ad divne nasha tayevin leotava ovadehon vetikla kayema beovadin divne nasha veal da betachbulato lefaolam vela kayema tadir

Ta chaze kudsha berich hu garam sibbuvin veovadin bealma begin lemebad kolla kedeka yeut vecholla nafka meikkara vesharsha dilela akriv avraham legabbeh nafak minneh yishmael dela hava avraham gazir kad nafak minneh begin deihu letatta vela ishtelim beat keyama kaddisha
Levatar kudsha berich hu sibbev sibbuvin betachbulotav veitgezar avraham veal babberit veishtelim bishmeh veikre avraham ve illaa aatarat leh beraza demayim meruach

Kevan deraza ishtelim veitgezar nafak minneh yitzchak vehava zara kaddisha veitkashshar leela beraza deesh mimmayim veal da ketiv veanochi netatich sorek kullo zera emet vela itkeshar behahu sitra achora
Ta chaze lot nafku minneh umibbenateh terin umin mitparshan veitkesharu behahu sitra deitchaze lon veal da kudsha berich hu mesabbev

Amar rabbi yitztzechak meolam en yitztzer hara mitpatte ella baachila ushtiyya umittoch simchat hayyayin az sholet baadam batztzaddik ma ketiv beh tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho veno mishtakker leolam deamar rabbi yehuda hay tzurva merabbanan demarvi karena aleh nezm zahav beaf chazir velo od ella shemchallel shem shamayim minhag harshaim mahu hinne sason vesimcha hayyayin az sholet baadam harog bakar veshachot tzon vegv alehem amar hakkatuv hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu vegv kede leorer layyitztzer hara sheen yitztzer hara mitorer ella mittoch hayyayin hada hu dichtiv vattashkena et avihen yayin

Amar rabbi abbahu ma ketiv velo yada beshichvah uvkumah kelomar yetztzer hara eno mashgiach bah beshichvah baolam hazze uvkumah laolam habba ella mitorer im koach hagguf laavod taavato baolam hazze deamar rabbi abbahu beshaa shennichnasin harshaim baggehinnam machnisim layyetztzer hara lirot bahen hada hu dichtiv velot ba tzoara letztzaarah shel gehinnom venafak leh mittamman livriyyata lenassuta kidkaamaran hada hu dichtiv vayyaal lot mitztzoar mitztzaarah shel gehinnom
Vayyishev bahar amar rabbi yitztzechak mashma dichtiv bahar melammed shehu sham moshavo bemakom har guf shehu charev kahar delet beh tivuta ushte benotav immo ellu hav kochot deamaran ki
219: Sibbuvin umgalgel gilgulin bealma deyitavid kolla kedeka yeut veyitkashshar kolla beatreh

Ta chaze yaot hava lelot dekudsha berich hu yafik minneh umeitteteh terin umin illen ella begin leitkashshara beatrayehu deitchaze lehu veitavidu miggo yena vehahu yena izdamman lehon bammearta hahi lelya veda hu raza deitavidu kema deatte amer vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar veha ittemar veukmuha

Ta chaze moav veammon innun karan lon shemahan moav meav rabbi yose amar bechira bachatzifu amra moav meabba hu vehatztzeira gam hi yalda ben vattikra shemo ben ammi bitzniu amra ben ammi bar ammi vela amra mimman hava

Ta chaze bekadmita ketiv vela yada beshichvah uvkumah bev venakud al begin desiyyua deela hava ishtechach behahu ovada dezammin malka meshicha lenafka minneh uvgin kach ishtelim hacha bev uvachora ketiv uvkummah chaser begin dela nafak minah chulka lekudsha berich hu kehay achora veal da ketiv behay achora keshisha uvkumah bev male venakud alah

Rabbi shimon amar la yeda dezammin kudsha berich hu leokma minah david malka ushlomo vechal shear malchin umalka meshicha tu uvkumah dichtiv berut vattakam beterm yakkir ish et reehu vegv uvhahu yoma hava lah kima vadday

Yare lashevet betztzoar yira vacharada nofelet alav beshaa sheroe tzaar gehinnom shemtzaarin larshaim vechoshev sheshsham yiddon kevan sheroe sheeno niddon sham yotztze veholech lefattot bene adam acharav
Rav huna kad hava darish leizdahara livne adam hava amar lehu banay istammaru mishlicha shel gehinnom uman hu zehu yetztzer hara shehu shaliach shel gehinnom

Rabbi abba amar may dichtiv laaluka shette vanot hav hav ellu shette benot lot deamaran shehi nefesh hammitau venefesh hammishtattefet bagguf harodefet achar yitztzer hara leolam amar rabbi yehoshua ketiv hacha belot ki yare lashevet betztzoar uchtiv hatam laaluka shette vanot hav hav yare begimatriyya hu aluka amar rabbi yitztzechak i yare hu lemay ate lemite beriyyata ella kach derech kal ose avela kesheroe hara mityare lefi shaa miyyad chozer lerishato veno choshesh lichlum kach yetztzer hara beshaa sheroe din barshaim yare kevan sheyyotztze lachutz eno choshesh kelum

Rabbi abba amar mahu deammaru vattomer habbechira el hatztzeira avinu zaken may avinu zaken zehu yetztzer hara shennikra zaken shenneemar melech zaken uchsil shehu zaken shennolad im haadam detaninan amar rabbi yehuda amar rabbi yose otah nefesh hammitava omeret laacheret avinu zaken nirdof acharav venidbak
220: Itchabbar immah boaz lehakim shem hammet al nachalato veittakam minnah kal hanne malchin vechal illuya deyisrael velo yada beshichvah dichtiv vattishkav margelotav ad habboker uvkumah dichtiv vattakam beterem yakkir ish et reehu vegv begin kach uvkumah nekud

Ta chaze invetanuta deavraham deha afilu bekadmita kad baa kudsha berich hu lemebad dina bisdom la vaa minneh rachame al lot levatar dichtiv vayyar vehinne ala kitor haaretz kekitor hakkivshan la tava aleh delot vela amar aleh lekudsha berich hu kelum uf hachi kudsha berich hu la amar leh midi begin dela yachasov avraham dekudsha berich hu gara mizchuteh kelum

Vei tema deavraham la hava chashiv leh lelot belibbeh kelum ha masar nafsheh lemehach leaggacha kerava bachamishsha melachin takkifin kema deatte amer vayyishma avram ki nishba achiv vegv uchtiv vayyechalek alehem layela uchtiv vayyashev et kal harchush vegam et lot achiv urchusho heshiv vegv aval birchimuta dirchim lekudsha berich hu vechama ovadoy delot dela chashran kedeka yeut la vaa avraham divgineh yishbok kudsha berich hu kelum middileh uvgine chach la tava aleh rachame la bekadmita vela vesofa

Bo kishar kal harshaim shebbaolam vish en baaretz lavo alenu en ish tzaddik baartz veen ish shallit al yitztzero harbe reshaim baaretz let anan bilchodana chayyavin naase kederech kal haaretz shehem chayyavim shead hayyom derech kal haaretz hu lecha nashke et avinu yayin nismach baolam hazze nochal vnishte venirve chamra venidbak beavinu bayitztzer hara vnishkeva immo veruach hakkodesh tzoochat veomeret gam elle bayyayin shagu uvashshechar tau

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze ma ketiv vtashkena et avihen yayin derech harshaim litot achare hayyayin lefannek layetztzer hara ulorro vad shehu sameach beshichruto shochev al mitato miyyad vattakam habbechira vattishkav et aviha hi mezemmenet immo umitava umharheret bechal hirhurim raim vyetztzer hara mitchabber immah venidbak bah veno mashgiach bah ma hu mimmennah beshichvah uvkumah beshichvah baolam hazze uvkumah leatid lavo beshichvah baolam habba keshettitten din vcheshbon uvkumah leom haddin dichtiv verabbim miyeshene admat afar yakitzu vegv beshum inyan meellu en mashgiach bah yitztzer hara ella davek bah vhi nidbeket bo ulachar ken meoreret leachora leachar shehahirhur gadol nidbak bayyitztzer hara baa haacheret venidbeket bo
Vayyissa mishsham avraham artza hannegev kal matlanoy hau lesitra dedaroma
221: Avihen yayin kemo chen leorer layyitztzer hara venidbeket bo vazay tashlum haraot laasot umitabberot shettehen miyyitztzer hara hada hu dichtiv vattaharen shette venot lot meavehen ad sheyyatztza lappoal maasehen zo yoledet rishatah vzo yoledet rishatah vechen darkam shel reshaim beinyan ze im yitztzer hara ad shehoreg laadam umolicho laggehinnom umachniso sham veachar kach ole mishsham lefattot livne adam kemo chen umi shemmakkir bo nitztzol mimmennu veeno mitchabber immo

Amar rabbi yitztzechak mashal lema haddavar dome lechatte listim shehau orvim badderachim ligzol velaharog livne adam umafrishim mehem echad sheyyodea lehasit livne adam ulshono rach me avid makdim veholech lekabbelam venaasa keeved lifnehem ad shemmaaminim hatippeshim bo uvotchim beahavato uvsichato usmechim immo umolicham bechelek devarav beoto hadderech shehallistim sham kevan shemmaggia immahem lesham hu harishon shehoreg bam leachar shennotnam beyad hallistim lehargam velakachat mamonam veinnun tzavechin veamrin vay daatztzitna leden velirkicha delishneh leachar shehargu elle ole mishsham veotztze lefattot livne adam kemittechilla happikchim ma hem osim kesheroim laze yotztze likratam umfatte lahem makkirin bo shehu tzode et nafsham vehorgim oto veholchim bederech acheret kach hu yitztzer hara yotztze mikkat hallistim ole miggehinnom lekavla divne nasha ulfattot lahem bechelek metek devarav hada hu dichtiv vayyaal lot mitztzoar vayyishev bahar kemo listim leerov livne adam ma ose over lifnehem vehatippeshim maamanim bo uvahavato shehu holech lefattotam veoved lahem keeved shennoten lahem nashim yafot asurot noten lahem bene adam lehara mefarek mehem ol tora veol malchut shamayim hatippeshim
Yattir missitra achora begin deha bechachmata avad leitdabbeka bedaroma

Vayyomer avraham el sara ishto achoti hi taninan la libae leh levar nash lesamcha al nisa vei kudsha berich hu archish nisa lebbar nash la it leh lesamcha al nisa zimna achora begin delav bechal shaata veshaata itrechish nisa

Vei yeul bar nash garmeh beatar denizka ishtechach leena ha paka kal zechuteh deavad bekadmita veukmuha kema deatte amer katonti mikkal hachasadim umikkal haemet vegv veavraham kevan desalik mimmitzrayim veishteziv zimna chada hashta ammay ail garmeh betzaara kekadmita veamar achoti hi

Ella avraham la samich al garmeh kelum vechama shechinta tadir bediyyurah desara vela aade mittamman uvgin dehavat tamman asmich avraham veamar achoti hi kema dichtiv emor lachachma achoti att uvgin kach amar achoti hi

Vayyavo elohim el avimelech vegv vechi kudsha berich hu ata legabbayehu derashshiayya kema dichtiv vayyavo elohim el bilam vayyavo elohim el lavan ella hahu memanna shelicha deitpakkeda alayehu hava begin dechulhu kad avde shelichuta natle shema da umissitra dedina ka atyan veal da vayyavo elohim el avimelech bachalom hallayela vayyomer lo hincha met al haishsha asher lakachta vegv
Rabbi shimon patach veamar sefat emet vegv sefat emet tikkon laad da avraham dechal milloy bekadmita uvsofa hau beemet vead argia leshon shaker da avimelech
Beavraham neemar vayyomer avraham el sara ishto achoti hi da bekadmita deamar begin shechinta dehavat immah desara achoti hi veavraham bechachmeta avad
222: Roim kach botchim beahavato ad sheholech immahem umolicham beoto derech shehallistim sham bederech gehinnom asher en derech lintot yamin usmol kevan shemmaggia immahem lesham hu harishon shehoreg lahem venaasa lahem malach hammavet umachnisan laggehinnom umoridin lehon malache chabbala veinnun tzavechin veamrin vay daatztzitna leden vela mehanya lon leachar ken ole mishsham veotztze lefattot livne adam happikchin kesheroin oto makkirim oto umitgabberim alav ad sheshsholtin alav vsatin mizze hadderech velokchin derech acheret lehinnatztzel mimmennu

Rav yosef kad hava nachit levavel chama innun ravakaya dehau ayele venafke beni nashshe shappirin vla chatan amar lon la mistafu illen miyitztzer hara amru leh la mikkonditon bisha kaatena mikdushata dekaddisha itgazzarna deamar rav yehuda amar rav tzarich adam lekaddesh atztzemo bishat tashmish venafke minnih beni kaddishe beni maale dela mistafu miyetztzer hara shenneemar vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim

Rabbi abba amar may dichtiv veet shabbetotay kaddeshu ella en onatan shel talmide chachamim ella mishshabbat leshabbat umazhar lehu dehoil detashmish hammita demitztzeva hu kaddeshu kelomar kadshu atztzemechem beshabbetotay behahu tashmish demitztze amar rav yehuda amar rav hay man deayil lekarta vechame nashshe shappiran yarkin enoy veyema hachi bach safan igzar igzarna kardita tekil puk puk deavoy kaddisha deshabbatta hu may tama dechamimut dearcha shalat beh veyachil yitztzer hara leshalta aloy
Begin deavraham missitra deyamina ihu amar achoti hi veraza kema deatte amer achoti raayati yonati tammati veal da avraham kara lah tadir achoti begin deitdabbak bahadah vela yitaddun

Lesof ma ketiv vegam amna achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi vechi hachi hava ella kolla begin shechinta kaamar achoti hi bekadmita dichtiv emor lachachma achoti atte ulvatar vegam amna may vegam leittosfa al ma dekaamar bekadmita achoti vat avi hi beratteh dechachma illaa uvgin kach itkere achoti veitkere chachma ach lo vat immi meatar desheruta decholla setima illaa veal da vattehi li leishsha beachva bachavivuta dichtiv vimino techabbekeni vecholla raza dechachmeta ihu

Ta chaze bekadmita kad nachtu lemitzrayim hachi kaamar begin leitdabbeka bego mehemnuta vekara lah achoti begin dela yitun go innun dargin dilvar uf hacha achoti begin dela itade miggo mehemnuta kedeka yeut

Deha avimelech vechal innun yatve ara hau azle batar pulchana nuchraa veihu itdabbak go mehemnuta uvgin kach al letamman veamar achoti ma achot la itperash meacha lealmin uf hacha deha itteta yechilat leitperasha aval achot la itperash deha teren achin la yachlin leitparsha lealmin ulalme almin

Uvgin kach amar avraham achoti hi deha kulhon hau lehutin go tahore kochvaya umazzale ufalche lon veavraham hava mitdebbak go mehemnuta veamar achoti dela nitperash lealmin vesimanich velaachoto habbetula deittemar lechohen atra deavraham sharya beh
Ketiv et Adonai elohecha tira oto taavod uvo tidbak uvishmo tishshavea hay kera ukmuha aval ta chaze layeya elohecha tira la ketiv ella et
223: Adonai may et da darga kadmaa atar dachala dekudsha berich hu uvgin kach ketiv tira detamman bae bar nash ledachala kamme mareh begin deihu dina

Veoto taavod da darga illaa dekayema al hay darga tattaa vela mitparshan lealmin et veoto da beda devekin vela itparshan may veoto da atar berit kaddisha ot lealmin deha pulchana la sharya beet velav ihu lemiflach ella lemidchal aval pulchana ihu leela uvgin kach veoto taavod
Uvo tidbak beatar deihu devekuta leitdabbeka deihu gufa deshare beemtzaita uvishmo tishshavea atar sheviaa dedargin vesimanich veet david malkam asher akim lahem

Begin chach itdabbak avraham bimhemnuta kad nachat lemitzrayim vechad azal leara diflishtim lebbar nash devaa lenachata go guva amika dachil dela yachil lesalka miggo gova ma avad kashar chad kishra dechevel leela min gova amar hoil dekashirna kishra da mikkan ulhala iul tamman kach avraham beshaata devaa lenachata lemitzrayim ad la yechut tamman keshar kishra dimhemnuta bekadmita leittakkefa beh ulvatar nachat

Uf hachi name kad al leara diflishtim vegin kach sefat emet tikkon laad vead argia leshon shaker da avimelech deamar betom levavi uvnikon kappay vechad ahadderu leh ma ketiv gam anochi yadati ki betam levavcha asita zot vela ketiv nikon kappayim

Veatta hashev eshet haish ki navi hu rabbi yehuda patach veamar ragle chasidav yishmor vegv chasido ketiv chad veda avraham dekudsha berich hu natir leh tador vela aade netiru minneh lealmin uma deamar ragle da itteteh dekudsha berich hu shaddar shechinteh immah venatar lah tadir

Davar acher ragle chasidav yishmor chad da avraham dekudsha berich hu azil immeh tadir begin dela yechlun lenazka leh urshaim bachoshech yiddammu illen innun malchin dakattal kudsha berich hu behahu lelya deradaf batrayehu

Hada hu dichtiv bachoshech yiddammu da lelya deitkashshar bachashocha vekatal lon veavraham radif velelya katil lon hada hu dichtiv vayyechalek alehem layela hu vaavadav vayyakkem vayyechalek alehem layela da kudsha berich hu defalig rachame min dina begin lemebad nukmin leavraham uvgin kach urshaim bachoshech yiddammu vayyakkem vayyakkum mibbae leh ella da kudsha berich hu ki lo vechoach yigbar ish deihu veeliezer hau bilchodayehu

Rabbi yitzchak amar veha taninan beatar denizka shechiach la yismoch bar nash al nisa vela hava atar denizka ishtechach kehay deavraham azil batar chamishsha malchin lemirdaf batrayehu velaagacha kerava amar rabbi yehuda kad azil avraham lehay la azal laagacha kerava vela samach al nisa ella tzaara delot afkeh mibbeteh venatil mamona lemifrak leh vei lav dimut bahadeh go shivyah kevan denafak chama shechinta denahara kammeh vechamma chelin sachoraneh behahi shaata radaf batrayehu vekudsha berich hu katil lon hada hu dichtiv urshaim bachoshech yiddammu

Rabbi shimon amar raza ihu ragle chasidav yishmor da avraham vechad nafak ishtattaf yitzchak bahadeh venaflu kammeh vei lav deishtattaf yitzchak bahadeh deavraham la ishtetziu hada hu dichtiv urshaim bachoshech yiddammu ki lo vechoach yigbar ish af al gav dechela ishtechach tadir beyamina i la hava besitra dismala la itdachyan kammeh

Davar acher ragle chasidav yishmor beshaata debbar nash rachim leh lekudsha berich hu kudsha berich hu rachim leh bechal ma deihu avid venatir archoy kema deatte amer Adonai yishmar tzetcha uvoecha meatta vead olam
Ta chaze kamma chavivuteh deavraham legabbe kudsha berich hu debbechal atar dehava azil la hava chayis al dileh kelum
224: Ela begin leitdabbeka beh bekudsha berich hu uvgin kach ragle chasidav yishmor veda hi itteteh dichtiv vaavimelech lo karav eleha uchtiv ki al ken lo netatticha lingoa eleha

Befaro ma ketiv vayenagga Adonai et paro vegv al devar ihi amra vekudsha berich hu hava mache uvgin kach ragle chasidav yishmor urshaim bachoshech yiddammu illen paro veavimelech dekudsha berich hu avad behu dinin belelya ki lo bechoach yigbar ish man ish da avraham dichtiv veatta hashev eshet haish vegv

Vayeya pakad et sara kaasher amar vegv rabbi chiyya patach veamar vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol omed lifne malach Adonai vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno hay kera it leistakkala beh vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol da yehoshua ben yehotzadak omed lifne malach Adonai man malach Adonai da atar tzerora denishmateh detzaddik tzerira beh vechal innun nishmatin detzaddikaya kayemin tamman veda hu malach Adonai

Vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno da yetzer hara deihu meshotet veazil bealma lenatla nishmatin ulappaka ruchin ulmiste lon livriyyata leela vetatta veda hu beshaata deatil leh nevuchadnetztzar leesha im innun nevie hashsheker vehay hava mastin leela begin deyittokad immehon

Dehachi hu archoy delav ihu mekatreg ella bezimna desakkana uvzimna detzaara sharya bealma veit leh reshu lemiste ulmebad dina afillu bela dina kema deatte amer veyesh nispa belo mishpat mahu lesitno dehava amar o kulhu yishtezvun o kulhu yittokdun deha beshaata deityehiv reshuta limchabbela lechabbala la ishteziv zakkaa min chayyavaya

Uvgin kach beshaata dedina sharya bemata bae bar nash learka ad la itpas tamman deha mechabbela kevan deshare hachi name avid lezakkaa kechayyava vechal shekken dehau telatehon kechad vehava tava deyittokdun kulhu o yishtezvun kulhu begin dechad itavid

Vayeya pakad et sara kaasher amar rabbi yochanan patach behay kera roshech alayich kakkarmel vedallat roshech kaargaman melech asur barhatim asa kudsha berich hu shiltonim lemala veshiltonim lemata keshennoten kudsha berich hu maala lassarim shel mala notlim maala hammelachim shel mata natan maala lesaro shel bavel natal maala nevuchadnetztzar harasha dichtiv beh ante hu resha di dahava vhau kal haolam meshubadim tachat yado uvno uven beno hada hu dichtiv roshech alayich kakkarmel zehu nevuchadnetztzar hada hu dichtiv techotohi tatlel chevat bara vedallat roshech kaargaman zehu belshatztzar deamar argevana yilbash melech asur barhatim zehu evil merodach shehaya asur ad shemmet aviv nevuchadnetztzar umalach tachtav

Amar rabbi yehuda lemay ata hay taam beshir hashshirim ella amar rabbi yehudda shiva devarim nivreu kodem shennivra haolam veellu hen vechu kisse hakkavod shenneemar nachon kisacha meaz meolam atta uchtiv kisse chavod marom merishon shehu haya rosh hannikdam lakkol venatal hakkadosh baruch hu et hanneshama hathora mikkisse hakkavod lihot meira lagguf hada hu dichtiv roshech alayich kakkarmel zehu kisse hakkavod shehu rosh al hakkol vedallat roshech kaargaman zo hi hanneshama hannitelet mimmennu melech asur barhatim zehu hagguf shehu asur bakkever vechala beafar velo nishar mimmennu ella kimlo tarvad rekev umimmennu yibbane kal hagguf uchsheppoked hakkadosh baruch hu et hagguf hu omer laaretz shettaflit oto lachutz dichtiv vertz refaim tappil
Amar rabbi yochanan hammetim shebbaeretz hem chayyim techilla hada hu dichtiv yichu metecha nevelati yekumun ellu shebbechutztza laaretz hakitzu vrannenu
225: Nisa la itavid palgu nisa ufalgu dina ella kolla kechada o nisa o dina

Amar lo rabbi yose vela veha bezimna devaka kudsha berich hu yamma leyisrael hava kara yamma leillen veazlin beyabbeshta umayya hau tavin missitra achora vetavin leillen umetin veishtechach nisa hacha vedina hacha kolla kechada

Amar leh veda hu dekashya kammeh dechad kudsha berich hu avid dina venisa kechada lav beatar chad vela beveta chada vei itavid kashya kammeh deha leela la itavid kolla ella bishlimu kechada o nisa o dina beatar chad vela befalgu

Vegin kach la avid kudsha berich hu dina bechayyavaya ad deishtallimu bechovayehu hada hu dichtiv ki lo shalem aon haemori ad henna uchtiv besasa beshalchah terivenna veal da hava astin leh lihoshua deyittokad behu ad deamar leh yigar Adonai becha hassatan man amar leh da malach Adonai Adonai

Vei tema vayyomer Adonai el hassatan yigar Adonai becha vegv ta chaze hachi name lemoshe bassene dichtiv vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh uchtiv vayyar Adonai ki sar lirot lezimnin malach Adonai ulzimnin malach ulzimnin Adonai uvgin kach amar leh yigar Adonai becha hassatan velo amar hinneni goer becha
Ta chaze kegoona da beoma deishtechach dina bealma vekudsha berich hu yativ al kurseya dedina keden ishtechach hay satan deaste leela vetatta veishtechach ihu lechabbala alma velitol nishmatin

Rabbi shimon hava yativ velae beorayeta vehava mishtaddel behay kera velakchu zi kene hair hahi eglat bakar vegv vearfu sham et haegla bannachal vedina ihu bekufitz learpa lah amar leh rabbi elazar hay lemay itzterich
Bacha rabbi shimon veamar vay lealma deitmeshach batar da deha min hahu yoma dehahu chiveya

Shochne afar ellu hammetim shebbammidbar deamar rabbi yochanan lamma met moshe bechutztza laaretz leharot lechal bae olam keshem sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaot lemoshe kach atid lehachaot ledoro shehem kibbelu hattora vealehem neemar zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich lechtech acharay bammidbar beeretz lo zerua

Davar acher hakitzu vrannenu shochni afar ellu hem haavot vehammetim bechutztza laaretz yibbane gufam umitgalgelim tachat haaretz ad eretz yisrael vsham yekabbelu nishmatam velo bechutztza laaretz hada hu dichtiv lachen hinnave veamarta alehem hinne anochi poteach et kivrotechem vehaaleti etchem mikkivrotechem ammi veheveti etchem el admat yisrael ma ketiv acharav vnatatti ruchi vachem vichyitem

Rabbi pinchas amar hanneshama nitla mikkisse hakkavod shehu harosh kidkaamar roshech alayich kakkarmel vedallat roshech kaargaman zo hi hanneshama shehi dalat harosh melech asur barhatim hu hagguf shehu asur bakvarim zehu hagguf vezehu sara vezehu melech vekudsha berich hu pokdah lammoed asher dibber elav hada hu dichtiv vayeya pakad et sara kaasher amar poked et hagguf lazzeman hayyadua shebbo yfkod hatztzaddikim

Amar rabbi pinchas atid hakkadosh baruch hu leyappot leguf hatztzaddikim leatid lavo keofi shel adam harishon keshennichnas laggan eden shenneemar venachacha Adonai tamid vegv vehayita kegan rave amar ravi levi hanneshama beodah bemaalatah nizonet beor shel mala umitlabbeshet bo uchshettikkanes laguf leatid lavo beoto haor mammash tikkanes veazay hagguf yair kezohar harakia hada hu dichtiv vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia veyassigu beni adam dea shelema shenneemar ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai mena lan ha mimma dichtiv venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia betztzachatztzachot nafshecha ze or shel
226: Bisha deitpatta beh adam shalit al adam veshallit al bene alma ihu kaim lemiste alma vealma la yachil lenafka meansheh ad deyete malka meshicha veokim kudsha berich hu lidmiche afra dichtiv billa hammavet lanetzach vegv uchtiv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz veihu kaim al alma da lemital nishmatin dechal bene nasha

Veta chaze ha ketiv ki yimmatze chalal vegv ta chaze kal bene alma al yede malach hammavet nafka nishmatayehu i tema debbar nash da al yeda dehahu malach hammavet nafak nishmateh lav hachi ella man dekatil leh appik nishmateh ad la mata zimneh leshaltaa beh hahu malach hammavet

Uvgin kach velaaretz lo yechuppar vegv velaaretz dilan vela day lon dekaim ihu lemiste alma lemaggana ulkatrega tadir chal shekken degazlin mineh ma deit leh lenatla vekudsha berich hu chayis al benoy uvgin kach karevin al hay egla begin letakkana immeh ma deitnetil hahi nishmata debbar nash minneh vela yishtechach mekatrega al alma

Veraza illaa taninan hacha shor para egel egla kulhu beraza illaa ishtechachu uvgin kach beda metakkenin leh veda hu dichtiv yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze vegv lo shafchu vela garimna mitateh uvda la ishtechach mekatrega alayehu uvcholla yahiv kudsha berich eta lealma

Ta chaze kegoona da beom rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim dedina ishtechach bealma ihu kaim lekatrega veyisrael bayan leitara beshofar ulatara kol dechalil beesha umaya verucha veitavidu chad ulashmaa hahu kol miggo shofar
Vehahu kol salka ad atar decharseya dedina yatva uvatash bah vesalka kevan demata hay kol mittatta kol deyaakov ittakkan leela vekudsha berich hu

Mala veatztzemotecha yachlitz ze pekidat hagguf vehayita kegan rave uchmotztza mayim asher lo yechazvu memav zehu daat habbore yitbarach veazay yedu habberiyyot shehanneshama hannichneset bahem shehi nishmat hachayyim nishmat hattaanugim shehi kibbela taanugim millemala umadennet lagguf vehakkol temehim bah vomrim ma yafit uma naamte ahava battaanugim zo hi hanneshama leatid lavo

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze shekkach hu dichtiv melech asur barhatim uchtiv batreh ma yafit uma naamte veamar rabbi yehuda beoto zeman atid hakkadosh baruch hu lesammeach olamo velismoach bivriyyotav shenneemar yismach Adonai bemaasav veazay yihye sechok baolam ma sheen achshav dichtiv az yimmale sechok pinu hada hu dichtiv vattomer sara tzechok asa li elohim sheazay atidim bene adam lomar shira shehu et sechok rabbi abba amar hayyom sheyyismach hakkadosh baruch hu im beriyyotav lo hayeta simcha kemotah miyyom shennivra haolam vehatztzaddikim hannisharim birushalayim lo yashuvu od leafram dichtiv vhaya hannishar betztziyyon vehannotar biyerushalami kadosh yeamar lo hannotar betztziyyon uviyerushalami dayeka

Amar rabbi acha im ken zeirin innun ella kal innun deishtearu beara kaddisha deyisrael dina dilhon kiyerushalami uchtziyyon lechal davar melammed dechal eretz yisrael bichlal yerushalami hi mimmashma dichtiv vchi tavou el haaretz hakkol bichlal

Rabbi yehuda berabbi elazar shaal lerabbi chizkiyya amar lo metim sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaotam lamma la yahiv nishmathon beatar deitkevaru tamman veyetun leachaya beara deyisrael amar lo nishba hakkadosh baruch hu livnot yerushalami veshello tehares leolamim deamar rabbi yirmeya atid hakkadosh baruch hu lechadesh olamo velivnot yerushalami ulhoridah benuya millemala begin shello yihares venishba shelo tigle od keneset yisrael venishba shello yehares binyan yerushala shenneemar
227: Itar rachame deha kegavena deyisrael mitare letatta kol chad kalil beesha verucha umaya denafke kechada miggo shofar hachi name itar leela shofar vehahu kol dechalil beesha umaya verucha ittakkan venafak da mittatta veda meela veittakkan alma verachame ishtechachu

Vehahu mekatrega iarbev dechashiv leshaltaa bedina ulkatrega bealma vechame demitare rachame keden iarbav veitteshash cheleh vela yachil lemebad midi vekudsha berich hu dain alma berachame dei tema dedina itavid lav hachi ella itchabbaru rachame bedina vealma itdan berachame

Ta chaze ketiv tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leom chaggenu deitkasya sihara deha keden shalta hay chiveya bisha veyachil lenazka alma vechad mitare rachame salka sihara veitavarat mittamman veihu itarbev vela yachil leshaltaa veitavar dela yitkerav tamman veal da beom rosh hashshana bae learbeva leh keman deitar mishshenateh vela yeda kelum

Beom hakkippurim bae lenayecha ulmebad leh nayecha derucha besair dekarevin leh uchden ithappach sannegorya alayehu deyisrael aval beoma derosh hashshana itarbav dela yeda vela yachil lemebad kelum chame itaruta derachame salkin mittatta verachame milleela vesihara salka benayehu keden itarbav vela yeda kelum vela yachil leshaltaa

Vekudsha berich hu dan lehu leyisrael berachame vechayis alayehu veishtechach lehu zimna kal innun yomin deven rosh hashshana leom hakkippurim lekabbela kal innun detayevin kammeh ulchappara lon mechovayehu vesalik lon leoma dechippure
Veal da becholla kudsha berich hu pakkid lon leyisrael lemebad ovada begin dela yishlot alayehu man dela itzterich vela yishlot alayehu dina vihon kulhon zakkain beara

Lo yiamer lach od azuva ulartzech lo yeamer od shemama uvchal makom sheatta motztze lo lo hi shevua hada hu dichtiv velo yikkaret kal basar od mimme hammabbul vlo yihye od mabbul vegv uchtiv asher nishbati meavor me noach mikkan shello lo shevua umin lav atta shomea hen veatid hakkadosh baruch hu lekayyem olamo kiyyum shello tigle keneset yisrael velo tehares binyan bet hammikdash lefichach en mekabbelin nishmatan ella bemakom kayyam leolamim kede shettihye hanneshama kayyemet bagguf leolamim vda hu dichtiv hannishar betztziyyon vhannotar biyerushalam kadosh yeamer lo

Amar rabbi chizkiyya mehacha hu kadosh yerushalam kadosh hannotar bah kadosh hu kadosh dichtiv kadosh Adonai tzevaot uchtiv bekirbech kadosh yerushalami kadosh dichtiv umimmakom kadosh yehallechu hannotar bah kadosh dichtiv vhaya hannishar betztziyyon vehannotar biyerushalami kadosh yeamer lo ma kadosh harishon kayyam af hashshear kadosh kadosh kayyam

Amar rabbi ytzchak may dichtiv od yeshvu zekenim uzkenot birchovot yerushalam veish mishanto beyado merov ymim may tivuta da lemezal keden dichtiv veish mishanto beyado ella amar rabbi yitztzechak atidim hatztzaddikim leatid lavo lehachaot metim keelisha hannavi dichtiv vekach mishanti beyadcha valech uchtiv vesamta mishanti al pene hannaar amar leh kudsha berich hu davar sheatidim laasot hatztzaddikim leatid lavo atta rotztze achshav laasot ma ketiv vayyasem et hammishenet al pene hannaar ven kol veen one veen kashev aval hatztzaddikim leatid lavo ala beyadam havtacha zo dichtiv veish mishanto beyado kede lehachaot bo et hammetim mehaggerim shennitgayeru meummot haolam dichtiv behu ki hannaar ben
228: Kirchimu deabba al benin vecholla beovada uvmillin talya veha okimna millin
Mea shana yamut vehachote ben mea shana yekulal amar rabbi yitztzechak sofeh dikra mochiach dichtiv merov yamim

Davar acher vattomer sara tzechok asa li elohim ketiv simchu et yerushalami vegilu vah kal ohaveha sisu ittah masos kal hammitabbelim aleha amar rabbi yehuda lo hayeta simcha lifne hakkadosh baruch hu miyyom shennivra haolam keotah simcha sheatid lismoach im hatztzaddikim leatid lavo vechal echad veechad mare baetztzebba vomer hinne elohenu ze kivinu lo veoshienu ze Adonai kivinu lo nagila vnismecha bishuato uchtiv zammeru Adonai ki geut asa mudaat bechal haaretz

Rabbi yochanan amar lo chazinan man depparish hay milla kedavid malka deamar tastir pancha yibbahelun mikkan sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ose raa leshum adam ella kesheeno mashgiach bo hu kale meelav dichtiv tastir panecha yibbahelun tosef rucham yigvaun vegv veachar kach teshallach ruchacha yibbereun veachar kach yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav veazay hassechok baolam dichtiv az yimmale sechok pinu ulshonenu rinna hada hu dichtiv vtomer sara tzechok asa li elohim lismoach bishuato

Rabbi chiyya amar ta chaze ad shehagguf omed baolam hazze hu chaser min hattashlum leachar shehu tzaddik veholech bedarche yosher umet beoshro nikra sara betashlumo higgia litchiyyat hammetim hu sara kede shello yomru sheacher hu shehecheya kudsha berich hu leachar shehu chay vesameach im hashshechina umaavir hakkadosh baruch hu hayyagon min haolam dichtiv billa hammavet lanetztzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kal panim azay nikra yitztzechak bishvil hatztzechok vehassimcha sheyyihye latztzaddikim leatid lavo
Rabbi yehuda ata lehahu atar dichfar chanan shadru leh tikrovta kal bene mata al legabbeh rabbi abba amar leh ematay lezil mar amar leh efra ma deyahavu li

Vayeya pakad et sara kaasher amar dichtiv lammoed ashuv elecha kaet chayya ulsara ven vetaninan pakad et sara pekida lenukva zechira lidchura uvgin kach vayeya pakad et sara kaasher amar dichtiv shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya vegv mehacha mashma deamar vayyomer shov ashuv elecha vayyomer setam deihu hava vela shelicha achora

Vayyaas Adonai lesara vegv kevan deamar vayeya pakad et sara mahu vayyaas Adonai lesara ella hachi taninan deiba deovadoy dekudsha berich hu mehahu nahar denagid venafik meeden ihu veihu nishmathon detzaddikayya veihu mazzala dechal birchan tavan vegishme birchan nazle minneh umittamman nafke dichtiv lehashkot et haggan deihu mazzil umashke meela letatta begin devane behay mazzala talyan vela beatar achora veal da ketiv vayeya pakad et sara pekida bilchodoy
Vayyaas Adonai lesara asiyya ihu leela mehay darga kema deittemar deha bemazzela talya veal da kan pekida vechan asiyya uvgin kach amar Adonai vayeya vecholla chad

Rabbi elazar patach veamar hinne nachalat Adonai banim sachar peri habbaten hinne nachalat Adonai achsanta leitachada bayeya dela yitavar minah lealmin devar nash dezache livnin behay alma zache behu lemeal lefargoda bealma deate begin dehahu bera deshavik bar nash vezache beh bealma da ihu yizke leh lealma deate vezache leaala beh lenachalat Adonai man nachalat Adonai da eretz hachayyim vehachi kara lah leeretz yisrael deihi eretz hachayyim
David malka nachalat Adonai dichtiv ki gershuni hayyom mehistappeach benachalat Adonai lemor lech avod elohim acherim uvgin kach hinne nachalat Adonai
229: Beni mata veezil amar leh la lechush mar lehay tikrovta leorayeta hu deavdu vela yekabbelu minnach kelum amar leh vela mekabbele mille deorayeta amar in atu kal beni mata amar leh rabbi yehuda kullehon mare metivta amar leh vi it man dela yaot lemetav hacha lekum velezil kam rabbi abba veavdil minnayehu asara di yekabbelun minnih amar lehu yettivu bahade gavra rabba dena vana vinnun nekabbel lemachar venetiv immeh azlu vinnun asara deishtaaru immeh yetivu vela amar kelum amru leh i reuteh demar nekabbel appe shechinta amar lehu vha rabbi abba let hacha shadru bahadeh veata

Patach veamar vayeya pakad et sara kaasher amar may shinnuya hava hacha hava leh lememar vayeya zachar et sara kema deamar vayyizkor elohim et rachel deen pekida ella al ma dehava bekadmita ella bekadmita hava dichtiv shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya veal oto inyan neemar sheppakad achshav mashma dichtiv kaasher amar deilmale lo neemar kaasher amar lema zechira aval pakad hahi milla deamar lammoed ashuv elecha

Levatar amar hachi hay tzaddik dezache lemesak lehahu yekar illaa diukneh mitpattach becharse yekorih vchen lechal tzaddik vetztzaddik diukneh leela kad hava letatta leavtacha lehahi nishmata kaddisha

Vehayenu deamar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv shemesh yareach amad zevula dezaharan gufa venishmata dekayemin beidra kaddisha illaa dilela kidiukna dehava kaim beara vhahi diukna mimmezonah hanaat nishmata vhahi atida leitlabbash behay garma deishtaar beara veara mitavar minnih vtafal tineh levara veda hu deitkere kedusha
Vechad kayema diukna hahi dilela ata bechal yarcha
Banim man azke leh levar nash benin i zache behu behay alma sachar peri habbaten agra vechulaka tava behahi alma behahu iba demeoy ihu dezache bar nash behahu alma behu

Ta chaze hinne nachalat Adonai banim yeruta veachsanta deibin deovadoy dekudsha berich hu milleela ihu meilana dechayye deha mittamman zache bar nash livnin kema deatte amer mimmenni peryecha nimtza ma ketiv ashre haggever asher mille et ashpato mehem lo yevoshu vegv ashre bealma den veashre bealma deate

Lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyevim bashshaar man oyevim bashshaar illen marihon dedinin dechad nishmata nafkat mehay alma kamma innun marehon dedinin dezamminin kammeh ad la yeul leduchteh bashshaar behahu tara deyeul tamman begin demashkonin shavik behay alma uvginehon yizke behahu alma veal da lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyevim bashshaar

Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose hau azle bearcha amar leh rabbi yehuda lerabbi yose petach pumach velae beorayeta deha shechinta ishtakkechat gabbach dechal zeman divmille deorayeta laan shechinta atya umitchabbera vechal shekken beorcha

Patach rabbi yose veamar eshtecha kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha banecha kishtile zetim saviv leshulchancha eshtecha kegefen poriyya kal zimna deitteta beyarkete veta vela nafka levar hi tzenua veitchaze leolada benin dechashran kegefen ma gefen la itnata la bezinah vela bezina achora kach itteta dechashra la teevad netian bevar nash achora ma gefen la it beh rechiva meilana achora uf hachi itteta dechashra hachi name
230: Lesagda kamme malka kaddisha berich hu dichtiv vhaya midde chodesh bechadsho vhu mevasser leh veamar lammoed ashuv elecha lehahu zeman deatid leachaya metaya ad deitpakdat lehahu zimna kema deitbassar hada hu dichtiv vayeya pakad et sara kaasher amar vehahu yoma dechade kudsha berich hu beovadoy hada hu dichtiv yismach Adonai bemaasav

Amar leh rabbi abba nema lan mar al parashata levatar amar yaot lechon lemiftach parshata da patach veamar vayehi achar haddevarim haelle vehaelohim nissa et avraham vegv vayyomer kach na et bincha et yechidcha asher ahavta vegv hacha it leistakkala hay umana deappik kaspa mimkora deara may avad bekadmita meayyil leh benur dalik ad denafik minnih kal zuhama deara veha ishtaarat kaspa aval la chaspa shelemata levatar may avid meayyil leh benura kidvekadmita umappik minneh setayefe kema deatte amer hago sigim mikkasef vegv uchden hu kaspa shelemata bela irbuvya
Kach hakkadosh baruch hu meayyil hay gufa techot ara ad demitrekav kuleh venafik minneh kal zuhama bisha vishtaar hahu tarvad rekev veitbene gufa minnih vead kean hu gufa la shelim

Levatar hahu yoma rabba dichtiv vhaya yom echad hu yivada layeya lo yom velo layela mittammeran kullehu beafra kidvekadmita min kodam dechilu vtakkifu dekudsha berich hu hada hu dichtiv uvau bimarot tzurim uvimchillot afar mippene pachad Adonai umehadar geono vegv venafik nishmatayehu umitakkel hahu tarvad rekev vishtaar guppa deitbene tamman dileh kinhora deshimsha uchzahara dirkia dichtiv vhammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia uchden kaspa shelim gufa shelema bela irbuvya achranayeta
Banecha kishtile zetim ma zetim la nafle tarpayehu kal yome shatta vechullehu keshurin tadir uf hachi banecha kishtile zetim saviv leshulchanecha

Ma ketiv batreh hinne chi chen yevorach gaver yere Adonai may hinne chi chen yevorach gaver hinne chen mibbae leh ella leasgaa milla achora deolifna da minah dechal zimna dishchinta hava tzenia beatrah kedeka chaze lah kivyachol banecha kishtile zetim illen yisrael kad sharan beara saviv leshulchancha deachle veshatan ukrevin karbanin vechadan kamme kudsha berich hu umitbarchan illain vetattain beginayehu

Levatar dishchinta nafkat itgalu yisrael meal petora deavuhon vehau bene ammamaya vetzavechin kal yoma velet deashgach behu bar kudsha berich hu dichtiv veaf gam zot bihotam beeretz oyevehem vegv vechaminan kamma kaddishin illain mitu bigzerin takkifin vechal da begin onasha deorayeta dela kiyemu yisrael kad hau sharan beara kaddisha

Chame ma ketiv tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvtuv levav merov kol hay kera ihu raza tachat asher lo avadta besimcha bizman dechohane hau kerevin karbanin vaalavan veda hi besimcha uvtuv levav illen levae merov kol ellu yisrael dehau emtzaiyyim benayehu venatle birchan mikkal sitrin

Dichtiv hirbita haggoy lo higdalta hassimcha illen kahane samchu lefanecha kesimchat bakkatzir ellu yisrael dekudsha berich hu barich lon ibbura dechakla veyahave maasra mikkolla kaasher yagilu bechallekam shalal illen levae denatla maasra miggo idra
Davar acher hirbita haggoy illen yisrael dimhemnuta dekudsha berich hu alayehu kedeka chaze lo higdalta hassimcha da ihu darga resha illaa deavraham deitdabbak bah deihu gadol vechedva beh ishtakkach
231: Gufa denahir yirme kudsha berich hu milleela dichtiv ki tal orot tallecha uchtiv hinne Adonai metaltelcha uchden yitkerun kaddishin illain dichtiv kadosh yeamer lo veda hu deitkere techiyyat hammetim devatrayeta veda hu batrayeta vela yitamun od taama demota dichtiv bi nishbati neum Adonai ki yan asher asita vegv ki barech avarechcha vegv uvhahu zimna matztzelu tzaddikayya dela yitnassun beda ytir

Ma ketiv vayyissa avraham et enav vayyar vehinne ayil illen shear chayyave alma deitkerun elim kema deatte amer ele nevaot yeshartunech umtargeminan ravreve nevaot achar neechaz bassevach vegv kema deatte amer vechal karne reshaim agaddea vayyilech avraham vayyikkach et haayil vegv deinnun mezumanin leitnassaa bechal nisona bisha veyishtaarun hatztzaddikim lealma deate kemalachin illain kaddishin leyachada shemeh uvgin kach ketiv bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushmo echad
