Amar leh rabbi yehuda mikkan ulhala atztzelachu pitcha al yoma achora alu kammeh kal beni mata amru leh lema lan mar millaya deorayeta befarshata dekarenan bah yoma deshabbatta vayeya pakad et sara kam bene ammude patach veamar vayeya pakad et sara vegv shalosh maftechot beyado shel hakkadosh baruch hu velo mesaram lo beyad malach velo beyad saraf mafteach shel chayya veshel geshamim veshel techiyyat hammetim ba eliyyahu venatal hashshenayim shel geshamim veshel techiyyat hammetim veamar rabbi yochanan lo nimsar beyad eliyyahu ella achat deamar rabbi yochanan keshebbikkesh eliyyahu lehachaot ben hatztzarfit amar leh kudsha berich hu la yaot lach lemesav bidach shette maftechot ella ten li mafteach haggeshamim utchayye hammet vhayenu dichtiv lech herae el achav vegv veettena matar lo amar vten matar ella veettena

Beshaata desalkin leitdabbeka bach kesimchat bakkatzir da keneset yisrael desimchat bakkatzir dileh hava kaasher yagilu bechallekam shalal kaasher yagilu illen shear chelin urtichin letatta bezimna dimchalleke shalal vetarfe tarfa bereshita decholla

Rabbi yehuda patach veamar et laasot layeya heferu toratecha et laasot layeya mahu ella ha ukmuha aval et da keneset yisrael deikre et kema deatte amer veal yavo vechal et el hakkodesh may veal yavo vechal et kema deatte amer lishmarcha meishsha zara veda hu vayyakrovu lifne Adonai esh zara vegv may tama et begin deit lah et uzman lecholla lekarva leitnahara leitchabbera kedeka yeut kema deatte amer vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon

Laasot layeya kema dichtiv vayyaas david shem dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta keilu avid vetakken hay et lechabbera lah bekudsha berich hu vechal kach lamma begin deheferu toratecha deilu lo heferu toratecha la ishtakkach piruda dekudsha berich hu miyyisrael lealmin
Amar rabbi yose kegavvena da ketiv ani Adonai beittah achishenna mahu beittah beet Adonai detakum meafra keden achishenna
Amar rabbi yose veim kal da yoma chad neelamti dumiyya begin deistallak min vekol la ishtakkach keden dibbur itallam
Uvgin kach hi shechivat beafra kal hahu yoma deh uman ihu elef chamishshaa veaf al gav deakdimat begaluta ad la yeul hahu elef chamishshaa raza deh
Vechad yete elef shetitaa deihu raza
232: Leh in lekayyem pi shenayim berucho shel eliyyhu ella shelashtam lo mesaram hakkadosh baruch hu beyad shaliach deamar rabbi simon bo ure kocho shel hakkadosh baruch hu befaam achat mechayyi metim umorid sheol vayyaal mazriach meorot umorid geshamim matztzemiach chatztzir medashshen yevulim poked akarot noten parnasot ozer dallim somech noflim zokef kefufim mehaade malchin umhakem malchin vehakkol bizman echad uvrega echad uvvat achat ma sheen shaliach leolam yachol laasoto

Tanya amar rabbi yose kal ma sheose hakkadosh baruch hu eno tzarich laasot ella bedibbur dechevan deamar mimmekom kedushato yehe chach miyyad naasa bo ure koach gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu deamar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv veavarti beeretz mitztzerayim ani velo malach

I hachi yekara saggia hu lemitztzerae dela dame man detafas malka leman detafas hedota veod en lecha uma mezuhemet bechal tuma kemo hammitztzerim dichtiv behu asher besar chamorim besaram vegv shehem chashudim al mishkav zachur vehem baim mecham sheasa ma sheasa leaviv vekillel oto velichnaan beno vechi lo haya lehakkadosh baruch hu malach o shaliach leshagger laasot nekama bemitztzerayim kemo sheasa beashshur shehaya beno shel shem dichtiv uvne shem elam veashshur vshem haya kohen gadol venitbarech shenneemar baruch Adonai elohe shem vehaya leshem haggedulla vehabberacha al echav uchtiv bam vayyitztze malach Adonai vayyakke bemachane ashshur veal yede shaliach naasa chal shekken hammitztzerim shehem mezuhamim yoter mikkal uma vamar ani velo malach

Ella amar rabbi yehuda mikkan lamadnu koach gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu umaalato shehu gavoha al hakkol amar hakkadosh baruch hu uma zo shel mitztzerayim mezuhemet umtunefet ven rauy leshagger malach velo saraf davar kadosh ben reshaim arurim metunafim ella ani
Dev keden yokim leh bezimna shit zimnin eser shittin nefesh keden shelimu eser zimnin shit zimnin eser salka be nachata beh

Ishtelim go eser shit zimnin keden hau shittin leakma meafra uvchal shittin veshittin mehahu elef shetitaa ittakkaf vesalka bedargoy leittakkefa uvshit mea shenin lishtitaa yitpattechun tare dechachmeta leela umabbue dechachmeta letatta veyittakkan alma leaola bishviaa kevar nash demittakkan beoma shetitaa mechi arav shimsha leaala beshabbatta uf hachi name vesimanich bishnat shesh meot shana lechayye noach vegv nivkeu kal mayenot tehom rabba

Amar leh rabbi yose kal da arichu zimna yattir mikkema deukmuha chavraya deihu yoma chad galuta dichneset yisrael vela yattir dichtiv netanani shomema kal hayyom dava amar leh hachi olifna meabba berazin deatvan dishma kaddisha uvome dishne alma uvome divreshit vecholla raza chada ihu
Uchden yitchaze kashta baanana bigvane nehirin keitteta demitkashsheta levaalah dichtiv uritiha lizkor berit olam veha ukmuha veshappir hu uritiha bigvanin nehirin kedeka yeut

Uchden lizkor berit olam man berit olam da keneset yisrael veyitchabbar beh veyekim lah meafra kema deatte amer vayyizkor elohim et berito da keneset yisrael deihi berit kema deatte amer vehayeta leot berit vegv
Kad yitar legabbe keden atin illain yitarun bealma uvnoy diruven zeminin deyitarun keravin bechal alma uchneset yisrael yokim lah meafra veyidkar lah kudsha berich hu
Veyishtakkach kudsha berich hu legabbah go galuta kechushban shit zimnin eser zimnin shit shenin uchden tekum veyitpakad alma lemebad nukmin uman deihu maich yitreme
Amar leh rabbi yose shappir kaamarte begin
233: Ose ma sheen yachol laasot malach velo saraf velo shaliach sheani omer mimmekom kedushshati yehe chach umiyyad naasa ma sheen hammalach yachol laasoto aval hakkadosh baruch hu mimmekom kedushshato omer yehe chach umiyyad naasa ma shehu rotztze laasot ulfichach lo naaset nekama zo al yede malach veshaliach bishvil kelon hammitztzerim ulharot gedullato shel makom shello ratztza sheyyikkansu benehem davar kadosh veal hadderech hazze neemar ani velo malach ani yachol laasoto velo malach

Kayyotztze bo amar rabbi yehuda may dichtiv vayyomer Adonai laddag vechamma tzaddikim vachasidim miyyisrael shello dibber immahem hakkadosh baruch hu uva ledabber im haddag davar sheeno makkir veodea ella amar rabbi yehuda kevan shealta tefillato shel yona lifne hakkadosh baruch hu mimmekom kedushshato amar bishvil sheyyaki haddag et yona el hayyabbasha laddag kemo bishvil kelomar vayyomer Adonai bishvil haddag sheyyaki et yona el hayyabbasha mimmekom kedushshato amar hakkadosh baruch hu yehe chach umiyyad naasa ma sheen shaliach yachol laasoto

Tanya amar rabbi shimon mafteach shel chaya beyado shel hakkadosh baruch hu hi uvod shehi yoshevet al hammashber hakkadosh baruch hu meayyen beoto havvelad im rauy hu latztzet laolam poteach daltot bitnah veotztze veim lav soger daltoteha umetu shenehem i hachi lo yitztze rasha laolam ella hachi taninan al shalosh averot nashim metot vechu veamar rabbi yitztzechak lamma ishsha mappelet peri vitnah ella amar rabbi yitztzechak hakkadosh baruch hu roe oto haubbar sheeno rauy latztzet laolam umakdim lahamito bime immo shenneemar hannefilim hau baaretz bayyamim hahem hannefilim ketiv belo yud rishona velamma bishvil sheachare chen bau bene haelohim el benot haadam veyaldu lahem biznut vayyirbu

Deihu go raza deatvan velet lan leatara chushban vekitztzin achoranin deha besifra derav yeva sava ashkechan chushban da dichtiv az tirtze haaretz vehu raza dev dichtiv vezacharti et beriti yaakov veda hu kolla kechada veal da ezkor ulvatar vehaaretz ezkor da keneset yisrael tirtze titree ara legabbe kudsha berich hu

Aval yoma chad deamru chavraya vadday kolla hu ganiz kamme kudsha berich hu vecholla ishtechach beraza deatvan dishma kaddisha deha galuta beinnun atvan gale lon rabbi yesa hacha vehashta beinnun atvan itgalleyan vegale lon

Amar leh ta chaze deafilu kad itpakkeda sara mehay darga la pakkid lah ella beraza dev dichtiv vayeya pakad et sara vegv begin decholla beraza dev ihu uvha kalil kolla uveh itgalleya kolla begin dechal milla deihi setima ihi galle kal satim vela ate man deihu beitgalleya vigalle ma deihu satim

Amar rabbi yose kamma it lan leitmashshecha go galuta ad hahu zimna vecholla tale leh kudsha berich hu kad yetuvun bituvta i yizku vei la yizku kema deitmar behay kera dichtiv ani Adonai beittah achishenna zachu achishenna lo zachu beittah

Azlu ad dehau azle amar rabbi yose adkarna hashta deha beatar da yativna yoma chad im abba veamar li beri zammin ante kad matun yomach leshitin shenin leashkacha behay atar sima dechachmeta illaa veha zachina leinnun yomin vela ashkachna vela yedana i hanne millin dekaamaran o hahi chachmeta deihu amar
Veamar li kad yimtun kulfin denura go tehire yedach itavid minach amina leh abba bamme yedate amar li behanne teren tzipporin deaavaru al reshach yedana
Addehachi itperash rabbi yose veal go mearta
234: Hemma haggibborim asher meolam sheen gibbor ufaritz varitz kemo hammamzir anshe hashshem shehakkol yakkiru likroto hashshem hayyadua mamzir dechevan sheroim maasav shehu paritz vearitz vegibbor hakkol yikreuhu oto shem uma deamar rabbi shimon hakkadosh baruch hu meayyen beoto havvelad en lecha rasha baolam meotam harshaim hayyotztzeim laolam sheen hakkadosh baruch hu meayyen bo vroe im oto hagguf yanniach ben tzaddik vechasher o sheyyatztzil leadam miyyisrael mimmita meshunna o sheyyaase tova achat uvishvil kach hakkadosh baruch hu motztzio laolam

Beomoy derabbi yose hau innun peritze dehau meshaddede beturayya im peritze ummot haolam vechad mashkeche bar nash vetafse leh lekatleh hau amrin leh ma shemach i hava yuday hau azlin immeh umafkin leh min turayya vei hava bar nash acharina katle leh vhava amar rabbi yose itchazun innun bechol hay lemeal lealma deate

Tanu rabbanan devarim hallalu enan bain laolam ella bekolot kol chayya dichtiv beetztzev teldi banim uchtiv vayyishma eleha elohim kol geshamim dichtiv kol Adonai al hammayim uchtiv ki kol hamon haggashem kol techiyyat hammetim dichtiv kol kore bammidbar may bae hacha kala bemadbera ella amar rabbi zerika illen innun kalaya leatara mete midbar umikkan dehu haddin lechal haolam amar rabbi yochanan ha tenan keshennichnas adam lakkever nichnas bekolot kesheyyakumu bitchiyyat hammetim eno din sheyyakumu bekole kolot

Amar rabbi yakov atida bat kol lihot mitpotztzetztzet bevatte kevarot veomeret hakitzu vrannenu shochni afar vaatidim lichot betal shel or gadol shel mala dichtiv ki tal orot tallecha veeretz refaim tappil
Chada veashkach sifra chad dehava naitz go nukva detinnara bisyafe mearta nafak beh

Kevan defatach leh chama shivin utren gelifin deatvan deitmesaru leadam harishon uvhu hava yada kal chachmeta deillain kaddishin vechal innun devatar rechaya demitgalgelan batar paruchta go tehirin illain vechal innun millin dezamminin lemete lealma ad yoma deyekum anana devistar maarav veyachshich alma

Kara lerabbi yehuda vesharu lemile behahu sifra la sefiku lemile tere o telata sitrin deinnun atvan ad dehau mistakkelin behahi chachma illaa kevan dematu lemile bistiru desifra umishtau da im da nafak sheviva deesha veilula derucha uvatash bidehon veitavid minnayehu bacha rabbi yose veamar dilma chas veshalom chova ihu gabban o delav anan zakkin leminda leh

Kad atun legabbe derabbi shimon ishtau leh ovada da amar lon dilma beketz meshicha deinnun atvan havetun mishtaddele amru leh da la yadinan deha kolla itneshe minan amar lon rabbi shimon let reuta dekudsha berich hu beda deyitgele kal kach lealma vechad yehe kariv leome meshicha afilu ravye dealma zeminin leashkacha temirin dechachmeta ulminda beh kitztzin vechushbenin uvhahu zimna itgalleya lecholla hada hu dichtiv ki az ehpoch el ammim vegv mahu az bezimna detekum keneset yisrael meafra veokim lah kudsha berich hu keden ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai ulavdo shechem echad

Ta chaze af al gav deavraham ketiv beh vayyissa avram haloch venasoa hannegba vechal matlanoy hau ledaroma veitkashshar beh la salik leduchteh kedeka yeut ad deityelid yitzchak kevan deityelid yitzchak istallak leatreh veihu ishtattaf bahadeh veitkashsheru
235: Vegin kach ihu kare leh yitzchak vela achora begin leshattefa maya beesha dichtiv vayyikra avraham et shem beno hannolad lo asher yalda lo sara yitzchak man hannolad lo esh mimmayim

Vattere sara et ben hagar hammitzrit asher yalda leavraham metzachek amar rabbi chiyya miyyoma deityelid yitzchak vehava yishmael beveta deavraham la istallak yishmael bishma beatar dedahava sharya sosfita la idkar kammeh uvgin kach et ben hagar hammitzrit gevar dela yitchaze leadkara kammeh deyitzchak

Amar rabbi yitzchak vattere sara beena diklana chamat leh sara dela chamat leh beena deihu bera deavraham ella deihu bera dehagar hammitzrit uvgin kach vattere sara desara chamat leh beena da velo avraham deilu beavraham lo ketiv et ben hagar ella et beno
Ta chaze levatar ma ketiv vayyera haddavar meod beeni avraham al odot beno vela ketiv al odot ben hagar hammitzrit vegin kach vattere sara et ben hagar hammitzrit vela chamat deihu berih deavraham

Rabbi shimon amar hay kera tushbachta desara ihu begin dechamat leh deka metzachek lekkochavim umazzalot amra vadday lav bera da bera deavraham lemeevad ovadoy deavraham ella bera dehagar hammitzrit ihu ahaddar lechulaka deimmeh vegin kach vattomer leavraham garesh haama hazzot veet benah ki lo yirash ben haama hazzot im beni im yitzchak

Vechi salka datach dekanne lah sara o livrah i hachi lo ode kudsha berich hu immah dichtiv kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah ella begin dechamat leh bekkochavim umazzalot veimmeh ulfa leh nimmuse dekkochavim umazzalot begin kach amrat sara ki lo yirash ben haama hazzot ana yadana dela yarit lealmin chulaka dimhemnuta vela yehe leh im beri chulaka la bealma den vela bealma deate uvgin chach ode immah kudsha berich hu

Vekudsha berich hu baa leafrasha bilchodoy zara kaddisha kedeka yeut divgin kach bara alma deha yisrael salik biruta dekudsha berich hu ad la yivre alma uvgin kach nafak avraham lealma vealma mitkayyem begineh veavraham veyitzchak kayemu vela ityashvu beduchtayehu ad denafak yaakov lealma

Kevan denafak yaakov lealma itkayemu avraham veyitzchak veitkeyyam kal alma umittamman nafak amma kaddisha lealma veitkeyyam kolla kegavena kaddisha kedeka yeut uvgin kach amar leh kudsha berich hu kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara velo beyishmael ma ketiv levatar vattelech vatteta bemidbar beer shava
Ketiv hacha vatteta uchtiv hatam hevel hemma maase tatuim vekudsha berich hu begineh deavraham la shavik lah velivrah

Ta chaze bekadmita chad azlat mikkammah desara ma ketiv ki shama Adonai el anyech vehashta detaat batar kochavim umazzalot af al gav dichtiv vattissa et kolah vattevcha ma ketiv ki shama elohim el kol hannaar vela ketiv ki shama elohim et kolech

Baasher hu sham ha ukmuha delav bar onasha hu legabbe be dina dilela deha be dina diltatta anshin mittelesar shenin ulela uve dina dilela meesrim shenin ulhala veaf al gav dechayyava hava lav bar onasha ihu veha ukmuha veda hu dichtiv baasher hu sham

Amar rabbi elazar i hachi man deistallak mealma ad la matun yomoy leesrin shenin mean atar itannash begin deha mittelesar shenin ultatta lav bar onasha ihu ela bechetoy deavoy aval mittelesar shenin ulela mahu amar leh kudsha berich hu chas aleh delemut zakkay veyahiv leh agar tav behahu alma vela lemut chayyav deyitannash behahu alma veukmuha
Amar leh i chayyava hu vela matun yomoy
236: Leesrin shenin mahu kevan deistallak mealma bemay hu onsheh amar leh beda itkeyyam veyesh nispa belo mishpat dechad onasha nachit lealma ihu aara bela kavana leela vetatta behahu mechabbela veyitannash kad la ashgachu aleh milela

Vealeh ketiv aonotav yilkeduno et harasha leasgaa man dela matun yomoy leitanasha aonotav yilkeduno vela be dina dilela uvchavle chattato yittamech vela be dina diltatta begin kach ketiv ki shama elohim el kol hannaar baasher hu sham

Rabbi shimon patach veamar vezacharti et beriti yaakov male bev ammay ella bitren sitrin ihu raza dechachmeta chada deihu raza darga dechachmeta atar deshare beh yaakov aval hay kera al galuta deyisrael ittemar dechad innun go galuta hahu zimna deyitpakdun yitpakdun beraza dev veihu beelef shetitaa

Ufkida beraza dev shit rige uflag idan uvzimna deshittin shenin leibbura dedashsha beelef shetitaa yakim elah shemaya pekidu livratteh deyaakov umehahu zimna ad diyehe lah zechira shit shenin ufalga umehahu zimna shit shenin achoranin veinnun shivin utren uppalga

Beshitin veshit yitgele malka meshicha beara degalil vechad kochava devistar mizrach yivla sheva kochvaya mistar tzafon veshalhova deesha uchma tehe talya birkia shitin yomin ukravin yitarun bealma listar tzafon utrin malchin yippelun beinnun keravin

Veyizdavvegun kullehon ammemaya al beratteh deyaakov leidachya lah mealma veal hahu zimna ketiv veet tzara hi leyaakov umimmennah yivashea uchden yistayemun nafshin miggufa uvayan leitchaddesha vesimanich kal hannefesh habbaa leyaakov mitzrayema vegv kal nefesh shishshim vashesh

Beshivin utlat kal malche alma yitkanneshun lego karta rabbeta deromi vekudsha berich hu yitar alayehu esha uvarda veavne algavish veyitabbedun mealma bar innun melachin dela yimtun letamman vihadderun leaggacha keravin achoranin umehahu zimna malka meshicha yitar bechal alma veyitkanneshun immeh kamma ammin vechamma chayyalin mikkal seyafe alma vechal bene yisrael yitkanneshun bechal innun atre

Ad deishtallimu innun shenin lemea keden yitchabbar beh uchden veheviu et kal achechem mikkal haggoyim mincha layeya vegv uvne yishmael zeminin behahu zimna leatara im kal ammin dealma lemete al yerushalem dichtiv veasafti et kal haggoyim el yerushala lamilchama vegv uchtiv yityatztzevu malche eretz veroznim nosdu yachad al Adonai veal meshicho uchtiv yoshev bashshamayim yischak Adonai yilag lamo

Levatar zeira yitar leitchabbara ulchaddesha nishmatin dehau attikin begin lechadta alma kema dichtiv yismach Adonai bemaasav uchtiv yehi chevod Adonai leolam leitchabbara kedeka yeut yismach Adonai bemaasav lenachata lon lealma ulmeheve kullehon beriyan chadtin lechabbera almin kullehu kechad

Zakkain innun kal innun deyishtaarun bealma bisyafe elef shetitaa lemeal beshabbatta deha keden ihu yoma chad lekudsha berich hu bilchodoy leizdavvega kedeka yeut ulmilkat nishmatin chadtin lemeheve bealma im innun deishtaaru bekadmita dichtiv vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyerushalam kadosh yeamer lo kal hakkatuv lechayyim biyerushala
Vayehi achar haddevarim haelle vehaelohim nissa et avraham vayyomer elav avraham vayyomer hinnini rabbi yehuda patach veamar atta hu malki vegv da hu shelimu dechal dargin kechada da beda
Tzave yeshuot yaakov kal innun shelichan deavde shelichuta
237: Bealma delehve kullehu missitra derachame vela leho missitra dedina begin deit mare shelichan missitra derachame umissitra dedina kashya innun shelichan deatyan missitra derachame la avde shelichuta dedina bealma kelal

Vei tema ha malacha deitgele leh levilam ha taninan shelicha derachame hava veithappach ledina la leolam la ishtanne ella shelicha derachame hava laagana alayehu deyisrael ulmeheve sannegorya alayehu ulkovleh hu dina vechach orchoy dekudsha berich hu kad otiv leda hahu tivu dina leda kach ha shelicha derachame hava lehu leyisrael ulvilam ithappach ledina vegin kach tzave yeshuot yaakov amar david pakkid al alma kad yishtallechun shelichaa di leheveyan missitra derachame

Rabbi abba amar tzave yeshuot yaakov deinnun go galvata veyishtakkach purkana lehon go galuthon ta chaze tushbechan deavahan yaakov hava veilmale yitzchak la ata yaakov lealma uvgin kach tzavi yeshuot yaakov da yitzchak dechevan deishteziv yitzchak yeshoot yaakov hau

Vayehi achar haddevarim haelle rabbi shimon amar ha taninan vayehi bime al tzaara ittemar vayehi af al gav dela ketiv bime tafse detzaara it beh vayehi achar batar darga tattaa dechal dargin illain uman ihu devarim kema deatte amer lo ish devarim anochi

Uman hava batar darga da vehaelohim nissa et avraham deatya yetzer hara lekatrega kamme kudsha berich hu hacha it leistakkala vehaelohim nissa et avraham et yitzchak mibbae leh deha yitzchak bar telatin vesheva shenin hava veha avoy lav bar onasha dileh hava deilmale amar yitzchak la vaena la itanash avoy aleh may tama vehaelohim nissa et avraham vela ketiv nissa et yitzchak

Ella et avraham vadday devae leitkelala bedina deha avraham la hava beh dina kelal mikkadmat dena vehashta itkelil maya beesha veavraham la hava shelim ad hashta deitattar lemebad dina ulatkana leh beatreh

Vechal yomoy la hava shelim ad hashta deitkelil maya beesha veesha bemaya uvgin kach vehaelohim nissa et avraham velo et yitzchak deazmin avraham leitkelala bedina vechad avid da al esha bemaya veishtelim da im da veda avid dina leitkelala da beda uchden yetzer hara ata lekatrega aleh deavraham dela ishtelim kedeka yeut ad deyaavid dina beyitzchak deyetzer hara achar haddevarim ihu veata lekatrega

Veta chaze raza demilla af al gav dekaamaran deavraham ketiv vela yitzchak yitzchak name itkelil beh behay kera raza dichtiv vehaelohim nissa et avraham nissa leavraham la ketiv ella et avraham et dayeka veda yitzchak deha behahi shaata bigvura tattaa sharya kevan deitakkad veizdamman bedina al yeda deavraham kedeka yeut keden itattar beatreh bahadeh deavraham veitkelilu esha bemaya usliku leela uchden ishtakkach machloket kedeka yeut maya beesha

Man chama abba rachamana deitavid achzar ella begin leishtakkacha machloket maya beesha ulitattera beatrayhu ad deata yaakov veittakkan kolla kedeka yeut veitavidu telata abbahan shelemin veittakanu illae vetattae

Vayyomer kach na et bincha vechi heach yachil avraham deihu sava i tema begin deyitzchak la nafik mershuteh kelal yaot aval kema deatte amer kach et aharon veet elazar beno ella begin leamshacha lon bemillin uladbara lon liruta dekudsha berich hu uf hacha kach bemillin et bincha et yechidcha asher ahavta ha
238: Ukmuha velech lecha el eretz hammoriyya kema deatte amer elech li el har hammor leatkana beatra deyitchaze

Bayyom hashshelishi vayyissa avraham et enav vayyar et hammakom merachok bayyom hashshelishi ha ukmuha ella kevan deittemar vayyakam vayyelech el hammakom asher amar lo haelohim may tama bayyom hashshelishi vayyar et hammakom merachok ella begin dichtiv ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara veda hu yaakov denafak minneh vehay hu bayyom hashshelishi vayyar et hammakom merachok kema deatte amer merachok Adonai nira li

Vayyar et hammakom da hu yaakov dichtiv vayyikkach meavne hammakom istakkal avraham bayyom hashshelishi deihu darga telitaa vechama leh leyaakov dezammin lemefak minneh merachok kema deamaran merachok vela lizman kariv
Amar leh ribbi elazar may shevacha ihu leavraham kad istakkal vechama dezammin lemefak minnih yaakov deha kad azil lemeekad leh leyitzchak lav shevacha kal kach ihu dileh

Amar leh vadday chama leh leyaakov deha mikkadmat dena yada avraham chachmeta veistakkal hashta bayyom hashshelishi deihu darga telitaa lemebad shelimu uchden chama leh leyaakov dichtiv vayyar et hammakom aval hashta kayema leh milla merachok begin deazil lemeekad leh leyitzchak vela baa leharher avatreh dekudsha berich hu

Merachok chama leh go aspaklarya dela nahara bilchodoy uvgin kach chama leh vela itgeli kolla deillu aspaklarya denahara hava shechiach al hay aspaklarya dela nahara itkeyyam aleh avraham kedeka yaot aval merachok bilchodoy hava merachok

May tama istallak mehay milla aspaklarya denahara begin dehay darga deyaakov hava uvgin deyaakov ad la ityelid la ishtakkach hashta al hay darga vetu begin dihach vikabbel agra vayyar et hammakom merachok da yaakov kema deittemar merachok dela zacha beh
Lo miyyad ela begin deha istallak merachame deabba al bera uvgin kach ketiv hinnenni veni hinnenni deistallaku rachame veithappach ledina

Vayyomer avraham vela ketiv vayyomer aviv deha la kaim aleh keabba ella baal machloket hava beh elohim yire lo hasse yire lanu mibbae leh may yire lo ella amar leh elohim yire lo legarmeh kad ihu yitzterich aval hashta beni vela imra miyyad vayyelchu shenehem yachdav

Ribbi shimon patach veamar hen erelam tzaaku chutza malache shalom mar yivkaun hen erelam illen malache illae tzaaku behahi shaata uvau lekayema al hahi milla dichtiv vayyotze oto hachutza begin kach tzaaku chutza

Malache shalom illen innun malachin achoranin dehau zeminin lemehach kammeh deyaakov uvgineh deyaakov avtach lon shelimu kudsha berich hu dichtiv veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu bo malache elohim veillen ikrun malache shalom kullehu bachu kad chamu leh leavraham deakid leh leyitzchak veizdazeu illae vetattae vechullehu aleh deyitzchak
Vayyikra elav malach Adonai vegv pasik tama begavayehu delav avraham batraa kekadmaa batraa
239: Shelim kadmaa la shelim kegavena da shemuel shemuel batraa shelim kadmaa la shelim batraa navi kadmaa la navi aval moshe moshe la pasik begin demiyyoma deityelid la aade minneh shechinta avraham avraham rabbi chiyya amar begin leatara leh berucha achora beovada achora belibba achora

Rabbi yehuda amar itberir yitzchak veistallik biruta kamme kudsha berich hu kerecha diktoret busmin dekarvin kahanayya kammeh teren zimnin beoma veishtelim karbana deha tzaara deavraham hava beshaata deittemar leh al tishlach yadcha el hannaar veal taas lo meuma chashiv dekarbaneh la ishtelim ulmaggana avad vesidder kolla uvna mizbeach miyyad vayyissa avraham et enav vayyar vehinni ayil achar vegv

Ha taninan hu ayil deitbere ben hashshemashot hava uven shenato haya kema deatte amer keves echad ben shenato vehachi itzterich veatte amarte ben hashshemashot ella itpakkad chela leizdammena hahu imra beshaata deitzterich leh leavraham kema dechal innun millin dehau ben hashshemashot itmanna chela leizdammena hahu milla beshaata deitzterich leh hachi name hay ayil deitkeriv techoteh deyitzchak

Patach veamar bechal tzaratam lo tzar umalach panav hoshiam vegv ta chaze bechal tzaratam deyisrael kad izdamman lon akan ketiv lo belf ukri bev begin dekudsha berich hu immehon beaku lo belf atar illaa yattir af al gav delav behahu atar rugza veaku lehatam leela mata akta deyisrael lo belf kema deatte amer hu asanu velo anachnu ketiv belf ukri bev

Umalacha panav hoshiam veha ihu imhon behahu aku veatte amarte hoshiam ella moshiam lo ketiv ella hoshiam mikkadmat dena deihu zammin behahu aku lemisbal immehon ta chaze bechal zimna deyisrael innun begaluta shechinta immehon begaluta veha ukmuha dichtiv veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutcha verichamcha vegv

Davar acher umalach panav hoshiam da shechinta deihi immehon begaluta veatte amarte deihu hoshiam ella hachi hu vadday deillen innun mishkenotav dekudsha berich hu begaluta uvgin dishchinta immehon kudsha berich hu adkar lon leotava lon veleafaka lon min galuta dichtiv vaezkor et beriti bekadmita ulvatar veatta hinne tzaakat bene yisrael baa elay

Vegam raiti leasgaa reiya achora deihu kadmaa decholla uchtiv vayyizkor elohim et berito da shechinta et avraham leavraham mibbae leh ella et avraham da hu chavruta veziuuga dilah baavahan et avraham da hu maaravit deromit et yitzchak da hu tzefonit maaravit veet yaakov da hu ziuuga chada kelala chada ziuuga shelim kedeka yaot

Kegavena da et hashshamayim da hu kelala middat layela bayyom veet haaretz da middat yom belayela kechada uf hacha bechullehu et uvyaakov veet lemeheve kolla ziuuga chada dela mitparshin dechar venukva lealmin vezammin kudsha berich hu leachraza bechal alma ulashmaa kal deyema vayyomer ach ammi hemma banim lo yeshakkeru vyehi lahem lemoshia baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
240: Vayyihu chayyi sara mea shana vesrim shana vsheva shanim rabbi yose patach veamar vyisu et yona vyetiluhu el hayyam vyaamod hayyam mizzapo hacha it leistakkala may tama arishat yamma aleh deona vla arishat aleh ara kevan dehava azil begin dela tishre aleh shechinta yamma ammay achid beh kad hava azil
Ela vadday milla beatreh hava yam tenan yam damya lerakia verakia lechisse hakkavod uvgin kach yamma achid beh venetal leh mikkamme yama arak shade yamma yeda beh beduchtaha

Vayyisu et yona vayetiluhu el hayyam olifna kad hau natle leh vetave yarchoy beyamma hava yamma shachich zakfin leh itreish yamma kal ma detave leh hachi ishtechich yamma ad deihu amar sauni vahatiluni el hayyam miyyad vayyisu et yona vayetiluhu el hayyam
Kevan deitramme bayyam parcha minneh nishmateh vesalka ad kurseya demalka veitdanat kammeh veahadarat leh nishmateh veal befuma dehahu nuna umit nuna levatar itkeyyam hahu nuna veukmuha

Hava amar bimtallenoy kotz kotzita demichan demiyemin shinta bechurehon kayyamin bikomehun malka demimmelal vela iabbaru ishtechachu natre tarin shellita dechilin saggiin kam bekiyyumeha
Kullehu la margeshan vela yadi desafra patiach uvishma echtov vedome kaem venatel bechushbana vedayeri afra tayevin levar vekariv tav leitmenea behu la teevin gilgola vahafoch
Naflin vela kayemin itmechun chayyavin missifra dedome man yitba lon uman yatev bechushbanhon vave lon vave lichyayehon vay lorogoshohn lenafshihon beginhun ittakkari yimchu mispar chayyim vego

Vayyihu chayye sara may shena hacha sara dichtiv mitata beorayeta mikkal neshe dealma dela ketiv hachi mitathon beorayeta amar rabbi chiya velav vehachtiv vattamat rachel vattikkaver bederech efrata ukketiv vattamat sham miryam vegv uchtiv vattamat devora

Midrash hanneelam vayyihu rabbanan patche behay kera lecha dodi netztze hassade nalina bakkefarim tanu rabbanan hayyotztze ladderech yitpallel shalosh tefillot tefilla shehi chova shel yom utfillat hadderech al hadderech shehu ose utfilla sheyyachzor leveto leshalom velema lehu lehanne shelosha afilu beechad yachil lemebedeh detaninan kal sheelotav shel adam yachil lemichlelinhu beshomea tefilla

Amar rabbi yehuda kal ovadoy devar nash ketivin besifra hen tav hen bish veal kullehon atid lemitan dina detaninan amar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv galmi rau enecha otam haddevarim sheasa haggolem sheeno mashgiach baolam habba kullam rau enecha sheiyyanta bahem veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu liten alehem din vcheshbon laolam habba hilkach yakdim adam tefillato tamid veoil leh

Amar rabbi yitztzechak en adam ose averot ella mi shehu golem vlo adam vehayenu hahu dela mistakkal benishmata kaddisha ella kal ovadoy kehay beira dela mashgachat vela yadat amar rabbi bo vechi golem mitkere dad deamar hay pesuka amar lo rabbi yitztzechak adam harishon amaro galmi
241: Ta chaze beshata devar nash salik bearseh kal lelya velelya nishmateh nafkat minneh veitdanat kamme be dina demalka i zakkaa leitkayema ithaddarat lehay alma

Vedina hu bitren gevanin deha la dayenin leh levar nash al bishin deihu atid vezammin lemebad dichtiv ki shama elohim vegv baasher hu sham vela tema dedanin leh al tavin deavid lechud ella leotava leh al inun tavin dehashta kema deittemar vedanin leh al zachyan deihu zammin lemebad uvginayehu ishteziv af al gav deihu hashta chayyava begin dekudsha berich hu avid tivu im kal biryan vechal archoy deihu avid leotava lecholla vela dain levar nash al bishin deihu zammin lemebad uvgin kach itdan bar nash kamme kudsha berich hu

Ta chaze kevan deattilu leh leona beyamma ma ketiv vayyaamod hayyam mizzapo hayyam illaa may vayyaamod dekaim bekiyyumeh kedeka yeut baamida ihu kad rugza shachich beshata dedina sharya bealma hahu be dina ihu keitteta demitabbera vekashya leolada vechad olidat shechich rugza hachi name kad dina sharya bealma la shachich vela nach ad deitavid dina bechayyavaya keden hu nayecha dileh lemekam beduchta shelim ulmekam bekiyyumeh hada hu dichtiv uvaavod reshaim rinna veha okimna
Baavod reshaim rinna vehachtiv hechafotz echpotz mot rasha veha let nayecha kamme kudsha berich hu kad itavid dina berashshiayya ella kan kodem deishtelim kista kan levatar deishtelim kista

Rau enecha kodem shezzarakta bi neshama rau enecha lemebad bidokni bene nasha dedamu li veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu man inun yamim yutztzaru kehay tzura didi velo echad bahem dela ishtaar chad minnehon

Amar rabbi bo lamma amar leh ta chaze kullehu dedamu leh o birmiza dileh la metu bemitat nafshehon vechullehu laku behahu inyana mammash ta chaze amar rabbi yehuda diukneh deadam harishon veshappiruteh hava kezahara dirkia illaa deal gabbe shear rekie uchhahu nehora deganiz kudsha berich hu letztzaddikayya lealma deate vechal inun dehau remiza beh midiukneh deadam harishon beh laku umitu

Dechach orchoy dekudsha berich hu yahiv utra levar inish lamma lemezan anayin ulmebad pikkudoy la avid hay vitgae behahu utra beh yilke dichtiv osher shamur livalav leraato yahiv leh benin lamma lemelaf lehu orchoy dekudsha berich hu ulmitar pikkudoy kidamur beavraham ki yedativ lemaan asher yetztzavve et banav veet beto acharav veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka vegv la avid hay umitgae behu behu lake dichtiv lo nin lo velo neched beammo vegv vechen kehay gana kad yahiv kudsha berich hu mishappiruta tava illaa deadam harishon lehu lamma begin lemitar pikkudoy ulmebad reuteh la avdu keden ella itgau beh beh laku behay shappiruta

Amar rav yehuda kad bara kudsha berich hu adam harishon hava golem ad la zarik beh nishmata vekara lehahu malacha dehu memunne al diukna divne nasha veamar lo ayyen vetztzor bediukna deden shita beni nesha hada hu dichtiv vayyolled bidmuto ketztzalmo vayyikra et shemo shet kelomar shita
Amar rabbi yitztzechak mehahu afra mammash deitbere adam harishon nasiv kudsha berich hu leitberaa illen shita vekara leh shet shita hada hu dichtiv
242: Meneket rivka uchtiv vattamat bat shua eshet yehuda

Amar rabbi yose bechullehu la ketiv kema dichtiv besara deittemar vayyihu chayye sara mea shana veesrim shana vesheva shanim shene chayye sara deha bechullehu la itmanun yomin ushnin kemo lesara bechullehu la ketiv parshata chada bilchudaha kemo lesara ella raza ihu begin hahu darga dechal yomin ushnin devar nash beh talyan

Patach veamar veyitron eretz bakkol hi melech lesade neevad veyitron eretz bakkol hi vadday deha mittamman nafkin ruchin venishmatin vetoalta lealma melech lesade neevad man melech da kudsha berich hu lesade neevad kad ihu Adonai keriach sade asher beracho Adonai dechad ihu neevad veittakkan bechal ma deitzterich leh kedeka yaot keden melech illaa itchabbar immeh

Rabbi elazar amar melech lesade neevad kamma gavene razin illain hacha melech da shechinta dela sharya beveta leittakkana vah ella bezimna deitnasiv bar nash veizdavag beinteteh leolada ulmebad ibin veihi afikat nishmatin leashraa vah uvgin kach lesade neevad vela leachora

Davar acher melech da ishsha yirat Adonai kema deatte amer ishsha yirat Adonai hi tithallal lesade neevad da ishsha zara kema deatte amer lishmarcha meishsha zara begin deit sade veit sade it sade dechal birchaan vekiddushin beh sharyan kema deatte amer kereach sade asher beracho Adonai veit sade dechal chiruv umsaavu veshetzaa vekatolin ukravin beh sharyan vehay melech zimnin deihu neevad lehay sade dichtiv tachat shalosh ragza eretz

Vayyoled bidmuto ketztzallemo meotah haisa shennivra haggolem shello veal kach neemar galmi rau encha veiyant bo laasot dedamu leh veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu man inun kullehu dela natru may deyahav kudsha berich hu lon veittardu min alma

Tenan hatam amar rav yehuda amar rav ashkachna ditlat mitran havi lelya vechal chad vechad it inyana dekudsha berich hu bevar nash kad nafik nishmateh mineh vishtaar hahu golma naim al arseh venishmateh salka bechal lelya kamme kudsha berich hu amar rabbi yitztzechak i zakkaa hi chadan immah vei la dachyan lah levar amar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv hishbati etchem benot yerushalami im timtzeu et dodi ma taggidu lo shecholat ahava ani

Amar rabbi pinchas amar rabbi yehuda hishbati etchem benot yerushalam hanneshama omeret leotam hanneshamot hazzochot likanes lirushalam shel mala vhem hannikraot benot yerushalami al shezzochot likanes sham ulfichach hanneshama omeret lahem hishbati etchem benot yerushalami im timtzeu et dodi da kudsha berich hu rav amar ze ziv aspaklarya shel mala ma taggidu lo shecholat ahava ani lehanot mizziv shello ulhistofef betztzillo rav huna amar shecholat ahava ani otah hatteshuka vehakkissuf shekkasafti baolam al hakkol lefichach ani chola rabbi yehuda amar zo ahava sheohevet hanneshama lagguf dechen shennishlam kitztzo shel guf otam hayyamim shennigzeru alav kema deatte amer vayyihu chayye sara ma ketiv vayyakam avraham meal pene meto vegv
Amar rav yehuda amar rav ma ketiv bappasuk kodem ze dichtiv vattamat sara bekiryat arba hi chevron beeretz kenaan
Rabbi yitztzechak amar rabbi yochanan bara
243: Vegv tachat eved ki yimloch vegv veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah vehay melech itkasseya nehoreh veitchashshach ad deitdakke veitchabbar leela

Uvgin kach sair derosh chodesh begin deitperash hahu sade mimmalka kaddisha vela sharyan behay sade birchaan mehay melech vechad ihu neevad lehay sade keden ketiv ki vassade metzaah vegv ki bassade kema deittemar

Ta chaze atat chava lealma itdabbekat behay chivveya veattil vah zuhama vegarma mota lealma ulvaalah atat sara venachatat vesalkat vela itdabbekat beh kema deatte amer vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim hu veishto vechal asher lo ata noach lealma ma ketiv vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal vegv

Uvgin deavraham vesara la itdabbaku beh vegin kach sara zachta lechayyin illain lah ulvaalah velivnaha batraa hada hu dichtiv habbitu el tzur chutzavtem veel makkevet bor nukartem veal da vayyihu chayye sara dezachta behu bechullehu vela ketiv bechullehu nashshe vayyihu chayye chava vechen becholla hi itdabbekat bachayyin veal da dilah hau chayyin

Tosefta zakkaa ihu man deazir garmeh behay alma kamma ihu rav veillaa behahu alma vehachi pattach rav mettivta man deihu zeer ihu rav man deihu rav ihu zeer dichtiv vayyihu chayye sara vegv mea deihu chushban rav kettiv beh shana zeiru dishnin chad azir leh sheva deihu chushban zair asge leh vrabbe leh dichtiv shanim ta chaze dela rabbe kudsha bericha hu ella lidazir vla azir ella lidrabbe zakkaa ihu man deazir garmeh behay alma kamma ihu rav beilluya lehahu alma ad kan

Man deppasak yitteppasak man dekatztzar yittekatztzar man dekatztzar yittearacha retztzono lomar man deppasak millin deorayeta millin betelin yitteppaskun chayyohi mehay alma vedinih kayema behahu alma man dekatztzar amen vla maaricha go nayecha yittekatztzar mechayyin dehay alma man deamar echad itztzetericha lechatpa alef ulkatztzer karna dileh vla yeakkev behay ott kelal uman deyaavid da yittearchun chayyav
Vayyihu chayye sara inun chayyin kullehu leela mea shana leela veesrim shana leela vesheva shanim leela kullehu hau kedeka yeut amar rabbi shimon

Kudsha berich hu laadam vehichnis bo arbaa devarim hannechelakim bagguf amar rabbi yehuda hamchubbarim bagguf rabbi yitztzechak amar hannecholakim bagguf shehem cholkim lehitparesh kal echad lisodo kesheyyotztze haadam min haolam hazze rabbi yehuda amar hamchubbarim bagguf bechayyav mashma mikra dichtiv vattamat sara ze hagguf bekiryat arba ellu haarba yesodot hi chevron shehau mechubbarim begufo bechayyav beeretz kenaan baolam hazze habbocher adam bizman muat

Vayyavo avraham lispod lesara vlivkotah hayenu ditnan kal shivat hayyamim nafsho shel adam pokedet legufo umitabbelet alav hada hu dichtiv ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval kehay gavena vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah vayyavo avraham zo hi hanneshama lispod lesara ze hagguf

Amar rabbi yitztzechak beshaa shehanneshama zocha veola limkom maalatah hagguf shochev beshalom veyanuach al mishkavo hada hu dichtiv yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam holech nechocho may holech nechocho amar rabbi yitztzechak hanneshama holech nechocho limkom haeden hagganuz lah may mashma amar rabbi yehuda mehay mashma nechocho ketiv beh uvshaa sheenah zocha vehi reuya lekabbel
244: Ta chaze raza demilla may shena bechullehu deamar shana shana uvinun sheva deamar shanim dichtiv mea shana veesrim shana ulvatar sheva shanim

Ella kolla chad mea shana kelala decholla kudsha berich hu deitkelil meatar illaa setima dechal setimin bemea beraza demea birchaan dechal yoma vechen esrim shana uvgin kach ketiv shana raza deyichuda dela itperash machashava veovla lealmin

Sheva shanim illen itparshan venafkan mikkelala setimaa dilela veaf al gav decholla yichuda chada aval mitparshan bedina verachame bechamma sitrin veorchin ma dela havi hachi leela uvgin kach ketiv shana raza deyichuda dela itperash lealmin sheva shanim illen itparshan bedina verachame bechamma sitrin veorchin ma dela have hachi leela uvgin kach beillen sheva shanim ketiv behu shanim vela shana vechullehu ikrun chayyim vayyihu chayye sara dehau mammash deitberiu veitkayemu leela

Amar rabbi chiyya ha ukmuha deha kad itakkad yitzchak bar telatin vesheva shanim hava vechevan deitakkad yitzchak mitat sara dichtiv vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah meayin ba mehar hammoriyya ba millemeekad leh leyitzchak veinun telatin vesheva shenin miyyoma deityelid yitzchak ad shata deitakkad inun hau chayye sara vadday kechushban vayyihu begimatriyya telatin ushva shenin hau kema deittemar middeityelid yitzchak ad deitakkad

Rabbi yose patach veamar mizmor shiru layeya shir chadash ki niflaot asa hoshia lo yemino uzroa kadsho hay kera ukmuha chavraya defarot amruha kema dichtiv vayyishsharna happarot badderech may vayyishsharna dehau amre shirata chadta umay shira amru mizmor shiru layeya shir chadash ki niflaot asa

Hacha it leistakkala dechal ma devara kudsha berich hu bealma kullehu amri tushbechan veshirata kammeh ben leela ben letatta vei tema deinhu miggarmayehu amre shirata da hachi hu vadday deraza illaa ihu aval hanne arona hava al gabbayehu vechevan daarona ishtekil alayehu veshaveuha leela inun sheriru shirata deha kevan deitnetil minnayehu arona hau gaan keorach shear parot dealma vela amru shirata vadday arona
Onshah holechet meshomemet umvakkeret bechal yom lagguf velakkever

Amar rabbi yose hay kulita dekardinuta kad azil bisrichuta lechan ulchan azal umvakker lah leatrah teresar yarche kach nishmata hahi deitchazzeya lekabbela ansha azla levar bealma umafkedet la leatrah teresar yarche bevatte kivre uvalma

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze dichtiv vayyakam avraham meal pene meto amar rabbi abba veha tenan dechad nishmata hi betashluma illaa nitosaf bah Adonai venikret avraham betashluma illaa vehacha atte amer dechad leta zakkaa kal kach dichtiv vayyakam avraham avdat man deyativ bekkurseya nachit bego zutar tattaa

Ella hachi gazzarna vayyakam avraham meal pene meto deamar rabbi bo amar rabbi zerika keshehanneshama reuya laalot limkom idna kodem megina al hagguf hakkadosh sheyyotztzet mishsham veachar kach ola limkom maalatah hada hu dichtiv vayyakam avraham meal pene meto zehu hagguf

Vayedabber el bene chet ellu shear gufot hatztzaddikim shehem chattechattim venehelamim baolam lemaan yirat konam chattim al shehem shochne afar veammay tzericha lehu amar rabbi yehuda kolla beminyana ketivin veal gufa beminyana immehon
Uma amar lehu bederech piyyus uvderech kavod
245: Mizmor ha okimna veittemar becholla ketiv mizmor ledavid o ledavid mizmor vehacha la amar david kelal ella mizmor deruach kudsha zammin lezammera leh lezimna deokim kudsha berich hu leyisrael meafra uchden shiru layeya shir chadash keden ihu chadash deha shirata kehay la ittemar miyyomma deitbere alma

Amar rabbi chiyya ketiv en kal chadash tachat hashshemesh vehacha shirata da ihi chadash veihi tachat hashshemesh deha techot shimsha lehve umay ihu da sihara uchden havi chadash tachat hashshemesh may tama begin ki niflaot asa uman inun niflaot hay dichtiv hoshia lo yemino uzroa kadsho hoshia lo leman

Ger vetoshav anochi immachem vegv dehay gufa yehevi beminyana chad immechon bechibbura da amar rabbi ree ma ketiv vayyaanu bene chet et avraham vegv kemo chen bederech kavod bederech piyyus hada hu dichtiv shemaenu adoni nesi elohim atta betochenu

May nesi elohim atta amar rabbi pinchas kodem sheyyitztze hatztzaddik min haolam bat kol yotztzet bechal yom al otam hatztzaddikim began eden hachinu makom lifloni sheyyavo lechan veal ken hem omrim meet elohim millemala atta nasi bechal yom betochenu bemivchar kevarenu bemivchar hatztzaddikim hatztzaddikim bachavurat hammuvcharim mene oto hachnisehu becheshbon immanu veish mimmennu lo yimna et hamminyan ki chullanu semechim bo umakdimim lo shalom

Tosefta ribbi yose ben rabbi yehuda azil lemecheme lerabbi chiyya amar leh lema mar i shama hay parshatta hecha amru mare mattenita deppershuha beinyana denishmatta amar zakkaa chulakehon detztzaddikayya bealma deatte dechacha hi orayeta belibbehon kemabbua rabba demaya deaf al gav demastimin leh misgiutt mayya pattechi mabbuin denavin lechal evar

Ta shema rabbi yose rechima atte ana ema lacha behay parshatta leolam en guf haadam nichnas becheshbon hatztzaddikim al yad duma ad shettare hanneshama pinkas simana shennottenin lah hakkeruvim baggan eden amar rabbi yose ana shemaana deha nishmatta battar deayelatt tamman hi azlatt lesalka leattera leela vla lemechatt lettatta aval kodem shettaale vtikkanes naasett appatroppos hagguf yad duma umara lo sherauy hu lekabbel sachar arba meott olamott
Amar rabbi chiyya ha rabbi elazar amar deha duma yada kodem mishum demachreze alah beginta deeden aval ana kacha shamana di beiddana deyahavin
Rav yosef kad hava shama parshatta da mimmarehon dimtivta hava amar man deihu appera may ka zache lehay man yizke uman yakum hada hu dichtiv mi yaale behar Adonai

Amar rabbi abba ta chaze may dichtiv vyishma avraham el epperon vyishkol avraham leepperon ett hakkesef da hu kisuppa rabbatta deinun almin vechisuppin arba meott shekel kesef arba meott olamott vehanaott vchisuppin over lasocher rav nachman amar sheyyaavor kal shaare shamayim vrushalayim shel mala ven moche beyadah

Ta chaze ma kettiv vachare chen kavar avraham ett sara ishto vnimne im shear hatztzaddikim bachavurattam mippitteka dimmanna al yedoy deduma amar rabbi yitztzechak hachi gemirna kal inun dichtivin bidoy deduma ummannan al yedoy yekumun lezimna dezammin leachaya dayere appera vay lehon lerashiayya dela chettivin yedoy beppitteka sheyyovdu baggehinnam lealmin veal da neemar uvaett hahi yimmalet imcha kal hannimtza kattuv basepper
246: Lehahu darga deamar shirata da begin debbehu istammich bimina uvismala hoshia lo yemino vadday lehahu darga dehay mizmor ematay bezimna dikumun mete alma veyitarun meafra keden yehe chadash ma dela itavid behay alma

Rabbi yose amar bezimna deyaavid kudsha berich hu nukmin bealma beginayehu deyisrael keden yitamar shirata deha levatar yitarun meafra mete alma veyitchaddesh alma bekiyyum shelim dela lehve garim mota bealma lecholla veistaav alma veitchashich anpoy

Ta chaze ketiv veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha may veeva kedichtiv chalfu im oniyyot eve deha kamma arvin shatan go yamma rabba veit arvin usfinan mitparshan da min da veinun arvin dehay nachash shat begavayehu ikrun oniyyot eva

Bencha uven haishsha da ishsha yirat Adonai uven zarecha illen shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot uven zarah illen yisrael hu yeshufcha rosh da kudsha berich hu dezammin levaara leh mealma dichtiv billa hammavet lanetzach uchtiv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz

Rosh da lezimna deate deyitarun metaya deha keden leheve alma rosh deyitkayyam barosh deihu alma illaa veatta teshufennu akev da behay alma hashta deihu akev velav ihu bekiyyuma vehahu chiveya nashich lealma veachshich anpoy biryan

Ta chaze yomin devar nash itberiu vekayemu beinun dargin illain kevan dimsayemu leitkayema beinun dargin dichtiv yeme shenotenu bahem shivim shana vegv mikkan ulhala let darga leitkayema uvgin kach verahbam amal vaaven veinun kela hau

Pazzi ta chaze kevan shehanneshama pogaat bahem leachar kach pogaat leoto hammalach hammunne alehem ditnan malach memunne al batte kivre veduma shemo vhu machriz benehem bechal yom al hatztzaddikim haatidim likanes benehem umiyyad pogaat bo kede leshakken hagguf behashket uvvitcha uvimnucha uvahanaa hada hu dichtiv vayedabber el efron

Amar rabbi yisa ze hammalach hannikra duma velamma nitkanne shemo efron al shehu memunne al shochne afar vehufkedu beyado kal pinkese hatztzaddikim vachavurot hachasidim hashshochnim beafar vehu atid lehotztziam becheshbon

Vetana amar rabbi elazar leatid lavo kesheyyifkod hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaot hammetim yikra lammalach hammemunne al hakkevarot veduma shemo veyitteva mimmennu minyan kal hammetim hatztzaddikim vehachasidim veotam gere hatztzedek veshennehergu al shemo vehu motztziam becheshbon kemo shennetalam becheshbon hada hu dichtiv hammotztzi bemispar tzevaam vegv ish lo nedar

Vetana amar rabbi shemuel berabbi yaakov nefashot harshaim netunot beyado shel malach ze sheshshemo duma lehachnisam baggehinnam vladun sham vechevan shennimsarot beyado shuv enan chozrot ad sheyyikkansu laggehinnom veze yirat david shennityare kesheasa oto aon shenneemar lule Adonai ezrata li kimat shachna duma nafshi amar rabbi yisa hanneshama pogaat lo lehachnis oto guf im shear gufot hatztzaddikim becheshbonam hada hu dichtiv vayedabber el efron vegv

Amar rabbi tanchum hammalach kodem veomer lo ree ma ketiv lemala veefron yoshev betoch bene chet shichato lishkon beafar vhu makdim veomer lo lehachnis oto hagguf becheshbon hatztzaddikim hada hu dichtiv vayyaan efron hachitti et avraham beazne vene chet lechol bae shaar iro lemor may lechol bae shaar iro rav nachman amar inun
247: Hau veitkayemu kema deatte amer vayyihu chayye sara vechen veelle yeme shene chayye avraham vei tema hachi name ketiv beyishmael dichtiv shene chayye yishmael ella bitshuva ahadar veal da kare vayyihu
Dealu bichtav chushban pinkaseh deamar rav nachman vehachi itgezar cheshbon al yedoy deduma alin bevatte kivre uvchushban pitka zammin leafaka lon vehu memunne al dayere afra

Mahu hassade natatti lach vehammeara asher bo amar rabbi yose hafkada deshalleva umnucha rabba amar rabbi shalom bar minume en lecha kal tzaddik vetztzaddik meotam haoskim battora sheen lo matayim olamot vechissufin bishvil hattora hada hu dichtiv umatayim lannotrim et piro umatayim al shemmosrim atztzemam bechal yom keilu nehergu al kedushat shemo nitztzecho kehay pesuka dichtiv veahavta et Adonai vegv vetana kal hamchavin libbo behay pesuka kede limsor nafsho al kedushat shemo maale alav hakkatuv keillu neherag bechal yom alav hada hu dichtiv ki alecha horagnu kal hayyom amar rav nachman kal hammoser nafsho behay pesuka nochel arba meot olamot laolam habba amar rav yosef veha tenan matayim amar rav nachman matayim al hattora umatayim al shemmasar atztzemo bechal yom al kedushat shemo

Vattamat sara bekiryat arba rabbi abba amar kegavena da la hau bechal neshe alma deha ittemar chushban yomaha ushnaha vekiyyumaha bealma vehahu atar deitkavrat beh ella leachazaa dela hava kesara bechal neshe alma

Vei tema ha miryam dichtiv vattamat sham miryam vattikkaver sham begin leachazaa sarchana deyisrael ka ata deha maya la azle lehu beyisrael ella bizchuta demiryam aval la ittemar bemitatah kema deittemar besara

Rabbi yehuda patach ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorin vesarayich baet ychelu hay kera ukmuha chavraya aval it lan leistakkala beh dezakkain inun yisrael dekudsha berich hu yahav lon orayeta leminda kal orchin setimin ulitgalleya lon razin illain veha ittemar

Ashrecha eretz da eretz hachayyim begin demalka dilah azmin lah kal birchan deitbarcha meavahan illain raza dev deihu kayema learka alah birchan tadir veihu ben chorin ben yovela deappik avdin lecheru bera dealma illaa deappik tadir kal chayyin vechal nehiru vechal meshach revut vecholla aid hay bera buchra lehay eretz kema deatte amer beni bechori yisrael uvgin kach ashrech eretz

Uma deittemar i lach eretz shemmalkech naar kema deukmuha dehay eretz tattaa vealma tattaa la yanka ella miggo shaltanuta dearla vecholla mehahu malka deikre naar kema deukmuha vay leara deitzterich linaka hachi

Veavraham zaken ba bayyamim matnitin amar rabbi elazar al kal panim kach hu dehay matnitin shappir deitavid nishmata hahu dichtiv beh vhinne ofan echad baaretz etztzel hachayyot learbaat panav kidamur behahi matnita kammayeta

Amar leh ribbi abba lema lan mar mehahi matnitin amar leh hachi itperash bitlat eser mechilan derachame befarshata dileh aval hacha it lan lememar patach veamar achat hi yonati tammati achat hi leimmah amar ribbi elazar may hi deanan karinan hacha beshir hashshirim lishna denukveta vehatam beorayeta lishna didchura
Ela amar rabbi elazar hacha battora nikra belashon zachar etztzel hagguf mippene shehagguf etztzel hanneshama keishsha etztzel hazzachar
248: Let leh migarmeh kelum bar kad natil birchan lezimnin yedian vechal zimnin deitmenau minneh veitpegim sihara veitchashach uvirchan itmenau minneh vay lealma deitzterich linaka behahi shata veod bechamma dinin itdan hay alma ad la yanka minneh decholla bedina itkayyam veitavad veukmuha

Ta chaze vattamat sara bekiryat arba raza ihu begin dela hava mitatah al yeda dehahu nachash akimaa vela shalat bah kishar bene alma deihu shallit behu veal yadeh metu bene alma miyyoma degarim lon adam bar mshe veaharon umiryam dichtiv behu al pi Adonai uvgin yekara dishchinta la ketiv bemiryam al pi Adonai

Aval besara ketiv bekiryat arba raza dekiryat arba beraza illaa vela al yeda achora bekiryat arba velo benachash bekiryat arba hi chevron deitchabbar david malka baavahan veal da la hava mitatah bida achora ella bekiryat arba

Ta chaze kad yomin devar nash itkayemu bedargin illain itkayyam bar nash bealma kevan dela itkayyam bedargin illain nafke venachate letatta ad dikrivu lehay darga demota sharya beh uchden natil reshu leappik nishmata vetas alma bezimna chada venatil nishmata vesaiv leh legufa veishtaar mesaava zakkain inun tzaddikayya dela istaavu vela ishtaar behu mesaavuta
Veta chaze beemtzaut dirkia itkattar chad orcha kasterira veihu chiveya dirkia dechal kochavin dakkikin kulhu ketirin beh vekayeme beh tille tillin veinun memannan bistiru ovade bene alma
Kegavena da kamma chavile tehirin nafke lealma mehay chiveya illaa kadmaa deitpatta beh adam vechulhu memannan bistiru ovade
Vehanneshama legabbe mala kinkeva bifni hazzachar vechal echad maalato yoresh

Tenan hatam bearbaa peamim beshaa bechal yom eden menatef al haggan veotztze meotam hatippot nahar gadol hammitchallek learbaa rashim ushmone vearbaim tippot menatef bechal yom umishsham seveim ilane haggan hada hu dichtiv yisbeu atztze Adonai rabbi tanchum amar mehacha mashke harim mealiyyotav ezo hi aliyya zehu eden veeden beeze makom hu rabbi yehuda amar lemala mearavot hu rabbi yose amar baaravot hu deha tenan sham ginze chayyim tovim beracha veshalom venishmatan shel tzaddikim vhagganuz haelon hu eden lemata mechun kenegedo gan baaretz venotel mimmennu shefa bechal yom

Amar rabbi abbahu shemona vearbaim neviim amdu lahem leyisrael vechal echad natal bechelko tamtzit tippa achat meotam tippot shel eden shehem shemone vearbaim tippot uma im kal navi shennatal tippa achat mehen hayeta maalato beruach hakkodesh al kal hashshear adam harishon shehaya mekabbel mishshemona vearbaim lo kal shekken mikkan atta lamed kamma hayeta chachmato

Rabbi ba amar rav kahana vchi meayin haya lahem lanneviim meotam hatippot ella hachi tenan bechal tippa vetippa hayyotztzet meeden ruach chachma yotztze immo veal ken itgezar bematnitin it maya megaddelan chakkimin veit maya megaddelan tippeshin vinun maya dimgaddelan chakkimin inun maya hau mitippin deeden

Deamar rabbi yose maya deveh tippin yatvin mikkal inun arba nahare kadmaa hu dichtiv shem haechad pishon may shem haechad pishon hamuchad mikkullam pishon vhu hannofel beeretz mitztzerayim ulfichach hayeta chachmat mitztzerayim yoter mikkal haolam
Umishshennigzera gezira sheavda chachmat mitztzerayim natal kudsha berich hu otam tippin vezarak lon
249: Alma uvgin kach ate bar nash leitdakkaa mesayein leh milleela vesiyyua demareh sachara leh veistammar veikre kadosh

Amar ribbi yitztzechak gavriel molich otam leeretz yisrael mena lan dichtiv hatelchi im haish hazze uchtiv hatam vehaish gavriel amar ribbi yose may dichtiv ulrivka ach ushmo lavan amar rabbi yitztzechak en yitztzer hara batel min haolam af al pi shekkullo lo nimtza ketztzato nimtza

Ta chaze battechilla keshehaya mutal baolam hazze nikra lot laolam habba yibbatel min haolam aval lo kullo vnikra lavan lo menuval kevarishona ella keman desache minniuulo lavan lemay itztzeterich amar rabbi shimon lemebad periyya urviyya itztzeterich deamar rabbi shimon im en yetztzer hara nimtza periyya urviyya eno matztzuy
Ta shema kevan shehagguf nivna veomed bekiyyumo may ketiv vayeshallechu et rivka achotam vegv may veet meniktah ze koach hattenua ribbi yitztzechak amar ze koach hagguf

Ribbi abbahu patach behay kera itti millevanon kalla itti millevanon tavoi amar ribbi abbahu kevan shehagguf nivne al kiyyumo umviin oto lekabbel nishmato leeretz yisrael hanneshama mamtenet elav veotztzet likrato kema deatte amer vayyetztze yitztzechak lasuach bassade hada hu dichtiv itti millevanon kalla zo hi hanneshama tashuri
256: Vetatta uvgin kach sede hammachpela vadday vela sade kaful

Tu raza demilla sede hammachpela vadday man machpela Adonai devishma kaddisha deihi machpela vecholla kayema kechad uvgineh kaamar beorach satim Adonai machpela dela have bishma kaddisha at achora machpella bar ihi

Veaf al gav dimarta chafelta hava vadday deihi mearta go mearta aval al shum achora ikre mearat sede hammachpela kema deittemar veavraham yada vechad amar livne chet kasse milla veamar veyitten li et mearat hammachpella al shum deihi mearta kafelta veorayeta la kare lah ella mearat sede hammachpela kedeka yeut

Vekudsha berich hu avad kolla leishtakkacha hay alma kegavena dilela ulitdabbaka da beda lemeheve yekareh leela vetatta zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya dekudsha berich hu itrae behu behay alma uvalma deate

Veavraham zaken ba bayyamim vayeya berach et avraham bakkol rabbi yehuda patach ashre tivchar utkarev yishkon chatzerecha hay kera ittemar aval zakkaa hu bar nash deorchoy itkashran kamme kudsha berich hu veihu itrae beh lekarava leh legabbeh
Ta chaze avraham itkeriv legabbeh vetiuvteh dileh hava kal yomoy behay vela itkeriv avraham beoma chada o bezimna chada ella ovadoy kerivu leh bechal yomoy middarga ledarga ad deistalak bedargoy

Kad hava siv veal bedargin illain kedeka chaze dichtiv veavraham zaken uchden ba bayyamim beinun yomin illain beinun yomin yedian beraza dimhemnuta vayeya berach et avraham bakkol demittamman nafkin kal birchan vechal tivu
Zakkain inun marehon ditshuva deha beshata chada beoma chada beriga chada
Merosh amana hayenu dichtiv vayyissa enav vayyar
Amar rabbi yehuda im hi hanneshama tenach avraham kidkaamaran aval yitztzechak mahu amar rabbi abbahu ha chavrayya amru deachshav itkere yitztzechak al shum chedvata saggia divalma

Amar rabbi abbahu battechilla nikret hanneshama avraham vehagguf sara achshav nikret hanneshama yitztzechak vehagguf rivka tenan bematnitin amar rabbi shimon arbaim shana kodem kiyyum hagguf mamtenet hanneshama lagguf beeretz yisrael beeze makom bemakom hammikdash
Amar rabbi abbahu ta chaze vayyikkach et rivka vattehi lo leishsha vayeehaveha vayyinnachem yitztzechak achare immo ohev leoto hagguf umitnachem immo vhu et lischok vehachedva baolam
Amar ribbi yehuda ha kal parshata da itberar lan aval la yachilna leminda mahu vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushmah ketura ulshikkula dedata kal parshata da listure
Kad ata rav dimi amar hay parshata da shamana vela idkarna amru deillain takkifin la zimnuha legallaa vanan may nema kam ribbi yehuda veamar mimtivta dechavrana mare matnita galya

Kamu veazlu hu vribbi yisa veribbi chiyya ashkechuha leribbi elazar beribbi shimon vehava megalle razin ditfilin alu kammeh veamru bemay itassak mar amar lon tama ditfilin amina deha zakkaa hu bar nash demanach tefilin veyada tama didhu

Amru i nicha kammeh demar lema lan milla amru shemana meavuch dekudsha berich hu birchimu saggia dehava leh im yisrael amar lon lemebad leh be mashkena kegana dirticha illaa dilela veyete diyyureh immehon hada hu dichtiv veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham veshamana meavuch dehacha satim tama ditfilin behay
257: Kerevin legabbe kudsha berich hu ma dela hava hachi afilu letzaddikim gemurim deitkerivu gabbe kudsha berich hu bechamma shenin avraham la al beinun yomin illain ad dehava siv kema deittemar vechen david dichtiv vehammelech david zaken ba bayyamim aval marih ditshuva miyyad al veitdabbak beh bekudsha berich hu

Rabbi yose amar taninan atar demarehon ditshuva kayeme beh behahu alma tzaddikim gemurim let lon reshu lekayema beh begin deinun kerevin lemalka yattir mikkullehu veinun mashche alayehu biruta delibba yattir uvchela sagya leitkerava lemalka
Ta chaze kamma atrin metukanin leh lekudsha berich hu behahu alma uvchullehu be motve lon latztzaddikim kal chad vechad lefum dargeh kedeka chaze leh

Ketiv ashre tivchar utkarev yishkon chatzerecha dekudsha berich hu kariv lon legabbeh desalkin inun nishmatin mittatta leela ulitachada beachsantehon deittaknan lehu yishkon chatzerecha illen atrin vedargin levar uman inun kema deatte amer venatatti lecha mahlechim ben haomdim haelle vehay hu darga ben kaddishin illain
Uman dezakkain ledarga da inun shelichan demare alma keinun malachin veavdin shelichuta tadir biruta demarihon begin deillen tadir bikdushsha vela istaavu

Kegavena da man deistaav behay alma ihu mashich aleh ruach mesaav vechad nafak nishmateh minneh mesaavin leh umdoreh ben inun mesaavin veillen inun mazzikin dealma kema deitmeshach bar nash garmeh behay alma hachi hu medoreh veitmeshach behahu alma
Ta chaze man deitkaddash venatir garmeh behay alma dela istaav medoreh behahu alma ben inun kaddishin

Amar leh ta chazi kegavena illaa itavad mikdash birtichoy kaddishin uvatar ken ashre kudsha berich hu diyyureh immehon keinyana da uchgana da itaru chavrayya mare matnita betama ditfillin lemehevi hahu gavra dugma dirtiche illain reticha tattaa reticha illaa lemete malchuta dileh veyashre diyyureh ilavi

Vetaninan it beh razin illain vedugmehon veit beh telat retichin dugmat illain kaddishin razin ditlat atvata dishmahan kaddishe almin telat retichin telata atvata arba parashiyyot shallit al arba veal kach raza deshn ditlat kitrin dearba kitrin telata melachin shallitin begufa tefilin aloy kudsha berich hu leela illen tefilin deresha tefilin didroa arba parashiyyan

Libba rachiv dugma dirticha tattaa vetattaa rachiv od taninan da rechiva didroa letatta velibba rachiv dugma deihu letatta veitmasserun bideh leaalaa lon kal chele shemaya kach libba hu rachiv letatta vitmasseru bidoy kal evre gufa

Veela minnih arba parashiyyan al mocha deresha ihu aval kudsha berich hu shallita illaa malka mikkolla vraza dechachmeta da hu kegana demakdesha dichtiv vaase keruv echad mikkatztza mizze uchruv echad mikkatztza vealayehu diyyureh demalka bearba atvan teren retichin

Uchhay gana libba umocha libba mikkan umocha mikkan vealayehu medoreh dekudsha berich hu bearba parashiyyan amar rabbi elazar mikkan ulhala raze dechitre atvata ufarashiyyan begufayehu urtzuotehon halacha lemoshe missinay urmiza dilhon itgeli vetama decholla bitlat eser mechilan
Amar ribbi yehuda ilmale la atena ella bedil raza da dayyay amru leh zakkaa chulakach lealma deate dechal raz la anis lach amru leh atena
258: Illain veavdin shelichuta tadir veillen kayeme bachatzer kema deatte amer et chatzar hammishkan

Veit achoranin deinun lego yattir delav inun bachatzer ella beveta kema deatte amer nisbea betuv betecha amar david nisbea betuv betecha kevan deamar yishkon chatzerecha ammay ketiv nisbea betuv betecha yisba betuv betecha mibae leh kema dichtiv yishkon ella ha taninan let yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilchudayehu

Veit atar lachaside elonin deayele lego umay inun kedichtiv vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav vegv vechamma madorin al madorin unhorin al nehorin mitparshan behahu alma vechal chad ichsif minnehora dechavreh kema deovadin itparshan behay alma hachi name duchtin unhorin mitparshan behahu alma

Veta chaze ha ittemar deafilu behay alma kad bar nash naim al arseh venishmatin itzterichu leitshotta bealma venafku miggo gufa lav kal nishmata venishmata salka veshatya lemechoze bikar sever appe deattik yomin ella kema deitmeshich tadir uchfum ovade hachi nishmateh salka

I istaav ihu naim venishmata nafka vechal inun ruchin mesaavin naktin lah veitdabbekat behu beinun dargin tattain deshatyan bealma veinun modiin lah millin deinun kerevin lemete bealma ulzimnin demodin lah millin kedivan vechayechan bah veha ukmuha

Vei zache bar nash kad ihu naim venishmateh salka azla veshatya uvaka ben illen ruchin mesaavin vechullehu machrizin veamrin pannun atar pannun lav da missitrana veihi salka ben inun kaddishin umodae lah milla chada dikshot
Vechad nachata kal inun chavilin terikin baan leitkerava bahadah leminda hahi milla veinun modain lah millin achoranin vehahi milla denatla go inun kaddishin ben inun
Kammeh demar leminda raza dehay pesuka vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushmah ketura

Amar perusha dehay pesuka kema degalu chavrana mare matnitin dechad nishmata yete behahu gufa kaddisha dilah ha milayya hau al chayyavaya dikumun vyichsherun ovadin veyitten lehu mizziva yekara dileh deyindeun vituvun veyizkun zechuta shelemata

Vechad chama shelomo da hava sagge veamar uvchen raiti reshaim kevurim vvau umimkom kadosh yehallechu sheyyavou veyichu mimkom kadosh vtaninan amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan ketiv hayahafoch kushi oro venamer chavarburotav kach harshaim shelo zachu lashuv baolam hazze ulhaktir maasim tovim laolam lo yaktiru baolam habba ree ma ketiv vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha vesherotztze laasot lahem neshama legufam ulkarvam bitshuva kema deatte amer veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan

Amar ribbi elazar ta chaze ma ketiv vteled lo et zimran veet yakshan harbe maasim raim ad shennigrashim min haolam dichtiv vayeshallechem meal yitztzechak beno vaalehem neemar verabbim mishene admat afar yakitzu vegv veal haacherim neemar vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia

Amar ribbi yehuda hay mashma al parshata umashma deoto zeman avad shem avraham uvimkomo nikret ytzchak kidkaamaran hada hu dichtiv vyehi achare mot avraham vayevarech elohim et yitztzechak beno vayyishev yitztzechak im beer lachay roi im yediat hachay shehu chay haolamim ladaat ulhassig ma shelo hissig baolam hazze hada hu dichtiv ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai
259: Achoranin ihu keibbura go tivna vehay

Kegavena da kad nafkin nishmatin miggufa mehay alma baan lesalka vechamma tarin chavile tehirin kayeme i inun missitrayehu kullehu achadin behu beinun nafshan umasre lon bida deduma leaola lon baggehinnam

Ulvatar salkan veachadan behu veinun natle lehon umachreze behu illen inun deavru al pikkude demarehon vechen shatyan bechal alma ulvatar mehaddere lehu laggehinnom vechen ad teresar yarche levatar teresar yarche mishtakkeche behahu atar deitchaze lon inun nishmatin dezachu salke leela kema deittemar vezachan beduchtayehu

Ta chaze zakkain inun tzaddikaya deitgeniz lehu kamma tavin lehahu alma velet atar penimaa bechal inun keinun deyade raza demarehon veyade leitdabbeka behu bechal yoma al illen ketiv ayin la raata elohim zulatecha yaase limchakke lo

May limchakke lo kema deatte amer chikka et iyyov bidvarim veillen inun dedachakin lemilla dechachmeta vedayekin lah umchakkan lah leminda berira demilla veishtemoda lemarehon illen inun demarehon mishtabbach behon bechal yoma illen inun dealin ben illain kaddishin veillen alin kal tare dilela velet man deyimche bidehon zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvalma deate

Ta chaze avraham al leminda ulitdabbeka bemareh kedeka yaot levatar deakdim ovadoy bekadmita vezacha beinun yomin illain veitbarach meatar dechal birchan nafke mittamman dichtiv vayeya berach et avraham bakkol may bakkol atar denahara dela paske memoy lealmin

Amar ribbi chiyya ta chaze deavraham la baa leitarva binshe alma ulitdabbeka bishar amin ovde kochavim umazzalot begin dinshayya dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot inun saavin leguvrayehu ulinun demitdabbekin behon begin dechad avraham yada chachmeta yada ikra vesharsha umean atar nafke veshatyan ruche mesaavin bealma veal da ome leavdeh dela yissav itteta livreh mishshear ammin

Ribbi yitzchak patach veamar veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu laadam natal afareh meatar demakdesha uvana gufeh mearba sitrin dealma dechullehu yahavu leh chela levatar itrak aleh rucha dechayye kema deatte amer vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim vegv levatar kam veyada deihu meela vetatta uchden itdabbak veyada chachma illaa

Kegavena da kal bar nash dealma ihu kalil meela vetatta vechal inun deyadin leitkaddesha behay alma kedeka yeut kad olidu bar mashchin aleh ruach kaddisha meatar dechal kaddishe nafkin minneh veillen ikrun benin lekudsha berich hu begin degufa itavid bikdusha kedeka yaot hachi name yahavin leh rucha meatar illaa kaddisha kedeka chaze veha ittemar

Ta chaze beshata dezammin bar nash lemehav chushban ovadoy ad la yippuk mealma hahu yoma yoma dechushban ihu degufa venishmata yahave chushbena levatar nishmata itparsha mineh vegufa tav leara vecholla tav leatreh deitnasiv mittamman veha ukmuha ad zimna dekudsha berich hu zammin laachaya metaya kolla ganiz kammeh

Vehahu gufa mammash vehahi nishmata mammash zammin kudsha berich hu leatava lealma kemillekadmin ulchadta anpe alma hada hu dichtiv yichu metecha nevelati yekumun vehahi nishmata mammash geniza kamme kudsha berich hu vetavat leatrah kefum archaha kema deatte amer veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah ulzimna dezammin kudsha berich hu laachaya metaya zammin ihu learaka talla merisheh alayehu uvhahu talla yekumun kolla meafra
Hada hu dichtiv ki tal orot tallecha may tal orot orot mammash meinun nehorin dilela divhon zammin laaraka chayyin lealma begin deilana
260: Dechayye yarik chayyin dela paskin lealmin deha hashta paskin begin deha chiveya bisha shalta veitkasse sihara uvgin kach kivyachol paskin memoy vechayyin la shaltin bealma kedeka yeut

Uvhahu zimna hahu yetzer hara deihu chiveya visha yistallak mealma veyaavar leh kudsha berich hu kema deittemar veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz ulvatar deihu yitavar mealma sihara la itkasya venahara denagid venafik la yippaskun mabbuoy uchden ketiv vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim vegv

Amar rabbi chizkiyya i tema dechal gufin dealma yekumun veyitarun meafra inun gufe deitnetiu benishmata chada ma tehe minnayehu amar rabbi yose inun gufin dela zachu vela atzlachu hare inun kela hau kema dehau etz yavesh behahi alma hachi name behahu zimna vegufa batraa deitneta veatzlach venatal sharashoy kedeka yeut yakum

Vealeh ketiv vehaya keetz shatul al mayim vegv vehaya alehu raanan vegv deavad ibin venata sharashin veatzlach kedeka yeut veal hahu gufa kadmaa dela avad ibin vela nata sharashin ketiv vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov vegv ki yavo tov da techiyyat hammetim

Veyitnehir hahu nehora dezammin leanhara lehu letzaddikayya dehava ganiz kammeh miyyoma deitbere alma dichtiv vayyar elohim et haor ki tov uchden zammin kudsha berich hu laachaya metaya uchtiv vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka vegv uchden yitgabbar tov bealma vehahu deitkere ra yitavar mealma kidamaran uchden inun gufin kadmae leheo kella hau

Amar ribbi yitzchak zammin kudsha berich hu laaraka alayehu al inun gufin ruchin achoranin vei zachan behon yekumun bealma kedeka yeut vei lav yehon kitma techot raglehon detzaddikaya dichtiv uchtiv verabbim mishene admat afar yakitzu vegv vecholla ittakam veitattad kamme kudsha berich hu vechullehu beminyana hau kema deatte amer hammotzi bemispar tzevaam vegv

Ta chaze ha ittemar kal inun metin divara deyisrael yekumun bekadmita begin dekudsha berich hu yitar alayehu veokim lon alayehu ketiv yichu metecha illen inun di veara deyisrael nevelati yekumun illen inun divgo aran achoranin dela ketiv behu techiyya ella kima deha rucha dechayye la tishre ella beara kaddisha deyisrael uvgin kach ketiv behu yichu metecha veinun dilvar yitbere gufa dilhon vikumun gufa bela rucha ulvatar yitgalgelun techot afra ad deyimtun leeretz yisrael vetamman yekabbelun nishmata vela birshu achora begin deyitkayemun bealma kedeka chaze

Ribbi elazar veribbi yesa hau yatve lelya chad veaske beorayeta amar ribbi elazar ta chaze beshata dekudsha berich hu zammin laachaya metaya kal inun nishmatin deyitarun kammeh kullehu kayemin diuknin diuknin kammeh behahu diukna mammash dehau behay alma venachit lon kudsha berich hu veyikre lon bishmahan kema deatte amer lechullam beshem yikra vechal nishmata teol leduchtaha vikumun bekiyyuma bealma kedeka chaze uchden yehe alma shelim veal hahu zimna ketiv vecherfat ammo yasir vegv may vecherpat ammo yasir da yetzer hara deachshich anpe biryan veshallit behu

Amar ribbi yose ha chaminan kal zimna devar nash kaim berucha da lav ihu mesaav nafka nishmateh minneh ihu mesaav amar leh vadday hachi hu vehachi ittemar deha hahu yetzer hara kad natil rucha devar nash saiv leh veishtaar gufa mesaav ushar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot kad inun bechayyehon inun mesaavin deha missitra missaava it lon nishmatin vechad itrik minneh hahu mesaavu ishtaar gufa bela mesaavu kelal
261: Man deitdabbak beitteta dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot istaav ihu vehahu bera deityelid leh yekabbel aleh ruach mesaava vei tema ha besitra deavoy miyyisrael ka atya ammay yekabbel aleh ruach mesaova ta chaze deha bekadmita istaav avoy beshata deitdabbak behahi itteta deihi mesaova vechevan deav ihu istaav behahi itteta deihi mesaova kal shekken deihu bera deityelid minah yekabbel aleh ruach mesaova vela od ella deavar al orayeta dichtiv ki lo tishtachave leel acher ki Adonai kanna shemo begin dekanne al hay berit kaddisha

Amar ribbi elazar ta chaze deha ittemar dechevan deyada avraham avinu chachmeta baa leitperasha mikkal shear ammin vela leitdabbaka behu uvgin kach ketiv veashbiacha bayeya eloke hashshamayim viloke haaretz asher lo tikkach ishsha livni mibbenot hakkenaani vegv mibbenot hakkenaani vadday raza ihu kema deatte amer uvaal bat el nichar asher anochi yoshev bekirbo anochi dayeka ketiv hacha asher anochi uchtiv hatam

Ta chaze hay man deail hay berit kaddisha behahi itteta dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot garim leistaava atar achora veal da ketiv tachat shalosh ragza eretz vegv veaf al gav deome leh behay berit la avtach beh avraham ad detzalle tzeloteh kamme kudsha berich hu veamar Adonai eloke hashshamayim vegv hu yishlach malacho vadday da malach habberit begin deyitnetir hay berit vela yistaav ben inun ammin

Rak et beni lo tashev shamma may tama begin deyada avraham deha bechullehu la hava man deishtemoda leh lekudsha berich hu bar ihu bilchodoy vela baa delehu medoreh deyitzchak benayehu ella dihe medoreh immeh veyitzchak yolif minneh tadir archoy dekudsha berich hu vela yiste limina velismala veal da la baa avraham dilheve medoreh deyitzchak tamman
Amar ribbi yesa vadday zechuteh deavraham aora kammeh dehahu avda dehahu yoma nafak vehahu yoma mata leena demayya dichtiv vaavo hayyom el haayin veha ukmuha

Ribbi elazar patach veamar gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha kama inun beni nesha tippeshin dela yadin vela mistakkelin leishtaddela beorayeta begin deorayeta kal chayyin vechal cheru vechal tuv bealma den uvalma deate chayyin inun bealma den deyizkun leomin shelemin behay alma kema deatte amer et mispar yamecha amalle ulomin arichin bealma deate begin deinun chayyin shelemin inun chayyin dechedu chayye bela atzivu chayyin deinun chayyin cheru bealma den cheru decholla dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta la yachlin leshaltaa aloy kal ammin dealma

Vei tema inun beni shemad gezera hi milleela kegon rabbi akiva vechaveroy vechach salik bemachashava cheru demalach hammavet dela yachil leshaltaa aloy vehachi hu vadday dei adam hava itdabbak beilana dechayye deihu orayeta la garim mota leh ulchal alma uvgin kach kad yahav kudsha berich hu orayeta leyisrael ma ketiv bah charut al halluchot veha ukmuha veilmale inun la chatu veshavku ilana dechayye la garmu mota lealma kemilkaddemin vekudsha berich hu amar ani amarti elohim attem uvne elon kullechem chavaltun garmechon achen keadam temutun vegv veal da kal man deishtaddal beorayeta la yachil leshaltaa aloy hahu chiveya bisha deachshich alma
Amar rabbi yesa i hachi moshe ammay mit dei hachi kevan dela chav la yemut amar leh vadday mit aval la shalata beh kaamrinan ella la mit al yedoy vela istaav beh vela mit
262: Vadday ella itdabbak bishchinta veazil lechayye alma

Vehay chay ikre kema deokimna dichtiv uvnayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay vegv veal da kal man deishtaddal beorayeta cheru it leh mikkolla bealma den mishshibuda dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot cheru bealma deate begin dela yitbeun minneh dina behahu alma kelal

Ta chaze beorayeta kamma razin illain setimin it bah begin kach ketiv yekara hi mippeninim kamma genizin temirin it bah veal da kad istakkal david berucha dechachmeta veyada kamma pelian nafkin meorayeta patach veamar gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha

Davar acher vehinne rivka yotzet kema dichtiv yotzot lishov mayim ammay yotzot velo holchot velo vaot ella begin ditmirin hau kal yoma uvhahi shata nafkin leshaava maya vesimana nakit bideh
