263: Metabbar tarin vedafik lon leaala tzeloteh el dimati al techorash da ail kamme malka velet tara dekaim kammeh ulolam la ahadaru dimin berekanya
Tu ha ketiv hacha telat dargin tefilla shavea dima lakovel illen telat achoranin ki ger anochi immach levatar toshav levatar kechal avotay ikra dealma

Ta chaze tzelota devar nash meomed begin ditre tzelota ninhu chad mioshshev vechad meomed veinun chad lakovel teren dargin tefilla shel yad utfilla shel rosh legabbe yom valayela vecholla chad uf hacha tefilla mioshshev legabbe tefilla shel yad leatkin lah kema deatkin lechalla vekashit lah leaala lechuppa hachi name mekashtin lah beraza dirtichaa umashshiryaha yotzer meshartim vaasher meshartav vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh vechu
Veal da tzelota meushshav kevan deaolat legabbe malka illaa veihu ate lekabbela lah keden anan kayemin kamme malka illaa deha keden dechura itchabbar benukva uvgin kach la yafsik ben geulla litfilla

Uvgin devar nash kaim kamme malka illaa natal arba ammot litzloteh veukmuha divshiura desurta deotzer kolla vechal ma deate besitra didchura bae leh leinish lemekam vekiyyumeh veizdakkaf kegavena da kad ihu korea korea bevaruch vechad ihu zakif zakif bashshem begin leachazaa shevacha didchura al nukva

Veta chaze deha ukmuha la yitzle bar nash achore rabbeh veittemar kema dichtiv et Adonai elokecha tira et leachlala devae lemidchal merabbeh kemora dishchinta udchilu detalmid rabbeh ihu begin kach beshata ditzlota la yashve hahu mora lekammeh ella mora dekudsha berich hu bilchodoy vela mora achora

Veta chaze tzelota demincha atkin leh yitzchak vadday kema deatkin avraham tzelota detzafra lakovel hahu darga deitdabbak beh vechen yitzchak atkin tzelota demincha lakovel hahu darga deitdabbak beh veal da tzelota demincha mechi nate shimsha lenachata bedargoy listar maarav

Deha ad la nata shimsha letzad maarav ikre yom mitztzafra ad hahu zimna dichtiv chesed el kal hayyom vei tema ad chashecha ta chaze dichtiv oy na lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev ki fana hayyom lakovel tzelota detzafra dichtiv chesed el kal hayyom deha keden shimsha ihu listar mizrach kevan denata shimsha venachata listar maarav ha keden ihu zeman tzelota demincha uchvar pana hayyom veatu tzille arev veitar dina kashya bealma

Ufana hayyom deihu darga dechesed venatu tzille arev deinun darga dedina kashya uchden itcharav be makdesha veittokad hechala veal da taninan dihe var nash zahir bitzlota demincha deihu zimna dedina kashya sharya bealma
Yaakov atkin tzelota dearvit deha ihu atkin lah vezan lah bechal ma deitzterich vadday atkin leh veh ittezanat min delet lah nehora miggarmah kelal

Uvgin kach tefillat arvit reshut deha itkelilat bitzlota deoma begin leitnahara vehashta lav zimna ihu veokimna lah deha la itgalya nehora dimama deyanhir lah veihi shalta bachashocha ad zimna defalgut lelya deishtasha kudsha berich hu im tzaddikaya beginta deeden uchden ihu zimna leishtashea bar nash beorayeta kema deittemar

Ta chaze david ata veamar illen telat zimnin ditzlote dichtiv erev vavoker vetzahorayim ha telata veihu la tzalle ella tere minnayehu dichtiv asicha veeheme vela yattir da litzlota detzafra veda litzlota demincha begin kach asicha veehme dayeka betzafra deihu shata dechesed sagge leh bechesed beasicha uvmincha dehu shata dedina kashya bae hamaya uvgin kach veehme ulvatar kad itpelig lelya hava kam beshirin vetushbechan kedeka
264: Yaot dichtiv uvallayela shiro immi veha ittemar

Kam rabbi shimon veazlu azal hahu var nash bahadeh ad teverya ad dehau azlu amar ribbi shimon ta chaze tefillot keneged temidin tiknum rabbanan deanshe keneset haggedola begin deashkechan tere dichtiv et hakkeves echad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim veinun mitkarvin behanne tere zimne deoma deinun zimnin litzlota
Amar hahu gavra ha bekadmita avot tiknum lehanni tzelote uma deatkinu avraham veyitzchak hu ikra uma deatkin yaakov deihu shevacha deavahan ammay ihu reshut vela ikkera kehanne

Amar ribbi shimon ha ittemar aval ta chaze hanni tere zimne ditre tzelote lav inun ella lechabbera leyaakov beadveh kevan deitchabbaru da beda anan la tzerichin yattir dechevan deityehivat itteta ben teren deroin veitchabbarat begufa la itzterich yattir veal da anan bainan leitara teren deroin begin deityehivat benayehu kevan deihi benayehu gufa veitteta millayehu bilchishu dela leadkara

Uvgin kach yaakov meshammesh bammarom taninan may bammarom kema deatte amer veatta marom leolam Adonai vecholla ihu raza leyade middin atu ribbi abba vehahu yuday unshaku yedoy amar ribbi abba ad yoma den la kaimna bemilla da bar hashta zakkaa chulaki dezachina lemishma leh

Vayevieha yitzchak haohla sara immo amar rabbi yose hay kera kashya haohla leohel sara immo mibbae leh may haohela daahadderat tamman shechinta begin dechal zimna desara kayema bealma shechinta la aade minah ushragga hava delikat meerev shabbat leerev shabbat vehava nahir kal inun yome deshabbatta batar demitat kavta hahi sheragga kevan deatat rivka ahaddarat shechinta ushragga adlikat sara immo dedamya lesara bechal ovadaha

Ribbi yehuda amar kema dediukneh deyitzchak hava kediuknih deavraham vechal man dechame leyitzchak amar da avraham vaday avraham holid et yitzchak hachi name rivka diukkenah mammash havat diukna desara uvgin kach sara immo vadday

Amar ribbi elazar becholla hachi hu aval ta chaze raza ihu deaf al gav desara mitat deukna la aade min beta vela itchaze tamman miyyoma demitat ad deatat rivka kevan deaolat rivka itchaziat diukna desara dichtiv vayevieha yitzchak haohla vegv miyyad sara immo itchaziat tamman vela hava chame lah bar yitzchak bilchodoy kad ail tamman veal da vayyinnachem yitzchak achare immo deimmo itchaziat veizdammena beveta veal da la ketiv achare mitat immo ella achare immo

Ribbi shimon amar may shena dichtiv beh beyitzchak vayyikkach et rivka vattehi lo leishsha vayyeehaveha kevan deamar vattehi lo leishsha la yedana dehu rachim lah deha kal beni alma rachame linshayehu may shena beyitzchak dichtiv beh vayyeehaveha

Ella vadday itaruta dirchimu didchura legabbe itteta lav ihu ella semala dichtiv semolo tachat leroshi vechoshech velayela kechad inun usmala itar rechimu tadir legabbe nukva veachid bah veal da af al gav deavraham rachim lah lesara la ketiv beh vayyeehaveha ella beyitzchak vei tema vayyeehav yaakov et rachel sitra deyitzchak dehava beh kaovid leh

Ta chaze avraham kad chama lesara hava mechabbek lah vela yattir aval yitzchak deihu baalah achid bah veshave deroeh techot reshah dichtiv semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni levatar ata yaakov veshimmesh arsa veolid teresar shevatin kolla kedeka yeut
Veta chaze avahan kullehu beraza chada
265: Azlu vechullehu shimshu bearba nashin kal chad minnayehu avraham bearba sara vehagar utre pillagshim dichtiv velivni happillagshim asher leavraham pillagshim tere ha arba

Yitzchak beraza dearba distiru derivka dichtiv vayyikkach et rivka chad vattehi lo leishsha tere vayyeehaveha telat vayyinnachem yitzchak achare immo ha arba lakovel da hau leyaakov arba nashin vecholla beraza chada

Ribbi chiya amar avraham veyitzchak shimmeshu kal chad beitteta chada beraza dekudsha avraham besara yitzchak berivka velakovel tarvayehu have arba nashin leyaakov bitren chulakin ribbi shimon amar seliku millin leatrayehu deha kolla beraza kaddisha itavad vecholla beraza chada

Vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushmah ketura ketura da hi hagar deha taninan batar deitperasha hagar minneh deavraham vetaat batar gillule deavuha levatar itkashra beovadin dechashran uvgin kach ishtanne shemah veikre ketura beovadin dechashran veshadar avraham unsavah leh leintu mikkan deshinnuy shema mechapper chovin veal da ishtanne shemah

Vayyosef avraham may vayyosef i tema deal sara ihu deosif lav hachi ella beomaha desara izdavag bahadah zimna chada ulvatar tarich lah al iske deyishmael ulvatar vayyosef kemilkadmin zimna achora al ma denasiv lah bekadmita uchfum deshane ovadaha hachi name shane shemah

Ta chaze deamar rabbi elazar vayevieha yitzchak haohla sara immo deitgalya diukna desara veyitzchak itnecham achare deitgalya immo vediuknaha hava chame kal yoma veavraham af al gav deinsiv la al behahu beta vela ail lah lehay itteta tamman begin deshifcha lo tirash gevirta uvohel desara la itchaze itteta achora ella rivka

Veavraham af al gav dehava yada dediukna desara itgalleya tamman shavkeh leyitzchak hahu ohel lemechome diukna deimmeh kal yoma yitzchak vela avraham hada hu dichtiv vayyitten avraham et kal asher lo leyitzchak et kal asher lo dayeka da hahu diukna desara behahu mashkena

Davar acher vayitten avraham et kal asher lo leyitzchak raza dimhemnuta illaa leitdabbeka yitzchak bedarga dechulakeh kedeka yeut ta chaze hacha itkelil esha bemaya vadday esha natil maya mashma vayyitten avraham et kal asher lo leyitzchak da maya deitkelil beesha uvkadmita itkelil kechada esha bemaya ematay beshata deakad leh leyitzchak lemebad beh dina keden itkelil esha bemaya vehashta itkelilu maya beesha lemehve kolla raza dimhemnuta illaa

Velivne happilagshim asher leavraham natan avraham mattanot may mattanot illen sitre dargin tattain deinun shemahan desitre ruach mesaava begin leashlama dargin veistallak yitzchak al kolla bimhemnuta illaa kedeka chaze

Bene happilagshim illen hau bene ketura pillegesh bekadmita ufillegesh hashta rabbi chiyya amar pilagshim mammash vayeshallechem meal yitzchak veno dela leshalletaa legabbeh deyitzchak beodenu chay beod dehava avraham chay vekayyam bealma dela yekatregun leh levatar uvgin deyittakkan yitzchak bistar dina kashya illaa leittakkefa al kullehu vechullehu itkafyan kammeh kedma el eretz kedem begin detamman inun sitre chorashe mesaave

Ta chaze ketiv vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kal bene kedem illen inun dehau mibbene bene pilagshim deavraham veha okimna deha beinun harre kedem inun deolfin chorashin livne nasha umehahi eretz kedem nafku lavan uvor uvilam beno vechullehu chorashe veha ukmuha

266: Veyisrael levozzim halo Adonai vegv ta chaze mizzimna deitcharav be makdesha birchan la sharyan bealma veitmenau kivyachol itmenau meela vetatta vechal inun shear dargin tattain mittakfe veazle veshalte alayehu deyisrael begin deinun garmu bechovayehu

Uvshata dezammin kudsha berich hu lemifkad al ammeh keneset yisrael tetuv min galuta bekadmita tehach leveta vegin devet hammikdash yitbene bekadmita veyema lah kudsha berich hu kumi meafra hi tavat veamra lean atar ehach betay charav hechali ittokad benura ad dekudsha berich hu yivni be makdesha bekadmita veyatkin hechala veyivne karta diyerushala ulvatar yokim lah meafra hada hu dichtiv boni yerushalayim Adonai vegv bone yerushalayim bekadmita ulvatar nidche yisrael yechannes veyema lah hitnaari meafar kumi shevi yerushalayim vegv veyitkannesh galuthon deyisrael hada hu dichtiv bone yerushalayim Adonai bekadmita ulvatar nidche yisrael yechannes uchden harofe lishvure lev umchabbesh leatzvotam da techiyyat hammetim uchtiv veet ruchi etten bekirbechem veasiti et asher bechukkay telechu vegv baruch Adonai leolam amen vamen

Midrash hanneelam velle toldot yitztzechak ben avraham avraham holid et yitztzechak ribbi yitztzechak patach haddudaim natnu reach tanu rabbanan leatid lavo hakkadosh baruch hu mechayye et hammetim vinaer otam meafram shello yihu binyan afar kemot shehau battechilla shennivreu meafar mammash davar sheeno mitkayyem hada hu dichtiv vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar min haadama
267: Shaashuim yom yom al tikre amon ella uman

Kad baa lemivre adam amra tora kammeh i bar nash yitbere ulvatar yechote veante tidun leh ammay yehon ovade yedach lemaggana deha la yechul lemisbal dinach amar leh kudsha berich hu ha atkinat teshuva ad la varati alma amar kudsha berich hu lealma beshaata deavad leh uvara leadam amar leh alma alma ante venimusach la kayemin ella al orayeta uvgin kach barati leh laadam bach begin deyitassak bah vei lav ha ana ahadar lach letohu vavohu vecholla begineh deadam kayema hada hu dichtiv anochi asiti eretz veadam aleha barati veorayeta kayema umachreza kammayehu divne nasha begin deyitasseku veyishtaddelu bah velet man deyarchin udneh

Ta chaze kal man deishtaddal beorayeta ihu kiyyem alma vekiyyem kal ovada veovada al tikkuneh kedeka yeut velet lach kal shayefa veshayefa dekayema beh bevar nash dela have lekovleh beriya bealma deha kema devar nash ihu mitpallig shayefin vechullehu kayemin dargin al dargin mittaknin illen al illen vechullehu chad gufa hachi name alma kal inun beriyyan kullehu shayefin shayefin vekayemin illen al illen vechad mittaknan kullehu ha gufa mammash vecholla kegavena deorayeta deha orayeta kolla shayefin ufirkin vekayemin illen al illen vechad mittakkenan kullehu itavidu chad gufa kevan deistakkal david beovada da patach veamar ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyancha

Beorayeta inun kal razin illain chatimin dela yachlin leitdabbaka beorayeta kal inun millin illain deitgalleyan vela itgalleyan beorayeta inun kal millin dilela ultatta kal millin dealma den vechal millin dealma deate beorayeta inun velet

Shaa yitnaaru meafar meoto habbinyan veyaamdu bevinyan mekuyam lihot lahem kiyyuma hada hu dichtiv hitnaari meafar kumi shevi yerushalami yitkayemu bekiyyuma veyaalu mittachat laaretz vikabbelu nishmatam beeretz yisrael beotah shaa yatztzif kudsha berich hu kal mine rechin shebbagan eden alehem hada hu dichtiv haddudaim natnu reach

Veal petachenu ellu pitche shamayim shehem petuchim lehorid neshamot lifgarim kal megadim ellu hanneshamot chadashim gam yeshanim otam sheyyatztzeu nishmatam mehayyom kamma shanim veotam sheyyatztzeu nishmatam miyyamim muatim vezachu bechishron maasehem lehikkanes baolam habba kullam atidim lered bevat achat lehikkanes baggufot hammuchanim lahem

268: Man deyashgach veyada lon uvgin kach ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kal tehillato

Ta chaze ata shelomo uvaa lemekam al milloy deorayeta veal dikduke orayeta vela yachil amar amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni david amar gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha ta chaze ketiv bishlomo vayedabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayehi shiro chamishsha vaalef veha ukmuha dechamishsha veelef teamim hau bechal mashal umashal dehava amar uma shelomo deihu basar vadam kach hau bemilloy millin deorayeta dekaamar kudsha berich hu al achat kamma vechamma debbechal milla umilla it bah kamma meshalim kamma shirin kamma tushbechan kamma razin illain kamma chachman veal da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai

Ta chaze ma ketiv leela veelle toldot yishmael deinun teresar nesiin levatar amar veelle toldot yitzchak salleka datach dechevan dichtiv beh beyishmael deolid terisar nesiin veyitzchak olid teren benin deda istallak veda la istallak al da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai da yitzchak veyitzchak appik leh leyaakov dehava ihu bilchodoy yattir mikkullehu deolid teresar shivtin kiyyuma dilela vetatta aval yitzchak leela bikdushsha illaa veesav letatta veal da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kal tehillato da yaakov kad itdabbak shimsha besihara kamma kochvaya nehirin minnayehu

Veelle toldot yitzchak ben avraham amar ribbi yose may shena dead hacha la ketiv ben avraham vehashta amar ella af al gav dichtiv vayevarech elohim et yitzchak beno hashta demit avraham diukneh hava beh veishtaar beh beyitzchak dechal man dechame leyitzchak hava amar da avraham vadday vehava sahid veamar avraham holid et yitzchak

Amar rav yehuda amar rav atid hakkadosh baruch hu lismoach beoto zeman im hatztzaddikim lehashrot shechinato immahem vehakkol yismechu beotah simcha hada hu dichtiv yismach Adonai bemaasav amar ribbi yehuda atidim hatztzaddikim beoto zeman livro olamot ulhachaot metim amar leh ribbi yose vehatnan en kal chadash tachat hashshamesh amar leh ribbi yehuda ta shema beod sheharshaim baolam veyirbu kal haolam eno bekiyyum uchshehatztzaddikim baolam azay haolam mitkayyem veatidim lehachaot metim kidkaamaran od yeshvu zekenim uzkenot birchovot yerushalam veish mishanto beyado merov ymim kedichtiv leel

Beoto zeman yassigu hatztzaddikim daat shelema deamar ribbi yose beoma deyechede kudsha berich hu beovadoy zeminin inun tzaddikaya leminda leh belibbehon uchden yisge suchletanu belibbehon keilu chazu leh beena hada hu dichtiv vamar bayyom hahu hinne elohenu ze vegv vsimchat hanneshama bagguf yeter mikkullam al sheyyihu shenihem kayyamim veyidu veyassigu et boram vyehenu mizziv hashshechina vezehu hatov hagganuz latztzaddikim leatid lavo hada hu dichtiv velle toldot yitztzechak ben avraham ellu hem toldot hassimcha vehassechok sheyehe baolam beoto zeman ben avraham hi hanneshama hazzocha lechach velihot shelema bemaalatah avraham holid et yitztzechak hanneshama molida hassimcha vehassechok hazze baolam

Amar ribbi yehuda leribbi chiyya ha detaninan deatid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot seuda latztzaddikim leatid lavo may hi amar leh ad la azlit kamme inun malachin kaddishin mare matnitin hachi shemia li kevan deshamit ha deamar ribbi elazar itshva belibbay deamar ribbi elazar seudat hatztzaddikim leatid lavo kehay dichtiv vayyechezu et haelohim vayychlu vayyishtu veda hu ditnan nizonin veamar ribbi
269: Lemile beorayeta verabbi yehuda kam bekesaroy behahi shata amar rabbi yehuda ekum veezil legabbe rabbi yitzchak veile beorayeta venitchabbar kechada azal immeh chizkiyya berih dehava ravya kad kariv abbava shama leh leribbi yitzchak dehava amar vayehi achare mot avraham vayevarech elohim et yitzchak beno vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi hay kera lav resheh sefeh velav sefeh resheh may shena dekudsha berich hu itzterich levarcha leh leyitzchak begin deavraham la beracheh may taama mishshum dela yitbarech esav veal da seliku inun birchan lekudsha berich hu veukmuha vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi may lachay roi ella deitchabbar vah bishchinta bera demalach kayama itchaze alah ketargumo uvgin kach beracheh

Adhachi batash rabbi yehuda abbava veal veitchabbaru amar rabbi yitzchak hashta ziuuga dishchinta bahadan amar ribbi yehuda hay beer lachay roi dekaamarte shappir aval bemilla ishtema patach veamar mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon hay kera ittemar aval ha ukmuha mayan ganim da avraham beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak venozlim min levanon da yaakov beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak hayenu dichtiv vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi umay beer da shechinta lachay da chay haolamim tzaddik chay haolamim velet leafrasha lon chay hu bitri almin chay leela deihu alma illaa chay legabbe alma tattaa vealma tattaa begineh kayema venahara

Ta chaze sihara la itnehirat ella kad chazya leh leshimsha vechevan dechazya leh itnehir veal da hay beer lachay roi vadday uchden itnahara vekayema bemayin chayin lachay roi begin leitmalleya ulitnahara mehay chay

Elazar beatar chad taninan nehenin uvatar achora taninan nizonin may ben hay lehay ella hachi amar avoy hatztzaddikim shello zachu kal kach nehenin meoto ziv shello yassigu kal kach aval hatztzaddikim shezzachu nizzonin ad sheyyassigu hassaga shelema veen achila ushtiyya ella zo vezo hi hasseuda vehaachila umna lan ha mimmoshe dichtiv vayehi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layela lechem lo achal umayim lo shata may taama lechem lo achal umayim lo shata mippene shehaya nizzon misseuda acheret meoto ziv shel mala uchhay gavena seudatan shel tzaddikim leatid lavo

Amar ribbi yehuda seudat hatztzaddikim leatid lavo lismoach besimchato hada hu dichtiv yishmeu anavim veyismachu rav huna amar mehacha veyismechu chal chose vach leolam yerannenu amar ribbi yitztzechak hay vhay ita leatid lavo vetana amar ribbi yose yayin hamshumar baanavav mishsheshet yeme vereshit ellu devarim attikim shello niglu leadam miyyom shennivra haolam vaatidim lehitteggalot latztzaddikim leatid lavo vezo hi hashshetiya vachila vadday da hi

Amar ribbi yehuda beribbi shalom im ken mahu liveyatan umahu hashshor dichtiv ki vul harim yisu lo amar ribbi yose vha ketiv baet hahi yifkod Adonai becharbo hakkasha vhaggedola vehachazaka al liyatan nachash bariach veal liveyatan nachash akalaton vharag et hattannin asher bayyam ha hacha telata ella remez hu deka ramaz al malkevata amar ribbi tanchum let lememar al ma deamru rabbanan vadday kach hi

Amar ribbi yitztzechak ana havina kammeh deribbi yehoshua veshailna hay milla amarna hay seudata detztzaddikaya leatid lavo i kach hu la ityashva belibbay deha amar ribbi elazar seudat hatztzaddikim leatid lavo kehay gavena
270: Uvnayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay dehava tzaddik venahir ledareh kema dechay dilela nahir lealma uvchal zimna hay beer lachay istakkal vechame begin leitnahara kidkaamaran vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi hayenu dichtiv bekachto et rivka veyativ bahadah veitachid immah choshech ballayela dichtiv semolo tachat leroshi veta chaze yitzchak bekiryat arba hava batar demit avraham mahu vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi deizdavag beh veachid beh behahu bera leatara rechimuta kidkaamaran

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar vezarach hashshemesh vva hashshemesh veel mekomo shoef zoreach hu sham vezarach hashshemesh da shimsha denahir lesihara dechad itchaze bahadah keden nahara veitnehir vezarach meatar illaa dekayema aleh mittamman zarach tadir uva hashshemesh leizdavvega bahadah desihara holech el darom deihu yemina veshave tukfeh beh uvgin detukfeh beh kal chela degufa bimina hu uveh talya ulvatar sovev el tzafon nahir lesitra da venahir lesitra da sovev sovev holech haruach bekadmita ketiv shemesh vehashta ruach ella kolla chad veraza chada vechal da begin desihara itnahara minneh veyitchabberun tarvayehu

Ta chaze kad ata avraham lealma chavik lah lesihara vekariv lah kevan deata yitzchak achid bah veatkif bah kedeka yeut umashich lah birchimu kema deittemar dichtiv semolo tachat lerosh kevan deata yaakov keden itchabbar shimsha besihara veitnehir veishtakkach yaakov shelim vechal sitrin vesihara itnehirat veittakkanat bitresar shivtin

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar hinni barchu et Adonai kal avde Adonai vegv hay kera ukmuha aval ta chaze hinne barchu et Adonai uman inun deyitchazun levarcha leh lekudsha berich hu kal avde Adonai begin dechal bar nash
Dichtiv vayechezu et haelohim vayyochlu vayyishtu amar ribbi yehoshua shappir kaamar ribbi elazar vchach hu

Od amar ribbi yehoshua hay mehemnuta deamru rabbanan lerubba dealma dezamminin inun behay seudata deliyatan vehahu tora ulmishte chamra tav deitnetar mikkad itbere alma kera ashkachu vdarshu dichtiv vaachaltem lachmechem lasova deamar ribbi zera kal mine pituy pitta hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael lehachaziram lemutav veda hu yattir mikkullehon deamar lehu vaachaltem lachmechem lasova uvakkelalot vaachaltem velo tisbau veda kashya lehu mikkullehu may taama dichtiv mi yitten mutenu beyad Adonai beeretz mitztzerayim vegv amar ribbi zera melammed demishshum haachila masru nafsham lamut beyadam kevan sheraa hakkadosh baruch hu taavatam amar lahem im tishmeu lekol hammitztzeot vaachaltem lasova kede lehaniach datam kehay gavena chamu rabbanan degaluta itmashshach istakkemu al kerae deorayeta veamru dizminin lemechal ulmechede bisudata rabba dezammin kudsha berich hu lemebad lehu veal da rubba dealma savlu galuta begin hahi seudata

Amar ribbi yochanan let lan listor mehemnuta decholla ella lekayema leh deha orayeta ashidat aloy deha anan yadin mehemnuta detztzaddikaya vechissufa dilhon may hi dichtiv nagila venismecha vach velo vaachila nazkira dodecha miyyayin vehahi seudata dizminin bah yehe lan chulak lemehene minnah vzo hi hassimcha vehassechok veelle toldot yitztzechak sheyyitztzechaku hatztzaddikim leatid lavo avraham holid et yitztzechak zakkut hanneshama molid hassechok hazze vehassimcha baolam
271: Bealma miyyisrael af al gav decholla yitchazun levarcha leh lekudsha berich hu birchata divginayehu yitbarchun illain vetattain man hi hahi devarchin leh avde Adonai vela kullehu uman inun devirkathon bircheta haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot illen inun dekayemu befalgut lelya veitare lemikre beorayeta illen kayeme bevet Adonai ballelot deha keden kudsha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden veanan kayeme hacha leitara bemille deorayeta nema bemille deyitzchak deanan beh

Patach rabbi yitzchak veamar vayehi yitzchak ben arbaim shana bekachto et rivka vegv ben arbaim shana ammay ata lemimne hacha dehava ben arbaim shana kad nasiv lah lerivka ella vadday ha itkelil yitzchak betzafon vedarom beesha umayya uchden hava yitzchak ben arbaim shana bekachto et rivka kemare hakkeshet yarok chivar sumak bat shalosh shanim achid bah kad achid bah berivka vechad olid olid ben shishim leolada kedeka yeut begin deyifuk yaakov shalem mibben shishim shana kedeka yeut vechullehu achid lehu yaakov levatar veitavid gevar shelim

Bat betuel haarammi mippaddan aram achot lavan haarammi may ichpat lan kule hay deha kevar ittemar uvtuel yalad et rivka vegv vehashta amar bat betuel haarammi ulvatar mippadan aram ulvatar achot lavan haarammi ella ukmuha dehavat ben reshaim veihi la avdat keovadayehu dehavat bat betuel umippadan aram vaachot lavan vechullehu chayyavin leavasha vehi salka ovadin dechashran vela avadat keovadayehu

Hashta it leistakkala i rivka havat bat esrin shenin o yattir o bat shelosh esre keden hu shevacha dilah dela avdat keovadayehu aval ad kean bat shalosh shanim havat may shevacha dilah amar ribbi yehuda bat shalosh shanim havat veavidat leavda kal hahu ovada
Amar ribbi yitzchak af al gav dechulay hay avdat la yedana ovadaha i inun kesheran o lav

Vayehi yitztzechak ben arbaim shana ribbi bo beshem ribbi yose patach vamar yishshakeni minneshikot pihu bechamma maalot nivra haolam detaninan amar ribbi acha bar yaakov kal ma shebbara kudsha berich hu baolamot shello chutz mimmennu hau beshittuf umi amar ribbi acha hachi chas veshalom deha bemilla da yisge pelugta bealma dei tema hachi hammalachim shehem nivraim ruach hakkodesh mammash yomar sheyyish shittuf bahem ha kal appayya didhon vdidan shaveyan

Amar ribbi abba bemilla da yisge pelugta bealma deha tenan bematnitin didan dechal deavad kudsha berich hu avad kegon gufa vnishmata vei tema deha let gufa lammalachim kach hu aval let inun yachlin lemebad avidta ad sheyyishtattef behu hahi nishmata kaddisha dehi siyyua dilela uvhay gavene kal may deavid itztzeterich lehahi siyyua dilela minnih

Amar ribbi yose behahi shata dezammin kudsha berich hu laachaya metaya veha sofa kal amikin bearbaim lehevi ugzar keyam arbaim yakkennu lo yosif sof halichatam shel yisrael bammidbar bishnat haarbaim arbaim shana kodem techiyyat hagguf mamtenet lo hanneshama beeretz yisrael bishnat haarbaim yekumun haggufot meafra bearbaim nichla haggeshem hada hu dichtiv vayehi haggeshem al haaretz arbaim yom uchtiv vayehi mikketz arbaim yom vayyiftach noach zeman geulatam shel yisrael bishnat haarbaim hu uvachamishshim ata yishshuv alma dehi hayyovel hachzarat
272: Ella ta chaze ketiv keshoshanna ben hachochim ken raayati ben habbanot keshoshanna da keneset yisrael deihi ben uchlusaha kevarda ben kuvin veraza demilla yitzchak ate missitra deavraham deihu chesed illaa veavid chesed im kal biryan veaf al gav deihu dina kashya verivka atat missitra dedina kashya veistallekat mibbenayehu veitchabberat beyitzchak deha rivka missitra dedina kashya atya veaf al gav deihi missitra dedina rafya havat vechuta dechesed tale bah veyitzchak dina kashya veihi rafya keshoshanna ben hachochim hau vei lav deihi rafya la yachil alma lemisbal dina kashya deyitzchak kegavena da kudsha berich hu mezaveg ziuugin bealma chad takkif vechad rafya begin leittakkana kolla veyitbassem alma

Patach ribbi yehuda avatreh veamar vayyetar yitzchak layeya lenochach ishto mahu vayyetar dekariv leh karebbana vetzalle alah uma karbana kariv ola kariv dichtiv vayyeater lo Adonai ketiv hacha vayyeater lo Adonai uchtiv hatam vayyeater elohim laaretz vegv ma lehallan karban af kan karban ketiv vayyetar yitzchak uchtiv vayyeater lo denafak esha milleela lekovla esha diltatta

Davar acher vayyetar yitzchak detzalle tzeloteh vechatar chatira leela legabbe mazzala al benin deha behahu atar talyan benin dichtiv vattitpallel al Adonai uchden vayyeater lo Adonai al tikre vayyeater lo ella vayyechater lo chatira chatar leh kudsha berich hu vekabbil leh uchden vattahar rivka ishto

Ta chaze esrin shenin ishtahe yitzchak im itteteh vela olidat ad detzalle tzeloteh begin dekudsha berich hu itrae bitzlothon detzaddikaya beshata devaan kammeh tzelothon al ma deitzterichu may tama begin deyitrabbe veyittosaf revut kudsha lechal man

Hanneshama lagguf bishnat haarbaim shehimtina lo beeretz yisrael hada hu dichtiv vayehi yitztzechak ben arbaim shana shehimtin lagguf bekachto et rivka behachnasatah bagguf hammezuman lo beotah shaa behachnasatah bo en taavatam vechissufam ella lehanot mizziv hashshechina velizon mizzivah hada hu dichtiv yishshakeni minneshikot pihu amar ribbi abba yishshakeni yefarneseni sheen parnasatan ella lehanot velizon mizzivah shel mala amar ribbi yose sofeh dikra mochach dichtiv ki tovim dodecha miyyayin

Bat betuel bat bitto shel el rav huna amar lo chach hu veana havit bichrakke hayyam veshamana dehau karan lehahu garma deshiddera hahu deishtaar bekivra mikkal gufa betuel rammaa sheelit aleh amru dehu keresha dechiya deihu rammaa vhahu garma hu rammaa mikkal shear garme

Detana amar ribbi shimon hahu garma lamma ishtaar bekiyyuma ytir mikkal shear garme mishshum deihu rammaa velet savil taama dimzona divne nasha kishar garme uvgine kach hu takkif mikkal garme vhu lehevi ikkera degufa itbene minneh hada hu dichtiv bat betuel haarammi

Vetana amar ribbi shimon hu rammay umeolam rammay veshachen yitztzer hara deihu rammay hada hu dichtiv bat betuel haarammi garma rammaa mippaddan aram mitztzemed rammain keditnan paddena detora shehu tzemed achot lavan achot yetztzer hara haarammi keditnan battechilla shehaya menuval bechataot baz haolam nikra lot leatid lavo shello yehe menuval kidvekadmita keman desache umatbil mesaavuteh karan leh lavan al kal panim en yitztzer hara batel min haolam
Ta shema dehachi anan okimna bematnita shette benot lot shehen shette kochot hagguf hamorrot layyitztzer hara achshav sheeno menuval kal kach venitbal millichlucho
273: Ta chaze avraham la tzalle kamme kudsha berich hu deyitten leh benin af al gav desara akara havat vei tema ha ketiv hen li lo natatta zara hahu lav begin tzelota hava ella keman demishtae kamme mareh aval yitzchak tzalle al itteteh begin deha ihu hava yada delav ihu akar ella itteteh deyitzchak hava yada beraza dechachmeta deyaakov zammin lemepak minneh bitresar shivtin aval la yada i behay itteta i beachora veal da lenochach ishto vela lenochach rivka

Amar hahu ravya bereh deribbi yehuda i hachi ammay la rachim leh yitzchak leyaakov kal kach kemo leesav hoil vehava yada dezammin ihu lekayema minneh teresar shivtin amar leh shappir kaamarte ella kal zina rachim leh lezineh veitmeshich veazil zina batar zineh

Ta chaze esav nafak sumak kema dichtiv vayyetze harishon admoni kullo vegv veihu zina deyitzchak deihu dina kashya dilela venafak minneh esav dina kashya letatta dedamya lezineh vechal zina azil lezineh veal da rachim leh leesav yattir miyyaakov kema dichtiv vayyeehav yitzchak et esav ki tzayid befiv ketiv hacha ki tzayid befiv uchtiv hatam al ken yeamar kenimrod gibbor tzayid lifne Adonai

Amar ribbi yitzchak ketiv vayyitrotzatzu habbanim bekirebbah vattomer im ken lamma ze anochi vattelech lidrosh et Adonai lean atar azlat leve midresha deshem veever vayyitrotzatzu habbanim bekirbah detamman hava hahu rasha deesav agach kerava beh beyaakov vayyitrotzatzu itbaru kema deamrinan ratzatz et mocho itbaru da im da veitpelagu ta chaze da sitra derochev nachash veda sitra derochev al karseya shelemata kaddisha besitra
Nikra lavan votan shette banot enan betelot mammash hada hu dichtiv ullavan shette vanot

Amar ribbi yose kach hu tamman ketiv bechira utztzeira vehacha ketiv gedola uktanna amar ribbi yose aval enan bechoach laasot ra ulhitorer layitztzer hara kemittechilla mashma dichtiv shem haggedola lea shellea mikkochah umerishatah veshem hakketanna rachel sheen bah koach hammitorer kema deatte amer uchrachel lifne gozzeha neelama amar rav huna ze yitztzer hara ushte benotav mitchallefot mikkemot shehau barishona battechilla lot mekullal menuval achshav lavan melubban sheeno mekullal umnuval beniulo kevarishona battechilla shette benotav chazakot kal achat vachat bechochah veachshav shem haggedola lea lea belo koach lea belo chizzuk lea mimmaaseha harishonim veshem hakketanna rachel kidkaamaran velo kemot shehau barishona

Amar ribbi acha bar yaakov ta chaze ma ketiv vayetar yitztzechak la lenochach ishto ki akara hi amar ribbi acha mippene ma hi akara mippene sheyyetztzer hara eno nimtza bechocho baolam veal kach en nimtza periyya urviyya zulati battefilla ma ketiv vayyeater lo Adonai vattahar rivka ishto kevan shemmitorer yitztzer hara nimtza periyya urviyya

Amar ribbi yose im ken ma hefresh ben haolam haz leoto hazzeman veod deha kera kaamar dekudsha berich hu avid amar ribbi acha kach hu dekudsha berich hu itar leh lehahu inyana detztzarich lezavvega vela lechal shata dihe tadir im bar nash kemo kean deihu ishtakkach tadir vechatan beh bene nasha ella lehahu ziuuga bilchodoy hahi veitaruta itaruta dekudsha berich hu lehevi hada hu dichtiv vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar mahu lev basar amar ribbi yehuda lev lehotztzi basar velo ledavar acher
274: Veta chaze begin deitmeshach esav avatrih dehahu nachash azil immeh yaakov beakima kenachash deihu chakkim veihu azil beakimu kema deatte amer vehannachash haya arom vegv chakkim veovadoy deyaakov legabbeh hau leh kenachash vehachi itzterich leh begin leamshacha leh leesav batreh dehahu nachash veyitperash minneh vela yehe leh chulaka immeh bealma den uvalma deate vetaninan ba lehargecha akdim ante vekatleh ketiv babbeten akav et achiv deashre leh letatta behahu akev hada hu dichtiv veyado ochezet baakev esav deshave yedoy al hahu akev leikkafya leh

Davar acher veyado ochezet dela yachil lemepak minneh mikkol vachol ella veyado ochezet baakev esav da sihara deitkasseya nehora begin ekev deesav veal da itzterich leh lemehach immeh bechachmeta begin ledachaya leh letatta veyitdabbak beatreh

Vayyikra shemo yaakov kudsha berich hu kare leh yaakov vadday ta chaze ketiv hachi kara shemo yaakov nikra shemo la ketiv ella kara shemo vayyaakveni vadday chama leh kudsha berich hu deha hahu chiveya kadmaa ihu chakkim leavasha kevan deata yaakov amar ha vadday chakkim lekovleh uvgin kach kara leh yaakov

Ha okimna bechal atar vayyikra setam hay hu darga batraa kema dichtiv vayyikra el moshe vegv vehacha vayyikra shemo yaakov bechal atar shemeh la ikre al yeda debbar nash beatar achora ma ketiv vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael kudsha berich hu kara leh leyaakov el amar leh ana elaha beillae veante elaha betattae
Veta chaze yaakov hava yada deesav hava leh leitdabbeka behahu chiveya akima veal da bechal ovadoy itmashshich aleh kechiveya akima achora

Ribbi yitztzechak beribbi yose hava ate mikkappotkiyya lelod paga beh ribbi yehuda amar leh ribbi yitztzechak tomar dachaverana chakkime matnita itaru lehay inyana deyitztzer hara yitneshe min alma bar hahi shata leziuga amar leh chayecha hachi itztzeterich yitztzer hara laolam kemitra laolam deilmale yitztzer hara chedvata dishmata la lehevi aval la menavela kekadmita lemechete beh hada hu dichtiv lo yareu velo yashchitu bechal har kadshi vegv amar ribbi shimon hu libba dimdoreh deyitztzer hara beh ribbi eliezer omer libba tava binyana degufa venishmeta uvgin kach ketiv veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechal levavcha dehu ikkara decholla

Kad ata rav kahana amar hachi amrin mishshemehon demare matnita tere binyanin degufa inun kavda velibba deamar ribbi shimon amar ribbi yehuda kavda velibba inun menahage gufa bechal sitre evaroy menahaga deresha mocha aval degufa inun teren vekadmaa hu kavda tinyana libba vehayenu dichtiv befarshata vayyitrotztzatztzu habbanim bekirbah illen teren binyane degufa

289: Deihu al leshonah leanhaga milla ulachada lah deha let dibbur bela kol veukmuha

Patach ribbi chiyya avatreh veamar ani chachma shachanti arma vedaat mezimmot emtza ani chachma da keneset yisrael shachanti arma da yaakov deihu chakkim vedaat mezimmot emtza da yitzchak dehava leh daat mezimmot levarcha leh leesav uvgin dechachma ishtattef bahadeh deyaakov deihu arma vedaat mezimmot emtza deitbarach yaakov meavoy vesharu aleh kal inun birchan veitkayemu beh uvivnoy lealam ulalme almin

Meinun itkayemu behay alma vechullehu yitkayemun lezimna demalka meshicha dichden yehon yisrael goy echad baaretz veam echad lekudsha berich hu hada hu dichtiv veasiti otam legoy echad baaretz veyishletun leela vetatta dichtiv vaaru im anane shemaya kevar enash ate da malka meshicha dichtiv uvomehon di malchayya innun yekim elah shemaya malchu vegv veal da baa yaakov deyistallekun birchoy lehahu zimna deate vela natal lon lealtar

Patach ribbi yesa avatreh veamar veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai veal techat yisrael vegv hay kera ukmuha aval behahi shata denafak yaakov mikkamme avoy beinun birchan istakkal benafsheh amar ha illen birchan baena lesalka lon levatar learichu yomin vehava dachil umistafe nafak kala veamar veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai ki ittecha ani la eshbok lach behay alma ki hinni moshiacha merachok lehahu zimna deante salik lon leinun birchan

Veet zaracha meeretz shivyam deaf al gav dehashta natil birchoy esav veyishtabedun bivnach ana appik lon midoy uchden yeshabedun banecha beh veshav yaakov leinun birchan veshav yaakov da shechinta veshav yaakov vadday veshakat veshaanan kema deukmuha meinun malkevan mibbavel mimmaday umiyyavan umeedom deinhu hau deishtabedu behu beyisrael veen macharid lealam ulalme almaya

Azlu ad dehau azle amar ribbi yose vadday kal ma deavid kudsha berich hu beara kolla hava beraza dechachmeta vecholla begin leachazaa chachmeta illaa lehu livne nasha begin deyilfun mehahu ovada razin dechachmeta vecholla inun kedeka yeut veovadoy kullehu orche deorayeta begin deorche deorayeta inun arche dekudsha berich hu velet milla zeera delet bah kamma orchin ushvilin verazin dechachmeta illaa

Ta chaze deha ribbi yochanan ben zakkay hava amar telat mea halachot pesukot beraza dechachmeta illaa bappasuk veshem ishto mehetavel bat matred bat me zahav vela gale lon ella leribbi liezer dehava immeh begin leminda dechamma razin illain inun bechal ovada veovada deihi beorayeta uvchal milla umilla chachmeta ihi veorayeta dikshot begin kach inun millin deorayeta millin kaddishin inun leachazaa minah niflaot kema deatte amer gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha

Ta chaze beshata deakim hahu chiveya leadam ulitteteh deakriv leitteta veattil bah zuhama veitpatta beh adam keden istaav alma veitlatya ara begineh vegarim mota lechal alma vekayema alma leitpara minneh ad deata ilana dechayye vechafe al adam vechafya leh lehahu nachash dela yishlot lealmin al zara deyaakov

Deha bezimna deakrivu yisrael sair hava itkafya hahu nachash veithappach leavda kema deittemar veal da akriv yaakov leavoy teren seirin chad leakkefeya leesav deihu sair vechad begin darga dehava tale beh esav veitdabbak beh veittemar
Uvgin kach kayema alma ad detete itteta kegavena dechava uvar nash kegavena deadam veyaakimu veyachkimu
290: Leh lehahu chiveya bisha vehahu derachiv aleh vecholla ittemar

Patach veamar vayehi eshav ish yodea tzayid ish sade veha ittemar veyaakov ish tam yshev ohalim ish tam gevar shelim ketargumo yshev ohalim ammay ihu tam begin deihu yshev ohalim deachid litren sitrin leavraham ulyitzchak veal da yaakov besitra deyitzchak ata legabbe deesav kema deittemar dichtiv im chasid titchassad veim ikkesh tittappal vechad ata im birchan besiyyua dilela ka ata besiyyua deavraham veyitzchak uvgin kach bechachmeta hava kema deittemar

Ta chaze kad yaakov itar legabbe samael darga deesav vekabbil aleh leyaakov veyaakov natzach leh bechamma sitrin natzach lechiveya bechachmeta uvaakimu vela itnatzach bar besair veaf al gav decholla chad natzach kemo chen lesomol benitzchona achora venatzcheh hada hu dichtiv vayeavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar vayyar ki lo yachol lo

Veyaakov hava takkif bechal sitrin besitra deyitzchak uvsitra deavraham deinun hau takkifu deyaakov ata limina chama leavraham takkif vitkifu deoma besitra dimina dechesed ata lismala chama leyitzchak takkif bedina kashya ata leguppa chama leyaakov takkif mitteren sitrin illen desacharan leh chad mikkan vechad mikkan keden vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho deihu atar levar miggufa veihu chad ammuda degufa keden vatteka kaf yerech yaakov beheavko immo vegv

Ta chaze kamma birchan itbarech yaakov chad deavoy behahu akimu veravach kal inun birchan vechad dishchinta devarich leh kudsha berich hu kad hava ate millavan dichtiv vayevarech elohim et yaakov vechad devarcheh leh hahu malacha memanna deesav vechad beracha achora devarcheh leh avuha kad hava azil lefaddan aram dichtiv veel shadday yevarech otcha vegv

Behahu zimna dechama yaakov garmeh bechal hanne birchan amar beman birchata deminnayehu eshtammesh hashta amar bachalasha minnayehu eshtammesh hashta uman ihu da batrayeta devarcheh avuha veaf al gav deihi takkifa amar lav ihi takkifa beshaltanuta dehay alma kekadmaa

Kacha esav hahu yekara deokir leh leavoy orich leh kal hanne zimnin deyishlot bealma da veinun dimin oridu lon leyisrael beshibuda dileh ad dituvun yisrael lekudsha berich hu bivchiya uvdimin dichtiv bivchi yavou vegv uchden ketiv vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayeta layeya hammelucha baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen

Ribbi elazar amar tiferet yisrael natil kolla vechad itmashshecha keneset yisrael leela natla uf hachi kolla alma didchura dekudsha berich hu vechen alma

Vikrun havalim achoranin lealkaa bene nasha ulattekana lon deyahachun beorach meshar veikrun hevel desharya behu choli ra hevel deihu reutt ruach veinun kiyyuma deveginehon bene nasha azlin beorach meshar udchilu mikudsha bericha hu da saggiin inun havalim demitteppashte mehanne sheva

Shimsha besihara chada inun bela piruda vesihara af gav deihu techott shimsha kolla ihu shimsha bela piruda uttechott hay kolla ihu reutt ruach veasir leitteddabbaka beh
Vayyitztzu yaakov bekitra distimu miggo sittera settima nappeka zohar aspaklarya denahara kelila mitteren gevanin demittechabberan kechada

Tosefta bene alma rechime illaa hurmana devurayere kerivu shemau man chakkima bachu mare deayenin besuchlettanu lete velinda beshata deresha chivara natil telatt attevan vegalif lon begilluppa begilluppin chad chad vechad vitteggelif resha illaa decholla temira dechal temirin seliku dirutta havi ishtachlal meresha leela vnachatt lettatta nappak vappik telattin utteren shevilin ad deitteggelipu ben avne yekar demittelahatan vittekasharu beott deihu dechar vnukva teren rechimin kishura takkipa behu ishtachlalu ushma kaddisha behu ittekashar minnayehu ishtakkach mezona lecholla ishtachlalu almin
Val da itteggelif peshuta kelala ditteren keppuppa nukva chada deihi reutta
293: Denukva dekudsha berich hu kema denafke kal nehorin mehay alma hachi name natil kolla hay alma deha da kegavena da uvgin kach beer sheva da yovla beer da ihi shemitta veshimsha la nahir ella miyyovla uvgin kach vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana da maarav deihi shemitta

Man makom ribbi chiyya amar da hu mekomo dekaamaran dichtiv veel mekomo shoef vayyalen sham ki va hashshamesh kema deatte amer shoef zoriach hu sham deha begin leanhara leh kaatya

Vayyikkach meavne hammakom avne hammakom la ketiv ella meavne hammakom illen inun avne yekar margelan tavan deinun teresar avnin illain kema dichtiv shettem esre avanim utchot illen teresar elef verivvan avne fesilan vechullehu ikrun avnin begin kach meavne hammakom velo avne da hu makom dekaamar
Vayyasem meraasotav meraashotav deman ella meraashotav dehahu makom may meraashotav i tema keman deshavi techot resheh la ella meraashotav learba sitrin dealma telat avnin listar
Kevan deillen ittekkelilu da beda ittechazun beh kal genin argaman ihu kal chezu dinhorin beh kelilan ratztzo vashov inun nehorin la mitteakkevan lemecheme chibbura chada ittechabberan behahu zohar

Behay zohar share man deshari shema ihu lehahu desattim dela yedia kelal kol yaakov ikre behay ittechaze mehemnutta decholla hahu desattim vela yedia kelal behay sharya shelimu dechal sitrin ihu illaa vettattaa hacha ishtakkach yaakov shelimu deavahan deachid mikkal sitrin da al beriru dishma da ikre dichtiv yaakov asher becharticha teren shemahan ikre yaakov veyisrael bekadmita yaakov ulvattar yisrael

Sittera desittera da kad hava bekadmita behay soppa demachshava deihu perusha deorayeta devichtav vihi tora shebbeal pe veal da ikre beer shenneemar hoil moshe beer ett hattora beer ihu lehahu deikkere sheva dichtiv vayyivnehu sheva shanim vhayenu kol gadol

Yaakov kevan deal bimhemnutta itztzetericha lemeal

Deappik shevilin batash ben attevan veavad rekia deyaakov ben teren ruchin vattil beni shayepe millule ad denachatt lehay deihi keppuppa vchivru lah kechada tzappon vdarom levattar ittekasharu kechada hay keppuppa beer sheva ikre veittemalle miyyaakov leashakaa kal edre ana val da vyetztze yaakov mibbeer shava vyelecha charana tu mibbeer shava leela deha minah nappik levattar azil leashkaa lecharana deihu bera diltatta charon af Adonai cherv Adonai dina be dina elohim val da elohim bau goyim benachalattecha

Uchden vayyishkav bammakom hahu kevan deittakan arsa shachiv beh man shachiv beh shimsha veal da ketiv beyaakov vayyeshev al hammitta deha le itchaze vela leachora veal da vayyishkav bammakom hahu uvgin kach ketiv vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshemesh

Ribbi yitzchak hava yativ yoma chad kamme mearta deafikuta aavar chad bar nash utren benin immeh vehava amar chad lechad da tukfa deshimsha missitra dedarom ihu vealma la itkeyyam ella al ruach begin deruach ihu kiyyuma shelimu dechal sitrin veilmale deihu kayema bishlimu la yachil alma leitkayyama

Amar leh achuha zeera ilmale yaakov la itkeyyam alma ta chaze beshata deyichadu benoy yichuda dilela veamru shema yisrael Adonai lohenu Adonai echad da hu shelimu illaa leityachada beyichuda chad keden itchabbar yaakov avuhon venatil beteh veyativ beh bechibbura chada im avahan leitchabbera dechar venukva kechada

Amar ribbi yitzchak eshtattaf bahadayehu veeshma may kaamre azal bahadayehu patach hahu bar nash veamar kuma Adonai limnuchatecha atta vaaron uzzech kuma Adonai limnuchatecha keman deamar yekum malka leve nayecha demashkeneh

Teren inun hau deamru kuma Adonai moshe vedavid moshe amar kuma Adonai veyafutzu oyevecha vedavid amar kuma Adonai limnuchatecha may ika benayehu ella moshe keman deppakkid leveteh kaamar moshe pakkid lah leagacha kerava lakovel sanoy david zammin leh lenayecha kema demazmin lemarih zammin lemalka ulmatronita immeh hada hu dichtiv kuma Adonai limnuchatecha atta vaaron uzzecha begin dela leafrasha lon

295: Garma venappesha malya deayenin dachalan charba shenana bideh tipin meriran talyan mehahu charba katil leh lehahu shatya vearme leh lego gehinnom

Yaakov nachatt legabbah veazal leatterah shenneemar vayyilecha charana vechama kal tikkun beta veishteziv minah dechura dilah samael avish kammeh venachatt leagacha beh kerava velo yachil leh dichtiv vayyeavek ish immo vegv keden ishteziv mikkolla veishtelim bishlimu vistallak bedarga shelim veittekkere yisrael keden salik bedarga illaa veishtelim becholla vehava ammuda deemtzaita vealeh kettiv vhabberiach hattichon vegv
Mahu vyigga bechaf yerecho leh la yachil aval naga bechaf yerecho deinhu nadav vaavihu denappeku min yarcho deaharon vehabberiach hattichon bettocha hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatztze el hakkatztze
Ovadoy begin lemehav chedva lemalka i archeh demalka dechadan leh bediche hedote yesaddar kammeh bediche rofinus ufardashche vei lav lav ihu bedichuta demalka

Ta chaze david zammin leh lemalka ulmatronita lenayecha ma avad shane bediche demalka begin rofinus uman ninhu dichtiv kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek vachasidecha yerannenu vachasidecha yerannenu leviyyecha yerannenu mibbae leh deha levae inun bediche malka vehashta david dezammin leh lenayecha avad kohane vachaside delehu inun bediche malka

Amar leh kudsha berich hu david la vaena leatracha alach amar leh david mari kad ante behechalach atte avid reutach hashta dezamminna lach biruti kayema milla leakrava illen deinun chashive yattir af al gav delav archayehu behay

Mikkan olifna deman deihu beveteh yesadder orcheh veovadeh kiruteh i mezammenin leh yaavid reuteh deushpizeh kema dimsaddar aloy deha david achlaf levae vesaddar kahane vekudsha berich hu okim milla kiruteh

Amar david baavur david avdecha al tashev pene meshichecha siddura deka saddarna la yetuv laachora amar leh kudsha berich hu david chayyecha afilu bemanin dili la eshtammesh ella bemanin dilach vela zaz kudsha berich hu mittamman ad deyahiv leh nevazbezan umattenan dichtiv nishba Adonai ledavid emet lo yashuv mimmennah mipperi vitnecha ashit lechisse lach ata ribbi yitzchak unshakeh amar i la atena lehay archa ella lemishma da dayyay

Patach chad bereh veamar vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana hayenu dichtiv al ken yaazav ish et aviv veet immo vedavak beishto davar acher vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana ramaz kad nafku yisrael mibbe makdesha veitgalu bene ammaya kema deatte amer vayyetze min bat tziyyon kal hadarah uchtiv galta yehuda meoni vegv

Patach achora zeera veamar vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham ki va hashshemesh vegv may vayyifga bammakom lemalka deazil leve matronita bae lemifga lah ulvassema lah bemillin begin dela tishtakkach gabbeh kehefkera vela od ella deafilu it leh arsa dedahava uchsutute merakman beaflatya lemevat behu veihi metakkena arseh beavnin beara uvkistera detivna yishbok dideh veyavit behu lemehav lah nayecha uvgin dihe reuta dilhon kechada bidla anisu kema deolifna hacha dechevan deazal legabbah ma ketiv vayyikkach meavne hammakom vayyasem meraashotav vayyishkav bammakom hahu begin lemehav lah nayecha deafilu avne veta rechimin kammeh lemevat behu

Bacha ribbi yitzchak vechade amar margelan illen techot yedayechu vela ezil batrayechu amru leh atte tezil leorchach veanan neul lemata lehillula dehay beri amar ribbi yitzchak hashta it li lemehach learchi
296: Azil leh vesidder millin kammeh deribbi shimon amar ribbi shimon vadday shappir kaamru vecholla bekudsha berich hu ittemar amar millin illen mibbene benoy deribbi tzadok chalasha ninhu may tama ikkere chalasha begin dearbain shenin itanne al yerushlem dela yitcherav beomoy vehava parish al kal milla umilla deorayeta razin illain veyahiv behu archa livne alma leitnahaga behu

Amar ribbi yitzchak la hau yomin zeirin ad deaarana behahu bar nash uvreh zeera immeh amina leh an hu berach achora amar li avidna leh hillula veishtaar bidvithu kevan deishtemoda bi amar leh chayyecha dela zeminna lach lehillula divri begin telat millin chad dela yedana bach vela ishtemodana lach dehachi mezammenin leh levar nash kefum yekareh vedilma ante gavra rabba veafgim yekarach vechad dilma ante azil bearchach bivhilu vela atrach alach vechad dela tachsif kamme enashe dechavura deorcha dilan dechal inun deachle liftora dechatan vechalla kullehu yahave nevazbezan umattenan lon amina leh kudsha berich hu yadin lach letav amina leh ma shemach amar leh tzadok zuta behahu shata olifna minneh telesar razin illain beorayeta umin bereh telat chad binvua vechad bechelma

Veamar ma ben nevua lechelma nevua bealma didchura ihu vechelma bealma denukva umehay lehay keshita dargin nachata nevua bimina uvismala vechelma bismala vechelma mitparsha lechamma dargin letatta begin kach chelma ihu bechal alma aval kefum dargeh hachi chame kefum bar nash hachi dargeh dinvua la itpashsheta ella beatreh

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyachalom vehinne sullam mutzav artza verosho maggia hashshamayema vehinne malache elohim olim verdim bo patach veamar hayo haya devar Adonai el yechezkel ben buzi hakkohen beeretz kasdim al nehar kevar vattehi alav sham yad Adonai hayo haya nevua leshaata hayeta deitzterich al galuta begin dishchinta nechatat behu beyisrael begaluta vechama yechezkel ma dechama lefum shata veaf al gav dela itchaze hahu atar lehay begine chach ha haya may ha haya ella hayo leela haya letatta dichtiv sullam mutzav artza verosho maggia hashshamayema natil leela venatil letatta hayo haya chad leela vechad letatta

Ta chaze hay sullam bitre almin ittakkaf beela vetatta beeretz kasdim al nehar kevar beeretz kasdim beatar degaluta sharya beh veim kal da al nehar kevar may nehar kevar ella dehava kevar mikkadmat dena dishchinta

Sitre vayyachalom vehinne sullam mutztzav artza verosho maggia hashamayema chelma madrega shettitaa meinun dargin teren dinvua ad hahu darga shit dargin inun veal da chelma chad mishittin dargin dinvua sullam chama benoy dezamminin lekabbela orayeta betura desinay sullam da sinay begin deihu naitz beara vechashiv bisliku lishmaya vechal rettichin umashiryan illain kullehu nachatte tamman bahade kudsha bericha hu kad yahiv lon orayeta

Vecholla chama chama matotoron sava deveta deshallit bechal dileh deihu kay beshaltanu alma beshaltanu beshem vsalik leela bisliku doshoma demareh attar deyaakov ishtalim beh levattar verosho doshom shadday ihu veda maggia hashamayema kevan demate vesalik att da lehahu attar ishtelim veittekere behahu shema demareh
Vhinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo inun malachin kaddishin dikrevin lemalchutta salkin veinun achoranin dela kerevin hem nachatte
Vettu bo salke vnachatte kad ihu salik salkin bahadeh kad nachit nachattin bahadeh
297: Sharya aloy dichtiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan vegv veda hu nahara chad meinun arba naharin uvgin desharya aloy mikkadmat dena vehava aloy kevar sharya beh hashta veitgeli leh lichezkel

Ta chaze vayyachalom vechi yaakov kaddisha deihu shelema deavahan bechelma itgeli aloy uvaatar da kaddisha la chama ella bechelma ella yaakov behahu zimna la hava nasiv veyitzchak hava kayyam vei tema veha levatar deitnasiv ketiv vaere bachalom tamman atar garim veyitzchak hava kayyam veal da ketiv beh chalom

Ulvatar deata leara kaddisha im shivtin veishtelim lehon akeret habbayit veem habbanim semecha ketiv vayyera elohim el yaakov vegv uchtiv vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayela hacha la ketiv beh chalom deha middarga achora ilaa hava

Ta chaze chelma ihu al yede degavriel deihu letatta bedarga shetitaa minnevua mare al yeda dehahu darga dehahi chayya deshalta belelya vei tema ha ketiv gavriel haven lehallaz et hammare hachi hu vadday demare milloy setimin yattir uvchelma parish yattir ufarish setimin demare veal da itpakkad gavriel diyefaresh milloy demare deihu satim yattir

Veal da ketiv bemare vayyera vaera may tama begin demare ihu kehay mare deitchaze kal diuknin begaveh begine chach vaera achmit diukneh beel shadday deihu mare deitchame diukna achora begaveh vechal diuknin illain beh itchazun

Begine chach yaakov behahu zimna ketiv vayyachalom vehinne sullam mutztzav artza mahu sullam darga dishar dargin beh talyan vehu yesod dealma verosho maggia hashshamayema hachi hu leitkashshera bahadeh verosho maggia hashshamayema man rosho rosho dehahu sullam uman ihu da dichtiv beh rosh hammitta begin deihu rosh lehay mitta uminnah nahir maggia hashshamayema begin deihu siyyuma degufa vekaim ben illaa vetattaa kema divrit ihu siyyuma degufa vekaim ben yarchin vegufa veal da maggia hashshamayema

Vehinne malache elohim olim veordim bo illen memannan dechal ammin deinun salkin venachatin behay sullam kad yisrael chatan maich hay sullam vesalkin inhu memannan vechad yisrael mitkashran ovadayehu istallak hay sullam vechullehu memanne nachate letatta veitavar shultanuta dilhon kulla behay sullam kayema hacha chama yaakov bechelmeh shaltanuta deesav veshaltanuta dishar amin

Davar acher vehinne malache elohim olim veordim bo beman behahu rosho dehahu sullam dechad istallak rosho minneh sullam itkafya vesalkin kullehu memannan vechad itchabbar rosho behahu sullam istalak vechullehu memannan nachatin vecholla chad milla
Ketiv nira Adonai el shelomo bachalom hallayela vayyomer elohim sheal ma etten lach vei tema hacha bachalom vechi ma

Malache elohim teresar margelitan tavan vinun michael podol gavriel tzodokol roppol nuriel ypol anel alpe shinan shinan shor nesher arye adam kalil dechar venukva veinun salke kad ihu salik veillen nachatte kad ihu nachit

Vettu kal inun deshalte beshaltanu dehay alma al yedeh salkin vechal inun denachatte al yedeh nachatte kullehu behay sullam shalta al kolla dichtiv vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav kad ittear kettiv en ze ki im bet elohim vze shaar hashamayim bet elohim vadday veihu tara leaola lego dichtiv pittechu li shaare tzedek avo vam ode yah ze hashaar la ze shaar hashamayim kolla chad
298: Reshu it leh lachalom behay ella hacha itkelil darga bedarga darga illaa bedarga tattaa begin dead kean shelomo la hava shelim kevan deishtelim ketiv va natan chachma lishlomo uchtiv vatterev chachmat shelomo dekayema sihara beashlamuta uve makdesha itbene uchden hava chame shelomo ena beena chachmata vela itzterich lechelma
Levatar dechata itzterich leh lechelma kekadmita veal da ketiv hannire elav paamayim vechi paamayim hava velo yattir ella sitra dechelma hava leh paamayim sitra dechachmata kal yoma hava

Veim kal da sitra dechelma hava yattir al kal shear beni nasha begin deitkelil darga bedarga mare bemare veha hashta besof yomoy chashich yattir veda begin dechata vesihara kayema leitpagma may tama begin dela natir berit kaddisha beishtadluteh benashim nachriyyot veda hu tenay deavad kudsha berich hu im david dichtiv im yishmeru vanecha beriti vegv gam benehem ade ad yeshvu lechisse lach

May ade ad hayenu dichtiv kime hashshamayim al haaretz uvgin dishlomo la natar hay berit kedeka yeut sharya sihara leitpagma veal da besofa itzterich chelma vechen yaakov itzterich leh lechelma kidamaran
Vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav dimhemnuta kechad nitztzav umelech en beedom kelo ani Adonai elohe avraham avicha vilohe yitzchak len innun teren sitrin beyamina usmala

Adonai kelo Adonai vela ketiv elohe yitzchak avicha dechevan deitkashshar beh beavraham ishtakkach deihu beemtzaita ulvatar haaretz asher atta shochev aleha ha kolla reticha chada kaddisha vehacha chama deyehve shelimu deavahan

Ta chaze elohe avraham avicha dechevan deamar avraham avicha vadday ihu beemtzaita velohe yitzchak hacha itremiz dekashir litren sitrin veachid lon kashir lesitra chad dichtiv avraham avicha vekashir lesitra achora dichtiv vilohe yitzchak tosefet legabbe yitzchak leachazaa deyaakov achid litren sitrin

Vead deyaakov la itnasiv la ittemar beitgalleya yattir veittemar beitgalleya leman deyada orchoy deorayeta levatar deitnasiv veolid ittemar leh beitgalleya hada hu dichtiv vayyatztzev sham mizbeach vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael mehacha olifna man dela ishtelim letatta la ishtelim leela shane yaakov deishtelim leela vetatta aval la beitgalleya

Vei tema deishtelim behahi shata la ella chama deyishtelim levatar zimna vei tema ha ketiv vehinne anochi immach ushmarticha bechal asher telech ella ashgachuta dekudsha berich hu untiru dileh la ishtevik minneh deyaakov lealmin bechal ma deitzterich leh behay alma aval bealma illaa ad deishtelim

Vayyikatz yaakov mishshenato vayyomer achen yesh Adonai bammakom hazze veanochi lo yadati vechi tevaha hu dela yada ella may veanochi lo yadati kema deatte amer ufni Adonai lo chilliti amar vechi kal hay itgeli li vela istakkalna leminda anochi ulmeal techot gadfe dishchinta lemeheve shelim
Ta chaze ketiv vattomer im ken lamma ze anochi kal yoma veoma chamat rivka nehora dishchinta
299: Dehaveya shechinta bemishkenaha vetzalliat tamman kevan dechamat aku dilah bimaha ma ketiv vattelech lidrosh et Adonai nafkat middarga da ledarga achora deihu begine chach amar yaakov vechi kal kach chamena veanochi lo yadati begin dehava bilchodoy vela al techot gadfe dishchinta
Miyyad vayyira vayyomar ma nora hammakom hazze milla da litren sitrin ihu ma nora hammakom hazze chad al hahu makom dekaamar bekadmita vechad al at kayyama kaddisha dela baya leitbattala

Veaf al gav deinhu tere sitre chad hu amar en ze ki im bet elohim en ze lemeheve batil en ze leishtakkecha bilchodoy keyama dileh lav ihu ella bet elohim leishtammesha beh ulmebad beh perin velaaraka beh birchan mikkal shayefe gufa dehay hu tara dechal gufa hada hu dichtiv veze shaar hashshamayim da tara degufa vadday tara ihu laaraka birchan letatta achid leela veachid letatta achid leela dichtiv veze shaar hashshamayim letatta dichtiv en ze ki im bet elohim veal da vayyira vayyomar ma nora hammakom hazze uvne nasha la mashgechan bikara deveh lemeheve beh shelim leela vetatta ata avoy unshakeh

Amar ribbi yitzchak kad millin inun shemana mippumeh bachena veamena berich rachamana dela batil mealma chachmeta illaa azlina immehon ad telat parse ad deaolana immehon lemata la sefiku lemeal ad deshiddech hahu bar nash livreh veamre leh millach la yehon levattala

Amina ha deamar ribbi shimon demillin illen kullehu beraza dechachmeta ninhu ulachazaa millin achoranin kad saddarna millin kammeh derabbi shimon amar li la tema demillin illen dinuka ninhu ella millin derazin illain ninhu vecholla beraza dechachmeta reshimin

Vayyiddar yaakov neder lemor im yihye elohim immadi vegv amar ribbi yehuda kevan dechal hay avtach leh kudsha berich hu ammay la heemin deamar im yihye elohim immadi vegv ella amar yaakov chelma chalamna vechelmin minnayehu keshot uminnayehu la keshot veim yitkayyem ha yedana dechelma keshot hu veal da amar im yihye elohim vegv kema dechalamna vehaya Adonai li lelohim ana ehe mashich birchan mimmabbua denachala decholla leatar da deikre elohim

Ta chaze yisrael deihu beemtzaita kolla natil hu bekadmita mimmekora decholla ulvatar deyimte leh minneh nagid veamshich lehay atar mashma dichtiv vehaya Adonai li bekadmita ulvatar kolla lelohim kema deelohim yehe natir veavid li kal illen tavan uf ana ehe mashich leh meatar dili kal inun birchan veyitchabbar kishra decholla beh ematay veshavti beshalom el bet avi kad ehe yativ bedarga dili veehe yativ bedarga deshalom letakkena bet avi veshavti veshalom dayeka keden vehaya Adonai li lelohim
Davar acher veshavti veshalom el bet avi detamman hu ara kaddisha tamman ishtelim vehaya Adonai li lelohim beatar da asallek middarga da ledarga achora kedeka yeut vetamman eflach pulchaneh

Ribbi chiyya patach veamar divre aonot gavru menni peshaenu atta techapperem ha kera kashya delav sofeh resheh velav resheh sofeh ella david baa al garmeh ulvatar baya al kolla divre aonot gavru menni amar david ana yadana begarmay dechavna aval kamma chayyavin inun bealma deitgabberu chovayehu alayehu yattir minni hoil vechen li
300: Ta chaze beshata dechayyavin saggiin bealma inun salkin ad hahu atar desifre dechayyavaya itpattechu kema deatte amer dina yativ vesifrin petichu vehahu sefer begine kach divre aonot gavru menni veal da peshaenu atta techapperem

Yaakov kegavena da begin kach la hemin i tema dela hemin bekudsha berich hu la ella dela hemin beh begarmeh dilma yechuv vehahu chova yimna leh dela yetuv bishlam veyistallak netiru minneh uvgin kach la hemin begarmeh vehaya Adonai li lelohim afilu rachame kad ituv bishlam ashave lekovli ledina begin deana palach kammeh tadir

Amar ribbi acha amar yaakov hashta la itzterichna ledina kad ituv levet abba itkelilna bedina veetkashshar beh amar ribbi yose lav hachi ella amar hashta im yihye elohim immadi dina itzterichna lenatra li ad deituv bishlam levet abba aval kevan deituv bishlam itkelilna rachame bedina veetkashshar bekishshura mehemna leachlala kolla kechad vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva yihye bet elohim deha keden yehe kolla kishshura chada vehay even itbarcha mimina umismala itbarcha meela umittatta begin deetten maasra mikkolla

Amar ribbi abba ha ketiv vayyikkach meavni hammakom vei tema deavna da illaa kamma avnin leatar motaveh lemishre alayehu veha ketiv vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva begin deamar en ze ki im bet elohim hacha arim lah kamma illaa begin detala kal shevacha deze bah deen ze lekayyama ki im bet elohim veshappir veal da asher samti matztzeva ketiv

Ki sachor secharticha bedudae beni may bedudae beni begin denicha leh leyaakov al da deillen mesayein leolada veyaakov hava yada demilla la kayema baddudaim ella leela

Amar ribbi yehuda kal illen shivtin tikkunin diltatta inun vechullehu kegavena dilela ta chaze ki sachor secharticha lenasva minneh gufa uman ihu tora sachor secharticha lecha legufach mammash sachor
314: Mehacha man delae beorayeta achsin alma deate veachsin achsanta deyaakov achsin alma deate dichtiv yissashchar yesh sachar ki yesh sachar lifullatech uchtiv lehanchil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle
Ki yaladti lo shishsha vanim amar ribbi chizkiyya illen ela vetatta vearba sitrin dealma uman dearich beechad bae leh leamlacha lekudsha berich hu leela vetatta ularba sitre dealma vehayenu echad

Amar ribbi chizkiyya ketiv al hare vater uchtiv al hare vesamim man inun hare vesamim illen shit benin delea deachlalan shit achoranin veinun teresar veinun shit begin dechal chad kalil bechavreh velea alayehu lekayema em habbanim semecha halleluya
Veal da ketiv lo tikkach haem al habbanim begin deihu alma deitkasseya vela itgalleya veal da shallach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach begin deihu alma deitkasseya vela itgalleya kelal

Veet habbanim tikkach lach hayenu dichtiv ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vegv ulmiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim vechal hanne ikrun hare vesamim mikkan ultatta ikrun hare vater dichtiv umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim ture defiruda

Amar ribbi yesa bene hashshefachot keshiru kishrin arba kishrin deitzterichu letikkuna veamar ribbi elazar divgin kach nafke levar inun kishrin veaf al gav dechullehu chad umikkan ulhala kullehu chad beorach meshar veal da kullehu shivtin salkin besahaduta dilela hada hu dichtiv sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah edut leyisrael lehodot leshem Adonai

Veamar ribbi elazar ketiv vayehi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegv ma chama yaakov lemehach leorcheh kad ityelid yosef vead la ityelid yosef la vaa lemehach leorcheh ella ha ukmuha dechama deityelid sitna deesav

Veta chaze yosef ashlim duchteh batreh veosef zache leh deikre tzaddik vehacha siyyuma degufa kevan dechama yaakov deishtelim gufa baa gufa lemehach leorcheh vesiyyuma degufa hu berit veim kal da binyamin ashlim chushbena deveh ishtelimu teresar

Vei tema vechi la hava yada yaakov dead kean la ishtallimu shivtin af al gav deityelid yosef may tama la orich ad deyityelid binyamin veyishtallimu shivtin ella yaakov bechachmeta avad umilla yada amar vadday i ishtallimu hacha kullehu shivtin ha yedana detikkuna dilela sharya alayehu kedeka yeut uvara da la libae deyishtelimu ella beara kaddisha

Ta chaze dehachi hu dechullehu teresar shivtin tikkuna dealma tattaa ninhu vechevan deityelid binyamin mitat rachel venatla duchta hay alma tattaa leittakkana behu veal da la ityelid binyamin ella beara kaddisha hada hu dichtiv vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel beeretz kenaan badderech vetamman mitat rachel venatla duchta hay alma tattaa leityashsheva beveta shelemata vechal zimna derachel kayema alma tattaa la ittakkena behu mitat rachel natla beta bishlimu

Vei tema lea ammay la mitat behahu zimna ella begin deveta bealma tattaa ihu vecholla minneh hau leittakkena velav mealma illaa uvgin kach la mitat behahi shata vechal ovadoy delea beitkasseya inun begin dealma ilaa ihu beitkasseya velav beitgalleya uvgin kach la idkar mitatah delea kemitatah derachel

Veta chaze dehachi hu vadday begin dealma illaa kal milloy beitkasseya vealma tattaa kal milloy beitgalleya begin kach itkasseya lea bimarta dechafelta verachel begilluya deorcha da besitra veda beitgalleya uvitkasseya alma illaa itreshim dichtiv vattomer lea beashri ki ishruni vanot uvgin kach kara shemeh asher
315: Uvgin da kolla chad deha kolla have mealma illaa hachi name uvchal atar teren almin da beitgalleya veda beitkasseya veanan la mevarchinan lekudsha berich hu ella bitren almin dichtiv baruch Adonai elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam begine kach alma illaa karenan vekarenan lealma tattaa atta begin deihu baruch mealma illaa al yeda detzaddik hada hu dichtiv baruch Adonai mitztziyyon shochen yerushalam vegv vadday mitztziyyon ihu baruch
Ta chaze kegavena da Adonai Adonai teren almin ninhu da beitgalleya veda beitkasseya veal da pasik tama begavaveyehu umealma da ad alma da kolla chad

Vayehi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegv amar ribbi yehuda ta chaze shelemuta deyaakov dela vaa lemezal ella birshuteh delavan vei tema zimna acharina ammay la azil birshuteh ela begin dedachil yaakov dela yishbok leh veyishtelimu teresar shivtin beara achora veal da kevan dechama demata shata devinyamin barach kema deatte amer vayyivrach hu vechal asher lo

Dechevan deityelid binyamin itkashrat shechinta bechullehu shivtin venatla beta bechullehu veyaakov hava yada beraza dechachmeta dechad yishtallimu teresar shivtin dishchinta titkashshet vetitkashsher behu verachel tamut veihi natla beta

Ta chaze hachi olifna alma tattaa itchaze leh leyaakov kema deitchaze lemoshe ella dela yechilat ad dehau teresar shivtin beveta leitkashshera behu uchden itdakkiat rachel venatla ihi veta bechullehu shivtin vahavat ikkera deveta uchden moshivi akeret habbayit vadday

Amar yaakov ha mata zimna deishtelimu teresar shivtin vadday alma dilela yechot hu leveta leitkashshera behu umiskenuta da itdachya kammeh i tamut hacha la ippuk mehacha lealmin vela od ella veara da la itchaze leashlama veta begin kach vayehi kaasher yalda vegv ad la ishtallimu shivtin

Shama ribbi shimon amar vadday kal milloy derabbi yehuda shappir veda salik al kolla vei tema ammay la azal leh leorcheh miyyad ella kal zeman derachel la mitabbera mibbinyamin itakkav tamman kevan demata zimna devinyamin arak vela vaa reshuta begin dela yitakkev tamman veyitchabber yaakov bechulhu shivtin beatra deitzterich

Ribbi abba patach vayyelech moshe vayyashav el yeter chotno vegv ta chaze moshe rae ana deyitro chamuy hava vediyyureh hava beh vechad bae lemezal la azal ella birshuta dideh veyaakov dehava shelim vediyyureh hava tadir immeh delavan ammay la vaa reshuta minneh ella ha ittemar dela yegalgel lavan immeh gilgulin veyishtaar tamman deha bekadmita amar leh umiyyad gilgel aleh gilgulin veishtaar tamman vehashta dachil minneh

Aval yitro la hava hachi legabbe moshe begin delavan charasha hava uvcharasha hava kal ovadoy legabbe deyaakov vehashta la vaa yaakov leitakkeva tamman deha kudsha berich hu amar leh shuv el eretz avotecha vegv veal da la vaa leitakkeva ulmishbak pikkuda demareh

Ta chaze ketiv vayyizkor elohim et rachel vegv patach veamar lamnatztzeach livne korach al alamot shir hay kera it leistakkala beh deraza dechachmeta ihu vechal hanne shirin vetushbechan dehau amre bene korach kullehu mechadtin inun shirin vetushbechan dehau millekaddemin vechen kal inun shirin vetushbechan deamar david vechal inun dehau immeh kullehu hau beraza illaa beraza dechachmeta
Ta chaze avad kudsha berich hu alma tattaa kegavena dealma illaa vechal inun sidderin desidderu david ushlomo bereh vechal inun nevie keshot kullehu
316: Ta chaze kegavena deika mishmarot beara hachi name birkia dimzammere lemarayehu veamre shirata tadir vechullehu kayemin illen lakovel illen vecholla besidderan deshirin vetushbechan veha ukmuha chavraya

Alamot shir may alamot shir ela kema deatte amer shishshim hemma melachot ushmonim pilagshim vaalamot en mispar may vaalamot en mispar kema deatte amer hayesh mispar ligdudav uvgin delet lon chushbena ketiv vaalamot en mispar
Vechullehu shurin shurin mesacharan sedarin illen lakovel illen lezammera ulshabbacha lemarehon veillen inun alamot shir uvgin deit alamot dela mezammerin keillen illen ikrun alamot shir

Ta chaze inun teren atvan illain desalkin baavira inun kelilan da beda rachamay bedina uvgin kach inun teren veinun mealma illaa beraza didchura vehay desalka veitchabbera immehon ihi nukva veitkelilat betarvayehu kegavena denukva itkelilat bitre sitre bimina uvismala veitchabberat behu hachi name hay at nukva deitchabberat bitre atvan achoranin veinun bitren sitrin illen illain veda letatta vecholla ihu chad dechar venukva dechad itbere alma deinun atvan mealma illaa ninhu deinun olidu kal ovadin letatta kegavvena dilhon mammash uvgin kach man deyada lon veizdehar behu rachim leela urachim letatta

Siddera telitaa delistar tzafon bitlat sidderin inun lehahu sitra veinun tisha uvitlat sitrin telat telat lechal setar inun tisha veinun sidrin mittelat sitrin kema deittemar
317: Beraza deatvan deinun shiva veesrin veaf al gav deinun teren veesrin shelimu deatvan inun shiva veesrin vehachi siddura desidderin illen shiva veesrin litlat telat sidderin lechal setar veishtakkachu illen mehay sitra deinun veillen telat mehay sitra deinun tisha veillen telat dehay sitra deinun tisha ishtakkachu kullehu shiva veesrin
Veraza deillen shiva veesrin inun tisha atvan deinun beraza denukve leitchabbera behu nukva im inun temane sare sitre achoranin beraza deittamar vecholla ihu kedeka chaze

Ta chaze kegavena deinun atvan illain dealma illaa hachi name atvan achoranin letatta atvan ilain ravrevin veatvan tattain zeirin vecholla da kegavena da vechal hanne razin beraza didchar venukva kolla chad bishlimu

Vayyizkor elohim et rachel deha bemazzala talya uvgin kach ketiv bah zechira va pakad et sara lav mimmazzala hava vei tema deha benin bemazzala talyan vela letatta hacha besara lav bemazzala hava ella va ketiv kolla kechada

I hachi ammay ketiv pekida ella vadday zechira havat mikkadmat dena veitmasar maftecha da letatta kema dichtiv veet beriti akim et yitzchak asher teled lecha sara lammoed hazze vegv ulvatar kegavena da vechevan deidkar beraza dilela levatar ittemar beraza denukva pekida lemeheve kelala decholla kechada

Vayyizkor elohim et rachel rabbi chiyya patach veamar vegam ani shamati et naakat bene yisrael asher mitzrayim maavidim otam vaezkor et beriti vaezkor ha zechira begin deihu leela dehay mazzala deihu leela bidchura ata al pekida deihi begaluta letatta venukva kegavena da vayyizkor elohim et rachel kema deatte amer vaezkor et beriti

Ta chaze ketiv pakod pakadti etchem vechi pakod pakadti veha pekida benukva kayema uvhahu zimna begaluta havat veihi amrat pakod pakadti ella hacha it leistakkala veraza dechachmeta hacha veihi begaluta hech itchaze lemoshe hacha vehech amrat pakod pakadti

Ella hachi olifna shimsha kad nahir ihu bishmaya vetukpeh vecheleh shalta al ara bechal atar kegavena da melo chal haaretz kevodo bezimna demakdesha kaim melo chal haaretz kevodo da ara kaddisha vehashta deyisrael begaluta ihi leela vetukpa sachara lehu leyisrael leagana alayehu veaf al gav deinun beara achora

Veta chaze shechinta letatta ushchinta leela shechinta leela bitresar techume retichin kaddishin utresar chevan illain shechinta letatta bitresar shivtin kaddishin uchden itkelilat shechinta leela vetatta vecholla bechad zimna kechada veaf al gav debbezimna deyisrael begaluta letatta la ittakkanat leela hachi name la ittakkanat begin diltatta la ittakkanat veda hu begaluta immehon deyisrael deihi begaluta immehon

Bemma ittakkanat lemalka demit bereh ma avad kafa leh learseh al evla divreh vela atkin leh learseh ella natal kuvin vedardarin veattil techot arseh veshachiv aleh kach kudsha berich hu kevan deitgalu yisrael veitcharev makdesha natal kuvin vedardarin veshave techoteh hada hu dichtiv vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene begin deyisrael hau begaluta

Pakod pakadti etchem man dela kayema birshuteh ma pakkid uma avid ella pakod milleela pakadti milletatta may tama begin dehay zechira havat alah mikkaddemat dena dichtiv vaezkor et beriti kevan dichtiv vaezkor ha zechira itmena ala ubbegin kach amrat levatar pakod pakadti
318: Deha simana naktat mikkaddemat dena kegavvena da sara dichtiv va pakad et sara aval hacha rachel dela idkarat mikkaddemat dena la ittemar bah pekida ella zechira vecholla bizchira ihu beraza demazzala

Amar leh illu havena telata yaot hu dechad yema utren yativu leh amar leh hanne mille bevirchan begin deidkar chad shema dekudsha berich hu utren yativu leh hada hu dichtiv ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu ki shem Adonai ekra da chad dimvarech havu godel lelohenu illen teren achoranin aval beorayeta afilu tere yatve veyahave revu vetukpa deshivcha deorayeta lekudsha berich hu

Ad dehau azle amar ribbi yehuda taninan it zechira letav veit zechira levish it pekida letav veit pekida levish it zechira letav kema deukmuha dichtiv vezacharti lahem berit rishonim vegv vayyizkor elohim et noach vayyizkor elohim et berito veit zechira levish dichtiv vayyizkor ki vasar hemma ruach holech velo yashuv pekida letav dichtiv pakod pakadti etchem pekida levish dichtiv ufakadti beshevet pisham uvingaim aonam vechullehu razin illain

Amar ribbi chizkiyya hachi hu vadday zakkaa ihu man dechulakeh itkeyyam besitra tava vela yarchin garmeh lesitra achora veyishteziv minhon amar leh ribbi yehuda hachi hu vadday vezakkaa man deyachil leishtezava minneh mehahu sitra vezakkain inun tzaddikayya deyachle leishtezava minnayehu velaagacha kerava behahu sitra amar ribbi chizkiyya bemma patach veamar ki betachbulot taase lecha milchama vegv man milchama da milchama dehahu sitra bisha deitzterich bar nash laagacha beh kerava ulshaltaa aloy ulishtezava minneh

Ta chaze deyaakov hachi ishtaddal legabbe esav begin hahu sitra dileh leitchakkema aloy ulmezal immeh beakimu bechal ma deitzterich begin leshaltaa aloy beresha vesofa vecholla kedeka yeut veresha vesofa kechada da kegavena da kema dichtiv bechorati ulvatar birchati sheruta vesofa kechada da kegavena da begin leshalletaa aloy beorach meshar kedeka chaze leh uvgin kach zakkaa ihu man deishteziv minnayehu veyachil leshalletaa alayehu
Ta chaze zechira ufkida letav inun kechada beraza dimhemnuta vezakkaa ihu man deishtaddal batar mehemnuta kema deatte amer achare Adonai yelchu kearye yishag vegv amar ribbi chizkiyya hachi hu vadday
Vetta chaze bar nash kad tzalle tzeloteh la yema aleh zachreni ufakdeni begin deika zechira ufkida letav uzchira ufkida
319: Levish vezamminin lenatla milla min puma veatyan leadkara chovoy devar nash velaanasha leh bar i ihu zakkaa shelim dechad badke chovoy hahi zechira ufkida levish la yishkechun lon kegon ezra deamar zachra li elohay letova

Deha bechal atar devar nash tzalle tzeloteh yachlil garmeh ben saggiin bichlala desaggiin veta chaze shunammit kad amar lah elisha hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech o el sar hatztzava hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech hahu yoma yom tov derosh hashshana hava vehahu yoma demalchuta dirkia shalta lemedan alma vekudsha berich hu ikre melech hammishpat behahu zimna uvgin kach amar lah hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech

Ma ketiv vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshevet may kaamra la vaena lemeheve reshimaa leela ella leaalaa reshay ben saggiin vela leafaka mikkelala dilhon vechach bae leh levar nash leitkelala bichlala desaggiin vela leityachada bilchodoy begin dela yishgechun aleh leadkara chovoy kidkaamaran

Amar leh kudsha berich hu vechi ana katil bene nasha haniglu lecha shaare mavet veshaare tzalmavet tire kamma tarin inun petichan behahu sitra umota shalta alayehu vechullehu setimin mibbene nasha vela yadin inun shearim

Vechal inun dargin denafke minnayehu umitkashsheran behu inun shearim dilhon kema dilela kema deatte amer seu shearim rashechem vegv veillen ikru naharin venachalin shit sitrin dealma uf hachi inun shaare mavet veshaare tzalmavet missitra achora dargin yedian deshaltin bealma shaare mavet veshaare tzalmavet da nukva veda dechura vetarvayehu kechada
