Ta chaze vayyizkor elohim et rachel vayyishma eleha elohim vayiftach et rachamah tere zimnin elohim elohim ammay ella chad mealma didchura vechad mealma denukva begin divmazzala talya milleta

Vechad itarat rachel bishma da dichtiv yosef Adonai li ben acher yada yaakov deihi itchazzeya leashlama kullehu shivtin vela titkayyem bealma begin kach baa lemezal vela yachil vechad mata zimna devinyamin arak veazal leh begin deveara achora la yishtelam beta leitkashshera alma kaddisha beh

Vehayenu dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el yaakov shuv el eretz avotecha ulmoladtecha veehye immach may veehye immach ella amar leh ad hacha rachel havat immach ikkera deveta mikkan ulhala ana ehe immach veetol beta bahadach bitresar shivtin vehayenu dichtiv vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel alay hava uvgini hava milla deitdachya ihi veatya diyyura achora venatla veta begini ledayera immi
Vayyomer nakva secharcha alay veettena may nakva amar ribbi yitzchak hahu rasha amar ana chame deyaakov la istakkel ella benukve
320: Uvgin kach yiflach li amar nakva secharcha ha nekeva deihu secharcha kad bekadmita veettena ema man nekeva istakkalte bah veettena uflach li beginah

Vayyomer yaakov lo titten li meuma amar yaakov chalila deha ana kal ma deavidna leshem yekara demalka kaddisha avidna veal da lo titten li meuma deha lav datay behay ella im taase li haddavar hazze vegv

Ela yaakov bachin shata demazzeleh hava deshare leh leenash lemivchan shateh ad la yatuv leareh vei mazzaleh kaim bemma deavid shappir vei lav la yoshit ragloy ad deyislak legabbeh

Ta chaze ketiv veanta bi tzidkati beom machar vegv deha ihu la avad begin deyittol middileh lemaggana ella kolla bekushta ushlimu diruta vela od ella deihu natil reshu millavan veal da ketiv nichashti vayevaracheni Adonai biglalecha kamma chorashin vezinin avad lavan uvachin mazzaleh begineh deyaakov vehava ashkach begineh deyaakov mea ana kal yarcha uma imrin uma izzin yattir al aneh

Et hammaklot man maklot illen dargin deinun be dina asher pitztzel deaavar minnehon dina barhatim hayenu dichtiv melech asur barhatim deha mehahu melech atyan birchan lechullehu almin
321: Melech asur barhatim melech da asur vekashur beinun rehatin illain deminnayehu ishtakyan kolla mimmelech illaa beshikkatot hammayim illen inun nachalin denafkin veatyan ad dematu leatar demitkanshe tamman asher tavona hatztzon lishtot kema deatte amer yashku kal chayeto saday yishberu feraim tzemaam uvhahu atar demitkanshe tamman maya kullehu atyan leashkaa minneh

Ta chaze hachi name yaakov birer achsanteh veadveh lechulakeh vesalik leela mikkal dargin venatil leh leadveh makkal livne lach hayenu darga chivara distar yemina veluz vearmon hayenu darga sumka distar semala

Vayefatztzel bahen petzalot levanot deaavar dina min da veitchabbar leh bimina vehu al benayehu venatil lon kechada veitavid kolla chad bitri gavene veim kal da machsof hallavan deyitgalle chivara al sumka vechal da lemay leamshacha ledarga da deadveh birchan mimmabbua decholla ulshavaa ledarga da deihu telata kechada

322: Leitbarcha kullehu almin letatta veyaakov natal chulakeh meinun birchan desharyan aleh letatta begin deihu chulakeh veadva dekudsha berich hu

Aval ha okimna berachot lerosh tzaddik tzaddik ikre hahu atar divrit deminneh nafkin mabbuin levar nukva dekista dechamra nafik minneh ihu resha kach rosh tzaddik hahu atar kad zarik mabbuin lenukva ikre rosh tzaddik tzaddik ihu rosh begin dechal birchan beh sharyan

323: Vetiuvta detarvayehu kechada bedibbuka chad dela mitparshan veal da la itzterich lemitba alah
Amar leh uvzimna degaluta lav hachi amar leh zaro ketiv velav ihu ematay nafik kad nukva bedibbuka chad im dechura vei tema la raiti tzaddik neezav bezimna degaluta may hi
Ella ha achid leela vela neezav lealmin bezimna achora lo neezav minnukva achid leela veachid letatta achid leela bezimna degaluta bezimna achora achid litren sitrin leela vetatta ulolam eno neezav
Ketiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim da tzaddik veaf al gav deittemar birkia hashshamayim ella birkia hashshamayim vadday deihu siyyuma degufa

Ta chaze terin rekiin inun veinun sheruta vesiyyuma da kegavena da sheruta rekia teminaa beh shekian kal kochvaya zeirin veravrevin veda hu rekia illaa setimaa dekaim kolla uminneh nafik kolla veihu teminaa mittatta leela vehu sheruta leafaka minneh kolla

Vei tema alma dilela man ihu veha hahu rekia teminaa illaa setimaa alma dilela ihu vehachi ikre deha teren almin ninhu kema deittemar ella ihu alma illaa vechal inun denafke minneh al shemeh ikrun veinun denafke mealma tattaa al shemeh ikrun vechal hay vehay kolla chad berich hu lealam ulalme almin

Davar acher davka nafshi acharecha leitattera dargeh leela deha kad itdabbak hahu darga bedargin illain lesalka batrayehu keden yemina achid beh lesalka leh ulchabbera leh bechibbura chad kedeka yeut kema deatte amer vetochazeni yeminecha uchtiv vimino techabbekeni veal da bi tamcha yeminecha
Vechad achid beh bekudsha berich hu keden ketiv semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni veihu yichuda chad vechibbura chad vechad ihu chibbura chad keden itmalleya hahu darga dileh veitbarcha

Vechad itmalyan kal inun rehatin itmalyan learba sitrin dealma vechullehu adaraya ishtakkeyan kal chad vechad lesitreh vechad ata yaakov leatkana hay darga barir leh sitra dimina deitchaze leh vesitra achora dela itchaze leh itparshat mineh kema dichtiv vayyashet lo adarim levaddo velo shatam al tzon lavan levaddo hava bilchodoy dela yishtammesh betaavan achoranin divsitrin achoranin zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael dealayehu ketiv ki am kadosh atta layeya elohecha uvcha bachar Adonai vegv
Veta chaze yaakov ihu tushbecha deavahan veihu kelala dechullehu uvgin deihu kelala decholla begin kach ihu kaim leanhara lesihara deyaakov ihu kaim leatkana litfillat arvit

Vechal hahu tikkuna ihu kedeka chaze leh kal inun sitrin kaddishin kullehu betikkuna atkin besitroy veafrish chulakeh mechulaka dishar amin illen sitrin illain kaddishin bikdushsha illaa veillen sitrin mesaavin bimsaavan dimsaavuta

Veal da yaakov shelimu deavahan atkin raza dimhemnuta veafrish chulakeh veadveh mechulaka veadva dishar ammin veal da ketiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom

326: Veyishtaar kudsha berich hu bilchodoy kema dichtiv vehaelilim kalil yachalof uchtiv venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu hu bilchodoy kema dichtiv veen immo el nechar begin deyishtetze chela mesaava mealoma vela yishtaar leela vetatta ella kudsha berich hu bilchodoy veyisrael lefulchaneh am kaddish veyitkere kaddish dichtiv vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalam kadosh yeamer lo kal hakkatuv lachayyim birushalami uchden yehe malka yechiday leela vetatta veamma yechidaa lefulchaneh kema dichtiv umi keamcha yisrael goy echad baaretz

Et karbani lachmi hada hu dichtiv achalti yaari im divshi shatiti yiyini im chalavi leishshay hada hu dichtiv ichlu reim vegv uma kudsha berich hu pakkid leitara mezona leela begin leitara mezona letatta mehahu mezona man deyahiv mezona lekayema nafsha al achat kamma vechamma dekudsha berich hu barich leh veyitar leh mezona dilela veyitbarach alma begineh
Amar ribbi yitzchak vadday raza da kedeka chaze veshappir kaamar amar ribbi yesa vadday al da amru dela yezalzel bar nash leshum bar nash achora bealma bitre gaveni zachina lehay bar nash
327: Ribbi elazar et karbani lachmi leishshay et karbani raza dichneset yisrael dichtiv et et dayeka karbani da ihu karbana vekishshura leitkashshera lachmi da mezona deate milela beitaruta diltatta leishshay leitkelala shear chelin achoranin deitzterichu leittezana kal chad vechad kedeka chaze leh reach nichochi da reuta vekishshura deitachada kolla beraza dealma illaa

Tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado man moado bizman deitar avraham lemebad reuteh dichtiv vayyashkem avraham babboker uvzimna deitakad yitzchak al gabbe madbecha dehahi shata ben haarbayim hava veamar ribbi yesa i hachi hay dichtiv bemoado bemoadim mibbae leh amar leh hahi shata itkelil esha bemaya umaya beesha uvgin kach ketiv bemoado

Ta chaze bechal karbanin la ketiv kema dichtiv hacha tishmeru lehakriv li tishmeru raza deshamor deihu tzericha lekarva legabbe ela dichtiv tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado bimina usmala kema deittemar beavraham veyitzchak vecholla beraza illaa

Amar ribbi yesa ilmale la atena hacha ella lemishma millin illen dayyay zakkain inun yisrael bealma den uvalma deate al da ketiv veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer

Velavan halach ligzoz et tzono vegv amar ribbi yose man terafim ella avoda zara hau veammay ikre terafim lignay hava kema detaninan bemakom hattoref umnalan deavoda zara hau dichtiv lamma ganavta et elohay uchtiv im asher timtza et elohecha vegv velavan charasha dechal chorashin dealma hava uvhay hava yada bechal man devae leminda

Amar ribbi chiyya bekesem itavid ribbi yose omer benachash amar ribbi yehuda la itavidu ella beshate yedian veammay ikre terafim begin devatshe hay shata vehay shata arpe yeda kema deatte amer rav atta heref yadecha

Umana kad avid leh hahu deyada rige veshate kaim aleh veamar hashta arpe vehashta avid vela tishkach avidta deitzterich deyirpun minah ella hay veihu mallil tadir veyahiv etin bishin leavasha lenafsheh devar nash

Verachel dechilat begin deyahav eta leavasha leh leyaakov uvgin bizona deavoda zara shave lon techotah ad dela yachil lemallala deha kad ihu mittakkan lemallala mechabbedin umarbitzin kammeh vehashta ma ketiv vatteshev alehem dechar venukva hau ufulchanin saggiin ka avdin ad la memallelan uvgini kach itakkav lavan telat yomin dela yada dearak yaakov dichtiv vayyuggad lelavan bayyom hashshelishi ki varach yaakov

Veamar ribbi yehuda zammin garmeh bitren millin izdaraz bechal chorashin dehava leh veizdaraz bezayenin begin leovada leh min alma dichtiv arammi oved avi kevan dechama kudsha berich hu devaa leovada leyaakov ma ketiv hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov ad ra vehayenu dichtiv yesh leel yadi laasot immachem ra bamme itrechitz bachorashin dehau bideh

Ta chaze lavan azal beoma chad orach shiva yamim deazal yaakov begin leaakara leh min alma chad al deazal vechad al inun terafim veaf al gav derachel ihi avdat leaakara leh laavuha mibbatar avoda zara itanashat dela reviat leh levinyamin vela kayema bahadeh shata chada begin tzaara deavuha af al gav deitkavvenat letav

Ribbi yitzchak amar kal hahi tochachta dehava leh leyaakov belavan ahadar leh lelavan leodaa leh lekudsha berich hu dichtiv ree elohim ed beni uvenecha ta chaze ketiv elohe avraham vilohe nachor yishpetu benenu ahadar hahu rasha letakleh kevan deamar elohe avraham ahadar veamar vilohe nachor
328: Vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak may tama befachad yitzchak vela belohe avraham ella dela vaa leatracha limina begineh delavan vela od ela dela libbae leh leinish af al gav deome bekushta leomaa beatar illaa decholla

Amar ribbi yose vadday lekiyyuma kedeka yeut ome yaakov kach vehachi itchaze veyaakov ashgach bemilla amar ha ihu amar elohe avraham veshavak leabba ana ashlim kolla miyyad vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak davar acher leitkelala bedina lemekam aleh delavan

Veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim ribbi abba patach veamar zachar unkeva beraam vegv kamma it lan leistakkala bemille deorayeta vay lon leinun atime libba ustimin ayenin ha orayeta kare kammayehu lechu lachamu velachmi ushtu beyayin masachti mi peti yasur henna chasar lev amra lo velet man deyashgach

Ta chaze hay kera it beh razin ilain ihu lego veihu levar zachar unkeva beraam ishtema lehay gavena veishtema lehay gavena veishtema deshimsha vesihara bechibbura chada inun dichtiv beraam kema deatte amer shemesh yareach amad zevula veishtema deadam vechava kechada itberiu beziuuga chad vechevan deishtakkachu beziuuga chad miyyad vayevarech otam delet birchata sharya ella beatar deishtakkachu dechar venukva

Ta chaze kad nafak yaakov lemehach lecharan bilchodoy hava dela insiv ma ketiv vayyifga bammakom vegv vela ativu leh ella bechelma hashta deinsiv vehava ate bechullehu shivtin kivyachol mashshiryan illain pagin beh veitchannenu leh dichtiv vayyifgeu vo inun ahadaru lemifga beh bekadmita ihu vayyifga bammakom hashta inun vayyifgeu vo

Begin divgineh deyaakov uvinun shivtin itshakyan inun mimmaya deyamma rabba vela od ella bekadmita ballayela bechelma hashta bechezu deena uvimama hada hu dichtiv vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam machane elohim ze vegv
Sitre veyaakov halacha ledarko vayyippeggeu vo malache elohim mattenitin tokpe dehurmene zekipin milleela veshinnena decharba dimlahata memanna kal chelin umashiryan

Hahu charba melahata hi charba sumka dichtiv cherev layeya mala dam hahu charba dettalya beh hippucha inun dimhappeche lechamma gevanin hu nashyan hu guvrin besitrin saggiin mittepparshin gevanin achoranin lechamma dargin

Missitra deilana dechayye nappeke inun demitteyachade beyichuda bekishura kaddishin illen ishtaavan tadir mital hashamayim shemeh delokim ittettakkin behu bearba sitrin dealma itteavidu samchin dekkurseya kullehu margelitin shayepin vesamchin la mittepparshin lealma miggo da shema inun kishurin deyaakov devarir lechulakeh umittekashran bishma da kullehu nappeku

Veyaakov kad nappak lemezal learcheh learba sitrin akipu leh learba zaveyan dealma natru leh beshata kalla itteregish meilana leela lemitar ilana diltatta uchden vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam machane elohim ze keden vayyikra shem hammakom hahu machanayim

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze shelemutteh deyaakov dela bae lemezal ella birshutteh delavan vei tema zimna achora ammay la ella begin dedachil yaakov dela yishbok leh veyishtelimu teresar shivtin beara achora veal da kevan dechama demata shata devinyamin barach kema deatte amer vayyivrach hu vechal asher lo dechevan deitteyalid binyamin ittekashar shechinta bechullehu shivtin venatal beta behu veyaakov hava yada berucha dechachmetta dechad yishtallimu teresar shivtin dishchinta tittekashar behu verachel tamutt veihi natla beta
Vetta chaze hachi olipna alma tattaa ittechaze leh leyaakov kema deittechaze leh lemoshe ella dela
329: Ishtemoda lon ela chama deinun hau inun dechama bechelma begine kach kara lon machanayim mashshiryan deitchazu leela umashshiryan deitchazu letatta

Ammay itgalliu lemifga leh ela shechinta azla legabbeh lenatla leveteh umchakka leh levinyamin lenatla beta immeh deyaakov kedeka yeut uchden ketiv veshav yaakov vshakat veshaanan ven macharid baruch Adonai leolam amen vamen

Yechilatt ad dehau shivtin beveta leittekashra behu uchden itteddachyat rachel untalatt ihi beta bechullehu shivtin vehavatt ikra deveta uchden moshivi akerett habbayitt amar yaakov ha mata zimna deyishtallimu shivtin uvadday alma dilela yechutt leh leveta vittekashra behu umiskenatta da itteddachya kammeh i timutt hacha la eppok mikkan lealmin velo od ella beara da la ittechaze leashlama beta begin kacha vayehi kaasher yalda rachel ett yosef ad la yishtallimu shivtin

Shama ribbi shimon amar vday kal milloy deribbi yehuda shappir salik al kolla vei tema ammay la azal leh learcheh miyyad ella kal zimna derachel la mitteabbera mibbinyamin itteakkav tamman kevan demata zimna devinyamin arak vela vaa reshutta begin dela yitteakkav tamman vittechabbar yaakov bechullehu shivtin beattar deitztzetericha
330: Vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam vegv umeinun malachin shaddar leh leesav hada hu dichtiv vayyishlach yaakov malachim malachim mammash hau vadday

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar ketiv chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vayechalletzem ha ukmuha aval beatar chad ketiv ki malachav yetzave lach malachav saggiin vehacha chad dichtiv chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vayechalletzem ella ki malachav yetzave lach illen shear malachin malach Adonai saviv da shechinta kema deatte amer vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene uvgin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav laakafa leh bechal sitrin begin leshezava leh vechad shechinta sharya begaveh devar nash kamma mashshiryan kaddishin kullehu izdammenu letamman

Ta chaze kad david malka ishteziv meachish melech gat keden amar hay begin dishchinta sachara leh veishteziv minnayehu meachish umeammeh kal inun deatkifu beh ma ketiv vayyitholel beyadam ammay vayyitholel vayyishtaggea mibbae leh kema deatte amer ki hevetem et ze lehishtaggea alay

Ella ahadar al hahu milla deamar david bekadmita dichtiv ki kinneti bahollim vegv amar leh kudsha berich hu chayyecha adayin ante itzterich lehay kevan deal leve achish veatkifu beh ma ketiv vayyitholel beyadam keinun hollim dekanne bekadmita uchden atya shechinta vesharya sacharaneh dedavid

Vei tema shechinta la sharya ella beachsanteh deihi ara kaddisha vadday la sharya begin linaka minnah aval laagana sharya vehacha kad ata yaakov mibbe lavan kullehu mashshiryan kaddishin sacharan leh vela ishtaar bilchodoy

Amar ribbi chizkiya i hachi ammay ketiv vayyivater yaakov levaddo vegv amar ribbi yehuda begin deail garmeh lesakkana vehava chame lehahi sakkana beenoy inun itparshu minneh uchden amar katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkal haemet illen inun mashshiryan kaddishin deitparshu minneh

Ribbi yitzchak amar begin leshavka leh im hahu memanna deesav devirshuta illaa hava ate veillen azle lememar shirata demata zimnayehu leshabbacha leh lekudsha berich hu behahi shata ulvatar ahadaru hada hu dichtiv katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkal haemet asher asita et avdecha vegv veatta hayiti lishne machanot machane shechinta vechal beteh lishni machanot dehava shelim michal sitrin mitteren chulakin chivar vesumak

Ribbi elazar amar ha ittemar hahu lelya shultanuta desitra deesav hava behahi shata deha ketiv yehi meorot chaser uvgin kach vayyivater yaakov levaddo deishtaar yaakov deihu shimsha bilchodoy deitkasya sihara min shimsha veaf al gav dintiru dekudsha berich hu la itade minneh mikkol vachol veal da lo yachol lo dichtiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo

Istakkal limina vechama leavraham istakkal lismala vechama leyitzchak istakkal begufa vechama deitkelil missitra da veitkelil missitra da keden vayyiga bechaf yerecho bechad ammuda desamich legufa deihu levar min gufa

Uvgin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vayechalletzem akkif leh bechal sitroy begin leshezava leh vechad shara shechinta begaveh kamma chelin umashshiryan atu bahadeh umeinun malachin shaddar legabbeh deesav

Vayyishlach yaakov malachim amar ribbi abba vechi ammay itar ihu legabbeh deesav vetav hava leh leishtuke minneh ella amar yaakov yedana deesav chayyish leh likara deabba ulalam la argiz kammeh veha yedana hoil veabba kayyam la mistafina minneh aval hashta immeh miyyad vayyishlach yaakov malachim lefanav
Vayyishlach yaakov malachim ribbi shimon patach veamar tov nikla veeved lo mimmitkabbed vachasar lechem hay kera al yetzer
331: Hara ittemar begin deihu mekatrega tadir legabbe bene nasha veyetzer hara ihu arim libbeh uruteh devar nash begaavata veazil avatreh mesalsel saareh uvresheh ad deihu itgae aleh umashich leh laggehinnom

Aval tov nikla hahu dela azil avatreh deyetzer hara vela itgae kelal umaich rucheh velibbeh uruteh legabbe kudsha berich hu uchden hahu yetzer hara mithappech leeved lo dela yachil leshaltaa aloy vehahu bar nash shallit aloy kema deatte amer veatta timshal bo
Mimmitkabbed kema deamaran deihu okir garmeh mesalsel besaareh itgae berucheh veihu chasar lechem chasar mehemnuta kema deatte amer lechem elohav vegv lechem elohehem hem makrivim vegv

Davar acher tov nikla da yaakov demaich rucheh legabbeh deesav begin dilvatar leheve eved lo veyishlot aloy veyitkayyam beh yaavducha ammim veyishtachau lecha leumim vegv vaadayin la hava zimneh kelal ella begin desalik leh yaakov levatar yomaya veal da hava miyyad nikla ulvatar hahu deihu mitkabbed yehe eved lo hahu deihu chasar lechem yehe avda lehahu deyahavu leh rov dagan vetirosh

Ta chaze al da begin deyada yaakov deitzterich leh hashta ithappach leh nikla veoter chachma vaakimu avad beda mikkal ma deavad legabbe deesav deilu hava yada esav chachma da yiktil leh legarmeh vela yete leda aval kolla avad bechachmeta vealeh amra channa Adonai yechattu merivav vegv veyitten oz lemalko vegv

Vayetzav otam lemor ko tomrun ladoni leesav ko amar avdecha yaakov im lavan garti vaechar ad atta miyyad patach yaakov leithappacha leh leavda begin dela yistakkal esav beinun birchan devarcheh avoy deha yaakov salik lon levatar kedeka amaran

Amar ribbi yehuda may chama yaakov deshaddar leh leesav veamar im lavan garti vechi ma avid bishlichuteh deesav milla da ella lavan haarammi kaleh azil bealma dela hava var nash deyishteziv minneh dehu hava charash bechorashin verav bekosmin vaavoy divor hava uvor avoy devilam dichtiv bilam ben beor hakkosem velavan chacham bechorashin vekosmin yattir mikkullehu veim kal da la yachil beyaakov uvaa leovada leyaakov bechamma zayenin hada hu dichtiv arammi oved avi

Amar ribbi abba kule alma have yade delavan hava rav chakkimin vachorashin vekosmin uman devae leovada bechorashoy la ishteziv minneh vechal ma deyada bilam minneh hava uchtiv beh bevilam ki yadati et asher tevarech mevorach vaasher taor yuar vechule alma hau mistafe millavan umechorashoy umilla kadmaa deshaddar yaakov leesav amar im lavan garti vei tema dizer hava yerach o shatta lav hachi ella vaechar ad atta esrin shenin itacharit immeh

Vei tema dela salik beyadi kelum vayehi li shor vachamor inun teren gizre dinin dechad mitchabberan tarvayehu kechada la mitchabberan ela leavasha alma uvgin kach ketiv lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav

Tzon veeved veshifcha ilen inun kitre tattae dekatal kudsha berich hu bemitzrayim bechor behema bechor hashshevi bechor hashshifcha hada hu dichtiv tzon veeved veshifcha miyyad mistafe hava esav venafak lakodamuteh udchilu hava leh miyyaakov kema dehava leh leyaakov meesav

Levar nash dehava azil bearcha ad dehava azil shama al chad listim dehava kaman bearcha paga beh var nash achora amar leh mimman ante amar leh mippeloni ligon ana amar leh sete lach miggabbay dechal man dekariv bahaday chad chiveya ana mayete vekatil leh azal hahu var nash lehahu ligon amar leh chad var nash ate vechal man di kariv bahadeh nashcheh chad chiveya dehu mayete
332: Shama hahu ligon vedachil amar yaot deezil lekovleh veitpayes bahadeh ad dechama leh hahu var nash amar vay dehashta yikteleneh hahu ligon share sagid vechara lekovleh amar hahu ligon ilmale hava leh bideh chiveya lekatla la segid kulay hay lekovli share ligonaa leitgaa amar hoil vechal kach kara lekivli la ektelineh

Kacha amar yaakov im lavan garti vaechar ad atta esrin shenin itacharit immeh veana mayete chiveya lekatla beni nasha shema esav amar vay man yakum kammeh dehashta yiktelineh yaakov befumeh share nafik lakodamuteh leitpayesa immeh

Kevan dechama leh ma ketiv vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo kevan dekariv bahadeh share kara vesagid lekovleh hada hu dichtiv vayyishtachu artza sheva peamim ad gishto ad achiv amar esav ilmale kal kach hava immeh la segid lekivli share leitgaa

Ta chaze ma ketiv bevilam vayyavo elohim el bilam layela belavan ketiv vayyavo elohim el lavan haarammi bachalom hallayela vayyomer lo hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov vegv pen tedabber pen taase leyaakov raa mibbae leh ella lavan la radaf avatreh deyaakov bechela deguvrin laagacha beh kerava deha chela deyaakov uvnoy rav minneh ella lemikteleh befumeh ulshetzaa kolla hada hu dichtiv arammi oved avi uvgin kach pen tedabber vela ketiv pen taase uchtiv yesh leel yadi laasot minnayin hava yada diyecholta hava bideh ella kema deittemar elohe avichem emesh amar elay vegv
Veda hu sahaduta deppakkid kudsha berich hu leashada dichtiv veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha arammi oved avi vegv veanita kema deatte amer lo taane vereacha ana veachiv

Ketiv beh bevilam velo halach chefaam befaam likrat nechashim dehachi hu archeh deihu hava menachesh belavan ketiv nichashti deashgach bacharashoy uviksamoy beiska deyaakov vechad baa leovada leyaakov binchasha uvacharasha dileh baa leovadeh vela shavkeh kudsha berich hu

Vehayenu deamar bilam bar bereh ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael man yachil lehon deha savay baa leovada laavuhon binchashim uviksamim dileh vela selika bidoy dela shavkeh lelatya hada hu dichtiv ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael

Uvchullehu asara zine chorashin vekosmin dekuztefe dechitrin tattain avad lavan lekovleh deyaakov vela yachil hada hu dichtiv vattachlef et maskurti aseret monim dechullehu avad lavan lekovleh vela seliku bidoy leavasha leh dichtiv vehecholif et maskurti aseret monim velo netano elohim lehara immadi may monim ketargum zinin uchtiv lasseirim asher hem zonim acharehem monim minim kemashmao vaasara zinin inun decharashin vekosmin bechitrin tattain vechullehu avad lekovleh
Asara zinin inun dichtiv kosem kesamim meonin umnachesh umchashshef vechover chaver veshoel ov veyidoni vedorish el hammetim ha asara inun

Amar ribbi yose nachash vekesem tere zine inun uvdarga chad salkin vechad ata bilam bekesem avad lekivlehon deyisrael vehayenu dichtiv uksamim beyadam ulkovleh deyaakov ata lavan benachash hay vehay la seliku bidayehu hada hu dichtiv ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael ki lo nachash beyaakov bekadmita beomoy delavan velo kesem beyisrael levatar beomoy devilam
Amar bilam levalak ta chaze man yachil lehon dechal kesamin vacharashin divchitrin dilan mikkizfa demalchuta dilela mitatteran vehu itkashshar behu dichtiv Adonai elohav immo utruat melech bo
Amar ribbi yehuda chas veshalom dehava yada bilam bikdusha dilela
333: Kelal deha kudsha berich hu la itrae beam velishan achora deyishtammesh bikareh ella benoy kaddishin veamar vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim man deinun kaddishin yishtamshun bikdushsha yisrael inun kaddishin dichtiv ki am kadosh atta atta kadosh vela am achora

Man deinun mesaavin mesaavu izdamman lon leistaava aleh ketiv tame hu badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo umsaava limsaava kare dichtiv vetame tame yikra man deihu tame letame yikra kola azil batar zineh

Amar ribbi yitzchak yaot hu leyaakov dehava kaddisha lomar deistaav belavan uvacharashoy o shevacha hu dileh amar leh ribbi yose af al gav dekaamar rabbi yehuda ana mesayyea lach deha ketiv anochi esav bechorecha vechi yaot hu letzaddika keyaakov lemichlaf shemeh bishma dimsaava ella anochi paska tama veamar anochi man deana aval esav bechorecha veha ukmuha

Uf hacha vayehi li shor vachamor lomar la teshave libbach urutach lehahi birchata devarich li abba deitkeyyam bi hu barich li hevi gevir leachecha veyishtachau lecha bene immecha begin kach avdecha yaakov ladoni leesav hu barich li berov dagan vetirosh ha la itkeyyam bi dela otzarna lon ella vayehi li shor vachamor tzon veeved rae ana bechakla hu barich li mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz ha la itkeyyam bi begin deha im lavan garti kegiyyora dela hava li beta chada kal shekken mishmanne haaretz vechal da begin dela yistakkal beh beyaakov al inun birchan vikatreg immeh

Ribbi abba amar ketiv beh beyaakov ish tam yoshev ohalim gevar shelim begin deihu yetiv bitren mishkanin illain veashlim lehay gisa ulhay gisa veihu la amar deistaav bacharashoy aval al ma dekaamar ribbi yehuda begin delibboy shelim al tivu ukshot deavid leh kudsha berich hu dechal alma yade ovadoy delavan man inun uman yachil leishtezava mikkitruga dileh devae leovada li vekudsha berich hu shezvani minneh vecholla hava begin dela yistakkal beh esav deitkayemu beh inun birchan vela yintar leh devavu veal da ketiv ki yesharim darche Adonai vegv uchtiv tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha

Vayyashuvu hammalachim el yaakov lemor banu el achicha el esav vegam holech likratcha vearba meot ish immo kevan deamar banu el achicha la yedana deihu esav vechi achin achoranin hau leyaakov ella banu el achicha vei tema dehadar bitshuva veazil beorach metakkena lav hachi ella esav harasha kidmeikara vegam holech likratcha vei tema deihu bilchodoy azil lav ela arba meot ish immo

Vechal kach lamma amru leh begin dekudsha berich hu itrae tadir bitzlothon detzaddikaya umitatter bitzlothon kidamrinan dehahu malacha dimmanna al tzelothon deyisrael sandalfon shemeh natil kal inun tzelotin veavid minnayehu atara lechaye haolamim veukmuha vechal shekken tzelothon detzaddikayya dekudsha berich hu itrae behu veitavdan atara leitattera beinun tzelotin lekudsha berich hu vei tema mashshiryan kaddishin hau atyan immeh ammay dachil ella tzaddikaya la samchin al zechutayehu ella al tzelothon uvauthon legabbe marehon

Vetta chaze deamar ribbi shimon tzelota desaggiin salik kamme kudsha berich hu umitatter behahu tzelota begin desalka bigvanin saggiin veitkelilat mikkamma sitrin uvgin deitkelilat mikkamma gevanin itavidat atara umancha al resha detzaddik chay haolamim utzlota deyachid lav ihi kelila velav ihi ella begavan chad veal da tzelota deyachid lav ihu mittakna leitkabbela kitzlota desaggiin vetta chaze yaakov kalil hava veal da tzeloteh taiv lah kudsha berich hu ma ketiv vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo
Ribbi yehuda patach veamar ashre adam mefached tamid umakshe libbo yippol beraa
334: Zakkain inun yisrael dekudsha berich hu itrae behu veyahav lon orayeta dikshot begin lemizke vah lechayye alma dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta kudsha berich hu mashich aleh chayyin illain veail leh lechayye alma deate dichtiv ki hi chayyecha veorech yamecha uchtiv uvaddavar hazze taarichu yamim chayyin behay alma vechayin bealma deate

Ribbi elazar amar kal man deishtaddal beorayeta lishmah lav mitateh al yeda deyetzer hara begin Adonai deittakkif beilana dechayye vela arpe minneh uvgin kach tzaddikaya demishtaddele beorayeta la mistaave gufa dilhon dela shara alayehu ruach mesaava

Yaakov ilana dechayye hava ammay dachil deha la yachol leshaltaa aloy veod deha ketiv vehinne anochi immach vegv ammay hava dachil vetu deha ketiv vayyifgeu vo malache elohim i mashshiryan kaddishin hau immeh ammay hava dachil

Ella kolla yaot hava veyaakov la hava bae lemismach al nisa dekudsha berich hu begin dechashiv delav ihu keday dekudsha berich hu yaavid leh nisa may tama begin dela falach leavoy ulimmeh kedeka yeut vela ishtaddal beorayeta venatal tere achaot veaf al gav decholla ittemar veim kal da bae leh levar nash lemidchal tadir ultzallaa kamme kudsha berich hu bitzlota dichtiv ashre adam mefached tamid veha ukmuha

Ta chaze tzelota deavahan kayemu alma vechal bene alma alayehu kayeme vesamchin lealam ulalme almin la itneshe zechuta deavahan begin dizchuta deavahan ihu kiyyuma deela vetatta vekiyyuma deyaakov ihu kiyyuma shelim yattir mikkullehu uvgin kach beshata deaku livnoy deyaakov kudsha berich hu achme kammeh diukna deyaakov vechayis al alma kema deatte amer vezacharti et beriti yaakov yaakov bev ammay bev begin deihu diukna deyaakov mammash

Ta chaze kal man dechame leh leyaakov keman deistakkel beaspaklarya denahara veha ittemar deshufreh deyaakov keshufreh deadam kadmaa amar ribbi yesa ana shemana dechal man deistakkal bechelmeh vechama leh leyaakov mekustar bekusfoy chayyin ittosfan leh

Ribbi shimon amar ha ittemar dedavid malka ad la hava la hau leh chayyim kelal bar deadam kadmaa yahav leh shivin shenin middileh vechach hava kiyyumeh dedavid malka shivin shenin hau vekiyyuma deadam kadmaa elef shenin chasar shivin ishtakkachu behanne elef shenin kadmae adam harishon vedavid malka

Patach veamar chayyim shaal mimcha natatta lo orech yamim olam vaed chayyim shaal mimcha da david malka deha kad bara kudsha berich hu ginta deeden attil beh nishmata dedavid malka veistakkal beh vechame delet leh chayyim middileh kelum vekayema kammeh kal yoma kevan devara adam harishon amar ha vadday kiyyumeh umeadam kadmaa hau shivin shenin deitkeyyam david malka bealma
Tu avahan shavku leh mechayyehon kal chad vechad avraham shavak leh vechen yaakov veosef yitzchak la shavak leh kelum begin dedavid malka missitreh ka ata

Vadday avraham shavak leh chamesh shenin dehava leh leitkayema mea utmanin shenin veitkeyyam mea veshivin vechamesh shenin chaserin chamesh yaakov hava leh leitkayema bealma keome deavraham vela itkeyyam
335: Ella mea vearbain vesheva shenin chaserim temanya veesrin ishtakkachu deavraham veyaakov shevaku leh mechayyehon telatin utlat shenin yosef deitkeyyam mea veeser shenin hava leh leitkayyama mea vearbain vesheva shenin keome deyaakov vechaser minnehon telatin vesheva shenin ha shivin shenin dishvaku leh ledavid malka leitkayema behon uvhu itkayam david bechal inun shenin dishvaku leh avahan

Vei tema yitzchak ammay la shavak leh kelum kehanne begin deihu choshech vedavid missitra dechoshech ka ata uman deihu bachoshech let leh nehora kelal velet leh chayyim uvgin kach la hau ledavid chayyim kelal aval illen dehau lehon nehora nehiru leh ledavid malka uminnayehu itzterich leanhara ulmehve leh chayyim deha missitra dechoshech let leh chayyim kelal veal da la ata yitzchak bechushbena

Vei tema yosef ammay yattir mikkullehu ella vadday yosef bilchodoy kechullehu begin deikre tzaddik veda hu deanhir lesihara yattir mikkullehu uvgin kach hay shavak leh ledavid malka yatir mikkullehu chayyin dichtiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz

Ta chaze yaakov tzeloteh agin leh meesav begin devaa lesalka zechuteh livnoy avatreh vela leafaka leh hashta legabbeh deesav veal da tzale tzeloteh lekudsha berich hu vela istemich al zechuteh leshezava leh beginih

Vayyomer im yavo esav el hammachan haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachan hannishar lifleta ta chaze ma ketiv vayyachatz et haam asher itto veet hatztzon veet habbakar vehaggemallim lishne machanot ammay lishne machanot begin deamar im yavo esav el hammachan haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta

Ta chaze shechinta la adiat meohel lea umeohel rachel amar yaakov yadana deha netiru lon leillen min kudsha berich hu ma avad vayyasem et hashshefachot veet yaldehen rishona amar im yaktil esav leillen yaktel aval illen la mistafina minnayehu begin dishchinta immehon veal da vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta kevan deavid hay atkin tzeloteh alayehu ma ketiv vayyomer yaakov elohe avi avraham vilohe avi yitzchak Adonai haomer elay shuv leartzecha ulmoladtecha veetiva immach

Ribbi yose patach veamar tefilla leani chi yaatof velifni Adonai yishpoch sicho hay kera ukmuha bechamma atar ella david malka amar da kad istakkal vechama bemille demiskena veistakkal beh kad hava azil vearak mikkamme chamoy amar da tefilla leani da hu tzelota devae miskena kamme kudsha berich hu veda tzelota deakdimat lechal tzelothon dealma

Ketiv hacha tefilla leani uchtiv hatam tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim ma ben hay lehay ella da tefilla shel yad veda tefilla shel rosh velet leafrasha ben hay tefilla leani uven tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim vetarvayehu shekilin kechad

Veal da tzelota deani akdimat kamme kudsha berich hu mikkal tzelotin dealma begin dichtiv ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut ani vegv ta chaze tefilla leani da tefilla shel yad deani itdabbak bemiskenuteh keman delet leh miggarmeh kelum
Davar acher tefilla da moshe leani da david ki yaatof kad itkasseya sihara veitkasse shimsha minah velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho begin leitchabbera bahade shimsha

Ta chaze tzelota dechal bene nasha tzelota utzlota demiskena ihi tzelota dekayema kammeh dekudsha berich hu vetavar tarin ufitchin vealat leitkabbala kammeh hada hu dichtiv vehaya chi yitzak elay veshamati ki channun ani uchtiv shamoa eshma tzaakato velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho keman demitraem al dinoy dekudsha berich hu
Amar ribbi elazar tzelothon detzaddikaya chedvata lichneset yisrael
336: Leitattara kameh kudsha berich hu vegin kach chaviva hu yattir kammeh kudsha berich hu uvgin kach kudsha berich hu taiv litzlothon detzaddikayya beshata deitzterich lon begin deyade leratztzuye lemarehon

Ma ketiv beh beyaakov elohe avi avraham velohe avi yitzchak Adonai haomer elay shuv vegv iatar veikshar kishshura bekishshura chad kedeka chaze elohe avi avraham limina vilohe avi yitzchak lismala haomer elay hacha tale milla leitattera leatreh benayehu shuv leartzecha ulmoladtecha veetiva immach

Katonti mikkol hachasadim ammay hava itzterich hay im hay ella amar yaakov atte avtachte li leotava immi veana yedana dechal ovadach kullehu al tenay ha ana let bi zechuta deha katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkal haemet asher asita et avdecha vechal ma daavadat li ad yoma lav begin zechutay hava ella beginach hu daavadat li vehahu tivu ukshot beginach hava deha kad avarna bekadmita dehavena azil mikkamme deesav yechiday avarna leh lehahu nahara veante avdit immi tivu ukshot veha ana hashta maavar leh bitre mashshiryan inun teren mashshiryan defalig

Ad hacha siddura deshivcha demareh mikkan ulhala baa ma deitzterich leh leachazaa lechal beni alma deitzterich leh levar nash lesaddera shevacha demareh bekadmita ulvatar yibbae bauteh dehachi avad yaakov bekadmita sidder shevacha demareh ulvatar desidder shevacha amar bauteh deitzterich leh

Hada hu dichtiv hatztzileni na miyyad achi miyyad esav ki yare anochi oto pen yavo vehikkanni em al banim mikkan man detzalle tzeloteh devae lefarsha milloy kedeka yeut hatztzileni na vei tema deha shezavte li millavan miyyad achi vei tema kerivin ocharanin setam achin ikrun miyyad esav may taama begin lefarsha milla kedeka yeut vei tema ana ammay itzterich ki yare anochi oto pen yavo vehikkani begin leishtemoda milla leela ulfarsha lah kedeka yeut vela yastim milla
Veatta amarta hetev etiv immach vegv veatta amarta hetev etiv may veatta kema deatte amer veatta mechayye et kullam uf hacha veatta amarta
Ta chaze david malka amar yihu leratzon imre fi illen millin deitparshan vehegon libbi illen millin distiman dela yachil bar nash lefarsha lon befumeh da hu hegon deihu belibba dela yachil leitparsha

Veal da itzterich milla leitparsha befuma umilla detalya belibba vecholla raza ihu chad lakovel darga tattaa vechad lakovel darga illaa milla deitparsha lakovel darga tattaa deitzterich leitparsha hahu detalya belibba ihu lakovel darga penimaa yattir vecholla kechada ihu veal da amar yihu leratzon imre fi vehegon libbi lefanecha vegv

Kegavena da amar yaakov bekadmita parish milla kedeka yeut ulvatar satim milla deihi talya behegona delibba dela itzterich lefarsha dichtiv vesamti et zaracha kechol hayyam asher lo yissafer merov hacha ihu milla detalya belibba dela itzterich lefarsha vechen itzterich kidkaamaran begin leyachada yichuda shelim kedeka yeut zakkain inun tzaddikaya deyade lesaddera shevacha demarehon kedeka yeut ulmive bauthon uvgin kach ketiv vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar
Vayyivater yaakov levaddo vegv ribbi chiya patach veamar lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beaholecha ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma avad bechal yoma veoma
337: Avidteh deitchaze leh veha ukmuha veittemar beoma reviaa avad nehorin uchden itbere sihara chaser nehora deazirat garmah uvgin deihi meorot chaser ityehiv duchta leshalletaa kal ruchin veshedin veilulin umazzikin vechal ruche mesaave

Kullehu salkin veshatin bealma leastaa veitmannun beduchte deitcharivu uvchaklin takkifin uvmadberin charivin vechullehu missitre ruach mesaava veha ittemar deha ruach mesaava deatya minnachash akimaa ihu ruach mesaava mammash veihu itmanna bealma leastaa bar nash legabbeh veal da yetzer hara shallit bealma

Veihu itmanne legabbayehu divni nasha veishtakkach immehon uvaakimu uvtaskufin ate legabbayehu leastaa lon mearchoy kudsha berich hu kema deaste leadam kadmaa vegarim mota lechal alma hachi name aste lehu livne nasha vegarim lon leistaava
Uman deate leistaava ihu mashich aleh hahu ruach mesaava veitdabbek bahadeh vechamma inun dizminin lesaava leh umsaavin leh veihu mesaav vesaovin leh behay alma uvhahu alma veha ittemar

Uvshaata deate bar nash leitdachaa hahu ruach mesaava itkafya kammeh vela yachil leshaltaa aloy uchden ketiv lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beaholecha amar rabbi yose lo teunne elecha raa da lilit venega lo yikrav veaholecha illen shear mazzikin veha ukmuha veittemar

Ribbi elazar amar ha amaran dela yippuk bar nash yechidaa belelya vechal shekken bezimna desihara itberiat vehava chasera veukmuha deha keden rucha mesaava shalta veda hu ruach raa man raa da chiveya visha venega da hu man derachiv al chiveya raa venega kechada inun

Veaf al gav detaninan denega illen nige bene adam denafku meadam deha kal inun shenin dela kariv adam im itteteh ruche mesaave hau ka atyan umitchamman minneh veolidan minneh vehanne ikrun nige bene adam

Veha ittemar dechad bar nash bechelmeh vela shallit begufeh vegufa ishtakkach ruach mesaava atya vesharya aleh veit zimnin deruche nukvin mesaavin atyan vekarvan bahadeh umashchin leh bahadayehu umitchamman minneh veolidu levatar ruchin umazzikin ulzimnin itchazyan kechezu bene nasha bar delet lon saare beresha

Uvcholla it leh levar nash leistammera mikkammayehu begin dihach bearche deorayeta vela yistaav bahadayehu deha let lach man denaim belelya bearseh dela taim tama demota venafkat nishmateh minneh vechevan deishtaar gufa bela nishmata kaddisha ruach mesaava zammin vesharya aleh veistaav veha okimna milla delet leh levar nash leaavara yedoy al enoy betzafra begin deha rucha mesaava sharya alayehu vechu veha ittemar
Ta chaze deha yaakov af al gav deitrachim kammeh kudsha berich hu begin deishtaar bilchodoy rucha achora hava zamin leizdavvega bahadeh

Ribbi shimon amar ta chaze ma ketiv beh behahu rasha devilam vayyelech shefi mahu shefi yechiday kema deatte amer shefifon ale orach kehay chiveya deazil yechiday vechamin ale archin ushvilin hachi name bilam hava azil yechiday may tama begin leamshacha aleh rucha mesaava dechal man deazil yechiday bizmannin yedian afilu bemata beatrin yedian mashich aleh rucha mesaava

Vegin kach bechal zimna la yehach bar nash yechiday bearcha vemata ella beatar divne nasha azlin vetavin umishtakkechin tamman veal da la yehach bar nash yechiday belelya hoil uvne nasha la mishtakkeche vehayenu tama dela talin nivlato
338: Dela lekayema gufa mita bela rucha al ara belelya begin kach hahu rasha devilam hava azil yechiday kehay nachash kema deukmuha

Vayyeavek ish immo may vayyeavek ribbi shimon amar min avak avak tafel leafar ma ben afar leavak da avak deishtaar min nura vela avad ibin lealmin afar dechal ibin nafke minneh veihu kelala beela vetatta

Amar ribbi yehuda i hachi may mekim meafar dal amar leh kemashmao aval behay gavena mekim meafar dal begin delet leh miggarmeh kelum umehahu afra nafak dal delet leh kelum umehahu afar kal ibin vechal tivu dealma nafke minneh uveh itavidu kal ovadin dealma kema dichtiv hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar vetaninan hakkol haya min heafar veafilu galgal chamma aval avak la avid perin veibin lealmin uvgin kach vayyeavek ish deatya behahu avak urchiv aleh begin lekatrega leh leyaakov

Ad alot hashshachar deitavar shultanuteh veitchallaf vechach hu lezimna deate begin degaluta hashta kelelya damya veihu lelya veshalta hahu avak al yisrael veinun shechive leafra ad deyistallak nehora veyitnehar yemama uchden yishletun yisrael ulhon yityahiv malchuta deinun kaddishe elonin kema deatte amer umalchuta veshaltana urvuta di malchevat techot kal shemaya yehivat leam kaddishe elonin malchuteh malchut alam vechol shaltanaya leh yiflechun veyishtammeun

Vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani ribbi yehuda patach veamar mi zot hannishkafa kemo shachar yafa challevana bara kachamma ayumma kannidgalot hay kera ukmuha veittemar aval mi zot hannishkafa illen inun yisrael bezimna dekudsha berich hu yokim lon veyafik lon min galuta keden yiftach lon pitcha dinhora dakkik zeer ulvatar pitcha acharina deihu rav mineh ad dekudsha berich hu yiftach lon tarin illain petichin learba ruche alma

Vechen kal ma deavid kudsha berich hu leyisrael ultzaddikaya di behu hachi kullehu velav bezimna chada levar nash deityehiv bachashocha vediyyureh hava bachashocha tadir kad yivun leanhara leh bayan leiftecha leh nehora zeerta keena demachata ulvatar rav minneh uchden bechal zimna ad deyinharun leh kal nehora kedeka yeut

Kacha inun yisrael kema deatte amer meat meat a gorashennu mippanecha ad asher tifre vegv vechen leman deate asvata lav ihu beshata chada ella zeer zeer ad deyittakkaf aval leesav lav hachi ella bezimna chada nahir leh veitavid minneh zeer zeer Adonai ad deyittakfun yisrael vishetzun leh mikkolla mealma den umealma deate uvgin denahir beshata chada hava leh shetziu mikkolla aval yisrael nehora dilhon zeer zeer ad deyittakfun veyanhir lon kudsha berich hu lealmin

Vecholla shaale lon veamre mi zot hannishkafa kemo shachar ihu kadruta detzafra veda ihu nehora dakik ulvatar yafa challevana begin desihara nehora dilah nahir yattir mishshachar ulvatar bara kachamma begin dinhoreh takkif venahir yattir missihara ulvatar ayumma kannidgalot takkifa binhora takkif kedeka yeut

Ta chaze beod deitchashach yemama veitkasya nehora veate tzafra yitnehir bekadmita zeer zeer ad deyitrabbe nehora kedeka yeut deha kevan dekudsha berich hu yitar leanhara lah lichneset yisrael yitnehir bekadmita kemo shachar deihi uchma ulvatar yafa challevana ulvatar bara kachamma ulvatar ayumma kannidgalot kema deittemar
339: Vetta chaze kevan deistalik tzafra deha la ketiv ki va hashshachar ella ki ala deha bezimna ki va hashshachar keden ittakkaf hahu memanna veakkish leh leyaakov begin dehahu memanna akkish leyaakov lemehav takkifu leitattakkafa leesav

Vechad salik hahu uchma deshachar veitchaze ata nehora veittakkaf yaakov deha cheden mata zimneh leitnehara ma ketiv vayyizrach lo hashshemesh kaasher avar et penuel vehu tzolea al yerecho vayyizrach lo hashshemesh deha keden zimna leitnahara

Vehu tzolea al yerecho keden ihu remez deha beod deyisrael begaluta vesavlin keevin vetzaarin vechamma bishin kad itnehir lon yemama veyete lon nayecha keden yistakkelun veyichavun begarmayehu mikkamma bishin vetzaarin desavlu veyitmehu alayehu begin kach vayyizrach lo hashshemesh dehahu zimna denayecha uchden vehu tzolea al yerecho itkaav vetzaer garmeh al ma deavar

Veihu kad istallak kadruta deshachara keden ittakkaf veitachid beh dechad itchallash cheleh delet leh shultanuta ella belelya veyaakov shaltanuteh bimama veal da amar vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar deha ana birshutcha kaimna veha ittemar veukmuha
Kelo velo rabbi chiyya amar illemale la itchallash chela da deyaakov itkeyyam yaakov legabbeh veitbar chela deesav leela vetatta

Ribbi shimon patach veamar kemare hakkeshet asher yihye beanan beom haggeshem ken mare hannogah saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai vaere vaeppol al panay vegv hay kera ittemar aval ta chaze deha ketiv velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe ma ben moshe lishar nevie alma moshe istakkal beaspaklarya denahara shear nevie la hau mistakkele ella beaspaklarya
340: Dela nahara moshe hava shama vekaim al ragloy vecheleh ittakkaf vehava yada milla al buryeh kema dichtiv umare velo vechidot shear nevie hau nafle al anpayehu veitchallash chela dilhon vela hau yachle lekayema al buryeh demilla man garam lon da begin dichtiv ki naga bechaf yerech yaakov vehu tzolea al yerecho

Vechal inun neviin la yachilu lekayema al ma dezammin kudsha berich hu lemebad leh leesav bar ovadya nevia dehava giyyora deate missitra deesav da kaim bekiyyumeh aleh deesav vela itchallash cheleh veal da kal shear nevie itchallash tukfayehu vela hau yachlin leitkayema lekabbela milla al buryeh kedeka yeut may tama begin ki naga bechaf yerech yaakov begin hannashe denassiv veshaiv kal chela deyarcha veal da itbar chela deyarcha veishtaar tzolea al yerecho deha kal neviin dealma la yachilu leiddabbeka ulkayema beh

Ta chaze neviin kullehu bar moshe la kayemu betukfayehu kedeka chaze uman delae beorayeta velet man desamich leh vela ishtechach man deattil melay lechiseh leittakfa al da orayeta ka mishtakkecha bechal dara vedara veitchallash tukfa deorayeta kal yoma veoma begin delet lon leinun delaan bah al ma desamchin umalchu chayyava ittakkaf bechal yoma veoma ta chaze
Kamma garim chova da uvgin delet man deasmich leorayeta kedeka yeut inun samchin challashin vegarmin leittakfa lehahu delet leh shokin veraglin lekayema alayehu

Patach veamar vayyomer Adonai elohim el hannachash ki asita zot arur atta mikkal habbehema vegv al gechoncha telech may al gechoncha telech deittavru samchin dileh uktzitzu ragloy velet leh al ma dekaim kad yisrael la baan lesamcha leh leorayeta inun yahavin leh samchin veshokin lekayema ulittakkefa behu

Ta chaze kamma akimu vechakkimu itchakkam behahu lelya hahu derachiv nachash lekovleh deyaakov deha ihu hava yada dichtiv hakkol kol yaakov vehayyadayim yede esav vei pasik kala deyaakov keden vehayyadayim yede esav begin kach istakkal lechal sitrin leavasha leh leyaakov ulafsaka kaleh

Vechama leh takkif becholla deroin missitra da umissitra da deinun takifin gufa deittakkaf benayehu vechama tukfa deorayeta veittakkaf becholla kede vayyar ki lo yachol lo ma avad miyyad vayyigga bechaf yerecho deitchakkam lekovleh amar kevan deittevaru samchin deorayeta miyyad orayeta la ittakkaf uchden yitkayyam ma deamar avuhon hakkol kol yaakov vehayyadayim yede esav vehaya kaasher tarid ufarakta ullo meal tzavarecha

Uvda itchakkam lekovleh deyaakov deha begin deyittavar chela deorayeta azil veittakkaf esav vechad chama dela yachil lah leorayeta keden chalish tukfa deinun desamchin lah vechad la yishtakkach man desamich leorayeta keden la yehe kol kol yaakov vihon yadayim yede esav

Vechad chama yaakov hachi kad salik tzafra atkif beh veitgabbar aleh ad deihu berich leh veode leh al inun birchan veamar leh lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im yisrael lav yaakov beakimu ella begeuta vetukfa delet man deyachil lach

Vetta chaze mehay nachash kamma chelin mitparshan lechal setar veishtakkachu bealma legabbe bene nasha uvinan lekayema lehahu gid hannashe deaf al gav dekariv beh hahu derachiv al chiveya kayyam ihu veitkeyyam begavan vela ittebbar
Vechela beinan leittakkafa bealma ulachazaa ki sarita im elohim veim anashim vattuchal vechad chame deha la ittebbar vela itachil hahu atar keden itbar cheleh vetukfeh
341: Vela yachil leavasha livnoy deyaakov veal da la beinan lemehav duchta livriyyata dealma lemechal leh vela leitachala kelal

Rabbi yesa sava darash ki naga bechaf yerech yaakov ketiv hacha ki naga bechaf uchtiv hatam kal hannogea bemet benefesh haadam vegv ma lehallan mesaava uf hacha name mesaava desaiv hahu atar umeatar mesaava let lan leithanaa minneh kelal kal shekken beatar dekariv hahu setar mesaava veorayeta la kaamar ella ki naga uchtiv vayyigga bechaf yerecho kema deatte amer vechol asher yigga bo hattame yitma berich rachamana deyahiv orayeta leyisrael lemizke vah bealma den uvalma deate kema dichtiv orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod

Vehu avar lifnehem vayyishtachu artza sheva peamim ad gishto ad achiv rabbi elazar patach veamar ki lo tishtachave leel acher ki Adonai kanna shemo vechi yaakov deihu shelema deavahan deitberir chulaka shelemata lekudsha berich hu veihu itkeriv legabbeh yattir hech sagid leh lehahu rasha deesav deihu besitra deel acher uman desagid leh sagid leel acher i tema begin deamru tala beidaneh sagid leh lav hachi deha esav keel acher hava veyaakov lo yisgod lehahu sitra ulhahu chulaka kelal

Ela ketiv vaamartem ko lechay veatta shalom uvetcha shalom vechal asher lecha shalom veha ittemar deasir leakdume lehu shelam lerashshiaya vechevan deasir hechi ashkachna dedavid amar hay kera lenaval ella ha ukmuha dilkudsha berich hu kaamar begin lekashra leh lechay vechashiv naval dealeh kaamar

Kegavena da vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta vechi legabbe divreh segid ella leatreh dishchinta ka kara vesagid uf hacha vehu avar lifnehem may vehu da shechinta illaa dehava azla kammeh veda hu netiru illaa kevan dechama yaakov amar ha idan lesagda legabbeh dekudsha berich hu dehava azil kammeh

Kara vesagid sheva zimnin ad gishto ad achiv vela ketiv vayyishtachu leesav ella kevan dechama deha kudsha berich hu azal kammeh keden sagid lekovleh begin dela lemehav yekar lemisgad leachora bar minnih vecholla ihu kedeka yeut zakkain inun tzaddikaya dechal ovadehon deka avde begin yekara demarehon ihu uvgin dela yistun limina velismala

Vayyaratz esav likrato vayechabbekehu vayyippol al tzavarav tzavaro ketiv chaser vayyishshakehu vayyivku rabbi yitzchak amar veharshaim kayyam nigrash ki hashket lo yuchal vayyigreshu memav refesh vatit hay kera ittemar umille deorayeta kamma razin illain it behu meshanyan da min da vecholla chad

Veharshaim kayyam nigrash ki hashket lo yuchal da esav dechal ovadoy birshiu uvchiyyuva deha kad ata legabbeh deyaakov ovadoy la hau bishlam vayyippol al tzavarav chad tzavaro da yerushala deihu tzavaro dechal alma vayyippol al tzavaro velo al tzavarav begin ditren zimnin itchariv be makdesha chad mibbavel vechad mizzareh deesav deappil garmeh aleh zimna chada vechariv leh veal da vayyippol al tzavaro chad
Vayyishshakehu nakud leel dela nashkeh biruteh utnan may dichtiv venetarot neshikot sone da bilam kad barich lon leyisrael deha la barich lon biruta delibba uf hacha netarot neshikot sone da esav

Amar ribbi yose ketiv kuma Adonai hoshieni elohay ki hikkita et kal oyevay lechi shinne reshaim shibbarta utnan al tikre shibbarta ella shirbavta deha asgiu shinoy vechashiv lenashcha leh vechu veal da vayyivku da bache veda bache veukmuha chavraya
342: Libbeh uruteh deesav legabbe deyaakov deha afilu behahu shata chashiv leorech zimnin lemebad leh bishin ulkatrega leh veal da vayyivku da hava bache dela hava chashiv leishtezava min yedoy veda hava bache begin deavoy hava kayyam vela yachil leh

Amar ribbi abba vadday itchallash rugzeh deesav beshata dechama leh leyaakov may tama begin deha istakkam bahadeh hahu memanna deesav veal da la yachil esav leshaltaa berugzeh dehachi kal millin dehay alma talyan leela vechad istakkemu leela bekadmita istakkemu letatta shaltanuta lav ihu letatta ad deityahiv shaltanuta leela vecholla da beda talya

Yaavar na adoni lifne avdo vaani etnahala leitti vegv amar ribbi elazar hayenu dekaamrinan bekadmita deyaakov la baa hashta inun birchan kadmay devarcheh avoy vaadayin la itkayemu beh afilu chad minnayehu begin desalik lon lesof yomaya beshata deitzterichu livnoy legabbe kal ammin dealma

Uvgin kach beshata deamar esav nisa venelecha veniflug hay alma kechada venishlot kechada ma amar yaavar na adoni lifne avdo yakdim esav shaltaneh hashta behay alma yaavar na kema deatte amer vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vayeya berosham akdim ante shultanutach bekadmita behay alma vaani etnahala leitti ana asallek garmi lehahu alma deate ulsof yomaya leinun yomaya deazlin leat

Leregel hamlacha man melacha da aspaklarya dela nahara devah itavid avidta dealma asher lifne da hi min kodam Adonai bechal atar ulregel hayeladim da hu raza dichruvim leachazaa raza dimhemnuta deihu itdabbak behu
Ad asher avo el adoni seira ana esbol galuta dilach ad deyete veyimte zimna dili leshaltaa al har esav kema deatte amer vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav uchden vehayeta layeya hamlucha

Veyaakov nasa sukkota vayyiven lo bayit ulmiknehu asa sukkot al ken kara shem hammakom sukkot ribbi chiyya patach veamar shir hammaalot lishlomo im Adonai lo yivne bayit vegv im Adonai lo yishmar ir vegv ta chaze beshata desalik biruta dekudsha berich hu lemivre alma appik mibbutzina dekardinuta chad kittura veitlehit miggo chashocha veishtaar bisliku venachata letatta hahi chashecha lahit bemea shevilin orchin dekikin ravrevan veitavid beta dealma

Hay beta ihu go emtzaita decholla kamma pitchin veidrin leh sechor sechor duchtin illain kaddishin tamman mekanne tzippore shemaya kal chad vechad lezineh begaveyh nafik chad ilana ravreva vetakkif afyeh veinbeh sagge mezona lecholla beh hahu ilana salik laanane shemaya veittammar ben telat turin mittechot ilen telat turin nafik salik leela nachit letatta

Hay beta itshakya minneh veganiz begaveyh kamma ginzin illain dela ityedau beda itbene hay beta veishtachlal hahu ilana itgalleya bimama veitkasseya belelya vehay beta shalta belelya veitkasseya bimama

Beshata deal chashocha veitkattir beh shalta vechal pitchin setimin mikkal sitrin keden kamma ruchin parchin baavira teivin leminda ulmeal beh vealin ben inun tzipporin venatlin sahaduta veshatyan vechaman ma dechaman
Ad deitar hahu chashocha deitkattir beh veappik chad shalhova uvatash bechal pattishin takkifin uftach pitchin uvaka tinnarin salka venachata hahu shalhova uvatash bealma veitar kalin leela vetatta
343: Karoza salik veitkattir baavira vekare hahu avira nafka miggo ammuda daanana demadbecha penimaa vechad nafka itpashshat bearba sitre alma elef alfin kayemin missitra deihu semala veribbo rivvan kayemin missitra deihu yamina vecharoza kaim bekiyyumeh kare vechayil veachriz keden kamma inun dimtakkeni shirata ufalchin pulchana utren pitchin petichu chad listar daroma vechad listar tzafon

Salka hay veta veityehivat veitkatterat ben teren sitrin veshirin mezammeran vetushbechan salkin keden al man deal bilchisha uveta mitlahata beshit nehorin naharin ziva lechal setar venaharin devusma nafkin veitshakyan kal chevat bera kema deatte amer yashku kal chayeto saday yishberu feraim tzemaam vegv vezamrin ad desalka tzafra vechad salka tzafra keden kochvaya umazzale shemaya vechelehon kullehon meshabbechan veamre shirata kema deatte amer beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kal bene elohim

Ta chaze im Adonai lo yivne vayit shave amlu vonav bo im Adonai lo yishmar ir shave shakad shomer im Adonai vegv da malka illaa deihu bone lehay beta tadir veatkin leh ematay kad salkin reutin pulchanin mittatta kedeka yeut

Im Adonai lo yishmar ir ematay beshata deitchashcha lelya vesitrin mezayenin sharan veshatan bealma ufitchin setimin veitnetir mikkal sitrin dela yikrav beh arel umsaava kema deatte amer lo yosif yavo vach od arel vetame dezammin kudsha berich hu leaavara lon mealma

Man arel uman tame ela kolla chad arel vetame da hu deitpatta beh veazil avatreh adam veinteteh vegarimu mota lechal alma veihu demasiv hay beta ad hahu zimna deyaavar leh kudsha berich hu mealma vegin kach im Adonai lo yishmar ir shave vadday

Ta chaze veyaakov nasa sukkota itnetil lekovla chulakeh dimhemnuta ma ketiv leela vayyashav bayyom hahu esav ledarko seira uchtiv veyaakov nasa sukkota ella kal chad itperash lesitra dileh esav lesitra deseir man seir da hi ishsha zara el nichar veyaakov nasa sukkota da mehemnuta illaa
Vayyiven lo vayit kema deatte amer bet yaakov amar ribbi elazar deatkin tefillat arvit kedeka yeut ulmiknihu asa sukkot shear sukkot lenatra lon veda hu chulakeh

Uchden vayyavo yaakov shalem shalem mikkolla veukmuha uchtiv vayehi veshalem sukko vegv veukmuha vecholla raza chada keden itchabber immeh mehemnuta kad hava shelim kad itatar beduchteh deitchaze leh uchden hay sukka itatterat bahadeh dehava shelim meavahan dehava shelim mibbenoy veda hu shalem shalem leela shalem letatta shalem bishmaya shalem beara shalem leela deihu kelala deavahan tiferet yisrael shalem letatta bivnoy kaddishin shelim bishmaya shelim beara uchden vayehi veshalem sukko veukmuha miyyad ma ketiv vatetze dina vat lea veukmuha chavraya
Ta chaze kamma dargin vesitrin mitparshan leela vechullehu meshanyan da min da chevan meshanyan illen meillen illen mekatregin leshalletaa al illen ulmitraf tarfin kal chad vechad lezineh
Missitra derucha mesaava kamma dargin mitparshin vechullehu kaman lekatrega illen lakovel illen deha ketiv lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav dechad ka mitchabberan mekatrege alma

Vetta chaze tiuvta dedargin mesaavin lav ihu ella lekatrega besitrin kaddishin yaakov deihu kaddisha kullehu kaman leh vekitregu bahadeh bekadmita nashcheh chiveya kema deatte amer vayyigga bechaf yuricho hashta nashcheh chamor
Tamman ihu kaim legabbe chiveya hashta shimon velevi deatu missitra
344: Dedina kashya kayemu legabbeh dechamor veshallitu aloy bechal sitrin veitkafya kammayehu kema deatte amer veet chamor veet shechem beno hargu lefi charev veshimon dehava mazzaleh shor ata al chamor vekitreg beh begin dela yitchabberun kechada veishtakkach ihu mekatrega dileh

Vechullehu ate lekatrega leh leyaakov veishteziv ulvatar ihu shallit alayehu levatar ata shor veishtalim bachamorim dechullehu missitra dechamor yosef deihu shor umitzrayim deinun chamorim dichtiv behu asher besar chamorim besaram

Veal da levatar bene yaakov naflu ben inun chamorim begin deizdavag shor bahadayehu venashchu lon garmaya uvisra ad deitar levi kemilkaddemin uvaddar leinun chamorim lechafya lon vetavar tukfehon mealma veappik leshor mittamman hada hu dichtiv vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo

Ta chaze kad ata shimon bekadmita al hahu chamor itar alehon dam deitgazzaru ulvatar vayyahargu kal zachar kegavena da avad kudsha berich hu al yeda delevi da moshe beinun chamorim bemitzrayim bekadmita dam ulvatar vayyaharog Adonai kal bechor beeretz mitzrayim vegv hacha behay chamor ketiv veet kal chelam veet kal tappam veet kal behemtam vegv hatam beinun chamorim ketiv kele chesef uchle zahav usmalot uchtiv vegam erev rav ala ittam vetzon uvakar vegv

Veshimon velevi da kaim legabbe hay chamor veda kaim legabbe kal inun chamorim kullehu bau leishtattefa bahadeh deyaakov kaddisha veittakkenu lenashcha leh veihu bivnoy kaim legabbayehu vechayyif lon techoteh
Hashta deesav nashich leh velivnoy man yakum legabbeh yaakov veosef da missitra da veda missitra da dichtiv vehaya bet yaakov esh uvet yosef lehava uvet esav lekash vegv

Vayyissau vayehi chittat elohim al hearim asher sevivotehem velo radfu achare bene yaakov amar ribbi yose kullehu hau mitkanneshe vechad hau chagre zayene kerava hau merattete veshavkin lon uvgin kach velo radfu achari bene yaakov

Hasiru et elohe hannechar vegv hasiru et elohe hannechar illen inun denatlu mishshechem mane kaspa vedahava dehava chakik alayehu taava dilhon ribbi yehuda amar taavan hau mikkaspa vedahava veyaakov atmin lon tamman begin dela yithannun missitra deavoda zara deasir leh levar nash leithanne minneh lealmin

Ribbi yehuda veribbi chizkiyya hau azle bearcha amar ribbi chizkiyya leribbi yehuda may dichtiv vayyikkach et ateret malkam meal rosho umishkalah kikkar zahav veeven yekara vattehi al rosh david vetaninan shikkutz bene ammon milkom shemeh veda hu ateret malkam may taama vattehi al rosh david umay tama ketiv shikkutz deha bishar taavan ammemaya ovde avoda zara ketiv elohe haammim elohim acherim el nechar el acher uvhay amar shikkutz chad

Amar leh uvchal taavan ammemaya ovde avoda zara hachi kara lon kudsha berich hu dichtiv vattiru et shikkutzehem veet gillulehem uma deamar vayyikkach et ateret malkam deihu milkom hachi hu vadday ella itay haggitti ad dela itgeyyar keden ihu tavar lah lehahu ateret deihu milkom hahu diukna dechakik alah ufagim lah keden ihu avad lah heter leithanne minnah vehavat al resheh vetta chaze shikkutz bene ammon chad chiveya besurta hava chakik al hahu kitra uvgin kach ikre shikkutz zuhama

Ribbi yitzchak amar hasiru et elohe hannechar illen shear nashin dehau mayete begavayehu kal nevazbezan dilhon veal da ketiv vayyittenu el yaakov et kal elohe hannichar illen nashin kal nevazbezan vechal taavan dedahava vechaspa vayyitmon otam yaakov begin dela
345: Ta chaze deyaakov gevar shelim becholla hava vehava mitdabbak beh bekudsha berich hu ma ketiv venakuma venaala bet el veeese sham mizbeach lael haone oti beom tzarati vayehi immadi badderech asher halachti miyyad vayyittenu el yaakov mikkan devae bar nash leshabbacha lekudsha berich hu ulodaa leh al nissin veal tavan deavad immeh hada hu dichtiv vayehi immadi badderech asher halachti

Ta chaze bekadmita ketiv venakuma venaale bet el vegv achlil benoy bahadeh ulvatar ketiv veeese sham mizbeach vela ketiv venaase deappik lon mikkelala da may tama begin dealeh hava milla yaakov atkin tefillat arvit vadday veihu avad madbecha vealeh hava milla uvgin deihu avar kal inun aktin min yoma dearak kammeh deachuha dichtiv vayehi immadi badderech asher halachti veinun atu levatar lealma veal da la ail lon bahadeh
Ribbi elazar amar mikkan man deyitavid leh nissa ihu bae leodaa man deachil nahama befatora ihu bae levarcha vela achora dela achil midi

Vayyiven sham mizbeach vegv ta chaze ketiv vayyiven sham mizbeach vela ketiv deassik aleh nischin vealavan ella begin deatkin hahu darga deitchaze leittakkena mizbeach layeya leatkana darga tattaa lechabbera leh bedarga illaa veal da vayyiven sham mizbeach da darga tattaa layeya da darga illaa vayyikra lammakom el bet el shema da kishma illaa begin dechad itnahara keden keimma bittah vecholla chad

Ki sham niglu elav haelohim begin deinun la ishtakkachu ella bishchinta deha shivin hau deinun mishtakkeche tadir bahade shechinta veshivin kattadrae sacharanih dishchinta veal da ki sham niglu elav haelohim beatra da deitgalleya deha ketiv vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav

Vayyaal mealav elohim bammakom asher dibber itto ribbi shimon amar mikkan deitavid reticha kaddisha bahade avahan vetta chaze yaakov ihu reticha kaddisha illaa dekayema leanhara lesihara veihu reticha bilchodoy hada hu dichtiv vayyaal mealav elohim

Patach veamar ki mi goy gadol asher lo elohim kerovim elav kayeya elohenu bechal karenu elav ta chaze kamma inun chavivin yisrael kamme kudsha berich hu delet lach am velishan bechal ammin ovde avoda zara dealma deit leh elaha deyishma lon kema dekudsha berich hu zammin lekabbela tzelothon uvauthon deyisrael bechal shata deitzterich lon lemishma tzelota deinun baan begin hahu darga dillehon

Ta chaze yaakov kare leh kudsha berich hu yisrael dichtiv lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael yihye shemecha vayyikra et shemo man vayyikra da shechinta kema deatte amer vayyikra el moshe vayyomer lo elohim
Leel okimna yisrael deha ishtellim becholla kedeka yeut uchden istallak bedargeh veishtelim bishma da veal da vayyikra et shemo yisrael veha ittemar

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose hau azle bearcha amar ribbi yose lerabbi elazar vadday ha deamarte deyaakov shelema deavahan ihu veihu achid lechal sitrin vekara shemeh yisrael uchtiv lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael yihye shemecha uchtiv vayyikra et shemo yisrael ammay ahadar kudsha berich hu vekara leh yaakov bechamma zimnin vecholla karun leh yaakov kemillekaddemin i hachi mahu velo yikkare shimcha od yaakov
Amar leh shappir ka amarte patach veamar Adonai kaggibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina hay kera ukmuha aval ta chaze kaggibbor yetze gibbor mibbae leh keish milchamot ish milchamot mibbae leh
Ella ha ittemar Adonai bechal atar rachame ihu vadday
346: Kudsha berich hu Adonai shemeh ihu dichtiv ani Adonai hu shemi vechaminan dilzimnin itkere shemeh elohim vehu dina bechal atar ella bezimna deasgiu zakkain bealma Adonai shemeh veitkere bishma derachame uvzimna deasgiu chayyavin bealma elohim shemeh veitkere bishma deelohim kach bezimna deyaakov la hava ben sanin vela hava beara achora kare leh yisrael vechad hava ben sanin o beara achora kare leh yaakov

Amar leh adayin la ityashva milla dichtiv lo yikkare veha anan karinan leh umay daamarte dechad hava ben sanin o beara achora kare leh yaakov ta chaze ketiv vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan veha la hava beara achora

Amar leh ha bekadmita ittemar kema dekudsha berich hu lezimnin itkere Adonai ulzimnin itkere elohim hachi name lezimnin ikre yisrael ulzimnin ikre yaakov vecholla bedargin yedian uma deittemar lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov leityashsheva bishma da

Amar leh i hachi ha ketiv velo yikkare od et shimcha avram vehaya shimcha avraham amar leh hatam ketiv vehaya veal da kayema behahu shema aval hacha la ketiv vehaya ella ki im yisrael yihye shemecha vela ketiv vehaya shimcha yisrael veafilu bezimna chada sagge leh kal shekken dilzimnin kach ulzimnin kach vechad itatteru benoy bechohane velevae veistalleku bedargin illain keden itattar bishma da tadir

Ad dehau azle amar leh ribbi yose leribbi elazar ha ittemar dechad mitat rachel natla beta man deitzterich leittakkena bitresar shivtin kedeka yeut ammay mitat rachel miyyad amar leh ha lemeheve shechinta mitattera kedeka yeut ulmeheve em habbanim semecha uveh sharya lenatla beta ulittakkana veal da binyamin hu tadir bemaarav vela vesitra achora
Uveh sharya leittakkena bitresar shivtin uveh sharya malchuta dirkia leishtemoda beara veraza da bechal sheruta deatya leishtemoda bekashu ihu veal da it bah dina demota umittamman ityashshevat

Hacha kad baa leittakkena ulnatla beta itavid dina berachel uvatar ken ittakkenat leityashsheva kad baa leishtemoda malchuta beara sharya bedina vela ityashshevat malchuta beduchta kedeka yeut ad deitar dina bishaul lefum ovadoy ulvatar ityashshevat malchuta veittakkenat

Ta chaze kal sheruta takkif ulvatar nayecha berosh hashshana sheruta takkif dechal alma itdan kal chad vechad lefum ovadoy ulvatar nayecha selicha vechippure begin desheruta ihu mismala veal da dinoy takkifin ulvatar itar yamina veal da have nayecha

Ulzimna deate zammin kudsha berich hu leitara benayecha al shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot ulvatar yittakkaf alayehu bedina kashya hada hu dichtiv Adonai kaggibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina yaria af yatzriach al oyevav yitgabbar Adonai bekadmita deihu rachame ulvatar kaggibbor vela gibbor ulvatar keish milchamot velo ish milchamot levatar itgeli tukfa alayehu veyittakkaf leshetzaa lon dichtiv yaria af yatzriach al oyevav yitgabbar uchtiv veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem keom hillachamo beom kerav uchtiv mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra vegv

Vayehi betzet nafshah ki meta vattikra shemo ben oni veaviv kara lo binyamin ribbi yehuda patach veamar tov Adonai lemaoz beom tzara veyodea chose vo zakkaa chulakeh devar nash deittakkaf beh bekudsha berich hu begin detukfa dekudsha berich hu ihu tukfa veukmuha tov Adonai kema deatte amer tov Adonai lakkol lemaoz da hu tukfa deit beh yeshuot dichtiv umaoz
347: Yeshuot meshicho hu beom tzara beoma deaku deakin shear ammin leyisrael

Ta chaze ma ketiv hitrappita beom tzara tzar kochecha may hitrappita man deitrappe yedoy mikudsha berich hu dela leittakkefa beh vehech yitkaf var nash beh bekudsha berich hu yatkif beorayeta dechal man deittakkaf beorayeta ittakkaf beilana dechayye kivyachol yahav tukfa lichneset yisrael leittakfa
Vei hu yitrappe meorayeta ma ketiv hitrappita i ihu itrappe min orayeta beom tzara tzar kochecha beoma deyete leh aku kivyachol dachik lah lishchinta deihu chela dealma

Davar acher tzar kochecha ta chaze beshata devar nash itrappe meorayeta veazil bearcha dela chashra kamma baale devavu zeminin leh limeheve leh kattegorin beoma deaku veafilu nishmateh devar nash deihu chela vetukfa dileh ihu mare devavu lekovleh dichtiv tzar kochecha begin deihu tzar legabbeh amar ribbi abba beshata devar nash azil bearche deorayeta vechal archoy mittakkenan kedeka yeut kamma sanegorin kayemin aleh leadkara leh letav

Patach veamar im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef lehaggid leadam yashro vayechunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer hanne kerae it leistakkala behu vechi la itgeli kolla kame kudsha berich hu deihu tzarich lemalcha deyema kammeh tav o vish
Ella vadday itzterich dechad it leh levar nash sannegorin leadkara zechu dideh kammeh vela it leh kattegorin keden vayechunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer

Ta chaze behay kera tishkach berira demilla ketiv im yesh alav malach i la ketiv yattir yaot hu aval malach melitz echad minni alef ketiv uman ihu da hu malach dimmanna immeh devar nash bistar semala dichtiv yippol mitztzidcha elef veda hu sitra dismala dichtiv batreh urvava miminecha

Aval echad minni elef da hu yetzer hara deihu echad meinnun elef dehau listar semala begin deihu salik leela venatil reshu veal da i var nash azil beorach keshot hahu yetzer hara ihu eved lo kema deittemar dichtiv tov nikle veeved lo keden ihu salik veitavid sannegora veamar kamme kudsha berich hu zechu aleh devar nash keden kudsha berich hu amar pedaehu meredet shachat
Veim kal da la ahadar berekanya begin deityehiv leh achora leshaltaa aloy velitol nishmateh minneh begin deakdim chovoy dehahu bar nash veihu kofer al hay hada hu dichtiv matzati kofer lemifde leh

Davar acher matzati chofer hahu zechu deamarte ihu aleh kofer lemifde leh dela yechot laggehinnom vela yemut veal da mibbae leh levar nash lemehach beorach keshot uvgin diyehe leh hahu kattegora sannegora

Kegavena da yisrael beoma dechippure deyahave leh sair veitassiku bahadeh ad deithadar eved lehu vesalik vesahid sahaduta kamme kudsha berich hu veitavid lehu sannegora veal da amar shelomo im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem veim tzame hashkehu mayim veal hay yetzer hara ittemar

Uvgin da beom tzara kad var nash itrappe meorayeta kivyachol dachik leh kudsha berich hu bahadeh dehahu yetzer hara deihu itavid kattegora tzar kochecha tzar koach ko begin deitkarev kammeh lekatrega veitchallash chela

Ta chaze tov Adonai lemaoz beom tzara may beom tzara da yaakov kad ata aleh esav lekatrega leh veodea chose vo kad ata aleh aku dedina vetta chaze let mekatrega ishtakkach aleh devar nash ella bezimna desakkana
Vetta chaze begin deyaakov achar nidreh denadir kamme kudsha berich hu ittakkaf dina al yeda dimkatrega dekatrig aleh deyaakov
348: Uvaa dina beshata desakkana dehavat rachel bah amar kammeh kudsha berich hu veha yaakov nadar nidreh vela shalim veha ihu takkif mikkolla beutra uvivnin bechal ma deitzterich vela shalim nidreh denadar kammach vela nasavte onasha minneh miyyad vatteled rachel vattekash belidtah may vattekash deitkashshe dina leela gabbe malach hammavet
Veitannash yaakov behay may tama begin dichtiv veim en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha veal da mitat rachel veitmasar dina al yeda demalach hammavet

Vetta chaze beshata deata esav ma avad vayyasem et hashshefachot veet yaldehen rishona veet lea viladeha acharonim veet rachel veet yosef acharonim may tama begin dedachil ala derachel dela yistakkal hahu rasha beshappiru dilah vela yekatreg leh alah

Tu ma ketiv vattiggashna hashfachot henna veyaldehen vattishtachavena vattiggash gam lea viladeha vayyishtachau nashin mikkamme guvrin aval berachel ma ketiv veachar niggash yosef verachel veosef mikkame immeh veihu chappa alah veal da ketiv ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin deasge gufeh vechappa al immeh ale ayin ale ena dehahu rasha

Vehacha itanashat al yeda deyetzer hara dekitreg beshata desakkana veitannash yaakov al nidra dela shalim veda kashya leh leyaakov mikkal aku daavru aleh umnalan divgineh deyaakov hava dichtiv meta alay rachel alay vadday al deacharit nidri
Ribbi yose amar ketiv killelat chinnam lo tavo veukmuha lo beyv dei killelat tzaddika hi afilu dela itkavan bah kevan denafka mippumeh natal lah hahu yetzer hara vekitreg bah beshata desakkana

Yaakov amar im asher timtza et elohecha lo yichye veaf al gav deihu la hava yada natil lah lehahi milla hahu satan deishtakkach gabbayehu tadir bivni nasha veal da taninan leolam lo yiftach bar nash pumeh lesitna begin denatil hahi milla vekitreg bah leela vetatta kal shekken milla dechacham o milla detzaddika veal teren illen itanashat rachel

Vayehi betzet nafshah ki meta amar ribbi abba vechi kevan deamar vayehi betzet nafshah la yedana ki meta ela itzterich begin dela ahadarat legufa yattir umitat rachel mitat gufa begin deit beni nasha denafke nishmatayehu veahadran leatrayehu ukkema deatte amer vattashav nafsho elav vayyetze libbam nafshi yatza bedabbero lo notra bo neshama aval hay nafkat nishmatah vela ithaddarat leatrah umitat rachel

Vattikra shemo ben oni dekashu dedina deitgezar alah veyaakov ahadar leh vekashir leh lemina begin demaarav itzterich lekashra leh limina veaf al gav deihu ben oni sitra dedina kashya ben yamin ihu deha bimina itkashsherat
Veitkevarat bearcha kema deittemar hay itgalleya mitatah ukvuratah aval lea la itgalleya mitatah ukvuratah veaf al gav dehanne arba immahan raza it lon veha ukmuha
Vayyatztzev yaakov matztzeva al kevuratah amar ribbi yose may tama begin dela itkasya atrah ad yoma dezammin kudsha berich hu laachaya metaya kema deittemar ad hayyom ad hahu yoma mammash

Ribbi yehuda amar ad yoma detehdar shechinta begaluthon deyisrael behahu atar kema deatte amer veyesh tik leacharitech neum Adonai veshavu vanim ligvulam veda omaa deome lah kudsha berich hu uzminin yisrael kad yetuvun min galuta lekayema al hahi kevura derachel ulmivke tamman kema deihi bachat al galuthon deyisrael veal da ketiv bivchi yavou uvtachanunim ovilem vegv uchtiv ki yesh sachar lifulatech uvhahi
349: Shata zeminat rachel deihi vearcha lemechede behu beyisrael veim shechinta veukmuha chavrayya

Vayehi bishkon yisrael baaretz hahi vayyelech reuven vayyishkav et bilha pillegesh aviv vayyishma yisrael vayyihu bene yaakov shenem asar ribbi elazar amar vayehi bishkon yisrael baaretz hahi deha lea verachel mitu venatla beta man denatil

Vechi salka datach diruven azil veshachiv bahadah devilha ella kal yoma delea verachel shechinta sharya alayehu vehashta demitu shechinta la itperashat min beta vesharya beveta bemishkena devilha veaf al gav dishchinta baya lenatla beta kedeka yaot ilmale yaakov la ishtakkach beziuuga dechar venukva la sharya shechinta beitgalleya beveta veal da kayema shechinta bemashkena devilha veata reuven uvgin dechama devilha yarta atra deimmeh azal uvilbel arsa veal dekayema shechinta alah ketiv beh vayyishkav et bilha

Rabbi yesa amar denaim al hahu arsa vela chayyish likara dishchinta uvgin kach la itpegim mechushbana deshivtin veata kera veavid chushbena begin kach ketiv bechor yaakov reuven veihu avid kera resha dechal shivtin

Rabbi yehuda patach veamar ki yesharim darche Adonai vegv kal archoy dekudsha berich hu kullehu yesharim vearchoy keshot uvni alma la yadin vela mashgichin al ma inun kayemin veal da vetzaddikim yelchu vam begin deinun yadin archoy dekudsha berich hu umishtaddele beorayeta dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta ihu yada veazil behu dela sate limina velismala

Ufoshim yikkashlu vam illen inun chayyavin dela mishtaddele beorayeta vela mistakkelan bearchoy dekudsha berich hu vela yadin lean orche azlin uvgin dela yade leistakkela velo mishtaddele beorayeta inun kashle behu beinun archoy behay alma uvalma deate

Ta chaze kal bar nash deishtaddal beorayeta kad nafik mehay alma nishmateh salka beinun archin ushvilin deorayeta veinun archin ushvilin deorayeta yedian inun veinun deyade archoy deorayeta behay alma yahachun behu behahu alma kad yifkun mehay alma

Vei la ishtaddalu beorayeta behay alma vela yadin archin ushvilin kad yifkun mehay alma la yindeun lemehach beinun archin ushvilin vechashlin behon keden yehach bearchin achoranin delav inun archin deorayeta veyitarun leh bechamma dinin veitannash behu

Uman deishtaddal beorayeta ma ketiv beshachbecha tishmor alecha vahakitzota hi tesichecha beshachbecha bekivra orayeta titztzor alecha middina dehahu alma vehekitzota kad kudsha berich hu yitar ruchin venishmatin leachayya metaya keden hi tesichecha hi tehe sannegorya al gufa begin dikumun inun gufin deishtaddelu veorayeta kiddeka yaot veillen inun dikumun bekadmita lechayye alma kema deatte amer verabbim misheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam vegv veillen inun lechayye olam begin deitasseku bechayye olam deihi orayeta

Vetta chaze kal inun deishtaddelu beorayeta hahu gufa yitkayyam veorayeta tagin aleh may tama begin divhahi shata yitar kudsha berich hu chad rucha dechalil mearba ruchin vehahu rucha dechalil mearba ruchin izdamman lechal inun deishtaddelu beorayeta laachaya lon behay rucha begin deyitkayam lealmin

Vei tema ha ketiv mearba ruchot boi haruach ammay la itkayemu deha kullehu mitu kemillekadmin ta chaze hahu zimna deokim kudsha berich hu al yeda dichezkel inun metaya hahu rucha af al gav dehava mearba ruchayya la nachit lekayema lon bekiyyuma ella leachazaa dezammin kudsha berich hu laachaya metaya behahu gavena ulkayema lon berucha
350: Deitkelil behay gavena veaf al gav deahadaru garmin behahi shata kema dehava kudsha berich hu baa leachazaa lechal alma deihu zammin laachaya metaya begin dekudsha berich hu zammin lekayema lehu kiyyuma shelim bealma kedeka yeut veinun deishtaddelu beorayeta behay alma hi kayema aleh devar nash veitavidat sannigorya kamme dekudsha berich hu
