Ribbi shimon amar kal inun millin deorayeta vechal hahi orayeta deishtaddal bah bar nash behay alma inun millin vehahi orayeta kayema kamme kudsha berich hu vaamarat kameh vehi arimat kalin vela ishtakkachat ulhahu zimna ihi tasiach vetema kefum deitdabbak bar nash veishteddal behay alma veal da inun yekumun bekiyyuma shelim lechayye alma kedekaamaran uvgin kach ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam

Rabbi chiyya patach veamar veeli zaken meod veshama et kal asher yaasun banav lechal yisrael veet asher yishkevun et hannashim hatztzovot petach ohel moed vechi salka datach dechohane Adonai deyaavdun avidta da veha mikkadmat dena ittemar ufrishat orayeta hahu chova dilhon dichtiv ki niatzu haanashim et minchat Adonai uchtiv umishpat hakkohanim meet haam kal ish zoveach zevach vegv uchtiv gam beterem yaktirun et hachelev uva naar hakkohen veamar laish hazzoveach tena litzlot lakkohen vegv uchtiv veamar lo ki atta titten veim lo lakachti bechazka veal da vattehi chattat hannearim gedola meod vegv vechal da la hau natlin ella meinun chulakin dehau lehu lechahane lemechal minneh veal dehava kalil karbana beenayehu itanashu vehacha amar et asher yishkevun et hannashim hatztzovot

Chas veshalom dehau avdu avera da kal shekken beatra kaddisha hahu dela yekumun kal yisrael veyiktelun lehon ella begin dehau meakkeve lon leaola lemakdesha umachan bidehon dela leaola lemitzle tzelota ad dekurbanaya itavidu begin deinun la mayetin karbanin lemetal chulaka minnayehu uvgin kach meakkevin lon uvgin kach inun nashim hau baan minnayehu leaola tamman veal da ketiv et asher yishkevun et hannashim dimakkeve lon kidkaamaran

Kegavena da vayyishkav et bilha chas veshalom deihu shachav immah ella begin deakkav lah leshammasha baavoy shimmusha demitzva veda hu bilbula dearsa veavad lakovel shechinta avidta da debbechal atar deshimmusha demitzva ishtakkach shechinta sharya al hahu atar veishtakkach tamman uman degarim leakkava shimmusha demitzva garim deyistallak shechinta mealma veal da ketiv ki alita mishkeve avicha az chillalta yetzui ala uvgin da ketiv vayyishkav et bilha pilegesh aviv vayyishma yisrael vayyihu beni yaakov shenem asar kullehu hau beminyana vela gara mizzechuta dilhon kelum

Ribbi elazar amar may taama bekadmita yisrael ulvatar yaakov dichtiv vayyishma yisrael vayyihu bene yaakov shenem asar ella kad ata reuven uvilbel hahu arsa amar uma teresar shivtin hau leh leabba lekayema bealma vela yattir vehashta bae leolada benin dilma anan pegimin deihu bae leolada achoranin kemillekadmin miyyad bilbel hahu arsa veitakkav hahu shimmusha keilu avad kelana legabbe shechinta desharya al hahu arsa veal da ketiv vayyishma yisrael deha bishma da istallak go teresar deitkasyan deinun teresar nahari afarsemona dachya
Vayyihu beni yaakov shenem asar illen teresar shivtin dishchinta ittakkanat behu uman inun illen deorayeta ahadarat veavid lon chushbena
351: Kemillekaddemin kullehu kaddishin kullehu itchazyan legabbe shechinta leistakkala bikdusha demarehon deilu avad hahu ovada la yete reuven beminyana

Veim kal da itanash deitnetil bechorateh minneh veityehiv leosef kema deatte amer uvne reuven bechor yisrael ki hu habbechor uvchallelo yetzue aviv nittena bechorato leosef ta chaze lehve shemeh di elaha mevarach min alma vead alma di kal mabedohi keshot vearchateh din vechal ma deihu avid kolla ihu bechachmeta illaa

Ta chaze kamma garim ovada devar nash deha kal may deihu avid kolla itreshim vekayema kamme dekudsha berich hu deha yaakov beshata deal legabbah delea kal hahu lelya reuteh velibbeh hava berachel dechashiv derachel ihi umehahu shimmusha vetippa kadmaa umehahu reuta itavarat lea veukmuha deha ilmale deyaakov la yada la yistallik reuven bechushbana veal da la istallak bishma yedia ella shemeh setam reuven

Veim kal da ahadar ovada leatreh kema dehahu reuta kadmaa itavidat berachel hahu reuta ithaddarat bah deha bechorateh ahadarat leosef buchra derachel atar diruta havat berachel vecholla salik beatreh begin dechal ovadoy dekudsha berich hu kullehu keshot uzchu

Ribbi chizkiyya ashkecheh yoma chad lerabbi yose dehava mistemit safsina go kitre denura vehava salik kittora ditnana leela amar leh illu kittura ditnana dekarbana dehava salik al gabbe madbecha hava salik tadir ki hay gavena la sharya rugza bealma veyisrael la itgeli meal ara

Patach rabbi yose veamar mi zot ola min hammidbar ketimrot ashan mekutteret mor ulvona mikkol avkat rochel mi zot ola ta chaze bezimna dehau yisrael azle bemadbera shechinta azla kammayehu veinhu hau azle avatrah dichtiv vayeya holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan lanchotam hadderech velayela beammud esh lehair lahem vegv uvgin kach ketiv ko amar Adonai zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich lechtech acharay bammidbar vegv

Ushchinta havat azla vechullehu anane yekar bahadah vechad hava shechinta natla hau natlin kema dichtiv uvhealot heanan meal haohel veachare chen yisseu beni yisrael vegv vechad ihi salka hahu anana salka ad leela vechal bene alma chaman veshaale veamre mi zot ola min hammidbar ketimrot ashan
Hahu anana dishchinta itchazya ashan may taama ihi ashan begin denura deadlik avraham veyitzchak bereh hava achid bah vela aade minah vechad itachdat hahu nura begavah hava salik anana
Veim kal da mekutteret mor ulvona may mekutteret mitkatra bitren sitrin achoranin anana deavraham limina anana deyitzchak lismala mikkol avkat rochel da yaakov

Davar acher da yosef hatztzaddik begin daarona deosef hava azil legabbeh ammay rochel begin dehava rachil laachoy legabbeh deavoy davar acher ammay rochel ella ma chenvani da ketire dekustere veavke defulme kullehu bideh hachi name yosef ihu kiyyuma deorayeta begin deihu kiyyem lah begin dechal pikkude orayeta mitkashsheran bintiru divrit kaddisha

Veal da shechinta mitkattera beavraham yitzchak veyaakov veosef kechada inun vediukna chada lehu hada hu dichtiv elle toldot yaakov yosef uvgin kach mikkol avkat rochel begin demeatar denahara denagid venafik ishtakya kolla unhiru kal anpin

Vetta chaze kad hau yisrael beara vehau makrivin karbanin kullehu hau mitkarvin legabbe kudsha berich hu kedeka yaot vechad karbana itavid utnana salik beorach meshar keden hau yade ditnana demadbecha adlik
352: Botzina deitchazzeya leadlaka vechal anpin nehirin uvotzinin dalkin

Umiyyoma deitchariv be makdesha let lach yoma veoma delet beh zeimu verugza kema deatte amer veel zoem bechal yom veitparash chedva meela umittatta veyisrael azlin begaluta veinun birshu detaavan achoranin uchden itkeyyam kera dichtiv veavadta sham elohim acherim
Vechal da lamma begin dichtiv tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvtuv levav merov kol may merov kol hacha merov kol vehatam bechoser kol

Ad deyitar kudsha berich hu veyifrok lon mibbeni ammaya kema deatte amer veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutcha verichamcha veshav vekibbetzcha mikkal haammim asher hefitzcha Adonai elohecha shamma uchtiv im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim mishsham yekabbetzcha vegv

Veelle toldot esav hu edom ta chaze bechayye yitzchak la itmannun benoy deesav kema deitmannun benoy deyaakov deha ad la mit yitzchak itmannun aval beesav ma ketiv vayyigva yitzchak vayyamat vayyeasef el ammav zaken usva yamim vayyikberu oto esav veyaakov banav batreh ma ketiv veelle toldot esav hu edom may tama begin deha bechulakeh uvachsanteh veadveh lav ihu ella yaakov uvnoy uvgin kach yaakov uvnoy inun chulakeh dekudsha berich hu vealin bechushbena aval esav delav ihu bechulaka devistar dimhemnuta avid chushbeneh levatar demit yitzchak veitperash chulakeh leatar achora

Ta chaze levatar demit yitzchak veesav itparash lesitreh ma ketiv vayikkach esav et nashav vegv mippene yaakov achiv deshavak leh leyaakov keren verevach shibuda demitzrayim veara vezabbin leh chulakeh min mearta dechafelta veazal leh min ara umin mehemnuta umechulakeh deazal leh mikkolla

Ta chaze kamma hava chulakeh deyaakov tava becholla begin dela ishtaar esav bahadeh veitperash minneh veazal leh lechulakeh uladveh veishtaar yaakov achid beachsanat avoy uvachsanat avhatoy veal da vayyelech el eretz mippene yaakov achiv may mippene yaakov achiv dela baa chulakeh veachsanteh veadva dimhemnuta dileh zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov aleh ketiv ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato

Veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom lifne melach melech livne yisrael rabbi yesa patach veamar hinne katan netatticha baggoyim bazuy atta meod ta chaze kad avad kudsha berich hu alma ufalag ara leshiva techume peligin lakovel shivin ravrevin memannan vekudsha berich hu palig lon leshivin amin kal chad vechad kedeka chaze leh kema deatte amer behanchel elon goyim behafrido bene adam yatzev gevulot amim

Umikkullehu ravrevan memannan deitmasru lishar amin la it behu bazuy kammeh kimmanna deesav may taama begin desitra deesav sitra mesaava ihu vesitra dimsaava ihu kelana kammeh kudsha berich hu meinun dargin zeirin devatar rechaya serikta dekostere sumke ka atya veal da hinne katan netatticha baggoyim bazuy atta meod dichtiv al gechoncha telech veafar tochal kal yeme chayyecha meod kema deatte amer arur atta mikkal habbehema umikkal chayyat hassade

Ta chaze bedargin tattain it dargin al dargin kullehu meshanyan da min da vechullehu dargin kaftirin illen ukshirin illen beillen umalchu itparash da min da umalchu itkashshar bemalchu da ayyil veda salik achidan bekishra chada
Hahu kishra mishchata chada leh utlat kishrin lehahi mishchata bechal kishra vekishra chad ittera uvchal ittera veittera chad kafsora

353: Kochava vechad mazzala vechal kochvaya zeminin inun beinun dargin dilela veal da kal darga vedarga itattar beatrin yedian kedeka chaze

Telat dargin hacha bekadmita yaakov ulvatar yisrael ulvatar yeshurun ta chaze yaakov ha ukmuha yisrael uf hachi name veaf al gav dedargin inun chad

Yeshurun ammay ikrun yisrael bishma da ella yisrael vishurun kolla chad yeshurun kema deatte amer yashor al anashim begin denatil shura lehay sitra ulhay sitra uvgin inun teren shurin ikre yeshurun veda hu yisrael
Yisrael al denatil revu vetukfa mikkolla yisrael al inun chulake teren sitrin terin shurin kedeka amaran vecholla chad

Veinun shemahan kullehu salke lechad yaakov avdi zimnin deihu eved keavda deit leh pikkuda demareh ulmebad reuteh vechen yisrael bacharti vo leashraa aleh vecholla beraza illaa ihu ketiv boraacha yaakov veyotzercha yisrael uchtiv ko amar Adonai osecha kal illen dargin salkin lechad veha ittemar bore yotzer ose vechullehu dargin illen al illen vechullehu chad

354: Bechamma ovadin levish veittakkafu bechelhon leavasha

Veha ittemar ki kachomer beyad hayyotzer ken attem beyadi bet yisrael may kachomer ela da hu chomer dehahu zechuchit deaf al gav deittavar ittakkan veit leh takkana kemillekaddemin

Besod yesharim illen inun yisrael dechal dargin behu mitatteran kahane velevae tzaddike vachaside yesharim veeda kema deatte amer nitztzav baadat el veinun raza dekudsha berich hu itattar behu

Vechad deha chaminan kamma rechimin hau tzaddikaya kame kudsha berich hu vela ittavru bemarin vela bemachovin vela itchallash gufa dilhon lealmin ammay lav illen keillen deillen ittavru veillen kayeme begufayehu kedeka yeut

Veim tomar deha illen dekayemu bekiyyuma kedeka yeut begin deinun tzaddike bene tzaddike inhu kema deukmuha veillen achoranin tzaddike velav beni tzaddike ha ka chamenan tzaddike bene tzaddike deha avoy deden zakkaa bar zakkaa veihu zakkaa ammay ittavar gufeh bemachovin vechal yomoy betzaara

Ella hacha raza ihu deha kal ovadoy dekudsha berich hu bikshot uzchu ki foal adam yeshallem lo uchorach ish yamtziennu ashkachna besifre kadmae raza chada ulgabbeh raza achora chad deihu teren deha it zimnin desihara ihi bifgimu vesharya bedina veshimsha la ishtakkach gabba uvchal zimna uvchal shata it lah leafaka nishmatin bivne nasha kema delakta bekadmita vaafikat lon hashta bezimna deihi kayema bedina hay man denakit lah behahu zimna leheve tadir bigriuta umiskenuta azla legabbeh veittavar tadir bedina kal yomoy devar nash ben chayyava ben zakkaa bar ditzlota batil kal gizre dinin veyachil lesalka bitzlota

Vehahu zimna dekayema hahu darga bishlimu vehahu nahar denagid venafik ishtammash bah keden hahu nishmata denafkat veitdabbekat beh behahu var nash hahu bar nash ishtallim becholla beutra bivnin bishlimu degufa
360: Hahu mazzala denagid venafik veitchabbar behahu darga leishtallema beh ulitbarcha minneh veal da kolla bemazzala talya milleta veal da taninan bani chayye umzone lav bizchuta talya milleta ella bemazzala talya milleta deha bizchuta lav ihu ella ad deitmalleya veitnehir min mazzala
Uvgin kach kal inun deittavru behay alma veinun zakkay keshot kullehu ittavru behay alma veitdanu bedina may tama begin dehahi nafsha garma lehu veal da chayis alayehu kudsha berich hu lealma deate

Ribbi elazar amar kal ma deavid kudsha berich hu bedina ihu begin leddakkaa lehahi nafsha leayetaa lah lealma deate inun bedina ukshot uvgin leaavara minneh hahu zuhama dekabbilat behay alma veal da ittavar hahu gufa veitdechiat nafsha uvgin kach kudsha berich hu avid lehahu zakkaa deyisbol yissurin umachovin behay alma veyitneke mikkolla veyizke lechayye alma veal da ketiv Adonai tzaddik yivchan vadday veha ittemar

Ribbi shimon patach ach el happarochet lo yavo veel hammizbeach lo yiggash ki mum bo velo yechallel et mikdashay ki ani Adonai mekaddesho ach el happarochet lo yavo ta chaze behahi shata dehahu nahar denagid venafik appik kal inun nishmatin veitavarat nukva kullehu kayemin lego bekurta dilgo besito kurta

Vechad sihara itpegim behahu sitra dechiveya visha keden kal inun nishmatin denafkin af al gav dechullehu dachyan vechullehu kaddishin hoil venaflu bifgimu bechal inun atre dematu inun nishmatin kullehu ittavru veitpegimu bechamma tzaarin bechamma keevin veilen inun deitree behu kudsha berich hu levatar deittavru veaf al gav denishmatin baatzivu vela bechedvan

Raza demilla sharyan kegavena dilela gufa itpegim venishmata lego kegavena dilela vadday kegavena deda uvgin kach illen inun devayan lechadtute bechadtuta desihara veal illen ketiv vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbatto yavo chal basar lehishtachaot lefanay amar Adonai kal basar vadday deillen yitchadtun becholla uvayan lechadtute bechadtuta desihara

Veillen inun beshuttafuta chada besihara pegimin behahu pegimu dilah uvgin kach ihi sharya begavayehu tadir dela shavka lon kema deatte amer veet dakka ushfal ruach uchtiv karov Adonai lenishbere lev leinun desavle im sihara hahu pegimu inun kerevin lah tadir veal da lehachaot lev nidkaim beinun chayyim deatyan lah leitchadta yehe lon chulkehon inun desavle immah yitchadtun immah

Veillen ikrun yissurin shel ahava shel ahava inun vela minneh dehahu var nash shel ahava inun deitpaggim nehora shel ahava zuta deitdachya meahava rabba begin kach illen inun chaverim meshuttafim bahadah zakkaa chulakhon bealma den uvalma deate deinun zachu lehay lemehve chaverim bahadah alayehu ketiv lemaan achay vereay vegv

Patach veamar hinne yaskil avdi yarum venissa vegavah meod zakkaa chulakhon detzaddikaya dekudsha berich hu gale lon arche deorayeta lemehach behu ta chaze hay kera raza illaa ihu hinne yaskil avdi veukmuha aval ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma avad lah lesihara veazar lah nehoraha deha let lah migarmah kelum uvgin deazirat garmah itnahara begin shimsha uvtukfa dinhorin illain
Uvzimna dehava be makdesha kayyam yisrael hau mishtaddelin bekurbanin veillavan ufulchanin dehau avdin kahani velevae veyisreele begin lekashra kishrin ulanhara nehorin
Ulvatar deitcharav be makdesha itchashshach nehora vesihara la itnehirat min shimsha veshimsha
361: Istallak minnah vela itnehara velet lach yoma dela shalta beh levatin vetzaarin uchevin kema deittemar

Uvhahu zimna demete zimna desihara leitnahara ma ketiv hinni yaskil avdi aleh desihara ittemar hinne yaskil avdi da hu raza dimhemnuta hinne yaskil deitar itaruta leela keman dearach recha veate leitara ulistakkala yarum missitra dinhora illaa dechal nehorin
Yarum kema deatte amer velachen yarum lerachemchem venissa missitra deavraham vegavah missitra deyitzchak meod missitra deyaakov veaf al gav deukmuha vecholla chad beraza dechachmeta

Uvhahu zimna yitar kudsha berich hu itaruta illaa leanhara lah lesihara kedeka yeut kema deatte amer vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim uvgin kach yittosaf bah ruach illaa uvgin kach yitarun keden kal inun metaya deinun go afra
Veda hu avdi raza demaftechan demareh bideh kema deatte amer vayyomer avraham el avdo da sihara kema deittemar deihu eved shelicha demareh
Zekan beto kema deatte amer naar hayiti gam zakanti hammoshel bechal asher lo begin dechal gevanin itchazun beh yarok vechivar vesumak

Sim na yadcha tachat yerechi da hu tzaddik raza demilla kiyyuma dealma deha keden hay eved memanna beraza illaa laachaya lon ledayere afra veyitavid shelicha berucha dilela veleatava ruchin venishmatin leatrayehu leinun gufe deitbalu veitrekavu techot afra

Veashbiacha bayeya elohe hashshamayim veashbiacha may veashbiacha leitlabbesha beraza dishva nehorin illain deinun raza dishlimu illaa asher lo tikkach ishsha da hu gufa ditchot afra deit leh kiyyuma laakama meafra dechal inun deitkevaru vah vezachu leitkevara beara deyisrael inun yitarun bekadmita kema deokimna dichtiv yichu metecha bekadmita illen metin deara deyisrael nevelati yekumun inun metin dishar aran veal da leinun gufehon deyisrael deitkevaru tamman vela legufe dishar amin ovde avoda zara deistaava ara minayehu

Veal da asher lo tikkach ishsha livni may livni dechal nishmatin dealma denafke mehahu nahar denagid venafik inun benin lekudsha berich hu veal da asher lo tikkach ishsha da gufa livni da nishmata mibbenot hakkenaani illen gufin deammin ovde avoda zara dezammin kudsha berich hu lenaara lon meara kaddisha kema deatte amer veyinnaaru reshaim mimmennah keman dimnaer tallita mizzuhama dilah

Ki el artzi veel moladti telech artzi da hi ara kaddisha deihu kadmaa lechal shear arin kema deittemar veal da ki el artzi veel moladti kevan deamar el artzi mahu veel moladti ella el artzi kema deittemar veel moladti illen inun yisrael

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyikkach haeved kema deittemar asara gemallim illen inun asara dargin dehay eved shalta alayehu kegavena dilela miggemalle adonav deinun kehahu gavena mammash kema deittemar vehay eved shalta veittakkan behu
Vechal tuv adonav beyado kal hahu tivu rechin illain denafke miggo inun nehorin uvotzinin illain vechal tuv adonav hahu shimmusha deshimsha deitmashshecha bah besihara

Vayyakam vayyelech el aram naharayim da atar deara kaddisha devachat tamman rachel kad chariv be makdesha vayyavrech haggemallim michutz lair el beer hammayim leittakfa chelaha betukfaha kedeka yeut ad la tiul laakama lon leinun gofin
Leet erev may leet erev da erev shabbat
362: Deihu zimna deelef shetitaa leet erev kema deatte amer velaavodato ade arev uchtiv ki yinnatu tzillele arev

Leet tzet hashshoavot dehahu zimna zeminin lemekam velaachaya bekadmita mikkal shear bene alma inun deshaave memoy deorayeta begin deitasseku leshaava mimmeme deorayeta veittakkafu beilana dechayye veinun yifkun bekadmita deilana dechayye garma lon dikumun bekadmita kema deittemar

Uvnot anshe hair yotzot may yotzot kema deatte amer veeretz refaim tappil dezammina ara lemiflat minnah kal ruchin deinun begavah veal da ketiv yotzot lishov mayim lenatla nishmata ulkabbela lah kedeka yeut metakna meatrah kedeka chaze

Vehaya hannaara asher omar eleha hatti na chaddech veeshte begin deha ittemar dechal inun nishmatin dealma deitkayemu behay alma veishtaddelu leminda lemarehon beraza dechachmeta illaa ihi salkat veitkayemat bedarga illaa al kal inun dela itdabbeku vela yadu veinun itkayemun bekadmita veda hu sheelta dekaim hahu eved leminda ulmishal bemma itassekat hahi nishmata behay alma

Veamra elay gam atta shete ante bae lemishte ulitshakya bekadmita uvatrach vegam ligmallecha ashke begin dechal inun shear retichin af al gav deitshakyan mehay darga kullehu itshakyan mippulchana detzaddikaya deyade pulchana demarehon kedeka yeut detzaddikaya yade lesappeka lechal darga vedarga kedeka yeut veal da vegam ligmallecha ashke vadday hi haishsha asher hochiach Adonai leven adoni vadday hahi ihu gufa deizdamman lehahi nishmata illaa

Ta chaze deha ittemar detiuvta didchura legabbe nukva avid nishmata vetiuvta denukva legabbe dechura salka veitarav bahadah dilela veitkelil da beda veavid nishmata uvgin kach hi haishsha da hu gufa vadday deihu zemina lehahu reuta denishmata denafka min dechura

Veinun gufin zeminin leatara bekadmita kidamaran ulvatar deillen yekumun yekumun kal achoranin devishar aran veyitkayemun bekiyyuma shelim veyitchadtun bechadtuta desihara veyitchaddesh alma kemilkaddemin uchden ketiv behahu zimna yismach Adonai bemaasav
Uvgin kach hinne yaskil avdi leahadara nishmatin kal chad vechad leatreh yarum venissa vegavah meod missitra dechal inun dargin illain kidkaamaran

Kaasher shammu alecha rabbim ken mishchat meish marehu vetoaro mibbene adam ta chaze deha ittemar dechad itcharav be makdesha ushchinta bego aran nuchrain benayehu ma ketiv hen erelam tzaaku chutza malache shalom mar yivkaun kullehu bachu al da ukshiru bechiya veevla vechal da ala dishchinta deitgalleya meatrah vechamma deihi mishtannet mikkema dehavat uf hachi baalah la nahir nehoreh veishtanne mikkema dehava dichtiv chashach hashshemesh betzeto veal da ketiv ken mishchat meish marehu

Davar acher ken mishchat meish marehu mehay eved deishtanni diukneh ugvaneh mikkema dehava davar acher ken mishchat meish marehu kema deatte amer albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam deha miyyoma deitcharav be makdesha la kayemu shamayim binhora dilhon veraza demilla birchan la sharyan ella beatar deishtakkachu dechar venukva veukmuha kema deatte amer zachar unkeva beraam vayevarech otam uvgin kach mishchat meish marehu
Veda hu kema dichtiv hatztzaddik avad avud o neevad lo neemar ella avad dela sharyan birchan ella beatar deishtakkachu dechar venukva kechada kema deittemar
Begin da behahu zimna dela ishtakkach
363: Dechura bahadah uchden kal inun nishmatin denafke kullehu have lehu shinnuya mikkema dehau bezimna deshimsha itchabbar besihara kema deittemar veal da elle toldot yaakov yosef vegv veittemar
Vehu naar begin dela mitparshin lealmin tzaddik vetzedek kechada inun kema deihi itkeriat bishma didchura hachi name itkere ihu bishma dilah dichtiv vehu naar
Et bene bilha veet beni zilpa bechullehu kayema lechadta lon kedeka yeut ulishtashea lon bechedva dileh dechullehu anfin vechullehu alin kullehu itbarchin bechedva dileh

Elle toldot yaakov yosef kema deittemar dechal diukna deyaakov hava beh beosef vechal ma deera lehay era lehay vetarvayehu kechada azle veda hu raza deat deazle tarvayehu kechada begin deinun raza chada vediukna chada

Vayyave yosef et dibbatam raa ha ukmuha dehava amar leavoy alayehu dehau achle shayefa mibbaale chayyin kad inun chayyin vayyave yosef et dibbatam raa vechi ha beminyana hau inun bene shefachot hech hau mezalzelin behon bene lea vehech hau achlin evar min hachay vehau avrin al pikkuda demarehon deha pakkid al bene noach pikkuda da kema deatte amer ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu veinun hau achle leh veavrin al pikkuda demarehon ella yosef hava kaamar veal da itannash
Ribbi yehuda amar et dibbatam raa kema deukmuha deyahave enayehu bivnot ara veda hu dibbatam raa leyanka lechal inun dargin dela kaddishin deatyan missitra mesaava

Veyisrael ahav et yosef mikkal banav ki ven zekunim hu lo veasa lo ketonet passim ribbi elazar patach veamar lech ammi bo vachadarecha usgor delatcha baadecha chavi chimat rega ad yaavar zaam lech ammi bo vachadarecha ta chaze kamma kudsha berich hu rachim lon leyisrael uvgin rechimuta dilhon derachim lon al kal ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot azhar lon uvae lenatra lon bechal ma deinun avdin
Ta chaze telat zimnin it beoma dedina sharya bealma vechad ate hahu zimna mibbae leh levar nash leizdahara ulistamra dela yifga beh hahu dina veinun zimnin yedian veha ukmuha

Begin deha kad salik tzafra avraham itar bealma veachid leh ledina lekashra leh bahadeh uvsheruta ditlat shae kammayeta natil dina meatrih leatara beh beyaakov ad deitar tzelota demincha deahadar dina leatreh veitar dina diltatta leitkashshera bedina dilela deha keden itkashshar dina bedina uvae leizdahara

Tu kad dina itar bealma umota ishtakkach bemata la libae leh levar nash lemehach yechiday beshuka veha okimna mille ella bae leasgara garmeh dela yippuk levar kema deukmuha benoach deasgar garmeh betevuta dela yishtakkach kame mechabbela
Veal da lech ammi bo vachadarecha asgar garmach usgor delatcha baadecha dela yitchaze kammeh dimchabbela chavi kimat rega ad yaavor zaam devatar deaavar dina let leh reshu limchabbela lechabbala
Ta chaze dekudsha berich hu begin rechimuta deihu rachim lon leyisrael vekariv lon legabbeh kal shear ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot sanin lon leyisrael begin deinun mitrachakin veyisrael kerevin
Vetta chaze begin rechimuta derachim yaakov leosef yattir meachoy af al gav dechullehu hau leh achin ma ketiv vayyitnakkelu oto lahamito kal shekken ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot leyisrael
Ta chaze kamma garim leh hahu rechimuta derachim leh yattir degaram leh deitgele meavoy veitgeli avoy bahadeh vegaram lehu galuta
364: Velishchinta deitgalleya benayehu veaf al gav deitgezirat gezera veukmuha divgin ketonet passim deavad leh yattir ma ketiv vayyiru echav

Vayyachalom yosef chalom vegv ribbi chiyya patach veamar vayyomer shimu na devaray im yihye neviachem Adonai bammara elav etvadda bachalom adabber bo ta chaze kamma dargin ledargin avad kudsha berich hu vechullehu kayeme da al da darga al darga da leel min da vechullehu yankin illen min illen kedeka chaze lon illen mimina veillen missemala vechullehu itmannan illen al illen kolla kedeka yeut

Ta chaze kal nevie dealma kullehu yanke missitra chada miggo terin dargin yedian veinun dargin hau itchazzeyan bego aspaklarya dela nahara dichtiv bammara elav etvadda may hu mara kema deittemar chezu dechal gevanin itchazzeyan begavah veda hi aspaklarya dela nahara bachalom adabber bo da hu chad mishshittin binvua kema deukmuha veihu darga shetitaa mehahu darga dinvua veihu darga degavriel dimmanna al chelma veha ittemar

Ta chaze kal chelma deihu kedeka yeut mehay darga ka atya veal da let lach chelma dela yitarvun immeh millin kedivin kema deokimna uvgin kach minnayehu keshot uminnayehu kedivan velet lach chelma dela it beh mehay gisa umehay gisa

Uvgin deit beh bechelma kolla kidamaran kal chelmin dealma azlin batar pishra defuma veukmuha dichtiv vayehi kaasher patar lanu ken haya may tama begin deit beh bechelma kedivu ukshot umilla shalta al kolla uvgin kach bae chelma pishra tava ribbi yehuda amar begin dechal chelma middarga diltatta ihu vedibbur shalta aleh uvgin kach kal chelma azla batar pishra

Patach veamar bachalom chezon layela binfol tardema al anashim bitnumot ale mishkav az yigle ozen anashim uvmosaram yachtom ta chaze kad salik bar nash learseh mibbae leh leamlacha aleh malchuta dishmaya bekadmita ulvatar yema chad pesuka derachame veukmuha chavraya begin deha kad bar nash naim al arseh ha nishmateh nafka minnih veazla veshatya leela kal chad vechad kefum archeh vehachi selikat kema deittemar

Ma ketiv bachalom chezon layela kad bene nasha shachve bearsayehu nayemin venishmata nafkat minnayehu hada hu dichtiv bitnumot ale mishkav az yigle ozen anashim uchden kudsha berich hu oda lah lenishmata behahu darga dekayema al chelma inun millin dizminin lemete al alma o inun millin kefum inun hirhurin delibbeh begin devar nash natil archa detochache dealma

Begin deha la modain leh levar nash beod deihu kaim betukfa degufa kidkaamaran ella malacha oda lenishmata venishmata levar nash vehahu chelma ihu milleela kad nishmatin nafkin miggufe vesalkin kal chad vechad kefum archeh
Vechamma dargin al dargin beraza dechelma kullehu beraza dechachmeta vetta chaze chalom darga chada mara darga chada nevua darga chada vechullehu dargin ledargin illen al illen

Vayyachalom yosef chalom vayyagged leechav vayyosifu od seno oto al chalomotav mehacha dela mibbae leh levar nash lememar chelmeh bar lehahu bar nash derachim leh vei lav ihu garim leh dei hahu chelma mithappech legavena achora ihu garim lesalleka

Ta chaze deosef ihu amar chelma laachuhi veal da garmu leh lesallaka chelmeh teren veesrin shenin deitakkav ribbi yose amar menalan dichtiv vayyosifu od seno oto may seno oto degarmu leh kitrugin beda
Ma ketiv vayyomer alehem shimu na hachalom hazze
365: Asher chalamti devaa minayehu deyishmeun leh veihu oda lehu hahu chelma deilmale inun deahafachu leh legavena achora hachi itkeyyam veinun ativu veamru hamaloch timloch alenu im mashol timshol banu miyyad amru leh pishra dechalma vegazru gezera uvgin kach vayyosifu od seno oto

Ribbi chiyya veribbi yose hau shechiche kameh deribbi shimon amar ribbi chiyya ha taninan chelma dela itpashshar keiggarta dela mitkarya i begin deitkeyyam veihu la yada o dela itkeyyam kelal amar leh itkeyyam vela ityeda deha hahu chelma chela talya aleh veihu la ityeda vela yedia i itkeyyam i la itkeyyam

Velet lach milla bealma dead la yete lealma delav ihi talya bechelma o al yeda decharoza deha ittemar dechal milla umilla ad la yete lealma machreze aleh barakia umittamman itpashshat bealma veityehiv al yeda decharoza vecholla begin dichtiv ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar ki im gala sodo el avadav hanneviim bezimna dinviim ishtakkachu bealma vei lav af al gav dinvua la sharya chakkime adife minneviim vei la ityehiv bechelma vei lav betzippore shemaya mishtakkeche milla veha ukmuha

Vayyelchu echav lirot et tzon avihem bishchem ribbi shimon amar lirot tzon avihem mibbae leh may et nakud milleela leasgaa imhon shechinta deihi immehon sharya begin deinun hau asara deha yosef la hava immehon uvinyamin ihu zeir beveta uvgin kach inun hau asara vechad azlu havat shechinta benayehu veal da nakud milleela
Uvgin kach bezimna dezabbinu leh leosef ishtattafu kullehu bahade shechinta veashtifu lah bahadayehu kad avidu omaa vead deitgalleya milla deosef la sharya shechinta aleh deyaakov

Vei tema dishchinta la ishtakkechat immehon ta chaze dichtiv sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah edut leyisrael lehodot leshem Adonai kullehu tzaddike vachaside kiyyuma dechal alma kiyyuma inun leela vetatta

Patach veamar samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nilech hay kera ukmuha dedavid hava im libbeh lemivne beta kema deatte amer vayehi im levav david avi livnot bayit leshem Adonai vegv ulvatar ma ketiv rak atta lo tivne habbayit ki im bincha hayyotze mechalatzecha hu yivne habbayit lishmi vechal yisrael hau yade da vehau amru ematay yamut david veyakum shelomo bereh veyivne beta uchden omdot hau raglenu bisharayich yerushalayim keden nisak venakriv tamman karbanin

Veim kal da af al gav dehau amru ematay yamut sava da keden samachti vechedva hava li begin beri dehau amre divri yakum techoti lemigmar pikuda lemivni veta keden share veshabbach lah veamar yerushalayim habbenuya keir shechubbera lah yachdav

Tenan avad kudsha berich hu yerushalayim letatta kegavena dilela veda mittakkena lakovel da dichtiv machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai habbenuya dezammin kudsha berich hu lenachata lah yerushalayim dilela kedeka yaot uvgin kach habbenuya shechubbera lah yachdav veha ukmuha shechubbera shechibberu mibbae leh ella deitchabbarat imma bivratta vehau kechada veukmuha

Veittemar sheshsham alu shevatim illen inun kiyyuma dealma vetikkuna dealma tattaa vela tema dealma tattaa bilchodoy ella afilu dealma illaa dichtiv shivte yah edut leyisrael leyisrael dayeka begin deinun kiyyuma letatta sahaduta inun leela vecholla lehodot leshem Adonai leodaa shemeh dekudsha berich hu lechal sitrin dichtiv lehodot leshem Adonai
Vayyimtzaehu ish vehinne toe bassade vayyishalehu haish lemor ma tevakkesh
366: Ma ketiv leela vayyomer yisrael el yosef halo achecha roim bishchem lecha veeshlachacha alehem vechi yaakov shelema dehava rachim leh leosef mikkal benoy vehava yada dechal achuy hau sanin leh ammay shaddar leh legabbayehu ella ihu la chashid alayehu dehava yada dechullehu hau zakkain vela chashid lon ella garim kudsha berich hu kal da begin lekayema gezera degazar ben habbetarim

Ashkachna besifre kadmay devayan illen bene yaakov leshalletaa aloy ad la yechot lemitzrayim deilu hu yechot lemitzrayim veinun la shaltu beh bekadmita yachle mitzrai leshalletaa lealmin alayehu deyisrael veitkayema beh beosef deizdabban leavda veinun shaltu aloy veaf al gav deosef hava malka levatar umitzrae hau avdin leh ishtakkachu yisrael deshaltu al kullehu

Ta chaze deosef deihu berit ilaa kal zimna deitkeyyam berit shechinta itkeyyam bahadayehu deyisrael bishlam kedeka yeut kevan deistallak yosef berit illaa mealma keden berit shechinta veyisrael kullehu begaluta nafku veha okimna dichtiv vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim asher lo yada et yosef vecholla hava meim kudsha berich hu kedeka yeut

Ta chaze vayyimtzaehu ish da gavriel veukmuha ketiv hacha vayyimtzaehu ish uchtiv hatam vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon battechilla vehinne toe becholla toe deavtach al achuy dehava mitba achva dilhon vela ashkach vetava lehu vela ashkach veal da toe becholla veal da vayyishalehu haish lemor ma tevakkesh

Vayyomer et achay anochi mevakkesh vegv vayyomer haish nasu mizze vegv ribbi yehuda patach mi yittencha keach li yonek shede immi emtzaacha vachutz eshakcha gam lo yavozu li hay kera ukmuha chavraya aval hay kera keneset yisrael amaro lemalka dishlama dileh mi yittencha keach li keosef al achuy deamar veatta al tirau anochi achalkel etchem veet tappechem yahav lon mezona vezan lehu bechafna begin kach mi yittencha keach li

Davar acher mi yittencha keach li da yosef legabbah dishchinta deitachad immah veitdabbak bahadah yonek shede immi deha keden achva ushlimu bahadayehu emtzaacha bachutz go galuta deihu beara achora eshakcha begin leitdabbeka rucha berucha gam lo yavozu li af al gav deana beara achora
Ta chaze deosef af al gav deachoy la hau leh keachin kad nafal bidayehu ihu hava lon keacha kad naflu bideh veha ukmuha dichtiv vayenachem otam vayedabber al libbam becholla dibber al libbayehu

Veta chaze ma ketiv vayyomru ish el achiv da shimon velevi deinun hau achin vadday becholla begin deka atu missitra dedina kashya uvgin kach rugza dilhon ihu rugza diktala bealma kema deatte amer arur appam ki az veevratam ki kashata

Ta chaze raza demilla it rugza veit rugza it rugza deihu mevarcha meela umittatta veikre baruch kema deittemar dichtiv baruch avram leel elon koni shamayim vaaretz veha ukmuha veit rugza deihi itlatya leela vetatta kema deittemar deikre arur dichtiv arur atta mikkal habbehema umikkal chayyat hassade arur appam ki az

Veal raza da it teren turin dichtiv venatatta et habberacha al har gerizim veet hakkelala al har eval lakovel illen teren dargin veal da da ikre arur veda ikre baruch veshimon velevi inun missitra dedina kashya umin sitra dedina kashya takkifa nafkat rugza deitlatya
Vetta chaze missitra dedina kashya nafke rugza litre sitrin chad deitbarach vechad deitlatya
367: Chad baruch vechad arur kegavena da missitra deyitzchak nafku teren benin chad mevorach vechad deitlatya leela vetatta da itparash lesitreh veda itparash lesitreh da diyyureh beara kaddisha veda diyyureh betura deseir dichtiv ish yodea tzayid ish sade da atreh beatar demidbara vecharva ushmama veda yoshev ohalim vecholla kegavena deitzterich

Uvgin kach teren dargin inun baruch vearur da lesitreh veda lesitreh mehay nafkin kal birchan dealmin leela vetatta vechal tivu vechal nehiru vechal purkan vechal shezavuta umehay nafkin kal levatin vechal charba vechal dama vechal shemama vechal bishin vechal mesaavu dealma

Ribbi shimon patach veamar erchatz benikkaon kappay vaasovva et mizbachacha Adonai hay kera ukmuha aval ta chaze raza demilla hacha deha let lach bar nash bealma dela taim tama demota belelya veruach mesaava sharya al hahu gufa may tama begin denishmata kaddisha istallekat minneh devar nash venafkat minneh veal denishmata kaddisha nafkat veistallekat minnih sharya rucha mesaava al hahu gufa veistaav

Vechad nishmata ithadderat legufa itavar hahu zuhama veha ittemar didoy devar nash zuhama dimsaavu ishtaar behu veal da la yaavar yedoy al enoy begin dehahu ruach mesaava shar aloy ad denatil lon vechad natil yedoy kedeka chaze keden itkaddosh veikre kadosh

Vehecha bae leitkaddesha bae chad keli letatta vechad keli milleela begin deyitkaddash mehahu dilela vehahu diltatta deyativ bezuhama dimsaavu beh veda keli lekabbela mesaavu veda leitkaddesha minneh da baruch veda arur vela bayan inun mayin dezuhama leoshda lon beveta dela yikrav behu bar nash deha behu mitkanneshe sitra dilhon yachil lekabbela nizka meinun mayin mesaavin

Vead deyitavar zuhama min yedoy la yevarech veokimna uvgin kach bar nash ad la yekaddesh yedoy betzafra ikre tame kevan deitkaddash ikre tahor uvgin kach la yittol ella min yeda deidke bekadmita dichtiv vehizza hattahor al hattame da ikre tahor veda ikre tame

Begin kach chad keli leela vechad keli letatta da kaddisha veda mesaava umeinun mayin asir lemebad behu midi ella bae leoshda lon beatar divne nasha la avrin alayehu vela yavit lon beveta deha kevan deittoshdan beara rucha mesaava ishtakkach tamman veyachil lenazka vei chafar lon midron techot ara dela yitchazun shappir

Vela yahiv lon linshe chorashaya deyichlun leavasha behu livni nasha begin deinun mayin deitlatyan vekudsha berich hu bae ledakkaa lon leyisrael ulmeheve kaddishin dichtiv vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim uthartem mikkol tumotechem umikkal gillulechem ataher etchem

Vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora vehabbor rek en bo mayim ribbi yehuda patach veamar torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh kamma it lon livne nasha leishtaddela beorayeta dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta lehve leh chayyim bealma den uvalma deate vezache bitren almin veafilu man deishtaddal beorayeta vela yishtaddal bah lishmah kedeka yaot zache leagar tav bealma den vela dayenin leh behahu alma

Vetta chaze ketiv orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod orech yamim behahu deishtaddal beorayeta lishmah deit leh orech yamim behahu alma deveh orcha deomin veinun yomin inun yomin vadday tamman ihu rachatzanu dikdusha dilela deitrechitz bar nash behay alma leishtaddela beorayeta leittakkefa behahu alma
368: Bismolah osher vechavod agar tav veshalva it leh behay alma

Vechal man deyishtaddal beorayeta lishmah kad nafik mehay alma orayeta azla kammeh veachrazat kammeh veaginat aleh dela yikrevun bahadeh marehon dedina kad shachiv gufa bekivra hi natrat leh kad nishmata azla leistalleka lemetav leatrah ihi azla kammah dehahi nishmata vechamma tarin ittavru mikkammah deorayeta ad dealat leduchtah vekayema aleh devar nash ad deyitar bezimna dikumun metaya dealma veihi malfa sannegora aleh

Hada hu dichtiv behithallechcha tanche otach beshachbecha tishmor alecha vahakitzota hi tesichecha behithallechcha tanche otach kema deittemar beshachbecha tishmor alecha beshata deshachiv gufa bekivra deha keden behahu zimna itdan gufa bekivra uchden orayeta aginat aleh vahakitzota hi tesichecha kema deittemar bezimna deyitarun mete alma min afra hi tesichecha lemeheve sannegorya alach

Ribbi elazar amar hi tesichecha may hi tesichecha begin deaf al gav dehashta yekumun meafra orayeta la yitneshe minnehon deha keden yindeun kal hahi orayeta deshavku kad istalku mehay alma hahi orayeta netira mehahu zimna vetiul bemeayehu kemillekaddemin veihi temallel bemeayehu

Vechal millin mittakkenan yattir mikkema dehau bekadmita deha kal inun millin deihu la yachil leadbaka lo kedeka yaot veihu ishtaddal behu vela itdabbak behu kullehu alin bemeoy mittaknan veorayeta temallel beh hada hu dichtiv vahakitzota hi tesichecha ribbi yehuda amar kegavena da kal man deishtaddal beorayeta behay alma zache leishtaddela bah lealma deate veha ittemar

Ta chaze hahu var nash dela zache leishtaddela behay alma beorayeta veihu azil bechashocha kad nafik mehay alma natlin leh vealin leh laggehinnom atar tattaa dela yehe merachem aleh deikre bor shaon tit hayyaven kema deatte amer vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven vayyakem al sela raglay konen ashuray

Ubbegin kach hahu dela ishtaddal beorayeta behay alma veittannaf betinnufe alma ma ketiv vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora da hu gehinnom atar dedayenin lehu leinun dela ishtaddelu beorayeta vehabbor rek kema deihu hava rek may tama begin dela hava beh mayim

Veta chaze kamma hu onsha deorayeta deha la itgalu yisrael meara kaddisha ella begin deistallaku meorayeta veishtevaku minah hada hu dichtiv mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot vegv al ma avda haaretz vegv vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati vegv ribbi yose amar mehacha lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat
Begin kach kolla kayema al kiyyuma deorayeta vealma la itkeyyam bekiyyumeh ella beorayeta deihu kiyyuma dealmin ela vetatta dichtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti

Vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora ramaz al dearmiu leh lego mitzrae atar dela ishtakkach raza dimhemnuta kelal ribbi yitzchak amar i nechashin veakrabbin hau beh ammay ketiv biruven lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashivo el aviv vechi la chayyish reuven lehay deha inun nechashin veakrabbin yenazkun leh veech amar lahashivo el aviv uchtiv lemaan hatztzil oto

Ella chama reuven denizka ishtakkach bidayehu deachoy begin deyada kamma sanin leh uruta dilhon lekatla leh amar reuven tav leminpal leh lego gova dinchashin veakrabbin vela yitmesar bida desanoy dela merachame aleh mikkan amru yappil var nash garmeh leesha o leguva dinchashin veakrabbin vela yitmassar bida desanoy
369: Begin dehacha atar dinchashim veakrabbim i ihu tzaddika kudsha berich hu yarchish leh nisa ulzimnin dizchu deavahan mesayein leh levar nash veyishteziv minnayehu aval kevan deyitmassar bida desanoy zeirin inun deyachlin leishtezava

Uvgin kach amar lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam miyyadam dayeka vela ketiv lemaan hatztzil oto vetu la ella amar reuven yishteziv min yedayehu vei yemut beguva yemut uvgin kach ketiv vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam

Ta chaze kamma chasiduteh diruven divgin deyada deshimon velevi shuttefuta vachachimuta vechavruta dilhon kashya inun dechad itchabbaru bishchem katlu kal dechura la day lon ella denatlin nashin vataf vechaspa vedahava vechal beire vechal mane dikar vechal man deishtakkach bekarta vela day kal da ella deafilu kal ma divchakla natlu dichtiv veet asher bair veet asher bassade lakachu

Amar uma karta rabbata ki hay la ishteziv minnehon ilmale ravya da yippol bidayehu la yasharun minneh umtza bealma veal da amar tav leishtezava minnayehu dela yasharun minneh ishtaaruta bealma vela yechome abba minneh kelum lealmin

Vehacha i yemut la yachlin leh veyishtaar kal gufeh shelim vaativ leh leabba shelim veal da lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashivo el aviv af al gav dimut hatam uvgin kach amar hayyeled enennu vela amar ennu chay ella amar enennu afilu met

Ta chaze may deavad deihu bechachmeta hava shattif garmeh bahadayehu dichtiv lo nakkennu nafesh vela ketiv la takkuhu veihu la hava tamman kad izdabban yosef deha kullehu meshammeshe laavuhon kal chad vechad yoma chad vehahu yoma diruven hava veal da baa divhahu yoma dehava shimmusha dileh la yitavid yosef uvgin kach ketiv vayyashav reuven el habbor vehinne en yosef babbor vayyikra et begadav vehine en yosef dayeka afilu mit miyyad vayyashav el echav vayyomer hayyeled enennu
Veafilu reuven la yada mehahu zevina deosef veha ukmuha deishtattif behu shechinta veal da la yada reuven mehahu zevina deosef vela itgalya leh ad hahu zimna deitgele yosef laachohi

Ta chaze kamma garim leh liruven begin deihu ishtaddal leachaya leh leosef ma ketiv yechi reuven veal yamot vegv deha begin da af al gav deyada deishtekil becheruteh minneh veityehiv leosef ishtaddal leachaya leh vetzalle moshe veamar yechi reuven veal yamot veitkeyyam bealma den veitkeyyam bealma deate may tama begin da uvgin deavad teshuva mehahu ovada dechal man deavid teshuva kudsha berich hu kayyam leh bealma den uvalma deate

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyikchu et ketonet yosef vegv ha ukmuha divgin dedama desair damya ledama devar nash aval ta chaze af al gav demilla atya kedeka chaze kudsha berich hu medakdek behu betzaddikaya afilu kechut hassaara

Yaakov avad ovada kedeka yaot bemay begin deakriv legabboy avoy sair deihu sitra dedina kashya veim kal da begin deihu akriv sair veakkechish leh leavoy deihu sitra dileh itanash behay sair achora deakrivu leh benoy dama dileh

Beihu ketiv veet orot gedaye haizzim hilbisha al yadav veal chelkat tzavarav begin kach vayyitbelu et hakkuttonet baddam akrivu leh kuttonta leakkechasha leh vecholla da lakovel da ihu garim dichtiv vayyechorad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod begin kach garmu leh decharad charada behahu zimna dichtiv hakker na hakketonet bincha hi im lo
370: Ribbi chiyya amar beh ketiv haatta ze beni esav im lo leh ketiv hakketonet bincha hi im lo ubbegin kach kudsha berich hu medakdek behu betzaddikaya bechal ma deinun avdin

Ribbi abba amar kevan dechamu kullehu shivtin hahu tzaara deavuhon itnechamu vaday vihivu garmayehu aleh deosef deyifdun leh ilmale yishkechun leh kevan dechamu dela yachilu ahadaru legabbeh dihuda veaavaru leh mealayehu begin deihu hava malka alayehu aavaruhu mealayehu ma ketiv vayehi baet hahi vayyered yehuda vegv

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai veelon yitten kolo barad vegachale esh ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma atkin leh shiva semachin al ma dekayema vechullehu semachin kayeme bechad samcha yechiday veha ukmuha dichtiv chachmot nashim banta vetah chatzva ammudeha shiva veillen kullehu inun kayeme bechad darga minnayehu deikre tzaddik yesod olam

Vealma kad itbere mehahu atar itbere deihu shichlula dealma vetikkunoy deihu chad nekuda dealma veemtzaita decholla uman ihu tziyyon dichtiv mizmor leasaf el elohim Adonai dibber vayyikra eretz mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo umean atar mitztziyyon dichtiv mitztziyyon michlal yofi elohim hofia mehahu atar deihu sitra deshichlula dimhemnuta shelemata kedeka yeut vetziyyon takkifu unkuda dechal alma umehahu atar ishtachlal kal alma veitavid umiggaveh kal alma ittezan

Vetta chaze vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai veelon yitten kolo vegv kevan deamar vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai ammay ketiv veelon yitten kolo ha hacha raza dimhemnuta deamina detziyyon ihu shichlula veshappiru dealma vealma minneh ittezan begin ditren dargin inun veinun chad inun tziyyon viyerushalam da dina veda rachame vetarvayehu chad mehacha dina umehacha rachame

Meela leela nafka kol deishtema levatar dehahu kol nafka veishtema nafke dinin vearche dedina verachame nafkin umitparshan mittamman vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai da be dina berachame veelon af al gav dela ishtakkach vela ityeda kevan dehahu kol nafik keden ishtakkach kolla dina verachame hada hu dichtiv veelon yitten kolo kevan deyitten kolo keden barad vegachale esh maya veesha

Ta chaze beshata deityelid yehuda ma ketiv vattaamod milledet begin deda hu yesoda reviaa meinun arba deinun reticha illaa samcha chad meinun arba samchin ma ketiv beh vayehi baet hahi vayyered yehuda meet echav dehava malka alayehu may tama begin deosef nachatu leh lemitzrayim kidkaamaran
Vayyar sham yehuda bat ish kenaani vechi kenaani hava ella ha ukmuha chavrayya vattahar vatteled ben vayyikra et shemo er telat benin hau leh lihuda vela ishtaaru minnayehu bar chad veda hu shela

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose veribbi chiyya hau azle bearcha amar ribbi yose leribbi elazar ammay ketiv bivnoy dihuda bekadmaa vayyikra et shemo er uvitren achoranin ketiv vattikra et shemo onan vattikra et shemo shela

Amar leh ta chaze hay parshata raza illaa ihu vecholla ihu kedeka chaze vayyered yehuda meet echav deha itkasya sihara venachatat middarga detikkunna lego darga ochara deitchabbar beh chivveya kema deatte amer vayyet ad ish adullami ushmo chira
Vattahar vatteled ben vayyikra et shemo er veihu ra vecholla chad deatya missitra deyetzer hara uvgin kach ketiv vayyikra et shemo vela ketiv vayyikra shemo
371: Beyaakov ketiv vayyikra shemo dekudsha berich hu kara leh yaakov vehacha et leasgaa darga achora dezuhama dimsaava ityelid veda hu er ra vecholla chad

Levatar la itbassam atra ad deata shela dehava ikkara dechullehu ma ketiv vayehi er bechor yehuda ra beeni Adonai ketiv hacha ra uchtiv hatam ki yetzer lev haadam ra minurav ra deoshid damin oshid zara al ara uvgin kach vayemitehu Adonai ma ketiv batreh vayyomer yehuda leonan bo el eshet achicha vegv

Vayyomer yehuda leonan bo el eshet achicha vegv ribbi shimon patach veamar hairoti mitztzafon vayyaat mimmizrach shemesh yikra vishmi veyavo seganim kemo chomer uchmo yotzer yirmas tit ta chaze kamma inun beni nasha tippeshin dela yadin vela mistakkelin leminda archoy dekudsha berich hu deha kullehu nayemin dela mitare shenta bechorehon

Ta chaze kudsha berich hu avad leh levar nash kegavena dilela kolla ihu bechachmeta delet lach shayefa veshayefa bevar nash dela kayema bechachmeta illaa deha kevan deittakkan kal gufa beshayefoy kedeka yeut kudsha berich hu ishtattaf bahadeh veail beh nishmata kaddisha begin leolafa leh levar nash lemehach bearchoy deorayeta ulmitar pikkudoy begin deyittakkan bar nash kedeka yeut

Deit beh nishmata kaddisha mibbae leh levar nash leasgaa diukna demalka illaa bealma veraza da deha hahu nahar denagid venafik la paskan memoy lealmin veal da mibbae leh levar nash dela yafsik nahara umkora dileh behay alma vechal zimna devar nash la yatzlach behay alma kudsha berich hu akar leh venata leh bechamma zimnin kemillekaddemin

Ta chaze ma ketiv hairoti mitztzafon vayyat hairoti da itaruta deziuuga devar nash behay alma deihu itaruta missitra detzafon vayat da hi nishmata kaddisha deatya milleela vekudsha berich hu meshadder lah milleela atya behay alma vealat bego bene nasha kidkaamaran

Mimmizrach shemesh da atar dehahu nahar denagid venafik demittamman nafkat nishmata veitnehirat veyavo seganim illen inun chelin dealma deatyan begin hahu itaruta denishmatin kemo chomer kegavena deitar bar nash begufa

Deha begin da kudsha berich hu avid ziugin veattil nishmatin bealma vechavruta ishtakkach leela vetatta umkora decholla hu baruch ubbegin kach kudsha berich hu avad leh levar nash begin leishtaddala bearchoy vela yafsik mekoreh umabbua dileh lealmin
Vechal man defasik mekoreh kad nafik mehay alma hahu bar nash la al befargoda vela natil chulak behahu alma
372: Ta chaze ketiv lo tohu beraah leshevet yetzarah dekudsha berich hu begin da avad leh levar nash kedeka yeut kedeamaran vekudsha berich hu avad tivu im alma ta chaze ma ketiv vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushmah ketura raza denishmata atat leittakkana kemilkaddemin

Ta chaze hahu gufa ma ketiv vayeya chafetz dakkeo hecholi im tasim asham nafsho yire zera yaarich yamim vechefetz Adonai beyado yitzlach vayeya chafatz dakkeo hay kera it leistakkala beh ammay chafetz begin deyitdakke im tasim asham im yasim asham mibbae leh may im tasim ella lenishmata ahadar milla i hahi nishmata baya leittakkana kedeka yaot yire zera begin dehahi nishmata azlat veshatat veihi zemina leaola behahu zera deitassak bah bar nash bifriyya urviyya uchden yaarich yamim vechefetz Adonai da orayeta bideh atzlach

Ta chaze af al gav devar nash ishtaddal beorayeta yemama velelya umkoreh umabbueh kayema beh lemaggana let leh atar leaala lefargoda veha ittemar devera demaya i hahu mekora umabbua la al beh lav ihu beer devera umkora kechada inun veraza chada ihu veokimna

Ketiv shave lachem mashkime kum meachare shevet ochle lechem haatzavim ken yitten lidido shena ta chaze kamma chavivin inun mille deorayeta dechal milla umilla deorayeta it beh razin illain kaddishin veha ittemar dechad yahav kudsha berich hu orayeta leyisrael kal genizin illain kaddishin kullehu yahav lehu beorayeta vechullehu ityehivu lehu leyisrael beshata dekabbilu orayeta besinay

Ta chaze shave lachem mashkime kum ilen inun yechidim deishtakkachu delav inun dechar venukva kedeka yeut veakdeman betzafra laavidtayehu kema deatte amer yesh echad veen sheni vegv veen ketz lechal amalo meachare shevet meacharin nayecha kema deatte amer ki vo shavat begin deitteta legabbe bar nash ihi nayecha legabbeh vadday

Ochle lechem haatzavim may lechem haatzavim dechad bar nash it leh benin hahu nahama deachil achil leh bechedva uviruta delibba vehahu delet leh benin hahu nahama deachil ihu nahama daatzivu veillen inun ochle lechem haatzavim vadday

Ken yitten lidido shena may yitten lidido da hu dimkoreh mevarach dekudsha berich hu yahav leh shena behahu alma kema deatte amer veshachavta vearva shenatecha begin deit leh chulaka bealma deate begin dehahu bar nash shachiv veyithanne behahu alma deate kedeka yeut

Yesh echad veen sheni vegv yesh echad da hu bar nash deihu yechiday bealma la yechiday kedeka yeut ella deihu bela ziuuga veen sheni delet immeh semech gam ben deokim shemeh beyisrael la shavak veach leayetaa leh letikkuna
Veen ketz lechal amalo deihu amel tadir deakdim yemama velelya gam eno lo tisba osher velet leh libba leashgacha ulmemar lemi ani amel umchasser et nafshi
373: Mittova vei tema divgin deyechul veyishte yattir veyaaved mishtaya bechal yoma tadir lav hachi deha nafsha la ithanni minneh ella vadday ihu mechasser lenafsheh mittivu dinhora dealma deate begin deda hi nafsha chasra dela ishtallimat kedeka yeut ta chaze kamma chas kudsha berich hu al ovadoy begin deka bae deyittakkan vela yitavid mehahu alma deate kidkaamaran

Ribbi chiyya baa hay deihu zakkaa shelema veishteddal beorayeta yome velele vechal ovadoy lishma dekudsha berich hu vela zacha livnin behay alma kegon deishtaddal behu vela zacha o dehau leh umitu ma inun lealma deate amar leh ribbi yose ovadoy vehahi orayeta ka maginan aleh lehahu alma

Amar ribbi yitzchak alayehu veal inun zakkae keshot alayehu ketiv ko amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay uvacharu baasher chafatzti umachazikim bivriti ma ketiv batreh venatatti lahem beveti uvchomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo asher lo yikkaret begin deillen it lon chulaka lealma deate amar leh ribbi yose yaot hu veshappir

Ta chaze zakkaa shelim dehau kal illen beh veishtelim kedeka yeut umit bela benin veha ka yarit duchteh behahu alma itteteh baya livume o la i tema delibbae livume ha berekanya ihu deha atreh ka yarit behahu alma

Ella vadday baya livume begin dela yadinan i hava shelim beovadoy i lav vehi i ityabmat la hava berekanya begin deatar it leh lekudsha berich hu deha bar nash hava bealma umit bela benin ufuraka la have leh bealma kevan demit hay zakkaa shelim veittete ityabmat veihu atreh yarit ata hahu bar nash veishtallim hacha uven kach uven kach kudsha berich hu atar zammin leh ad deyemut hay zakkaa shelim veyishtelim ihu bealma hada hu dichtiv ki veir miklato yeshev ad mot hakkohen haggadol vegv
Veda hu detaninan benin zeminin inun letzaddikaya bemitathon bechayyehon la zachu uvmitathon zachu uvgin kach kal ovadoy dekudsha berich hu kullehu keshot uzchu vechayyim al kolla

Tovim hashshenayim min haechad asher yesh lahem sachar tov baamalam illen inun demitassekin behay alma leolada benin deinun benin deshavku beginehon it lon agar tav behahu alma uvginehu yartin avahan dilhon chulaka behahu alma veukmuha
Ta chaze kudsha berich hu nata ilanin behay alma i atzlachu yaot la atzlachu aakar lon veshatal lon afilu kamma zimnin ubbegin kach kal archoy dekudsha berich hu kullehu letav ulatkana alma

Bo el eshet achicha veyabbem otah deha yehuda vechullehu shivtin hau yade da veikkera demilleta vehakem zera begin dehahu zera itzterich leittakkana milla ulmiglam golama letikkuna dela yitperash giza mishsharsheh kedeka yeut hada hu dichtiv veadam al afar yashuv

Vechad mittakkan levatar kedeka yaot illen mishtabbechin behahu alma begin dekudsha berich hu itrae behu uvgin kach ketiv veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu dayeka min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim adenna may adenna kema deatte amer achare veloti hayeta li edna uchtiv yashuv lime alumav

Vetov mishshenihem et asher aden lo haya asher lo raa et hammaase hara asher naasa tachat hashshemesh vetov mishshenihem et asher aden lo haya dela shav lime alumav vela itzterich leittakkana vela savil chovin kadmae begin dekudsha berich hu
374: Yahav leh atar metakna behahu alma kedeka yaot

Ta chaze ma ketiv uvchen raiti reshaim kevurim vegv kema deittemar begin dekudsha berich hu avid tivu vela vaa leshetzaa alma ella kema deittemar vechal archoy kullehu keshot uzchu leotava lehu behay alma uvalma deate zakkaa chulkehon detzaddikaya deinun azle beorach keshot alayehu ketiv tzaddikim yirshu aretz

Vayyera beene Adonai asher asa vayyamet gam oto ribbi chiyya patach babboker zera et zaracha velaerev al tannach yadcha vegv ta chaze kamma itchaze leh levar nash leizdahara mechovoy ulizdahara beovadoy kamme kudsha berich hu begin dechamma shelichan vechamma memannan inun bealma deinun azlin veshayetan vechaman ovadehon divne nasha vesahadin aloy vecholla besifra chetivin

Vetta chaze bechal inun chovin deistaav behu var nash behay alma da ihu chova deistaav beh var nash yattir behay alma uvalma deate man deoshid zareh berekanya veappik zara lemaggana bida o beragla veistaav beh kema deatte amer ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra

Begin da la al lefargoda vela chame sevar appe attik yomin kema detaninan ketiv hacha lo yegurcha ra uchtiv vayehi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai uvgin kach ketiv yedechem damim maleu zakkaa chulakeh devar nash dedachil lemareh vihe netir meorach bisha veyadke garmeh leishtaddala bidchilu demareh
Ta chaze babboker zera et zarecha hay kera ukmuha babboker da hu bezimna devar nash itkayyem becheleh vihe beulemo keden ishtaddal leolada benin beitta dechazya leh dichtiv babboker zera et zarecha

Deha keden zimna ihu kema deatte amer kechitztzim beyad gibbor ken beni hanneurim begin deyachil lemelaf lehu archoy dekudsha berich hu vihe leh agra tava lealma deate dichtiv ashre haggever asher mille et ashpato mehem lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyevim bashshaar lo yevoshu behahu alma bezimna demarehon dedina yetun lekatrega aloy delet lach agra tava behahu alma kehahu deolif leh livreh dechilu demareh bearchoy deorayeta

Ta chaze ma amar beavraham dichtiv ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzave et banav veet beto acharav veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka umishpat veal da hahu zechu kayema leh behahu alma legabbe kal marehon dedina

Uvgin kach babboker zera et zarecha velaerev al tannach yadecha afilu beome dezikna deihu zimna desiv var nash ma ketiv al tannach yadecha la yishbok milleolada behay alma may tama begin dela teda eze yichshar hazze o ze lifne haelohim begin dikumun begineh behahu alma

Veal da ketiv hinne nachalat Adonai banim da tzerora denishmata sitra dealma deate ulhay nachala man zache leh levar nash leaala behahu nachalat Adonai banim inun benin zachan leh lenachalat Adonai veal da zakkaa hahu bar nash dezache lon deolif lon archoy deorayeta kema deittemar

Vattasar bigde almenutah mealeha vegv ta chaze tamar bat kohen havat vechi salka datach deihi azla begin leaznaa im chamuha deha ihi tzeniuta ishtakkechat bah tadir ella ihi tzaddeket havat uvchachma avdat hay deha ihi la afkarat garmah legabbeh ella begin didia yadat vechachmeta istakkalat veal da ihi atat legabbeh lemebad tivu ukshot veal da atat veishtaddelat beiska da
Ta chaze begin deihi yadat yedia veishtaddelat beiska da kudsha berich hu avad siyyua tamman behahu ovada veitabberat miyyad vecholla hava
375: Minneh vei tema ammay la ayete kudsha berich hu inun benin meitteta ochara ammay min da ella vadday ihi itztericha leovada da vela itteta achora

Teren neshin hau deminnayehu itbene zara dihuda veatu minnayehu david malka ushlomo malka umalka meshicha veillen teren neshin da kegavena deda tamar verut demitu baalayehu bekadmita veinun ishtaddelu leovada da

Tamar ishtaddelat legabbe chamuha deihu kariv yattir livnoy demitu may tama ihi ishtaddelat legabbeh dichtiv ki raata ki gadal shela vehi lo nittena lo leishsha uvgin da ishtaddelat beovada da legabbe chamuha

Rut mit baalah ulvatar ishtaddelat beovada da legabbeh devoaz dichtiv vattegal margelotav vattishkav veishtaddelat bahadeh ulvatar olidat leh leoved vei tema ammay la nafik oved meitteta achora ella vadday hi itzterichat vela itteta achora umitteren illen itbeni veishtachlil zara dihuda vetarvaveyehu bechashrut avdu lemebad tivu im inun metaya leittakkena alma levatar

Veda hu kema deittemar veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu deha kad hau chayyin bekadmita la hava behu shevacha vetarvayehu ishtaddelu lemebad tivu ukshot im innun metaya vekudsha berich hu siyyea behahu ovada vecholla hava kedeka yaot zakkaa ihu man deishtaddal beorayeta yemama velelya kema deatte amer vehagita vo yomam valayela lemaan tishmor laasot kechal hakkatuv bo ki az tatzliach et derachecha vegv

Veosef hurad mitzrayema vayyiknehu potifar vegv may hurad deistakkam kudsha berich hu behahu ovada lekayema gezera dileh digzar ben habbetarim dichtiv yadoa teda ki ger yihye zaracha vegv vayyiknehu potifar listar chataa kana leh

Patach veamar haomer lacheres velo yizrach uvad kochavim yachtom ta chaze shiva kochvaya avad kudsha berich hu birkia vechal rekia urkia it beh kamma shammashin memannin leshammasha leh lekudsha berich hu
Begin delet lach shammasha o memanna delet leh pulchana veshimmusha lemareh vekayeme kal chad vechad al hahu shimmusha deitpakda beh vechal chad yada avidteh leshammasha

Minnehon meshammeshe bishlichuta demarehon veitpakkedan bealma al kal ovadehon divne nasha uminnehon deka meshabbechin leh veinun itpakkedan al shirata veaf al gav deinun itpakkedan behay let lach kal chela bishmaya vechochavin umazzale dechullehu la meshabbechan leh lekudsha berich hu
Deha beshata deal lelya keden itparshan telat sitrin mashshiryan litlat sitre alma uvchal sitra vesitra elef alfin veribbo rivvan vechullehu memannan al
376: Telat mashshiryan inun vechad chevata kaddisha memanna alayehu vekayema alayehu vechullehu ka meshabbechan leh lekudsha berich hu ad deate tzafra kad ate tzafra kal inun devistar darom vechal kochvaya denahare kullehu meshabbechan veamre shirata lekudsha berich hu kema deatte amer beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kal bene elohim beran yachad kochve voker illen kochvaya devistar darom kema deatte amer vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyariu kal bene elohim illen inun devistar semala deitkelilu bimina

Uchden tzafra nahir veyisrael natle shirata umshabbechan leh lekudsha berich hu bimama telat zimnin bimama lakovel telat zimnin delelya vekayemin illen lakovel illen ad deyistallak yekara dekudsha berich hu bimama uvlelya kedeka yeut vekudsha berich hu istallak behu beshit illen

Hahu chevata kaddisha dekayema alayehu leela kayema al yisrael letatta begin leatkana kolla kedeka yeut ma ketiv bah vattakam beod layela vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha vattitten teref levetah illen inun mashshiryan dilela vechok lenaaroteha illen mashshiryan deyisrael letatta uvgin kach yekara dekudsha berich hu istallak mikkal sitrin meela umittatta veal da kolla hava birshuteh kayema vecholla ihu biruteh

Haomer lacheres velo yizrach ribbi shimon amar da yosef uvad kochavim yachtom illen inun achoy dichtiv behu vaachad asar kochavim mishtachavim li davar acher haomer lacheres da yaakov beshata deamru lo hakker na velo yizrach beshata deistalkat shechinta minneh uvad kochavim yachtom begin benoy itchattam veastim nehora dileh shimsha itchashach vechochvaya la nehiru begin deosef itparash meavoy vetta chaze mehahu yoma dehahu ovada deosef itperash yaakov mishshimmusha dearsa veishtaar avela ad hahu yoma deitbassar besora deosef

Vayehi Adonai et yosef vayehi ish matzliach vayehi bevet adonav vegv ribbi yose patach ki Adonai ohev mishpat velo yaazov et chasidav leolam nishmaru hay kera ukmuha beavraham et chasidav chasido ketiv veha ittemar

Ta chaze bechal atar detzaddikaya azle kudsha berich hu natir lon vela shavik lon david amar gam ki elech bege tzalmavet lo ira ra ki atta immadi shivtecha umishantecha vegv bechal atar detzaddikaya azle shechinta azla immehon vela shavik lon

Yosef azal bege tzalmavet venachatu leh lemitzrayim shechinta havat immeh hada hu dichtiv vayehi Adonai et yosef uvgin dehavat immeh shechinta bechal ma dehava avid hava matzlach bideh deafilu may dehava bideh vehava tava leh mareh begavena achora hava mithappech bideh lehahu gavena diruta demareh hava rae beh kema deatte amer vayyar adonav ki Adonai itto vechal asher hu ose Adonai matzliach beyado matzliach beyado vadday ki Adonai itto

Ta chaze vayyeda adonav ki Adonai itto la ketiv ella vayyar adonav deha beenoy hava chame ovada denissin bechal yoma dekudsha berich hu avid bideh veal da vayevarech Adonai et bet hammitzri biglal yosef kudsha berich hu natir lon letzaddikaya uvginehon natar lon lerashshiaya deha rashshiaya mitbarchin beginehon detzaddikaya kegavena da ketiv vayevarech Adonai et bet oved edom haggitte baavur aron haelohim
Tzaddikaya achoranin mitbarchin beginayhu veinun la yachlu leittezena bizchutayehu veha ukmuha yosef itbarech mareh begineh veihu la yachil leishtezava bizchuteh minneh ulnafka lecheru

Ulvatar ail leh bevet hassohar kema deatte amer innu vakkevel raglo barzel baa nafsho ad dilvatar kudsha berich hu appik leh lecheru veshalteh al kal ara demitzrayim uvgin kach ketiv velo yaazov et chasidav leolam
377: Nishmaru chasido ketiv veittemar vekudsha berich hu agin alayehu detzaddikaya bealma den uvalma deate dichtiv veyismechu chal chose vach leolam yeranninu vetasech alemu veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha

Vayehi achar haddevarim haelle vattissa eshet adonav et eneha el yosef ribbi chiyya patach veamar barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro ta chaze kamma itzterich leh levar nash leistammera mechovoy ulmehach beorach mittakkena begin dela yiste leh hahu yetzer hara deihu mekatrega leh kal yoma veoma kema deittemar

Uvgin deihu mekatrega leh tadir bae bar nash leittakkefa aleh ulistalleka aleh beatar takkifu devae lemeheve gavar aleh ulishtattefa beatar digvura begin dechad var nash itkaf aleh keden ihu bistar gevura veitdabbak beh leittakkefa uvgin dehahu yetzer hara takkif bae var nash dihe takkif mineh

Veillen bene nasha deittakkefu aleh ikrun gibbore choach leishtakkecha zina im zineh veillen inun malachav dekudsha berich hu deatyan missitra digvura kashya leittakkefa aleh gibbore koach ose devaro barchu Adonai malachav keosef deikre tzaddik vegibbor venatar berit kaddisha deitreshim begaveh

Ribbi elazar amar vayehi achar haddevarim haelle may hi ha ukmuha atar da deyetzer hara mekatreg deihu darga achar haddevarim begin deosef yahav leh duchta lekatraga dehava yosef mesalsel besaareh veatkin garmeh vekashshit leh keden ityehiv duchta layetzer hara lekatrega deamar uma avoy deihu mitabbel aleh veosef mekashshit garmeh umsalsel besaareh keden itgare beh dubba vekatrig leh

Vayehi achar haddevarim haelle ta chaze bezimna dekudsha berich hu ashgach beh bealma lemedan yateh veashkach chayyavin bealma ma ketiv veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar vehaadama lo titten et yevulah uchden vaavadtem mehera deha begin chovin divne nasha shemaya veara itatzaru vela nahage nimmusehon kedeka yeut

Vetta chaze inun dela natru lehay keyama dekudsha garme perishu ben yisrael laavuhon devishmaya begin dichtiv vesartem vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem uchtiv veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar dehay ihu keman desagid lelaha achora dimshakker behay at keyama kaddisha

Vechad keyama kaddisha itnetir bealma kedeka yaot keden kudsha berich hu yahiv birchan leela leatraka bealma kema deatte amer geshem nedavot tanif elohim nachalatcha venila atta chonanta geshem nedavot da geshem diruta kad itrae kudsha berich hu bichneset yisrael uvae laaraka lah birchan keden nachalatcha venila atta chonanta

Nachalatcha inun yisrael deinun achsanteh dekudsha berich hu kema deatte amer yaakov chevel nachalato venila da keneset yisrael deihi nila beara achora deihi tzachya lemishte uchden ihi nila vechad hahu geshem diruta ityehiv keden atta konanta

Veal da shemaya veara vechal chelehon kullehu kayema al kiyyuma da dichtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti ubbegin kach bae leizdahara beda veha ukmuha uvgin kach ketiv vayehi yosef yefe toar vife mare uvatreh ketiv vattissa eshet adonav et eneha el yosef

Vayehi kedabberah elav yom yom ribbi elazar patach veamar lishmarcha meeshet ra vegv zakkain inun tzaddikayya deyade archoy dekudsha berich hu lemezal behu begin deinun mishtaddele beorayeta yemama velelya dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta yome velele achsin teren almin alma illaa vealma
378: Tattaa achsin hay alma af al gav dela itassak bah bar nash lishmah veachsin hahu alma illaa kad itassak bah bar nash lishmah

Ta chaze ma ketiv orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod orech yamim biminah man deazil limina deorayeta archa dechayyin ihu lealma deate dezache tamman likara deorayeta deihu yekara vechitra leitattera al kolla dechitra deorayeta behahu alma ihu bismolah osher vechavod behay alma deaf al gav dela itassak bah lishmah zache behay alma beutra vikara

Deha ribbi chiyya kad ata mehatam leara deyisrael kara beorayeta ad dehau anpoy nehirin keshimsha vechad hau kayemin kammeh kal inun delaan beorayeta hava amar da ishtaddal beorayeta lishmah veda la ishtaddal lishmah vehava tzalle al hahu deitassak lishmah delehve hachi tadir veyizke lealma deate vetzalle al hahu dela itassak bah lishmah deyete leitasseka bah lishmah veyizke lechayye alma

Yoma chad chama chad talmid dehava lae beorayeta veanpoy morikan amar vadday meharher becheta ihu dena achid leh lekammeh veamshich aleh bemillin deorayeta ad deityashav rucheh begaveh min hahu yoma ulhala shave al rucheh dela yirdof batar inun hirhurin bishin veyishtaddal beorayeta lishmah

Amar ribbi yose kad chame var nash dehirhurin bishin atyan legabbeh yitassak beorayeta uchden yitavrun minneh amar ribbi elazar kad hahu sitra bisha ate lemifte leh levar nash yehe mashich leh legabbe orayeta veyitperash minneh

Ta chaze deha taninan dechad hay sitra visha kayema kammeh dekudsha berich hu leastaa al alma begin ovadin bishin kudsha berich hu chas al alma veyahiv eta livne nasha leishtezava minneh vela yachil leshaltaa alehon vela al ovadehon umay ihu eta leishtaddela beorayeta veishtezavu minneh menalan dichtiv ki ner mitzva vetora or vederech chayyim tochchot musar ma ketiv batreh lishmarcha meeshet ra mechelkat lashon nachriyya

Veda hu sitra mesaava sitra achora deihi kayema tadir kammeh kudsha berich hu leastaa al chovehon divne nasha vekayema tadir leastaa letatta livni nasha kayema tadir leela begin leadkara chovehon divni nasha ulastaa lon al ovadehon uvgin deityehivu birshuteh kema deavad leh leiyyov

Vechen kayema alayehu leastaa uladkara chovehon bechal ma deavadu beinun zimnin dekudsha berich hu kayema alayehu bedina keden kaim leastaa lon uladkara chovehon vekudsha berich hu chas alayehu deyisrael veyahav lon eta leishtezava minneh uvma bashshofar beoma derosh hashshana uvoma dechippure besair hammishtalleach deyahavin leh begin leitperasha minnayehu ulishtaddela behahu chulakeh veha ukmuha

Ta chaze ma ketiv ragleha yordot mavet sheol tzeadeha yitmochu uvraza dimhemnuta ma ketiv deracheha darche noam vechal netivoteha shalom veillen inun archin ushvilin deorayeta vecholla chad hay shalom vehay mavet vecholla hippuchan da min da

Zakkaa chulkehon deyisrael deinun mitdabbekin beh bekudsha berich hu kedeka chaze veyahiv lon eta leishtezava mikkal sitrin achoranin dealma begin deinun amma kaddisha leachsanteh vechulakeh veal da yahiv lon eta becholla zakkain inun bealma den uvalma deate

Ta chaze kad hay sitra bisha nachat veshat bealma vechame ovadin divne nasha deinun kullehu satin archayehu bealma salik leela veastin lon veilmale dekudsha berich hu chayis al ovade yedoy la yishtaarun bealma
Ma ketiv vayehi kedabberah el yosef yom yom kedabberah
379: Desalka vesate bechal yoma veoma veamar kamme kudsha berich hu kamma bishin kamma diltorin begin leshetzaa beni alma

Ma ketiv velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihot immah velo shama eleha begin deihu chayis al alma lishkav etzlah mahu lishkav etzlah begin lenasva shaltanu leshalletaa al alma veshaltanu la shalta ad deityehiv leh reshu

Davar acher lishkav etzlah kema deatte amer ulish asher yishkav im temea lihot immah lemehav lah revu uvirchan vesiyyata deillemale siyyua hava lah milleela la ishtaar bealma afilu chad aval begin dekudsha berich hu chayis al alma ishtaar alma bekiyyumeh

Ribbi abba amar kolla ihu archa chada aval yetzer hara hu deka azil umfatte lon livne nasha begin leastaa archayehu ulitdabbeka behu bechal yoma veoma uvchal idan veidan sate leh levar nash mearcha dikshot begin ledachya leh mearcha dechayye leamshacha leh laggehinnom

Zakkaa ihu man deavid venatir archoy ushviloy begin dela yitdabbak beh hayenu dichtiv vayehi kedabberah el yosef yom yom velo shama eleha kemma deihi amrat leh bechal yoma deha ruach mesaava yetzer hara ihu mefatte leh levar nash bechal yoma lishkav etzlah go gehinnom ulitdana tamman lihot immah

Ta chaze kad var nash itdabbak behahu sitra itmeshach avatrah veistaav immah behay alma veistaav immah bealma achora ta chaze hay sitra mesaava menuvala ihu lichlucha ihu keddichtiv tze tomar lo tzoa mammash uveh itdan man deaste archoy min orayeta uveh itdanu inun chayyavin dealma delet lon mehemnuta bekudsha berich hu

Ma ketiv vayehi kehayyom hazze vayyavo habbayeta laasot melachto veen ish meanshe habbayit sham babbayit vayehi kehayyom hazze yoma deyetzer hara shalta bealma venachata leastaa livne nasha ematay yoma deate bar nash leatava bituvta al chovoy o leishtaddela beorayeta ulmebad pikkude deorayeta uchden behahu zimna nachata begin leastaa livne alma

Vayyavo habbayeta laasot melachto begin leishtaddela beorayeta ulmebad pikkude deorayeta deihu melachto devar nash behay alme vechevan deavidta devar nash behay alma hu avidta dekudsha berich hu bae le levar nash lemeheve takkifa kearya bechal sitroy begin dela yishlot aloy sitra achora vela yachil lemifte leh ma ketiv veen ish let gevar deyekum lekovleh deyetzer hara veyiggach beh kerava kedeka yaot

May orcheh deyetzer hara kevan dechame delet bar nash kaim lekovleh ulaggacha beh kerava miyyad vattitpesehu bevigdo lemor shichva immi vattitpesehu bevigdo begin dechad shallit yetzer hara aleh devar nash atkin leh vekashshit leh levushoy mesalsel besaareh hada hu dichtiv vattitpesehu bevigdo lemor shichva immi itdabbak immi

Man deihu zakkaa ittakkaf lekovleh veaggach beh kerava ma ketiv vayyaazov bigdo beyadah vayyanas vayyetze hachutza yishbok leh veyittakkaf lekovleh veyearok minneh begin leishtezava minneh vela yishlot aloy

Amar ribbi yitzchak zeminin inun tzaddikaya lemechome leyetzer hara kechad tura ravreva veyitmehun veyemrun ech yachilna leakkefeya leh letura ravreva haden illaa uzminin rashshiaya lemecheme leh leyetzer hara dakkik kechuta desaara veyitmehun veyemrun hech la yachilna leakkefeya lechuta desaara keda dakkik illen yivkun veillen yivkun vekudsha berich hu yevaer leh mealma veyikkos leh leenayehu vela yishlot od bealma veyechomun tzaddikaya veyechedun kema deatte amer ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha
380: Vayehi achar haddevarim haelle chatu mashke melech mitzrayim vegv ribbi yehuda patach hayishag arye bayyaar veteref en lo hayitten kefir kolo mimmeonato bilti im lachad hayishag arye bayyaar ta chaze kamma it lon livne nasha leashgacha befulchana dekudsha berich hu dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta uvfulchana dekudsha berich hu dachalteh veemateh hu al kolla deha kad bara kudsha berich hu alma avad kal biryan dealma kal chad vechad bediukneh kedeka chaze leh ulvatar bara leh levar nash bediukna illaa veshalteh al kullehu bediukna da

Dechal zimna devar nash kaim bealma kal inun biryan dealma zakfin resha umistakkelan bediukna illaa devar nash keden kullehu dachalin vezain mikkammeh kema deatte amer umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kal chayyat haaretz veal kal of hashshamayim vegv vehanne mile kad mistakkelan vechaman beh hay diukna venishmata beh

Amar ribbi elazar af al gav denishmata lav beh tzaddikaya la mishtanyan mikkema dehava deuknehon bekadmita vechad bar nash la azil bearchoy deorayeta hay diukna kaddisha itchallaf leh uchden chevat bera veofa dishmaya yachlin leshalletaa aleh begin deitchallaf leh hay diukna kaddisha itchallaf leh hay diukna devar nash

Vetta chaze kudsha berich hu achlaf ovadin dilela vetatta begin leahadara millin leatrayehu ulishtakkecha reuteh bechal ovade dealma daniyyel la ishtanne diukneh kad appilu leh beguva dearyevata uvgin kach ishteziv amar ribbi chizkiyya i hachi ha ketiv elahi shelach malacheh usagar pum aryavata vela chabbeluni mashma divgin malacha deasgar lefumayehu la itchabbal

Amar leh begin da la itchabbal deha hahu diukneh devar nash zakkaa ihu malacha mammash disgir puma vekashir lon lenatra leh dela yechabbelun leh ubbegin kach elahi shelach malacheh hahu dechal diuknin dealma mitchakkekan beh veihu atkif diukni bi vela yachilu leshaltaa bi vesagar pumayehu veal da shalach malacheh vadday

Vehay malacha hahu dechal diuknin mitchakkekan beh dichtiv yadin baggoyim male geviyyot ihu dela ishtanne kammeh kal diuknin dealma veal da mibbae leh levar nash leistammera archoy ushviloy begin dela yechota kammeh demareh veyitkayyam bediukna deadam

Ta chaze yechezkel natar pumeh mimmaachale deisure dichtiv vela ba befi besar piggul zacha veikre ben adam daniyyel ma ketiv beh vayyasem daniyyel al libbo asher la yitgaal befat bag hammelech uvyen mishtav zacha hu veitkeyyam bidiukneh deadam begin dechal millin dealma kullehu dachalin mikkamme diukna deadam deihu shallita al kullehu veihu malka al kolla

Amar ribbi yose begin da itzterich leh levar nash leistammera mechovoy vela yiste limina velismala veim kal da bae leh levar nash lemivdak bechovoy bechal yoma veoma deha kad var nash kaim mearseh teren sahadin kayemin kammeh veazle bahadeh kal yoma

Bae bar nash lemekam inun sahade amrin leh beshata deaftach enoy enecha lenochach yabbitu veafappecha yayeshiru negeddecha kam veatkin ragloy lemehach inun sahadin amrin leh palles magal raglecha vegv veal da kad azil var nash bechal yoma bae leh leistammera mechovoy

Bechal yoma veoma kad ate lelya bae leistakkela ulmivdak bechal ma deavad kal hahu yoma begin deyetuv minnayehu veyistakkel behu tadir begin deyetuv kamme mareh kema deatte amer vechattati negdi tamid begin deyetuv minnayehu
Vetta chaze bezimna dehau yisrael beara kaddisha la ishtakkach bidayehu chova kema deukmuha begin deinun karbanin dehau makrivin bechal yoma
381: Hau mechappere alayehu hashta deitgalon yisrael meara velet man dimchapper alayehu orayeta hi mechappera alayehu veovadin dechashran begin dishchinta immehon begaluta uman deihu la mistakkal bearchoy dekudsha berich hu garim lishchinta leitkafya bego afra kema deatte amer yashpilenna yashpilah ad aretz vegv
Amar ribbi yitzchak vechen man deishtaddal beorayeta uvovadin dechashran garim lah lekkeneset yisrael laarama resha bego galuta zakkaa chulakehon deinun demishtaddele beorayeta yemama velele

Ta chaze gilgel kudsha berich hu gilgulin bealma begin laarama resha detzaddikaya deha begin deyarim yosef resheh bealma al deishtakkach zakkaa kammeh argiz ribbona al avdoy kema deatte amer chatu mashke melech mitzrayim vehaofe laadonehem lemelech mitzrayim vecholla begin laarama resha deosef zakkaa vetta chaze al yeda dechelma itkafya meim achoy veal yeda dechelma itrabbe al achoy veitrabbe al kal alma

Vayyachalmu chalom shenehem ish chalomo belayela echad ish kefitron vegv ta chaze deha ittemar dechal chelmin azlin batar puma yosef kad pashar lehu chelma ammay pashar lehay pishra tava ulhay pishra bisha ella inun chelmin aleh deosef hava uvgin deyada milla al ikkara vesharsha dilah begin kach pashar chelma lehu kema deitzterich lechal chad vechad pashar lehon pishra leahadara milla al atreh

Ma ketiv vayyomer alehem yosef halo lelohim pitronim sapperu na li may tama begin dehachi mibbae leh lemifshar chelma lefakda pishra lekudsha berich hu begin detamman ihu kiyyuma decholla uveh kayema pishra
