Ta chaze ha ittemar dedarga dechelma letatta ihu veihu darga shetitaa begin deha meatar dinvua sharya ad hay darga dechelma shita dargin inun vesalka pishra middarga dechelma ledarga achora chelma ihu darga diltatta ufishra kayema alayehu ufishra kayema bedibbur veal da bedibbur kayema milla dichtiv halo lelohim pitronim halo lelohim vadday

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayesapper sar hammashkim et chalomo leosef vegv ribbi elazar patach veamar vayehi beavram veeliyyahu amar el elisha sheal ma eese lach beterem ellakach meimmach vayyomer elisha vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay hacha it leistakkala vehay kera tevaha ihu veeliyyahu amar el elisha sheal ma eese lach vechi birshuteh kayema veha birshuteh dekudsha berich hu ihu vetu deelisha hachi name ihu hava yada may tama amar vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay

Ella vadday man deachid bishmaya veara vechal almin hech la yehe birshuteh da vadday eliyyahu ushar tzaddikim kudsha berich hu avid reuthon detzaddikayya tadir dichtiv retzon yereav yaase vechal shekken dehahu rucha kaddisha di aleh yarit leh letzaddika deelisha dehava shammasha dileh veha kudsha berich hu amar leh veet elisha ben shafat meavel mechola timshach lenavi tachtecha veal da hava leh leelisha leyarta leh

Pi shenayim beruchacha may pi shenayim beruchacha elay vechi salka datach deal chad teren shail uma dela hava birshuteh hech shaal mineh ella ihu la shail ruach al chad teren ela hachi shaal mineh behahu rucha dehava leh deyaavid teren nimmusin bealma behahu rucha

Ma ketiv vayyomer hiksheta lishol im tire oti lukkach meittach yehi lecha chen veim ayin lo yihye may tama im tire oti ella amar leh im techul lemekam al ikkara derucha dishavakna lach beshata deitnasivna minach yehe lecha keden deha kal hahu ikkara derucha beshata deyistakkel beh kad chame leh leeliyyahu yeheve devekuta beh kedeka yeut
382: Ta chaze hay man deistakkal bemma deolif merabbeh vechame leh behahu chachmeta yachil leittosfa behahu rucha yattir ta chaze deha yosef bechal ma deihu avid have chame berucha dechachmeta lehahu diukna deavoy hava mistakkal uvgin kach hava mistayea leh milleta veittosfa leh rucha achora binhiru illaa yattir

Beshata deamar leh hahu rasha vehinne gefen lefanay izdaza yosef dela hava yada al ma tete milla kevan deamar uvaggefen shelosha sarigim miyyad itar rucheh veittosaf binhiru veistakkal bediukna deavoy keden itnehir rucheh veyada milla

Ma ketiv uvaggefen shelosha sarigim amar yosef ha vadday besora dechedva bishlimu ihu may tama begin dehay gefen al keneset yisrael itchaze leh veitbassar yosef behay uvaggefen shelosha sarigim illen inun telata dargin ilain denafke mehay gefen kahane levae veyisreele

Vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah deha veginehon salka keneset yisrael veitbarchat meim malka illaa hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim illen inun tzaddikaya dealma deinun kaanavim mevushalim kedeka chaze davar acher hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim da hu yayin deitnetir beinvayehu mishsheshet yeme vereshit
Ad hacha itbassar yosef bechelmeh mikkan ulhala chelma ihu dileh begin deit chelmin leh ulacharanin vaekach et haanavim deihu leh legarmeh

Taninan hay man dechame invin chivarin bechelma siman yafe lo uchame la may tama begin deihu raza ditren dargin yedian inun uchame vechivare hay ihu tav vehay ihu dela tav vechullehu invin beraza dimhemnuta talyan veal da mitparshan bechachmeta hen letav hen levish illen tzerichin rachame veillen ashgachuta derachame

Ta chaze adam harishon inteteh sachata leh invin vegarimat leh mota ulchal yisrael ulchal alma noach ata lehanne invin vela itnetar kedeka yeut ma ketiv vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch aholo behe bene aharon shatu chamra minnayehu vekarivu karbana behahu chamra umitu veha ittemar uvgin kach ketiv anavemo inve rosh ashkelot merorot lammo begin deinun invin garme hay

Chama invin deinun tavin behahu kerem deka salkin nayecha verecha bedargin shelemin kedeka yeut veal da yosef yada milla veistakkal beikkara ufashar chelma al buryeh begin deitbassar behahu chelma kedeka yeut uvgin kach pashar pishra letav veitkeyyam hachi

Ma ketiv vayyar sar haofim ki tov patar vayyomer el yosef af ani bachalomi vehinni shelosha salle chori al roshi ta chaze arurin inun rashshiaya dechal ovadehon kullehon levish vechal inun millin deinun amrin kullehu levish ulavasha

Kevan defatach pumeh beaf miyyad dachil yosef veyada dechal milloy inun leavasha uvsora devish befumeh vehinni shelosha salle chori al roshi keden yada yosef deitbassar al charivu deve makdesha veyisrael begaluta deyitgalun meara kaddisha

Chame ma ketiv uvassal haelon mikkal maachal paro maase ofe vehaof ochel otam min hassal meal roshi illen inun shear amin demitkanshe alayehu deyisrael vekatle lon vecharve vetayehu umfazzere lon learba sitre dealma vecholla istakkal yosef veyada dehahu chelma al yisrael kad yehon bechiyyuva kamme malka miyyad pashar leh pishra levish veitkeyyam beh
Vetta chaze teren dargin illen deka chama hay vechama hay da chama
383: Kad salik veka shallit darga illaa veitnehir sihara veda chama deitchashshach veshallit alah chiveya visha uvgin kach istakkal yosef behahu chelma ufashar leh pishra levish veal da kolla befishra kayema veda veda chamu beillen teren dargin deshallit da veshallit da

Ribbi yehuda patach lev tahor bera li elohim veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi hay kera ukmuha aval lev tahor kema deatte amer venatatta leavdecha lev shomea vegv uchtiv vetov lev mishte tamid uvgin kach lev tahor vadday

Veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi da hu ruach nachon vadday kema deatte amer veruach elohim merachefet al peni hammayim veitaru ze rucho shel mashiach veitaru veruach chadasha etten bekirbechem vetzalle david hahu ruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi

Begin deit missitra achora lev tame veruach iveim deaste livne alma veda hu ruach tuma deikre ruach iveim kema deatte amer Adonai masach bekirbah ruach iveim veal da veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi may chaddesh da chiddusha desihara beshata deitchaddash sihara david melech yisrael chay vekayyam uvgin kach chaddesh

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose hau azle vearcha amar ribbi yose leribbi elazar hay dichtiv vayyetze haruach vayyaamod lifne Adonai vayyomer ani afattennu vayyomer Adonai elav bemma vayyomer etze vehayiti ruach sheker befi kal neviav vayyomer tefatte vegam tuchal tze vaase chen vetaninan dehava ruach navot hayyizreeli vechi nishmatin kevan desalkin vekayemin leela inun yachlin leatava behay alma umilla temiha deamar etze vehayiti ruach sheker befi vegv

Vetu may tama itanash aleh achav deha dina deorayeta deshave shemuel kammayehu deyisrael hachi hu dichtiv et sedotechem vecharmechem vezetechem hattovim yikkach vei achav natal hahu kerm benavot dina hava vetu dehava yahiv leh karma achora o dahava vela vaa

Amar leh yaot shealte ta chaze hay ruach dekaamru deihu ruach denavot hacha it leistakkala vechi rucha denavot yachil lesalleka ulkayema kammeh dekudsha berich hu lemitba shikra dichtiv vayyetze haruach vei tzaddika hu ech yibbae shikra behahu alma deihu alma dikshot uma behay alma la vae zakkaa shikra behahu alma la chal shekken vei lav zakkaa ihu hech yachil lekayema kamme kudsha berich hu

Ella vadday navot lav zakkaa hava kal kach lekayema kamme kudsha berich hu ella rucha achora hava deshalta bealma deda hu rucha dekayema tadir vesalka kamme kudsha berich hu veda hu deaste livni alma beshikra uman deihu ragil beshikra ishtaddal tadir beshikra veal da amar etze vehayiti ruach sheker vegv veal da kudsha berich hu amar leh tze vaase chen puk mehacha kema deukmuha dichtiv dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay uvgin da ihu ruach sheker vadday

Vetu al ma dekatal leh lenavot venatal karma dileh katula ammay katil leh ella al dekatil leh bela dina itannash katal leh bela dina venasiv karma dileh uvgin kach ketiv haratzachta vegam yarashta veal da itannash vetta chaze kamma inun bene nasha bealma deaste lon hay ruach shikra beshikra veshallit ihu bealma bechamma sitrin uvchamma ovadin veha okimna mille

Veal da david malka baa leistamra minneh vvaa leafaka miggo mesaavu dichtiv lev tahor bera li elohim veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi da hu ruach nachon veachora ihu ruach sheker veal da teren dargin inun chad kaddisha vechad mesaava

Patach veamar vayeya natan kolo lifne chelo ki rav meod machanihu vechi atzum ose devaro vegv hay kera ukmuha aval vayeya bechal atar hu uve dineh natan kolo da hu kala dichtiv kol devarim uchtiv hatam lo ish devarim man ish devarim kema deatte amer ish haelohim lifne chelo illen inun yisrael
Ki rav meod machanehu kema deatte amer hayesh mispar ligdudav
384: Dechamma memannan ushlichan it leh lekudsha berich hu vechullehu kayeme leastaa alayehu deyisrael veal da kudsha berich hu izdamman kammayehu deyisrael begin lenatra lehu vela yachilu lekatrega lehu

Ki atzum ose devaro man atzum da hu zakkaa hahu deishtaddal beorayeta kaddisha yemama velele davar acher ki atzum da hu mekatrega deishtakkach kamme kudsha berich hu veihu takkifa kefarzela takkifa ketinara ose devaro denatil reshut milleela venatil nishmata mittatta

Ki gadol yom Adonai venora meod umi yechilennu deihu shallit al kolla veillaa vetakkifa al kullehu vechullehu techot shaltaneh zakkain inun tzaddikayya dekudsha berich hu itrae behu tadir lezakkaa lon lealma deate ulmechede lehu bechedu detzaddikaya dizminin lemechode beh bekudsha berich hu dichtiv veyismechu chal chose vach leolam yeranninu vetasech alemo veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha baruch Adonai leolam amen vamen
385: Kullehu achidan begufa deilana ubbegin kach man deishtaddal beorayeta ihu achid becholla veha ukmuha veittemar

Vayehi mikketz may mikketz ribbi shimon amar atar delet bah zechira veda hu ketz dismala may tama begin dichtiv ki im zechartani ittecha kaasher yitav lach vechi hachi itchaze leh leosef tzaddika deihu amar ki im zechartani ittecha ella kevan deistakkal yosef bechelmeh amar vadday chelma dizchira ihu veihu taa behay deha beh bekudsha berich hu have cholla

Veal da atar dehava beh nashu kam kammeh ma ketiv velo zachar sar hammashkim et yosef vayyishkachehu kevan deamar velo zachar sar hammashkim mahu vayyishkachehu ella vayyishkachehu atar deit beh shichcha veda hu ketz desitra dechoshech shenatayim yamim may shenatayim detav darga ledarga deit beh zechira
Ufaro cholem vehinne omed al hayeor da chelma deosef hava begin dechal nahar deosef hatztzaddik ihu veraza da have hay man dechame nahar bachalom chame shalom dichtiv hinni note eleha kenahar shalom

Vayehi mikketz shenatayim ribbi chiyya patach veamar melech bammishpat yaamid eretz veish terumot yehersenna ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma illaa atkin kolla kedeka yeut veappik nehorin illain menaharin lechal sitrin vecholla ihu chad uvara shamayim dilela veeretz dilela leittakna kullehu kechada letoalta detattae

Ta chaze melech bammishpat yaamid eretz man melech da kudsha berich hu bammishpat da yaakov deihu kiyyuma deara veal da ittezan min Adonai illaa Adonai tattaa ittezanat min dekiyyuma deara ihu bemishpat deha mishpat yaamid ertz bechal tikkunoy vezan lah

Davar acher melech da kudsha berich hu bammishpat da yosef yaamid eretz dichtiv vechal haaretz bau mitzrayema lishbor el yosef uvgin dekudsha berich hu itrae beh beyaakov avad leh leosef shallita al ara

Ribbi yose amar melech da yosef bammishpat yaamid eretz da yaakov deha ad la ata yaakov lemitzrayim la hava kiyyuma beara miggo kafna kevan deata yaakov lemitzrayim bizchuteh istallak kafna veitkeyyam ara
Davar acher melech bammishpat yaamid eretz da david malka dichtiv vayehi david ose mishpat utzdaka lechal ammo veihu kiyyem ara uvizchuteh kayema levatar dena veish terumot yehersenna da rechavam

Ta chaze kudsha berich hu beginehon detzaddikaya af al gav defuranuta itgezar al alma mitakkeva beginehon vela shalta al alma kal yomoy dedavid malka itkayema ara begineh levatar demit itkayema bizchuteh dichtiv vegannoti al hair hazzot lehoshiah lemaani ulmaan david avdi kegavena da kal yomoy deyaakov vechal yomoy deosef la shalta puranuta bealma

Ta chaze melech bammishpat yaamid eretz da yosef veish terumot yehersenna da paro deha begin deakshe libbeh legabbe dekudsha berich hu chariv ara demitzrayim uvkadmita al yeda deosef itkeyyam ara behahu chelma dechalam dichtiv vayehi mikketz shenatayim yamim vegv

Vayehi mikketz vegv ribbi elazar patach veamar chay Adonai uvaruch tzuri veyarum elohe yishi elohe ketiv beyv hay kera it leistakkala beh chay Adonai da chay tzaddika yesoda dealma deikre chay dealmin uvaruch tzuri da hu dichtiv baruch Adonai tzuri veda alma deitkeyyam aleh tzaddika da veyarum elohe yishi veyarum da alma illaa elohe bev da shamayim kema deatte amer hashshamayim shamayim layeya
Ta chaze baruch adonay yom yom yaamas lanu baruch adonay bealef dalet nun yud vehay kera raza dechachmeta ihu yom yom ellu shenatayim yamim kema deatte amer
386: Vayehi mikketz shenatayim yamim ufaro cholem vehinne omed al hayeor raza ihu kema deittemar da yosef denahar da yosef hatztzaddik hu

Vehinne min hayeor olot sheva parot yefot mare uvriot basar vattirena baachu vehinne min hayeor deha minnahar da itbarchan kal inun dargin diltatta begin dehahu nahar denagid venafik ihu ashke vezan lecholla veosef ihu nahar leitbarcha kal ara demitzrayim begineh

Vetta chaze hahu nahar sheva dargin itshakyan veitbarchan minneh veillen inun yefot mare uvriot basar vattirena baachu bechibbura beachvata dela ishtakkach behu piruda vechullehu leshabbacha kayemin deha kal hanne dargin sheva dekaamaran raza ihu kema deatte amer veet sheva hannearot haruot latet lah mibbet hammelech vegv veal da sheva parot yefot mare velakovel da ketiv shivat hassarisim hamshartim et pene hammelech vegv
Ribbi yitzchak amar sheva parot hattovot dargin inun illain al achoranin vesheva happarot haraot dargin achoranin diltatta illen missitra dikdusha veillen missitra dimsaava

Amar ribbi yitzchak af al gav deittemar dela achzeyan leh levar nash ella behahu darga dileh shani limlachim deachzeyan lon millin illain umshanyan mibbene nasha achoranin kema demalka dargeh illaa al kal shear achoranin hachi name achaziu leh bedarga illaa al kal shear achoranin kema deatte amer et asher haelohim ose hera et paro aval lishar bene nasha la gale lon kudsha berich hu ma deihu avad bar linvie o lachaside o lechakkime dara veha ukmuha
Ta chaze ketiv oti heshiv al kanni veoto tala mikkan dechelma azil batar pishra heshiv al kanni man ella da yosef veoto tala behahu pishra deka pashar leh uchtiv vayehi kaasher patar lanu ken haya

Vayyishlach paro vayyikra et yosef vayeritzuhu min habbor vegv ribbi abba patach veamar rotze Adonai et yereav et hamyachalim lechasdo kamma kudsha berich hu itrae behu betzaddikaya begin detzaddikaya inun avdin shelama leela veavde shelama letatta veaolin kalla bevaalah uvgin kach kudsha berich hu itrae behu beinnun dedachalin leh veavdin reuteh

Lamyachalim lechasdo man inun meyachalim lechasdo hve ema inun demishtaddele beorayeta belelya veishtattefu bahade shechinta vechad ate tzafra inun mechakkan lechasdo veha ukmuha bezimna devar nash ishtaddal beorayeta belelya chuta dechesed itmeshich aleh bimama kedichtiv yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo uvalayela shiro immi may tama yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo mishshum devallayela shiro immi ubbegin kach rotze Adonai et yereav ketiv velo vireav keman derae biruteh leachara veitree leh leitpayesa bahadeh uvgin kach rotze Adonai et yereav velo bireav

Kegavena da yosef hava atziv baatzivu derucha baatzivu delibba dehava asir tamman kevan deshaddar paro begineh ma ketiv vayeritzuhu itpayesu leh veahadaru leh millin dechedva millin lemechede libba begin dehava atziv min bera ta chaze bekadmita nafal bevera bevera istallak levatar

Ribbi shimon amar ad la era leosef hahu ovada la ikre tzaddik kevan denatar hahu berit kayyama ikre tzaddik vehahu darga divrit kaddisha itattar bahadeh umay dehava babbor bekadmita istallak bahadeh uchtiv vayeritzuhu min habbor istallak min da veitattar biver mayim chayyim

Vayyishlach paro vayyikra et yosef likro leosef mibbae leh ella vayyikra et yosef da kudsha berich hu dichtiv ad et bo devaro imrat Adonai tzerafathu ad et bo devaro hada hu dichtiv vayykra et yosef ketiv hacha vayyikra et yosef uchtiv hatam vayyikra el moshe vayegallach vayechallef simlotav begin yekara demalka veha ukmuha
Ribbi elazar patach vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim veyaakov gar beeretz cham ta chaze dekudsha berich hu megalgel gilgulin bealma umkayyem esarin vekiyyumin begin lekayema kiyyuma ugzera deihu gazir

Deha tenan illemale chavivu urchimu derachim kudsha berich hu laavahan hava itchaze lenachata yaakov lemitzrayim beshalshele defarzela uvirchimu dilhon shalteh leosef bereh veavad leh malka deshallita al kal ara venachatu kullehu shivtin bikara veyaakov kemalka

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim veyaakov gar beeretz cham kevan dichtiv vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim la yedana deyaakov gar beeretz cham ammay itzterich ha ella vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim da kudsha berich hu veyaakov gar beeretz cham da yaakov deha begineh deyaakov uvnoy ata shechinta lemitzrayim vekudsha berich hu gilgel gilgulin
388: Veachit leh leosef bekadmita devizchuteh itkeyyam berit bahadeh veshalteh al kal ara

Ma ketiv shalach melech vayyattirehu moshel ammim vayefattechehu ribbi shimon amar ketiv Adonai mattir asurim vegv vehacha ketiv shalach melech vayyattirehu ammay moshel ammim vayefattechehu ella shalach melech da kudsha berich hu moshel ammim da kudsha berich hu shalach melech melech illaa shalach vayyattiyirihu uman ihu deshalach da malach haggoel deihu moshel ammim deihu moshel al tattae vecholla meim kudsha berich hu ihu

Vayeritzuhu chaser uman ihu da kudsha berich hu begin deha let man deasir ufattach bar kudsha berich hu dichtiv yisgor al ish velo yippateach uchtiv vehu yashkit umi yarshia veyaster panim umi yeshurennu veal goy veal adam yachad deha kolla beh uchtiv uchmitzbeyeh aved bechel shemaya vedayere ara vela itay di yemache videh veyemar leh ma avadte uvgin kach ketiv vayeritzuhu min habbor vegv

May vayeritzuhu kema deatte amer yetar el eloha vayyirtzehu kegavena da vayeritzuhu min habbor ulvatar vayyavo el paro davar acher vayeritzuhu deamshich aleh chuta dechesed lemehav leh chinna kammeh defaro elohim yaane et shelom paro begin leakdama leh shalom ulmiftach beshalom

Ribbi abba amar ta chaze behahu rasha defaro deihu amar lo yadati et Adonai ufaro chakkim hava mikkal chorashoy ella vadday shema deelohim hava yada deha ketiv hanimtza chaze ish asher ruach elohim bo uvgin demoshe la ata legabbeh ella bishma dayeya velo bishma deelohim veda hava kashya kameh mikkolla deihu hava yada deha shema da ihu shallit beara uvishma dayeya la hava yada veal da kashya kammeh shema da
Veda hu dichtiv vayechazek Adonai et lev paro demilla da hava atkif libbeh veakshe leh veal da moshe lo oda leh milla dishma achora ela shema dayeya bilchodoy veukmuha

Patach veamar mi kayeya elokenu hammagbihi lashavet vegv mi kayeya elokenu hammagbihi lashavet deistallak meal karse yekareh vela itgeli letatta beshata dela ishtakkachu zakkain bealma ha ihu istallak minnayehu vela itgeli lehu hammashpili lirot beshata dezakkain inun deishtakkachu bealma kudsha berich hu nachit bedargoy lekivlehon detattae leashgacha al alma leotava lehu
Deha kad zakkain la ishtakkachu bealma ihu istallak veastir anpin minnayehu velo ashgach alayehu begin detzaddikayya inun yesoda vekiyyuma dealma dichtiv vetzaddik yesod olam

Veal da kudsha berich hu la galle shemeh kaddisha bar leyisrael bilchodoy deinun chulak adveh veachsanteh vealma palig leh kudsha berich hu limmannan terisin veha ittemar dichtiv behanchel elon goyim vegv uchtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato
Ribbi chiyya veribbi yose hau azle vearcha amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyya tevahna al hay dekaamar shelomo kal milloy setimin vela ityadun deha kohelet satim setimin

Patach veamar kal haddevarim yegeim lo yuchal ish ledabber lo tisba ayin lirot velo timmale ozen mishmoa kal haddevarim yegeim vechi kal haddevarim yegeim inun lemallala dekaamar lo yuchal ish ledabber velo tisba ayin lirot velo timmale ozen mishmoa may tama illen ella begin ditren minhon veinun ayenin veudnin la kayyamin birshuteh devar nash ufuma ihu birshuteh vechal illen telat la yachlin leashlama kolla uladbaka kolla

Amar ribbi chiyya hachi hu dedibbura devar nash la yachil lemallala veayenin lemecheme veudnin lemishma veen kal chadash tachat hashshemesh vetta chaze afilu biryan vekastorin deavad kudsha berich hu tachat hashshemesh la yachlin lemallala kal millin dealma veena la yachil

Vetta chaze kal ovadin dealma bechamma kasterin talyan vechal bene alma la yadin vela mashgichin al ma kayeme bealma veafilu shelomo malka dehava chakkim mikkal bene alma la yachil lekayema behu

Patach veamar et hakkol asa yafe beitto gam et haolam natan belibbam mibbeli asher lo yimtza haadam et hammaase asher asa haelohim vegv ta chaze zakkain inun demishtaddele beorayeta veyade leistakkala berucha dechachmata et hakkol asa yafe beitto kal ovadin deavad kudsha berich hu bealma bechal ovada veovada it darga memanna al hahu ovada bealma hen letav hen levish minnehon dargin limina uminhon dargin lismala azil bar nash limina hahu ovada deavid hahu darga memanna lehahu sitra veavid leh siyyua vechamma inun dimsayee leh azal bar nash lismala veavid ovadoy hahu ovada deavid memanna ihu lehahu sitra veka mekatreg leh veovil leh lehahu sitra veaste leh ubbegin kach hahu ovada deavid bar nash kedeka chaze hahu memanna distar yemina ka mesayyea leh veda hu beitto yafe beitto dehahu ovada mitkashshera beitto kedeka chaze leh

Gam et haolam natan belibbam kal alma vechal ovadoy dealma lav inun ella biruta delibba kad salik biruta devar nash zakkain innun tzaddikayya deamshichu ovadin tavin leotava lon ulchal alma veinun yadin leitdabbeka beet shalom uvchela ditzdaka deavdin letatta inun mashchin lehahu darga deikre kal leanhara beitto
Vay lon lechayyavaya dela yadin et dehahu ovada vela mashgichin lemebad ovadehon bealma al tikkuna deitzterich leh lealma ulatkana ovada behahu darga deitchaze leh may tama begin dela yadin

Veal da ityehiv kolla biruthon divne nasha dichtiv mibbeli asher lo yimtza haadam et hammaase asher asa haelohim merosh vead sof uvgin kach deinun ovadin la itavidu leatkana bedargayehu kidkachaze deyitkelil ovada da bedarga da kolla ketikkuna ella kefum reuta devar nash ma ketiv batreh yadati ki en tov bam ki im lismoach velaasot tov bechayyav yadati ki en tov bam beinun ovadin dela itavidu kedeka yeut ki im lismoach bechal ma deyete aloy ulmehav hodaa lekudsha berich hu velaasot tov bechayyav deha i hahu ovada garim leh bisha begin hahu darga deka memanna aloy it leh lemechode beh ulodaa aleh deihu garim leh lenafsheh veihu azil bela yedia ketzifora da bego kustira

Vechal da menalan dichtiv ki gam lo yeda haadam et itto kaddagim shenneechazim bimtzoda raa vechatztzipporim haachuzot bappach kahem yukashim bene haadam leet raa keshettippol alehem pitom ki gam lo yada haadam et itto may itto itto dehahu ovada deka avid kema deatte amer et hakkol asa yafe beitto uvgin kach inun katztzipporim haachuzot bappach uvgin kach zakkain inun demishtaddele beorayeta veyade orchoy ushviloy deorayeta demalka illaa lemehach bah beorach keshot

390: Ribbi chiyya amar paro baa lenassaa leh leosef veachlaf leh chelma veosef begin dehava yada dargin istakkal bechal milla umilla veamar kach chamita kal milla umilla kedeka chaze

Ma ketiv bedaniyyel edayin ledaniyyel bechezva di lelya raza gali bechezva di lelya man chezva di lelya da gavriel deihu chezva chezu min chezu

Ta chaze ma ketiv vehinne kevod eloke yisrael ba midderech hakkadim vekolo kekol mayim rabbim vehaaretz heira mikkevodo ma ketiv batreh uchmare hammare asher raiti bevoi leshachet et hair umarot kammare asher raiti el nehar kevar vaeppol el panay kal illen marot inun shit deinun marot vechezu dechezva chezu it leh leitchazaa beh gevanin dilela veitchazun behahu chezu veit chezu lechezu vechezu lechezu da al da vechullehu kayemin bedargin yedian veshalte veikrun chezu delelya uvhu mitparshin kal chelmin dealma veillen inun kegavena dilela alayehu
Ubbegin kach daniyyel bechezva delelya raza gali itgeli la ketiv ella raza gali chad meillen dargin galle leh hahu chelma ufishreh aval yosef miggo milloy defaro istakkal bedargin illain vekaamar

Uvgin kach pakdeh al kal ara demitzrayim begin dekudsha berich hu middileh deosef ka yahiv leh puma dela nashak laavera ketiv veal picha yishshak kal ami yada dela kariv laavera ketiv vayyitten otah al yad yosef tzavar dela kariv laavera ketiv vayyasem revid hazzahav al tzavaro gufa dela kariv laavera vayyalbesh oto bigde shesh regel dela rachiv laavera ketiv vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne asher lo hammachashava dela chashav nikra navon vechacham lev shello hirher vayyikreu lefanav avrech vecholla middileh natal

Ma ketiv vayyetze yosef millifni faro vayyaavor bechal eretz mitzrayim amar ribbi chizkiyya may tama vayyaavor bechal eretz mitzrayim begin leshaltaa demachreze kamme hachi uvgin lemichnash ibbura bechal atar vaatar ribbi elazar amar kanash yosef ibur bechal atar begin dela yitrakkav

Amar ribbi shimon kal ma deavad kudsha berich hu kolla ihu legalgela gilgulin begin devae lekayema kiyyuma ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma ayete kal ma deitzterich alma bekadmita ulvatar ayete leh levar nash lealma veashkach mezona

Kegavena da kudsha berich hu amar leavraham yadoa teda ki ger yihye zaracha beeretz lo lahem vegv veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol kad ata yosef leara demitzrayim la ishtechach bah rechush gadol gilgel gilgulin veayete kafna al alma vechal alma hau mayetin kaspa vedahava lemitzrayim veitmele chal ara demitzrayim kaspa vedahava levatar deittakkan kolla rechush gadol ayete yaakov lemitzrayim
Dehachi arche dekudsha berich hu bekadmita bare asvata ulvatar mache kach bekadmita atkin rechush gadol ulvatar
391: Ayete lon legaluta veal da gilgel gilgulin veayete kafna al kal alma begin delehu mayetin kaspa vedahava kal alma lemitzrayim

Ta chaze begin yosef deihu tzaddik ihi garim utra kaspa vedahava lenatla yisrael kedichtiv vayyotziem bechesef vezahav veen bishvatav koshel umin yeda detzaddik ata da leyisrael vecholla lemizke lon lealma deate
Patach veamar ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta vegv ta chaze hay kera beraza illaa ihu veukmuha ree chayyim illen chayyin dealma deate dezachaa hu bar nash dezache beh kedeka yeut
Im ishsha asher ahavta da keneset yisrael begin devah ketiv ahava dichtiv veahavat olam ahavticha ematay beshata desitra dimina achid bah dichtiv al ken meshachtich chased

Kal yeme chayye hevlecha begin deihi itkashsherat bachayyim veihi olam dechayyin sharyan beh deha alma da la sharyan beh chayyim begin deinun tachat hashshemesh vela matan hacha inun nehorin dehahu shimsha veistallaku mealma miyyoma deitchariv be makdesha dichtiv chashach hashshemesh betzeto vegv may chashach hashshemesh desalik nehoreh vela nahir kema deatte amer hatztzaddik avad vegv
Ki hu chelkecha bachayyim da hu shimsha besihara uvinan lemeal sihara beshimsha veshimsha besihara dela leafrasha lon veda hu chulaka devar nash lemeal behu lealma deate

Ma ketiv batreh kal asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashol asher atta holech shamma hay kera it leistakkala beh kal asher timtza yadcha laasot vechi huttera retzua lemebad bar nash kal ma deyachil ella laasot bechochacha ketiv may bechochacha da nishmateh devar nash deihi chela devar nash lemizke vah lealma den ulalma deate
Davar acher bechochacha da hi ishsha dekaamaran deihi chela leittakfa bah bealma den uvalma deate uvae bar nash lemizke vah behay alma behay chela begin deyittakkaf bah behahu alma

May tama begin dilvatar deyippuk bar nash mehay alma let beh chela lemebad midi velomar hashta mikkan ulhala aavid ovadin tavin devadday en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashol asher i la zache bar nash behay alma la yizke beh levatar behahu alma veukmuha man dela atkin zevadin lemehach mehay alma la yechul behahu alma veit ovadin tavin deavid bar nash behay alma deyechul minnayehu hacha vecholla ishtaar lealma deate ulittezena minnayehu
Ta chaze yosef zacha behay alma vezacha bealma deate begin devaa leitachada beishsha yirat Adonai kema deatte amer vechatati lelohim uvgin kach zacha lemishlat behay alma vezacha lon leyisrael

Ma ketiv vayelakket yosef et kal hakkesef vehachi itchaze deha hahu nahar denagid venafik ihu lakit kolla vechal utra beh kayema veda hi raza dichtiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim vecholla ihu kedeka yeut vadday yosef bae lemishlat al malchuta

Vetta chaze ketiv vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne man mirkevet hammishne kudsha berich hu avid leh latztzaddik shallita begin deha minneh ittezan alma veitzterich leittezana vekudsha berich hu it leh reticha illaa veit leh reticha tattaa reticha tattaa ihi mirkevet hammishne veosef tzaddik ikre veleh itchaze lemehve rachiv al mirkevet hammishne asher lo lekudsha berich hu vecholla ihu beraza ilaa lemeheve kegavena dilela
Ta chaze vayyikreu lefanav avrech may avrech keshiru deitkashshar shimsha besihara vecholla karin lakovel atar da venaton oto al kal alma vechullehu odan legabbeh

Ta chaze kudsha berich hu avad malchuta deara keen malchuta dirkia vecholla da kegavena da vechal ma deitavid beara kayema kamme kudsha berich hu bekadmita ta chaze malchuta kaddisha la kabbil malchuta shelemata ad deitchabbar baavahan begin dekudsha berich hu avad lah lemalchu illaa leitnahara meraza deavahan

Vechad yosef hatztzaddik nachat lemitzrayim bekadmita ihu mashich lah lishchinta levatar immeh deha shechinta la azla ella batra detzaddik uvgin kach itmeshach yosef lemitzrayim bekadmita venatil kal utra dealma kedeka yeut ulvatar nachatat shechinta lemitzrayim vechullehu shivtin bahadah

Uvgine kach yosef denatar leh labberit zacha leitattera beatreh vezacha lemalchuta dilela ulmalchuta diltatta veal da kal man denatar berit kaddisha keilu kiyyem orayeta kaddisha kola deha berit shakil kechal orayeta

Vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim vayyomer yaakov levanav vegv ribbi chiyya patach veamar massa devar Adonai al yisrael neum Adonai note shamayim veosed aretz veotzer ruach adam bekirbo hay kera it leistakkala beh massa devar Adonai bechal hanne atar dekaamar massa massa ammay ella bechal atar deihu al dina dishar ammin veamar massa letav bechal atar deihu al yisrael veamar massa levish

Bechal atar deihu al dina dishar amin letav begin demassa matula ihu kivyachol matula ihu aleh dekudsha berich hu shalom deammin ovde kochavim umazzalot vechad itgezar dina alayehu maavar minneh hahu matula deihu savil alayehu bechal atar dedina itgezar alayehu deyisrael veamar massa kivyachol matula ihu aleh dekudsha berich hu ubbegin kach massa mehay gisa umehay gisa matula ihu

Kevan deamar note shamayim veosed aretz ammay itzterich veotzer ruach adam bekirbo vechi la havena yade deihu yotzer ruach adam ella leachazaa darga yedia dechal ruchin venishmatin dealma behahu darga kayemin

Ribbi shimon amar hay kera kashya i amar veotzer ruach adam vela yattir yaot aval bekirbo mahu ella raza ihu bitren sitrin deha mehahu nahar denagid venafik mittamman nafke ufarche nishmatin kullehu veitkenishu beatar chad vehahu darga ihu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo vehay keitteta deitabbera min dechura vehahu velada tzarat lah bimaha ad deitztayyer kolla betziyyura shelimu bimaha kach veotzer ruach adam bekirbo bekirbo kayema ad deitbere bar nash bealma veyahiv leh

Davar acher veotzer ruach adam bekirbo bekirbo deadam mammash begin dechad itbere var nash vekudsha berich hu yahav leh nishmateh venafik laavira dealma hahu rucha divgaveh la ashkach gufa leitpashsheta begaveh vekayema besitra chad begaveh

Vechad bar nash itpashat gufeh hahu rucha itpashshat veyahiv beh chela vechen kegavena degufa itrabbe hachi rucha yahiv chela beh leittakkefa bar nash bahadeh uvgin kach yotzer ruach adam bekirbo mammash
Vei tema yotzer ruach adam mahu begin dehahu rucha itzterich chela dilela yattir leistayea bahadeh veal da kudsha berich hu ihu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo veyahiv leh siyyua bevar nash
Ta chaze kad hahu rucha itzterich siyyua kegavena deihu hahu bar nash uchgavena dehahu gufa ittakkan hachi name hahu rucha metaknin leh veosfin leh rucha leittakkena veda hu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo
Vetta chaze kevan deitavid yosef meavoy yaakov avid hahu tosefet rucha dehava leh veistallekat minneh shechinta levatar ma ketiv vattechi ruach yaakov avihem vechi ad hashta
393: Mit hava ella hahu tosefet rucha istallak minneh shechinta vela hava begaveh begin deitzvona dehava beh garma leh la hava rucheh bekiyyumeh uvgin kach vattechi ruach yaakov avihem
Vehacha dead kean la itbassar mena hava yada ella vayyar yaakov dechama lechal dayere ara deazle lemitzrayim umayetan ibbura
Ribbi yitzchak amar ta chaze david malka zacha leitchabbera baavahan veyarit duchteh begavayehu hada hu dichtiv even maasu habbonim hayeta lerosh pinna

Ribbi yesa veribbi chizkiyya hau azle mikkappotkiyya lelod vehava immehon chad yuday bematul dekaftira dechamra ad dehau azle amar ribbi yesa leribbi chizkiyya aftach pumach veema chad milla meinun mile maalyata deorayeta deatte amer bechal yoma kamme butzina kaddisha

Patach veamar deracheha darche noam vechal netivoteha shalom deracheha darche noam illen archin deorayeta deman deazil bearche deorayeta kudsha berich hu ashre aleh neimuta dishchinta di la taade minneh lealmin vechal netivoteha shalom dechullehu netivin deorayeta kullehu shelam shelam leh leela shelam leh letatta shelam leh bealma den shelam leh bealma deate

Amar hahu yuday isira bekistera behay kera ishtakkach amru leh minayin lach amar lon meabba shemana veolifna hacha behay kera milla patach veamar hay kera bitren gevanin ihu uvitren sitrin kare beh derachim vekare beh netivot kare beh noam vekare beh shalom man derachim uman netivot man noam uman shalom

Ella deracheha darche noam hayenu dichtiv hannoten bayyam darech deha bechal atar deikre beorayeta derech hu orach peticha lecholla kehay archa deihu petiach lechal bar nash kach deracheha darche noam ilen derachim deinun petichan meavahan decharan beyamma rabba vealin begaveh umeinun orchin mitpattechin lechal evar ulchal sitre alma

Vehay noam hu neimu denafak mealma deate umealma deate naharin kal butzinin umitparshan lechal evar vehahu tivu vehahu nehora dealma deate deyankin avahan ikre noam davar acher alma deate ikre noam vechad itar alma deate kal chedu vechal tivu vechal nehorin vechal cheru dealma itar uvgini kach ikre noam

Veal da taninan chayyavin degehinnom beshata deal shabbatta nayechin kullehu veit lehu cherut venayecha beshata denafik shabbatta it lan leitara chedu illaa alana denishteziv mehahu onasha dechayyavaya deitdanu mehahi shata ulhala veit lan leitara velema vihi noam Adonai elokenu alenu da hu noam illaa chedu decholla veal da deracheha darche noam

Vechal netivoteha shalom man netivoteha illen inun shevilin denafkin milleela vechullehu nakit lon berit yechiday deihu ikre shalom shelama deveta veail lon leyama rabba kad ihu betukfeh uchden yahiv leh shelama hada hu dichtiv vechal netivoteha shalom ta chaze yosef berit shalom hava vehava bemitzrayim malka veshallit al ara veyaakov begin deistallak minneh shechinta la hava yada

Veim kal da yaakov hava leh tavra begin lemizban ibbura bemitzrayim vechama deihu tevira al tevira deyechatun benoy lemitzrayim vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau begin dela tachamun gufayechu ella kirevin keguvrin delet lon sava
Amar ribbi chizkiyya vadday raza hacha deha bechal zimna detzaara ihu bealma la bae bar nash leachazaa garmeh beshuka begin dela yittafes bechovoy veal da amar lamma titrau veha ittemar
Davar acher vayyar yaakov ki yesh
394: Shever bemitzrayim ibbur mammash deha kudsha berich hu al da shaddar kafna bealma begin lenachata leyaakov uvnoy letamman veal da chama bene ara dehau mayetin mittamman ibbur

Vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim beshata demit yitzchak atu yaakov veesav lemiflag veesav nafak mechulakeh deara umikkolla veyaakov deyisbol galuta yittol kolla veal da chama hahu tevira dehava leh bemitzrayim hu uvnoy lemisbal galuta veal da vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau mikkame dina dilela dela yishtakkach alayechu mekatrega vayyomer hinne shamati ki yesh shever bemitzrayim redu shamma ha ukmuha chushban da hau yisrael bemitzrayim

Veosef hu hashshallit al haaretz vegv ribbi yesa patach veamar veatta yarum roshi al oyevay sevivotay veezbecha beaholo zivche terua ashira vaazammera layeya ta chaze kad kudsha berich hu itrae beh bevar nash zakif leh al kal bene alma veavid leh resha decholla vechullehu sanoy itkafyan techotoy

David malka sanu leh achoy dachu leh minnayehu kudsha berich hu arim leh al kal bene alma ata chamoy arak mikkameh kudsha berich hu arim leh al kal malchuteh vechullehu hau karin vesagdin kammeh veosef dachu leh achuy levatar kullehu karu usgidu kammeh hada hu dichtiv vayyavou ache yosef vayyishtachau lo appayim artza
Davar acher veatta yarum roshi may veatta kemo veatta ribbi yehuda amar ha ittemar et deihu darga illaa uman ihu hahu et da veikre atta veatta da ihu uve dineh

Yarum roshi laarama lah bikara umalchuta al oyevay sevivotay illen shear malche ara veezbecha beaholo da yerushala beaholo da ohel moed zivche terua lemishma kal alma ashira vaazammera mehahu sitra ditrua hi deha mittamman mehahu sitra ditrua hi atya shira vetushbachta

Davar acher veatta yarum roshi da keneset yisrael al oyevay sevivotay da esav vechal afarchin dileh veezbecha beaholo illen yisrael zivche terua dichtiv zivche elohim ruach nishbara begin leaavara dina mealma ashira vaazammera leodaa ulshabbecha lekudsha berich hu bela pesiku leolam

Davar acher veatta yarum roshi becholla yetzer tov al yetzer ra dichtiv al oyevay sevivotay da yetzer hara deihu sacharaneh devar nash veihu saneh becholla veezbecha veaholo zivche terua da orayeta deityehivat missitra deeshsha kedichtiv mimino esh dat lamo deha begin orayeta yarum resheh veittavru kal sanoy kodamoy kedichtiv tachria kamay tachtay

Davar acher veatta yarum roshi leitkelala baavahan deha david malka it leh leitdabbaka baavahan uchden yitromem vesalik leela veihu bechad kishshura behu al oyevay sevivotay illen inun devistar semala kullehu mare dinin demitkavvenin lechabbala uchden shimsha itchabbar besihara vehave kolla chad

Ta chaze ketiv veosef hu hashshallit al haaretz da shimsha deshallit besihara venahir lah vezan lah hu hammashbir lechal am haaretz deha hahu nahar denagid venafik minneh itzanu kullehu umittamman parchin nishmatin lecholla uvgin da kullehu sagdin legabbeh dehahu atar deha let lach milla bealma dela tale bemazzala veukmuha

Vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu ribbi elazar patach veamar lamma ira bime ra aon akevay yesubbeni ta chaze telat inun dedachalin vela yadin mimma dachalin veukmuha aval it man dedachil vela yada mimma ihu dachil begin inun chete dela yada deinun chatain vela ashgach behu veihu dachil mime ra
Man inun yeme ra illen inun yomin deinun izdammenan behahu
395: Ra uman inun da yetzer hara deihu ikre ra veit leh yomin yedian deityehiv leh reshu bealma leastaa lechal inun dimsaave archayehu deman deate leistaava mesaave leh veillen inun ikrun yeme ra veillen memannan al inun chovin dedashin behu beni nasha baakevayehu

Ta chaze kal inun dimsaave archayehu kamma chavile tehirin izdammenan legabbayehu umsaave lehu bearcha devae bar nash lemehach behahu archa medabberin leh mammash ate bar nash leitdakkaa kamma inun dimsayein leh
Ha taninan dechad bar nash kam betzafra bae leaschaa yedoy miggo natla demaya deihu mana litol minneh maya miggo man deasche yedoy bekadmita kema deukmuha vetta chaze begin natla da okimna milla

Vetu devaya leh levar nash lenatla yeda yemina bismala begin leshaltaa yemina al semala veyisteche yemina min semala uvgin kach ihu netila veal da man denatil yedoy yittol yemina bismala leashlata yemina al semala begin dela yahiv duchta leyetzer hara leshalletaa kelal veha okimna
Ta chaze beshata dedina bisha shalta la ativ yedeh milavasha uvshata dimina shalta al amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot letavra lon chayis kudsha berich hu alayehu vela shatze lon

Ubbegin kach kal man deihu chate beinun chetin dedash behu beragloy la yada behu vedachil tedira david malka hava istamar tadir mechovin illen vechad hava nafik likrava hava mefashpesh lon veal da la dachil laagacha immehon kerava

Vetta chaze arba malchin hau man deshail da la shail da david amar erdof oyevay veassigem velo ashuv ad kallotam may tama begin dehava istammar meillen chovin vela yahiv duchta lesanoy leshalletaa veal da bae lemirdaf abbatrayehu tadir vela yirdefun inun avatreh lemitba chovoy veyippol bidayehu

Asa hava dachil yattir af al gav dehava mefashpesh bechetoy vela chedavid malka ihu bae lemirdaf abbatrayehu vela yaggiach lon veyiktol lon kudsha berich hu vechach hava dichtiv vayyirdefem asa vehaam asher immo vegv uchtiv vayyiggof Adonai et hakkushim lifne asa velifni yehuda vayyanusu hakkushim david ma ketiv beh vayyakkem david mehanneshef vead haerev lemachoratam aval asa ihu radif vekudsha berich hu mache

Yehoshafat melech yehuda uf hachi name hava shail veamar la yachilna lemirdaf vela lekatla ella ana azammer veatte ketel lon begin dela hava mefashpesh kal kach keasa vekudsha berich hu avad leh hachi dichtiv uvet hechellu verina uthilla natan Adonai mearvim al beni ammon moav vehar seir habbaim lihuda vayyinnagefu

Chizkiyya melech yehuda uf hachi name amar ana la yachilna la lezammara vela lemirdaf vela laagacha kerava begin dedachil meillen chovin dekaamaran ma ketiv vayehi valayela hahu vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachani ashshur mea ushmonim vachamishsha elef vayyashkimu vabboker vehinne chullam pegarim metim vechizkiyya hava yativ beveteh veshachiv bearseh vekudsha berich hu katil lon

Uma tzaddikim illen hau dachalin meillen chovin shear beni alma al achat kamma vechamma begin kach it leh levar nash leistammera meillen chovin ulfashpesha behon kidkaamaran begin dela yishletun aloy inun yeme ra dela merachame aleh

Ta chaze vayyakker yosef et echav beshata denaflu beyadeh ihu rachim alayehu begin deihu shelim vehem lo hikkiruhu deinun shimon velevi atu missitra dedina kashya veal da la rechimu aleh deha kal inun marehon dedina kashya la merachame alayehu divne nasha beshata denafle bidayehu
Uvgin kach amar david lamma ira yareti la ketiv ella ira deit li lemidchal
396: Meinun yeme ra kidkaamaran aon akevay yesubbeni man akevay illen inun beraza dimhemnuta dichtiv veyado ochezet baakev esav da hu akeva veinun akevin demistakkelin behu tadir behahu chova dedash beh bar nash tadir baakevoy

Ta chaze ma ketiv hoy moshche heaon bechavle hashshave vechaavot haagala chattaa bechavle hashshave dedash beh baakeva vela chayyish aleh ulvatar ittakkaf veitavid kaavot haagala veittakkaf hahu cheta veaste leh behay alma uvalma deate

Zakkain inun tzaddikaya deyadin leistammera mechovehon veinun mefashpeshin tadir beovadayehu begin dela yishtakkach alayehu mekatrega behay alma vela yistun alayehu lealma deate deha orayeta metakna lehu archin ushvilin lemehach behu dichtiv deracheha darche noam vechal netivoteha shalom

Vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vegv ribbi chiyya patach veamar binfol oyivcha al tismach uvikkashlo al yagel libbecha ta chaze kudsha berich hu avad leh levar nash deyizke likara dileh ulshammasha kammeh tedira ulishtaddela beorayeta yemama velele begin dekudsha berich hu itrae bah beorayeta tadir

Vechevan devara kudsha berich hu leadam yahav kammeh orayeta veolef leh bah leminda archaha menalan dichtiv az raah vayesapperah hchinah vegam chakarah ulvatar vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vesur mera bina kevan deistakkal bah vela natir lah avar al pikkuda demareh veitpas bechoveh

Vechal inun deavru al milla chada deorayeta ittefasu vah shelomo malka deitchakkam al kal bene alma avar al milla chada deorayeta vegarim leh leitavara malchuteh minne ulitpallega malchuta min benoy man deaavar al orayeta al achat kamma vechamma

Veosef dehava yada orayeta vaachoy naflu bideh ammay gilgel alayehu kal gilgula da veha ihu yada orayeta deolif leh avoy ella chas veshalom deosef gilgel alayehu gilgulin lenakma minnayehu ella kal da la avad ella leayetaa laachuha binyamin legabbeh detiuvteh hava legabbe veihu la shavak laachoy leminpal deha ketiv vayetzav yosef vayemalleu et kelehem bar vegv vechal da begin dela yinpelun

Ribbi yehuda amar kad bera kudsha berich hu lesihara hava istakkal bah tadir keddichtiv tamid eni Adonai elohecha bah ashgachuta dileh bah tadir uchtiv az raah deha shimsha beashgachuta dileh bah itnehir vayesapperah may vayesapperah kema deatte amer mekom sappir avaneha

Hechinah deihi yatva betikkuna bitresar techumin mitpallega beshivin kesirin atkin lah beshiva samchin illain leitnahara ulyatva al shelimu vegam chakarah leashgacha alah tadir zimna batar zimna dela pasik lealmin

Ulvatar azhar leh levar nash veamar vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vesur mera bina dehay mitattera al tattay ledachala ulminda leh lekudsha berich hu beginah vesur mera bina beriru mippesaluta dela lemikrav bahadeh uchden ashgachuta devina leminda ulistakkela bikara demalka illaa

Ribbi yose kam belelya chad leishtaddela beorayeta vehava tamman immeh chad yuday deaora beh behahu veta patach ribbi yose veamar lo yoilu otzrot resha utzdaka tatztzil mimmavet lo yoilu otzrot resha illen inun dela mishtaddele beorayeta veazle batar mille dealma ulmichnash otzrin dechiyyuva ma ketiv veavad haosher hahu beinyan ra begin deinun otzrot resha

Utzdaka tatztzil mimmavet illen demishtaddele beorayeta veyadin orchaha leishtaddela vah deha orayeta etz chayyim ikre veitkeriat tzedaka dichtiv utzdaka tihye lanu davar acher utzdaka tatztzil mimmavet da tzedaka mammash uvitren gevanin ihu uvitren sitrin kare beh orayeta
397: Amar hahu yuday vekare beh shalom amar ribbi yose hachi hu vadday deikre shalom kam hahu yuday veishtattaf bahadeh patach hahu yuday veamar oved admato yisba lachem umraddef rekim yisba resh hay kera kashya vechi shelomo malka deihu chakkim mikkal bene alma hech amar deyishtaddal bar nash lemiflach ara ulishtaddela avatreh veyishbok chayye alma

Ella raza ihu patach veamar vayyikkach Adonai elohim et haadam vayyannichehu vegan eden leavdah ulshamrah veukmuha beraza dekarbanin ihu ta chaze leavdah da malka illaa ulshamrah da malka tattaa alma illaa vealma tattaa leavdah beraza dezachor ulshamrah beraza deshamor

Ubbegin kach oved admato da gan eden deitzterich lemebad ulmiflach ulamshacha lah birchan milleela vechad itbarcha veitmashshecha lah birchan milleela ihu name itbarech bahadah ta chaze dechahana dimvarech mitbarech kema deatte amer vaani avarachem uvgin kach oved admato yisba lachem da hu mezona dilela umraddef rekim man deyitdabbak besitra achora deihu meraddef rekim yisba resh vday amar ribbi yose zakkaa ante dezachit lehay milla

Tu patach veamar kera avatreh ish emunot rav berachot da hu bar nash dimhemnuta dekudsha berich hu beh kegon ribbi yesa sava deaf al gav dehava leh mechla dehahu yoma lemechal la hava matkin leh ad deshail mezoneh kamme malka kaddisha levatar detzalle tzeloteh veshail mezoneh kamme malka keden hava metakkin vehava amar tadir la netakkin ad deyinnatnun mibbe malka
Veatz lehaashir lo yinnake begin dela baa leishtaddela beorayeta deihi chayyin dealma den vechayyin dealma deate hashta deihi shata leishtaddela beorayeta nishtaddel

Patach hahu gavra beraza dechelma veamar vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vegv vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot vechi yosef ammay adkar lon inun chalomot dechalam lehu uma sagya leh illu la adkar lehu deha yosef chakkim hava uchtiv kal arum yaase vedaat uchsil yifros ivelet

Aval kevan dechama deinun attu vesagde leh appin al ara keden idkar mimma dechalam lehu kad hava immehon dichtiv vehinne kamma alummati vegam nitztzava vehinne tesubbena alummotechem vattishtachavena laalummati amar yosef beshata dechama decharin achoy kammeh dichtiv vayyavou ache yosef vayyishtachau lo appayim artza keden vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam deha chama dehau kayeme

Tu vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam adkar lon begin delet nashu kamme kudsha berich hu deha chelma deihu tava bae var nash leadkara leh dela yitneshe uchden itkeyyam deha kema deitneshe kammeh devar nash hachi itneshe aleh

Ta chaze chelma dela itpashshar keiggarta dela mitkarya vetta chaze begin dela idkar keman dela yada leh veal da man deitneshe minneh chelma vela yada leh la kayema aleh leitkayema uvgin da yosef hava dachir chelmeh begin leitkayema begin dela yitneshe chelma minneh lealam vehava mechakke leh tadir vayyomer alehem meraggelim attem ihu dachir chelma aval milla la amar lon ella meraggelim attem

Patach ribbi yose veamar ki va hachalom berov inyan vekol kesil berov devarim ki va hachalom berov inyan ha ukmuha dechamma inun semichin bechelma ummannan dargin al dargin ad dechalmin minhon keshot kullehu uminnehon deit behon keshot uchdivu aval leinun zakkae keshot la itgeli lon millin kedivan kelum ella kullehu keshot
Ta chaze daniyyel ma ketiv beh edayin ledaniyyel bechezva di lelya
398: Raza galle uchtiv daniyyel chelem chaza vechezve resheh al mishkeveh bedayin chelma chetav vei it beh millin kedivan ammay ichtiv ben ketuvim ella inun zakkae keshot beshata denishmathon salkin la mitchabberan behu ella millin kaddishin deodin leh mille dik shot millin kayeman dela meshakran lealmin

Vei tema ha tenan dedavid malka la chama chelma tava ha ishtema dehava chame david millin dela keshot ella vadday kal yomoy hava mishtaddel leoshda damin veaggach keravin vechal chelmoy la hau ella chelmin bishin churva veshommuta vedama veoshidu dedamin vela chelma dishlam

Vei tema levar nash tav achaziu leh chelma bisha hachi hu vadday kal inun bishin dezamminin leitdabbeka al inun deavre al pitgame deorayeta veinun onashin dezamminin leitanasha behahu alma kullehu chame begin dechal shata yehe dechilu demareh aleh veha itaru dichtiv vehaelohim asa sheyyiru milfanav ze chalom ra veal da lehahu zakkaa achaziu leh chelma bisha kema deittemar

Ta chaze deha taninan dehahu bar nash dechame chelma bae leh lemiftach pumeh beh kamme bene nasha derachame leh begin deyistallak reuta dilhon legabbeh letav veyiftechun pumayehu letav veyishtakkach reuta umilla kolla letav reuta deihi machashava sheruta decholla umilla deihi siyyuma decholla veal da ishtakkach deha shelimu ihu beraza illaa uvgin kach itkeyyam kolla uvinan rechimin devar nash leitkayema behahu pishra tava vecholla ihu kedeka yeut

Ubbegin kach kudsha berich hu oda leh levar nash kal chad vechad behahu darga dileh kema deihu uvhahu gavena dechal chad vechad amar dihe chelma amar hahu yuday vadday dechelma lav ihu ella levar nash zakkaa deihu chama chelma kedeka chaze

Vetta chaze dechad bar nash naim al arseh nishmateh nafka veshatya bealma leela vealat beatra dealat vechamma chavile tehirin kayemin veazlin bealma ufagin bah behahi nishmata i zakkaa hi salka leela vechamat ma dechamat vei lav itachadat behahu sitra umodiin lah millin kedivan o millin dezamminin lemete lizman kariv vechad itar hahi nishmata deveh ihi moda leh ma dechamat

400: Veyisgun beh begin denishmatin la nafke lealma ela behay berit vechen nagozu hay im shelemim denatre leh tadir nagozu man deitgezar vekibbel aleh keyama da veavar may veavar hahu zuhama dearla dehava beh bekadmita

Ta chaze it dina kashya veit dina rafya dina kashya takkif dina rafya chalash vechad yanka hay dina rafya middina kashya keden ittakkaf veihu takkif

Davar acher vechen nagozu kad mitabbere minnayehu inun ovadin bishin keden veavar may veavar ribbi shimon amar bezimna denishmata nafkat mehay alma bechamma dinin itdanat ad la tiul leatrah levatar kal inun nishmatin it lon lemeevar behach nehar dinur denagid venafik ulistachaa tamman uman ihu deyakum tamman veyaavar bela dechilu kema deatte amer mi yaale behar Adonai vegv venishmata dezakkaa aavar bela dechilu veyakum bimkom kadsho

Vehay kera ukmuha beosef zakkaa dela baa leashlama bisha laachoy beshata denaflu bidoy kave layeya veosha lach begin dehu hava
401: Dachil lekudsha berich hu dichtiv zot asu vichu vegv veihu tadir hava mechakke lekudsha berich hu

Ribbi abba patach veamar mayim amukim etza belev ish veish tevuna yidlenna mayim amukim etza belev ish da kudsha berich hu begin deihu avid etzot deayete taamin legalgela gilgulin al alma al yeda deosef lekayema hahu gezera degazar kafna al ara veish tevuna yidlenna da yosef degale inun amikin degazar kudsha berich hu al alma
Ta chaze yosef lo day leh deihu la shallim bisha laachoy ela deavad immehon tivu ukshot vechach archehon dezakkae tadir begin da kudsha berich hu chayis alayehu tadir bealma den uvalma deate
Mayim amukim etza belev ish da yehuda veha ukmuha beshata deitkariv legabbeh deosef al iska devinyamin veish tevuna yidlenna da yosef

Ribbi abba hava yativ atara deabbava delod chama chad bar nash dehava ate veyativ bechad kulta detala deara vehava lae mearcha veyativ venaim tamman addehachi chame chad chiveya dehava ate legabbeh nafak kostefa degurdena vekatil leh lechiveya kad itar hahu bar nash chama hahu chiveya lekovleh dehava mit izdakkaf hahu bar nash venafal hahu kulta leumka ditchotoy veishteziv
Ata ribbi abba legabbeh amar leh ema li man ovadach deha kudsha berich hu rachish lach illen teren nissin lav inun lemaggana

Amar leh hahu bar nash kal yomay la ashlim li bar nash bisha bealma dela itpayyasna bahadeh umachilna leh vetu i la yachilna leitpayesa bahadeh la salikna learsi ad demachilna leh ulchal inun dimtzaaru li vela chayeshana kal yoma lehahu bisha deashlim li velav di li da ella dimhahu yoma ulhala ishtaddalna lemebad immehon tava
Bacha ribbi abba veamar yattir ovadoy deden miyyosef deosef hau achoy vadday vehava leh lerachama aloy aval ma deavid da yattir hu miyyosef yaot hu dekudsha berich hu yarchish leh nisa al nisa

Patach veamar holech battom yelech betach umakkesh derachav yivadea holech battom yelech betach da hahu bar nash deazil bearchin deorayeta yelech betach dela yachilu nizke dealma leavasha leh umakkesh derachav yivadea man yivadea da hu man deaste mearcha dikshot uvae gabbe dechavreh yivadea mahu yivadea yishtemoda ihu beenehon dechal mare dedina dela yitavid minnayehu diukna dehahu bar nash begin leayetaa leh leatra deyinkemun minneh uvgin kach yivadea

Vetta chaze hahu deazil beorach keshot kudsha berich hu chafe aleh begin dela ityeda vela ishtemoda legabbe marehon dedina aval meakkesh derachav yivadea veyishtemoda legabbayehu zakkain inun bene nasha deazle beorach keshot veazle lerochatzan al alma dela dachale inun bealma den vela bealma deate

Vayyiru haanashim ki huvu bet yosef ribbi yose amar vay lon livne nasha dela yade vela mistakkelin bearche deorayeta vay lon beshata dekudsha berich hu yete lemitba lon dina al ovadehon veyakum gufa venafsha lemehav chushbana mikkal ovadehon ad la yitparshun nafsha min gufa

Vehahu yoma yoma dedina ihu yoma desifrin petichan umarehon dedina kayemin begin dehahu zimna kayema nachash bekiyyumeh lenashcha leh vechal shayefe mitraggeshin legabbeh venishmata itparsha min gufa veazla veshatya vela yadat lean archa tehach ulan atar salkin lah

402: Utnan leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara veyishtaddel avatreh i azil minneh yaot vei lav yishtaddal beorayeta deha let lach milla letavra yetzer hara ella orayeta i azil mutav vei lav yadkar leh yoma demota begin letabbera leh

Hacha it leistakkala deha da hu yetzer hara veda hu malach hammavet vechi malach hammavet mitbar mikkamme yoma demota veha ihu katola divni nasha have veishtema dechedva hu dileh uvgin kach aste lon livni nasha tadir begin leamshacha lon leda

Ella vadday ma deittemar deyidkor leh bar nash hahu yoma demota vadday hachi hu begin demitbar libba devar nash deha yetzer hara la sharya ella beatar deishtakkach chedva dechamra vegassuta derucha vechad ishtakkach rucha tevira keden itperash minneh vela sharya bahadeh uvgin kach bae leadkara leh yoma demota veyitbar gufeh veihu azil leh

Ta chaze kamma garim hahu chova begin degalle ma dehava satim dechevan deitgele ityehiv duchta leatar achora dela itzterich leshalletaa aleh begin kach lav beracha sharya ella beatar satim veukmuha ma deihu satim beracha sharya aloy kevan deitgele ityehiv duchta leatar achora leshaltaa aloy

Veraza ihu deha hahu istakkeluta deihu mistakkel behahu bauta garim leh lemachalat lev may machala lev da ihu man dekaim tadir aleh devar nash leastaa leela vetatta

Davar acher tochelet memushacha machala lev da hu atar deityehiv hahi milla beatar achora dela itzterich veitmashshecha ad deityehiv miyyada leyada ulzimnin dela yiyite may tama begin deitpashsheta veitmashshecha bechal inun memannan lenachata leh lealma

Davar acher tochelet memushacha da yaakov deitmashshecha leh tochalta deosef ad zeman arich veetz chayyim taava vaa da hu binyamin deha mizzimna detava leh yosef ad hahu zimna deata legabbeh la hava ella zimna zeer dela itmashshecha hahu zimna hada hu dichtiv vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv ben immo may ben immo dediukneh deimmeh hava beh vehava dame diukneh lediukna derachel vegin kach ketiv vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv ben immo

Uf hacha vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv ben immo ma ketiv batreh vayemaher yosef ki nichmeru rachamav el achiv vayevakkesh livkot vayyavo hachadra vayyevchi shamma
Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar massa ge chizzaon ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot ta chaze ha ukmuha bezimna deitchariv be makdesha vehau mokdin leh benura seliku kal inun kahane
404: Al kotlehon demakdesha vechal maftechin bidayehu veamru ad hacha havena gizbarin dilach mikkan vaelach tol dilach

Ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot deha kad itcharav makdesha shechinta atat uslikat bechal inun atrin dehava medorah behu bekadmita vahavat bachat al bet medorah veal yisrael deazlu begaluta veal kal inun tzaddike vachaside dehau tamman veitavidu umnalan dichtiv ko amar Adonai kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al baneha veha ittemar uchden kudsha berich hu shail lah lishchinta veamar lah ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot
Mahu kullach deha ki alit sagya mahu kullach leachlala bahadah kal chelin vechal retichin achoranin dechullehu bechu immah al churban be makdesha

Uvgin kach ma lach efo amra kammeh vechi banay begaluta umakdesha ittokda veana ma li hacha shariat veamrat teshuot melea ir homiyya kirya alliza chalalayich lo challe cherev velo mete milchama al ken amarti sheu minni amarer babbechi vegv veha okimna dekudsha berich hu amar lah ko amar Adonai mini kolech mibbechi vegv

Hashta deitchariv be makdesha ushchinta immehon begaluta let lach yoma dela ishtakkach beh levatin vealma itlatya vechedvan la ishtakkachu leela vetatta

405: Yizrach shemesh da hu yaakov dinhiru dileh kinhiru dehahu boker boker lo avot begin dehahu boker lav ihu chashuch ella nahir deha beshata deate boker la shalta dina kelal ella kolla nahir besitra deavraham minnogah mimmatar da hu sitra deosef hatztzaddik deihu amtir al ara leafaka disa vechal tivu dealma

Deha let lach dargin illain dela itay behu yemina usmala rachame vedina dargin al dargin kaddishin missitra dikdushsha umsaavin missitra dimsaava vechullehu dargin al dargin illen al illen

Ribbi chiyya patach veamar vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha ta chaze zammin kudsha berich hu leanhara lon leyisrael hahu shimsha deganiz kudsha berich hu miyyoma deitbere alma mikkamme rashshie dealma kema dichtiv vayyimna mershaim oram

Vehahu nehora ganiz leh kudsha berich hu dechad nafak bekadmita hava nahir misseyafe alma vead seyafe alma kevan deistakkal bedareh deenosh uvdareh demabbul uvdareh dehaflaga uvchal inun chayyavaya ganiz leh lehahu nehora

406: Orayeta kayema kammayehu vela mishtaddele vah tav lon dela yibbarun al ma yekumun bela sachletanu vay lon kad yitarun yome dera alayehu veyitredun lehon mealma
Man inun yomin dera i salka datach deinun yome desivu lav hachi deha yome desivu i zacha bivnin uvni venin yome detav inun man inun yomin dera

Uvgine chach amar david lamma ira bime ra aon akevay yesubbeni yeme ra vadday veraza da illen ikrun yeme raav shenin deraav veillen ikrun yeme sava shene sava

Veraza demilla dela leafaka mabbua divrit kaddisha beome raav bishnat haraav uvgin kach yosef deihu raza divrit satim mabbueh bishnat haraav vela yahav leh duchta leasgaa bealma veda bae leh levar nash dechad shalta shenat haraav deyastim mabbua divrit kaddisha dileh begin dela yahav leh duchta leasgaa bealma

Ribbi shimon amar raza da ihu raza illaa behahi shenat haraav kevan deihi shalta bae leastama mabbueh begin dei la satim leh garim leamshacha rucha lehahu valda mehahu sitra veyahiv duchta lehahu sitra lemifshe bealma sitra dimsaava besitra dekudsha vetu raza dichtiv tachat shalosh ragza eretz vegv

Ubbegin kach yosef tzaddika raza divrit salik vesatim mabbueh bishnat haraav dela leitarva bahadah kelal ulmehav lah duchta uman deaftach mabbueh behahu zimna aleh ketiv bayeya bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu atta yochlem vegv deha illen ikrun banim zarim vadday bayeya bagadu vadday ubbegin kach zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael kaddishin dela itchallefu duchta kaddisha beduchta mesaava

Veal da ketiv ulosef yullad sheni vanim beterem tavo shenat haraav deha mehahu zimna deshalta shenat haraav astim mabbueh vesalik mekoreh dela lemehav benin lesitra mesaava vela leachlafa duchta dekudsha beduchta dimsaava uvae var nash lechakkaa lemareh dekudsha kad yete veyishlot kedichtiv vechikketi layeya hammastir panav mibbet yaakov vekiviti lo

Zakkain inun tzaddikaya deyadin orchoy dekudsha berich hu venatre pikkude deorayeta lemehach behu dichtiv ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam uchtiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom
407: Uvgin da kudsha berich hu azhar lehu leyisrael leitkaddasha vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani man ani da kudsha berich hu malchut shamayim kaddisha malchuta achara deovde avodat kochavim umazzalot ikre acher dichtiv ki lo tishtachave leel acher ki Adonai kanna shemo

Vetta chaze ani shaltanu dealma den vealma deate vecholla beh talya acher sitra mesaava acher sitra achora besitra mesaava veshultanu dileh behay alma velet leh bealma deate kelum uvgin da man deitdabbak behay ani it leh chulaka bealma den uvalma deate

Uman deitdabbak behay acher itavid mehahu alma velet leh chulaka bealma deate veit leh chulaka behay alma bimsaavu begin dehahu malchu achara ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot kamma inun teresin gardinin memannan beh leshalletaa behay alma
Uvgine kach elisha acher denachat veitdabbak behay darga itterid mehahu alma deate vela ityehiv leh reshu lemehdar bituvta veitterid mehahu alma veal da ikre acher
Ubbegin kach bae var nash leitperasha mikkal sitrin dela leistaava behahu sitra lemizke behay alma uvalma deate veal da da beracha veda kelala da sava veda raav kolla behippucha da min da veha okimna
Uvgin kach behahu zimna dishnat haraav let leh levar nash leitchazaa beshuka vela leiftecha mabbueh leolada lemehav benin leel acher veha ittemar

Zakkaa ihu var nash deistammar lemehach beorach keshot ulitdabbeka bemareh tadir dichtiv uvo tidbak Adonai uvishmo tishshavea uvo tishshavea la ketiv ella uvishmo may tishshavea kema deokimna lemeheve mitdebbak beraza dimhemnuta

408: Teren deitchazzeyan lemehve beh let beh deha la atkin garmeh ledoron uvdoron shelama kalil beh amar ribbi yose dilma ihu mishtaddel bitzloteh o marchish talmudeh begin dela yeakar leh

Amar lon rabbotay bemma chashadtun li kad yahavitu li shelam vela ativna lechu amar leh ribbi yose dilma tzelota havet amar o marchish betalmudach amar lon kudsha berich hu yadin lechu lechaf zechu

Vehahu ra deihu semala itkelilu beh ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot veityehiv besitra dilhon begin deinun arle libba vearle bisra ulistaova beh aval beyisrael ma ketiv ach tov leyisrael

Amar ribbi yose begin detov hu leyisrael yisrael it lon chulaka bealma den uvalma deate lemechome ena beena chezu yekara kema dichtiv ki ayin beayin yiru beshuv Adonai tziyyon baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
409: Bae lemivre zammin hu leargaza kammach ilmale la taarich rugza tav leh dela yitbere amar lah kudsha berich hu vechi lemaggana itkerena erech appayim
Ella kolla beorayeta itbere vecholla beorayeta ishtachlal begin dead la bara kudsha berich hu alma atyan kal atvan kammeh vealu kal chad vechad lemafrea

Ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu leh leadam achnish afreh mearba sitrin dealma veavad garmeh beatar demakdesha letatta veamshich aleh nishmata dechayye mibbe makdesha leela

Ta chaze kolla inun dargin illen al illen nefesh ruach neshama darga al darga nefesh bekadmita veihi darga tattaa kidkaamaran ruach levatar desharya al nefesh vekayema alah neshama darga desalka al kolla veukmuha

Veal da ki hinne hammelachim noadu avru yachdav itregizu kechada veitreggizu da beda begineh devinyamin ma ketiv hemma rau ken tamahu nivhalu nechpazu reada achazatam sham lechal inun dehau tamman

Davar acher ki hinne hammelachim noadu da yehuda veosef
411: Deizdammenu leitvakkecha da im da leitvakkecha tarvayehu kechada begin dihuda hava melech veosef hava melech vetarvayehu atu kechada leitvakkecha da im da da al binyamin veda al binyamin
