Hemma rau ken tamahu salka datach deinun melachim ella illen marehon dedinin dechedva dilhon lemebad hahu dina deitpakkedu aleh uchden kad melachim izdammenu tarvayehu biruta chada keden hema rau hahu reuta ditren almin ken tamahu nivhalu nechpazu begin dechullehu mare dedina itkafyan umitavran mealma vela yachle leshalletaa uchden mitavrin kiyyumehon meavrin shaltanhon

Ribbi elazar amar vayyigash elav yehuda may tama yehuda begin dehachi itzterich deihu arav kema deatte amer ki avdecha arav et hannaar veraza demilla yehuda veosef hachi itzterichu leitkarva kechada begin deosef ihu tzaddik yehuda ihu melech veal da vayyiggash elav yehuda begin dekurva dilhon deitkerivu kechada garam kamma tavin lealma garam shelama lechullehu shivtin garam shelama benayhu garam leyaakov deitkeyyam rucha dileh kema deatte amer vattechi ruach yaakov avihem veal da kerivu deda im da itzterich bechullehu sitrin leela vetatta

Ribbi abba patach veamar yefe nof mesos kal haaretz har tziyyon yarkete tzafon kiryat melech rav hay kera raza dimhemnuta ihu yefe nof da ihu yosef hatztzaddik dichtiv beh vayehi yosef yefe toar vife mare mesos kal haaretz ihu chedva vechedu leela vetatta har tziyyon yarkete tzafon begin divchulakeh kaim mashkena deshilo har tziyyon da yerushala yarkete tzafon hachi hu vadday leela vetatta

Kiryat melech rav atar ihu metakkena lakovel melech rav da malka illaa decholla kodesh hakkodashim deha mittamman atya kal nehiru vechal birchan vechal chedu decholla deha mittamman naharin kal anpin uve makdesha itbarcha mittamman vechad ihi mitbarcha mittamman nafke birchan lechal alma deha kal alma mittamman itbarcha

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yose iaru bichfar chanan ad dehau yatve be ushpizayehu ata chad bar nash vechad matula dechamra kameh veal beveta addehachi amar ribbi yehuda leribbi yose ha taninan dedavid malka hava mitnamnem kesus veshenteh zeer hech hava kam befalgut lelya hay shiura zeer ihu vela hava itar afilu bitlatut lelya

Amar leh beshata deal lelya hava yativ im kal ravreve veteh vedain dina veasik bemille deorayeta ulvatar hava naim shenteh ad palgut lelya vekam befalgut lelya veitar veishteddal befulchana demareh beshirin vetushbechan
412: Hahu bar nash vechi hay milla dekaamritu hachi hu raza demilla hacha deha david malka chay vekayyam lealam ulalme almin vedavid malka hava natir kal yomoy dela yitam taam mita begin deshenta chad mishshittin bemita ihu vedavid begin duchteh deihu chay la hava naim ella shitin nishme dead shittin nishme chaser chad ihu chay mittamman ulhala taim bar nash tama demota veshallit beh sitra deruach mesaava

Veda hava natir david malka dela yitam tama demota veshallit beh sitra derucha achora begin deshittin nishme chaser chad ihu raza dechayyim dilela ad shittin nishme deinun shittin nishme illain veilen raza dilhon detalyan behon chayye umikkan ultatta raza demota hu

Veal da david malka hava meshaer shiura delelya begin deyitkayyem bachayyim dela yishlot beh tama demota vechad itpelig lelya hava david mitkayyem beatreh begin dechad itar palgu lelya vechitra kaddisha itar baa dela leashkacha leh ledavid mitkashshar beatar achora beatar demota

Begin dechad itpelig lelya ukdushsha illaa itar uvar nash denaim bearseh vela itar leashgacha bikara demareh ha ihu itkashshar beraza demota umitdabbak beatar achora veal da david malka hava kaim leashgacha bikara demareh tadir chay legabbe chay vela naim beshenta letaama tama demota uvgin kach hava mitnamnem kesus shittin nishme vela bishlimu

Atu ribbi yehuda veribbi yose unshakuha amru leh ma shemach amar lehon chizkiyya amru leh yityasher chelach veyittakkaf orayetach yetivu amar ribbi yehuda hoil vesharit ema lan mehanne razin illain dekaamarte

Patach veamar Adonai bechachma yasad eretz konen shamayim bitvuna ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma chama dela yachil leitkayema ad devara orayeta begin deminnah nafkin kal nimmusin illain vetattain uvah kayeme illae vetattae hada hu dichtiv Adonai bechachma yasad aretz konin shamayim bitvuna deha bechachma kayemin kal kiyyumin dealma vechullehu nafke miggavah

Davar acher Adonai bechachma yasad eretz alma illaa la itbere ella miggo chachma vealma tattaa la itbere ella miggo chachma tattaa vechullehu nafkan miggo chachma illaa umiggo chachma tattaa konen shamayim bitvuna konen may konen ella konen kal yoma veoma vela pasik vela ittakkan bezimna chada ella bechal yoma veoma atkin leh

Vehayenu raza dichtiv veshamayim lo zakku veenav vechi salka datach digriuta ihu mishshamayim ella chashivu mishshamayim ihu begin chavivu uru sagya dekudsha berich hu rae behu vachavivutayehu legabbeh deha af al gav deihu matkin lon kal yoma veoma la dame beenoy deinun mittaknan kedeka yeut begin dirchimuta dilhon legabbeh uruteh leanhara lon tadir bela pesiku deha alma deate appik nehorin zehirin kal yoma veoma tadir bela pesiku begin leanhara lon tadir veal da lo zakku beenav lo zakku bilchodoy la ketiv ella lo zakku veenav uvgin kach konen shamayim bitvuna
Man shamayim da hu raza deavahan veraza deavahan da hu yaakov deihu kelala dilhon begin deyaakov tushbachta deavahan ihu veihu kayema leanhara al alma

Uvgin deihu istallak go alma deate nafak minneh anafa chada shappira bechezu vechal nehorin mineh nafkin vechal sava umshach revu leanhara leara uman ihu da yosef hatztzaddik deihu yahiv sava lechal alma vealma minneh ittezan uvgin kach kudsha berich hu kal ma deavad bealma kolla ihu beraza illaa vecholla kedeka chaze
Adhachi ata ribbi elazar kevan dechama lon amar vadday shechinta hacha bemay askitu amru leh
413: Kal ovada amar vadday shappir kaamar aval inun shittin nishme vadday shittin nishme inun dechayyin ben leela ben letatta mikkan ulhala ika shittin nishmin achoranin deinun kullehu missitra demota vedarga demota alayehu veikrun durmita vechullehu taama demota

Uvgin kach david malka hava ihu mitdebbak beinun shittin nishmin dechayyin umittamman ulhala la naim kelal hada hu dichtiv im etten shenat leenay leafappay tenuma veal da shappir kaamar begin deyakum david chay besitra dechay vela besitra demota yatvu kullehu veishtaddelu beorayeta veitchabbaru kechada

Patach ribbi elazar veamar Adonai eloke yeshuati yom tzaakti vallayela negdecha ta chaze david malka hava kam befalgut lelya veishteddal beorayeta beshirin vetushbechan lechedva demalka umatronita veda hava chedva dimhemnuta beara begin dehay ihu shevacha dimhemnuta deitchaze beara

Deha leela patche bechedva shirata kamma malachin illain bechamma zinin deka meshabbechan belelya bechal sitrin kehay gavena letatta beara man dimshabbach leh lekudsha berich hu beara belelya rae beh kudsha berich hu vechal inun malachin kaddishin deka meshabbechan leh lekudsha berich hu kullehu tzayetin lehahu deka meshabbach leh belelya beara dehay tushbachta ihu bishlimu lesalka yekare dekudsha berich hu mittatta ulzammera bechedva deyichuda
Ta chaze david malka katav Adonai elohe yeshuati vegv Adonai elohe yeshuati ematay ihu yeshuati behahu yoma deakdemit tushbachta belelya legabbach keden ihu yeshuati bimama

Vetta chaze deha belelya man dimshabbach lemareh betushbachta deorayeta keden atkaf bitkifu biyemama besitra dimina deha chuta chad nafka missitra dimina uchden itmashshach aleh veittakkaf beh veal da amar Adonai elohe yeshuati yom tzaakti vegv

Uvgin kach amar lo hammetim yehallelu yah lo hammetim begin deitzterich leshabbecha chay lechay umet lechay lav hachi dichtiv lo hammetim yehallelu yah vaanachnu nevarech yah deha anan chayyin velet lan chulaka besitra demota kelal chizkiyyahu amar chay chay hu yodecha kamoni begin dechay itkerav lechay david malka ihu chay vekurva dileh lechay haolamim uman deitkeriv legabbeh ihu chay dichtiv veattem haddevekim ba elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom uchtiv uvnayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay rav pealim mikkavtzeel

Patach hahu yuday avatreh veamar veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elokecha vechi la mevarchinan leh lekudsha berich hu ad la nichul veha it lan leakdume betzafra ulsiddure shevacha dileh kedeka yeut ulvarcha bishmeh ad la yevarech leachara bealma uchtiv lo tochelu al haddam asur leh lemechal ad la yevarech lemareh vehashta ketiv veachalta vesavata uverachta

Ella da birchata ditzlota deyichuda veda birchata dimzona leachazaa legabbe darga dimhemnuta sava kedeka yaot uchden bee levarcha leh kedeka yeut dehahu darga dimhemnuta yitrave vivarech veyitmalle chedu mechayyin dilela kema deitzterich begin lemehav lan mezone

Deha kashin mezona devar nash kame kudsha berich hu kikriat yam suf may tama begin dimzona dealma dilela hu ditnan bane chayye umzone vechu uvgin kach kashyan kammeh mezone dealma deha bemazzala talya milta deminneh nafke mezone vechayye uvane uvgin kach kashin kammeh mezone dealma deha lav birshuteh kayema ad deyitbarech ihu
Kegavena da ziyiveggin dealma kashin kammeh vecholla begin derakia vilon la meshammesh kelum vechal shekken illen millin dekayemin leela beatar achora veal da itzterich leitbarcha
Ta chaze kal ziugin dealma kashin kammeh hay darga begin dechad hay ziuuga kaddisha ishtakkach kal
414: Nishmatin nafkin miggo hay mazzala leela deihu hahu nahar denagid venafik vechad tiuvta ishtakkach milra leela keden parchin nishmatin veityehivu kullehu kelilan dechar venukva kechada behay darga ulvatar ihu parish lon kal chad vechad leatreh kedeka chaze leh ulvatar kashin kamme hay darga lechabbera lon kekadmita begin dela mitchabberan bar keinun arche debbar nash vecholla leela talyan
Veal da kashin kammeh kikriat yam suf deha keriat yamma leitpattecha beh shevilin leela ihu uchma demitpattechin shevilin veorchin beh hachi itbakka veitpattach
Uvgin kach kolla talya leela uvinan levarcha leh ulmehav leh tukfa mittatta begin deyitbarcha milleela veyittakkaf kedeka chaze veal da ketiv uverachta et Adonai et dayeka

Ulgabbe hay atar itzterich leachazaa kammeh sava unhiru deanpin ulgabbe sitra achora bezimna deihi shalta bealma bee leachazaa kammeh kafna dehahu darga raav ihu veitchaze leachazaa kammeh kafna vela sova hoil vesava la shalta bealma veal da veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elokecha amar ribbi elazar hachi hu vadday vehachi itzterich

Amar ribbi yehuda zakkain inun tzaddikayya dekurva dilhon ihu shelama bealma begin deyade leyachada yichuda umkarve kurva leasgaa shelama bealma deha yosef vihuda ad la itkerivu da im da la hava shelama kevan deitkerivu yosef vihuda kechada keden asgiu shelama bealma vechedu ittosaf leela vetatta kema dekurva dihuda veosef vechullehu shivtin ishtakkachu kechada beh beosef vehahu kurva asge shelama bealma kema deokimna dichtiv vayyiggash elav yehuda

Velo yachol yosef lehitappek lechal hannitztzavim alav vegv ribbi chiyya patach veamar pizzar natan laevonim tzidkato omedet laad karno tarum bechavod ta chaze kudsha berich hu bara alma veashlit aleh laadam dihe malka al kolla

Vehay bar nash mitparshan minneh bealma kamma zinin minnehon tzaddikayya uminnehon rashshiaya minnehon tippeshin uminnehon chakkimin vechullehu itkayemu bealma atirin umiskenin vechullehu begin lemizke illen beillen lemizke tzaddikaya im rashshiaya lemizke chakkimin im tippeshin lemizke atirin im miskenin deha begin kach zache bar nash lechayye alma veitkashshar beilana dechayye vela od ella deha tzedaka deihu avid kaim lealmin dichtiv vetzidkato omedet laad

Pizzar natan laevonim ribbi elazar amar kad bara kudsha berich hu alma kaim leh al samcha chad vetzaddik shemeh vehay tzaddik ihu kiyyuma dealma veda ihu deashke vezan lecholla dichtiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim

Umishsham yippared mahu yippared ella hahu mezona umashkaya dehahu nahar natil ginta kolla ulvatar itbaddar hahu mashkaya led sitrin dealma vechamma inun dimtzappan leitshakya ulittezena mittamman kema deatte amer eni chol elecha yesabberu veatta noten lahem et achlam beitto uvgin kach pizzar natan laevonim da tzaddik tzidkato omedet laad da keneset yisrael divgin kach ihi kayema beraza dishlam bekiyyuma shelim rasha yire vechaas da malchut ovde kochavim umazzalot

Ta chaze malchut shamayim ihi be makdesha lekayema kal miskene bego tzilla desheruta dishchinta vetzaddik da ihu ikre gabbay tzedaka lemechan ulmezan lecholla dichtiv pizzar natan laevonim begin kach gabbae tzedaka natle agra lakovel kullehu deyahave tzedaka
Ta chaze velo yachol yosef lehitappek lechal hannitztzavim illen inun kal dekayeme leittezana ulitshakya minneh velo amad ish itto
415: Behitvadda yosef el echav itto da keneset yisrael echav illen shear retichin chayalin dichtiv behu lemaan achay vereay davar acher velo amad ish itto bezimna dekudsha berich hu ate leizdavvega bikkeneset yisrael behitvadda yosef el echav bezimna dekudsha berich hu hava mitchabber behu beyisrael begin deinun natle bilchodayehu vela chibbura deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bahadayehu begin kach bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem deha bezimna da ihu kudsha berich hu bilchodoy bechibbura chada im yisrael dichtiv behu achay vereay kema deukmuha

Ribbi yesa patach kera bezimna dekudsha berich hu yokim lah lichneset yisrael meafra veyibbae leinnakma nikmata meammemaya ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot keden ketiv umeamim en ish itti uchtiv hacha velo amad ish itto behitvadda yosef el echav kema deatte amer vayenattelem vayenasseem kal yeme olam

Velo yachol yosef lehitappek ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar shir hammaalot elecha nasati et enay hayyoshvi bashshamayim hay kera ukmuha veittemar aval ta chaze elecha nasati et enay uchtiv essa enay el heharim ella da leela veda letatta essa enay el heharim da leela begin leamshacha birchan meela letatta meillen harim illain leamshacha minnayehu birchan lichneset yisrael deitbarcha minnayehu elecha nasati et enay lemitzpe ulchakkaa leinnun birchan denachatu mittamman letatta

Hayyoshvi bashshamayim dechal tukfaha vechelaa vekiyyumaha ihu bashshamayim begin dechad yovela aftach mabbue dechal inun tarin kullehu kayeme bashshamayim vechevan deshamayim natil kal inun nehorin denafke miyyovela keden ihu zan veashke lah lichneset yisrael al yeda detzaddik chad

Vechevan deda itar legabbah kamma inun dekayeman bechal sitrin leitshaka ulitbarcha mittamman kema deatte amer hakkefirim shoagim latteref ulvakkesh meel achlam uchden ihi salka beraza derazin kedeka chaze umkabbela iddunin mivaalah kedeka yeut vechullehu dekayemin bechal sitrin amde bilchodayehu kema deatte amer velo amad ish itto dichtiv vayyikra hotziu kal ish mealay ulvatar deihi mekabbela iddunin mibbaalah kullehu itshakyan levatar veittezanu kema deatte amer yashku kal chayeto saday yishberu feraim tzemaam

Ribbi yose patach kera beeliyyahu dichtiv vayyikra el Adonai vayyomar Adonai elohay hagam al haalmana asher ani mitgorer immah hareota lehamit et benah ta chaze tere hau dekaamrin millin lakovel kudsha berich hu moshe veeliyyahu moshe amar lamma hareota laam hazze veeliyyahu amar hareota lehamit et benah vetarvayehu milla chada kaamru

May tama ella raza ihu moshe amar lamma hareota may tama ella begin deityehiv reshu lesitra achora leshalletaa alayehu deyisrael hareota yehavte reshu lesitra achora dera lemishlat alayehu eliyyahu amar hareota yehavte reshu lesitra dera litol nishmata deda veda hu hareota vecholla raza chada

Ta chaze eliyyahu amar hagam al haalmana asher ani mitgorer immah begin dekudsha berich hu amar leh leeliyyahu hinne tziviti sham ishsha almana lechalkelecha vechal man dezan umfarnes leman deitzterich leh vechal shekken beoma dechafna ha itachid beilana dechayye vegarim leh chayyim velivnoy veha okimna vehashta eliyyahu amar kal man dekiyyem nafsha bealma zache leh chayyim vezache leitachada beilana dechayye vehashta shalta ilana demota sitra dera al haalmana deante pekadte lemezan li begin kach hareota

Vei tema dera la itavid levar nash meim kudsha berich hu ta chaze bezimna devar nash azil limina netiru dekudsha berich hu tadir legabbeh vela yachil sitra achora leshaltaa aleh vehay ra itkafya kammeh vela yachil leshalletaa vechevan dintira dekudsha berich hu itavra minneh begin
416: Deihu itdabbak bera keden hahu ra kevan dechame delav immeh netiru keden shallit aleh veate leshetzaa leh uchden ityehiv leh reshu venatil nishmateh
Moshe amar lamma hareota deityehiv leh reshu lesitra dera lemishlat alayehu deyisrael lemeheve beshibuda dileh davar acher lamma hareota dechama kamma minhon dehau metin veitmesaru besitra dera

Ta chaze beshata detov itar deihu yemina kal chedu vechal tivu vechal birchan mishtakkechan vecholla bachashay ihu kema deukmuha deamre baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed bachashay veraza da begin deihu keden yichuda kedeka chaze

Amar ribbi chiyya vechi eliyyahu kevan deihu gazar vekudsha berich hu mekayyem veihu gazir al shemaya dela laachata mitra vetalla hech dachil ihu meizevel deshadderat leh dichtiv ki chaet machar asim et nafshecha kenefesh achad mehem umiyyad dachil vearak al nafsheh

Amar leh ribbi yose ha ukmuha detzaddikaya la baan leatracha lemarehon beatar denizka ishtakkechat leena kegavena dishmuel dichtiv ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani amar leh eglat bakar tikkach beyadecha begin detzaddikayya la baan leatracha lemarehon beatar denizka ishtakkach uf hachi eliyyahu kevan dechama denizka ishtakkach la bae leatracha lemareh

Amar leh ana milla shemana deha beeliyyahu la ketiv beh vayyira vayyelech el nafsho ella vayyar reiya chama uma chama ella chama deha mikkamma shenin azal batreh malach hammavet vela itmasar bideh vehashta vayyelech el nafsho may vayyelech el nafsho azal lekiyyuma denafsha uman ihu ilana dechayye leitdabbeka tamman

Ta chaze kullehu ketiv et nafsho vehacha ketiv el nafsho veraza da shemana deamar ribbi shimon kal nishmatin dealma kullehu nafke mehahu nahar denagid venafik vechullehu nakit lon hahu tzerora dechayya vechad nukva itabberat min dechura kullehu betiuvta ditren sitrin betiuvta denukva legabbe dechura vechad tiuvta didchura nafka biruta keden inun nishmatin bekiyyuma yattir begin decholla betiuvta uru deilana dechayya veeliyyahu begin dehava mehahu reuta yattir mibbar nash achora itkeyyam

Uvgin kach el nafsho ketiv vela ketiv et nafsho deha et nafsho da hi nukva vei tema veel haishsha amar kelala diddechar venukva kad hi bego dechura keden veel haishsha amar et haishsha nukva bilchudaha vela diddechura kegavena da el nafsho dachar bilchodoy et nafsho nukva bilchudaha vela kelilu diddechura uvgin deihu missitra diddechura yattir mikkal bene alma itkeyyam bekiyyumeh yattir vela mit kishar bene alma begin decholla ihu meilana dechayye vela miggo afra uvgin da istallak leela vela mit keorach kal bene alma dichtiv vayyaal eliyyahu bisara hashshamayim

Ta chaze ma ketiv vehinne rechev esh vesuse esh vegv deha keden itpashshat gufa min rucha veistallak dela kishar orach bene alma veishtaar malacha kaddisha kishar kaddishe elonin veavid shelichuta vealma veha ukmuha denissin deavad kudsha berich hu bealma al yedeh itavidan

Veta chaze ma ketiv vayyishal et nafsho bekadmita vayyelech el nafsho kema deittemar bekiyyuma vehacha et nafsho lamut ilana deveh sharya mota vetamman itgeli aleh kudsha berich hu kema dichtiv tze veamadta bahar ma ketiv batreh veachar haraash esh la vaesh Adonai veachar haesh kol demama dakka da hu atar penimaa decholla deminneh nafkin kal nehorin
Ma ketiv vayehi kishmoa eliyyahu vayyalet panav beaddarto vehinne elav kol vayyomer ma lecha fo eliyyahu vayyomer kanno kinneti amar leh kudsha berich hu ad matay atta mekanne li terakat galla dela
417: Yachil leshalletaa bach mota lealma vealma la yachil lemisbelach im banay amar leh ki azvu veritcha beni yisrael vegv amar leh chayyecha debbechal atar devanay yekayemu keyam kaddisha ante tehe zammin tamman

Ta chaze ma garam hahi milla deeliyyahu dichtiv vehisharti beyisrael shivat alafim kal habbirkayim asher lo karu labbaal vechal happe asher lo nashak lo amar leh kudsha berich hu mikkan ulhala dela yachil alma lemisbelach im banay veet elisha ben shafat meavel mechola timshach lenavi tachtecha yehe nevia achora legabbe banay veatte tistallak leatrach

Vetta chaze kal hahu bar nash dimkanni leh lekudsha berich hu la yachil malacha demota leshalletaa beh kishar bene nasha veyitkayyem beh shelam veha ukmuha kema deittemar befinchas lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom
Vayyippol al tzavvere binyamin achiv vayyevchi uvinyamin bacha al tzavarav ribbi yitzchak amar ha ukmuha devacha al mikdash rishon veal mikdash sheni

Patach veamar kemigdal david tzavarech banuy letalpiyyot elef hammagen taluy alav kol shilte haggibborim kemigdal david man migdal david da migdal david vadday devana leh david vesalik leh go yerushalayim ella kemigdal david da yerushalem dilela dichtiv beh migdal oz shem Adonai bo yarutz tzaddik venisgav man nisgav ella hahu migdal nisgav begin deveh yarutz tzaddik
Tzavarecha da bet makdesha diltatta deihu kaim betikkuna deshappiru kekadla legufa ma tzavar ihu shappiru dechal gufa hachi name be makdesha ihu shappiru dechal alma
Banuy letalpiyyot tilla dechal bene alma hau mistakkelan beh vehachi ukmuha talpiyyot tel dechal piyyot dealma meshabbechan umtzallan legabbeh
Elef hammagen taluy alav illen elef tikkunin dimtakkenin beh kedeka yeut kol shilte haggibborim dechullehu ka atyan missitra dedina kashya

Ma tzavar kal tikkunin deitteta beh talyan kach bemakdesha kal tikkunin dealma beh talyan vesharyan veha ukmuha dichtiv al tzavarenu nirdafnu al be makdesha deihu tzavar veshappiru dechal alma nirdafnu yaganu lemivne leh teren zimnin velo hunach lanu deha la shavkuha lan veitcharav vela itbene levatar
Ma tzavar kevan deishtetze kal gufa ishtetze immeh hachi name be makdesha kevan deihu ishtetze veitchashshach kal alma hachi name itchashshach vela nahir shimsha vela shemaya veara vechochvaya

Begin kach bacha yosef al da ulvatar devacha al da bacha al shivtin deitgalu kad itchariv be makdesha kullehu shivtin itgalu miyyad veitbadderu bene ammaya hada hu dichtiv vayenashshek lechal echav vayyevchi alehem alehem vadday

Al kullam bacha al be makdesha deitchariv teren zimnin veal achoy aseret hashshevatim deitgalu begaluta veitbadderun bene ammaya veachare chen dibberu echav itto vela ketiv vayyivku deha ihu bacha denitznetza beh rucha kaddisha veinun la bachu dela shara alayehu ruach kudsha

Vehakkol nishma bet paro ribbi abba patach veamar nichsefa vegam kalta nafshi lechatzrot Adonai libbi uvsari yerannenu el el chay ta chaze kal bar nash detzalle tzeloteh kamme mareh itzterich leh leakdama leh birchan bechal yoma veoma ultzalle tzeloteh kamme mareh bezimna deitzterich

Betzafra leachada bimina dekudsha berich hu bemincha leachada bismala utzlota uvauta itzterich leh levar nash bechal yoma veoma begin leitachada beh veokimna man detzalle tzeloteh kamme mareh itzterich leh dela lemishma kaleh bitzloteh uman deashma kaleh bitzloteh tzeloteh la ishtema
418: Ditzlota lav ihi hahi kala deishtema dehahu kol deishtamma lav hi tzelota uman ihi tzelota da kala achora detalya bekala deishtema uman hu kala deishtema da hahu kol dehu bev kala detalya beh da hahu kol bela

Uvgin kach la itzterich leh levar nash lemishma kaleh bitzloteh ella letzallaa belachash behahu kala dela ishtema veda hi tzelota deitkabbalat tadir vesimanich vehakkol nishma kol bela nishma da hi tzelota dehi bachashay dichtiv bechanna vekolah lo yishshama da hi tzelota dekudsha berich hu kabbil kad itavid go reuta vechavana vetikkuna kedeka yeut ulyachada yichuda demareh kedeka yaot bechal yoma
Ribbi elazar amar kala bachashay da hi kala illaa dechal kalin nafkin mittamman aval kol bela da hi tzelota diltatta deihi azla leistalleka bev ulitchabbera beh

Ta chaze vehakkol nishma da hu kol bela da hi kala debbachat al mikdash rishon veal mikdash sheni nishma kema deatte amer kol berama nishma berama may berama da hu alma illaa alma deate vesimanich min harama vead bet el min haolam vead haolam hacha berama da alma illaa deha behahi shata di berama nishma keden ma ketiv vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulmisped vegv

Vehakkol nishma leela leela may tama begin dev itrachak veistallak minneh uchden rachel mevakka al baneha meana lehinnachem al baneha ki enenu ki enennu ki enam mibbae leh ella ki enennu veha okimna ki enennu devaalah la ishtakkach immah deillemale baalah yishtakkach immah titnachem alayehu deha keden benaha la yehon begaluta uvgin deenennu lav ihi mitnachama al benaha begin divnaha itrachaku minnah al deenennu immah

Ta chaze bet paro da hu simanich leela beta deitperau veitgalleyan minneh kal nehorin vechal butzinin kal ma dehava satim mittamman itgeli uvgin kach kudsha berich hu appik kal nehorin vechal butzinin begin leanhara lehahu kol deikre kol bela

Ta chaze kad yakim kudsha berich hu lehay kol meafra veyitchabbar bev keden kal ma deitavid minnayehu bezimna degaluta yithadar veyitaddenun binhorin illain deittosfan miggo alma illaa kema deatte amer vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol uvau haovdim beeretz ashshur vehanniddachim beeretz mitzrayim vehishtachau la behar hakkodesh birushalam

Veatta tzuveta zot asu kechu lachem meeretz mitzrayim vegv ribbi chiyya patach simchu et yerushalam vegilu vah kal ohaveha sisu ittah masos vegv ta chaze kad itcharav be makdesha vegarmu chovin veitgalu yisrael meara istallak kudsha berich hu leela leela vela ashgach al charuv be makdesha veal ammeh deitgalu uchden shechinta itgalleya immehon

Kad nachat ashgach al beteh deittokad istakkal al ammeh veha itgeli shaal al matronita veittarchat keden vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulmisped ulkarecha velachagor sak vehi gam hi ma ketiv bah eli kivtula chagurat sak al baal neureha kema deatte amer ki enennu begin deistallak minah veishtakkach piruda

Veafilu shemaya veara kullehu itabbalu dichtiv albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam malache illae kullehu itabbalu aleh dichtiv hen erellam tzaaku chutztza malache shalom mar yivkaun shimsha vesihara itabbalu vechashchu nehorehon dichtiv chashach hashshemesh betzeto vegv vecholla illae vetattae bachu alah
419: Veitabbalu may tama begin deshalta alah sitra achora deshalta al ara kaddisha

Patach veamar veatta ben adam ko amar Adonai elohim leadmat yisrael ketz ba hakketz al arba kanfot haaretz hay kera raza illaa ihu leadmat yisrael ketz may ihu vechi admat yisrael ketz hi ella hachi hu vadday veittemar ketz ihu limina ketz ihu lismala ketz limina dichtiv leketz hayyamin ketz lismala dichtiv ketz sam lachoshech ulchal tachlit hu choker veda hu ketz kal basar kema deittemar

Ketz dimina hayenu dichtiv leadmat yisrael ketz ba hakketz da ketz dismala ketz dimina da ketz deyetzer hattov ketz dismala da ketz deyetzer hara veda ihu dechad chovin garmu veitgabberu itgezar veityehiv shaltana lemalchut harshaa leshaltaa ulcharava beteh umikdesheh veda hu dichtiv ko amar Adonai elohim raa achar raa hinne vaa vecholla chad

Uvgin kach itabbalu illae vetattae al deityehiv shaltano lehay ketz dismala uvgin kach kevan demalchu kaddisha malchut shamayim itkafya umalchut chayyava itgabbar it leh lechal bar nash leitabbala immah ulitkafya immah uvgin dechad ihi yizdakkefa vealma yitchadde yitchadde ihu bahadah dichtiv sisu ittah masos kal hammitabbelim aleha

Ta chaze ketiv behu bemitzrayim egla yefifiya mitzrayim veraza deegla da hau yisrael techot shaltaneh kamma zimnin vechamma shenin uvgin dizminin yisrael leshalletaa levatar alah itremiz lon hashta agalot

Ribbi elazar amar remez ramaz leh yosef leyaakov al egla arufa deha behahu pirka itperash minneh veukmuha egla arufa deihi atya al deishtakkach katola vela ityeda man katil leh uvgin dela yishletun al ara ruchin bishin dela itzterichu yahavin hay egla letikkuna begin dela yishtemodun legabbeh vela yishletu alayehu
Ta chaze kal bene nasha kullehu avrin al yede demalach hammavet bar mehay deakdimu leh bene nasha ad la yimte zimna leshalletaa beh velitol reshu deha la shallit bevar nash ad denatil reshu

Uvgin kach it leh dina leshalletaa al hahu atar kema deatte amer lo noda mi hikkahu hachi name it leh dina dela ityeda begin lekatrega al hahu atar veal da velakchu zikne hair hahi eglat bakar vegv begin leaavara dineh dehahu atar ulittakkana dela yishlot beh mekatrega ulishtezava minneh

Ta chaze yosef kad itperash meavoy bela levaya uvla achila ishtaddar vehava ma dehava vechad amar yaakov tarof toraf yosef amar ki ered el beni avel sheola deana garimna leh vetu dahavena yada daachoy sanyan leh veshaddarna leh veremez ka ramiz leh

Amar leh ribbi yehuda inun agalot al pi paro shaddar lon dichtiv vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro amar leh diyyuka demilla dichtiv veatta tzuveta zot asu veatta tzuveta dayeka uvgin kach ketiv beh mashma deosef tava lon uvgin kach vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro veyaakov la itkeyyam bemilla ad dechama lon dichtiv vayyar et haagalot asher shalach yosef laset oto vattechi ruach yaakov avihem

Amar rabbi shimon bekadmita vattechi ruach yaakov ulvatar vayyomer yisrael rav od yosef beni chay ella bekadmita kare leh orayeta yaakov begin shuttafuta deishtattefu shechinta behahu cherem kad izdabban yosef vehashta dishchinta salka keden ihu vattechi ruach yaakov avihem veda hu raza dishchinta uvatar deihi kayema bekiyyuma keden darga dilela itavar legabbah darga deihu yisrael mikkan dedarga dilela la itar leela ad deitar bekadmita letatta deha hacha vattechi ruach
420: Vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayela bemarat ketiv ta chaze vayyizbach zevachim lelohe aviv yitzchak bekadmita begin leitara semala beraza dirchimu uchden vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayela behay darga dekaamaran deihi marot hallayela

Vayyomer anochi hael elohe avicha may tama begin desitra dikdushsha dilela hachi hu deha sitra dimsaava la adkar shema dekudsha berich hu vechal setar dikdushsha idkar bishmeh anochi ered immecha mitzrayema vegv mikkan dishchinta nachatat immeh begaluta uvchal atar deyisrael itgalu shechinta itgalleya immehon veha ukmuha

Ta chaze kamma agalot hau shit kema deatte amer shesh eglot tzav davar acher shitin hau vecholla raza chada bekadmita ketiv baagalot asher shalach yosef ulvassof asher shalach paro ella kullehu deshaddar yosef hau bechushbana kedeka chaze veinun deshaddar paro yattir minnayehu la hau beraza da vela hau bechushbana
Veillen veillen kaatu begin kach asher shalach yosef asher shalach paro vechad yifkun yisrael min galuta ma ketiv veheviu et kal achechem mikkal haggoyim mincha la vegv

Vayyeesor yosef merkavto ribbi yitzchak patach veamar udmut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach hannora natuy al rashehem millemala hay kera ukmuha aval ta chaze it chayya leel min chayya veit chayya kaddisha dekayema al rish chevata
Veit chayya illaa leela al kal shear chevata vehay chayya shalta al kullehu begin dechad hay chevata yahava venahara lechullehu keden kullehu natlin lematlanoy vihivat da leda veshalta da al da

Veit chevata leela al tattae al shear chevata letatta vechullehu ittezanu minah ved sitre dealma reshimin bah anpin nehirin yedian lechal setar veihi shalta al sitre veha ukmuha deinun listar da veg listar da vechen led sitrin dealma

Veit rakia leel min rakia vehay rakia deshalta alayehu kullehu mistakkelan legabbeh ma ketiv vetachat harakia kanfehem yesharot ishsha el achotah vegv begin dechullehu shaltin al ma deitpakdu ushlichu dekusta dekuftera behu
Veinun lechal setar tisha led sitrin dealma veinun bechushbena vechad mitchabberan kullehu itavidu reshima chada beraza dishma chada beyichuda shelim kidkachaze

Vechad mittakne legabbe karseya ma ketiv umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav millemala veha okimna dehay even tava becharseya dekayema al kayemin veal hahu karseya diukna deadam leitchabbera beh kechada ulitbarcha kedeka yeut

Vechad ihi mittakna legabbeh deadam lemeheve kolla reticha chada lehay adam keden ketiv vayyeesor yosef merkavto da tzaddik vayyaal likrat yisrael aviv goshna likrat yisrael da raza deadam goshna tikruvta chada leitkerava kechada bekarbana chada veyichuda chada

Vayyera elav dechad itchaze shimsha besihara keden nahir sihara veanhir lechullehu diltatta vechen kegavena da kal zimna dikdushsha dilela shara al makdesha diltatta itnehir be makdesha vekayema bishlimuteh vechad istallak minneh veitchariv be makdesha keden vayyevchi al tzavarav od devachun kolla al makdesha deitchariv od may od da galuta batraa
Keden kevan dechama yaakov veistakkal deha tikkuna diltatta ishtachlal kegavena dilela keden amar amuta happaam vegv ki odcha chay deitkayemat beraza divrit kaddisha
421: Deikre chay haolamim uvgin kach ki odcha chay veal da bekadmita amar rav od yosef beni chay deitzterich lemekam beraza dechay veha ittemar
Ta chaze ma ketiv vayevarech yaakov et paro amar ribbi yose paro af al gav deukmuha beraza ochara semech deka samchinan bealma

Aval ta chaze lesusati berichve faro dimmitich raayati ta chaze it retichin lismala beraza desitra achora veit retichin limina beraza dilela dikdushsha veillen lakovel illen illen derachame veillen dedina

Vechad kudsha berich hu avad dina bemitzrae kal dina deavid kehahu gavena deinun retichin mammash uchgavena dileh dehahu sitra mammash ma hahu sitra katil veappik nishmatin uf kudsha berich hu avid behahu gavena mammash dichtiv vayyaharog Adonai kal bechor vechen kolla bemitzrayim behahu gavena mammash uvgin kach dimitich raayati kegavena dilah mammash lekatla dichtiv ki ani Adonai ani hu velo acher ulzimna deate ma ketiv mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra vegv

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen vayyeachazu vah vayyifru vayyirbu meod vayyeachazu vah achsanat almin veyyeachazu bah deha lehon itchaze kema deukmuha vayyifru vayyirbu meod vday deha tzaara la sharat behu vekayeme betafnuke alma uvgin kach vayyifru vayyirbu meod baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
422: Hahi sefekan deamin sappirin dechurse yekara vela mata lehon shum enish la min illaa vela min tattaa ella veraza da ki lo yirani haadam vachay

Kamma hu raza illaa beda kera veanan chavraya temehin alayehu al vayechi dedachir immeh yaakov hava leh lememar kamme yisrael yisrael minnayin dichtiv kodesh yisrael la reshit vegv beni bechori yisrael ribbi elazar bereh deribbi shimon amar vechi la amar kera vayyimkor et bechorato leyaakov
Amar ribbi shimon avuha beidna dehau yisrael keshitin vezakkain veavdin zechu vela hau retitin yisrael ella yaakov lechudeh bedin tavan deavdin hava lemebad lehu tavan saggiin da beda

Middechavu veitgeliu al chovehon veal ovadehon bishin la hau savlin yateh dela yeheveyan lealma bekushta al chovehon veal da ate mechilta derachame vedina lechud yisrael veyahavit yathon beara galuthon
Yaot bae beri aval inish mistakkel veyinda yateh yaakov demitlaf im vayechi kodesh veal dena raza amrin yaakov bachar yateh sappira bechurse yekara
Ribbi shimon patach veamar veet dakka ushfal ruach lehachaot ruach shefalim ulhachaot lev nidkaim lev nidkaim da yaakov kema deatte amer techot min darga nechitat alohi neviin birchan bemitzrayim
Tana amar ribbi abba libba chama deyaakov dehava bemitzrayim let nevuateh maaluta ara saggia

Ta chaze la zache levarech lechad mibbenohi vela hava bideh rucha levarech ella bemitzrayim kad barich yathon kal chad vechad beraza veraza vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau ta chaze dela ityehivat nevuata ella litvire libba kema deatte amer redu shamma veshivru lanu mishsham venichye velo namut

Amar ribbi yose techot karse yekara kaddisha yaakov sappir deihi mechilata dedina lesitreh ata amar lo yaakov yeamer od shimmecha ki im yisrael ki sarita im elohim veim anashim vattuchal atte mashkach deyaakov chaza lesitreh mechilata dedina vayyizrach lo hashshemesh kaasher avar et penuel vegv veraza demilla oy lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzillele arev
Ribbi shimon amar kad itgeliu min yerushlem veaadiu tedira vesaiv mesana yat hechala beiddana hahi la sovlat malchuta leyisrael al chovehon ella yisrael begin dehi mittere gisa rachame vedina

Umilla delo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im yisrael kad itperish bisvireh yisrael yaakov illaa da min da uvginehon hava chutra demoshe gelifa mitteren sitroy mishmeh kaddisha chad rachame bedina vechad dina bedina

Veraza lo hibbit aven beyaakov velo raa amal beyisrael middaanan begaluta dechikan ben sane veistallikat matronita min malka veitrechikat minneh hu yashre shechinta benana veyifrekinana veraza ko amar Adonai melech yisrael vegoalo Adonai tzevaot vayechi chay ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay
Binyan illaa shette raglay chay rabbata lech zeerta letov lev led hada hu denafik meillaa
Techot karseh yekara meeven tava beeretz mitzrayim hayenu dichtiv venagaf Adonai et mitzrayim vegv perisha ki tal orot tallecha begin perisha

Uvgin da mitchalaf kechada perisha galuta perisha kadmayeta ta chaze may dichtiv bet yaakov lechu venelcha beor Adonai begaluta atvan deitgezar alehon al chovehon bekushta bedina hau beorayeta takkanta vetifkun min chamra tina dehi galuta vetahachu lenahara dayeya
Retzono lomar baaretz ittzappe ata betigna desifra deorayeta veana itpalig baaretz baaretz atte mashkach betigna desifra deorayeta mitlappin kechada galuta may galuta demitzrae arba
423: Mea shenin hava amar leavraham dihe galuta livnohi bemitzrae vechi havet maneta yathon matan vetishin shenin hau

Ta chaze vayyamat yosef ben mea veeser shanim ribbi shimon patach veamar hinne haalma hara veoledet ben vekarat shemo immanuel idduy veleda deitmele legilluyan veaktan saggiin veidan bishin veaf al gav diyehu beillen matrunita izdazeat veitrachakat min baalah tehe immana begaluta ben mea veeser hava gillufa deittosaf yitree lememar vehava avar min galuta mea veeser shenin umatan vetishin havi arba mea shenin vela itmene galuta deyaakov ella middemit yosef

Vayehi yeme yaakov shene chayyav sheva shanim vearbaim umat shena hacha raza begaluta beminyena tikunta yehon benaya deitgalleyan bemichilata dedina telata gallavan kadmaa demitzrae deitmetal bishva shenin ribbi chiyya patach veamar hishbati etchem benot yerushalam bitzvaot o beayelot vegv

Ribbi shimon amar mehacha merachok Adonai nira li veahavat olam ahavtich vegv hacha raza begaluta takkanta yehon benohi deyisrael mishtere gallaya veyitree lememar yehon benaya kaddisha deitgallavan al chovehon bedina shenin saggiin yehe sheva kechattotechem ki shivatayim yukkam kayin begaluta kadmaa demitzrae dehi zeera
Tinyana galuta deshoftim deitmetal learbaim shenin bishva deinhu saggie minneh
Telitae galuta daanan beh aricha deitmetal lima shenin learbein vehayenu da al gabbe ilaa deamar umeet husar hattamid velatet shikkutz shomem vegv

Vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut ribbi chizkiyya amar chama da akta degaluta dehava aran livnohi keriva anafsheh udchikat limmat la ishtaar chay kad hava nachit midargin bedil chovehon deyisrael la nachit immehon begaluta zakkaa chulkehon dei la nachit immehon begaluta ishattaaran bene ammaya veatte amarte maddua bati veen ish karati veen on veen one da yisrael bati veen ish da shechina hakkatzor katzra yadi mippedut veim en bi koach lehatztzil hen begaarati achariv yam asim neharot midbar kudsha berich hu yahav chulaka leyisrael dela yishlot ravrevana achora vehon nachatu legaluta shechinta immehon vehu rachik mimmatronita
Vayyikra livno leosef vayyomer lo im na matzati chen beenecha chakar yat benohi kullehon veamar lehon aktan saggiin bishin ravrevin chamit lemeal livrechon ashkechan rachame illae

Vei attun baan lemepak mikkal akta kayemu li vehavu benana ribbon alma vetaavdun keshot vedina vetehve kaavahatchon ufakkide bechal dar vedar deyete batrechon vei attun baan lemebad hachi tifkun mikkal akta deyete alechon
Ribbi shimon amar vehatztzigu vashshaar mishpat ulay yechonan Adonai elohe tzevaot sheerit yosef
Vei taavdun hachi la tikberun chad min beri ella itti tetuvun learachon bishlama

Hada hu dichtiv sim na yadcha tachat yerechi mahu yadcha patach veamar chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha sayefa dekay bah chesed veemet teren sefiran sefiran vela shavkin da leda veal da amar chesed veemet yekadmu fanecha pene Adonai chillekam vei hau tavan benohi veavidu ma dekayemu la mit chad mibbenayehu bemitzrae dechal tav vetav degazir shema delaha al enasha la have ella al dihon tavin vei la la kema deamar david lemaan yakim Adonai et devaro asher dibber alay lemor im yishmeru vanecha et darkam lalechet lefanay beemet vei la la
Ta chaze kamma hu adif rucha deabba merucha devara derucha deabba hu rucha divra rucha merucha salka vei sayeat avira achora berucha la nafik shelim
424: Deha chasir hu behay avira vehayenu pere limmud midbar beavat nafshah shaafa ruach

Tana rav hamnuna sava azal lekappotkiyya al lekammayhu rav yiyisa sava amar leh bemay askitu vay leh vay lenafsheh i ishtelaf rucha dimsaava deishtakkach immeh veorit leh livreh vehay ihu dekudsha berich hu let leh chulaka shavik leh chulaka shavik leh leshetzaa leh lealma deate amar leh mena lach ha amar leh hacha olifna dehay yeruta bishta achsenin kullehu benoy i la yetuvun deha let milla kayema kame teshuva veana hachi olifna deha asvata da yahavu li zimna chada dehavena reshim beanpi veoma chad havena azil bearcha vearana bechad zakkaa veal yedoy itavar minay hahu reshima amar leh ma shemach amar leh elazar vekarena leh elazar achora amar leh berich rachamana dechamena lach zakkaa chulakach bealma den uvalma deate

Vayyomer hishshava li vegv ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo kiyyem kudsha berich hu deyippuk leyisrael min galuta dilhon veda kiyyem lehon keyam dela yishbok lon beara sanehon
Vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani man berachtani yahav lon galuta vekkiyyem lon deyifkun minneh

427: Vayyomer yaakov el yosef el shadday nira elay beluz beeretz kenaan ribbi abba amar luz da yerushala illaa deashraa shechinta benaha amar yaakov illaa letatta hav li birchata dehu bae leanpish yatchon ana ulmitan yat ara livnechon luz zo yerushala illaa kudsha berich hu hav ravreva dehaveyan beracha da al yedeh beara ravya aval bera leara achora la yehe birchata

Zakkaa chulkehon dehay amma dachya dehu alehon deikre vanim chavivim yattir meillaa ketiv banim attem la kolla bedil da may hu bedil deishtelim shema bechotama dilhon deinun gezirin

Vayechi yaakov vegv ribbi chiyya patach veamar veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz vegv zakkain inun yisrael yattir mikkal ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot dekudsha berich hu kara lon tzaddikim leachsin lon yerutat almin bealma deate leitanaga behahu alma kema dichtiv az titanneg al Adonai may tama begin demitdabbekin begufa demalka dichtiv veattem haddevekim ba elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom

Ribbi yitzchak patach veamar veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz hay kera raza illaa ihu ben mechatzde chakla deha beraza deaggadta tane ribbi shimon deachsanat yeruta illaa dehahi eretz let man deyarit lah bar hahu deikre tzaddik deha matronita beh itdabbekat leitbassema vetzaddik yarit lematronita vadday

Uf hacha bachavivuta dekudsha berich hu leyisrael amar veammech kullam tzaddikim uvgin kach leolam yirshu eretz itchazun leyarit lematronita may tama ikrun tzaddikim umay tama yartin lematronita begin deitgazzaru kema detaninan kal man deitgezar veayyil behay achsana venatir lehay berit al veitdabbak begufa demalka veal behay tzaddik uvgine kach ikrun tzaddikim veal da leolam yirshu aretz may aretz da eretz hachayyim

Ahadar veamar netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer nitzer mattaay anafa meinun anafin denata kudsha berich hu kad bara alma dichtiv vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem vehay eretz chad minnayehu begini kach nitzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer
Davar acher veammech kullam tzaddikim da yaakov uvnoy denachatu lemitzrayim ben am keshe kedal veishtakkachu kullehu zakkain uvgin kach ketiv leolam
431: Yirshu eretz demmittamman seliku lirat ara kaddisha
Vayechi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim ammay parshata da setima ribbi yaakov amar beshata demit yaakov istimu enehon deyisrael ribbi yehuda amar dichden nachatu legaluta veishtabidu behon

Ribbi shimon amar ma ketiv leela vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen vayyeachazu vah vayyifru vayyirbu meod uchtiv vayechi yaakov dela itchaze leafrasha ben da leda ma inun kayeme betafnukin demalchin vekabbilu innuga vechissufin legarmayehu uf yaakov name kayyam betafnuke malchin beinnuga vechissufa legarmeh la itperash da min da

Vehacha ikre vayechi deha kal yomoy la ikre vayechi begin dechal yomoy betzaara hau betzaara ishtakkechan aleh ketiv lo shalavetti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez batar denachat lemitzrayim ikre vayechi chama livreh malka chama lechal benoy zakkain tzaddikin vechullehu betaanuge vetafnuke alma vehu yativ benihon kachamar tav deyativ al durdayyeh keden ikre vayechi yaakov vela parish ben vayyifru vayyirbu meod levayechi yaakov vehachi itchaze

Sheva esre shana may tama sheva esre shana ella amar rabbi shimon kal yomoy deyaakov betzaara hau betzaara aavar lon bekadmita kevan dechama leosef vehava kaim kammeh kad yaakov mistakkel beosef hava ishtelim benafsheh keilu chama leimmeh deosef deshappiru deosef dame leshappiru derachel vehava dame begarmeh kema dela aavar aleh tzaara beomoy

Vechad yosef itperash minneh keden itkeyyam lo shalavetti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez deda kashya leh leyaakov mikkal ma deavar uvzimna deitperash yosef minneh ma ketiv yosef ben sheva esre shana haya roe vegv vechal yomin deyaakov la hava leh tzaara kehay vehava bache kal yoma leinun sheva esre shana deosef

May kaativu leh veosef yashit yado al enecha ha lecha sheva esre shana achoranin beinnugin vetafnukin vahanaot vechissufin hada hu dichtiv vayechi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim sheva esre shana vegv tana kal inun shenin shechinta yekara dekudsha berich hu immeh ishtakkecha uvgin kach chayyim ikrun

Ta chaze ketiv vattechi ruach yaakov avihem itchaze deha bekadmita mit hava hahu rucha dileh vela hava mitkaven lekabbela rucha achora deha rucha dilela la sharya berekanya amar ribbi yose shechinta la sharya ella beatar shelim vela beatar chaser vela beatar pagim vela beatar atziv ella beatar deitkaven beatar chadu uvgin kach kal inun shenin deosef itperash meavoy veyaakov hava atziv la sharya beh shechinta

Tana amar ribbi elazar amar ribbi abba ketiv ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana leafaka delet pulchana dekudsha berich hu ella miggo chedva deamar ribbi elazar let shechinta sharya miggo atzvut dichtiv veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamnaggen menaggen menaggen telat zimne ammay begin leatara rucha mishlemuta decholla dehu ruach shelema

Amar ribbi abba tamman taninan mearba sitrin kolla ishtakkach vechal sharashin deillain vetattain behu achidan vetana da ayil veda nafik da satim veda parish itachad chad bachavertah veinun avahan decholla
Ribbi shimon amar rak baavotecha chashak Adonai ketiv baavotecha mammash telata umashma dichtiv rak rak mammash umeillen mitparshan umitachadan kal shear achoranin vesalkin shema leitattera

Tana amar ribbi yose min yoma deistallik ribbi shimon min mearta millin la itkasyan min chavraya verazin illain hau mistakkelan veitgalleyan mibbenayehu keillu ityehivu hahi shata betura desinay batar deshachiv ketiv vayyissachru mayenot
432: Tehom vaarubbot hashshamayim vehau chavraya merachashan mille vela mitkayeme behu
Deoma chad hava yativ ribbi yehuda afitcha ditverya vechama tere gemalle desalke katfira mealoy dechitfin nafal matula dekatfira veatu tzippore vead la matu alayehu itbakkau
Levatar atu kamma tzipporin vehau azle alayehu vesharu lon betartisha vela mitbakkein vehau tzavechin lon vela hau mitparshan shamu chad kala itra deitrin bekidrin sharya umarih levar

Ad dehava yativ avar chad gavra ashgach behu amar la kiyyem da ha dichtiv vayyered haayyit al happegarim vayyashshev otam avram amar ribbi yehuda veha avidna vela itparshan ahadar resheh hahu gavra veamar ad la marit da resheh demareh vead la galish lematronita rahat avatreh telat millin vela amar leh chalash dateh deribbi yehuda

Yoma chad idmuch techot ilana vechama bechelmeh gadfin mittaknan vesalik ribbi shimon alayehu vesefer tora immeh vela shavik kal sifre razin illain vaagadta dela salik lon bahadeh vesalik lehon lirkia vechama demitkasya meena vela itgalya
Kad itar amar vadday middeshachiv ribbi shimon chachmeta istallekat meara vay ledara dehay avna tava dehau mitchazan minneh vesamchin aleh illain vetattain itavid minnayehu

Ata legabbeh deribbi abba sach leh salik ribbi abba yedoy al resheh uvacha veamar ribbi shimon rechaya detachanin minneh manna tava kal yoma velaktin leh kema dichtiv hammamit asaf asara chomarim vehashta rechayya umanna istalleku vela ishtaar bealma mineh bar kema dichtiv kach tzintzenet achat veten shamma melo haomer man vehannach oto lifne Adonai lemishmeret veillu beitgalleya la ketiv ella lemishmeret leatznauta hashta man yachil legallaa razin uman yinda lon

Lachish leh leribbi yehuda bilchishu vadday hahu gavra dechamit eliyyahu hava vela baa legallaa razin begin detinda shevacha deribbi shimon dehava beomoy veyivkon dara aloy amar leh day lemivke bechiyya aleh

Ribbi yehuda hava bache kal yoma aloy deha aara immeh beidra kaddisha deribbi shimon ushar chavraya amar leh vay dela istallakna hahu yoma im inun telata deistallaku vela lecheme dara da deha ithappach

Amar leh ribbi ema li ketiv vehem yikchu et hazzahav veet hattechelet veet haargaman veet tolaat hashshani veet hashshesh veilu kesef la ketiv veha ketiv zahav vachesef amar leh veha name nechoshet dechesef unchoshet bechushbena hau vehacha la ella i la degalle botzina kaddisha beatreh la itztarichna legallaa
Patach veamar li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai hayenu dichtiv hashshamayim shamayim la

Bechamma atar istakkalna beillen mane dekudsha dichtiv bigde kodesh hem uchtiv veasu bigde kodesh may kedushsha hacha ella hachi taninan kedushsha inun bechal atar uchtiv bigde kodesh hem veasita bigde kodesh kegavena dilela

Detanya kohen gadol leela kohen gadol letatta levushin dikar leela levushin dikar letatta uma dela amar kesef unchoshet leatar achora istalliku dichtiv kal ammude hechatzer saviv mechushakim kasef vegv uchtiv veadnehem nechoshet deinun mane shimmusha leishtammasha mashkena behu

Aval hacha beillen levushin dikar la bae leishtammasha behu bar nash achora bar mikkahana rabba dirvu meshach kudsha al resheh dichtiv veasita bigde kodesh leaharon achicha lechavod ultifaret divinun levushin dame legavena dilela
Tanya vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut amar ribbi yehuda vay lealma deha bene nasha la chaman vela shemaan vela
433: Yadin deha kal yoma veoma kala decharoza ishtema bematan vechamshin almin
Tana alma chada ishtemoda leela vechad karoza nafik hahu alma mizdazea umitchalchela nafke teren tzipporin deistallaku mehahu alma dimdorehon techot ilana dechezu dechayye umota beh
Nafka chad tzippora listar daroma vechad tzippora listar tzafona vechad tzippora kad nahir yemama vechad kad itchashach yemama kal chad vechad kare umachreza ma deshamin mehahu karoza

Levatar bau leistallaka leatrayehu umishtamte raglayehu benukva dithoma rabba umitlakkedan begaveh ad deitpelig lelya kad itpelig lelya karoza kare vechatztzipporim haachuzot bappach kahem yukashim bene haadam

Amar ribbi yehuda beshata demitlakkedan ragloy divne nasha veomoy itkerivu hahu yoma itkere yom Adonai leatava rucheh leh tana behahi shata pakda hahu kitra kaddisha al rucheh uman ihu dichtiv yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana vehi kitra sheviaa decholla

Veim missitra digvura kaote ketiv veim bigvurot shemonim shana dechitra digvura teminaa have mikkan ulhala let atar leitmeshach kema deatte amer verahbam amal vaaven beatar dela have yesoda binyana la itkeyyam

Amar ribbi yehuda zakkain inun tzaddikaya kad kudsha berich hu baa leatava rucheh leh ulshaava hahu rucha begaveh detanya beshata dekudsha berich hu baa leatava rucheh leh i zakkaa hu hahu rucha ma ketiv veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah

Vei la ishtakkach zachaa vay lehahu rucha devae leistachaa benura dedalik ulittakkana begin leishtaava begufa demalka vei la ittakkanat vay lehahu rucha demitgalgela keavna bekosfita dichtiv veet nefesh oyevecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala tanya i hahu rucha zache kamma tavin genizin leh behahu alma dichtiv ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo
Amar ribbi yose kad hahu bar nash itkerivu yomoy telatin yomin machrize aloy bealma veafilu tzippore shemaya machrizin aloy vei zakkaa hu telatin yomin machrizin aloy ben tzaddikaya beginta deeden

Tana kal inun telatin yomin nishmateh nafkat minneh bechal lelya vesalkat vechamat duchtah behahu alma vehahu bar nash la yada vela ashgach vela shallit benishmateh kal inun telatin yomin kema dehava bekadmita dichtiv en adam shallit baruach lichlo et haruach vegv amar ribbi yehuda mikkad sharan inun telatin yomin tzalma debbar nash itchashach vediukna deitchaze beara itmenaat
Ribbi yitzchak hava yativ yoma chad afitcha deribbi yehuda vehava atziv nafik ribbi yehuda ashkecheh letareh dehava yativ veatziv amar leh man yoma den mishshear yomin

Amar leh atena legabbach lemive minach telat millin chad dechad tema mille deorayeta vetadkar meinun millin deana amina detema lon mishshemi begin leadkara shemi vechad detizke leosef beri beorayeta vechad detezil lekivri kal yomin vetive bautich alay

Amar leh minnayin lach amar leh ha nishmati istallekat mini bechal lelya vela anhir li bechelma kema dehava bekadmita veod dechad ana matzlena umatina leshomea tefilla ashgachna betzulmi dili bechotla vela chamina leh veamina dehoil vetzalma itavar vela itchaze deha karoza nafik vechariz dichtiv ach betzelem yithallech ish kal zimna detzulma devar nash la yitavar minneh yithallech ish verucheh itkayema begaveh itavar tzulma devar nash vela itchaze itavar mehay alma
Amar leh umehacha dichtiv ki tzel yamenu ale aretz amar leh kal illen millin deatte bae avidna aval baina minach
434: Divhahu alma tevarir duchtay gabbach kema dahavena behay alma bacha ribbi yitzchak veamar bematu minach dela titparesh minnay kal illen yomin

Azlu legabbeh deribbi shimon ashkechuhu dehava lae beorayeta zakif enoy ribbi shimon vechama leribbi yitzchak vechama lemalach hammavet derahit kammeh verakid kammeh kam ribbi shimon achid bideh deribbi yitzchak amar gozarna man deragil lemeal yeul uman dela ragil lemeal la yeul alu ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda katir malach hammavet levar

Ashgach ribbi shimon vechama dead kean la mata iddana deha ad temanya shate deoma hava zimna otveh kamme ribbi shimon vehava lae leh beorayeta amar rabbi shimon leribbi elazar berih tiv afitcha uma detechome la tishtae bahadeh vei yive lemeal hacha ome omaa dela leol

Amar ribbi shimon leribbi yitzchak chamit diukna deavuch yoma da o la deha taninan beshata devar nash istallak mealma avoy vekerevoy mishtakkechin tamman immeh vechama lon veishtemoda lon vechal inun dehava medoreh gabbayehu behahu alma bedarga chad kullehu mitkanneshe umishtakkeche immeh veazlin im nishmateh ad atar detishre beatreh amar ad kean la chamena

Addehachi kam ribbi shimon veamar mare dealma ishtemoda ribbi yitzchak legabban umeinnun shiva ayenin dehacha hu ha achidna beh vehav li nafak kala veamar kurseya demareh keriva begadfoy deribbi shimon ha didach hu veimmach tayeteh bezimna detiol lemishre bechurseyach amar ribbi shimon vadday

Addehachi chama ribbi elazar dehava istallik malach hammavet veamar let kuftera detifsa beatar deribbi shimon ben yochay shechiach amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar bereh ul hacha veachid beh beribbi yitzchak deha chamena beh demistafe al ribbi elazar veachid beh veribbi shimon ahadar anpeh velae beorayeta

Nayim ribbi yitzchak vechama leavoy amar leh beri zakkaa chulakach bealma den uvalma deate deha ben tarpe ilana dechayye deginta deeden ityehiv ilana rabba vetakkif bitren almin ribbi shimon ben yochay hu deha hu achid lach beanfoy zakkaa chulakach beri

Amar leh abba uma ana hatam amar leh telat yomin hau dechafu idra demishkavach vetakkinu lach kevan petichan leanhara lach mearba sitrin dealma veana chamena duchtech vechadena daamena zakkaa chulakach beri bar dead kean berach la zache beorayeta

Veha hashta have zeminin lemete gabbach teresar tzaddikaya dechavraya vead dahavena nafke itar kala bechullehu almin man chavrin dekayemin hacha itataru begineh deribbi shimon sheelta shail veityehiv leh

Vela da bilchodoy deha shivin duchte mitatteran hacha dileh vechal duchta veduchta patchin petichan leshivin almin vechal alma vealma itpattach le rehitin vechal rehita urhita itpattach leshivin kitrin illain umittamman itpattachu archin leattika setimaa decholla lemecheme behahu neimuta illaa denahara umhanya lecholla kema deatte amer lachazot benoam Adonai ulvakker behechalo mahu ulvakker behechalo hayenu dichtiv bechal beti neeman hu

Amar leh abba kamma zimna yehivu li behay alma amar leh let li reshuta vela modae leh levar nash aval behillula rabba deribbi shimon tehe metakken patoreh kema deatte amer tzeena urena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo imo beom chatunnato uvom simchat libbo
Addehachi itar ribbi yitzchak vehava chayich veanpoy nehirin chama ribbi shimon veistakkel beanpoy amar leh milla chadta shemata amar leh vadday sach leh ishtattach kammeh deribbi shimon
435: Ribbi yitzchak achid livreh bideh velae leh beorayeta vela hava shavkeh kad hava al kammeh deribbi shimon otveh livreh levar veyativ kammeh deribbi shimon vehava kare kammeh Adonai ashka li arveni

Tana behahu yoma takkifa udchilu devar nash kad mate zimneh leistallaka mealma arba sitrin dealma kayemin bedina takkifa umitarin dinin mearba sitre alma vearba kishshurin natzan uktatuta ishtakkach benayehu uvayan leitperasha kal chad lesitroy
Karoza nafik umachreza behahu alma veishtema bematan veshivin almin i zakkaa hu kullehu almin chadan lekadamuteh vei lav vay lehahu bar nash ulchulakeh
Tana behahu zimna decharoza kariz keden nafak chad shalhova missetar tzafon veazla veittokad binhar dinur umitparsha learba sitre alma veokid nishmathon dechayyavaya
Venafak hahu shalhova vesalka venachata bealma vehahu shalhova mata begadfoy detarnegola uchma uvatash begadfoy vekare befitcha ben tare

Zimna kadmaa kare veamar hinne yom Adonai ba boer kattannur vegv zimna tinyana kare veamar ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach umaggid leadam ma secho vehahi shaatta yativ bar nash beovadoy desahadin kammeh vehu ode alayehu zimna telitaa kad bayan leafaka nishmateh minneh kare tarnegola veamar mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata vegv

Amar ribbi yose tarnegola uchma lemay nafka amar leh ribbi yehuda kal ma deavad kudsha berich hu beara kullehu ramiz bechachma bar divne nasha la yade hada hu dichtiv ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyanecha umishshum deitavidu bechachma kullehu remizin bechachma

Vetarnegola uchma taninan let dina sharya ella beatar dehu zinih veuchma missitra dedina kaate uvgin kach befalgut lelya mammash kad rucha desitra detzafon itar chad shalhova nafik uvatash techot gadfoy detarnegola vekare vechal shekken betarnegola uchma deitkaven yattir meachara

Uf hacha beshata dedina devar nash yitar share vekare leh velet deyada leh bar hahu bar nash deshachiv detaninan beshata devar nash shachiv vedina sharya aleh lenafka mehay alma ittosaf rucha illaa beh ma dela hava beomoy vechevan desharya aloy veitdabbak beh chame ma dela zacha beomoy mishshum deittosaf beh hahu rucha vechad ittosaf beh vechama keden nafik mehay alma hada hu dichtiv tosef rucham yigvaun veel afaram yeshuvun keden ketiv ki lo yirani haadam vachay bechayyehon la zachan bemitathon zachan

Tana beshata devar nash mit ityehiv leh reshuta lemecheme vechame gabbeh kerivoy vechavroy mehahu alma veishtemoda lehu vechullehu gelifin bediuknehon kema dehau behay alma i zakkaa hahu bar nash kullehu chadan kammeh umakdeme leh shelam

Vei zakkaa la have la ishtemodan gabbeh bar meinun chayyavaya detardin lon bechal yoma baggehinnam vechullehu atzivin ufatchin bevay umsayemin bevay vesalik enoy vechama lon ketisa demistalleka min nura uf hachi hu patach vay

Tanya beshata denafak nishmateh devar nash azlin kullehu kerivoy vechavroy dehahu alma im nishmateh umachzeyan leh atra deidduna veatra deonasha i zakkaa havi chame duchteh vesalik veyativ veitadan beidduna illaa dehahu alma vei la have zakkaa ishtearat hahi nishmata behay alma ad deitamir gufa beara kevan deitamar kamma gardinin denimmusin achadan beh ad demata leduma vealin leh bemadoroy degehinnom
Amar ribbi yehuda kal yomin nishmata azla mibbeteh lekivreh umikkivreh leveteh veitabbalat aloy
436: Degufa dichtiv ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval azla veyatva beveteh chame lechullehu atzivin umitabbela

Tana batar yomin gufa have kema dehava venishmateh alat leduchta alat limarta dechafelta chamat ma dechamat vealat leatar dealat ad dematat leggan eden vearat lichruvim veshanan decharba di beggan eden diltatta i zakkaa hu deteul alat
Tana arba samchin zeminin vechad diukna degufa bidayehu mitlabbesha beh bechedvata veyativat behahu madora deggan eden diltatta ad zimna deitgezar alah levatar keroza kare

Veammuda ditlat gevane izdamman vehahu ammuda itkere mechon har tziyyon dichtiv uvara Adonai al mechon har tziyyon veal mikraeha anan yomam veashan vegv salka behahu ammuda lefitcha detzedek detziyyon virushalam beh

I zache lesalka yattir tav chulakeh veadveh leitdabbeka bego gufa demalka vei la zache lesalleka yattir ketiv vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalam kadosh yeamer lo vei zache lesalka yattir zakkaa hu dezache likara demalka ulitaddena beidduna illaa dilela meatar deikre shamayim dichtiv az titanneg al Adonai al Adonai dayeka zakkaa chulakeh deman dezache lechesed da dichtiv ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha

Vechi al hashshamayim hu veha ketiv ki gadol ad shamayim chasdecha amar ribbi yose it chesed veit chesed chesed illaa vechesed tattaa chesed illaa meal shamayim hu chesed tattaa hu dichtiv chasde david hanneemanim uvhanne ketiv ad shamayim

Tanya amar ribbi yitzchak ketiv em habbanim semecha halleluya imma yedia habbanim man inun amar ribbi shimon ha taninan teren benin it lekudsha berich hu chad dechar vechad nukva dechar yahaveh leyaakov dichtiv beni bechori yisrael uchtiv yisrael asher becha etpaer bat yahavah leavraham dichtiv va berach et avraham bakkol bat hayeta lo leavraham uvakkol shema

Veima revia alayehu deyanka lehu veal hay ketiv lo tikkach haem al habbanim vetaninan la yasge bar nash chovoy letatta begin deyistallak imma meal benin uchtiv immecha hi lo tegalle ervatah vay leman degale eryata

Vechad tayevin bene alma veasgin bizchuta kamme kudsha berich hu veimma tavat vechasya al benin keden itkere teshuva may teshuva da teshuva deimma detavat bekiyyumaha uchden ketiv em habbanim semecha em habbanim vadday veal da la lippatar inish mipperiyya urviyya ad deolid ben uvat

Tanya amar ribbi yitzchak ketiv lachazot benoam Adonai ulvakker behechalo tiuvta detzaddikaya lemecheme da Adonai veatte amarte al Adonai amar ribbi shimon kolla chad mashma dichtiv noam Adonai deatya meattika kaddisha lehay shamayim vetiuvta detzaddikaya kach hu vadday veal hashshamayim ketiv az titanneg al Adonai zakkaa chulakeh man dezache vadday zeirin inun

Taninan amar rabbi shimon ketiv bene immi nicharu vi samuni notera et hakkeramim bene immi kema dichtiv hishlich mishshamayim eretz dechad baa kudsha berich hu lemechrava beteh diltatta ulaglaa yisrael bene ammaya aavar kudsha berich hu mikkammeh lehay eretz veitrachaka minnih kedichtiv vattetatztzav achoto merachok vechad hay eretz itrachaka mishshamayim dilela hay eretz diltatta itcharva veyisrael itpazzeru beni ammaya amra keneset yisrael man garim li hay uman avid li hay bene immi denicharu vi veitrachaku minni beni immi vadday
Ribbi yose hava azil bearcha vehava immeh ribbi chiyya bar rav ad dehau azle amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyya chameta ma deana chamit amar leh chamena gavra chad benahara vetzippora chad al
437: Resheh veila befumeh detzippora veachla verafsa beragloy vehahu gevar rame kalin vetzavach vela yedana may kaamar

Amar nikrav gabbeh venishma amar mistafina lemikrav amar leh vechi bar nash hu beatar da ella remiza dechachmeta deramiz lan kudsha berich hu kerivu gabbeh shamu dehava amar otra otra teren benin sharyan levar la nach vela nayecha ad detzafra bekisra remiv
Bacha ribbi yose veamar hayenu detaninan bene immi nicharu vi vegv may tama begin decharmi shelli lo natarti

Amar vadday galuta itmeshach veal da tzippore shemaya la aadiu ad di shaltanuta deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot aadiu min alma veematay ad deyimte yoma dekudsha berich hu itar dinoy bealma dichtiv vehaya yom echad hu yivada la lo yom velo layela
Ad dehau azlin shamu chad kala dehava amar okida dekuftira mata bedinoy nafak chad shalhova veokid lehahu tzippora amar vadday kema dichtiv vihivat likedat eshsha

Amar ribbi yose la agle kudsha berich hu leyisrael ella bezimna dela ishtakkach mehemnuta benayehu kad itmena mehemnuta benayehu kivyachol hachi ishtakkach becholla dichtiv vechipper beritchem et mavet

Amar ribbi chiyya may dichtiv billa hammavet lanetzach amar leh kad yitar kudsha berich hu yemina dileh itmena mota min alma vela yitar hay yemina ella kad yitarun yisrael bimina dekudsha berich hu umay nihu tora dichtiv bah mimino esh dat lamo behahu zimna yemin Adonai osa chayil vegv lo amut ki echye vaasapper maase yah

Tana hahu zakkaa dekudsha berich hu itrae beh vecharoza kare aleh yomin bene tzaddikaya beginta deeden kullehu tzaddikaya chadan kullehu tzaddikaya atyan umatteran duchteh dehahu tzaddika ad deyete lemedar diyyureh benayehu
Vei chayyava hu karoza kare aleh baggehinnam telatin yomin vechullehu chayyavaya kullehu atzivin

Kullehu patchin vay deha dina chadta itar hashta begineh diflanya kamma gardinin denimmusin mizdammenin lekovleh ulakdama leh vay oy larasha oy lishcheno vechullehu patchin veamrin oy lerasha ra ki gemul yadav yease lo may gemul yadav amar ribbi yitzchak leachlala man dezane bidoy leafaka ulchabbela zareh berekanya

Deha taninan kal man deappik zareh berekanya ikre ra vela chame appe shechinta dichtiv ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra uchtiv vayehi er bechor yehuda ra uf hacha oy lerasha ra vay lehahu chayyava deihu ra deavad garmeh ra ki gemul yadav yease lo leachlala man dezane bidoy leafaka ulchabbela zareh verekanya ulhay tardin behahu alma yattir mikkolla

Ta chaze deha ketiv oy lerasha kevan dichtiv oy lerasha ammay ra ela kema deamina deavad garmeh ra uchtiv lo yegurcha ra vechullehu salkin vehay la salik vei tema shear chayyavin dekatlu bene nasha ta chaze kullehu salkin vehu la salik may tama inun ketilu bene nasha achora vehay katil benoy mammash oshid damin saggiin ta chaze bishar chayyave alma la ketiv vayyera beene Adonai vechan ketiv vayyera beene Adonai asher asa may tama mishshum dichtiv veshichet artza

Tenan amar ribbi yehuda let lach chova bealma dela it leh teshuva bar mehay velet lach chayyavaya dela chaman appe shechinta bar mehay dichtiv lo yegurcha ra kelal amar ribbi yitzchak zakkain inun tzaddikaya bealma den uvalma deate alayehu ketiv veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz may leolam yirshu aretz amar ribbi yehuda kema dichtiv ethallech lifne Adonai beartzot hachayyim
Vayechi yaakov begavayehu al da libbae leh levar nash dela leitarva tzulma dileh
438: Betzulma deoved kochavim umazzalot begin dehay kaddisha vehay mesaava

Ta chaze ma ben yisrael leamin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot deyisrael kad ishtakkach bar nash mit hu mesaav lechal gufa uveta mesaava vegufa deoved kochavim umazzalot la masiv leachora vegufeh la mesaava kad ihu mit may tama
Yisrael beshata deihu mit kal kiddushe demareh mitavran minneh itavar minneh hay tzulma kaddisha veitavar minneh hay ruach kudsha ishtaar gufa mesaava

Aval oved kochavim umazzalot oved avoda zara let hachi divchayye mesaav bechal sitrin tzulma dileh mesaava verucha dileh mesaava uvgin desoavute illen sharyan begaveh asir lemikrav legabbeh kevan demit nafke kal illen mesaavuta veishtaar gufa bela mesaavuta lesoava

Veaf al gav degufa dilhon mesaav ben bechayyehon uven bemitathon aval bechayyehon dechal inun mesaavin ishtakkeche legabbayehu it lon chela lesoava leacharini bemitathon denafke kal inun mesaavin minnayehu la yachlin lesaava udyisrael yachil lesaava leacharine begin dechal kaddishin nafkin minneh veshara aleh sitra achora

Ta chaze hay tzelem kaddisha chad azil bar nash veitrabbe veitavid mehay partzufa diukna dileh itavid tzulma achora umitchabberan kechada veda natil leda beshata deishtakkechu teren tzulmin natir hu bar nash vegufa dileh bekiyyuma verucheh sharya begaveh
Beshata dekarivu yomoy mitavran minneh veda salik leda veishtaar bar nash bela netiru keden ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim tere

Ta chaze kad itar dina bealma dekudsha berich hu yativ al karse dedina lemedan alma bae bar nash leatara teshuva deyetuv mechiyyuva deha hahu yoma pitkin ketivu umishtakkeche kullehu beachmata ha chetivin i zache bar nash deyetuv kamme mareh karin pitkin dealeh
Levatar kudsha berich hu zammin kammeh debbar nash yoma dechippure yoma ditshuva i tav mechetoy tav vei la pakkid malka lemichtam pitkin vay deha teshuva baya leistallaka minneh

I zache bitshuva vela shelemata kedeka yeut talyan leh ad hahu yoma batraa daatzeret dehu teminaa lechag vei avad teshuva shelemata lekamme mareh itkerau vei la zache inun pitkin nafkin mibbe malka veitmasseran bidoy desantira vedina mitavid ufitkin la mehadderan tu leve malka

Keden tzulmin itavaru minnih vela mishtakkechin immeh kevan demitavran minneh ha vadday tufseka demalka yaavor aleh veyitom kassa demota uvhahu lelya dechagga batraa santerin zeminin ufitkin natlin batar denatle lon tzulmin mitavran vela mishtakkechin behu yade vei mishtakkechin behu yade dina geria o yaavor aloy dina marin bishin bigriuta dilhon veha okimna leha
Uvsifre kadmae amre yattir kad resha igra veyishtakkach gufa bereh o inteteh yishtakkachu vehu yistallek vehani mile kad la ahadar kal hahu zimna bituvta aval i ahadar taama demota yitam veyittese
Vei gufa la itchaze veyishtakkach resha inun salkin vehu itkayyem vehane mile kad bereh zeera birshuteh
Vei yedoy pegimu avidta didoy pegimin ragloy marin radfin aleh arak tzulma veahadar arak veahadar aleh ketiv babboker tomar mi yitten erev vehay kad nahara sihara velelya ittakkan binhora

Aval zakkae chaside bechal yoma veoma mistakkele belibbayehu keillu hahu yoma mistalleke mealma veavdin teuvta shelemata kamme marehon vela yitztarchun lemilla achora zakkaa chulkehon bealma den uvalma deate

Ta chaze kal hannikra bishmi kamma illain ovade malka kaddisha deha beinun ovade deihu avid letatta katir lon bemillin illain dilela vechad natlin lon letatta veavde behu ovada itar hahu ovada dilela dekatir bah kegon ezova etz erez veha okimna
439: Veit minnayehu deachidan bishma kaddisha kegon lulav veetrog hadas vaarava dechullehu achidan bishma kaddisha leela veal da taninan leachada lon ulmebad behu ovada begin leitara chedva hahu deachid beh veal da taninan bemillin veovada bayan leachazaa milla begin leitara milla achora
Hada hu dichtiv kal hannikra bishmi velichvodi leatara yekari berativ leyachada li yetzartiv lemebad beh ovada af asitiv leatara beh chela dilela
Davar acher kal hannikra bishmi hayenu dichtiv peri etz hadar velichvodi berativ hayenu kappot temarim yetzartiv hayenu vaanaf etz avot af asitiv hayenu vearve nachal
Vetikkuna dehay deamar kera ulkachtem lachem bayyom harishon dayeka dehu chamishaa al asor
Aval bayyom harishon hahu yom rishon man hu ella yom denafik rishon lenatla bemabbuoy demayin neviin veanan bayan leamshacha leh lealma

Metal lemalka dekatar bene nasha bekitroy immeh matronita atat vaafikat lon lecherut umalka ashgach likara dilah veyahav lon bidaha ashkachat lon kayefin vetzachin amaratte ha afikat lon lecheru ayete lon mechla umishtayya

Kacha ha yom hakkippurim appik lecholla lecheru veanan kafni mezona kaimna vetzachinan lemishtayya hi aatarat lemalka beitteroy behay yoma yedana deha mayin neviin immah sharyan shailna lemishtayya leman deappik lon lecheru veal da karinan leh yom rishon
Da besifra deaggadta veshappir hu aval behay yoma leavraham sheruta decholla i baanane yekar hu sheruta i bemaya hu sheruta deavraham share lemechperi beyiri demaya

Peri etz hadar da bera deyitzchak deyitzchak ahadar leh lekudsha berich hu vekara leh etz hadar peri dehay etz hadar yedia kappot temarim dichtiv tzaddik kattamar yifrach vela ishtakkach benayehu piruda veal da la ketiv vechappot ella kappot begin dela salik da bela da uvhay itmalya hay beer mibbeer mayim illain neviin hahu itmalle bekadmita uminneh itmalya bera ad deihu neviu lecholla

Vaanaf etz avot da anafa deilana ravreva deatkif veishtarsha besharshoy itavid ilana illaa al kolla deachid bechal sitreh anaf deihu etz avot etz deachid leavot deha mehay natal yesoda dealma veitmalleya laaraka bevera hay hu alma araka deshakuta

Vearve nachal tere inun teren nachalin demayya itkenish behu laaraka latztzaddik davar acher vearve nachal illen inun gevuran deachidan beh beyitzchak deatyan missitra dehahu nachal illaa vela missitra deabba vegin kach kolla yae vela besima leferin vela avid perin
Vearve nachal teren keyamin degufa kayema alayehu aval vearve nachal vadday kema deittemar veillen inun kullehu laaraka mayya levera
Davar acher ulkachtem lachem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar da avraham kappot temarim da yitzchak vaanaf etz avot da yaakov vearve nachal illen inun teren dargin deamaran

Uman dematne hay begin deetz avot da yaakov deachid lechullehu chalakin vadday da yaakov aval ha okimna peri etz hadar da bera deyitzchak da gevura tattaa kappot temarim kappot chaser kishshura deitkashshar bevera kema deatte amer kefitu besarbalehon begin deillen la salkin da bela da vaanaf etz avot anafa hu illaa deitavid etz avot veachid lechal sitra kema deittemar arve nachal da yitzchak bechal sitre deachidan besitra denachala vela besitra deabba detaninan af al gav divhay nachal dina la ishtakkach beh dinin mitarin minneh

Verav hamnuna sava parish vearve nachal inun teren kayemin dekaamaran demayya nafke minnayehu veshappir aval ta chaze ha chazinan ditren dargin illen dekayeme al darga detzaddik iba uchnishu ravreva nafke minnayehu vearve nachal la nafke minnayehu iba vela tama vela recha veha okimna vecholla shappir
440: Bismala lakovel libba lulav bimina kappot becholla vekatir becholla deha tzaddik kappot hu bechal sitrin vekatir becholla veda hu kishshura dimhemnuta

Uvsifra deaggadta shappir kaamar dechal illen inun ushpizin dezamminin amma kaddisha behay yoma devayan leashkacha lehu kevan dezammin lon uvhu bae bar nash lemalka bauteh zakkain inun yisrael deyadin archoy demalka kaddisha veyadin archoy deorayeta lemehach beorach keshot lemizke behu bealma den uvalma deate

Beoma da nafke yisrael besimanin reshimin miggo malka begin deinun natzchin dina umay simanin inun simane mehemnuta chotama demalka illaa litre beni nasha dealu kodam malka ledina vela yade alma man minnayehu natzach nafak chad ligon mibbe malka sheilu lo amar lon man deyippuk uvidoy simanin demalka hu natzach

Kacha kule alma alin ledina kodam malka illaa vedain lon miyyoma derosh hashshana veom hakkippurim ad chamesh sare yomin leyarcha uven kach ishtakkachu yisrael zakkain kullehu bituvta tarchin besukka velulav veetrog vela yade man natzach dina malache illae shaalu man natzach dina kudsha berich hu amar lehu inun demafke bidayehu simanin dili inun natzchin dina

Behay yoma nafke yisrael birshimu demalka betushbachta dehallela alin bassukka etrog bismala lulav bimina chaman kullehu deyisrael reshimin birshimin demalka kaddisha patche veamre ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam she elohav

Ad kan chedvata decholla chedvata deushpizin veafilu ummot haolam chadan bechedvata umitbarchin minnah veal da karbanin bechal yoma alayehu laatala alayehu shelam veyitbarchun minan mikkan ulhala yoma chad demalka illaa dechade behu beyisrael dichtiv bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem deha yoma da min malka bilchodoy chedvata dileh beyisrael lemalka dezammin ushpizin vechu

Ribbi shimon patach veamar ani chavatztzelet hashsharon shoshannat haamakim kamma chaviva keneset yisrael kamme kudsha berich hu dekudsha berich hu meshabbach lah vehi meshabbachat leh tadir vechamma meshabbechin umzammerin azminat leh tadir lekudsha berich hu zakkaa chulkehon deyisrael deachidan beh beadva dechulaka kaddisha kema dichtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo vegv
Ani chavatztzelet hashsharon da keneset yisrael dekayema beshappiru denoy beginta deeden hashsharon dehi shara umshabbachat lemalka illaa

Davar acher ani chavatztzelet hashsharon devaya leashkaa mishshaku denachala amika mabbua denachalin kema deatte amer vehaya hashsharav leaggam shoshannat haamakim dekayema baamikta decholla man inun amakim kema deatte amer mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai chavatztzelet hashsharon chavatztzelet mehahu atar deshaku denachalin nafkin vela paskin lealmin shoshannat haamakim shoshanna mehahu atar deikre amika decholla satim mikkal sitrin
Ta chaze bekadmita yeruka kachavatztzelet detarpin dilah yerukin levatar shoshannat sumka bigvanin chiverin shoshanna beshit tarpin shoshannat deishteniat miggoona legoona veshanniat gevanaha

Shoshannat bekadmita chavatztzelet beiddana devaya leizdavaga beh bemalka ikre chavatztzelet batar deitdabbekat beh bemalka beinun neshikin ikre soshannat begin dichtiv siftotav shoshannim shoshannat haamakim dehi meshanya gevanaha zimnin letav vezimnin levish zimnin lerachame zimna ledina

Vattere haishsha ki tov haetz lemaachal vechi taava hu laenayim ta chaze deha bene nasha la mistakkelin vela yadin vela mashgichin beshata devara kudsha berich hu leadam veokir leh bikiru illaa baa minneh leitdabbeka beh begin deyishtakkach yechiday uvlibba yechiday uvaatar didvekuta yechiday dela
441: Ishtanne vela mithappech lealmin behahu kishshura yechida decholla beh itkashshar hada hu dichtiv veetz hachayyim betoch haggan

Levatar satu mearcha dimhemnuta veshavku ilana yechiday illaa mikkal ilanin veatu leitdabbeka beatar demishtanne umithappech miggoona legoona umittav levish umibbish letav venachate meela letatta veitdabbaku letatta beshinnuyin saggiin veshavku ilana yechidaa illaa mikkal ilanin hada hu dichtiv asher asa haelohim et haadam yashar vegv
Vadday keden ithappach libbayehu behahu sitra mammash zimnin letav zimnin levish zimnin lerachame zimnin ledina behay milla deitdabbaku bah vadday vikshu chishvonot rabbim veitdabbaku behu

Amar leh kudsha berich hu adam shevakte chayye veitdabbakte bemota chayye dichtiv veetz hachayyim betoch haggan deikre chayyim deman deachid beh la taim mota lealmin itdabbakte beilana achora ha vadday mota hu lekivlach hada hu dichtiv ragleha yordot mavet uchtiv umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha vadday beatar demota itdabbak veshavak atar dechayye begin kach itgezar aleh veal kal alma mota

I hu chata kal alma ma chatu i tema dechal alma achle meilana da veitramme lecholla lav hachi ella beshata deadam kaim al ragloy chame leh biryan kullehu udchilu mikkammeh vehau natlin avatreh keavdin batar malka vehu amar lon ana veattun bou nishtachave venichraa vegv veazlu kullehu avatreh kevan dechazu deadam segid lehay atar veitdabbak beh kullehu itmashshechu avatreh vegarim mota lechal alma

Uchden ishtanne adam lechamma gevanin zimnin dina zimnin rachame zimnin mota zimnin chayye vela kaim bekiyyuma tadir bechad minnayehu begin dehahu atar garim leh veal da ikre cherev hammithappechet hammithappechet missitra da lesitra da mittav levish merachame ledina mishshelam lekarava mithappechet hi becholla tav vera dichtiv veetz haddaat tov vara

Umalka illaa lerachama al ovadoy ochach leh veamar leh umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu vegv vehu la kabbil minneh veitmeshach batar itteteh veittarach lealmin deha itteta leatra salka vela yattir veitteta garim mota lecholla

Ta chaze lealma deate ketiv ki kime haetz yeme ammi kime haetz hahu deishtemodaa beh zimna ketiv billa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kal panim vecherpat ammo yasir meal kal haaretz vegv
