Vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut tana amar ribbi chiyya ketiv vayechi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim sheva esre shana hatam bekiyyumeh yaakov vehacha bemitateh yisrael dichtiv vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut amar ribbi yose hachi hu vadday deha la ketiv vayyikrav yom yisrael lamut ella yeme vechi bechamma yome mit bar nash veha beshata chada beriga chada mit venafik mealma

Ella hachi tana kad kudsha berich hu bae leatava rucheh leh kal inun yomin dekaim bar nash behay alma itpakdan kammeh vealin bechushbena vechad itkerivu kammeh lemeal bechushbena mit bar nash veativ kudsha berich hu rucheh leh hahu hevel deappik venafach beh otveh legabbeh

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash deomoy itkerivu gabbe malka bela kissufa vela dache yoma minnayehu levar deyishkach behahu yoma deitavid beh chova begin kach ketiv betzaddikaya keriva mishshum dekarivu yomoy kamme malka bela kissufa

Vay lerashshiaya dela ketiv behu keriva vehech yikrevun yome kamme malka deha kal yomoy bechove alma ishtakkachu vvgine kach la yikrevun kamme malka vela yitmannun kammeh vela yiddachru leela ella inun shetzean miggavayehu alayehu ketiv derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu
442: Vehacha vayyikrevu yeme yisrael vadday bela chissufa bishlemuta bechedvata shelim uvgine kach yeme yisrael dehava shelim yattir yisrael miyyaakov vei tema veha ketiv veyaakov ish tam shelim shelim hava vela shelim bedarga illaa keyisrael

Tanya amar ribbi yose beshata deomoy devar nash itpakkidan kame malka it zakkaa deitpakkedan yomoy urchikin mikkamme malka veit zakkaa dechad mitpakkedan yomoy kerivin usmichin lemalka vela mitrachakin bela chissufa alin vekarivin lemalka zakkaa chulkehon hada hu dichtiv vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut

Vayyikra livno leosef amar ribbi yitzchak vechi shear shivtin lav benoy inun ella amar ribbi abba yosef beno hava yattir mikkullehu detaninan beshata deinteteh defotifar dechakat leh leosef ma ketiv vayyavo habbayeta laasot melachto veen ish meanshe habbayit hay kera hachi mibbae leh veen ish babbayit mahu meanshe habbayit ella leachlala diukna deyaakov dehava tamman veishtakkach tamman uvgine kach meanshe habbayit aval ish achora hava tamman kevan desalik yosef enoy vechama diukna daavoy yetiv bekiyyumeh vetav laachora

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayemaen vayyomer el eshet adonav amar leh kudsha berich hu atte amarte vayemaen vayyomer chayyecha vayemaen vayyomer achora yete levarcha livnach veyitbarchun beh hada hu dichtiv vayemaen aviv vayyomer yadati beni yadati

Kevan deamar yadati beni ammay amar yadati achora ella amar yadati beni bezimna dekayemat begufach deatte bari kad chamit diukna dili vetavat bekiyyumach uvgine kach ketiv yadati beni yadati al ma deamarte deda hu buchra gam hu yihye leam vegam hu yigdal vehacha begin kach ketiv vayyikra livno leosef livno leosef mammash

Davar acher vayyikra livno leosef devediukna chad hau mitchazzeyan dechal man dechame leosef hava ashid divreh deyaakov hava ribbi yose amar kolla hachi hu veod deosef zan leh velivnoy besivuteh uvgine kach beno mammash yattir mikkullehu vayyikra livno leosef ammay leosef vela leachora mishshum dirshuta hava bideh lesalkeh mittamman

Ribbi yose amar kevan deyaakov hava yada divnoy yishtabedun begaluta tamman bemitzrayim ammay la itkabbar tamman begin deyagin zechuteh al benoy ammay baa leistalleka mittamman veha ketiv kerachem av al banim an hu rachmanuta

Ella hachi tana beshata dehava nachit yaakov lemitzrayim hava dachil hava amar dilma chas veshalom yishtetzun banay beni ammemaya vedilma kudsha berich hu yesallek shechinteh mini kekadmita ma ketiv vayyera elohim el yaakov vegv al tira merda mitzrayema ki legoy gadol asimcha sham uma deamarte dilma asallek shechinatti mibbenach anochi ered immecha mitzrayema
Amar od dachilna dilma itkabbar tamman vela ezke im avahatay amar leh veanochi aalcha gam alo aalcha mimmitzrayim gam alo leitkabberaa bekivra daavahatach

Begine kach baa lesalka garmeh mimitzrayim chad dela yaavdun minneh dachala deha chama dekudsha berich hu zammin leitperaa middachalehon vechad dechama dishchinta yeshave medoreh ben benoy begaluta vechad begin dihe gufeh dayyar ben gufayehu daavahatoy leitkelala benayehu vela yitmanne im chayyavaya demitzrae

Vetaninan gufa deyaakov itmeshich mishshufroy deadam harishon vehava diuknih deyaakov diukna illaa kaddisha diukna dechurseya kaddisha vela baa leitkevara beni chayyavaya veraza demilla devaavahan let piruda kelal veal da ketiv ve shachavti im avotay
Vayyikra livno leosef beno bechad diukna deanpin begin deviruta derucha velibba olid leh yattir mikkullehu ta chaze ma ketiv hamat kachtech et ishi dechal reuta deyaakov berachel hava uvgin kach
443: Tana ribbi shimon patach veamar hannistarot la elokenu vegv hannistarot la elokenu ta chaze kamma it leh levar nash leizdahara mechovoy ulistakkala dela yaavar al reuteh demareh detaninan kal ma devar nash avid behay alma besifra ketivu inun ovadin vealin bechushbena kame malka kaddisha vecholla itgalleya kammeh hada hu dichtiv im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai i hachi ech la yistammar bar nash millemechav kammeh demareh vetaninan afilu hahu ma dechashiv bar nash veistallak biruteh kolla ishtakkach kame kudsha berich hu vela itavid minneh

Ta chaze behahu lelya dealat lea legabbeh deyaakov veyahavat leh inun simanin deyahav yaakov lerachel salik biruteh deihi rachel veshammash shimmusha bah vehahi tippa kadmita deyaakov havat dichtiv kochi vereshit oni vesavar deihi rachel kudsha berich hu deihu gale amikta umsattarta veyada ma bachashocha salik hahu reuta leatreh uvcheruta diruven istallak leosef may tama mishshum deha derachel havat hahi tippa kadmita denafkat miyyaakov uvgin dehavat dilah hahu becheruta mammash diruven yarit yosef verachel yarta lehahu dilah

Uvgin kach raza demilla la istallak reuven bishma kishar shivtin ella reuven kelomar chamu bar reu ben setam vehay ben la ityeda shemeh veal da la karya lea bene behay shema vela ikre reu beni deha lea yadat ovada

Vetaninan gale kamme kudsha berich hu deyaakov lav reuteh lemechav kammeh behay vela istakkal biruta beitteta achora behahi shata kishar chayyave alma veal kach ketiv vayyihu bene yaakov shenem asar deha benayehu dishar chayyave alma deavdin hahu ovada bishma achora ikrun veha yedia milla da legabbe chavraya uvgine kach vayyikra livno leosef beno mammash mishsheruta vesiyyuma beno hava

Tana amar ribbi yose bamme ome leh yaakov leosef dichtiv sim na yadcha tachat yerechi ella behahu at kayyama dehava rashim bevisreh deda chashivuta deavahan yattir mikkolla vehay berit raza deosef ihu

Amar rabbi shimon beavraham uvyaakov ketiv sim na yadcha tachat yerechi techot yurichi kelomar behahu atar dirmiza bishma kaddisha veappik zara kaddisha mehemna lealma beyitzchak lo ketiv begin denafik minneh esav

Tu may tama hacha sim na yadcha tachat yerechi al na tikbereni bemitzrayim ella amar leh yaakov leosef behay reshima kaddisha ome li deappik zara kaddisha mehemna lealma veitnetir vela istaav lealmin dela yitkabbar ben inun mesaavin dela natru leh lealmin dichtiv behu asher besar chamorim besaram vezirmat susim zirmatam

Vei tema ha yosef denatir leh al kolla ammay itkabbar benayehu ella taninan ketiv hayo haya devar Adonai el yechezkel ben buzi hakkohen beeretz kasdim al nehar kevar veha taninan dishchinta la sharya ella beara deyisrael ammay hacha shechinta ella al nehar kevar ketiv uchtiv vattehi alav sham yad Adonai uf hacha yosef bemaya itrame arona dileh amar kudsha berich hu i yosef istallak mehacha galuta la itkeyyam ella tehe kevurteh beatar dela yistaav veyisbelun bene yisrael galuta

Tana amar ribbi yose chama yaakov deha becholla ittakkan lecharseya kaddisha baavahan amar i hachi yitkabbar hech gufa da achida baavahata veafilu mearta deitkabbar tamman ikre chafelta begin dechal milla dechafelta hu teren vechad uf mearta teren vechad
Vetta chaze avhata zachu leitkabbera tamman inun veziuugayehu yaakov
444: Hu velea may tama rachel la veha ketiv verachel akara deihi ikkara deveta ella lea zachta beh leafaka shit shivtin miggiza kaddisha bealma yattir uvgine kach ityahavat immeh leziuuga bimarta

Amar ribbi yehuda lea kal yomaha havat befarashat orchin kayyama uvachat begineh deyaakov kad shamat deihu tzaddika utzlota akdamat leh vehayenu dichtiv veene lea rakkot kema deokimna demakdamat veyatvat befarashat orchin lemishal

Rachel la nafkat leorchin lealma begine kach zachta lea leitkabbera immeh verachel kayyemet kevuratah befarashat orchin veitkevarat tamman hada hu dichtiv vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel mahu alay alay vadday kelomar begini beeretz kenaan badderech begini mitat badderech dela nafkat begini lealmin kaachatah

Vegin kach lea denafkat uvachat befarashat orchin begineh deyaakov zachta leitkevara immeh rachel dela baat lemefak ulmishal bahadeh vegin kach kevurata befarashat orchin veraza demilla ha okimna veittemar da beitgalya veda beitkasseya

Vetta chaze detanya dimin saggiin shadiat hahi tzaddeket lea begin lemeheve chulakeh deyaakov vela behahu rasha deesav vehayenu detaninan kal bar nash deoshid dimin kammeh dekudsha berich hu af al gav deitgezar aleh onasha yitkara vela yachil hahu onasha leshalletaa beh menalan millea deha lea itgezar lemeheve chulaka deesav vehi bevauta akdimat leh leyaakov vela ityehivat leh leesav

Amar ribbi chiyya veshachavti im avotay vegv ribbi yitzchak patach veamar ma yitron laadam bechal amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh bechamma atar ittemar deistakkalna bemilloy dishlomo veitchaze milloy setimin aval kullehu mille dishlomo kullehu ikrun bechachmata

Detanya ketiv vatterev chachmat shelomo beomoy dishlomo malka kayema sihara beashlamuta vehayenu dichtiv vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kal bene kedem tamman taninan man inun beni kedem ha ukmuha aval chachmat bene kedem hi chachmeta deyartu meavraham

Detanya ketiv vayyitten avraham et kal asher lo leyitzchak may et kal asher lo da chachmeta illaa dehava yada bishma kaddisha dekudsha berich hu umashma et kal asher lo dehava dileh kidtaninan behahi bat dehavat leh leavraham uvakkol shemah

Velivne happilagshim asher leavraham natan avraham mattanot vegv deyahav lehu milin yedian bechitrin tattain uvan atar ashre lon el eretz kedem umittamman yaritu beni kedem chachmata vehayenu dichtiv mechachmat kal bene kedem

Tana yoma chad hava ate ribbi shimon mikkappotkiyya lelod vehava immeh ribbi abba veribbi yehuda ribbi abba hava lae vehava rahit avatreh deribbi shimon dehava rachiv amar ribbi abba vadday achare Adonai yelechu kearye yishag

Nachat ribbi shimon amar leh vadday ketiv vaeshev bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layela vadday chachmeta la mityashva ella kad bar nash yativ vela azil ella kaim bekiyyumeh veha okimna mille al ma ketiv vaeshev hashta benayecha talya milta yatvu

Amar ribbi abba ketiv vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kal bene kedem umikkal chachmat mitzrayim may hi chachmat shelomo umay hi chachmat mitzrayim umay hi chachmat kal beni kedem amar leh ta chaze bechamma atar ukmuha behahu shema desihara kad itbarcha mikkolla ketiv vatterev beomoy dishlomo deitreviat veitbarchat vekayema beashlamuta
Vetaninan elef turin mitravrevin kammah vechullehu neshiva chad hau lekammah elef naharin saggiin lah uvigmia chada gama lon
445: Yedaha achidan learba veesrin elef evar let denafik minnah listar hay velet denafik minnah listar achora kamma vechamma elef teresin mitachadin besaaraha

Chad ulema deorkeh meresha dealma lisyafe dealma nafik ben raglaha beshittin pulse denura mitlabbesh begavene da itmana al tattae mearba sitraha da ihu naar deachid shit mea utlat asar maftechan illain missitra deimma vechullehu maftechan illain beshinnena decharba dachagir bechartzeh talyan

Hahu naar karun leh chanoch ben yered beinun beriyyate dichtiv chanoch lannaar al pi darko vei tema matnitin hi vela berayeta bematnita dilan okimna mile veha ittemar vecholla milleta chada istakkalu techoteh titlal chevat bera detanya kema deyisrael kaddisha illaa ikre ben leimmeh dichtiv ki ben hayiti leavi rach veyachid lifne immi uchtiv beni bechori yisrael hachi name letatta da ikre naar leimmeh dichtiv ki naar yisrael vaohavehu uvchamma gevanin ikre ben yared veha okimna aval ta chaze ben yered mammash detaninan eser yeridot yarda shechina leara vechullehu ukmuha chavrayya veittemar utchot hay kamma chevata kayemin deikrun chevat bera mammash

Techot inun chevata mitachadan saaraha desihara deikrun kochvaya desharvita desharvit mammash mare demarin mare dematkela mare dekashu mare dechutzpa vechullehu ikrun mare deargevana yedaha veraglaha achidan behay kearye takkifa deachid al tarpeh veal da ketiv vetaraf veen matztzil

Tufraha kal inun deadkerin chove bene nasha vechatvin verashmin chovayehu bitkifu dedina kashya veal da ketiv chattat yehuda ketuva beet barzel betzipporen shamir mahu shamir hahu derashim venakiv avna ufasik lah lechal sitra
Zuhama detofraha kal inun dela mitdabbekin begufa demalka veyankin missitra dimsaavuta kad share sihara bifgimu
Uvgin dishlomo malka yarta lesihara bishlemuta bae leyarta lah bifgimuta veal da ishtaddal lemeda bedata deruchin veshedin lemerat sihara bechal sitra

Uvomoy dishlomo malka becholla itnehir sihara hada hu dichtiv vatterev chachmat shelomo vatterev dayeka mechachmat kal beni kedem raza illaa hu kema dichtiv veelle hamlachim asher malchu beeretz edom vegv veillen ikrun beni kedem dechullehu la itkayemu bar mehay dichlila dechar venukva deikre hadar dichtiv vayyimloch tachtav hadar vegv
Vetana deaf al gav deitkayemat la itnehirat beashlamuta ad deata shelomo deitchaze lekivlaha kema deokimna divgin kach immeh bat sheva havat

Umikkal chachmat mitzrayim da chachma tattaa deikre shifcha devatar rechaya vecholla itkelilat hay chachma dishlomo chachmat beni kedem vechachmat mitzrayim amar ribbi abba berich rachamana deshailna kammach milla da deha bechal hanne mile zachina amar ribbi shimon millin illen ha okimna lon veha ittamru

Tana ma yitron leadam bechal amalo yachol af amala deorayeta talmud lomar sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh shane amala deorayeta dilela min shimsha hu ribbi chiyya amar af amala deorayeta deihu amal beginehon divne nasha o begin yekara dileh hay tachat hashshemesh ketiv deha la salik leela tanya amar ribbi elazar afilu i bar nash kayyam elef shenin hahu yoma deistallak mealma dame leh keilu la itkeyyam bar yoma chad
Veshachavti im avotay zakkaa chulkehon daavahata dekudsha berich hu avid lon reticha kaddisha leela veitree behu leitattera immehon hada hu dichtiv rak baavotecha chashak Adonai vegv amar ribbi
446: Elazar yaakov hava yada deha ittura dileh baavahateh hu deha ittura daavahan immeh hu vehu immehon veal da beatvan gelifin taninan telat kishrin teren kishrin chad mehay sitra vechad mehay sitra vechad dechalil lon veda hu detaninan vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze vehahu kishra divemtzaita achid lehay sitra ulhay sitra veal hay ketiv veshachavti im avotay vadday

Veshachavti im avotay vegv ribbi yehuda patach veamar hachershim shemau vehaiverim habbitu lirot hachershim shemau illen bene nasha dela tzayetin lemillule orayeta vela pakchin udnayehu lemishma lefikkude demarehon vehaiverim dela mistakkelin leminda al ma inun kayemin deha bechal yoma veoma karoza nafik vekare velet man deyashgach

Detanya inun yomin debbar nash kad itbere behahu yoma denafak lealma kullehu kayemin bekiyyumayehu veazlin vetasin bealma nachatin veazharan lebbar nash kal yoma veoma bilchodoy vechad hahu yoma ate veazhar leh uvar nash avid behahu yoma chova kamme mareh hahu yoma salik bechissufa veashid sahaduta vekaim bilchodoy levar

Vetana batar dekaim bilchodoy yativ ad devar nash avid minneh teshuva zacha tav hahu yoma leatreh la zacha hahu yoma nachit veishtattaf behahu rucha dilvar vetav leveteh veittakkan bediukneh dehahu bar nash mammash begin leavasha leh vedayyar immeh beveta veit dediyyura letav i hu zache vei lav diyyureh immeh levish

Ben kach uven kach itpakdan inun yomin vechaserim vela alin beminyana deinun deishtaaru vay lehahu bar nash degara yomoy kamme malka kaddisha vela shavik leela yomin leitattera behu behahu alma ulitkarva bahadayehu kamme malka kaddisha

Ta chaze kad kerivu inun yomin kamme malka kaddisha i hu zakkaa hay bar nash denafik mealma salik veal beinun yomin veinun levushe yekar demitlabbesha beh nishmateh veinun yomin hau dezacha behu vela chav behu

Vay lehahu degara yomoy leela dechad baan lealbasha leh beomoy inun yomin defagim ihu bechovoy chasrin mehahu levusha veitlabbash bemana chasera kal shekken i saggiin inun vela lehve leh lebbar nash bamme deitlabbash behahu alma keden vay leh vay lenafsheh dedayenin leh baggehinnam al inun yomin yomin al yomin yomin al chad terin dechad nafik mehay alma la ashkach yomin deitlabbash behu vela have leh levusha bame deitkasse zakkain inun tzaddikaya deomehon kullehon temirin inun legabbeh demalka kaddisha veitavid minnayehu levushe yekar leitlabbesha behu bealma deate

Taninan beraza dematnitin may dichtiv vayyedu ki erummim hem yedia yade mammash dehahu levusha dikar deitavid meinun yomin gara minnayehu vela ishtaar yoma meinun yomin leitlabbesha beh hada hu dichtiv galmi rau encha veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu yamim yutzaru yamim yutzaru vadday velo echad bahem deha la ishtaar chad minnayehu leitlabbesha behu ad deishtaddal adam veavad teshuva vekudsha berich hu kabbil leh veavid leh mana levusha achoranin vela min yomoy hada hu dichtiv vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam ulishto katnot or vayyalbishem

Ta chaze beavraham dezacha ma ketiv ba bayyamim mishshum dezacha kad istallak mehay alma beinun yomin mammash dileh al veitlabbash behu vela gara mehahu levush yekar kelum dichtiv ba bayyamim beiyyov ma ketiv vayyomer arom yatzati mibbeten immi vearom ashuv shamma deha la ishtaar levusha leitlabbesha beh
Tana zakkain inun tzaddikaya deomehon zakkain veishtaaru lealma deate vechad nafkin mitchabberan kullehu veitavidu
447: Levushe yekar leitlabbesha beh uvhahu levusha zachan leitannaga meinnuga dealma deate uvhahu levusha zeminin laachaya ulmekam vechal inun deit lehu levusha yekumun hada hu dichtiv vayyityatztzevu kemo levush vay leinun chayyave alma deomehon bechovehon chasrin vela ishtaar minnayehu bamme deitkasyan kad yifkun mealma

Tana kal inun zakkain dezachu leitlabbesha bilvush yekar beomehon mitatteran behahu alma meitture demitattere behu avahan mehahu nachal denagid venafik leginta deeden hada hu dichtiv venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha vegv veinun chayyave alma dela zachu leitlabbesha bilvusha deomehon alayehu ketiv vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov veshachan charerim bammidbar
Amar ribbi yitzchak zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov derachatzanu yattir hava leh dichtiv veshachavti im avotay deezke behu vela beachora deezke behu leitlabbesha beomin dileh uvomin dilhon

Ribbi yehuda amar ketiv vayarach et reach begadav vayevarachehu begadav bigde esav mibbae leh deha lav dideh hau ella deesav hau hanhu begadim dichtiv vattikkach rivka et bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot bigde esav ketiv vehacha reach begadav deyaakov mashma

Ella hachi okimna vayyarach kelomar istakkal lehala vearach recha dilvushoy dehahu alma keden barcheh veal da ketiv ree reach beni kereach sade da hu chakal detappuchin kaddishin amar hoil vezachita beinun levushe yekar veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim may mashma begin divhahu chakal detappuchin kaddishin natil talla kal yoma mehahu atar deikre shamayim dichtiv mittal hashshamayim

Amar ribbi yose becholla barcheh mittal hashshamayim umishmanni haaretz may tama begin devayyarach et reach begadav begadav mammash kema deokimna tana elef vachamash mea rechin salkin bechal yoma miggan eden demitbasseme behu inun levushin dikar dehahu alma demitatteran min yomoy devar nash

Amar ribbi yehuda kamma levushin inun amar ribbi elazar ture dealma al da peligu aval telata inun chad demitlabbeshe behahu levusha rucha divginta deeden deara vechad yekara mikkolla demitlabbesha beh nishmata bego tzerora dechayye ben purpira demalka vechad levusha dilvar dekaim vela kaim itchaze vela itchaze behay mitlabbesha beh nafsha veazla veshata bealma
Uvchal resh yarche veshabbatta azlat veitkashsherat berucha divginta deeden deara dekayema ben pargoda yakkira uminneh olif veyada ma deyada veshat veoda leh bealma

Tana bitren kishshurin itkashshar nafsha bechal resh yarcha veshabbatta bekishshura derucha di ben reche busmin divginta deeden deara umittamman azil veshat veitkashshar im rucha benishmata ditzrira bitzrora dechayye umitraveya umitzanat meinun zivin yekarin dehay sitra udhay sitra hada hu dichtiv venachacha Adonai tamid tamid dayeka

Vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha mahu betzachtzachot ella tzachuta chad kad itkashshar berucha divginta diltatta tzachuta dilgav min tzachuta kad mitkashsheran benishmata dilela bitzrora dechayye vehayenu betzach chad tzachot teren deinun leela leela beyakkiru denishmata vadday kelomar tzachtzachot man yarit da nafshecha nafshecha mammash zakkaa chulkehon detzaddikaya

Amar rabbi shimon kad ana ben inun chavraya devavel mitkanshe gabbay veolfe mille beitgalleya veinun ayele lon begushpanka defarzela takkifa setima mikkal sitrin kamma zimnin olifna lon archoy deginta demalka orchoy demalka
Kamma zimnin olifna lon kal innun dargin detzaddikaya divhahu alma vechullehu mistafe lememar
448: Millin illen ella laan begimguma begini kach pesilusin ikrun kehahu pesiluta dimgamgem befumeh

Aval lizchuta dainna lehu hoil umistafe deha avira kaddisha verucha kaddisha itade minnayehu veyanke meavira verucha dirshuta achora vela od ella dekeshet itchaze alayehu velav inun keday lemechome sever anpoy kal shekken sever anpin achoranin

Aval da mehanya lehu deana shechiach bealma veana simana bealma deha bechayyay la yativ alma betzaara vela itdan bedina dilela batray la yakum dara kedara da vezammin alma dela yishtakkach man deyagin alayehu vechal anpin chatzifin yishtakkechun ben leela ben letatta leela bechovayehu diltatta vachatzifuta dilhon

Uzminin beni alma detzavechin velet man deyashgach alayehu yehadderun resha lechal sitre alma vela yetuvun beasvata aval chad asuta ashkachna lehu bealma vela yattir behahu atar deyishtakkechun inun delaan beorayeta veishtakkach benayehu sefer tora dela mishtakkar beh kad mafke hay begineh mitare illae vetattae vechal shekken i achtiv beh shema kaddisha kedeka chaze veha olifna milla
Vay ledara deitgalleya benayehu sefer tora vela mitare aleh leela vetatta man itar aleh beshata dealma betzaara tefe veitzterich alma lemitra veitzterich leaglaa sefer tora yattir bedochaka dealma

Dechad alma betzaara uvaan bene nasha rachamin ale kivre kullehu metin mitarin aleh deha nafsha akdimat umodaa lerucha deha sefer tora ishtakkach begaluta deigle bedochaka dealma vechayya atan uvaan rachame

Keden rucha moda linshama unshama lekudsha berich hu uchden kudsha berich hu itar vechas al alma veda al galuta desefer tora meatrih vechayya atin lemive rachamay al kivre metayay vay ledara i itzterich sefer tora leaglaa leh meatar leatar afilu mibbe kenishta leve kenishta deha la ishtakkach benayehu al ma yishgechun alayehu

Veda la yadin kullehu bene nasha deha shechinta kad itgalleya galuta batraa ad la tistallak leela ma ketiv mi yittenini bammidbar melon orchim levatar bezimna dedachaka ishtakkach tefe bealma tamman ishtakkechat uvgaluta desefer tora tamman hi vecholla mitarin aleh illae vetattae

Amar ribbi shimon i hanne bavlae tippeshae yindeun millin deraze dechachmeta al ma kaim alma vesamchoy al ma ka mitraggeshan kad yishtakkach bedochaka yindeun shevacha derav yeva sava kad ishtakkach benayehu vela hau yade shivcheh veha ashkachna milloy mitkashsheran bemilloy dishlomo malka beraza illaa dechachmeta veinun la hau yade shevacheh
Vehashta azlin batar mille dechachmeta velet man dekaim alah velet man dekare veim kal da it benayehu pikchin beibbura deshatta uvikviuta deyarche af al gav dela ityehiv lehu vela itmasar bidayehu

Taninan teresar yarche hay nefesh ihi mitkashshera begufa bekivra veitdanu bedina kechada bar hahi nefesh detzaddikaya kema deukmuha uzmina bekivra veyada betzaara dileh uvtzaara dechayye yada vela ishtaddelat alayehu
Ulvatar teresar yarche itlabbash bilvusha chad veazil veshat bealma veyada min rucha ma deyada veishteddal tzaara lealma ulmibbae rachame ulminda tzaara dechayye

Uman itar lechal hay bezimna deit zakkaa deoda lehu kedeka yeut vehahu zakkaa ishtemoda benayehu detanya zakkaa kad ishtaar bealma ben chayya uven metaya ishtemoda deha kal yoma machreze aleh benayehu vechad tzaara tafe bealma vehu la yachil laagana al dara hu oda lehu tzaara dealma
449: Demachreze aleh benayehu vela ishtakkach man deitar lehu betzaara dealma ella sefer tora keden illae vetattae mitarin aleh utzrichin kolla deyishtakkechun behahi zimna bitshuva vei la mishtakkeche ha mare dedina itarun alayehu veafilu ruach deginta deeden mitarin alayehu begineh desefer tora kidittemar

Tana veshachavti im avotay begufa benafsha berucha benishmata birticha chada bedarga illaa amar ribbi yehuda kamma atimin mikkolla bene alma dela yade vela mashgiche vela shame vela mistakkele bemille dealma vehech kudsha berich hu mishtakkach alayehu berachamin bechal zeman veidan velet man deyashgach

Telat zimnin beoma al rucha chada bimarta dechafelta venashiv bekivre avahata veitseyan kal garmin vekayeme bekiyyuma vehahu rucha nagid talla milleela meresha demalka atar demishtakkeche avahan illae vechad mate hahu talla minnayehu mitarin avahan diltatta

Vetana nachit hahu talla bedargin yedian darga batar darga umate legan eden diltatta umehahu talla itseche bevusmin deginta deeden veitar rucha chada dechalil bitren achoranin vesalik veshat bene busmin veayil befitcha dimarta keden mitarin avahan inun veziugan uvan rachame al benoy

Vechad ishtakkach alma betzaara begin deinun demichin al chove alma vehahu talla la itnegid vela ishtakkach ad deitar sefer tora kedeka chaze bealma venafsha oda lerucha verucha lenishmata venishmata lekudsha berich hu keden yativ malka bekkurseya derachame venagid meattika kaddisha illaa negidu detalla devadolcha umate lerisha demalka umitbarchin avahan venagid hahu talla leinun demichin uchden mitchabberan kullehu vechayis kudsha berich hu al alma vetana la chayis kudsha berich hu al alma ad deoda laavahan uvginayehu alma itbarcha amar ribbi yose vadday hachi hu veha ashkachna mille besifra dishlomo malka hahu illaa dekara leh eta dechachmeta decholla

Verav hamnuna hachi galle veamar deha achziyyu leh deyattir avdat rachel dekayema befarashat orchin bechal zimna deitzterich alma mikkullehu veraza demilla aron vechapporet uchruvim bechulka devinyamin deityelid beorcha ushchinta al kolla

Vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta man rosh hammitta da shechinta amar rabbi shimon chas veshalom ella ledideh kara vesagid ta chaze mitta da shechinta dichtiv hinne mittato shellishlomo rosh hammitta man hu da yesoda dealma dehu risha dearsa kaddisha al rosh da yisrael dekaim al rosh hammitta begine kach yisrael ledideh ka sagid

Vei tema ha behahu zimna la hava mara deha levatar ketiv vayehi achar haddevarim haelle vayyomer leosef hinne avicha chole uvshata desagid la hava chole veal deyada deha vehahu zimna salik bedarga illaa kaddisha kurseya shelemata begine kach sagid lehahu reticha kurseya illaa shelimu deilana ravreva vetakkif deikre al shemeh veal da vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta al rosh hammitta vadday deha istallak leatreh veitattar beitroy demalka kaddisha

Vayyomer hishshava li vayyishshava lo vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta ribbi chiyya patach veamar kal ze nissiti vachachma amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni ha taninan shelomo malka yarit sihara mikkal sitroy uvomoy kayema bishlemuta hahi sihara deitbarcha mikkolla vechad baa lemekam al nimuse orayeta amar amarti echkama vegv
Amar ribbi yehuda yaakov amar veshachavti im avotay unsatani mimmitzrayim ukvartani bikvuratam tamman taninan man denafak nishmateh birshuta achora
450: Vegufa dileh itkabbar beara kaddisha aleh ketiv vattavou vattetammeu et artzi venachalati samtem letoeva veyaakov amar ukvartani bikvuratam venishmateh nafka birshuta achora

Amar ribbi yehuda shane yaakov dishchinta havat achidat beh veitdabbekat beh hada hu dichtiv anochi ered immecha mitzrayema ledayera immach begaluta veanochi aalcha gam alo leizdavvega bi nishmatach ulitkevara gufach bekivre avahatach may ka mayere nafkat nishmateh birshuta achora

Veosef yashit yado al enecha yosef vadday deha hu buchra dehirhura delibba buchra detippa kadmaa havat kidittemar uvgin deyada kudsha berich hu temira da itbassar leh beosef deha kal rechimuta beh talya

Yashit yado al enecha may ka mayere amar ribbi yesa begin yekara deyaakov ulitbassera deha yosef kayyam veyishtakkach aleh bemitateh ribbi chizkiyya amar milla olifna vedachilna legallaa uvovade alma chachmeta ishtakkach ata ribbi abba batash beh amar ema milach vezayyen zayenach beomoy deribbi shimon millin itgalleyan

Amar olifna mippirkin derav yesa sava benimmuse alma bar nash dezache levar behay alma libae leh lenagda afra al enoy kad itkabbar veda hu yekara dileh leachazaa dealma astim minneh vehu yarit leh lealma techotoy

Begin deenoy devar nash chezu dealma beh itchaze vechal gevanin hachi inun deascharu chivara deveh hu yamma rabba okyanos deaschar kal alma bechal sitre goona achora hu yabbeshta deafiku maya veyabbeshta kaim ben maya hachi hu goona ben maya

Goona achora telitaa hi bimtziuta deveh da yerushala dehi emtzauta dealma goona reviaa hi chezu dechal ena veikre bat ayin divhahu bat ayin itchaze partzufa vechezu yekara mikkolla da tziyyon deihi nekuda emtzauta mikkolla dechezu dechal alma tamman itchaze vetamman sharya shechinta dehi shappiru decholla vechezu decholla veena da hu yerutat alma uvgine kach hay shavik leh vehay natil leh veyarit leh

Amar leh shappir kaamarte aval milla setima ihu yattir uvne alma la yadin vela mistakkelan deha beshata devar nash nafik mealma nafsha dileh temira immeh vead la nafkat enoy debbar nash chamu ma dechamu kema deokimna dichtiv ki lo yirani haadam vachay bechayyehon la chaman aval bemitathon chaman

Veenoy pekichan mehahu chezu dechama veinun dekayemin aleh baa leshavea yada al enoy ulastama enoy begin hahu deolifna beraza denimmuse alma divshata deishtaaru enoy pekichan mehahu chezu yakkira dechama i zache levar bera kadim leshavea yadeh al enoy ulastama lon kema dichtiv veosef yashit yado al enecha begin deha chezu achora dela kaddisha izdammenat lekovleh veena dechama hashta chezu kaddisha illaa la yistakkal bechezu achora

Veod dehahu nefesh semichat lekovleh beveta vei ishtaar ena pekicha vehahu chezu achora yishre al enoy bechal ma deistakkal itlatya velav yekara deena hu vechal shekken mikrivoy vechal shekken min mita delav yekara dileh leistakkala bamme dela itzterich ulashraya al enoy milla achora levatar itkasya beafra veha itaru chavraya al dina dekivra mahu vikara hu deyastim ena min kolla al yeda divreh deshavak bealma
Ta chaze kal shiva yomin nafsha azla mibbeta lekivra umikkivra leveta veitabbalat aleh utlat zimnin beoma itdanu kechada nafsha vegufa velet man deyada bealma veyashgach leatara libba
Levatar gufa itterid venafsha azla veissetachya
451: Baggehinnam venafka veshata bealma umvakra lekivreh ad demitlabbesha bemma deitlabbesha

Levatar teresar yarche nayechin kolla gufa shavik beafra nafsha ittzerer veitnehir berucha bemana deitlabbash rucha itannag beginta deeden nishmata salka litzrora deinnuga dechal innugin vecholla itkashshar da beda lezimnin yedian

Ta chaze vay lon livne nasha dela mistakkelin vela yadin vela ishtemodan al ma kayeme veyitneshe minnayehu lemebad pikkude orayeta deit pikkude orayeta deavde levush yekar leela veit pikkude orayeta deavde levush yekar letatta veit pikkude orayeta deavde levushe yekar lehay alma vecholla itzterichan leh lebbar nash umin yomoy mammash kullehu mittaknan kema deokimna

Ribbi yehuda sava itraggish bedateh yoma chad veachazu leh bechelmeh chad diukna minnehora dileh takkif deizdehar learba sitrin amar leh may hay amar leh levusha dilach hu lediyyura dehacha umehahu yoma hava chade

Amar ribbi yehuda kal yoma veoma ruchin detzaddikaya yatvin bilvushehon shurin shurin beginta deeden umshabbechan lekudsha berich hu bikara illaa hada hu dichtiv ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha amar ribbi abba bekadmita ma ketiv vayyishtachu yisrael vegv kema deokimna man mitta da keneset yisrael rosh hammitta da tzaddik al rosh hammitta da malka kaddisha dishlama kolla dileh kema dichtiv hinne mittato shellishlomo deyaakov ledideh ka sagid lehahu dekaim al rosh hammitta yisrael shemeh begini kach vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta

Levatar kevan deyada yaakov deha bedarga illaa ishtelim vedarga dileh hu leela im avahata vehu bilchodoy tikkuna shelemata achsin libbeh vechade veittakkaf biruta illaa dekudsha berich hu beh ma ketiv beh vayyitchazzek yisrael vayyeshev al hammitta al hammitta mammash deha bedarga illaa yattir ishtallam zakkaa chulakeh

Tana amar ribbi yehuda bematnita dilan okimna ha detaninan bearbaa perakim bashshana haolam niddon bappesach al hattevua baatzeret al perot hailan berosh hashshana kal bae haolam ovrim lefanav kivne meron uvachag niddonin al hammayim ha okimna mille veraza dematnita okimna befesach al hattevua vechu lakovel reticha illaa raza deavahan vedavid malka befesach al hattevua dehachi hu mammash veha okimna milla da al ma atya matztza befesach veha dina hu dina demalchuta dina veda sheruta deshariu yisrael lemeal bechulaka kaddisha dekudsha berich hu ulvaara minnayehu chametz deihu taavan achoranin di memannan al ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot deikrun elohim acherim elohe nichar veikrun chametz yetzer hara ulmeal bematztza chulaka kaddisha dekudsha berich hu ammay tevua begin kach befesach niddonin al hattevua veokimna dealma itdan al dina deh
Baatzeret al perot hailan perot hailan perot hailanot mibbae leh man perot hailan ella da hu ilana ravreva vetakkif leela perot hailan kema dichtiv ani kivrosh raanan mimmenni peryecha nimtza

Berosh hashshana ovrin lefanav kivne maron tana rosh hashshana da hu resha deshatta demalka uman hu rosh hashshana da yitzchak deikre rosh deihu chad resha demalka atar deikre shana begine kach kal bae olam ovrin lefanav kivne maron veal da taninan berosh hashshana deha beresha deshatta share yitzchak

Uvachag niddonin al hammayim da hu sheruta dimina demalka veal da chedvata demaya ishtakkach becholla beshata denasche maya veshaave lon begin demayim da yedia veal da bearbaa perakim illen kolla mishtakkechin
452: Amar ribbi yose kad yistakkelun mille kolla ishtakkach behanni pirkin avraham yitzchak veyaakov david malka uvhanni alma itdan uvarba perakin bene nasha itdanu beomin deishtakkachu bealma uvchal yoma veoma sifrin petichan veovadin ketivin velet man deyashgach velet man deyarchin udneh veorayeta ashidat beh bechal yoma vekala kare vechela mi peti yasur henna chasar lev amra lo velet man deyatzit lekaleh

Tana beshata devar nash kaim betzafra sahadin kayemin lekovleh vesahadin beh vehu la ashgach nishmata ashidat aleh bechal iddan uvchal shata i atzit yaot vei lav ha sifrin petichin veovadin ketivin amar ribbi chiyya zakkain inun tzaddikaya dela mistafu min dina la bealma den vela bealma deate hada hu dichtiv vetzaddikim kichfir yivtach uchtiv tzaddikim yirshu aretz

Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar vayehi hashshemesh lavo vetardema nafla al avram vegv hay kera ukmuha aval da yoma dedina kashya deafke leh lebbar nash mehay alma detanya zimna demata devar nash nafik mehay alma hahu zimna yoma dedina rabba deitchashshach shimsha min sihara kema dichtiv ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh da nishmata kaddisha deitmenaat mibbar nash telatin yomin ad la yippuk mealma vechama detzulma deitmenaat minneh vela itchaze

May tama itmenaat minneh begin denishmeta kaddisha salkat veitavarat minneh vela itchaze dela tema dechad mit bar nash veitchallash hay nishmata itavarat minneh ella kad ihu bechayyav betukpeh itavarat minneh hay nishmeta vela nahara lerucha verucha la nahir lenafsha keden tzulma itavarat minneh vela nahir leh mehahu yoma kolla machreze aleh veafilu tzippore shemaya may tama begin denishmata ha salka minneh verucha la nahir lenafsha keden nafsha itchallashat umechla vechal tiuvta degufa salka minneh veitavar

Veamar ribbi yehuda veafilu kal zimna denafil inish beve mareh vela yachil letzallaa nishmata itavarat vesalka minneh uchden la nahir rucha lenafsha ad dedayenin dinih devar nash vei dayenin leh levar nash letav keden nishmata ithadderat leatrah unhira lecholla ha bezimna dekayema milla bedina uvzimna dela kayema milla bedina telatin yomin akdimat nishmata lecholla vetzulma itavar minneh

Tana bezimna dedayenin leh levar nash leela salkin lenishmateh leve dina vedayenin al memraha vehi ashidat becholla veashidat bechal raaoni devar nash uvovadin la ashidat deha kullehu besifra chetivin vechullehu dayenin leh lebbar nash behahi shata dedayenin leh lebbar nash leela keden dochaka degufa ishtakkach yattir mishshear zimnaya

I dayenin leh letav keden arpin minneh vezea itbakka al gufa venishmata ahadderat levatar venahara lecholla vela salik bar nash mibbe mareh lealmin ad dedayenin dineh leela vei tema ha kamma chayyave alma kamma rashshie alma kayemin bekiyyumayehu ella kudsha berich hu ashgach bedineh debbar nash af al gav dehashta la zache vehu chame deha levatar zache dain leh letav o lezimnin deolid bar deyeheve zakkaa bealma veal da kudsha berich hu dain leh letav

Vechal ovadoy vedinoy dekudsha berich hu letav uvcholla ashgach kema dichtiv chay ani neum Adonai vegv im echpotz bemot harasha ki im beshuv rasha middarko uvgin da kal inun chayyave alma dekayemin bekiyyumayehu kudsha berich hu dain lon letav
Ulzimnin deinun marin ishtallimu zimnayehu millemishre tamman kema deatte amer vacholaim raim veneemanim deavadu mehemnuta dechad sharian aleh devar
453: Nash mistalleke minneh levatar deashlimu zimnayehu ben letzaddikaya ben lechayyavaya vecholla itavad bedina kidkaamaran

Vayyar yisrael et bene yosef vayyomer mi elle amar ribbi yitzchak hay kera kashya dichtiv vayyar yisrael uchtiv veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken lo yuchal lirot i lo yuchal lirot mahu vayyar yisrael ella dechama beruach kudsha inun bene yosef deinun yaravam vachaverav deyaravam avad teren egle zahav veamar elle elohecha yisrael uvgin kach mi elle man hu dezammin lememar elle elohecha letaavan achoran uvgin kach vayyar yisrael et bene yosef

Mikkan detzaddikaya chaman ovada lemerachok vekudsha berich hu meatter lon beitra dileh ma kudsha berich hu chame lemerachok kema dichtiv vayyar elohim et kal asher asa vehinne tov meod dekudsha berich hu chama kal ovadin ad la yaaved lon vechullehu aavaru kammeh

Kegavena da kal darin dealma misseyafe alma ad seyafe alma kullehu itattadu vekayemu kammeh ad la yetun lealma hada hu dichtiv kore haddorot merosh ad la itbere alma begin dechal nishmatin denachatin lealma ad la yechatun kullehu kayeme kammeh dekudsha berich hu bediukna dekayeme behay alma veikrun bishmahan dichtiv lechullam beshem yikra

Uf hachi tzaddikayya kudsha berich hu achme lon kal darin dealma ad la yetun veyishtakkechun bealma mena lan meadam dehava kadmaa dekudsha berich hu achme leh kal inun darin ad la yetun kedichtiv ze sefer toldot detaninan achme leh kal inun darin dezamminin lemete lealma vechen lemoshe dichtiv vayyarehu Adonai et kal haaretz dekudsha berich hu achme leh kal darin dealma vechal inun manhige alma vechal shear nevie ad la yetun lealma

Uf hacha vayyar yisrael et bene yosef chama lemerachok veizdaza veamar mi elle vehay kera ashlim litren sitrin lehay sitra ulhay sitra veal da ativ yosef veamar banay hem asher natan li elohim baze umna lan dekudsha berich hu achme leh berucha dekudsha dichtiv vehinni hera oti elohim gam et zarecha gam leasgaa inun denafkin minneh kidkaamaran

Vayevarecha et yosef vayyomar haelohim asher vegv behay kera it leistakkala beh vayevarech et yosef dela ashkechan hacha beracha divrich leh leosef ella livnoy i livnoy vayevarachem mibbae leh mahu vayevarech et yosef vela ashkechan hacha deitberich yosef
Amar ribbi yose et dayeka ketiv et yosef bircheta divnoy hava vechad itbarchan benoy ihu mitbarech devircheta divnoy devar nash birchateh ihi
Amar ribbi elazar vayevarech et yosef et dayeka devarich leat kayyama raza divrit denatar yosef uvgin kach ikre tzaddik et deosef raza divrit dekayema bahadeh deosef

Haelohim asher hithallechu avotay lefanav haelohim da raza divrit kaddisha keyama kaddisha avotay lefanav dayeka lefanav deinun kadmae illae mikkamme raza dena avraham veyitzchak deha minnehon ittezan veyanka hahu atar

Haelohim haroe oti may tama zimna achora haelohim ella raza illaa ihu vehacha barich lehahu atar beraza deelohim chayyim mekora dechayye deminneh nafkin birchan uvgin da adkar garmeh behay atar veamar haelohim haroe oti begin dechal birchan denagde mimmekora dechayye yaakov natil lon vechevan denatil lon ihu hay atar natal birchan vecholla ihu talya bedibbura veal da vayevarech et yosef ketiv
Begin kach bechal atar devirchan itzterichu levarcha bae kudsha berich hu leitbarcha bekadmita ulvatar itbarchu achoranin vei kudsha berich hu la itbarich bekadmita inun birchan la
454: Vei tema ha yaakov devarcheh avuha vela barcheh lekudsha berich hu bekadmita ta chaze beshata devarich yitzchak leyaakov la barcheh ad devarich lekudsha berich hu bekadmita kevan devarich lekudsha berich hu bekadmita barcheh leyaakov mena lan dichtiv vayyomer ree reach beni kereach sade asher beracho Adonai hacha kiyyem beracha lekudsha berich hu dichtiv asher beracho Adonai itbarech bekiyyuma devirchan ulvatar ketiv batrih veyitten lecha vegv kevan dehahu sade itkeyyam bekayema devirchan denafke mineh birchan levatar deihu itkeyyam bevirchoy kegavena da barich yaakov bekadmita lekudsha berich hu ulvatar barich livnoy ta chaze betzafra bae bar nash leakdama birchan lekudsha berich hu ulvatar lishar bene alma veha okimna dichtiv babboker yochal ad vegv

Vetta chaze kad baa yaakov levarcha leinun bene yosef chama beruach kudsha dezamin lenafka meefrayim yaravam ben nevat patach veamar mi elle mashma deamar baavoda da desitra deavoda zara elle elohecha yisrael ella raza ihu kal inun sitrin dehahu chiveya bisha umissitra dehahu ruach mesaava hahu chiveya veit man derachiv aleh vechad mizdavegan ikrun elle veinun mizdammenin bealma bechal inun sitrin dillehon
Veruach dekudsha ikre zot deihu raza divrit reshima kaddisha deishtakkach tadir bebbar nash vechen ze eli veanvihu ze Adonai Adonai aval illen ikrun elle veal da ketiv elle elohecha yisrael

Uvgin kach ketiv gam elle tishshachachna veanochi raza dezot lo eshkachech uchtiv al elle ani bochiya dehahu chova garma lon lemivke kamma bechiyyan davar acher al elle ani may tama begin deityehiv reshu leatar da leshalletaa al yisrael ulcharava be makdesha uvgin deityehiv lon reshu leshalletaa ani bochiya da ruach kudsha deikre ani

Vei tema ha ketiv elle divre habberit hachi hu vadday dechal illen la mitkayeme ella miggo elle detamman kal levatin sharyan kema deokimna deihu arur uvgin da akdim veamar elle dekayema leman deavar divre habberit

Elle hammitzot asher tziva Adonai begin dechal pikkuda deorayeta leitdakkaa bar nash vela yiste meorcha da veyistammar mittamman veyitperash minnayehu vei tema elle toldot noach hachi hu vadday deha nafak cham deihu avi chenaan uchtiv arur kenaan veihu raza da deelle

Veal da ketiv vayyomru ele elohecha yisrael vechal hanne hittucha sosfita dedahava aharon kariv dahava deihu sitra dileh dechalil ihu betukfa deesha vecholla chad vesitra da dahava veeshsha ruach mesaava deishtakkach tadir bemadbera ashkach atar behahu zimna leatkafa beh

Uma dehau yisrael dachyan mehahu zuhama kadmaa deatil bealma degarim mota lealma kad kamu al tura desinay levatar ahadaru vegarim lo kemillekaddemin lesaava lon ulittakfa alayehu vegarim lon mota ulchal alma ledarehon batrayehu hada hu dichtiv ani amarti elohim attem vegv achen keadam vegv

Veal da kad chama yaakov leyaravam ben nevat deavad kochavim umazzalot veamar elle elohecha izdaza veamar mi elle kad baa levatar levarcha lon barich leh barich livnoy kevan devarich lekudsha berich hu bekadmita levatar mehahu atar devarich bekadmita barich lon hada hu dichtiv hammalach haggoel oti mikkal ra vegv

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel el Adonai ha ukmuha dela litzle bar nash ella samuch lechotla vela yehe milla chatzitz beneh leven kotla dichtiv vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir may shena bechullehu detzalle tzelota dela ketiv behu vayyassev panav el hakkir deha day leh deyema veyitpallel el Adonai deha man dematzle tzelota ihu kivin dateh kedeka yeut deha ketiv bemoshe vayyitpallel moshe el Adonai vayyitzak moshe el Adonai vela ketiv
455: Vayyassev panav hacha bechizkiyyahu may tama vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir ulvatar vayyitpallel

Ella raza demilla ihu detaninan chizkiyya behahu zimna la hava nasiv vela hava leh intu vela olid benin ma ketiv vayyavo elav vegv ki met atta velo tichye vetaninan ki met atta baolam hazze vela tichye baolam habba may tama begin dela olid benin

Dechal man dela ishtaddal leolada benin behay alma la mitkayyem bealma deate vela yehe leh chulaka behahu alma veittarchat nishmateh bealma vela ashkachat nayecha beatar dealma veda hu onasha dichtiv beorayeta aririm yamutu umtargeminan bela velad begin deman deihu bela velad kad azil behahu alma mit hu tamman mit bealma den uvalma deate veal da ketiv ki met atta velo tichye
Velo od ella dishchinta la sharya aloy kelal keden ketiv vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir olifna deshave raaonoy vechaven anpohi lemesav itteta begin detishre aloy shechinta raza dekir

Veal da ketiv hammalach haggoel oti mikkal ra oti denatil birchan miggevanin dilela vechevan deihu natil yevarech et hannearim da raza dichruvim deminnayehu nagde
456: Hammalacha haggoel oti mikkal ra yevarech et hannearim vegv ribbi chiyya patach veamar bayit vahon nachalat avot vechi nachalat avot inhu veha kudsha berich hu yahiv kolla lebbar nash ella dechevan deachsin beta levar nash umamona lezimnin deyachasin kolla livreh vihe achsana deavot aval umeyeya ishsha maskalet begin deitteta kad achsin lah bar nash meim kudsha berich hu achsin lah deha la yachsin lah kudsha berich hu lebbar nash ella kad machrizin aleh birkia

Dekudsha berich hu mezaveg ziugin ad la yetun lealma vechad zachu bene nasha lefum ovadehon hachi yahave lon itteta vecholla itgalleyan kammeh dekudsha berich hu ulfum ovadin dezakkain hachi mezavig ziuugin

Ulzimnin deka seliku biklitin veaste hahu bar nash archeh salik ziuugeh leachora ad deyichshar ovadoy vechad yichshar ovadoy o demate zimneh itdache gevar mikkamme gevar veate hay venatil dileh veda kashe kammi kudsha berich hu mikkolla ledachya bar nash mikkamme gavra achora uvgin kach kudsha berich hu ihu yahiv itteta lebbar nash uminneh atyan ziuugin veal da umeyeya ishsha maskalet

Begin kach kudsha berich hu yahiv kolla levar nash vei tema ishsha maskalet vela achora ta chaze af al gav dekudsha berich hu azmin tavan lebbar nash lemehav leh vehu aste archoy meim kudsha berich hu legabbe sitra achora mehahu sitra achora deitdabbak beh yete leh man deyete bechal kitrugin vechal bishin vela atyan leh meim kudsha berich hu ella mehahu sitra bisha deitdabbak beh beinun ovadin deavad

Veal da itteta delav ihi maskelet kara al da shelomo umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha begin dechovoy debbar nash hu mashich aleh beinun ovadin deavad veal da kad kudsha berich hu itrae beh bevar nash begin ovadoy dechashran ihu azmin leh intu deihi maskelet ufarik leh befurkan miggo sitra achora

Veal da amar yaakov hammalach haggoel oti mikkal ra may mikkal ra dela izdammenat li itteta deihi miggo sitra achora vela iara pesul bezari dechullehu tzaddike ushleme bishlimu begin deitperak mikkal ra veyaakov la itdabbak behahu sitra achora kelal

Veal da hammalach haggoel oti mikkal ra yevarech et hannearim may tama itchazu leitbarcha begin denatir yosef at kayyama kaddisha veal da amar yosef banay hem asher natan li elohim baze achme leh raza divrit denatar leh uvgin denatar leh itchazu leitbarcha veitchaze ihu levirchan saggiin begin da lechullehu yahav bircha chad ulosef birchan saggiin mashma dichtiv birchot avicha gavru al birchot horay vegv birchot shadayim varacham tihyena lerosh yosef

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar elecha nasati et enay hayyoshvi bashshamayim hay kera ukmuha aval ta chaze tzelota debbar nash deitkaven bah ihu leela leumka illaa demittamman nagde kal birchan vechal cheru umittamman nafke lekayema kolla

Veal da yattir begin dela pasik yud meatar da lealmin uvgin da ketiv hayyoshvi bashshamayim achid leela beraza dechachmeta illaa veachid letatta deyativ al karseya deavahan yativ al karseya deikre shamayim uvgin kach hayyoshvi bashshamayim ketiv

Umehacha kad birchan nagde meela meumka da kullehu natil lon hay atar deikre shamayim umehay nagde letatta ad dematu letzaddikayya keyama dealma umehacha mitbarchin kal inun chayyalin vechal inun mashshiryan liznayehu veha ukmuha

Ta chaze beshivin utren nehorin istallak atara dechal mashshiryan iggula dealma beshivin duchte chad iggula lechullehu bego hahu iggula nekuda chada dekayema beemtzaita mehay nekuda ittezanat kal hahu iggula bet kodesh hakkodashim ihu atar
457: Lehahu rucha dechal ruchin ittammar begaveh hay temiru ihu bego chelaha temira ihu bego lego kad salka da kolla salkin avatrah hada hu dichtiv mashcheni acharecha narutza

Ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yose veribbi yehuda hau azle beorcha amar ribbi yose kal chad vechad minan lema mille deorayeta patach ribbi yehuda veamar al tizkar lanu aonot rishonim maher yekadmunu vegv ta chaze kudsha berich hu birchimuta deyisrael rachim lon deinun adveh veachsanteh la mistakkal achora bedinayehu bar ihu bilchodeh vechevan deihu mistakkel bedinayehu itmale alayehu rachamin begin deihu keav derachim al banim kema deatte amer kerachem av al banim richam Adonai vegv vechevan deishtakkach lon chovin maavar lon rishon rishon ad deaavar lon lechullehu mikkammeh vechevan deaavar lon mikkammeh la ishtaar alayehu chovin lemehav shaltanu lesitra achora dedina alayehu

Ate lemechav kammeh kedebbekadmita inun chovin kadmae deaavar mikkammeh chashiv alayehu veal da ketiv al tizkar lanu aonot rishonim maher yekadmunu rachamecha vegv dei rachamecha lo yakdimu alayehu deyisrael la yachlin lekayema bealma begin dechamma inun mare dedina kashya mare terisen vechamma diltorin dekayeme alayehu deyisrael leela veilmale deakdim kudsha berich hu rachamim alayhu deyisrael ad la yashgach bedinehon la yachlin lekayema bealma veal da maher yekadmunu rachamecha ki dalonu meod dalluta deovadin tavin dalluta deovadin dechashran

Ta chaze ilmale yesaggelun yisrael ovadin dechashran kamme kudsha verich hu la hau kaimu aleh ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bealma aval yisrael inun garmin lishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot lezakfa reshayehu bealma deilmale yisrael la yehon chatan kamme kudsha berich hu shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot itkafyan kammayehu

Veta chaze ilmale deamshichu yisrael beovadin bishin listar achora beara kaddisha ha ittemar dela shaltu shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot beara kaddisha vela itgalu meal ara veal da ketiv ki dallonu meod delet lan ovadin dechashran kedeka chaze uvgin kach ki dallonu meod maher yekadmunu rachamecha

Ribbi yose patach veamar ivdu et Adonai beyira vegilu birada uchtiv ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana ta chaze kal bar nash deate lemiflach leh lekudsha berich hu betzafra uvfanya bae lemiflach leh lekudsha berich hu

Betzafra kad salik nehora veitaruta distar yemina itar bealma keden bae bar nash leitkashshera bimina dekudsha berich hu ulmiflach kammeh befulchana ditzlota begin ditzlota achsin tukfa leela veamshich birchan meumka illaa lechullehu almin umittamman amshich birchan letattae veishtakkechu illain vetattain mitbarchan behahu pulchana ditzlota

Pulchana ditzlota deka bae bar nash lemiflach kamme kudsha berich hu besimcha uvirnana leachlala lichneset yisrael benayehu ulvatar leyachada yichuda kedeka chaze dichtiv deu ki Adonai hu elohim da raza deyichuda beraza defulchana

Veim kal da bae bar nash lemiflach kammeh dekudsha berich hu bechedva ulachazaa chedva befulchaneh veillen teren simcha urnana lakovel teren illen teren tzelotin teren kurbanin leoma lakovel teren illen deinun simcha urnana simcha betzafra urnana beramsha veal da et hakkeves echad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim

Veal da tzelota dearvit reshut ihi begin dehahi shata mechallek tarpa lechal chelaha ve lav shata leadkara ella lemehav mezona bimama hi mitbarechet mitteren sitrin illen betzafra uvramsha miggo simcha urnana uvlelya palig birchan lecholla kedeka chaze hada hu dichtiv vattakam beod layela vattitten teref levetah vegv

458: Detzafra dela ketiv tikkon tefillati babboker ella hachi ittemar tikkon tefillati ketoret lefancha ketoret la atya ella al chedva hada hu dichtiv shemen uktoret yesammach lev veal da kahana kad adlik botzinin hava makriv ketoret kema deatte amer behetivo et hannirot yaktirenna uvhaalot aharon et hannirot ben haarbayim yaktirenna betzafra al chedva deshata garim beramsha lemechode setar semala vehachi itchaze ulalam la ate ella al chedva

Veta chaze ketoret mekashsher kishrin veachid leela vetatta veda aavar mota vekitruga verugza dela yachil leshaltaa bealma kema dichtiv vayyomer moshe el aharon kach et hammachta veten aleha esh meal hammizbeach vesim ketoret veholech mehera vegv levatar da ketiv vayyaratz vegv vayechapper al haam uchtiv vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim vatteatzar hammaggefa begin dela yachlin kal sitrin bishin vechal mekatregin lemekam kamme ketoret veal da ihu raza decholla vekishshura decholla

Uvshata demincha dedina sharya bealma itkaven david behahu tzelota dichtiv tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanecha vegv vehay tzelota desalik yaaver rugza dedina kashya deshallit hashta behay zimna behahu ketoret dedache veaavar kammeh kal rugza vechal kitruga dealma minchat arev dedina talya bealma

Ta chaze kad itcharav be makdesha beshata deittokad zeman mincha hava veal da ketiv oy lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev man tzille arev inun mekatregin dealma verugze dedinin dizminin behahi shata veal da taninan devae bar nash lechavvena dateh bitzlota demincha bechullehu tzelota bae bar nash lechavvena dateh uvhay tzelota yattir mikkullehu begin dedina sharya bealma veal da zeman tzelota demincha yitzchak takkin leh veha ukmuha

Ad dehau azle aolu bechad tura amar ribbi yose hay tura dachala nihach vela nitakkev hacha begin detura dechila hu amar ribbi yehuda i hava chad hava amina hachi deha taninan deman deazil yechiday beorcha itchayyav benafsheh aval telata la vechal chad vechad minan itchaze dela taade minan shechinta

Amar ribbi yose ha taninan dela yismoch bar nash al nissa menalan mishmuel dichtiv ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani veha itchaze shemuel yattir minan amar leh afilu hachi ihu hava chad vehezzeka ishtakkach leena aval anan telata vehezzeka la ishtakkach leena dei mishshum mazzikin ha taninan delitlata la mitchaze vela mazke vei mishshum listim la mishtakkeche hacha deha rachik meyishuva hay tura uvne nasha la mishtakkeche hacha beram dechilu hu dechevan bara demishtakkechin hacha
