Ma ketiv beyaakov im yihye elohim immadi da ziuga dishchinta ushmarani badderech hazze lemifrak li mikkolla veyaakov yechiday hava
459: Behahu zimna ushchinta azlat kammeh kal shekken chavraya deit benayehu millin deorayeta al achat kamma vechamma

Amar ribbi yose may naavid i nitakkev hacha ha yoma maich lemeal i nehach leela tura rav ihu udchilu dechevan chakla dachilna amar ribbi yehuda tevahna alach ribbi yose amar leh ha taninan dela yismoch bar nash al nisa dekudsha berich hu la yarchish nisa bechal shata amar leh hane mile yechiday aval anachna telata umille orayeta benana ushchinta immana la dachilna

Ad dehau azle chamu leela betura tinnara chad vechad mearta begavah amar ribbi yehuda nihach venesak lehahu tinara deana chame chada mearta tamman seliku letamman vechamu hahi mearta amar ribbi yose dachilna dilma hahi mearta atar dilchevan ihu vela yifgeu lon hacha

Amar ribbi yehuda leribbi chizkiyya ha chamena deribbi yose dachil ihu i tema begin deihu chattaa dechal man dedachil chattaa ihu dichtiv pachadu vetziyyon chattaim ha lav ihu chattaa uchtiv vetzaddikim kichfir yivtach amar ribbi yose begin denizka shechiach

Amar leh i nizka shechiach hachi hu aval hacha la ishtakkach nizka ulvatar deanan niol limarta la leul nizka letzaara lan alu limarta amar ribbi yehuda niflog lelya litlat mishmarot dehave lelya kal chad vechad minnan lekum al kiyyumeh behanne telat sitre lelya vela nidmuch

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar maskil leetan haezrachi hay tushbachta avraham avinu amarah beshata deishtaddal befulchana dekudsha berich hu veavid chesed im bene alma deyishtemodun kolla lekudsha berich hu dekudsha berich hu shallit al ara veikre etan begin deatkif bitkifu beh bekudsha berich hu

Chasde Adonai olam ashira vechi missitra dachasidim atyan lezammera ella hacha itkelil sitra dismala bimina veal da kudsha berich hu nasse leavraham uvachen leh veha ittemar deyitzchak bar telatin ushva shenin hava behahu zimna may nissa et avraham nissa et yitzchak mibbae leh ella nissa et avraham deyishtakkach bedina ulitkelala bedina deyishtakkach shelim kedeka yeut veal da chasde Adonai olam ashira

Davar acher chasde Adonai olam ashira inun chasadim dekudsha berich hu avid im alma ledor vador odia emunatcha befi tivu ukshot deavid im kolla ledor vador odia emunatcha da mehemnuta dekudsha berich hu deoda avraham bealma veadkar leh befuma dechal biryan veal da odia emunatcha befi

Vekudsha berich hu oda leh leavraham raza dimhemnuta vechad yada raza dimhemnuta yada deihu ikara vekiuma dealma divgineh itbere alma veitkeyyam hada hu dichtiv ki amarti olam chesed yibbane vegv dechad bara kudsha berich hu alma chama dela yachil lemekam ad deoshit yemina aleh veitkeyyam vei lav deoshit yemina aleh la itkeyyam begin dealma da bedina itberi veha okimna

Veittemar bereshit veraza kelala chada teren gevanin hacha bereshit af al gav deamaran sheruta mittatta leela reshit hachi name meela letatta vekaamrinan reshit kidkaamrinan bet kodesh hakkodashim dehay ityehivat lehahu reshit umilla kelila ihi kechada

Uvhay itbere alma da vela itkeyyam ella bimina veha ukmuha behibbaram beavraham ketiv uvgin kach amarti olam chesed yibbane uvinyana kadmaa dealma hahu nehora deoma kadmaa hava beh lekayema ulvatar beoma tinyana bismala uvhanhu atkin shamayim uchtiv shamayim tachin emunatcha bahem
Davar acher shamayim tachin emunatcha bahem shamayim beinun chasadim ittaknu veraza deemuna atkanat behu delet tikkunaha ella miggo shamayim karatti berit livchiri da hu raza dimhemnuta
460: Tzaddik demineh nafkin birchan lechullehu tattae vechal chevan kaddishan kullehu itbarchan min hahu negidu denagid letattay uvgin kach ketiv karatti berit livchiri

Nishbati ledavid avdi da raza dimhemnuta deihu kayema tadir betzaddik da kiyyuma dealma dela yitbadderun lealmin bar bezimna degaluta dingidu devirchan itmenau veraza dimhemnuta la ishtallim vechal chedvan itmenau vechad ayil lelya mehahu zimna chedvan la alu kamme malka

Veaf al gav dechedvan la itaru aval levar kayeme umzammere shirata vechad itpelig lelya veitaruta salka mittatta leela keden kudsha berich hu atar kal chele shemaya livchiya uvaat birkia veizdazean illae vetattae

Velet nayecha kammeh bar bezimna demitare letatta beorayeta keden kudsha berich hu vechal inun nishmatin detzaddikaya kullehu tzayetin vechadyan lehahu kala uchden nayecha begin demiyyoma deitchariv makdesha letatta ome kudsha berich hu dela yeul bego yerushlem dilela ad deyaalun yisrael liyerushalam diltatta dichtiv bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir veha ukmuha chavraya

Vechal inun mezammere kayeme levar veamre shirata bitlat palge lelya vechullehu meshabbechan betushbachtan yedian vechullehu chele shemaya kullehu mitare belelya veyisrael bimama ukdusha la mekaddeshe leela ad dimkaddeshe yisrael letatta uchden kal chele shemaya mekaddeshe shema kaddisha kechada veal da yisrael kaddishin mitkaddeshin meillae vetattae kechada hada hu dichtiv kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem

Patach ribbi yose veamar al ma adaneha hatbau hay kera kudsha berich hu amar leh begin dechad bara alma la vara leh ella al samchin deinun samchin dealma kema deatte amer chatzva ammudeha shiva veinun samchin la ityeda al ma kayemin

Begin deihu raza amika setima dechal setiman vealma la itbere ad denatal avna chada veihu avna deitkere even shetiyya venatal lah kudsha berich hu vezarak lah lego tehoma veitneitz meela letatta uminneh ishtil alma veihi nekuda emtzaita dealma uvhay nekuda kayema kodesh hakkodashim hada hu dichtiv o mi yara even pinnatah kema deatte amer even bochan pinat yikrat uchtiv even maasu habbonim hayeta lerosh pina

Ta chaze hay even itkare meeshsha umerucha umimmaya veitgelid mikkullehu veitavid avna chada vekayema al tehome ulzimnin navin minneh maya veitmalyan tehome vehay avna kayema leat beemtzaita dealma vehay ihu even dekiyyem veashtil yaakov shetilu vekiyyuma dealma hada hu dichtiv vayyikkach yaakov aven vayerimeha matztzeva

Vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva vegv vechi hay even shave leh yaakov veha hay even itbere bekadmita kad bara kudsha berich hu alma ella deshave lah kiyyuma dilela vetatta veal da asher samti matztzeva ketiv may asher samti dichtiv yihye bet elohim deshave medora dilela hacha

Ta chaze hay even it alah shiva enayim kema deatte amer al even achat shiva enayim al ma itkeriat shetiya chad deminnah ishtil alma vechad shetiya shat ya deshave kudsha berich hu lah leitbarcha minnah alma begin dealma minnah mitbarcha

Vetta chaze beshata deal shimsha hanne keruvim dekayemin behay duchta vehau yatve beat hau akshan gadfayehu leel ufarse lon veishtema kol nigguna degadfayehu leela uchden sharan lenagna inun malachin deamre shirata besheruta delelya begin disallak yekareh dekudsha berich hu mittatta leela umay shirata hau amru hahu nigguna degadfayehu dichruvim hinne barchu et Adonai kal avde Adonai vegv seu yedechem kodesh vegv uchden ihu shirata leinun malache illae lezammara
461: Akshe gadfayehu leela veishtema kol nigguna dilhon uchden sharan lenagna inun malachin dekayemin bemishmarta tinyana umay shirata hau amre behay shata nigguna degaddefayehu dichruvim habbotchim ba kehar tziyyon lo yimmot vegv uchden ihu sheruta leinun dekayeme behay mishmara tinyana lenagna

Bemishmara telitaa hanne keruvim akshu gadfayehu veamre shirata umay hi halluya hallelu avde Adonai vegv yehi shem Adonai mevorach vegv mimmizrach shemesh vegv keden inun malachin dekayeme bemishmara telitaa kullehu amre shirata
Vechullehu kochave umazzale devirkia patche shirata kema dichtiv beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kal bene elohim uchtiv halleluhu kal kochve or deha inun kochve dinhora menagnan al nehora

Kad ate tzafra uchden natle shirata abbatrayehu deyisrael letatta vesalka yekareh dekudsha berich hu mittatta umilleela yisrael letatta bimama umalache illae leela belelya uchden ishtelim shema kaddisha bechal sitrin

Vehay even dekaamar kullehu malache illae veyisrael letatta kullehu itkafu behay even veihi salka leela leitattera go avahan bimama uvlelya kudsha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden

Zakkain inun kal dekayeme bekiyyumayehu umishtaddelin beorayeta belelya begin dekudsha berich hu vechal inun tzaddikaya divginta deeden shamu kalayehu divne nasha inun demishtaddele beorayeta kema dichtiv hayyoshevet baggannim vegv

Ta chaze hay even ihu even tava veda hu raza dichtiv umilleta vo milluat even arbaa ture even veillen inun sidrin deeven tava ashlamuta deeven yekara begin deit even achora dichtiv vahasiroti et lev haeven vegv uchtiv veet ruchi etten bekirbechem vehay ihu even bochan pinnat yikrat veukmuha
Veal raza da ketiv luchot haeven deinun luchot itgezaru mehacha veal da ikrun al shemeh dehay even vehay hu raza dichtiv mishsham roe even yisrael kema deittemar

Patach ribbi chizkiyya veamar vehaavanim tihyena al shemot beni yisrael shettem esre illen avne yekarin illain deitkarun avni hammakom kema deatte amer vayyikkach meavne hammakom veha ukmuha vehaavanim al shemot bene yisrael kema deit shevatim letatta hachi name leela teresar shivtin veinun terisar avanin yakkirin uchtiv sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah edut leyisrael da yisrael raza dilela vechullehu lehodot leshem Adonai veal da vehaavanim tihyena al shemot bene yisrael

Uchma deit shae bimama hachi it shae belelya beoma leela belelya letatta kolla da lakovel da hanne shae divlelya mitpallege litlat pelagan vechamma memanne terisin kayeme techotayehu dargin al dargin kullehu memannan belelya venatle tarpa bekadmata

Uchden kad itpelig lelya kayemin teren sidrin missitra da utren sidderin missitra achora verucha illaa nafak benayehu uchden kal inun illanin divginta deeden kullehu patche shirata vekudsha berich hu al beginta deeden hada hu dichtiv az yerannenu atze hayyaar millifne Adonai ki va lishpot et haaretz kema dichtiv veshafat betzedek dallim begin demishpat al benayehu veitmalya minnah gan eden
Verucha detzafon itar bealma vechedva ishtakkach venashiv hahu rucha beinun busmin vesalkin rechin leela umitatterin tzaddikaya beitrayehu umithannan miggo ziva deaspaklarya denahara

Zakkain inun tzaddikaya dezachan lehahu nehora illaa vehahu nehora deaspaklarya denahara nahir lechal sitrin vechal chad vechad meillen tzaddikaya natil lechulakeh kedeka chaze leh vehava natil kal chad vechad kefum ovadoy deavad behay alma it minnehon demitkasfe mehahu nehiru denatil chavreh
462: Chulakeh delelya mikkad share lelya lemeal kamma gardine nimmusin mitarin veshatan bealma ufatchin setimin ulvatar kamma zinin liznayehu kema deokimna uchden kad itpelig lelya sitra detzafon nachit meela letatta veachid beh belelya ad teren chulakin delelya

Ulvatar sitra dedarom itar ad deate tzafra vechad ate tzafra keden darom vetzafon achidu beh uchden atan yisrael letatta salkin lah bitzlothon uvauthon leela ad desalka veitgenizat benayehu venatla birchan meresha dechal reshin

Veitbarcha mehahu talla deitmashshecha milleela umehahu talla parish lechamma sitrin vechamma ravvan ittezanu minneh mehahu talla uminneh atidin laachaya metaya hada hu dichtiv hakitzu verannenu shochne afar ki tal orot talecha talla meinun nehorin illain denaharin leela

Ad dehau yatve itpelig lelya amar leh ribbi yehuda leribbi yose hashta rucha detzafon itar velelya itpelag vehashta iddana dekudsha berich hu taiv lekalhon detzaddikaya behay alma inun demishtaddele beorayeta hashta kudsha berich hu tzayyet lan behay atar la nifsok mille deorayeta

Patach veamar hammalacha haggoel oti mikkal ra ha ittemar veukmuha aval ta chaze ketiv hinni anochi sholeach malach vegv da hu malach deihu paroka dealma netiru divne nasha vehay ihu deazmin birchan lechal alma begin deihu natil lon bekadmita vlvatar ihu azmin lon bealma uvgin da ketiv hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha veshalachti lefanecha malach

Vehay ihu malach dilzimnin dachar ulzimnin nukva vehachi ihu debbezimna deihu azmin birchan lealma keden ihu dachar veikre dachar kidchura deazmin birchan lenukva hachi ihu azmin birchan lealma uvzimna dekayema bedina al alma keden ikre nukva kenukva deihi ubbara hachi ihu itmele min dina uchden ikre nukva veal da lezimnin ikre dechura ulzimnin ikre nukva vecholla raza chada

Kegavena da ketiv veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet malachin it sheluchan bealma demithappechin lechamma gevanin lezimnin nukve lezimnin dechure lezimnin dina lezimnin rachame vecholla bechad gavena kegavena da hay malach bigvanin saggiin ihu vechal gevanin dealma kullehu itanhu behay atar veraza da kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beom haggeshem ken mare hannoggah saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai uchma deit beh kal inun gevanin hachi name anhig lechal alma

Tosefta rechime illae mare desuchlettanu istakkalu hurmani yedian bekulpe desichta kerivu leminda man minnechon mare deayenin besuchlettanu veyada beshata desalik birutta deraza derazin leappaka telatt gevanin kechada kelilan vinun chivar vesumak vyarok telatt goonin kechada ishtelivan da im da mizdagan da im da magroppaya tattaa itztabba vnappeka miggo goonin illen

Vechal goonin illen ittechazun behay chezu ihu leistakkala keena divdolcha ittechaze beshata kegavena devatash begavah hachi ittechaziyi levar illen telatt goonin sacharan lehay vegoona azla salka venachatta kistorin dekitra kevie begon

Goonin sacharin kelilan kechada salkin lah leela bimama venachatta belelya sheraga dedalik ittechaziyi belelya bimama istattaratt nehora temira bematan vearbain uttemanya almin kullehu azlin legavah milleela lettatta go telatt mea veshittin vechamesh shayepin geniza vittekkasya lettatta
463: Leashkacha lah yittevar gadpin kelipin temirin veyippettach tarin man dezache lemecheme yecheme go yedia vesuchlettanu keman dechame battar kottela bar min moshe nevia mehemna illaa dehava chame leh ena beena leela beattar dela itteyeda

Man dela zache dachu leh levar kamma chavile tehirin izdammenu legabbeh izdammenan nappeke aleh vappiku leh dela yistakkal beinnuga demalka vay lon leinun chayyavin dealma dela zachan leistakkala kema deatte amer velo yavou lirott kevalla t hakkodesh vegv

Amar ribbi yehuda mistakkel havena veha miggo zehirin illen mistakkelan nishmattehon detzaddikaya kad itteddabbaku behay attar miggo zehirin illen mistakkelin nishmattehon detzaddikaya inun goonin salkin veittekkelilan kechada zakkaa ihu man deyada leachlala ulyachada kullehu kechada leattekana kolla beattar deitztericha leela leela uchden ittenetir bar nash behay alma uvalma deatte

Patach ribbi yose veamar veoz melech mishpat ahev atta konanta mesharim vegv veoz melech mishpat ahev da kudsha berich hu veoz melech tukfa deatkif kudsha berich hu lav ihu ella bemishpat deha bemishpat itkeyyam ara kema deatte amer melech bemishpat yaamid aretz

Uvgin kach veoz melech mishpat ahev vela ittakkanat keneset yisrael ela bemishpat begin demittamman ittezanat vechal birchan denatla mittamman natla uvgin kach veoz melech mishpat ahev kal teivu vechal rechimu dilah lakovel mishpat atta konanta mesharim raza ditren keruvim letatta deinun tikkuna veyishuva dealma veha ittemar

Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar hallelu yah hallelu avde Adonai hallelu et shem Adonai hay kera it leistakkala beh kevan deamar halleluya ammay hallelu avde Adonai ulvatar hallelu et shem Adonai ella hachi taninan man dimshabbach leachara itzterich leshabbacha leh kefum yekareh uchfum yekareh hachi itzterich shivcheh vetaninan man dimshabbach leachara beshivcha delet beh hu gale genuteh vetzave legallaa leh veal da man deavid hespeda al bar nash itzterich kefum yekareh vela yattir demiggo shivcheh ate lignuteh uvcholla shevacha itzterich kefum yekareh
Ta chaze halluyah hacha it shevacha illaa demare decholla atar dela shalta beh ena leminda ulistakkala deihu temira dechal temirin uman ihu shema illaa al kolla

Uvgin kach halleluyah shevacha ushma kechada kelilan kechada vehacha satim milla deamar halleluyah vela amar man halleluyah leman amru hallelu ella kema de satim hachi shevacha deshabbuche satim inun dimshabbeche la yedana man inun vehachi itzterich lemeheve kolla satim beraza illaa ulvatar desatim beraza illaa galle veamar hallelu avde Adonai hallelu et shem Adonai begin deda ihu atar dela satim kehahu illaa temira dechal temirin da hu atar deikre shem kema deatte amer asher nikra sham shem Adonai
Kadmaa satim dela galya satim vegalya uvgin dekayema beitgalleya amar inun deka meshabbeche lehahu atar man inun vekaamar deinun avde Adonai deitchazzun leshabbacha leatar da
Yehi shem Adonai mevorach may shena dekaamar yehi ella yehi raza deamshachuta mehahu atar illaa deihu satim dekaamaran deihu ad raza divrit deihu tattaa kegavena deud illaa sheruta kesofa
Uvgin kach yehi raza deamshechuta mittemira dechal temirin ad darga tattaa uvmilla da itkeyyam kal ovada divreshit kema deatte amer yehi rakia yehi meorot yehi or bechal inun ovadin dilela ketiv yehi
Bechal inun ovadin diltatta la ketiv yehi begin deraza da deihu meraza illaa setimin dechal setimin la itkeyyam ella bemillin illae dilela vela ittemar beinun
464: Uvda mitbarach shema kaddisha becholla veal da ketiv yehi shem Adonai mevorach vegv mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo da atar illaa deka nahir minneh shimsha venahir lecholla veda hu atar deresha illaa setimaa

Vead mevoo da hu atar kishra deitkashshar beh mehemnuta kedeka chaze umittamman nafkan birchan lecholla vealma mehacha ittezan kema deittemar uvgin kach kayema hay atar leittezana meela ulitbarcha mittamman vecholla kayema beitaruta diltatta demitare inun avde Adonai kad mevarche shema kaddisha kidkaamaran vvgin kach deihu beitgalleya ketiv hallelu avde Adonai hallelu et shem Adonai

Adhachi hava nahir tzafra nafku min mearta uvhahu lelya la demichu azlu bearcha kad nafku meinun turin yatvu vetzallu tzelota matu lechad kefar veyatvu tamman kal hahu yoma behahu lelya namu ad dehava palgut lelya kamu leitasseka beorayeta

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar vayevarachem bayyom hahu lemor becha yevarech yisrael vegv vayevarachem bayyom hahu may bayyom hahu deha sagge dekaamar vayevarachem vetu kal lemor ketiv chaser vehacha lemor beyv ketiv may shena

Ela raza ihu vayevarachem bayyom hahu may bayyom hahu raza dedarga deitmanna al birchan leela yom hahu yom mehahu atar illaa deikre hu vehay yom hahu delet piruda ben yom uven hu uvchal atar hayyom hahu da teren dargin darga illaa vetattaa deinun kechada

Uvgin kach kad baa yaakov levarcha livnoy deosef barich lon beyichuda dilela vetatta kullehu kechada begin deyitkayyam birchathon ulvatar kalil kolla kechada veamar becha yevarech yisrael may becha vadday da raza deyichuda bekadmita mittatta leela ulvatar nachit leemtzaita ultatta lemor bev ha emtzaita ulvatar nachit letatta becha vehachi hu yaot kedeka chaze mittatta leela umeela letatta

Becha yevarech yisrael may yisrael yisrael sava yevorach yisrael la ketiv ella yevarech deha yisrael natil birchan milleela ulvatar ihu mevarech lecholla behay darga tattaa dayeka dekaamar becha yevarech yisrael lemor

Yesimcha elohim keefrayim vechimnashshe akdim leh leefrayim bekadmita begin deefrayim al shema deyisrael ikre mena lan meha dechad shivta deefrayim nafak ad la ishtelim zimna deshibuda demitzrayim dachaku shata venafku min galuta kamu alehon sanehon uktalu lon uchtiv ben adam haatzamot haelle kal bet yisrael hemma mashma dichtiv kal bet yisrael hemma veal da akdim leefrayim kodam menashshe begin kach efrayim matuleh listar maarav umatlanoy hava

Ta chaze bircheta devarich livne yosef ammay akdim lon birchan ad la yevarech livnoy ella mikkan dachavivuta divne benoy chaviv aleh debbar nash yattir mibbenoy uvgin kach akdim chavivuta divne benoy kodem livnoy levarcha lon bekadmita

Vayevarachem bayyom hahu lemor ribbi yose patach veamar Adonai zecharanu yevarech yevarech et bet yisrael vegv Adonai zecharanu yevarech illen guvrin yevarech et bet yisrael illen nashin begin didchurin bayan leitbarcha bekadmita ulvatar nashin venashin la mitbarchan ela mibbirchathon didchurin dechad dechurin mitbarchan keden nashin mitbarchan vei tema meha dichtiv vechipper baado uvad beto devae lechappara aleh bekadmita ulvatar al beteh begin demitbarcha minneh

Ta chaze denashin la mitbarchan ella migguvrin kad itbarchan inun bekadmita umehay birchata mitbarchan ella bemay okimna yevarech et bet yisrael ella kudsha berich hu yahav tosefet birchan lidchura denasiv begin demitbarcha mineh itteta vechen bechal atar
465: Yahiv kudsha berich hu tosefet birchan lidchura denasiv begin demitbarcha mehahu tosefet devirchan kevan deinsiv bar nash yahiv leh teren chulakin chad leh vechad lenukveh veihu natil kolla chulakeh vechulak nukveh
Ta chaze vayevarachem bayyom hahu levatar lemor bev hacha itremiza bera buchra beni bechori yisrael uchtiv veefrayim bechori hu veal da tosefet

Ribbi chizkiyya patach galmi rau enecha veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu vegv hay kera ukmuha bechamma atar aval ta chaze kal inun nishmatin dehau miyyoma deitbere alma kullehu kayeme kamme kudsha berich hu ad la nachatu lealma behahu diukna mammash deitchazun levatar bealma vehahu chezu degufa devar nash dekaim behay alma hachi kaim leela

Uvshata denishmata da zemina laachata bealma hahi nishmata behahi diukna mammash dekayema behay alma hachi kaim kamme kudsha berich hu veome lah kudsha berich hu deyittor pikkude orayeta vela yaavar al keyamin

Umna lan dekayemin kammeh dichtiv chay Adonai asher amadti lefanav amadti vadday veha ukmuha uvgin kach galmi rau enecha ad la yitchaze bealma veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu deha kal nishmatin behahu diukna dilhon kullehu besifra ketivin yamim yutztzaru ha ukmuha yutzaru vadday velo echad bahem behay alma lemekam bekiyyuma demarehon kedeka chaze

Ta chaze yomin debbar nash kad zache behay alma beovadin tavan yomin dileh itbarchan leela mehahu atar deihu middat yomoy patach veamar hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi vegv hay kera ukmuha aval ta chaze kitztzi da ketz hayyamin deihu mitkashshar beh bedavi umiddat yamay ma hi da ihu deitmanne mammash al yomoy

Amar ribbi yehuda ha shamana meribbi shimon dehay kera ittemar al inun yomin deitgezaru aloy meadam kadmaa deinun deha ittemar dechayyin kelal la hau leh ella deyahiv leh adam meinun yomin dileh shivin shenin

Veraza da vilon la meshamesh kelum vesihara la naharat miggarmah kelal veshivin shenin naharin lah bechal sitraha veinun chayye david setam veal da baa david lekudsha berich hu leminda raza da al ma let lah chayyin lesihara miggarmah ulminda ikkara dilah

Umiddat yamay ma hi da hu darga illaa setima deihu kayema al kal inun yomin deinun chayyin dilah atar denahir lecholla eda me chadel ani amar david inda al ma chadel ana nehora miggarmi veitmena minni kishar kal inun nehorain illain deit lon chayyin lechullehu veana al ma ana chadel veal ma itmena minni veda hu devaa david leminda vela ityehiv leh reshuta leminda

Ta chaze kal birchan illain kullehu itmesaru lehay darga levarcha lecholla veaf al gav delet lah nehora miggarmah kal birchan vechal chedu vechal tivu kullehu kayemin bah uminnah nafke veal da itkeriat kos shel beracha veikre beracha mammash kema dichtiv birkat Adonai hi taashir veal da ketiv umale birkat Adonai yam vedarom yerasha
Uvgin kach it lah bechullehu shiyyur umikkullehu itmalya umikkullehu it bah veitbarcha mikkal
466: Inun birchan illain veitmesaru lah birchan levarcha menalan deamar ribbi yitzchak yaakov barich livnoy deosef meatar da dechal birchan itmesaru bideh levarcha kema deatte amer veheye beracha mikkan ulhala birchan itmesaru beyadecha

Ta chaze kegavena da anan mevarchan umshabbechin lishma da veal da hallela deinun yomin dekaamre hallela deamar ribbi chiyya behallela tzerichin dargin chasidim tzaddikim veyisreelim chasidim missitra dimina tzaddikim missitra dismala veyisrael mikkal inun sitrin begin deyisrael kelilan mikkullehu veal da istallak tushbachta dekudsha berich hu mikkolla vechen bechal atar deyisrael meshabbechan leh lekudsha berich hu mittatta istallak yekareh becholla

Teren tzipporin salkin deka metztzappetztzeppan chad listar darom vchad listar tzappon parchin baavira tzippetztzuppa vekal neimu degalgalla mittechabberan kechada keden mizmor shir leom hashabbatt vechal birchan nagdin bilchishu beda neimu miggo rechimu dekol shoppara
Lekabbela inun birchan nachattin milleela lettatta vitteggenizu kechada bego umka devera neviu devera dela paska bilchishu ad deittemalya hahu galgalla sachara

Inun teren magroppin sacharan chad dimina kare vechayil vamar zehiru dezaharin desalka vnachatta tere alpe almin izdaharu alma deemtzaita begavayehu izdahar bezohara demaracha kal inun mare deayenin istakkalu uppikchu enechon vtizkun lehay nehiru lehay idduna illen inun birchan denagde milleela man dezache galgalla salka aschar limina vangid vamshicha lehahu dezache vitteaddan meillen birchan illain dezaharan zakkain inun dezachan behu

Vechad la zache galgalla aschar vhahu magroppa delistar semala aschar vnachatt lettatta vamshicha dina al hay dela zache vkala nappekatt leinun chayyavin dela zachu mehahu sitra nappik esha deshalhova dedalik deshare al reshehon dechayyavaya zakkain inun kol inun daazlu beorach keshot behay alma lemizke lehahu nehora illaa birchan detztzachtzechan kema deatte amer vhisbia betztzachtzachott nappeshecha
Vayyikra yaakov el banav vayyomer heasfu vegv ribbi abba patach veamar pana el tefillat haarar velo baza et tefillatam hay kera ukmuha veakshu beh chavraya pana hikshiv mibbae leh o shama may pana

Ella kal tzelotin dealma tzelotin utzlota deyachid la al kamme malka kaddisha ella bechela takkifa dead la aolat hahi tzelota leitattera beduchtah ashgach bah kudsha berich hu veisteche bah veisteche bechovoy uvizchuteh dehahu bar nash ma dela avid ken bitzlota desaggiin ditzlota desaggiin kamma inun tzelotin dela min zakkain inun vealin kullehu kamme kudsha berich hu vela ashgach bechovayehu

Vegin kach pana el tefillat haarar mehappech veisteche vah veisteche bah bemma reuta itavid uman hahu bar nash detzalle tzelota da uman inun ovadoy vegin kach libae leh lebbar nash diltzalle tzelota betzibbura may tama begin dela vaza et tefillatam af al gav delav kullehu bechavana uruta delibba

Davar acher pana el tefillat haarar da yechiday deitkelil besaggiin uman hu yechiday deitkelil besaggiin heve ema da yaakov deihu kalil bitren sitrin ukra livnoy vetzalle tzeloteh alayehu man tzelota deyitkabbelun bishlimu leela tzelota dela yishtetzun begaluta

Behay shata deyaakov kara lon istallak minneh shechinta veha ukmuha vetta chaze beshata deyaakov hava kare livnoy izdammenu avraham veyitzchak tamman ushchinta al gabbayehu ushchinta hava chade beh beyaakov leitchabbera baavahan
467: Leitkashshera im nafshayehu kechad lemehve reticha

Beshata defatach yaakov veamar heasfu veaggida lachem et asher yikra etchem beacharit hayyamim beacharit da shechinta kivyachol yahav atzivu beh veistallak ulvatar ahadaru lah benoy beyichude demilayehu ufatchu veamru shema yisrael vegv behahi shata kaim lah yaakov veamar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed veityashvat shechinta beduchtah vayyikra yaakov may keria hacha ella keria lekayema duchtayehu lekayema lon leela vetatta

Ta chaze bechal atar keria behay gavena dichtiv vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua lekayema duchteh beatar deitzterich ulkashra leh vechen vayyikra shemo yaakov uchtiv vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael kudsha berich hu kiyyem leh leatar da bishma da keria lekiyyuma ka atya

I tema veyikreu el elohim karati mitztzara li el Adonai hachi hu vadday lekashra ulkayema kiyyuma leela uman ihu siddura deshivcha demareh vechal inun millin devaan kamme mareh kiyyuma yahiv leh lemareh deachaze deveh talya kolla vela beatar achora ha kolla kayyam kiyyuma kehay gavena vayyikra yaakov el banav kiyyem lon bekiyyuma shelim kegavena da vayyikra el moshe itkeyyam bekiyyumeh

Amar ribbi yitzchak devayyikra ammay hi zeera amar leh itkeyyam moshe bishlimu vela becholla deha istallak meitteteh besifre kadmae amre leshivcha veanan hachi taninan may deistallak leela yitkashshar leela ultatta uchden ihu shelim tu alef zeera meatar zeera hava zeera deihu rav beitchabberuteh leela

Vayyomer may vayyomer ha ukmuha veamarta vilvavecha amira bachashay heasfu isfu mibbae leh kema deatte amer isfu li chasiday ella kim lan heasfu meatar dilleela hu heasfu bekishshura shelim beyichuda chad veaggida lachem may veaggida raza dechachmeta ihu

Ribbi yose shail leribbi shimon amar leh veaggida o veyagged o veyaggidu vechen kullehu detaninan deraza dechachmata ihi ammay bemilla da ihu raza dechachmeta amar leh begin deihu milla deatya begimel dalet bela piruda vehay ihu raza dechachmata milla deatya bishlimu beraza deatvan hachi hu kad inun bechachmeta aval dalet bela gimel lav hu shelimu vechen gimel bela dalet deha da beda itkashsheru bela piruda uman deafrish lon garim legarmeh mota veraza da chova deadam

Vegin kach hu milla deraza dechachmeta veaf al gav deit lezimnin ben gimel ledalet lav have piruda vecholla kishshura chada veal da milla da hachi hu vadday veaggida lachem raza dechachmeta baa legallaa sofa dechal ovadehon deyisrael

Vei tema dela gale may devaa legallaa i hachi ammay ketiv beorayeta milla deyaakov shelema veitpegim levatar vela ishtelim milla ella vadday ishtelim kal ma deitzterich legallaa galle vesatim amar milla vegalle levar vesatim lego umilla deorayeta la itpegim lealmin

Vecholla hu satim beh beorayeta begin deorayeta hu shelimu decholla shelimu dilela vetatta vela it milla o at beorayeta pegimu veyaakov kal ma deitzterich leh lememar amar aval galle vesatim vela pagim mikkal ma devaa afilu ot achat

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yose hau yatve yoma chad afitcha delod amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda ha dechaminan deyaakov barich livnoy chaminan mimma dichtiv vayevarech otam aval an birchata dilhon amar leh kolla birchan inun devarich lehu kegon yehuda atta yoducha achecha dan yadin ammo measher shemena lachmo vechen kullehu
Aval ma devae legalle lon la galle devaa legallaa lehu et hakketz veha ukmuha deit ketz limina veit ketz lismala uvaa legallaa lon et hakketz begin leistammera
468: Ulitdakkea mearla vman degalle lon ityeda veitgalle ad dealu leara kaddisha aval millin achoranin lav inun beitgalleya ustimin inun beorayeta behay parshata deyaakov uvinun birchan

Patach veamar reuven bechori atta kochi vereshit oni may ka chama yaakov lemiftach biruven liftach bihuda deihu kadmaa lechal mashshiryan veihu malka vechaminan dela barcheh vesalik birchan minneh ad deata moshe vetzalle tzelota aleh kema deatte amer yechi reuven veal yamot

Aval vadday barcheh vesalka hahu bircheta leatreh levar nash dehava leh bar kad mata zimneh leistalleka mealma ata malka aleh amar ha kal mamona dili lehve bida demalka natir livray kad chame malka divri itchaze yahiv leh kach yaakov amar reuven bechori atta rechima demeay ante aval birchan dilach yistallekun bida demalka kaddisha ad deyechome vach begin deazalte lakovel appach vegv ketargumo

Reuven bechori atta vegv ribbi elazar patach veamar vayyomer elay hinnave el haruach vegv kamma atimin inun bene nasha dela yadin vela mashgichin bikara demalka deha orayeta achriz alayehu bechal yoma velet man detzayyit udneh lekovleh hay kera kashya kevan dichtiv hinnave el haruach ammay zimna achora hinnave ben adam veamarta el haruach

Ella mikkan olifna raza dechachmeta teren kayemin hacha chad leitara mittatta leela dei la mitarin letatta la mitarin leela uvitaruta diltatta itar leela hinnave el haruach mittatta leela hinnave ben adam veamarta el haruach meela letatta

Deha afilu leela beitaruta diltatta nakit hahu illaa meillaa minneh kegon hay kera ko amar Adonai mearba ruchot boi haruach mearba ruchot da darom umizrach vetzafon umaarav veruach atya mimmaarav beitchabberuta deillen achoranin kema deatte amer karuha nedive haam vegv

Umehacha nafkin ruchin venishmatin livne alma leitztayera behu ufache kema deatte amer vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim ta chaze nakit mehay gisa veyahiv begisa achora veal da kal hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam ennu male ammay enennu male begin denakit veyahiv ail veappik

Ribbi elazar shail sheelta leribbi shimon amar hoil vekudsha berich hu gale kammeh divne nasha yemutun ammay nachit nishmatin lealma veammay itzterich leh amar leh sheelta da kammayehu derabbanan sheilu chamma vechamma veukmuha aval kudsha berich hu yahiv nishmatin denachatin lehay alma leishtemoda yekareh venakit lon levatar i hachi ammay nachatu

Ella raza da hachi hu patach veamar shete mayim mibborecha venozlim mittoch beerecha ha okimna bor atar dela nevia miggarmeh veematay navin hanne maya beshata deishtelim nishmata behay alma kad salka lehahu atar deitkashshar beh keden hu shelim mikkal sitrin mittatta umeela

Vechad nishmata salka keden itar tiuvta denukva legabbe dechura uchden navin maya mittatta leela uvor itavid beer mayin nevian uchden itchabberuta veyichuda vetiuvta veraava ishtakkach deha benishmata detzaddika ishtelim hahu atar veitar chavivuta uruta leela veitchabbar kechad

Reuven bechori atta hachi hu vadday tippa kadmaa deyaakov hava uruteh beatar achora hava kema deittemar ta chaze reuven vechullehu shivtin teresar kullehu itachadan bishchinta vechad chama yaakov lishchinta al gabbeh kara livnoy teresar leitchabbera bah
Veta chaze arsa shelemata la ishtakkach min yoma deitbere alma kehahi shata devaa
469: Yaakov leistalleka mealma avraham mimineh yitzchak mismaleh yaakov hava shachiv benayehu shechinta kammeh kevan dechama yaakov chach kara livnoy veachid lon sacharaneh dishchinta vesidder lon besiddura shelim

Mena lan desidder lon sacharaneh dishchinta dichtiv heasfu uchden ishtakkach tamman shelimu decholla vechamma retichin illain sacharanayehu patche veamre lecha Adonai haggedulla vehaggevura vegv keden itkenish shimmesha legabbeh desihara veitkeriv mizrach bemaarav hada hu dichtiv vayyeesof raglav el hammitta veitnehir sihara veishtakkach bishlimu uchden vadday taninan yaakov avinu la mit kevan dechama yaakov sitra shelim ma dela ishtakkach hachi levar nash achora chade veshabbach leh lekudsha berich hu ufatach uvarich livnoy kal chad vechad kedeka yeut leh

Ribbi yose veribbi yesa hau azle bearcha amar ribbi yiyisa ha vadday taninan kal benoy deyaakov ittakkanu besiddura shelim veitbarchu kal chad vechad kedeka yeut leh may ka nema behay kera dichtiv measher shemena lachmo vegv amar leh la yedana begin dela shamana beh mibbutzina kaddisha ella ante veana nezil legabbe butzina kaddisha azle kad matu legabbe deribbi shimon amru milla veshailu sheilta amar lon vadday raza dechachmeta hu

Patach veamar asher yashav lechof yammim veal mifratzav yishkon ammay yativ tamman ella man deyativ besifta deyamma ishtammesh betafnuke alma vehay pitcha ishtemoda tadir birchan dealma veikre asher veda hu ammuda meinun dekaim alma alayehu

Vehahu atar deikre lechem oni mehahu atar atkin hada hu dichtiv measher shemena lachmo ma dehava lachma demiskena ithaddar lechem pannag begin dearik vearme beh birchan vetafnukin vesofa dikra ochach vehu yitten maadanne melech man melech da keneset yisrael deminnah ittezan betafnuke alma veda yahiv lehay melech kal birchan kal chedu vechal tivu hu yahiv uminna nafke amru i la atena lealma ella leminda da tav lan

Reuven buchra deyaakov hava amar ribbi chiyya leh hava itchaze kolla veitavar minah kolla veityehiv malchu lihuda becheruta leosef kehunnata lelevi hada hu dichtiv pachaz kammayim al totar la tishtaar behu uma deamar kochi vereshit oni hacha barcheh ufakdeh lekudsha berich hu

Lirchima demalka yoma chad aavar bereh beshuka amar lemalka da hu beri vadday rechima denafshay shama malka veyada deha shail al bereh kach yaakov amar reuven bechori atta kochi vegv hacha fakdeh lemalka

Pachaz kammayim al totar hacha amar ma deiara leh dela ishtaar beara veshade leh levar meara lakovel da chad memanna missitra demishkena leela di memanna techot yada demichael veamre lah techot yeda degavriel umichael hu resha bechal atar missitra dechesed vegavriel missitra dismala digvura vihuda od rad im el setar gevura be dina ikre vesamich leh reuven af al gav demalchu hava dihuda reuven samuch lekovleh hava

Amar rabbi shimon zeminin inun bene reuven laagacha teren keravin bego ara ta chaze ketiv kochi begaluta demitzrayim vereshit oni deinun hau kadmain legabbe achuhon likrava yeter seet legaluta deashshur demittamman galu bene gad uvne reuven kadmay mikkullehu vesavle kamma bishin vechamma innuyin savlu vela tavu ad kean
Veyeter az lezimna demalka meshicha yitar bealma inun yifkun veyigchun keravin bealma vinatzchun veyittakfun al ammaya uvne alma yidchalun minnayehu veyirtetun kammayehu
470: Veyachshivu leitgabbera bemalchuta vela yishtaarun beh hada hu dichtiv pachaz kammayim al totar may tama la yishtaarun beh veafilu besitra chad dealma begin ki alita mishkeve avicha dizminin leaala ulaggacha keravin bego ara kaddisha mishkeve avicha dayeka zo yerushalem

Ta chaze bearba sitre alma itbadderu bene reuven begaluta lekivlehon dechal yisrael deitgalu begaluta arba zimnin bearba sitre alma hada hu dichtiv kochi chad vereshit oni tere yeter seet telat veyeter az arbaa kegavena da zeminin inun laagacha kerava bearba sitre alma ulmishlat bekirbayehu al kolla vinatzchun amamin saggiin veyishletun alayehu

Pachaz kammayim al totar ki alita mishkeve avicha hacha itremiz al hirhura kadmaa dehava leh leyaakov behay tippa kadmaa berachel deilmale hirhura dehahi tippa hava beatrah ishtaar reuven becholla aval pachaz kammayim al totar ki alita mishkeve avicha alita behirhura achora az chillalta vegv

Davar acher pachaz kammayim al totar deha kad yigchun kerava beni reuven bealma vinatzchun amamin saggiin la yishtaarun bemalchuta may tama ki alita mishkeve dizminin laagacha kerava beara kaddisha dayeka dichtiv ki alita mishkeve avicha mishkav mibbae leh ella avicha da yisrael sava mishkeve avicha vela mishkav begin deha bitre zimne itbene yerushala utlitaa lezimna demalka meshicha veal da mishkeve avicha vehacha itgalleya beracha umay dehava behahu zimna umay dehava kad alu yisrael leara uma diyehe bezimna demalka meshicha beovada diruven

Shimon velevi achim amar ribbi yitzchak hacha achid lon besitra semala dishchinta dechama ovadin dedina kashya dela yachil alma lemisbal amar ribbi yose bircheta dilhon an hi amar ribbi yitzchak shimon la itchaze lehay dechama leh kamma ovadin bishin velevi deate missitra dedina kashya uvircheta la talya beh veafilu kad ata moshe la tale birchateh beh dichtiv barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze bekudsha berich hu talya

Ta chaze ketiv ze hayyam gadol urchav yadayim sham remes veen mispar chayyot ketannot im gedolot ze hayyam gadol da shechinta dekayema aleh deyaakov kad baa leistalleka mealma urchav yadayim deha kal alma imle veishtelim veittzamtzem tamman sham remes veen mispar dechamma malache illae vekaddishae ishtakkechu tamman chayyot ketannot im gedolot illen inun shevatin benoy deyaakov deishtakkachu behon bishlimu chad ayyala vechad zeev vechad ari vechad tale amar ribbi yitzchak arye chad vetale chad chad zeev vechad gedi vechen kullehu leishtakkecha chayyot ketannot im gedolot

Ribbi yehuda amar kullehu shappir aval yehuda arye shimon shor veha ukmuha chavraya dehau mashgichin da lakovel da da mimina veda mismala letora deovadoy bishin amru netzayyer ikkunin dearye bekofteh veyistakkel beda veyidchal minneh kach shimon shor yehuda arye

Shimon la zacha levirchan ella tafal leh moshe bihuda ketiv hacha shema Adonai kol yehuda uchtiv hatam ki shama Adonai ki senua anochi amar ribbi yehuda shimon velevi avuhon salik lon lemoshe amar leh ribbi yose may tama avuhon salik lon lemoshe amar leh af anan naslik leh levutzina kaddisha illaa

Atu shaalu leh leribbi shimon amar kamma chavivin millin atfach bidoy uvacha amar man yegalle lach mehemna kaddisha istallakte bechayyach al bene nasha istallakte bemotach veastim deuknach mappettechan demarach itmasru bidach tadir
Ta chaze yaakov hava leh arba nashin veolid benin mikkullehu
471: Veistallik binshoy kad baa yaakov leistallaka shechinta kayeme aloy baa livruche leillen vela yachil mikkamme shechinta dedachil amar hech aavid deha tarvayehu missitra dedina kashya ka atyan i atkif bishchinta la yachilna deha arba nashin hau li veishtallimna behon ella asallek lon lemare deveta deha beta biruteh kayema uma devae yaavid
Kacha yaakov amar chulakin dinshin uvnin ha nasvit behay alma veishtallammena hech atkif bematronita yattir ella asallek millin lemare matronita vehu yaavid ma devae vela yidchal

Ta chaze ma ketiv vezot habberacha asher berach moshe ish haelohim mareh deveta mareh dematronita kema dichtiv ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu deha kallot moshe ketiv veal da moshe barich man devaa vela dachil kidokimna uvgin kach amar yaakov ha chamenan devanay illen besitra dedina kashya yete marih deveta vivarech lon

Moshe vadday ish haelohim haya uruteh avid beveteh kema deatte amer ishah yekimennu hada hu dichtiv vayyomer moshe kuma Adonai veishah yeferennu hada hu dichtiv uvnucho yomar shuva Adonai vadday reuteh avad mareh deveta velet deyimche videh kevar nash degazar al inteteh veavda reuteh veal da yaakov af al gav dehava achid beilana dechayye la hava mare deveta ella letatta moshe hu leela begin kach salik lon lemareh deveta

Besodam al tavo nafshi vegv ribbi abba patach veamar sod Adonai lireav vegv sod Adonai lireav raza illaa deorayeta la yahiv kudsha berich hu ella leinun dachalay chattaa uman deinun dachale chattaa itgeli lon raza illaa deorayeta uman ihu raza illaa deorayeta heve ema da at kayyama kaddisha deikre sod Adonai berit kodesh

Shimon velevi atrechu garmayehu al hay sod beanshe shechem deyigzerun garmayehu vikabbeloy alon hay sod ukra ashid bemirma tu beovada dezimri ben salu defasal hay sod veyaakov amar besodam al tavo nafshi may nafshi da nafsha deaolat veitachadat bivrit illaa leela veikre nefesh tzerora dechayye

Bikhalam al techad kevodi ha ukmuha kema deatte amer vayyakhel alehem korach al techad kevodi da kevod yisrael setam veal da la barich lon avuhon begin desalik lon lemoshe ribbi chiyya amar mehanne kerae dela itachid da beda veitzterich hachi veal da it beh kolla velet lach dara bealma dela nachata dina dillehon lekatrega bealma veasgiu mehaddere al petachayehu divne nasha he lach kolla

Yehuda atta yoducha achecha yadcha beoref oyevecha vegv ribbi yose patach asa yareach lemoadim vegv asa yareach begin lekaddesha beh resh yarchin veresh shattin ulalmin sihara la nahir ella mishshimsha vechad shimsha shallit sihara la shalta kad itkenish shimsha keden sihara shalta velet chushban lesihara ella kad itkenish shimsha

Vetarvayehu avad kudsha berich hu leanhara hada hu dichtiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz vegv vehau leotot illen shabbatot dichtiv ki ot hi ulmoadim inun yomin tavin ulyamim illen reshe yarchin ulshanim illen rishe shenin delehon ummot haolam avdin chushban leshimsha veyisrael lesihara

Veazla ha ki ha deamar ribbi elazar ketiv hirbita haggoy lo higdalta hassimcha hirbita haggoy illen yisrael dichtiv behu ki mi goy gadol uchtiv goy echad baaretz lo begineh higdalta hassimcha da sihara deitreviat binhora beginehon deyisrael ummot haolam leshimsha veyisrael lesihara he minnayehu adif vadday sihara
472: Leela veshimsha deummot haolam techot hay sihara hu vehahu shimsha mehay sihara nahir chame ma ben yisrael lehu yisrael achidu besihara veishtalleshelu beshimsha illaa veitachadu beatar dinhira meshammesha illaa umitdabbekan beh dichtiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom

Yehuda atta vegv ribbi shimon amar malchu lihuda itkeyyam vehayenu deamrinan may dichtiv happaam ode et Adonai begin deihu reviaa ode et Adonai begin deihu ragla reviaa lecharseya da reshima dishma illaa uvma ishtelim beh vehayenu batraa dishma kaddisha shema kaddisha shelim beatoy vekesher deachid lon al da yoducha achecha demalchu lach itchazya leitkayema vaday vihuda od rad im el veim kedoshim neeman man kedoshim illen kedoshim elonin dechullehu odan legabbeh veshaveuha neeman begin kach hu kadmaa bechola hu malka al kolla

Ribbi shimon patach veamar kal kevudah bat melech penima kal kevudah da keneset yisrael kevudah begin deihu kavod da al da da dachar veda nukva veitkere kevudah bat melech hayenu bat sheva bat kol deihu kol gadol vehay melech illaa hu penima begin deit melech delav ihu lego kavateh vehay kevudah bat melech

Mimmishbetzot zahav levushah begin deitlabbeshat veitachadat bigvurata illaa vehay uf name melech ikre uvginah kayema ara ematay beshata deitachadat bemishpat kema deatte amer melech bammishpat yaamid aretz veda karenan malchu dishmaya vihuda itachid bah veyarit malchuta divara

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak hau kaazle bearcha amar ribbi yitzchak niftach bemille deorayeta venizil patach ribbi yitzchak veamar vayegaresh et haadam vayyashken mikkedem leggan eden vegv hay kera ukmuha chavraya aval vayegaresh kebbar nash degarish leinteteh et haadam dayeka

Ta chaze raza demilla adam bemma dechata ittefas vegarim mota leh ulchal alma vegarim lehahu ilana dechata beh teruchin leittarcha beh ulittarcha bivnoy lealmin hada hu dichtiv vayegaresh et haadam et dayeka kema dichtiv vaere et Adonai uf hachi et haadam

Vayyashken mikkedem leggan eden vegv hay letatta uchma dichruvim leela it keruvim letatta vehay ilana ashre alayehu veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet inun tafse deshallehove deeshsha mehahu charba demitlahata hammithappechet da hay charba deyanka bitren sitrin veithappecha missitra da lesitra achora davar acher hammithappechet da lahat inun tafse deshallehova dekaamaran demithappechan lezimnin guvrin ulzimnin nashin umithappechan midduchtayehu lecholla vechal da lishmor et derech etz hachayyim man derech kema deatte amer hannoten bayyam darech

Amar ribbi yehuda shappir vehachi hu vadday degarim adam lehahu ilana dechata beh leittarcha veafilu shear bene alma name kema deatte amer uvfishechem shullecha immechem aval shappir kaamarte deha midduchteh mashma dichtiv vayegaresh et haadam begin deda shelimu deadam hu

Umehahu yoma itpegim sihara ad deata noach veal bettiuvta atu chayyavaya veitpegim ad deata avraham vekayema bishlimu deyaakov uvnoy veata yehuda veachid beh veitkaf bemalchuta veachsin leh achsanat almin hu vechal benoy batroy hada hu dichtiv yehuda atta yoducha achecha vadday beshata dekayemu yisrael al yamma dechullehu odu leh venachatu avatreh beyamma

Yadcha beoref oyevecha kema deatte amer yehuda yaale yishtachau lecha bene avicha kelala dechal inun shear shivtin begin da beni avicha vela bene immecha bene avicha ha kullehu shear shivtin deaf al gav deitpelig litren malkevan kad hau salkin liyerushala hau segidin vecharan lemalka deviyerushala begin demalchuta diyerushala
473: Yishtachau lecha vela ketiv veyishtachau dei ketiv veyishtachau leosafa lishar ammin veyishtachau la ketiv ella bezimna deyete malka meshicha dichtiv sarim veyishtachau hashta deamar yishtachau leachazaa deyisrael kullehu bilchodayehu kullehu yiflechun leresha degola lerosh devavel vela shear ammin

Gur arye yehuda bekadmita gur ulvatar arye veraza demilla bekadmita naar ulvatar ish Adonai ish milchama mitteref beni alita may mitteref leachlala malach hammavet deihu kayema al teref leshetzaa bene alma vela meshezziv kema deatte amer vetaraf veen matztzil umehahu teref istallekat shechinta

Kara begaluta devavel ravatz begaluta deedom kearye deihu takkifa uchlavi deihu takkifa yattir kach yisrael takkifin inun divne alma ovde kochavim umazzalot mefattin vedachakin lon veinun kayeme bedatehon uvnimusehon kearye uchlavi

Kach shechinta deaf al gav dichtiv nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael hi takkifa kearye uchlavi behay nefila ma arye velavi la naflin ella begin lemitraf tarpa ulshalletaa deha merachik arach tarpeh umishata dearach nafal vela kam ad dedalig al tarpeh veachil lah kach shechinta la nafla ella kearye uchlavi begin lenakma meammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot uldallega alayehu kema deatte amer tzoe berov kocho

Mi yekimennu hu la yakum lenakma minnayehu nukma zeera ella mi yekimennu mi kema deatte amer mi yirpa lach vehu ihu alma illaa deveh shaltanuta leittakfa lecholla uchtiv mibbeten mi yatza hakkerach veukmuha

Lo yasur shevet mihuda vegv ukmuha chavraya aval ad ki yavo shilo beh begin deshear bev leachazaa hacha raza dishma kaddisha beatar achora shilo bela Adonai beatar achora shillo bela vehacha shil bed raza dishma kaddisha illaa dishchinta takum bishma de veihu raza de kidkaamrinan

Osri laggefen iro velassoreka beni atono vegv ribbi chiyya patach Adonai yishmarcha mikkal ra yishmor et nafshecha kevan deamar Adonai yishmarcha mikkal ra ammay yishmor et nafshecha ella Adonai yishmarcha mikkal ra behay alma yishmor et nafshecha behahu alma

Shemira dehay alma hu lemehve natir bar nash mikkamma zinin bishin mekatregin deazlin lekatrega beni nasha bealma ulitdabbeka behu behahu alma may hu kema deamaran kad nafik bar nash mehay alma i ihu zache nishmata dileh salka veitatterat beatreh vei la kamma chavilin terikin izdammenan leingeda leh laggehinnom ulimsera leh bida deduma deitmassera limmanna al gehinnom utlesar elef ribbo memannan immeh vechullehu izdammenan al nafshayehu dechayyavaya

494: Venura dalik veanhir behay itaruta diltatta vechahana itar velevae meshabbechan veachzeyan chedu uchden chamra itnesach leitkashshera bemaya vechamra nahir veachaziyi chedu begini kach chamra tav letatta leachazaa chedu lechamra achora dilela vecholla itar leitkashshera semala bimina

Veal da asir leh lebbar nash levarcha lechavreh betzafra ad divarech lekudsha berich hu deihu bae leitbarcha berisha vehayenu babboker ychal ad ulvatar yitbarchun achoranin velaerev yechallek shalal deha karbanot dehava beresha kolla itkerav lekudsha berich hu veitaruta salka tamman uvgin deha hu itbarach hava mekashshar kishrin lechal shear chelin illain umaflig lon birchan lechal chad vechad kedeka chaze veyaot leh umitbasseman almin veitbarchan ilain vetattain

495: Ribbi yehuda patach kera veamar vayekkal yaakov letzauot et banav vegv vayechal yaakov letzauot et banav letzauot levarech mibbae leh ella deppakkid lon legabbe shechinta leitkashshera bahadah tu deppakkid lon al iske mearta dehi keriva legan eden detamman hu adam harishon kavur

Ta chaze hahu atar ikre kiryat arba may tama begin detamman itkevaru arba zugot adam vechava avraham vesara yitzchak verivka yaakov velea ha kushya hacha detaninan avahan inun reticha kaddisha urticha lav pachot mearba vetaninan kudsha berich hu ichabbar lemalka david bahadayehu veitavidu reticha shelemata hada hu dichtiv even maasu habbonim vegv dedavid malka itchabbar lemehve reticha shelemata bahadayehu i hachi david baya leitkevara bego avahan veyehve kiryat arba bahadeh may tama la itkabbar bahadayehu

Ella david malcha atar mittakkan hava leh kedeka yeut uman hu tziyyon leitchabbera leh kechada veadam deitkabbar bego avahan ha inun itkevaru bahadeh begin deihu melech kadmaa hava veitavar minneh malchu veityehav ledavid malka umiyyomoy deadam itkeyyam david malka deadam elef shenin itgezar aloy veitavaru minneh shivin shenin yomoy dedavid malka vehu yahiv lon veavahan hech yekumun ad deyete david malka ella zacha leatreh kedeka chaze leh begine kach la itkevar legabbe avahan
Tu avahan beatar didchura sharyan vedavid beatar denukva vaavahan nukvan itkevaru bahadayehu vedavid itkevar veitchabbar beatar didchura milla kedeka chaze leh
Vayyeesof raglav el hammitta begin deha ihu beatar dechayyin yativ kad baa leistallaka mealma nachit ragloy legabbe mitta veitkenish veistelak mealma hada hu dichtiv vayyigva vayyeasef el ammav

Ta chaze beshata deitkenish yaakov itnehir sihara vetiuvta deshimsha illaa itar legabbah begin deshimsha kad salik itar shimsha achora veitdabbak da beda veitnehir sihara
Amar ribbi shimon shappir ka amarte aval ha ittemar deillaa alma didchura itkashshar betattaa deihu alma denukva vetattaa itkashshar beillaa vecholla da kegavena da

Ella hachi amru kal hahu zimna dehava yaakov bemitzrayim itbarach ara begineh venilus hava nafik veashke ara veod defasak kafna begineh deyaakov veal da mitzrae avadu aveluta veitkanne alayehu

Tu mi yemallel vidabber kolla chad yedabber deha kamma vechamma gevuran inun delet lon chushbana kamma mare dedinin kamma mare teresin kamma gardine nimmusin umillula la yachil lemallala lon

497: Tzahali kolech hay kera lichneset yisrael ittemar begin deihi meshabbachat leh lekudsha berich hu bekala meshabbecha veal da tzahali kolech mehacha olifna kal man devae leshabbecha lekudsha berich hu bekala baya leh kala neimuta deyeerav leachoranin deshamin leh vei lav la yakum laarama kala

499: Usmala uvae deitmalya chamra begin chamra deorayeta deihu nafik mealma deate

Vetta chaze kos shel beracha behay itgalyan millin illain hacha deanan bimarta ema hacha itgalleya raza dirticha kaddisha kos shel beracha bae lekabbela leh bimina usmala da tzafon vedarom vechos shel beracha dihe natil beracha minnayehu man kos shel beracha da mittato shellishlomo divinan deityehiv ben tzafon ledarom uvae laanacha lah bimina vegufa deyittakken bahadayehu veyashgach beh behahu kos levarcha leh bearba birchan begin dichtiv tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah vegv ishtakkach bechos shel beracha raza dimhemnuta tzafon vedarom umizrach umaarav ha reticha kaddisha kedeka chaze leh

Ufatora benahama begin deyitbarcha hahu lechem diltatta veyitbarach lechem oni vihe lechem pannag veha okimna veyishtakkach dichneset yisrael mitbarcha bed sitre alma leela vetatta leela vechos shel beracha leitchabbera david malka baavahan veyitbarach letatta deyitbarach patora debbar nash leishtakkecha beh mezona tadir

Kamu kullehu unshaku yedoy amru berich rachamana deailna hacha ushmana millin illen nafku min mearta veazlu kad alu bemata chamu itra divne nasha demitu denafal beta alayehu yatvu vechamu deka safde leinun demitu im inun romae

Patach ribbi shimon veamar vayyavou ad goren haatad man goren haatad ella hacha itremez shaltanuta demitzrae deitade goren haatad da memanna shultana demitzrae deitade mikkamme shultanuta deyisrael deha chamu kema deatte amer melubbashim begadim baggoren veal da vayispedu sham misped gadol vechaved meod vegv

Al ken kara shemah avel mitzrayim ad hayyom hazze devadday mimmitzrayim hava uf hacha lav deudae ninhu illen bachyan af al gav demitu beh yudae veillen yudae illemale hau yudae la mitu vechevan demitu kudsha berich hu mechapper chovayehu

Amar ribbi shimon ta chaze deyaakov af al gav denafkat nishmateh bemitzrayim lav birshuta achora nafkat may tama kema deittemar dela hava miyyoma deitbere alma arsa shelemata kehahu arsa deyaakov beshata dehava salik mealma nishmateh miyyad itkashshar beatreh veha okimna

Ta chaze kad hava al yaakov bimarta kal rechin deginta deeden ishtakkach bimarta umarta salka nehora ushragga chad dalik vechad alu avahan legabbe deyaakov lemitzrayim leishtakkacha immeh istallak nehora desharga kevan deal yaakov bimarta hadra sheraga leatreh keden ishtelim mearta mikkal ma deitzterich

Vead yome alma la kabbilat mearta bar nash achora vela tekabbel venishmatin dezachan iavran mikkammayehu beve mearta begin deyitarun vechamin zara dishvaku bealma veyechodu kamme kudsha berich hu amar ribbi abba chanita deyaakov may ihu amar leh zil sheil leasya

Ta chaze ketiv vayetzav yosef et avadav et harofim lachanot et aviv vayyachantu harofim et yisrael salka datach kishar beni nasha hava chanita da i tema begin orcha hu deavadu ha ketiv vayyamat yosef ben vegv vayyisam baaron bemitzrayim ha la azlu immeh bearcha deha tamman itkabbar uchtiv vayyachantu oto

Ella archa demalchin inun begin lekayema gufayehu chanate lon bimshach revut illaa al kal mishchin meorav bevusmin veshaiv leh begufa yoma batar yoma behahu mishcha tava arbein yomin dichtiv vayyimleu lo arbaim yom ki chen yimleu yeme hachanutim batar deishtelim da kayema gufa shelim zimnin saggiin
Begin dechal hahu ara dichnaan veara demitzrayim mechalla gufa umrakkev leh
500: Lizman zeir mikkal shear ara uvgin lekayema gufa avde da veavde chanita da miggo umibbara miggo deshaveyan hahu mishcha al tabbura vehu al betabbura lego veishteiv bemeoy vekaim leh legufa miggo umibbara lezimnin saggiin

Veyaakov hachi hava bekiyyuma degufa vehachi itzterich degufa deavahan ihu vehava bekiyyuma begufa venafsha kegavena da leosef deihu dugma degufa uvkiyyuma degufa venafsha hu bekiyyuma degufa dichtiv vayyachantu oto bekiyyuma denafsha dichtiv vayyisam baaron bemitzrayim

Utninan tere yudin ammay ella yosef natar leh berit letatta venatir leh berit dilela istallak mealma itshavi bitre arone bearon letatta uvaron leela aron dilela man ihu ella kema deatte amer hinne aron habberit adon kal haaretz dearon dilela aron habberit ikre deha la yarit leh ella man denatar berit uvgin deosef natar leh livrit itshave bitre arone

Vayyisem baaron bemitzrayim hachi hu vadday ukra ochach raza achora deaf al gav denafkat nishmateh birshu achora itkashshar bishchinta hada hu dichtiv vayyisem baaron leela ultatta begin dehava tzaddik dechal tzaddik yarit ara kaddisha illaa kema deatte amer veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz nitzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen salik sefer bereshit

Bereshit bara elohim et hashamayim veet haaretz rashe tevin debbeh itberiu shemaya veara be itberiu shemaya va be itberiat ara vechal ma deit bah vehu yahiv tiuvta vechal ilanin veisbin di beara vehu ma sheamru en lecha kal esev veesev milmatta sheen memune alav milmala veshomer oto shemakke oto veomer lo gedal shenneemar hayadata chukot shamayim im tasim mishtaro baaretz

Matnitin keture ramae hormane debburyere kerivu shemau man minnechon desalik venachit man kenash rucha bidoy yekum veyinda beshata desalik biruta deresha chivara lemebad yekara likareh salik chad tehiru setimu berisha dechola nashav bah veappik kumrin tehirin mitchabberan kachada kolla usliku venachtu veitavid kolla chad

Vehahu tehiru setimu kad nashiv bah veanhir ikre hahu tehiru salka venachta vezarik zikin netzitzin veanshiv bah veappik chad chela temira veikre shemeh asher biglifu tamir vesatim inun kumrin tehirin deitchabberu miggo chad tinara satim nafke begillufa bechela dehahu tehiru illaa veikre Adonai
501: Veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayema et yaakov ish uveto bau vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed vhammaskilim illen inun demistakkelle beraza dechachmeta yazhiru naharin venotztzin beziva dechachmeta illaa kezohar nehiru untzitzu denahara denafik meeden veda ihu raza setima deikre rakia beh kayamin kochavaya umazzale shimsha vesihara vechal inun butzinin dinhora

Zohar dehay rakia nahir binhiru al ginta veilana dechayye kayyam bimtziut ginta deanpoy chafyan kal inun diuknin veilanin uvusmin divginta bemanin dechashran uttallin techoteh kal chevat bara vechol tzippore shemaya yedurun techot inun anfin

Zohar iba deilana yahiv chayyin lecholla kiumeh lealam ulalme almin sitra achara la sharya beh ella sitra dikdushsha zakkaa chulakehon inun detaamin mineh inun kayemin lealam ulalme almin illen ikrun maskilim vezakkaan chayyin behay alma vechayyin bealma deate

Zohar ilana da zakfa leela leela chamesh mea parse hillucheh shittin ribbo ihu bifshituteh behay ilana kayema chad zohara kal gavenin kayyamin beh inun gavenin salkin venachtin la mityashve beduchta achara bar behahu ilana

Kad nafke minneh leitchazaa bego zohar dela nahara mityashshevan vela mityashshevan kayeman vela kayeman begin dela mityashshevan beatar achara meilana da nafke teresar shevatin demittechamman beh veinun nachtu behay zohar dela nahara lego galuta demitzrayim bechamma mashshiryan illain hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot bene yisrael vego
Ribbi shimon patach hayo haya devar Adonai hayo haya tere
502: Zimni amay vetu it leshaala i yechezkel nevia mehemana hava amay galle kal ma dechama man demalka ail leh behechaleh it leh legalaa razin dechame ella vadday yechezkel nevia mehemana hava vechal ma dechama bimhemanuta ihu uvirshuta dekudsha berich hu galle kal ma degalle vecholla itzterich

Amar rabbi shimon man deragil lemisbal tzaara af al gav deate lefum shata tzaara savil matlanoy vela chayish aval man dela ragil betztzaar vahava kal yomoy betafnukin veidunin veate leh tzaara da ihu tzaara shelim veal da itzterich lemivke

Kacha yisrael kad nachtu lemitzrayim regilin betzaara hao deha kal yomoy dehahu zakkaa avuhon betzaara hava veal da savlu galuta kedeka yaut aval galuta devavel hahu hava tzaara shelim hahu hava tzaara deillain vetattain bachan aleh

Illain dichtiv hen erellam tzaaku chutza vego tattain dichtiv al naharot bavel sham yashavnu vego kullehon bachu al galuta devavel may tama begin dahao betafnuke malchin dichtiv bene tziyyon hayekarim vego

Vehashshetta hao nachtin begaluta berechayya al kadlehon videhon mehaddekan laachora vechad alu begaluta bevavel chashivu deha let lehu kiyyuma lealmin deha kudsha berich hu shavik lon vela yashgach behon lealmin

Vetanenan amar ribbi shimon behahi shaata kara kudsha berich hu lechal pamalya dileh vechal retichin kaddishin vechal cheleh umashshiryateh veravrevanoy vechal chela dishmayya veamar lon ma attun avdin hacha uma bene rechimay begaluta devavel veattun hacha kumu chutu kullechon lebbavel vaana immechon hada hu dichtiv ko amar Adonai lemaanchem shillachti vavela vego lemaanchem shillachti vavela da kudsha berich hu vehoradti varichim kulam illen kal retichin umashiryan illain

Kad nachtu lebbavel itpattachu shemayya vesharat ruach nevua kaddisha al yechezkel vechama kal ma dechama veamar lon leyisrael ha marechon hacha vechal chele shemayya urtichu deatu lemedar benechon la hemnuhu ad deitzterich legallaa kal ma dechama vaere kach vaere kach vei galle yattir ma degalle kolla itzterich kevan dechamu yisrael kach chadu vechad shamu millin mippumeh dichezkel la chayeshu al galuthon kelal deha yadu dekudsha berich hu la shavik lon vechal ma degalle birshuta galle

Vetaninan bechal atar deyisrael galu taman shechinta galta imhon vehacha begaluta demitzrayim ma ketiv veelle shemot bene yisrael vego kevan dichtiv bene yisrael mahu et yaakov habbaim itto itzterich lememar ella elle shemot bene yisrael inun retichin umashshiryan illain denachtu im yaakov bahade shechinta begaluta demitzrayim

Veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayema et yaakov ish uveto bau ribbi chiyya patach Adonai itti millevanon kalla itti millevanon tavoi tashuri merosh amana merosh senir vechermon mimmeonot araot meharre nemerim hay kera al keneset yisrael ittemar beshaata denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim ukarivu letura desinay lekabbela orayeta amar lah kudsha berich hu itti millevanon min hahu idduna illaa ka atat kalla shelemata kehay sihara deishtelimat min shimsha bechal nehora untzitzu
503: Itti millevanon tavoi begin lekabbela banayich orayeta

Tashuri merosh amana tashuri kema deatte amer utshura en lehavi tekabbil takruvta al banayich merosh amana mereshita dealu bimhemanuta illaa veamru kal asher dibber Adonai naase venishma vahau bematkela chada kemalachin illain dehachi kettiv behu barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro keden kabbilat keneset yisrael teshura

Merosh senir vechermon da tura desinay dekarivu legabbeh veitattadu techoteh dichtiv vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar mimmeonot araot illen bene seir dekudsha berich hu zamin lon beorayeta vela bau lekabbelah meharre nemerim illen beni yishmael dichtiv Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo hofia mehar paran veata merivvot kodesh

May veata merivvot kodesh detanenan kad baa kudsha berich hu lemehav orayeta leyisrael atu mashiryan demalachin illain patchu veamru Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechal haaretz asher tena hodcha al hashshamayim baan deyityehiv lon orayeta

Amar lon kudsha berich hu vechi it bechon mota dichtiv adam ki yamut beohel vechi yihye veish chet mishpat mavet vehumat chet it benayechu vechi attun baan ledinin it benayechu gezel o geneva dichtiv lo tignov it benayechu nashin dichtiv lo tinaf it benayechu shikra dichtiv lo taane vereacha ed shaker it benayechu chemda dichtiv lo tachmod ma attun baan orayeta miyyad patchu veamru Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechal haaretz veillu asher tena hodcha al hashshamayim la kettiv veal da veata merivvot kodesh keden mimino esh dat lamo

Yose okim lehay kera Adonai kad nachta shechinta begaluta demitzrayim verabbi shimon amar hay kera al raza deyichuda dimhemanuta ittemar itti millevanon kalla kol amar ledibbur itti begin deha kol ate ledibbur umdabbar lah vahadeh lemeheve kachada bela piruda kelal begin dekol ihu kelal dibbur ihu perat veal da kelal itzterich lifrat ufrat itzterich lichlal deha let kol belo dibbur velet dibbur belo kol veal da itti millevanon kalla vego deikara detarvayehu millevanon ka atyan

Tashuri merosh amana da ihu garon demittamman nafka rucha leashlema kolla meraza dilvanon satim veganiz merosh senir vechermon da ihi lishana resha veemtzaita dimchattecha leddibbur mimmeonot araot illen inun shinayim meharre nemerim illen inun sifvan shelimu deishtelim behu dibbur

Veelle shemot bene yisrael ribbi chiyya patach al tilcham et lechem ra ayin veal titav lematammotav al tilcham et lechem ra ayin begin denahama o hanaa dehahu bar nash dehave ra ayin lav ihu keday lemechal ulithani minnih dei kad nachtu yisrael lemitzrayim la yitamun nahama demitzrae la ishtevaku begaluta vela yeikun lon mitzrae

Amar leh ribbi yitzchak veha gezera itgezar amar leh kolla ihu kedeka yaut deha la itgezar bemitzrayim daveka deha la ketiv ki ger yihye zaracha beeretz mitzrayim ella beeretz lo lahem vaafilu beara achara

Amar yitzchak man deihu baal nefesh demechleh yattir mishshear bene nasha o man dehu azil batar meoy i ira behahu ra ayin yechus garmeh vela yechul minnahama dileh delet nahama bisha bealma bar mehahu lechem ra ayin ma ketiv ki lo yuchlun hammitzrim leechol et haivrim lechem ki toeva hi lemitzrayim ha lach lechem ra ayin
Telata inun dedachyan shechinta mealma vegarmin dediureh dekudsha berich hu la have bealma uvni nasha tzavechin vela ishtema kallehon veillen inun man
504: Deshachiv bannidda begin delet misavu takkif bealma bar misseavu denidda misavu denidda kashya mikkal misavu dealma isteav ihu vechal demitkarvin bahadeh yistaavun immeh bechal atar deazlin itdachya shechinta min kamayehu

Velo od ella degarim marin bishin al garmeh veal hahu zara deolid dechevan deyikrav bar nash legabbe nidda hahu misavu dalig aloy veyishtaar bechal shayefin dileh zara deolid behahu shaata mashchin aloy ruach misavu vechal yomoy yehe bimsaavu deha binyana visoda dileh ihu bimsaavu rav vetakkif mikkal mesaava dealma demiyyad dekariv bar nash legabbe nidda hahu misavu dalig aloy dichtiv uthi niddatah alav

Man deshachiv bevat el nechar deail berit kodesh veat kayyama birshu achara dichtiv uvaal bat el nechar vetanenan let kina kame kudsha berich hu bar kina divrit kaddisha deihu kayyama dishma kaddisha veraza dimhemanuta ma ketiv vayyachel haam liznot el benot moav miyyad vayyichar af Adonai beyisrael

Reshe amma deyadu velo michu bidayehu itanshu bekadmita dichtiv kach et kal rashe haam vehoka otam la neged hashshamesh ribbi abba amar may neged hashshamesh neged habberit deikre shemesh vaaleh ittemar ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim shemesh umagen da berit kaddisha ma shemesh zarach veanhir al alma uf hachi berit kaddisha zarach veanhir gufa debbar nash magen ma magen ihu leaggana aleh debbar nash uf hachi berit kaddisha magen aleh debbar nash uman denatir leh let nizka bealma deyachil lemikrav bahadeh veda hu neged hashshamesh

Reshe amma yittafsun bechal dara vedara bechova da i yadin vela mekanin leh begin dechova da alayehu lekanaa leh lekudsha berich hu behay berit man deail kedusha da birshuta achara aleh ketiv lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna vecholla kina chada veal da itdachya shechinta mikameh man dimshakker bivrit kaddisha dechatim bivsareh debbar nash keilu meshakker bishma dekudsha berich hu man dimshakker chotama demalka meshakker beh bemalka let leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael i la bechela detiuvta tadir

Yose patach veamar vayyishkechu et Adonai elohehem vego vayaazvu et Adonai may vayyishkechu vayaazvu dedachu minnayehu berit kayama kaddisha hao gazrin vela parin ad deatat devora undivat behay lechal yisrael kemma dichtiv bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barachu Adonai
Man dekatil benoy hahu obbara demitabbera itteteh vegarim lekatala leh bimaha desatir binyana dekudsha berich hu veumanuta dileh it man dekatil bar nash vehay kattil benoy

Telata bishin avid dechal alma la yachil lemisbal veal da alma mitmogga zeer zeer velo yedia vekudsha berich hu istalik mealma vecharba vechafna umotana atyan al alma veillen inun katil benoy satir binyana demalka dache shechinta deazla umshatteta bealma vela ashkachat nayecha veal illen rucha dekudsha bachya vealma itdan bechal hane dinin vay lehahu bar nash vay leh tav leh dela yitbere bealma

Zakkain inun yisrael deaf al gav dahau begaluta demitzrayim istamaru mikkal hane telata minnidda umibbat el nichar umikkettol zara veishtaddalu befarhesya befirya urviyya deaf al gav digzera itgazrat kal habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu la ishtechach benehon man dekatil ubbara bimaha deitteta kal shekken levatar uvizchuta da nafku yisrael min galuta
505: Dichtiv vayyaash et hakkiyyor nechoshet veet kanno nechoshot bemarot hatztzovot mippene ma zachu nashin lehay begin deistamaru garmayehu begaluta demitzrayim dilvatar deitdachyan hao atyan mitkashshetan umistakkelan bammara bivalehon umorran lon befirya urviyya
Mibbat el nechar dichtiv yatzu kal tzivot Adonai vego uchtiv shivte yah edut leyisrael edut leyisrael vadday veelle shemot beni yisrael shivte beni yisrael dabber el bene yisrael

Vei tema veha ketiv vehu ben ish mitzri ha vadday chad hava ufirsemo kera dichtiv vehu ben ish mitzri vego veshem immo shelomit bat divri lematte dan pirya verivya dichtiv uvne yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu vego umikkal hane istamaru yisrael bene yisrael alu bene yisrael nafku hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot beni yisrael vego

Veelle shemot bene yisrael ribbi elazar veribbi yose hao azle beorcha ad dahao azle amar ribbi elazar leribbi yose aftach pumach veyinharun milach amar leh nicha kameh demar deeshal milla chada dekashya li ha shemana mibbutzina kaddisha dehava amar veelle shemot beni yisrael yisrael sava kal inun chelin umashreyan dehao nachtin legaluta bahade yaakov dichtiv et yaakov mahu dichtiv ish uveto bau amar leh vadday hachi hu ella ha tanenan kal dimkabbel meachara ihu beta mehahu deyahiv veal da ish uveto bau

Patach ribbi elazar veamar vayehi kechallot shelomo livnot et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech vego vechi kevan deamar et bet Adonai mahu veet bet hammelech i begin shelomo ittemar lav hachi ella et bet Adonai da bet hammikdash veet bet hammelech da kodesh hakkodashim

Bet Adonai deihu bet hammikdash kegon azarot ulshachot uvet haulam vehaddevir da bet hammikdash vadday ikre bet Adonai bet hammelech da kodesh hakkadashim deihu penimaa decholla hammelech setam melech da af al gav deihu melech illaa ihu nukba legabbe nekuda illaa setima decholla veaf al gav deihu nukba ihu dechura legabbe melech diltatta uvgin kach kolla kegavena da veal da tattae beraza da ketiv behu ish uveto bau

Veelle shemot ribbi yose patach veamar gan naul achoti challa gal naul mayan chatum gan naul da keneset yisrael shehi gan naul deamar ribbi elazar ma haggan hazze tzarich lishmor lador ulhashkot velizmor kach keneset yisrael tzericha lador velishmor ulhashkot velizmor venikret gan venikret kerm ma hakkerem hazze tzarich lador ulhashkot velizmor velachpor kach yisrael hada hu dichtiv ki kerem Adonai tzevaot bet yisrael uchtiv vayeazkehu vayesakkelehu vego

Tosefta matnitin amar ribbi shimon anan patchin enana chaman galgalle retichata kaddishata natlin bematlanoy vekal shirata besima leudnin yae lelibba salleka venachta azla vela natla mizdazein elef alfin veribbo rivvan ufatchin shirata milra leela

Lekal neimuta hahu kayemin man dekayemin umitkannefin bichnufya lesitra dimina arba mea vechamshin alfin mare deayenin chamman vela chamman kayemin bekiyyumehon teren sitrin achoranin itchavveru beginehon ulsitra dismala matan vechamshin alfin

Inun marehon divava meyabbevin umyallelin meatar bet motvehon patchin bedina umsayemin bedina meyabbevin tinyanut vedina yativ vesifrin petichu beh shaata salik mareh dedina dekaim alehon veyativ bechursayya dedina veshirata ishtechach ad la tistayyam dina
Sacharan mare deayenin dilsitra yemina veimmehon
506: Tamnesar alfin acharanin takin vela meyabbevin vela meyallelin patchin shirata mizdazean matan vechamshin alfin mare divava
Taka tinyanut vela meyabbevin natil patrona mehahu kursayya veyativ bechursayya devatranuta beh zimna hava midkar shema kaddisha illaa rabba divhahu shema chayyim lecholla

Patach veamar zimna chada yod he vav he kema deatte amer vayyikra veshem Adonai patchin kikadmeta mare galgalle kaddishin veelef alfin veribbo rivvan veamre shirata meshabbechin veamrin berich yekara de meatar bet shechinteh

Atya hahu ginta dehavat temira bematan vechamshin almin hu shechinta yekara bezivah denafik mizziva leziva vezivah nagid mineh led sitrin reshin lekadmae mehahu ziva nafak lechullehu deinun letatta vehahi ikre ginta deeden
