Vehahu kochava yaggiach behu kerava betisin denura melahatin menatztzetzin lechal ever uvatash behu ad devala lon bechal ramsha veramsha uvoma appik lon veyaggichun kerava leenehon dechal alma vechen bechal yoma ad shivin yomin levatar shivin yomin yitgeniz hahu kochava veyitgeniz mashiach ad teresar yarchin veyithaddar hahu ammuda deesha kemillekadmin uveh yitgeniz mashiach vehahu ammuda la yitchaze

Levatar teresar yarchin yesalkun leh lemashiach behahu ammuda lego rekia vetamman yekabbel tukpa veitra demalchuta vechad nachit yitchaze hahu ammuda deesha kemillekaddemin leenehon dechal alma veyitgele levatar mashiach veyitkanneshun legabbeh ammin saggiin veyittear keravin bechal alma uvhahu zimna yittear kudsha berich hu gevurteh lechal ammin dealma umalka meshicha yityeda bechal alma vechal malchin dealma yitarun leitchabbera leaggacha kerava beh

Vechamma mipperitze yehudain yithappechu leahaddera legabbayehu veyetun immehon leaggacha kerava al malka meshicha keden yitchashshach kal alma chamesh esre yomin vesaggiin meamma deyisrael yehon metin behahu chashocha veal da ketiv ki hinne hachoshech yechasse eretz vaarafel leummim
513: Yikkare kan tzippor lefancha badderech bechal etz o al haaretz efrochim o betzim vehaem rovetzet vego shallech teshallach et haem vego hay kera okimna leh veihu chad mippikkude orayeta genizin vaanan it lan beh raziyi deorayeta genizin shevilin vearchin yedian lechavrayya beinun telatin utren shevilin deorayeta

Amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar bereh elazar bezimna deyittear malka meshicha kamma atin venissin acharanin yittearun bealma ta chaze beginta deeden diltatta it atar chad ganiz vetamir dela ityeda veihu merukkema bechamma gavenin uveh genizin elef hechalin dechissufin velet man deayil behu bar mashiach deihu kaim tadir beginta deeden

Vechal ginta mesachara birtichin saggiin detzadikayya umashiach kaim alayehu veal kamma chelin umashiryan denishmatin detzadikayya tamman uvrashe yarche uvizmanne uvshabbate mashiach al behahu atar leishtashea bechal inun hechalin

Lego lego mikkal inun hechalin it atar achara tamir veganiz dela ityeda kelal veikre eden velet man deyachil leminda beh umashiach agniz levar sacharaneh dehahu atar ad deitgele leh chad atar deikre kan tzippor veihu atar dechariz aleh hahu tzippor deittear beginta deeden bechal yoma

Uvhahu atar merukkeman deyyuknin dechal shear ammin deitkenashu alayehu deyisrael leavasha lon al behahu atar zakif enoy vechaze avahan dealin becharban bet elaha ad dechame lerachel dedimaha beanpaha vekudsha berich hu menachem lah vela tzeviat lekabbela tanchumin kema deatte amar meana lehinnachem al baneha keden mashiach arim kaleh uvache veizdaza kal ginta deeden vechal inun tzaddikayya detamman gau uvachu immeh

Gae uvache zimna tinyana veizdaza hahu rekia deal gabbe ginta elef vechamesh mea ribbo mashreyan illain ad demate lego kurseya illaa keden kudsha berich hu ramiz lehahu tzippara veal lehahu ken dilah veyatva legabbe mashiach vekare ma dekare veittear ma deittear

Ad demiggo kurseya kaddisha itkere telat zimnin hahu kan tzippor umashiach vecholla sallekin leela veume lon kudsha berich hu leabera malchu chayyava min alma al yeda demashiach ulnakma nakmin deyisrael vechal inun tavvan dezamin kudsha berich hu lemebad leammeh vetav hahu kan tzippor umashiach leduchteh vetav mashiach veitgeniz go hahu atar kemillekaddemin

Uvzimna deyittear kudsha berich hu leatkena almin veitnehiru atvan dishmeh bishlimu yod behe vav behe lemeheve kolla bishlimu chad keden yittear chad kochava dechila beemtza rekia kegaven argevana lahit venatzitz bimama leenehon dechal alma

Vikum chad shalhova deeshsha missitra detzafon go rekia vikum da lakovel da arbein yomin veyitbahalun kal bene alma lesof arbein yomin yaggichun kerava kochava veshalhova leenehon decholla veyitpashshat hahu shalhova bikidu deeshsha missitra detzafon go rekia veyachashov lemivla hahu kochava vechamma shallitin umalchin veumayya veamamya yitbahalun mehay

Keden yistallak hahu kochava listar darom veyishshelot al hahu shalhova vehahu shalhova yitbela zeer zeer birkia mikkame hahu kochava ad dela yitchaze kelal keden hahu kochava yaved orchin birkia bitresar techumin vekayemin inun nehorin birkia teresar yomin

Levatar teresar yomin yizdazeun kal bene alma veyitchashshach shimsha befalgut yoma kema deitchashshach yoma deitcharav be makdesha ad dela yitchazun shemayya veara veyittear chad kalla beraam vezikin veitchalchala ara mehahu kalla vechamma chelin umashiryan yemutun minneh
Vehahu yoma yittear bekarta deromi rabbeta chad shalhova deeshsha behahu kalla deyittear bechal
514: Alma veokid kamma migdalin vechamma hechalin vechamma migdalin yippelun vechamma pardashke veravreve yippelun behahu yoma vechullehu yitkanneshun alla levish vechal bene alma la yachlin leishtezava

Mehahu yoma ad teresar yarchin yityaatun kal malchaya veyigzerun kamma gezerot vechamma shemadot al yisrael veyitzlechun beh kema deittemar zakkaa ihu man deyira tamman vezakkaa ihu man dela yiara tamman vechal alma yehe beirvuvya sagya
Lesof teresar yarche yakum shevet miyyisrael da malka meshicha deyittear go ginta deeden vechal inun tzaddikayya yaterun leh tamman veyachgerun leh mane zayena beatvan reshiman demane dishma kaddisha

Vekala yitpotzetz beanfe ilanin deginta kare bechayil veamar itaru kaddishe elonin kumu mikkame meshicha ha idana leitchabbera itta bevalah uvalah bae lenakma lah nukmin dealma ulakama lah ulanara lah meafra
Keden yekumun kullehu veyachgerun leh kemillekaddemin mane zayeneh avraham mimineh yitzchak missomaleh yaakov kameh moshe raya mehemna al kal illen tzaddikayya azil verakid go ginta deeden

Kevan deitkan mashiach al yeda detzadikayya beginta deeden yeul behahu duchta deikre kan tzippor kemillekaddemin vechame tamman hahu diyyukna decharban bet makdesha vechullehu tzaddikayya deitketalu beh keden natil mittamman levushin veinun eser levushe kina veyitgeniz tamman arbein yomin dela itgalya kelal

Lesof arbein yomin kala chad yittear veyitkere miggo kurseyya illaa hahu kan tzippor bemalka meshicha deitgeniz beh uchden sallekin leh leela vekudsha berich hu chame leh lemalka meshicha mitlavash bilvusha nukma vechagir mane zayene natil leh venashik leh al resheh

Keden mizdazean mea vetishin rekiin vearmiz kudsha berich hu lechad rekia meinun dehava ganiz misheshet yeme bereshit veappik mechad hechla divhahu rekia chad kitra gelifa mechakkeka bishmahan kaddishin behahu itra itattar kudsha berich hu kad avru yisrael yat yamma lemetal nukmin mikkal retiche paro ufarashoy veatar leh lemalka meshicha

Kevan deitattar veittakkan bechal hane tikkunin natil leh kudsha berich hu venashik leh kemillekaddemin man chame retichin kaddishin umashiryan illain desacharin leh veyahavin leh mattenan unvizbezan saggiin veyitattar mikkullehu

Al tamman bechad hechla vechame kal inun malache illae deikrun avele tziyyon inun devachu al charban be makdesha uvachan tadir veinun yahavin leh chad purfira sumaka lemebad nukmin keden kudsha berich hu ganiz leh behahu kan tzippor veitkasse tamman telatin yomin

Levatar telatin yomin behahu kan tzippor yechut meutar bechal inun tikkunin meela umittatta chamma mashiryan kaddishin sacharaneh veyechmun kal alma chad nehiru tale merkia leara veyekum shiva yomin vechal bene alma yitmehun veyitbahalun vela yindeun kelal bar inun chakkimin deyadin berazin illen zakkaa chulakehon

Vechal inun shiva yomin yitated beara behahu kan tzippor bean atar badderech da kevurat rachel deihi kayema befarashat orchin vivasser lah vayyinachem lah uchden tekabbel tanchumin vetakum vetenashik leh
Levatar yekum hahu nehiru mehahu atar veshare biyericho karta deilane bechal etz da yericho o al haaretz da yerushlem viyehe ganiz behahu nehiru dekan tzippor teresar yarche

Batar teresar yarche yizdekaf hahu nehiru ben shemayya veara veyishre beara degalil detamman hava sheruta degaluta deyisrael vetamman yitgele mehahu nehiru dekan tzippor vetav leatreh vehahu yoma yizdaza kal ara kemillekaddemin missayefe shemayya ad
515: Sayefe shemayya uchden yechozun kal alma deha itgele malka meshicha beara degalil

Veyitkanneshun leh kal inun delaan beorayeta veinun zeirin bealma uvizchut yenuke deve rav yittakef cheleh leitgabbera veraza da efrochim vei la yishtekkechun illen ha yenuke deyatvin betukpa deimmehon veyanke kema deatte amer gemule mechalav attike mishshadayim vehayenu o vetzim divgin illen sharya shechinta immehon deyisrael begaluta

Deha chakkimin zeirin inun deyishtakkechun behahu zimna vehayenu vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim lo tikkach haem al habbanim veyitakkav ad teresar yarchin acharanin levatar yete balah veokim lah meafra kema deatte amer akim et sukkat david hannofalet

Behahu yoma malka meshicha shaare veyichnosh galuta missayefe alma ad sayefe alma kema deatte amer im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim vego mehahu yoma kal atin venissin ugvuran deavad kudsha berich hu bemitzrayim yaavid lon leyisrael kema deatte amer kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot

Amar rabbi shimon elazar beri kal illen millin tishkach beraza dittelatin utren shevilin devishma kaddisha vead denissin illen la yittearun bealma la yishtelim raza dishma kaddisha vela tittear leahava kema deatte amer hishbati etchem benot yerushalayim bitzvaot bitzvaot da malka deikre tzevaot o beayelot hassade shear chelin umashshiryan diltatta im tairu veim teorru et haahava da yemina dekudsha berich hu deikre ahava ad shettechpatz hahi dishchivat leafra vihe reuta demalka bah zakkaa ihu man deyizke lehahu dara zakkaa ihu bealma den vezakkaa ihu bealma deate

Shimon arim yedoy bitzlo lekudsha berich hu vetzalle tzeloteh levatar detzalle tzeloteh atu elazar bereh ver abba veyatvu kameh ad dehau yatve kameh chamu chad nehiru dimama deitchashach veishteka chad tzinnora deshalhova deeshsha go yamma ditverya veizdaza kal hahu atar

Amar rabbi shimon vadday hashshetta hu idana dekudsha berich hu idkar livnoy veachit teren dimin lego yamma rabba vechad nachtin pagin behay tzinnora deshalhova deeshsha veyishtaku da beda beyamma bacha rabbi shimon uvachu chavrayya

Amar rabbi shimon ha ittearna beraze deatvan dishma kaddisha besitra deitaruta dileh legabbe benoy aval hashta it li legallaa ma dela ityehiv reshu lebbar nash achara legallaa ella zechu dedara da yekayyem alma ad deyete malka meshicha amar rabbi shimon ler elazar bereh ulribbi abba kumu bekiumayechu kamu elazar abba bacha rabbi shimon zimna achara amar vay man yekum bema deamina galuta yitmeshach man yachil lemisbal

Uf ihu kam veamar Adonai elohenu bealunu adonim zulatecha levad becha nazkir shemecha hay kera ukmuha aval behay kera it raza illaa go mehemanuta Adonai elohenu da hu sheruta derazin illain atar demittamman nafkin kal nehiru desheraggin kullehu leadleka vetamman talya kal raza dimhemanuta shema da shallit al kolla
Bealunu adonim zulatecha deha amma deyisrael let man deshallit aleh bar shema illaa da vehashta begaluta shallit aleh sitra achara

Levad becha nazkir shemecha raza dishma kaddisha kelala deesrin utren atvan uchneset yisrael la mitbarcha ella miggo shema da deikre becha kema deatte amer asher nishbata lahem bach becha yevarech yisrael ki becha arutz gedud uvizmena dishlimu ishtechach la hava mitperash da min da veasir
516: Leafresha da min da itteta mibbalah lav berayoni velav bidchiru begin dela leachazaa piruda vehashshetta begaluta piruda ishtechach demiggo aku dechal zimna vezimna anan avdin piruda leadkera hahu shem bar mibbalah begin deihi shechivat leafra vehayenu levad becha nazkir shemecha
Bar mibbalah anan dachrin lehay shem beferuda begin daanan rechikin minach veshaltin acharanin alan ushmecha ihu beferuda min shema deikre becha vehay beome degaluta

Begin degaluta kadmaa hava mibbayit rishon uvayit rishon hu raza de kadmaa velakovel shenin dilah galuta devayit rishon hava shenin veinun shenin la ishtechachat ima revia alayehu vahava piruda min shema illaa raza de illaa uchden yod raza illaa istallak leela leela leen sof uvayit rishon illaa kaddisha la nevia neviu demayin chayyin deha mekora dilah istallak

Veihi shenin begaluta begin deihi shenin ikre kema deatte amer vayyivnehu sheva shanim vei tema deshalta malchut bavel leela beraza de shenin chas veshalom ella bezimna dehava be makdesha kayyam nehora unviu deima illaa hava nahir venachit letatta kevan dechatu yisrael veitcharav makdesha veshalta malchut bavel hava chafe veachshich hahu nehiru vetattae kaddishin la hao nehirin

Kevan detattae la hao nehirin begin shaltanu demalchuta devavel istallak hahu nehora vehahu mabbua illaa dehava nevia raza de istallak leela leela been sof keden inun shenin la hao nehirin begin hahu nehiru deitmena veda hu vday galuta de shenin

Kevan deadiu shultanu devavel veshariat he tattaa leanhara yisrael kullehu la ahadru leadkaa lemeheve segula shelemata kemillekaddemin ella zeer zeer vechevan dishlimu la ishtechach keden neviu illaa la nachit kal kach leanhara kema dehava kemillekaddemin ella zeer zeer beirbuvya dela hao dachyan kemillekaddemin kema deitchaze veal kach neviu illaa vela nevia vela nahir ella deahadar leanhara zeer zeer miggo dochaka dishma

Veal da itgaru behu beyisrael keravin saggiin ad dehachoshech yechasse eretz ve tattaa itchashach venaflat leara unviu illaa istallak kemillekaddemin begin demalchut edom ittakkaf veyisrael ahadru lesarchanayehu

Veal da Adonai bayit sheni itcharav vechal inun teresar shevatin dilah kechushban mashiryan dilhon inun begaluta demalchut edom unviu illaa istallak mehahu neviu dekayema alah kema deatte amer hatztzadik avad avad hahu neviu dimkora illaa dehava nagid umashich milleela

Uchden hava piruda behe bayit sheni veihi begaluta deedom bechal inun terisar shevatin umashreyan dilhon teresar shevatin sallekin lechushban saggi veal deraza de hava behu bechal hahu chushbana galuta itmeshach

Raza derazin lechakkime libba itmesar shevatin elef shenin teren shevatin matan shenin sharu dimin leminpal patach veamar bacho tivke ballayela vedimatah al lechoyah lesof teresar shevatin degaluta lelya yitchashach leyisrael ad deyittear vav lizman shittin veshit shenin

Levatar teresar shevatin deinun elef umatan shenin degaluta ulvatar shittin veshit shenin bechashocha delelya keden vezacharti et beriti yaakov da itaruta deat deihu nefesh devet yaakov veraza da kal hannefesh habbaa leyaakov mitzrayema vego shishshim vashesh veihu nefesh devayit sheni raza de tattaa veda raza deshishshim vashesh shishshim leitaruta deyaakov veshesh leitaruta deosef veal da ihu vav deinnun teren bechibbura chada veraza chada
Mittamman ulhala yittear kudsha berich hu leinun nissin veatin
517: Dekaamaran veyitarun al yisrael inun aktin dekaamaran uchden veaf et beriti yitzchak ulvatar kad yaggiach malka meshicha keravin bechal alma bimina dekudsha berich hu kema deatte amer yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach keden veaf et beriti avraham ezkor ulvatar vehaaretz ezkor da Adonai batraa behahu zimna ketiv vehaya Adonai lemelech al kal haaretz baom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushmo echad

Lesof shittin veshit shenin acharanin deinun mea utlatin utren shenin yitchazun atvan bishma kaddisha gelifan bishlimu ela vetatta kedeka yeot veraza da illaa vetattaa vechal inun shevilin deinun telatin utren shenin dichlilan beraza deat raza dishlimu demea utlatin utren

Lesof mea utlatin utren shenin acharanin yitkayyem leechoz bechanfot haaretz veyinnaaru reshaim mimmenna veyitdakke ara kaddisha vekudsha berich hu yittear metayya deara kaddisha vikumun chayyalin chayyalin beara degalil
Uchden yittear setimu dinviu illaa at veyitkayemun telatin utren shevilin bishlimu lenagda letatta veyitkayemun atvan dishma kaddisha kullehu bekiyyumayehu dead kean la yehon bishlimu

Ad zeman deyangid veyitmeshach hahu neviu illaa bechibbura deatvan go Adonai batraa veda ihu lesof tashlum mea vearbein vearbea shenin acharanin deyishtallemun veyitarun shear mete yisrael devishar aran

Deyishtechach kal da bechushban chet deityeshiv alma veyitbasam veyitavar sitra achara mealma vehe tattaa titmele miggo neviu illaa vetitatar vetitnehir bishlimu uchden ketiv vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim

Ad dihe shabbat la lealkata nafshin betaanuge kedushsha Adonai kal hahu elef sheviaa veda ihu itaruta deruchin kaddishin deamma deyisrael leitlabbesha levatar shabbat begufin acharanin kaddishin leitkere kaddishin dichtiv vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyerushalam kadosh yeamer lo ad kan millin derazin setimin

Vayyakam melech chadash yosi amar bechal yoma kudsha berich hu avid malachin shelichan al alma dichtiv ose malachav ruchot asa la ketiv ella ose begin dechal yoma veoma ose uvhahu zimna itmana memana chad al mitzrayim veda ihu dichtiv vayyakam melech chadash chadash vadday

Asher la yada et yosef deha meatar deferuda hao kema deatte amer umishsham yippared vekadmaa mehahu piruda nahara demitzrayim ihu uvgin kach asher lo yada et yosef atar dechal yichuda sharya beh deikre tzaddik

Elazar yose hao azle beorcha ukdimu binhora lemezal chamu chad kochava dehava rahit missitra da vechochava achara missitra da amar ribbi elazar hashta mata zimna dechochve boker leshabbecha lemarihon verahate middechilu veemata demarehon leshabbecha ulzammera leh hada hu dichtiv beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kal beni elohim begin dechullehu beyichuda chada ka meshabbechan leh

Patach veamar lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar mizmor ledavid ayyelet hashshachar dechad nehiru anpoy demizrach veitparsha chashocha delelya chad memana it listar mizrach umashich chad chuta dinhiru distar darom ad deate venafik shimsha uvaka beinun kave rekia veanhir alma vehahu chuta afrish chashocha delelya

Keden ayyalta deshachra ate veate nehiru ochama bekadru leitchabbera bimama venahir yemama unhiru dimama kalil veshaiv begaveh lehahu ayyalta veal hay ayyalta kad itperash miyyoma levatar dechalil lah amar david shirata dichtiv lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar
518: Eli eli lamma azavtani deha itperash ayyalta deshachra minnehiru dimama ad dahau azle nahir yemama umatta idan tzelota amar ribbi elazar netzalle tzelota venizil yatvu vetzallu levatar kamu veazlu

Patach elazar veamar yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz asher yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim vego amarti sheggam ze havel hay kera ukmuha veittemar aval yesh hevel shelomo malka aved sifra da veokim leh al shiva havalim dealma kayema alayehu
Veinun shiva ammudin samchin dealma lakovel shiva rekiim veillen inun vilon rakia shechakim zevul maon machon aravot ulokavlayehu havel havalim amar kohelet havel havalim hakkol havel
Kema deinun shiva rekiin veit acharanin dedavke behu umitpashshete venafke minnayehu hachi name it havalim acharanin demitpashshete venafke meillen vechullehu amar shelomo

Vehacha raza dechachmeta it beh yesh hevel denafka meinun havalim illain dealma kayema alayehu veda naasa al haaretz veitkayyam bekiumeh veittakkaf betukpeh beovde ara uvisliku desalleka meara veda itmana al ara vechal tukpa vekiyyuma dileh beinun nishmatin detzaddikayya deitlekitu meara kad inun zakkain ad la sarchu beod deyahave recha tav kegon chanoch dichtiv beh veenennu ki lakach oto elohim venatal leh ad la mata zimneh veishtaasha beh vechen shear zakkain dealma

Detanenan al teren millin tzaddikayya mistalleke mealma ad la yimte zimnayehu chad al chove dara dechad asgiu chayyavayya bealma inun zakkain demishtakkeche benayehu ittafsun bechovehon vechad kad itgele kame kudsha berich hu deyisrechun levatar salik lon mealma ad la mata zimnayehu hada hu dichtiv asher yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim mate alayehu dina dilela keilu avdu chovin veovadin derashiayya

Deha zimna chada shail ribbi yose ben ribbi yaakov ish kefar ono bezimna deribbi akiva vechavroy istalaku mealma umitu behahu gavena leribbi meir amar leh vechi ketiv da bechal orayeta kulah amar leh vela veha amar shelomo asher yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim mate alayehu dina milleela keilu avdu chovin veovadin derashiayya veyesh reshaim shemmaggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim yatve besheket ushlam behay alma dina la mata alayehu keilu avdu ovadin detzaddikayya

Amay i begin deitgele kame kudsha berich hu dituvun betiuvta o deyippok minayehu zara diyehe keshot bealma kegon terach denafak minnih zara dikshot avraham achaz denafak minneh chizkiyyahu ushar chayyavin dealma uvgin kach besitra da uvsitra da hevel dekaamran naasa veittakaf al haaretz kidkamran

Davar acher yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz kidkamran deittakkaf al alma bemay begin deyesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim matan lidayehu keinun ovadin dechayyavayya kegon bat ovde avoda zara o chad meinun ovadin deinun mimmaase harshaim veinun kayeme bekiyyumayehu middechilu demarehon vela baan leistaava kegon kamma zakkae keshot dematu lidayehu keovadin illen veinun gibbore choach deavde reuta demarehon vela chatu veal da hevel naasa al haaretz veittakaf betukpeh

Veyesh reshaim shemmaggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim mate lidayehu chad mitzva deihu ovada detzaddikayya vezakkan bah veavdin yatah kegon listim mekappecha hava mishtechach beturaya bahade inun listim ovde avoda zara vechad hava yuday avar tamman hava mashziv leh venatir leh minnayehu vahava kare aleh ribbi akiva yesh reshaim asher maggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim
519: Beshivvuteh deribbi chiyya delelya chad paga bah behahi itteta dahavat azlat leve berattah baa lemitkaf bah amra leh bematu minach okir lemarach vela techeta gabbay shavkah vela chav bah hve omer veyesh reshaim asher maggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim amarti sheggam ze havel kema deittakkaf hahu hevel bahade inun tzaddikayya dematu lidayehu ovde dechayyavayya vela chatan uf hachi ittakkaf bahade inun chayyavayya demate lidayehu ovade deinun tzaddikayya veavde lehu

Detanenan aved kudsha berich hu tzaddikim urshaim bealma vechamma deityakar ihu bealma beovde detzaddikayya hachi name ityakar ihu berashiayya kad avde ovada tava bealma kema deatte amer et hakkol asa yafe veitto vay lachayyava kad avid garmeh ra veittakkaf bechoveh kema deatte amer oy larasha ra vego

Tu patach veamar et hakkol raiti bime hevli vego hay kera uf hachi ukmuha chavrayya aval kad ityehiv chachma lishlomo chama kolla bezimna deshalta sihara yesh tzaddik da ammuda dealma oved kema deatte amer hatztzaddik avad bezimna degaluta betzidko begin dehi shechivat leafra tzedek da kal zimna deyisrael begaluta ihi immehon begaluta uvgin kach tzaddik oved betzidko deha la matan legabbeh inun birkan illain

Veyesh rasha maarich beraato da samael deorich sheket veshalva leedom bemay beraato behahi raa itteh nachash takkifa deha la mata alayehu sheket veshalva ella begin deitdabbak behahi nukba kegavena da lishar malkevan ad dekudsha berich hu yakim meafra lehahi sukkat david hannofelet dichtiv akim et sukkat david hannofalet

Vayyelech ish mibbet levi ribbi yose patach dodi yarad leganno laarugot habbosem vego leganno da keneset yisrael begin dehi arugat habbosem deihi kelila mikkal sitrin busmin verechin dealma deate beshaata dekudsha berich hu nachit leginta da kal inun nishmathon detzaddikayya mitatteran tamman kullehu yahave recha kema deat amer vereach shemanayicha mikkal besamim illen inun nishmathon detzaddikayya deamar ribbi yitzchak kal inun nishmatin detzaddikayya dehau behay alma vechal inun nishmatin dizminin lenachta lehay alma kullehu beginta

Di beara kayemin bediyyukna vetziyyura dehau kayemin behay alma vesitra veraza da itmesar lechakkime rucha denachit livne nasha deihu missitra denukba mitgallefa tadir begillufa kehay chotam tziyyura degufa devar nash behay alma balit levar verucha itgelif lego kad itpashat rucha min gufa hahu ruach balit beginta deara betziyyura udukna degufeh mammash dibbehay alma begin dehava tadir kachotam

Veal da amra ihi simeni kachotam ma chotam galif begillufa lego veittzayyar betziyyura belita levar uf hachi ihi rucha dehava missitra dilah kehay gavena mammash behay alma galif begillufa lego vechad itpashat min gufa veal beginta deara avira detamman balit hahu gillufa leittzayera levar veittzayyar betziyyura belita levar kegavena detziyyura degufa behay alma
Nishmeta deihi meilana dechaya ittzayyar tamman leela behahu tzerora dechayye leitanga benoam Adonai kema deatte amer lachazot benoam Adonai ulvakker behechalo
Vayyelecha ish mibbet levi da gavriel kema deat amer vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon vego mibbet levi da cheneset yisrael deatya missitra dismala vayyikkach et bat levi da nishmeta
Detaninan beshaata deityelid gufa detzaddik behay alma
520: Kudsha berich hu kare leh leggavriel venatil hahi nishmeta di beginta venachta lah lehay gufa detzaddikayya deityelid behay alma veihu itpekad ala venatir lah
Vei tema hahu malacha deitmana al ruchehon detzaddikayya layela shemeh veatte amarte deihu gavriel hachi hu vadday begin deate missitra dismala vechal man deate missitra dismala hachi ikre
Vayyelecha ish da amram vayyikkach et bat levi da yocheved uvat kol nachtat veamrat leh leizdavvega bah deha kariv zimna defurkana deyisrael al yeda dibbera deityelid minnayehu

Vekudsha berich hu siyyea beh detanenan shechinta sharya al arsayehu uruta dilhon bidvekuta chada hava bah bishchinta veal da la itade shechinta mehahu bera deolidu lekayema dichtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim bar nash dimkaddesh garmeh millera kudsha berich hu mekaddesh leh leela kema diruta dillehon hava bidvekuta dishchinta hachi itdabbeka shechinta behahu ovada mammash deavdu

Amar ribbi yitzchak zakkain inun tzaddikayya diruta dillehon bidvekuta dekudsha berich hu tadir vechema deinun mitdabbekin beh tadir hachi name ihu itdabbak behu vela shavik lon lealmin vay lerashiayya diruta dillehon udvekuta dillehon mitrachaka minneh vela day lehu demitrachakan minneh ella demitdabbekan besitra achara ta chaze amram deitdabbak beh bekudsha berich hu nafak minneh moshe dekudsha berich hu la ade minneh lealmin ushchinta itdabbekat bahadeh tadir zakkaa chulakeh
Vattahar haisha vatteled ben vattere oto ki tov hu may ki tov hu amar ribbi chiyya deityelid mahul begin deraza divrit tov ikre dichtiv imru tzaddik ki tov
Ribbi yose amar nehiru dishchinta denahir beh chamat divshaata deityelid itmalya kal beta nehora dichtiv vatter oto ki tov hu uchtiv vayyar elohim et haor ki tov veal da ki tov hu ketiv vecholla hava

Vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim yerachim may ka mayere amar yehuda remez hu deka ramaz dela ishtemoda moshe bezihara illaa ad yerachim dichtiv bachodesh hashlishi deha keden ityehivat tora al yedoy ushchinta itgalya vesharya aloy leenehon decholla dichtiv umoshe ala el haelohim vayyikra elav Adonai velo yachla od hatztzefino dead hahu shata la ishtemoda milluleh bekudsha berich hu uchtiv moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanenu bekol

Vattikkach lo tevat gome remez al haaron deluchot kayyama alin begaveh tevat gome aron habberit ihu vattachmera vachemar uvazzafet deha haaron hava mechuppe millegav umillevar ribbi yehuda amar da hi orayeta dehechomira kudsha berich hu bemitzot ase uvmitzot lo taase

Vattasem bah et hayyeled ellu yisrael kema deatte amer ki naar yisrael vaohavehu vattasem bassuf dela hao pikkude orayeta chumra lemebad ad sof dealu yisrael leara lesof arbein shenin al sefat hayeor al memra deinun demorim orayeta vechukka leyisrael

Davar acher vayyelech ish da kudsha berich hu dichtiv Adonai ish milchama mibbet levi da kudsha berich hu atar dechachma illaa vehahu nahar mitchabberan kachada vela mitparshin lealmin mibbet levi deashre liveyatan lechidu bealma hada hu dichtiv liveyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo vayyikkach et bat levi da kudsha berich hu atar dinhiru desihara nahir
Vattahar haishsha vatteled ben haishsha vadday kema deatte amer lezot yikkare ishsha bekadmita bat levi vehachi hu vadday vechi bat levi bekadmita
521: Vehashta isha ella hachi hu vadday vehachi olifna itteta ad la izdavvegat itkeriat bat peloni batar deizdavvegat itkeriat ishsha vehacha bat veishsha vechalla chad darga ihu

Vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim illen telat yarchin dedina kashya sharya bealma umay ninhu tammuz av tevet may mashma dead la nachat moshe lealma shechiach hava ihu leela veal da izdavvegat beh shechinta miyyoma deityelid mikkan amar ribbi shimon ruchehon detzaddikayya shechichin inun leela ad la yechotun lealma

Velo yachla od hatztzefino vego may vattikkach lo tevat gome dechafat leh besimanaha lemehve natir meinun nune yamma deshatin beyamma rabba dichtiv sham remesho veen mispar vehi chafat leh lemehve natir minnayehu bechafu yakkira ditren gavenin chivar veucham veanach leh lemoshe benayehu deyishtemoda immehon begin dezamin lesalleka zimna achara lekabbela orayeta
Vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor da ihi deatya missitra dismala dedina kashya kema deatte amar lirchotz al hayeor al hayeor dayeka velo al hayyam
Vei tema veha ketiv umattecha asher hikkita bo et hayeor umoshe la macha ella yamma vekaryeh yeor ella yeor hava demacha aharon al yede demoshe veshaveyeh kera deihu avid

Kehay gavena veyimmale shivat yamim achare hakkot Adonai et hayeor veaharon hikkahu ella al deata missitra dekudsha berich hu karyeh kera achare hakkot Adonai levatar karyeh bishma demoshe venaaroteha holchot al yad hayeor illen shear mashshiryan deatyan missitra da

Vattiftach vattirehu et hayyeled vattirehu vattere mibbae leh may vattirehu amar ribbi shimon let lach milla beorayeta delet bah razin illain veyakkirin ella hachi olifna reshima demalka umatronita ishtechach beh veihu reshima devav he umiyyad vattachmol alav vego ad kan leela mikkan ulhala letatta bar mehay kera

Vattetatztzav achoto merachok vego vattetatztzav achoto achoto deman achote dehahu dekara likkeneset yisrael achoti kema deatte amer pitchi li achoti rayati merachok kema deatte amar merachok Adonai nira li

Mashma deinun zakkain ad la nachtu lealma ishtemodaan inun leela legabbe kolla vechal shekken moshe umashma name denishmatehon detzaddikayya itmeshachu meatar illaa kema deokimna veraza demilla olifna demashma deav vaem it lenishmeta kema deit av vaem legufa beara umashma divkal sitrin ben leela ben letatta midchar venukba atyan kolla umishtachche veha ukmuha raza dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya haaretz da keneset yisrael nefesh chayya nafsha deadam kadmaa illaa kema deittemar ata ribbi abba unshakeh amar vadday shappir kaamarte vehachi hu vadday zakkaa chulakeh demoshe nevia mehemana al kal shear nevie alma

Davar acher vattetatztzav achoto da hi chachma kema deatte amar emor lachachma achoti atte amar ribbi yitzchak meolam la itadiat gizrat dina mealma deha bechal shata dehau yisrael chatan hava dina mekatrega immehon uchden vattetatztzav achoto merachok kema deatte amer merachok Adonai nira li
Vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor beshaata dahau paske yisrael meorayeta miyyad vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor havat nachtat middat haddin
522: Leistachaa middama deyisrael al elbona deorayeta venaaroteha holchot al yad hayeor illen umayya deinun azlin veradfin abbatrayehu al yad hayeor al sibbat elbona deorayeta veinun demorim bah derafu yedayehu minah

Amar ribbi yehuda kal millin dealma talyan bitshuva uvitzlota detzalle bar nash lekudsha berich hu vechal shekken man deoshid dimin bitzloteh delet lach tara dela alin inun dimin ma ketiv vattiftach vattirehu et hayyeled vattiftach da shechinta dekayema alayehu deyisrael keima al benin vehi patcha tadir bizchutehon deyisrael

Kevan sheppatcha vattirehu et hayyeled yeled shaashuim deinun yisrael demitchattan kame malchehon becholla umiyyad demitchannenan kame kudsha berich hu hadre bitshuva uvachan kameh kivra devache kame avoy ma ketiv vehinne naar boche kevan devache itadu kal gizrin bishin dealma ma ketiv vattachmol alav ittear aloy berachamim umrachem leh

Vattomer miyyalde haivrim ze deinun rakke libba vela miyyalde haavodat kochavim umazzalot deinun keshe kedal ukshe libba miyyalde haivrim rakke libba meavahan umeimmahan leatava kame marehon vattikra et em hayyaled shehayeta bocha hada hu dichtiv kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al baneha vego hu boche veem hayyeled hi bocha

Amar ribbi yehuda lezimna deate ma ketiv bivchi yavou uvtachanunim vego mahu bivchi yavou bizchut bechi deem hayyeled shehi rachel yavou veyitkanshun min galuta veamar ribbi yitzchak purkana deyisrael la talya ella bivchi kad yishtallemun veyichlun bechi demaot devacha esav kame aviv dichtiv veyissa esav kolo vayyevche veinun dimin achitu leyisrael begaluteh kevan deyichlun inun dimin bevichya deyisrael yifkun miggaluteh hada hu dichtiv bivchi yavou uvtachanunim ovilem

Vayyifen ko vacho chama beillen atvan dimyachadin leh yisrael bechal yoma shema yisrael paamayim deit behon tere zimne vela chama beh vayyifen ko vacho vego ko vacho amar ribbi abba ko chama i hao beh ovadin dechashran vacho i zamin lenafka minneh bera mealya miyyad vayyar ki en ish chama beruach kudsha dela zamin lenafka minneh bera mealya

Deamar ribbi abba kamma chayyavin inun bealma demafke beni mealya yattir meinun zakkain vehahu bera mealya denafak min chayyava ihu mealya yattir lemeheve tahor mittame nehora miggo chashocha chachmeta miggo tippeshuta veda ihu mealya mikkolla

Vayyar vyar dehacha kolla beruach kudsha istachal vechama uvgin kach istakkal beh vekatal leh vekudsha berich hu sivev kolla limhach lehahu bera kema deazal yaakov legabbe hahu bera dichtiv vayyeshev al habbeer beyaakov ketiv vayyar vehinne beer bemoshe ketiv vayyeshev beeretz midyan vayyeshev al habbeer begin demoshe veyaakov af al gav divdarga chada hao istalak moshe behay yattir minneh

Ribbi yose veribbi yitzchak hao azle beorcha amar ribbi yose hahu beer dechama yaakov vechama moshe i da hava hahu bera dechafar avraham veyitzchak amar leh lav ella beshaata deitbere alma itbere hay bera uverev shabbat ben hashshemashot itbere puma dileh vehay ihu beer dechamu yaakov umoshe
Matnitin inun derodfe keshot inun detave raza dimhemanuta inun deitdevaku bekishshura mehemana inun deyadin orchoy demalka illaa kerivu shimu

Kad seliku teren venafku lekadmut chad mekabbelin leh ben teren deroin teren nachte litlata teren inun chad minayehu chakla detappuchin kaddishin ihu mehay bera yatve motva dinvie yankin behu chad benayehu chibbura ihu decholla ihu natil mikkolla
523: Hahu bera kaddisha kaim techotayehu chakla detappuchin kaddishin ihu mehay bera itshakyan adarayya derae moshe bemadbera mehai bera itshakyan adariya debbarir yaakov kad barir lon leggo chulake kal inun retichin kal inun mare degadpin telat kayemin reviin al hay bera hay bera minnayehu itmele adonay itkere al da kettiv adonay Adonai atta hachillota vego uchtiv vehaer panecha al mikdashcha hashshamem lemaan adonay adon kal haaretz hada hu dichtiv hinne aron habberit adon kal haaretz beh ganiz chad mekora kaddisha dinvia beh tadir veamle leh Adonai tzevaot ikre berich hu lealam ulalme almin

Ulchohen midyan sheva banot vattavona vattidlena vego amar ribbi yehuda i bera da ihu bera deyaakov ha ketiv beh veneesfu shamma chal haadarim vegalalu vego vehacha benot yitro la itzterichu lehay ella vattavona vattidlena belo torach achara

Amar ribbi chiyya yaakov ade lah min bera deha ketiv kad mitkanshe tamman kal adaraya veheshivu et haeven uvyaakov la ketiv vayyashev et haeven deha la itzterich levatar ken deha bekadmita mayya la hao sallekin kevan deata yaakov seliku mayya legabbeh vehahu avna la hava al pum bera uvgin kach vattavona vattidlena
Elazar abba hao azle mitteverya letzippori ad dahau azle paga behu chad yuday itchabbar bahadayehu amar ribbi elazar kal chad lema milla deorayeta

Patach ihu veamar vayyomer elay hinnave ben adam hinnave el haruach veamarta el haruach vego mehay kera yedana atar deharuach nafka minneh vechi yachil hava yechezkel lenabbea al haruach veha ketiv en adam shallit baruach lichlo et haruach ella bar nash la yachil leshalletaa baruach aval kudsha berich hu ihu shallit becholla veal memreh hava mitnabbe yechezkel vetu deha ruach hava begufa behay alma uvgin kach itnabbe aleh mearba ruchot boi haruach mehahu atar deittecham besamchoy bearba sitrin dealma

Dalig hahu yudai kameh amar leh ribbi elazar may chamit amar milla chamena amar leh may hi amar leh ruach bene adam i itlavash beggan eden bilvusha dediyyukna begufa dehay alma hava leh lemichtav ko amar Adonai miggan eden boi haruach mahu mearba ruchot

Amar leh rucha la nachta lehay alma ad desalleka migginta deara lego kurseya dekayema al arba samchin kevan desalleka tamman istaava miggo hahu kurseya demalka venachta lehay alma gufa itnetil mearba sitre alma ruach uf hachi itnetil mearba sitre dechurseyya demittatkena alayehu

Amar leh hahu bar nash deliga deka daligna kamayechu milla chamena mehay sitra begin deoma chada havena azil bemadbera vachamena ilana chad demirgag lemechoze vechad mearta techoteh karivna gabbeh vachamena hahi mearta desalleka rechin mikkal zine rechin dealma ittakafna begarmay veailna behahi mearta venachitna bedargin yedian bego duchta chada dehau beh illanin saggiin verechin uvusmin dela yachilna lemisbal

Vetamman chamena chad bar nash vesharvita chad bideh vahava kaim bechad pitcha kevan dechama li tava vekam legabbay amar li ma atte hacha umean atte ana dachilna sagya amena leh mari min chavrayya ana kach vechach chamena bemadbera vealana behay mearta venachitna hacha
Amar li hoil umin chavrayya ante tol hay kitra dichtava vehav leh lechavrayya inun deyadin razin deruchehon detzaddikayya
524: Vatash bi behahu sharvita vedamichna addehachi chamena kamma chelin umashshiryan go shenata dahao atyan beorcha lehahu duchta vehahu gavra batash behahu sharvita veamar beorcha deilani zilu addehachi dahao azli parche baavira vesalke vela yedana lean atar ushmana kalin demashshiryan saggiin vela yedana mean ihu ittearna vela chamena midi vedachilna behahu atar

Addehachi chamena lehahu bar nash amar li chamit midi amena leh chamena go shenata kach vechach amar behahu archa azle ruchehon detzaddikayya go ginta deeden leaala tamman uma deshamat minnayehu hu dekayeme beginta bediyyukna dehay alma vechaddan beruchehon detzaddikayya dealin tamman

Uchma degufa itbeni behay alma mikketura dearba yesode veittzayar behay alma uf hachi rucha ittzayar beginta mikketura dearba ruchin dekayema beginta vehahu rucha itlabbesha tamman umittzayerat minnayehu betziyyura dediyyukna degufa deittzayyar behay alma veilmale inun arba ruchin deinun avirin deginta rucha la mittzayera betziyyura kelal vela itlabbesha behu

Inun ruchin ketirin illen beillen kachada vehahu ruach ittzayyar veitlavash behu kegavena degufa ittzayar bekitture ded yesode alma uvgin kach mearba ruchot boi haruach meinun arba ruchin deggan eden deitlavsha veittzeyret behu vehashshetta tol hay kitra dichtava vezil learchach vehav leh lechavrayya

Ata ribbi elazar veinun chavrayya veneshakuhu beresheh amar ribbi elazar berich rachamana deshadrach hacha devadday da hu berira demilla vekudsha berich hu azmin lefumi hay kera yehav lon hahu kitra dichtava kevan denatal leh ribbi elazar ufatach leh nafak afuta deeshsha veaschar leh chama beh ma dechama ufarach min yedoy

Bacha elazar veamar man yachil lekayema beginzayya demalka Adonai mi yagur beaholecha mi yishkon behar kadshecha zakkaa hay orcha vehahi shaata deirana bach umehahu yoma hava chadde ribbi elazar velo amar kelum lechavrayya ad dahao azle pagu bechad bera demayya kayemu aleh veshatu min mayya

Amar ribbi elazar zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya yaakov arak mikkame achuy veizdeman leh bera kevan devira chama leh mayya ishtemodau lemarehon vesallekin legabbeh vechaddu bahadeh vetamman izdavvegat leh bat zugeh moshe arak mikkame paro veizdaman leh hahu bera umayin chamu leh veishtemodau lemarehon vesalku legabbeh vetamman izdavvegat leh bat zugeh

Ma ben moshe leyaakov yaakov ketiv beh vayehi kaasher raa yaakov et rachel vego vayyiggash yaakov vayyagel et haeven vego moshe ma ketiv beh vayyavou haroim vaye gorashum vayyakam moshe vayyoshian vego bevadday yada hava moshe kevan dechama mayya desallekin legabbeh detamman tizdaman leh bat zugeh vetu deha ruach kudsha la itade minneh lealmin uveh hava yada detzippora teheve bat zugeh amar moshe vadday yaakov ata lehacha umayya seliku legabbeh izdaman leh bar nash deachnish leh leveteh veyahav leh kal ma deitztarich ana uf hachi

Amar hahu bar nash hachi olifna deyitro komer lekkochavim umazzalot hava kevan dechama dekkochavim umazzalot let bah mammashu itperash mippulchana dileh kamu amma venidduhu kevan dechamu benateh hao metarchan lon deha bekadmita inun hao raan aneh kevan dechama moshe beruach kudsha deal milla dekkochavim umazzalot hao avde miyyad vayyakam moshe vayyoshian vayyashk et tzonam veitavid kina lekudsha berich hu becholla
Amar leh ribbi elazar ante legabban vela yedana
525: Shemecha amar ana yoezri ben yaakov atu chavrayya unshakuhu amru uma ante legabban vela havinan yadin bach azlu kachada kal hahu yoma leoma achara ozfuhu telat milin veazil leorcheh

Vattomarna ish mitzri hitztzilanu ribbi chiyya amar ha ukmuha chavrayya denitznetza behu ruach kudsha veamru velo yadu ma amru levar nash dehava yativ bemadbera vahau yomin dela achal bisra yoma chad ata dova lenatla chad imra arak imra vedova avatreh ad dematu legabbe hahu bar nash lemadbera chama imra veatkif beh ushchateh veachal bisra

539: Chacham gadol haya vehaya roe tzono kaddin vechashshura lefichach asahu hakadosh baruch hu melech al kal yisrael velamma tzon velo bakar amar ribbi yehuda yisrael nikraim tzon shenneemar veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem uchtiv ketzon kodashim ketzon yerushalayim

Ma haroe et hatztzon keshehu roe tov matztzil et hatztzon min hazzeevim umin haaraot kach hammanhig leyisrael im hu tov matztzilan min haavodat kochavim umazzalot umiddin shel matta umiddin shel mala umadrichan lechayye haolam habba kach moshe roe neeman haya veraa hakadosh baruch hu shekkeday hu lirot et yisrael beoto haddin mammash shehaya roe et hatztzon lakkesavim kefi harauy lahen vehannekevot kefi harauy lahen

540: Dedina tochlu basar uchtiv habbasar odennu ben shinnehem veaf Adonai chara vaam mishshum deven haarbayim dina demalchuta shalit uvabboker tisbeu lachem mishshum deikre chesed hahu shaata uchtiv chesed el kal hayyom uchtiv vayyikra elohim laor yom deihu mitztzafra

Veamar ribbi yehuda mahu dichtiv et hakkeves haechad taase vabboker vela ketiv et hakkeves harishon ella et hakkeves haechad meuchad keneged middat hachesed divchal makom sheni lo neemar bo ki tov

Ta chaze hay eretz ikre eretz yisrael yaakov deihu yisrael amay la shalit al da kemmoshe deha ketiv vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday vela yattir

Hu aharon umoshe asher amar Adonai lahem hotziu et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim vego hu aharon umoshe hem aharon umoshe mibbae leh ella leachlala da beda rucha bemayya hu moshe veaharon leachlala mayya berucha veal da ketiv hu velo hem

Ribbi elazar veribbi abba hao shechiche lelya chad beve oshpizayehu belud kamu leishtaddela beorayeta patach ribbi elazar veamar veyadata hayyom vehashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim hay kera hachi mibbae leh veyadata hayyom ki Adonai hu haelohim vehashevota el levavecha tu vehashevota el libbecha mibbae leh

Ella amar moshe i atte bae lemekam al da ulminda ki Adonai hu haelohim vehashevota el levavecha uchden tinda leh levavecha yetzer tov veyetzer ra deitkelil da beda veihu chad keden tishkach ki Adonai hu haelohim deha itkelil da beda veihu chad veal da vehashevota el levavecha leminda milla

Tu amar ribbi elazar chayyavin avdin pegimuta leela may pegimuta dismala la itkelil bimina deyetzer ra la itkelil beyetzer tov begin chovayehu divne nasha ufgimu la avde ella lon mammash hada hu dichtiv shichet lo lo banav mumam kivyachol avde vela avde avde dela yitmashshech alayehu birkan dilela kema deatte amar veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar vela avde deha shemayya natle lon legarmayehu birkan may deitzterich vela natle leamshacha letatta vadday mumam deinun chayyavin ihu

551: Missitra dismala veitdevak bimina begin lenatztzecha amin ultavra chelehon dei la itdevak bimina la yitbar chelehon vei tema amay bimina veha semala itar dinin bealma

Ella raza da beshaata dekudsha berich hu dan lehu leyisrael la dan lehu ella missitra dismala begin diyehe dache lon bismala umkarev bimina aval lishar ammin dache lon bimina umkarev lon bismala vesimanich ger tzedek dache lon bimina kema dichtiv yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev mekarev lon bismala kema deamaran

Begine kach yehuda deihu mistar semala itdabbak bimina umtalnoy limina veinun deimmeh itchabberu kullehu limina yissschar delae beorayeta deihi yemina dichtiv mimino esh dat lamo zevulun deihu tamich orayeta yemina kema deatte amer shok hayyamin veal da yehuda itkeshar missitra da veda tzafon bammayim semala bimina

Reuven dechata legabbe avoy shara bimina veitkashshar bismala veitdabbak beh veal da inun deishtechachu immeh inun semala shimon deihu semala missitra deshor dichtiv ufne shor mehassemol gad shoka semala ketiv gad gedud yegudennu vehu yagud akev hacha itdabbak darom beeshsha yemina bismala

Veal da ha deamaran vehashevota el levavecha leachlela lon kachada semala bimina keden teda ki Adonai hu haelohim amar ribbi abba vadday hachi hu vehashta yedia hu aharon umoshe hu moshe veaharon rucha bemayya umayya berucha lemeheve chad veal da ketiv hu

Abba patach veamar veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechal levavcha uvchal nafshecha uvchal meodecha kehay gavena hacha itremiz yichuda kaddisha veazhara hu levar nash leyachada shema kaddisha kedeka yeot birchimu illaa bechal levavcha da yemina usmala deikre yetzer tov veyetzer ra uvchal nafshecha da nefesh david deityehivat benayehu uvchal meodecha leachlela lon leela baatar delet beh shiura hacha hu yichuda shelim lemircham leh lekudsha berich hu kedeka yeot
Tu uvchal meodecha da yaakov deihu achid lechal sitrin vecholla hu yichuda shelim kedeka yeot begine kach hu aharon umoshe hu moshe veaharon kolla hu chad bela piruda

Ki yedabber alechem paro lemor ribbi yehuda patach veamar ma ahavti toratecha kal hayyom hi sichati uchtiv chatzot layela akum lehodot lach al mishpete tzidkecha ta chaze david ihu malka deyisrael veitzterich lemedan amma ledabbera lon leyisrael keraya dimadbar aneh dela yistun meorcha dikshot ha ballayela ketiv chatzot layela akum lehodot lach al mishpete tzidkecha veihu itasak beorayeta uvtushbechan dekudsha berich hu ad deate tzafra

Veihu ittear tzafra kema dichtiv ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar kad ate yemama amar hay kera ma ahavti toratecha kal hayyom hi sichati may kal hayyom hi sichati ella mikkan olifna dechal man deyishtedal beorayeta leashlema dina al buryeh keilu kiyyem orayeta kolla begin kach kal hayyom hi sichati

Ta chaze beoma ishtaddal beorayeta leashlema dinin belelya ishtaddal beshirin vetushbechan ad deate yemama may tama kal yoma itasak leashlama dinin begin leachlala semala bimina belelya begin leachlela darga delelya bimama

552: Elazar besitra yemina illaa nafkin telesar mabbuin illain naharin amikin illen sallekin veillen nachtin ayiyil kal chad bechavreh chad appik resheh veail leh bitren gufin chad gufa denahara natil miyyamin leela afrish letatta elef yeorin nafkin learba sitrin

Resha sumaka kevarda kashkashoy takkifin kefarzela gadpoy gadpin shatan veitparshan lechal inun yeorin kad salik zanbeh mache uvatash lishar nunin let man deyekum kameh

Pumeh melahata eshsha kad natil bechal inun yeorin mizdazean shear tanninaya vearkin vealin beyamma chad leshivin shenin ravitz lesitra da vechad leshivin shenin ravitz lesitra da elef yeorin chaser chad itmalyan minneh da tannina ravitz ben inun yeorin

Ad delistar tzafon kam chad shalhova deeshsha vecharoza kare izdakafu savtin itbedaru led zaveyan ha ittear man deshave kodla al anpoy detannina kema deittemar venatatti chachim bilchayyecha vego keden kullehu itbadderun venaktin leh letanina venakve anpoy bistar iloy vealin leh lenukba dithoma rabba ad deitbar cheleh keden ahadru leh lenaharoy
Chad leshivin shenin avdin leh keden begin dela yetashtesh atrin dirkiin usmachayehu vealayehu kolla odan umvarchan veamrin bou nishtachave venichraa nivrecha lifne Adonai osenu

Tanninaya illain ilen kayemin inun demitbarchan kema deatte amer vayevarech otam elohim illen shaltin al kal shear nunin dichtiv umilu et hammayim bayyammim veal da ketiv ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita

Tosefta eshkol hakkofer dodi li eshkol da ima illaa ma eshkol mitkashshet bechamma alin bechamma zemorot leyisrael deachlin leh hachi shechinta illaa mitkashshetet bechamma kishshutin dishmona kelim mikkamma karbanin mikkamma mine tachshitin dechappera livnaha veihi kamat behon kame malka umiyyad uritiha lizkor berit olam vihivat lan sheeltin dilah beillen birkan detakinu rabbanan bitzlota lemishal kame malka

Behahu zimna kal dinin dishchinta tattaa deihi adonay mithappechan lerachame kegavena da lekayyem im yihu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu im yadimu chattola katztzemer yihu kal dinin mitlabbenin mishchinta illaa

Veihi shechinta lahat hacherev hammithappechet lishmor et derech etz hachayyim veukmuha rabbanan dimhappecha zimnin rachame zimnin dina peamim anashim peamim nashim zimnin dina kegavena da zimnin rachame kegavena da deha ihu missitra deilana dechayye kal dinin mithappechin lerachame umissitra deetz haddaat tov vara kal rachame mithappechan ledina lemedan behu leinun deavre al pitgame orayeta

553: Aval meetz haddaat tov vara deihu kegavena dematte zimnin demithappechin hannashim leshedot anashim leshedim uvgin da vayyagged yaakov lerachel uvgin da ukmuha rabbanan delet leh levar nash leshammesha im itteteh ad dimsapper immah shemma nitchallefa lo besheda begin delahat beetz haddaat tov vara mithappechet mittov lara vei tema dimchashshefe paro dichtiv vayyaasu chen hachartummim belatehem hao mehappechin inun matot dilhon linchashin umissitra deillen hippuchan yachlin leithappecha

Veamarta el aharon kach et mattecha may taama matte aharon velo matte moshe ella hahu demoshe ihu kaddisha yattir deitgelif beginta illaa bishma kaddisha vela bae kudsha berich hu lesaova leh beinun chutrin decharshayya velo od ella leachpeya lon lechal inun deatyan missitra dismala begin deaharon ata mimina usmala itkafya bimina

Ribbi chiyya shail leribbi yose ha galle kame kudsha berich hu deinun charashin yaavdun tanninaya may gevurta ihu lemebad kame paro tanninaya amar leh begin demittamman hu sheruta lealkaa umishsheruta detannina shaari shultaneh keden chadu kullehu charashe deha resh chachmeta denachash dilhon hachi hava miyyad ithaddar hahu tannina deaharon leaa yevesha uvala lon
Veal da tavehu veyadu deshultana illaa it beara deinun chashivu deha letatta bar minnayehu la it shultana lemebad midi keden vayyivla matte aharon matte aharon dayeka deithaddar leaa uvala lon

Veal da aved aharon teren atin chad leela vechad letatta chad leela tannina illaa deshalta al inun dilhon chad letatta deshalit aa al tannina dilhon ufaro chakkim hava mikkal charashoy veistakkal deshultana illaa shalit al ara shalit leela shalit letatta

Amar ribbi yose i tema charashayya kal ma deavdin lav ihu ella bechezu deena dehachi itchaze vela yattir ka mashma lan vayyihu dayeka dichtiv vayyihu letanninim veamar ribbi yose afilu inun tanninaya dilhon ahadru lemehve ain veaa deaharon bala lon
Ketiv hinni alecha paro melech mitzrayim hattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav mittamman sheruta letatta beshultana dilhon aval chachmeta dilhon letatta mikkullehu dargin ihu

Ta chaze chachmeta dilhon bedargin tattain leachfeyan lon leillen dargin bedargin illain reshe shultanuthon veikara dilhon letatta mehahu tannina umishtalshelan betannina deha mittamman natil chela darga illaa dilhon mashma dichtiv asher achar harechayim

554: Ruchehon deinun deamrin dela zamin kudsha berich hu leachaya metayya vehech yitavid minnayehu birya chadta yetun veyechomun inun tippeshain chayyavayya rechikin meorayeta rechikin minneh bideh deaharon hava chutra aa yevesha vekudsha berich hu lefum shaata ahdar leh birya meshanya berucha vegufa inun gufin dahao behu ruchin venishmatin kaddishin venatru pikkude orayeta veishtaddalu beorayeta yemama velele vekudsha berich hu tamir lon beafra levatar bezimna dichade alma al achat kamma vechamma deyaavid lehu birya chadta

Amar ribbi chiyya velo od ella dehahu gufa dehava yakum mashma dichtiv yichu metecha vela ketiv yivra mashma deviryan inun aval yichu deha garma chad yishtear min gufa techot ara vehahu la itrekav vela itbele beafra lealmin uvhahu zimna kudsha berich hu yerakkech leh veyavid leh kachamira beisa veyistelak veyitpeshat learba zaveyan uminneh yishtachlal gufa vechal shayefoy vekudsha berich hu yahiv beh rucha levatar amar leh ribbi elazar hachi hu veta chaze hahu garma bema itrechach battal dichtiv ki tal orot tallecha vego

555: Binhora illaa lemehve kolla chad vechad ata shelomo ashkach alma shelim vesihara deitmalya vela itzterich leatrecha alla leanhara

Tu patach chiyya veamar emor el aharon kach mattecha unte yadcha al meme mitzrayim may tama aharon velo moshe ella amar kudsha berich hu aharon mayin kayemin beduchteh usmala bae lenagda mayin mittamman aharon deate mehahu sitra yittear leh vechad semala nakit lon inun yithadderun dama

Ta chaze tattaa dechal dargin macha bekadmita amar rabbi shimon mittattaa shara kudsha berich hu veyada dileh macha bechal etzbea veetzbea vechad mata ledarga illaa dechal dargin aved ihu dileh veavar beara demitzrayim vekatal kolla uvgine kach katal kal buchrin beara demitzrayim begin deihu darga illaa uvuchra decholla

Veta chaze paro hava shultaneh bemayya dichtiv hattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav begin kach ithappach nahareh bedama bekadmita levatar tzefardeim dimshammete lon bekalin tesirin mekarkerin bego meayehu venafke miggo yeora vesalke beyabbeshta veramin kalin bechal sitrin ad deinun naflin kemetin bego beta

556: Kullehu shultanuta dilhon begin levalbela datayehu vela hao yade lemebad midi ta chaze kal inun dargin dilhon kevan denafke lemebad midi deitchaze lecholla la yachlin lemebad midi yada takkifa desharya alayehu

Vesharatz hayeor tzefardeim vealu uvau bevetecha shimon patach veamar kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al baneha vego ta chaze hay kera ukmuha bechamma atre vehay kera kashya rachel mevakka al banha benaha derachel yosef uvinyamin hao vela yattir velea shit shevatin hao dilah amay bachat rachel velo lea

Ella hachi amru ketiv veene lea rakkot amay rakkot begin dechal yoma nafkat lefarashat orchin veshaalat al esav vahau amrin lah ovadoy dehahu rasha vedachilat leminpal bego adveh vahavat bachat kal yoma ad deitrekkachu enaha

Vekudsha berich hu amar ante bachat begin hahu tzaddika dela teheve beadveh dehahu rasha chayyayich achatach takum befarashat orchin vetivke al galuthon deyisrael veatte takum lego vela tivke alayehu verachel ihi bachat al galuthon deyisrael

Ta chaze keneset yisrael hachi ikre rachel kema deatte amer uchrachel lifni gozzeha neelama amay neelama dechad shaltin shear ammin kala itpesak minah vehi itallemat

557: Hacha chad behahu zimna vechad beomoy deosef vechad beomoy demoshe dealke bekolfoy

Vei tema hech la yachlin lekatla lon ella i arim bar nash chutra o avana lekatla chada itvakat venafkin shit minah miggo meaha veazle vetartashe beara ad dehavi mitmana lemikrav behu

558: Kamma nechalin lechamma sitrin lechamma yeorin lechamma naharin vechulaka dimmana desitra demitzrayim inun mayin merachashan illen delet lach mayin denafkin miggo yamma dela mafke nunin lezinin

Kinnim desalleka afra deara veta chaze kal iva deityelidat beara mechela dilela memana deizdera ala ihu vecholla hava kegavena dilela

Veinun techume ara leela kal chad vechad mitparshan leeser veinun mitpallegan le memanan dimmanan al shivin ammin vehahu ara techuma dechal amma veamma sachara leara kaddisha deyisrael kema deatte amer hinni mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael vaasara begavayehu temirin veinun desacharan ara kaddisha veda hu leela kegavena da letatta

Ribbi yehuda veribbi chiyya hao azle beorcha amar ribbi chiyya chavrayya kad inun beorcha
559: Bayan lemehach belibba chad vei iarau o azle begavayehu chayyave alma o bene nasha delav inun mehechala demalka bau leitparsha minnayehu mena lan mikkalev dichtiv veavdi chalev ekev hayeta ruach acheret immo vayemalle acharay may ruach acheret deitperash meinun meallelin dichtiv vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron deitperash meinun meallelin veata ihu bilchodoy lechevron leishtattecha al kivre avahan

Ella raza demilla shemana kegavena da ketiv vayyishal david bayeya lemor haeele beachat are yehuda vayyomer Adonai elav ale vayyomer david anna eele vayyomer chevrona hacha it leistakkela kevan deha mit shaul vedavid beome deshaul itmeshach lekabbela malchu kevan demit shaul amay la amlichu leh ledavid vela kabbil malchu al kal yisrael veata lechevron vmalchu kabbil al yehuda bilchodoy sheva shanim veitakkav tamman kal hane sheva shanim ulvatar demit ish boshet kabbil malchu al kal yisrael birushalayim

Vesimanicha vayyivnehu sheva shanim da alma illaa vela ketiv vayyivnehu besheva shanim kema deatte amer ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz man sheshet yamim da avraham dichtiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram beavraham veavraham sheshet yamim ikre uvgin deihu sheshet yamim itbene alma behahu gavena vayyivnehu sheva shanim

Man netivoteha illen inun netivot ushvilin denafke milleela vechullehu nakit lon berit yechiday deihu ikre shalom shelama deveta veail lon leyamma rabba kad ihu betukpeh uchden yahiv leh shelam hada hu dichtiv vechal netivoteha shalom atu ribbi yesa chizkiyya venashku leh amru uma kal hane millin illain temirin gabbach vela yadana azlu kad matu chad be chakal chamu beire deve chakal metin amru vadday dever diviyiri it baatar da

Ribbi yose veribbi chiyya hao azle beorcha amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyya amay atte shatik ha orcha la ittekan ella bemille deorayeta itnegid ribbi chiyya uvacha patach veamar vattehi saray akara en lah valad vay al da vay al hahu zimna deolidat hagar leyishmael

Adonai Adonai Adonai amar leh ribbi yose amay veha olidat levatar vahava lah bera giza kaddisha amar leh atte chame vaana chamena vehachi shemana mippumoy derabbi shimon milla uvachena vay al hahu zimna divgin desara itakkevat ketiv vattomer saray el avram vego bo na el shifchati vego veal da kayema shaata lehagar lemerat lesara gevirtah vahava lah bera meavraham

Veavraham amar lu yishmael yichye lefanecha veaf al gav dekudsha berich hu hava mevasser leh al yitzchak itdevak avraham beyishmael ad dekudsha berich hu ativ leh ulyishmael shematicha vego levatar itgezar veal bekayema kaddisha ad la yippuk yitzchak lealma

Vetta chaze arba mea shenin kayema hahu memana divni yishmael uvaa kame kudsha berich hu amar leh man deitgezar it leh chulaka bishmach amar leh in amar leh veha yishmael deitgezar amay let leh chulaka bach kemo yitzchak amar leh da itgezar kedeka yeot uchtikunoy veda lav hachi velo od ella deillen mitdabbekin bi kedeka yeot litmanya yomin veillen rechikin minni ad kamma yamim amar leh veim kal da kevan deitgezar la yehe leh agar tav begineh
Vay al hahu zimna deityelid yishmael bealma veitgezar ma aved kudsha berich hu archik lehu livne yishmael middevekuta dilela veyahav lehu chulaka letatta beara kaddisha begin hahu geziru dibbehon

Uzminin bene yishmael lemishlat beara kaddisha kad ihi rekanya mikkolla zimna saggi kema digziru dilhon berekanya belo shelimu veinun yeakkevun lehon livni yisrael leatava leduchtayehu ad deishtelim hahu zechuta divne yishmael

Uzminin bene yishmael leatara keravin takkifin bealma ulitkannesha beni edom alayehu veyitarun kerava behu chad al yamma vechad al yabbeshta vechad samuch lirushlem veyishletun illen beillen veara kaddisha la yitmesar livni edom

Behahu zimna yittear amma chad missayefe alma al romi chayyava veyiggach bah kerava telat yarchin veyitkanneshun tamman amamya veyippelun bidayehu ad deyitkanneshun kal beni edom alla mikkal sayefe alma uchden yittear kudsha berich hu alayehu hada hu dichtiv ki zevach layeya bevatzra vego ulvatar da ma ketiv leechoz bechanfot haaretz vego vishetze livne yishmael minah veyitbar kal chelin dilela vela yishtear chela leela al amma dealma ella chela deyisrael bilchodoy hada hu dichtiv Adonai tzillecha al yad yeminecha
