562: Vayyomer Adonai el moshe bo el paro ki ani hichbadti et libbo vego ribbi yehuda patach vamar ashre haam yode terua Adonai beor pancha yehallechun kamma itzterichu bene nasha lemehach bearche dekudsha berich hu ulmitar pikkude orayeta begin deyizkun bah lealma deate ulshezava lon mikkal kitrugin dilela vetatta begin deha kema deishtechachu mekatregin bealma letatta hachi name ishtechachu mekatregin leela dekayeme alayehu divne nasha

Inun deavdin pikkude orayeta veazle beorach meshar bidchala demarehon kamma inun sannegorin dekayemin alayehu leela kema deatte amar im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef vego uchtiv vayechunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer begin kach zakkaa ihu man denatir pikkude orayeta

Amar leh ribbi chiyya i hachi amay itzterich hacha malach delehevi sannegora aleh devar nash veha ketiv ki Adonai yihye bechislecha vshamar raglecha millached uchtiv Adonai yishmarcha mikkal ra deha chame kudsha berich hu kal ma devar nash avid bealma hen tav hen bish vechen hu omer im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai

Amar leh ribbi yehuda kolla hachi hu vadday aval ha ketiv vega el atzmo veel besaro uchtiv vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam leachazaa deha reshu itmesar lesitra achara lekatrega al millin dealma ulitmassera bidoy vechal illen archin temirin kame kudsha berich hu velet ante keday lemehach avatrayehu begin deinun nimmusin dekudsha berich hu uvne nasha lav inun rashshain ledakdeka avatrayehu bar inun zakkae keshot deyadin raze orayeta veazlin bearcha dechachmeta leminda inun millin setimin deorayeta

Ribbi elazar patach vayehi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai vayyavo gam hassatan betocham vayehi hayyom da rosh hashshana dekudsha berich hu kaim lemedan alma kegavena da vayehi hayyom vayyavo shamma hahu yoma yom tov derosh hashshana hava

Vayyavou bene haelohim illen ravrevin memanan shelichan bealma leashgecha beovadin divni nasha lehityatztzev al Adonai kema deatte amer vechal tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav mimino umissemolo aval lehityatztzev al Adonai behay kera ashkachna rechimuta dekudsha berich hu alayehu deyisrael begin dehane shelichan deinun memanan leashgacha al ovadin divne nasha azlin veshatin venatlin inun ovadin kullehu uvoma dekae dina lemekam lemedan alma itavidu kategorin lemekam alayehu divne nasha veta chaze mikkal ammin dealma la kayemin leashgacha beovadehon bar beyisrael bilchodayehu begin deillen benin lekudsha berich hu

Vechad la ishtechachu ovadin deyisrael kedeka yeot kivyachol inun memanan shelichan kad baan lekayema al inun ovadin deyisrael al Adonai vadday kayemin deha kad yisrael avdin ovadin dela kashran kivyachol mattishin chela dekudsha berich hu vechad avdin ovadin dechashran yahavin tukpa vechela lekudsha berich hu veal da ketiv tenu oz lelohim bema beovadin dechashran veal da behahu yoma kullehu ravrevan memanan itkanashu al Adonai al Adonai vadday deha kevan deal yisrael itkanashu aleh itkanashu
Vayyavo gam hassatan betocham gam leasgaa alayehu dechullehu atyan lemeheve kategorin alayehu deyisrael
563: Veda ittosaf alayehu begin deihu daltora ravreva mikkullehu kategora mikkullehu kevan dechama kudsha berich hu dechullehu atyan lekatrega miyyad vayyomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo vechi lo hava yada kudsha berich hu mean hava ate ella leayetaa ovada liruteh

Vayyomer Adonai el hassatan vego vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar mishshut baaretz mikkan olifna deyishshuva deara itmesar lesitrin acharanin bar ara deyisrael bilchodaha kevan deamar mishshut baaretz ashgach kudsha berich hu devae lemeheve daltora alayehu deyisrael miyyad vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz
Chama shaata lemehav leh chulaka bema deyitasak veyitperash minnayehu deyisrael veha ukmuha leraya devaa lemebar aneh bechad nahara vechu miyyad itassak beh hahu satan velo kitreg alayehu deyisrael
Vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim lav tavaha leavda demareh avid leh kal reuteh dihe dachil leh ade ashgachutach mineh vetechome i dachil lach veim lav

Ta chaze beshaata deaku kad ityehiv chulaka chada lehay setar leitasseka beh itperish levatar mikkolla kegavena da sair berosh chodesh sair beoma dechippure begin deitassak beh veshavik lehu leyisrael bemalchehon vehacha mata zimna lemetal chulaka da mikkal zara deavraham besitra achara kema deatte amer hinne yalda milka gam hi vego et utz bechoro vego

Vetta chaze beshaata deamar mishshut baaretz baa mineh lemebad dina beyisrael deha dina hava leh al avraham lemitba mekkudsha berich hu begin dela itavid dina beyitzchak kad itkeriv al gabbe madbecha deha la hava leh leachlefa karbena deazmin al madbecha baochara kema deatte amar lo yachalifennu vehacha kaim yitzchak al gabbe madbecha vela ishtelim minneh karbena vela itavid beh dina uvaa da meim kudsha berich hu kema devaa dinih deosef lechamma darin vechal ma devaa beorach dina baa

Umehahu zimna deishteziv yitzchak veitchallaf karbaneh zammin leh kudsha berich hu lehahu mekatrega hay lechulakeh kema deatte amer hinne yalda milka gam hi vego et utz bechoro vehacha mata lemetal chulakeh aleh mikkal zareh deavraham vela yikrav besitra achara

Vecholla bedina ata kema deihu dan hachi ittedan begin deiyyov mikkerive eta defaro hava vechad kam paro alayehu deyisrael baa lekatla lon amar leh la ella tol mamonehon ushlot al gufehon befulchana kashya vela tiktol lon amar leh kudsha berich hu chayyecha behahu dina mammash tehe dain ma ketiv ulam shelach na yadcha vega el atzmo veel besaro vego bema deihu dan hachi ittedan veaf al gav divchal shear hava dachil lekudsha berich hu

Ta chaze ma ketiv ach et nafsho shemor veityehiv leh reshu lemishlat al bisra begin raza dichtiv ketz kal basar ba lefanay veukmuha ba lefanay vadday veda ihu ketz kal basar velo rucha veitmar deihu ketz deate missitra dechoshech kema deatte amer ketz sam lachoshech ulchal tachlit hu choker ulchal bisra begin deit ketz achara veikre ketz hayyamin veda ihu ketz achara missitra dismala deihu choshech veal da ityehiv leh reshu beatzmo uvsaro

Vattesiteni vo levalleo i hachi lav bedina hava ella bememar hahu mekatrega deasit leh veaste leh ella kolla bedina hava vehachi amar lo elihu ki foal adam yeshallem lo uchorach ish yamtziennu vehachi hava kema deittemar kema deihu gazar hachi itgezar aleh

Vehay deamar vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam vattesiteni levalleo la ketiv ella vattesiteni vo beh kayema bedateh deihu chashiv deha tesiteni kema deamar veal atzat reshaim hofata kegavena da vayefattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo vayefattuhu vayechazzevu lo la ketiv ella vayefattuhu befihem befihem kayema milla da deha itpatta
564: Amar ribbi abba kolla hu shappir aval hachi olifna ditnan salik veastin vechi ihu yachil leastana in deha ihu melech zaken uchsil dichtiv tov yeled misken vechacham mimmelech zaken uchsil veal da yachil leastana levar nash may taama begin deihu meheman al ovadoy divne nasha

Ta chaze hay bedina deyachid aval bedina dealma ketiv vayyered Adonai lirot erada na vaere dela ityehiv mehemanuta ella bideh bilchodoy deha la baa leovada alma al memar dehahu mekatrega detiuvteh ihu tadir leshetzaa menalan dichtiv ketz sam lachoshech ulchal tachlit hu choker leshetzaa kolla hu choker veda ihu ketz kal basar ba lefanay vadday begin leshetzaa

Vetta chaze vayehi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai kema deittemar vehahu yoma kayemin teren sitrin lekabbela beni alma kal inun deatyan kame kudsha berich hu bituvta uvovadin tavin inun zachyan lemeheve ketivin legabbeh dehahu sitra deihu chayyim veappik totzot chayyim uman deihu missitreh achtiv lechayyim vechal inun deatyan beovadin bishin inun ketivin lehahu sitra achara deihu mota veikre mavet uveh sharya mota

Uvhahu yoma kayemin illen teren sitrin chayyim umavet it man deachtiv lesitra dechayyim veit man deachtiv lesitra demavet ulzimnin dealma sharya beemtzaita i kayema chad zakkaa bealma deachra alayehu kullehu kayemin veachtivu lechayyim vei chad chayyava achra alma kullehu achtivu lemita

Vehahu zimna alma hava kayyam beemtzaita vehahu mekatrega baa leastaa miyyad ma ketiv hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz vego kevan deishtemoda ihu bilchodoy miyyad atkif beh mekatrega veal da tanenan dela itzterich leh levar nash leitparsha mikkelala desaggiin begin dela yitreshim ihu bilchodoy vela yekatregun aleh leela

Dichtiv bashshunammit vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet la beena leappaka garmay mikkelala desaggiin betoch ammi yativna ad yoma da uvtoch ammi bichlala chada ishtemoda leela vehacha iyyov kevan deishtemoda leela veitreshim miyyad atkif beh mekatrega veamar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim kal ma dedachil lach veittakaf lav lemaggana avid halo atta sachta vaado uvad vego aval tol kal hay tava deante aved leh umiyyad im lo al pancha yevarchekka yishbok lach veyitdabbak besitra achara deha hashta befatorach ihu achil salik patorach mineh venecheze mimman ihu uvan sitra yitdabbak

Miyyad vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hinne chal asher lo beyadecha leachazaa didchilu deiyyov legabbeh dekudsha berich hu hu lenatra utreh umehacha olifna dechal inun dedachalin leh lekudsha berich hu al utrayehu o al benayehu lav ihu dechilu kedeka yeot veal da kitreg hahu mekatrega veamar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim halo atta sachta vaado vego maase yadav berachta veal da ihu dachil lach veityehiv leh reshu lekatrega beh ulachazaa dela palach iyyov lekudsha berich hu birchimu
Dechevan deitnasse nafak meorcha vela kaim bekiumeh ma ketiv bechal zot la chata iyyov bisfatav lo chata bisfatav aval biruteh chata ulvatar chata becholla
Vei tema dela itnasse bar nash ha ketiv Adonai tzaddik yivchan vego uvgin kach itnasse iyyov veaf al gav dela kaim bekiumeh kedeka yeot la nafak mittechot reshuta demareh leitdabbeka besitra achara
Vechamma hava hahu nissuta dileh teresar yarche shultanuta dehahu sitra achara kema detanenan dina dechayyavaya baggehinnam yarche uvgin dela itdabbak besitra achara ketiv vayeya berach et
565: Shimon amar hay deiyyov lav nissuta ihu dekudsha berich hu kenisuta dishar tzaddikayya deha la ketiv vehaelohim nissa et iyyov kema dichtiv vehaelohim nissa et avraham deavraham ihu bideh akriv livreh yechiday dileh legabbe kudsha berich hu veiyyov la yahiv kelum vela masar leh lekudsha berich hu kelum

Vela ittemar leh deha galle kameh dela yachil lekayema beh aval itmesar bida dimkatrega uvdina dekudsha berich hu itavid vekudsha berich hu ittear dina da lehahu mekatrega legabbeh hada hu dichtiv hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov vego

Patach veamar vayehi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama mikketz yamim velo mikketz yamin ihu dacha leketz yamin veitkeriv leketz yamim veha okimna veatta lech leketz veamar daniel lean ketz leketz hayyamin o leketz hayyamim ad deamar leh leketz hayyamin veal da david dachil veamar hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi o leketz hayyamim o leketz hayyamin vehacha ma ketiv vayehi mikketz yamim velo mikketz yamin uvgin kach la itkabbal karbaneh deha missitra achara hava

Ta chaze ma ketiv vehevel hevi gam hu may gam hu leasgaa da beda karbaneh lekudsha berich hu hava kolla veikara dekarbena lekudsha berich hu veyahav chulaka lesitra achara kema deatte amer umechelvehen vekayin ikara aved mikketz yamim raza desitra achara veyahiv chulaka lekudsha berich hu veal da la itkabbal

Beiyyov ma ketiv vehalchu vanav veasu mishte vego veshalchu vekaru lishloshet achotehem leechol velishtot immahem vayehi ki hikkifu yeme hammishte vego uvmishteya bechal yoma mekatrega shechiach vela yachil leh mena lan dichtiv halo atta sachta vaado uvad beto uvad kal asher lo missaviv ulolam la yahiv chulaka kelal legabbeh deha ketiv veheela olot mispar kullam ola salleka leela leela vela yahiv chulaka lesitra achara deilmale yahav leh chulaka la yachil leh levatar vechal ma denatal middileh natal

Vei tema amay avish leh kudsha berich hu ella deilmale yahav leh chulaka yifni archa veyistelak meal makdesha vesitra dikdushsha istelik leela leela veihu la aved ken veal da kudsha berich hu tava bedina

Ta chaze kema deihu itperash vela achlil tov vara ihu dan leh behahu gavena yahiv leh tov ulvatar ra ulvatar ahadreh letov dehachi itchaze lebbar nash leminda tov ulminda ra ulahdara garmeh letov veda ihu raza dimhemanuta ta chaze iyyov meavde paro hava veda hu dichtiv beh hayyare et devar Adonai meavde paro ta chaze dela baa kudsha berich hu leaakara iyyov meatreh deihu hava michse al paro kevan deitchalash avad nukmin lefaro

Amar ribbi shimon hashta it legallaa razin deinun mitdabbekin leela vetatta ma ketiv bo el paro lech el paro mibbae leh may bo ella deayil leh kudsha berich hu iddarin batar iddarin legabbe tannina chada illaa takkifa dechamma dargin mishtalshelen minneh uman ihu raza dehattannin haggadol
Umoshe dachil minneh vela kariv ella legabbe inun yeorin veinun dargin dileh aval legabbeh dachil vela kariv begin dechama leh mishtarish besharashin illain

Kevan dechama kudsha berich hu dedachil moshe ushlichan memanan acharanin leela la yachlin lekarva legabbeh amar kudsha berich hu hinni alecha paro melech mitzrayim hattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav vekudsha berich hu itzterich leaggacha beh kerava velo achara kema deatte amar ani Adonai veukmuha raza dechachmeta dehattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav leinun mare middin deyadin berazin demarehon

Patach rabbi shimon veamar vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim veet kal nefesh hachayya haromeset asher shartzu hammayim leminehem hay kera ukmuha leh aval vayyivra elohim et hattanninim hu raza da
566: Liveyatan uvat zugo tanninim chaser ketiv begin dekatal lenukba vesalleka kudsha berich hu letzaddikayya veukmuha

Hattannim haggadol tesha yeorin inun deihu ravitz benayehu vechad yeora ihu dememav shechichin uvrechan dememin deginta naflin beh telat zimnin beshatta vechad teren zimnin mitbarech hahu yeora velo kal kach vechad chad lav hachi

Vehay tannina al behahu yeora ittakif veazil veshat al go yamma uvala nunin lechamma zinin veshalit vetav lehahu yeora illen tisha yeorin azlin vesallekin vesacharaneh kamma ilanin vaasavin lezinayehu

Yeora kadmaa nafka missitra semala bechad tzinnora denagid venafik telat tippin vechal tippa vetippa itperash litlat tippin vechal tippa vetippa itavid minneh yeora chad veillen inun tisha yeorin demittakfin veazlin veshatan vesacharan bechal inun rekiin
Mimma deishtear meinun tippin kad sayemin lemefak ishtear tippa chada denafka bishchichu nafal benayehu veitavid minneh yeora chada hay yeora ihu hahu deamaran deazla bishchichu

Hay yeora kad hahu nahar denagid venafik appik tippin acharanin ravreva missitra dimina ma deishtear meinun tippin ishtear tippa chada bishchichu meinun birkan venafal behahu yeora deihu shachich vehay ihu yeora deadif mikkullehu

Kad nafkin umitparshan inun arba naharin denafkin migginta deeden hahu deikre pishon nafil behahu yeora veitkelil beh veal da malchut bavel itkelil behay ufishon ihu malchut bavel miyeora da ittezanu veitmalyan kal inun yeorin acharanin

Bechal yeora viora azla veshat chad tannina veinun tesha vechal chad vechad nakiv nukba beresheh kema deatte amer shibbarta rashe tanninim vego vaafilu hay hattannin haggadol hachi hu begin dechullehu nafchin ruchin legabbe ela velo letatta

Ketiv bereshit bara elohim uchtiv vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim bechal ovada deinun eser amiran kayemin lekavlayehu inun eser yeorin vechad tannina mitparpera berucha lekavel kal chad vechad

Veal da chad leshivin shenin mizdaza alma begin dehay hattannin haggadol kad hu salik senappiroy veizdaza keden kullehu mizdazean beinun yeorin vechal alma mizdazea veara mitchalchelet vechullehu kelilan behay tannin haggadol

Vehaaretz hayeta tohu vego amar ribbi shimon ovada divreshit chavrayya laan beh veyadin beh aval zeirin inun deyadin lerammeza ovada divreshit beraza detannin haggadol veal da tanenan dechal alma la mishtalshela ella al senappiroy deda

Ta chaze vehaaretz hayeta tohu vavohu vego tanenan hayeta veokimna begin dibbehay yeora kadmaa dekamran kad hay hattannin haggadol al beh keden itmalya vesati vedaich nitzotzin deitlekatu beinun almin deitcharavu bekadmita

Inun tanninin acharanin dekamran hao vela hao amay begin deitchalash chelayehu dela yetashteshun alma bar leshivin shenin chad zimna veinun ittekafu bechela dehahu tannin haggadol vehay ihu bilchodoy leittatkefa veilmale nukveh kayyemet legabbeh la yachil alma lemisbal lon
Ad la katal kudsha berich hu lenukba haaretz hayeta tohu tohu hayeta ulvatar dekatal lah hava bohu sharat leitkayema vechoshech al ad la havat nehira ovada deavad

Me avid kudsha berich hu machatz resheh didchura leela veitkafya begin deha tehoma letatta la hava nahir may tama la hava nahir begin dehay hattannin haggadol hava nashiv rucha al tehoma veachshich leh vela merafrefa letatta

Veavar rucha achara dilela venashav uvatash behahu rucha veshachich leh hada hu dichtiv veruach elohim merachefet al peni hammayim vehayenu detanenan dekudsha berich hu batash rucha berucha uvara alma
Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayehi or nahir nehiru dilela uvatash
567: Al gabbe rucha denashiv veistallak meal tehoma vela chafa leh kevan dithoma itnehir veihu istallak keden hava nehiru

Da nahir al resheh umayya hao nafke miggo afuteh verucha nashiv leela venahir minnehiru da ad dehava nachit nehoreh menatznetza leshivin utren nehorin deshimsha kevan deinun nehorin itreshimu bego shimsha letatta hao chayyavayya dealma yadin behu vahau palchin leshimsha kevan deistakkal kudsha berich hu beinun chayyavayya salik nehoreh veganiz leh amay ganiz leh begin dehahu tannin hava salik venachit uvatash beinun yeorin ad deganaz leh vela itgalya
Vezara leh zerua bechad tzaddik deihu gannana deginta uzrua dezara beginta bignizu bitmiru dehay or ihu

Kad hay hattannin haggadol chame detzamach beginta zerua deor da keden ittear lesitra achara lehahu nahar deikre gichon veitpelagu memoy dehay gichon chad shevila dileh ihu azil go hahu zerua deatzmecha go ginta veanhir beh birvu dizrua da veikre gichon

Umiggo hahu revu dizrua da istelak lirvu deshelomo malka kad istelak lemalchu dichtiv vehoradtem oto el gichon uchtiv umashach oto sham sham velo baatar achara begin dehava yada david malka da umemoy acharanin istalaku lemalchu achara veda ihu malka deihu takkifa

Vehay hattannin haggadol ittear leh veistallak senappiroy dehay tannin behahu nahar leittatkefa beh vechal inun shear yeorin kullehu sallekin venachtin bettukpa dehay hattannin haggadol vetaav veal lehahu yeora shechicha veishtechach beh

Uchden kad hahu or itgeniz leiula leh hahu gannana dekamran keden nafak choshech kadmaa uvatash al resheh behahu nukba deitmattecha beh veitperash chad chuta ben hahu nehiru deor da deitgeniz uven hahu chashocha dechoshech da dichtiv vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech
Hay tannin tav behahu perishu dehay chuta deafrish veafrish leinun yeorin go chashocha veitperashu nunin lezinayehu illen meillen behahu perishu
Vechad itperashu mayin illain kaddishin kal inun yeorin itperashu vealu lego hahu yeora shechicha deitberir mikkullehu venafik vealin beh telat zimnin beoma

Vechal inun nunin dimgaddelan go inun yeorin perishan illen meillen veikrun lelot veillen inun rashin lechal inun nunin denafkin levar veillen shaltin al kullehu veillen ikrun bechore mitzrayim umehacha itbadar levar buchrin vechullehu ittezanu mishshaku deinun yeorin vehay hattannin haggadol shalta al kullehu

Vecholla bifrishu demayin illain dichtiv vihi mavdil ben mayim lamayim veitreshimu mayin kaddishin illain veitperashu leela umayin tattain itperashu kullehu illen meillen kaddishin udla kaddishin veal da ikrun malachin illain perishan begin deitperashu illen meillen lezinayehu

Vayyomer elohim tadshe haaretz deshe esev mazria zera raza da kad hay hattannin haggadol hava nashiv rucha behahu nukba umrafrefa legabbe ela kal inun asavin hava mehappech lon livishu ad derucha achara nashiv behahu rucha veshachich leh letatta vaasavin tzamchu kemillekaddemin veshaltin umshabbechan veodan kame kudsha berich hu

Missetar semala ulgo yeora shechicha nafkin beirin lezinayehu veazlin lemikrav legabbe deinun asavin vela yachlin vetavin leatrayehu kal illen yeorin azlin veshatin im hahu tannina deshalit behu vesacharin leinun asavin vela yachlin bar lezimnin derucha illaa la nashiv veihu merafrefa rucha behahu nukba dilela kema deokimna keden shalit hahu rucha al inun asavin

Viora shechicha tav leatreh vesalleka venachta uvgin dememoy shechichin azil bishchichu vehay hattannim haggadol salleka legabbe inun yeorin vaasavin kullehu megaddelan sacharaneh dehahu yeora shechicha veillen megaddelin bechal ivar keden salleka hahu tannina veitrabbe benayehu vetav lechal inun yeorin
Vayyomer elohim yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim da ihu nachash bariach amay bariach begin desagir litren sitrin vela nafik lealmin ella chad zimna leovla
Uvsifre kadmae da nachash akallaton deihu beakkimu tadir veayete levatin al alma kad hay kam ittevar tukpeh
568: Dehahu tannina vela yachil lemekam ad deavid gishmeh begin dekudsha berich hu kafif leh go yamma kad al legabbeh veihu darach al tukpeh deyamma vetukpeh deyamma da ihu tannina kema deatte amer vedorech al bamote yam

Vechad hay nachash kam keden ma ketiv veharag et hattannin asher bayyam da ihu hattannin haggadol veal da ketiv hinni alecha veda nachash ihu meorot bilvatin lecholla begin deihu takkifa aleh betukpeh dehahu nahar ravreva deikre chiddekel veha okimna

Hahu nachash ihi beyabbeshta kad nafkin da beda da divyabbeshta ittekaf tadir begin dechal orchoy vetokfoy beyabbeshta ihu veachil ara veafra tadir kema deatte amer veafar tochal kal yeme chayyecha da gaddil beafra veda gaddil bemayya nachash deitgaddil bemayya lav takkifa kehay deitgaddil beyabbeshta veal da ketiv meorot chaser

Veda izdaman legabbe hahu demayya veaf al gav deizdeman legabbeh la agach legabbeh ella kudsha berich hu bilchodoy dekatil leh miggo yamma kema deokimna begin gassut rucha deveh kema deatte amer asher amar li yeori vego

Veavar Adonai lingof et mitzrayim vego tana amar ribbi yose hay kera kashya vechi veraa et haddam veachar kach ufasach demashma desimana hu deavid vei tema begin dama deihu mitzva amay levar vaamay bitlat duchte defitcha veha ketiv hu galle amikata vego umay tama baa deitgalya dama al hammashkof veal shette hammezuzot

Ella tana ketiv vayyar Adonai vayyinatz uchtiv vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baaretz vetanenan la itchaze ashgachuta dilela ella kad itchaze letatta ovada deitavedu ovada minneh veal da la mashgichin bar hirhura deavoda zara dichtiv hishshamru lachem pen yifte levavchem umiddeitaved ovada ashgachuta dilela ittear uvgin kach kolla ben letav uven levish beovada talya milleta
Amar ribbi yose kal shevake mitzrayim malyan taavan hao veod divchal beta uveta hao shechiche zinin demitkatre becharashayehu beinun kitrin tattain diltatta umitarin ruach misava begavayehu

Veraza demilla tana ketiv ulkachtem aguddat ezov utvaltem baddam asher bassaf vehiggatem el hammashkof veel shette hammezuzot aguddat ezov lamma begin levaara ruach misava mibbenayehu Adonai Adonai ulachazaa befitchayehu behane telat duchte mehemanuta shelemata chad hacha vechad hacha vechad begavayehu begin kach ufasach Adonai al happetach velo yitten hammashchit lavo el battechem lingof mishshum dechame shema kaddisha rashim al pitcha
Amar ribbi yehuda i hachi amay dama deha tanenan chivar vesumak vechad dechalil bene gavene amar leh tere dame hao chad demila vechad defischa demila rachame defischa dina

Amar ribbi yehuda lav hachi ella kema deolifna deachzar hahu dama kudsha berich hu lerachame keilu hao chivar bego gavene hada hu dichtiv vaeevor alayich vaerech mitboseset bedamayich veomar lach bedamayich chayi vego veaf al gav dehava sumaka itchazar lerachame dichtiv bedamayich chayi uvgin kach rashim pitcha bitlat sitrin chad hacha vechad hacha vechad benayehu
Tane chizkiyya teren dame itchazu lakovel tere kitrin deitchazu leela behahi shaata amar ribbi yose chad kitra dichlila bitren sitrin temirin

588: Hada hu dichtiv vayyakam paro dekam lekatala ulshetzaa

Orchoy dechalba kad machyan leh beavna ihu ate venashich lechavreh kach paro levatar ihu hava azil bashshevake vahava machriz veamar kumu tzeu mittoch ammi attun kataltun lechal beni mata attun kataltun sarche veafarche vechal bene beti hada hu dichtiv vayyikra lemoshe ulaharon layela kevan devidchon hava kolla uverachtem gam oti dela tiktelun li levatar ihu begarmeh ozif lon veappik lon meara hada hu dichtiv vayehi beshallach paro et haam vego

Vayyassev elohim et haam derech hammidbar yam suf letakkena archa leatreh yehuda amar may shena kad hao yisrael bemitzrayim dichtiv shallach et ammi ki im maen atta leshalleach et ammi beni vechori yisrael uvhahu zimna la hao gezirin vela itkashsharu beh kedeka yeot vehacha dahao gezirin veavdu pischa veitkashsharu beh kare lon et haam

Ella begin hahu erev rav deitdevaku behu veitarvu bahadayehu kare lon et haam setam kema deatte amer vayyiggof Adonai et haam al asher asu et haegel vayyikkahel haam al aharon vayyar haam ki voshesh moshe vechen kullehu

Yitzchak yehuda hao azle meusha lelud vahava immehon yose tayyaa biktira degammale atufira bechatfayehu ad dahao azle ashkach hahu yose tayyaa intu chada dishar ammin dekatir biroke chakla ishtemit minnayehu veatkif bah veata alla tavehu yitzchak yehuda amru netuv mearcha da deha kudsha berich hu baa leachzaa lan dela nitchabbar bahadeh tavu mearcha badku batreh veashkachu divreh devat el nichar hava vaavuha pasil zara hava amru berich rachamana desheziv lan

Patach yitzchak veamar al titchar bammereim man inun mereim dela ketiv chattaim o reshaim ella meriim deavishin legarmayehu ulhani demitchabberan bahadayehu yehuda amar mereim archek garmach mimmereim dela tehon reim vachaverim kachada dela yavishu lach ovadoy vetitpas bechetoy

Ta chaze i la hao inun erev rav deitchabberu behon yisrael la itavid hahu ovada vela mitu miyyisrael kal inun demitu vela garim lon leyisrael kal ma degarim vetta chaze hahu ovada vehahu chova mammash garim galuthon deyisrael

Detanenan baa kudsha berich hu deyishtakkechun yisrael behahu shaata kemalache illae ulmebad lon cherin mikkolla cherin mimmota ulmeheve cherin min shibuda dishar ammin kema deatte amer charut al halluchot al tikre charut ella cherut

Kevan deitavid hahu ovada garimu kolla garimu mota garimu shibud malkevan garimu deittebbaru inun luche kadmae garimu demitu miyyisrael kamma alfin minnayehu vechal da begin itchabberuta deinun erev rav deitchabberu behu

Uf hacha beginehon la itkerun beni yisrael vela yisrael vela ammi ella haam setam vei tema vachamushim alu bene yisrael kad hao sallekin mimmitzrayim vela itchabberu bahadayehu inun erev rav kare lon bene yisrael kevan deitchabberu bahadayehu dichtiv vegam erev rav ala ittam kare lon haam

Ribbi yose akshe veamar ketiv ki asher reitem et mitzrayim hayyom lo tosifu lirotam od ad olam i hachi kal yoma hao chaman lehahu erev rav amar ribbi yehuda erev rav ketiv velo mitzrayim deha kamma shear ammin hao dayere bemitzrayim velo od ella dechullehu itgezaru vechevan deitgezaru la ikrun mitzrae
Veal puma demoshe kabbilu lon vehayenu ma
589: Deamar hakkatuv lech red ki shichet ammecha saru maher min hadderech asher tzivitim tzivitam ketiv vachamushim alu beni yisrael meeretz mitzrayim chad mechamishsha hao ver yose omer chamishsha miyyisrael vechad minnayehu ribbi yehuda omer vachamushim echad mechamishshim

Amar rabbi shimon begin dehahu yovla salik lon mimmitzrayim begin kach vachamushim alu bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim vei lav la seliku veal da itakkevu chamshin yomin lekabbela orayeta umehahu atar nafkat orayeta veityehivat veal da vachamushim chaser divgin da alu bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim

Vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef vego amay salik garmoy ella begin dehava resha lenachta legaluta velo od ella deihu simana digula hava leh veume lehu leyisrael al da hada hu dichtiv ki hashbea hishbia et bene yisrael veha ittemar

Zakkaa chulaka demoshe deyisrael hao aske lemishal mamona mimmitzrae umoshe hava asik beumaa deosef veit deamre arona benilus hava uvishma kaddisha salik leh veod amar moshe yosef higia zeman purkana deyisrael veamar ale shor vesalik veit deamre ben malche mitzrae hava umittamman salik veit deamre begin dela yaavdun leh avoda zara shao benilus veserach bat asher chaviat leh lemoshe

Vayeya holech lifnehem yomam ribbi yose patach lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar mizmor ledavid kamma chaviva orayeta kameh dekudsha berich hu dechal man deishtaddal beorayeta rachim hu leela rachim hu letatta kudsha berich hu atzit leh lemiluloy la shavik leh behay alma vela shavik leh bealma deate

Veorayeta bae lemile bah bimama uvlelya dichtiv vehagita bo yomam valayela uchtiv im lo veriti yomam valayela vego tinach bimama belelya amay begin diyehe shechiach legabbe shema kaddisha shelim kema delet yomam bela lelya velav ihu shelim ella da im da kach bae orayeta leishtakkecha immeh debbar nash yoma velelya lemeheve shelemuta legabbe debbar nash yomam valayela

Veha ittemar deikara delelya mippalguta veilach veaf al gav defalgu kadmita bichlala delelya hu aval befalgut lelya kudsha berich hu al beginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikayya uchden bae leh levar nash lemekam ulmile beorayeta

Veha ittemar dekudsha berich hu vechal tzaddikayya divginta deeden kullehu tzayetin lekalleh hada hu dichtiv hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashmiini veha ukmuha hayyoshevet baggannim da keneset yisrael deihi meshabbachat leh lekudsha berich hu bishvacha deorayeta belelya zakkaa chulakeh man deishtattaf bahadah leshabbecha leh lekudsha berich hu bishvacha deorayeta

Vechad ate tzafra keneset yisrael atya umishtashea beh bekudsha berich hu veoshit lah legabbah sharvita dechesed vela alla bilchodaha ella alla veal inun demishtattefin bahadah veha ittemar dichtiv yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayela vego veal da ayyelet hashshachar ikre

Veamar rabbi shimon beshaata devae leitnahara tzafra itchashach veitkaddar nehora vekadruta ishtechach keden itchabberat itteta bevalah detanenan ishsha mesapperet im balah lemishtae bahadeh vealat lehechleh

Levatar kad bae shimsha lemeal itnehir veatat lelya venatil leh keden kal tarin setimin vechamrin naarin vechalbin navchin kad itpelag lelya shaari malka lemekam umatronita lezammera veate malka veakish letara dehechla veamar pitchi li achoti rayati vego uchden mishtaasha benishmathon detzaddikayya

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu deittear hahu zimna bemille deorayeta begin da kal inun divne hechla dematronita kullehu bayan lemekam behahu zimna leshabbecha lemalka vechullehu meshabbechan kameh ushvacha desalik mehay alma da deihu rachik da nicha leh lekudsha berich hu mikkolla
Kad istelik lelya veate tzafra veitkaddar keden malka umatronita beraza bechedva veyahiv lah mattenan ulchal bene hechlah zakkaa chulakeh man deihu beminyana

590: Amar ribbi yitzchak hayenu detanenan shechinta baavahata natla holech lifnehem yomam da avraham beammud anan da yitzchak lanchotam hadderech da yaakov dichtiv beh veyaakov halach ledarko velayela beammud esh lehair lahem da david malka

Vechullehu reticha illaa kaddisha lemehach yisrael bishlimuta decholla begin deyechozun avahan purkana dilhon dichtiv veanochi aalcha gam alo im hammerkava uchtiv vayeya holech vego lalechet yomam velayela vechi amay hao azle yomam velayela yahachun bimama vela yahachun belelya kivni enasha dearkin kevan dekudsha berich hu natir lon amay azlin bimama uvlelya ella leishtakkecha behu shelemuta decholla delet shelimu ella yom velayela

Amar ribbi abba hachi okimna vayeya holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan da avraham velayela beammud esh da yitzchak vei hachi yaakov an hu ella bemilla kadmaa ittemar vetamman shaari kema dichtiv vayeya

Velayela beammud esh hava nahir besitra da uvda begin deyirdefun mitzrae batrehon leityakra shema dekudsha berich hu birtichoy ufarashoy begin lemezal yemama velelya aspakalarya denahara udla nahara vetu begin leataa lemitzrae deyemrun mikre hu dichtiv noalu sare tzoan uchtiv meshiv chachamim achor veal da azle bimama uvlelya

Ribbi abba amar zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael dekudsha berich hu appik lon mimmitzrayim lemeheve chulakeh veachasanteh vetta chaze besitra deovla ishtechach cheru leyisrael vechen lezimna deate dichtiv vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol vego
Uvgin hahu yovla illaa itakkevu chamshin yomin lekabbela orayeta ulmikrav letura desinay vechevan deazle biyemama azle belelya lemehve kolla chad yoma ben yemama velelya vela ishtechach perishu

Velo od ella dechullehu benayecha azlin liruta denafshayehu beoma dekabbilu orayeta hao chamshin yomin shelemin yome velele kedeka yeot delet yom belo layela velet layela belo yom velayela veom ikre yom echad vechevan deazlu chamshin yomin shelemin keden sharu alayehu inun yomin deovla umissitra deovla ityehiv lehu orayeta uvgin kach azlin yoma velelya

Veamar ribbi abba ketiv vayehi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav amay ha okimna man derachim lachayyava hachi hu vetta chaze beyitzchak itkelil lelya velelya lo bahir veal da vattichhena enav vecholla chad

Yitzchak patach veamar vayyuggad lemelech mitzrayim ki barach haam vayyuggad man kaamar leh ella ha ukmuha aval chachmoy vecharshoy itkenashu legabbeh veoduhu ki barach haam vaamay kamru da ella chamu bechachmeta dilhon dahao azle yemama velelya amru vadday arkin inun velo od ella dechamu dela hao azle beorach meshar kema dichtiv veyyashuvu veyyachanu lifne pi hachirot

Vayyikkach shesh meot rechev bachur chiyya amar ketiv yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom veal malche haadama al haadama bezimna dekudsha berich hu yahiv shultanuta leravreve ammin leela yahiv lehu leamma dilhon letatta uvshaata denachit lon middargehon dilela nachit lon leamma letatta vayyikkach shesh meot rechev bachur ha memana dilhon veukmuha dedavar retichin dishar ammin vechullehu naflu bemashrita desisra levatar vehayenu bachur vechol rechev mitzrayim

591: Ta chaze paro beshaata dehava radif avatrayehu deyisrael ma aved natal susvan nukvan vechafat lon birtichoy bekadmita vesusin duchrae kafat lon laachorehon vahau mezayenin duchre lakovel nukve venukve la baan veochan lemezal kevan dekariv legabbayehu deyisrael natal nukve veshave lon laachore vesusvan duchrin lekadmin leavasha leyisrael ulaggacha behu kerava
Kegavena da vayeya holech lifnehem yomam uvatar chazra shechinta laachorehon deyisrael dichtiv vayyissa malach haelohim vego begine kach dimmitich rayati
Ufaro hikriv vehay kera ha ukmuha deakriv lechal cheloy urtichoy leaggacha kerava vetu ufaro hikriv ribbi yose amar ha ittemar dekariv lon litshuva ufaro hikriv

Ketiv Adonai batztzar pekaducha tzakun lachash vego batztzar pekaducha la pakdin yisrael lekudsha berich hu beshaata denayecha ella beshaata deakin lehu uchden kullehu pakdin leh tzakun lachash vechullehu tzallan bitzlotin uvvautin veariku kameh tzelotin ematay musarcha lamo beshaata defakid lon kudsha berich hu birtzuoy keden kudsha berich hu kaim alayehu berachame venicha kameh hahu kala dilhon begin leitpara min sanehon veitmele alayehu berachame

Kema deokimna metal leona im hannitz vechu kach yisrael hao kerivin leyamma vahau chaman leyamma kamayehu azil vesair vegalgallohi zakfin leela hao dechilin zakfu enayehu vechamu lefaro ulmashiryateh veavne girin uvallisterain keden vayyiru meod ma avdu vayyitzaku bene yisrael man garim hay dekarivu yisrael legabbe avuhon dilela paro hada hu dichtiv ufaro hikriv veha ittemar

Vayyomer moshe el haam al tirau hityatztzevu uru et yeshuat Adonai amar ribbi shimon zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael deha raya kemmoshe azil begavayehu ketiv vayyizkor yeme olam moshe ammo vayyizkor yeme olam da kudsha berich hu moshe ammo shakil hava moshe kechal yisrael veolifna meha ki raya deamma hu mammash amma kullehu i ihu zache amma kullehu zachan vei ihu la zache amma kullehu la zachan veitanashu begineh veha ukmuha

Hityatztzevu uru let lechu leaggacha kerava deha kudsha berich hu yaggiach kerava beginechon kema deatte amer Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun ta chaze hahu lelya kanash kudsha berich hu leppamalya dileh vedain dinayehu deyisrael veilmale deakdimu avahan alayehu deyisrael la ishtezivu min dina ribbi yehuda amar zechuta deyaakov aggin alayehu deyisrael hada hu dichtiv lule Adonai shehaya lanu yomar na yisrael yisrael sava

Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun ribbi abba patach im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beom kadshi zakkain inun yisrael dekudsha berich hu itrae behon leitdabbeka behu mikkal shear ammin dealma umiggo rechimuta dilhon kariv lon legabbeh veyahav lon orayeta veyahav lon shabbat deihu kaddisha mikkal shear yomin venayecha mikkolla vechedva decholla veshakil shabbat lakovel orayeta kella uman denatir shabbat keilu natir orayeta kulla

Vekarata lashshabbat oneg innuga decholla innuga denafsha vegufa innuga deillain vetattain vekarata lashshabbat may vekarata deyazmin leh kema deatte amer mikrae kodesh kelomar zeminin kema dimzammin ushpiza leveteh veal da vekarata lashshabbat oneg deyazmin leh kema dimzamnin ushpiza befatora metakkena beveta metakkena kedeka yeot bemechla uvmishteya kedeka yeot yattir al shear yomin vekarata lashshabbat mibbeod yom likdosh Adonai mechubbad da yom kippurim tere deinun chad vechibbadto measot
592: Mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar veha ittemar begin dehahi milla salleka veittear milla dechol leela man dimzammin ushpiza beh bae leishtaddela vela baachora

Ta chaziyi hahu milla denafik mippumeh devar nash salleka veittear itaruta leela i letav i levish uman deyativ beinnuga deshabbeta asir leh leitteara milla dechol deha pagim pegimu beoma kaddisha man deyativ behilula demalka la yitchaze lemishbak lemalka veyitassek beachara
Uvchal yoma bae leachazaa ovada ulitara ataruta mimma deitzterich uvshabbat bemille dishmayya uvikdushsha deoma bae leitteara vela bemilla achara

Ta chaze hacha kad itkeriv paro leaggacha kerava behu beyisrael behahi zimna la bae kudsha berich hu deyittearun yisrael itaruta letatta kelal deha itaruta leela hu deha avahan akdimu veattearu itaruta da leela uzchuta dilhon kaim kameh vela baa kudsha berich hu deyisrael yittearun letatta kelal hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun tacharishun vadday vela titarun milla dela itzterich lechu vehacha itkelil shema kaddisha beatvan reshiman veha itaru beh chavrayya

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda hao azle bearcha amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda vadday tannina Adonai bechal atar rachame veaf al gav deaggach kerava veavid dina hahu dina birchimuta hu vehacha chamena dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem vela itchaze behahu dina rachame kelal deha ketiv lo nishar bahem ad echad

Amar leh milla da shemana meribbi shimon deamar deafilu hacha dina berachame hava dechafa alehon yamma umitu ulvatar appik lon yamma vekudsha berich hu baa bikarehon veitkevaru beara vela baat ara lekabbela lon ad deoshit lah kudsha berich hu yemineh vekabbilat lon hada hu dichtiv natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz uvgin da hay dina berachame hava

Veal da la baa kudsha berich hu deyittearun yisrael milla bealma dei yitarun yisrael milla la yitarun shema derachame vela yitavid dina berachame hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun dela titarun midi deha shema derachame bae leitteara alayehu lemebad dina berachame veal da bae dela taavdun pegimu vetitarun milla achara

Amar leh veha ketiv veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem i hachi da dina berachame hava amar leh hachi hava vadday dina hu berachame demota dilhon la ishtechach kemotana dishar bene alma ella chas alayehu kudsha berich hu dela yehon kemotana dishar bene alma dekatilu lon ella benachat belo tzaara ha dina berachame ihu
Uvchal atar shema da dina berachame ihu bar atar chad dichtiv Adonai kagibbor yetze vego vechi kagibbor velo gibbor ella yeshanne levushoy veyilbash levushin acharanin keish milchamot yeshanne zineh

Veim kal da dina hu yattir aval rachame beh kema dichtiv kagibbor velo gibbor keish milchamot velo ish milchamot devadday af al gav deavid dina chas al ovadoy veal da Adonai yillachem lachem vadday veattem tacharishun zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael dekudsha berich hu barir lon lechulakeh veachasanteh dichtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay milla da ha ukmuha besifra ditzniuta vetamman hu raza dileh vayyomer Adonai el moshe yehuda patach veamar vayyitpallel yona el Adonai elohav mimmee haddaga ma ketiv leela vayeman Adonai dag gadol vayeman kema deatte amer vayeman lahem hammelech devar yom beomo asher minnah et maachalchem
593: Mibbae leh vayeman Adonai et yona laddag dehu mana hu dimshadder leh ella vadday hahu dag hu hava mana leona lenatra leh min shear nuni yamma veyehve ganiz begaveh vechevan deaaleh begaveh chama yona bemeoy putya daatar yamma kemo hechla ravreva utren enoy dehahu nuna denaharin keshimsha veeven tava hava bemeoy denahir leh vahava chame kal ma di beyamma uvithomoy

Vei tema i hachi may dichtiv karati mitztzara li ha la itchaze dechal hay revacha hava leh ella vadday kevan deachme leh hahu nuna kal ma di beyamma uvithomoy mit dela yachil telat yomin lemisbal keden akat leh leona

Deamar ribbi elazar kevan dechama yona kal hahu revacha hava chadde amar kudsha berich hu uma tive yattir leha ailna lach hacha ma avad katal lehahu nuna umit vechal shear nune yamma hao sachare sacharanih dehahu nuna da nashich leh mehay gisa veda nashich leh mehay gisa keden chama yona garmoy beaku miyyad vayyitpallel yona el Adonai

Bekadmita dag vehashta daga kema deatte amer vehaddaga asher bayeor meta uchden ketiv karati mitztzara li vela ketiv hayiti batztzara o yashavti batztzara ella karati mehahu aku deakin li nuni yamma mibbeten sheol shivati deha mit vela ketiv mibbeten chay o mibbeten dag ella devadday hava mit

Ma ketiv vayyitpallel yona el Adonai elohav mimmee haddaga laatar dehava kashir beh mashma dichtiv Adonai elohav vela ketiv vayyitpallel el Adonai vela yattir ella Adonai elohav uf hacha vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay elay dayeka

Dabber el bene yisrael veyyisau veyyisau milleasgaa millin lav idana ditzlota hashta veyyisau vechi lean atar pakid lon deyintelun deha al yamma hao sharan ella ahdar leela dichtiv ma titzak elay deha kullehu baatar da kayeme veal da vayyisu yintelun min da delav idana hu

Ella al galuta deyiskun mimmitzrayim umeashshur ittemar vei ittemar al mitzrayim veal ashshur al inun chasidin dilhon deahadru betiyyuvta veishtaarun lemiflach leyisrael ulmalka meshicha dichtiv veyishtachau lo kal melachim uchtiv vehau melachim omnayich vego

Amar leh may dichtiv deracheh darche noam amar leh kamma tippeshin bene alma dela yadin vela mashgichin bemilloy deorayeta deha millin deorayeta inun archa lemizke behahu noam Adonai dichtiv deracheh darche noam vechal netivoteha shalom darche noam vadday may noam kema dichtiv lachazot benoam Adonai veha ukmuha begin deorayeta vearchoy mehahu noam atyan veinun archin perishan beh veal da deracheh darche noam vechal netivoteha shalom
Amar ribbi chiyya taninan beshaata dekudsha berich hu yahav orayeta leyisrael nafak nehora mehahu noam veitattar beh kudsha berich hu umehahu noam avhiku zivan dechullehu almin
613: Dechullehu rekiin dechullehu kitrin al hahi shaata ketiv tzeena urena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo vego

Vehahi shaata deitbene makdesha itattar kudsha berich hu behahu attara veyativ bechurseya dileh veitattar baatroy umehahu zimna deitcharav be makdesha la itattar kudsha berich hu baatroy vehahu noam ittammar veitgeniz

Amar ribbi elazar beshaata deal moshe bego anana kema dichtiv vayyavo moshe betoch heanan kevar nash dehava azil baatar derucha ira beh chad malacha ravreva vetana kemuel shemeh vehu memana al teresar alfin memanan shelichan baa leizdavvega beh bemoshe patach moshe pumeh bitresar atvan gelifan dishma kaddisha deolif leh kudsha berich hu bassene veitrechak minneh teresar alfin parsin vahava azal moshe baanana veenoy melahatan kegumrin deeshsha

Ad deiara beh chad malacha ravreva veyakkira min kadmaa vetana hadarniel shemeh vehu illaa al shear malachin elef veshittin ribbo parsin vekaleh azil bematan elef rekiin demistacharan beeshsha chivara kevan dechama leh moshe la yachil lemallela baa lemishde garmeh miggo anana

Amar leh kudsha berich hu moshe vechi ante hu deasgit millin immi bassene devait leminda raza dishma kaddisha vela dachalte vehashta atte dachil mechad mishshammashay kevan dishma moshe kaleh dekudsha berich hu ittakkaf patach pumeh bev atvan dishma illaa kevan dishma hadarniel atvan dishma kaddisha mippumeh demoshe izdaza kariv legabbeh amar leh zakkaa chulakach moshe deitgele lach ma dela itgele lemalache illae

Vahava azil immeh ad dematu leeshsha takkifa dechad malacha di shemeh sandalfon vetana sandalfon illaa hu al shear chavroy chamesh mea shenin vehu kaim batar pargoda demareh vekasher leh kitrin mibbautehon ditzlota deyisrael uvshaata demate hay keter leresheh demalka kaddisha hu mekabbel tzelotehon deyisrael vechullehu chayyalin veuchlosin mizdazein venahamin veamrin berich yekara dayeya meatar bet shechinteh

Amar leh hadarniel lemoshe moshe let ana yachil limhach immach dela yokid li essa takkifa desandalfon beh shaata izdaza moshe ad deatkif beh kudsha berich hu bemoshe veotveh kameh veolif leh orayeta vechafa leh lemoshe behahu nehora veziva dehahu noam vahau anpoy demoshe nehirin bechal inun rekiin vechal chela dishmayya hao mizdazein kameh beshaata dehava nachit beorayeta

Kevan dechavu yisrael letatta natal kudsha berich hu elef chulakin mehahu ziva beh shaata bau malachin illain vechal inun ochlosin leokda lemoshe beshaata deamar leh kudsha berich hu lech red ki shichet ammecha izdaza moshe vela yachil lemallela ad deasge bitzlotin uvautin kame kudsha berich hu

Amar leh kudsha berich hu moshe atkif bechurseya dili ad degaar kudsha berich hu bechal inun ochlosin bechal inun chayyalin veatkif moshe bitren luchin deavnin veachit lon letatta veda hu dichtiv ir gibborim ala chacham vaored oz mivtecha umehahu ziva deishtear beh hao mavhikin anpoy demoshe uma behay deishtear beh la have yachlin leistakkela beanpoy behahu deistallak mineh al achat kamma vechamma

Chiyya amar yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach da orayeta veal da yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev delet milla bealma deyitbar chelehon deammin ovde kochavim umazzalot bar beshaata deyisrael mitassekin beorayeta dechal zeman deyisrael mitassekin beorayeta yemina ittekaf veittebbar chela vettukpa deovde avodat kochavim umazzalot uvgine kach orayeta ikrit oz kema deatte amer Adonai oz leammo yitten

Uvshaata deyisrael la mitassekin beorayeta semala ittakaf veittakaf chelehon deovde avodat kochavim umazzalot veshaltin alayehu vegazrin alayehu gizrin dela yachlin lemekam behu veal da itgeliu beni yisrael veitbadaru beni ammayya
614: Al ma avda haaretz vego vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati deha kal zimna deyisrael yishtaddelun beorayeta ittevar chela vettukpa dechal ovde avoda zara hada hu dichtiv yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev amar ribbi elazar vadday hachi hu dechal zimna dekalehon deyisrael ishtema bevatte kenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot vechu kema detannina hakkol kol yaakov vei lav hayyadayim yede esav veha okimna

Uvrov geoncha taharos kamecha chizkiyya patach veamar lamma Adonai taamod berachok talim leittot batztzara beshaata dechove alma garmu kudsha berich hu salik leela leela uvne nasha tzavechin venachtin dimin velet man deyishgach alayehu may tama begin deihu salik leela leela utshuva itmanna minnayehu keden ketiv uvrov geoncha taharos kamecha

Yitzchak amar hay kera beshaata deitlavash kudsha berich hu gauta al amamya deyitkanneshun aleh kema dichtiv veroznim nosdu yachad al Adonai veal meshicho vetana zeminin inun shivin kastorin mikkal ivar leitkannesha behahu zimna beochlosin dechal alma ulmebad kerava al yerushala karta kaddisha ulachada etin aleh dekudsha berich hu umay amre nokim al patrona bekadmita ulvatar al ammeh veal hechaleh

Keden zamin kudsha berich hu lechayecha alayehu dichtiv yoshev bashamayim yischak Adonai yilag lamo behahu zimna yilbash kudsha berich hu gauta alayehu vishetzinun min alma kema dichtiv vezot tihye hammaggefa asher yiggof Adonai et kal haammim asher tzavu al yerushala hamek besaro vehu omed al raglav

Ribbi abba amar mishshemeh derav yesa sava vehachi amar rabbi shimon zamin kudsha berich hu leachaya lechal inun malchin deaku leyisrael veliyerushala leanderianus lelufinos unvuchadnetzar ulsancheriv ulchal shear malche ammin decharivu beteh ulshalletaa lon kekadmita veyitkanneshun immehon shear ammin vezammin kudsha berich hu leitpara minnayehu beitgalleya sacharane yerushalam hada hu dichtiv vezot tihye hammaggefa asher yiggof Adonai et kal haammim asher tzavu al yerushala asher yitzbeu la ketiv ella asher tzavu keden ketiv uvrov geoncha taharos kamecha veda lezimna deata meshicha ketiv veshirata da shirata dealmin hi
Uvruach appecha neermu mayim behahu zimna uvgin kach it behahu zimna ulzimna demalka meshicha ulzimna degog umagog nitztzevu kemo ned lezimna dealma deate deihu chedvata dechal almin

Amar oyev erdof assig achallek shalal amar oyev da hahu memana ravreva al mitzrae beshaata deityehiv leh shultanuta al yisrael chashiv deyeshetzinun techot shultaneh ella dedachar kudsha berich hu ture alma dahao meginin alayehu vela tema da bilchodoy ella kal inun ravrevin dimmanan al kal ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot vechad ityehiv lehu reshuta veshultanuta al yisrael kullehu baan dishetzun yisrael techotayehu

Veal da inun ammin ditchot shultanehon deinun memanan kullehu gazrin gezirin leshetzaa lon ella dekudsha berich hu dechar ture alma veagin alayehu vechad chama moshe da shara leshabbecha lekudsha berich hu veamar mi chamocha baelim Adonai

Amar rabbi shimon ilana chad ravreva illaa takkifa beh ittezanu illain vetattain vehu ittecham bitresar techumin ittakkaf bearba sitre alma deistacharan beduchtayehu shivin anafin sallekin begaveh veittezanu minneh beikar sharshoy yankin inun sacharaneh veinun anafin demishtachchin beilana
Kad mate idan shultaneh dechal anafa vaanafa kullehu baan leshetzaa kolla gufa deilana deihu ikara dechullehu anafin hahu deshalit alayehu veyisrael achidan beh kad mata alayehu shultanuta dehahu
615: Gufa deilana chulaka deyisrael bae lenatra lon ulmehav shelama bechullehu veal da shivim pare hechag lemihav shelama leshivin anafin divgo ilana

Veal da mi chamocha baelim Adonai mi kamocha deyaaved keovadach virachem al kolla mi kamocha bechal hahu sacharaneh deilana deaf al gav deihu shalta natir lecholla natir lechal shear vela baya lemebad immehon gemira mi kamocha nedar bakkodesh behahu chela illaa deikre kodesh nedar bakkodesh mammash veikre koach Adonai noam Adonai veha okimna mile

Mi kamocha baelim Adonai yose patach raiti et kal hammaasim asher naasu tachat hashshamesh vehinni hakkol hevel urut ruach shelomo malka deistallak bechachmeta yetera al kal bene alma hech amar dechal ovadin hevel urut ruach yachol af maase hatztzedaka veha ketiv vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom ella ha ukmuha kal hammaasim asher naasu tachat hashshamesh ketiv shani maase hatztzedaka deihu leela min shimsha

Vehinne hakkol hevel urut ruach may ka mayere i tema hakkol hevel kema deokimna deihu beraza dechachmeta kema deatte amer havel havalim amar kohelet veinun havalim kiyyuma dealma dilela vetatta may tema behay dichtiv hacha hakkol hevel urut ruach

Ella hachi ukmuha vehachi hu ta chaze beshaata deovadin mitkashsheran letatta uvar nash ishtaddal befulchana demalka kaddisha hahu milla deavid hevel itavid mineh leela velet lach hevel delet leh kala desalik veitattar leela veitavid sannegora kame kudsha berich hu

Vechal inun ovadin deishtaddal behu bar nash delav inun pulchana dekudsha berich hu hahu milla deavid haval yitavid mineh veazla veshatat bealma vechad nafkat nishmateh devar nash hahu hevel megalgela leh bealma keavna bekusfita kema dichtiv veet nefesh oyevecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala

May yekalenna hahu hevel dimgalgel leh sacharaneh bealma keden kal millin demitabbedin delav inun pulchana dekudsha berich hu hevel yitavid minnayehu ihu tevira derucha demittabbar lerucha desalik venachit umitgalgel bealma hada hu dichtiv hevel urut ruach
Aval hahi milla deihi pulchana demareh da salik leela min shimsha veitavid minneh hevel kaddisha veda hu zara dezara bar nash behahu alma uma shemeh tzedaka dichtiv ziru lachem litzdaka

Hay medabbar leh levar nash kad tipuk nishmateh mineh vesalleka lah beatra dechavod dilela ishtechach leittzarra bitzrora dechayye hada hu dichtiv vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha begin ledabbera lach lesalleka lach laatar deikre kevod Adonai dichtiv kevod Adonai yaasfecha

Kal inun nishmatin dehahu hevel kaddisha medabbar lehu hahu deikre kevod Adonai kanish lon begaveh veittzeriran beh Adonai veda ikre nayecha derucha aval achara urut ruach ikre zakkain inun tzaddikayya dechal ovadehon leela min shimsha vezarin zara ditzdaka lemizke lon lealma deate veal da ketiv vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka

Amar ribbi shimon ta chaze bekadmita kad itbeni be makdesha letatta la itbeni ella bedina verugza kema dichtiv ki al appi veal chamati vego begin divaatar dedina sharya lezimna deate zammin kudsha berich hu lemivne leh ulatkena leh bedarga achara illaa deikre tzedaka dichtiv bitzdaka tikkonani begin kach itkayyam ushmeh
616: Mammash tzedek yitkere menalan dichtiv veze shemo asher yikreo Adonai tzidkenu

Tippol alehem emata vafachad emata ema mibbae leh may emata deha let lach at o milla chada beorayeta dela it bah razin illain may emata amar ribbi shimon kelomar dechilu dishchinta
