Veal da teviemo yetera teviemo leinun daachidan bev vetittaemo kema deatte amer nitzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer leinun daachidan bev ulinun batrae ittear milla velet lach milla beorayeta o at zeera beorayeta delet bah razin illain vetaamin kaddishin zakkaa chulakehon deyadin behu

Raya mehemna pikkuda lemivne makdesha letatta kegavena deve makdesha dilela kema deatte amer machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai deitzterich lemivne be makdesha letatta ultzallaa begaveh tzelota bechal yoma lemiflach leh lekudsha berich hu deha tzelota ikre avoda
Vehahu be kenishta itzterich lemivne leh bishfiru sagya ulatkena leh bechal tikkunin deha be kenishta diltatta kayema lakovel be kenishta dilela

Bet hamikdash letatta ihu kaim kegavena devet hammikdash dilela dekaim da lakovel da vehahu be makdesha kal tikkunoy vechal pulchanoy vechal inun manin veshammashin kullehu inun kegavena dilela mashkena deka aved moshe bemadbera kolla hava kegavena dilela

Be makdesha devana shelomo malka hu be nayecha kegavena illaa bechal inun tikkunin lemeheve betikkuna dilela be nayecha veachasanta hachi be kenishta itzterich bechal tikkune shappiru lemeheve kegavena illaa lemeheve bet tzelota leatkena tikkunin bitzlota kema deukmuha

Vehahu be makdesha delehevi beh challonot dichtiv vechavin petichan kegavena dilela veal da mashgiach min hachallonot metzitz min hacharakkim vei tema afilu bechakla begin derucha leheve salik lav hachi deha anan tzerichin bayit veleka leishtakkecha bayit letatta kegavena devayit illaa lenachta diyyura illaa lediyyura tattaa
Vetu dehahu tzelota vehahu rucha itzterich lesalleka velenafka miggo aku beorach meshar lakovel yerushalam
617: Veal da ketiv min hammetzar karati yah deitzterich atar dachik beaku leshaddera begaveh hahu rucha dela yiste limina velismala uvchakla la yachil kala leshaddera leh hachi deha kegavena da kala deshofar itdachya levar beorach meshar miggo atar dachik veazil uvaka rekiin vesalik bisliku leatteara rucha leela
Vei tema ha ketiv vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade shane yitzchak demilla achara hava beh ma dela hava bechal alma vetu dehay kera lav lehachi ata devadday bassade acher la hava metzalle veha okimna

Tanya amar ribbi abba zakkaa chulakehon deinun dezakkan lememar shirata da behay alma dezakkan lememar lah bealma deate veshirata da itbene beesrin utren atvan kaddishin gelifan uveser amiran vecholla itreshim bishma kaddisha vecholla shelemuta dishma kaddisha veha ittearna mille

Amar ribbi shimon behahi shaata dahao kayemin yisrael al yamma vahau amre shirata itgele kudsha berich hu alayehu vechal retichoy vecheloy begin deyindeun lemalkehon deavad lon kal inun nissin ugvuran vechal chad vechad yada veistakkal ma dela yadu veistakkalu shear nevie alma

Dei tema dela yadin vela idbaku chachmeta illaa min shirata da techome dechullehu bechachmeta istakkalu veyadu millin veamru dei lav hachi ech amru kullehu millin achdin dela satu illen meillen uma deamar da amar da vela akdim milla da lemilla da ella kullehu beshikkula chada verucha dekudsha befuma dechal chad vechad umillin ittemaru kullehu keillu nafkin mippuma chad ella vadday kullehu bechachmeta illaa istakkalu veyadu milin illain verucha dekudsha befum kal chad vechad

Vaafilu inun devime immehon hao amre shirata kullehu kachada vahau chaman kullehu ma dela chama yechezkel nevia veal kach hao kullehu mistakkele keillu chaman ena beena vechad siyemu millin kullehu mitbasseman benafshayehu vettaavon lemecheme ulistakkela vela hao baan lenatla mittamman missegiut tiuvta

Behahi shaata amar moshe lekudsha berich hu banayich missegiut tiuvta leistakkela bach la baan lenatla min yamma ma aved kudsha berich hu astim yekareh levar lemadbera vetamman itgele vela itgele amar lon moshe leyisrael kamma zimnin amena lenatla mittamman vela baitun ad di achze lon ziva yekara dekudsha berich hu bemadbera umiyyad hao taavin

Vela natlu ad deachid behu moshe veachme lon ziva yekara dekudsha berich hu bemadbera keden missegiut tiuvta uruta leistakkela antil lon moshe hada hu dichtiv vayassa moshe et yisrael miyyam suf vayyetzu el midbar shur may midbar shur madbera dahao baan leistakkela beh ziva yekara demalka kaddisha veal da ikre midbar shur istakkeluta sham

Vayyelchu sheloshet yamim bammidbar velo matzu mayim veen mayim ella tora shenneemar hoy kal tzame lechu lammayim amar ribbi yesa vechi man yahav lehu orayeta hacha veha ad kean la ityehivat lon orayeta

Amar ribbi elazar inun nafku lemadbera leistakkela kudsha berich hu natal ziva yekara dileh mittamman veinun azlu leistakkela beh vela ashkechuhu veolifna dekudsha berich hu tora ikre veen mayim ella tora veen tora ella kudsha berich hu

Amar ribbi shimon ad dahao azle bemadbera itgele alayehu reshuta achara dishar ammin hahu deshalit bemadbera veiarau behu tamman chamu yisrael dela hava hahu ziva yekara demalkehon hada hu dichtiv vayyavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara may tama ki marim hem la itbesam nafshayehu kekadmita velo od ella deate lekatrega alayehu
Ma ketiv veyitzak el Adonai vayyorehu Adonai etz
618: Veen etz ella tora dichtiv etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah veen tora ella kudsha berich hu ribbi abba amar en etz ella kudsha berich hu dichtiv ki haadam etz hassade etz hassade vadday da etz sade detappuchin kaddishin vechad itgele ziv yekara demalkehon alayehu keden vayyashlech el hammayim vayyimteku hammayim may vayyimteku hammayim dekattegora itavid sannegora

Amar ribbi abba ta chaze bekadmita kad alu yisrael bekayama dekudsha berich hu la alu kedeka yeot may taama begin deitgezaru vela itperau vela itgalleya reshima kaddisha kevan dematu hacha ma ketiv sham sam lo chok umishpat tamman alu yisrael bitren chulakin kaddishin behahu gilluya deitgalya reshima dilhon veikrun chok umishpat chok kema deatte amar vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha umishpat kema deittemar mishpat lelohe yaakov vesham nissahu behahu at kaddisha

Kema deatte amer ki chok leyisrael hu besifra derav yiyiva sava amar milla al hahu chutra kaddisha vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha vayyomer may vayyomer la ketiv man kaamar da ella kudsha berich hu amar ribbi chizkiyya amar shamenan amira setam meamira setam dichtiv veel moshe amar ale el Adonai amar la ketiv man kaamar uf hacha vayyomer setam vela ketiv man kaamar
Amar ribbi yose mashma dichtiv veyitzak el Adonai vayyorehu Adonai etz mehacha mashma vayyomer umashma man amar milla lekol Adonai elohecha lekoli mibbae leh ella lehahu kol dealu beh

Amar ribbi abba batar deitgalya behu reshima kaddisha alu bitren chulakin kaddishin kema deittemar vechevan dealu beillen teren alu beillen teren chulakin acharanin dechad yistallekun beillen teren acharanin yitchabberun beillen vela mimmane birkan ubbegin kach beillen matu birkan ad malka kaddisha

Umeatreh dikra ishtema milla dichtiv vayyomer im shamoa tishma vayyomer da malka kaddisha umay kaamar im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha kema deatte amer ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu da keneset yisrael vehayyashar beenav taase da tzaddik vehaazanta lemitzotav da netzach veshamarta kal chukkav da hod kevan dealu beillen ha matu lemalka kaddisha levatar ma ketiv kal hammachala asher samti bemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha ki ani Adonai da malka kaddisha

Ishtema dechal man denatir lehay reshima kaddisha mineh salik ad malka kaddisha illaa may mashma mashma inun teren deitkenash behu zara umashach revut kudsha deshadyan leh befum ama itkashsharu kachada umalka illaa alayehu veitkashsharu beh veal kach man deal beillen teren venatir lon itkashshar bitren acharanin veal behu uchden mate lemalka kaddisha
Amar ribbi yitzchak vadday man dezache betzadik zache benetzach vehod veillen inun telata deitbarcha behu keneset yisrael uman dezachu behu zache bemalka kaddisha veal bechullehu arbea

Velakovle arbea illen netiru lehay reshima kaddisha mearba millin netiru dichneset yisrael istammeruta denidda netiru detzaddik istammeruta deshifcha netiru denetzach istammeruta devat avodat kochavim umazzalot netiru dehod istammeruta dezona veal da lekol Adonai elohecha da keneset yisrael

Bamme zachan yisrael lekabbela appe shechinta beistammeruta min nidda veal da ketiv veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav legallot ervatah may legallot ervatah da keneset yisrael uvhay achidan umitkashsheran millin acharanin dichneset yisrael itkashsherat behu veha ukmuha mille
Vehayyashar beenav taase da tzaddik kema dichtiv ene Adonai el tzaddikim leistammera mishshifcha
619: Veha okimna mille dichtiv veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah degarim latztzaddik deitdabbak beshifcha vehaazanta lemitzotav da netzach leistammera dela yeul reshima da bevat el nechar velo yeshakker beh benetzach dichtiv vegam netzach yisrael lo yeshakker uman denatir hay kiyyem mitzotav dichtiv ki lo tishtachave leel acher veshamarta kal chukkav da hod leistammera min zona

Veazla ha kema detanenan amar ribbi yehuda may dichtiv chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha ella kal man dimzarez garmeh veshave dechilu decharba shinnana takkifa lakovleh al yarech may al yarech da reshima kaddisha kema deatte amer sim na yadcha tachat yerechi

Davar acher chagor charbecha kelomar zarez veatkif yitzrecha bisha deihu charbecha al yarech al hahu reshima kaddisha lenatra leh vei natar leh keden ikre gibbor vekudsha berich hu albish leh bilvushoy uman levushoy dekudsha berich hu hod venetzach dichtiv hod vehadar lavashta uf hacha hodcha vahadarecha uchden itdabbak bar nash bemalka kaddisha kedeka yeot

Mikkan ulhala kal hammachala asher samti bemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha da malka kaddisha veal da azhar lon al hahu milla mammash deyahav verashim behu vela yattir vead kean la ityehivat lehu orayeta ella kevan dichtiv sham sam lo chok umishpat miyyad vayyomer im shamoa tishma vego

Ta chaze kad baa kudsha berich hu leazhara leyisrael al orayeta bechamma millin mashich lehu bechamma meshichan dachavivuta kevar nash demashich bereh leve rav vetta chaze la baa kudsha berich hu lemehav lehu orayeta ad dekarivu bahadeh uvamme kerivu bahadeh begilluya dirshima da kema deittemar
Amar yehuda la kerivu yisrael letura desinay ad dealu bechulaka detzaddik vezachu beh menalan dichtiv bayyom hazze bau midbar sinay bayyom hazzehi mammash kivinu lo vgo

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim ribbi yehuda patach veamar ashre maskil el dal beom raa yemalletehu Adonai hay kera okimna leh beshaata devar nash shachiv beve mareh ha ittefas beatronya demalka resheh bekulra ragloy bechufsirin kamma chelin natrin leh mehay gisa umehay gisa shayefoy kullehu bedochaka maggichin illen beillen mechla itade minneh

Behahu zimna pakdin aleh appotrofa lemelaf aleh zechut kame malka dichtiv im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef behahi shaata zakkaa chulakeh debbar nash deal aleh veolif leh archa leshezavuteh min dina hada hu dichtiv ashre maskil el dal

Vehecha yachil leshezava leh lemelaf leh archoy dechayye leatava lekame mareh keden itavid appotrofosa aleh leela may agreh beom raa yemalletehu Adonai davar acher ashre maskil el dal kamma takkifa agra demiskena kame kudsha berich hu

Amar ribbi chiyya tavahna al hay kera dichtiv ki shomea el evonim Adonai vechi el evonim shomea velo leachara amar ribbi shimon begin deinun kerivin yattir lemalka dichtiv lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze velet lach bealma deihu tavir libba kemiskena tu amar ribbi shimon ta chaze kal inun beni alma itchazyan kame kudsha berich hu begufa venafsha umiskena la itchaze ella benafsha bilchodoy vekudsha berich hu kariv lenafsha yattir miggufa
Miskena chad hava bishvivuteh der yesa vela hava man deashgach beh vehu hava achsif vela takkif bivne nasha
620: Yoma chad challash al aleh ribbi yesa shama chad kala deamar tilka tilka ha nafsha parcha gabbay vela matu yomoy vay livni mateh dela ishtechach behu deyativ nafsheh legabbeh kam ribbi yesa shadde befumeh mayya degargerin afuta dekunta itbeza ziyia beanpoy vetav rucheh legabbeh

Levatar ata veshail leh amar chayyecha ribbi nafsha nafkat minnay umatu lah kame kurseya demalka uvaat leishtaara tamman ella devaa kudsha berich hu lezakkaa lach veachrizu alach zammin hu ribbi yesa lesalleka rucheh ulitkeshshera bechad idra kaddisha dizminin chavrayya leitteara beara veha atkinu telat kurseyan dekayemin lach ulchavrach mehahu yoma hao mashgichin beh bene mateh

Tu miskena achara avar kameh der yitzchak vahava bideh pelag mea dechesef amar leh leribbi yitzchak ashlim li velivnay velivnatay nafshaan amar leh vehech ashlim nafshayechu deha la ishtechach gabbay bar pelag mea amar leh beda ashlimna biflag achara deit gabbay afkeh veyahaveh leh

Achziu leh bechelmeh dehava avar bisfata deyamma rabba uvaan lemishdeyeh begaveyh chama leribbi shimon dehava oshit yedoy lakovleh veate hahu miskena veafkeh veyahaveh bidoy deribbi shimon veishteziv kad ittear nafal befumeh hay kera ashre maskil el dal beom raa yemalletehu Adonai

Veta chaze kal yoma veoma natif talla meattika kaddisha lizer appin umitbarchan kal chakal tappuchin kaddishin umehahu talla angid leinun diltatta umalachin kaddishin ittezanu minneh kal chad vechad kefum mechaleh hada hu dichtiv lechem abbirim achal ish umehahu mezona achlu yisrael bemadbera

Amar ribbi shimon kamma bene nasha mittezanin behay zimna minneh uman inun illen chavrayya demishtaddele beorayeta yome velele vechi salleka datach mehahu mezona mammash la ella keen hahu mezona mammash deshakil al chad teren

Ta chaze yisrael kad alu veitdevaku bemalka kaddisha begin gilluya dirshima kaddisha keden zachu lemechal nahama achara illaa yattir mimma dehava bekadmita bekadmita kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim alu benahama deikre matztza vehashta zachu vealu lemechal nahama achara illaa yattir meatar illaa dichtiv hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim min hashshamayim mammash uvhahu zimna ishtechach lehu leyisrael meatar da chavrayya demishtaddele beorayeta meatar achara illaa yattir ittezanu may hu kema dichtiv hachachma techayye vealeha atar illaa yattir
Amar leh elazar i hachi amay chalsha nafshayehu yattir mishshear bene alma deha shear bene nasha bechela vettukpa yattir itchazun leishtakkecha amar leh yeot shailta

Ta chaze kal mezoni divne alma milleela ka atyan hahu mezona deate min shemayya veara da mezona dechal alma vehu mezona dechola vehu mezona gas veav vehahu mezona deate yattir meela hu mezona yattir dakik kaatya meatar dedina ishtechach veda hu mezona deachlu yisrael kad nafku mimmitzrayim mezona deishtechach lehu leyisrael behahu zimna bemadbera meatar illaa deikre shamayim hu mezona yattir dekika deayil yattir lenafsha mikkolla umitperash yattir miggufa veikre lechem abbirim

Mezona illaa yattir mikkolla hu mezona dechavrayya inun demishtaddele beorayeta deachle mezona derucha venishmeta vela achle mezona degufa kelal vehayenu meatar illaa yakkira al kolla veikre chachma begine kach chalish gufa dechavrayya yattir mibbene alma deha la achle mezona degufa kelal veachle mezona derucha venishmeta meatar rechika illaa
621: Yakkira mikkolla uvgine kach hahu mezona dakik min dekika yattir mikkolla zakkaa chulakehon hada hu dichtiv hachachma techayye vealeha zakkaa chulaka degufa deyachil leittezana bimzona denafsha

Amar leh elazar vadday hachi hu aval behay zimna ech ishtakkeche mezone illen amar leh vadday yeot shailta ta chaze veda hu beriru demilla mezona kadmaa hu mezona dechal alma hahu deatya min shemayya veara vehu mezona degufa

Mezona dehu illaa minneh hahu deihu dekika yattir veata meatar dedina sharya deikre tzedek veda hu mezona demiskene veraza demilla man deashlim lemiskena ashlim leh at chad veitavid tzedaka veraza da gomel nafsho ish chesed gemilut chasadim mashma deha bedina sharya veashlim leh chesed keden hu rachame

Mezona illaa yattir meillen hu mezona illaa veyakkira meatar deikre shamayim vehu dakik mikkullehu vehu mezona divne mare hada hu dichtiv Adonai yisadennu al eres devay kal mishkavo hafachta vechalo Adonai dayeka may tama begin dehane bene mare la ittezene ella behahu dekudsha berich hu mammash
Mezona illaa kaddisha veyakkira da hu mezone deruchin venishmatin vehu mezona daatar rechika illaa Adonai

Veyakkira mikkolla hu mezona dechavrayya demishtaddele beorayeta vehu mezona deate mechachma illaa may tama meatar da begin deorayeta nafka mechachma illaa veinun demishtaddele beorayeta ayele beikara desharshaha veal da mezona dilhon mehahu atar illaa kaddisha ka atya

Ata elazar venashik yedoy amar zakkaa chulaki dekaimna bemillin illen zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya demishtaddele beorayeta yemama velele dezache lon behay alma uvalma deate dichtiv ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha

Hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim ribbi yose patach poteach et yadecha umasbia lechal chay ratzon ma ketiv leela ene chol elecha yesabberu kal inun beni alma metzappan vezakfan ayenin lekudsha berich hu begin kach kal inun bene mehemanuta baan bechal yoma veoma leshaala mezonayehu mikudsha berich hu ultzallaa tzelotehon aleh

May tama begin dechal man dimtzale tzeloteh legabbe kudsha berich hu al mezoneh garim deyitbarech kal yoma al yedoy hahu ilana demazon decholla beh Adonai veaf al gav deishtechach immeh bae lemishal kame kudsha berich hu ultzallaa tzelota al mezona kal yoma begin deyishtechachu al yedoy birkan kal yoma veoma leela veda hu baruch Adonai yom yom

Val da la livae leh leenash levashshela mezona min yoma leoma acharina dela leakkev yoma leoma achara hada hu dichtiv veyatza haam velaktu devar yom beomo yom beomo dayeka bar meerev shabbat leshabbat kema deokimna uchden ishtechach kudsha berich hu male birkan bechal yoma uchden ketiv poteach et yadecha vego may ratzon hahu ratzon deishtechach meattika kaddisha venafik minneh ratzon leishtakkecha mezone lecholla uman deshail mezone bechal yoma veoma hahu ikre bera mehemana beraza divgineh mishtachchan birkan leela

Abba patach veamar rotze Adonai et yereav et hamyachalim lechasdo kamma it lehu livne nasha lemehach bearchoy demalka kaddisha ulmehach bearchoy deorayeta begin deyishtakkechun birkan lechullehu leillae ultattae
Detanya maydichtiv yisrael asher becha etpaar etpaar vday may mashma divgin
622: Yisrael letatta kudsha berich hu mitpaar leela umay peera dileh deitchabbash bitfilin demitchabbera gaveni leitpaara

Tana rotze Adonai et yereav rotze Adonai bireav mibbae leh may rotze Adonai et yereav ella rotze Adonai et yereav kelomar appik hay ratzon umitrae behu kudsha berich hu lireav dedachalin leh uman inun yereav deappik lon hay ratzon hadar veamar et hamyachalim lechasdo inun dimtzafan umchakkan bechal yoma veoma lemibbae mezonayehu min kudsha berich hu mashma dichtiv et hamyachalim lechasdo

Ribbi yesa sava la atkin seudata bechal yoma ad devaa bauteh kame kudsha berich hu al mezone amar la natkin seudata ad detityehiv mibbe malka levatar devae bauteh kame kudsha berich hu hava mechakke shaata chada amar ha idan detityehiv mibbe malka mikkan ulhala atkinu seudata veda hu archa deinun dachale kudsha berich hu dachale chattaa

Inun chayyavayya deazlin akimin bearche orayeta ma ketiv behu hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu veal da rotze Adonai et yereav et hamyachalim lechasdo lechasdo dayeka ishtemodan inun bene mehemanuta bechal yoma veoma hada hu dichtiv veyatza haam velaktu devar yom beomo yom beomo kaamar velo devar yom leom acher

Vechal kach lamma lemaan anassennu hayelech betorati im lo bechan ishtemodan inun bene mehemanuta dechal yoma veoma inun azle beorach meshar beorayeta ribbi yitzchak amar mehacha tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho batar desava nafsheh milletzalle ulmikre beorayeta

Ribbi shimon amar ta chaze ad la yahav kudsha berich hu orayeta leyisrael avchin ben inun beni mehemanuta uven inun chayyavayya delav inun beni mehemanuta vela kayemin beorayeta uvamme avchin lon bamman kema deittemar anassennu vechal inun deishtechachu deinun bene mehemanuta rashim leh kudsha berich hu birshimu dechitra dechesed kema deatte amer hamyachalim lechasdo veal da lemaan anassennu vechal inun dela mishtakkeche beni mehemanuta ade minnayehu kitra illaa da umana achriz veamar uveten reshaim techsar veim kal da lo hedif hammarbe vehammamit lo hechsir

Tana behahu shaata ishtelimu yisrael letatta kegavena dilela kema deokimna dichtiv vayyavou elima vesham shettem esre enot mayim veshivim temarim vegv veittakkaf ilana kaddisha bitresar techumin bearba sitre alma veittakkaf beshivin anfin vecholla kegavena dilela

Behahi shaata natif talla kaddisha meattika setimaa umalya leresheh dizer anpin atar deikre shamayim umehahu talla dinhora illaa kaddisha hava nagid venachit mana letatta vechad hava nachit hava mitperash gelidin gelidin veakrish letatta hada hu dichtiv dak kakkefor al haaretz

Kal inun bene mehemanuta nafke velakte umvarchan shema kaddisha aleh vehahu mana hava salik rechin dechal busmin deginta deeden deha beh itmeshach venachit letatta shaveyeh lekameh bechal taama deihu bae hachi taim leh umvarech lemalka kaddisha illaa
Uchden mitbarech bemeoy vahava mistakkel veyada leela veistache bechachma illaa veal da ikrun dor dea veillen hao bene mehemanuta ulhon ityehivat orayeta leistakkela bah ulminda archaha

Veinun dela ishtechachu beni mehemanuta ma ketiv behu shatu haam velaktu may shatu shetuta hao nasbe legarmayehu begin dela hao bene mehemanuta ma ketiv behu vetachanu varechayim o dachu bammedocha vego man atrach
623: Lon kal hay ella deinun la hao bene mehemanuta

Kegavena da inun dela mehemne beh bekudsha berich hu la baan leistakkela bearchoy veinun baan leatrecha garmayehu kal yoma batar mezona yemama velele dilma la salik bidayehu pitta denahama man garim lon hay begin delav inun bene mehemanuta

Uf hacha shatu haam velaktu shatu bishtuta degarmayehu uvaan leatrecha aleh hada hu dichtiv vetachanu varechayim batar kal tircha da la salik bidayehu ella dichtiv vehaya tamo ketaam leshad hashshamen vela yattir man garim lon hay begin dela hao bene mehemanuta

Amar ribbi yose may leshad hashshamen ika deamre delish bemishcha ketargumo veika deamre ma hashshed itchazar lechamma gavenin uf mana itchazar lechamma gavenin ribbi yehuda amar leshad hashshamen yenika demishcha

Ribbi yitzchak amar ish lefi achlo lakatu vechi man deachil kima lakit kima uman deachil yattir lakit yattir veha ketiv lo hedif hammarbe vehammamit lo hechsir ella lefum inun deachlin laktin mashma achlo man dehava achil leh uvgine kach la ketiv achilato

May ka mayere achid bar nash beavda o beamata veamar dehu dileh ata chavreh veamar hay avda dili hu kerivu lekameh demoshe ledina amar lon kamma nafshaan bevetecha vechamma nafshaan beveteh deden amar kach vechach vehahu shaata amar lon moshe lakatu machar vechal chad minnayechu yete legabbay lemachar nafku velaktu veatyan kame moshe shaveyan kameh mana hava madid leh i hahu avda deden ashkach hahu omra deavda behay mana deha chad omra lechal nefesh venefesh mibbeteh madid leden veishtechach chasra hahu mechla deavda behahu mana dileh vechad omra lechal nefesh venefesh mibbeteh amar avda deden hu hada hu dichtiv ish lefi achlo lakatu uchtiv omer laggulgolet mispar nafshotechem

Amar chiyya ketiv erev vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim uvoker uritem et kevod Adonai erev vidatem bemay yindeun ella hachi tana bechal yoma veoma ishtechachu nimuse kudsha berich hu betzafra ittear chesed bealma behahu zimna deikre erev talya dina bealma veha ukmuha divgine kach yitzchak tikken tefillat hammincha veal da erev vidatem kad ittear dina bealma tindeun divhahu dina appik Adonai yatchon mimmitzrayim uvoker uritem et kevod Adonai deha behahu zimna ittear chesed bealma veyitten lechu lemechal

Chiyya amar ipcha ma ketiv leela beshivtenu al sir habbasar vego beh shaata ittear erev dehahu zimna deittear dina ittear name chesed bealma hada hu dichtiv vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim tindeun hahu chesed deavad immechon bezimna dedina veappik yatchon meara demitzrayim uvoker uritem et kevod Adonai kevod Adonai ha yedia vekkal kach lamma bishmoa Adonai et telunnotechem vego
Amar yesa la shane kudsha berich hu nimusoy bar deinun chayyave alma shanyan lon umhappeche rachame ledina kema deittemar

Tane elazar mehay mana zeminin tzaddikayya lemechal lealma deate vei tema behay gavena la ella yattir dela hava ken lealmin may ihu kema deokimna dichtiv lachazot benoam Adonai ulvakker behechalo uchtiv ayin la raata elohim zulatcha vego
Reu ki Adonai natan lachem hashshabbat chizkiyya patach shir hammaalot mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai shir hammaalot satam vela parish man amaru ella shir hammaalot dizminin
624: Kal bene alma lememar dezammin hay shir lememreh ledare alma

Umay hu mimmaamakkim keraticha hachi tana kal man dimtzale tzelota kame malka kaddisha bae lemibbae bauteh ultzallaa meimka delibba begin deyishtechach libbeh shelim bekudsha berich hu vichaven libba uruta umi amar david hachi veha ketiv bechal libbi derashticha veda kera saggi may bae mimmaamakkim

Ella hachi tana kal bar nash devae bauteh kame malka bae lechavvena data uruta meikara dechal ikarin leamshacha birkan meimka devera begin deyangid birkan mimmabbua decholla umay hu hahu atar denafik minneh veishtechach minneh hahu nahar dichtiv venahar yotze meeden uchtiv nahar pelagav yesamchu ir elohim veda ikre mimmaamakkim imka decholla imka devera demabbuin nafkin venagdin levarcha kolla veda hu sheruta leamshacha birkan meela letatta

Amar ribbi chizkiyya kad attika setimaa dechal setimin bae lezamna birkan lealmin ashre kolla veachlil kolla behay amika illaa umehacha shaiv veitnegid bera denachalin umabbuin itnegidu minneh umitshakyan minneh kullehu uman dimtzale tzeloteh bae lechavvena libba uruta leamshacha birkan mehahu amika decholla begin deyitkabbal tzeloteh veyitavid reuteh

Vayyomer moshe alehem ish al yoter mimmennu ad boker amar ribbi yehuda bechal yoma veoma mitbarech alma mehahu yoma illaa deha kal shita yomin mitbarchan miyyoma sheviaa vechal yoma yahiv mehahu beracha dekabbil behahu yoma dileh
Veal da moshe amar ish al yoter mimmennu ad boker may tama begin dela yahiv vela yozif yoma da lechavreh ella kal chad vechad shalit bilchodoy behahu yoma dileh deha la shalit yoma beoma dechavreh

Begine kach kal inun chamishsha yomin shallitin beomayehu veishtechach beh ma dekabbilu veoma shetitaa ishtechach beh yattir veazla ha keha deamar ribbi elazar may dichtiv yom hashshishshi vela ittemar hachi bechal shear yomin ella hachi ukmuha hashshishshi deizdavvega beh matronita leatkena patora lemalka ubbegin kach ishtechachu beh teren chulakin chad leomeh vechad letikkuna bechedvata demalka bematronita

Vehahu lelya chedvata dematronita bemalka veziuuga dilhon umitbarchan kal shita yomin kal chad vechad bilchodoy begin kach bae bar nash lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta begin deshari aleh birkan milleela uvirkata la ishtechach al patora rekanya begin kach talmide chachamim deyadin raza da ziuuga dilhon meerev shabbat leerev shabbat

Reu ki Adonai natan lachem hashshabbat may shabbat yoma deveh nayechin shear yomin vehu kelala dechal inun shita acharanin uminneh mitbarchin ribbi yesa amar vechen name keneset yisrael ikre shabbat begin deihi bat zugo veda hi kalla dichtiv ushmartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi lachem lachem vela lishar ammin hada hu dichtiv beni uven bene yisrael veda hi achasanat yerutat almin leyisrael veal da ketiv im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha vego uvatrih okimna mille

Ketiv al yetze ish mimmekomo bayyom hashshevii mimmekomo tanenan mehahu makom deitchaze lemehach veraza demilla dichtiv baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo veda ihu makom veda ihu raza dichtiv ki hammakom asher atta omed alav admat kodesh hu atar yedia karenan leh makom deishtemoda yekara illaa
Uvgin kach azharuta levar nash deka mitattera beittura kaddisha dilela dela yippuk minneh befumeh millula dechol begin dei yippuk minneh ka
625: Mechallel yoma deshabbeta bidoy beovadta beragloy lemehach levar mitteren alfin ammin kal illen chillula deshabbeta inun

Al yetze ish mimmekomo da ihu atar yakkira dikdushsha deha levar minneh elohim acherim ninhu baruch kevod Adonai da kavod dilela mimmekomo da kavod diltatta da ihu raza daattara deshabbat begin kach al yetze ish mimmekomo zakkaa chulakeh man dezache likara deshabbeta zakkaa ihu bealma den uvalma deate

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe avor lifne haam vego ribbi chiya patach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vayechalletzem zakkain inun tzaddikayya dekudsha berich hu itree bikarehon yattir al dileh ta chaze kamma inun bene alma dimcharfe umgaddefe leela kegon sancheriv cheref vegiddef veamar mi bechal elohe haaratzot vego vekudsha berich hu machil vela tava minnih kevan deoshit yedeh al chizkiyya ma ketiv vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachani ashshur vego

Yaravam ben nevat hava palach leavoda zara umkatar lah umzavach lah vekudsha berich hu la tava minneh vechad ata ido nevia veitnabbe aleh veoshit yaravam yeda lekavleh ma ketiv vattivash yado vego velo yachol lahashivah elav

Paro cheref vegiddef veamar mi Adonai vego vekudsha berich hu la tava minneh ad desariv behu beyisrael dichtiv odcha mistolel beammi hinne yad Adonai hoya bemikneche vego vechen bechal atar kudsha berich hu tava elbona detzaddikayya yattir al dileh
Hacha moshe amar od meat uskaluni amar leh kudsha berich hu moshe lav idan hu lemitba elbonach ella avor lifne haam veachme man yoshit yedoy lakovlach vechi birshutayehu atte kaim o birshuti

Umattecha asher hikkita bo et hayeor kach beyadcha vehalachta may tama mishshum dimchakkek bannissin hava ushma kaddisha illaa reshima beh bekadmita nachash kema deittemar derech nachash ale tzur nachash ha ityeda deittear tzur bean atar itgele hacha itgele dichtiv hinni omed lefanecha sham al hatztzur uman tzur kema deatte amer hatztzur tamim paolo vetamman yada moshe hech kaim nachash ale tzur veha okimna mille

Amar ribbi yehuda i lishtik kera yeot shailta ella ha ketiv vehikkita vatztzur vayyatzu mimmennu mayim amar leh vadday hachi hu delet lach kal shema ushma meinun shemahan kaddishin dekudsha berich hu dela aved nissin ugvuran veappik kolla deitzterich lealma kal shekken leappaka hacha mayya

Amar leh i hachi ha ketiv hen hikka tzur vayyazuvu mayim man mache lishmeh amar leh pattisha charifa bekitroy yedia veatte shail da ella ta chaze bechal atar tzur gevura vechad bae kudsha berich hu lemachaa o lealkaa ittear gevura da vehahu gevura mache velake veda hu dichtiv hen hikka tzur vayyazuvu mayim vei lav deittear tzur velake beatar deitzterich la naviin mayya

Amar leh i hachi ha ketiv tzur yeladcha teshi vetanenan may teshi kelomar challasht leh amar leh vadday hachi hu deilmale yindeun chayyavayya dehay tzur zemina leitteara lakovlayehu ulalkaa lon yimmanun millemechav kameh ella chalsha ihi beenayehu hoil vela mistakkele bah vela mistakkele beorchayehu veal da tzur yeladcha teshi

Abba amar it tzur veit tzur missitra detzur illaa nafak tzur achara umay tzur illaa tzur dechal tzurim umay ihu hahu deolidat leyisrael dichtiv tzur yeladcha teshi deha missitra detzur illaa dilela nafka tzur achara missitra deima nafka gevura
Veazla ha keha deamar ribbi elazar ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai may gevurot Adonai leachlela ima illaa decholla deaf al gav delav ihi dina missitraha ishtechach deha missitraha
626: Gevura ishtechach uvgine kach tzur illaa ikre vattishkach el mechollecha da nehiru deabba may nihu chesed illaa deihu nehiru deabba

Tu amar ribbi abba mayim bechal makom ha yedia vekudsha berich hu behay tzur ittear learka mayya deha la itchaze veda hu at venisa dekudsha berich hu veal da shavach david veamar hahofchi hatztzur agam mayim vego umashma hahofchi deha lav archoy detzur bechach
Veal da betzur illaa appik mayya meatar diltatta uma shemeh dehahu diltatta sela dichtiv vehotzeta lahem mayim min hassela uvamme appik hay sela mayya bechela detzur dilela

Rabbi shimon amar hatztzur tamim paolo may mashma hatztzur tamim paolo deithappach tzur lemebad paolo detamim umay ihu avraham dichtiv beh hithallech lefanay vehye tamim veda hu hahofchi hatztzur agam mayim umashma tamim paolo veda avraham

Beshaata da ithaddar hatztzur tamim beshaata achara tinyana kad baa moshe leappaka mayya behay tzur bechovayehu deyisrael la ithaddar tamim kekadmita beh zimna itraam moshe veamar tzur yeladcha teshi kelomar challasht leh mimma dehava bekadmita divginach la ishtechach tamim hashta veitavid dina ma dela hava beome yeladcha kelomar ulemach

Amar ribbi abba may dichtiv hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin vechi tippeshin hao yisrael dela yade milla da veha chamu shechinta kamayehu vaaneni kavod alayehu desachron lon veinun amru hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin guvrin dechamu ziv yekara demalkehon al yamma vetanenan raata shifcha al hayyam ma shello raa yechezkel inun ishtechachu tippeshin veamru hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin

Ella hachi kaamar rabbi shimon bau leminda ben attika setimaa dechal setimin deikre ayin uven zeer appin deikre Adonai veal da la ketiv hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im lo kema dichtiv hayelech betorati im lo ella hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin
I hachi amay itanshu ella al daavidu piruda vaavidu benisona dichtiv veal nassotam et Adonai amru yisrael i hay nishal begavena chad vei hay nishal begavena achara veal da miyyad vayyavo amalek

Vayyavo amalek vayyillachem im yisrael birfidim ribbi yose patach ashrechem zore al kal mayim meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor ashrechem zore al kal mayim tamman taninan kamma mayim vechamma mayim mishtakkechin zakkain inun yisrael delet zara lehu ella al hammayim dichtiv veyyachanu sham al hammayim inun dahao techot anfe ilana dekudsha berich hu

Detanya ilana it lekudsha berich hu vehu ilana ravreva vetakkifa uveh ishtechach mezona lecholla vehu ittecham bitresar techumin bematkela veittakkaf bearba ruche alma ve anpin achidan beh veyisrael mishtakkeche begufa dehahu ilana veinun shivin anpin sacharana dilhon

Vehayenu dichtiv vayyavou elima vesham shettem esre enot mayim veshivim temarim veha ukmuha veittemar bechamma atar may veyyachanu sham al hammayim ella behahu zimna shalitu al inun mayya deinun techot anpin deilana deikrun hammayim hazzedonim veal da ashrechem zore al kal mayim

Meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor inun teren kitre semala daachidan behu ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot deikrun shor vachamor vehayenu dichtiv vayehi li shor vachamor begin delavan chakkim hava bacharashin uvinun kitrin tattain uvinun baa leovada leyaakov kema dichtiv arami oved avi veha ittemar uchsheyyisrael zakkain meshalleche lehu vela yachle leshalletaa alayehu hada hu dichtiv meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor dela shalte behu
Amar ribbi abba kad mizdavvege kachada la yachle bene alma lemekam behu veal da
627: Ketiv lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav yachdav dayeka vetanenan la yahiv inish duchta lezinin bishin deha beovada debbar nash ittear ma dela itzterich vechad mizdavvege kachada mittekifuta dilhon deikre kelev veda chatzifa mikkullehu hada hu dichtiv ulchal bene yisrael lo yechoratz kelev leshono amar kudsha berich hu attun amartun hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin hare ani moser etchem lakkelev miyyad vayyavo amalek
Yehuda amar reshit goyim amalek veacharito ade oved vechi reshit goyim amalek vahalo kamma lishanin veammin veumin hao bealma ad la ata amalek

Ella kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim dechilu veemata nafla al kal ammin dealma miyyisrael hada hu dichtiv shamu ammim yirgazun chil achaz yoshve pelashet vela hao amma dela hava dachil miggevuran illain dekudsha berich hu vaamalek la hava dachil hada hu dichtiv velo yare elohim la dachil lemikrav legabbach veal da reshit goyim

Deatu leaggacha kerava beyisrael amalek hava uvgine kach veacharito ade oved dichtiv ki macho emche et zecher amalek uchtiv timche et zecher amalek hada hu dichtiv veacharito ade oved ade avdo mibbae leh ella ad deyete kudsha berich hu veyovad leh dichtiv ki macho emche vego amar elazar ta chaze af al gav dehatztzur tamim paolo veavid immehon chesed leappaka lon mayya la shavak dideh deha ketiv vayyavo amalek

Abba patach veamar yesh raa chola raiti tachat hashshamesh kamma bene nasha atimin libba begin dela mishtaddele beorayeta yesh raa chola vechi yesh raa dehi chola veyesh raa delav hi chola ella vadday yesh raa chola detanenan missitra dismala nafke kamma gardini nimusin devakan baavira

Vechad bayan lemefak azlin veishtaavin benukva dithoma rabba levatar nafkin umitchabberan kachada uvkain avirin veshatin bealma umitkarvin legabbayehu divne nasha vechal chad ikre raa kema deatte amer lo teunne elecha raa may lo teunne begin deatya betaskufa al beni nasha

Chola amay hi chola kad sharya hay al bene nasha avid lon kamtzanin mimmamonehon atyan gabbay tzedaka gabbeh hi machat bideh amar leh lo tipuk middidach atyan miskene hi machat bideh ate hu lemechal mimmamoneh machat bideh begin lenatra leh leachora umin yoma desharya aleh devar nash hi chola kehay shachiv mera dela achil vela shette veal da hi raa chola

Ushlomo malka tzavach bechachmeta veamar ish asher yitten lo haelohim osher unchasim vechavod vego hay kera lav resheh sefeh velav sefeh resheh ketiv ish asher yitten lo haelohim osher unchasim vechavod vego may velo yashlitennu haelohim leechol mimmennu i hachi lav birshuteh hu debbar nash

Ella i ketiv velo yaazvenu haelohim leechol mimmennu havena amar hachi ella velo yashlitennu divgin dehu hemneh lehahi raa veachid bah kudsha berich hu la shalteh aleh leitbaraa techoteh al dehu itree bah veachid bah
Vechal archoy kishchiv mera dela achil vela shete vela kariv lemamoneh vela appik mineh venatir leh ad dehu yippuk mealma veyete achara veyittol leh dehu bealav

Ushlomo malka tzavach veamar osher shamur livalav leraato man bealav da achara deyarit leh velamma zacha hay achara lemeheve bealav dehahu utra begin dehay hemin lehahi raa veitterae ba veitdabbak ba begin kach hay achara dela itdabbak behahi raa zacha lemeheve bealav dehahu utra hada hu dichtiv leraato kelomar begin raato dehava mitdavak bah ravach leh hay
Davar acher yesh raa chola hay man deyativ bechulaka tava bevet avoy vehu azil lakovel avoy
628: Betaskufe millin ha itdevak behahu raa chola kevar nash shachiv mera dechal archoy betaskufa da beena veda la beena uvgin hay utra itdabbak bar nash beraa chola veitanash behay alma uvalma deate veda hu osher shamur livalav leraato

Kacha yisrael kudsha berich hu natil lon al gadpe nishrin aschar lon baanani yekara shechinteh natil kamayehu nachat lon mana lemechal appik lon mayya metukin veinun hao azlin immeh betaskufin miyyad vayyavo amalek

Vayyavo amalek amar ribbi shimon raza dechachmeta hacha miggizrat dina kashya ka atya kerava da ukrava da ishtechach leela vetatta velet lach milla beorayeta dela it bah razin illain dechachmeta demitkashsherin bishma kaddisha kivyachol amar kudsha berich hu kad yisrael inun zakkain letatta itgabbar chela dili al kolla vechad la ishtechachu zakkain kivyachol mattishin chela dilela veitgabbar chela dedina kashya

Ta chaze beshaata dechavu yisrael letatta ma ketiv vayyavo amalek vayyillachem im yisrael ata lekatrega dina berachame decholla ishtechach leela vetatta birfidim berafuy yadayim derafu yedehon meorayeta dekudsha berich hu kema deokimna amar yehuda tere zimne aggach kerava amalek beyisrael chad hacha vechad dichtiv vayyered haamaleke vehakkenaani vego

Amar shimon leela vetatta kitruga dekudsha berich hu hava leela kema deittemar letatta bekudsha berich hu hava dahao nasbe legavre vegazre lon arlata dirshima kaddisha venatle lehu vearmu lon leela veamre tol lach ma deitreit veal kal panim dekudsha berich hu hava kolla

Vayyomer moshe el yehoshua bachar lanu anashim vetze hillachem baamalek vechi ma chama moshe desalik garmeh mehay kerava kadmaa dekudsha berich hu pakid ella moshe zakkaa chulakeh deistakkal veyada ikara demilla amar moshe ana azmin garmi lehahu kerava dilela veante yehoshua zammin garmach lekarva diltatta
Vehayenu dichtiv vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael yisrael dilela uvgin kach salik moshe garmeh mikkerava diltatta begin leizdarza bikrava dilela veyitnetzach al yedoy

Amar shimon vechi kalah hi beenecha kerava da daamalek ta chaze min yoma deitbere alma ad hahu zimna umehahu zimna ad deyete malka meshicha vaafilu beomoy degog umagog la yishtekkach kevateh lav begin chayyalin takkifin vesaggiin ella begin divchal sitrin dekudsha berich hu hava

Vayyomer moshe al yehoshua amay lihoshua vela leachora veha behahu zimna ravya hava dichtiv vihoshua bin nun naar vechamma hao beyisrael takkifin minneh ella moshe bechachmeta istakkal veyada may chama chama dehava nachit missitra dilela lesayea laamalek letatta amar moshe vadday kerava hacha takkifa itchaziyi

Yehoshua behahu zimna bedarga illaa yattir ishtechach i tema divshechinta ishtechach behahu zimna lav hachi deha bemoshe itnesivat veitachadat ishtechach yehoshua deitachad letatta minah uvamme amar shimon behahu atar deitkere naar

Vehayenu deamar ribbi yehuda may dichtiv enecha tirena yerushala nave shaanan ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lanetzach yerushala yerushala dilela deikre ohel bal yitzan dela yishtekkach yattir lemehach begaluta veda hu raza dichtiv vihoshua bin nun naar naar vadday lo yamish mittoch haohel hahu deikre ohel bal yitzan melammed divchal yoma veoma hava yanik mishchinta kema dehahu naar dilela lo yamish mittoch haohel veyanik minneh tadira kach hay naar
629: Diltatta lo yamish mittoch haohel veyanik minnah tadira

Begin kach kad chama moshe nachit lesayea laamalek amar moshe vadday hay naar yekum lakovleh veyishshelot aleh lenatztzecha leh miyyad vayyomer moshe el yehoshua bachar lanu anashim vetze hillachem baamalek dilach hay kerava diltatta vaana izdarez likrava dilela bachar lanu anashim zakkain bene zakkain deyitchazun lemehach immach

Amar rabbi shimon beshaata denafik yehoshua naar ittear naar dilela veittakkan bechamma tikunin bechamma zayenin deatkinat leh imeh likrava da lenakma nukma divrit vehayenu dichtiv cherev nokemet nekam berit veda hu raza dichtiv vayyachalosh yehoshua et amalek veet ammo lefi charev lefi cherev vadday vela lefum rumchin vezayenin ella bacherev vadday hi hay deikre cherev nokemet nekam berit

Umoshe ittakkan likrava dilela vide moshe kevedim kevedim mammash yakkirin kaddishin la istavan lealmin yekirin deitchazun leaggacha behu kerava dilela vayikchu even vayyasimu tachtav vayyeshev aleha begin deyisrael sharyan betzaara vihe immehon betzaarehon

Veaharon vechur tamchu veyadav mizze echad umizze echad vayehi yadav emuna vego may tamchu veyadav emuna vechi al deaharon vechur temichu lidoy hao yedoy emuna ella moshe kolla bechachmeta avid ma deavid aharon vechur da missitra dileh veda missitra dileh veyadoy beemtzaita veal da vayehi yadav emuna mehemanuta aharon begin deyittear sitra dileh vechur begin deyittear sitra dileh vahau achidan bidoy mikkan umikkan deishtachcha siua dilela

Vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael kaasher yarim dezakif yemina al semala veitkavan bifrishu deyadoy vegavar yisrael yisrael dilela vechaasher yaniach yado vegavar amalek beshaata deyisrael letatta mishtakkechin mitztzelota la yachlin yede moshe lemekam bizkifu vegavar amalek mikkan olifna af al gav dechahana paris yedoy bekarbena letakkena garmeh becholla yisrael bayan leishtakkecha bitzlothon immeh

Tana bikrava da daamalek ishtechachu illain vetattain veal da vayehi yadav emuna behemnuta kadka chaze vayehi yadav emuna vayyihu yadav mibbae leh ella begin detalya kolla bimina ketiv vayehi uchtiv yadav begin dehu ikara decholla uchtiv yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe ketov zot zikkaron besefer vego ta chaze ma ketiv leela vayyachalosh yehoshua et amalek veet ammo lefi charev vayyachalosh vayyaharog mibbae leh ella vayyachalosh kema deittemar cholesh al goyim yehoshua hava cholesh alayehu vehahu cherev nokemet nekam berit katil lon dichtiv lefi charev kema deittemar
Ketov zot zikkaron zot dayeka vesim beazne yehoshua deha hu zamin lekatla malchin acharanin ki macho emche macho leela emche letatta zecher duchrana dilela vetatta
Amar ribbi yitzchak ketiv ki macho emche uchtiv timche et zecher amalek ella amar kudsha berich hu attun machun duchraneh letatta vaana emche duchraneh leela

Amar ribbi yose amalek ammin acharanin aytin immeh vechullehu dechilu lekarva behu beyisrael bar ihu uvgin kach yehoshua hava cholesh alayehu ribbi yesa amar vayyachalosh yehoshua detavar chela dilhon milleela
Vayyiven moshe mizbeach vayyikra shemo Adonai nissi vayyiven moshe mizbeach lakovel hahu dilela vayyikra shemo hahu moshe Adonai nissi may Adonai nissi begin deankim nikmata dehahu reshima
630: Kaddisha deyisrael umehahu zimna itkere cherev nokemet nekam berit

Ribbi yose amar vayyiven moshe mizbeach mizbach lechappera alayehu vayyikra shemo shemo deman amar ribbi chiyya shemeh demadbecha hahu Adonai nissi kema deatte amer vesham nissahu vecholla milla chad al deitperau yisrael veitgalya hahu at kayyama reshima kaddisha mikkan olifna dechevan deitgezar bereh devar nash veitgalya beh at reshima kaddisha kayyama hahu ikre mizbeach lechappera aleh uma shemeh Adonai nissi
Kegavena da yaakov benah madbecha dichtiv vayyatztzev sham mizbeach vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael leman lehahu atar deikre mizbeach uman shemeh el elohe yisrael

Amar ribbi yose may dichtiv vayyiru et elohe yisrael vego vechi man yachil lemechome leh lekudsha berich hu veha ketiv ki lo yirani haadam vachay vehacha amar vayyiru ella deitgalya keshet alayehu bigvanin nehirin vehachi tanenan kal man deistakkal bakkeshet keman demistakkal bashshechina ulistakkela bishchinta asir

Veal da asir leh leinish leistakkela beetzbeayehu dechahane beshaata defarse yedayehu asur leistakkela bakkeshet man keshet amar ribbi abba bakkeshet setam amar leh may bakkeshet setam amar leh bakkeshet dilela uvakkeshet diltatta

Bakkeshet dilela bigvanoy dechal man deyistakkal bigvanoy keilu istakkal beatar dilela veasir leistakkela beh dela yaavid kelana bishchinta keshet diltatta may hi hahu at kayyama deitreshim beh bevar nash dechal man deyistakkal beh avid kelana leela

Amar ribbi yitzchak i hachi vehachtiv sim na yadcha tachat yerechi dehava ome leh behay at amar leh anach lehu laavahan dealma delet inun kishar bene alma veod sim na yadcha tachat yerechi ketiv vela ketiv ree tachat yerechi begin kach asir leistakkela bakkeshet setam kema detanenan

Tana vayyiru et elohe yisrael deitgalya keshet alayehu bigvanin shappirin nehirin melahatan lechal ivar mashma dichtiv et elohe yisrael vela ketiv vayyiru elohe yisrael amar ribbi yose nehora devutzina dishchinta umay nihu hahu deikre naar dimshammesh lishchinta bemakdesha uvgin kach et dayeka

Vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir deitreshim beh techot duchteh chad levenata meinun levenin dahao banin bemitzrayim detanenan itteta chada olidat bemitzrayim vahava atin sarche paro vealat leh bechad levenata veata pas yeda veachid leh veitreshim techot ragloy dishchinta vekayema kameh ad deittokad be makdesha diltatta dichtiv velo zachar hadom raglav

Chiyya amar livnat hassappir nehiruta desappir kaldite bekandite gelifin illain dilela demitlahata leshivin utren ivri hada hu dichtiv visadtich bassappirim uchetzem hashshamayim may etzem hashshamayim amar ribbi abba ma etzem hashshamayim gelifa beshivin utren anafin parchin melahatan bechal ivar uf hacha chezu dehahu etzem hashshamayim kechezu shemayya mammash ribbi yehuda amar kolla itreshim behahu nehiru dechezu demitgalfa missitra dishchinta

Amar ribbi chizkiyya i hachi veha shittin inun besacharanih dishchinta dichtiv shishshim gibborim saviv lah amar leh hachi hu vadday ella inun shittin itnehiru bitresar techumin vela adiu missacharanutaha lealmin detanenan teresar techumin gelifin illain bematkela seliku beilana kaddisha rabba vetakkif vechullehu nehirin bematronita kad itchabberat bemalka veda hu etzem hashshamayim etzem hashshamayim mammash vechal inun nehirin shevilin menaharin beh binhiru dematronita
Vetana nehiru deillen shittin desacharanaha reshimin beh behahu naar vekarenan lehu shittin pulse denura deitlabbash behu missetar dishchinta mitlahatan bedina hada hu dichtiv
631: Tana vayyiven moshe mizbeach kema daamena vayyikra shemo Adonai nissi Adonai nissi mammash amay begin daamalek natal kal inun dahao gezirin vela itperau vegazar lon veshade lehu leela veamar tol ma deitreit beh beh shaata ma ketiv vayyomer ki yad al kes yah milchama la baamalek middor dor middor dor chaserin middiyyurin dilela umiddiyyurin diltatta

Amar ribbi yehuda bechal dara vedara bechal darin deatyan lealma let lach dar delet behu mehahu zara bisha vkudsha berich hu agach behu kerava vealayehu ketiv yittammu chattaim min haaretz vego min haaretz bealma den uvalma deate beh zimna ketiv barchi nafshi et Adonai halluyah
632: Uvha kal sitra dikdushsha itachad leela learama keden kal sitrin acharanin itkafyan kullehu veodan lemalka kaddisha

Ta chaze beraza dikdushsha ihu melech vechohen umshammesh techoteh ben leela ben letatta it melech leela deihu raza dekodesh hakkodashim veihu melech illaa utchoteh it kohen raza deor kadmaa deka meshammesh kameh veda ihu kohen deikre gadol sitra dimina

It melech letatta deihu kegavena dehahu melech illaa veihu melech al kolla diltatta utchoteh it kohen dimshammesh leh raza demichael kahana rabba deihu limina veda ihu raza dimhemanuta shelemata sitra dikdushsha

Besitra achara delav ihu sitra dikdusha it raza deihu melech veha okimna deikre melech zaken uchsil utchoteh it kohen on veda hu raza dichtiv vayyomer efrayim ach asharti matzati on li begin dechela da shalta al hahu ovada daavad yaravam veilmale deashkach chela da la yachil leatzlacha behahu ovada

Raza demilla beshaata dehay melech vehay kohen itkafyan veittebbaru keden kal sitrin acharanin itkafyan veodan leh lekudsha berich hu keden kudsha berich hu shalit bilchodoy ela vetatta kema deatte amer venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu

Ayenin dekikin umithappechan zeir besumaka da ihu pekicha kal milloy vechiuva bemitztzechoy tishkach reshimin telat chad rav deabar missitra da lesitra da utren acharanin dela avrin keritzin deenoy ravrevin mareh dekashu ihu kad mallil kamit bechutmin berugzih i bekashu delibbeh zakif shum bish aleh bish beene decholla kolla sanin leh atztzelach lezimnin ulzimnin la
645: Derucha balta levar veitchazze veitgeniz vechal hane diuknin itchazyan mittzayeran betziyyura deatvan af al gav deinun genizin illen arba diuknin itchazyan lefum shaata leinun mare deayenin deyadin beraza dechachmeta leistakkela behu

Tziura kadmaa kad azil bar nash beorach keshot inun deyadin berazin demarehon mistakkelan beh begin dehahu rucha dilgo mettatkena beh uvalit levar tziyyura decholla vehahu tziyyura ihu tziyyura deadam veda ihu tziyyura shelim yattir mikkal tziyyurin veda ihu tziyyura deabar lefum shaata kame enayehu dechakkime libba hay kad mistakkelan beanpoy levar inun anpin dekayemin kameh ayenin delibba rachim lon

Arba simanin deatvan it behu shuryeka chad balit bishchivu besitra diyimina veshuryeka chad dechalil teren acharanin daachidan beh besitra dismala veillen simanim inun atvan deikrun edut vesimana da hahu shuryeka distar yemina devalit bishchivu veinun terin atvan demitchabberan beh inun hahi shuryeka dechalil teren acharanin veda ihu raza dichtiv edut bihosef shemo dechal man dechama leh hava rachim leh belibboy uvirchimu ishtelim

Zara dedavid mithappechan beh chezu digvanin ubbegin kach taa shemuel dichtiv al tabbet el marehu begin desitra achara hava beh beeliav dela hava hachi bedavid deyyuknin dedavid temirin inun deha deyyuknin desitra achara itkelil go diyyuknin vehahu diyyukna distar achara itchaze beh bekadmita deabar al ayenin lefum shaata uvahil libba vedachil ulvatar vetov roi vayeya immo veda ihu edut legabbeh
Diyyukna da deadam kalil kal diuknin vechullehu kelilan beh hay la bahil berucheh beshaata derugzeh ihu benayecha umilloy benayecha umiyyad itpayyas
Bechaddoy al libbeh sifvan dileh attikin mareh gauta beshigona lishana bisha

Saaroy sheiin ravrevin vesaggiin anpoy anpin arichin zeer veaggulin zeer lezimnin itcharat mikkal ma deavad vetav lekilkuleh beeneh tishkach shuryake teren beena dimina vechad beena dismala udnoy zeirin kayemin bekiyyuma

Zara dedavid behippucha zara dedavid kal simanin illen letav ulmebad tivu bar sifn ravrevin dechal man deshifvateh ravrevin mareh delishana bisha ihu ben zakkaa ben chayyava bar i tzaddik gamur hu uvzachu dileh natztzach venatir garmeh

Ayenin yerokin zeir miggavin sumak azil benayehu bemitztzecheh teren reshumin missitra da lesitra da vechad leela zeera vechad letatta ihu beat veat da mitztzecheh rav beiggula ihu tav lecholla yahiv mikkal ma deit leh lechal bar nash vtran ihu saaroy sheia vetale bistar yemina it leh chivaru desaare miyyoma deitbere

Matnitin bene alma marehon desachletanu pekichin marehon ayenin dimhemanuta di hava geniza bechu man minnechun desalik venachit man di ruach elahin kaddishin beh likum velinda beshaata desalik biruta deresha chivara lemivre adam batash bego butztzina chada uvatash butztzina bifshitu denahir vhahu peshitu devutztzina appik nishmatin

646: Zara dedavid deitchaze beh hahu diyyukna bekadmita deabar lefum shaata al ayenin berugzeh benayecha miyyad itpayyas aval natir devavu kenachash lesofa begin dehahu sitra garma leh desachara bechal sitrin aval mocha divgo kelifa velibba mityashshera veyatztziva da leinun zakkain aval chayyavin la mitabberan mehahu diyyukna kadmaa bisha veitchabberan beh becholla

Tziura tinyana i hahu bar nash la azil kal kach bearcha bisha veaste mehahu archa vetav lemarih la dehu regila bearchoy dimtakkenan ella ihu dehava beinun orche mitade vesate minnayehu vetav lemareh hay ihu rucha tava share lemishri aloy ulittatkefa al zuhama kadmaa dehava beh uvalit levar beistakkeluta deayenin lefum shaata kechad diyyukna dearye deitgabbar hay beshaata dechame leh hahu chezu garim leh leabar belibbeh arye demitgabbera lefum shaata

Hay mistakkelan beanpoy levatar inun anpin delibba la rachim lon lefum shaata umiyyad tav libbeh verachim leh kad mistakkelan beh achsif vechashiv decholla yadin be anpoy chafyan dama lefum shaata mithappechan lechivvera o liroka

Telat shuryekan it beanpoy chad limina deda itpashat beanpoy veitachid beh chad desalleka lechotameh leela utren lismala vechad deitpashshat letatta meinun terin veachid behay uvhay veillen inun atvan demitchakkekan beanpoy veinun baltin dela shechivin vechad mityashva veargil beorach keshot shechivin
Veraza deinun atvan ihu kariv da hava rachik vehashta inun atvan baltin beanpoy vesahadin beh bivhilu vesimana da Adonai missetar yemina atvan acharanin missetar

Ityashav hahu rucha behahu afra veitlavash beh keden hahu afra mechashkesha venachat letatta vechanash afra sitrin dealma veitavid diyyukna chada ufartzufa vehahu rucha ittammar miggo lego vehahu afra deitkenish sitrin batash legabbeh nefesh kelila beafra

Vehahu nefesh ihu yesoda leovade gufa kefum ovadin dehahu nefesh begufa hachi itchazi bemashcha levar rucha da ittammar lego vehahu achze levar salik venachit uvatash beanpoy veachze diyyuknin urshimin batash bemitztzecheh achze diyyuknin urshimin batash beenoy veachze diyyuknin urshimin hada hu dichtiv hakkarat penehem anta bam

Butztzina deitmeshach minneh medidu dechad chuta yeroka shalhavuta detohu batash bidoy beshaata devar nash naim verashim reshimin vesirtutin bideh uchfum ovadin debbar nash hachi itreshim veillen atvan mithappechan mittatta leela veyade lon chavre keshot birshimu deatvan devutztzina vechal illen chelin dilgo bebbar nash avdin reshumin vshirtutin atvan mithappechan man derakim da rakim beshippule mashkena kema deatte amer rukkamti betachtiyyot aretz berich hu berich shemeh lealam ulalme almin
Ayenin chivara veevarin sumakin beatreh denafik mineh da ihu beat vat kelila kachada

Mitztzecheh rav telat sirtutin sallekin bemitztzecheh shit zeirin acharanin sumak hu vla sumak kayema ben teren gavenin saareh uf hachi anpoy ravrevan saareh kamit vela kal kach tale zeer techot udnoy tav ihu mare dimhemnuta mare derugza takkif beshaata deitregiz

Hahu sumaka ditchot ena itpashat beeneh rugzeh bish beshaata demallil berugzeh satim pumeh venafik tenana minnechiroy velizman zeer nach rugzeh vela kal rugzeh ad yoma achara o teren yomin da atztzelach lezimnin ulzimnin la aval kaim tadir beatztzelachuta ben zeer uven rav
Vei sumaka defum ena zeer kechuta vela itpashat beshaata derugzih beena vit beh kal hane simanin chalsha belibba veihu dachil mikkolla
647: Semala veaf al gav deshuryake acharanin itchazun beanpoy la baltin levar kehane bar bezimna dehava azil beakkimu
Hayi ihu zara dedavid ithappach mechezu da bekadmita itchaze bediyyukna deadam ulvatar kayema bediyyukna dearye veitperash bediyyukna desitra achara uvcholla mithappecha mishshear bene nasha

Tziura telitaa i hahu bar nash azil bearcha dela mettatkena vesate orchoy mearche deorayeta hahu rucha kaddisha istallak minneh verucha achara itchaze beh udukna achara uvalit levar beistakkeluta deayenin dechakkime libba lefum shaata diyyukna deshor beshaata dechaman leh maberan belibbayehu hahu diyyukna veistakkelan beh

Kurtame sumake beanpoy besitra dimina veinun shuryake sumakin dekikin utlat bismala veillen inun atvan devaltin beh chad ihu shuryeka dakik beiggula utren dekikin acharanin aleh vechullehu beiggula uchden shekiin enoy

Veraza deinun atvan chad ihu teren acharanin inun vechen listar semala vesimana da hahu dichtiv hakkarat penehem anta bam veillen atvan baltin beanpin al kal shear shuryakin vei tav missemala limina itkafya hahu rucha veittakkaf rucha dekudsha veillen shuryakin shechivu veacharanin baltin levar kema deittemar

Zara dedavid ihu behippucha itchazya bediyyukna dearye bekadmita ulvatar ithaddar bediyyukna deshor terin shuryakin ukkamin beanpoy chad mimina vechad missemala veillen inun atvan chad ikre vechad ikre vecholla mithappecha mishshear bene nasha

Tziura reviaa da ihu tziyyura devar nash dekayema tadir leittakna al raza demilkaddemin hay ihu chezu lechakkime libba bediyyukna denesher hahu rucha dileh ihu rucha chalsha hay la achze beanpin atvan devaltin levar deha itavidu minneh veishtekau bezimna achara demilkaddemin deistallaku minneh veal da la baltin beyih

Veraza dileh enoy la nehirin bintzitzu kad ihu bechedva uvzimna desafar sear resheh vediknih begin derucheh la nahir leh beatvan veishteka netzitzu dileh dehava bekadmita la kayema beistakkeluta deanpin leistakkela veraza dehay veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim adenna zara dedavid sod Adonai lireav uvrito lehodiam

Berucha devar nash itzteyyaru atvan kema deittemar veiyihu balit lon levar veitmesar chachmeta da lechakkime libba leminda ulishtemoda rucha kayema beraza deze sefer vecholla beraza da kayema bar chezu deanpin deitteddan begavena achara kefum shultanu
Shenateh la ityashav beh chashiv tadir machashavin vedachil mikkullehu veatztzelach lecholla mareh digria la chash legiyyufa

Lezimnin tav bituvta vedachil umiggo dechilu keden tishkach beeneh yemina hahu sumaka defum ena besofa beshippule ena vchad shuryaka dakik sumak beeneh semala vi mitchallefe ma dimina lismala uma dismala limina keden ihu bekilkuleh vtav vetavar geziza devarda begin leabera avera

Teren kemitin al resha utlat deena letatta uvragleh semala beetztzebbea deemtzaita shit saarin uvzimna achara chamesh vhashta shit chad zeira benayehu ayenin ukkamin ukritzin deal enoy ravrevin saggiin saarin illen al illen vinun ayenin ukkamin veyaroka azil begavayehu vehahu yeroka atba yattir hay it leh chamesh sirtutin bemitztzecha teren deavrin missetar listar utlat dela avrin vechu

648: Derucha o marih derucha zakkain inun chakkimin decholla itmesar lon leminda ad hacha raza deanpin

Mikkan ulhala beraza desifvan beat dechalil beraza deat sifvan ravrevan da ihu bar nash mallil belishana bisha vela achsif vela dachil mare demachloket rechila ihu ben hay lehay umshalleach medanim ben achim lav ihu marih derazin vechad ishtaddal beorayeta mechasse razin aval marih delishana bisha vela shavi dechilu belibbeh
Vesimana da at dechalil beat vela itkelil beat hay ihu deitchaze deihu zakkaa vela dachil chattaa ihu vela bae leishtaddela avatreh begin dechal milloy inun befuma vela begufa

Beraza deudnin man deudnoy ravrevin tippesha belibeh veshigona berucheh man deudnoy zeirin vekayemin al kiyyuma pekicha delibba beitaruta ihu tzave leishtaddela becholla veraza da at deitkelil bechal shear atvan

Ad hacha razin dediyyuknin devar nash mikkan ulhala razin acharanin beatvan demor dela kayemin go partzufa ella leminda razin dehay pesuka go dargin illain bizmanin utkifin dehay alma vela zachenan behu

Amar shimon banay zakkain attun bealma den uvalma deate vezakkain enay deyizkun lemecheme da kad eul lehahu alma deate begin nishmati kare leattik yomin hay kera taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray dishshanta vashshemen roshi kosi revaya vekudsha berich hu kare alan pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik shomer emunim

Uf inun patchu veamru ketiv vide adam mittachat kanfehem hay kera ukmuha chavrayya deinun yedin lekabbela marihon ditiuvta detavaan legabbe kudsha berich hu aval yede adam illen inun deyyuknin verazin illain deshavi kudsha berich hu bevar nash vesidder lon beetzbean levar ulgo uvhahu kaf

Veraza dechaf deat da deikre kaf dichtiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo da ihu raza deat kaf at da it beh razin illain vediyyuknin illain behay kaf talyan eser amiran mimina umissemala chamesh mimina vechamesh missemala veinun chad beraza chada
Vechad hao bechibbura chada ketiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vego vayyivra elohim da seliku demachashava beraza penimaa et haadam raza dechar venukba kachada betzelem elohim raza dechaf
Kad itbere adam ma ketiv beh or uvasar talbisheni
649: Vego i hachi haadam mahu i tema deeno ella or uvasar veatzamot vegidim lav hachi deha vadday haadam lav ihu ella nishmeta veillen dekaamar or uvasar atzamot vegidim kullehu la hao ella malbusha bilchodoy manin inun devar nash velav inun adam vechad hay adam istallak itpashat meinnun manin deka levish

Atzmot vegidim inun retichin vechal inun chayyalin dekayemin lego vechullehu malbushin lifnimaa raza deadam ilaa deihu penimaa

Behay rekia dilela dimsakkech al kolla itreshimu beh reshimin leitchazaa ulminda beinun reshimin deitkeviu beh millin verazin setimin veinun reshimin dekkochavayya umazzale deitreshimu veitkeviu behay rekia desachich levar uf hachi or deihu sikkucha levar bevar nash deihu rekia desachich al kolla it beh reshimin vesirtutin veinun kochavayya umazzale dehay or leitchazaa behu ulminda behu millin verazin setimin bechochavayya umazla leayena behu chakkime libba ulistakkela behu leminda istakkeluta beanpin berazin dekaamaran veraza da hovre shamayim hachozim bakkochavim
Veda ihu kad inun nehirin vekayemin belo rugza bezimna derugza shalta aleh devar nash dina achara itmesar leminda beh bema dela ityehiv leshalletaa leminda bezimna deena shalta birkia

Aval istakkeluta deanpin al arach keshot beshaata deanpin nehirin vekayema bar nash al kiyyuma veinun reshimin itchazun beorach keshot dichden behahu istakkeluta yachil leitteddana al buryeh yattir veaf al gav divcholla kal inun chakkimin yachlin leistakkela
Sirtute yedin vesirtute etzbean lego kullehu kayemin berazin acharanin leminda bemillin setimin veillen inun kochavayya dinhirin leistakkela go mazzale bitsirin illain

Etzbean kayeme berazin illain tufre etzbean dekayemin dechafyan levar hu ukmuha beinun razin dahao panim dilvar uvhu it razin leinun charashin demistachle betufre binhiru demilla achara deshalta behu veinun charashin ka mesaave lehahu atar

Betufrin it zimnin denaharin behu kochavin chivarin dekikin veillen inun ketolda ditlufchin veinun shekiin kehay masmera al lucha velav inun keinun chivarin acharanin dela shekiin ella dekayemin leela behani dela shekiin let behu mammasha aval hani dishkiin chivarin ketolda ditlufchin it behu mammasha veit simana tava leh levar nash bechedu veyatzlach behahu zimna o gezera itgezar alleh veishteziv minah
650: Beetzbean lego beyadin sirtutin ravrevin sirtutin zeirin dekikin illain bimina beinun etzbean divhu sirtutin zeirin beetzbea zeera dimina it reshimin dekikin etzbea da kayema tadir al ovadin devistar achara

Beetzbea deemtzaita hay etzbea kayema lemebad ovada hahu dechashiv i sirtuta chada kayema bearka ben sirtute defutya hay chashav machashavin veistallekan minneh vedachil vela avid vehahi machashava la itavid kelal

651: Dimina bizera uvravreva vesiman kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun ellu teren etzbean berazin illen vehachi inun berazin deolifna minneh demor beraze derav yesa sava mikkan ulhala sirtutin acharanin deikrun kullehu toldot veinun toldot adam kema dichtiv toldot hashshamayim veha ittemar decholla raza da kegavena da toldot adam bechal inun diyyuknin deanpin uvchal inun dekaamaran uvillen toldot desirtute yedin deitchazyan berazin penimain kema deitchaze
Ze sefer toldot adam lesirtutin siman razin lechakkime libba chamesh atvan bechamesh tarin leminda chachma besuchletanu
