Attem reitem asher asiti lemitzrayim veeshsha etchem al kanfe nesharim may kanfe nesharim amar ribbi yehuda berachame dichtiv kenesher yair kinno vego vehayenu raza deamar shimon derech hannesher bashshamayim may bashshamayim berachame ma nesher ishtechach berachame al benoy vedina legabbe acharanin kach kudsha berich hu ishtechach berachame legabbe yisrael vedina legabbe ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot

Elazar hava azil mikkapputkiyya lelud vahava azil yose ver chiyya immeh kamu binhora kad nahir yemama vahau azle amar chiyya chamena hay kera dichtiv ufne arye el hayyamin learbatan ufne shor mehassemol learbatan ufne nesher learbatan ha arye bimina shor missemala nesher bean atar duchteh

Amar leh elazar beatra deyanika sharya may tama mishshum denesher becholla ishtechach rachame livnoy dina legabbe acharanin kach kudsha berich hu ovil lon leyisrael berachame uvdina legabbe acharanin dichtiv veeshsha etchem al kanfe nesharim uchtiv kenesher yair kinno

Menalan denesher rachame ikre dichtiv derech hannesher bashshamayim bashshamayim mammash uvgine kach arye limina shor lismala nesher benayehu veachid lon adam kalil kullehu vecholla ittekkelilan beh dichtiv veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav millemala

Vayehi vayyom hashlishi vego abba patach achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah ma naase laachotenu bayyom sheyedubbar bah achot lanu ketanna da keneset yisrael deikre achot lekudsha berich hu veshadayim en lah hayenu detanenan beshaata dekarivu yisrael letura desinay la hava behon zachvan veovadin tavin leaggana alayehu dichtiv veshadayim en lah deha inun tikkuna ushfiru deitteta velet shappiru deitteta ella inun ma naase laachotenu ma yitavid minah beshaata dekudsha berich hu yitgele betura desinay lemallela befitgame orayeta veyifrach nishmathon minayehu

Amar yose behahu shaata dekarivu yisrael letura desinay behahu lelya venaghe telata yomin dela izdavvegu leintetayehu atu malachin illain vekabbilu leyisrael beachvata inun malachin leela veyisrael malachin letatta inun mekaddeshin shema illaa leela veyisrael mekaddeshin shema illaa letatta

Veitatteru yisrael beshivin kitrin behahu lelya umalache illae hao amre achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah delet behu zachvan veovadin tavin ma naase laachotenu kelomar ma yekar urvu navid leachatana da beoma dekudsha berich hu yitgele betura desinay lemehav lehu orayeta
Vayehi vayyom hashlishi ketiv hu nechonim lishloshet yamim al tiggeshu el ishsha vehayenu vayyom hashlishi shimon amar beshaata dekudsha berich hu baa leitgallaa
659: Betura desinay kara kudsha berich hu lechal pamalya dileh amar lon hashta yisrael ravyan dela yadin nimusay vaana bae leitgele alayehu i itgele alayehu bechela digvura la yachlin lemisbal aval itgele alayehu berachame vikabbelun nimusay hada hu dichtiv vayehi vayyom hashlishi vayyom hashlishi vadday deihu rachame menalan dichtiv vayyet shamayim vayyerad
Uvhay itgele kudsha berich hu leyisrael akdim lehu rachame bekadmita ulvatar ityehiv lehu orayeta missitra digvura vayyom hashlishi dehachi itchaze lehu divgine kach yisrael ikrun

Bihot habboker dichtiv boker lo avot ha i hava avot kadruta ishtechach vela itgalleya chesed veematay itgalleya chesed babboker kema deatte amer habboker or dechad nahir tzafra chesed ishtechach bealma vedinin mitabberan uvzimna dela nahir boker dinin ad kean la mitabberan dichtiv beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kal bene elohim kevan deitabberan inun kochavayya venahir shimsha beh shaata ketiv boker lo avot vechesed ittear bealma tattaa behahi shaata ketiv bihot habboker vechevan demitabberan kochavayya boker ishtechach
Amar yose bihot habboker share kudsha berich hu leitgallaa betura desinay tana bihot habboker kad ittear zechuteh deavraham dichtiv beh vayyashkem avraham babboker
Vayehi kolot uvrakim amar rabbi abba kolot ketiv chaser teren kalin deahadru lechad da nafka min da rucha mimmayya umayya merucha teren deinun chad vechad deihu tere

Amar rabbi yose kolot chad veihu kala ravreva takkifa dela paskat lealmin hahu dichtiv beh kol gadol velo yasaf deha shear kalin itpassekan detanya bearbaa tekufin bashatta kala itpassekat uchden dinin mitarin bealma vehay kala dechalil shear kalin beh la itpesak lealmin vela itavar mikkoyyuma shelim vettukpa dileh tana hay kala kala dekalin kala dechalil kal shear kalin

Amar yehuda let kala ella missitra derucha umayya veeshsha vecholla avid kala veitkelil da beda veal da ketiv kolot uvrakim amar ribbi yose hayenu dichtiv berakim lammatar asa shalhova beutre ketira derachame bechibata dela shechichu

Tana yehuda omer bistar gevura orayeta ityehivat amar rabbi yose i hachi bistar semala havi amar leh ithaddar limina dichtiv mimino esh dat lamo uchtiv yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach vego ashkechan semala deitchazzar limina vimina lismala ha gevura lismala
Veanan kaved al hahar vego anana takkif dishkia beatreh dela natil vekol shofar chazak meod miggo daanana takkif hava nafik hahu kala kema deatte amer vayehi keshamachem et hakkol mittoch hachoshech
Amar rabbi yehuda telat chashoche hao dichtiv choshech anan vaarafel vehahu kala hava nafik penimaa mikkullehu amar rabbi yose penimaa decholla hava deveh ketiv kol gadol velo yasaf

Amar abba ketiv vechal haam roim et hakkolot roim shomim mibbae leh ella hachi taninan inun kalin hao mitgallefe behahu chashocha vaanana vekabbala umitchazyan behu kema deitchaze gufa vechaman ma dechaman veshamin ma deshamin miggo hahu chashocha vekabbala vaanana umiggo hahu chezu dahao chaman hao nehirin binhiru illaa veyadin ma dela yadu darin acharanin deatu batrayehu

Vechullehu hao chaman appin beappin hada hu dichtiv panim befanim dibber Adonai immachem uman hao chaman tane rabbi yose minnehiru deinun kalan dela hava kol dela hava nahir binhiru demistachle beh kal genizin vechal temirin vechal darin deyetun ad malka meshicha uvgine kach ketiv vechal haam roim et hakkolot roim
660: Amar rabbi elazar vechal haam roim roim kema daamena dechamu minnehiru deinun kalan ma dela chamu darin batrain acharanin et hakkolot kema deatte amer vaere et Adonai vaere Adonai la ketiv ella et Adonai uf hacha vechal haam roim hakkolot lo neemar ella et hakkolot

Kegavena da et hashshamayim veet haaretz deha atin divorayeta leistakkela beorayeta ityehivu kabbed et avicha veet immecha kabbed et Adonai mehonecha vechullehu leitkelala behu milla achara uf hacha et hakkolot leasgaa hahu kala achara letatta dechanish lon legabbeh ma denafik minnayehu deveh chaman umistakkelan bechachmeta illaa kal ginzin illain vechal razin temirin ustimin ma dela itgalleya ledarin batrain deatu batrehon vela ledarin deyetun lealmin ad zimna deyete malka meshicha dichtiv ki ayin beayin yerau beshuv Adonai tziyyon veet hallappidim bekadmita berakim vehashta lappidim kolla chad aval middeittekanu betikkunoy leitchazaa itkerun hachi
Veet kol hashofar tane rabbi yitzchak ketiv achat dibber elohim shettayim zu shamati kema deatte amer anochi velo yihye lecha
Amar ribbi yehuda kol bashofar mibbae leh hashofar lamma ella hahu kol deikre shofar dichtiv vehaavarta shofar terua bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh beom hakkippurim beda itbere shofar
Amar ribbi yose ma shofar appik kala eshsha verucha umayya uf hacha kolla itkelil behay umidda nafkin kalin acharanin
Amar ribbi elazar kol denafik mishshofar demashma deshofar chad vekol nafik minneh veshshofar bekiumeh shechiach uvgine kach ketiv kol hashofar
Rabbi yehuda amar hachi kol hashofar hashofar ketiv chaser kema deatte amer shefar kodem daryavesh milki yishpar alach shefar kodamay lehachavaya

Rabbi shimon amar kol hashofar atra dekala nafik minneh ikre shofar tu amar rabbi shimon ta chaze kol hashofar atra dekala hayenu dichtiv ki al kal motza pi Adonai yichye haadam may motza pi Adonai da kol hashofar hu rav mikkal shear kale tattae vetakkifa mikkullehu dichtiv vekol shofar chazak meod veal kal shear kalin la ittemar chazak meod behay kol hashofar talya kolla veda hu deikre kol gadol dichtiv kol gadol velo yasaf veikre kol demama dakka nehiru devutzine dehu zach vedakik vezachich venahir lecholla

Demama mahu demama amar rabbi shimon devae bar nash lemishtoka minneh ulmechesam pumeh kema deatte amer amarti eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni eshmera lefi machsom demama ihi shettuka dela ishtema levar vayyar haam vayyanuu vayyaamdu merachok dechamu ma dechamu vayyanuu kema deatte amer vayyanuu ammot hassippim mikkol hakkore

Tana ma ketiv beh bichezkel kad chama gevuran nimuse kudsha berich hu dichtiv vaere vehinne ruach seara baa vego ruach seara amay amar ribbi yose letavra arba malkevan amar ribbi yehuda tannina rucha rabba deittear benimuse gevura dilela baa min hatztzafon mitztzafon la ketiv ella min hatztzafon hahu deishtemoda leela hahu detamir veganiz leela

Anan gadol veesh mitlakkachat dehava achid beh vela hava achid besitroy leitteara dina detanenan telat zimnin beoma yanka hahu dina kashya bekardite gelifin missitra digvura hada hu dichtiv veesh mitlakkachat begin leitteara bealma
Uma mevassem leh hahu dichtiv beh venogah lo saviv dehahu zihara deaschar leh mikkal sitroy mevassem leh umatkin leh begin dela lehve dina kashya veyechlun bene nasha lemisbeleh
Umittochah keen hachashmal tana umittochah umiggavah keen hachashmal may chashmal amar ribbi yehuda chayyot essa memallela

Tana amar ribbi yose chashmal ma dehava libba leeshsha dichtiv mittoch haesh keen hachashmal velo hachashmal mittoch haesh miggo eshsha deihi lego beeshsha keen hachashmal deihi batar arba dargin dichtiv ruach seara anan gadol veesh mitlakkachat venogah lo
661: Saviv umittochah keen hachashmal mittoch haesh hahu dichtiv beh veesh mitlakkachat

Tanya rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda amar chamu yisrael hacha ma dela chama yechezkel ben buzi vechullehu itdevaku bechachmeta illaa yakkira chamishsha dargin dekalin chamu yisrael betura desinay uvachamishsha dargin illen ityehivat orayeta darga chamishaa hu dichtiv kol hashofar yechezkel lakovlehon chama chamishsha dargin deinun levar meillen deinun ruach seara anan gadol veesh mitlakkachat venogah lo saviv veen hachashmal

Amar rabbi elazar beyisrael ketiv panim befanim dibber Adonai vego bichezkel ketiv keen udmut keman dechame batar kotalin saggiin keman dechame bar nash batar kotala amar rabbi yehuda ma dechamu yisrael la chama nevia achara kal shekken ma dechama moshe dela chama nevia achara zakkaa chulakeh dichtiv beh vayehi sham im Adonai velo bechezu achara kema dichtiv umare velo vechidot

Amar rabbi yose ta chaze ketiv hayo haya devar Adonai nevua leshaata hayeta yehuda omer lekiyyuma hu deata deitzterich lemeheve beginehon deyisrael leishtemoda deha la shavik lon kudsha berich hu uvchal atar demitpazrin yisrael begaluta imhon hu sharya

Amar rabbi elazar hayo haya dechama vela chama dekaim beinun millin vela kaim hada hu dichtiv vaere keen chashmal vela chashmal aval yisrael ma ketiv behu vechal haam roim et hakkolot kal chad vechad chama kadka chaze leh

Detanya kal chad vechad hao kayemin shurin shurin techumin techumin vechadka itchaze lehu chamu kal chad vechad amar rabbi shimon reshe deamma bilchodayehu reshe dishvatin bilchodayehu nukve bilchodayehu Adonai dargin limina ve dargin lismala hada hu dichtiv attem nitztzavim hayyom kulchem lifne Adonai elohechem rashechem shivtechem ziknechem veshotrechem kol ish vego ha Adonai dargin limina ve dargin lismala man inun hayenu dichtiv tappechem neshechem vegercha asher bekerev machancha mechotev etzecha ad shoev memecha ha Adonai dargin lismala
Kullehu dargin ittakanu kegavena dilela lakovlehon yartu yisrael achasanat almin eser amiran divhu talyan kal pikkudin vechal zachvan vechal yerutat achasana deinun chulaka tava deyisrael
Tana behahi shaata dekudsha berich hu itgele betura desinay hao chaman kal yisrael keman dechame nehora baashishata umehahu nehora hava chame kal chad vechad ma dela chama yechezkel nevia

May tama mishshum deinun kalin illain itgeliu bechad kema daamena dichtiv vechal haam roim et hakkolot aval bichezkel shechinta itgele birtichoy vela yattir vahava chame keman dechame batar kotalin saggiin
Amar rabbi yehuda zakkaa chulaka demoshe dichtiv beh vayyered Adonai al har sinay vayyikra Adonai lemoshe zakkaa dara dichtiv beh yered Adonai leene chal haam al har sinay

Ta chaze ketiv mimino esh dat lamo deha mimina itgele ma deitgele ma ben hay lehay amar yose hacha besinay resha vegufa demalka dichtiv vayyet shamayim vayyerad uvaatar deit resha it gufa aval bichezkel ketiv vattehi alav sham yad Adonai deitgele yeda vela gufa vetanenan afilu bida yad Adonai illaa yad Adonai tattaa

Ta chaze ketiv niftechu hashshamayim vaere marot elohim marot ketiv chaser leitchazaa divgin shechinta kaamar deha vaere marot chaser mare chad amar yesa vechi shechinta lav kolla amar rabbi yose la dame resha demalka leragloy demalka af al gav decholla have begufa demalka
Ta chaze bishayahu ketiv vaere et Adonai bichezkel ketiv vaere marot elohim hacha et hatam marot ma dechama da chama da zakkaa chulakeh demoshe dela hava nevia mehemana shelema kevateh
Vaere et Adonai et dayeka vaere marot elohim marot dayeka uvdarga chad hao i
662: Hachi amay la parish yeshaya kule hay amar rabbi yose da kalil da parish may taama parish kule hay yechezkel ella kolla itzterich beginehon deyisrael deyindeun chavivuta dechaviv lehu kudsha berich hu deshechinteh urtichoy atyan ledayyara benayehu begaluta

Amar ribbi chiyya beeretz kasdim veha ketiv hen eretz kasdim ze haam lo haya amay itgele shechinta tamman i tema beginehon deyisrael hava tav detishre shechinta begavayehu vela yitgalya ella hachi tana i lav deitgalya la hao yadin

Veha deitgalya ma ketiv al nehar kevar al mayya beatar dela yisteav vela sharya mesaovuta vehahu nahara hava chad mearba naharin denafkin migginta deeden dichtiv al nehar kevar may kevar dichvar hava meatar dishchinta sharya aloy uchtiv vattehi alav sham yad Adonai sham vela beatar achara

Amar rabbi chiyya ketiv umittochah demut arba chayyot veze marehen demut adam lahenna tana beraza illaa arba chivan it deinhu lego bego hechala kaddisha veinun kadmae attikin deattika kaddisha kelala dishma illaa vichezkel chama demut dirtichin illain deha hu chama meatar dela hava nahir kal kach tana kegavena dilela it letatta minayehu vechen bechullehu almin kullehu achidan da beda veda beda

Vei tema leela yattir dechama taninan moshe chama beaspakalarya denahara vechullehu nevie la chamu ella miggo aspakalarya dela nahara dichtiv vaere marot elohim uchtiv im yihye neviachem Adonai bammara elav etvadda vego lo chen avdi moshe vegv uchtiv pe el pe adabber bo

Amar ribbi yose ta chaze dinviin kullehu legabbeh kenukva legabbe dechura dichtiv pe el pe adabber bo umare velishar neviim Adonai bammara elav etvadda bammara vela marot kal shekken yechezkel deafilu mare la ketiv beh ella marot chaser vekkal shekken dichtiv bemoshe velo vechidot ella kal milla al buryeh zakkaa ihu dara dinvia da share begavayehu

Amar ribbi yose berabbi yehuda appin beappin chamu yisrael ziv yekara demalkehon vela hava behon sumin vechiggerin uktiin vechershin sumin mashma dichtiv vechal haam roim chigrin dichtiv vayityatztzevu betachtit hahar ketiin vechershin naase venishma ulzimna deate ketiv az yedalleg keayyal pisseach vetaron leshon illem

Vayedabber elohim et kal haddevarim haelle lemor rabbi yehuda patach mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kal tehillato bechamma archin orayeta ashidat bevar nash dela yechuv kame mareh bechamma archin yahiv leh eta dela yiste mearchoy limina velismala bechamma archin yahiv leh eta hech yetuv kame mareh veyimchol leh

Ditnan shit mea utlat asar zine eta yahiv orayeta levar nash lemehve shelim bemareh begin demareh baa leotava leh bealma den uvalma deate veyattir bealma deate deha tanenan kal ma dekudsha berich hu ashlim leh levar nash meinun tavan dezache behu lealma deate ishtelim behu may taama mishshum dealma deate dekudsha berich hu havi

Vehachi tanenan hay alma lakovleh dealma deate la have ella kifrozdor legabbe teraklin vechad zache hahu zakkaa bedideh zache detanya ketiv venachala lo yihye lo bekerev echav may tama mishshum dayeya hu nachalato zakkaa chulakeh man dezache leachasana achasanta illaa da zache bah bealma da uvveta dehay alma kach bealma deate uvveta illaa kaddisha dichtiv venatatti lahem beveti uvchomotay yad vashem
663: Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu zakkaa demadoreh im malka beveteh

Shimon amar zakkaa chulakeh dehahu zakkaa dezache lehay dichtiv az titannag al Adonai im Adonai la ketiv ella al Adonai may al Adonai atar deillain vetattain itmashshechan mineh vetaavin lehahu atar dichtiv meayin yavo ezri uchtiv vead attik yomayya meta ukdamohi hakrevuhi vetiuvta veinnuga detzaddikayya leistakkela lehahu ziva dechal ziva mineh nafka veitmashshechan mineh kal inun kitrin

Tu amar rabbi shimon tanenan behay kera az titannag al Adonai sofyeh dikra ma ketiv vehirkavticha al bamote aretz al hahu atar deikre bamote aretz ihu leela mehay eretz vehahu atar deikre bamote aretz hayenu shamayim vehayenu dichtiv al bamote aretz

Al Adonai amar abba az teshev la ketiv ella az titannag al Adonai hayenu shamayim dichtiv ruma al hashshamayim elohim vehirkavticha al bamote aretz hayenu eretz hachayyim mimmashma dichtiv al bamote leachlela tziyyon virushlem deikrun bamote aretz vehayenu shamayim dilela veeretz dilela umilla deamar shimon hachi hu vecholla chad dichtiv vead attik yomaya meta vego vechal hane mile laatar chad sallekin

Amar abba lerabbi shimon lema li mor hay kera kuleh bemay okimna leh dichtiv az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bamote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha amar leh ha kolla ittemar detafnuka veidduna al Adonai ketiv atar deihu leela uchtiv vead attik yomayya meta vego al bamote aretz kema deittemar

Vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha kema dichtiv veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim vego vehayenu nachalat yaakov uvirkata devarich yitzchak leyaakov al hay shamayim kaamar uvarcheh bevirkata dizminin benoy deyaakov leachaya behahu talla lezimna deate dichtiv veyitten lecha haelohim lecha velo leachara mittal hashshamayim deveh zeminin metayya leachaya lezimna deate denafik meattika lezeera deappin vesharya behay shamayim istakkal abba veamar hashta ishtema kolla veishtechach devirkata deyitzchak illaa mimmay dachashivna

Tana mi yemallel gevurot Adonai mi yemallel mi yedabber mibbae leh amar chiyya kema deatte amer vekatafta melilot beyadecha gevurot Adonai desaggiin inun venafkin miggevura chad vetana chad gevura illaa itra deitterin mitattera venafkin mineh chamshin tarin minnehon yemina uminhon semala vechal chad vechad gevura itkere vechal chad vechad mitattera bekarditi gelifin nehorin vechullehu ikrun gevurot Adonai
Amar rabbi chiyya gevurot Adonai chaser ketiv deha kullehu kelilan beda yashmia kal tehillato da hu shechinat ziv yekareh dekudsha berich hu dichtiv uthillato mala haaretz

Amar rabbi shimon ketiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan vego shem haechad pishon vego ha illen bishmahan ikrun vahani arba mehahu nahar denafik itmashshechan ma shemeh dehahu nahara denafik amar shimon yuval shemeh dichtiv veal yuval yeshallach sharashav uchtiv velo yamish measot peri may taama lo yamish mishshum deal yuval yeshallach sharashav veal da ketiv uchmotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav uvgin kach ketiv yotze yotze veeno posek

Tana amar ribbi shimon ketiv vayedabber elohim et kal haddevarim vego vayedabber begin leachreza milin detana beshaata dekudsha berich hu itgele veshaari lemallela illain vetattain itchalchalu venafku nishmathon deyisrael
Vetana hahu milla hava tas milleela letatta umitgallefa bearba ruche alma vesalleka venachta kad salleka ishtaava miture deafarsemona
664: Dachya veishtaava behahu talla dilela veaschar besacharanehon deyisrael vetavat behon nishmathon veaschar vimitgallefa beatreh beluche avna vechen kal milla umilla
Amar rabbi shimon kal milla umilla hava malya bechal inun taamin bechal inun millin gezirin agrin veonashin razin vesitrin keaskuppa da deihi malya mikkolla

Uvshaata dehava nafik hahu milla itchaze chad vechad hava mitgallefa beatroy itchazun behahu milla shivin anpin desallekin begava vechamshin kitrin chaser chad mehay gisa vechamshin chaser chad miggisa achara kefattisha da bezimna deihu batash betinara kema deatte amer uchfattish yefotzetz sala vahau chaman kal yisrael ena beena vahau chaddan

Elohim da gevura et deitkelil bimina kema detanenan et hashshamayim deihu yemina veet haaretz deihu semala dichtiv af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim vimina da hu et kal leachlela kal shear kitrin haddevarim mitkashsheran da beda haelle kal inun taamin kal inun razin kal inun sitrin gizrin veonashin

Tu amar tefilla leani kal atar deikre tefilla milla illaa hi dehi salleka laatar illaa tefilla deresha inun tefile demalka deanach lehu

Shimon aschar resheh vechama lera yehuda ulr chizkiyya dematu gabbeh batar desiyyem istakkal behu amar lehu sima hava lechu veitavid minnayechu amru leh vadday defitcha illaa patach mor vela yachilna lemeal bah

Amar may hi amru leh vehu yihye pere adam vesofyeh dikra baena leminda dichtiv veal pene chal echav yishkon mahu al pene chal echav deha berira dechuleh kera yedana vehay la yedana desefeh dikra la itchaze kerisheh
Amar lon chayyechon kolla chad milla hi uvchad darga salleka tana kamma panim lappanim it leh lekudsha berich hu panim denaharin panim dela naharin panim tattain panim
671: Rechikin panim kerivin panim dilgo panim dilvar panim dimina panim dismala

Ta chazi zakkain inun yisrael kameh dekudsha berich hu daachidan beanpin illain demalka beinun panim dehu ushmeh achidan behu veinun ushmeh chad hu ushar ammin achidan beinun panim rechikin beinun panim tattain uvgini kach inun rechikin miggufa demalka deha chamena kal inun demitzrayim kerivoy deyishmael kema achin ukrivin hao leh vechullehu hao beanpin tattain beinun panim rechikin

Uvgineh deavraham kad itgezar yishmael zacha deshave madoreh vechulakeh baatar deshalita al kal inun panim rechikin vetattain al kal inun panim dishar ammin hada hu dichtiv yado vakkol uvgine kach al peni chal echav yishkon kelomar yeshave madoreh vechulakeh leela mikkullehu dichtiv yado vakkol deshalta al kal shear panim diltatta ubbegin kach al pene chal echav vadday dela zachu kevateh

Atu rabbi yehuda ver chizkiyya venashku yedoy amar ribbi yehuda hayenu deamri inshe chamara bedurdeya unvia devera biktira dekizra itattar vay lealma kad yistallak mor minneh vay ledara deyitteara behahu zimna zakkaa dara deishtemodun leh lemor zakkaa dara deihu share begaveh

Amar rabbi chizkiyya ha tanenan giyyora kad itgezar ikre ger tzedek vela yattir vehacha amar mor yado vakkol amar rabbi shimon kolla itkeshar bechad aval giyyora tanenan shane yishmael delav giyyora hu bereh deavraham hava bereh dekaddisha hava uchtiv beh beyishmael hinni berachti oto ketiv hacha berachti oto uchtiv hatam vayeya berach et avraham bakkol veal kach ketiv yado vakkol

Uvgine kach ketiv al pene chal echav yishkon dei shear kerivoy itgezaru ikrun gere tzedek vela yattir vehu yattir veillaa mikkullehu kal shekken inun dela itgezaru dekayemin beinun appin rechikin beinun appin tattain veihu madoreh leela mikkal panim didhu umikkal panim deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot hada hu dichtiv al pene chal echav yishkon amar ribbi yehuda kudsha berich hu begin kach achriz veamar lo yihye lecha lohim acherim al panay deda hu mehemanuta dileh
Lo taase lecha fesel vechal temuna ha ittemar veamar rabbi yosi kal partzufin share bar mippartzufa deadam deha hay partzufa shalit becholla

Davar acher lo taase lecha fesel vechal temuna rabbi yitzchak patach al titten et picha lachati et besarecha kamma it leh levar nash leizdahara al pitgame orayeta kamma it leh leizdahara dela yite behu vela yafik meorayeta ma dela yada vela kabbil merabbeh dechal man deamar bemille deorayeta ma dela yada vela kabbil merabbeh aleh ketiv lo taase lecha fesel vechal temuna vekudsha berich hu zammin leitpara minnih bealma deate bezimna denishmateh baya lemeal leduchta dachyan lah levar vetishtetze mehahu atar ditzrira bitzrora dechayye dishar nishmatin

Kema detanenan lamma yiktzof haelohim al kolecha kolecha da hi nishmateh devar nash amar rabbi chiyya al da ketiv ki Adonai elohecha el kanna may tama mishshum dekanni lishmeh becholla i begin partzufin mekanni lishmeh mishshum dimshakker bishmeh i mishshum orayeta

Tanenan orayeta kolla shema kaddisha hi delet lach milla beorayeta dela kalil bishma kaddisha uvgini kach bae leizdahara begin dela yite bishmeh kaddisha vela yeshakker beh uman dimshakker bemalka illaa la alin leh lifalteroy demalka veyishtetze mealma deate
Amar rabbi abba ketiv hacha lo taase lecha fesel vechal temuna uchtiv hatam
672: Pesal lecha sheni luchot avanim kelomar lo taase lecha fesel la tabed lecha orayeta achara dela yadat vela amar lach rabbach may taama ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna ana hu dezammin leitpara minach bealma deate beshaata denishmeta baya lemeal kammay kamma zeminin leshakra bah ulayela lah go gehinnam

Tanya amar yitzchak lo taase lecha vego devae bar nash dela leshakra bishma dekudsha berich hu dekishra kadmaa deitkesharu yisrael bekudsha berich hu kad itgezaru veda hu kiyyuma kadmaa decholla lemeal bivrit deavraham dehu kishra dishchinta uvae bar nash dela leshakkera behay berit deman dimshakker behay berit meshakker bekudsha berich hu may shikra hu dela yeul hay berit birshuta achara kema deatte amar uvaal bat el nechar

Yehuda amar mehacha bayeya bagadu ki banim zarim yaladu man dimshakker behay berit meshakker bekudsha berich hu mishshum dehay berit bekudsha berich hu achida uchtiv lo taase lecha fesel vechal temuna asher bashshamayim mimmaal vego

Lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem elazar hava azil bearcha vahava chiyya immeh amar chiyya ketiv veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar vego may taama veha ketiv lo titchatten bam amar leh beod devirshutayehu kayeme

Veta chazi let lach intu beammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot keshera kadka chazi detanenan amay asmich parshetta da leven sorer umore ella bevadday man denasiv hay itteta ben sorer umore yarit minah may taama mishshum dekashe lemebar zuhama minah vechal shekken hahi deitnesivat bekadmita dedina bedina itdevak veisteavat bah vekashya zuhama lemebar minah vehayenu deamar moshe binshe midyan vechal ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash deyarit achasanta da venatir lah divhahu achasana kaddisha itdabbak bar nash bekudsha berich hu kal shekken i zache befikkude orayeta deha pashit malka yemineh lakovleh veitdevak begufa kaddisha veal da ketiv behu beyisrael veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem uchtiv banim attem layeya banim attem mammash dichtiv beni vechori yisrael uchtiv yisrael asher becha etpaar

La tissa et shem vego shimon patach vayyomer eleha elisha ma eese lach haggidi li ma yesh lach babbayit amar lah elisha kelum it lach al ma detishre birchata dekudsha berich hu detanenan asur leh levar nash levarcha al patora rekanayya may tama mishshum devirkata dilela la sharya baatar rekanayya
Uvgine kach bae bar nash lesaddera al patoreh chad nahama o yattir levarcha aloy vei la yachil bae leshayera mehahu mezona deachal al ma divarech vela yishtekkach divarech berekanya

Kevan deamra en leshifchatcha chol babbayit ki im asuch shamen amar vadday ha birchata shelemata behay dichtiv tov shem mishshemen tov dishma kaddisha mishshemen nafka leitbarcha leadleka butzinin kaddishin may shemen da yitzchak amar kema deatte amer kashshemen hattov al harosh vego elazar omer illen ture deafarsemona dachya

Amar shimon tov shem kamma tava shema illaa devutzinin illain kaddishin kad kullehu naharin mishshemen tov kema daamena veasir leh levar nash leadkera shemeh dekudsha berich hu berekanya dechal man deidkar shema dekudsha berich hu berekanya tav leh dela itbere
Elazar amar la itzterich lemidkar shema kaddisha ella batar milla
673: Deha shema kaddisha la idkar beorayeta ella batar teren millin dichtiv bereshit bara elohim

Rabbi shimon amar la idkar shema kaddisha ella al olam shalem dichtiv beom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim mikkan dela leadkera shemeh kaddisha berekanya uchtiv la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshave Adonai Adonai

Vetanenan amar rabbi yosi mahu beracha shema kaddisha begin demineh mishtechach bircheta lechal alma uvircheta la ishtechach al atar rekanayya vela sharya aloy hada hu dichtiv la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshave

Zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho rabbi yitzchak amar ketiv vayevarech elohim et yom hashshevii uchtiv bamman sheshet yamim tilketuhu uvom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone ma bircheta ishtechach beh

Ella hachi tana kal birkan dilela vetatta beoma sheviaa talyan vetana amay la ishtechach manna beoma sheviaa mishshum dehahu yoma mitbarchan mineh kal shita yomin illain vechal chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta kal chad beomoy mehahi beracha demitbarchan beoma sheviaa

Uvgine kach man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta bae lesaddera patora ulatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta begin deyitbarech patoreh kal inun shita yomin deha behahu zimna izdaman beracha leitbarcha kal shita yomin deshabbeta uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya veal kach bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta benahame uvimzone
Rabbi yitzchak amar afilu beoma deshabbeta name rabbi yehuda amar bae leitanga behay yoma ulmechal telat seudate beshabbeta begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma

Rabbi abba amar leizdammena bircheta beinun yomin dilela demitbarchan mehay yoma vehay yoma malya resheh dizer anpin mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin telat zimne mikkad ayiyil shabbeta deyitbarchun kullehu kachada

Veal da bae bar nash leitanga telat zimnin illen deha beha talya mehemanuta dilela beattika kaddisha uvizer appin uvchakla detappuchin uvae bar nash leitanga behu ulmechode behu uman degara seudata minayehu achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi
Begine kach bae lesaddera patoreh telat zimne mikkad ayiyil shabbeta vela yishtekkach patoreh rekanayya vetishre bircheta aleh kal shear yome deshabbeta uvhay milla achze vetale mehemanuta leela

Rabbi shimon amar hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata kala nafik umachreza aleh az titannag al Adonai da seudata chada lakovel attika kaddisha dechal kaddishin vehirkavticha al bamote aretz da seudata tinyana lakovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin

Ulokavlayehu bae leashlema seudateh uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate ulmechode bechal chad vechad minnayehu mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata uvgin kach shabbeta ityakkar mikkal shear zimnin vechaggin mishshum decholla beh ishtechach vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge amar rabbi chiyya begin kach mishshum deishtechach kolla beh idkar telat zimnin dichtiv vayechal elohim bayyom hashshevii vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii vayevarech elohim et yom hashshevii

Rabbi abba kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta have chadde bechal chad vechad vahava amar da hi seudata kaddisha deattika kaddisha setima decholla bisudata achara hava amar da hi seudata dekudsha berich hu vechen bechullehu seudate vahava chadde bechal chad vechad kad hava
674: Ashlim seudate amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta

Rabbi shimon kad hava ate lisudata hava amar hachi atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa atkinu seudata demalka vahava yativ vechadde kad ashlim seudata telitaa hao machrize aleh az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bamote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy illen seudate hech mittaknin amar leh lelya deshabbeta ketiv vehirkavticha al bamote aretz beh belelya mitbarcha matronita vechullehu chakal tappuchin umitbarcha patoreh devar nash venishmeta ittosfat vehahu lelya chedva dematronita have uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvata ulmechal seudata dematronita

Beoma deshabbeta bisudata tinyana ketiv az titannag al Adonai al Adonai vadday dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha vechullehu almin bechedvata ushlimu vechedvata deattika avdenan usudata dileh hu vadday

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha da hi seudata dizer appin dehave bishlemuta vechullehu shita yomin mehahu shelimu mitbarchan uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh ulashlema illen seudate deinun seudate mehemanuta shelemata dezara kaddisha deyisrael di mehemanuta illaa deha dilhon hi vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot uvgini kach amar beni uven bene yisrael

Ta chaze bisudate illen ishtemodun yisrael deinun beni malka deinun mehechala demalka deinun beni mehemanuta uman defagim chad seudata minnayehu achze pegimuta leela veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu veyahavin aleh chumra ditlat millin dina degehinnam vegv

Veta chazi bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin bae bar nash lechde ulmechde lemiskene vei hu chadde bilchodoy vela yahiv lemiskene onsheh saggi deha bilchodoy chadde vela yahiv chidu leachara aleh ketiv vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem vei ihu beshabbata chadde af al gav dela yahiv leachara la yahavin aleh onsha kishar zimnin vechaggin dichtiv peresh chaggechem persh chaggechem kaamar velo peresh shabbattechem uchtiv chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi veillu shabbat la kaamar

Uvgine kach ketiv beni uven bene yisrael umishshum dechal mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara nishmeta illaa nishmeta dechal shelimu bah kedugma dealma deate uvgine kach ikre shabbat mahu shabbat shema dekudsha berich hu shema deihu shelim mikkal sitroy

Amar rabbi yosi vadday kach hu vay leh levar nash dela ashlim chedavata demalka kaddisha uman chedvata deleh illen telat seudate mehemanuta seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta mikkal sitroy

Tana bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan vechal benin yankin ma delav hachi bechal shear chaggin uzmanin bahaden yoma chayyavayya degehinnam nayechin bahaden yoma kal dinin itkafyan vela mitarin bealma bahaden yoma orayeta mitattera beitrin shelemin bahaden yoma chedvata vetafnuka ishtema bematan vechamshin almin

Ta chazi bechal shita yome deshabbeta kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha dina takkifa shalta vechal dinin mitarin aval beoma deshabbeta kad mata idan ditzlota demincha raava deraavin ishtechach veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh vechal dinin mitkafyan umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla
Uvhay ratzon istallak moshe nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma begin leminda dela bedina istallak vehahi shaata
675: Beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh veittammar beh begin kach velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv ma attika kaddisha temira mikkal temirin vela yadin illain vetattain uf hacha hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkal temirin dealma vedina la shalta beh zakkaa chulakeh demoshe

Tana behay yoma deorayeta mitattera beh mitattera becholla bechal inun pikkudin bechal inun gizrin veonashin beshivin anafin dinhora dezaharin mikkal sitra vesitra man chame anafin denafkin mikkal anafa vaanafa chamishsha kayemin bego ilana kullehu anpin behu achidan man chame inun tarin demitpattechan bechal setar ustar kullehu mizdaharin venaharin behahu nehora denafik vela pasik

Kal karoza nafik ittearu kaddishe elonin ittearu amma kaddisha deitbachar leela vetatta ittearu chedvata lekadmut marechon ittearu bechedvata shelemata izdemanu bitlat chedvan ditlat avahan izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta dechedva dechal chedvata zakkaa chulkechon yisrael kaddishin bealma den uvalma deate da hu yaruta lechon mikkal ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot veal da ketiv beni uven bene yisrael
Amar yehuda hachi hu vadday veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchtiv kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai uchtiv vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad

Tana behay yoma kal nishmatehon detzaddikayya mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha setima dechal setimin verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta bechullehu almin vesalleka venachta umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin lechullehu neture orayeta venayechin benayecha shelim mitneshe mikkullehu kal rugzin kal dinin vechal pulchanin kashin hada hu dichtiv beom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha

Begine kach shakil shabbeta lakovel orayeta vechal denatir shabbeta keilu natir orayeta kulla uchtiv ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kal ra ishtema deman denatir shabbat keman denatir orayeta kulla

Yuday shail leh lera shimon yoma chad deara immeh bearcha amar leh ha ketiv befarshetta da shabbat deamar yeshaya dichtiv cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vego venatatti lahem beveti uvchomotay vego ma ka mayere

Amar leh kapputkaa chamarach kitre betifsa unchit demilla deorayeta bae tzachuta o afche laachorach vezil avatray utchaven libbach amar leh begineh demor avidna archa uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta

Amar leh ta chaze milla da ha ukmuha chavrayya vela perishu milla cho amar Adonai lassarisim man sarisim illen inun chavrayya demishtaddele beorayeta umsarse garmayehu kal shita yomin deshabbeta velaan beorayeta uvlelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayehu beziuuga dilhon mishshum deyade raza illaa beshaata dematronita izdavvegat bemalka
Veinun chavrayya deyadin raza da mechavvenin libbayehu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beiba dimehon behahu lelya veda hu dichtiv asher yishmeru kema deatte amar veaviv shamar et haddavar

Veikrun sarisim vadday begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti may baasher chafatzti da ziuuga dematronita umachazikim bivriti kolla chad bivriti setam zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da veyada raza da
Ta chazi ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kal
676: Melachtecha veom hashshevii shabbat layeya elohecha vego kal melachtecha beinun shita yome avidtayehu divne nasha uvgin hay milla la mizdavvege chavrayya bar bezimna dela yishtekkach meavidtayehu divni nasha ella avidte dekudsha berich hu umay avidte ziuuga dematronita leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma

Uvgin kach behay lelya chavrayya mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon umchavvene libbayehu venafke bene maale benin kaddishin dela satan limina velismala benin demalka umatronita veal illen ketiv banim attem layeya elohechem layeya elohechem vadday begin deillen ikrun benin dileh benin lemalka ulmatronita

Veha datayehu dechavrayya deyadin raza da beda mitdabbekan uvgin kach ikrun benin lekudsha berich hu vehani inun dealma mitkayema beginayehu vechad salik alma bedina istakkal kudsha berich hu beinun benoy umrachem al alma veal da ketiv kullo zera emet zera emet vadday mahu emet izka kaddisha shelemata kema deatte amer titten emet leyaakov vecholla chad uvgine kach zera emet vadday

Amar leh yuday berich rachamana deshadarni hacha berich rachamana deha milla da shemana mippumach bacha rabbi yuday amar leh shimon amay ka bachit amar leh bachena daamena devay leinun bene alma dearchehon kivire vela yade vela mistakkele detav lon dela itberiu vay lealma kad yippuk mor minneh deman yachil legallaa razin uman yinda lon uman yistakkal bearche orayeta

Amar leh chayyecha let alma ella leinun chavrayya demishtaddele beorayeta veyadin setime orayeta vadday bikshot gazru chavrayya al amma deara dimchabbelin archayehu vela yadin ben yemina lismala deha inun kivire deyeot lemebad behu dina afilu beom hakkippurim veal benayehu ketiv ki vene zenunim hemma vene zenunim mammash
Amar leh hay kera bae leityashva bearchoy ketiv venatatti lahem beveti uvchomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo etten lahem mibbae leh mahu etten lo

Amar leh ta chaze venatatti lahem beveti mahu beti kema deatte amar bechal beti neeman hu uvchomotay kema deatte amer al chomotayich yerushala hifkadti shomrim yad vashem kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midduchta da vehahu yad chulak beashlamuta tav malya mibbenin umibbenatan shem olam etten lo lehahu chulak shelim asher lo yikkaret ledare darin davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla veyitkevan bema devae lechavvena

Tu amar shimon ketiv lo tevaaru esh bechal moshvotechem beom hashshabbat may taama begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma vei tema ha laggavoha salleka bechal moshvotechem kaamar vela laggavoha vehahu desalleka laggavoha leachfeya ledina achara salleka detanenan it eshsha achla eshsha veesha demadbecha achla eshsha achara
Uvgine kach itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma mikkal shear yomin uvzimna deitgalya attika la itchaze dina kelal vechal illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvata shelemata vedina la shalta

Tana ketiv ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz sheshet yamim vadday vela besheshet vehane yomin kaddishin illain ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu veinun ittekkelilan beh zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkal ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot alayehu ketiv veattem haddevekim bayeya elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom
677: Kabbed et avicha veet immecha rabbi chiyya patach venahar yotze meeden vego venahar da neviu demabbua denafik tadir vela pasak uminnahara demabbua da itshakya kal ginta deeden vehahu nahara demabbua kaddisha ikre av may taama mishshum deihu nevia leittezana leginta

Rabbi abba amar eden mammash ikre av mishshum dehay eden mishtechach mehahu atar deikre ayin uvgini kach ikre av veha ukimna meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla ikre atta veikre av kema deatte amar ki atta avinu

Elazar amar kabbed et avicha da kudsha berich hu veet immecha da keneset yisrael et avicha et dayeka leachlela shechinta rabbi yehuda amar kabbed et avicha setam veet immecha setam deha kolla hava beminyana et lerabbot kal ma dilela vetatta

Rabbi yosi amar hay deamar rabbi abba meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla ikre atta shappir deha olifna hahu detamir vela it beh sheruta karenan hu meatar desheruta ishtechach karenan atta veikre av vecholla chad berich shemeh lealam ulalme almayya amen

Rabbi chizkiyya amar vadday kolla chad kabbed et avicha da kudsha berich hu veet immecha da keneset yisrael deha tenan amar rabbi shimon ketiv banim attem layeya elohechem hahu atar deikre banim uvgine kach setima demilla kabbed et avicha veet immecha leachlela kolla dilela vetatta yitzchak amar leachlela beh rabbeh dehu ail leh lealma deate amar rabbi yehuda bichlala dekudsha berich hu have

Tana behane chamesh amiran kalil kolla behane chamesh amiran itgelifu chamesh acharanin vadday chamesh go chamesh ha ketzad anochi Adonai elohecha lakovel lo tirtzach detanenan teren illen bichlala chada ittekkelilan deman dekatil azir demuta vetzalma demareh dichtiv ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam uchtiv veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam

Amar chiyya ketiv sofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech vegv man deshafich dama keillu azir demuta vetzalma dilela kelomar la azar demuta da ella demuta achara mashma dichtiv shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech baadam illaa mate hay pegimuta mehahu dama deoshid may taama mishshum ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam uvgin kach ha beha talya

Lo yihye lecha lakovel lo tinaf da meshakker bishma dekudsha berich hu deitreshim beh bevar nash uvda kamma vechamma chovin vegazrin veonashin talyan uman dimshakker behay meshakker beh bemalka dichtiv bayeya bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu uchtiv lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem veha beha talya
Lo tissa lakovel lo tignov uchtiv cholak im gannav sone nafsho alla yishma velo yaggid vadday ha beha talya deha gannava leda izdaman leumaa beshikra man deavid da avid da

678: Avuy uchtiv kabbed et avicha vego lo tachmod bet reecha sadehu uchtiv hacha al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach hahu deyahav lach yehe dilach velo tachmod achara vadday ha beha talya

Veillen chamesh kadmae kelilan chamesh acharanin uvgine kach mimino esh dat lamo decholla itavid yemina veal da bachamishsha kalin orayeta ityehivat amar yehuda kullehu hao chamesh go chamesh lakovlehon chamishsha chumshe tora

Tane elazar beillen eser amiran itgelifu kal pikkude orayeta gezirin veonashin dachya umsaava anfin vesharashin ilanin untiin shemayya veara yamma uthome deha orayeta shema dekudsha berich hu havi ma shema dekudsha berich hu itgelif beeser amiran uf orayeta itgelifa beeser amiran illen eser amiran inun shema dekudsha berich hu veorayeta kolla shema chad have shema kaddisha dekudsha berich hu mammash
Zakkaa chulakeh deman dezache bah man dezache beorayeta zache bishma kaddisha yosi amar bekudsha berich hu mammash zache deha hu ushmeh chad hu berich shemeh lealam ulalme almin amen
Lo taasun itti elohe kesef velohe zahav amar yosi li hakkesef veli hazzahav af al gav deli hakkesef veli hazzahav lo taasun itti itti kelomar oti

Amar yitzchak ketiv meen kamocha Adonai gadol atta vegadol shimcha bigvura vego gadol atta hayenu li hakkesef vegadol shimcha bigvura hayenu veli hazzahav illen teren gavenin la mitchazyan vela mitpaaran bar kad inun gelifin baatar chad bean atar itgelifu beyisrael kan itchazun gavenin leitpaara kema deatte amer yisrael asher becha etpaar

Yehuda patach sos asis tagel nafshi belohay vego zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael meammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot dechedveta vetafnuka dilhon bekudsha berich hu dichtiv sos asis bayeya kevan deamar bayeya amay ketiv belohay ella hachi amru yisrael i berachame ate alana sos asis bayeya i bedina tagel nafshi belohay

May tama mishshum deillen beh itgelifu dichtiv ki hilbishani bigde yesha mahu bigde yesha gavenin deitgelifu leistakkela beh kema deatte amer yishu vego el Adonai yesha istakkeluta hu man devae leistakkela bi bigvanin dili yistakkal may taama mishshum dichtiv meil tzedaka yeatani tzedaka mammash digvanin beh itgelifu kechatan yechahen peer ha gavena chad vechakkalla tade keleha ha gavena achara vechad gavenin mitchabberan beh shaata itchazyan vechullehu teivin leachazaa ulistakkela beh

Yosi amar sos asis bayeya teren chedvan bayeya berachame tagel nafshi ha bedina amar yehuda becholla chedva al chedva vechedva detziyyon zammin kudsha berich hu leachdaa leyisrael bechedvata yattir mikkolla dichtiv ufduye Adonai yeshuvun uvau tziyyon berinna vegv ufduye Adonai yeshuvun ha chad uvau tziyyon berinna ha tere vesimchat olam al rosham ha telat sason vesimcha yassigu ha arba lakovlehon dearba zimnin deitpezaru yisrael bene amamya uchden ketiv vaamartem bayyom hahu hodu layeya kiru vishmo vego
Vayedabber elohim et kal haddevarim haelle kal haddevarim kelala da hu kelala decholla kelala dilela vetatta

Anochi raza dealma illaa beraza dishma kaddisha anochi itgalya veitgeniz itgalya beraza kaddisha dechurseya desihara kayema bishlimu kachada kad shimsha shalta vesihara itnehirat velet lah shevacha bar shevacha
679: Anochi beashlemut razin dishlimu dechurseyya letatta veistallaku chevan kaddishin veihi ittaknat betikkunaha vechad ihi shappira bechezu uvaalah ate legabbaha keden ikre anochi

Anochi raza decholla kachada bichlala dechal atvan bishvile orayeta denafku miggo raza illaa behay anochi talyan razin illain vetattain anochi raza lemehav agar tav letzaddikayya deka mechakkan leh venatre pikkude orayeta behay it lon bitchona kadka chazi lealma deate vesimanich ani faro

Anochi velo yihye lecha ittemar beraza deorayeta veda ihu zachor veshamor anochi raza setima veganiz bechal inun dargin dealma illaa bichlala chada vechevan deittemar anochi itchabbar kolla kachada beraza chada
Anochi raza ditren kursevan ani Adonai dechurseya achara

Anochi deka itdache makdesha venuchraa la itkerav bahadeh umakdesha nahir bilchodoy deka itbattal behahi shaata yetzer hara mealma vekudsha berich hu istallak bikareh bilchodoy uchden ittemar anochi Adonai elohecha raza shelim bishma kaddisha leyachada raza dishma kaddisha bedargoy lemeheve chad begin deraza dileh ihu raza lemidchal mikudsha berich hu ulminda deit din veit dayyan veit agar tav letzaddikayya ufuranut lerashiayya begin deraza dileh Adonai tattaa

Lekaddesha shema kaddisha bechal yoma leitkaddesha bedargin kaddishin ultzallaa tzelota legabbeh bechal zimna leistalleka kitra illaa raza dechurseyya illaa al gabbe chivan illain kedeka yeot veraza dileh Adonai illaa

Leishtaddela beorayeta yemama velele ulmigzar geziru beraza litmanya yomin ulkaddesha buchra ulannacha tefilin vetzitzit umzuza ulmimsar nafsha legabbe kudsha berich hu ulitdabbeka beh illen inun teresar pikkudin illain dichlilan pikkudin acharanin deinun beraza deanochi kelala dezachor veat da la itchallaf beatar achara da begin deihi raza illaa kelala deorayeta uvillen teresar it teresar mechilin derachame detalyan minnayehu vechad deshalta lemeheve telesar

Lo yihye lecha raza deshamor bitlat mea veshittin vechamesh pikkude orayeta raza dela lemehav yekar urvu leelaha achara migaddela defarach vesalik baavira dela yiste libba lemivne lah leelaha achara kema deit raza devone migaddela dela lemifni bediyyukna deavoda zara dela leharhara avatraha dela lesaggeda vela leachfeya garmeh leelaha achara

Dela lechallefa yichuda demareh begin taavan acharanin dela leharhara deit elaha achara bar minneh dela lemiste batar bidin udchuro beraza dediyyukna deadam vela bediyyukna achara dela lemishal min metayya vela lemebad charshin dela yome befumoy bishma deelaha achara ad hacha teresar acharanin deinun pikkude shamor uvillen teresar talyan telat mea vechamshin utlat pikkude deshamor acharanin dichlilan beillen teresar veraza da anochi
Amar rabbi shimon tu tanenan anochi kelala deela vetatta kelala deillain vetattain kelala dechevan kaddishin dichlilan beh kolla hu beraza deanochi lo yihye lecha letatta raza ditresar chevan tattain

Lo taase lecha fesel pislu mehahu atar illaa mehahu atar kaddisha fesel pesolet dikdusha deihu raza detaava achara veraza da kema deatte amer vaere vehinni ruach seara baa min hatztzafon vego vechal temuna hada hu dichtiv veesh mitlakkachat ki anochi Adonai elohecha begin leatara libba legabbe ela vela lenachta letatta vela lemikrav litra beta el kanna dekina ihu behahu atar
Veraza da tachat shalosh ragza eretz veihu lo taase lecha chad fesel teren vechal temuna telat veeretz da al da
680: Poked aon avot al banim al shilleshim veal ribbeim ilana chada deintziv chada utren zimnin utlat zimnin vearba zimnin veitpekad al chove kadmae av uven shelishi urvii chad hu kad la ittakkan vela chayish leittakna vechen behippucha deda leilana deihu ittakkan kadka chazi vekaim al kiumeh veose chesed vego

La tissa raza da ha ukmuha chavrayya begin dekudsha berich hu kad shatil alma atba go tehome tzerora chada chakika bishma kaddisha veatba lah lego tehoma vechad mayya baan lesalleka chaman raza dishma kaddisha chakik al hahu tzerora vetayevin umishtakkein vehadrin laachora ushma da kayema ad yoma da go tehoma
Uvshaata deomin bene nasha al keshot bekiyyuma dikshot hahu tzerora salleka umkabbela hahu omaa veahdar veitkayyam al tehoma vealma itkayyam vehahu omaa dikshot kayyam alma

Uvshaata deomu bene nasha omaa leshakkera hahu tzerora salleka lekabbela lah lehahi omaa kevan dechaze deihu deshikra keden hahu tzerora dehava salik tav laachora umayin azlin veshatin veatvan dehahu tzerora parchan go tehome veitbadderan uvaan mayya lesalleka lechafya alma ulahdara leh kemillekaddemin

Ad dezammin kudsha berich hu lechad memana yeazriel di memana al shivin maftechan beraza dishma kaddisha veal legabbeh dehahu tzerora vechakik beh atvan kemilkaddemin uchden itkayyam alma veahadru mayin leduchtayehu veal da ketiv la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshave

Raya mehemna pikkuda leomaa bishmeh beorach keshot uman deome shevua hu kalil garmeh beinun dargin illain dishma dekudsha berich hu itkelil behu veha shita inun hahu bar nash deome omaa dikshot al pi bet din kalil garmeh behu vehu sheviaa lekayema shema kaddisha beduchteh val da ketiv uvishmo tishshavea uman deome omaa lemaggena ulshakkera garim lehahu atar dela yitkayyam beduchteh

Omaa lekayema pikkuda demareh da ihu shevua dikshot kad hahu yitztzer hara mekatreg levar nash umfatte leh lemebar al pikkuda demareh da ihu omaa demareh ishtebbach beh veitztzeterich leh levar nash leumaa bemareh al da vihu shevacha dileh vekudsha berich hu mishtebbach beh kegon boaz dichtiv chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker ha yitztzer hara hava mekatreg leh vome al da

Neder ihu leela vinun chayye malka raza dermch shayefin utrisar ketirin kechushban vneder veal da chamir mishshevua chayye demalka illen deyahiv chayyin lechal illen shayefin vikrun hachi begin inun chayyin veinun chayyin nachtin meela letatta lehahu mekora dechayyn umehahu mekora nachtin letatta lechal inun shayefin

Shevua lekayema darga diltatta raza dishma kaddisha vda ikre melech atztzemo derucha illaa vegufa dileh lemishre begavih uldayera beh berucha deshare go gufa veal da ikre melech atztzemo derucha ilaa taiva dile lemishre begavi atztzemo dehahu desattir leela uvgin kach man deome bikshot hu mekayyem lehahu atar vechad kae hay atar mekuyam mekayyem kal alma neder sharya al kolla al mitztzeva veal reshuta delav hachi bishvua vhachi ukmuha chavrayya
681: Zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho da ihu raza divrit kaddisha uvgin dibbehay berit kayemin kal mekorin deshayefe gufa veihu kalal kolla kegavena da shabbat ihu kelala deorayeta vechal razin deorayeta beh talyan vekiyyuma deshabbat kekiyyuma dechal orayeta man denatir shabbat keilu natir orayeta kulla

Raya mehemna pikkuda lemehevi dachir yom hashshabbat kema deatte amer zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho raza deshabbat ha okimna bechal inun duchte yoma duchrana denayecha dealma veihu kelala deorayeta uman denatir shabbat keilu natir orayeta kolla veha ittemar duchrana deshabbat lekaddesha leh bechal zine kidushin man deidkar lemalka itztzeterich levarcha leh man deidkar shabbat tzarich lekaddesha leh veha ittemar
Zachor lidchura ihu shamor ihu lenukba yom shabbat raza dechal mehemanuta detalya meresha illaa ad sofa dechal dargin shabbat ihu kolla

Telat dargin inun vechullehu ikrun shabbat shabbat illaa shabbat deoma shabbat delelya vechullehu chad veikre kolla shabbat vechal chad kad ihu shalta natil lechavroy vezamin lon bahadeh behahu shultanu dileh vechad hay ate lealma kullehu atyan uzminin bahadeh

Kad ate lelya zamin bahadeh leshabbat dimama vezamin leh behechaleh veittammar bahadeh kevan dehay atya shabbat illaa itmeshach aleh vchullehu genizin behechla delelya uvgin da seudata delelya chamur mibbeyemama

Kad ate yemama zamin bahadeh litren illen acharanin darga illaa vedarga tattaa da deanhir leh veda deitnehir minih vecholla kachada ikre shabbat veshaltin beoma deshabbat veillen telat dargin inun kelala vraza dechal orayeta tora shebbichtav neviim uchtuvim man denatir shabbat natir orayeta kulla
Teren margelan inun vchad sichata bahadayehu begavayehu dekaim ben hay uven hay margela illaa let beh gon let beh chezu beitgalleya

Hay margela kad shaari leitgalya naharin atvan gelifin baltin venotztzetztzin uvkain bekiin vkastirin vnaharin kal chad vechad veinun atvan inun teren shemahan mechukkakin behahu margela uvoma deshabbat natztzetztzin venaharin ufatchin pitchin venafke veshalte veinun mitnatztzetztze atvan uvintzitzu dilhon alin da beda venaharin da beda
Vechad alin da beda naharin da miggo da bitren ganin chad gon chivar vechad gon sumak umeinun teren ganin itavidu teren shemahan acharanin ad desallekin atn lesheva shemahan

Nafik venatztzitz val beat vnaharin tarvayehu bitren gavenin vinun teren shemahan chad ikre vechad ikre el venaharin kachada Adonai nafik vnatztzitz veal beat Adonai venaharin tarvayehu bitren gavenin veinun teren shemahan chad ikre yedod raza deelohim vechad ikre elohim venaharin kachada al be venaharin untzitzin kachada vealu da beda venaharin tarvayehu gelifin mechukkekan kachada veinun zakfan resha nehirin menatztzetztzin anpin sallekin mehay sitra umehay sitra vinun chad sare anpin

Veillen teren atvan denaharan mitchabbekan da beda inun yedod yedod motztzofotz motztzofotz beraza ditlesar mechilan derachame veillen teren atn kad alin da beda vechad mitchabbekan da beda zakfin resha vnaharan umnatztzetztzan al kolla beinun chad sare anpin denafkin bechal
682: Adonai deishtear ihi salleka bishma chad leitchabbera bahadayehu vihi adonay vechal illen shemahan baltin venotztzetztzin venafke veshalte behay yoma kevan deillen shalte nafak hahu margela illaa balta menatztzetztza umiggo netztzitzu dilah la itchazi bah gon

Kad nafka batash beillen shemahan chad shema minnayehu adonay deihu sheviaa mitatra val bemargela tattaa veityeshav shema achara techoteh veihu veistechar hahu margela illaa beh umitatra hahu netztzitzu denatztzitz behay shema

Levatar dechanish behane shemahan nafkin minayehu shivim anpin lechal setar umitchabberan kullehu kachada veitavid reticha vechurseya chada lehahu margela illaa vshalta beitroy malka bechurseya beoma da vechadde kolla kevan dechadde kolla yativ malka al kurseya vesalik beshivin anpin kurseya kidkamran

Veinun teren atvan sallekin venachtin venaharin umitatrin atn kelala deorayeta batshe bitre atvan kadmae vesalke lechad beshit shevatin ulchad beshit shevatin acharanin veillen inun shevatin deyisrael illaa

Tu illen terin atn sallekin vnachtin uvatshe bitren atn desofa atn vsalke chad bechamesh dargin vechad bechamesh dargin veillen eser amiran leachlela lechv atn shevatin bitrin atn kelala deorayeta vaesher amiran ditren atn desofa ha atvan desofa deorayeta vraza da yarit margela illaa behahu kurseya dev vnaharin atvan

Margela tattaa beshaata deyativ margela illaa behahu kurseya dev vnaharin atn keden hahu margela tattaa dehu bechashocha mistakkel behahu nehiru bechela dettukpa deinun atn deitreshim behon deikrun adonay uchden itnehir vesalik hahu nehora venatil kal inun atn illain vshaiv lon hahu margela begavih venahir nehiru denatztzitz lev evar
Kevan dehay margela natztzitz vshaiv leinun atvan bahadah keden margela illaa itmeshach bahadayehu veitdabbak margela bemargela vhavi kolla chad veda ihu raza chada detushbachta veha okimna

Atn kad natztzetztzin mehay sitra umehay sitra da ihu sichata di begavayehu ben margela lemargela keden itavidu raza dishma kaddisha demv atn becholla raza dishma kaddisha dev atn dirticha illaa vecholla hay vhay itkere shabbat veda ihu raza deshabbat

Zachor raza didchura ihu raza didchura denakit kal shayefe dealma illaa et yom hashshabbat leasgaa maale shabbeta deihu layela veda ihu et lekaddesho deitzterich kedusha miggo amma kaddisha ulitattera behu kadka chazi

Zachor atar delet leh shichcha vela kayema beh shichcha deha let shichcha baatar divrit illaa vekkal shekken leela ultatta it shichcha atar deitzterich leadkera veal da ketiv yizzacher aon avotav vego veit tamman memanan deadkeran zachyan devar nash vechovoy

Velet shichcha kame kurseya kaddisha ma deihu kameh uman ihu kameh zachor vekkal shekken leela begin decholla raza didchura ihu vetamman itgelif raza dishma kaddisha ultatta itzterich leitkaddesha uvamme itkaddash bezachor deha minneh natil kal kiddushan vechal birkan veda kad mitattere maale shabbeta al amma kaddisha kedeka yeot bitzlotin uvvautin uvsiddura dechedva

Vei tema zachor la itzterich leitkaddesha deha minneh nafkin kal kedushin dealma lav hachi deha da itzterich leitkaddesha bimama veda itzterich leitkaddesha belelya vechal kedushin natlin lon yisrael levatar veitkaddeshan bekiddushe dekudsha berich hu
683: Kabbed et avicha veet immecha bechal zine yekar lemechode lon beovde dechashraan kema deatte amer gil yagil avi tzaddik veda ihu yekara daavoy udimmeh

Raya mehemna kabbed et avicha veet immecha kabbedehu bichsut nekiyya dehaynu kanfe mitztzeva kabbed et Adonai mehonecha da tora umitztzeot hada hu dichtiv orech yamim biminah bismolah vgo deani lav ihu bar nash ella min hattora umin hammitztzeot ishtemoda devatar deukmuha mare matnitin en ani ella min hattora umin hammitztzeot deutra devar nash orayeta umitztzeot

Uvgin da kabbed et Adonai mehonecha vla tishtaddel beorayeta kede lehitgaddel bah kema deukmuha chavrayya veal taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem velo tomar ekra baavur sheyyikreuni rabbi ella gaddelu layeya itti kabbed et Adonai mehonecha keven deihu chayyav bikara daavoy veimmeh

Begin deihu meshuttaf mitteren tippin deminnehon notztzar bar nash mitippa deavuha chivaru deayenin vegarmin veevarin umitippa deimmeh shachor di beayenin vesaara umashcha uvisra verabbiu leh beorayeta veovadin tavin

Devar nash chayyav lelammed beno tora dichtiv veshinnantam levanecha vei la olif leh orayeta ufikkudin keilu avid leh pesel uvgin da lo taase lecha fesel veatid lihot ben sorer umore umvazze avuy veimmeh vegozel minneh kamma birkan dehoil vihu am haaretz chashid ihu al kolla vafilu al shefichut damim vegiluy araot veavoda zara deman deihu am haaretz veazil laatar dela ishtemodun leh vela yada levarcha chashdinan leh deihu ovde avoda zara

Kabbed et avicha kema deatte amer kabbed et Adonai mehoncha mehonecha mimmamonecha mehonecha mechinnecha bechedva deniguna lemechode libba deha da chedva delibba kegavena da nigguna dechal alma ovadin dechashraan dehahu bera chadde libba deavuha udimmeh mehonecha mimmamonecha lechal ma deitzterichu

Kegavena devar nash okir lekudsha berich hu hachi itzterich leabba ulima begin deshuttafuta chada it lon bekudsha berich hu aleh uchma deitzterich lemidchal lekudsha berich hu hachi itzterich lemidchal leavuha ulimmeh ulokir lon kachada bechal zine yekar

Lemaan yaarichun yamecha begin deit yomin leela detalyan behu chayye bar nash behay alma veokimna al inun yomin devar nash behahu alma leela vechullehu kayemin kame kudsha berich hu uvhu ishtemodan chayye devar nash
Al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach avtachuta leithanya beaspakalarya denahara veraza da al haadama da aspakalarya denahara beinun yomin illain denaharin miggo mabbua decholla

May shena beillen teren pikkudin deorayeta dichtiv behu lemaan yaarichun yamecha beda uvshilluach hakken ella teren pikkudin illen kullehu talyan leela abba veima raza dezachor veshamor kachada uvgine kach ketiv lemaan yaarichun yamecha uvshilluach hakken dichtiv shallach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach lemaan yitav lach vego raza dealma illaa dela ityehiv beh reshu leistakkela veitzterich leshalleach miggo sheelta veistakkeluta beh
Veet habbanim tikkach lach dichtiv ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vego mikketze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim aval leela mikketze hashshamayim shallach teshallach merayonecha lemishal

Uvda ketiv lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim lemaan itav lach la ketiv ella lemaan yitav lach veyaarichun yamecha la ketiv ella vehaarachta yamim lemaan yitav lach hahu atar deotiv lecholla veihu alma desatim veganiz vehaarachta
684: Yamim kema dichtiv tikkach lach birshuta devar nash ihu

Vei izdaman leh ovada vichaven beh zakkaa ihu veaf al gav dela mechaven beh zakkaa ihu deavid pikkuda demareh aval la itchashiv keman deavid reuta lishmah vichaven beh biruta deistakkeluta bikare demareh keman dela yada lemisbar sevara deha biruta talya milla lishmah uvovada diltatta lishmah istallak ovada leela veittakkan kadka yeot

Kegavena da beovada degufa ittakkan ovada denafsha behahu reuta deha kudsha berich hu bae libba uruta devar nash vaafilu hachi i lav tamman reuta delibba deihu ikara decholla al da tzalle david veamar umaase yadenu konna alenu vego deha let kal bar nash chakkim leshavaa reuta velibba letakkena kolla veyavid ovada demitzva al da tzalle tzelota da umaase yadenu konna alenu

May konna alenu konna veatkin tikkunach leela kadka yeot alenu af al gav delet anan yade leshavaa reuta ella ovada bilchodoy maase yadenu konnehu leman lehahu darga deitzterich leittakna konnehu bechibbura chada baavahan lemeheve mettatkena behon behay ovada kedeka yeot

Lo tirtzach lo tinaf lo tignov lo paska taama bechal hani telat vei la defaska taama la have tikkuna lealmin viyehe asir lan lekatla nafsha bealma af al gav deyaavor al orayeta aval bema defaska taama asir veshare

Lo tinaf i lav defaska taama asir afilu leolada o lemechode beitteteh chedva demitzva uvamme defaska taama asir veshare lo tignov i lav defaska taama hava asir afilu lemignav data derabbeh beorayeta o data dechacham leistakkela beh o dayyana dedain dina lefum taana deitzterich leh lemignav data derammaa ulmignav data detarvayehu leappaka dina linhora uvamme defaska taama asir veshare

Lo taane vereacha ed shaker hacha la paska taama begin deasir hu kelal kelal uvchal mile deorayeta kudsha berich hu shavi razin illain veolif livne nasha archa leittakna bah ulmehach bah kema deatte amer ani Adonai elohecha melammedcha lehoil madrichcha bederech telech

Uf hachi lo tachmod la pasik taama kelal vei tema afilu chimmuda deorayeta asir kevan dela paska ta chaze bechullehu avdat orayeta kelal uvhay avdat perat bet reecha sadehu veavdo vego bechal mile dealma aval orayeta ihi chamudat tadir shaashuim ginze dechayye arka deomin bealma den uvalma deate

Hane eser amiran deorayeta inun kelala dechal pikkude orayeta kelala deela vetatta kelala dechal eser amiran divreshit illen itchekaku al luche avanin vechal ginzin dahao behu itchazun leenehon decholla leminda ulistakkela beraza detrg pikkudin deorayeta dichlilan behu kolla itchaze leayenin kolla ihu besachletanu leistakkela belibba deyisrael kullehu vecholla hava nahir leenayehu
Behahu shaata kal razin deorayeta vechal razin illain vetattain la ade minayehu begin dahao
685: Chaman ena beena ziv yekara demarihon ma dela hava kehahu yoma miyyoma deitbere alma dekudsha berich hu itgele bikareh al tura desinay

Vei tema ha tanenan dechamat shifcha al hayyam ma dela chama yechezkel nevia yachol kehahu yoma dekaimu yisrael al tura desinay lav hachi begin dehahu yoma dekayemu yisrael al tura desinay abar zuhama minnayehu vechal gufin hao metzachtzechan ketzachtzecha demalachin illain kad mitlabbeshan bilvushe metzachtzechan lemebad shelichuta demarehon

Uvhahu malbusha metzachtzecha alin leeshsha vela dachalin kegavena dehahu malacha demanoach kad itchaze leh veal beshalhova vesalik lishmayya dichtiv vayyaal malach Adonai belahav hammizbeach vechad abar minayehu hahu zuhama ishtaaru yisrael gufin metzuchtzachin belo tinnufa kelal venishmatin lego kezohara dirkia lekabbela nehora

Hachi hao yisrael dahao chaman umistakkelan go yekara demarihon ma dela havi hachi al yamma dela itavar zuhama minnayehu behahu zimna vehacha besinay defaska zuhama miggufa afilu ubbarin devime iman hao chaman umistakkelan bikare demarehon vechullehu kabbilu kal chad vechad kadka chazi leh

Vehahu yoma hava chedva kame kudsha berich hu yattir miyyoma deitbere alma begin deoma deitbere alma la hava bekiyyuma ad dekabbilu yisrael orayeta dichtiv im lo veriti yomam velayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti

Ken dekabbilu yisrael orayeta al tura desinay keden itbassam alma veitkeyamu shemayya veara veishtemoda kudsha berich hu ela vetatta veistallak bikareh al kolla veal hahu yoma ketiv Adonai malach geut lavesh lavesh Adonai oz hitazzar veen oz ella tora shenneemar Adonai oz leammo yitten Adonai yevarech et ammo beshalom
686: Sava nachat legabbeh amar leh i hachi rabbi ma tosefet lenishmeta deihi minnah deittemar bah lo taase chal melacha atta uvincha uvitecha veavdecha vego

Amar leh sava sava veatte shail da devadday hay al nishmeta detzaddik ittemar deaf al gav deitchayyav leachata begilgula bechal illen afilu beeved veama uviran deinun ofannim o bechal chevan deminnehon nishmatin divni nasha ketiv bah lo taase chal melacha vehay ihu lo taavod bo avodat aved betzadik deihu yom hashshabbat lo taavod bo avodat aved deihu yom dechol

Aval sava sava shabbat deihi bat yechida veihi bat zugeh detzaddik deihu shabbat may im acheret yikkach lo amar leh ha vaday havdala chulo shel shabbat deit achara dela itkeriat chulo shel shabbat ella chulo shel tuma shifcha amar leh veha chulo shel shabbat may hi amar leh da amata deihi gufa devat yechida dealah ittemar im acheret yikkach lo
Ta chazi nishmeta it deitkeriat ama veit shechinta deitkeriat shifcha veshechinta it deitkeriat berata demalka hacha it ish deittemar beh Adonai ish milchama veit ish deittemar beh vehaish gavriel

Uvgin da nishmeta deihi michayeva begilgul im hi berata dekudsha berich hu i tema deizdevan begufa nuchraa detamman shultanuta deyetzer hara deihu missitra desamael chas veshalom deha ketiv ani Adonai hu shemi uchvodi leacher lo etten deihu yetzer hara

Vehahu gufa desharya berata demalka i tema deizdevan bechitrin tattain dimsaavu chalila vechas alah ittemar vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut ki li haaretz man gufa divrata demalka da metatron vehay gufa ihu ama dishchinta af al gav deihi nishmeta deihi berata demalka shevuya tamman begilgula atya deatyan gilgulin begin deattit tamman ma ketiv bah vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haavadim

Veod vechi yimkor ish da kudsha berich hu et bitto ellu yisrael deinun missitra devat yechida itkeriu bitto vei tema deyifkun kegavena deilen missitra deeved deihu metatron denafku bimnusa mimmitzrayim lo tetze ketzet haavadim hada hu dichtiv ki lo bechippazon tetzeu uvimnusa lo telechun

Ta chazi bar nash kad ityelid yahavin leh nafsha missitra divira missitra dedachu missitra deillen deitkerun ofanne hakkodesh zacha yattir yahavin leh rucha missitra dechayyot hakkodesh zacha yattir yahavin leh nishmeta missitra dechurseya utlat illen inun ama eved veshifcha divrata demalka

Zacha yattir yahavin leh nafsha beorach atzilut missitra devat yechida veitkeriat ihi bat melech zacha yattir yahavin leh rucha deatzilut missitra deammuda deemtzaita veikre ben lekudsha berich hu hada hu dichtiv banim attem layeya elohechem zacha yattir yahavin leh nishmeta missitra deabba veima hada hu dichtiv vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim may chayyim ella inun dealayehu ittemar kal hanneshama tehallel yah veishtelim beh

Zacha yattir yahavin leh bishlimu deatvan yud he vav he deihu adam beorach atzilut deela veitkere bediyyukna demareh vealeh ittemar urdu bidgat hayyam vego vehay ihu shultanuteh bechal rekiin uvchal ofannim usrafim vechevan uvchal chayyalin vetukfin dilela vetatta uvgin da kad bar nash zache benefesh missitra devat yechida ittemar beh lo tetze ketzet haavadim

Rabbi chiyya verabbi yosi iarau chad lelya bemigdal detzor itarachu tamman vechaddu da beda amar rabbi yosi kamma chaddena dachamena anpe shechinta dehashta bechal archa da itztaarna bachada sava tayyaa dehava shail li
687: Man hu nechasha defarach baavira veazil befiruda uven kach uven kach it nayecha lechad nemala deshachiv ben shinnoy share bechibbura vesiyyem befiruda umay ihu nishra deka mekannena beilan dela hava benoy deitgezalu velav min biryan deitberiu baatar dela itberiu kad sallekin nachtin kad nachtin sallekin teren deinun chad vechad deinun telata mahu ulemta shappirta velet lah eynin vegufa temirta veitgalya ihi nafkat betzafra veitkassiat bimama itkashtat bekishshutin dela hao

Kal da shail bearcha veitztaarna vehashta it li nayecha deilu havena kachada itasakna bemille deorayeta ma dahavenan bemillin acharanin detohu amar rabbi chiyya vehahu sava tayyaa yadat beh kelum amar leh yadana delet mammashu bemilloy deilu hava yada yiftach beorayeta vela hava archa berekanayya amar rabbi chiyya vehahu tayyaa it hacha deha lezimnin beinun rekanin yishkach gevar zaggin dedahava amar leh ha hacha ihu veatkin chamareh bemechla
Karu leh veata lekamayehu amar lon hashta teren inun telat utlat inun kechad amar rabbi yosi la amena lach dechal milloy rekanin veinun berekanayya yativ kamayehu

Amar lon rabbanan ana tayyaa itavidna umiyyomin zeirin deha bekadmita la havena tayyaa aval bera chad zeira it li veyahavit leh beve sifra uvaena deyishtaddal beorayeta vechad ana ashkachna chad merabbanan deazil bearcha ana tain avatreh vehay yoma chashivna deeshma millin chadtin beorayeta vela shemana midi
Amar yosi bechal millin deshamana dekaamart la tavahna ella mechad o ante bishtuta amart o millin rekanin inun amar hahu sava uman ihi amar ulemta shappirta vechu

Patach hahu sava veamar Adonai li la ira ma yaase li adam Adonai li beozray vego tov lachasot bayeya vego kamma tavin unimin veyakkirin veillain millin deorayeta vaana hechi ema kame rabbanan dela shemana mippumayehu ad hashta afilu milla chada aval it li lememar deha let kissufa kelal lememar mille deorayeta kame kolla

Itattaf hahu sava patach veamar uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel hay kera akra achara samich uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugrusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel vechal zar lo yochal bo hane kerae kemashmaan aval millin deorayeta millin setimin inun

Vechamma inun millin dechachmeta distimin bechal milla umilla deorayeta veishtemodan inun legabbe chakkimin deyadin archin deorayeta deha orayeta lav millin dechelma inun deka itmasran leman defashar lon veitmashshechan batar puma veim kal da itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy uma i millin dechelma itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy millin deorayeta deinun shaashuin demalka kaddisha al achat kamma vechamma deitzterichu lemehach beorach keshot behu dichtiv ki yesharim darche Adonai vego

Hashta it lememar uvat kohen da nishmeta illaa berateh deavraham avinu kadmaa laggiyyorin veihu mashich lah lehay nishmeta meatar illaa ma ben kera deamar uvat ish kohen uven kera deamar uvat kohen vela ketiv ish ella it kohen deikre ish kohen velo kohen mammash veal archa da hava kohen vahava segan vahava kohen gadol vahava kohen delav ihu gadol kohen setam rav veillaa yattir meish kohen veal da it nishmeta
688: Uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar da nishmeta kaddisha deitmashshechat meatar illaa vealat lego setimu deilana dechayye vechad rucha dechahana illaa nashva veyahiv nishmatin beilana da parchin mittamman inun nishmatin vealin beotzar chad

Vay lealma dela yadin bene nasha leistammera deka mashchin meshichu bahade yetzer hara deihu ish zar vehay bat kohen parchat letatta veashkechat binyana beish zar uvgin deihu reuta demara alat tamman veitkafiat vela yachilat leshalletaa vela ishtallimat behay alma kad nafkat minneh hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel kishar kal nishmatin deishtelimu behay alma

Tu it behay kera uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar aluvata ihi nishmeta kaddisha ki tihye leish zar deka itmashshechat al giyyora deitgeyar ufarchat aleh miggan eden beorach satim al binyana deitbeni mearla misava da havat leish zar

Veda hu raza illaa yetera mikkolla beammuda dekayema letiklin go avira denashvat it tikla chada behay sitra veit tikla achara behay sitra behay sitra mozni tzedek uvhay sitra mozne mirma vehay tikla la shachich lealmin venishmatin sallekin venachtin alin vetavin veit nishmatin ashikin kad shalta adam beadam dichtiv et asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo lera lo vadday

Aval hay nishmeta dahavat lesitra achara ish zar veitashshekat minneh da ihi lera lo lo lehahu ish zar veihi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel ad deavid bah kudsha berich hu ma deavid ata kera veamar uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hachi hu

Hacha it raza hech mitashshekan nishmatin ella hay alma itnehag kolla beilana dedaat tov vara vechad itnahagan bene alma besitra detov tikla kayema veachra lesitra detov vechad itnahagan besitra dera achra lehahu sitra vechal nishmatin dahao behahi shaata betikla hava ashik lon venatil lon

Aval lera lo deinun nishmatin kafyan lechal ma deashkechan missitra bisha veshatzan leh vesimana leda arona kaddisha deitashak go pelishtim ushlitu beh lera lon uf hachi hane nishmatin itshakin missitra achara lera lon

Ma itavidu meinun nishmatin chamenan besifre kadmae deminnayehu hao inun chaside umot haolam veinun mamzere talmide chachamim dekadman lechahana rabba amma deara vechashuv bealma af al gav deal lifnay velifnim bacha hay sava riga chada tavehu chavrayya vela amru midi

Patach hahu sava veamar im raa beene adonha asher lo yeadah vehefdah leam nachri vego hay parshetta al raza da ittemar vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haavadim im raa vego mareh dealma man la yidchal minach deante shalit al kal malchin dealma kema deatte amer mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata vego

Kamma inun bene nasha bealma deka mishtabbeshan behay kera vechullehu amri aval kera da la ityashar befumayehu vechi kudsha berich hu melech haggoyim ihu vahalo melech yisrael ihu vehachi ikre deha ketiv behanchel elon goyim vego uchtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo veal da ikre melech yisrael vei tema deihu melech haggoyim ikre ha shevacha dilhon dekudsha berich hu melech alayehu vela kema deamrin deitmasrin leshammashin velimmanan dileh
Vetu sefa dikra dichtiv ki bechal chachme haggoyim uvchal malchutam meen kamocha kal hay shevacha ihu lishar ammin utvaha ihu hech la mistalleke behay kera lerum
689: Rekia ella dekudsha berich hu sama enayehu vela yade beh kelal deha ma daanan amre dechullehu ayin vaefes vatohu dichtiv kal haggoyim keayin negdo meefes vatohu nechshevu lo ha ikara illaa rabba veyakkira shave lon kera da

Amar leh chiyya veha ketiv malach elohim al goyim vego amar leh ana chamena devatar kotlayehu havit venafkat behay kera lesayea lon hava li leatava bekadmita al ma daamena aval kevan deashkachna lach bearcha abar lach mittamman umittamman ehach leabera kolla

Ta chaze kal shemahan vechal kinnuyan dishmahan deit leh lekudsha berich hu kullehu mitpashshetan learchayehu vechullehu mitlabbeshin illen beillen vechullehu mitpalgin learchin ushvilin yedian bar shema yechidaa barir dechal shear shemahan deachasin leamma yechidaa barir mikkal shear ammin veihu yud he vav he dichtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo uchtiv veattem haddevekim bayeya bishma da mammash yattir mikkal shear shemahan

Ushma chad mikkal shear shemahan dileh hahu deitpeshat veitpelag lechamma archin ushvilin veikre elohim veachasin shema da veitpelag letattae dehay alma veitpelag shema da leshammashin velimmanan dimnahage lishar ammin kema deatte amer vayyavo elohim el bilam layela vayyavo elohim el avimelech bachalom hallayela vechen kal memana ummanna deachasin lon kudsha berich hu lishar ammin bishma da kelilan vaafilu avoda zara bishma da ikre ushma da malach al goyim vela hahu shema da hahu demalach al yisrael deihu yechidaa leamma yechidaa leamma deyisrael amma kaddisha

Vei tema al archa da nokim kera dichtiv mi la yiraacha melech haggoyim deda ihu shema deka malach al goyim elohim deha dechilu beh sharya vedina beh sharya lav hachi velav al da ittemar dei hachi afilu avoda zara bichlala da ihu

Aval kevan dechotala dahavet samich avatreh itnesach kera kaim al kiyyuma beistakkeluta zeer mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim vei tema demelech haggoyim al kudsha berich hu ittemar lav hachi ella man hu melech haggoyim dela yiraacha dela dachil minach vela yizdaza minach mi melech haggoyim dela yiraacha kegavena da halluyah hallu avde Adonai hallu et shem Adonai man dishma leh la yada may kaamar kevan deamar halluyah uf hachi hallu avde Adonai dehava leh lemichtav avde Adonai hallu et shem Adonai uf hacha hava leh lemichtav mi mimmelech haggoyim dela yiraacha ella kolla al tekkuneh ittemar

Ki vechal chachme haggoyim uvchal malchutam meen kamocha mahu milla deitpashshat benayehu bechachmeta dillehon meen kamocha vechullehu odan al da kad chaman bechachmeta dilhon ovadach ugvurtach itpashat milla da benayehu veamre meen kamocha bechal chachme haggoyim uvchal malchutam meen kamocha amre veitpashshat benayehu chaddu chavrayya uvachu vela amru midi uf hachi bacha ihu kemillekaddemin

Patach veamar vattomer leavraham garesh haama hazzot veet benah vego chavrayya ittearu devaat sara lefannaa avoda zara mibbeta veal da ketiv kal asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah hacha ketiv vechi yimkor ish et bitto da nishmeta begilgule al ovadin bishin dealma leama hahu sitra achara begilgula bisha detikla deahadar veha itashshekat leappaka lah mittamman vadday lo tetze ketzet haavadim kal inun nishmatin demitashshekan

Man inun hacha ihu raza illen inun nishmatin dinokin zeirin kad inun yanke miggo tukpa deimmehon vekudsha berich hu chame dei yitkayemun bealma yevaashun rechehon veyachmetzun kechometz da lakit lon zeirin beod deyahave recha
Ma avid shavik lon leitashsheka bida dehahi ama veda ihi lilit dechevan
690: Deityehivu birshutah chaddat behahu yenoka vaashikat leh veappikat leh mealma kad ihu yanik betukpa deimmeh
