Vei tema inun nishmatin deyaavdun tav lealma lav hachi dichtiv im raa beene adoneha deyachamitz hahu gavra bah levatar yomin i itkayyam bah da itashkat veachara la itashshekat veal illen ketiv vaere et kal haashukim vego vehayenu im raa beene adoneha
Asher lo yeadah lo bealef ketiv i tema deha behahu sitra achara azmin lah kudsha berich hu miyyoma dahavat la vehashta begilgule tikla lo yeadah bevav ma dela havat mikkadmat dena

Vehefdah may vehefdah parik lah kudsha berich hu hashta desalleka recha ad la tachamitz vesalik lah lerume meromim bimtivta dileh vei tema kevan deitashshekat mehahu sitra achara yahiv lah kema deamru lachaside shear ammin ulinun mamzere ta chaze ata kera veochach leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah vadday bevigdo vah deashik lah baashiku degilgula detikla ella leyisrael vadday vela leachara vechad nafkat min tikla lo tetze ketzet haavadim ella mitattera beitteraha baarama al resheh

Vei tema dehay sitra alat lah behahu yannuka lav hachi ella natlat lah vechaddat bahadah ufarchat min yedaha vealat behahu atar veihi pekidat lehahu yenoka vechaddat beh vechayechat beh vetaivat lehahu basar ad dilvatar natil kudsha berich hu nishmateh vehi legufa ulvatar kolla ihu birshuta dekudsha berich hu

Ta chaze lo tetze ketzet haavadim may hu ella beshaata denafkat min tikla vehahu sitra bechedu rashim lah lekudsha berich hu vechatim lah bechad gushpanka ufaris alah levush yekar dileh uman ihu shema kaddisha deikre eloha veda hu bevigdo vah levusha yakkira demalka paris alah uchden ihi netira dela itmasserat leam nachri ella leyisrael lechud
Veda ihu dichtiv kime eloha yishmereni veal raza da ketiv hacha leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah bevigdo vah beod dilvush yekar demalka bah kevan devigdo vah ketiv leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah

Ma reshu it lehahu sitra bah ta chaze kal bene alma kullehu birshuteh demalka kaddisha vechullehu it lon zimna behay alma ad deihu bae lesalleka lon min alma veda let leh zimna veal da ihi chayechat behu vechaddat behu

Tu azharuta levar nash it behane kerae vechamma etin tavin illain inun bechal mile deorayeta vechullehu keshot beorach keshot veishtemodan legabbe chakkimin deyade veazle beorach keshot bezimna devaa kudsha berich hu lemivre alma salik biruta kameh vetziyyer kal nishmatin deinun zeminin lemehav bivni nasha levatar vechullehu ittzeyyaru kameh behahu tziyyura mammash dizminin lemeheve bivni nasha levatar vechama kal chad vechad

Veit minnehon dizminin leavasha archayehu bealma uvshaata demata zimnayehu kare kudsha berich hu lehahi nishmeta amar lah zili uli bedoch pelan beguf pelan ativat kameh mareh dealma day li bealma da daana yatva beh vela ehach lealma achara deyishtabedun bi veehe meluchlecha benayehu amar lah kudsha berich hu min yoma deitberiat al da itberiat lemehve behahu alma kevan dechamat nishmeta kach beal karchah nachtat vealat tamman
Orayeta deyahivat eta lechal alma chamat hachi azhirat livne alma veamrat chamu kamma chas kudsha berich hu alayechu margalita tava dahavat leh zabbin lechu lemaggana detishtabedun bah behay alma
Vechi yimkor ish da kudsha berich hu et bitto da nishmeta kaddisha leama lemeheve ama mishtabeda benayechu
691: Behay alma bematu minnayechu beshaata demate zimna lenafka mehay alma lo tetze ketzet haavadim la tippuk mittannefa bechovin tippuk bat chorin berira nekiyya begin deyechede bah marah veyishtabbach bah veyahiv lah agar tav betzichtzuche deginta deeden kema deatte amer vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha vadday kad tippuk berira nekiyya kedeka yeot

Aval im raa beeni adoneha kad nafkat meluchlacha betinufe chovin vela itchaziat kameh kedeka yeot vay lehahu gufa deitavid mehahi nishmeta lealmin begin dechad nishmatin sallekin beriran venafkin nekiyyin mehay alma kal nishmeta venishmeta alat besifra deachmata demalka vechullehu bishmahan veamar da hi nishmeta diflanya zeminat tehe lehahu gufa deshavkat uchden ketiv lo yeadah bev

Vechad nafkat raa beene adoneha deka isteava bechovin uvtinnufa dechattain keden lo yeadah be veitavid hahu gufa minah veihi la izdammenat legabbeh bar hahi demarah itree vetav betiuvta degufa bah keden ketiv vehefda kema deatte amer fada nafsho meavor bashshachat vehefdah hay ihu bevar nash deeta dileh deyifrok lah veyetuv betiuvta velitren sitrin kaamar kudsha berich hu vehefdah betiuvta levatar detav betiuvta pada lah mearcha degehinnam

Leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah man am nachri aluvata ihi nishmeta dechad nafkat mealma uvar nash aste archeh bahadah hi baat lesalleka leela go mashreyan kaddishin begin demashreyan kaddishin kayemin behahu archa deggan eden umashreyan nuchrain kayemin behahu archa degehinnam

Zachta nishmeta vehahu netiru ufrisu dilvusha yakkira alah kamma mashreyan kaddishin ka mitattedan lah leitchabbera bahadah ulmeal lah leggan eden lo zachta kamma mashyryan nuchrain mitattedan lemeal lah bearcha degehinnam veinun mashreyan demalache chabbala zeminin lemebad bah nukmin ata kera veochach leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah illen malache chabbala bevigdo vah ihu netira dekudsha berich hu avid lah netira dela yishlot bah am nachri behahu perisu dintiru alla

Veim livno yiadenna ta chaze kamma it leh lebbar nash leizdahara dela yiste archoy behay alma dei zacha bar nash behay alma venatir lah lenishmeta kedeka yeot hay ihu bar nash dekudsha berich hu itree beh veishtavach beh bechal yomayya befamalya dileh veamar chamu bera kaddisha deit li behahu alma kach vechach avid kach vechach ovadoy mittakkenan
Vechad hay nishmeta nafkat mehay alma zachya nekiyya berira kudsha berich hu anhir lah bechamma nehorin bechal yoma kare alah da hi nishmeta diflanya beri netira lihavi leh lehahu gufa deshavak

Veda hu dichtiv veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah may kemishpat habbanot hacha it raza lechakkimin bego tinara takkifa rekia temira it hechala chada deikre hechal ahava vetamman inun ginzin temirin vechal neshikin dirchimu demalka inun tamman veinun nishmatin rechiman demalka alin tamman

Kevan demalka al behahu hechala demalka tamman ketiv vayyishshak yaakov lerachel vekudsha berich hu ashkach tamman lehahi nishmeta kaddisha kadim miyyad venashik lah vegafif lah vesalik lah bahadeh veishtaasha bah

Veda hu kemishpat habbanot yaase lah kedina deabba avid livrateh deihi chaviva legabbeh denashik lah vegafif lah veyahiv lah matnan kach kudsha berich hu avid lenishmeta zakkaa bechal yoma kema dechettiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah

Hayenu dechettiv yaase limchakke lo kema dehay berata ashlimat asiyya behay alma uf hachi kudsha berich hu ashlim lah asiyya achara bealma deate dechettiv ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo vehacha ketiv
692: Yaase lah al ken hahu sava ishtattach vetzalle tzelota bacha kemilkaddemin

Veamar im acheret yikkach lo vego may im acheret vechi nishmeta achara zammin kudsha berich hu leatava letzaddikayya behay alma velav hay nishmeta deashlimat behay alma reuta demarah i hachi let avtachuta letzaddikayya kelal may im acheret yikkach lo

Patach hahu sava veamar veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah hay kera ukmuha chavrayya becharban be makdesha veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya hacha ihu may dechettiv vehakkenaani az baartz keshehaya vadday veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah may veharuach tashuv da shechinta deihi ruach kaddisha kad chamat shechinta beinun eser massaot deka natla vela baun yisrael leatava bituvta kame kudsha berich hu veshalta sitra achara al ara kaddisha veukmuha chavrayya

Ta chazi rucha devar nash zakkaa itattar bediyyukna beggan eden diltatta uvchal shabbate umoade vereshe yarche mitatteran ruche umitpashshetan vesallekin leela kemma deavid kudsha berich hu behahi nishmeta illaa kaddisha leela hachi name avid behay rucha letatta beggan eden letatta deka salkat kameh veamar da ihi rucha diflanya gufa miyyad meattera lah kudsha berich hu lehay rucha bechamma itrin veishtaasha bah
Vei tema deha begin rucha da shavik kudsha berich hu ma deavid lenishmeta lav hachi ella sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra illen inun telat shemahan illain deayin la raata elohim zulatcha

Vechullehu bealma deate veitmashshechu mittamman chad minnayehu sheerah meshichu dintzitzu unhiru denahir beorach satim mezona dezan kolla veikre binkudat elohim sheerah behippuch atvan Adonai vedda measher shemmena lachmo veda hu sheerah
Kesutah perisu demalka da meshichu achara denahir venatir lah tadir ferisu dilvusha demalka defaris alah eloha da bevigdo vah tadir dela itade minah vehay ihu kesutah

Veonatah man ihu da meshichu dealma deate deveh kolla Adonai tzevaot ihu veda ihu denahir bechal nehorin setimin illain deilana dechayye deveh ona temira demittamman nafkat vechal da beidduna vechissufa dealma deate

Telata hane lo yigra lah kad ihi zakkat kaddeka yeut vei lav ihi kadka yeut hane telata garan minah dela yitavid lah attara afilu mechad minnayehu ta chazi ma ketiv veim shelash elle lo yaase lah dela zachat behu veyatza chinnam en kasef tippuk mikkameh vedachyan lah levar en kasef let lah kissufa velet lah idduna kelal

Ad kan ochichat orayeta dechal etin bah talyan veyahivat eta tava livni nasha mikkan ulhala nehdar lemillin kadmain behahu netiru illaa deka paris alah kudsha berich hu begin dela tehe leam nachri deha bigdo vah untiru ihu lah tadir

Veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah amar hahu sava chavrayya kad tahachun legabbe hahu tinara dealma samich aleh imru leh deyidkar yoma detalga deizderau polin lechamshin utren gavenin vahadar akrenan hay kera vehu yema lechon

Amru bematu minach man deshari milla hu yema amar lon vadday deyadana dezakkain attun veit lerammeza lechun remaza dechakkimin veal ma daana ema kad tidkerun leh simana da hu yashlim al da hashta it lomar man hu deikre ben lekudsha berich hu
693: Hahu dezache litlesar shenin ulhala ikre ben likkeneset yisrael vechal man deihu mibben esrin shenin ulela vezache behu ikre ben lekudsha berich hu vadday banim attem layeya elohechem

Kad mata david litlesar shenin vezacha behahu yoma deal learbesar keden ketiv Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha may tama deha mikkadmat dena la hava leh bera vela sharat aleh nishmeta illaa deha bishne arla hava uvgin kach ani hayyom yelidticha hayyom vadday yelidticha ani vela sitra achara kema dehava ad hashta ani bilchoday bar esrin shenin ma ketiv bishlomo ki ven hayiti leavi leavi mammash vadday

Veim livno yiadenna bar telesar shenin ulhala deha nafka mershu desitra achara deizdammenat leh ma ketiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah mahu kemishpat habbanot tanenan bechal yoma veoma chame kudsha berich hu lehahu yenoka dekae birshu dearla veihu nafik minah veitmeshach leve sifra vetabbar lah veazil leve kenishta vetabbar lah ma avid kudsha berich hu lehahi nishmeta ail lah leiddara dileh veyahiv lah mattenan unvizbezan saggiin vekashit lah bekishshutin illain ad zimna deail lah lachuppa behahu bar mittelesar shenin ulela

Im acheret yikkach lo hacha it raza derazin lechakkimin itmesare veit leodaa bekadmita milla chada ta chaze beoma deshabbeta beshaata deitkaddash yome nafke nishmatin miggo ilani dechayye umnashshevan inun nishmatin kaddishin letattae venayechin behu kal yoma deshabbeta ulvatar denafik shabbeta sallekin kullehu nishmatin umitatteran beitrin kaddishin leela uf hachi kudsha berich hu azmin lehahu bar nash veda hu nishmeta acheret veaf al gav deda zemina leh nishmeta dahavat leh bekadmita sheerah dekadmeta kesutah veonatah lo yigra kema deittemar

Bacha hahu sava kemilkaddemin veamar ihu lenafsheh sava sava kamma yagata leadbeka millin kaddishin illen vehashta tema lon beriga chada i tema detechas alayehu al inun millin vela tema lon ha ketiv al timna tov mibbealav bihot leel yadcha laasot

May al timna tov mibbealav ella kudsha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael inun hacha deha bechal atar demillin deorayeta amrin kudsha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael inun taman vetzayete lon uchden hahu ilana detov vara beshaata deazlin mittamman vetzayetu inun millin hahu sitra detov itgabbar veistallak leela vekudsha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael mitatteran behahu tov veillen inun bealav dehahu tov

Sava sava atte amarte millin illen vela yadate i kudsha berich hu hacha vei illen dekayeme hacha zakkain lemillin illen la tidchal sava deha havet bechamma keravin degavrin takkifin vela dachilat vehashta ante dachil ema milach deha vadday hacha ihu kudsha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael vezakkain inun illen dehacha vei lav hachi la aarana behu vela sharena beillen millin ema millulach sava ema bela dechilu

Patach veamar Adonai elohay gadalta meod hod vehadar lavashta Adonai elohay da sheruta dimhemnuta seliku demachashava vealma deate raza chada bela piruda gadalta da sheruta yoma kadmaa veinun yomin attikin sitra dimina meod da hu sitra dismala

Hod vehadar lavashta illen teren badde aravot ad hacha kevan demata lego ilana dechayye ittammar vela istallak lemeheve beminyana begin hahu meod may meod semala dechal anpin diltatta uvichlala anafa merira chada veal da ittammar hahu ilana dechayye vela baa lemehevi beminyana da ad deahadar kemillekaddemin veshabbach begavena achara
Veamar ote or kassalma da sheruta
694: Deoma kadmaa note shamayim hacha itkelil semala vela amar meod itkelil semala bimina lemehve nahir bichlala deshamayim hamkare vammayim aliyyotav hacha nafik bechedva hahu ilana dechayye nahar denafik meeden veishterashu beh bememoy inun tere badde aravot deinun gadlin bememoy hada hu dichtiv hamkare vammayim aliyyotav man aliyyotav illen badde aravot

Veda hu dichtiv veal yuval yeshallach sharashav veda hu raza dichtiv nahar pelagav yesamchu ir elohim man pelagav illen inun sharashav vehachi ikrun aliyyotav sharashav pelagav kullehu ishterashu beinun mayin dehahu nahar

Hassam avim rechuvo da michael vegavriel illen hem avim hamhallech al kanfe ruach lemehav asvata lealma veda ihu refael mikkan ulhala ose malachav ruchot vego sava sava i kal hane yadate ema vela tidchal ema milach veyinharun millin defumach chaddu chavrayya vahau tzayetin bechedva lemilloy kaddishin amar i sava i sava bema ayelat garmach alat beyamma rabba it lach leshatteta velenafka mittamman

Im acheret yikkach lo kamma gilgulin attikin hacha dela itgallun ad haidana vechullehu keshot kedeka yeot delet leastaa meorach keshot afilu kimlo nima bekadmita it leitteara nishmatin degiyyorin kullehu parchan miggo ginta deeden beorach satim kad mistallekan mehay alma nishmathon deka revacha miggo ginta deeden lean atar tayevin

Ella tanenan man denatil veachid benichse giyyorin bekadmita zache behu uf hachi kal inun nishmatin kaddishin illain deka zammin lon kudsha berich hu letatta kidkamran kullehu nafkin lezimnin yedian begin leishtashea beggan eden ufagan beinun nishmatin degiyyorin man deachid behu meillen nishmatin achid behu vezache behu umitlabbeshan behu vesallekin vechullehu kayeme behay levusha venachtu go ginta bilvusha da begin divginta deeden la kayeman tamman ella bilvusha kal inun dekayeme tamman

I tema divgin hay levusha garan inun nishmatin mikkal innuga dehava lon bekadmita ha ketiv im acheret yikkach lo sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra beginta kayeme bilvushe da dekadman leachada behu vezache behu vechad sallekin leela mitpashshetan minneh deha tamman la kayeman bilvusha

Bacha hahu sava kemillekaddemin veamar lenafsheh sava sava bevadday it lach lemivke bevadday it lach leoshada dimin al kal milla umilla aval galle kame kudsha berich hu ushchinteh kaddisha daana biru delibba uvfulchana dilhon kamena begin deinun bealav dechal milla umitatteran behu

Kal inun nishmatin kaddishin kad nachte lehay alma begin lemishre kal chad al duchtayehu deitchazun behu livni nasha kullehu nachte mitlabbeshan beinun nishmatin deka amaran vehachi alin vezara kaddisha uvmalbusha da kayeme leishtabeda minnayehu behay alma vechad ishtaavan inun malbushin mimmillin dehay alma inun nishmatin kaddishin ittezenan merecha deka aricha miggo levushehon illen

Kudsha berich hu kal millin setimin deihu avid al lon beorayeta kaddisha vecholla ishtechach beorayeta vehahi milla setima galle lah orayeta umiyyad itlabbesha bilvusha achara veittammar tamman vela itgele vechakkimin deinun malyan ayenin af al gav dehahi milla astim bilvusha chaman lah miggo levusha uvshaata deitgele hahi milla ad la teul bilvusha raman bah pekichu deena veaf al gav demiyyad astim la itavid meenayehu
Bechamma duchtin azhar kudsha berich hu al giyyora dezara kaddisha yizdaharun beh ulvatar nafik milla setima minnartikah
695: Vechevan deitgele ahdar lenartikah miyyad veitlavash tamman

Kevan deazhar al giyyora bechal inun duchtin nafak milla minnartikah veitgele veamar veattem yedatem et nefesh hager miyyad alat lenartikah veahadrat bilvusha veittammerat dichtiv ki gerim hyitem beeretz mitzrayim dechashiv kera divgin deitlebbash miyyad la hava man deashgach bah behay nefesh hager yadat nishmeta kaddisha bemillin dehay alma veithaniat minnayehu

Patach hahu sava veamar vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar vego anan da may hi ella da hu dichtiv et kashti natatti beanan tanenan dehahu keshet ashlachat levushoy veyahiv lon lemoshe uvhahu levusha salik moshe letura uminneh chama ma dechama veithane mikkolla ad hahu atar atu inun chavrayya veishtetachu kameh dehahu sava uvachu veamru ilmale la atena lealma ella lemishma millin illen mippumach day lan

Amar hahu sava chavrayya lav begin da bilchodoy sharena milla deha sava kegini lav bemilla chada avid kish kish vela kare kamma bene alma beirbuvya besachletanu dilhon vela chaman beorach keshot beorayeta veorayeta kare bechal yoma binhimu legabbayehu vela baan leatava resha

Veaf al gav daamena deha orayeta milla nafka minnartikah veitchaziat zeer umiyyad ittammarat hachi hu vadday uvzimna deitgeliat miggo nartikah veittammerat miyyad la avdat da ella leinun deyadin bah veishtemodan bah

Mashal lema haddavar dome lirchimata deihi shappirta bechezu ushfirta bereva veihi temirta bitmiru go hechala dilah veit lah rechima yechidaa dela yadin beh bene nasha ella ihu bitmiru hahu rechima miggo rechima derachim lah avar litra beta tadir zakif enoy lechal setar ihi yadat deha rechima aschar tera beta tadir ma avdat patchat pitcha zeera behahu hechala temira deihi tamman ugliat anpaha legabbe rechima umiyyad ithadderat veitkasiat kal inun dahao legabbe rechima la chamu vela istakkalu bar rechima bilchodoy umeoy velibbeh venafsheh azlu avatrah veyada demiggo rechimu dirchimat leh itgeliat legabbeh riga chada leitteara hachi hu milla deorayeta la itgeliat ella legabbe rechima yadat orayeta dehahu chakkima delibba aschar litra beta kal yoma ma avdat geliat anpaha legabbeh miggo hechala vearmizat leh remiza umiyyad ahadrat leatrah veittammerat kal inun detamman la yade vela mistakkele ella ihu bilchodoy umeoy velibbeh venafsheh azil avatrah veal da orayeta itgeliat veitkassiat veazlat birchimu legabbe rechimha leitteara bahadeh rechimu

Ta chaze archa deorayeta kach hu bekadmita kad sharya leitgallaa legabbe bar nash armizat leh birmizu i yada tav vei la yada shadrat legabbeh vekarata leh peti veamrat orayeta lehahu deshadrat legabbeh imru lehahu peti deyikrav hacha veishtae bahadeh hada hu dichtiv mi peti yasur henna chaser lev vego kariv legabbah shariat lemallela immeh mibbatar parochta defarsa leh millin lefum archoy ad deyistakkal zeer zeer veda hu derasha

Levatar tishtae bahadeh mibbatar shushifa dakik millin dechida veda ihu haggada levatar deihu ragil legabbah itgeliat legabbeh anpin beanpin umlilat bahadeh kal razin setimin dilah vechal archin setimin dahao belibbea temirin miyyomin kadmain keden
696: Ihu bar nash shelim baal tora vadday mare deveta deha kal razin dilah geliat leh vela rechikat vela kassiat mineh kelum

Amra leh chamit milla dirmiza deka ramizna lach bekadmita kach vechach razin hao kach vechach hu keden chame deal inun millin lav leosafa velav lemigra minnayehu uchden peshateh dikra kema deihu delav leosafa vela lemigra afilu at chad veal da beni nasha itzterichu leizdahara ulmirdaf avatra deorayeta lemehve rechimin dilah kema deittemar

Ta chaze im acheret yikkach lo gilgulin demitgalgelan behay kera kamma ravrevin veillain inun deha kal nishmatin alin begilgula vela yadin bene nasha archoy dekudsha berich hu veheach kayema tikla vehech itdanu bene nasha bechal yoma uvchal idan vehech nishmatin alin bedina ad la yetun lehay alma vehech alin bedina levatar denafke mehay alma

Kamma gilgulin vechamma ovadin setimin avid kudsha berich hu bahade kamma nishmatin artilain vechamma ruchin artilain azlin behahu alma dela alin lefargoda demalka vechamma almin ithappach behu vealma deithappach bechamma pelian setimin uvne nasha la yadin vela mashgichin vehech mitgalgelin nishmatin keavna bekuspita kema deatte amer veet nefesh oyevecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala

Hashta it legallaa deha kal nishmatin meilana ravreva vetakkifa dehu nahar denafik meeden nafke vechal ruchin meilana achara zeera nafkin neshama milleela ruach milletatta umitchabberan kachada kegavena dedachar venukba vechad mitchabberan kachada keden nehirin nehiru illaa uvchibbura detarvayehu ikre ner ner Adonai nishmat adam mahu neshama ruach veal chibbura detarvayehu kachada ikre ner dichtiv ner Adonai nishmat adam

Neshama veruach dechar venukba leanhara kachada veda belo da la nehirin vela ikre ner vechad mittechabberan kachada ikre kolla ner uchden itattaf neshama beruach lekayema tamman leela behechla temira dichtiv ki ruach millefanay yaatof yitattef la ketiv ella yaatof may tama begin dinshamot ani asiti tamman leela beginta behechla temira itattaf veitlavash neshama beruach kema deitchaze

Vechevan divhahu hechala la have vela ishtammash ella beruach unshama nefesh la ate letamman ella mitlavash behahu ruach tamman vechad nachta lego gan eden diltatta itlavash behahu rucha achara daamena hahu denafik mittamman vahava mittamman uvchullehu sharya behay alma veitlavash behu

Hahu ruach denafik mehay alma dela itrabbe vela itpashat behay alma azla begilgula vela ashkach nayecha itti begilgula bealma keavna bekusfita ad deyishkach hahu paroka deyifrok leh veayete leh behahu mana mammash dehava ihu ishtammash beh vedavik beh tadir rucheh venafsheh vahavat bat zugeh rucha berucha vehahu paroka bani leh kemillekaddemin

Vehahu rucha deshavak veitdevak behahu mana la itavid deha let milla afilu zeera bealma dela have leh atar veduchta leittammera ulitkannesha tamman vela itavid lealmin ubbegin kach hahu rucha deshavak behahu mana tamman hu vadday radif batar ikara visoda dileh deka nafik mineh veayete leh uvane leh beduchteh baatar dehahu ruach bat zugeh denafkat bahadeh veitbene tamman kemillekaddemin veda ihu birya chadta hashta bealma rucha chadta vegufa chadta
Vei tema ruach da hu ma dehava hachi hu aval la itbene ella begin hahu rucha achara deka shavak behahu mana
697: Hacha it razin besifra dechanoch binyana da deitbene la itbene ella behahu rucha achara deshavik tamman behahu mana vechad share leitbenaa da mashich avatreh dehahu ruach deazil artilaa umashich leh legabbeh vetamman tere ruchot deinun chad levatar da ihu ruach veda ihu neshama vetarvayehu chad

I zacha leitdakkea kedeka yeot tarvayehu inun chad leitlabbesha behu nishmeta achara illaa kema deit lishar bene alma ruach dezakkain behu nishmatin inun dekadman veachidan behu verucha achara milleela venishmeta kaddisha itlabbesha behu uf hachi name middileh mammash it teren ruchin begin leitlabbesha behu neshama illaa

Yehe leden gufa achara deka itbene hashta chadta hahu gufa kadmaa deshavak ma itavid minnih o hay berekanayya o hay berekanayya lefum sachletanu debbar nash ishtema dehay kadmaa dela ishtelim bekadmita itavid hoil vela zacha i hachi lemaggana ishtaddal befikkude orayeta o afilu bechad minnayehu veha anan yadenan deafilu rekanin shebbeyisrael kullehu malyan mitzot karimmon vegufa da af al gav dela ishtelim leitrabbea ulmizke ulmisge bealma pikkudin acharanin deorayeta natar dela itavidu minneh vechi lemaggana hao

Chavrayya chavrayya pekichu enayechu deha ana yedana dehachi attun savrin veyadin dechal inun gufin tziyyunin inun berekanayya dela it lon kiyyuma lealmin lav hachi vechas lan leistakkela beillen millin

Patach sava veamar mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kal tehillato man hu bealma deyachil lemallela gevuran deavid kudsha berich hu bealma tadir hahu gufa kadmaa deshavak la itavid vekiyyuma lehve leh lezimna deate deha onsheh saval bechamma zinin vekudsha berich hu la mekappeach agra deshum biryan devara bar inun denafku miggo mehemanuta dileh vela hava behu tav lealmin uvar meinun dela karu bemodim dehane kudsha berich hu avid minnayehu biryan acharanin begin dela yitbene hahu gufa diyyukna devar nash vela yekum lealmin aval hane lav hachi

Ma aved kudsha berich hu i hahu ruach zache leittakna behay alma behahu gufa achara me avid kudsha berich hu hahu paroka deka parik leh hahu ruach dileh deka ail tamman veshataf vearav behahu ruach dehava behahu mana vadday la itavid uma itavid deha telat ruchin tamman chad dehava behahu mana veishtear tamman vechad hahu deitmeshach tamman dehava artilaa vechad hahu deail tamman hahu paroka veitarav behu lemehve bitlat ruchin i efshar uma itavid

Ella kach inun gevuran illain deavid kudsha berich hu hahu rucha deail tamman hahu paroka beh itlavash hahi nishmeta baatar dilvusha degiyyore vehahu rucha artilaa detav tamman leitbenaa lehve levusha lenishmeta illaa vehahu ruach dehava bekadmita deishtear behahu mana parach mittamman vekudsha berich hu azmin leh atar bego razin kavin detinara devatar kitfoy deggan eden veittammar tamman veistallak lehahu gufa kadmaa dehu bekadmita uvhahu ruach yekum hahu gufa veda ihu chad deinun teren deka amena

Aval hahu gufa ad dela yekum onsheh sagya deha begin dela zacha leitrabbea nachte leh lego adama desamich learka veitdan tamman ulvatar sallekin leh lehay tevel hashta nachit vehashta salik ha salik veha nachit let leh shechichu bar beshabbate uvomin tavin uvreshe yarche
698: Admat meadama afar mittevel veal illen ketiv verabbim miyesheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot uldiron olam kal illen dela zachu leittakna aval i zacha hahu rucha artilaa detav kemillekaddemin leittakna zakkaa ihu deha hahu rucha deittemar beh deittemmar betinara yittakkan behahu gufa kadmaa veal illen kettiv ele lechayye olam veelle lacharafot vego kal inun dela zachu leittakna

Veillen inun gevuran illain demalka illaa kaddisha vela itavid kelum afilu haval defuma atar veduchta it leh vekudsha berich hu avid mineh ma deavid vaafilu milla devar nash vaafilu kala la have berekanayya vaatar veduchta it lehu lecholla
Hay deitbene hashta venafak lealma birya chadta let leh bat zug veal da la machrize deha bat zugeh itavidat minneh bat zugeh dahavat leh itavidat immeh veachuha avuha

Sava sava ma avdat tav hava lach shetika sava sava ha amena dealat beyamma rabba bela chavlin uvla digla ma taaved i tema detislak leela la tichol i tema detechut letatta ha imka dithoma rabba ma taaved i sava i sava la it lach leahaddera laachora beidanin illen la havet vela itreggilat leitchallesha betukfach deha yadat devar nash achara bechal dara da la al bearba beamika da deante tamman

Bereh deochay yada leistammera archoy vei al beyamma amika ashgach bekadmita hech yaavar bezimna chada vishotet beyamma ad la yeul veante sava la ashgacht bekadmita hashta sava hoil veante tamman la techolash betukfach la tishbok kal archach limshatteta limina velismala learka ulfutya leamka ulruma la tidchal sava sava ittakkaf betukfach kamma gavrin takkifin tavarte betukfehon vechamma keravin natzachte

Bacha patach veamar tzeena urena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo beom chatunnatto uvom shimchat libbo hay kera ukmuha vehachi hu aval tzeena urena vechi man yachil lemechome bammelech shelomo dehu malka dishlama dileh veha satim hu mikkal chele meromin dilela behahu atar deayin la raata elohim zulatcha veatte amarte tzeena urena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo vetu deha kavod dileh kullehu malache illae shaali veamre ayye mekom kevodo

Ella ma deamar tzeena urena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara ketiv vela ketiv uvaatara dechal man dechame hahu attara chame noam malka dishlama dileh sheittera lo immo ha tanenan kare lah bat vekare lah achot kare lah em vecholla ihu vecholla have man deyistakkal veyinda behay yinda chachmeta yakkira

Hashta ma avid i ema raza setima da la itzterich legallaa i la ema yishtaarun zakkain illen yatmin mehay raza nafal hahu sava al anpoy veamar beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet mana dahavat letatta hech yitavid leela balah dehava leela hech yithappech vahava letatta bat zugeh itavidat immeh tavaha al tavaha achuha avuha i avuha dekadmeta yifrok leh yeot aval achuha deleheve avuha vechi la tavaha ihu da alma behippucha ihu vadday illain letatta vetattain leela

Ella lehve shemeh di elaha mevarach min alma vead alma di chachmeta ugvurta dileh hi vehu mehashne iddanayya vezimnaya vego yada ma bechashocha unhora immeh shara ta chazi man dishre binhora la yachil leistakkela ulmechome bechashocha aval kudsha berich hu lav hachi
699: Yada ma vachashocha af al gav dinhora immeh shara miggo nehora istakkal bachashocha veyada kal ma detamman

Hacha it leakdema bekadmita milla chada deamru kadmae beinun chezve lelya ditnan man deate al immeh bechelma yetzappe labbina dichtiv ki im labbina tikra hacha it leistakkela i begin deihi em yeot vahava leh lemichtav hachi deman dechama immeh bechelma yizke labbina aval man deate al immeh amay
Ella raza illaa ihu begin deithappach vesalik mittatta leela bera hava bekadmita kevan desalik leela ithappach ilana veitavid ihu mealma illaa veshalit alah vezache labbina

Bekadmita kad salik enash shenin ma ketiv Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha keden ihu letatta minah kevan desalik alah hay ihu mealma illaa deha istallak bedarga deosef veda zache labbina

Uf hachi hay mana bekadmita ihu hava bedarga deosef baal ilana tattaa kayema biruteh veshalit aleh deha kal nukba bediyyukna denukba ilana tattaa kayema kevan deihu la baa lekayema behahu darga deosef vela itkeyam leshammesha beh ulappasha bealma ulmebad toladin keden nachit letatta veitavidat ihi immeh vehahu paroka yarit yaruta deosef dehava hu bekadmita veihu nachit letatta

Kevan denachit letatta keden itkayyam beh Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha ithappach ilana ma dehava techoteh veihu shalit aleh ithaddar veshalit hahu ilana aleh veihu nachit letatta kevan deihu nachit letatta hahu deyarit yaruta atar deosef avoy ikre avoy have vadday kolla ihu al tekkuneh vadday kedeka yeot

Bekadmita hava mealma didchura veha itakkar mittamman vehashta ihu mealma denukba uma dehava ihu shalit alah shalta ihi aleh veithaddar lemehve bealma denukba veal da let leh bat zug kelal vela machrize aleh al nukba deha mealma denukba ithaddar ihu

Vehahu gufa kadmaa deshavak ilmale yindeun veyistakkelun beni alma tzaara deit leh kad yitakkar mealma didchura veithaddar lealma denukba yindeun deha let tzaara bealma kehahu tzaara bat zug let leh deha la kayema beatar didchura la machrize aleh al nukba deha mealma denukba ihu vei it leh bat zug havi berachame iarat bahade nukba dead kean la it lah bar zug veal da tanenan dilma yekaddemenu acher berachamim acher tenan vecholla ihu al tekkuneh

Veal da ketiv uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugrusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha uvat kohen ha okimna milla da almana mehahu gufa kadmaa ugrusha dela alat lefargoda demalka dechal inun dela kayeme bealma didchura la it lehu beh chulaka hu ishtemit veakar garmeh mealma didchura la it leh chulaka beh veal da ihi gerusha vezera en lah dei hava lah zera la itakkar minneh vela hava nachit lealma denukba

Veshava el bet aviha man bet aviha da alma denukba dehahu alma bet aviha ikre vehahu mana dehava ittakkan leishtammesha beh ithappach veihu nachit letatta vehahu mana salik leela kinureha kehahu zimna dichtiv ani hayyom yelidticha yelidticha vadday yashuv lime alumav kema dehava mittelesar shenin ulela
I zachat leittakna hoil veshava el bet aviha millechem aviha tochel
700: Titannag mehahu innuga dealma denukba deachle minnahama deabbirim denachit milleela aval leistakkela ulithane bema deithanun shear tzaddikayya la yachla begin dehava zar letamman veal da la achil kodesh aval achil teruma deihu yativ bealma denukba

Umiggo deihu mealma denukba la achil leh ella ballayela dichtiv uva hashshamesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkodashim ki lachmo hu deha kodesh deihu mealma didchura la itachil ella bayyom begine kach kodesh yisrael layeya reshit tevuato sheruta illaa dechal alma didchura kodesh ihu uma desalik beh bakkodesh yisrael hava uvgini kach kodesh yisrael layeya rishit tevuato

Kad ruchin pekidan beinun zimnin defakdin leve kivre inun la pakdin deha la zachan lealma dekodesh dichtiv vechal zar lo yochal kodesh vei la zacha hahu rucha leittakna kedeka yeot kevan deahadar begilgula afilu behahu atar bitruma la achil vezar ikre afilu lealma tattaa vela achil bah ad hacha beraza da

Sava sava kevan dishriat leshatteta beyamma rabba zil birutach lechal sitrin deyamma hashta it legallaa deha amena dehay paroka kad ate al gabbe hahu mana deka amena ail tamman vedavik tamman rucha dileh behahu mana vela itavid kelum afilu haval defuma yeot hu vechach hu sava sava i tema utgale ema bela dechilu

Shear bene nasha dealma deka mistalleke minneh veha yedana deruach dileh shavik behahi itteta dahavat leh verucha ail tamman ma itavid mehahu ruach vei nasva hay itteta uf hachi ma itavid mehahu ruach deshavak bah balah kadmaa deha gevar achara ate alah

Leitkayema ruach beruach la efshar deha hay deate alah hashta ruach ail bah vechen hahu kadmaa deistalik ruach ail bah hahu kadmaa deistallak benin hao leh veda dehashta lav paroka ihu ruach deshavak hahu kadmaa behahu mana veata hay achara veail bah ruach vadday la yachle tarvayehu leitkayema behahu gufa deitteta kachada i nima deitavid i efshar ma itavid minneh

Uf hachi i ihi la itnesivat hahu rucha deshavak bah balah may itavid minnih i nima deitavid lav hachi kal da tzarich legallaa hashta sava sava chame ma avdat uvamme ailat garmach kum sava arim diglach kum sava veashpil garmach kame marach

Patach hahu sava veamar Adonai lo gavah libbi velo ramu enay vego david malka amar da begin dehava malka illaa veshallita al kal malchin illain veshallitin deit mimmizrach vead maarav vela salik al libbeh leastaa mearcha vetadir shafil libbeh kame mareh vechad hava lae beorayeta hava mitgabbar kearya veenoy tadir meichin beara middechilu demareh vechad hava azil ben amma la hava beh gassut rucha kelal

Veal da ketiv Adonai lo gavah libbi vego lo gavah libbi af al gav daana malka shallita al kal shear malchin dealma velo ramu ene bezimna daana kayema kammach lae beorayeta velo hillachti bigdolot uvniflaot mimmenni beshaata daana azil ben amma vei david malka amar hachi shear bene alma al achat kamma vechamma vaana kamma ana shafil libba umaich ena kame malka kaddisha vechas li divmillin kaddishin deorayeta yerom libbay bacha vedimoy naflin al dikneh
Amar sava lae bechela kamma shappiran dimin al diknach kema dehava shappir mishcha tava kad hava nachit al dikna desava tava deaharon ema milach sava
701: Deha malka kaddisha hacha shear bene nasha dealma deka istalaku minneh veshavku rucha behahu mana dahao mishtammeshe beh veitnesivat veata achara veail behahu mana rucha achara ma itavid mehahu kadmaa kema deittemar
Ta chazi kamma illain gevuran demalka kaddisha deka avid uman yachil lemallela lon kad hay balah tinyana ate veail rucha behahu mana rucha kadmaa mekatrega behay ruach deal vela ityashvan kachada

Uvgine kach itteta la ityashvat kedeka yeot bahade balah tinyana begin derucha kadmaa mechashkesha bah uchden ihi dechirat leh tadir uvachat aleh o itanchat aleh deha rucha dileh mechashkesha bimaha kechiveya umkatrega bahade ruach achara deal bah mibbalah tinyana ad zeman saggi mekatregin da beda

Vei abar da deal lehahu dehava kadmaa da kadmaa nafik veazil leh ulzimnin dedache da kadmaa lehahu tinyana veitavid leh mekatrega ad deappik leh mealma veal da tanenan demitteren ulhala la yissav bar nash lehay itteta deha malach hammavet ittakkaf bah uvne alma la yadin deha rucha kevan deittakkaf veka natzach lehahu rucha achara tinyana mikkan ulhala la yitarav bar nash achara bahadah

Chavrayya ha yedana divaatar da it lechu lemikshe velema i hachi la mit bedina hay tinyana vela dayenin leh milleela ta chazi kolla ihu bedina deyintzach peloni lifloni o dela yekatreg aleh peloni lifloni uman denasiv armalta keman deal beyamma beruchin takkifin belo chavlin vela yada i yaavar bishlam i yitba go tehome

Vei da deal hahu rucha tinyana ittakif venatzach lehahu kadmaa hahu kadmaa nafak mittamman veazil leh lean atar azil leh uma itavid sava sava ma avdat chashavt ditmallel zeer venafkat lehay ha alat baatar dela al bar nash achara min yoma dedoeg vaachitofel avdu bayan illen beinun arba mea bayiyi dahao baan al migaddela defarach baavira vela ativ alayehu bar nash ad deata shelomo malka uvirer lon kal chad vechad al tekkuneh sava sava raza illaa dehava temira atit legallaa ma avadit

Sava sava bekadmita hava lach lenatra archach vetistakkal bereshach aval hashta lav shaata leittammera sava ahdar betukfach hahu ruach denafak lean azil bacha veamar chavrayya kal hani bichyan deka bachena lav beginayechu hu ella dachilna lemare alma degallena archin setimin belo reshu aval galle kame kudsha berich hu dela likara dili avidna vela likara deabba aval reuti lefulchana dileh vaana chamena yekara dechad minnayechu behahu alma veachara yedana dehachi hu aval la galle kamay vehashta chamena

Tanenan dachyan gavra mikkame gavra bechamma archin setimin itdachyan hahu rucha kadmaa deitdache mikkame hahu tinyana lean azil hahu rucha nafik veazil umshatteta bealma vela yedia veazil lego kivra dehahu bar nash umittamman meshatteta bealma veitchazze bechelma livni nasha vechaman bechelma diyyukna dehahu bar nash veoda lon millin lefum archeh dehahu ruach kadmaa deka itmeshach mineh kema deihu behahu alma hachi meshatteta hay veoda behay alma

Vehachi azil umshatteta bealma ufakdat tadir lehahu kivra ad zimna deruchot pakdan legabbe kivrayehu degufin keden hay rucha itchabbar behahu ruach dileh veitlavash beh veazil leh kad al leduchteh itpashat minneh veduchta it leh
702: Beinun hechalin degan eden o levar lefum archoy dechal chad vechad vetamman ittammar

Vechad ruchin pakdan lehay alma demetin nizkakin legabbe chayyin la nizkakin ella behahu meshichu derucha uveh itlavash rucha achara vei tema i hachi toalta ihu lerucha vehay itteta toalta avdat lecholla lav hachi deilmale la itnesivat legabbe achara vehay rucha kadmaa la mitdachya mikkame hay gavra achora toalta achara hava leh begavena achara vela yehe lae bealma kema dehave vela yizdakkek legabbe chayyin dehay alma kema dehave meshatteta hacha vehacha

I hachi ziuuga tinyana dehay itteta la have milleela veatte amarte deitdachya gevar mikkame gevar vaamena dehay balah tinyana denasiv leitteta da ihu bat zugeh mammash vehahu kadmaa lav bar zugeh mammash hava vehay tinyana dilah hava vechad mata zimneh itdachya da mikkammeh vaday hachi hu deha la itdachya hahu ruach kadmaa dehava behay itteta ella begin dehay tinyana deihu bar zugah

Vechal inun tinyanin deitdachyan mikkame kadmain kadmain hao bene zugayehu vela hane uvgin kach la it lon kiyyuma bahadayehu veitdachya ruach tinyana mikkame rucha kadmaa uvgin kach man denasiv armalta karenan aleh velo yada ki venafsho hu ki chinnam mezora harashet vego vela yedia i hi bat zugeh mammash i lav

Armalta dela nesivat af al gav deate bar zugah veihi la baat leitnasseva kudsha berich hu la kayif lah min dina vekudsha berich hu azmin lehahu bar nash itteta achara vela alat bedina kehay behahu alma veaf al gav delet lah bar deha ittetta la itpakkedat appirya urviyya kema deukmuha

Itteta da dela itnesivat zimna tinyana hahu ruach deshavak bah balah ma itavid minneh yativ tamman teresar yarche uvchal lelya velelya nafik ufakda lenafsha veithaddar leatreh levatar teresar yarche deka istallak dina dehahu gavra deha kal inun teresar yarche ha rucha itkafya baatzivu kal yoma levatar teresar yarche nafik mittamman veazil vekayema litra gan eden ufakda lehay alma legabbe hahu mana denafik minneh vechad hay itteta istallakat mealma hahu ruach nafik veitlavash behahu ruach dilah vezachat beh legabbe balah venaharin tarvayehu kedeka yeot bechibbura chada

Kevan deatena lehay atar hashta it legallaa archin setimin demare alma la yadin behu bene nasha vechullehu azlin beorach keshot kema deatte amer ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu bam ufoshim yikkashlu bam uvni nasha la yadin vela mashgichin kamma inun illain ovadin dekudsha berich hu vechamma meshanyan inun uvni alma la yadin vechullehu beorach keshot dela satan limina velismala

Hane demitgalgelin deka itterachu betiruchin mehahu alma velet lon bat zug bat zug deka mizdavvegan behay alma mean inun inun nashin deka mizdavvegan bahadayehu behay alma deha lechullehu bene nasha it lon bat zug bar mehay

Chamu hashta kamma inun ravrevin veillain gevuran dileh tanenan man dimtarech itteteh kadmaa madbecha achit aloy dimin madbecha amay ella ha amena dechal nashin dealma bediyyukna dehay mizbach kayeme veal da yartan inun sheva birkan dechullehu mikkeneset yisrael inun vei ihu
703: Metarach lah ahdar avna legirona may tama begin demitchabberan tiruchin bahade hadade

Veraza da dichtiv vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah vego veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayeta leish acher mimmashma deamar vehalcha vehayeta leish la yedana may acher ella kema deittemar acher tenan veacher ketiv veacher karenan leh dichtiv umeafar acher yitzmachu vetiruchin mitchabberan kachada tiruchin dehahu alma vetiruchin dehay alma uma dahavat hay itteta bediyyukna illaa ha ishtabeda lediyyukna tattaa karena leh acher

Vekkarenan leh acharon acharon menalan dichtiv veacharon al afar yakum vehacha ketiv usneah haish haacharon o ki yamut haish haacharon acharon sheni mibbae leh vei tema dela tizdaveg afilu laasara da batar da lav hachi vechi levalah da tizdaveg velo leachara may acharon

Ella da ihu hay acher dekaamran veihu acher veihu acharon hashta avna mitgalgela bekusfita acher amay ikre hachi deha kal binyana nafal veithaddar leafra ihu hava ma dehava vela achara amay karenan leh acher uf hachi amay ikre acharon vechi acharon ihu veha i yityeshar yeot vei la yehdar veyitgalgel veyitneta kemillekaddemin amay ikre acharon
Aval ta chazi ketiv vayyar elohim et kal asher asa vehinne tov meod may tov tanenan da malach detov meod da malach hammavet ulcholla kudsha berich hu azmin tikkunoy

Ta chaze ketiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan nahar da la shachich lealmin milleappasha ulmisge ulmebad perin veel acher isteras velet leh tiuvta lealmin vela appish vela avid perin deilmale avid perin yetashtesh lechal alma

Ubbegin kach bar nash degarim lehahu setar deyippush bealma ikre ra vela chame appe shechinta lealmin dichtiv lo yegurcha ra hay bar nash demitgalgela begilgula i ihu avar veitdabbak behahu el acher dela avid perin vela appish bealma begin kach ikre acher ushma garim leh ihu hu veachar ikre acher vadday

Acharon mikkadmaa veelach acharon karenan leh veacharon ikre tinyana ihu umiyyad ikre acharon vehachi kare leh kudsha berich hu acharon begin deyittakkan lemehve acharon vela yetuv kemillekaddemin telitaa uf hachi vechen bechal zimnin mikkadmaa veelach hachi ikre acharon vehachi itzterich lemikre acharon deilmale itkere miyad tinyana ha petichu defuma leahaddera kemilkaddemin vehahu binyana istetar

Menalan mibbayit sheni deikre acharon dichtiv gadol yihye kevod habbayit hazze haacharon min harishon deha mikkadmaa veelach acharon ikre deha la yehe petichu defuma dehahu binyana yinpol veyithaddar kemilkaddemin

Uf hachi da acharon karenan leh uvgin kach ketiv lo yuchal balah harishon asher shillechah lashuv lekachta lo yuchal lo yikkachenna mibbae leh may lo yuchal ella kevan dehay itteta itdabbekat beacher venachtat leishtabeda bedarga tattaa la bae kudsha berich hu deihu yetuv middarga dileh lemehav iva ulitdabbeka behahu darga delav dileh

Vetta chaze i hay itteta la itnesivat afilu tizne bechal guvrin dealma i bae balah yetuv legabbah aval i itdabbeka benissuin leacher da lo yuchal lashuv ledarga kadmaa dehava bekadmita legabbah lo yuchal vadday leatava lehahu darga lealmin
Achare asher huttammaa taninan dehuttammaa belibbeh i hachi afilu i titrachek vetizne bela nissuin ella kevan deitdabbekat leacher ha kabbilat ala chulaka dehahu sitra vebbalah
704: Kadmaa deihu missitra achara tava detov la yehe leh bah chulaka lealmin vela yappish kelal lehahu atar ha im shillechah haish haacharon o ki yamut haish haacharon lekadmaa asura aval lishar beni nasha tishtere dilma tishkach atra kemilkaddemin veacharon yakum deyizdavig bahadah

Man deit leh benin meitteteh kadmita veail hay lego beteh hahu yoma itdabbak becharba kashya demithappecha begin teren sitrin chad deha teren dachat lon levar vehashta ihu telitaa vetu mana deishtaabbed beh acher hech yete ihu lemehav beh rucha dileh veyishtattaf bahadah veyitdabbak bah lav deihi asura aval vadday shittufa bisha ihu legarmeh
Rabbi levitas ish kefar ono hava chayich umitlotzetz al itteta da kad chame man deizdavag bahadah vahava amar vattischak leom acharon ketiv man deitdabbekat beh beish acharon chiyyucha ihi levatar
Hashta it leahadra ulayena al atar chad rav veillaa dehava bealma vegiza vesharsha dikshot veihu oved avi yishay avi david deha ittemar deacharon hava hech nafak sharsha dikshot miggo atar da
Ella oved ittakkan betikkuna illaa veahdar sharsha deilana deka ithappach al tekkuneh veistelik beh veittakkan kedeka yeot veal da ikre oved ma dela zachu hachi shear bene alma

Ata ihu palach veadar ikara vesharsha deilana venafak meanfin meriran veahdar veittakan benofa deilana achara illaa ata yishay bereh veachasin leh vetakin leh veitachad beanpoy deilana achara illaa vechiver ilana beilana veistebbachu da beda kevan deata david ashkach ilanin mistavchan umitachadan da beda keden yarit shultanu beara veoved garim da

Bacha hahu sava veamar i sava sava vela amena lach dealat beyamma rabba hashta ante hu go tehome ravrevin ittakkan lesalleka sava sava ante garamte da deilmale havet shatik bekadmita hava yeot lach aval hashta la yachilat velet man deachid bidach ella ante bilchodach kum sava veistallak bisliku

Oved da ittakkan venefak miggo chakal bisha deguvin bishin ata yishay bereh veatkin veadar ilana veim kal da da raza derazin vela yedana i ema i la ema ema milach sava vadday ema beda yedian kal shear bene gilgula oved im kal da ilana atkin kad ata david malka beilana tattaa denukba ishtear veitzterich lekabbela chayyin meachara uma i hay deittakkan veatkin kolla hachi shear bene alma deatyan begilgula dela yachlin leittakna hachi al achat kamma vechamma

Bechal sitrin ithappach begilgula peretz hachi hava boaz hachi hava oved hachi hava uvcholla nafik ilana missitra dera veitdabbak levatar besitra detov bekadmita vayehi er bechor yehuda ra machlon uf hachi velav kal kach aval behani itakkal ra venafik tov levatar hahu dichtiv beh vetov roi vayeya immo hacha kayema ilana tattaa al tekkuneh umelech elohim al goyim

Besheruta decholla meikara visoda illaa ishterashu dargin reuven shimon levi yehuda ma ketiv beh happaam ode et Adonai uchtiv vattaamod milledet hayenu ranni akara lo yalada begin dechad ityelid yehuda nafkat nukba mitdabbeka bidchura vela havat al tikkunaha anpin beanpin vela itkesharat leolada kevan denasar lah kudsha berich hu veatkin lah keden itkesharat leitabbera ulolada
Uvsifra dechanoch vattaamod milledet lav al lea ittemar ella al rachel ittemar hahi dimvakka
705: Al baneha hahi deishtarashat bihuda yehu vattaamod milledet deha la ittakna

Bekadmita diyyukna dilela hava kolla reuven or ben vayyomer elohim yehi or yemina or shimon semala or behahu siga dedahava bahadeh shem aon levi chibbura decholla leitchabbera mitteren sitrin yehuda nukba bahade dechura mitdabbekat yehu da dechura da nukba dahavat bahadeh

Amay ella beitdabbekuta dera bahadah ihi dalet miskena ihi veitzterich leatava begilgula leitakkela hahu ra ulmitbele beafra ulvatar letzamcha besitra detov velenafka mimmiskenu laatiru uchden Adonai veal da yehu

Puk sava miggo tehome la tidchal kamma arbin zeminin lach beshaata ditshotet yamma begin lenayecha behu bacha kemillekaddemin veamar mare dealma dilma yemrun mashreyan illain daana sava uvache kinoka galle kammach deal yekarach ana avid vela avidna al yekara dili deha bekadmita hava li leistammera dela eul beyamma rabba vehashta kevan daana beh it li leshatteta bechal sitrin velenafka mineh
Yehuda atta yoducha achecha hayenu daanan amrin baruch atta ihu baruch veihi atta lechullehu benoy la amar yaakov atta ella laatar deitzterich da ihu atta

Shema da yoducha achecha kullehu odan lach al shema da vadday atta yoducha achecha al shema da istallak veitkafya setar achara begin dechad itkere veadkar ha nafkat sitra achara bahadah kevan deamre atta shultanu veravrevanu it lah vesitra achara itkafya vela itchaziat tamman vadday bishma da itreshim veitberir missitra achara veda istalaku veshultanu dilah utviru uvish lesitra achara kevan deoducha achecha al shema da atta keden yadcha beoref oyevecha miyyad itkafyan legabbach ushma da garim

Yadana chavrayya yadana deha atta shema da attun amrin laatar achara illaa dichtiv atta kohen leolam bimina illaa shappir ihu deha kevan derabbi shimon odan leh illain vetattain vezacha lecholla kal ma deihu amar hachi ihu veshappir

Aval kad teheon matan legabbeh imru leh veadkeru leh yoma detalga kad zerana polin lechamshin utren gavenin deha atta kohen hacha itkashshar kos divracha bimina belo piruda kelal uvgin kach atta kohen leolam hacha itkashshar kos bimina kedeka yeot
Veal da amar kera yehuda atta lehay atta yoducha achecha vela ketiv yehuda yoducha achecha vela yattir ella al shema deatta atta atar da itzterich lishma da vela achara

Yehuda abba kadmaa veabba tinyana vela hava beh chillufa lealmin ubbegin kach peretz ittakkaf beh betokfoy ma dela hava hachi lechal bene alma veal da binyana dedavid share cheshbona mipperetz vela mibboaz dehava beh shinnuya chavrayya i tashgechun lav millin bistimu ka amena veaf al gav distimin inun

Veal da yehuda ravach shema da deikre atta kam al buryeh zimna kadmaa vezimna tinyana vela ishtani lealam uvnoy dihuda vezara dileh odan veamrin ki atta avinu ma delet hachi lishar beni gilgula lealmin shear bene gilgula teren avahan teren immahan it lon gon levinyana verazin illen beimke yamma belibba dithome inun man yachil leappaka lon kum sava itgabbar veittakaf betukfach appik margelan miggo tehome

Boaz itchaze dehava beh shinnuya kad olid leoved deha oved beshinnuya hu lav hachi ivtzan hu boaz hu abba kadmaa dela aved shinnuya vei tema ihu hava vadday kad ittear leovada da beh hava man dehu takkif kearya uchleta beh hava begin dela
706: Lehve shinnuya beh bedavid veithaddar milla leikara kadmaa begin dihe kolla meabba chada veshalshela chada vecholla chad vela hava shinnuya begilgula dezara dedavid veal da atta meresha vead sofa belo shinuya kelal

Hashta nafkat sava meimke libba deyamma yehuda atta vadday meresha vead sofa vela itchaze lechal shear benin leitkere atta ella leh bilchodoy zakkaa chulakeh dedavid dehachi itberir veistallak mishshear ikara divne nasha beara

Yoducha achecha yoducha kal bene alma mibbae leh may tama achecha ella orach kal bene alma la mityabbemin legilgula ella missitra deachin veacha izdaman leyyivuma vehacha kullehu achecha yoducha dela yishtalshel minnayehu vela mechad minnayehu shilshula demalchu ella atta bilchodach atta merisha vead sofa atta avdat uminach nafak kal shilshula vegiza dearye

Banecha bene arye dela itavaru leshinnuya deachecha la itchelafu letale vela leshor vela ligdi vela leshum diyyukna achara ella arye share lemivne vearye siyyem binyana kal shilshulach bene arye ninhu deilmale ata gilgula missitra deachuch yitchallefun kal diyyuknin veyitarvun illen beillen veal da yoducha achecha dela hava chad minnehon begilgula deshalshelaa divnach yadcha zakif dela hava bach irbuvya achara minnayehu

Vehayenu mitteref beni alit dela hava tarpa leachara al patorach kara bemitat er ravatz bemitat onan levatar itgabbar kaari leakama leferetz uchlavi leakama lezerach mi yekimennu dichtiv velo yasaf od ledatah vetargum vela pasak mi yekimennu man hu deyema asura itteta da man hu deyema hoil veishlimat archaha la itztericha lach yattir yevama da kevan deashlimat archaha la itzterichat lach yattir veitchaziat leitparsha minah aval mi yekimennu vadday mittamman ulhala ihi dileh deha appik man dimchashkesh bimaha

Raza setima hacha achuha devar nash amay tu yehuda dehava avoy amay ella hahu dimchashkesha bimaha chame deman dehava natir leh mekatreg leh kitrugin bechal sitrin bae leappaka kevan denafik zammin leachara hahu ruach achara veatyan leaala kemillekaddemin ad deitbene kemillekaddemin bechela dekitruga takkif deka mekatreg beachuh mittamman ulhala shariat itteta da leh
Zakkaa chulaka dihuda bekadmita hava gur levatar arye deka itgabbar veitpashshat becheleh arye vesiyyem belavi kal shear bene alma lav hachi veal da yehuda kidkaamran

Reuven shimon levi ha telata kidkaamran yehuda itchabbar bahadayehu vecholla kedeka yeot yissaschar zevulun teren yarchin atar deyanke nevie keshot yissaschar yarcha yemina ketiv umibbeni yissaschar yode vina laittim uchtiv semach zevulun betzetecha uvshiura ravreva ketiv zevulun lechof yammim yishkon vehu lechof oniyyot may tama begin deveyarchato al tzidon shiura ad tzidon

Binyamin ishtear leela ben yarchin deha yosef hava diyyukneh beara ulishtammesha bealma da veimmeh ishtammash moshe dichtiv vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo binyamin istallak leela binyamin tzaddiko dealma

Mevarchin letatta dan venaftali gad veasher beyarcha semala dan ad pirka deragla pirka deragla naftali ubbegin kach naftali ayyala shelucha kal beragloy beyarcha yemina gad vehu yagud akev ad pirka deakev asher pirka deakev yemina vetovel bashshemen raglo uchtiv barzel unchoshet minalecha kal illen inun diyyuknin illain diyyukna dilela uvgin dahao biryan mammash behay alma itaknat behu shechinta
707: Beillen teresar pirkin teresar metichin deitmetachu miyyisrael mammash dichtiv kal elle shivte yisrael shenem asar metichin deyisrael elle ikrun leitmattecha shema demi lemehve binyana kadka yeot lemeheve yisrael bichlala dishma deelohim elle ihu yisrael bichlal mi chibber elle bahadeh vahava binyana shelim al tekkuneh shema chada mammash
Hada hu deamar leh leyaakov hahu memana deesav dichtiv ki sarita im elohim leela betikkuna kadmaa bevinyana kadmaa kal elle vadday binyana kadmaa ihu

Veal da let shetziu leyisrael lealam ulalme almin vechas veshalom ilmale yishtetziu shema da la have hada hu dichtiv vehichritu et shemenu min haaretz uma taase leshimcha haggadol shema gadol da binyana kadmaa shema kadmaa elohim vehashta deyisrael inun begaluta kivyachol kal binyana nafal lezimna deate kad yifrok kudsha berich hu livnoy miggaluta mi veelle dehava beferuda begaluta yitchabberun kachada ushma deelohim yehe shelim al tekkuneh vealma yitbesam hada hu dichtiv mi elle kaav teufena vechayyonim el arubbotehem

Uvgin deihu shema chada la ketiv mi veelle ella mi elle shema chada bela piruda vehu elohim dehashta begaluta istallak mi leela kivyachol ima meal benin uvnin naflu ushma dehava shelim dehu shema illaa ravreva kadmaa nafil

Veal da anan metzalan umkaddeshan bevatte kenesiyyot al shema da deyitbene kema dehava veamre yitgaddal veyitkaddash shemeh rabba amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach man shemeh rabba hahu kadmaa decholla begin delet leh binyana ella bahadan mi la yitbeni leolam ella beelle veal da behahu zimna mi elle kaav teufena veyechomun kal alma deha shema illaa ittakkan al tekkuneh

Vei shemeh rabba da itkan veitbeni al tekkuneh ha yisrael shallitin al kolla vechal shear shemahan yithadderun al tikkunayehu veyisrael shallitin al kolla deha kullehu talyan bishmeh rabba kadmaa lechal binyanin

Raza da kad bara kudsha berich hu almin kadmaa lechal binyanin shema da itbene dichtiv seu marom enechem uru mi vara elle bara shemeh al tekkuneh vechad bara elle bara leh bechal chelin deyitchazun leh lemeheve shemeh al tekkuneh kedeka yeot dichtiv hammotzi bemispar tzevaam

May bemispar ella bera chad denahir missayefe alma ad sayefe alma it leh lekudsha berich hu vehu ilana rabba vetakkif resheh mate letzet shemayya vesofeh matchin sharshoy veishtarshan beafar kaddisha umispar shemeh vetalya bashshamayim illain vechamesh rekiin talyan minneh ad hay mispar vechullehu natlin shema da begineh dichtiv hashshamayim mesapperim begin hay mispar kullehu shamayim ravechin shema da begineh veal da hammotzi bemispar tzevaam deilmale mispar da la yishtekkechun chayyalin vettoladin lealmin

Veal da ketiv mi mana afar yaakov umispar et rova yisrael teren inun demanu ana vealu bechushbana al yedayehu begin dela shalta behu ena bisha mi mana afar yaakov ha chad deavid chushbana umispar et rova yisrael ha mone achara

Veal teren illen la shalta behu ena bisha deha mi mana leafar yaakov illen inun avanin kaddishin avanin mefulamin deminnehon nafke mayin lealma veal da ketiv vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz ma hahu afar alma mitbarich begineh uf hachi vehitbarachu vezaracha kal goye haaretz kaafar haaretz mammash umispar deihu mone tinyana mana lerova kal inun nukvin margelan illain demitta deshachiv aleh yisrael
708: Ulhala ihu mone lecholla begin deihu tov ayin hada hu dichtiv mone mispar lakkochavim man hu mone lakkochavim mispar mone mispar lakkochavim al yedoy avrin kullehu bechushbana ulzimna deate od taavorna hatztzon al yede mone vela yadinan man hu ella begin divhahu zimna yehe kolla beyichuda belo piruda kolla lihave mone chad

Kum sava ittear veitgabbar bechelach veshut yamma patach veamar mi mana afar yaakov umispar et rova yisrael beshaata deyittear kudsha berich hu leachaya metayya hane deithaddaru begilgula teren gufin berucha chada teren avahan teren immahan kamma gilgulin mitgalgelan al da af al gav deittemar vehachi hu aval mi mana afar yaakov veihu yatkin kolla vela yitavid kelum vecholla yekum
Veha ittemar verabbim miyeshene admat afar yakitzu admat afar hane kema deittemar besifra dechanoch kad chavrayya istakkalu beinun atvan baavira beh veinun hayenu admat afar
Hayenu veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu admat afar inun atvan vekala ittear veoda vehachi amar bevinyana tinyana afar afar kadmaa admat tinyana deittakkan ikar kadmaa pesolet legabbeh

Admat afar kullehu yakitzu elle deittakanu lechayye olam man olam da olam diltatta deha la zachu lemohre baolam dilela veelle dela zachu lacharafot uldiron olam may lacharafot ella begin desitra achara yitabbar mealma vekudsha berich hu illen dahao minneviu dehahu sitra yashar lon letavveha behon kal bene alma

Kal da man garim hahu dela bae leappasha bealma vela bae lekayema berit kaddisha al da garim kal ma degarim vechal hane gilgulin deka amena alah ad hacha ad kan sava shatik riga chada vechavrayya hao tavehin vela hao yadin i hava yemama i hava lelya i kayeme tamman i la kayeme

Patach hahu sava veamar ki tikne eved ivri shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit vego kera da ochach al kal ma deittemar ta chaze kal dechura kaim bediyyukna bealma didchura vechal nukba kaim bediyyukna bealma denukba beod deihu avda dekudsha berich hu itdabbak beh beinun shesh shanim kadmoniyyot vei iakar garmeh mippulchaneh yakar leh kudsha berich hu meinun shesh shanim dealma didchura veitmesar lebbar nash deihu mishshit sitrin yiflach leh shit shenin veyitakkar mishshit shenin dilela
Levatar nachit mittamman veitmesar bealma denukba hu la baa lekayema bidchura nachit vekayema benukva atat nukba deihi sheviit venatla leh ha mikkan ulhala mealma denukba ihu
La baa lekayema bah uvfiruka dilah nachit letatta veitdabbak letatta veitachid besitra achara mikkan ulhala itakkar mealma didchura umealma denukba ha itachad beinun avadim deinun missitra achara

Hashta kevan dehachi hu itzterich pegam ulmebad beh reshimu difgam deha kal pegam desitra achara ihu umiyyovel ulhala ithaddar legilgula vetav lealma kemillekaddemin veitdabbak behahu alma denukba vela yattir zacha avid toladin bealma denukba vechullehu raza dichtiv betulot achareha reoteha muvaot lach vezakkaa ihu kad ittakkan vezache lechach
Vei la zacha afilu begilgula deovla ha ihu kela hava ithaddar vela ashlimu yomoy leitnasseva bealma ulmebad toladin ma ketiv im begappo yavo begappo yetze i yechiday yeul behahu alma bela
709: Toladin vela baa leishtaddela behay venafak mehay alma yechiday bela zara azil keavna bekusfita ad hahu atar detinara takkifa veal tamman umiyyad nashav rucha dehahu yechiday deka ishtevik minnukveh veazil yechiday kechiveya dela itchabbar beachara beorcha venashiv beh

Umiyyad nafak miggo hahu atar detinara takkifa hu bilchodoy veazil umshatteta bealma ad deka ashkach paroka leatava vehayenu im begappo yavo begappo yetze hay dela baa leitnasseva lemeheve leh toladin

Aval im baal ishsha hu deka itnesiv veishtaddal beitteteh vela yachil hahu la ittarach kehahu achara la yeul yechiday vela nafik yechiday ella im baal ishsha hu kudsha berich hu la mekappeach agar kal biryan af al gav dela zachu bivne ma ketiv veyatza ishto immo vetarvayehu atyan begilgula vezachyan leitchabbera kachada kemillekaddemin vehay la nasiv itteta ditruchin ella hahi deishtaddal bah bekadmita vela zachu hashshetta yizku kachada i yetakkenun ovadin veal da veyatza ishto immo

Im adonav yitten lo ishsha vego ahdar kera lemillin acharanin lehahu denafik yechiday bela nukba kelal vayifrok leh hahu duchta deikre sheviit vehahu sheviit ikre adonav adon kal haaretz ihu im da adonav chas aleh veativ leh lehay alma yechiday kema dehava veyahiv leh itteta hahi demizbeach achitat aloy dimin veitchabbera kachada veyalda lo vanim o vanot haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha kema deittemar

Deha i tav veatkin hahu atar defagim bechayyoy itkabbal kame malka kaddisha natil leh veatkin leh al tikkunoy levatar veda ikre baal teshuva deha yarit motveh dehahu atar dehahu nahar denagid venafik veatkin garmeh mimma dehava bekadmita kevan deittakkan vetav betiuvta ha salik al tekkuneh delet milla bealma velet maftecha bealma dela tavar hahu detav betiuvta

May yetze begappo ha ittemar aval tu raza it beh yetze begappo kema deatte amar al gappe merome karet ma lehatam illuya usliku uf hacha illuya usliku atar demarehon detiuvta sallekin afilu tzaddikim gemurim la yachlin lemekam tamman ubbegin kach kevan detav betiuvta kudsha berich hu mekabbel leh vadday miyyad

Tanenan let milla bealma dekayema kamme teshuva ulcholla kudsha berich hu mekabbel vadday vei tav betiuvta ha izdaman lakovleh orach chayyim veaf al gav defagim ma defagim kolla ittakkan vecholla ithaddar al tekkuneh deha afilu bema deit beh omaa Adonai kudsha berich hu mekabbel dichtiv chay ani neum Adonai ki im yihye kanyahu vego uchtiv kitvu et haish hazze ariri vego uvatar detav betiuvta ketiv uvne yechanya asir beno vego mikkan ditshuva mittebbar kamma gizrin vedinin vechamma shalshelain defarzela velet man dekayema kamme detiuvta
Veal da ketiv veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi asher pashu bi la ketiv ella happoshim bi dela baan leatava ulitnachama al ma deavdu aval kevan deitnachamu ha mekabbel lon kudsha berich hu
Begin kach bar nash da af al gav defasha beh ufagim beatra dela itzterich vetav lekameh mekabbel leh vechas aleh deha kudsha berich hu
710: Male rachamin ihu veitmele rachamim al kal ovadoy kema deatte amer verachamav al kal maasav afilu al beire veofoy matun rachamoy i alayehu matun rachamoy kal shekken al bene nasha deyadin veishtemodan leshavcha lemarehon derachamoy matun alayehu vesharan alayehu veal da amar david rachamecha rabbim Adonai kemishpatecha chayyeni

I al chayyavin matun rachamoy kal shekken al zakkain ella man bae asvata inun mare keevin uman inun mare keevin illen inun chayyavin inun baan asvata verachame dekudsha berich hu alayehu dela yehon shevikin minneh veihu dela istalak minnayehu vituvun lakovleh kad mekarev kudsha berich hu bimina mekarev vechad dache bismala dache uvshaata dedache yemina mekarev missitra da dache umissitra da mekarev vekudsha berich hu la shavik rachamoy minnayehu

Ta chaze ma ketiv vayyelech shovav bederech libbo uchtiv batreh derachav raiti veerpaehu veanchehu vaashallem nichumim lo velaavelav vayyelech shovav af al gav dechayyavin avdin kal ma deavdin bezadon deazlin bearcha delibbayehu veacharanin avdin behu hatraa vela baan letzayeta lon beshaata detavin bituvta venatlin archa tava dituvta ha asvata zemina lakovlayehu

717: Man inun harim uman inun etanim ella harim veetanim kullehu chad aval inun telat illain leela al reshayehu veinun telat letatta minnayehu vechullehu chad harim leela vealayehu amar david essa eni el heharim veillen inun telat kadmae vehaetanim mosde aretz illen inun telat batrae letatta minnayehu tere samche beta vechad chedva deveta veillen ikrun mosde aretz etanim inun veetanim ikrun

Sava sava ha yadate man deaggach kerava i la yada leistammera la yintzach keravin itzterich lemachaa bideh ulistammera berayoneh ma dihe chashiv achara dihe chashiv ihu veyad yemina zemina tadir lemachaa umachashavoy vida semalit zemina tadir lekabbela ulistammera vimina kolla

Hashta amarte vehaetanim etanim inun letatta veharim leela istammar sava deha rayona achara lakovlach dichtiv maskil leetan haezrachi veda ihu avraham sava veikre etan vei avraham ihu etan yitzchak veyaakov etanim ikrun kum sava deha yadate rayona da have mache lerayonach

Veyissa meshalo vayyomar etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha etan da boker deavraham vehayenu habboker or da ammuda dechal alma kayema aleh unhiru dileh meavraham yarit nahar hayyotze meeden ikre i sava sava ha rayona achara lakovlach vela yadate leistammera hechi maggichin kerava sava an hu tukpa dilach vadday lo laggibborim hammilchama

Ketiv maskil leetan haezrachi uchtiv maskil ledavid da nahar hayyotze meeden deihu turgeman ledavid leodaa leh meinun millin setimin illain i maskil ihu nahar denafik meeden etan haezrachi avraham ihu leela vadday ha yedana veaf al gav daana sava al rayona da machena etan haezrachi terin dargin inun kema deatte amer boker or or hu avraham boker hu nahar uf hachi etan haezrachi ezrach hu avraham etan kema deittemar da hahu nahar denaged venafik meeden

Hashta sava kum kaim al retichach dehashta tinpol vela tichul lemekam ha shelomo malka ate becheloy urtichoy vegavroy ufarashoy veate lakovlach kum puk min chakla dela yishkach lach tamman ketiv vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo kal ish yisrael beyerach haetanim bechag vego yerach deityelidu beh haetanim uman inun avahan veinun etane olam vayyarach da ihu tishre dealfa beta ahdar lemafrea mittatta leela

Vetu mimmilach yeot detippok min chakla vela tishtechach tamman ilu ketiv maskil etan haezrachi kidkaamarte hashta dichtiv maskil leetan haezrachi let keravach kelum vetippok min chakla beal karchach vela titchaze tamman

I sava anya miskena hechi teppok i hachi yintzechun lach vettaarok min chakla kal bene alma yirdefun avatrach velet lach anpin leitchazaa kame bar nash lealmin hacha omena dela ippok min chakla vehacha itchaze anpin beanpin bishlomo malka vechal ish yisrael veguvrin ufarashin urtichin dileh kudsha berich hu yesayyea lach sava deha lae chela ante kum sava itgabbar bechelach veittakkaf dead yoma da havet gibar takkif beguvrin
