718: Salik ad democha illaa itpayyas legabbeh vechadde lakovleh uchden maskil leetan haezrachi maskil leh veoda leh al yeda deavraham rechimoy kal ma deitzterich vehahu mocha illaa maskil leetan vechad david malka ittakkan betiuvta legabbeh ihu maskil ledavid kema dehava mocha illaa maskil leh veal da it maskil veit maskil
Beyerach haetanim deityelidu beha yerach etanim binyana letatta ihu kegavena dilela veityelidu beh harim veetanim harim setimin etanim yarchin takkifin kinchasha vehahu etan benayehu

Kum sava have mache lechal sitrin beshaata desalik moshe lekabbela orayeta masar leh kudsha berich hu shivin maftechan deorayeta kad mata letisha vechamshin hava chad maftecha ganiz vesatim dela hava masar leh itchannan lekameh amar leh moshe kal maftechan illain vetattain behay maftecha talyan amar lekammeh mareh dealma ma shemeh amar leh etan vechal inun etanim beh talyan uveh kayeman levar miggufa detora shebbichtav ihu oda leh umaskil leh ihu ikara umaftecha detora shebbichtav

Vechad ittaknat tora shebbeal pe legabbeh ikara dehechala hu maftecha dilah vadday keden maskil ledavid umiggo deyarta tora shebbeal pe atvan lemafrea al da ikre tishre ihu aval begin deihu raza dishma kaddisha chatim beh kudsha berich hu at dishmeh bammizbeach chatim beh Adonai harshet ad chatzi hammizbeach atat devora vechatim beh vehayenu dichtiv vattashar devora uvaatar da chatimu dishma kaddisha deachtim beh

Vehahu maftecha kad patcha battora shebbeal pe baenan leishtemoda leh veda ihu tanya etan moshavecha barayeta levar miggufa etanim inun tannaim ammudim samchin levar miggufa hashta it leodaa milla bezimna deillen legabbe tora shebbichtav ikrun etanim legabbe tora shebbeal pe ikrun tannaim etan legabbe tora shebbichtav tanya legabbe tora shebbeal pe vecholla kadka yeot

Chavrayya ha ana bechakla shelomo malka veguvrin takkifin dileh yete veyishkach chad sava lae bechela takkif gibar natzach keravin ha yedana deata vekayema levatar tinra dechakla vehu ashgach bi vehech gevurti kayema bechakla bilchodoy ashgach deihu ish shalom mareh dishlama veazal leh hashta sava gevurtach alach veante bilchodach bechakla tuv leatrach veshari zinach mealach
Shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz shimu harim kidkamran vehaetanim mosde aretz mosde aretz vadday deha minnayehu ittezan uminnayehu kabbil kal yoma veinun mosde aretz

Ki riv la im ammo man hu deyachil lemekam beriv dekudsha berich hu beyisrael veal da amar leillen shimu harim et riv Adonai da ihu matzuta chada kum riv et heharim matzuta tinyana denatzach behu kudsha berich hu kal illen rivot leyisrael vechal inun tochachot kullehu keabba deochach livrih veha ukmuha

Beyaakov ketiv beshaata devaa lenatztzecha bahadeh ma ketiv veriv layeya im yehuda velifkod al yaakov ma riv ihu kema dichtiv babbeten akav et achiv al hay milla ata tochacha vechal inun rivot vechi lav milla ravreva ihu babbeten akav et achiv vego hay lav milla zeira ihu may deavid babbeten vechi ukva avid babbeten in vadday
Becholla dacha yaakov leesav achuy begin dela yehe leh chulaka kelal esav la hitraam
719: Ella mechad deinun teren dichtiv vayyakeveni ze faamayim faamayim mibbae leh may ze ella chad deakish litren chad denafak litren umay nihu bechorati ithappechu atvan vahava birkati ze faamayim chad deittekash litrin

Vela yada esav ma deavad leh babbeten aval rav memana dileh yada hava vekudsha berich hu argish shemayya vcheylayehu lekala da deha beracha uvchora la tava memana dileh vela amar deha beracha hava leh lemitba vela tava achuha ha tava vday dichtiv umibbesarcha lo titallam vela baa yaakov lemehav leh lemechal ad denatal minne bechorata dileh

May bechora natal minneh habbechora dilela vetatta bechora chaser keden akav et achiv vday deavad leh ukva vearme leh laachora may achora akdim leh deyippuk bekadmita lehay alma amar yaakov leesav tol atta hay alma bekadmita vana levatar

Ta chaze ma ketiv veachare chen yatztza achiv veyado ochezet baakev esav may baakev esav vechi salleka datach dehava achid yedeh beragleh lav hachi ella yado ochezet beman dehahu dehava akev umanno esav deha esav akev ikre mishaata deakav leh leachuy umiyyoma deitbere alma akev kare leh kudsha berich hu dichtiv hu yeshufcha rosh veatta teshufennu akev ante deikre akev teshufennu bekadmita ulvassof hu deyimche reshach mealach umanno samael deihu resha dechiya demache behay alma

Veal da babbeten akav et achiv shavi aleh lemehevi akev venatal esav hay alma bekadmita vda raza dichtiv veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom lifne melach melech livne yisrael vda ihu raza deamar shelomo malka nachala mevohelet barishona veacharitah lo tevorach besof alma

Veal da babbeten akav et achiv uvono sara et elohim may veono hachi amru bechela vettukpa dileh yeot aval lav hachi beriru demilla yaakov diyyukna illaa hava vegufa kaddisha delet gufa miyyoma dehava adam harishon kegufa deyaakov veshufreh deadam harishon hahu shufreh mammash hava leh leyaakov vediyyukneh

Ella ta chazi delet bechal kalin denashin dealma deyachla kala dechiveya leitdabbeka bah ulitachada bah ulishtattefa bah ella terin nashin inun deyachla kala dechiveya leitachada behon chada hay dela netirat soavut niddutah vime libbunah kedeka yeot o deakdimat yoma chada litbol vachada hay itteta dimachret levalah ona dilah lemebad tzaara levalah bar i ihu la chayish vela ashgach leda

Illen inun teren nashin deha kema deakdimu hachi inun mitacharan legabbe kala denachash ad deadbik kala bekala uchma demitacharan lemebad tzaara levalah beikkuva demitzva hachi akdim kala denachash leitdabbeka behahi kala deitteta veillen inun teren nashin dekala denachash achid bekala dilhon kechalba bechalbeta siuvta batar siuvta zina batar zineh

Veim tomar ma ichpat lan i achid kala bekala i lo achid vay dehachi mitabbedan bene alma belo data hay kala deitteta kad itarav veishtattaf bahade kala denachash beshaata dechayyavat umarshaat nafkat miggo efa umshatteta bealma i arat behane teren kalin kala denachash vekala deitteta veitteta itchammemat behu veinun bah vechevan deitchammemat mitabbedin rucha veaglim bahadah ad dimshatteta veal bimaha dehay itteta

Vehay yannoka diyelidat kad atat hahi chayyavta pekidat leh lehahu rucha deihu chibbura bisha kala denachash dimkashkesha bah veihu mechayecha binoka ad deatat hahi chayyavta keitteta defakidat bera leitteta achara umfatfetet leh vechayechat leh befitputa ad detete immeh kach avda hay rucha uzmanin saggiin deihu shelicha dehahi chayyavta vekatla leh hada hu dichtiv umiyyad oshkehem koach vela
720: Adam harishon beshaata chiveya deata veitpatta al yedoy yachil chiveya leh may tama begin dela hava tukpa leadam harishon vead kean la itylid man dehava tukpa dileh umanno tukpa deadam harishon da shet dehava bediyyukna deadam harishon mammash dichtiv vayyoled bidmuto ketztzalmo vyikra et shemo shet may bidmuto ketztzalmo dehava mahul vechad ata memana deesav legabbe deyaakov kevar ityelid tukpa deyaakov deihu yosef vezehu uvono sara et elohim
Hay kala deitteta deyachla kala dechiveya leachada bah kechalba bechalbeta man ihu
Kema deattun amrin ella hahu koach dehahu rucha veal da terin zimnin ketiv behay kera veen lahem menachem chad millilit chayyavta vechad mehahu rucha
I sava hashta it lach rechimin veatte mishtae keman dela chamit inun maggiche kerava ha kullehu bishlama immach hashta mikkan ulhala la ade minnay mane kerava bedil leadkera shemi

Hahu chattat rovetz kaim al pitcha kechalba bezimna dekala batrayeta deyahivat itteta nafik ihu dalig meal pitcha veitavar mittamman veazil avatrah may tama begin dekudsha berich hu shadar chad maftecha dileh vekala parcha umaftecha atya vechiveya azal batar kala dehu nafik lealma vead tura devitna azil umchashkesha ad idan deitnekiat mehahu zuhama dinshichin dechiveya bisha vekudsha berich hu mesabbev sivuvin veavid ovadin kadka yeot

Vechal da begin dehahu beten itdachya ha vadday itdachya mehahu beten velet leh chulaka veitdache mibbeten diltatta dishar neshin dealma deaf al gav deavid tzaar la ityehiv leh reshu leshalletaa beh uman beten ityehiv leh veihu shalit aleh hahu beten desota dichtiv vetzavta vitnah begin dehay beten avid beh nukmin liruteh vehay beten dileh ihu vekudsha berich hu yahiv leh begin dela itdache mikkolla hashta rechimin dili atzitu la chamena lechu umallilna lechu kal haddevarim yegeim la yachil inish lemallela afilu millin deorayeta yegeim inun

Ketiv vayyivater yaakov levaddo vayyeavek ish immo uchtiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho vehahu yarech deravach miyyaakov vehahu yarech bachalishu dileh ad deata shemuel may bachalishu dela mashich nevua kad ata shemuel natal hahu yarech vesalkeh mehahu atar vechataf leh minneh umehahu zimna itade minneh vela hava leh chulaka bikdusha kelal

Kudsha berich hu la kafach vela dache leh mikkolla begin denatal shemuel yarech dileh ella yahiv leh chulaka chada may ihi yahiv leh hahu yarech uveten desota cholaf hahu yarech uveten deade minneh veal da tarvayehu yahiv leh kudsha berich hu lemehve atra dekudsha panuy mikkal saavuta

Velanpil yarech mahu velanpil venafla yerechah velatzbot vetzavta yerechah mibbae leh ella keman deashde garma lechalba veamar leh tol hay lechulakach umikkolla la avish kameh ella degazlu minneh yarech begin deihu yaga velae aleh veravach leh veappiku leh minneh veal da kudsha berich hu appil leh garma da desota veappik leh kidkamran uvda ihu ravi vechadde

Kal inun retichin vesiyyata dileh baan tadir yarech veazle bechisufa avatreh uvgin da hane barchi derabbanan deshalhe min da ihu dechal kissufa dilhon batar yarech ihu vechal shekken yarech derabbanan vechal milla ahdar leatreh vekudsha berich hu la gara kelum mikkal ma deitzterich vela baa deyikrav likdusha bar immeh veadveh chulakeh veachasanteh kema deavid kudsha berich hu leela hachi avde yisrael letatta vehachi itzterich lemebad vehachi tanenan asir leh leyisrael lemelaf orayeta leovde kochavim umazzalot dichtiv maggid devarav leyaakov vego lo asa chen lechal goy vego
Veal da dache leh yaakov vedache leh shemuel dela yehe leh chulaka
721: Bikdusha uvgin da kal netiru devavu leyisrael al da ihu lechalba dechatif ofa dachya min shoka veayete leh vead la ittevar ata chad bar nash vechatfa minneh levatar yahiv leh chad garma gerira bela toalta

Kacha lesaro shel esav appiku leh mehahu beten chatifu minneh hahu yarech levatar yahavu leh garma chad hahu beten vehahu yarech desota vela achora ha garma deka yahavu leh lechulakeh veadveh vearav leh ubbegin kach kal dinin dekudsha berich hu dinin dikshot inun uvni nasha la yadin vela mashgichin lekudsha berich hu vechullehu beorach keshot hi astiat garmah mibbalah kema deatte amer haozevet alluf neureha vego uf hachi itteta kegavena dilah beara

Ta chaze man deashkach chavra kevateh deavid keovadoy bealma rachim leh veitdabbak bahadeh veavid immeh tivu aval sitra achora lav hachi kevan deashkach man deshavak sitra dikdusha dekudsha berich hu veavid keovadoy veitdabbak bah keden baya leshetzaa ulappaka leh mealma hay itteta avdat keovadaha veitdabbekat bah chazi ma deavdat bah vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah kudsha berich hu lav hachi man deshavik lesitra achora veitdabbak beh bekudsha berich hu keden rachim leh veavid leh kal tivu dealma hashta sava atkin garmich deha chiveya azil leh uvaa leitgara bahadach vela yachil

Patach veamar ma yitron laadam bechal amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh vechi la ata shelomo ella leolfa milla da illu amar baamalo sheyyaamol yeot deha ishtear amal deit beh yitron ella kevan dichtiv bechal amalo ha kelala decholla dela ishtear kelum deit beh yitron

Ella lav lechal adam amar shelomo milla da ella adam it bealma deihu mishtaddel tadir bevish ulavashsha vela ishtaddal betav afilu riga chada veal da ketiv amalo vela ketiv yegio amalo kema deatte amer yashuv amalo verosho velo raa amal beyisrael yegio kema deatte amer yegia kappecha ki tochel vego uchtiv veet yegia kappay raa elohim aval amalo ketiv amal vachaas ishtaddeluteh hu tadir levish veal da ihu tachat hashshamesh

Beshaata dehay adam ishtaddal bevish al hay ketiv lo nin lo velo neched beammo vego deha kudsha berich hu bae dela yabid toladin deilmale yabed toladin hava metashtesha alma veal da ketiv ma yitron laadam bechal amalo uman dela yishtaddal lemebad toladin itdabbak behay sitra deadam bisha veal techot gadpoy

Rut amra ufarasta chenafecha al amatcha begin leizdavvega bahadeh detzaddik lemebad toladin vekudsha berich hu paris gadpoy al bar nash begin leappasha bealma leman dela bae lemebad toladin begappo yavo begappo dehahu bish deihu azil ariri kechiveya da deazil yechiday begappo yetze ihu dela ishtaddal lemebad toladin ha ittemar kal ma deitzterich

Riv deavad kudsha berich hu ha ittemar riv dichtiv kum riv et heharim may ihu ella inun turin diltatta amay riv da begin divhu talya kal chova deavdin yisrael legabbe avuhon devishmayya may taama begin deyisrael hao yadin shimmusha dechal malachin illain devishmayya vela anis lehu afilu shema dechad minnayehu vechal shimmusha dilhon

Uvitren sitrin have taan avatrayehu chad dahao yadin leamshacha chela dilhon dekkochavayya umazzale beara vechad dahao yade leumaa lon bechal ma deitzterichu veal da baa kudsha berich hu lemebad behu riv vedina vechevan dibbehon leheve riv vedina kal shilshula nafal deha la yeheve beh toalta uvgin kach kum riv vego vetishmana haggevaot kolecha
722: Man givot illen inun immahot dargin deikrun betulot achareha vego uvgin kach vetishmana haggevaot kolecha dehachi hao avde yisrael ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain ta chaze deit leahaddera sava bemillin kadmain

Dehachi hao avde yisrael ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain yarech deka amaran saggi atkifu lon yisrael behahu yarech mardechay hava achme lehahu rasha dehaman hahu yarech dileh veal da hava ragiz milla deitchaze leh veihu argiz leh bahadeh chamu chavrayya ma ketiv vattikkach rivka et bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot vego beillen levushin dileh gazal dileh veappik leh mikkal birkan dileh umibbechiruta

Uvgin kach ila deka ashkachu retichin dileh lerabbanan ihu dechufya dilhon lemane derabbanan tadir leyarchin dilhon ulmanin dilhon veillen teren millin distar achara hao vechal da begin degazlu lon minneh let lehu ila ella lerabbanan uvgin kach hane mani derabbanan deka balu mechufya dilhon ihu vehani barchi deshalhe minnayehu hu vadday umiddilhon hao uminnehon natle ila umimma dahao minnayehu baan lerabbanan deinun kelala dehahu yoshev ohalim veal da let ila bela ila veal da let milla bela dina vechal milla tav leatreh

Shelomo amar veshavti ani vaere et kal haashukim asher naasim tachat hashshamesh vehinne dimat haashukim veen lahem menachem umiyyad oshkehem koach veen lahem menachem hay kera armizna beh veittemar aval shavti ani vechi mean atar tav shelomo i nima levatar deamar milla da tav kemilkaddemin veamar milla achora yeot aval shavti vaere

Tamman tanenan bechal yoma hava akdim shelomo betzafra vahave shave anpoy listar mizrach vechame ma dechame ulvatar tav listar darom vechame ma dechame vehadar tav listar tzafon vekaim tamman maich enoy vezakif resheh

Behay shaata ha ammuda deeshsha veammuda daanana hao atyan veal hahu ammuda daanana hava ate nishra chada vehahu nishra hu ravreva vetakkif vechen hava ate gadpa yemina al gabbe ammuda deeshsha vegufa vegadpa semala al gabbe ammuda daanana vehahu nishra havi mayete teren tarfin befumaha ata ammuda daanana veammuda deeshsha vehahu nishra alayehu vesagdin lekameh deshelomo malka

Ata nishra umaich lekameh veyahiv leh inun tarfin natil lon shelomo malka vahava meriach behu vahava yada behon siman veamar da ihu denofel veda ihu digluy enayim beshaata ditren tarfin hao hava yada detarvayehu nofel ugluy enayim baan leodaa leh millin

Ma avid chatim kurseyeh begushpanka dehava chakik beh shema kaddisha veihu natil izka dechakik aleh shema kaddisha vesalik leigra verachiv al hahu nishra veazil leh vehahu nishra hava mistallak lerum ananin uvchal atar deihu avar hava itchashach nehora chakkime dahao behahu atar deitchashach nehora hao yade vahau amre shelomo malka ha azil veabar hacha vela yade lean atar hava azil tippeshin dahao tamman hao amre ananin hao inun deka azle vechashich alma

Gavah nishra bahadeh ufarach arba mea parsin ad demata leture chashoch vetamman ihu tarmud bammidbar beharim veihu nachit tamman zakif resheh vechame tura chashoch vahava yada tamman kal ma deitzterich vahava yada detamman yeul hava rachiv al nishra kemillekadmin vetas veal lego turin ad hahu atar dezeta taman kara bechela veamar Adonai rama yadcha bal yechozaun vego
Al tamman ad dekariv lehahu atar shave izka kamayehu vekariv vetamman hava yada kal ma devae meinun chachmetan nuchrain devae leminda kevan dahao amrin leh kal ma devae keden hava rachiv al hahu
723: Nishra vetav leatreh kevan dehava yativ al kurseyeh ityashav bedateh vahava memallel bedateh millin dechachmeta yakkira behahi shaata hava amar veshavti ani vaere shavti vadday mehahu archa shavti mehahi chachmeta veityeshavit belibbay uvdatay uchden vaere et kal haashukim vechi zeirin inun bealma deihu amar et kal haashukim

Ella may ashukim illen dehu amar inun yenokin demetin bettukfa deimmehon deka ashukim mikkamma sitrin ashukim baatar illaa dilela vaashukim letatta veha chavrayya ittearu vehachi hu aval saggiin inun kum sava ittear bechelach sava ema milach devadday bela dechilu tema
Let ashuk keinun ashukim dehava ihu ashik bekadmita o mittelata leachora kema dichtiv poked aon avot al banim veal bene vanim al shilleshim veal ribbeim

742: Tanya beraza derazin resha demalka ittakkan bechesed uvigvura behay resha talyan shaare nimin al nimin deinun kol meshichuta demitachadan behu illae vetattae mare demarin mare dikshot mare demitkela mare divava mare dilala mare dedina mare derachame vetaame orayeta veraze orayeta dachyan misavan kullehu ikrun shaare demalka kelomar meshichuta deitmeshach mimmalka kaddisha vecholla nachit meattika setimaa

Mitzcha demalka pekiduta dechayyavayya kad itpakkedan beovadayehu vechad itgalleyan chovayehu keden ikre mitzcha demalka kelomar gevura ittakkaf bedinoy veitpashshat besitroy veda ishtane mimmitzcha deattika kaddisha deikre ratzon

Ayenin demalka ashgachuta decholla ashgachuta deillain vetattain vechal inun mare ashgachuta hachi ikrun beayenin gavenin itachadan veinun gavenin ikrun kal inun mare ashgachuta demalka kal chad kefum archeh vechullehu gavenin deena ikrun kema deitchaze ashgachuta demalka hachi gavenin mitarin

Gevine deayenin ikrun atar deyahavin ashgachuta lechullehu gavenin mare ashgachuta hane gevinin legabbe diltatta gevinin leashgachuta mehahu nahara denagid venafik atar leitmashshecha mehahu nahara leistachaa bechivara deattika mechalava denagid meima dechad gevura mitpashsheta veayenin melahatan begaven sumaka nahir attika kaddisha chivara dileh velahata beimma veitmalleya mechalava veyanka lehane veistechan kullehu ayenin behahu chalava deimma deitnegid venafik tadir hada hu dichtiv rochatzot bechalav bechalav deima denagid tadira vela pasik

Chotama demalka kaddisha tikkuna defartzufa kad mitpashshetan gevuran umitachadan kachada inun chotama demalka kaddisha veinun gevuran mechad gevura achidan venafkin vechad dinin mitarin venafkin missitrayehu la mitbasseman ella bitnana demadbecha uchden ketiv vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach shane chotama deattika dela itzterich dechotama deattika orech appayim becholla ikre vehahu nehiru dechachmeta setimaa ikre chotama dileh vehayenu tehilla dichtiv uthillati echotam lach veal da ittear david malka tehilla ledavid vego

Udnin demalka kad raava ishtechach veima yanka unhiru deattika kaddisha itnehir mitarin nehiru ditren moche unhiru deabba veima kal inun deikrun moche demalka umitlahatin kachada vechad mitlahatan kachada ikrun azne Adonai deha itkabbilat tzelotehon deyisrael uchden itaruta letav ulvish uvitaruta da mitarin mare degadpin denatlin kalin dealma vechullehu ikrun azne Adonai

Anpoy demalka nehiru deabba veimma veitpashshetuta dilhon denaharin vesacharin velahatin behay resha demalka uchden sahaduta isittehad bemalka minnayehu diyyukna demalka yakkiruta mikkolla merisha share chesed illaa ugvura unhiru deabba veimma itpelag nehiru deabba bitlat nehorin veima bitren ha chamishsha chesed ugvura bechad nehora ha shita levatar itattar chesed veitlehit bitren nehorin deitnehir veinun temanya ugvura itnehir bechad ha tisha vechad mitchabberan kullehu nehorin kachada ikrun diyyukna demalka uchden ketiv Adonai kagibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina vego

Shifvan demalka hachi tana kad itnehir nehiru deabba nahir bitlat nehorin mechad nehora nahir chesed illaa mechad nehora itnehir nehiru deikre mocha demalka vechad nehora hava tale ad deitnehir nehiru deima vechad itnehir itnehir bechamesh nehorin
Bemay itnehir mechad shevila detamir veganiz
743: Deitdabbak beh abba dichtiv nativ lo yedao ayit vego kema deitdabbak dechura benukva veitabberat veolidat veappikat chamesh nehorin umeinun chamesh nehorin itgelifu chamshin tarin dinhorin saggiin chamshin inun lakovlehon panim tahor panim tame beorayeta ishtear chad vehay chad itnehir becholla vehahu deabba hava tale kad mitchabberan kachada umityashvan bemalka ikrun shifvan demalka uvgini kach gazar millin dikshot

Ufuma behu talya petichuta defuma may puma ella daat ganiz befuma demalka deikre tiferet peshituta detiferet dechal otzarin vechal gevanin itachadan beh dichtiv uvdaat chadarim yimmalu vehahu daat hu ganiz befuma demalka umalya kal iddarin veachsadrain vechad ittear nehiru deveh venafik keden ikre pe Adonai veshifvan deinun teren nehorin meabba umeima beshaata deitaran behahi nehiru dedaat mitchabberan kachada umillin itgezaru bikshot bechachma bitvuna uvdaat uchden kal millin dekudsha berich hu beillen itgezaru

Naharin telat illen veayelin bego lego veitattaru bechad vechad mitchabberan beittura chad keden ikrun chikko mamtakkim veinun chech demalka veikrun metika demalka veal hay ketiv taamu uru ki tov Adonai uvhay chech talyan kal inun shelitin vehurmanin demalka dichtiv uvruach piv kal tzevaam

Behay chech shelemuta decholla ishtechach uvgine kach kal atvan deinun behay atar shelemuta itchazya behu nehiru deattika kaddisha setimaa dechal setimin nehiru dechachmeta dela ishtechach vela itiddevak dichtiv lo yada enosh erkah Adonai nehiru deima denahir venagid venafik umashke lecholla veyanka livnin ad demate hahu revut umalle latztzaddik veihu itketar benukba tattaa veitbarcha mineh vela mitparshin da min da chivar miggo sumak dichtiv har hammor givat hallevona nehiru de anpin deitzanu mehay rucha denafik min puma keden shemahan dekudsha berich hu lakovlehon beara kal hannefesh levet yaakov habbaa mitzrayema shivim deha yaakov ilana beara veinun nefesh anpin

Meillen atvan nehirin arba acharanin me nahir gimel deihi agar tav letzaddikayya deikre gemul veal da ketiv az titannag al Adonai mech nahir yud dehi chachma kolla astim beud deihi setima mikkal sitroy ubbegin kach lo ishtechach dichtiv velo timmatze beeretz hachayyim me nahir kaf deihu nehiru umshach revut deitterak meima lehahu atar deitkere keren veikre keren hayyovel veda malchut david uvgin kach let meshicha ella beraza dechaf
Me nahir kema de shivin kach mea deinun shelimu vehachi hu uvgin kach behay chech shelimu decholla vechal man deyada raza da veizdehar beh zakkaa chulakeh
Gufa demalka itpashshetuta detiferet degevanin beh mitchabberan deroin demalka nehiru dechesed ugvura uvgin kach yamin usmol meoy bedaat ittaknan ayel beresha ittakkan veitpashshat lego uvgo gufa

Shokin itachadan bitren nehorin veinun teren nehorin mammash shokin utren kulleyan kullehu mitchabberan beatar chad dettamman itkenash kal revut vechal mishcha degufa umittamman sharyan kal hahu revut laatar deitkere yesod olam yesod mehahu atar deikre olam uman ihu netzach vehod veal ken Adonai tzevaot shemo berich hu berich shemeh lealam ulalme almin
Kal hane tikkunin atyan leitchabbera bechad ad dechal revut kudsha natil kolla hay yesod veashde lenukba umitbarcha mineh ematay mitbarcha
744: Mineh beshaata deittakkanu dinin diltatta vechad dinin mittaknin letatta mittaknin leela vechal tikkunin demalka bechedvata bishlimu deinun shema kaddisha vahava kolla chad uchden hu shari begavayehu dichtiv elohim nitztzav beadat el bekerev elohim yishfot

Vechad dinin la mittaknan letatta kivyachol hachi leela dechal tikkunin la mityashsheran hachi deha ima istalakat meal benin uvnin la yanke deha yesod la ashde benukba vechal dinin mitarin vechiveya takkifa shalta kivyachol tikkuni malka al dina istalaku dechevan dehay nukba la mitbarcha vetzadik la natil vechiveya takkifa shalta vay lealma deyanka minnayehu

Amar ribbi elazar kal hani tikkunin abba galle lon begin dela yeul bechisufa lealma deate hashta amay itzterichu leitgallaa amar leh ribbi abba hahu daana katavna mibbutzina kaddisha amena legabbe chavrayya deha inun yadin millin veha itzterich leminda dichtiv vidatem ki ani Adonai uchtiv veyadu ki ani Adonai begin deityashvan millin belibbana umikkan ulhala setimin millin begavan zakkaa chulakana behay alma uvalma deate deha ad kean butzina kaddisha itattar bemillin divgavan

Ta chaze ana chazena leh bechelma veshailna kameh derabbi shimon ha olifna kameh demar deihi chachma vehachi hu vadday Adonai amay ihu bina amar li ta chaze ha ketiv venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et haggan man hu nahar deotze meeden da bina ubbegin kach hahu nahar satim begaveh veud pashit nahara da mikkal sitroy veda hi Adonai begin kach hu levatar appikat ben techotah deihu kegavena da Adonai levatar olidat veappikat hay ben veshaveyeh lekammah uvgin kach deha lekammah yativ leyanka leh veal kach tanenan bematnita dilan Adonai havat middeitchabbar dechura immah itabberat mechad ben veikre Adonai levatar olidat veappikat hahu ben vekaim lekammah veal hay ketiv venahar yotze meeden minneh nafik vadday lehashkot et haggan leyanka leh

Havina achid bideh venashik bidoy ana behay idduna ittearna bache vechayich vahau telata yomin dela achilna midi chad mechedvata vechad dela zachena lemechome leh zimna achara veim kal da beh itkasharna tadira deha kad nehira li shemateta chamena diyyukneh deittear kammay zakkain inun tzaddikayya bealma den uvalma deate alayehu ketiv ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha

Uvchol asher amarti alechem tishshameru vego may tishshameru tishmoru mibbae leh ella tishshameru vadday may asher amarti alechem kelomar deagzimit lechon al memar pulchani tishshameru dela yamte alechon shum bish tishshameru mehahi shemira untura dili bilvad veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru lo tazkiru kema deokimna davar acher veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru kelomar lo tesabbevun detippelun beni amamya beara achara vikuyam bechu ma dichtiv veavadta sham elohim acherim vego

Davar acher uvchol asher amarti alechem tishshameru rabbi yehuda patach shema ammi veaida bach vego lo yihye vecha el zar vego anochi Adonai elohecha hammaalcha meeretz mitzrayim vego hane karan amaran david beruach kudsha veit leistakkal behu shema ammi bechamma atrin azhara orayeta lebbar nash bechamma atrin kudsha berich hu azhir beh bevar nash vecholla letoalta devar nash begin deyintar pikkude orayeta dechal man
745: Deyintar arche deorayeta veishtaddal bah keman deishtaddal bishma kaddisha

Detanenan orayeta kolla shema dekudsha berich hu uman demishtaddal bah keman demishtaddal bishma kaddisha begin deorayeta kolla chad shema kaddisha hu shema illaa shema dechalil kal shemahan uman degara ot chad minah keilu avid pegimuta bishma kaddisha tana veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru lo tosif al orayeta vela tigra minah rabbi chiyya amar veshem elohim acherim da man deyitasak besifrin acharanin dela missitra deorayeta la yishshama al picha deasur afilu leadkera lon ulmelaf minnayehu taama kal shekken al orayeta

Rabbi yehuda matne hachi may taama ketiv veshem elohim acherim vesamich leh et chag hammatztzot tishmor ella man dela natir hay keman dela natir mehemnuta dekudsha berich hu may taama mishshum deveh achida milla amar rabbi yitzchak vechen bechal shear zimnin vechaggin deha kullehu achidan bishma kaddisha illaa veal da taninan may dichtiv shalosh peamim bashshana mishshum divhu talya mehemnuta

Yerae kal zechurcha amay kal zechurcha amar ribbi elazar kal zechurcha mammash begin denatlin birkata mimmabbua denachala mikkan tanenan kal bar yisrael deitgezar bae leitchazaa kame malka kaddisha begin denatil birkata mimmabbua denachala hada hu dichtiv kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach uchtiv el pene haadon Adonai kema deokimna demittamman merikan birkan venatlin birkata zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkal shear ammin

Zimna chada seliku yisrael lemechag chagga veitarvu ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bahadayehu vehahu shatta la ishtechach birkata bealma atu shailu lerav hamnuna sava amar lehu chametun simana bekadmita behay amar leh simana chamenan dechad tavna mehatam kal archin astimu mimmayya vaanana vachashocha ishtechach dela yachlin lemehach kal inun desaliku letamman veod beshaata dealana leitchazaa appe shemaya itchashshachu veitregizu amar lehu vadday o it benayechu bene nasha dela itgezaru o ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot seliku bahadayechu deha la itbarchan behahi shaata bar meinun yisrael deitgezaru uvhay at kaddisha mistakkel kudsha berich hu uvarich lon

Leshatta achara seliku usliku inun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot deitarvu bahadayehu kad hao achlin karbenayya vahau chaddan vechamu leinun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot detafsan bekutrayehu lekutra dechotala ashgachu behu decholla mevarchin veinun la berichu atu veamru milla leve dina atu veshailu lon amru hay daachaltun chulaka dilchon man kurbana hava la hava bidayehu badku veashkachu deinun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot vekatlu lon amru berich rachamana desheziv leammeh devadday let bircheta sharya ella beyisrael zara kaddisha beni mehemnuta bene keshot vehahi shatta ishtechach bircheta bealma bishlimu patchu veamru ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha vego

Ribbi chiyya amar bizchut yisrael gezirin itkenau sanehon techotehon veyarte achasantehon ta chaze ma ketiv yerae kal zechurcha uchtiv batreh ki orish goyim mippancha vehirchavti et gevulecha dekudsha berich hu akar diyyurin meatrayehu veativ diyyurin leatrayehu uvgini kach yerae kal zechurcha et pene haadon Adonai rabbi yehuda amar haadon kema dichtiv hinne haadon Adonai tzevaot mesaef pura vego veyatza choter vego vecholla chad meakker diyyurin veativ diyyurin ribbi yitzchak amar it adon veit adon vecholla bechad talya
Rabbi yehuda amar adonay alef dalet nun yod kudsha berich hu ikre
746: Vehahu deikre kema deihu ketiv uman hu rabbi yosi omer marot elohim marat ketiv umahu marat shelimu decholla yud he vav he marat lemay ihu alef dalet nun yud hay ikre kichtavo vehay la ikre kichtavo uvgine kach ikre behay veal kach marat elohim ketiv

Rabbi yehuda amar lezimnin illain ikrun bishma dettattain ulzimna tattain ikrun bishma deillain haadon Adonai bishma illaa adonay hu veha okimna mille uvigvanin saggiin itparshan mille vecholla chad berich rachamana berich shemeh lealam ulalme almin

Hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha vego rabbi yitzchak patach yishshakeni minneshikot pihu vego amra keneset yisrael yishshakeni minneshikot pihu may taama yishshakeni yeehaveni mibbae leh amay yishshakeni ella hachi tanenan may neshikot adbekuta derucha berucha divgini kach neshika bappe deha puma afkuta umkora derucha hu veal da neshikin befuma bachavivuta vedavkin rucha berucha dela mitparshan da min da

Veal da man denafik nishmateh binshika mitdebbak berucha achara berucha dela mitperash minneh vehayenu ikre neshika veal da amra keneset yisrael yishshakeni minneshikot pihu leadbeka rucha berucha dela yitperish da min da

Ki tovim dodecha miyyayin may bae hacha yayin veha ketiv vegam elle beyayin shagu vego uchtiv yayin veshechar al teshte atta uvanecha may taama hacha yayin rabbi chiyya amar miyyenah deorayeta rabbi chizkiyya amar da dichtiv veyayin yesammach levav enosh veal da ketiv ki tovim dodecha miyyayin lechedvata delibba miyyayin dechadde li yattir mikkolla

Rabbi yehuda amar ketiv vayyishshak yaakov lerachel veyissa et kolo vayyevche amay ka bacha ella beitdabbekuta derucha bah la yachil libba lemisbal uvacha vei tema ha ketiv vayyishshakehu vayyivku tanenan amay nakud vayyishshakehu ella dela itdabbak beh rucha kelal veal da ketiv venatarot neshikot sone may venatarot neshikot sone ella man denashik bachavivuta mitdavak rucheh berucheh bidvekuta dachavivuta uman dela nashik bachavivuta lav bidvekuta hu ella venatarot may natarot gassuta dela davik rucheh behahu neshika vela itdabbak beh kelal uvgine kach ketiv yishshakeni minneshikot pihu dehu devekuta rucha berucha

Tana kal zimna dekudsha berich hu azil beyisrael kivyachol itdabbak rucha berucha veal da ketiv veattem haddevekim bayeya bechal inun gavene devekuta vela mitparsha da min da beshaata deittemar hinne anochi soleach malach lefanecha yada moshe difrishuta hu amar im en panecha holchim al taalenu mizze

Rabbi abba amar ma ketiv leela min da reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo may ka mayere ella dela learva milla tattaa beillaa dela yanka sitra dilvar missitra penimaa ma ben hay lehay da dilvar missitra dimsaava veda dilgo besitra kaddisha man immo da keneset yisrael deitkere em bachalev immo dela yanik mehay sitra man dela itzterich
Vehacha ketiv hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha amar moshe ha kabbilna bitchona minach dela titperash minan vadday im en pancha holchim al taalenu mizze uvamme yivada efo vego
Amar rabbi elazar milla da la kaamar kudsha berich hu ella birchimuta deyisrael ulitpayesa bahadayehu lemalka dehava bae lemezal im bereh vela bae leshavka leh ata bereh
747: Umistafe lemibbae leh lemalka deyezil bahadeh akdim malka veamar ha ligon pelan yezil bahadach lemintar lach bearcha levatar amar istammar lach minneh deha la gevar shelim hu amar bereh i hachi o ana otiv hacha o atte tezzil immi vela itperash minach kach kudsha berich hu bekadmita amar hinne anochi soleach malach lefanecha lishmarcha baddarech ulvatar amar hishshamer mippanav vego beh shaata amar moshe im en panecha holchim vego

Ata rabbi shimon ashkach lehu behay amar elazar beri shappir kaamarte aval ta chaze baatar da la amar moshe midi vela ativ milla lakovle may taama mishshum dehacha la ishtechach perishuta minneh veha okimna milla da legabbe chavrayya veit dematne ipcha vela hachi pershuha kadmae vechad yistakkelun mille kolla shappir vecholla bechad milla amre taamayehu

Ematay ativ moshe bezimna deamar veshalachti lefanecha malach uchtiv ki yelech malachi lefanecha satam vela parish milla veal da ketiv hacha ki im shamoa tishma bekolo veasita kol asher adabber asher adabber daveka uchtiv veayavti et oyevecha vetzarti et tzorarecha vecholla beh talya

Ribbi yehuda amar i tema detarvayehu malach mammash moshe la ativ alayehu dela chama duchta ematay ativ bezimna dichtiv im en pancha holchim vego amar ribbi shimon kelal decholla moshe la baa malacha deha ketiv vayyomer im na matzati chen beenecha adonay yelech na adonay bekirbenu

Amar ribbi yehuda hay deamar ribbi abba dichtiv lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo bachalev haem mibbae leh may immo vei tema keneset yisrael immo desitra dimsaova lav hachi deha shemana deamar ribbi shimon keneset yisrael ima kaddisha bechulakeh deyisrael itachada dichtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo

Amar ribbi shimon shappir kaamarte veha derabbi abba shappir vecholla da beda talya ta chazi ima itachada lehu leela lesitra da ulsitra da utren inun chada limina vachada lismala uvgine kach minnehon limina uminnehon lismala vechullehu talyan behay em imma kaddisha veitachadan bah

Ematay itachadan bah beshaata dehay em yanka missitra achara umikdesha isteav vechiveya takkifa shari leitgallaa keden gadya yanka mechalava deimmeh vedinin mitarin veal da yisrael kaddemin veeytan bikkurim uvshaata demayetin lehu bayan lememar ulmiftach beh belavan devaa becharshoy illen leshalletaa beyaakov uvzara kaddisha vela ityehivu bideh vela itmasseran yisrael lesitra da veal da ketiv reshit bikkure admatcha vego lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo vela yanka hahu sitra mechalava deimmeh deha la yisteav makdesha vedinin la mitarin

Begine kach la yechul bisra bechalava kal zara kaddisha vechal man deate missetar da dela yahiv duchta leman dela itzterich deha beovada talya milleta beovada diltatta leatara leela zakkain inun yisrael mikkal ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot demarehon kare alayehu uvcha bachar Adonai lihot lo leam segulla uchtiv ki am kadosh atta layeya elohecha uchtiv banim attem layeya elohechem vego

Ta chazi beshaata deyisrael la itkesharu ovadayehu ma ketiv ammi nogsav meolel venashim mashlu vo mashlu vo dayeka veha okimna mille beraza desifra deshelomo malka vehachi ashkechan beh tu ashkechan dechal man deachil hay mechla deitchabbar kachada beshaata chada o bisudata chada arbein yomin itchazya gadya mekullasa biklippoy legabbe inun dilela vesiyyata mesaava
748: Mitkarvin bahadeh vegarim leatara dinin bealma dinin dela kaddishin

Vei olid bar beinun yomin ozfin leh nishmeta missitra achara dela itztericha uchtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim vego ate leistaava mesaavin leh vadday dichtiv venitmetem bam chaser mesaovuta atima mikkolla delet reshu leitdakkea hachi kishar zine dimsaovuta demitdakkin vetu demistafe mechevan bishan deha beenayehu gadya ishtechach veyachil leattezeka deha tzulma devar nash itavar minneh

Rabbi yesa share lemechal letarnegola bigvina o bechalava amar ribbi shimon asir lach dela yahiv inish pitcha lezinin bishin lech lech amrin nezira sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav vadday asir lach hu dechumra it beh kivira lashshechita uman deshare hay ma ketiv vattashku et hannezirim yayin man deshare hay kemaan deshare hay uchtiv lo tochal kal toeva kal leachlala kolla

Tana bema zachu daniyel chananya mishael vaazarya deishtezivu meinun nisone ella begin dela istaavu bemechlehon amar ribbi yehuda ketiv vayyasem daniyel al libbo asher la yitgaal befat bag hammelech vego vetana bistima dematnitin mechla dehahu rasha bisra bechalava hava ugvina im bisra bar mechlan acharanin veda salik leh befatoreh bechal yoma

Vedaniyel deistammar mehay kad ramu yateh leguva dearyavata ishtelim betzulma demareh vela shane tzulmeh letzulma achara veal da dachalu aryavata minneh vela chabbeluhu vehahu rasha beshaata demalchuta itade minneh veim chevat bara hava madoreh ade tzulma deanpoy minneh umehahu yoma la itchaze tzulmeh tzulma devar nash vechal beira deate itchaze leh tzulma dezineh venukveh vahau atyan aleh kullehu uvchamma zimnin hao achlin leh chevat bara bar deitgezar hay onsha aleh begin dichtiv vehu bammelachim yitkallas begin kach kolla yitkallesu beh kal hahu zimna

Ta chazi ma ketiv ulmiktzat yamim asara nira marehen tov mikkal hayeladim haochlim et pat bag hammelech nira marehen tov detzulma demarehon la adiu minnehon umeacharine adiu man garim hay begin dela itgaalu begiule mechlehon zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael dichtiv behu veanshe kodesh tihun li

Veel moshe amar ale el Adonai vego veel moshe amar man amar da shechinta aleh el Adonai kema dichtiv umoshe ala el haelohim vego Adonai amay kal da lekayema immehon kayyam begin deha itperau ma dela nafku hachi mimmitzrayim deitgezaru vela itperau vehacha ha itperau vealu bivrit kayyama dichtiv sham sam lo chok umishpat dayeka vesham nissahu behay at kaddisha deitgalya behu vehacha itkayyam behu al yeda demoshe gezira dekayyama dichtiv vayyikkach moshe et haddam vayyizrok al haam vego

Amar ribbi yitzchak may dichtiv vachatzi haddam zarak al hammizbeach bammizbeach la ketiv ella al hammizbeach dayeka vehishtachavitem merachok mahu merachok kema deatte amer merachok Adonai nira li uchtiv vattetatztzav achoto merachok tane ribbi abba dekayema sihara bifgimuta uveh shaata zachu yisrael yattir bechulaka kaddisha vegazru kayyama kaddisha bekudsha berich hu

Veel moshe amar ale el Adonai may tama amra leh shechinta istelik leela deha ana veyisrael nishtattef kachada bishlemuta al yedach ma dela hava ad hacha ma ketiv vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam vego palag leh litren chatzi haddam zarak al haam vachatzi haddam zarak
749: Al hammizbeach kema deokimna uchtiv hinni dam habberit asher karat Adonai immachem vayyasem baagganot baagganat ketiv chaser vav kema dichtiv sharrech agan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg

Veniggash moshe levaddo el Adonai zakkaa chulakeh demoshe dehu bilchodoy zacha lema dela zacha bar nash achara yisrael zachu hashta ma dela zachu ad hahi shaata vehahi shaata itkeyyamu bekiyyuma illaa kaddisha uvhahu shaata itbassaru lemeheve benayehu makdesha kema deatte amer veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham

Vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir vego rabbi yehuda patach zot komatech damta letamar vego kamma chaviva keneset yisrael kame kudsha berich hu dela mitparsha minnih kehay tamar dela parish dechar min nukba lealmin vela salik da bela da kach keneset yisrael la mitparsha mekudsha berich hu

Ta chazi beshaata denadav vaavihu chamu veshivin savin ma ketiv behu vayyiru et elohe yisrael deitgele alayehu shechinta rabbi yehuda verabbi yosi amre et dayeka veda et hu merachok et leachlela ma di begaveh

Rabbi yitzchak amar veha ketiv hi hachayya asher raiti tachat elohe yisrael binhar kevar man chayya da amar ribbi yosi amar rabbi chiyya chayya zutratti vechi it chayya zutratti in chayya zutratti vechayya illaa vechayya zutra dezutarti
Vayyiru et elohe yisrael dayeka kema daamena vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir kechezu even tava dezammin kudsha berich hu lemivne makdesha dichtiv vsadtich bassappirim

Veel atzile bene yisrael da nadav vaavihu lo shalach yado desalik lon levatar zimna vela itanashu hacha rabbi yosi amar milla da lishvacha dilhon dichtiv vayyochlu vayyishtu dezanu enehon minnehiru da rabbi yehuda amar achila vaddait achlu vezanu garmayehu vehacha itkesharu leela i la desatu orchayehu levatar kema deokimna

Amar rabbi elazar vaafilu yisrael behahi shaata itkesharu veitkashsharat behu shechinta veda kayyama veorayeta kolla bechad zimna hava veyisrael kehahi shaata la chamu lealmin ulzimna deate zammin kudsha berich hu leitgallaa al benoy ulmechome kolla yekara dileh ena beena dichtiv ki ayin beayin yiru beshuv Adonai tziyyon uchtiv vnigla kevod Adonai vrau chal basar yachdav vgo
750: Ki chelek Adonai ammo veyahav lishar ammin shultanin ravrevan memanan alayehu vehu natil lechulakeh yisrael

Rabbi shimon patach mi zot hannishkafa kemo shachar yafa challevana bara kachamma auma kannidgalot mi zot raza ditren almin mitchabberan kachada veda hu olam veolam mi ha okimna darga illaa leela sheruta dekayema bishelta veikre mi kema deatte amer seu marom enechem uru mi vara elle zot darga tattaa letatta alma tattaa vetarvayehu teren almin bechibbura chada bekishshura chada kachada

Hannishkafa kad mitchabberan tarvayehu kachada kemo shachar kad baya shacharuta leanhara ulvatar itnehir kesihara kad batash bah nehiru deshimsha ulvatar keshimsha kad kayema sihara bishlimu auma takkifa leaggana al kolla deha kedin it lah shelimu utkifu lemebad chela

Venatla chela mealma illaa al yeda deyaakov shelema dechibber lon kachada chibber lon kachada leela vechibber lon kachada letatta umittamman nafku teresar shevatin kaddishin kegavena dilela yaakov dehava shelim ail rechimu bitren almin kema deokimna shear bene nasha deavdin keden megallin eryan leela vetatta garim devavu bitren almin vegarim piruda hada hu dichtiv veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror deitavedu mare devavu da leda

Vei tema vattekanne rachel baachotah hachi hu vadday deha alma tattaa kal tiuvteh lav ihu ella begin lemeheve kegavena dealma illaa ulmerat duchtaha beduchta achara kinat sofrim asgiat chachmeta vehacha kinat sofrin begin deit sefer vesefer asgiu meshichu dechachmeta legabbayehu

Veim kal da afilu yaakov la ashlim legabbayehu kadka chaze shear bene alma garmin devavu vegarmin piruda umgallin eryan decholla eryan deela vetatta uvraza da it raza deeryan eryan deima uvrata vecholla beraza chada mi zot itkerun achtan begin deinun beachva uvirchimu uvchibbura diruta veikrun ima uvrata man degalle arayathon let leh chulaka lealma deate velet leh chulaka bimhemanuta
Ta chaze ki yaakov bachar lo yah raza illaa leela kevan deashlim veikre yisrael keden lisgullato natil kolla bechal sitrin venatil leela venatil letatta veishtelim becholla

Amar ribbi shimon ha tanenan dechad bara kudsha berich hu alma gelif biglifoy deraze mehemnuta go tehirin berazin illain vegalif leela vegalif letatta vecholla beraza chada beraza degilufe dishma kaddisha deshalit beatoy ela vetatta uvraza da ishtachlalu almin alma illaa vealma tattaa

Alma illaa ishtachlal beraza deat nekuda illaa kadmaa denafka miggo desatim veganiz dela yedia vela kayema leminda vela ityeda kelal seliku deraza deen sof umiggo setimu da nahir nehiru chad dakik vesatim kalil begaveh kelala dechal nehorin uvhahu nehiru satim batash beh man dela batash nahir beh man dela nahir uchden appik chad nehiru deihu idduna leidduna leishtashea leitganneza nehiru dakik vesatim bego hahu nehiru
Vehahu nehiru deihu idduna leidduna satim itkayyamu veishtachlalu beh shit reshimin dela yedian bar lehahu nehora dakik kad al leitganneza idduna beidduna nahir binhiru

Vehay nehiru denafak miggo nehiru dakik ihu dechila veemtani vetakkifa yetera veitpashshat hay veitavid alma chada denahir lechal almin alma setima dela yedia kelal uvgaveh dayerin shit ribbo elef deinun dayerin vechelin umashryan illain
Vechevan deappik lon veishtachlalu kachada keden
751: Ihu chibbura chada veinun raza deat deitchabbar behahu alma setima uchden ketiv ki yaakov bachar lo yah kad nafik veishtachlal miggo yah keden yisrael lisgullato

Shear bene alma la ityehiv lon reshu lesalleka hachi ella lisgullato atar denatil vechanish kolla veda ihu darga letatta umiggo da natlin leela bistimu diru aval la beitgalya kema denatil yaakov hada hu dichtiv veyikchu li teruma
Veyikchu li teruma rabbi yehuda patach ma rav tuvcha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam hay kera ha ukmuha veittemar aval raza da ha ukmuha butzina kaddisha go razin illain
Darga illaa deihu raza dealma illaa ikre mi darga tattaa deihu raza dealma tattaa ikre ma vetanenan al tikre ma ella mea begin dechal dargin illain beashlemuthon hacha inun

Tu amay ikre ma ella af al gav dimshichu illaa itmeshach la itgalya ad deishtelim hacha deihu atar sofa dechal dargin sofa deamshachuta decholla vekayema beitgalya veaf al gav deitgalya yattir mikkolla kayema lishela ma ma chamit ma yadate kema deatte amer ki lo reitem kal temuna

Uvgin kach ma rav tuvcha da ihu yesoda dealma deikre rav tuv kema deatte amer verav tuv levet yisrael begin dehay ihu rav tuv or kadmaa ikre tov setam vehacha kelilan dechar venukba kachada asher tzafanta dehay itgeniz kegavena deor kadmaa deitgeniz veittammar paalta dehacha ihu umanuta decholla umanuta dechal alma umanuta denishmatin veruchin

Beraza da avid kudsha berich hu umanuta dechal alma veraza da bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz beraza da itavid mashkena veitbene deihu bediyyukna dealma dilela uvdiyyukna dealma tattaa hada hu dichtiv veyikchu li teruma li teruma teren dargin deinun chad demitchabberan kachada

Veyikchu li teruma vego rabbi shimon verabbi elazar veribbi abba veribbi yosi hao yatve yoma chad techot ilane bevikata gabbe yamma deginnosar amar rabbi shimon kamma yae tzilla da dechafya alan miggo ilane vaanan tzerichin leatera hay atar bemille deorayeta

Patach rabbi shimon veamar appiron asa lo hammelech shelomo meatze hallevanon hay kera ha okimna leh veittemar aval appiron da hechala diltatta deihu kegavena dehechala illaa vekudsha berich hu kara leh ginta deeden deihu nata leh lahanaateh vechissufa dileh leishtashea beh go inun nishmatin detzaddikayya dettamman kullehu kayemin urshimin begaveh inun nishmatin delet lon gufa behay alma kullehu sallekin umitatteran tamman veit lon duchtin lemechome leitannega go innuga illaa deikre noam Adonai vetamman itmalleyan mikkal kissufin denahare deafarsemona dachya
Afarsemon da hechala illaa temira geniza appiron da hechala diltatta delet beh semach ad deistemich miggo hechala illaa uvgin kach at samech ihu satim bechal sitroy kegavena da at setima

Ma ben hay lehay ella beshaata desatim veitgeniz begaveh go nehora illaa leela keden ihi kayema bediyyukna deat samech satim begavih veitgeniz beh lesalleka leela uvshaata dehadra veyatva revia al benin letatta leyanka lon keden ihi kayema bediyyukna deat revia setima lego arba sitrin dealma
752: Afarsemon veda hu appiron uvaatar teren atvan kayema beraza divrit deihu zammin lenatla kolla raza deinun mea birkan shitin vearbein shittin lakovel shit sitrin denafke meat arbein lakovel sitre alma vecholla ashlimu lemea veat yod ihu ashlim leraza demea kegavena dilela veal da da afarsamon veda appiron

Inun nahare nafkin meafarsemon da venishmatin illain delet lon gufa behay alma yankin mehahu nehiru denafik meinun nahare afarsemona dachya umitannege beinnuga da illaa venishmatin deit lon gufa behay alma sallekin veyankin mehahu nehiru deappiron da venachtin veillen yahave venatle yahave recha meinun ovdin dechashran demishtaddele behu behay alma venatle mehahu recha deishtear beh beginta kema deatte amer kereach sade asher beracho Adonai recha deishtear beh behahu chakla vechullehu kayeme behahi ginta illen mitannege leela veillen mitannege letatta

Asa lo hammelech shelomo asa lo legarmeh vei tema ha nishmatin detzaddikayya mishtashean beh veatt amart asa lo hachi hu vadday begin dehay appiron vechal inun nishmatin detzaddikayya kullehu kayeme leishtashea behu kudsha berich hu hammelech shelomo malka dishlama dileh veda ihu malka illaa hammelech setam da malka meshicha da alma didchura veda alma denukba meatze hallevanon inun ilanin netian deakar lon kudsha berich hu veshatil lon baatar achara veillen ikrun arze levanon kema deatte amer arze levanon asher nata vela itbene hay appiron vela ishtachlal ella behu

Tu meatze hallevanon illen shit yomin divreshit dechal yoma veoma mesadder behay appiron siddura deitchaze leh siddura kadmaa itnegid missitra dimina or kadmaa deitgeniz veitnetil missitra dimina veal behay appiron al yeda diyesoda chad veavid beh shimmusha levatar appik hahu appiron chad diyyukna kegavena dehay or veda hu raza dichtiv yehi or vayehi or kevan deamar yehi or amay ketiv vayehi or la itzterich kera lemichtav ella vayehi ken mahu vayehi or ella dehahu or appik or achara deitchaze leh veda ihu yoma kadmaa meinun atze hallevanon

Siddura tinyana itnegid missitra dismala perishu demayya bingidu deeshsha takkifa veitnetil missitra dismala veal behay appiron veavid beh shimmusha veafrish ben mayin devistar yemina uven inun mayin levatar appik hahu appiron chad diyyukna kegavena dileh veda ihu raza dichtiv ben hammayim asher mittachat larakia uven hammayim asher meal larakia vayehi chen veda ihu yoma tinyana meinun atze hallevanon

Siddura telitaa itnegid missitra deemtzaita umissitra dimina chad yoma telitaa deavid shelama bealma umittamman itmeshichu evin lecholla veda avid shimmusha behay appiron veappik zina lezineh zina leovadin saggiin zina deitchaze leh vechal deshain vaasavin veilanin bechamma chelin veishtear diyyukneh tamman veappik zina hahu appiron kehahu gavena mammash veda ihu yoma telitaa deitkelil miv sitrin meinun atze hallevanon

Siddura reviaa itnegid veitnehir nehiru deshimsha leanhara lehay appiron go chashuch dileh veal beh leanhara vela avid beh shimmusha ad yoma chamishaa deappik hay appiron hahu shimmusha dinhiru deal beh beoma reviaa veappik hahu appiron behahu gavena mammash dehahu nehiru veda ihu yoma reviaa chad meinun atze hallevanon
Siddura chamishaa itnegid chad meshichu dirchishu
753: Demayya veavid shimmusha leappaka hahu nehiru desiddura deoma reviaa veavid behay appiron shimmusha veappik zinin lezineh inun deitchaze kehahu gavena mammash vehay yoma shimmesh hahu shimmusha yattir mikkal shear yomin vecholla talya ad yoma shetitaa deappik appiron kal ma dehava ganiz beh dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah vego veda ihu yoma chamishaa chad meinun atze hallevanon

Siddura shetitaa da ihu yoma deatkin kal hay appiron velet leh tikkuna velet leh tukpa bar mehay yoma kad ata hay yoma ittakkan hay appiron bechamma ruchin bechamma nishmatin bechamma ulematan shefiran bechezu inun deitchazun lemetav behechla demalka uf ihu ittakkan bishfiru kal shear yomin dahao bekadmita veatkin lon betiuvta chada biruta bechedva tikkuna dilela vetatta

Keden itkaddash hay appiron bekiddushin illain veitattar beitroy ad desalik bisliku deitra denayecha veikre shema illaa shema kaddisha deihi shabbat nayecha decholla tiuvta decholla devekuta decholla deela vetatta kachada uchden ketiv appiron asa lo hammelech shelomo meatze hallevanon

Amar rabbi shimon man dezache behahu appiron zache becholla zache lemetav benayecha detzilla dekudsha berich hu kema deatte amer betzillo chimmadti veyashavti vehashta deyativna betzilla denayecha da it lan leistakkela dela yatvenan ella betzilla dekudsha berich hu go hahu appiron veit lan leaatara hay atar beitrin ilain ad deyitarun ilane dehahu appiron lemete alan betzilla achara

Patach rabbi shimon beresha veamar veyikchu li teruma meet kal ish asher yiddevennu libbo tikchu et terumati veyikchu li hay man devae leishtaddela bemitzva ulishtaddela beh bekudsha berich hu itzterich dela yishtaddal beh berekanayya uvmaggana ella itzterich leh levar nash leishtaddela beh kadka yeot kefum cheleh veha okimna milla da bechamma atre yeot lemesav bar nash hahu ishtaddeluta dekudsha berich hu kema deatte amer ish kemattenat yado vego

Vei tema ha ketiv lechu shivru veecholu ulchu shivru belo chesef uvlo mechir yayin vechalav deha ihu bemaggana veihu ishtadluta dekudsha berich hu ella ishtaddeluta deorayeta kal man devae zache bah ishtaddeluta dekudsha berich hu leminda leh kal man devae zache beh bela agra kelal aval ishtaddeluta dekudsha berich hu dekayema beovada asir lenattela leh lemaggana uvrekanayya begin dela zache behahu ovada kelal leamshacha aleh rucha dekudsha ella baagar shelim

Besifra decharshe deolif ashmeday lishlomo malka kal man devae leishtaddela leabera minneh ruach misava ulachpeya rucha achara hahu ovda devae leishtaddela beh bae lemikne leh baagar shelim bechal ma deyivun minneh ben zeer ben rav begin deruach misava ihu izdamman tadir bemaggana uvrekanayya veizdevan bela agra veanis livne nasha lemishre alayehu umfatte lon ledayera immehon bechamma pittuyin bechamma archin sate lon leshavaa diyyvirih imhon

Veruach kudsha lav hachi ella baagar shelim uvishtaddeluta rav saggi uvitdakkeuta degarmeh uvitdakkeuta demishkaneh uviruta delibbeh venafsheh ulvay deyachil lemirvach leh dishave madoreh immeh veim kal da deyahach beorach meshar dela yiste limina velismala vei lav miyyad istallak minneh veitrechak minneh vela yachil lemirvach leh kedivkadmeta
Veal da ketiv veyikchu li teruma meet kal ish mehahu deikre ish deitgabbar al yitzreh vechal man deitgabbar al yitzreh ikre ish asher yiddevennu libbo may asher yiddevennu libbo ella
754: Deyitree beh kudsha berich hu kema deatte amer lecha amar libbi tzur levavi vetov lev vayyitav libbo kullehu bekudsha berich hu kaamar uf hacha asher yiddevennu libbo minneh tikchu et terumati deha tamman ishtechach velav baatar achara

Umna yadenan deha kudsha berich hu itree beh veshave madoreh beh kad chamenan diruta dehahu bar nash lemirdaf ulishtaddela avatreh dekudsha berich hu belibbeh uvnafsheh uviruteh vadday tamman yadinan desharya beh shechinta keden baenan lemikne hahu bar nash bechesef shelim leitchabbera bahadeh ulmelaf minneh veal da kadmae hao amre ukne lecha chaver baagar shelim bae lemikne leh begin lemizke bishchinta ad hacha bae lemirdaf batar zakkaa ulmikne leh

Uf hachi hahu zakkaa bae lemirdaf batar chayyava ulmikne leh baagar shelim begin deyebar minneh hahu zuhama veyitkafya sitra achara veyaavid lenafsheh begin deyitchashshav aleh keilu hu bara leh veda ihu shevacha deyistallak beh yekara dekudsha berich hu yattir mishvacha achara veistallekuta da yattir mikkolla may taama begin deihu garim leachpeya sitra achara ulistalleka yekara dekudsha berich hu veal da ketiv beaharon verabbim heshiv meaon uchtiv beriti hayeta itto

Ta chaze kal man deachid beyada dechayyava veishtaddal beh lemishvak archa bisha ihu istallak bitlat sillukin ma dela istallak hachi bar nash achara garim leachpeya sitra achara vegarim deistallak kudsha berich hu bikareh vegarim lekayema kal alma bekiyyumeh leela vetatta veal hay bar nash ketiv beriti hayeta itto hachayyim vehashshalom vezache lemechome benin livnoy vezache behay alma vezache lealma deate kal mare dinin la yachlin lemedan leh behay alma uvalma deate al bitresar tare velet man deyimche bideh veal da ketiv gibbor baaretz yihye zaro dor yesharim yevorach hon vaosher beveto vetzidkato omedet laad zarach bachoshech or layesharim vego

Beiddara illaa kayemin telat gavenin veinun lahatin go shalhova chada vehahu shalhova nafka missitra dedarom deihu yemina veinun gavenin mitparshan litlat sitrin chad salik leela vechad nachit letatta vechad deitchaze veganiz beshaata deshimsha nahir

Gavena chada hahu desalik leela nafka vehahu gavena ihu gon chivar yattir mechivaru achara veal behahu shalhova veitzteva zeer vela itzteva vekayema hahu gon leela al resha dehahu idra uvshaata deyisrael alin leve kenishta umtzalin tzelothon kad matan legaal yisrael vesamchin geula littefilla keden hay gon chivar istallak al resha deiddara veitavid leh kitra

Vecharoza nafik veamar zakkain attun amma kaddisha deavde tov kameh dekudsha berich hu veraza da vehattov beenecha asiti desamich geula lattefilla begin deha behahi shaatta dematu lithillot leel elon desalik hay gon al risha dehahu iddara ittear hay tzaddik leitchabbera baatar deitzterich birchimu bachavivu bechedva biruta vechal shayefin kullehu mitchabberan betiuvta chada illen beillen illain betattain uvutzinin kullehu naharin umitlahatin vechulhon kayema bechibbura chada behay tzaddik deikre tov kema deatte amer imru tzaddik ki tov veda mechabber lechullehu bechibbura chada keden kolla bilchishu ela vetatta binshikin diruta vekayema milla bechibbura dive iddera

Kevan dematu lesim shalom keden avid shimmusha hahu nahar denafik meeden beiddara da uchden bayan kolla lenafka mikkame malka vela itzterich bar nash vela achara leishtakkecha tamman vela lemishal sheeltin
755: Ella itzterich leminpal al anpin may tama begin dehahi shaatta shaatta deshimmusha have uvae kal bar nash lemichsaf mikkame mareh ulchafya anpoy bechissufa saggi ulachlela nafsheh behahu shimmusha denafshin deitkelil hahu iddara meela umittatta benafshin veruchin keden gon achara denachit letatta kaim veachid beshippule dehay iddara

Vecharoza nafik vekare veamar illain vetattain ashidu sahaduta man ihu deavid nafshan vezakke lechayyavayya hahu deitra demalchuta al resheh hahu deitchaze leaala hashta kame malka umatronita deha malka umatronita shaale aleh

Beh shaata izdaman chad memana deihu gizbara al diyyuknin detzaddikayya beraza deshimmusha deatvan deitkere beraza yehodiam bechitra deshimmusha dishma kaddisha veramiz kudsha berich hu lehahu memana veayete diyyukneh dehahu bar nash deavid nafshan dechayyavayya vekaim leh kame malka umatronita

Vaana ashadna alay shemayya veara divhahi shaata masrin leh hahu diyyukna deha let lach kal tzaddika behay alma dela chakik diyyukneh leela techot yeda dehahu memana umasrin bideh maftechan dechal ginzeya demareh behu keden malka barich lehahu diyyukna bechal birkan devarich leavraham kad aved nafshan dechayyavayya

Vekudsha berich hu ramiz led mashreyan illain venatlin lehahu diyyukna veazlin immeh veihu al le almin genizin dela zache behu bar nash achara bar inun genizin leinun deavde nafshehon dechayyavayya veilmale hao yade bene nasha kamma toalta uzchu vezakkan beginayehu kad zachu lehon hao azlu avatrayehu veradfe lon keman deradif batar chayyin

Miskena zache livne nasha bechamma tavan bechamma genizin illain velav ihu keman dezakke bechayyavayya ma ben hay lehay ella man deishtaddal batar miskena ihu ashlim chayyin lenafsheh vegarim leh leitkayema vezache begineh lechamma tavan lehahu alma uman deishtaddal batar chayyavayya ihu ashlim yattir avid lesitra achara deelohim acherim deitkafya vela shalta veabar leh mishshultanuteh avid deistallak kudsha berich hu al kurse yekareh avid lehahu chayyava nafsha achara zakkaa chulakeh

Gavena achara deitchaze vela itchaze beshaata dematan yisrael likdusha desidra keden hay gavena deganiz venafik begin dehay ihu kedushata deka mekaddeshe yisrael yattir al malache illae deinun chaverim bahadayehu vehay gavena nahir veitchaze beshaata deyisrael mekaddeshe kedushata da ad dimsayeme yisrael begin dela yishgechun malachim illain veyanishu lon leela vela yekatregun alayehu

Keden karoza nafik veamar illain vetattain atzitu man ihu gas rucha bemille deorayeta man ihu dechal milloy begin lemigbah bemille deorayeta begin detanenan devar nash bae lemeheve shafil behay alma bemille deorayeta deha let gevahu beorayeta ella bealma deate

Bikdushata da baenan leistammera ulagneza lah benana begin denitkaddesh go kedusha beresha uvsofa yattir meinun kedushan deamre bahadan malache illae kedusha deanan mekaddeshe bishvacha deanan meshabbechan lemalache illae uvgin shevacha da shavkin lan lemeal go tare illae veal da anan amrin kedusha da
756: Belashon hakkodesh veshavkin lan birchimu lemeal tarin dilela miggo deanan meshabbechin lon besidura dilhon uvgin kach anan natlin kedushan yattir vealin tarin illain

Vei tema rammauta hi lav hachi ella malache illae inun kaddishin yattir minan veinun natle kedushata yattir veilmale deanan natlin umashchin alan kedushan illen la nechul lemeheve chaverim bahadayehu vikara dekudsha berich hu la yishtelim ela vetatta bezimna chada veal da anan mishtaddelin lemeheve immehon chaverim vistallak yekara dekudsha berich hu ela vetatta bezimna chada

Kedusha di besofa ihi targum kema deokimna veda afilu yachid yachil lomar lah inun mille detargum aval millin delashon hakkodesh dikdushsha lav inun ella baasara begin delashon hakkodesh shechinta mitchabbera bahadeh uvchal kedusha dishchinta atya lav ihu ella baasara dichtiv venikdashti betoch bene yisrael vego bene yisrael inun lashon hakkodesh vadday vela shear ammin deit lon lishan achara

Vei tema ha kedushata dekaddish deihu targum amay lav ihu beyachid ta chaze kedushata da lav ihu kishar kedushan deinun meshalshin aval kedushata da ihi salka bechal sitrin leela vetatta uvchal sitre mehemnuta vetavra manulin vegushpankan defarzela uklipin bishin leistalleka yekara dekudsha berich hu al kolla vaanan baenan lememar lah belishana desitra achara ulatava bechela takkif amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach begin deyitbar chela desitra achara vistallak kudsha berich hu bikareh al kolla vechad ittebbar bikdushata da chela desitra achara kudsha berich hu istallak bikareh veadkar livnoy veadkar lishmeh uvgin dekudsha berich hu istallak bikareh bikdushata da lav ihi ella baasara

Uvlishana da al karcheh desitra achara itkafya veittevar cheleh veistallak yekara dekudsha berich hu vetavar manulin vegushpankan veshalshelan takkifin uklipin bishin veidkar kudsha berich hu lishmeh velivnoy zakkain inun amma kaddisha dekudsha berich hu yahav lan orayeta kaddisha lemizke bah lealma deate

Amar rabbi shimon lechavrayya zakkain attun lealma deate vechevan desharenan millin dechitra demalchuta illaa ema ana beginayechu vekudsha berich hu yahiv lechon agra behahu alma vehahu haval defumayechu yistallak leela keilu attun mitarin millin illen

Patach veamar vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam zahav vachesef unchoshet hay kera ihu lesitra illaa veihu lesitra tattaa ihu lesitra illaa besitra dikdushsha veihu lesitra tattaa besitra achara ta chaze kad bara kudsha berich hu alma share lemivre missitra dechaspa deihu yemina begin dehahu kaspa hava milleela uvovada demashkena deihu kegavena dileh share missitra dismala ulvatar missitra dimina begin demashkena missitra dismala hava veal da share hacha missitra dismala vehatam missitra dimina vezot hatteruma vego

Uma deittemar tzahorayim deihu tukpa deshimsha lishana maalya nakat vehachi ihu archa levar nash ucham
757: Karan leh chivar velishana maalya nakat ulzimnin lechivar karan leh ucham dichtiv ki ishsha kushit lakach halo chivne chushiyyim attem li vego

Erev da tzelota dearvit uvgin diverev da itarav beh sitra achara dechashich nehoreh veshalta belelya shauu leh reshut velet leh zeman kavua emurin ufdarin mitakkelin behay zimna umikkan ittezanu kamma chavile tehirin denafkin veshaltin belelya
Vei tema i hachi ha taninan dechal inun mare sitra achara deruach misova la shalte beara kaddisha veha mitare lon yisrael behay veasir leitteara lon lesharya al ara kaddisha

Ella belelya hahu tenana salik vela salik kegavena dekarbena achara dehava salik tenana beorach meshar vehacha hava salik hahu tenana lechad nukba detzafon detamman kal madorin deruchin bishin vechevan dehahu tenana salik veakim orach lehahu sitra kullehu hao mitzanin vekayemin vealin beduchtayehu vela hao nafkin veshaltin bealma

Chad memana kayema lehahu sitra al hahu nukba detzafon bechal inun chavile tehirin sangirya shemeh uvshaata dehahu tenana akim archeh vesalik hay memana veshittin elef ribbo mashreyan acharanin kullehu mitattedan lekabbela leh ulattezena minneh vekayemin behahu nukba vealin bechad pitcha deikre keri veda ihu raza dichtiv veim telchu immi keri vego uchtiv vehalachti immachem bachamat keri behahu rugza denafik mippitcha dekeri

Veillen inun dimshattete belelya uvshaata denishmatin nafkin lesalleka leitchazaa leela inun nafkin umkatregan lon vela yachlin lesalleka ulitchazaa leela bar inun chaside kaddishin elonim deinun bakin rekiim vaavirim vesallekin veillen chavile tehirin nafkin umodiin millin kedivin livne nasha veitchazzeyan lon bediyyuknin acharanin vechayechan behu ad deoshdin zara veikrun marehon dekeri begin deinun denafkin mippitcha dekeri garme lon
Uvshaata demitakkele emurin ufdarin hahu tenana have rave lon vezan lon kefum yekara dilhon hachi mezona dilhon ma deitchaze lon uvhay la nafkan vela meshattete beara kaddisha

Erev kema deatte amer vegam erev rav ala ittam dechal inun chavile tehirin inun mitarve beshultanu delelya veal da la shaveuha chova litzlota dearvit delet man deyachil leatkena lah keyaakov deihu hava mari mashkena umtakken leh kedeka yeot

Veaf al gav deihu reshu tzelota da ihu leaggana alan miggo pachad ballelot miggo pachad dechamma sitrin degehinnam deha behahi shaata tarde lechayyavayya baggehinnam al chad teren mibbimama ubbegin kach mekaddeme yisrael lememar vehu rachum deihu begin pachad degehinnam uvshabbat dela ishtechach pachad dina degehinnam vela dina achara asir leatara leh deitchaze deha let reshu leshabbat leabera dina mealma

Vefachad dekitruga denishmatin kad baan lesalleka leela leitchazzaa kame marehon ubbegin kach anan makdimim shomer et ammo yisrael laad amen pachad dechamma mazzikin vekitrugin demishtakkeche belelya veit lon reshu lenazzeka leman denafik mittera beteh levar ubbegin kach anan makdimim ushmor tzetenu uvoenu

Befalgu lelya kad ruach tzafon ittear batash bechal inun madorin deruchin bishin vetavar sitra achara veal veshat leela vetatta vechal inun
758: Chavile tehirin ayelin leduchtayehu veittebbar chelayehu vela shaltin uchden kudsha berich hu al leishtashea im tzaddikayya beginta deeden veha ittemar

Kad ate tzafra nehora dishraga deshalta belelya itgeniz mikkame nehora dimama keden boker shalta veitabbar shultanu deerev hay boker ihu boker deor kadmaa hay boker ashlim tivu lealmin kullehu minneh ittezanu illain vetattain hay ashke leginta hay ihu netiru dechal alma

Hacha raza leyade middin man devae lemefak learcha yekum benagha veyishgach beistakkeluta lefum shaata listar mizrach veyecheme kechezu deatvan devatshe birkia da salik veda nachit veillen inun netzitzu deatvan deitberun behu shemayya veara

I ihu yada beraza deinun atvan deinun raza dishma kaddisha dearbein utren atvan veyidkar lon kadka chazi biruta delibba yechome go nehiru denagha dirkia shit yodin telat listar yemina utlat listar semala utlat vavin desallekin venachtin venatztze birkia veinun atvan devirkat kohanim uchden yitzle tzeloteh veyippuk learcha vadday shechinta akdimat immeh zakkaa chulakeh

Patach chad veamar halluyah hallu avde Adonai hallu et shem Adonai patach tinyana veamar yehi shem Adonai mevorach meatta vead olam patach telitaa veamar mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo mehullal shem Adonai keden karoza kadim vekare itatadu kaddishe elonin inun dimshabbechan lemarehon ittakkanu bishvacha dimama keden itparshun yemama min lelya zakkaa chulakeh man dekam betzafra miggo tushbachta deorayeta delae belelya behahu zimna tzelota detzafra

Ketiv amar shomer ata voker vegam layela im tivaun beau shuvu etau hay kera ukmuha leh al galut deyisrael deyatve go bene seir veyisrael amre lekudsha berich hu shomer ma millayela ma tehe alan min galuta da dedamme lachashocha delelya ma ketiv amar shomer da kudsha berich hu ata voker kevar nehirna lechu begaluta demitzrayim veassikna lechu vekarivit yatchon lefulchani veorayeta yahavit lechon begin detizkun lechayye alma shevaktun orayeti vegam layela ailna lechu begaluta kemillekaddemin im tivaun beau kema deatte amer dirshu meal sefer Adonai ukrau vetamman tishkechun bema talya galuta dilchon ugula dilchon vechad tivaun bah hi tema vetachriz kamayechu shuvu etau shuvu bitshuva shelemata umiyyad etau veikrivu legabbay

Uvhay kera ketiv massa duma veraza da beshit dargin dinvua ittemar linvie bemachaze bachazon bechizzaon bechazut bedavar bemash vechullehu chamishsha kullehu keman dechame batar kotala hahu nehiru dinhora uminnehon keman dechame nehora deshimsha miggo ashashita aval massa have kad mate hahu nehora betorach saggi veitrach milloy aloy dela yachil leitgalya leh kema deatte amer lasum et massa kal haam hazze alay ubbegin kach massa

Vehacha massa duma torach saggia dela yachil leitgalya veihu nevua bilchishu vekayema bilchishu elay kore misseir hacha la itgalya man amar elay kore misseir i kudsha berich hu i nevia mehemana aval nevua da vadday kayema bilchishu go raza dimhemnuta illaa umiggo raza setimaa nevia mehemana amar dilleh hava kara kala beraza dimhemnuta veamar elay kore misseir
759: Kema deatte amer vezarach misseir lamo vela ketiv vezarach leseir begin deraza dimhemnuta hachi ihu dargin miggo dargin illen penimain meillen kelifa go kelifa umocha go mocha

Veha okimna dichtiv vehinne ruach seara baa min hatztzafon ha darga chad anan gadol ha darga achara veesh mitlakkachat ha darga telitaa venogah lo saviv ha darga reviaa ulvatar umittochah keen hachashmal ulvatar umittochah demut arba chayyot ha dargin go middargin

Keden amma kaddisha baan leitchabbera ulaala beve kenishta vechal man deakdim bekadmita itchabbar bishchinta bechibbura chada ta chazi hahu kadmaa deishtechach beve kenishta zakkaa chulakeh deihu kayema bedarga detzaddik bahade shechinta veda ihu raza umshacharay yimtzaunni da salik bisliku illaa vei tema ha tanenan beshaata dekudsha berich hu ate leve kenishta vela ashkach tamman asra miyyad koes veatte amarte hahu chad deakdim itchabbar bishchinta vekayema bedarga detzaddik

760: Uven kach atu kal amma veitpayas malka immehon veshadar lon lishlam aval i inun bene mata la atyan vechad la akdim leishtae kame malka leitchazaa beginayehu deha kullehu atyan miyyad kais veragiz malka

Uf hacha kevan dechad akdim veishtechach beve kenishta ushchinta atya veashkach leh keden itchashiv keillu kullehu ishtechachu tamman deha da orich lon tamman miyad itchabbarat immeh shechinta veyatve beziuuga chad veishtemoda bahadeh veotiv leh bedarga detzaddik vei chad la akdim vela ishtechach tamman ma ketiv maddua bati veen ish veen asara la ketiv ella veen ish leitchabbera bahaday lemeheve gabbay kema deatte amer ish haelohim lemeheve bedarga detzaddik

Velo od ella deishtemoda bahadeh veshail aloy i yoma chad la ate kema deokimna dichtiv mi vachem yere Adonai shomea bekol avdo veha ittearna behay dichtiv elay kore misseir deha darga batar darga darga go darga hahu shomer kore bechela bechal yoma veoma veda ihu shomea bekol avdo avdo da metatron uvgin kach zakkaa ihu man deakdim leve kenishta lesalleka behahu darga illaa dekamran

Kad ate tzafra vetzibbura ishtechachu beve kenishta bau leishtakkecha beshirin vetushbechan dedavid veha okimna desiddura ihu leitara rechimu leela vetatta leatkena tikkunin ulitara chedva deha begin da levae mitare leitara rechimu vechedva leela beinun shirin vetushbechan

Uman demishtae beve kenishta bemillin dechol vay leh deachaze piruda vay let degara mehemnuta vay leh delet leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael deachaze deha let elaha vela ishtechach tamman vela dachil minneh veanhig kelana betikkuna illaa dilela

Deha beshaata deyisrael mesaddere beve kenishta siddura deshirin vetushbechan vesiddura ditzlota keden mitkanneshe telat mashreyan demalache illae mashiryata chada inun malachin kaddishin deka meshabbechan lekudsha berich hu bimama begin deit acharanin deka meshabbechan lekudsha berich hu belelya veacharanin inun deka meshabbechan lekudsha berich hu veamrin shirin vetushbechan bahadayehu deyisrael bimama

Mashiryata tinyana inun malachin kaddishin demishtakkeche bechal kedusha ukdusha deyisrael mekaddeshe letatta uvshultana dilhon kal inun demitarin bechal inun rekiin behahi tzelota deyisrael mashiryata telitaa inun ulemtan illain deka mittakkene im matronita umtakkene lah leaala lah kame malka veillen inun mashreyan ilain al kullehu

Vechullehu mittakkene besiddura deyisrael demitattekene letatta beinun shirin vetushbechan uvhahi tzelota deka metzalu yisrael kevan deillen telat mashreyan mizdammenan keden yisrael patche shirata vezamre kame marehon vehahi mashshiryata chada di memana leshabbecha lemarehon bimama izdammenan alayehu vezamre immehon kachada beinun shevache dedavid malka veha ukimna mille

Behahu zimna dimsayeme yisrael shevache deinun tushbechan dedavid keden tushbachta deshirata deyamma kema deokimna vei tema hay tushbachta amay ihi betikkuna batrayeta batar shevache dedavid veha tora shebbichtav akdimat letora shebbeal pe veakdimat lanneviim veakdimat lakketuvim uchma deakdimat hachi itzterich leakdema

Bah shaata kad shirata deyamma ittemar mitattera keneset yisrael behahu kitra dezammin kudsha berich hu leatera lemalka meshicha vehahu kitra gelifa mechukkaka bishmahan kaddishin kema deitattar kudsha berich hu hahu yoma deabaru yisrael yat yamma veatba lechal mashreyan defaro ufarashohi begin da bae bar nash leshavaa reuteh behay shirata vechal man dezache lah behay alma zache lemecheme lemalka meshicha betikkune hahu kitra uvachagiru dezayeneh vezakke leshabbecha hay shirata tamman veha ukimna mille

Kevan demate bar nash leyishtabbach natil kudsha berich hu hahu kitra veshave leh kameh ukkeneset yisrael sheriat leittakna lemete kame malka illaa veitzterich leachlala lah betelesar mechilan derachame illae deminnehon itbarchat veinun telesar busmin illain kema deatte amer nerde vecharkom kane vekinnamon vego vehacha inun shir ushvacha hallel vezimra oz umemshala netzach gedula uggevura tehilla vetiferet kedusha ha teresar ulvatar lechabbera lah bahadayehu velomar umalchut vahau telesar begin deihi mitbarcha minnayehu
