Patach veamar veyikchu li teruma kema deittemar bemay ihi teruma beraza dezahav deha mittamman ittezenat bekadmita begin deihi gevura tattaa deatya missitra dezahav veaf al gav deatya missitra dezahav kal ikar la ishtearat ella besitra dechesef deihu yemina

Veraza da kos shel beracha deitzterich lekabbela leh bimina uvismala vechal ikkar la ishtear ella bimina usmala ittear yemina vela itdevak beh begin deihu ityehiv ben yemina usmala usmala itachid techoteh vimina itachid beh leela kema deatte amer semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni zahav vachesef kema deatte amer li hakkesef veli hazzahav veha ittemar

Unchoshet da ihu gon kegavena dezahav begin deitztebbea miggaven zahav umiggaven dechesef veal da mizbach hannechoshet katan amay ihu katan kema deatte amer ki hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai katon mehachil et haola vego kema deatte amer vedavid hu hakkatan veaf al gav deihu katan kolla itachid begaveh vei tema mizbeach achara ikre katan lav hachi delav katan bar hay dichtiv et hammaor haggadol lememshelet hayyom veet hammaor hakkatan lememshelet hallayela veda ihu hammaor hakkatan hammaor haggadol da mizbeach happenimi deihu mizbach hazzahav
775: Da ihu techelet detzitzit techelet da ihu kurseya raza ditfilla deyad techelet da ihu kurseya dedayenin beh dini nefashot begin deit kurseya dedayenin beh dini mamonot veit kurseya dedayenin beh dine nefashot veal da kal gavenin tavin lechelma bar gon tichla begin deyinda deha nishmateh salka bedina vechad nishmeta salka bedina gufa ittedan leishtetzaa veitzterich hahu chelma lerachamin saggiin

Techelet da ihu kurseya dichtiv beh kemare even sappir demut kisse uchtiv venogah lo saviv begin deavdin beh kerichin letzitzit vechad nogah lo ithaddar legaven yarok kegaven karti mehahi shaata veelech ishtere zimna dikriat shema deha ishtani gon tichla mikkema dehava uvgin kach asir lemedan dine nefashot ballayela begin deshalta hahu gon tichla behahu zimna veityehiv reshu lemechotaf nafsha belo mishpat deha mishpat la shalta behahu zimna

Kad ate tzafra veittear yemina dilela nafik hahu nehora umate ad hay tichla veishtane mikkema dehava uchden shalta aleh veitdabbak beh kurseya achara kaddisha mehahi shaata veelech zimna dikriat shema

Veargaman da kenufya dichalila kal gevanin kachada vetolaat shani ketiv shani uchtiv shanim dichtiv ki chal beta lavush shanim ella hay ihu gon ikre shani denatil kal gavenin beh vecholla ihu chad shani veshanim shanim kad kullehu kelilan beh kachada shani denafik mikkurseya illaa deshalleta al techelet missitra dimina veda ihu appotropposa deyisrael dichtiv beh michael sarechem tolaat decheleh befumeh kattolaat dimtabbar kolla veoker kolla
Tolaat shani vashesh teren gavenin kachada dimina usmala chivar vesumak vashesh butza ihu deshit chutin mitchabberan veda ihu dichtiv ugviyyato chetarshish uvillen teren kelilan teren acharanin

Veizzim gevuran tattae dilvar lechafya al penimae vecholla itzterich veitzterich lemehav duchta lecholla deha missitra dedahava kaatyan veorot elim meaddamim meshichu ditren sitrin dimina usmala lechafya beduchta achara
Veorot techashim sitra chada it derabbe go sitra achara bechurba vela beyishshuva ishtechach veda ihu sitra dachu veikre tachash

Besifra deshelomo malka it go hay mizbach hannechoshet dekamran razin illain deha mizbach adama ketiv mizbach adama taase li vego veda ihu raza kedeka yeot nechoshet kad shaltin turin acharanin veihi tzericha lemezan lon itztebba behay gon lemezan lon veinun ikrun hare nechoshet

Veinun hare nechoshet itmeshach alayehu rucha chada miggo hay mizbeach vechad hay mizbeach istallak bisliku achara keden istallak at deihu mizbeach kaddisha veishtear rucha deillen ture nechoshet vechad hahu rucha istelik bekiyyumeh ikre tachash deha istallak minneh at
Vehay itperash lechamma ruchin acharanin veikrun uf hachi veal da ikre hahu amma tachash kema deatte amer veet tachash veet maacha inun hao yade beha chayya demashkena deikre al shemehon
Vaatze shittim illen inun razin kaddishin deinun luche mashkena veinun ikrun beraza dilhon ketiv atze shittim omdim uchtiv serafim omdim

Mikkan ulhala shemen lammaor meshichu dimshach revut kaddisha leamshacha alayehu avne shoham veavni milluim illen avne kudsha yesode demakdesha birtichin kaddishin illen izdammenan bilchodayehu leyakker ulshabbecha bilvush yekar leayena kahana behu tamman uladkera teresar shevatin veal da teresar avanin kema deittemar
Telesar zinin inun bar avnin yakkirin illen vechullehu sallekin lech atvan
776: Beraza illaa deyichuda velakovel illen galif veatkin moshe atvan beraza difsuka deyichuda dichtiv shema yisrael yedod elohenu yedod echad veinun atvan gelifan mechakkekan beraza dilela

Yaakov baa leatkena letatta beraza deyichuda veatkin bechd atvan veinun baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed vela ashlim lech atvan begin dead la ittakkan mashkena kevan deittakkan mashkena veishtelim milla kadmaa dehava nafik minne kad ishtelim la mallil ella bech atvan leachazaa deha ishtelim da kegavena dilela dichtiv vayedabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor ha atvan

Veal da zinin leashlema tikkuna demikdasha vechal hane atvan okimna beinun atvan gelifan deolifna mimmar uvgin demashkena ishtelim berazin illen ikre beyichuda dishlimu demashkena veal da vachasidecha yevarchucha ketiv raza dishlimu dechal mashkena vetikkuna dileh lakovel atvan veorayeta unviim uchtuvim deinun kelala chada veraza chada

Beshaata deyisrael ka meyachde yichuda behay kera beraza dech atvan deinun shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad ubbaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed deinun atvan vichaven kal chad behu kullehu atvan mitchabberan kachada vesallekin bechibbura chad tarin beraza deovla uchden itzterich lesalleka ad vela yattir uchden itpattachu tarin vechashiv kudsha berich hu lehahu bar nash keilu kiyyem orayeta kulah deihi atya bemt panim

Veal da itzterich lechavvena libba uruta bech uvchd ulsalleka lon biruta delibba lemt tarin dekamran kevan deitkavan behay yitkavan behahu yichuda deamar mar shema yisrael ubbaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed kelala dechal orayeta kullah zakkaa chulakeh man deyitkavan behu devadday kelala ihu dechal orayeta deela vetatta veda ihu raza deadam shelema didchar venukba veraza dechal mehemnuta

Machaloket deshammay vehillel bekima uvishchiva dichtiv veshachbecha uvkumecha deshammay savar baerev deka kelila nukba beshultanaha itzterich legabbe nukba deka yattu veyikreu uvabboker deka shalta dechura beshultanuta dealma illaa itzterich lemekam kameh didchura kema deitzterich bitfilla meumad uvchal atar didchura atya

Uvet hillel savar ilmale ishtechach da lechod veda lechod hachi itzterich aval kevan daanan mechabberan lon kachada bechibbura bemt panim umt tarin la itzterichna leafresha da lechod veda lechod ella leashgecha decholla ihu chad bela piruda uchma deizdamman leh levar nash hachi yema deha tarvayehu bechibbura chada kema denayecha lon vehachi itzterich leitchazaa

Veal da dechura beshit sitrin bakkera dishma yisrael deinun shit tevin venukba beshit sitrin baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed deinun shit tevin acharanin vesallekin bechibbura chada beraza demt tarin vahalacha kevet hillel bechal atar

Rabbi shimon arim yedoy uvarich lerabbi elazar bereh patach veamar mi heir mimmizrach vego hay kera okimna veittemar aval raza dechachmeta ihu mi raza dealma illaa ihu deha mittamman nafka sheruta leitgalya raza dimhemnuta veha okimna

Tu mi temira dechal temirin dela ityeda vela itgalleya kelal galle yekareh leishtemoda mehahu atar deikre mizrach deha mittamman sheruta dechal raza dimhemnuta unhora leitgalya ulvatar tzedek yikraehu leraglo deha tzedek galle gevurta illaa veshultanih dekudsha berich hu ulhay tzedek ashlete al almin kullehu ledabbera lon ulatkena lon kadka yeot veal da yitten lefanav goyim umlachim yarde
777: Deha kal malchin dealma birshuta dehay tzedek kayemin kema deatte amer vehu yishpot tevel betzedek

Tu tzedek yikraehu leraglo man kare leman ella tzedek ihu kare tadir leaspaklarya denahara vela shachich lealmin vetzedek kaim tadir leragloy dela itade mittamman vekare vela shachich hada hu dichtiv elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el vehashta kudsha berich hu anhar lan archa da beginan elazar beri dekare linhora illaa vela shachich zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya bealma den uvalma deate

Ribbi abba patach kera veamar mizmor ledavid bihoto bemidbar yehuda may shena mikkal shear tushbechan dela kaamar bean atar shabbach lon david malka umay shena hacha dekaamar bihoto bemidbar yehuda ella la da bilchodoy deha uf hachi namme beshannoto et tamo lifni avimelech bevo hazzifim vechen kullehu leachazaa lechal bene alma shevacheh dedavid deaf al gav divtzaara hava vahau radfe avatreh hava mishtaddal lomar shirin vetushbechan lekudsha berich hu

Veaf al gav divruach kudsha hava amar ruach kudsha la have share aloy ad deihu ishtaddal lemishre aloy vechen bechal atar la sharya ruach kudsha dilela ad deyittear aleh bar nash mitatta vedavid af al gav deka radfe avatreh vahava betzaareh la hava shavik shirin vetushbechan mippumeh ulshabbecha lemareh al kolla
Vei tema ha detanenan mizmor ledavid o ledavid mizmor vehacha sharat aleh ruach kudsha bekadmita begin deamar mizmor ledavid ella i ihu la hava mechaven garmeh bekadmita la sharat aleh ruach kudsha

Mizmor da ruach kudsha amay ikre hachi begin deihi meshabbachat tadir lemalka illaa dechal zimna hava ka meshabbechat umzammerat vela shachich kevan deata david ashkach gufa mettatkena kadka yeot vesharat aleh vahau megalle behay alma leshabbecha ulzammera lemalka vecholla begin deyittekan hay alma kegavena dilela

Ledavid gevar shelim betikkunoy gevar metakkana gevar zakkaa david vadday dela ishtane lealmin bihoto bemidbar yehuda da shevacha dedavid af al gav divtzaareh hava af al gav dahao radfe avatreh umay tushbachta kaamar tushbachta deihu rav veyakkira

Ushvacha dileh may ihi elohim eli atta ashacharekka elohim setam kevan deamar elohim amay eli ella hahu darga dileh telat dargin hacha elohim eli atta veaf al gav deinun telat shemahan chad darga ihu beraza deelohim chayyim elohim leela elohim chayyim eli ketze hashshamayim ad ketze hashshamayim atta darga dileh veaf al gav decholla chad uvishma chad salik

Ashacharekka i kemashmao dileh shappir aval ashacharekka atkin nehora denahir beshachruta deha nehora dekayema beshachruta la nahir ad deyittaknun leh letatta uman deatkin nehora shachara da af al gav deihi uchama zache linhora chivara denahir veda ihi nehora aspakalarya denahara veda ihu bar nash dezache lealma deate

Veraza da umshacharay yimtzaunni umshacharay dimtakkenin nehora meshacharay uchama yimtzaunni yimtzauni la ketiv ella yimtzaunni dezache litren nehorin linhora deshachara uchama velinhora chivara denahara vezache leaspakalarya dela nahir ulaspakalarya denahir veda ihu yimtzaunni veal da amar david ashacharekka atkin nehora deshachara uchama lenahara aleh nehora chivara denahara
Tzama lecha nafshi kamah lecha vesari keman dechafin lemechal vetzache lemishte beeretz tziyya veayef beli mayim begin deihu midbar velav ihu atar deyishshuva velav ihu atar dekudsha
778: Uvgin kach ihu atar beli mayim uchma deanan kafin vetzachan legabbach baatar da ken bakkodesh chaziticha vego vaanan kema deanan tzachan legabbe demar lemishte betzachuta milloy baatar da uf hachi tzachenan lemishte betzachuta milloy beve makdesha atar deikre kodesh amar rabbi shimon lera abba man deshari milla hashta yema

Patach ribbi abba veamar veyikchu li teruma meet kal ish vego moshe beshaata dekudsha berich hu achme leh ovada demashkena hava kashe kameh vela yachil lemekam beh veha ukmuha vehashshetta it lan lemikshe hacha i teruma da yahavah kudsha berich hu lemoshe bilchodoy hech yahavah leachara veamar delivne yisrael yikchu hay teruma

Ella vadday lemoshe yahavah vela yahavah leachara lemalka dehava bego ammeh vela havat matronita immeh demalka kal zimna dematronita la havat immeh demalka la mityaashe amma beh veinun la yatvin lerachatzan kevan deatat matronita kal amma chadan veyatve beruchtzanu kach bekadmita af al gav dekudsha berich hu avad lon nissin veatin al yede demoshe la mityaashe amma kevan deamar kudsha berich hu veyikchu li teruma venatatti mishkani betochchem miyyad ityaashu kullehu vechaddu befulchana dekudsha berich hu hada hu dichtiv vayehi beom kallot moshe denachtat kallat moshe leara

Vei tema vayehi bechal atar lav ihu ella lishana detzaara vehacha ketiv vayehi beom ella behahu yoma dishchinta nachtat leara ishtechach mekatrega legabbah vechafya hahu chashuch keval legabbah begin dela techot vetanenan elef vachamesh mea ribbo malachin mekatregin ishtechachu legabbah begin dela techot

Uvhahu zimna ishtechachu kal kenufya demalache illae kame kudsha berich hu amru kammeh mare dealma kal ziva vechal nehora dilan bishchinat yekarach ihu vehashta techot legabbe tattae behahi shaata ittatkefat shechinta vetavrat hahu chashuch keval keman demittebbar gezzizin takkifin venachtat leara kevan dechamu kullehu kach patchu veamru Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechal haaretz addir vadday detavrat kama gezzizin vechelin takkifin venachtat leara ushlitat becholla veal da ketiv vayehi tzaara dekabbilu kama chayyalin umashshiryan beoma dechallat moshe nachtat leara

Uvgin kach veyikchu li teruma vego veyikchu li utruma la ketiv ella veyikchu li teruma leachazaa decholla chad bela piruda veovada demashkena kegavena dilela da lakovel da leitkallela shechinta mikkal sitrin ela vetatta hacha behay alma ovada dileh keovada degufa leitkallela rucha begaveh veda ihi shechinta deitkelilat leela vetatta veihi ruach kudsha

Ulolam itmashshechat vealat go raza degufa leashraa mocha go kelifa kolla kema deitchaze hay rucha dekudsha itavid begufa leitkallela begavih ruach achara illaa dakik venahir vecholla hachi itachid veitkelil da beda veal da beda ad deitachid behay alma deihu kelifa batraa dilvar

Kelifa takkifa ihi lego miklifa dehay alma kegavena deegoza dehay kelifa dilvar lav ihi takkifa kelifa deihi lego minah ihi kelifa takkifa uf hachi leela kelifa takkifa ihi rucha achara deshalta begufa lego minneh ihi kelifa kelisha lego minneh mocha
Beara kaddisha metatkena kolla begavena achara deha kelifa takkifa ittabberat mehahu atar vela shalta beh kelal kelifa takkifa ittabberat tevir veitpatchat mehay sitra umehay sitra
Vehahi petichu hava beara kaddisha bechal zimna defalchin pulchana
779: Kedeka yeot kevan degarmu chovin meshichu hahu petichu lehay sitra ulhay sitra ad deitkarav kelifa kolla kachada kevan deastim kelifa lemocha keden shalta hahi kelifa alayehu vedacha lon levar mehahu duchta

Veim kal da af al gav deddacha lon levar la yachil hahi kelifa takkifa leshalletaa behahu duchta kaddisha delav atreh ihu vei tema i hachi hoil vela yachil hahi kelifa takkifa leshalletaa behahu duchta kaddisha amay kayema charuv deha charba la have bealma ella missitra dehahi kelifa takkifa

Ella vadday kad itcharav la itcharav ella mehahu sitra beshaata deastim lemocha vekudsha berich hu aved dela tishlot hahi kelifa takkifa al hahu duchta vechad dacha lon leyisrael minneh hahi kelifa ithadderat veitpatchat kemillekaddemin uvgin deamma kaddisha la hao tamman chafya al hahu petichu chuppaa kaddisha defarochta kelisha lenatra hahu atar dela yistom leh hahi kelifa takkifa veachid bechal sitroy

Lemeheve revut kudsha al ara kemilkaddemin la yachil deha hahu chuppaa kelisha achid dela yechut letatta deha amma kaddisha lav tamman veal da la itbene charban miyyoma deitcharivu leshalletaa hahi kelifa takkifa la yachla deha hahu chuppaa kelisha achid beh bechal sitroy behahu petichu dela tishlot tamman vela tastim mocha behahu chuppaa defarochta kelisha deihu miggo meshichu defarochta kaddisha dilela denatir hahu atar

Uvgin kach kal inun nishmatin dishar ammin dedayerin beara kad nafkin mehay alma la mekabbela lon vedache lon levar veazlin veshatan umitgalgelin bechamma gilgulin ad denafke mikkal ara kaddisha vesacharan lesitrayehu bimsaavu dilhon vechal inun nishmatin deyisrael denafkin tamman sallekin vehahu chuppaa kelisha mekabbela lon vealin likdushsha illaa begin dechal zina azla lezineh

Venishmatehon deyisrael denafke levar meara birshuta dehahi kelifa takkifa azla vesachara umitgalgela ad detavat ledduchtaha vealat laatar deitchaze lah zakkaa chulakeh man denishmateh nafka birshu kaddisha behahu petichu deara kaddisha

Man denishmateh nafkat beara kaddisha i itkebbar behahu yoma la shalta aleh rucha mesaava kelal veal da ketiv bitzliva ki kavor tikberennu baom hahu velo tetamme et admatcha begin divlelya ityehiv reshu leruach mesaava limshatteta veaf al gav deityehiv lon reshu la alin beara kaddisha bar i ashkechan tamman mana leaala beh

Evarin ufdarin demitakkelan belelya leattezena zinin acharanin lav deayelin beara vela leamshacha lon beara ella begin dela tishlot sitra achara go ara vela yitmashcha leaala tamman uvgin kach tenana minnayehu hava salik akima umitgalgela levar veazil bivhilu ad deal lenukba detzafon detamman madorin dechal sitrin acharanin vetamman al tenana vechullehu ittezanu tamman
Tenana dimama hava salik leduchteh beorach meshar veittezan ma deittezan umehahu petichu ittezanu kal sitre kelifa takkifa deihi levar meara kaddisha umehahi tenana gassa kema deokimna

Gufehon detzaddikayya dela itmeshachu behay alma batar hanain dehahi kelifa takkifa la shalta alayehu ruach mesaavu kelal deha la ishtatfu avatreh kelum behay alma kema degufa derashiayya itmeshach behay alma batar hahi kelifa takkifa vahanain veinnugin dileh vetikunin dileh hachi isteav batar denafkat nishmateh minneh
780: Alma ella mittaanuge demitzva usudate shabbatin vechaggin uzmanin hahu ruach mesaava la yachil leshaltaa alayehu deha la itannegu midileh kelum vehoil vela natlu midileh let leh reshu alehon kelal zakkaa ihu man dela ithane midileh kelum

Man denishmateh nafka levar meara kaddisha vehahu gufa isteav behahu ruach mesaavu hahu ruach mesaavu ishteiv begavih ad detav leh afra vei hahu gufa deishteiv beh hahu ruach mesaava sallekin leh leitkabbera go ara kaddisha aleh ketiv vattavou vattetammeu et artzi venachalati samtem letoeva artzi dela shalta alah ruach mesaavu behahu gufa dilchon deishteiv beh ruach mesaavu deka mayetin lekavra leh beartzi attun mesaavin lah leistaava beh i la deavid kudsha berich hu asvata leara deha kevan deitbale hahu gufa nashiv kudsha berich hu rucha milleela vedache leh lehahu ruach mesaava levar deha ihu chas al areh

Yosef la shallit al gufeh ruach mesaava lealmin af al gav denishmateh nafkat birshu achara may tama begin dela itmeshich bechayyoy batar ruach mesaava veim kal da la baa degufeh yesallekun leh leitkabbera beara kaddisha ella amar vehaalitem et atzmotay vela gufi

Yaakov la mit vegufeh itkayyam bekiyyuma tadir vela dachil lesitra achara deha arseh hava shelim bishlimu dinhora illaa binhiru ditresar shevatin uvshivim nefesh begin kach la dachil lesitra achara vela yachil leshalletaa aleh vetu deihu gufa dediyyukna illaa dishpiru dileh achid lechal sitrin vechal inun shayefin deadam kadmaa hao achidan beh veal da ketiv beh veshachavti im avotay unsatani mimmitzrayim gufa shelim veal da vayyachantu harofim et yisrael degufeh yehe kaim bekiyyuma vehachi itzterich shear bene alma denafkat nishmatayehu beara kaddisha nafsha vegufa ishtezziv mikkolla

Telat shemahan ikre nishmeta devar nash nefesh rucha venishmata vechullehu kelilan da beda uvitlat duchte ishtechach chelayehu nefesh da ishtechachat go kivra ad degufa itbele beafra uvda mitgalgelat hay alma leishtakkecha go chayyaya ulminda betzaara dilhon uvshaata di itzterichu baat rachame alayehu

Rucha da ihu deal begginta di beara veitztayar tamman bediyyukna degufa dehay alma bechad malbusha demitlabbesha tamman veda ithane tamman bahanain vechissufin beziva divginta uvshabbate veyarche uzmane salleka leela veithane tamman vetav leatreh veal da ketiv veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah tashuv vadday behane zimnin dekamran

Neshama ihi salleka miyyad leatraha lehahu atar denafkat mittamman veda ihi divginah itnehirat butzina leanhara leela da la nachtat letatta lealmin beda itkelilat man deitkelilat mikkal sitrin meela umittatta vead dehay la salleka leitkashshera bechurseyya la mitattera ruach begginta di beara venefesh la mityashsheva beduchtaha kevan deihi salleka kullehu it lehu nayecha

Vechad itzterich livne alma kad inun betzaara veazle leve kivre hay nefesh ittearat veihi azla umshatteta veittearat leruach vehahu ruach ittear legabbe avahan vesalik veittear legabbe neshama uchden kudsha berich hu chayyis al alma veha okimna veaf al gav deha ittearu millin illen denishmeta bigvanin acharanin kullehu sallekin bematkela da veda ihu berira demilla vecholla chad
Vechad nishmeta itakkevat milsalleka leduchtaha rucha azla vekayema befitcha degginta deeden vela patchin lah pitcha

Keruvim inun zahav kema deukmuha begin denafke missitra dezahav vela itarav behu kesef vela gon achara veda ihu gon zahav yerakrak bamishkan mitarvin gevanin zahav vachesef lemehach kachada lemeheve raza dilela bechad tu nechoshet lemehve bahadayehu ulmezal benayehu kal sitrin leishtachcha shelimu becholla kachada dichtiv zahav vachesef unchoshet

Davar acher zahav vachesef zahav deithadar lechesef vechesef lezahav vecholla itkelil kachada uvduchta chada bitlat gavenin ithaddar kad itzterich lecheddevata vela dina zahav kad itzterich lerachame chesef kad itzterich tukpa dedina nechoshet

Veal da istakkal moshe beovada dinchash hannechoshet dichtiv vayyaas moshe nechash nechoshet vahava yada atar dehitucha dezahav behahu nechoshet begin denachash kelishana dileh hu veatreh hava yada deha kudsha berich hu la amar leh ella ase lecha saraf veihu ata vaavad nechash nechoshet dechettiv vayyaas moshe nechash nechoshet may taama

Ella atar hava yada veikara demilta hava deha bekadmita ketiv vayeshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hassorafim uchtiv nachash saraf ikkara dilhon nachash ihu uvgin demoshe hava yada ikkara vesharasha visoda mehahu atar avad nachash veistemich aleh may tama begin deyisrael chatu belishanehon dechettiv vayedabber haam belohim uvmoshe veal da vayeshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hasserafim

Umoshe la azal ella batar ikkara vaavad nechash nechoshet behahu gavena deitzterich leh deha atreh nechoshet ihu vekudsha berich hu la amar leh mimma yitavid umoshe istakkal vaavad leh minchoshet kema deitzterich leatreh menalan dichtiv vayyaas moshe nechash nechoshet vayesimehu al hannes may al hannes al hahu reshimu deihu leela

Veha tanenan bechal atar hay nachash azla batar raza deeshet chayil uvaya eshet zenunim leittakna garmah kegavena dilah vela yachilat eshet chayil hahu reshimu veat dilah ihu at Adonai vehachi itchaze lah eshet zenunim hahu reshima veat dilah ihu kehahu gavena vela ittakkan lemeheve hachi veat dilah at dilah ittakna betikkuna deat Adonai Adonai kegavena dekofa etzel bene nasha deazla batar bene nasha vela ittakkan lemebad hachi kegavena da avad moshe hahu nachash al hahu reshimu deitchaze leh vetadir ittakkan leavasha vealeh chav adam veittarach migginta deeden dehava atar dioreh kegavena dediura dilela

Ketiv vayyomer elohim yehi or vayehi or amar rabbi yosi hahu or itgeniz veihu izdaman legabbe tzadikayya lealma deate kema deukmuha dichtiv or zarua latztzadik latztzadik vaday setam vehahu or la shimesh bealma bar yoma kadmaa ulvatar itgeniz vela shimmesh yatir
Rabbi yehuda omer ilmale itgeniz mikkol
795: Vachol la kaim alma afilu riga chada ella itgeniz veizdera kehay zara deavid toladin uzrain veevin uminneh itkayyam alma velet lach yoma dela nafik minneh bealma umkayem kolla deveh zan kudsha berich hu alma uvchal atar delaan beorayeta belelya chad chuta nafik mehahu or ganiz veitmeshich al inun delaan bah hada hu dichtiv yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo uvallayela shiro immi veha okimna

Yoma deitkam mashkena letatta ma ketiv vela yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed ki shachan alav heanan may heanan chad chuta hava mehahu sitra deor kadmaa denafak bechedva becholla alat lemashkena diltatta umehahu yoma la itgele aval shimmusha ka meshammesh bealma veihu mechaddesh bechal yoma ovada divreshit

Rabbi yosi hava lae beorayeta vahau immeh rabbi yitzchak veribbi chizkiyya amar ribbi yitzchak ha chamenan deovada demashkena kegavena deovada deshamayim vaaretz veha ittearu chavrayya berazin dilhon zeiru dela yachil bar nash lemechal befumeh ulmeshat yedeh lego pumeh ulmivla

Amar ribbi yosi millin illen nesallek lon lego butzina kaddisha deihu metakken tavshilin metikin kema deatkin lon attika kaddisha setima dechal setimin veihu atkin tavshilin delet behu atar lemete achara lemishde behu milcha vetu deyachil bar nash lemechal ulmishte ulashlema kerisoy mikkal idunin dealma ulishtaara uveh yitkayyam veyitten lifnehem vayyochlu vaotiru kidvar Adonai

Patach veamar vayeya natan chachma lishlomo kaasher dibber lo vayehi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo vayichretu verit shenehem hay kera ha ittemar bechamma duchte aval vayeya istakkemuta dilela vetatta kachada vayeya ihu uve dineh natan chachma natan keman deyahiv nevizbeza umattana lirchimeh kaasher dibber lo shelimu dechachmeta beutra uvishlam uvshultanu hada hu dichtiv kaasher dibber lo

Vayehi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo may tama begin dahao yade da leda setimu demillin dahao amre uvne nasha acharanin la hao yade leistakkela ulminda behu kelal uvginayehu ithaddar chiram leodaa lishlomo bechal milloy

Shelomo malka istakkal vahava chame deha afilu behahu dara dehava shelim mikkal darin acharanin la hava reuta demalka illaa deyitgele chachma kal kach al yedeh deitgele orayeta dehava setima bekadmita ufatach lah pitchin veaf al gav defatach setimin inun bar leinun chakkimin dezachu umitgamgeme behu vela yade lemiftach behu puma vedara da derabbi shimon sharya begaveh reuta dekudsha berich hu begineh derabbi shimon deyitgalyan millin setimin al yedoy

Aval tavahna al chakkime dara hech shavkin afilu riga chada lemekam kame derabbi shimon lemile beorayeta beod derabbi shimon kaim bealma aval bedara da la yitneshe chachmeta mealma vay ledara kad yistalak ihu vechakkimin yitmaatun vechachmeta yitneshe mealma

Amar ribbi yitzchak vadday hachi ihu deha yoma chad havena azil immeh bearcha ufatach pumeh beorayeta vachamena ammuda daanana naitz meela letatta vechad zihara zahir go ammuda dachilna dechilu saggi amina zakkaa ihu bar nash dehachi izdaman leh behay alma

Ma ketiv beh bemoshe veraa kal haam et ammud heanan omed petach haohel vekam kal haam vehishtachau ish petach aholo yeot hu lemoshe deihu nevia mehemana illaa al kal nevie alma vedara hahu dekabbilu orayeta al tura desinay vechamu kama nissin vechamma gevuran bemitzrayim veal yamma aval hacha bedara da zechuta illaa derabbi shimon ka avid leitchazaa nissin al yedoy
796: Utchelet amar rabbi yitzchak techelet mehahu nuna deyamma deginosar deihu beadveh dizvulun veitzterich gavena da leovada demashkena leitchazaa hay gon

Patach veamar vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim viyehi mavdil ben mayim lamayim hay rekia itbere bashsheni deovada da missitra dismala ihu uvoma tinyana deihu setar semala itbere beh gehinnam deihu nafik miggo hittucha denura dismala uvyama itzteva bah gon tichla deihu kurseyya dedina

Venatil hay yoma mayim dahao missitra dimina veinun mayim dahao missitra dimina la itgallu ella beom sheni beoma dileh la itgele mayim ella itchallaf begin deitkelil da beda veitbassam da beda or deoma kadmaa nehiru kadmaa mikkal shita nehorin ihu vehay or besitra deeshsha hava dichtiv vehaya or yisrael leesh vehahu or deyisrael missitra dimina hava itkelil beeshsha

Veoma kadmaa meinun shita yomin mayim ihu vela shimmesh ovada demayim ella ovada deor deihu missitra deesh deihu yom sheni leachazaa dekudsha berich hu la bara alma ella al shalom uvorach shalom hava kolla yoma kadmaa kal ma daavad missitra dechavreh aved yoma tinyana besitra deoma kadmaa avad hahu umana veshimmesh bah dechal chad shimmesh beovada dechavreh leachazaa deha itkelilu da beda yoma telitaa hava besitra detarvayehu uveh hava argaman veal da ketiv ki tov ki tov tere zimne beoma telitaa

Techelet da yoma tinyana itzteva bev gavenin sumak veucham utchelet sumak ihu dileh miyyoma tinyana mammash keen gon eshsha veda ihu elohim veyarit gon dedahava decholla gavena chada techelta nafik miggo hahu gon sumak vechad nachit letatta itrechak gon sumak veal go hahu atar deihu yamma veitzteva gon tichla hahu sumaka ayel go yamma veitchallash gon dileh veithaddar tichla veda ihu elohim aval lav ihu takkifa kekadmaa

Ucham gon da nafik mehittucha desumaka kad ithattach veitchallash letatta behittucha dezuhama venachit letatta venafik mehahu zuhama gon sumak mizzohama takkifa umiggo zuhama takkifa ithaddar leucham vecholla mehahu sumaka kadmaa ithattach vechal da itbere bashsheni vehay ikre elohim acherim

Hay ucham ihu chashuch yattir dela itchaze gon dileh miggo chashocha butzina kaddisha hachi amar dehay gon ucham chashuch bean atar itzteva ella kad hahu sumaka ithattach bego tichla veitarvu gavenin ithattach hittucha dezuhama lego tehome veitavid mittamman refesh vatit kema deatte amer vayyigreshu memav refesh vatit umiggo hahu tina dithome nafak hahu chashuch deihu ucham vela ucham ella chashuch yattir hada hu dichtiv vechoshech al peni tehom amay ikre choshech begin degaven dileh chashuch veachshich anpe biryan veda ihu sumak veucham uvgin da la ketiv bashsheni ki tov

Vei tema veha ketiv vehinni tov meod da malach hammavet vehacha amarte dela ittemar beginih ki tov ella raza derazin hacha deha vadday malach hammavet ihu tov meod may tama begin deha kal bene alma yade dimutun veyithadrun leafra vesaggiin inun dimhaddere betiyyuvta lemarehon begin dechilu da vedachale lemechote kammeh saggiin dachale min malka miggo detalya retzua lekamayehu kama tava hahi retzua legabbe bar nash deavdat lon tavin vekashitin umtakkenin bearchayehu kadka yeot veal da vehinne tov meod meod vadday
797: Raza derazin deolifna miggo butzina kaddisha vehinne tov da malach chayyim meod da malach hammavet deihu yattir amay malach hammavet ihu tov meod ella kad bara kudsha berich hu alma kolla hava mittakkan ad la yete adam deihu malka dehay alma kevan deitbere adam avad leh mittakkan beorach keshot hada hu dichtiv asher asa haelohim et haadam yashar vehema vikshu chishshevonot rabbim avad leh yashar ulvatar sarach veitrid migginta deeden

Gan eden ihu beara natia beinun netian denata leh kudsha berich hu kema deatte amer vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem ihu nata leh bishma shelim kegavena illaa leela vechal diuknin illain kullehu merukkeman umittzayeran behay gan eden diltatta vetamman inun keruvim lav inun gelifin biglifoy divne nasha middahava o mimmilla achara ella kullehu nehorin dilela gelifin umittzayerin betziyyura merukkema ovade yede umana dishma shelim dekudsha berich hu vechullehu mechukkekan tamman vechal diuknin vetziyyurin dehay alma kullehu mittzayeran tamman uggelifan umitchakkan tamman kullehu kegavena dehay alma

Vaatar da ihu madora leruchin kaddishin ben inun deatu lehay alma ben inun dela atu lehay alma veinun dizminin lemete lehay alma kullehu ruchin mitlabbeshan bilvushin veggufin ufartzufin kegavena dehay alma umistakkelan tamman beziv yekara demarehon ad deatyan lehay alma

Beshaata denafke mittamman lemete lehay alma mitpashshetin inun ruchin mehahu gufa ulvusha detamman umitlabbeshin begufa uvilvusha dehay alma veavdin diyyurehon behay alma bilvusha vegufa da deihu mittippa serucha

Vechad mate zimneh lemehach ulnafka mehay alma la nafik ad dehay malach hammavet afshit leh levusha degufa da kevan deitpashshat hay gufa mehahu rucha al yede dehahu malach hammavet azla umitlabbesha behahu gufa achara divginta deeden deitpeshit kad ate lehay alma velet chidu lerucha bar behahu gufa detamman vechadde al deitpashshat mehay gufa dehay alma veitlabbash bilvusha achara shelim kegavena dehay alma uveh yativ veazil veistakkal leminda berazin illain ma dela yachil leminda ulistakkela behay alma begufa da

Vechad itlabbeshat nishmeta behahu levusha dehahu alma kama idunin kama kisufin dilah tamman ma garim legufa da leitlabbesha beh rucha have ema hahu deafshit leh levushin illen vekudsha berich hu avid tivu im biryan dela afshit leh levar nash levushin illen ad deatkin leh levushin acharanin yakkirin vetavin meillen

Bar leinun chayyave alma dela ahadru betiyyuvta shelemata lemarehon deartilain atu lehay alma veartilain yetuvun tamman venishmeta azla bechissufa legabbe acharanin delet lah levushin kelal veittedanat behahu gehinnam divara miggo hahu eshsha dilela veit minnehon dimtzaftzefe vesalke veillen inun chayyave alma dechashvi belibbayehu teshuva umitu vela yachilu lemebad lah illen itdanu tamman begehinnam ulvatar metzaftzefe vesallekin

Chame kama rachamanuta dekudsha berich hu im birohi deafilu deihu chayyava yattir vehirher teshuva vela yachil lemebad teshuva umit hay bevadday mekabbel onsha ad deazil bela teshuva levatar hahu reuta deshave lemebad teshuva la adiat mikkamme malka illaa vekudsha berich hu atkin lehahu chayyava duchta bemadora dishol vetamman metzaftzefa teshuva deha hahu reuta nachit mikkamme kudsha berich hu vetavar kal gezzizin detare madore gehinnam umate lehahu atar dehahu chayyava tamman uvatash beh veittear leh hahu reuta kemillekaddemin uchden metzaftzefa
798: Hahi nishmeta lesalleka miggo madora dishol

Velet reuta tava deyitavid mikkamme malka kaddisha uvgin kach zakkaa ihu man dimharher hirhurin tavin legabbe mareh deaf al gav dela yachil lemebad lon kudsha berich hu salik leh reuteh keilu avid da letav aval reuteh levish la bar hirhura dekkochavim umazzalot veha ukmuha chavrayya
Inun dela hirharu teshuva nachte lishol vela salke mittamman ledare darin alayehu ketiv kalla anan vayyelach ken yored sheol lo yaale al kadmae ketiv Adonai memit umchayye morid sheol vayyaal

Amar rabbi yehuda dina deonshe degehinnam ha olifna deihu lemedan tamman lechayyavayya al ma itdanu benura degehinnam ella gehinnam ihu nur dalik yemame velele kegavena dechayyavayya mitchamman benura deyetzer hara lemebar al pitgame orayeta bechal chimuma vechimuma deinun mitchammeman beyetzer hara hachi ittokad nura degehinnam

Zimna chada la ishtechach yetzer hara bealma deailu leh go gushpanka defarzela benukba dithoma rabba vechal hahu zimna kava nura degehinnam vela ittokad kelal ahdar yetzer hara leatreh sharu chayyave alma leitchamma beh shaari nura degehinnam leittokda deha gehinnam la ittokad ella bechamimu dettukpa deyetzer hara dechayyavayya uvhahu chamimu nura degehinnam ittokad yemame velele vela shachich

Shiva pitchin inun laggehinnam veshiva madorin inun tamman shiva zine chayyavin inun ra beliyyaal chote rasha mashchit letz yahir vechullehu lakovlayehu it madorin laggehinnam kal chad vechad kadka chazi leh uchfum hahu darga dechata beh hahu chayyava hachi yahavin leh madora begehinnam
Uvchal madora umadora it malach memana al hahu atar techot yeda deduma vechamma elef veribbo immeh dedayenin lon lechayyavayya kal chad vechad kema deitchaze leh behahu madora deihu tamman

Eshsha degehinnam letatta mate miggo eshsha degehinnam dilela umate lehay gehinnam diltatta veittokad behahu ittearu dechamimu dechayyavayya deka mechamme garmayehu go yetzer hara vechal inun madorin delikin tamman

Atar it begehinnam vedargin tamman deikrun tzoa rotachat vetamman ihu zuhama denishmatin inun demitlachlechan mikkal zuhama dehay alma umitlabbenan vesallekin veishtearat hahu zuhama tamman veinun dargin bishin deitkerun tzoa rotachat itmanan al hahu zuhama venora degehinnam shalta behahu zuhama deishtearat

Veit chayyavin inun demitlachlechan bechovayehu tadir vela itlabbenan minnayehu umitu belo teshuva vechatu vehechotiu acharanin vahau keshe kedal tadir vela itbaru kame marihon behay alma illen itdanu tamman behahu zuhama uvhahi tzoa rotachat dela nafkin mittamman lealmin inun dimchabbelin archayehu al ara vela chashshu likara demarehon behay alma kal inun itdanu tamman ledare darin vela nafke mittamman

Beshabbate uvyarche uvizmanne uvchagge behahu atar nura ishtechach vela itdanu aval la nafke mittamman kishar chayyavin deit lehu nayecha kal inun dimchallele shabbatot uzmane vela chayeshe likara demarehon kelal begin lemetar lon ella mechallele befarhesya kema deinun la natre shabbate uzmani behay alma hachi name la natrin leh behahu alma velet lon nayecha

Amar ribbi yosi la tema hachi ella natre shabbate uzmani tamman begehinnam beal karchayehu amar rabbi yehuda illen inun ovde kochavim umazzalot dela itpekadu dela natre shabbat behay alma natre leh tamman baal karchayehu
Bechal maale shabbeta kad yoma itkaddash charozin
799: Azlin bechal inun madorin degehinnam seliku dina dechayyavayya deha malka kaddisha atya veoma itkaddash veihu aggin al kolla umiyyad dinin istalaku vechayyavayya it lon nayecha aval nura degehinnam la ishtekkach mealayehu dela natre shabbat lealmin vechal chayyave gehinnam shaale alayehu may shena illen delet lon nayecha mikkal chayyavin dehacha inun marehon dedina tayevin lon illen inun chayyavin dekkafru beh bekudsha berich hu veavru al orayeta kulla begin dela natru shabbat tamman begin kach let lehu nayechin lealmin

Veinun chayyavin kullehon nafkin midduchtayehu veityehiv lon reshu lemehach lemecheme behu umalach chad di shemeh santiriel azil veappik lehahu gufa dilhon veayil leh laggehinnam leenehon dechayyavayya vechamman leh desalleka tolain venishmeta let lah nayecha benura degehinnam

Vechal inun chayyavayya dettamman sacharin lehahu gufa umachrize aleh da ihu pelanya chayyava dela chayish likara demareh kafar beh bekudsha berich hu vechafar bechal orayeta kulla vay leh tav dela yitbere vela yete ledina da ulkissufa da hada hu dichtiv veyyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi ki tolatam lo tamut veishsham lo tichbe vehau deraon lechal basar ki tolatam lo tamut min gufa veishsham lo tichbe min nishmeta vehau deraon lechal basar vehau day raon ad dechal chayavin degehinnam dettamman yiyimrun day reiya da
Ribbi yosi amar vadday hachi hu begin deshabbat ihu lakovel orayeta kulla veorayeta ihi esh begin deavru al esh deorayeta ha esh degehinnam dalik dela shachich mealayehu lealmin

Amar rabbi yehuda levatar kad nafik shabbeta ate hahu malach umhader hahu gufa lekivreh veittedanu tarvayehu da lesitreh veda lesitreh vechal da beod degufa kayyama al buryeh deha kevan degufa itakkal let leh legufa kal illen dinin vekudsha berich hu lo yair kal chamato ketiv beh

Kal chayyavin dealma beod degufa shelim bechal shayefoy go kivra itdanu gufa verucha kal chad dina kadka chazi leh kevan degufa itakkal dina derucha ishtechach man deitzterich lenafka nafik uman deitzterich lemeheve alayehu nayecha it lon nayecha uman deitzterich lemeheve kitma veafra techot ragle detzaddikayya kal chad vechad kadka chazi leh itavid leh

Veal da kama tav lon ben letztzadike ben lechayyave lemehve gufa dilhon davik beara ulitakkela go afra lizman kariv vela lemeheve bekiyyuma kal hahu zimna saggi begin leitdena gufa venafsha verucha tadir deha let lach kal tzaddik vetzaddik bealma delet leh dina dekivra begin dehahu malach dimmana al kivre kaim al gufa vedan leh bechal yoma veoma im latzaddikim kach lechayavim al achat kamma vechamma
Uvzimna degufa itakkal veitbele beafra ha dina ishtechach mikkolla bar meinun chaside kayamin dealma deinun itchazun lesalleka nishmathon lehahu atar illaa deitchaze lon uzirin inun bealma
Kal inun metin dealma kullehu metin al yede demalacha mechabbela bar inun demetin beara kaddisha la metin al yedoy ella al yede demalacha derachame deshallit beara

Amar rabbi yitzchak i hachi may shevacha ihu lemoshe ulaharon umiryam dichtiv behu al pi Adonai deillen la mitu al yede dehahu malach mechabbela veat amarte dechule alma inun demitu beara deyisrael la metin al yedoy deda
800: Leh hachi hu vadday ushvacha demoshe aharon umiryam hava yattir mikkal bene alma deinun mitu levar meara kaddisha demoshe aharon umiryam levar meara kaddisha mitu vechullehu mitu al yede dehahu mechabbela bar inun moshe veaharon umiryam dela mitu ella al yede dekudsha berich hu aval inun demetin beara kaddisha la metin al yede dehahu mechabbela deha ara kaddisha la kayema birshu achara ella birshu dekudsha berich hu bilchodoy

Veal da ketiv yichu metecha nevelati yekumun hakitzu verannenu shochne afar vego yichu metecha illen demetin beara kaddisha deinun metin dileh vela meachara dela shalta tamman sitra achara kelal veal da ketiv metecha nevelati yekumun inun demitu beara nuchraa achara al yede dehahu mechabbela

Veal da ikrun nevela ma nevela metammea bemassa uf inun demetin levar meara kaddisha metamin bemassa veal da inun nevela kal shechita deifsil ikre nevela begin shechita ha ihi missitra achara umiyyad deifsil sharya alah sitra achara uvgin deihi dileh vesharya alah ikre nevela veraza da naval hu venaval shemo unvala immo

Veal da bechal atar deihu sharya ikre nevela menuval da la sharya ella beatar pesilu veal da shechita deafsil ha dileh hu veikre al shemeh uvgin kach metin deinun levar meara kaddisha techot reshu achara vesharya alayehu sitra achara ikrun nevela

Hakitzu verannenu shochne afar shochne dayerin demichin vela metin uman inun demichin dechevron deinun la metin ella demichin veal da ketiv behu gevia keman degava veit beh kiuma leanara uf hachi inun zuge dechevron demichin inun vela metin vechullehu kayemu bekiumayehu beinun gufin dilhon veyade sitrin genizin yattir mishshear bene nasha genizin hao tamman go pitcha deggan eden inun gufin dilhon veillen inun shochne afar veal da kal inun denafku nishmatayehu beara kaddisha la nafik al yede dehahu mechabbela vela shalta tamman ella al yede demalacha derachame deara kaddisha kayema beadveh

Atar it beyishshuva dela shalta beh hahu mechabbela vela ityehiv leh reshu leaala tamman vechal inun dedayere tamman la metin ad denafkin levar mikkarta velet lach bar nash mikkal dedayerin tamman dela metin vechullehu metin kishar bene nasha aval lav bemata may tama begin dela yachlin lemetav tadir bemata ella illen nafkin veillen alin veal da kullehu metin

May tama la shalta tamman hahu malach mechabbela i tema dela kayema birshuteh ha ara kaddisha dela kayema birshu achara umetin behahu atar amay la metin i tema begin kedushsha let atar bikdusha bechal yishuva kegavena deeretz yisrael vei tema begin hahu gavra devane lah kama bene nasha hao dizchutehon yattir midileh amar rabbi yitzchak ana la shemana vela ema

Atu shailu leh lerabbi shimon amar lon vadday hahu atar la shalta aleh malach hammavet vekudsha berich hu la bae divhahu atar yemut bar nash lealmin vei tema dekodem lachen behahu duchta ad la itbene mitu beh bene nasha lav hachi ella miyyoma deitbere alma ittakkan hahu atar lekiyyuma veraza derazin hacha leinun demistakkele beraza dechachmeta

Kad bara kudsha berich hu alma bara leh beraza deatvan veitgalgelu atvan uvara alma begillufe dishma kaddisha itgalgelu atvan veascharu alma begillufe vechad itgele veitpashshat alma veitbere vahau atvan sacharan lemivre amar kudsha berich hu deyistayyem beod ishtearat at behahu duchta
801: Talya baavera kevan deamar kudsha berich hu day yistayyem beod ishtearat at tet bilchodaha talya baavera al gabbe hahu duchta tet ihu at dinhiru chayyin begin kach man dechame tet bechelmeh simana tava hu leh vechayyin ittakanu leh veal da begin dehava talya al gabbe hahu atar la shalta beh mota

Kad baa kudsha berich hu lekayema alma zarik chad tzerora go mayya galif beraza dev atvan umittamman shaari lemehach hahu tzerora vela ashkach atar leitkayema beh bar ara kaddisha umayya hao azlin avatreh ad demata hahu tzerora techot hammizbeach vetamman ishteka veitkayyam kal alma

Vei tema i hachi divhahu atar sharyan chayyim amay la itbene tamman be makdesha lemehav chayyin leyatvaha ella hacha behay atar itkayyam begin at chad desharya aleh beve makdesha kal atvan kullehu sharan beh uvhu itbere ihu bilchodoy kegavena dechal alma

Vetu deara kaddisha yahiv chayyin vechappara leyatvaha behahu alma vaatar da lav hachi yahiv chayyin lehahu atar behay alma vela bealma deate uve makdesha behippucha mittamman begin deit chulaka leyisrael behahu alma vela bealma da veal da kayema be makdesha lechappara chovin ulmizke lon leyisrael lealma deate
Ta chaze tet nehiru dechayyin bechal atar veal da patach bah kera ki tov dichtiv vayyar elohim et haor ki tov mehay at arik malacha mechabbela la tema arik ella dela ityehiv leh reshu leaala tamman

At da meshanya meat la mityashva kelal beduchta bealma vesimanich ish lashon bal yikkon baaretz at tet ityashva bechal duchta veittakkanat leityashva kedeka yeot ubbegin kach bechal duchta deat tamman let yishuva leat tamman leityashva beh veal da atar da la shalta beh kelal sitra achara veyahiv chayyim dehay alma leyatve techoteh deat da vela yippuk levar vechad nafik levar it reshu lesitra achara leshalletaa beh kema deat da shalta beatar da hachi name shalta at achara beatar degehinnam uman ihi at

Uvsifra derav hamnuna sava hacha inun teren atvan veal da la hao ketivin go avni burla avanin deashlamuta ushvatin deyisrael teren atvan illen itmenau minnayehu begin dela yehe rashim beggavayehu chet

Beatar deve makdesha talyan kal atvan dealfa beta berazin gelifan dishmahan kaddishin keshirin merukkaman aleh vechal alma dilela vetatta kolla beraza deatvan mitchamman uggelifa verazin dikdusha illaa alayehu itgelif

Bemashkena itgelifu veittzayaru atvan kadka chazi deha betzalel hava yada chachmeta letzarfa atvan deitberiu behu shemaya veara veal chachmeta dileh itbene mashkena al yedeh veitberir mikkal amma deyisrael

Uchma deihu itberir leela hachi baa kudsha berich hu deyitberir letatta leela ketiv ree karati veshem betzalel letatta reu kara Adonai beshem betzalel ushmeh beraza illaa ikre hachi betzalel betzel el uman ihu da tzaddik deihu yativ betzel el hahu deikre el elon veihu yativ kegavena dehahu el hahu el natil shit sitrin hahu tzaddik natil lon uf hachi hahu el anhir leela hay tzaddik anhir letatta hahu el kelala dechullehu shit sitrin hahu tzaddik kelala dechullehu shit sitrin
Ben uri ben or kadmaa devara kudsha berich hu beovada divreshit ben chur ben chiru decholla davar acher ben chur ben chivar mikkal gavenin veda itmane lematte yehuda kolla kadka yeot
Kal gavenin tavin lechelma bar tichla kema deittemar begin deihu kurseya lemedan dinin denishmatin veha hay darga chivara ihu ella beshaata dekayema bedine denafshan kedin ihu gon tichla veha
802: Beshaata dechame bar nash lehay gon idkar bar nash lemebad pikkudin demareh kegavena dinchash hannechoshet beshaata dahao chaman leh hao dachale mikkamme dekudsha berich hu umnatran garmayehu mikkal chovin uvshaata dehahu dechilu dekudsha berich hu salleka alayehu miyyad ittasyan man garim lon leddachala mikkame kudsha berich hu hahu nachash hahi retzua demistakkelan bah uf hachi techelet uritem oto uzzechartem et kal mitzot Adonai mehahu dechilu dileh veal da techelet bemashkena

Amar rabbi yitzchak hay deamar mar techelet kurseya dedina ihi vechad ihi kayema begavena da keden ihi kurseya lemedan dine nafshan ematay ihi berachame amar leh beshaata dichruvim mehadran anpayehu da im da umistakkelan anpin beanpin kevan deinun keruvim mistakkelan anpin beanpin keden kal gavenin mittaknan veithappach gon tichla legaven achara mithappach gon yarok legaven zahav

Veal da behippucha digvanin ithappach middina lerachame vechen merachame ledina vecholla behippucha digvanin kema dimsadrin yisrael tikkunayehu legabbe kudsha berich hu hachi kayyama kolla vehachi itsadar veal da ketiv yisrael asher becha etpaar beinun gavenin dichlilan da beda shefiru dechullehu

Veasita shulchan atze shittim vego rabbi yitzchak patach veachalta veshavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha vego kama zakkain inun yisrael dekudsha berich hu itree behu vekariv lon legabbeh mikkal ammin uvginehon deyisrael yahiv mezona vesava lechal alma veilmale yisrael la yahiv kudsha berich hu mezona lealma vehashta deyisrael inun begaluta al achat kamma vechamma denatle mezona al chad teren

Bezimna dahao yisrael beara kaddisha hava nachit lon mezona meatar illaa veinun yahave cholak tamtzit leammin ovde kochavim veammin kullehu la ittezanu ella mittamtzit vehashta deyisrael inun begaluta ithappach begavena achara

Metal lemalka deatkin seudata livne beteh kal zimna deinun avde reuteh achle seudata im malka veyahave lechalbe chulak garmin lemigrar beshaata divni beteh la avde reuta demalka malka yahiv kal seudata lechalbe vesalik lon garme

Kegavena da kal zimna deyisrael avde reuta demarehon ha al patora demalka inun achle vechal seudata ittakkan lehon veinun mehahu chedva dilhon yahave garme deihu tamtzit leovade kochavim vechal zimna deyisrael la avde reuta demarehon azle begaluta veha seudata lechalbe veistallak lon tamtzit kacha yochlu bene yisrael et lachmam tame baggoyim deha tamtzit degiulehon achle vay livra demalka deyativ umtzappe lefatora deavda ma deishtear miggo patora ihu achil

David malka amar taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray dishshanta vashshemen roshi kosi revaya taaroch lefanay shulchan da seudata demalka neged tzorray inun kalbe deyatve kame patora metzappan lechulak garmin veihu yativ im malka beinuga disudata befatora

Dishshanta vashshemen roshi da resha disudata dechal mishcha veshamnuna vetikun seudata ityehiv bekadmita lirchima demalka ma deishtear levatar ityehiv lechalbe ulinun palche patora kosi revaya malya kassa kame rechima demalka tadir dela yitzterich lemishal veal raza da hao yisrael tadir im shear ammin

Rabbi chiyya hava azil legabbe derabbi shimon litverya vahau immeh rabbi yaakov bar idi verabbi yesa zeira ad dahao azle amar rabbi yesa lerabbi chiyya tema ma dichtiv velivnay varziyylay haggiladi taase chesed vehau beochle shulchanecha vego i hachi kal tivu ukshot lemechal al patoreh vela yattir middekaamar hacha vehau beochle shulchancha vetu lav yekara demalka ihu lemechal bar nash achora
803: Al patoreh demalka vela itzterich da ella malka bilchodoy vechullehu ravrevanohi sacharaneh letatta minneh

Amar rabbi chiyya la shemana behay midi vela ema amar leh lerabbi yaakov bar idi veatte shamata behay midi amar leh attun deyankin bechal yoma midduvsha demishcha illaa la shematun kal shekken ana amar leh lerabbi yesa veatte shamata midi behay amar leh af al gav daana ravya umiyyomin zeirin atena legabbayechu vela zachena mikkadmat dena ana shemana

Patach veamar noten lechem lechal basar ki leolam chasdo may ka chama david desium hallela rabba siyyem hachi behay kera ella telat shallitin inun leela dekudsha berich hu ishtemoda behu veinun raza yakkira dileh veillen inun mocha velibba vechavda veinun behippucha dehay alma leela mocha natil beresha uvatar yahiv lelibba velibba natil veyahiv lechavda ulvatar kavda yahiv chulak lechal inun mekorin diltatta kal chad vechad kadka chazi leh letatta kavda natil beresha ulvatar ihu mekarav kolla lelibba venatil libba shefiru demechla kevan denatil veittakaf mehahu tukpa uru deka natil yahiv veittear legabbe mocha ulvatar ahdar kavda ufalig mezona lechal mekorin degufa

Beoma detaanita bar nash mekarav mechla umishteyya legabbe kavda illaa umay ihu mekarav chelbeh vedameh uruteh hahu kavda natil kolla biruta kevan decholla ihu legabbeh natil umkarav kolla lekame libba deihu rav veshalit aleh kevan delibba natil veittakaf beraava mekarev kolla legabbe mocha deihu shallita illaa al kal gufa levatar ahdar kavda umfaleg chulakin lechal inun mekorin veshayefin diltatta bezimna achara kad mocha natil bekadmita ulvatar yahiv lelibba velibba yahiv lechavda vechavda yahiv lechullehu mekorin veshayefin diltatta ulvatar kad bae lefallega mezona lehay alma beresha yahiv lelibba deihu malka di beara ufatora demalka ittear bekadmita mikkal shear bene alma
Zakkaa ihu man dahave bechushbana defatora demalka deha ishtemoda leotava leh behahu tivu dilela

Veda ihu tivu ukshot daavad david livne varziyylay dichtiv vehau beochle shulchanecha vei tema divshulchana demalka achil bar nash achora bar minneh la ella malka achil beresha uvatar kal amma veinun deachle im malka beshaata deihu achil inun dechavivin aleh mikkullehu veinun itmenun mishulchana demalka

Vei tema ha ketiv al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel begin dechal mezona dileh la avid chushbana achora ella al shulchan hammelech demittamman hava ate mezona umechla dileh veda ihu al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel ata rabbi chiyya unshakeh al resheh amar leh ravya ante vechachmeta illaa sharya belibbach addehachi chamu leh lerabbi chizkiyya dehava ate amar leh rabbi chiyya vadday bechavruta da kudsha berich hu yitchabbar alana deha millin chadtin deorayeta yitchadtun hacha

Yatvu lemechal amru kal chad vechad lema mille deorayeta behay seudata amar rabbi yesa seudat aray ihi veim kal da seuda ikre vela od ella dehay ikre seudata dekudsha berich hu ithane minah veal da ketiv ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai deha millin deorayeta yischarun lehay atar
Patach rabbi chiyya veamar veachalta veshavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha vego vechi ad la achil bar nash lesava veyitmele keriseh la yevarech leh lekudsha berich hu
804: Bemay nokim veachalta veshavata uvatar uverachta ella afilu la yechul bar nash ella kezayit uruteh ihu aleh veyishave leh lehahu mechla ikara demechleh sava ikre dichtiv poteach et yadecha umasbia lechal chay ratzon lechal chay achila la ketiv ella ratzon hahu reuta deshave al hahu mechla sava ikre vaafilu delet kameh devar nash ella hahu zeer bichzayit vela yattir ha reuta desava shave aleh uvgin kach umasbia lechal chay ratzon ratzon ketiv vela achila veal da uverachta vadday veitchayav bar nash levarcha leh lekudsha berich hu begin lemehav chedva leela

Patach rabbi chizkiyya behay kera avatreh veamar veachalta veshovata mehacha deshikkor share leh levarcha bircheta dimzona ma delet hachi bitzlota ditzlota lav hachi deha tzelota maalya bela achila ihi may taama begin ditzlota salleka leela leela atar delet beh la achila vela shetiyya veal da taninan alma deate let beh achila ushtiyya vechu

Aval shear dargin diltatta it bevirkat mezona ishtechach gavena achora umaalya hahu bircheta deishtechach besava begin devirkat mezona ihi baatar deit beh achila ushtiyya uminneh nafak mezona vesava letatta veal da itzterich leachazaa kameh sava vechedva baatar ditzlota lav hachi deha salleka yattir leela leela veal da shikkor la yitzle tzelota

Bevirkat mezona shikkor share leh levarcha birkat mezona mashma mehay kera dichtiv veachalta veshavata uverachta veachalta zo achila vesavata zo shetiyya deha sava bechamra ihi rave chamra sava vadday veda ihu shikkor dichtiv uverachta et dayeka demashma devirkat mezona itzterich chedva vesava al haaretz hattova may tova sava kema deatte amer vannisba lechem vannihye tovim begin kach itzterich chedva vesava

Patach rabbi yesa veamar veasita shulchan atze shittim vego shulchan da ihu kayema lego bemashkena uvircheta dilela sharya aleh uminneh nafik mezona lechal alma veshulchan da la itzterich lemeheve berekanya afilu riga chada ella lemeheve aleh mezona deha bircheta la ishtechach al atar rekanayya uvgin kach itzterich lemehve aleh nahama tadir delehve tadir bircheta illaa mishtakkecha beh umiggo hahu shulchan nafke birkan umzone lechal shear patori dealma deitbarchan begineh

Shulchan dechal bar nash itzterich lemeheve hachi kameh beshaata deka mevarach leh lekudsha berich hu begin detishre aleh bircheta milleela vela yitchaze berekanya deha birkan dilela la sharyan beatar rekanayya dichtiv haggidi li ma yesh lachy babbayit veha ukmuha chavrayya

Shulchan dela ittemar aleh mille deorayeta aleh ketiv ki kal shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom veasur levarcha al hahu shulchan may tama begin deit shulchan veit shulchan shulchan ihu deka mesaddera kameh dekudsha berich hu leela veihu kayema tadir lesaddera beh pitgame orayeta ulachlela beh atvan demille deorayeta veihu lakit lon legabbeh vechalil kullehu begaveh uvhu ishtelim vechadde veit leh chedva veal shulchan da ketiv ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai lifne Adonai vela milifne Adonai
Shulchan achara it dela it beh chulaka deorayeta velet leh chulaka bikdusha deorayeta vehahu shulchan ikre ki tzoa veda ihu beli
805: Makom delet leh chulaka besitra dikdusha kelum begin kach shulchan dela ittemar aleh mille deorayeta ihu shulchan deki tzoa ihu shulchan detaava achara let behahu shulchan chulaka beraza deelaha illaa

Shulchan demille orayeta ittemaru aleh kudsha berich hu natil hahu shulchan veshavi leh lechulkeh vela od ella surya rav memana natil kal inun millin veshave diyyukna dehahu shulchan kame kudsha berich hu vechal inun millin deorayeta deitmaru aleh sallekin al hahu patora veitattar kame malka kaddisha mashma dichtiv ze hashulchan asher lifne Adonai deitattar kame kudsha berich hu shulchan devar nash kayema ledakkea leh levar nash mikkal chovoy zakkaa ihu man deillen teren kayemin al patoreh mille deorayeta vechulaka lemiskenin mehahu shulchan

Kad sallekin hahu patora mikkameh devar nash teren malachin kaddishin izdammenan tamman chad mimina vechad missemala chad amar da ihu shulchan demalka kaddisha diflanya ka mesadder kameh mesaddar yehe tadir patora da bevirkan ilain umishcha urvu illaa kudsha berich hu yishre aloy vechad amar da ihu shulchan demalka kaddisha diflanya ka mesadder kameh da patora di illae vetattae yevarchun leh mesaddar yehe hay patora kame attik yomin behay alma uvalma deate

Ribbi abba kad hava sallekin patora mikameh hava chafe leh vahava amar seliku hay patora bitzniu dela yehe bechissufa kame sheluche malka shulchan devar nash zache leh lealma deate vezache leh limzona dehay alma vezache leh leishtemoda letav kame attik yomin vezache leh leittosfa chela urvu baatar deitzterich zakkaa ihu chulakeh dehahu bar nash behay alma uvalma deate

Rabbi yaakov amar ketiv vayehi kal yodo meitmol shilshom vego hagam shaul banviim vechi shaul bechir Adonai mikkadmat dena hava dichtiv haritem asher bachar bo Adonai asher bocher bo la ketiv ella asher bachar bo mikkadmat dena uvshaata deata veal ben nevie veitnabbe benayehu amay tavehu

Ella kad kudsha berich hu itree beh la itree beh ella lemalchu aval linvua lo deha teren illen la itmesaru kachada bevar nash bealma bar mimmoshe mehemana illaa dezacha linvua vmalchu kachada vela ityehiv levar nash achara tarvayehu kachada

Vei tema ha shemuel dezacha letarvayehu linvua vmalchu lav hachi linvua zacha dichtiv vayyeda kal yisrael middan vead beer shava ki neeman shemuel lenavi lenavi vela lemelech navi vedayyan hava dei melech hava la shaalu yisrael melech aval ihu la hava ella nevia mehemana vahava dain dinehon deyisrael dichtiv veshafat et yisrael veal da kad hava shaul bannevua tavehu aleh

Vei tema amay shara aleh nevua hoil vezacha lemalchu ella tarvayehu la zacha behu kachada uvgin demalchu ityashav al attearuta deruach kudsha hava beitaru dinvua kodem lachen aval kad salik lemalchu la hava beh nevua ella ittearu deruach sachletanu lemedan keshot ittear aleh dehachi itchaze lemalka uvod dehava go inun nevie shara aleh nevua levatar deitperash minnayehu la hava beh nevua
Vaana man yahiv li itaruta deruach kudsha lemeheve bego nevie mehemne talmide deribbi shimon ben yochay deillain vetattain zain minneh kal shekken ana lemehve benayechu
Patach veamar veasita shulchan vego shulchan da ihu letatta leshavaa aleh lechem deappaya man adif da min da lechem o shulchan i tema decholla
806: Ihu chad ha shulchan mitsadra legabbe hahu lechem vetu shulchan letatta velechem aleh lav hachi ella shulchan ihu ikkara besiddura dileh lekabbela birkan dilela umzona lealma umeraza dehay shulchan nafik mezona lealma kema deityehiv beh milleela

Vehahu lechem ihu iba umzona deka nafik mehay shulchan leachazaa deha mishulchan da nafke perin veivin umzona lealma i la ishtechach kerem anavin deinun iba denafke minneh la yehon mishtakkechin i ilana la yehe iba la yishtekkach bealma begin kach shulchan ihu ikkara mezona denafik minneh ihu hahu lechem happanim

Vechahane hao lakte iba deshulchan meerev shabbat leerev shabbat leachazaa deha mezona illaa nafik miggo hahu deshulchan begin hahu lechem dahao lakte kahani itbarcha kal mezona umzona deachle veshatan dela lekatrega behu yetzer hara deha yetzer hara la ishtechach ella miggo mechla umishteyya hada hu dichtiv pen esba vechichashti vego demiggo mechla umishteyya yetzer hara mitrabbe bimoy devar nash

Lechem da mezona deka nafik miggo shulchan mevarech mezona dechahane dela yishtekkach behu mekatrega lekatrega lon lemiflach belibba shelim lekudsha berich hu veda itzterich lechahane yattir mikkal alma uvgin kach shulchan ihu ikkara veiba umzona deka nafik minneh ihu hahu lechem

Shulchan da itzterich siddura dileh leittakna besitra detzafon dichtiv vehashshulchan titten al tzela tzafon may tama begin demittamman sheruta dechedva semala natil mimina tadir bekadmita ulvatar ihu ittear legabbe nukba uvatar karivat leh yemina legabbeh veitdabbekat beh

Mayim inun mimina veihu chedva miyyad yahiv lismala veitdabbaku beh inun mayim vechaddan leh uvatar itkelil ihu limina veittear lenukba behahu chedva vesimanach man denatil mayya bideh yemina bemana kadmaa learka mayya bismala ihu vela missemala limina deha mayya mimina natil lon semala

Ubbegin kach mayya la ishtechachu ella missitra dismala kevan denatilu mayya legabbeh ha ittearu legabbe nukba beinun mayim veal da gevurot geshamim taninan uvgin kach vehashshulchan titten al tzela tzafon demehahu setar ivin ishtechachu beh yattir missitra achora beitaru dechedva dileh bekadmita kema deatte amer semolo tachat leroshi levatar vimino techabbekeni

Shulchan devar nash itzterich leishtakkecha binkiuta degufa dela yitkarev lemechal mezona dileh ella binkiuta degarmeh veal da itzterich bar nash lefannaa garmeh bekadmita ad la yechul mezona deshulchana dachya dehahu mezona deatkin leh beh itree kudsha berich hu begin dela yitkarev al hahu shulchan ki tzoa deihu meraza desitra achara vesitra achara la yekabbel mehahu mezona deshulchan da kelum

Levatar deachil bar nash veitannag itzterich lemehav chulaka detamtzit lehahu sitra uman ihu mayim acharonim hahu zuhama deyadin deitzterich lemehav lehahu sitra chulaka deitzterich leh veal da vadday inun chova chova inun uvaatar dechova sharyan veihu chiuva al bar nash lemehav leh chulaka da veal da la itzterich levarcha kelal deha beracha lav ihu behahu sitra

872: Vaanan miggo chashocha dehava bemadbera itgele lan nehora da rachamana yashre immach nehora bealma den uvalma deate azle rabbi shimon vechavrayya illen telat milin avatreh amar leh amay la azle illen immach kekadmita amar leh la beena leatrecha levar nash immi hashta deatu nezil kachada azlu verabbi shimon azal learcheh amar ribbi abba ha anan yedana shemeh veihu la yada shemeh demor amar leh minneh yadana dela leitchazaa barucha Adonai leolam amen veamen
873: Al pi bet din deihu gevura begin detamman levae deittemar behu vekiddashta et halviyyim ulvatar deitchaze sihara deyeotu leora mevarech aleha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bemaamaro bara shechakim uvruach piv kal tzevaam uvmi mitkadeshet umitbarechet betiferet begin deihu ateret tiferet laamuse vaten

Aval azlin leve midrashot patchin sifrin vechaman kal inun tavan deka mechakkan vechaman ketivin beorayeta deavtach lon kudsha berich hu alayehu umitnachamin begaluthon ushar amin mecharfin umgadfin lon veamre an hu lahachon an inun tavan deattun amrin dizminin lechon vechi kal ammin dealma yichsefun minnayechu

Hada hu dichtiv shimu devar Adonai hacharedim el devaro amru achechem sonechem vego may hacharedim el devaro inun desavlu kama bishin kama shemuot shame illen al illen veillen batar illen vecharidan alehon kema deatte amer ki vego kol charada shamanu pachad veen shalom vego inun charedim tadir el devaro kad itavid dina

Amru achechem sonechem illen inun achuchon bene esav menaddechem kema deatte amer suru tame karu lamo delet amma deka mevazzin lon beanpe umrakkekin beanpayehu leyisrael kivne edom veamre kullehu misavin kannidda veda ihu menaddechem lemaan shemi yichbad Adonai anan benoy deel chay di ban yityakar shemeh anan shaltanin al alma begin hahu deikre gadol esav beno haggadol uvishma da ikre kudsha berich hu gadol gadol Adonai umhullal meod anan bene haggadol veihu gadol vadday lemaan shemi yichbad Adonai

Aval attun zeirin mikkolla yaakov benah hakkatan ketiv an hu elahachon an hu inun tavan deyichsefun kal amamya mechedva dilchon man yitten venire vesimchatchem kema deattun amrin vehem yevoshu keman detale killata beachara begin deattun amrin dichden yevoshu veyikkalmu uvgin da ruach kudsha hava amar milla hachi veal da hen yevoshu veyikkalmu kol hannechorim bach may kol hannecherim bach deitkafu nechirehon berugza alach begaluta da behahu zimna yevoshu veyikkalmu mikkal tavin diyechomun lehon leyisrael

Amar ribbi chiyya hachi hu vadday aval chamenan vehachi chamu takife alma deha galuta itmeshach vaadayin bereh dedavid la ate amar ribbi yose vechal da hachi hu aval man avid deyisbelun yisrael galuta da kal inun havtachot deavtach lon kudsha berich hu veha ittemar dealin levatte kenesiyyot ulvate midrashot vechaman kal inun nechamot vechadan belibbayehu lemisbal kal ma deyete alayehu veilmale da la yachlin lemisbal

875: Amar ribbi yose kama satamte kal archin ushvilin mikkal beni galuta vela shavkat lon pitchon pe i hachi liho kema dahao bechal dara vedara dela yisbelun galuta vela agra veyifkun middina deorayeta veyitarvun bishar ammin

Patach veamar kemo hara takriv laledet tachil tizak bachavaleha vego may kemo hara arach ihu leubbarta leabera alah tesha yarchin shelemin veit bealma kama vechamma dela avar alah ella yoma chad o teren yomin mitteshiaa vechal tzirin vachavalin deubbarta bitshiaa inun veaf al gav dela abar alah ella yoma chada itchashiv alah keilu itavaru kal teshiaa shelim uf hachi yisrael kevan deitame taam galuta i yahadrun bitshuva yitchashav alayehu keillu aberu alayehu kal inun millin dichtivin beorayeta kal shekken vekkal shekken dechamma vechamma yissurin aberu alayehu min yoma degaluta share

Aval may dichtiv batztzar lecha umtzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim ta chaze kamma rachamanuta rachim kudsha berich hu leyisrael bemilla da lemalka dehava leh bera yechidaa verachim leh rechimu denafsha umiggo rechimu dileh yahav leh leimmeh matronita ditrabbe leh vetolif leh arche metatkenan zimna chada chav legabbe avuha ata avohi vealke leh ulvatar abar al choveh tav kemillekaddemin vechav laavuha veafkeh avuha mibbeteh veargiz aleh nafak hahu bera mibbeteh

Al hahi milla deachme kudsha berich hu lemoshe begin deaf al gav deyisrael chavin kameh bechal dara vedara la bae man deyema alayehu daltorin menalan mehoshea dichtiv techillat dibber Adonai behoshea ha ukmuha milla veal da vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam vego uvgin da barich lon bechamma birkan leahaddera betiyyuvta ulatava lon legabbe avuhon devishmayya vela ade mittamman ad dekudsha berich hu machal al chovayehu veitnekiu kameh

Eliyyahu ma ketiv beh vayyavo vayyeshev tachat rotem echad vego amar mareh dealma itteta chada shadrat lon leyisrael udvora shemah dichtiv vehi yoshevet tachat tomer devora da hu rotem veahadrat lon lemutav dichtiv ad shakkamti devora veana alit benayehu veachrazit kamayehu vela yachilna

Ad dehava yativ itgele aleh kudsha berich hu amar leh ma lecha fo eliyyahu bekadmita ka havet mekatrega umkanne al berit umiddechamena bach dekannit alay behahu berit natlit leh biru demoshe veyahivna lacha ad demoshe hava amar hinni noten lo et beriti shalom hashta deihu dilach la itchaze lach lekatrega aloy hava lecha lemishbak kinuyacha li kema bekadmita dehava dili shevakna leh lida achara vela katrigna aloy

Ma lecha fo may fo berit kayyama pe Adonai ihu kevan dela baat leshavka li pumach yetuv baatar dehahu puma tenan behahi shaata itabbar minneh hahu nevazbeza deyahav leh moshe ditnan may dichtiv vayyelech bechoach haachila hahi vego ad har haelohim choreva lemitba mittamman vechi mittamman hava bae ella lemitba kemillekaddemin mehahu deyarit behar haelohim berit da pinchas hu eliyyahu vadday bedarga chada amar leh moshe let ante yachil lekabbela minnay ella zil leyannokayehu deyisrael umeinun tirvach veinun yahave lach vechach hu avid
Kama tivu avid kudsha berich hu bechal dara vedara leyisrael ta chaze ma ketiv vaeshlach lefancha et moshe aharon umiryam veha kama nevie hao levatar moshe
878: Vaeshlach lefancha et moshe aharon veelazar ufinchas yehoshua veeliyyahu veelisha vechamma shear tzaddike vachaside mibbae leh illen telata amay ella amar kudsha berich hu ammi banay amay la tidkerun lechal tavin daavadit lechu deshaddarit lechu lemoshe aharon umiryam

Amar ribbi yose lav hava abba rachaman al benoy kekudsha berich hu ukra hu dichtiv lo nafal davar echad mikkol devaro hattov vego ta chaze rachmanu dileh illu amar lo nafal davar echad mikkol devaro vela yattir noach lealma dela itbere aval middeamar mikkol devaro hattov veappik bish laachora deha milla devish la bae lemebad
Veaf al gav deagzim vearim retzua atat ima veittakafat bidroeh yemina vekam retzua bekiyyumeh vela nachit letatta vela itavid begin diveta chada hao tarvayehu ihu deagzim veihu daachidat biyemineh

Vei tema menalan mimmilla deihi beitgalleya dichtiv lech red ki shichet ammecha sare learama retzua umoshe dela hava yada archa deima shatik kevan dechama kudsha berich hu kach ankid leh uvatash beh veamar veatta hannicha li miyyad argish moshe veachid bidroeh dekudsha berich hu dichtiv zechor leavraham da deroe yemina ubbegin kach la nachit retzua

Ta chaze it man deavid charshin veatzlach bidoy veit man deavid lon kehahu gavena mammash vela atzlach bidoy deha leovadin illen gavra metukkena itzterich

Addehachi hao zalgin enoy deribbi abba amar leh abba abba zil tanfir keturach veakpid bekultach deha razin deorayeta lezakkae ityehivu dichtiv sod Adonai lireav

973: Deyisrael mitare rachame behahu kol shofar keden itarveva leh kolla dela yada vela mashgach beinun deittedanu ad dilvatar kal inun dela mehaddere betiyyuvta veigzar alayehu mota vadday nafkin pitkin mibbe malka veitmesaru leh kevan deitmesaru leh la ahadru pitkin ad deitavid dina

Vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe vego ketiv umimmaal larakia da ihu rekia dekayema alayehu dearba chevan dechad mistalleke bego chad avera devatash behu la zakfin resha leistakkela leela
Begin dehahu ruach hachayya batash bechullehu uvhahu ruach mistalleke kullehu dichtiv uvhinnase hachayyot meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim leummatam uchtiv ki ruach hachayya baofannim

976: Veet banav lemor raza hacha deha okimna let tzav ella avodat kochavim umazzalot vehacha ityehivat leh leittokda hahi machashava raa ulabera lah miggo kudsha behay reuta desalleka leela uvha tenana vetarbin deittokdan begin leitabbera min kudsha vehay tzav birshutayehu kayema leafrasha lah min kudsha miggo hay karbana vei tema tzav et beni yisrael hachi name deha birshutayehu kayema kal zimna deavde reuta demarehon dela yachla leshalletaa alayehu

Uvgin kach al mokda al hammizbeach kal hallayela man layela da keneset yisrael deatya ledakkea leh levar nash mehahu reuta al mokda begin di nahar dinur ihu atar leokda lechal inun dela kayeme bekiyyumayehu deha alin lon behahu nora dedalik umabbere shultanehon mealma uvgin dela yishlot itzterich al mokda al hammizbeach kal hallayela veitkafya vela shalta

Ta chaze ketiv zechor Adonai livni edom et yom yerushala haomrim aru aru ad hayesod ba veal da zammin kudsha berich hu lemivne yesode yerushala miyesodin acharanin deyishletun al kolla uman inun sappirin dichtiv visadtich bassappirim deillen inun yesodin vesamchin takkifin veillain delet lehu chalishu kekadmae may taama begin deavanin
978: Kadmain meinun yesode yachilu shear ammin lemishlat alayehu may taama begin delet behu nehiru illaa kedeka yeot aval illen yehon nehirin miggo nehiru illaa umshakkean go tehome dela yachlin leshalletaa alayehu veillen inun sappirin deyinharun leela vetatta begin divhahu zimna yittosaf nehiru illaa leela vetatta

Bezimna deokim kudsha berich hu leveteh behahu zimna ma ketiv billa hammavet lanetzach billa kidamrinan billa Adonai velo chamal hahu kos deshata hay yishte hay

980: Berich hu ree karati veshem betzalel veitto aholiav uchtiv veasa betzalel veaholiav vechol ish chacham lev i yekara da hava demoshe deihu yabid leh yitkeyyam beh tadir

981: Leummatam deha kema deillen chaot natlin vesallekin hachi inun may taama begin ki ruach hachayya baofannim ruach hachayya ruach kudsha denashiv uvatash bechullehu ofannim lemehach ishtechach dechal man deihu bedarga illaa ihu natil leman denatil leh ta chaze dearon ihu hava natil leman denatil leh uf hacha chaot inun natlin laofannim

1049: Aleh uveh ishtelim pulchana lekudsha berich hu kahana kaim aleh vechavin milin bechedvata biruta leyachada shema kaddisha kedeka yaut velevae beshir keden ketiv deu ki Adonai hu elohim da hu karban lekarva rachame bedina umitbesam kolla

Ella raza demilla ha tanenan leolam yikkanis adam shiur sheni petachim vechu vitzale tzeloteh hada hu dichtiv lishmor mezuzot petachay shene petachim salleka datach ella ema shiur shene petachim kan remez lemma sheamar david seu shearim rashechem inun maon umachon deinun go lego sheruta dedargin chesed ufachad veinun pitchin dealma al da itzterich bar nash deyitkavin bitzloteh lakovel kodesh kudshin deinun shema kaddisha vitzale tzeloteh vehanhu illen shiur pitchin kitrin

Vit dematne hache simcha da keneset yisrael vesimcha ha ukmuha kedichtiv ki besimcha tetzeu vego uzminin yisrael lenafka min galuta behay simcha uman ihi keneset yisrael veal da ivdu et Adonai besimcha kema dichtiv bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh vecholla chad

Im ola karbano min habbakar amar ribbi yose may shena min habbakar leola umin hatztzon leola umin haof leola i kolla chad begin ma shanya da min da deha min kolla itavid chad milla ella man deadbak yedeh leda makriv min habbakar vei la yachil min hatztzon vei la yachil min haof deha ketiv veim dal hu veen yado masseget deha kudsha berich hu la atrach aleh devar nash yattir bemilla dela yachil

1050: Hu dekudsha berich hu katil lemiskene vekaim laatire deha mehashta yosifun lemechote kameh amar leh yeot shaalta veha ukmuha chavrayya veamru kad baa kudsha berich hu leitpara min rashshiayya ulovada lehu min alma keden yahiv lehu shalom vashlim lehu becholla

Aval ta chazi dechal bene alma la mishtakkechin kerivin lemalka illaa keillen manin deihu ishtammash behu uman inun lev nishbar vnidke veet dakka ushfal ruach illen inun mane demalka vechad ishtechach batzoret bealma vechafna vedina ittakkaf al miskene keden bachan vegaoan kame malka vekudsha berich hu kariv lon yattir mikkolla hada hu dichtiv ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut ani uchden kudsha berich hu pakid al ma atya kafna lealma vay leinun chayyavayya degarme hay

Vatta asita chesed im kal bene yisrael begin deahani lemoshe beveteh umoshe kelala dechal yisrael hava vetu begin deolif parsheta chada yattir beorayeta uvda avid chesed im yisrael

Velo od ella ma ketiv beh beyitro vayyikkach yitro choten moshe ola uzvachim lelohim dehu akriv karbena lekudsha berich hu veata leitgayera may ka mayere dekarbeneh
1051: Chashiv kame kudsha berich hu uvgin deihu akriv karbena lekudsha berich hu ketiv vayyavo aharon vechol zikne yisrael leechol lechem im choten moshe lifni haelohim lifne haelohim dayeka mikkan olifna dechal man deakriv karbena biruta delibba kudsha berich hu izdeman lakovleh

Kema demiskena artach chelbeh vedameh kach hahu kimcha merattechin leh bimshach revut vehachi olifna deafilu kal bar nash mekarev hay mincha al hammachavat uminchat marcheshet begin dichma dechattaa artach chelbeh vedameh beeshsha deyetzer hara vechal shayefoy ratche beeshsha kach karbena da kehay gavena mammash veikara dekarbena kegana dechattaa ulkarva kame kudsha berich hu reuta delibbeh verucheh venafsheh dehay chaviva min kolla kameh

Tu patach veamar baruch Adonai mitztziyyon shochen yerushalam halluyah vechi mitztziyyon hu baruch veha minnahara amika illaa ihu baruch ella baruch Adonai kad nahir sihara minnehiru deshimsha umitkarve da beda vela adiu nehora da min da ulzimnin desihara itkere bishma demalka kema deihu ikre Adonai kach hi nikret Adonai kema deatte amer vayeya himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim vela da bilchodohi ella afilu chad shelicha lezimnin itkere bishma demalka

Val da it atar beyishshuva kad nahir leillen chashich leillen leillen yemama ulillen lelya veit atar dechuleh yemama vela ishtechach beh lelya bar beshaata chada zeera vehay deamar besifre kadmae uvsifra deadam harishon hachi hu dehachi ketiv odcha al ki noraot nifleti niflaim maasecha uchtiv ma rabbu maasecha Adonai veal da kolla shappir veraza da itmesar lemarehon dechachmeta vela limfalge techumin begin deihu raza amika deorayeta

Mehahu yoma kad hava ate leve rav veamre milleta deorayeta hava bache amre leh amay ka bachit amar lon begin deavarna al mehemnuta demille derabbanan umistafena middina dehahu alma

1053: Hay rakia avid shelama benayehu vealma la mitkayema ella al shalom ta chazi kudsha berich hu ikre shalom hu shalom ushmeh shalom veitkeshshar kolla beshalom ribbi abba amar chamena dehay shema kaddisha illaa kolla hu shalom vecholla chad varchan mitparshan lehay sitra ulhay sitra

Resha achora tattaa hu resha leashkaa leginta vehu mabbua demayin dechal netian ishtakyan minneh veda hu bitlat kishrin veal da shalshelet ikre kehay shalshelet deitkashar da beda vecholla chad

Uvsifra dishlomo malka amar matun di bekatfura ditlata dichlilan bekitfa degufeh chad dechilu decholla chad satim shevilin chad nahar amika

Vehahu nahar appik teren benin kema deittemar uminah ittezanu levatar nafkin teren benin uvratta ittezenat mibben da ha ben hay malka dishlama kolla dileh raza ulvatar ishtechach Adonai deittezzenat min veha ukmeh Adonai ishtechach de ikkara vesharsha ushlimu decholla hada hu dichtiv bechachma yibbane bayit

Tenan shemot ishtachlalu venafku mehay yod dehi asiraa deatvan vechullehu ail lon lehahu nahar kaddisha kad itabbera vaasara shemahan kullehu setimin bechad vechullehu setimin be kalil lon appik lon hu av lecholla av laavahan

Minneh nafku remez laasara becheshbon atvan yod kalil lon shelimu decholla dechar venukba du karenan lon teren veal da adam du partzufin itbere veinun partzufin dechar venukba hao kegavena dilela meela letatta mittatta leela vecholla chad milla mechilan talyan beh veal da yod kalil kema deittemar veha ukmuha
Vta chaze shemahan inun lakovel atvan uvsifra derav hamnuna sava temanya inun utren dargin lakovel teren rekiin umishtanyan shemahan asra vetisha utmanya ushviaa

Teshiaa adonay veda malchut kaddisha dedinin nafkin mittamman lealma veda hu kitra batraa dechullehu shemahan veshem ehye kelala ustima dekadmeta veda hu kitra illaa resha dechal reshin shemeh satim vela itgalleya veittemar uvsifra deaggadta eser shemahan ketivan begavena achora vaana la tannena hachi

Ta chaze bene aharon la ishtechachu beyisrael kevatayehu bar moshe veaharon veinun ikrun atzile bene yisrael veal detau kame malka kaddisha mitu vechi kudsha berich hu baa leovada lon veha tanenan beraza dematnitin dekudsha berich hu aved chesed becholla vaafilu berashie alma la bae leovada lon vehane zakkae keshot salleka datach deinun itavidu mealma zechuta dilhon an hu zechuta deavuhon an hu zechuta demoshe hachi name veinun hech itavidu
