Uman devae leminda tzirufe shemahan kaddishin linda inun atvan dirshimin bechal kitra vechitra uchden linda veyitkeyyam becholla veha galifna lon bechal inun atvan dirshiman vidian bechal kitra vechitra missifra ilaa dishlomo vehachi salik bidan vechavrayya gelifin lon veshappir hu deha kal kitra vechitra ozif lechavreh atoy kema deokimna ulzimnin dela itzterich ella beatoy inun dirshimin beh vechullehu yedian legabbe chavrayya veha okimna lon

Zakkain inun tzaddikayya bealma den uvalma deate dekudsha berich hu bae bikarehon umgale lehon razin illain dishmeh kaddisha dela galle leillain kaddishin veal da yachil moshe leitattera bene kaddishin vechullehu la yachle lemikrav bahadeh kenura yakidta vegumre deeshsha dei lav hachi man hava leh lemoshe lemekam benayehu ella zakkaa chulaka demoshe deha kad share lemallela immeh kudsha berich hu baa leminda shemeh kaddisha satim vegalya bechal chad vechad kadka chaze uchden adbak veyada yattir mikkal bene alma

Ta chaze beshaata desalik moshe go anana yakkira al bene kaddishin paga beh chad malacha beshalhove nura beayenin melahatan vegadpoy mokdan baa leshaafa leh begaviyh vehahu malacha gavriel shemeh keden adkar moshe chad shema kaddisha dehava galif bitresar atvan veizdaza veitregash ad desalik moshe benayehu vechen lechal chad vechad zakkaa chulakeh veha okimna mile

Ervat ishsha uvittah lo tegalle tana betikkune matronita okimna illen eryan af al gav deinun beitgalya uvistima vetamman bat benah uvat bittah deha alma itzterich lon veinun yishshuva dealma kema deokimna uman degalle chad eryata minnayehu vay leh vay lenafsheh deha galle begin da eryan achoranin

Vetanya milla batraa deeser amiran deorayeta lo tachmod eshet reecha begin dehay kelala dechullehu uman dechamid itteta achora keillu abar al orayeta kulla beram la it milla dekayema kame teshuva vekkal shekken i kabbil onsheh kedavid malka amar ribbi yose tanenan kal man dechav veitperash mehahu chova teshuva ka mealleya leh tefe vei lav la salik bideh teshuva vela mealleya leh i hachi david hech la itperash mibbat sheva levatar amar leh bat sheva dideh havat vedideh natil deha mit balah

Detanya izdammenat havat bat sheva ledavid miyyoma deitbere alma uma akkeva leh denatal berateh deshaul malka vehahu yoma natal lah uriyya berachame af al gav dela havat dileh levatar ata david venatil dileh veal dedavid dachik shaata kame kudsha berich hu lekatla leuriyya ulmebad hachi avish kameh veanash leh ledavid deha kudsha berich hu baa leatava leh ledavid lekayema leh malchuta kaddisha illaa vechad taav ledideh taav

Tana amar ribbi yose may dichtiv ani Adonai ani Adonai atid liten sachar tov latzaddikim leatid lavo ani Adonai atid lehippara min harshaim leatid lavo inun dichtiv behu happoshim bi ketiv ani Adonai uchtiv ani amit vaachayye af al pi
1190: Sheani bemiddat harachamim harshaim hofchim oti lemiddat hadin detanya shem male Adonai elohim zachu Adonai vei lav elohim amar ribbi shimon chayyavin avde pegimuta leela may pegimuta kema deokimna pegimuta mammash veha ittemar

Tana ketiv veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav legallot ervatah tane ribbi yehuda dara deribbi shimon ben yochay share begavih kullehu zakkain chasidin kullehu dachale chattaa ninhu shechinta sharya benayehu ma delet ken bedarin achoranin begine kach milin inun mitparshan vela ittammeran bedarin achoranin lav hachi umillin deraze illaa la yachlin legallaa veinun deyade mistafu derabbi shimon kad hava amar raza dehay kera chavrayya kullehu enehon navin dimin vechulhu milin deamar hao beenayehu galyan kema dichtiv pe el pe adabber bo umare velo vechidot

Deoma chad shail ribbi yesa amar bea dekushta denafka meofa desharya benura veitbaka learba sitrin teren sallekin minnayehu vechad maich vechad revia birvia deyamma rabba amar ribbi abba avdat kammeh derabbi shimon kodesh chol deha ketiv pe el pe adabber bo amar leh rabbi shimon ad la yitbeka bea tistallak mealma vechach hava beiddara derabbi shimon
Tana beomoy derabbi shimon hava amar bar nash lechavreh petach picha veyairu devarecha batar deshachiv rabbi shimon hao amre al titten et picha lachati et besarecha

Tanya amar rabbi shimon i bene alma mistakkelan bema dichtiv beorayeta la yetun leargaza kame marehon tana kad mitarin dinin kashyan leachata bealma veel ishsha beniddat tumatah vego hacha ketiv sod Adonai lireav uvidara kaddisha ittemar hacha itzterichna legallaa deha laatar da istallak

Detanenan beshaata dechiveya takkifa dilela ittear begin chove alma share veitchabbar im nukba veatil bah zuhama itperash dechura minah begin deha isteavat veitkeriat misava vela itchaze lidchura lemikrav bahadah devay i isteav hu bahadah bezimna deihi isteavat

Vetana mea veesrin vachamesh zine mesaavuta nachtu lealma demitachadan missitra dechiveya takkifa veshiva veesrin ravrevin minnayehu mitachadan benukve veitdabbekan behu vay leman deyikrav bahadah behahu zimna deman deyikrav bahadah achze pegimuta leela deha bechova da ittear chiveya takkifa leela veashde zuhama baatar dela itzterich veitchabbar benukba veitrabbe saareh lidchura benukba isteavat vesaraha rabba vetufraha sagiu uchden dinin sharyan leitteara bealma veyistaavun kolla hada hu dichtiv ki et mikdash Adonai timme mikdash Adonai isteav bechovayehu divne nasha

Tana may dichtiv veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha arbaa veesrim zine mesaavuta attil chiveya benukba kad itchabbar immah kechushban veeva veesrin ved zinin mitarin leela veesrin vearba letatta vesaara rabba vetufrin segiu uchden dinin mitarin becholla vetana kad baat itteta leitdakkea baya lesappera hahu saara derabbe beoma deihi misava ulsappera tufraha vechal hahu zuhama di behon

Detana beraze dimsaavuta zuhama detufrin yittear zuhama achora uvgine kach bayan geniza uman deabar lon legamre keillu ittear chesed bealma detanya la live leh leinish lemehav duchrana lezinin bishin detanenan elaf vearba mea ve zinin bishin mitachadan behahu zuhama deatil chiveya takkifa vechullehu mitarin behahu zuhama detufrin
Vaafilu man devae yavid behu charshin livne nasha mishshum inun dettalyan behu uman deabar
1191: Lon keillu asge chesed bealma vedinin bishin la mishtakkechin veyyabar hahu zuhama vetufraha derashim beh detanya man dedarich beragleh o bimsaneh alayehu yachil leitzeka uma behay shiyyure deshiyyure dezuhama dilela kach itteta dimkabbela veitchabbarat bechiveya veatil bah zuhama al achat kamma vechamma vay lealma dimkabbela minah mehahu zuhama begine kach veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav

Amar ribbi shimon amar kudsha berich hu haviu alay kappara berosh chodesh alay vadday begin deyitabbar hahu chiveya veyitbasam man devaya alay kema dichtiv serafim omdim mimmaal lo veal da ketiv bekorach hannoadim al Adonai divginehon itar man deitar deate misitrayehu uf hacha haviu alay kafara alay mamash begin deyitbesam veyitavar vela ishtechach chiveya baatar deshare vekkal kach lamma al shemmiatti et hayyareach veshalta bah man dela itzterich uvgin kach ketiv veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav

Zakkaa dara derabbi shimon ben yochay share begavih zakkaa adveh ben illain vetattain aleh ketiv ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorin mahu ben chorin dezakif resha legallaa ulfarsha millin vela dachil kehay deihu ben chorin veyema may devaya vela dachil mahu malkech da hu ribbi shimon ben yochay mareh deorayeta mareh dechachmeta dechad hava ribbi abba vechavrayya chaman leribbi shimon hao rahate avatreh veamre achare Adonai yelchu kearye yishag

Amar ribbi shimon ketiv vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbato amay shakil da beda ella kolla bechad darga seliku da izdevag beda vechedvata deda beda la ishtechach ella kad itgele attika kaddisha uchden chedvata decholla vetanenan ketiv mizmor shir leom hashshabbat leom hashabbat mammash shevacha deka meshabbach kudsha berich hu keden chedavata ishtechach venishmeta ittosefet deha attika itgele veziuuga yizdaman

Uf hachi bechadtute sihara deha nahir lah shimsha bechedvata dinhiru deattika leela begine kach hay karbena hu leela begin deyitbesam kolla veyishtekkach chedvata bealma veal da haviu alay kappara dayeka milla

Tana ketiv olat shabbat beshabbato al olat hattamid devae lechavvena libba leela leela yattir mishshear yomin veal da al olat hattamid dayeka tanya ketiv bechanna vattitpallel al Adonai al dayeka begin divnin bemazzala kaddisha talyan kema deokimna velet lach milla beorayeta o at zeera beorayeta dela remiza bechachmeta illaa vetalyan minneh tile talin razin dechachmeta illaa hada hu dichtiv keutztzotav taltallim veha ittemar

Ribbi yose ashkacheh leribbi abba dehava yativ vekari hay kera dichtiv hashlech al Adonai yehavcha al dayeka deha mezone bemazzala talyan ribbi yehuda hava kare al zot yitpallel kal chasid elecha leet metzo al zot vadday leet metzo ha okimna aval leet metzo kema dichtiv dirshu Adonai behimatzo kerauhu bihoto karov davar acher leet metzo beshaata denaharin nagdin veitmashchan umistappeke avahan umitbarchan kola rak leshetef mam rabbim man shetef mam rabbim da amika demabbuin venaharin deman yizke leh uman yizke lekarva ulsalleka tamman hada hu dichtiv beh rak leshetef mayim rabbim elav lo yaggio deha la zakkaan vela yachlin

1192: Deate alayehu ketiv veyismechu chal chose vach leolam yerannenu vetasech alemo veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha uchtiv ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha uchtiv veyivtechu vecha yode shemecha ki lo azavta dorshecha Adonai baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen
1193: Roim illen inun madbere umanhige lebbar nash bagehinnam lo yadu sava kema deatte amer laaluka shette vanot hav hav begin kach deinun hav hav la yadu sava kullam ledarkam panu ish levitzo mikkatzehu deha tayyare degehinnam inun vechal da man garim lehu begin dela itkaddashu behahu ziuuga kema deitzterich veal da ketiv kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai amar kudsha berich hu mikkal shear ammin la rayati leadbeka bi ella yisrael dichtiv veattem haddevekim bayeya attun vela shear ammin begin kach

Kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai ribbi yitzchak patach hoy eretz tziltzal kenafayim vego vechi begin dehi eretz tziltzal kenafayim kintura beh ishtechach dichtiv hoy eretz ella amar ribbi yitzchak beshaata dekudsha berich hu bara alma uvaa legallaa amikta miggo mesatterata unhora miggo chashocha hao kelilan da beda uvgin kach miggo chashocha nafak nehora umiggo mesatterata nafak veitgalya amika veda nafka min da demiggo tav nafik bish umiggo rachame nafik dina vecholla itkelil da beda yetzer tov veyetzer ra yemina usmala yisrael ushar ammin chivar veucham vecholla chad bechad talya

Tana amar ribbi yitzchak amar ribbi yehuda kal alma kullehu la itchaze ella bechad atira dekutfa bekitroy kad itteddan alma bedina kalil berachame itteddan vei lav la yachil alma lekayema afilu riga chada veha okimna mille kema dichtiv ki kaasher mishpatecha laaretz tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel

Vetana behahu zimna dedina talya bealma vetzedek itattera bedinoy kama mare degadpin mitare lakovle mare dedina kashya leshalletaa bealma parsin gadpin mehay sitra umehay sitra leishtattecha bealma keden mitarin gadpin lemifras lon ulishtaava bedina kashya veshatin bealma leavasha keden ketiv hoy eretz tziltzal kenafayim amar ribbi yehuda chamina bene alma bechatzifuta bar inun zakkai keshot uvgin kach kivyachol kola hachi ishtachach ata leitdakkaa mesayein leh ata leistaava kema deokimna venitmetem bam

Ribbi yose hava azil beorcha paga beh ribbi chiyya amar leh hay deukmuha chavrayya dichtiv beeli velachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper aon bet eli bezevach umincha ad olam bezevach umincha eno mitkapper aval mitkapper hu bedivre tora amay begin dedivre tora sallekin al kal karbenin dealma kema deukmuha dichtiv zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim shakil orayeta lakovel kal karbenin dealma amar leh hachi hu vadday dechal man deishtedal beorayeta af al gav deitgezar aleh onsha milela nicha leh mikkal karbenin veillavan vehahu onsha itkera

Vetta chaze la itdache bar nash lealmin ella bemillin deorayeta begine kach millin deorayeta la mekabbelin tuma begin deihi kayema ledakkea leillen misave veasuta beorayeta ishtechach dichtiv rifut tehi lesharecha veshikkuy leatzmotecha vedachuta ishtechach beorayeta dichtiv yirat Adonai tehora omedet laad may omedet laad dekayema tedira behahu dachuta vela itade minneh lealmin

1194: Man deishteddal bah itdache ulvatar itkaddash dichtiv kedoshim tihu kedoshim heu la ketiv ella tihu tihu vadday amar leh hachi hu umikra ketiv veattem tihu li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh uchtiv elle haddevarim vego

Tana kedushsha deorayeta kedushsha dislikat al kal kiddushin ukdushsha dechachmeta illaa setima salleka al kolla amar leh lav orayeta bela chachmeta velav chachmeta bela orayeta vecholla bechad darga hu vecholla chad ella orayeta bechachma illaa ishtechachat uva kayema uva itnetau sharshaha mikkal sitrin

Ad dahao azle ashkachu chad bar nash bilkinta dekusta rachiv al susya ashmit yedoy lechad anpa deilana amar ribbi yose hay hu dichtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim adam mekaddesh atzmo millematta mekaddeshin oto millemala hada hu dichtiv kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai

Tane ribbi abba parshetta da kelala deorayeta hi vechotama dekushta degushpanka hi befarshetta da itchaddashu razin illain deorayeta beeser amiran vegizrin veonashin ufikkudin illain dechad matan chavrayya lefarshetta da hao chaddan

Amar ribbi abba may tama parshetta daaraot ufarshetta dikdoshim tihu semuchin da leda ella hachi tana kal man deistamar meillen eryan bikdushsha itavid vadday vekkal shekken i itkaddash bikdushsha demareh veha attearu chavrayya

Ematay onatan decholla leitkaddash bar nash ta chaze man devae leitkaddesha biruta demareh la lishammesh ella mippalgut lelya veelach o befalgut lelya deha behahi shaata kudsha berich hu ishtechach beginta deeden ukdushsha illaa ittear uchden shaata hi leitkaddesha hay lishar bene nasha talmide chachamim deyadin orchoy deorayeta befalgut lelya shaata dilhon lemekam lemile beorayeta leizdavvega bikkeneset yisrael leshabbecha lishma kaddisha lemalka kaddisha

Belelya deshabbeta diruta decholla ishtechach ziuuga dilhon behahi shaata leappaka reuta dekudsha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael kema deittemar dichtiv banim attem layeya elohechem veillen ikrun kaddishin dichtiv kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai uchtiv vehaya keetz shatul al palge mayim asher piro yitten beitto vego

Kedoshim tihu ribbi abba patach umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz ta chaze bechal ammin dealma la itree behu kudsha berich hu bar beyisrael bilchodayehu veavid lon amma yechidaa bealma vekara lon goy echad kishmeh veatar lon bechamma itrin vechamma pikudin leitattera behu veal da tefilin deresha utfilin didroa leitattera behu bar nash kegavena dilela ulishtakkecha chad shelim becholla

Uvhahi shaata deitattar behu bar nash veitkaddash behu itavid shelim veikre echad deechad la ikre ella kad ihu shelim uman defagim la ikre echad veal da kudsha berich hu ikre echad bishlimu dechola bishlimu daavahan bishlimu dichneset yisrael begin kach yisrael letatta ikrun echad dechad bar nash anach tefilin veitchappe bechissuya demitzva keden itattar beitrin kaddishin kegavena deleela veikre echad

Uvgine kach lete echad veyishtedal beechad kudsha berich hu deihu echad yishtedal beechad deha let malka mishtaddal ella bemay deitchaze leh uvgin kach ketiv vehu veechad umi yeshivennu la share kudsha berich hu vela ishtechach ella beechad beechad echad mibbae leh ella beman deittekan bikdushsha illaa lemehevi chad keden hu sharya beechad vela baatar achora
Veematay ikre bar nash echad beshaata deishtechach dechar venukba veitkaddash bikdushsha illaa veitkevan leitkaddesha vetta chaze bezimna
1195: Deishtechach bar nash beziuuga chad dechar venukba veitkavin leitkaddesha kedeka yeot keden hu shelim veikre echad bela pegimu

Begine kach bae bar nash lemechde leitteteh behahi shaata lezammena lah biruta chada immeh veyitkavvenun tarvayehu kechad lehahi milla vechad mishtakkeche tarvayehu kechad keden kolla chad benafsha uvgufa benafsha leadbeka da beda biruta chada uvgufa kema deolifna devar nash dela nasiv hu keman deitpelig vechad mitchabberan dechar venukba keden itavidu chad gufa ishtechach deinhu chad nafsha vechad gufa veikre bar nash echad keden kudsha berich hu share beechad veafkid rucha dikdushsha behahu echad

Veillen ikrun benin dekudsha berich hu kema deittemar uvgine kach kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai zakkain inun yisrael dela okim milla da baatar achora ella beh mammash dichtiv ki kadosh ani Adonai begin leitdabbeka beh vela beachora veal da kedoshim tihu ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem
Ish immo veaviv tirau vego ha tanenan defarshetta da kelala deorayeta makkish dechilu deabba veima leshabbetotay ella amar ribbi yose kolla chad man dedachil mehay natir lehay
Ish immo akdim immo leaviv bidchilu may tama kema deukmuha aval ima delet reshu bidaha kal kach keaviv Adonai akdim dechilu dilah
Ribbi yitzchak amar ma ketiv leela kedoshim tihu ate bar nash leitkaddesha beitteteh kechad mimman hu shevacha yattir behahi kedushsha havi ema minukba begin kach ish immo veaviv tirau

Ribbi yehuda amar ish immo veaviv tirau kehay gavena beom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim uvaatar achora akdim shamayim laaretz ella leachazaa detarvayehu kachada itavidu uf hacha akdim ima leabba uvaatar achora akdim abba leima leachazaa detarvayehu kachada ishtadalu beh

Veet shabbetotay tishmoru shakil da leda vecholla kachada ittekalu bematkela chad dichtiv ushmartem et hashabbat ki kodesh hi lachem uchtiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho ella chad leabba vechad leima ketiv hacha ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru uchtiv hatam et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau mahu mikdashi

Raya mehemna ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru pikkuda da shakil da leda shakil yekara deav veem likara deshabbat leabba akdim kavod vehay ihu deamar kera veim av ani ayye chevodi veim adonim ani ayyi morai kevodi salik bechushban eser amiran elohim deovada divreshit

Uvchal atar kavod chachamim yinchalu veukmuha rabbanan en kavod ella tora begin deinun lev elohim detora yekara dileh veillen chachamim deorayeta chachamim bechachma yartin hay kavod vela tippeshe dealayehu ittemar uchsilim merim kalon umnalan deman dela yada beorayeta ikre kesil dichtiv uchsil lo yavin et zot veen zot ella tora dichtiv vezot hattora asher sam moshe

Raya mehemana begin dachalishata patachna lefarshetta beillen pikudin lemehevi meat ezer lach ittakkaf bach deha mashshiryan dimtivtan atan legabbach befikkuda batar da deihu pikkuda lehaamid alecha melech leela vekudsha berich hu yokim lach melech beillain vetattain bediukneh begin derabbanan dimtivta alayehu shechinta illaa vetattaa vekudsha berich hu melech beemtzaita achid beillain vetattain hachi ante tehe bediukneh bera dileh kum bikara demalka
Kam raya mehemana vesalik yedoy leela veamar yehe raava dilach illat haillot deante mitalle meilluy leilluy ad delet illuy ella

Veal da bechullehu ketiv elohim vayyavo elohim el bilam vayyavo elohim el lavan vayyavo elohim el avimelech hu ata legabbayehu velav inun legabbeh deha let lehu atar zammin vei tema ha ketiv elohim ella shema da ishtettaf becholla vaafilu avoda zara name elohim ikre elohim acherim uvichlala deelohim acherim illen memanan uvichlala da hao uvgin kach ikre hache vehahu rasha hava amar becharshoy vekare leh veate legabbeh uvgin kach ketiv linu fo hallayela vahashivoti etchem davar kaasher yedabber Adonai elay hahu rasha ka meshabbach garmeh deha la ketiv beh ella vayyavo elohim

Davar acher kaasher yedabber Adonai elay al yede dehahu shelicha desitra achora vei tema ha bimama ishtechach legabbeh ella vadday benachash istakkeluta hava beh uvhahu zimna hava mistakkel lechavvena shaata hada hu dichtiv velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim vayyar bilam ki tov beene Adonai levarech et yisrael ella dehahu yoma istakkal lechavvena shaata vela ishtekkach kishar yome uchden chama deha rugza rabba la ishtekkach bealma keden yada ki tov beene Adonai levarech et yisrael behahu zimna shavik garmeh mikkal nechashim dealma vela istekkal behu hada hu dichtiv velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim

Ta chaze behahi shaata derittecha ishtechach keden semala ittear vahava yada hahu rasha atar leachada besitra semala lemelat veistakkal behahu zimna vela ishtechach keden ma ketiv ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zaam Adonai uvgin kach ammi zechar na ma yaatz balak vego ume ana oto bilam ben beor zakkain inun yisrael zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvalma deate

Im bechukkotay telechu im bechukkotay da atar digzirin deorayeta talyan behahu atar kema deatte amer et chukkotay tishmoru chok hu deikre hachi ugzirin deorayeta bah itkelilan veet mishpatay tishmeru mishpatay da hu atar achora illaa dehahi chukka achidat beh umitchabberan da beda deilae vetattae vechal pikkude orayeta vechal gizre orayeta vechal kiddushe orayeta behane achidan begin dehay tora shebbichtav vehay tora shebbeal pe

Veal da im bechukkotay kal inun gezirin vedinin veonashin ufikkudin deinun behahu atar deikre tora shebbeal pe chukka veet mishpatay tishmoru behahu atar deikre tora shebbichtav kema deatte amer mishpat lelohe yaakov veda achid beda veda beda vecholla chad veda hu kelala dishma kaddisha uman deabar al pitgame orayeta keillu pagim shema kaddisha begin dechok umishpat shema dekudsha berich hu havi veal da im bechukkotay telechu da tora shebbeal pe veet mishpatay tishmeru da tora shebbichtav veda hu kelala dishma kaddisha

Vaasitem otam may vaasitem otam kevan deamar telechu vetishmeru amay vaasitem ella man deavid pikkude orayeta veazil beorchoy kivyachol keillu avid leh leela amar kudsha berich hu keillu asaani veokmuha veal da vaasitem otam vaasitem attem ketiv vadday vehoil umitare alayechu leitchabbera da beda leishtakkecha shema kaddisha kedeka yeot vaasitem attem vadday

Kegavena da amar ribbi shimon vayyaas david shem vechi david avad leh ella begin deazil bearche deorayeta veavid pikkude orayeta veanhig malchuta kedeka yeot kivyachol asa shem leela vela hava malka bealma dezacha
1259: Lehay kedavid dehava kam befalgut lelya vahava meshabbach leh lekudsha berich hu ad desalik shema kaddisha bechurseyya beshaata desalik nehora dimama kivyachol hu avad shem mammash kema deatte amer vayyikkov ben haishsha hayyisreelit et hashshem vayekallel uvgin kach vayyaas david shem veal da vaasitem otam ketiv vei attun tishtaddelun lemebad lon leittakna shema kaddisha kedeka yaut kal inun birchan dilela yishtakkechun gabbayechu betikkunehon kedeka yeot

Venatatti gishmechem beittam vego kal chad vechad yitten chela dileh alayechu man inun hahu tikkuna daavadtun dehahu shema kaddisha kegavena da ketiv veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka umishpat vechi kevan dichtiv veshamru derech Adonai amay laasot tzedaka umishpat ella man denatir orchoy deorayeta kivyachol hu ose tzedaka umishpat umay tzedaka umishpat da kudsha berich hu bacha rabbi shimon veamar vay lon livne nasha dela yadin vela mashgichin bikara demarehon man avid shema kaddisha bechal yoma havi ema man deyahiv tzedaka lemiskene

Ta chaze ha ukmuha hachi hu demiskena achid beh bedina vechal mechlayehu bedina hu atar deikre tzedek kema deatte amer tefilla leani chi yaatof tefilla da tefilla shel yad veokimna uman deyahiv leh tzedaka lemiskena hu avid leela shema kaddisha shelim kedeka yaut begin ditzdaka da ilana dechayye utzdaka yahiv letzedek vechad yahiv letzedek keden itchabbar da beda ushma kaddisha ishtechach shelim man avid da ittearuta diltatta vadday keillu avid shema kaddisha bishlimu kegavena deihu avid lettatta hachi ittear leela veal da ketiv ashre shomre mishpat ose tzedaka bechal et ose tzedaka da kudsha berich hu kivyachol hu avid leh
Ta chaze miskena ha ittemar man hu atreh may tama begin demiskena la it leh midileh kelum ella ma deyahavin leh vesihara la it lah nehora midilah ella ma deyahiv lah shimsha

Ta chaze amay ani chashuv kammet may tama begin dehahu atar garim leh deha baatar demota hu shechiach uvgin kach ikre met hahu dechayis aleh hu yahiv leh tzedaka ilana dechayye sharya aloy kema deatte amer utzdaka tatztzil mimmavet uchgavena deavid bar nash letatta hachi name avid leela mammash zakkaa chulakeh dezache lemebad shema kaddisha leela begin kach tzedaka salik al kolla

Vehane mile tzedaka lishmah deha ittear tzedaka letzedek lechabbera lon kachada ulmehevi kolla shema kaddisha kedeka yaut deha tzedek la ittakkan vela ishtelim ella bitzdaka dichtiv bitzdaka tikkonani velichneset yisrael ittemar uvgin kach vaasitem otam vego

Venatatti shalom baaretz ushchavtem veen macharid vego ribbi yose patach rigzu veal techetau vego rigzu veal techotau hay kera ukmuha devae bar nash leargaza yetzer tov al yetzer hara veshappir aval beshaata deramash lelya uvar nash shachiv al arseh kama gardine nimusin mitarin bealma veazlin veshatin uvne nasha baan leitraggeza mikkame kudsha berich hu uldachala minneh begin dela yishtekkach nafsheh beggavayehu veyishteziv minnayehu veyive leh lebbar nash dela yappik minnayehu milla befumeh begin dela yittear lehu legabbeh vela yishtakkechun bahaddeh hada hu dichtiv imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem vedommu sela dela yappik minnayehu milla mippumeh

Ta chaze beshaata deishtechachu yisrael zakkain kamme kudsha berich hu ma ketiv venatatti shalom baaretz hay leela deate kudsha berich hu leitchabbera bichneset yisrael keden ushchavtem veen macharid may tama begin vehishbatti chayya raa min haaretz
1260: Da chayya dezina bisha letatta umay ihi agrat bat machalat hi vechal siata dilah hay belelya bimama bene nasha deatu missitraha da hada hu dichtiv vecherev lo taavor beartzechem

Ribbi abba amar ha ukmuha deafilu cherev shel shalom kegon paro necho aval vecherev lo taavor da siata dilah vehishbatti chayya raa dela tishlot beara vaafilu haavara bealma lo taavor alayechu vaafilu cherev dishar ammin vaafilu bar nash mizyana la yaavor alayechu

Veda darish yoshiyyahu malka veokmuha dehu atpas bechovayehu deyisrael kema dichtiv ruach appenu meshiach Adonai nilkad bishchitotam vego hacha it leistakkela deha tanenan i resha deamma hu tav kal amma mishtezvan begineh vei resha deamma la itkeshar kal amma ittafsan bechoveh veha yoshiyyahu resha dechashra hava veovadoy mitkashsheran amay itpas bechovehon deyisrael

Ella al dela hayemin beh beyirmiyahu vela kafit lehu leyisrael dechashiv dechullehu zakkain kevateh vahava amar leh yirmiyya vela hayemin beh uvgin kach itpas bechovehon veod desihara hava maich nehora uvaya leastema

Venatatti mishkani betochchem vego venatatti mishkani da shechinta mishkani mashkona dili dehi itmashkena bechovayehu deyisrael venatatti mishkani mashkoni vadday metal lebbar nash dehava rechima leachora amar leh vday birchimuta illaa deit li gabbach baena ledayera immach amar hech enda detedur gabbay natal kal kissufa deveteh veayete legabbeh amar ha mashkona legabbach dela itperash minach lealmin

Kach kudsha berich hu baa ledayera behu beyisrael ma avad natal kissufa dileh venachit lehu leyisrael amar lon yisrael ha mashkona dili gabbayechu begin dela itperash minnayechu lealmin veaf al gav dekudsha berich hu itrechik minan mashkona shavik bidan vaanan natrin hahu kissufa dileh man deyive mashkoneh yete ledayera gabban begin kach venatatti mishkani betochchem mashkona etten bidayechu begin deeddur immechon veaf al gav deyisrael hashta begaluta mashkona dekudsha berich hu hu gabbayehu vela shavku leh lealmin

Velo tigal nafshi etchem lebbar nash derachim lechavreh uvaa ledayera immeh ma avad natal arsa dileh veayeti leveteh amar da arsa dili bevetach begin dela archik minach arsach umanach kach kudsha berich hu amar venatatti mishkani betochchem velo tigal nafshi etchem ha arsa dili bevetayechu kevan dearsa dili immechon tindeun dela itperash minnayechu uvgin kach velo tigal nafshi etchem

Vehithallachti betochchem vehayiti lachem lelohim kevan demashkena dili gabbayechu bevadday tindeun daana azil immechon kema deatte amer ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha lehatztzilcha velatet oyevecha lefanecha vehaya machanecha kadosh

Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda hao shechiche lelya chad bichfar kariv leyamma ditverya kamu befalgut lelya amar ribbi yitzchak leribbi yehuda nema bemille deorayeta deaf al gav daanan baatar da la baena leitparsha meilana dechayye

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane vego umoshe yikkach et haohel amay ella amar moshe hoil veyisrael ka meshakkere beh bekudsha berich hu veachlifu yekara dileh ha mashkona dileh yehe bida dimhemana ad denecheme beman yishtear
Amar leh liyehoshua ante tehe mehemna ben kudsha berich hu uven yisrael veyishtear mashkona bidach behemnuta venechome
1261: Beman yishtear ma ketiv veshav el hammachane umsharato yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel may taama liyehoshua begin deihu kesihara legabbe shimsha veihu itchaze lenatra mashkona veal da lo yamish mittoch haohel

Amar leh kudsha berich hu lemoshe moshe la itchaze hachi deha mashkona dili yahavit bidayehu af al gav deinun chavu legabbay mashkona yehe legabbayehu dela yitparshun minneh tive deitperash minnayehu deyisrael vela etuv legabbayehu lealmin ella ativ mashkona dili legabbayehu uvgineh la eshbok lehon bechal atar

Af al gav deyisrael chavu legabbeh dekudsha berich hu hay mashkona dileh la shavku vekudsha berich hu la natil leh mibbenayehu veal da bechal atar degalle yisrael shechina immehon veal da ketiv venatatti mishkani betochchem veha ukmuha

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar dome dodi litzvi o leofer haayyalim hinne ze vego zakkain inun yisrael dezachu demashkona da lemehevi gabbayehu min malka illaa deaf al gav deinun begaluta kudsha berich hu ate bechal resh yarche veshabbatte uzmane leashgecha alayehu ulistakkela behahu mashkona deit leh gabbayehu deihu kissufa dileh

Lemalka desarcha matronita afkah mehechaleh ma avdat natlat berah dileh kissufa demalka rechima dileh uvgin dedata demalka alah shavkeh bidaha beshaata desalik reuta demalka al matronita veal bereh hava salik agrin venachit dargin vesalik kotalin leistakkela ulashgacha ben nukve kotala alayehu kevan dechame lon share bache meachore kuste kotala ulvatar azil leh

Kach yisrael af al gav deinun nafku mehechaleh demalka hahu mashkona la shavku uvgin diruta demalka alayehu shavkeh immehon beshaata desalik reuta demalka kaddisha al matronita veal yisrael salik agrin nachit dargin vesalik kotalin leistakkela ulashgacha ben kuste kotala alayehu kevan dechame lon share uvache hada hu dichtiv dome dodi litzvi o leofer haayyalim ledallega mikkotala leigra umeigra lechotala hinne ze omed achar katlenu bevatte kenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot mashgiach min hachallonot metzitz min hacharakkim leistakkela ulashgacha alayehu uvgin kach yisrael bau lemechde behahu yoma deinhu yade da veamre ze hayyom asa Adonai nagila venismecha bo

Veim bechukkotay timasu veggo ribbi yose patach musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto kama chavivin yisrael kamme kudsha berich hu dekudsha berich hu bae leochacha lehu uldabbera lehu beorach meshar keabba derachim livreh umiggo rechimu dileh legabbeh sharvita bideh tadir ledabbera leh beorach meshar dela yiste limina velismala hada hu dichtiv ki et asher yeehav Adonai yochiach uchav et ben yirtze uman dela rachim leh kudsha berich hu vesane leh salik minneh tochacha salik minneh sharvita

Ketiv ahavti etchem amar Adonai vego miggo rechimuta dileh sharvita bideh tadir ledabbera leh veet esav saneti begin kach selikit minneh sharvita selikat minneh tochachta begin dela etten leh bi chulaka rechika denafshay hu aval attun ahavti etchem vadday uvgin kach musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto may veal takotz la tekutzun beh keman dearak miggo guvin deinun milin kegovin legabbeh begarmeh

Ta chaze beshaata deittear tzedek bedinoy kama sitre tehirin mitarin mimina umissemala kama sharvitin nafkin minnehon sharvite eshsha sharvite gumrin sharvite shalhova kullehu nafkin umitarin bealma velakan livne nasha techotayehu memanan achoranin mare tafsin memanan dearbein chaser chad shatin venachtin lakan vesallekin venatlin reshuta ayelin
1262: Benukba dithoma rabba metzavin tafse venora dedalik itchabbar behu nafke gumrin veshatin venachtin veishtechachu lakovlehon divne nasha vehayenu dichtiv veyasafti leyassera etchem etten lemarehon dedina tosefet al dina dilhon

Kema deatte amer lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam may lo osif lo etten tosefet lemare dina leshetzaa alma ella tosefet kegavena deyachil alma lemisbal veal da veyasafti etten tosefet vadday

Tosefet amay begin leyassera etchem sheva al chattotechem sheva veha kudsha berich hu i gave hahu dilah la yachil alma lemisbal afilu riga chada hada hu dichtiv im aonot tishmor yah Adonai mi yaamod veatte amarte sheva al chattotechem

Ella ma talmud lomar sheva ella ha sheva lakovlayechu umay ihi da shemita deihi sheva deikre sheva kema deatte amer mikketz sheva shanim taase shemita veal da sheva al chattotechem veikre sheva veikre bat sheva ma ben hay lehay ella sheva bilchodaha lemebad shemitta ulmebad dinin leappaka cheru decholla ba bat sheva ikre deitchabbar beachra kachada leanhara lemishlat bemalchuta leodaa malchuta beara uvcholla bat sheva ikre ketiv al ken shem hair beer sheva ad hayyom hazze beer sheva beera deyitzchak hu vecholla chad milla hu
Ribbi abba amar veyissarti etchem af ani sheva al chattotechem veyissarti etchem al yeda dimmanan achoranin kema deukmuha af ani ha ana ittear lakovlayechu ha sheva leitteara alayechu

Ta chaze rechimuta illaa dekudsha berich hu beyisrael lemalka dehava leh bar yechiday vahava chate kamme malka yoma chad sarach kamme malka amar malka kal hane yomin alkena lach vela kabbilte mikkan veelach chame may abid lach i attarich lach min ara veappik lach mimmalchuta dilma yekumun alach dubbe chakla o zeeve chakla o listin veyaavrun lach mealma ma abid ella ana veante nefuk meara

Kach af ani ana veante nifuk meara kach amar kudsha berich hu yisrael ma abid lechu ha alkena lechu vela arkitu udnayechu ha ayetena alayechu mare terisin mare tafsin lealkaa lechon vela shematun i appik lechu meara lechodchon dachilna alayechu mikkamma dubbin mikkamma zeevin dikumun alayechu veyaavrun lechu mealma aval ma abid lechun ella ana veattun nefuk meara unhach begaluta hada hu dichtiv veyissarti etchem lemehach begaluta vei temrun deeshbok lechon af ani immechon sheva al chattotechem da sheva deyittarach immechon vaamay al chattotechem hada hu dichtiv uvfishechem shullecha immechem amar kudsha berich hu attun geramtun daana veattun la nedur bealma ha matronita nafkat mehechala immechon ha itcharev kolla hechala dili vedilchon itcharav deha lemalka la itchaze hechala ella kad ihu ayel im matronita vechedva demalka la ishtechach

Ella beshaata deal behechala dematronita veishtechach beraha immah behechala chaddan kullehu kachada hashta dela ishtechachu bera umatronita ha hechala chareva mikkolla ella ana ma abid af ana immechon vehashta af al gav deyisrael inhu begaluta kudsha berich hu ishtechach immehon vela shavik lon dechad yifkun yisrael min galuta kudsha berich hu yetuv immehon dichtiv veshav Adonai elohecha veshav Adonai elohecha vadday veha ittemar

Ribbi chiyya veribbi yose hao azle bearcha arau behahi mearta bechakla amar ribbi chiyya leribbi yose hay dichtiv elle divre habberit vego millevad habberit may divre habberit divre gevura mibbae leh amar leh ha ukmuha hallalu mippi haggevura vehallalu mippi atzmo shel moshe veha ittemar
Ta chaze illen veillen divre habberit hao
1263: Deaf al gav demippi haggevura hao millin mile berit hao deha tav uvish beh talyan tav deate mitzaddik bish deate min dina dina meatar dedina vehayenu tzedek vetzaddik vetzedek berit inun berit ikrun veal da millin illen mile berit inun vekashir berit kachada uvgine kach zachor veshamor kashir kachada zachor beom shamor ballayela ha berit kachada uvgin kach berit vadday divre habberit ninhu uvchal atar berit baatar da ihu

Amar ribbi chiyya vadday hachi hu uvgin kach shabbat deihu zachor veshamor ikre berit dichtiv veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam vecholla milla chad vaatar da ikre berit bechal atar
Ta chaze ketiv venatatti shalom baaretz hu yesod deihu shelama deara shelama deveta shelama dealma veyissarti etchem af ani sheva may da tzedek ha vadday berit uvgin kach divre habberit ninhu

Amar ribbi yose ketiv veaf gam zot bihotam beeretz oyevehem vego veaf gam zot veaf kema deatte amer af ani gam lerabbot keneset yisrael deikre zot dela shavkat lon lealmin bihotam beeretz oyevehem bihotam kolla kachada lo meastim velo gealtim begin dela itchabbar behu lehafer beriti ittam dei la efrok lehu ha beriti palig uvgin kach lehafer beriti ittam

Amar ribbi chiyya ana shemana milla chadta deamar ribbi elazar lo meastim velo gealtim lechallotam la hikkitim vela haragtim lechallotam mibbae leh ella la meastim vela gealtim man desane leachora mais hu lakovleh vegaala hu begiula kammeh aval hacha la meastim vela gealtim may tama begin dachavivuta denafshay benayehu uvginah kullehu chavivin gabbay hada hu dichtiv lechallotam lechallotam ketiv chaser vav beginah la meastim vela gealtim begin deihi rechimata denafshay rechimuta dili gabbaha
Lebbar nash derachim itteta vahavat dayera beshuka devursake i la havat hi tamman la ayel bah lealmin kevan dehi tamman dame beenoy keshuka derochle dechal rechin dealmin tavin ishtechachu tamman

Uf hacha veaf gam zot bihotam beeretz oyevehem deihu shuka devursake lo meastim velo gealtim vaamay lechallotam begin kallatam daana rechimna lah deihi rechimata denafshay desharya tamman vedami alay kechal rechin tavan dealma begin hahi kalla divgavayehu amar ribbi yose illu la atena hacha ella lemishma milla da day

Patach veamar ben yechabbed av veeved adonav ben yechabbed av kema deatte amer kabbed et avicha veet immecha veokmuha bemechla umishteya uvcholla hay bechayyoy deitchayyav beh batar demit i tema ha patur minneh hu lav hache deaf al gav demit itchayyav bikareh yattir dichtiv kabbed et avicha dei hahu bera azil beorach tekala vadday mevazze laavuy hu vadday avid leh kelana vei hahu bera azil beorach meshar vetakin ovadoy vadday da okir laavuy okir leh behay alma gabbe bene nasha okir leh behahu alma gabbe kudsha berich hu vekudsha berich hu chayis aleh veotiv leh bechurseya dikareh vadday ben yechabbed av

Kegon ribbi elazar deihu okir leh laavuy behay alma uvhahu alma hashta asge shevacha derabbi shimon bitren almin behay alma uvhahu alma yattir mechayyoy dezacha livnin kaddishin ulgizin kaddishin zakkain inun tzaddikayya dezakkan livnin kaddishin legizin kaddishin alayehu itkere kal roehem yakkirum ki hem zera berach Adonai amen baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen
1264: Vayedabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed vego ribbi abba patach vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vego hay kera ittemar ta chaze beshaata devara kudsha berich hu leadam aved leh bediyyukna deillae vetattae vahava kalil mikkolla vahava nehoreh nahir missayefe alma ad sayefe alma vahau dachalin kammeh kolla

1272: Yahivna lach befikdona hashta dekashirna yichuda veavedna ovada umillula kedeka yeot veodena al chataay ha nafshi masirna lach vadday

1274: Beorchoy deorayeta mashich aleh rucha kaddisha illaa kema deatte amer ad yeare alenu ruach mimmarom vechad bar nash sate orchoy mashich aleh rucha achara missitra achara dehu sitra demisava vesitra demisava ittear missitra denukba dithoma rabba detamman madorin deruchin bishin denazke livne nasha deikrun nazke alma deha missitra dekayin kadmaa ishtechachu

Vechal man deavar al pikkude orayeta kivyachol pagim leela pagim letatta pagim legarmeh pagim lechal almin metal leinun mafreshe yamin deshate bearba kam chad shatya benayehu baa lenakva vechu

Hada hu dichtiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha ad yedod vadday

Uvgin deihi al resheh debbar nash asir leh lebbar nash lemezal ammot begiluy deresha deem hi istalakat meal resheh debbar nash miyyad istelaku chayyim minneh

Vei tema dechach sharya al umin dealma af al gav dela itbere behon shemaya veara vechal toladin divhon la sharya vadday demoshe baa mikudsha berich hu dela tishre shechina al umin dealma veyahiv leh havla dekayema al umin dealma mean nafka o al chayyavayya deinun erev rav meuravin im yisrael ella vadday let kal appaya shavin afilu yisrael lav inun shaveyan kal shekken acharanin
Ella vadday al hay diyyukna deat Adonai ukmuha mattana tova yish li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah vechad hay sharya al yisrael let lon yegia vela shibud uva nefesh amela vigea shavat vayyinnafash

Vetta chaze beovadin debbar nash ishtemoda partzufa deihi aleh ufartzufa deanpoy hada hu dichtiv hakkarat penehem anta bam bediyyukna ishtemoda partzufa dechayya desharya aleh im hu aryi o shor o nesher o adam mehammerkava dekudsha berich hu ushchinteh o mehammerkava demalach sar happanim o mehammerkava bisha desamael o mehammerkava dearba yesodin dealma velet behon la hayitztzer tov vela hayitztzer hara ella kivirin dealma uvgin da kama havalim it bivne nasha kal chad lemineh veraza demilla totztze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah uvgin da bemmidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo uvchal partzufa it memana aleh

Ta chazi leshit yome bereshit lechal chad it leh partzufeh dehahu darga deanhig leh vela tishkach yom delet beh tov veaf al gav divoma tinyana la it beh tov beoma telitaa tishkach leh uvgin da ittemar beh tere zimne tov

Uvgin da man deihu chayava veyiul leminda razin deorayeta kama malache chabbala deitkeriu choshech vaafela nechashim veakrabbim chevat bara itkeriu umvalbelin machashavteh dela yiul laatar delav dileh

Aval man deihu tov kal illen netirin inun lememreh vekategor neesa sanegor veyialun letov haganuz veyemrun leh marana ha bar nash tov vetztzaddik yere shamayim bae leaala kodamach amar lanu pitchu li shaare tzedek avo vam ode yah hahu tov haganuz yima lon pitchu leh behay tara deitkere ahava o behay tara deihi teshuva kal tzaddik yiul kefum darga dileh veraza demilla pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik vego

Orka dechal saara denachit mikkamme udnoy la havi aricha vela itdevak da beda vela nachtin illen saarin mikkad nagdin itmashshechan vetalyan

Alma tinyana denafik mehay tikkuna shallit venafik venachit vesalik leshiva vechamshin elef dargin mare divava umitachadan minneh leachpeya bekudla bechivara
Alma telitaa denafik mehay tikkuna shallit venachit vesalik alfin mare dilala umitachadan minneh umehay tikkuna mitkafyan kullehu umitbasseman bimrira dedimin demitbassemin beyamma rabba

1303: Ditlesar illen mishtakkechin zehirin illen diltatta vecholla bechushbana deillen telesar ishtechach dikna demalka attika yakkira mikkolla kolla bechad ihu temira veyakkira

Kum ribbi chizkiyya vekaim bekiyyumach veokir yekara detikkuna da dedikna kaddisha kam ribbi chizkiyya share veamar ani ledodi vealay teshukato mi garam sheani ledodi mishshum dealay teshukato

Ana shail mehem pishra dechamet patchu veamru nose aon chameta amar da hu tikkuna tinyana yativ amar ribbi shimon haidana itkashshar alma berich ante ribbi chizkiyya leattika deattikin

Zakkaa chulakeh deman dezache lehay veda hu tikkuna telitaa dedikna yakkira kaddisha illaa attika deattike amar rabbi shimon vadday kudsha berich hu yasge leotava lach veyechde leaggana alach

Tarchuta bemay ka mayere dina baatar dina tarchuta ishtechach vechi sare dedikna tircha inun o dina inun veha kolla rachame itchazun ella dela itterach beyishshuva derucha dizer appin
